魂能形成一个沉重的，焦糖棕色的甲壳覆盖你的背部。短刺从这个壳中突出，光芒从其表面闪烁。尽管它没有实际的保护价值（除非你将其绑定到你的心脉轮），这个甲壳让你充满泰拉斯奎的毁灭之力。

当你的恐惧甲壳被塑造时，当你使用啮咬攻击时，你在伤害检定上获得 +2 加值，或者当你使用爪击或其他天生攻击时获得 +1 加值。作为交换，你在使用天生武器的攻击检定上受到 -1 减值。

魂髓：你投入恐惧甲壳的每点魂髓使你的攻击减值增加 1，伤害加值增加 2（对于啮咬攻击） 或 1（对于其他天生武器）. 

脉轮绑定（臂） 

虽然你的恐惧甲壳外观不变，你的上臂显现出鳞片状甲板，同时尖刺从你的肘部冒出。与此同时，你拥有的任何天生武器变得更加致命-更锋利，更长，更能切开皮肤和盔甲以撕裂脆弱的血肉。

你拥有的任何天生攻击（无论是天生的还是由于另一个灵魂融合） 的威胁范围加倍。

脉轮绑定（足）

虽然你的恐惧甲壳外观不变，你的腿变得越发肌肉发达，其形状略微改变，使你更自然地仅用脚趾和脚掌前部移动。

每分钟一次，你可以为你的速度添加 +60 尺的增强加值，持续 1 轮。

脉轮绑定（心） 

你的恐惧甲壳呈现出高度反光的光泽，暗示泰拉斯奎将法咒反射回施法者的能力。法咒很难穿过你的甲壳影响你。

你获得等于 5 + 每点投入恐惧甲壳的魂髓 4 的法术抗力。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

两只强大的角从你的头部突出。尽管它们在战斗中无用，但它们改变了你的外观，使你的面容相当可怕。当你冲锋时，你的面容暗示着某种完全非人的东西，将恐惧刺入你敌人的心中。

当你冲锋时，所有 60 尺内能看到你的敌人变得战栗 1 轮（意志无效）.
src:
Dread Carapace

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Arms, feet, heart (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms into a heavy, caramel-brown carapace covering your back. Short spines protrude from this shell, and light gleams from its surface. Though it has no actual protective value (unless you bind it to your heart chakra), the carapace fills you with the destructive power of the tarrasque.

While your dread carapace is shaped, you gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls when you are using a bite attack, or a +1 bonus when you are using a claw or other natural attack. In exchange, you take a -1 penalty on attack rolls with natural weapons. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your dread carapace increases your attack penalty by 1 and your damage bonus by 2 (for bite attacks) or 1 (for other natural weapons). 

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

While the appearance of your dread carapace is unchanged, your upper arms manifest scaly plates, while spikes emerge from your elbows. At the same time, any natural weapons you possess become more deadly-sharper, longer, better able to slice through skin and armor to tear at vulnerable flesh.

The threat range of any natural attacks you possess (either naturally or as a result of another soulmeld) is doubled.

Chakra Bind (Feet)

While the appearance of your dread carapace is unchanged, your legs become increasingly muscular, and their shape alters slightly so that you more naturally move on just your toes and the balls of your feet.

Once per minute, you can add an enhancement bonus of +60 feet to your speed for 1 round.

Chakra Bind (Heart) 

Your dread carapace takes on a highly reflective sheen, suggesting the tarrasque's ability to reflect spells back on their casters. Spells have a hard time reaching through your carapace to affect you.

You gain spell resistance equal to 5 + 4 per point of essentia you invest in your dread carapace.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Two mighty horns jut from your head. Though they are useless in combat, they alter your appearance, making your countenance quite fearsome. When you charge, your visage suggests something utterly inhuman, striking fear into the hearts of your foes.

When you charge, all enemies within 60 feet who can see you become shaken for 1 round (Will negates).

  体质 X2+1 至体质 X3：
  如上，但接触会释放 1d4 个法咒火焰能量等级作为光，并且引导者必须每小时进行反噬体质检定。
  体质 X3+1 至体质 X4：
  如上，但引导者感到体内有灼烧感（视为被非伤害法咒分心，专注 DC 20），并且必须每分钟进行反噬体质检定。接触会释放 1d6 个法咒火焰能量等级作为闪光术（DC 10 + 消耗的法咒火焰能量等级数） 针对引导者及其 5 英尺内的所有生物。
  体质 X4+1 至体质 X5：
  如上，但角色处于痛苦中（视为被非伤害法咒分心，专注 DC 25），并且必须每轮进行反噬体质检定。接触会释放 2d6 个能量等级作为闪光术（DC 10 + 消耗的法咒火焰能量等级数） 针对引导者及其 5 英尺内的所有生物。引导者必须每轮进行意志豁免（DC 25），否则被迫向 30 英尺内的随机目标释放最大强度的能量速度爆发，优先于任何其他动作。
  无论储存的法咒火焰能量等级数量如何，引导者每轮只能自愿消耗等于其体质值的法咒火焰能量等级。（非自愿消耗，如上述，不受此限制。）

Type of Feat: Class
  Prerequisite: Spellfire Channeler level 1.
  Specifics: The channeler's capacity for storing spellfire energy levels is multiplied by the listed value. However, spellfire energy levels in excess of the channeler's Constitution score is dangerous, with different effects depending upon the number of levels stored:
  Constitution +1 to Constitution X2:
  The channeler's eyes glow brightly, and any creature, magic item or spell effect that touches the channeler causes 1 spellfire energy level to be discharged as a harmless burst of light. Once per day, the channeler must make a constitution check (DC 10) or take 1d6 points of damage as one of her spellfire energy level backfires.
  Constitution X2+1 to Constitution X3:
  As above, except a touch releases 1d4 spellfire energy levels as light, and the channeler must make the backfire Constitution check every hour.
  Constitution X3+1 to Constitution X4:
  As above, except the channeler feels a burning sensation within her body (treat as if distracted by a nondamaging spell, DC 20 to concentrate), and must make the backfire Constitution check every minute. A touch releases 1d6 spellfire energy levels as a flare spell (DC 10 + number of spellfire energy levels expended) against the channeler and all creatures within 5 feet of her.
  Constitution X4+1 to Constitution X5:
  As above, except the character is in pain (treat as if distracted by a nondamaging spell, DC 25 to concentrate), and must make the backfire Constitution check every round. A touch releases 2d6 energy levels as a flare spell (DC 10 + number of spellfire energy levels expended) against the channeler and all creatures within 5 feet of her. The channeler must make a Will save (DC 25) every round or be forced to expend a maximum-strength blast of energy at a random target within 30 feet in preference to any other action.
  Regardless of the number of spellfire energy levels stored, a channeler can voluntarily expend only a number of spellfire energy levels per round equal to her Constitution score. (Involuntary expenditure, such as that noted above, isn't limited in this way.)
  Use: Automatic.

dst: "甚至抵达这座古老废墟的旅途也可能很危险。据说如今路上有许多强盗和怪物劫掠者横行，不过这类危险对你这种经验的人来说也许只是家常便饭。至于废墟本身，就连一些相当有能力的冒险者最终也被赶了出来，或者进去后就再也没了音讯。无论如何，在这座废墟里，如果你能进去并活下来，应该就能找到你需要的书。那里曾有一座图书馆，其藏书目录显示其中包含一版由历史学家巴伦·塔鲁克所著的《沙纳塔列王编年史》。你也许听说过这本书？"
src: "It may also be a dangerous journey to even reach this old ruin. They say there are many bandits and monstrous raiders plaguing the roads these days, though perhaps dangers of that sort are routine for someone of your experience. As for the ruins themselves, even some quite capable adventurers ended up being driven out, or going in only to never be heard from again. At any rate, within this ruin, if you can enter and survive, you should be able to find the book you need. A library was once located there, and records of its contents indicate it included an edition of the Chronicle of the Kings of Shanatar, by the historian Barun Tharuk. Have you perhaps heard of this book?"

dst: "确实。在你讲述之后，我的注意力肯定被吸引了。我的家族以前曾因刺客而遭受损失，我不打算让这种事再次发生。现在似乎很清楚，这个教团背后有某种邪恶。具体是什么邪恶，以及它的确切目的是什么，仍然未知。我不打算让它们继续未知。不幸的是，我们目前的选项相当有限，因为我们缺乏任何关于教团不当行为的坚实证据。"
src: "Indeed. After what you related, my attention has assuredly been captured. My family has suffered loss to assassins before, and I do not intend that it should happen again. It now seems clear that some sort of evil is behind this Order. Exactly what evil, and what its precise purpose may be, remain unknown. I do not intend that they remain so. Unfortunately, our options at the moment are rather limited, as we lack any solid proof of wrongdoing on the order's part."

dst:
（进阶职业）
神拳使是许多神庙中独立的组织。他们的苦行成员将神圣魔法转向内在，使身体和意志和谐一致。神拳使发誓不使用武器和重甲。他们认为身体和心智是神赐的礼物，并相信不将这些礼物发展到最大潜力是一种罪过。施法不会使他们或他们的神蒙羞。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 擅长：无。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础攻击加值：+4
技能：学识 8。
专长：战斗施法，闪避，精通徒手击打，震慑拳。
神术施法：能够施放 1 级法咒

注意：如果你穿着中甲或重甲，神圣防御等级和神圣速度将不起作用。

行为准则：携带任何武器，神拳使将失去所有职业能力，直到完全休息。

职业特性：

等级
1：徒手伤害 - 神拳使的等级与他的武僧等级叠加
  神圣防御等级 - +1。
2：无。
3：神圣速度 +10%.
4：神圣火焰 - 获得额外伤害，等于他的职业等级 + 感知调整值。使用 1/天（持续时间 1 分钟）.
5：神圣防御等级 - +2。
6：神圣速度 +20%.
7：无。
8：神圣火焰 - 2/天。
  神圣速度 +30%.
9：无。
10：神圣防御等级 - +3。
  内在护甲 - 获得 +4 防御等级，豁免，法术抗力 25，持续感知调整值轮。

奖励法咒

神拳使每升一级，角色获得新法咒每日数量，如同他在最高神术施法职业上也提升了一级。

传奇：

奖励专长：传奇神拳使在 10 级后每四级获得一个奖励专长

每 5 级：神圣防御等级增加 1。
每 4 级：获得 +1 神圣火焰使用次数。

传奇神拳使奖励专长列表：
护甲皮肤，自动法术瞬发，自动法术默发，自动法术定发，致盲速度，伤害减免，传奇法术穿透，传奇 prowess，传奇法术专攻，能量抵抗，传奇坚韧，大感知，精通战斗施法，精通法术抗力，精通震慑拳，自我隐蔽，卓越先攻，.
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Sacred fists are independent organizations found within many temples. Their ascetic members have turned their divine magic inward, bringing their bodies and wills into harmony. Sacred fists have forsworn the use of weapons and heavy armor. They consider their bodies and minds gifts from their deity, and they believe that not developing those gifts to their fullest potential is a sin. Spellcasting does not dishonor them nor their deity.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: None.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +4
Skills: Lore 8.
Feats: Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Unarmed Strike, Stunning Fist.
Divine Spellcasting : Able to cast spell level 1

Note: Sacred AC and Sacred Speed don't work if you wearing a medium or heavy armor.

Code of Conduct: Wearing any weapon the Sacred Fist lost all his class benefits until full rest.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Unarmed Damage - Sacred Fist's levels stack with his monk level
  Sacred AC - +1.
2: None.
3: Sacred Speed +10%.
4: Sacred Flame - Gains an additional damage equal to his class level + Wis mod. Use 1/day (duration 1 minute).
5: Sacred AC - +2.
6: Sacred Speed +20%.
7: None.
8: Sacred Flame - 2/day.
  Sacred Speed +30%.
9: None.
10: Sacred AC - +3.
  Inner Armor - Gains a +4 to AC, Saving throws, Spell Resistance 25 for mod Wis rounds.

BONUS SPELLS

Every level in Sacred Fist, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

EPIC:

Bonus Feats: The epic Sacred Fist gains a bonus feat every four levels after 10th

Every 5 levels : Sacred AC increased by 1.
Every 4 levels : gains + 1 Sacred Flames use.

Epic Sacred Fist Bonus Feats List:
Armor Skin, Auto Quicken Spell, Auto Silent Spell, Auto Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Damage Reduction, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Prowess, Epic Spell Focus, Energy Resistance, Epic Toughness, Great Wisdom, Improved Combat Casting, Improved Spell Resistance, Improved Stunning Fist, Self-Concealment, Superior Initiative,.

回避动物

src:
Hide from Animals
Abjuration
Level: Drd 1, Rgr 1, Justice of Weald and Woe 1
Components: S, DF
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Targets: One creature touched
Duration: 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes

Animals cannot see, hear, or smell the warded creatures. Even extraordinary or
supernatural sensory capabilities, such as blindsense, blindsight, scent, and tremorsense, cannot detect or locate warded creatures. Animals simply act as though the warded creatures are not there. Warded creatures could stand before the hungriest of lions and not be molested or even noticed. If a warded character touches an animal or attacks any creature, even with a spell, the spell ends.

dst: 我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎杀海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向纳兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭海盗。据船员说，这些海盗是一群牛头人，一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次袭击。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗海盗。我应该和船长谈谈，看看我的才能如何在即将到来的袭击中发挥作用。
src: Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates. I should speak to the captain about how my talents could be utilized in the upcoming assault.

dst: 人人都知道这个故事：一把剑，一条龙类，一场惊天动地的搏斗，以及一位品德高尚的骑士拯救了数百，不，数千条性命！是的，人人都知道这个故事的某个版本，但怎么会呢？一把剑真能如此完整地走遍世界吗？也许曾有许多把，也许只有几把，但很可能像这样的武器在传说中已经变得如此“广为人知”，以至于它们真正的历史已被遗忘。
src: Everyone knows the story: a blade, a dragon, a titanic struggle, and a virtuous knight saving hundreds, nay, thousands of lives! Yes, everyone knows a version of this tale, but how? Could one sword have traveled the world so completely? Perhaps there have been many, perhaps only a few, but it is likely that weapons such as this have become so "well known" in legend that their true histories are forgotten.

dst:
在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给莎尔神殿的首席女祭司费拉莎看时，她认出这是前些时候被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。她因我把找到的碎片给了她而奖励了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，她也想要，以便莎尔神殿可以玷污他们敌人提尔的这件圣物。

在找到圣戒的第二块碎片后，费拉莎告诉我，有了戒指的两块碎片，她可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。她还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖励。我接受了这个任务，现在已经从它的不死守卫那里取回了这枚提尔圣戒的最后一块碎片。回到神殿后，我得知我的奖励就是这枚戒指本身，它将被重铸但被莎尔的力量腐化，并注入一套我可以自己选择的力量。一旦我准备好并知道我想选择什么力量，费拉莎就会着手为戒指注入力量。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Ferazha, the head priestess of the Temple of Shar, she recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. She rewarded me for giving her the piece I found, and has told me that she would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find, so that the Temple of Shar might defile this artifact of their enemy Tyr.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Ferazha that with two pieces of the ring, she could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. She also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I accepted this quest and have now recovered the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr from its undead guardians. Returning to the temple, I was informed that my reward would be this very ring, reforged but corrupted by the power of Shar, and infused with a set of powers that I myself can choose. As soon as I am ready and know what powers I wish to select, Ferazha will proceed to empower the ring.

dst:
哈马德一直在筹备对阿然尼亚总部的进攻，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报，这次进攻几乎已经准备就绪，军队正集结在蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结地。哈马德指示我前往这个集结地，为进攻贡献我的能力。到达后，我需向那里的指挥官——卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以他认为合适的方式提供协助。是时候前往城门，带上我想带的任何随从，然后出发前往沼泽。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结地，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已经在与服务于我们阿然尼亚敌人的类人生物（这里主要是蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会取得胜利，但担心等到胜利时，我们敌人的首领已经逃离总部，以便从其他地方继续他们的战争。为了防止这种情况，他计划让我沿着斥候发现的一条向北的小路前进，这条小路可以让我绕过他们的主力部队，直达基地。我将沿着这条小路前进，并与驻扎在小路开始再次向南拐弯之前的一支军队斥候会合。然后，我和斥候们将一路杀过敌人后方区域，那里希望抵抗较弱，以抵达基地。一旦到达那里，我将在阿然尼亚首领策划逃跑之前杀死他们。

我已经到达了北边小路上本应与军队斥候会合的地点，但他们不见踪影。也许我应该在继续前往基地之前四处寻找他们的踪迹。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

I have reached the point along the northern path where I was supposed to rendezvous with the army's scouts, but they are nowhere to be seen. Perhaps I should look around for some sign of them before proceeding onward to the base.

dst: 萨曼·瓦拉迪告诉我，如果我在找工作，应该去找一个叫纳马尔·萨拉坎的人，他是“闪亮探寻者”号的船长，目前可在码头区找到。这位萨拉坎船长显然想找一位冒险者帮忙调查他发现的一件神秘神器。萨曼已经向他提过我可能适合他的需求，所以他应该准备好在我提出时接受我的帮助。\n\n我已与萨拉坎船长谈过，并了解了一些他交给我的任务。他找到了一种魔法手段，可以创造通往某个水下废墟的界门，并希望我帮助探索它。我和任何穿过界门（或之后被召唤）的同伴都将获得防溺水的魔法保护。这将持续四个小时，在完成任务之前我不应穿过界门返回，因为这会打断法咒。在水下行动会减慢我的速度并降低攻击效果，阻止使用远程武器，并使任何涉及火焰的法咒效果有限（最多如此）。当我准备好承担这些困难的任务时，应该再次与他交谈。
src: Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.\n\nI have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should speak to him again at such time as I am ready to undertake a quest with these difficulties.

src:
Sons of malicious, predatory mothers, hagspawn are not a complete race, as there are no females of their kind. Hags continue their awful lineage by taking human males for mates, usually murdering and devouring the hapless captive later. The female children of a hag quickly grow into hags like their mothers, but the male children are hagspawn, half-human outcasts. Feared and hated by normal humans, hagspawn must make their way in the world by dint of their strength, hardiness, and sheer determination.  

Hagspawn Ability Adjustments: +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, -2 Charisma: Hagspawn are strong and hardy, but are sullen and ill-tempered.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass hagspawn's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

dst:
根据我找到的资料，这个谜题基于曾服侍卡达辛的四名主要随从，并且取决于对每个人偏好的武器和盔甲，以及每个人在战斗开始时通常施放的法术的了解。我发现的线索如下：

第1名随从施放冰风暴。
第2名随从使用战斧。
第3名随从没有穿板甲。
第4名随从穿鳞甲。
锁子甲中释放出连环闪电。
战锤持有者释放涌火之泉。
弯刀持有者穿皮甲。
弯刀持有者和钉头锤持有者都不释放酸雾术。

我并不完全了解这个谜题的性质，但这些线索应该会有帮助。你应该把它们记下来。
src:
"According to the sources I found, the puzzle is based on the four chief henchmen who once served Kadathin, and depends on knowledge of the weapon and armor preferred by each, and the spell each typically cast upon battle commencing. The clues I discovered are as follows:

The 1st henchman casts Ice Storm.
The 2nd henchman wields a battleaxe.
The 3rd henchman does NOT don plate armor.
The 4th henchman dons armor of scale.
From chain mail Chain Lightning is unleashed.
The warhammer wielder unleashes a Firebrand.
The scimitar wielder dons armor of leather.
Neither the scimitar wielder nor the morningstar wielder unleashes Acid Fog.

I do not know everything about the nature of the puzzle, but these clues should be helpful. You should make a note of them."

dst:
扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角落”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。她告诉我，除了把详细说明她愿望的信交给他之外，我还可以提供最多5000金币（稍后由扎拉拉支付）以确保他协助。

我已经和伊纳斯·森卡尔谈过，但他不愿意仅仅为了钱而帮助扎拉拉。相反，他要我去被称为“黑暗卡林港”的古老废墟中寻找对历史研究有价值的东西，最好是一些书面记录（如果它能保存这么久，也许可以在石碑之类的东西上找到）。我听说人们可以在下水道的多个地点进入黑暗卡林港。也许在下水道系统的某处可以进入一处合适的废墟，让我找到森卡尔所要的东西。无论如何，如果想在这件事上取得任何进展，看来我必须这么做。

我在探索黑暗卡林港时设法找到了一件合适的物品。我应该把它带给森卡尔。
src:
Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. She has told me that in addition to taking him the letter detailing her wishes, I can offer him up to 5000 gold (to be paid later by Zarala) to secure his assistance.

I have spoken to Inas Senkhar, but he is not willing to assist Zarala solely in exchange for money. Instead he wants me to search the old ruins known as "Dark Calimport" for something of value to historical research, preferably some kind of written record (perhaps to be found on a stone tablet or the like if it has survived this long). I am told that one can gain access to Dark Calimport at various points in the sewers. Perhaps somewhere in the sewer system there is access to a suitable set of ruins where I can find what Senkhar seeks. At any rate, it seems I must if any progress is to be made on this matter.

I managed to locate an appropriate item while exploring Dark Calimport. I should bring it to Senkhar.

dst:
（进阶职业）
魔法飞弹是龙与地下城中最具标志性的元素之一，是许多奥术施法者钟爱的招牌法咒，也是纯粹魔法力量的典范。因此，一群奥术施法者将他们的研究集中于这个法咒，决心将它的施法技巧完善到超越一切的程度，也就不足为奇了。当这些施法者痴迷地探索魔法飞弹的秘密并拓展它的边界时，这个法咒的每一个符文和魔法符号都不可阻挡地铭刻在他们的脑海中。这种专注研究的结果，是能够扭曲施放魔法飞弹所涉及的魔法能量，从而创造出增强该法咒效果的新能力。最终，最虔诚的研究者会对魔法的运作方式产生新的理解，揭示出普通施法者无法触及的深不可测的力量。这些受到启发的施法者被称为魔弹射手。

其他施法者不理解魔弹射手只专注于一个法咒的执着，并对他们眼中误入歧途的研究皱眉不已。在他们看来，魔弹射手是所有施法者的耻辱，因为他们将自身对魔法的理解局限于钻研一个许多人认为终究微不足道的法咒的秘密。由于这种蔑视，魔弹射手避开他们那些研究更广泛的同行，要么暗中进行研究，要么离群索居。这导致许多人过上了流浪者的生活，从一所学院或图书馆旅行到下一所，了解更多关于他们所选法咒的知识并探索世界。

- 生命骰：d4
- 擅长：魔弹射手不获得额外擅长
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

需求：

技能：专注 9 级，法咒辨识 9 级
专长：战斗施法

职业特性：

等级 
1：额外飞弹 - 魔法飞弹多出一枚飞弹
2：迅捷护盾 - 每天 1 次以迅捷动作施放护盾术
3：强压飞弹 - 突破法术抗力的检定获得 +2 加值
4：反射护盾 - 将所有魔法飞弹反射回施法者
5：额外飞弹
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The spell magic missile is one of the most iconic elements of Dungeons and Dragons, a favored staple of many arcane spellcasters and an example of raw magical force. Thus, it is no wonder that a cabal of arcane spellcasters focuses their studies on this spell, determined to perfect its casting technique above all others. As these spellcasters obsessively explore magic missile's secrets and press its boundaries, every rune and magical symbol of the spell becomes inexorably etched upon their minds. The outcome of such focused study results in the ability to warp the magical energies involved in casting magic missile, which leads to the creation of new abilities that augment the spell's effects. Eventually the most devoted researchers come to a new understanding of how magic works, revealing unplumbed depths of power out of the reach of ordinary spellcasters. These inspired spellcasters are known as force missile mages. 

Other spellcasters don't understand the force missile mages' dedication to only one spell and frown upon what they see as misguided research. In their reasoning, force missile mages are a discredit to all spellcasters as they limit their understanding of magic to delve into the secrets of what many see as ultimately an insignificant spell. Due to this disdain, force missile mages avoid their more widely studied peers, either pursuing their studies subtly or in seclusion. This has led many to take up the life of a wanderer, traveling from one school or library to the next, learning more about their spell of choice and exploring the world. 

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Force Missile gains no additional proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Skills: Concentration 9 ranks, Spellcraft 9 ranks
Feats: Combat Casting

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Bonus Missile - Magic Missile has an extra missile
2: Swift Shield - Cast Shield as a swift action 1/day
3: Overpowering Missile - +2 bonus to break through spell resistance
4: Reflective Shield - Reflect all magic missiles back to caster
5: Bonus Missile

src: "This bounty might be suitable for you: 20000 gold for the head of Tughaur. Tughaur is a Tanarukk, that is, part orc and part fiendish. He leads a band of orc raiders who have been causing trouble for some time now. He is apparently extremely formidable and has slain many who sought to bring him down. By report, he actually eagerly seeks out opportunities to battle those he considers worthy foes. That brings up the complication that makes someone skilled with weapons such as you an appropriate hunter for him. He apparently only considers fellow warriors to be 'worthy" opponents and despises wielders of magic, stealthy assassins and such. To keep from being bothered by such people, he has set up a fortress in the Cloudpeaks that is guarded by large numbers of 'Anti-Magic Golems.' These golems are apparently immune to spells and elemental damage, able to see through stealth and illusions, and able to dispel buffs or other magic on others. The only way you will get through them is by straightforward combat."

dst:
我近期的冒险始于今年早些时候，当时我来到卡林港的流沙旅店寻找冒险工作。在那里，我遇到了一位名叫扎拉拉·加尔哈德尔的空气元素裔吟游诗人，并最终与她一起经历了许多冒险。在这些冒险过程中，我战死沙场，显然已经丧命，却发现自己身处似乎是气元素位面的地方，被那里某个强大的存在复活了。这个存在告诉我，如果我再在战斗中倒下（鉴于我职业的危险性，这很有可能发生），它能够并且愿意再次复活我（并将我送回我所在位面倒下的地点），尽管它在特定时间段内只能这样做有限次数。作为这项宝贵服务的回报，它告诉我，我将被期望担任扎拉拉的保护者，因为她据称肩负着某种伟大命运，而这个存在希望看到它实现。这个存在显然无法或不被允许直接帮助扎拉拉，于是选择通过帮助我——她的同伴——来间接帮助她。

后来，我最终被扎拉拉的父亲哈马德·加尔哈德尔雇为守卫。他是一位提尔的圣武士，也是卡林杉的贵族成员。我为哈马德执行了几个月各种任务，同时也在卡林港城中游荡时找到了其他冒险工作。这一切在我揭露帕夏卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔的一项阴谋后结束了。泽卡尔是哈马德的老朋友，也是偶尔的盟友，他计划与多股怪物势力结盟摧毁卡林港，并利用一件名为泽法德之剑的古代巨灵神器制造浩劫。最终真相大白，泽卡尔受到一个名为阿兹古尔卡的强大恶魔的影响。这个恶魔曾被泽法德之剑击败并困住，但因此能够通过这把剑行动。同时还发现，扎拉拉是巨灵泽法德（最初铸造此剑者）的后裔，因此对这把剑拥有某些力量。这使我们得以挫败泽卡尔的计划，并从他手中夺走此剑（过程中将其折断），但这并没有结束我们的麻烦。困住阿兹古尔卡的次元壁障已经开始崩塌，最终将会崩溃，释放出那个恶魔。此外，泽卡尔早先还安排哈马德卷入一项释放奴隶的犯罪计划（讽刺的是，这个计划原本就是泽卡尔自己的，他只是让哈马德间接参与其中），从而获得了攻击加尔哈德尔庄园并杀死那里所有人的权力。这包括扎拉拉和我，我们因此被迫逃离卡林杉，而哈马德牺牲了自己的生命，为我们争取逃跑时间。

我们乘着瓦尔库尔之剑号逃离。这是一艘猎捕海盗的船，船长为了偿还欠哈马德·加尔哈德尔的债务，把我们带出了卡林杉，而我们也为她的船员在与海盗的战斗中提供了一些帮助。这艘船在泰瑟尔的扎泽斯普尔港停泊了一段时间，在此期间，我们在这座城市及周边乡村的各种冒险中，最终获得了一本极有价值的书，它应该可以作为进入烛堡大图书馆的入场代价。扎拉拉希望最终能前往这座图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识。这样一把重铸之剑，也许是阿兹古尔卡重返这个位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。

然而，前往烛堡的旅程并不顺利……
src:
My recent adventures began earlier this year when I showed up at the Shifting Sands Inn in the city of Calimport, looking for adventuring work. There I met an air genasi bard named Zarala Galhadr, and ended up having a number of adventures with her. In the course of these adventurers I fell in battle, apparently killed, only to find myself in what appeared to be the Plane of Air, having been restored to life by some powerful entity there. This entity told me that it was able and willing to restore my life (and return me to the point at which I fell on my own plane) again if I ever fell in battle (a likely enough occurence given the danger of my profession), although it could only do so a limited number of times within a given time period. In return for this valuable service, it told me that I would be expected to act as Zarala's protector, as she allegedly has some great destiny the entity wants to see fulfilled. Apparently unable or forbidden to help Zarala directly, the entity chose to assist her by helping me, her companion, instead.

In due course, I ended up being hired as a guard by Zarala's father, Hamad Galhadr, a Paladin of Tyr and a member of Calimshan's nobility. I spent a few months performing various tasks for Hamad, among other adventuring work I found while wandering about the city of Calimport. This came to an end when I uncovered a plot by Pasha Kalomas Zekar, an old friend and occasional ally of Hamad's, to ally with various bands of monsters to destroy Calimport, as well as using an ancient djinn artifact known as the Sword of Zefad to unleash havoc. It eventually emerged that Zekar was under the influence of a powerful demon named Azghulkar, once defeated and entrapped by the sword of Zefad, but as a result able to act through it. It also emerged that Zarala was a descendant of the djinni Zefad (who had forged the sword in the first place) and thus had certain powers over it. This enabled us to foil Zekar's plans and take the sword from him (breaking it in the process), but that did not end our problems. The dimensional walls entrapping Azghulkar had begun to fall, and will eventually collapse, releasing the demon. Furthermore, Zekar had earlier arranged for Hamad to be implicated in a criminal enterprise to free slaves (a project that ironically was originally Zekar's own, and in which he had peripherally involved Hamad) and thus gained authority to attack the Galhadr estate and kill everyone there. This included Zarala and myself, and we were consequently forced to flee Calimshan, while Hamad sacrificed his life to buy time for our escape.

We fled onboard the Sword of Valkur, a pirate-hunting vessel whose captain took us out of Calimshan to repay a debt owed to Hamad Galhadr, and gave her crew some assistance in battles against pirates. This vessel stopped for a time in the port of Zazesspur in Tethyr, and during this period we were, in the course of various adventures in that city and the surrounding country, able to eventually acquire a book of great value which should serve as the price of admittance to the great library of Candlekeep. Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to this library, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.

The journey to Candlekeep has not gone smoothly however...

dst: "为了保护我，我的母亲被迫搬到另一个城镇，那里没人会知道我出身的相关情况，并终生掩盖我的蛇类特征。尽管如此，最终有人对我产生了怀疑，我不完全确定是怎么引起的，一次魔法调查证实我确实是蛇人。在某些地方，我或许能得到公正的听证或解释的机会，但正如我所说，在世界上那个对蛇类敏感的地区，这不能指望。我不得不逃亡以保全性命。"
src: "To protect me, my mother was forced to move to another town, where no one would know the circumstances surrounding my parentage, and conceal my serpentine characteristics all my life. Nevertheless, suspicions were eventually raised concerning me, I am not entirely sure how, and a magical investigation confirmed that I was indeed Yuan-ti. In some places, I might have been given a fair hearing or a chance at an explanation, but as I have said, that is not to be counted on in that region of the world where serpents are concerned. I had to flee to save my life."

dst: "达纳尔·加尔哈德尔。挚爱的儿子。生于1351年，卒于1356年，" 刻在这块石头上，标记着扎拉拉弟弟的坟墓，他比她小几岁。你记得初到庄园时，哈马德和扎拉拉告诉过你关于这另一场家庭悲剧的一些事情。那男孩死于一种神秘疾病，无咒语可医，这清楚地表明它是魔法所致，涉及某种敌对的超自然力量。哈马德怀疑这次死亡，如同他妻子的死一样，也是他的敌人实施的暗杀，但没有证据表明是谁干的，尽管他并非毫无怀疑。哈马德提到，选择这种死亡方式很可能是为了羞辱他，因为圣武士可以夸耀在对抗疾病方面有些专长，你记得他评论过，一个人得有多堕落才会认为他会在意这种事胜过他儿子的生命。
src: "Danar Galhadr. Beloved Son. b. 1351 d. 1356," is inscribed on this stone, marking the grave of Zarala's brother, younger than her by a couple of years. You remember a few things Hamad and Zarala told you about this other family tragedy when you first came to the estate. The boy died of a mysterious disease which no spell could cure, a clear sign that it was magically inflicted and some hostile supernatural power was involved. Hamad suspects that this death, like that of his wife, was also an assassination carried out by his enemies, but has no proof of who was responsible, though he is not without some suspicions. Hamad mentioned that the manner of death was likely chosen to humiliate him, since paladins can boast of some expertise in combating diseases, and you remember him commenting how depraved someone would have to be to think he would care about such a thing more than the life of his son.

It may be your companion Zarala can prevent this, if she is kept alive, as we have charged you to do. We intend to see her proper destiny fulfilled, but beware, there are other powers at work who would see that it is not. But I am not here to answer all your questions, only to keep you from continuing down the path to death. I shall return you to your own plane when you are ready."

Range: Personal
Target: You

Despite the horrific wounds you suffer, the flash of searing spells and the crash of a foe's mighty attacks, you stand resolute on the field. So long as the potential for victory exists you fight on.

While you remain in this stance, you cannot be killed through loss of hitpoints. Other effects, such as death spells, may still kill you. 例如，如果莫索斯正在与一个他从未遇到过的异界生物战斗，他可以选择用地狱霜爆和硫磺爆注入他的魔能爆。他掷 10d6 伤害，造成一半火焰和一半寒冷伤害。如果该异界生物恰好免疫寒冷但不免疫火焰，它仍然会受到造成火焰伤害的那一半的伤害。

此外，你使用的所有魔能本质邪术的 DC 增加 2.这是一个特异能力。

src:
Type of Feat: Epic
Prerequisite: One least, lesser, greater, and dark eldritch essence invocation, Spellcraft 24 ranks.
Specifics: When you use the eldritch blast ability, you can apply two eldritch essence invocations simultaneously. You could choose to fire an eldritch blast with both the binding blast and noxious blast eldritch essences. This also allows you to apply the same effect twice, though this is not beneficial in the case of all eldritch essences. The effects of each essence are resolved separately. If you imbue your eldritch blast with two different types of damage, half of the damage (rounded down) is dealt by each source. You must choose which essences you will use in conjunction with your eldritch blast before you start your action. If you possess the Eldritch Sculptor feat, you can apply two eldritch essence invocations to both your eldritch blasts in a single round. Activating this ability is part of the action to use an eldritch blast.

For example, if Morthos is fighting an outsider he has never encountered, he can choose to imbue his eldritch blast with both hellrime blast and brimstone blast. He rolls 10d6 damage, dealing half fire and half cold damage. If the outsider happened to be immune to cold, but not fire, it would still take damage from the half that dealt fire damage.

In addition, the DC of all eldritch essence invocations you use increases by 2. This is an extraordinary ability.

You can use this feat to toggle which essence slot your activated essence invocations go into.
Use: Selected.

半人马比其他类人种族更强壮，更迅捷，统治着大片荒野。他们建立起和平，田园般的社群，随心所欲地狩猎。半人马以大小不一的部落栖息在平原和森林中。尽管他们建造永久住所并在一地居住多年，半人马仍会定期离开家园，在相对较短的时间内游历极远的距离。
半人马认为这种远行对于理解家园周围的世界至关重要，并且纯粹为了远行本身的乐趣而极为享受这种活动。虽然他们的工艺尚未达到某些类人种族的水平，但这只是因为半人马更偏爱频繁离家远行，而非留在一地专攻一门手艺。

半人马属性调整：+8 力量，+4 敏捷，+4 体质，-2 智力，+2 感知。
天赋职业（巡林客）：在判断兼职半人马是否受到兼职经验值惩罚时，其巡林客职业等级不计入。

特殊能力：

大体型：防御等级 -1 惩罚，攻击检定 -1 惩罚，躲藏检定 -4 惩罚，擒抱检定 +4 加值
半人马的基础陆地速度为 50 英尺。
黑暗视觉
+3 护甲加值
种族生命骰：半人马初始拥有四级人形怪物，提供 4d8 生命骰；+4 基础攻击加值；以及强韧 +1，反射 +4，意志 +4 的基础豁免加值。
等级调整 +2。
人形怪物：就法咒效果而言，半人马被视为人形怪物。

特殊：半人马的外观不太好看。我们知道。
src:
Far stronger and faster than other humanoid races, centaurs rule huge swathes of the wild. They build peaceful, idyllic communities, hunting what and where they wish. Centaurs inhabit the plains and forests in tribes of varying size. Even though they build permanent shelters and live in one place for many years at a time, centaurs roam from their homes on a regular basis, ranging over great distances 
in relatively short amounts of time. Centaurs regard such excursions as essential to understanding the world around their homes, and they greatly enjoy such activity for its own sake. Although their crafts have not reached the level of some of the humanoid races, it is only because centaurs prefer to venture from their homes often rather than to stay in one place and ply a single trade. 

Centaur Ability Adjustments: +8 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, -2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass Centaur's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

Large size: -1 penalty to Armor Class, -1 penalty on attack rolls, -4 penalty on Hide checks, +4 bonus on grapple checks
A centaur's base land speed is 50 feet.
Darkvision
+3 armor bonus
Racial Hit Dice: A centaur begins with four levels of monstrous humanoid, which provide 4d8 Hit Dice; a base attack bonus of +4; and base saving throw bonuses of Fort +1, Ref +4, and Will +4.
Level adjustment +2.
Monstrous Humanoid: Centaurs are considered Monstrous Humanoids for the purpose of spells.

Special: The appearance isn't great for a centaur. We know.

It might be a little inconvenient for me to get there, seeing as I also have some business to conduct here. If you were to deliver it for me that wold be most helpful. 角色的基础领导力分数等于他的等级加上任何魅力调整值。为了考虑负魅力调整值，此表允许非常低的领导力分数，但角色仍然必须达到 6 级或更高才能获得领导力专长。

部属获得经验值如下：
在确定队伍经验值时，部属不计为队伍成员。

src:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Character level 6th
Specifics: Having this feat enables the character to attract a loyal companion and devoted follower, a subordinate who assists her. See the table below for what level of cohort the character can recruit.

A characters base Leadership score equals his level plus any Charisma modifier. In order to take into account negative Charisma modifiers, this table allows for very low Leadership scores, but the character must still be 6th level or higher in order to gain the Leadership feat.

The character can attract a single cohort of up to this level. Regardless of a characters Leadership score, he can only recruit a cohort who is two or more levels lower than himself. The cohort does not have any equipment of their own, that must be provided for them A character can try to attract a cohort of a particular race, class, and alignment. The cohorts alignment may not be opposed to the leaders alignment on either the law-vs-chaos or good-vs-evil axis, and the leader takes a Leadership penalty if she recruits a cohort of an alignment different from her own.

Cohorts earn XP as follows:
The cohort does not count as a party member when determining the party's XP.
Divide the cohorts level by the level of the PC with whom he is associated (the character with the Leadership feat who attracted the cohort).
Multiply this result by the total XP awarded to the PC and add that number of experience points to the cohorts total.
If a cohort gains enough XP to bring it to a level one lower than the associated PCs character level, the cohort does not gain the new level. Instead, the cohorts new XP total is 1 less than the amount needed attain the next level.

src:
Gold dragons hate injustice and foul play, but few things anger them more than tyranny of the strong over the weak, or the small.  When a gold dragon's territory includes or is near a halfling village, they often appoint themselves protector and take of threats too powerful for the halflings to handle alone.  Such villages seldom, if ever, learn of those dangers or of their guardian.  The dragon often walks among its charges, appearing as a small animal or as a halfling looking to settle in the town.  While any relationships from this are short-lived as far as the dragon is concerned, the signs of draconic heritage live on long after among the village inhabitants.  These dragonblooded halflings look for the most part like their more mundane kin, but bear a golden sheen to their complexion and inevitably have golden flecks in their eyes.  They also tend to show traits of nobility and courage, standing up to any threat they encounter.

Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.

Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass glimmerskin halfling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Touch of Luck: Once per day, a glimmerskin halfling can grant himself or an ally within 30' a +2 bonus to saves for one round as an immediate action.
- Dragonblooded: Glimmerskin Halflings have the dragonblood subtype.
- Halfling: Glimmerskin Halflings count as Halflings for the purpose of spells.

dst: "虽然我不知道这些信息有多大用处，但我听说过这个诺莫格-盖亚。3000多年前，卡林杉的人民与一支庞大的大地精军队开战，他们来自一个叫做诺莫格-盖亚的地方，或者崇拜一位名叫诺莫格-盖亚的神明之类的。最终地精被击败，他们所崇拜的、激励他们作战的巨大神像也被摧毁了。我想知道这个地方是不是那个时代遗留下来的？当然，与那些大地精的最终决战发生在奥姆拉兰丁山脉，即今天的泰瑟尔，但他们无疑在其他地方也有基地。无论如何，据我所知，我们现在可能就在奥姆拉兰丁山脉之下。谁知道那个界门把我们带到了哪里？"
src: "While I don't know how useful the information might be, I have heard of this Nomog-Geaya. More than 3000 years ago the people of Calimshan waged a war against a great army of hobgoblins who were from someplace they called Nomog-Geaya, or worshipped a deity named that or something. Ultimately the goblins were defeated, and the great idol they worshipped, inspiring their efforts, was destroyed. I wonder if this place is something left over from those times? Of course the final confrontation with those hobgoblins occured in the Omlarandin Mountains in what is today Tethyr, but they doubtless had some bases elsewhere. In any case for all I know we are now under the Omlarandins. Who knows where that portal took us?"

The blood of a Lung Wang Dragon courses through your veins.  In addition to standard Dragon Disciple progression, you receive certain specific benefits befitting your Lung Wang Dragon ancestry.

At level 10 in the Dragon Disciple class, you receive the ability to breath water and total immunity to 'drown' spells and effects.  You also receive total immunity to fire.

At level 3, you gain the ability to breath a 30 foot cone of fire once per day.  This cone will cause 2d10 damage, increasing to 4d10 at level 7, 6d10 at level 10, with further improvements in epic levels.

一位6级或更高的超凡之弦，且在表演技能上有16或更多级，知晓永恒之歌。作为一个标准动作，她可以笼罩60英尺内的一个生物在永恒领域中，前提是她对目标有效果线。受术者有权进行意志豁免（DC10 + 超凡之弦等级 + 魅力调整值）来否定效果。
如果受术者豁免失败，它被冻结在闪烁的永恒光环中，无法采取任何动作。然而，没有任何力量可以影响它 - 武器无法触及它，以它为目标的法咒自动失败，如果它站立的地面以某种方式被移走，它甚至不会开始下落。超凡之弦可以通过继续表演来保持目标冻结在时间中，最长每等级1分钟。当她停止表演时，受术者立即恢复正常。就该生物而言，似乎没有时间流逝。
src:
A Sublime Chord of 6th level or higher with 16 or more ranks in the Perform skill knows the Song of Timelessness. As a standard action she can envelop a single creature within 60 feet in a field of timelessness, provided she has line of effect to the target. The subject is entitled to a Will save (DC10 + Sublime Chord level + Cha modifier) to negate the effect.
If the subject fails it's save, it is frozen in a shimmering aura of timelessness and can take no actions. However, no force can affect it - weapons can not reach it, spells that target it automatically fail, and if the ground it is standing on is somehow taken away, it would not even begin to fall. A Sublime Chord can keep it's target frozen in time for as long as she maintains the power by continuing to perform, up to a maximum of 1 minute per level. When she stops performing, the subject immediately returns to normal. As far as the creature is concerned, no time seems to have passed.

dst:
阿沙德隆，未生者的柴堆
    
作为一个追求纯粹力量和财富的寻求者，恶魔红龙阿沙德隆是他那个时代最强大的生物之一。他曾不止一次逃脱死亡，因此他授予契灵师一些他作为龙和恶魔的力量，以及他强大恢复力的一部分。
  
契灵等级：8级
绑定DC:35
特殊要求：无
  
影响：你对那些伤害或轻视你的人怀有强烈的复仇渴望。阿沙德隆要求你接受任何攻击伤害或侮辱你的敌人的机会，优先于任何其他目标。
  
授予能力：
阿沙德隆授予你一些他在作为龙和恶魔生物的一生中收集的庞大力量。

阿沙德隆的信条：你在估价检定和搜索检定上获得等于你契灵师等级的加值。你还可以随意定位附近的物体，如同法咒定位物体。

阿沙德隆的存在：你可以将恐惧打入敌人的心中。这如同法咒恐惧术。一旦你使用了此能力，你5轮内不能再次使用。

阿沙德隆的活力术：阿沙德隆授予你一些他在生前享有的强大恢复力。当你绑定此契灵时，你获得等于你契灵师等级两倍的临时生命值。这些临时生命值持续最多24小时。

恶魔之心：你分享一些曾经绑定在阿沙德隆身体上的巴洛魔的防御优势。此效果赋予你伤害减免 10/+3 和火焰抗力 30。
src:
Ashardalon, Pyre of the Unborn
    
A seeker of pure power and wealth, the fiendish red dragon Ashardalon was among the toughest creatures of his era. Having escaped death more than once, he grants binders some of his powers as a dragon and fiend, as well as a portion of his great resilience.
  
Vestige Level: 8th
Binding DC: 35
Special Requirement: No
  
Influence: You greatly hunger for vengeance against those who harm or slight you. Ashardalon requires you to accept any opportunity to strike a foe who damages or insults you in preference over any other target. 
  
Granted Abilities: 
Ashardalon grants you some of the vast power he collected during his life as a dragon and a fiendish creature.

Ashardalon's Creed: You gain a bonus on Appraise checks and Search checks equal to your binder level. You can also locate objects near you, as the spell locate object at will.

Ashardalon's Presence: You can strike fear into the hearts of your foes. This acts as the fear spell. Once you have used this ability, you cannot use it again for 5 rounds.

Ashardalon's Vigor: Ashardalon grants you some of the vast resilience he enjoyed in life. When you bind this vestige, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your binder level. These temporary hit points last for up to 24 hours.

Fiend's Heart: You share some of the defensive benefits of the balor once bound to Ashardalon's body. This effect grants you damage reduction 10/+3 and resistance to fire 30.

Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric 2, Druid 2, Paladin 2,
Components: V, S, AF,
Casting Time: 1 round
Range: 0 ft.
Effect: Fills pot with healing stew (1 serving/2 levels)
Duration: Instantaneous (see text)
Saving Throw: Will half (harmless); see text
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

This spell calls upon Estanna, goddess of hearth and home 
, to fill a specially crafted stewpot with a potent healing stew.
The caster must be hold the pot in hand when Estanna's stew
is cast; otherwise, the spell fails and is wasted.
The spell creates one serving per two caster levels (maximum 5).
A single serving heals 1d6+1 points of damage and requires
a standard action to consume. Any portion of the stew that
is not consumed disappears after 1 hour.The stew can be 
splashed onto a single undead creature within 10 feet.
If a ranged touch attack succeeds, the undead creature 
takes 1d6+1 points of damage per serving splashed on it.
The undead creature can apply spell resistance and can 
attempt a Will save to take half damage.

dst: 卡齐娅警告过我，一旦到达泽卡尔塔的底层，我穿过那里时就会被传送到我之前待过的火焰位面陷阱中。她指导了我必须遵循的逃脱程序。要重新打开界门，我需要按下界门西北和东南方的两个发光的魔法球。不幸的是，我最初会发现它们被锁定在原地。要解锁它们，我需要向西走，并按正确的顺序多次扳动那里的拉杆。要确定正确的顺序，我必须找到界门东北方的未点燃的火盆。对它施放涉及火焰的法咒，比如燃烧之手或火球术，会使它亮起来，当它亮起时，我会看到火焰呈现出数字的形状。这些数字对应拉杆上的数字，并指示扳动它们的正确顺序。卡齐娅给了我一张燃烧之手卷轴用于此目的。如果我不能使用，扎拉拉应该能够使用它。\n\n火盆已被激活，并揭示了以下数字序列：3、1、2、3、2、3。
src: Kadzia has warned me that upon reaching the ground floor of the Zekar tower, I will be transported as I traverse it to the fiery planar trap I was in earlier. She has instructed me in the procedure I must follow to escape. To re-open the portal, I will need to press down the two glowing magical globes to the northwest and southeast of the portal. Unfortunately I will initially find them to be locked in place. To unlock them, I will need to head west, and flip the levers there a number of times in the correct order. To determine the correct order, I must locate the unlighted brazier, to the northeast of the poratl. Casting a spell on it that involves fire, such as Burning Hands or Fireball, will cause it to light up, and as it does I will see the flames take on the shape of numbers. These correspond to the numbers on the levers, and will indicate the correct sequence in which to flip them. Kadzia has given me a Burning Hands scroll to use for this purpose. Zarala should be able to use it if I am not.\n\nThe brazier has been activated, and revealed the following sequence of numbers: 3, 1, 2, 3, 2, 3.

dst: "塔纳厘是腐化的大师。我怀疑那位祖先的一个或多个仆从被引诱叛变，在关键时刻摧毁了一颗水晶。那位祖先能让水晶在比我目前所能达到的更远距离上发挥作用，这使它们在实战中不那么脆弱，但也许更容易遭到背叛，因为当力量接收者不在附近看守和守护水晶时，此类任务便被委派给仆从。我得好好想想如何防范这种潜在的弱点。阿兹古尔卡已被证明极为危险，必须谨慎应对。" 除了这些文字之外，还有一些材料记载着魔法知识或底栖魔鱼所进行的各种魔法实验的记录。
src: "The Tanar'ri are masters of corruption. I suspect one or more of the ancestor's servants was led to betrayal, and destroyed a crystal at a key moment. The ancestor was able to make the crystals work at a much greater distance than I have yet been able to accomplish, which made them less vulnerable in actual battle, but perhaps even more vulnerable to treachery, as, without the recipient of the power being nearby to watch and guard the crystals, such tasks were delegated to servants. I shall have to give some thought to how such a potential vulnerability may be protected against. Azghulkar has proven to be most dangerous, and must be dealt with cautiously." In addition to these writings, there are also materials containing magical lore or recountings of various magical experiments conducted by the aboleth.

dst: 在扎泽斯普尔的伊尔梅特神殿“泪之屋”地下，我遇到了一个名叫尼尔瓦·瓦尔切扎的人，一位伊尔梅特圣武士，她正守卫着抵御来自城市下方幽暗地域洞穴的威胁。在那里，她发现了一道由负能量构成的黑暗屏障，它正在扩张，并将幽暗地域的生物转化为亡灵怪物。她已确定，要穿透这道屏障到达其后方邪恶的假定源头，需要一颗游荡者之石，一种常用于传送魔法的稀有宝石。如果我在冒险途中遇到一颗游荡者之石，把它带给她可能是个好主意。\n\n我给尼尔瓦带了一颗游荡者之石，但在同意陪伴她并帮助她对抗黑暗屏障后方的任何邪恶之后，她暴露了自己是一个卓尔精灵！我拒绝与那种 monstrously evil 种族的成员合作，所以我将不再参与这个任务。
src: Beneath the House of Tears, a Temple of Ilmater in Zazesspur, I encountered one Nierva Var'cheza, a Paladin of Ilmater who is standing guard against a menace originating in the underdark caverns below the city. There she found a dark barrier of negative energy that is expanding and transforming creatures of the Underdark into Undead monstosities. She has determined that penetrating this barrier to reach the presumed source of this evil beyond it will require a Rogue Stone, a rare gem often used in teleportation magics. If I come across a Rogue Stone in the course of my adventures, it might be a good idea to bring it to her.\n\nI brought Nierva a Rogue Stone, but after agreeing to accompany her and aid her against whatever evil lies beyond the dark barrier, she revealed herself to be a Drow Elf! I refused to work with someone of that monstrously evil race, so I will be taking no further part in this quest.

dst: "那确实是一次有趣的冒险。我希望我们能多了解一些那个地方的历史，以及那位可怜的堕落圣武士——他似乎在那里作为不死怪物度过了数千年。我已经知道足够多，可以为他命运谱写一个悲伤的故事了……但我忍不住觉得，那里的故事远比我们所了解的要丰富得多。"

dst: 破碎者是一个献身于伊尔梅特的武僧教团，伊尔梅特是慈悲与坚忍之神。伊尔梅特鼓励他的追随者为了服务他人而自愿承受苦难，他的武僧倾向于极端的苦行主义。破碎者不是试图避免痛苦，而是为了精神上的益处而自愿忍受痛苦。这件长袍上的强化反映了这一哲学：它不像大多数武僧长袍那样增加护甲保护，而是增加承受能力。装备这件长袍的武僧会容易受伤，但难以被杀死。
src: The Broken Ones are an order of monks dedicated to Ilmater, god of compassion and perseverance. Ilmater encourages his followers to willingly embrace suffering in service to others, and his monks have a tendency towards extreme asceticism. Rather than seeking to avoid pain, the Broken Ones willingly endure it for the sake of spiritual benefits. The enhancements on this robe reflect this philosophy: rather than increasing armor protection, like most monk robes, it instead increases the capacity to endure. A monk equipped with this robe will be easy to hurt, but hard to kill.

dst: 抵达米尔森林附近、本应受我增援的军团所保护的泰布纳斯村时，我发现此地已陷入火海，正遭到一大群地精的袭击。我击败了附近的地精，并与村长交谈。他告诉我，我本应增援的军团已经进入森林，而且显然已被周围数量异常庞大、能力出众的地精部队击败，因为不久之后村庄就遭到了攻击。然而，森林中仍能听到战斗的声音，想必是军团残部仍在进行一些抵抗。看来我必须深入森林，营救军团的幸存者，并希望能找到办法阻止地精对这个防御薄弱的地区采取侵略行动。\n\n深入树林后，我在一个被地精用作补给站的洞穴中找到了一些关于这支地精军队的情报。其中提到了一个名叫乌拉斯的家伙，显然是他们的指挥官，还提到了一座位于森林更深处的堡垒，显然是他们的主要行动基地。如果我能杀死这个乌拉斯或摧毁这座基地，无疑会大大削弱这支地精部落的力量，不过我不确定这任务会有多容易。
src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nPressing into the woods, I found some information about the goblinoid army in a cave they were using as a supply depot. There were references to one Ulaz, apparently their commander, and to a fortress located deeper in the woods, apparently their main base of operations. If I could slay this Ulaz or destroy this base that would doubtless do much to cripple the power of this goblin horde, though I am not sure how easy a task this would be.

dst:
恐吼兽面具

描述符：恐惧，影响心智，音波  
职业：图腾师  
脉轮：眉间（图腾） 
豁免检定：见正文

你将魂能塑造成一个咆哮的兽形面具，露出骨骼和肌肉。它的基本形态介于大型猫科动物和狼之间，但没有皮肤，露出锋利的牙齿，白色的骨骼和粉红色的肌肉。

当你戴着恐吼兽面具时，你在跳跃和潜行检定上获得 +4 能力加值。

魂能点：你投入到恐吼兽面具中的每一点魂能点使你在跳跃和潜行检定上的能力加值增加 2. 
 
脉轮绑定（眉间） 

你的眼睛从恐吼兽面具中凝视前方，呈现出蓝绿色。当你说话时，面具的下颌会移动，其肌肉在众目睽睽之下怪异地伸缩--至少可以说，这是一种令人生畏的效果。

由于面具的可怕外观，你在威吓检定上获得的能力加值等于面具在跳跃和潜行检定上提供的加值。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

你的脸与恐吼兽面具融为一体，因此它所有的肌肉都会随着你的表情而移动。当你愤怒或进入战斗时，面具边缘的一圈皮肤会颤抖，你的声音中也会带上一丝低吼。

你获得发出响亮尖啸的能力（作为一个标准动作），类似于恐吼兽的尖啸。结合面具的恐怖外观，这种尖啸会使你 30 英尺内的一个生物如果意志豁免失败则陷入惊惧状态 1 轮。这是一个音波，影响心智的恐惧效果。
src:
Krenshar Mask

Descriptors: Fear, mind-affecting, sonic  
Classes: Totemist  
Chakra: Brow (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

You form incarnum into a snarling, bestial mask of exposed bone and muscle. Its basic form is somewhere between that of a large cat and a wolf, but it lacks skin, showing sharp teeth, white bone, and pink-red muscles.

While wearing your krenshar mask, you gain a +4 competence bonus on Jump and Move Silently checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your krenshar mask increases your competence bonus on Jump and Move Silently checks by 2. 
 
Chakra Bind (Brow) 

Your eyes stare forth from your krenshar mask, taking on a green-blue color. The jaws of the mask move as you speak, its muscles flexing weirdly in full view-an intimidating effect, to say the least.

As a result of the mask's frightful appearance, you gain a competence bonus on Intimidate checks equal to the bonus the mask gives on Jump and Move Silently checks. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your face becomes one with your krenshar mask, so all its muscles move to match your expressions. A ridge of skin around the edge of the mask quivers when you grow angry or enter combat, and a growling edge creeps into your voice.

You gain the ability to produce a loud screech (as a standard action) similar to that of a krenshar. In combination with the frightening aspect of the mask, this shriek causes one creature within 30 feet of you to become frightened for 1 round if it fails a Will save. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect.

dst:
这本书由一位名叫阿拉达尔·哈辛的人撰写，试图介绍人们对名为“扭曲符文”的组织所知的少量信息。

扭曲符文是一个由强大的亡灵施法者组成的联盟，由巫妖“黑暗者”瑞斯兰于DR 864年创立。据信它创立于卡林港城内，或至少是在其地下，而卡林杉显然至今仍是该组织的行动基地，尽管在其他地方遇到其特工也并非闻所未闻。该组织极其隐秘而神秘。甚至它雇用的许多特工也不知道其主人的真实身份。因此，很难确定其成员是否有比单纯增加自身权力和影响力更具体的议程。当然，众所周知他们曾暗中干预卡林杉的政治，也有人相信他们秘密统治着那个国家，而西尔帕夏不过是他们的傀儡。

本书结尾警告说，与扭曲符文的特工打交道时必须极其小心。这条建议并不特别有用，因为鉴于该组织的隐秘性，任何遇到其特工的人都不太可能意识到这一点。

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Like the paladin, the Soldier of Light is devoted to the destruction of all evil creatures and is always willing to help others. They often co-operate with paladin and other allies of good alignment.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: All simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +5
Alignment: Neutral Good
Skills: Lore 4 ranks.
Special: Must worship Elishar. (Clerics taking this class must have two of the following domains: Good, Healing, Knowledge, Luck, Protection, Sun.)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Turn Undead - As a cleric of the same class level as the Soldier of Light. This stacks with any levels of Cleric and/or Paladin.
2: Divine Grace - Applies Charisma bonus to all saving throws.
  Smite Undead - May add Wisdom bonus to attack bonus against an undead target. If the strike hits, the blow deals 1 point of positive damage per point of Wisdom bonus. Usable 3/day, +1 per Charisma bonus/day.
3: Positive Fortitude - Gains +2 to all saving throws against necromantic spells and drain effects.
4: Energon Companion - May summon a Xag-Ya companion (positive energy outsider), 1/day.
5: Divine Vengeance - May spend 2 Turn Undead attempts to add +2d6 positive damage against Undead to the caster's weapon (1 round/Cha bonus, minimum 1 round).
6: -
7: Fast Healing 1 - Regenerate 1 HP/round.
8: Positive Energy Burst - May spend two Turn Undead attempts to damage all undead within 100 feet of the character, dealing 1d6 positive damage per Soldier of Light level. Undead affected may make a reflex save (DC: 10 + Soldier of Light levels) for half damage.
  Improved Energon Companion: your companion gains +2HD.
9: -
10: Fast Healing 2 - Regenerate 2 HP/round.

SPELL LIST:
Casts spells as a cleric based on Wisdom with a caster level equal to class level (plus any applicable PrCs).

Level 1: Cure Light Wounds, Bless Weapon, Bless, Magic Weapon Shield of Faith, Protection from Evil, Light
Level 2: Cure Moderate Wounds, Aid, Consecrate Lesser Restoration
Level 3: Cure Serious Wounds, Greater Magic Weapon, Magic Circle against Evil, Searing Light, Negative Energy Protection, Prayer, Remove Disease
Level 4: Cure Critical Wounds, Death Ward, Holy Sword, Restoration

EPIC:

13: Healing Domain - Healing spells are empowered.
16: Maximize Turn Undead - When you turn undead, your turn damage is multiplied by 2 (Don't stacks with Empower Turning).
19: Fast Healing 3 - Regenerate 3 HP/round.
22: Supreme Positive Energy Burst: Now you only spend 1 turn attempt when you use Positive Energy Burst.

Bonus Feats: The epic Soldier of Light gains a bonus feat every three levels after 10th.

Soldier of Light Bonus Feats List:
Armor Skin, Devastating Critical, Epic Reputation, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Prowess, Great Smiting, Great Wisdom, Overwhelming Critical, Perfect Health, Planar Turning.

dst: 在稀有书籍专家登萨斯·韦莱本的建议下，我们经过漫长的任务，成功获得了一本价值足以作为进入烛堡的通行费的书。既然此事已完成，我们应回去与特法拉姆船长谈谈，他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停泊数周进行整修，而他或许能在下次猎捕海盗的出击中带我们更接近烛堡。\n\n特法拉姆船长告知我们，瓦尔库尔之剑号的下一次远征将攻击云峰山脉以西海岸的一个海盗基地，该地位于泰瑟尔以北很远，且正好在前往烛堡的路上。我们接受了他随行此次远征的提议，被他之后将我们送到博德之门港的承诺所吸引，那里离烛堡相当近。然而，在我们到达目的地之前，船遭到了一条龙的攻击，它声称是阿兹古尔卡派来消灭扎拉拉的。那条龙不知怎地召来了一场巨大的闪电风暴，摧毁了船，船不久后搁浅，并杀死了大部分船员。扎拉拉和我安全地被冲上岸，但那条龙现在找到了我们，仍打算杀死我们。扎拉拉声称在离此以东不远处看到一个洞穴，并建议我们逃进去，因为龙应该太大而无法跟进。我没有更好的主意，因为那条龙似乎太强大，无法成功对抗。
src: We have succeeded in acquiring a book of sufficient value to serve as the price of admittance to Candlekeep, after a long quest suggested to us by Densath Wayleben, an expert on rare volumes. With that accomplished, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram, who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting, and who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.\n\nCaptain Tefaram informed us that the Sword of Valkur's next expedition will be an attack on a pirate base on the coast west of the Cloud Peak mountains, a good distance north of Tethyr and well on the way to Candlekeep. We accepted his offer to go along on this expedition, lured by his promise to drop us off afterwards at the port of Baldur's Gate, quite near to Candlekeep. Before we could reach our destination, however, the ship was attacked by a dragon, who claimed to have been sent by Azghulkar to eliminate Zarala. The dragon somehow called down a massive lightning storm which wrecked the ship, which ran aground soon thereafter, and killed much of its crew. Zarala and I were safely washed ashore, but the dragon has now found us and still means to kill us. Zarala claims to have seen a cave a little ways to the east of here, and has suggested we flee inside as the dragon should be too large to follow. I do not have a better idea, as the dragon seems far too powerful to be successfully fought.

dst:
我已与达伦·索尔伯爵谈过，他正寻求雇佣兵来对抗其领地上的怪物入侵。比大多数同类怪物更强大的熊地精和大地精团伙频繁出现在伯爵乡间庄园周围的土地上，他悬赏每带回一个熊地精或大地精的头颅便支付100金币，希望能借此削减它们的数量。我可以通过伯爵城中住所内的传送门前往那座乡间庄园，该住所位于码头以北、市场以西的区域。到达那里后，我便可以开始巡视乡间，搜寻地精类生物。伯爵还让我与那里的资深仆人，一位名叫林·梅伦多斯的人交谈，以便上交头颅或处理此事引发的其他问题。

目前尚不清楚我是否有可能彻底消灭所有地精类生物，但尽我所能减轻它们的威胁很可能有利可图。此外，如果我停止巡视并返回城中，我随时都能通过传送门回来继续猎杀怪物，因此只要我有需要，这有可能成为一项稳定的收入来源。

在巡视过程中，我在大地精的尸体上发现了一些地图碎片。将它们全部拼合后，显现出一个标记地点，既然我现在知道了，便能够前往那里。那或许正是这些地精类生物的主要基地，也可能是某处重要宝藏的所在地。无论如何，都值得一探。
src:
I have spoken to Count Daren Thorl, who sought to hire mercenaries in order to combat monstrous incursions on his lands. Bands of Bugbears and Hobgoblins, more powerful than most such monsters, have been appearing frequently in the lands surrounding the Count's country estate, and he has offered a bounty of 100 gold for every Bugbear or Hobgoblin head adventurers can bring back, in hopes of thinning their numbers. I can travel to the country estate through a portal found in the Count's residence in the city, which is in an area north of the docks and west of the markets. Once there, I can commence to patrol the countryside in search of goblinoids. The Count has also told me to speak to the senior servant there, one Rin Merendos, to turn in heads or deal with any other questions raised by this matter.

It is not clear that it will be possible for me to ever eliminate all the goblinoids, but doing what I can to reduce their threat could well prove profitable. Furthermore, if I leave off patrolling and return to the city, I will be able to return by the portal for more monster hunting whenever it is convenient, so this has the potential to be a regular source of income, if I find myself in need of such.

In the course of patrolling, I found pieces of a map on the bodies of Hobgoblins. Assembling them all has revealed a marked location, to which, now that I know of it, I would be able to travel. It might perhaps be the main base of these goblinoids, or possibly the site of some significant treasure. In any case it might be worth investigating.

src: This book is a manual intended to assist anyone who has become a werecreature against his will in mitigating or even curing his condition. Among other information, it contains formulae for using the belladonna herb to concoct potions that may cure those afflicted with lycanthropy. It warns that these do not always work reliably and can sometimes kill the subject, but provides guidance in ways to reduce the probability of such an unsatisfactory outcome. Anyone seeking to combat a lycanthropic curse could hardly find a better reference manual.

dst: "这需要解释一下。你需要去北边的维尔德斯森林。"他继续翻看文件。"幸好你是半兽人，否则我无法建议你去寻找这本特别的书。你看，许多世纪以前，一位特别杰出的兽人军阀名叫古尔古穆克，他崛起并统一了星塔山脉中的许多部落。他有着漫长而辉煌的军事胜利生涯。作为兽人，这意味着周围所有其他种族的巨大不幸……但我们别纠结于此。事实上，他作为战士如此成功，据说他实际上是因年老而死，这对兽人领袖来说是最了不起的成就。"
src: "That requires a bit of explanation. You'll need to go to the Wealdath forest to the north." He continues looking through papers. "It is good you are a half-orc or I would not be able to suggest searching for this particular book. You see, many centuries ago, a particularly distinguished orcish warlord named Gurgumuk arose and united many of the tribes in the Starspire mountains. He had a long and glorious career of military successes. Being an orc, that meant great misfortune for every other race around...but let's not dwell on that. He was in fact so successful as a warrrior that it is said he actually died of old age, a most remarkable accomplishment for a leader of orcs."

dst: 在击败牛头人海盗的过程中，瓦尔库尔之剑号的船员发现了一些海图，上面标明了其他海盗基地的位置。其中一处是一群人类海盗的基地，他们早就想除掉这群海盗，所以我们的下一站就是他们所在的那座岛。扎拉拉和我自然会参与这次进攻。我们已经航行了好几天，很快就要接近目标了。在与船长交谈、了解我们在即将到来的战斗中担任什么角色时，我得知我们将乘坐小船进行隐秘的夜袭。扎拉拉和我将加入船员主力，进攻海盗的船，而船长本人则率领一支分队袭击海岸。\n\n我们偷偷登上了海盗船，等那边的事看起来已经稳操胜券，便荡下船去，前往海岸支援船长的进攻。船长的队伍已经烧毁了看起来是海盗主要营地的所在，并在我们的帮助下击败了一些海盗。此事完成后，船长建议我们探索岛上其余的地方，看看是否还能找到更多海盗。绝不能让他们任何人逃脱。
src: In the process of defeating the minotaur pirates, the Sword of Valkur's crew discovered some charts indicating the locations of other pirate bases. One of them is the base of a group of human pirates they have long been hoping to put out of business, so our next stop will be the island where they can be found. Naturally Zarala and I will be taking part in this assault. We have been sailing for several days and will soon be approaching our target. Upon speaking to the captain to discover our part in the upcoming battle, I learned that we would be making a stealthy night assault in small craft. Zarala and I will join the main body of the crew in an assault on the pirates' ship, while the captain himself leads a secondary attack on the shore.\n\nWe snuck on board the pirate vessel and, once that work seemed well in hand, swung off the ship and went to the shore to support the captain's assault. The captain's party had burned what appeared to be the main pirate encampment, and defeated some of the pirates about with our help. With that done, the captain has suggested that we explore the rest of the island to see if there are any more pirates to be found. None of them should be permitted to escape.

Duration: 10 min./level
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 17
Metapsionics: Extend

You create a circle on the floor or other horizontal surface that teleports, as greater teleport, any creature who stands on it to a designated spot. Once you designate the destination for the circle, you cant change it. The power fails if you attempt to set the circle to teleport creatures into a solid object, to a place with which you are not familiar and have no clear description, or to another plane.

The circle itself is subtle and nearly impossible to notice. If you intend to keep creatures from activating it accidentally, you need to mark the circle in some way.

Note: Magic traps such as teleportation circle are hard to detect and disable. A rogue (only) can use the Search skill to find the circle and Disable Device to thwart it. The DC in each case is 25 + spell level, or 34 in the case of teleportation circle.

src: Trolls are horrid, voracious monsters, who will eagerly devour anything from grubs to humanoids. They know no fear and attack unceasingly when hungry. Even experienced adventurers often prefer to avoid these beasts, on account of their amazing regenerative powers. Trolls are almost impossible to kill if one does not have fire or acid on hand: wounds caused by anything else will usually regenerate as fast as they are inflicted. It is doubtful you will be able to defeat this creature: flight, stealth or some sort of trickery would seem your best options when dealing with it.

You fashion an ephemeral mass of pseudo-living ectoplasm called an ectoplasmic shambler. As the consistency of the ectoplasmic shambler is that of thick mist, those within the shambler are blinded. In addition, manifesting powers (or casting spells) within the shambler is difficult due to the constant turbulence felt by those caught in the shambler's form.

Creatures enveloped by the shambler, regardless of Armor Class, take 1 point of damage for every two manifester levels you have in each round they become or remain within the roiling turbulence of the shambler. Anyone trying to manifest a power must make a Concentration check (DC 15 + power's or spell's level) to successfully manifest a power or cast a spell inside the shambler.

The subject withers away, losing physical abilities to the point of utter and complete weakness and frailty. 3 times per round, the subject must make a Fortitude saving throw, or else lose one point in either Constitution, Strength, or Dexterity. src: "As you must have already gathered, I am a Paladin of Tyr and a Noble of Calimshan. In my youth I was an adventurer not unlike yourself. Now I serve as a general in the Calishite Army, and an adviser to the Syl-Pasha. While the Syl-Pasha and I frequently disagree about what is best for our nation, my rank was great enough, and my services to the nation sufficiently impressive, that he felt he had no choice but to reward me with appropriate offices and titles. I strive always to serve our glorious nation of Calimshan, both by protecting it from any threat, and by doing what I can to end our occasional moral lapses: the slave trade, for example."

dst:
欧律诺墨, Mother of the Material
  
欧律诺墨 grants lordship over the beasts of land, seas, and air. She also gives those with whom she binds some of the might of titans.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 21
Special Requirement: 欧律诺墨 hates Amon for some unknown reason and will not answer your call if you are already bound to him.

Influence: 欧律诺墨's influence makes you paranoid and ungrateful; you see secret motives and possible betrayals behind every action. 欧律诺墨 requires that you not attack a foe unless an ally has already done so. If no allies are present, she makes no such requirement

Granted Abilities: 
欧律诺墨 grants you the ability to befriend animals and wield a massive hammer. In addition, she turns your blood into poison and gives you resistance to weapon blows.

Animal Friend: All animals automatically have an initial attitude of friendly toward you.

Damage Reduction: You gain damage reduction 2/+3。

欧律诺墨's Maul: You summon a magic warhammer (1d8+1d4 bludgeoning damage, ? crit). You are proficient with this weapon and can wield it without penalty. Your warhammer's exact bonus and abilities depend on your effective binder level, according to the following table.
Effective Binder Level Warhammer Summoned
10th or lower +1 warhammer
11th-14th +1 anarchic warhammer
15th-18th +1 anarchic adamantine warhammer
19th or higher +3 anarchic adamantine warhammer

Poison Blood: While you are bound to 欧律诺墨, your blood becomes poisonous. Any creature that makes a bite attack against you must immediately make a successful Fortitude save or take 1d6 points of damage. After 1 minute, the creature must make another Fortitude save at the same DC or take another 1d6 points of damage per three effective binder levels you possess (maximum 5d6). Each bite attack poisons the creature anew, forcing a new round of saving throws.

dst: "正是我所希望的。这是我提供的交易：在北边的一个房间里，你会找到一道传送门，你可以用它快速前往我的乡下庄园。到了那里，你可以出去在周围的乡村游荡，寻找熊地精之类的。每收集一个熊地精或大地精的头颅，你将获得100金币的赏金。外面有很多，所以我不知道你是否能全部杀死，但你为减少他们数量所做的任何事情都是好事。此外，你可以随时使用传送门回到城市，补给或做其他事情，然后回来继续狩猎。随你喜欢重复，只要你能找到怪物，你就可以继续杀死它们以获得更多赏金。"
src: "Exactly what I'm hoping. Here's the deal I'm offering: in a room to the north you'll find a portal that you can use to quickly travel to my country estate. Once there you can go out and wander the surrounding countryside, looking for bugbears and such. You'll be paid a bounty of 100 gold for every bugbear or hobgoblin head you collect. There are a lot of them out there so I don't know that you can kill them all, but anything you do to thin the population will be all to the good. Also, you can use the portal at any time to come back to the city, resupply or do other business, and return for more hunting. Repeat as you like, as long as you're finding monsters you can keep killing them for more bounties."

You don't have to complete all, or any given one, of these, but it would be helpful to do as many as you can. Three, some passages are protected by better locks than others. If you can't proceed down one route, try another. I think that's about everything relevant that I know."

dst:
（进阶职业）
战斗魔法通常保留给那些满足于从前线战斗人员的掩护后像火炮一样投掷法咒的二线施法者。毁灭法师则不然，他与战士的共同点不亚于与法师的共同点。毁灭法师学会了以如此鲁莽的方式施放法咒，以至于他可以同时用剑和法咒进行正面战斗，而不会招致其他施法者必须面对的苦涩后果。毁灭法师感兴趣的是在最短的时间内造成最大的杀戮，凭借在敌人最意想不到的地方快速施法。毁灭法师必须首先学习奥术魔法的方式，因此最有可能拿起剑（以补充魔杖）的是术士和法师。这些通常沉着的角色被战斗的狂热所吸引，在此期间，一把闪光的剑在他们手中可以像适时施放的法咒一样有效。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 擅长：毁灭法师不会获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

奥术施法：能够施放 2 级法咒。
基础攻击加值：+4
技能：知识 5 级。

职业特性：

等级
1：战斗施法 2 级 - 毁灭法师获得在进行一次武器攻击时施放 2 级或更低法咒的能力。以这种方式施放法咒不会引发借机攻击。
3：战斗施法 4 级
5：战斗施法 8 级

奖励法咒

毁灭法师每两个等级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高奥术施法者职业中也提升了一个等级。他不会通过其能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Combat magic is usually reserved for spellcasters in the second rank who are content to lob spells as if artillery from behind the cover of front-rank combatants. Not so the havoc mage, who shares as much in common with a fighter as with a wizard. The havoc mage has learned to toss off spells with such reckless abandon that he can fight head-to-head with both sword and spell without incurring the bitter consequences other spellcasters must contend with. A havoc mage is interested in maximum carnage in the shortest amount of time, by dint of a quick spell cast where an enemy least expects it. A havoc mage must first learn the ways of arcane magic, so those most likely to take up the sword (to complement the wand) are sorcerers and wizards. These normally sedate characters are drawn to the frenzy of battle, during which a flashing sword can be just as effect in their own hands as a well timed spell.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A havoc mage does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Arcane Spellcasting: Able to cast 2nd-level spells.
Base Attack Bonus: +4
Skills: Lore 5 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Battlecast 2nd level - A havoc mage gains the ability to cast 2nd level or lower spells while making a single weapon attack. Casting a spell in this manner does not provoke an attack of opportunity.
3: Battlecast 4th level
5: Battlecast 8th level

BONUS SPELLS

Every other level in Havoc Mage, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest arcane caster class. He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

dst: "我现在已经拥有全部三块碎片了。你完成了我的任务，作为回报，我可以如约为你提供一条离开幽暗地域的出路。正如我所说，这将涉及穿越诸界。我会首先将你传送到巴托的一座堡垒。如果你能穿过它，就会找到一个传送门，将你带到另一个外层界领域，那里有一片充满奇异野兽的森林，在森林的尽头，你可以到达通往天界一座堡垒的传送门。在这座堡垒内，你可以找到一个传送门，它会将你送回主物质界，位于地表之下的一座洞穴中，在被称为云峰的山脉北侧。你可以很容易地从那里上去，再从那里前往地表的任何地方。你准备好后，我随时可以传送你，但你可能希望先做好准备，因为这条路线可能非常危险。你将穿过的那些领域的居民都很强大，任何一个都可能攻击你，这取决于你与哪些力量结盟。"
src: "I now have all three pieces. You have accomplished my task, and in return I can provide you a way out of the Underdark, as promised. As I said, this will involve traversing the planes. I will initially transport you to a fortress in Baator. If you make your way through it you will find a portal taking you to another extraplanar realm, containing a forest filled with strange beasts, and at the end of the forest you can reach a portal to a fortress in the Celestial Realm. Within this fortress, you can find a portal that will return you to the Prime, in a cave just below the surface, on the north side of the mountains known as Cloudpeaks. You can easily go up from there, and from thence travel to any point on the surface. I can transport you any time you are ready, but you may wish to prepare yourself first, as this route might be very dangerous. The inhabitants of the realms you will go through are all powerful, and any might attack you, depending on what powers you are aligned with."

We will have to defeat him, and in addition to searching for his book, we will now have to search for Vido's coffin so his unlife can be permanently ended. Otherwise we must expect he will keep returning in attempts to kill us.\n\nWe have found Vido's coffin, and ended his cursed unlife.

src: After defeating some giants for the benefit of the proprietor of a roadside inn, Boran Trazal, I slept at the inn only to find that during my unconsciousness I had been transported to some underground chamber, stripped of my weaponry. From a nearby note, it appears the inn owners plan to play some sort of sadistic game with me, forcing me to survive some series of obstacles or attacks in order to get out of here. The note also indicates I can start my escape either by exiting through a door immediately to the north of my starting point, which I am warned will be more difficlut, or by exiting to a door a bit west of this point. To access this latter door, I am informed that I must pull a lever that will open a path to it, but at the cost of killing another inn guest trapped beyond.\n\nIt seems I have little choice for now but to play along with this game. I choose to open the path to the more easterly door. Unfortunately this killed the other prisoner, but our lives are more important.

src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nThe goblins are using an old fortress as a base. Unfortunately the only way in is blocked by a field of magical force, but a pixie named Zeepa has told me that one Gorav, a lieutenant of the goblin leader Ulaz, should have a wardstone that allows access to it.

dst: 我们在路边一个农场遇到的小男孩告诉我们，他的狗杜克失踪了，并请求我们帮忙寻找。我们搜寻后找到了那只狗，过程中还发现一群地精在附近的洞穴系统中构成了威胁。现在这两个问题都已解决：杜克已回到家中，地精也被击败了。
src: A young boy we came across on a farm on the side of the road told us that his dog, Duke, has gone missing, and has asked us to look for him. We searched and found the dog, and in the process also discovered a band of goblins who had taken up a threatening presence in a nearby cave system. Neither is any longer a problem: Duke has been returned to his home and the goblins defeated.

dst: “早些时候，我带给这个村庄一件魔法神器，可以建立保护场，阻止敌人进入，当时以为这里无知的牲口确实值得保护。但幸运的是，我的愚蠢被纠正了，因为这件神器无法保护他们免受内部威胁。不过，它仍有助于将烦人的入侵者数量降到最低。由于这件神器，来到这里的人通常是半身人种族中的杰出个体，适合成为新同伴。如果你证明是这种人，我也许会赐予你不朽。但这取决于你的价值。我们将看看我杀死你需要多久。如果你死得太快，我就知道除了食物，你毫无价值。”
src: "Earlier, I had brought to this village a magical artifact that could set up a protective field, preventing enemies from entering, thinking at the time that the ignorant cattle here actually deserved protection. But fortunately my foolishness was undone, for this artifact could not protect them from a threat arising within. Still, it has been helpful in keeping the number of annoying intruders to a minimum. Because of the artifact, those who do come here are usually exceptional instances of the halfling race, suitable for becoming new companions. If you prove to be such, I may grace you with immortality too. But that depends on your worthiness. We will see how long it takes me to slay you. If you die too quickly, I will know you have no value except as food."

dst: "现在我们需要着手恢复对海姆的崇拜，并修复格鲁扎尔造成的其他破坏。我想你还有自己的事情要办，我们已经耽搁你太久了。再次感谢你。"
src: "Now we will need to be about restoring the worship of Helm, and otherwise repairing the damage done by Gruzhaur. I expect you have other business of your own, from which we have kept you too long. Again, you have our thanks."

施法时间：1个标准动作

效果：射线
持续时间：1分钟/等级
豁免检定：无
法术抗力：是（物体）

一道绿色射线从你伸出的手中射出。你必须进行远程接触攻击来击中目标。任何被射线击中的生物或物体都被一个闪烁的翡翠场覆盖，完全阻挡跨维度旅行。被次元锚禁止的移动形式包括星界投影，闪现，任意门，以太漫步，灵体化，异界之门，迷宫术，位面转移，阴影行走，传送以及类似的类法咒或灵能能力。该法咒还在持续时间内阻止使用异界之门或传送法阵。

次元锚不会干扰施法时已经处于灵体或星界形态的生物的移动，也不会阻挡跨维度感知或攻击形式。此外，次元锚不会阻止召唤生物在召唤法咒结束时消失。
src:
School: Abjuration
Level: Clr 4, Sor/Wiz 4
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect: Ray
Duration: 1 min./level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes (object)

A green ray springs from your outstretched hand. You must make a ranged touch attack to hit the target. Any creature or object struck by the ray is covered with a shimmering emerald field that completely blocks extradimensional travel. Forms of movement barred by a dimensional anchor include astral projection, blink, dimension door, ethereal jaunt, etherealness, gate, maze, plane shift, shadow walk, teleport, and similar spell-like or psionic abilities. The spell also prevents the use of a gate or teleportation circle for the duration of the spell.

A dimensional anchor does not interfere with the movement of creatures already in ethereal or astral form when the spell is cast, nor does it block extradimensional perception or attack forms. Also, dimensional anchor does not prevent summoned creatures from disappearing at the end of a summoning spell.
