dst: "当然。你先把试剂放入机器，然后去操作拉杆，这需要你投入一百金币。火甲虫腹、妖精尘、食人魔蛛腺、史莱姆或软泥的脓液、沼泽莓、石化蜥蜴眼、石像鬼头骨和蓝石英晶体都是可以组合产生有用东西的物品。正确的组合可以产生有用的药剂。错误的组合会消耗试剂却毫无益处，有时甚至可能产生危险的爆炸。我建议尝试三种，且只有三种，不同试剂的组合，最有可能产生好结果。"
src: "Certainly. You first put reagents into the machine, then go to operate the lever, which requires you to insert one hundred gold. Fire beetle bellys, fairy dust, ettercap glands, the ichor from a slime or ooze, fenberries, basilisk's eyes, gargoyle skulls and blue quartz crystals are all items that might be combined to produce something useful. The right combination of these can produce a useful elixir. Wrong combinations will consume the reagents for no benefit, and might in some cases even produce a dangerous explosion. I suggest trying combinations of three, and only three, separate reagents, as most likely to produce good results."

dst: 最终扎拉拉稍微恢复了一些，回到她之前开始说的话。"既然泽卡尔胜利了，他将拥有比以往更多的权力和政治影响力，而且他显然想要我死。所以我们需要逃到他的势力范围之外。停靠在这里的船……名叫瓦尔库尔之剑，是一艘主要追捕海盗的私掠船。我父亲过去帮过他们，说船长欠他一个人情，并且已经和他安排好，必要时把我带出城。"
src: Eventually Zarala recovers herself somewhat and returns to what she started to say earlier. "With Zekar victorious, he'll have more power and political influence than ever, and he apparently wants me dead. So we'll need to flee beyond his reach. The ship docked here...it's named Sword of Valkur, it's a privateer that mostly hunts down pirates. My father helped them out with that in the past and said her captain owes him a favor, and that he'd arranged with him to have me taken out of the city if necessary."

dst: "但愿如此。你要带给我的是塞尔哈德圣甲虫，帕夏米尔达斯·塞尔哈德著名的传家宝。当他不佩戴它出席国事活动时，它就被锁在他庄园地下室的宝库里。那座庄园就位于贵族区的正中央。找到它不难，但进去就是另一回事了。那里有大量守卫和结界，你绝不可能从正门进去。不过，有一条穿过下方下水道进入地下室的路线。当然，那里有一把好锁，所以不是随便什么人都能从那进去的，但一个好盗贼可以。"
src: "Let's hope so. What you're going to be bringing me is the Serkhad Scarab, the famed heirloom of Pasha Myrdas Serkhad. When's he's not wearing it to affairs of state, it's kept locked in his treasure vault in the basement of his estate. The estate in question is located right in the middle of the Noble District. It won't be hard to find, but getting in is another question. It's got plenty of guards and wards and there's no way you're getting in through the main entrance. However, there is a route into the basement through the sewers underneath. It's got a good lock, of course, so not just anyone would be getting in that way, but a good thief could."

dst: "让我来拿这些文件吧，<FirstName>。我会确保它们被送到适当的当局手中。可惜我怀疑这不会有多大用：这些贵族影响力太大，不容易扳倒，而且在他们各种阴谋中抛出了那么多虚假指控，真的指控也很可能没人信。不过，职责要求我们必须尝试。"
src: "Let me take those papers, <FirstName>. I'll see they are brought to the appropriate authorities. Unfortunately I doubt they will do much good: these nobles have too much influence to be easily brought down, and with so many false accusations flung about in their various intrigues, true ones are likely to be disbelieved. Duty requires that we make the attempt, however."

龙火面具

描述符：龙族，火焰
职业：图腾师
脉轮：额头，喉咙（图腾）
豁免检定：见正文

魂能形成一个暗蓝色火焰的龙头，环绕你的头部并漂浮在你的肩膀上方。它直视前方，表情不变。龙头的眼睛和嘴巴充满了更明亮，闪烁的火焰，射出光芒。

当这个灵魂融合被塑造时，你获得昏暗视觉。

魂能：每投入一点魂能到你的龙火面具中，你在侦察检定上获得+2能力加值。

脉轮绑定（额头）

你自己的眼睛闪烁着与龙首内燃烧的相同火焰。

你获得60英尺的黑暗视觉（或你现有的黑暗视觉再延伸30英尺）.

脉轮绑定（喉咙）

一个沸腾的火环环绕你的脖子，龙首偶尔喷出缕缕烟雾。

你获得作为一个标准动作发出火焰喷吐武器的能力。喷吐武器是一个30英尺锥形，造成2d6点火焰伤害 + 每投入一点魂能到你的龙火面具中额外1d6点火焰伤害。目标允许反射豁免减半伤害。使用喷吐武器后，你必须等待1d4轮才能再次使用。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

龙首变成一个实心的蓝色面具，形成一个空心形状，在远处完全包围你的头部。火焰仍然从它的眼睛和张开的嘴巴中拖出。

你可以每轮一次作为一个迅捷动作发出恐惧存在光环。所有10英尺内生命骰少于你的生物变得战栗1轮。成功的意志豁免否定效果，并使该生物对24小时内这个灵魂融合的恐惧存在免疫。每投入一点魂能到你的龙火面具中，恐惧存在的半径增加10英尺，持续时间增加1轮。
src:
Dragonfire Mask

Descriptors: Draconic, Fire
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Brow, throat (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms a dragon head of dull blue fire that wreaths your head and floats above your shoulders. It stares straight ahead, its expression unchanging. The eyes and mouth of the dragon head are full of brighter, flickering fire that shoots out light.

You gain low-light vision while this soulmeld is shaped.

Essentia: For every point of essentia invested in your dragonfire mask, you gain a +2 competence bonus on Spot checks.

Chakra Bind (Brow)

Your own eyes flicker with the same flames that burn within your dragon head.

You gain darkvision out to 60 feet (or your existing darkvision extends another 30 feet).

Chakra Bind (Throat)

A seething ring of fire encircles your neck, and wisps of smoke occasionally burst from the dragon head.

You gain the ability to emit a fiery breath weapon as a standard action. The breath weapon is a 30-foot cone that deals 2d6 points of fire damage + an extra 1d6 points of fire damage for every point of essentia invested in your dragonfire mask. Targets are allowed a Reflex save for half damage. After using your breath weapon, you must wait 1d4 rounds before you can use it again.

Chakra Bind (Totem)

The dragon head becomes a solid blue mask, forming a hollow shape that completely encloses your head at a distance. Fire still trails from its eyes and open mouth.

You can emanate an aura of frightful presence once per round as a swift action. All creatures within 10 feet with fewer Hit Dice than you become shaken for 1 round. A successful Will save negates the effect and renders the creature immune to the frightful presence of this soulmeld for 24 hours. For every point of essentia you have invested in your dragonfire mask, the radius of the frightful presence increases by 10 feet, and its duration increases by 1 round.

dst:
林灾审判者是处理那些不光彩之事--通常涉及清除人类--的首选之人。当精灵的敌人无论在物理，魔法还是政治上都有周全保护时--而那些伟大的领主和贵妇们又不敢为了从人类侵占中保护精灵家园的核心而弄脏自己的手--他们便会求助于你，林灾审判者。你手持长弓，自然之力听你号令，你出击，一个无声无息的狙击手，解决掉二十个外交官一百年也解决不了的问题--然后在敌人残余势力还没意识到你曾在那里之前，就已融回森林之中。

需求：
基础攻击加值：+6
技能：制造武器 8，躲藏 8，学识 4，潜行 8
专长：近程射击，武器专攻（长弓）

职业特性：
生命骰：d8

施法：你按照以下表格获得每日法咒。你不会在任何已有施法职业上获得每日法咒。你只能从正义法咒列表中选择法咒。

      1级    2级    3级   4级
1     0      -      -     -
2     1      -      -     -
3     2      0      -     -
4     3      1      -     -
5     3      2      0     -
6     3      3      1     -
7     3      3      2     0
8     3      3      3     1
9     3      3      3     2
10    3      3      3     3

奖励专长：在第2级和第8级时，你获得一个奖励弓术专长。当你获得一个新的奖励专长时，你必须从以下列表中选择：拨挡箭矢，远射，精通重击（长弓），精通精准射击，多重射击，骑乘射击，精准射击，快速射击，移动射击，抓取箭矢，武器专精（仅限长弓），高等武器专攻（仅限长弓），高等武器专精（仅限长弓）.你必须满足奖励专长的所有先决条件。在判断你是否满足最低战士等级的先决条件时，使用你的正义等级。例如，一个8级巡林客/8级正义会满足高等武器专攻的要求（战士等级8级），但不满足高等武器专精的要求（战士等级12级）.

林地 stride (Ex)：在第2级时，你可以穿过任何类型的灌木丛。

偷袭（Ex）：从第3级和第7级开始，当你攻击一个失去敏捷加值到护甲的对手时，你造成额外1d6点伤害，例如当它被突袭且措手不及时，或当你从侧翼位置攻击时，如同游荡者的偷袭能力。你的伤害骰与你可能从先前职业获得的任何偷袭伤害骰叠加。

幸运射击（Su）：每天一次，作为一个自由动作，你可以用你的长弓在一次攻击骰上获得+10洞察加值。

无痕步（Ex）：在第4级及更高时，你在自然环境中不留下痕迹，并且无法被追踪。如果你愿意，你可以故意留下痕迹。

用毒（Ex）：在第5级时，你学会制造和/或提取天然毒药，并将其应用于你的武器而没有任何伤害自己的危险。

src:
The justice of weald and woe is the go-to person when something unsavory - usually involving the removal of humans - needs doing. When the foes of the elves are well protected physically, magically, and politically - and the grand lords and ladies dare not sully their hands with the dirty necessities of preserving the heart of elvendom from human encroachment - it is to you, the justice of weald and woe, that they turn. With your bow in hand and the power of nature at your command, you strike, a silent, unseen sniper, solving problems a score of diplomats couldn't solve in a hundred years - then melt back into the forest before what is left of the enemy's forces even knows you were there.

Requirements:
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Craft Weapon 8, Hide 8, Lore 4, Move Silently 8
Feats: Point Blank Shot, Weapon Focus (Longbow)

CLASS FEATURES:
Hit die: d8

Spellcasting: You gain spells per day as per the following tables.  You do not gain spells per day in any existing spellcasting class.  You can only choose spells from the justice spell list.

      1st    2nd    3rd   4th
1     0      -      -     -
2     1      -      -     -
3     2      0      -     -
4     3      1      -     -
5     3      2      0     -
6     3      3      1     -
7     3      3      2     0
8     3      3      3     1
9     3      3      3     2
10    3      3      3     3

Bonus Feats: At 2nd and 8th levels, you gain a bonus archery feat. When you gain a new bonus feat, you must choose from the following list: Deflect Arrows, Far Shot, Improved Critical (longbow), Improved Precise Shot, Manyshot, Mounted Archery, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Shot on the Run, Snatch Arrows, Weapon Specialization (longbow only), Greater Weapon Focus (longbow only), Greater Weapon Specialization (longbow only). You must meet all prerequisites for a bonus feat. Use your justice level when determining whether you meet a prerequisite of a minimum fighter level. For example, a ranger 8/justice 8 would meet the requirement for Greater Weapon Focus (fighter level 8th), but not Greater Weapon Specialization (fighter level 12th).

Woodland Stride (Ex): At 2nd level, you can move through any sort of undergrowth.

Sneak Attack (Ex): Beginning at 3rd and 7th level, you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage when striking an opponent when the opponent is denied a Dexterity bonus to armor class, such as when it is surprised and flat-footed, or when you attack from
a flanking position, as the sneak attack ability of rogues. Your damage dice stack with any sneak attack damage dice you might have gained from a previous class.

Lucky Shot (Su): Once per day as a free action, you can gain a +10 insight bonus to one attack roll with your longbow.

Trackless Step (Ex): At 4th level and higher, you leave no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked. You can leave a trail on purpose if you so desire.

Poison Use (Ex): At 5th level, you learn to create and/or extract natural poisons and apply them to your weapons without any danger of harming yourself.

Hide in Plain Sight (Ex): At 9th level, you gain the ability to hide in plain sight.

Death Attack (Ex): At 10th level, you gain the ability to study your victim for 3 rounds and then make a sneak attack with a longbow that, if it successfully deals damage, has the additional effect of possibly either paralyzing or killing the target (your choice).

Poison Immunity (Ex): At 10th level, you gain immunity to poisons and animal venoms.

src:
Ankheg Breastplate

Descriptors: Acid 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Throat (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

A thick, chitinous breastplate forms around your torso. The green plates of the armor glisten like the thorax of a living insect. Soft tissue and living muscle bind the plates together, rather than the chain and leather of conventional armor.

Your ankheg breastplate grants you a +2 armor bonus to your Armor Class. 

Essentia: For every point of essentia you invest in your ankheg breastplate, the armor bonus granted by the soulmeld improves by 1. 

Chakra Bind (Throat) 

Green chitin spreads from your breastplate up your neck, blending into your skin there. This thickened skin seems to pulse slowly, in a rhythm unrelated to the beat of your heart or the movement of your breath.

You gain the ability to spit a line of acid as a standard action. Once per minute, you can emit a line of acid that is 5 feet long plus 5 feet per point of invested essentia. Targets in the line take 2d6 points of acid damage plus 1d6 points for every point of invested essentia. They can reduce this damage by half with a successful Reflex save. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Green-brown chitin spreads from your breastplate up your neck to your face, and you sprout serrated mandibles like those of a giant insect. Outside of combat, they slowly open and close without any conscious direction. In battle, you can use these terrible clenching jaws to tear the flesh of your foes. When you shift essentia to this soulmeld, the mandibles sizzle with acid.

You gain a bite attack that deals 1d8 points of damage. You can use this bite as a primary attack. Every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld adds 1d4 points of acid damage to your bite damage.

dst:
（基础职业）
万物皆归于暗影，甚至光亦是如此。暗影并不代表光的缺失；它们昭示着黑暗的存在。因此，暗影与黑暗并非死亡或消亡；它们是宇宙的基本状态，是过去存在，现在存在，并将在万物寂灭之时依然存在的恒常。影之平面亦是如此，它是物质位面与诸多其他现实的黑暗镜像。影法师汲取这最根本的力量与位面，以施行其黑暗意志。通过将自身与影之平面相连，他们维系着与存在终极力量的微弱联系。

影法师理解黑暗真正原始的力量，使自身与影之平面同调，并习得堪比任何寻常法咒的伟大暗影秘术。这些黑暗施法者是异界魔法的操控者，拥有着连其他施法者都感到不安的，对世界与魔法的秘传理解。他们是黑暗力量的主人 - 也许，正如某些人所担忧的，也是其仆从。

- 生命骰：d6
- 擅长：你擅长所有简易武器。你不擅长任何类型的护甲或盾牌。任何类型的护甲都会干扰你的手势，这可能导致你的秘术在作为法咒运作时失败。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

职业特性：

等级
1：暗影基础 - 你初始可获取 3 个基础秘术，它们作为超自然能力运作，每天可使用 3 次。
    学徒秘术 - 你可以学习学徒秘术。
2：奖励专长
3：幽影视觉 - 黑暗视觉
4：奖励基础秘术
7：学徒秘术（类法咒），入门秘术
8：奖励基础秘术
11：幽影视觉 - 昏暗视觉
12：奖励基础秘术
13：学徒秘术（超自然），入门秘术（类法咒），大师秘术
14：基础秘术无限使用
15：维系暗影 I - 免疫毒素与疾病
16：奖励基础秘术
20：奖励基础秘术
    维系暗影 II - 免疫睡眠
    
秘术 - 你不像其他职业那样施放法咒，而是调用被称为秘术的神秘秘密。你在 1 级时知晓一个秘术，并且每提升一个职业等级再获得一个额外秘术。直到 6 级，你只能学习学徒秘术。在 7 级时，你获得入门秘术的获取权限，在 13 级时你能够使用大师秘术。在一个类别（学徒，入门，大师） 内，你只有学会了至少两个前一等级的秘术，才能学习一个新等级的秘术。然而，你总是可以选择你拥有获取权限的类别中最低等级的秘术。例如，即使你不知道任何 3 级秘术（所有这些都属于学徒类别），你也可以学习一个 4 级秘术（入门类别）.

当你只能施放学徒秘术时，你施放它们如同它们是奥术法咒。它们都具有姿势成分，基于护甲的法术失败率，并且可以被中断（但它们不需要材料成分，法器或语言成分）.在 7 级时，当你能够施放入门秘术时，你的学徒秘术作为类法术能力运作，并且不再需要姿势成分。你新的入门秘术作为奥术法咒运作，并遵循上述规则。当你达到 13 级并能够施放大师秘术时，另一个变化发生了。你的大师秘术现在作为奥术法咒运作，而你的入门秘术作为类法术能力运作。你的学徒秘术变为超自然能力，其 DC 公式变为 10 + 1/2 施法者等级 + 魅力，并且施放时不再引发借机攻击。

你每天可以使用每个你所知晓的秘术一定次数，具体取决于它是作为法咒（一次），类法术能力（两次） 还是超自然能力（三次） 施放。为了施放一个秘术，你的智力属性必须至少达到 10 + 该秘术的等级。你的秘术豁免 DC 等于 10 + 秘术等级 + 你的魅力调整值。最后，如果你的魅力足够高，你每天会获得奖励秘术。这遵循与术士或法师相同的公式。
奖励专长 - 你获得的奖励专长数量等于你完成的总道途数（道途是3个秘术的集合，全部属于同一类别）.你必须满足先决条件才能选择专长作为奖励专长。你可以选择的专长列表包括偏好秘术，高等道途专攻，夜行施法者，道途专攻，暗影施法以及任何超魔暗影专长。
src:
(BASE CLASS)
All things fall into shadow, even light. Shadows do not represent the absence of light; they show the presence of darkness. Thus, shadow and darkness are not death or diminishment; they are the fundamental state of the universe, the constant that existed before, that exists now, and that will exist when all other things are snuffed out. So it is with the Plane of Shadow, that dark mirror to the Material Plane and many other realities. Shadowcasters tap into this most fundamental of forces and planes to work their dark wills. By tying themselves to the Plane of Shadow, they maintain a tenuous link to the ultimate force of existence. 

The shadowcaster understands the true, primal power of darkness, attunes herself to the Plane of Shadow, and learns great shadow mysteries the equal of any mundane spell. These dark casters are workers of alien magic, possessing an occult understanding of the world and magic that even other spellcasters find disturbing. They are masters of a dark power - and perhaps, as some worry, its servants as well.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: You are proficient with all simple weapons. You are not proficient with any type of armor or shield. Armor of any type interferes with your gestures, which can cause your mysteries to fail when they function as spells.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Fundamentals of Shadow - You start with access to 3 fundamentals, which function as supernatural abilities and can be used 3 times/day.
    Apprentice Mysteries - You can learn apprentice mysteries.
2:  Bonus Feats
3:  Umbral Sight - Darkvision
4:  Bonus fundamental
7:  Apprentice Mysteries (spell-like), Initiate Mysteries
8:  Bonus fundamental
11: Umbral Sight - Low Light Vision
12: Bonus fundamental
13: Apprentice Mysteries (supernatural), Initiate Mysteries (spell-like), Master Mysteries
14: Unlimited use of fundamentals
15: Sustaining Shadow I - Immune to poison and disease
16: Bonus fundamental
20: Bonus fundamental
    Sustaining Shadow II - Immune to sleep
    
Mysteries - You do not cast spells as other classes do, but instead invoke mystical secrets called mysteries. You know one mystery at 1st level and gain one additional mystery every class level. Up to 6th level, you can learn only apprentice mysteries. At 7th level, you gain access to initiate mysteries, and at 13th level you become able to use master mysteries. Within a category (apprentice, initiate, master), you can only learn mysteries of a new level if you have learned at least two mysteries of a previous level. However, you can always select the lowest level mysteries in a category you have access to. For example, you could learn a 4th level mystery (Initiate category), even if you know no 3rd level mysteries (all of which are in the Apprentice category). 

When you are capable of casting only apprentice mysteries, you cast them as though they were arcane spells. They all have somatic components, armor-based spell failure chance, and are subject to interruption (but they do not require material components, foci, or verbal components). At 7th level, when you become capable of casting initiate mysteries, your apprentice mysteries function as spell-like abilities, and they no longer require somatic components. Your new initiate mysteries function as arcane spells and follow the rules described above. When you reach 13th level and become capable of casting master mysteries, another change occurs. Your master mysteries now function as arcane spells, and your initiate mysteries function as spell-like abilities. Your apprentice mysteries become supernatural abilities, changing their DC formula to 10 + 1/2 caster level + Cha, and no longer generating attacks of opportunity when cast.

You can use each mystery you know a certain number of times per day depending on whether it is cast as a spell (once), a spell-like ability (two times), or a supernatural ability (three times). In order to cast a mystery, you must have an Intelligence score of at least 10 + the mystery's level. The save DC for your mysteries equals 10 + mystery level + your Cha modifier. Finally, you gain bonus mysteries per day if you have a high enough Charisma. This follows the same formula as sorcerer or wizard.

Bonus Feats - You gain a bonus feat equal to the total number of Paths you complete (Paths are collections of 3 mysteries, all within the same category). You must meet the prerequisites in order to select a feat as a bonus feat. The list of feats you can select is Favored Mystery, Greater Path Focus, Nocturnal Caster, Path Focus, Shadow Cast, and any metashadow feat.

This part of the city has been having increasing trouble with violent criminal activity, so Hamad thinks it would be best for his charitable contribution to be delivered by someone armed and combat-capable, such as myself. The temple has been having its own troubles trying to cope with the increasingly out-of control crime, and Hamad has also asked that when I arrive I put myself at the disposal of this Nasirak to assist him in improving conditions there in whatever manner he suggests. So I am off to the slums.\n\nI have delivered the contribution, completed all of the several tasks given me by Nasirak, and reported back to Hamad. He has given me a reward and I am now ready to move on to other tasks.

dst: "嗯，他曾是一位强大的卓尔巫师。据说他密谋反对卓尔母权制——那种将社会中任何男性，无论多么强大，都贬为从属角色的制度——并在众多巢穴中填满了武器和亡灵仆从（他在死灵法术方面有特殊天赋），计划用于某种叛乱。传说还说，在某个时候，他甚至杀死了自己的姐妹，并将她们变成某些巢穴中特别强大的亡灵守卫。这一切都发生在很久以前，相关记载不完整也不清楚，但看来他策划的无论什么叛乱最终都被击败了，他也从历史中消失了。然而，他的巢穴和其中的亡灵守卫仍然存在，至少许多仍然存在。对于像你这样的冒险者来说，它们可能是个机会，因为据说其中包含许多奇异而有价值的魔法，是泽克斯卡顿秘学研究的结果。不过，闯入这样的巢穴当然相当危险。"
src: "Well, he was once a Drow wizard of great power. It is said that he plotted against the Drow matriarchy that reduced any males of their society, however powerful, to a subordinate role, and filled numerous lairs with weapons and undead servants (he had a particular talent for necromancy), that he planned to use in some sort of revolt. At some point, or so legend says, he even killed his own sisters and set them as particularly powerful undead guardians of some of these lairs. This all happened a very long time ago, and accounts of it are incomplete and unclear, but it appears that whatever revolt he plotted was ultimately defeated, and he disappeared from history. His lairs and their undead guardians remain, however, or at least many of them do. They might be an opportunity for an adventurer like you, for they are said to contain much strange and valuable magic, the results of Xerxkatun's esoteric research. Invading such a lair would of course be quite dangerous, however."

dst:
（进阶职业）
夜术士弥合了暗影与奥术魔法之间的鸿沟。那些成功成为这些精英之一的人不仅提升了他们的秘术使用者和奥术施法者能力，而且能够像其他人一样操纵他人的秘术和法咒。

- 生命骰：d4
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：
技能：知识 6级，法咒辨识 6级
暗影施法：能够施展2级秘术
施法：能够施展2级奥术

职业特性：
等级
1： 捕获魔法之影（超自然） - 在1级时，当你成功解除一个秘术或法咒时，你可以吸收其能量。你将你解除的秘术或法术等级的一半
    加到你在下一轮施展的任何秘术或法咒的施法者等级上。
2： 天生反制法咒 - 从2级开始，你可以尝试在不使用准备动作的情况下反制法咒。每天一次，你可以作为一个即时动作反制法咒，通过消耗一个法术位或法咒使用，只要消耗的法咒与被反制的法术等级相同。
5： 天生反制法咒 - 2次/天
6： 邪术干扰 - 作为一个标准动作，你可以干扰60英尺内单个目标的魔法能量。该目标必须进行意志豁免（DC 10 + 你的夜术士等级 + 你的魅力调整值），否则其施展的任何秘术或法咒的施法者等级受到-4惩罚，持续1分钟。你可以每天使用邪术干扰三次。
7： 天生反制法咒（保留能量） - 当你使用此能力成功反制法咒时，你获得使用一个等级为被反制法术等级一半的秘术。
8： 天生反制法咒 - 3次/天
10：邪术漩涡 - 你可以以自己为中心20英尺半径速度爆发神秘能量。该区域内除你之外的任何生物，其施展的任何秘术或法咒的施法者等级受到-4惩罚。漩涡持续1分钟，每天可使用一次。
    暗影持久 - 你获得临时免疫，免疫任何通过你的捕获魔法之影或天生反制法咒能力捕获或反制的秘术或法咒。持续1分钟，你不能被该秘术或法咒的任何施法影响。

秘术/施法：在每一级，你获得新的每日秘术和法咒，以及施法者等级提升（以及已知秘术和法咒，如果适用），如同你在你的秘术使用职业和奥术施法职业中都提升了一级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Noctumancers bridge the gap between shadow and arcane magic. Those who succeed in becoming one of these elite not only gain a boost to their mystery user and arcane caster abilities, but are able to manipulate the mysteries and spells of others as no others can.

- Hit Die: d4
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Skills: Lore rank 6, Spellcraft rank 6
Shadowcasting: Able to cast level 2 mysteries
Spellcasting: Able to cast level 2 arcane spells

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Capture Magic's Shadow (Su) - At 1st level, when you successfully dispel a mystery or spell you can absorb its energy. You add one-half
    the level of the mystery or spell you dispelled to the caster level of any mystery or spell you cast in the next round.
2:  Innate Counterspell - Starting at 2nd level, you can attempt to counter a spell without using a readied action. Once per day, you can counter a spell as an immediate action by expending a spell slot or a spell use as long as the spell expended is of the same level as the spell to be countered.
5:  Innate Counterspell - 2/day
6:  Eldritch Disruption - As a standard action, you can disrupt the magical energies of a single target within 60 feet. That target must make a Will saving throw (DC 10 + your noctumancer level + your Cha modifier) or take a -4 penalty to its caster level for any mysteries or spells it casts for 1 minute. You can use eldritch disruption three times per day.
7:  Innate Counterspell (retain power) - When you successfully counter a spell using this ability, you gain the use of a mystery of 1/2 the countered spell level.
8:  Innate Counterspell - 3/day
10: Eldritch Vortex - You can emit mystic energies in a 20-foot-radius burst around yourself. Any creature other than you within that area takes a -4 penalty to caster level for any mysteries or spells. The vortex lasts 1 minute and can be used once per day.
    Shadow's Persistence - You gain temporary immunity to any mystery or spell captured or countered by means of your capture magic's shadow or innate counterspell ability. For 1 minute, you cannot be affected by any casting of that mystery or spell.

Mysteries/Spellcasting: At each level, you gain new mysteries and spells per day and an increase in caster level (and mysteries and spells known, if applicable) as if you had gained a level in both your mystery-using class and your arcane spellcasting class.

- 强光敏感：兽人在明亮光线下行动时，攻击检定，豁免和检定受到 -2 惩罚。

src:
Orcs are aggressive humanoids with a reputation for war and destruction. They are stronger than their Half-Orc cousins but not as wise to the world beyond their surroundings. An orc's hair is usually black and he sports lupine ears with reddish eyes. Orcs believe that survival depends on conquering as much territory as possible, which makes relations with other creatures very difficult. Orcs often make their home in caves but are capable of building organized cities below ground. They wear their battle scars proudly as signs of achievement.

Orc Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, -2 Int, -2 Cha, -2 Wis.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass orc's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Orcs are able to see in the dark.
- Light Sensitivity: Orcs suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Orcish: Orcs are considered Orcish for the purpose of spells.

dst:
这是大学者卡帕达尔的《卡林杉史》第五卷，旨在成为该主题的权威著作。

 本卷记录了建立于 DR 27 年的舒恩王朝的历史。尽管王朝早期经历了一些动荡，舒恩家族最终缔造了一个伟大的帝国，将卡林杉带到了其权力和疆域的巅峰。
 最终，舒恩家族将卡林杉的边界向北扩展至高地荒原。然而，在 DR 376 年惨败于科米尔的阿祖恩一世之手后，持续的膨胀术戛然而止。此外，在 DR 449 年，卡林杉再次受挫，被重新征服的泰瑟尔发生叛乱，最终重获独立。
 尽管如此，尽管偶有挫折，舒恩王朝时代仍被铭记为卡林杉历史上最辉煌的时期。
“好，如果你装备了正确的武器，金币足够，其他一切就绪，我现在就施加符文的魔法。”

He wants me to obtain a number of items he will need to effect a cure: some belladonna, a book detailing the proper preparation for the belladonna before he dare actually ingest it, and some alchemical equipment to actually carry out said preparations. This last can be obtained from a merchant named, according to Querzat, "Blimfin Nemquin or Temquin or something." I have been given a list of items to present to this Blimfin when I locate him. Querzat is not sure where the other two items might be found, but suggests I check out the various stores in the city.\n\nI have given Querzat the book. I still need to bring him the belladonna and the alchemical equipment.

商人特隆·兰纳告诉过我们，在商贸之路沿线他的营地东北方，有一个附近被毁的采矿村庄，据称那里闹鬼，居民都在最近的內战中被屠杀。结果发现那地方其实并没有闹鬼，而是一群食人魔和兽人的藏身处。食人魔法师奥布格隆是它们的首领，维持着幽灵的幻象，以吓退不速之客。

发现这一点后，我决定清除这群危险的人形生物，既有利可图，也有益于该地区。然而，为了实施这个计划，我继续深入这座废弃矿坑时，触发了一个魔法陷阱，被传送到了这个地下矿洞和洞穴网络的某个下层区域。在那里我遇到了一个叫科尔佐布的食人魔混血儿，他原本是占据这座矿坑的人形生物团伙的一员，但与团伙首领奥布格隆发生了分歧。我与他结伴，并听从他的建议，前往附近的废墟——奥布格隆最初就是在那里找到了设置各种陷阱所需的装置和奥术知识——并在那里找到了一根能够抵消他传送陷阱的魔法金杖，不过在取得它的过程中与一个危险的奥胡恩战斗。

结果，我们得以直面奥布格隆，他现在已经被杀。此事完成后，我们已经与科尔佐布分道扬镳。也许是时候继续旅行，继续我们的主要任务了。
src:
The merchant trader Teron Lanner has told us of a nearby ruined mining village, found northeast of his camp along the Trade Way, and allegedly haunted by its inhabitants who were slaughtered in the recent civil wars. It turns out that the place was not actually haunted, but a hideout for a band of ogres and orcs. Obgron, the ogre mage was their leader, maintained illusions of ghosts to deter unwanted visitors. 

Upon discovering this, I decided that it would be both profitable and helpful to the region to clear out this dangerous group of humanoids. Proceeding to advance into the ruined mine in pursuance of this plan, however, I triggered a magical trap that teleported me to a lower section of this underground network of mines and caves. There I met one Korzob, an ogrillon who was part of the humanoid band occupying this mine, but who had a disagreement with the band's leader Obgron. I joined up with him, and, following his advice, went to the nearby ruins where Obgron found the various devices and arcane knowledge required to set up his various traps in the first place, and there found a magical golden rod able to nullify his teleportation traps, battling a dangerous Alhoon in the process of securing it.

As a result, we were able to confront Obgron, and he is now slain. With this accomplished we have parted ways with Korzob. Perhaps it is time to travel on and continue our primary quest.

具体效果：通过此专长，你可以进行强大但笨拙的攻击。你可以选择从所有近战攻击检定中减去一个数字，并将相同数字加到所有近战伤害检定上。此数字不能超过你的基础攻击加值。

技术说明：PRC猛力攻击专长是即时专长（NWN v1.66+），无需动作激活。
你的猛力攻击选择是来自'猛力攻击：0 -4'和'猛力攻击：0 - 20'径向菜单选择的总和。
通常，快速选择会将你的猛力攻击设置为你放入其中的任何值（如果未初始化则为零）.
要更改快速选择中存储的值，首先使用猛力攻击 - 快速选择径向菜单下的更改快速选择专长。然后，在接下来的10秒内使用任何快速选择专长。该专长的旧值将被你当前的猛力攻击值覆盖。

注意：根据PRC配置变量，这可能表现为：
1) 如上所述
2) 仅限于牺牲与使用Bioware猛力攻击和精通猛力攻击专长一样多的值

Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Str 13+
Specifics: With this feat you can make powerful but ungainly attacks. You may choose to subtract a number from all melee attack rolls and add the same number to all melee damage rolls. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus.
Use: Selected

Technical: The PRC Power Attack feats are instant feats (NWN v1.66+) and take no action to activate.
Your power attack selection is the sum of your selections from the 'Power Attack: 0 -4'  and 'Power Attack: 0 - 20' radials.
Normally, a quickselect sets your power attack to whatever value you have placed in it (zero if uninitialized).
To change the value stored in a quickselect, first use the Change Quickselect feat under Power Attack - Quickselects radial. Then, use any of the quickselect feats within the next 10 seconds. The old value for that feat will be overwritten with your current power attack value.

NOTE: Depending on PRC configuration variables, this may either behave either:
1) as described above
2) be limited to sacrifice only as much as you could using the Bioware Power Attack and Improved Power Attack feats
3) be completely disabled.

在码头区闲逛时，我遇到了商船船长法纳斯·纳塞布。他的专长是运送异国动物。不幸的是，他货舱里的一只凶暴虎挣脱了笼子，正威胁着要祸害下面的其他动物。他请求我帮忙制服这头野兽，并给了我一把附魔匕首，专门对老虎生效，能让它们入睡。我只需击中老虎一次，而且应该注意不要杀死如此珍贵的生物。

老虎已被制服，此事已报告给纳塞布船长。不过，他又给了我另一个任务，找到在码头区域各处传送的闪现犬，告诉它们回到他的船上。原来它们最初就是从那里来的，直到被老虎吓跑。他给了我一根法杖，可以证明我是他的代理人。装备它后，我应该与犬交谈，告诉它们老虎的威胁已经结束。总共有六只犬，而且它们不断传送，要找到全部可能有点困难。我需要查看码头区域各处以及相邻建筑内部。

七只犬都已找到并劝回，纳塞布船长已为我的工作给了报酬。
src:
While wandering about the Docks District, I ran into Phanas Naseb, captain of a merchant ship. His specialty is transporting exotic animals. Unfortunately, a dire tiger in his hold has broken free of its cage, and is threatening to wreak havoc amongst the other animals down there. He has asked my assistance in geting the beast under control, giving me a dagger that has been enchanted to affect tigers specifically, putting them to sleep. I should only need to score one hit on the tiger, and should make a point not to kill so valuable a creature.

The tiger has been rendered harmless, and this has been reported to Captain Naseb. He has given me another task, however, to find the various blink dogs teleporting about the docks area and tell them to return to his ship. It turns out that was where they orignally came from, until scared away by the tiger. He has given me a rod which will identify me as his agent. With it equipped, I should speak to the dogs and tell them that the threat from the tiger is over. There are six dogs in total and it may prove a bit difficult to find them all as they keep teleporting about. I will need to look all around the docks area as well as inside adjoining structures.

All seven dogs have been found and induced to return, and Captain Naseb has rewarded me for my work.

src:
Alternate Form (Su): An aranea's natural form is that of a large monstrous spider.  It can assume two other forms.  The first is a Medium-size humanoid (the exact form is fixed at birth).  The second form is a Medium-size, spider-humanoid hybrid.  Changing form is a standard action.

The aranea keeps its ability scores and can cast spells, but cannot use webs or poison in humanoid form.

In hybrid form, an aranea looks like a humanoid at first glance, but a closer inspection will reveal its fangs and spinneretes.  The aranea can use weapons and webs in this form.

凯勒姆·伊沙丁是伊尔梅特的一位圣武士，先前被派去对抗泰坦帮，此后便杳无音信。他很可能已在与他们的战斗中阵亡，但这并不确定，因此在对抗泰坦的同时，纳西拉克希望我留意任何有关他下落的迹象，若我查明他的遭遇，便向他报信。

我找到了凯勒姆，他被泰坦帮俘虏了。如今我已将他解救出来，他加入了与我并肩作战，协助我对抗剩余的泰坦。他持有一把钥匙，可以打开通往他们逃入的下水道的道路，若我需要，他还能帮我解除据说布满这条通道的陷阱。

我们已解决了泰坦帮，凯勒姆如今已经离去。我现在可以返回伊尔梅特神殿，报告此任务已完成。
src:
Kelem Ishadin is a paladin of Ilmater who was sent to fight the Titan gang earlier, and has not been heard from since. Likely he fell in battle against them, but this is not known with certainty, so while fighting the Titans Nasirak wants me to keep an eye out for any signs of his fate, and bring word to him if I discover what happened to him.

I have found Kelem, who had been captured by the Titan gang. Now that I have liberated him, he has joined with me to assist me in fighting the remaining Titans. He possesses a key that will open the path to the sewers down which they have fled, and should I need it can also help me in disarming the traps with which this route is said to be covered.

We have dealt with the Titan gang, and Kelem has now departed. I can now return to the Temple of Ilmater and report this mission as accomplished.

dst: "嗯，蛇人是兼具人类和蛇类特征的生物。像我这样的纯血蛇人没有非常明显的爬虫特征，很容易冒充人类，至少乍看之下如此。半血蛇人基本上是人形，但有鳞片皮肤或其他特征，使他们的血统一目了然。憎恶蛇人则完全不是人形，只有能让他们挥舞武器的双臂，才使他们没有被简单归类为巨蛇。"
src: "Well, Yuan-ti are creatures who combine human characteristics with those of snakes. Purebloods, such as myself, have no very obvious reptilian characteristics, and can easily pass as human, at least to a casual inspection. Halfbloods have a basically humanoid form, but have scaled skin or other features that make their heritage readily apparent. Abominations are not humanoid at all, with only the arms that allow them to wield weapons distinguishing them from being classified as simply giant snakes."

（进阶职业）
淑妮·火发鼓励美丽，激情和爱，无论它们在哪里被发现。心护者是审美家和享乐主义者，他们积极寻求一切事物中的快乐和美丽，并培育美丽物品的创造。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 武器和防具擅长：心护者不获得任何武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：混乱善良。
专长：闪避，灵活移动，法咒专攻：附魔，异种武器擅长：鞭子
技能：唬骗 3，说服 6。
神术施法：能够施展3级法咒。
特殊：必须信仰淑妮·火发。（牧师必须拥有魅惑，善良和保护领域中的两个。）

职业特性：

等级
1：魅力增加 - 魅力加值 +1。
2：激情之心 - 基于魅力的检定（技能，驱散）加值 +2。
3：魅力增加 - 魅力加值 +2。
4：狂喜之唇 - 攻击，伤害，豁免加值 +2，附魔法咒豁免 +4.（豁免失败则晕眩）.
5：魅力增加 - 魅力加值 +3。
6：塞壬之声 - 获得高等法术专攻：附魔和法术穿透专长，适用于语言法咒。
7：魅力增加 - 魅力加值 +4。
8：永恒之金之泪 - 每天制造一次水之神圣。
9：魅力增加 - 魅力加值 +5。
10：精类蜕变 - 类型变为精类。

奖励法咒

在心护者获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高施法职业（德鲁伊或牧师）中也获得了等级一样。他不通过其能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Sune Firehair encourages beauty, passion, and love wherever they may be found. Heartwarders are aesthetes and hedonists who actively seek out pleasure and beauty in all things who nurture the creation of beautiful objects.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: The Heartwarder gains no weapon or armor proficiency.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Chaotic Good.
Feats: Dodge, Mobility, Spell Focus: Enchantment, Exotic Weapon Proficiency: Whip
Skills: Bluff 3, Persuade 6.
Divine Spellcasting: Ability to cast spells of Level 3.
Special: Must worship Sune Firehair. (Clerics must have two of Charm, Good and Protection domains.)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Charisma Increase - Bonus +1 to Charisma.
2: Heart of Passion - Bonus +2 to Charisma-based checks (skills, turning).
3: Charisma Increase - Bonus +2 to Charisma.
4: Lips of Rapture - Bonus +2 to Attacks, damages, saves and +4 to Enchantment spells saves. (Dazed on failed save).
5: Charisma Increase - Bonus +3 to Charisma.
6: Voice of a Siren - Gains Greater Spell Focus: Enchantment and Spell Penetration feats to verbal spells.
7: Charisma Increase - Bonus +4 to Charisma.
8: Tears of Evergold - Craft a Water Holy once per day.
9: Charisma Increase - Bonus +5 to Charisma.
10: Fey Metamorphosis - Type change to Fey.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Heartwarder, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (druid or cleric). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

dst:
卡达斯和他的探险队正在卡林沙漠中发掘一些古代遗迹。然而，在地下探索中，他们遭遇了巨型蜘蛛和亡灵带来的麻烦。由于没有准备好应对这些障碍，卡达斯请我替他探索遗迹。如果可能的话，我应该清除其中的怪物，或者，如果做不到，至少留意那些有助于他研究的重要历史文物。

在探索遗迹时，一扇受魔法控制的门在我身后砰然关闭。从这一侧似乎无法打开它：看来我可能被困在遗迹中了！我唯一能想到的就是继续深入，希望能在某处遇到另一个出口。

我终于找到了离开遗迹的路：一段向上通往卡林沙漠的楼梯。不过，我仍然需要找到回卡达斯营地的路。如果我在遗迹里没有完全迷失方向，它应该在我现在位置的西南方，但周围有太多岩石和山脊，我不确定该去哪里寻找一条畅通的路线。也许我最大的希望就是向西走，直到与通往孟农的商队路线相交。一旦到了那里，辨明方向并找到营地应该就很简单了。

A race of tigerlike humanoid warriors, the zakya are another breed of rakshasa.  Unlike their sorcerer brethren, zakya prefer to charge in and get down and dirty in melee combat, and they are able to twist their backwards hands to wield weapons normally.  In most other ways, however, they are identical to their sorcerer cousins.

Zakya Rakshasa Ability Adjustments: +10 Str, +4 Dex, +10 Con, +2 Int, +2 Wis.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass zakya rakshasa's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Zakya Rakshasa are able to see in the dark.
- Base movement of 50.

很少有矮人像古代火血氏族那样深入地下。这些矮人特别喜欢休眠火山，他们沿着火山轨迹和隧道寻找通往世界深处的进一步通道。不幸的是，他们偶然发现了一个红龙巢穴，愤怒的龙奴役了这个倒霉的氏族，为他们开采宝藏。随着时间推移，无论是通过杂交，自然突变还是魔法效果，火血氏族开始呈现出独特的特征，使他们更好地适应高温……以及对抗龙类。他们最终赢得了自由，但对邪恶龙类，尤其是红龙的仇恨仍然在这个矮人种族中深深燃烧。然而，该氏族现在已通婚并将血统传播到许多氏族中，火血矮人可能出生于任何矮人父母。他们与标准矮人基本相同，但皮肤呈深红棕色，通常秃顶，只有最微弱的胡须。

矮人属性调整：+2 体质，-2 魅力。
天赋职业（战士）：兼职火血矮人战士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

- 石工：在地下区域进行的搜索检定获得+2种族加值。

- 对地精类的攻击训练：对地精类（地精，大地精和熊地精）的攻击检定获得+1种族加值。
- 对龙类的防御训练：对龙类的AC获得+4闪避加值。
- 技能亲和（学识）：学识检定获得+2种族加值。

src:
Few dwarves delved as deep as the ancient Fireblood clan.  Particularly fond of dormant volcanos, these dwarves followed volcanic trails and tunnels in search of further access to the world's depths.  Unfortunately they stumbled on a nest of red dragons, and the outraged dragons enslaved the hapless clan to mine treasures for them.  Over time, whether by interbreeding, natural mutation, or magical effect the Fireblood clan began to take on unique traits making them better adapted to higher temperatures... and to battling dragons.  They won their freedom eventually, but the hatred for evil dragons in general and red dragons in specific still burns deep within this breed of dwarf.  The clan intermarried and spread their bloodline across many clans now, however, and a Fireblood dwarf may be born to any dwarf parents.  They are much the same as standard dwarves, but have dark red-brown skin, and are usually bald, with only the faintest of beards.

Dwarven Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass fireblood dwarf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Resistance to fire 5: Fireblood Dwarves have Fire Resistance 5.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Orcs: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Dragons: +4 dodge bonus to AC against dragons.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft Armor): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft Weapon): +2 racial bonus to Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Dragonblooded: Fireblood Dwarves have the dragonblood subtype.
- Dwarven: Fireblood Dwarves count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.\n\nI have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. I underwent a program of training and instruction under his direction, and should now be a more competent monk because of it.

src:
Type: Class
Prerequisite: Scout level 1
A Scout relies on mobility to deal extra damage and improve her defense. She deals an extra 1d6 points of damage on all attacks she makes during any round in which she moves at least 10 feet. The extra damage applies only to attacks taken during the Scout's turn. This extra damage increases by 1d6 for every four levels gained above 1st.
The extra damage only applies to living creatures that have a discernible anatomy. Undead, constructs, oozes, plants, incorporeal creatures and creatures immune to extra damage from critical hits are not vulnerable to this additional damage. The Scout must be able to see the target well enough to pick out a vital spot and must be able to reach such a spot. Scouts can apply this extra damage to ranged attacks made while skirmishing, but only if the target is within 30 feet.
At 3rd level, a Scout gains a +1 competence bonus to AC during any round in which she moves at least 10 feet. The bonus applies as soon as the Scout has moved 10 feet, and lasts until the start of her next turn. This bonus improves by 1 for every four levels gained above 3rd.
A Scout loses this ability when wearing medium or heavy armor or when carrying a medium or heavy load.

src: Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.\n\nI have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should simply enter the portal whenever I am ready. The necessary spells will be automatically cast as I go through.

dst: "嗯，我曾经像你一样是个冒险者。曾经我使用斧头或剑的灵巧程度就像我现在使用菜刀一样！然而，当我和战友们露营时，我不知怎么得到了在篝火上做饭的工作。最终，我也擅长了那个，所以当年龄开始追上我时，我想我可以在退休后当个厨师。我在帕夏加尔哈德尔的冒险岁月里认识了他，所以他很乐意雇用我。"
src: "Well, I used to be an adventurer like you. Once I was as deft with an axe or sword as I now am with a cooking knife! When I was camping with my comrades in arms, however, I somehow got the job of cooking meals over the campfire. Eventually, I got good at that too, so when age started catching up to me, I figured I could be a cook in my retirement. I'd met Pasha Galhadr in his adventuring days, and so he was happy to hire me."

dst: "是的，杀了你。如你所知，我曾希望救出我的学生扎拉拉，现在依然如此。而且我必须承认，你似乎比表面看起来要复杂得多。你竟然真的能打败我，这让我相当惊讶。也许我能从你身上学到些什么。不像塔尔沙姆，他之所以令人忌惮，只是因为他可怜巴巴地向神明乞求恩宠。"
src: "Yes, to kill YOU. As you recall, I hoped to save Zarala, my student, and I still do. And I have to admit there seems to be more to you than meets the eye. I was quite surprised you were actually able to beat me. It may be I can learn something from you. Unlike Talsham, who is only formidable because he pathetically begs a deity for favor."

src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Dread Necromancer 8.
Specifics: All undead creatures created by a dread necromancer who has reached 8th level or higher gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength and Dexterity and 2 additional hit points per Hit Die. 
In addition, when a dread necromancer uses the animate dead spell to create undead, she can control 4 + her Charisma bonus HD worth of undead creatures per class level (rather than the 4 HD per level normally granted by the spell).
Similarly, when a dread necromancer casts the control undead spell, the spell targets up to (2 + her Cha bonus) HD/level of undead creatures, rather than the 2 HD/level normally granted by the spell.
Use: Automatic.

目标每轮治疗 1 点此类伤害，直到法咒结束，并且如果在此期间因生命值损失而濒死，则自动稳定。

次级活力术不能恢复因饥饿，口渴或窒息而失去的生命值，也不能使生物再生或接合失去的身体部位。

多个活力术法咒的效果不叠加；只有最高等级的效果生效。
src:
Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric 1, Druid 1
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15 rounds)
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

With a touch of your hand, you boost the subject's life energy, granting him or her the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.

The subject heals 1 hit point per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.

Lesser vigor does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts.

The effects of multiple vigor spells do not stack; only the highest-level effect applies.

dst: 哈马德终于把注意力转向了我发现的关于变形蛛组建邪恶类人生物军队攻击卡林杉的阴谋。他收到了证实我发现的报告：地精在米尔森林集结，兽人在行进山脉集结。他建议了两个受到威胁的地点，我可以前往那里增援已经驻扎在那里的士兵：米尔森林附近的特布纳斯村，以及行进山脉山麓的阿哈兹堡。我应该前往城门，从那里向东前往其中一个或另一个地点，最终或许两个都去。\n\n其中一支类人生物军队的威胁已经解决。这已经报告给了哈马德，我现在应该把注意力转向另一支。
src: Hamad has finally turned his attention to the plot I discovered of aranea raising armies of evil humanoids to attack Calimshan. He has received reports confirming my discoveries: goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs in the Marching Mountains. He has suggested two threatened points that I could travel to in order to reinforce the soldiers already there: the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, and Fort Akhaz, in the foothills of the Marching Mountains. I should make my way to the city gates and from there travel east to one or the other of these locations, and in time perhaps both.\n\nThe threat posed by one of these humanoid armies has been dealt with. This has been reported to Hamad, and I should now turn my attention to the other one.

src: This weapon is a vicious implement of war formed from the gnarled branch of a great oak and a monstrous blade of rough-finished cold iron. This example and several others were among the unwanted remnants of battles with demonic creatures, probably those under Malimshar or Gaulguth in the Weeping War. Left in the purest of groves for years on end, nature has leeched the fiendish taint away, leaving the pure material of the weapons behind to be a vessel of power for those committed to neutrality and balance.

dst: 弩常被大量生产以装备军队，因为人们发现新兵学会使用这种武器并达到尚可的水平，比掌握普通弓要快得多。遗憾的是，弩的射速缓慢，这意味着装备弩的军队在被迫面对熟练的长弓手时，往往处于劣势。有一位国王试图弥补这一缺陷，为他的士兵装备了能提供特殊防护以抵御箭雨的弩。这确保了弩手缓慢但稳定而精准的射击能够轻易反制任何敌方弓箭手，后者的射击无论多么密集，此时大多都会落空。
src: Crossbows are frequently mass-produced for armies, since it has been found that new recruits can learn to use these weapons with reasonable competence more quickly than they can master a regular bow. Unfortunately, the slow rate of fire of crossbows means that an army equipped with them will often be at a disadvantage when forced to confront skilled longbowmen. One king tried to make up for this deficiency by equiping his soldiers with crossbows that provided special protection against a hail of arrows. This insured that the slow, but steady and accurate, fire of the crossbowmen would easily counter any enemy archers, whose shots, however numerous, would now mostly miss.

Prerequisite: Havoc Mage level 1.
Specifics: A havoc mage gains the ability to cast spells of a certain level or lower while making a single weapon attack. Using battlecast does not provoke an attack of opportunity. To use this ability, merely turn it on. On all subsequent spells, you will perform a single attack against the spell target. However, if the spell target is out of range of your physical attack, it will not work, for example if you cast a spell at range while holding a sword you will not attack the target. At 1st level, this ability allows you to battlecast 2nd level or lower spells. At 3rd level this increases to 4th or lower, and at 5th level you may battlecast 8th or lower.

src: Spells per Day/Powers Known: When a new psychic theurge level is attained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also attained a level in any one divine spellcasting class he belonged to before he added the prestige class. He gains additional power points per day and access to new powers as if he had also gained a level in any one manifesting class he belonged to previously. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of either class would have gained (bonus metamagic, metapsionic, or item creation feats, psicrystal special abilities, and so on). This essentially means that he adds the level of psychic theurge to the level of whatever other divine spellcasting class and manifesting class the character has, then determines spells per day, caster level, power points per day, powers known, and manifester level accordingly.

Transmutation
Level: Drd 2, Rgr 3, Justice of Weald and Woe 2
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 hour/level (D)

By means of this spell, you are able to assume the form of a Large living tree or a Large dead tree trunk with a small number of limbs. The closest inspection cannot reveal that the tree in question is actually a magically concealed creature. To all normal tests you are, in fact, a tree or shrub, although a detect magic spell reveals a faint transmutation on the tree. While in tree form, you can observe all that transpires around you just as if you were in your normal form, and your hit points and save bonuses remain unaffected. You have an effective Dexterity score of 0 and a speed of 0 feet. You are immune to critical hits while in tree form. All clothing and gear carried or worn changes with you. You can dismiss tree shape as a free action.

src:
Ogres are hulking monsters standing over 9 feet tall with a thick, tough hide. The skin on their 650-pound frame ranges from yellow to brown. They are known for being violent and bad-tempered and tend to keep company with trolls, giants and ogre mages. Although living in small, tribal communities, it is not unheard of for an ogre to accept mercenary work among humans. Their bent toward chaos makes them ideal barbarian. A raging ogre barbarian is an inspiration to other ogres.

Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass ogre's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Ogres are able to see in the dark.
- Weapon Proficiency (Martial): All ogres are proficient with Martial Weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All ogres are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Armor Proficiency (Medium): All ogres are proficient with Medium Armor.
- Armor Proficiency (Light): All ogres are proficient with Light Armor.
- Shield: All ogres are proficient with Shields.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 5.
- Large Creature: Ogres suffer -1 penalties to their Attack and Armor Class, and -4 to their Hide skill.
- Giant: Ogres count as Giants for the purpose of spells.

src:
Transmutation
Level: Druid 6,
Components: V, S, DF,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

In the blink of an eye, the creature you touched grows the armor plating of a tortoise across its torso and a tough, leathery skin elsewhere.  Tortoise shell grants a +6 enhancement bonus to the subject's existing natural armor bonus. This enhancement bonus increases by 1 for every three caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of +9 at 20th level.

The enhancement bonus provided by tortoise shell stacks with the target's natural armor bonus, but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor. A creature without natural armor has an effective natural armor of +0, much as a character wearing only normal clothing has an armor bonus of +0.

Tortoise shell slows a creature's movement as if it were wearing heavy armor. An elf subject to tortoise shell, for example, would have a speed of 20 feet and could run only 60 feet per round.  The spell affects only a creature's speed; tortoise shell doesn't carry an armor check penalty or an arcane spell failure chance.

src: The halfling rogue Haldo Burrows was fond of robbing mages; after all, powerful spellcasters invariably owned plenty of valuable items. Unfortunately this habit also tended to make him some powerful and magically capable enemies. While Haldo was an expert at evading fireballs and lightning bolts, he was less capable of dealing with enchantment spells, a weakness that could easily leave him at the mercy of a hostile wizard. He applied some of his ill-gotten wealth to the goal of acquiring items that would compensate for this weakness, and in due course obtained this headgear, which he thought an excellent tool for aiding a thief. as it both concealed identity, and possessed a limited ability to shield one from mind-affecting spells. Of course, these benefits can be helpful to many adventurers, not just thieves, but the item's history has made it a bit disreputable in some circles.\n\n

dst: "啊，泽卡尔……这本身就说来话长。你必须明白，像阿兹古尔卡这样拥有非凡力量的恶魔并不会轻易被放逐，而泽法德战胜他付出了沉重的代价。当恶魔被剑困住时，他仍然能够通过那把剑本身对这个位面施加影响。你也许听说过关于武器或盔甲中困有恶魔的故事？通过‘杀死’阿兹古尔卡，泽法德之剑被他的力量污染，变得非常像传说中的这类物品，成为他的恶魔力量进入世界的通道。"
src: "Ah, Zekar...that is a bit of a story in itself. You must understand that a demon of Azghulkar's extraordinary might is not banished with ease, and that Zefad's victory over him came at a heavy price. While the demon was trapped by the sword, he was still able to exert influence into this plane through that very sword. You perhaps have heard tales of weapons or armor that have a demon trapped within them? By 'slaying' Azghulkar, the Sword of Zefad was tainted by his power and became something very like such items of legend, a channel through which his demonic power could enter the world."

src: The bartender at the Winsome Repose told me that there had been a problem with some venomous snakes who had strangely appeared in the sewers and from thence the inn's basement, but that another adventurer, apparently some sort of warrior woman, had already been dispatched to deal with the problem. This adventurer planned to hunt down the source of this infestation of serpents and deal with it, and she has been gone for some time. Perhaps I should go to the basement and sewers, following in her path, to see if I can assist in her quest.\n\nI have found the adventurer referred to, one Jalkesi Tzaru. According to her, the infestation of serpents is the fault of a group of Yuan-Ti hiding in the city. She has located their hiding place, but unfortunately has been trapped in a small corridor of the sewers by the Yuan-Ti. The only way she can be released is by a lever on the far side. To reach it, I must go to the Yuan-Ti hideout above ground, and fight my way through it until I reach her location from the other side. She has indicated the building the Yuan-Ti are using on my map, in an area north of the docks and west of the merchants, and asked me to assist her in this way.

dst:
泰尔是冰封北方的原始猎人，是残忍而野蛮的生物，出没于东方的偏远山脉和隘口。他们向更温暖的地区发动战争，掠夺牲畜，食物储备，甚至人口作为氏族的食物。比起兽人或豺狼人等其他邪恶种族，泰尔更被其他种族视为粗鲁，嗜血的野兽，毫无可取之处。尽管泰尔将其他生物视为潜在的敌人或食物，但他们拥有令人惊讶的复杂口述历史，氏族内部的行为规则和部落智慧。
  
很久以前，这个种族发展出了一套全面的法典来约束其暴力倾向，至少在其成员之间是如此。任何不属于泰尔氏族的人都不受此法典保护，可以被随意抢劫，谋杀或吃掉。少数流浪到文明地区的泰尔要么将其“氏族”的概念扩展到其他一些智慧生物群体，如一群强盗，一个村庄或一支冒险队伍，要么很快就会死在愤怒的暴民手中。

泰尔属性调整：+4 力量，+2 体质，-4 智力，-2 魅力：泰尔坚韧且极其强壮，但狭隘且不具备其他种族的推理能力。
天赋职业（野蛮人）：在决定兼职泰尔是否遭受经验值惩罚时，其野蛮人职业不计入其中。

- 中型体型
- 泰尔的基础陆地速度为 30 英尺
- 巨人
- 种族生命骰：泰尔初始拥有两个巨人等级。这提供 2d8 生命骰，+1 基础攻击加值，以及强韧 +3，反射 +0 和意志 +0 的基础豁免。
- 黑暗视觉
- 天生防御 +2
- 天生攻击：徒手的泰尔可以以其正常攻击加值进行两次猛击，并以 -5 的惩罚进行啮咬攻击。泰尔的猛击造成 1d3 点伤害，啮咬造成 1d4 点伤害
- 寒冷亚种（超自然）：泰尔免疫寒冷伤害，但易受火焰攻击。无论是否允许豁免，也无论豁免成功或失败，他们受到火焰伤害为正常伤害的一倍半（+50%）
- 天赋职业：野蛮人
- 等级调整：+1
src:
Primitive hunters of the icebound north, taers are cruel and savage creatures who haunt the remote mountains and passes of the East. They launch war parties into warmer lands, carrying off livestock, food stores, or even people for the clan's larder. Even more so than other evil folk such as orcs or gnolls, taers are regarded by other races as crude, bloodthirsty beasts without a single redeeming quality. Although taers regard other creatures as potential enemies or meals, they possess a surprisingly complex store of oral histories, rules for conduct within the clan, and tribal wisdom.
  
Long ago, the race developed a comprehensive code to govern its tendency toward violence, at least between its own members. Anyone not of the taer's clan is beyond the protection of this code and can be robbed, murdered, or eaten at will. Those few taers who wander into civilized lands either extend their concept of "clan" to some other set of intelligent creatures, such as a group of bandits, a village, or an adventuring band, or quickly die at the hands of an angry mob. 

Taer Ability Adjustments:  +4 Strength, +2 Constitution, -4 Intelligence, -2 Charisma: Taers are tough and tremendously strong, but are insular and do not have the reasoning capacities of other races.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass taer's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Medium size
- A taer's base land speed is 30 feet
- Giant
- Racial Hit Dice: A taer begins with two levels of giant. This provides 2d8 Hit Dice, a base attack bonus of +1, and base saving throws of Fort +3, Ref +0, and Will +0. 
- Darkvision
- Natural Armor +2
- Natural Attacks: An unarmed taer can make two slam attacks at his normal attack bonus and a bite attack at a -5 penalty on his normal attack bonus. The taer's slam attacks deal 1d3 points of damage, and the bite deals 1d4 points of damage
- Cold Subtype (Ex): Taers are immune to cold damage but are vulnerable to fire attacks. They take half again as much (+50%) damage as normal from fire, regardless of whether a saving throw is allowed, or if the save is a success or failure
- Favored Class: Barbarian
- Level Adjustment: +1

src: This orb is small enough to be held in one's hand, and glows from the extra-planar magical forces contained within. It has the power to restore lost life-forces to those attuned to these energies, applying a Resurrection spell to such a being. However, this spell will only affect beings of extra-planar origin, outsiders and elementals, and is useless if applied to anyone else. A further disadvantage is that it requires the one using it to sacrifice a small portion of his own life-forces to activate it: a player who uses this item will lose 10 Experience Points per level, or the maximum experience he can lose while retaining his current level, whichever is less.\n\nThis orb was given to you by a strange entity on the Plane of Air, so that you would be able to resurrect Zarala if that became necessary. It would be unwise to sell or discard it, especially if you have no other means of casting a Raise Dead or Resurrection Spell.

src:
It is foolhardy to explore a dungeon alone. Those who attempt to do so quickly find that they lack the skills needed to get the job done. Sometimes, this can happen in larger parties as well. Enter the factotum, capable of mimicking the abilities of others and filling in when the need is greatest. After a lifetime of work, few can claim even a fraction of the versatility that the factotum displays every day. Skilled in nearly every art, factotums draw upon their lore to master almost any trade or ability for a brief period of time before other pursuits draw their attention. Constantly on the hunt for new abilities and tricks, factotums eventually find the right tool to overcome practically any problem. 

- Alignment: Any.
- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Factotum gains proficiencies with Martial and Simple Weapons, Light Armour, and Shields.
- Skill Points: 6 + Int Modifier

CLASS FEATURES:

1: Inspiration - At the beginning of each fight, gain a pool of inspiration
   Cunning Insight - Spend inspiration to add Int to attack, damage, or saves

A weapon affected by this spell deals wounds that can't be healed in the usual fashion. Any damage dealt by the weapon (not including damage from special weapon properties such as flaming, holy, wounding, and so on) cannot be cured by any means until the damaged individual has received a Remove Curse spell (or some other effect that neutralizes a curse). If a creature is slain by a weapon that is under the effect of this spell, it can't be raised from the dead unless a Remove Curse spell (or similar effect) is cast on the body or a True Resurrection spell is used.

dst:
在扎泽斯普尔的伊尔梅特神殿“泪之屋”地下，我遇到了一个名叫尼尔瓦·瓦尔切扎的人，一位伊尔梅特圣武士，她正守卫着抵御来自城市下方幽暗地域洞穴的威胁。在那里，她发现了一道由负能量构成的黑暗屏障，它正在扩张，并将幽暗地域的生物转化为亡灵怪物。她已确定，要穿透这道屏障到达其后方邪恶的假定源头，需要一颗游荡者之石，一种常用于传送魔法的稀有宝石。如果我在冒险途中遇到一颗游荡者之石，把它带给她可能是个好主意。

我给尼尔瓦带了一颗游荡者之石，并且也同意陪伴她，帮助她对抗黑暗屏障后方的任何邪恶，既然现在它可以被穿透了。要到达屏障，我们应该穿过尼尔瓦设置的结界门，使用她拥有的钥匙，并一直向下前进，直到最终到达一个巨大的幽暗地域洞穴。在那里我们应该向东北方向前进，直到到达黑暗屏障。据尼尔瓦说，屏障周围会定期出现和消失一些发光的光点。我们应该靠近其中一个并与之互动，然后尼尔瓦就可以使用游荡者之石传送到另一边。

穿过黑暗屏障后，我们遇到了似乎应对其存在负责的生物：一位前矮人圣武士，现在是一个堕落的亡灵末日骑士。他的家园显然很久以前被卓尔入侵者摧毁，他现在寻求对所有卓尔复仇。为了获得复仇，他与某些黑暗力量达成了某种契约，释放出一个不断扩张的负能量轨道，将落入其中的生物转化为亡灵。他声称它最终会扩张到覆盖整个扎泽斯普尔城，给他一支亡灵大军，他计划带领这支大军对卓尔进行灭绝战役。告诉我们这些之后，他就消失了。想必可以在他所主宰的废墟更深处找到他，我们需要找到并击败他，以阻止他所释放的一切。
src:
Beneath the House of Tears, a Temple of Ilmater in Zazesspur, I encountered one Nierva Var'cheza, a Paladin of Ilmater who is standing guard against a menace originating in the underdark caverns below the city. There she found a dark barrier of negative energy that is expanding and transforming creatures of the Underdark into Undead monstosities. She has determined that penetrating this barrier to reach the presumed source of this evil beyond it will require a Rogue Stone, a rare gem often used in teleportation magics. If I come across a Rogue Stone in the course of my adventures, it might be a good idea to bring it to her.

I brought Nierva a Rogue Stone, and have also agreed to accompany her and aid her against whatever evil lies beyond the dark barrier, now that it can be penetrated. To reach the barrier, we should go through the warded gate Nierva set up, using the key she posesses, and keep heading downwards, until we eventually reach a large Underdark cavern. There we should proceed northeast until we reach the dark barrier. According to Nierva, there are glowing lights that appear and disappear around the barrier regularly. We should approach and interact with one, and Nierva can then use the Rogue Stone to transport to the other side.

Having passed through the dark barrier, we encountered the creature apparently responsible for its presence: a former dwarven paladin, now a corrupted, undead Doom Knight. His home was apparently destroyed by Drow invaders long ago, and he now seeks vengeance against all Drow. To obtain it, he has made some compact with dark powers that unleashed an expanding orbit of negative energy that transforms into undead those who fall within it. He claims that it will eventually grow to encompass the entire city of Zazesspur, giving him an army of undead that he plans to lead on a campaign of extermination against the Drow. Having told us this, he disappeared. Presumably he can be found deeper in the ruin over which he presides, and we will need to find and defeat him to stop whatever he has unleashed.

dst:
一个名叫维蒂亚雷的扒窃高手偷走了我所有的金币，然后消失了，当时我正被他同伙的其他冒险者分散了注意力。如果这是永久性的损失，那可是一笔不小的数目，但也许还有希望找到这个维蒂亚雷并追回我的金币。看来他的脑袋上还悬赏，可以从奥布莱克那里领取。我应该看看能否找到关于维蒂亚雷现在可能在哪里的线索。他似乎经常在纳什kel一带活动，所以也许那个镇上的某个人会知道一些关于他的事情。

在镇上时，维蒂亚雷经常被看到在打嗝龙酒馆喝酒， accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn, presumably a friend or associate. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. I learned where to meet this Frago from a farmer named Hodgent, one of his customers, and from Frago I learned the location of Vitiare's hideout: an old abadoned house, sunk under water, a little to the south of Beregost. Vitiare and some associates have sealed off the basement from the water, and can be reached there from a secret door near some rocks to the south of the house.

I located and defeated Vitiare, and recovered a percentage of the gold he stole from me. I can also turn in his head to Oublek to collect a bounty.
src:
An expert pickpocket known as Vitiare stole all my gold and then disappeared, while I was distracted by the rest of the adventuring party he was working with. This represents a considerable loss, if it is permanent, but perhaps there is some hope of locating this Vitiare and recovering my gold. It appears there is also a bounty on his head, that can be collected from Oublek. I should see if I can find any clues as to where Vitiare might now be found. He seems to commonly operate around Nashkel, so perhaps someone in that town would know something about him.

When in town, Vitiare is often seen drinking at the Belching Dragon accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn, presumably a friend or associate. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. I learned where to meet this Frago from a farmer named Hodgent, one of his customers, and from Frago I learned the location of Vitiare's hideout: an old abadoned house, sunk under water, a little to the south of Beregost. Vitiare and some associates have sealed off the basement from the water, and can be reached there from a secret door near some rocks to the south of the house.

I located and defeated Vitiare, and recovered a percentage of the gold he stole from me. I can also turn in his head to Oublek to collect a bounty.

纳西拉克告诉过我一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特信徒，他是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他武僧提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名武僧，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅，我之前没有理由注意到它，它通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通向隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我这也可能很危险。

我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他开始了我的训练计划，并给了我几项任务。首先，我要去拿他洞穴西南角一个袋子里的刚毛衬衣，我将在训练期间穿着它。接下来，他要我从我来这里时穿过的隧道里一具尸体上找到的四件武僧装备中拿一件，带到洞穴外的悬崖边，扔进那里的深渊。他相信这将帮助我培养对物质财富的漠不关心。

我扔掉了其中一件物品，然后回来在伊拉姆大师的指导下进行了一些体能训练。现在他要我去站在他洞穴的东北角，什么都不做，直到他说可以为止，以帮助培养耐心和自制力。
src:
Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.

I have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and given me a couple of tasks. Firstly, I am to get the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave, which I am to wear during my training. Next, he wants me to take one of four items of monk gear I found on a corpse in the tunnel I traversed coming here, bring it to the cliff outside the cave, and throw it into the chasm there. He believes this will assist me in developing a lack of concern for material possessions.

I threw away one of the items, and then returned to carry out some phyical exercises under Master Iram's direction. Now he wants me to go stand in the northeast corner of his cave without doing anything until he says otherwise, to assist in developing patience and self-control.

src: I have learned of an intriguing opportunity offered by a mage known as Radamur the Conjurer: He has set up a portal that leads to some far plane, apparently guarded by fiendish monstrosities but also allegedly containing great wealth for the taking. For a price, he will permit adventurers who wish to test their mettle to pass through the portal. Unfortunately the price he demands for two adventurers to enter is quite high: 100000 gold. I shall have to consider whether this venture is worth the cost and the risks.\n\nApparently Radamur's portal leads to Cania, the Eighth Hell. This sector of the realm was apparently under the control of a powerful White Dragon known as Lord Snatylar'charv'zen, but I was able to slay him. I am not certain there is much else to be accomplished here beyond endless fights against legions of Baatezu.

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·寻宝者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地表的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他所认识的一支由另外六名斯涅布力侏儒组成的队伍，当时正在附近调查各个派系和近期事件，如今已经失踪。他希望我要么找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深地侏儒，要么至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒分别是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到其中任何一人或他们遭遇的证据，都应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我找到并营救了施内拉·潜影者，她曾被囚禁在一座夺心魔据点中。据她说，弗雷博·渔夫和塔克塞维克·钢手与她一同被俘，但死于夺心魔强迫他们参加的角斗中。我还找到了凯齐布·煤切者被肢解的尸体碎片，他显然是被一队卓尔俘虏并折磨致死。仍有2名斯涅布力侏儒下落不明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found and rescued Schnella Shadowsneaker, who was being held captive in a Mind-Flayer stronghold. 这是大学者卡帕达尔的《卡林杉史》第六卷，也是最后一卷，旨在成为该主题的权威著作。

 本卷将卡林杉的历史叙述至近乎当代，主要关注该国自舒恩王朝以来的衰落。在此期间，国家饱受苦难，DR 1018 年蓝龙萨菲拉克塔对该领域的蹂躏或许是最严重的灾难。
 尽管卡林杉仍是该地区最杰出的强权，但它已不再是昔日的大帝国。其边界已大幅收缩，如今大多数卡林杉人对商业的兴趣远大于战争与膨胀术。毕竟，卡林杉一直是一个商业强国，是横跨闪耀海南方的楚尔特与费伦北方之间的天然十字路口。
 表面上放弃早先的帝国主义并未完全解决与外国势力的紧张关系。最大的问题可能是卡林杉商人拒绝放弃奴隶贸易，这一活动为北方许多国家所不齿。
 尽管经济实力是当今卡林杉精英的首要关注点，但过去的帝国荣耀并未被遗忘。

dst: "我研究的一部分就是找出最佳组合。你只能自己实验，最终对你来说有点赌博性质。实际上，说到赌博，我得警告你，有些组合会产生危险的爆炸，而不是有用的东西，但这对像你这样经验丰富的<CUSTOM104>来说可能不算什么。另一个风险是，每当你操作拉杆时，机器里的任何试剂都会被消耗，无论它们是否产生药剂。关于这个过程，我可以给你几条建议：不要同时放入超过一种相同类型的试剂（那通常会产生不良反应），并且尝试三种（且只有三种——多余试剂的存在也会搞砸过程）不同试剂的组合，因为那些最有可能产生有用的东西。"
src: "Part of my research is to determine the best combinations. You'll just have to experiment, and ultimately it's a bit of a gamble for you. Actually, on the subject of gambling, I should warn you that a few combinations can produce a dangerous explosion, rather than anything useful, but it's probably nothing an experienced <CUSTOM104> like you can't weather. Another risk is that whenever you operate the lever, any reagents in the machine will be consumed regardless of whether they produce an elixir. There are a couple pieces of advice I can give you about the process: don't put more than one reagent of the same type in at a time (that usually produces a bad reaction), and try combinations of three (and only three - the presence of extra reagents can mess up the process too) separate reagents, as those are the one's most likely to produce something helpful."

卡拉什塔是一个复合种族，是人类和一个称为库里的无形种族的融合，原生于一个梦境位面。为了逃避迫害，他们找到了逃到主物质位面的方法，并与那些愿意欢迎他们的人类结合。现在，卡拉什塔是一个自己的种族，每个都有一小部分与他们的祖先结合的原始库里，但由于库里的流放，卡拉什塔无法做梦。在物理上，他们大部分看起来像人类，但通常稍高一些，特征稍微更有棱角。当他们移动时，带着比平常更多的恩典和优美。

dst: "奥林·吉西亚是一支精灵法师教团，致力于守护那些最好永远不被发现的知识的秘密。精灵族是许多被短命种族遗忘的传说的继承者，而这些传说若落入不当之手，可能造成极大的危害。我们的职责就是确保远古怪物仍被束缚，被诅咒的器物仍被藏匿，黑暗魔法的源头仍未被触及，危险的知识不被那些无法明智运用它的人所得。因此，当听说这些卓尔试图进入这个蕴藏远古魔法的地方时，我们便设法阻止，因为此地的守护结界本意是阻挡人类，而我们的黑暗表亲是否会被它们挡住尚不清楚。如今必须判定是否也该阻止你进入。你寻找塞里姆·加卢伦的失传论著，究竟是为了什么目的？"
src: "The Olin Gisiae are an order of elven mages dedicated to maintaining the secrecy of knowledge best left undiscovered. The elven people are heirs to much lore forgotten by the short-lived races, and much of this lore could do great harm in the wrong hands. It is our task to see that ancient monsters remain bound, cursed artifacts remain hidden away, sources of dark magic remain untapped, and dangerous knowledge be kept from those who cannot use it wisely. Thus, upon hearing that these Drow were seeking entrance to this place, containing ancient magic, we sought to prevent it, for the wards about it were meant to keep out humans, and it is not clear if our dark cousins would be stopped by them. Whether your entrance should not be prevented as well must now be determined. For what purpose do you seek Seriem Galuren's lost treatise?"

这个变化系法咒将一瓶（1 品脱） 水注入秩序的秩序，将其转化为公理之水。公理之水对混乱异界生物造成的伤害，如同圣水对不死生物和邪恶异界生物造成的伤害。一瓶公理之水可以作为溅射武器投掷。将此攻击视为射程增量为 10 尺的远程接触攻击。如果投向实体生物的身体，瓶子会破碎，但要对虚体生物使用，持有者必须打开瓶子并将公理之水倒在目标上。因此，角色只有在与虚体生物相邻时才能用公理之水浇淋它。这样做是一次不会引发借机攻击的远程接触攻击。

一瓶公理之水直接命中会对混乱异界生物造成 2d4 点伤害。在瓶子击中点 5 尺内的每个此类生物受到 1 点溅射伤害。

材料成分：5 磅铁粉和银粉（价值 25 gp）.
src:
Transmutation [Lawful]
Level: Cleric 1, Paladin 1,
Components: V, S, M,
Casting Time: 1 minute
Range: Touch
Target: Flask of water touched
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates (object)
Spell Resistance: Yes (object)

You speak the ancient, slippery words as you pour the iron and silver into the flask. Despite the fact that there is more powder than will fit in the container, all of it dissolves, leaving a flask of water dotted with motes of gunmetal gray.

This transmutation imbues a flask (1 pint) of water with the order of law, turning it into axiomatic water. Axiomatic water damages chaotic outsiders the way holy water damages undead and evil outsiders. A flask of axiomatic water can be thrown as a splash weapon. Treat this attack as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 10 feet. A flask breaks if thrown against the body of a corporeal creature, but to use it against an incorporeal creature, the bearer must open the flask and pout the axiomatic water out onto the target. Thus, a character can douse an incorporeal creature with axiomatic water only if he is adjacent to it. Doing so is a ranged touch attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

A direct hit by a flask of axiomatic water deals 2d4 points of damage to a chaotic outsider. Each such creature within 5 feet of the point where the flask hits takes 1 point of damage from the splash.

Material Component: 5 pounds of powdered iron and silver (worth 25 gp).

dst:
拉贾尔又给我派了一项任务。我要去偷取塞尔哈德圣甲虫，它位于塞尔哈德贵族庄园的宝库中。为了进去，我应该进入贵族庄园下方的下水道，在那里我会找到通往该庄园地下室的通道。一旦进入，我需要在庄园里搜寻两把钥匙，一把用于宝库的外门，一把用于内门。找到这些后，我就可以进入庄园地下室的宝库，但我必须迅速找到圣甲虫并离开，因为内门在打开一分钟后会自动锁上。我还必须确保不伤害庄园里的任何人，因为如果这种事发生在显赫贵族的庄园里，当局绝不会轻饶。

我拿到了塞尔哈德圣甲虫，但当我试图离开时，我发现我进来的路线已被牢牢锁住并有守卫把守，这或许表明守卫察觉到了我在庄园里留下的某些痕迹。不过我还是找到了另一条出去的路，现在可以把圣甲虫带给拉贾尔了。

我成功逃出了庄园。现在只需要把圣甲虫带给拉贾尔。
src:
Rajar has assigned me yet another mission. I am to steal the Serkhad Scarab, located in the treasure vault of the Serkhad Noble Estate. To get in I should enter the sewers beneath the noble estates, where I will find a passage to the basement of this estate. Once in, I will need to search the estate for two keys, one for the outer, and one for the inner door to the vault. Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.

I acquired the Serkhad Scarab, but when I attempted to leave, I found the route through which I entered securely locked and guarded, perhaps an indication that the guards detected some sign of my presence on the estate. However I was able to find another means of getting out, and can now bring the Scarab to Rajar.

I was able to escape the estate. Now I just need to bring the scarab to Rajar.

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psion/wilder 2
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Targets: You and one willing creature
Duration: 1 hour/level
Power Points: 3
Metapsionics: Extend

This power creates a psychometabolic connection between you and a willing subject so that some of your wounds are transferred to the subject. You take half damage from all attacks that deal hit point damage to you, and the subject takes the remainder. The amount of damage not taken by you is taken by the subject. If your hit points are reduced by a lowered Constitution score, that reduction is not shared with the subject because it is not a form of hit point damage. When this power ends, subsequent damage is no longer divided between the subject and you, but damage already shared is not reassigned.

If you and the subject move farther away from each other than close range, the power ends.


Implementation notes:
You may not have more than one Share Pain or Share Pain, Forced active at any one time. Any subsequent uses override the previous.

Chakra: Feet (totem)

Incarnum forms steel plates backed with white fur that fit over your shins, covering any clothing, boots, or armor you might wear. When you walk through ice and snow, your feet find solid purchase.

You gain a +5 bonus on Balance checks. 

Essentia: If you invest essentia in your urskan greaves, it also protects you from cold damage. You gain resistance to cold equal to 5 times the number of points of essentia you invest in this soulmeld. 

Chakra Bind (Feet) 

White fur covers your lower legs and your urskan greaves merge into your flesh. Strength seems to radiate up from your greaves through your whole frame, lending power to your attacks when you can build up a good running start.

You gain the ability to make a powerful charge. When you charge, if your melee attack hits, you deal an additional +1d4 points of damage per point of essentia you invest in your urskan greaves. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

White fur covers your legs and strength pours through you. No foe can stand in your way when you put all your strength into your charge.

When you attempt to overrun an opponent, the target cannot choose to avoid you. You also gain a +2 bonus on your Strength check to knock down your opponent, with an additional +1 for every point of essentia you invest in your urskan greaves.

dst: 裂隙拉芬，一位在纳什克尔集市的法师，为我提供了一种游戏。他在纳什克尔村周围藏了一些特殊的卡牌，有些只是放在不太可能的地方，但有些只能通过某种特殊才能才能获取。我应该在村子里四处寻找这些卡牌，并尽可能多地收集。当我收集到我认为能收集到的足够多卡牌后，就可以带着它们回到拉芬那里，他承诺会给我某种奖品，其价值取决于找到的卡牌数量。他只会颁发一次奖品（这意味着之后收集的任何卡牌都毫无价值），所以我应该确保在返回领奖之前彻底探索。\n\n我找到了一些卡牌并回到了拉芬那里。作为回报，他对我施了一个法术，让我变得更强大，大概与我带回来的卡牌数量成正比。
src: Rift Raphen, a mage at the Nashkel fair, has provided a game of sorts for me to play. He has hidden a number of special cards around the village of Nashkel, some merely in unlikely places, but some only accessible by the use of special talents of some sort. I should look for these cards as I go about the village, and collect as many as I can. When I have collected as many cards as I think I will be able to, I can return with them to Raphen, who has promised to give me some sort of prize, the value of which will be dependent on the number of cards found. He will only award this prize once (meaning any cards collected afterwards are worthless) so I should be sure to thoroughly explore before returning for this purpose.\n\nI found a number of cards and returned to Raphen. In return, he cast a spell on me making me more powerful, presumably in proportion to the number of cards I brought back.
