dst: 我清理了客栈里的老鼠，却又遇到了另一个问题。显然，住在附近下水道里的一个疯狂鼠人自封为老鼠的保护者，对我的干涉很不高兴。他自称瓦古，显然是他杀死了萨鲁德在地下室放出的猫，还偷走了他的灭鼠药。他宣称，他不会容忍进一步干涉那些想以客栈储备为食的老鼠，并让我把他的警告带给客栈老板。\n \n鼠人不容易被常规武器伤害，我不确定自己能否击败他。也许我应该和萨鲁德谈谈这一情况，看看他想怎么做。
"有些人会害怕或说难听的话，但我不担心。加尔哈德尔老板告诉我，这应该提醒我，那么多人这样看待豺狼人，很大程度上是我们自己的错，我需要树立恩赐的榜样来抵消这种印象。如果我发火，那只会让我做出证明他们是对的行为。" *低吼*
src: "A few people get scared or make nasty remarks, but I not worry. Galhadr boss tells me that such should remind me that is largely our own fault that so many people think of gnolls that way, and that I need to set example of virtue to counteract. If I get mad that just make me act in way that prove such people right." *Growl*

dst: 在码头区闲逛时，我遇到了商船船长法纳斯·纳塞布。他的专长是运输异域动物。不幸的是，他货舱里的一头凶暴虎挣脱了笼子，正威胁着要在下面其他动物中大肆破坏。他请求我帮忙制服这头野兽，并给了我一把专门附魔用来影响老虎的匕首，能让它们入睡。我只需要击中老虎一次，并且应该注意不要杀死这么珍贵的生物。\n\n老虎已经被制服了。我应该向纳塞布船长报告此事。
src: While wandering about the Docks District, I ran into Phanas Naseb, captain of a merchant ship. His specialty is transporting exotic animals. Unfortunately, a dire tiger in his hold has broken free of its cage, and is threatening to wreak havoc amongst the other animals down there. He has asked my assistance in geting the beast under control, giving me a dagger that has been enchanted to affect tigers specifically, putting them to sleep. I should only need to score one hit on the tiger, and should make a point not to kill so valuable a creature.\n\nThe tiger has been rendered harmless. I should report this to Captain Naseb.

src:

You store a divine spell within a specially prepared herb
Prerequisites: Lore 4 ranks, divine spellcaster level 3rd.
Benefit: You create an infusion of any divine spell available to you. Infusing an herb with a spell takes one day. When you create an infusion, you set the caster level, which must be sufficient to cast the spell in question but not higher than your own level. The base price of an infusion is its spell level times its caster level times 50 gp.  To create an infusion, you must spend 1/25 of this base price in XP and use up raw materials costing one-half this base price.  Any infusion that stores a spell with a costly material component or an XP cost also carries a commensurate cost. In addition to the costs derived from the base price, you must also expend the material component or pay the XP when creating the infusion

src:
The deep Imaskari are heirs to the lost empire of Imaskari. One of the earliest human empires, the Imaskari were destroyed by the slaves they had abducted from other worlds. A few, however, managed to preserve themselves and their kin. Fleeing deep into the bowels of the earth, they sealed themselves away from both the knowledge and the recriminations of the surface world. A deep Imaskari appears mostly human tall and slender. Her skin looks pale and stone like, as if expertly sculpted from the finest veined marble, though it is as soft as human skin to the touch.

Deep Imaskari Ability Adjustments: +2 Int, -2 Dex.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass imaskari's wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Skill Affinity (Hide): +2 racial bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Hide Underground): +4 racial bonus to Hide checks when underground
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Human: Imaskari are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

（进阶职业）
许多野蛮人部落中都有一些成员，他们的凶猛与狂怒甚至令同族野蛮人也感到敬畏和恐惧，冰原上的部落也不例外。冰冻狂战士是强大而危险的战士，一些人相信他们是从霜巨人神祇斯里姆那里获得了不稳定却强大的超自然战斗狂怒（另一些人则认为这是诅咒）.这种可怕的狂怒不仅使冰冻狂战士在进入战斗狂怒时体型增大，还让他的拳头和武器充满寒冷的冰碎片。那些将冰冻狂战士的本领视为恩赐的部落指出，他们在战斗中的技巧几乎无人能及；而那些将这些能力视为诅咒的部落则指出，冰冻狂战士在狂怒时往往过于沉溺于破坏和杀戮，令人难以信任。事实上，冰冻狂战士在霜怒状态下仍能控制自己的行为…… 只是大多数冰冻狂战士就是喜欢制造混乱和破坏。

所有冰冻狂战士在某种程度上都是野蛮人，尽管许多人是野蛮人/德鲁伊的多职业者。关于这类角色接连激活霜怒和野性变身能力的故事在冰原上广为流传；一只处于霜怒状态，化身为凶暴熊的角色确实是可怕的对手。其他野蛮人会在成为冰冻狂战士之前兼修一些战士或巡林客等级，以进一步强化自己的战斗能力；少数拥抱奥术魔法的部落中还存在罕见的野蛮人/术士冰冻狂战士，但其他组合几乎闻所未闻。

- 生命骰：d12 
- 擅长：冰冻狂战士不会获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础攻击加值：+6
技能：威吓 4 级，学识 4 级
专长：冰冻狂战士，精通徒手击打，猛力攻击

职业特性：

等级 
1：霜怒 - 防御等级 +4，徒手攻击造成 1d4 点寒冷伤害
   冻结之血 - 免疫创伤和流血致死
2：连环拳 - 徒手战斗中额外攻击

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Many barbarian tribes have members whose ferocity and rage impress and terrify even their fellow barbarians, and the tribes of the frostfell are no different. The frostragers are powerful and dangerous warriors believed by some to be gifted from (and others cursed by) the frost giant deity Thrym with an unstable but powerful supernatural battle rage. This terrible fury not only causes the frostrager to increase in size when he enters his battle rage, but infuses his fists and weapons with cold shards of ice. Those tribes that view a frostrager's prowess as a gift point to the fact that their skills in battle can be matched by few, while those that view these abilities as a curse point to the fact that while in a rage, frostragers tend to revel in destruction and slaughter a little too much to make them trustworthy. In truth, frostragers retain control of their actions while in a frostrage... the simple fact is that most frostragers enjoy causing mayhem and destruction. 

All frostragers are barbarians to some degree, although many are multiclass barbarian/druids. Stories of such characters who activate their frostrage and wild shape abilities in succession abound in the frostfell; a frostraging character in the shape of a dire bear is a terrible opponent indeed. Other barbarians pick up some levels of fighter or ranger to further focus their combat prowess before becoming frostragers, and a rare few barbarian/sorcerer frostragers exist in some tribes that embrace arcane magic, but other combinations are virtually unknown. 

- Hit Die: d12 
- Proficiencies: A frostrager does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies. 
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Intimidate 4 ranks, Lore 4 ranks
Feats: Frozen Berserker, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack
Special: Rage as a class ability

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Frostrage - Add +4 to AC, 1d4 cold damage on unarmed attacks
   Freezing Blood - Immune to wounding and bleeding out
2: One-Two Punch - Extra attacks during unarmed combat
3: Absorb Cold - Cold damage heals frostrager
4: Improved Frostrage - Add +6 to AC, 1d6 cold damage on unarmed attacks
5: Rend - Do extra damage if hitting with two or more unarmed strikes

dst: 在前往烛堡的途中，我遇到了一位树精，她正与一群信奉风暴与毁灭之神塔洛斯的人发生冲突。据树精所说，这些塔洛斯信徒试图获取古代耐瑟瑞尔风暴与毁灭之神科扎的雕像，据信科扎是塔洛斯的一个化身或别名。塔洛斯信徒显然能从这尊雕像中获得强大的力量，鉴于他们信仰的本质，他们无疑会将其用于毁灭性的目的。树精请求我前往北边不远处的废墟，亲自取回雕像，以阻止这一切。这可能很危险，因为这会让我与这些塔洛斯信徒发生冲突，而且据说雕像本身具有扭曲心智的力量。尽管如此，这似乎是一项值得完成的任务。\n\n我一路杀过一些塔洛斯信徒，到达废墟并取回了雕像。接下来我需要通知树精我成功了。
src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. According to the dryad, these Talosians seek to acquire an idol of the ancient Netherese god of storms and destruction Kozah, who is believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos. The Talosians can apparently gain great power from this idol, which given the nature of their beliefs they will doubtless use for destructive ends. The dryad has asked me to head to these ruins, a little ways to the north, and recover the idol myself, in order to prevent this. This may be dangerous, as it will put me in conflict with these Talosians, and the idol itself is said to have mind-warping powers. Nevertheless, it seems a worthy quest.\n\nI fought through some Talosians to reach the ruins and recover the idol. Next I need to inform the dryad of my success.

商人特隆·兰纳告诉过我们，在商贸之路沿线他的营地东北方，有一个附近被毁的采矿村庄，据称那里闹鬼，居民都在最近的內战中被屠杀。结果发现那地方其实并没有闹鬼，而是一群食人魔和兽人的藏身处。显然是它们首领的食人魔法师维持着幽灵的幻象，以吓退不速之客。我们决定清除这群危险的人形生物，既有利可图，也有益于该地区，于是我们继续深入这座废弃矿坑，却触发某种魔法陷阱，把我们传送到了这个地下矿洞和洞穴网络的某个下层区域。

我们与一个叫科尔佐布的食人魔混血儿会合，他原本是占据这座矿坑的人形生物团伙的一员，但与团伙首领——一个名叫奥布格隆的食人魔法师——发生了分歧。据科尔佐布说，我们唯一能绕过奥布格隆设置的传送陷阱的方法，就是去附近的同一片废墟中找一根魔法金杖，奥布格隆最初就是在那里找到了设置各种陷阱所需的装置和奥术知识。

我们已经获得了科尔佐布认为我们需要的物品，可以用来抵消奥布格隆的传送陷阱，不过在取得它的过程中，我们不得不与一个危险的奥胡恩战斗。现在我们需要返回矿坑，直面那个食人魔法师。
src:
The merchant trader Teron Lanner has told us of a nearby ruined mining village, found northeast of his camp along the Trade Way, and allegedly haunted by its inhabitants who were slaughtered in the recent civil wars. It turns out that the place is not actually haunted, but a hideout for a band of ogres and orcs. The ogre mage who is apparently their leader maintains illusions of ghosts to deter unwanted visitors. Deciding it would be both profitable and helpful to the region to clear out this dangerous group of humanoids, we proceeded to advance into the ruined mine, only to trigger some sort of magical trap that has teleported us to some lower section of this underground network of mines and caves.

We have joined up with one Korzob, an ogrillon who was part of the humanoid band occupying this mine, but who had a disagreement with the band's leader, an ogre mage named Obgron. According to Korzob, the only way we can get past the teleportation traps set up by Obgron is to find a magical golden rod in the same nearby ruins where Obgron found the various devices and arcane knowledge required to set up his various traps in the first place. 

We have acquired an item of the type Korzob believes we need to nullify Obgron's teleportation traps, though we had to battle a dangerous Alhoon in the process of securing it. Now we need to return to the mines and confront the ogre mage.

一个符文对入侵者及其5英尺内的所有生物造成每两个施法者等级1d8点伤害（最大5d8）.该伤害是强酸，寒冷，火焰，电击或音波（施法者在施法时选择）.每个受影响的生物可以尝试反射豁免以减半伤害。法术抗力对此效果适用。

Innate Level: 3

Component(s): Verbal, Somatic, Material
Range: Short
Area of Effect / Target: Large
Duration: Permanent until discharged
Additional Counter Spells:

This powerful inscription harms those who enter, pass, or open the warded area or object. A glyph of warding can guard a bridge or passage, ward a portal, trap a chest or box, and so on. You set the conditions of the ward. Glyphs respond to invisible creatures normally but are not triggered by those who travel past them ethereally.

When casting the spell, you weave a tracery of faintly glowing lines around the warding sigil.  When the spell is completed, the glyph and tracery become nearly invisible. Glyphs cannot be affected or bypassed by such means as physical or magical probing, though they can be dispelled.

A glyph deals 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d8) to the intruder and to all within 5 feet of him or her. This damage is acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic (caster's choice, made at time of casting). Each creature affected can attempt a Reflex save to take half damage. Spell resistance applies against this effect.

Material Component: You trace the glyph with incense, which must first be sprinkled with powdered diamond worth at least 200 gp.

src:
Rapture of Rupture
Transmutation [Evil]
Level: Corrupt 7
Components: V, S, Corrupt
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature touched per level
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude half
Spell Resistance: Yes

With this spell, the caster's touch deals grievous wounds to multiple targets. After rapture of rupture is cast, the caster can touch one target per round until she has touched a number of targets equal to her caster level. The same creature cannot be affected twice by the same rapture of rupture. A creature with no discernible anatomy is unaffected by this spell.

When the caster touches a subject, his flesh bursts open suddenly in multiple places. Each subject takes 6d6 points of damage and is stunned for 1 round; a successful Fortitude save reduces damage by half and negates the stun effect. Subjects who fail their Fortitude save continue to take 1d6 points of damage per round until they receive magical healing, succeed at a Heal check (DC 20), or die. If a subject takes 6 points of damage from rapture of rupture in a single round, he is stunned in the following round.

Corruption Cost: 1 point of Strength damage per target
touched.

Casters of good alignment cannot cast Corrupt spells.

An epic blighter is the walking death of ecosystems, a roving apocalypse wrapped in bone and flame. Where they pass, forests blacken, rivers sour, and life recoils in terror. No longer merely forsaken by nature, they have become its antithesis, an unrelenting force of defilement. Their very breath poisons the wind, and their touch spreads pestilence faster than wildfire.

Hit Die: d8.
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Intelligence modifier.
Bonus Feats: The epic Blighter gains a bonus feat every five levels.

Special:
Contagious Touch: the epic blighter gains another use of Contagious Touch every other level.
Undead Wild Shape: the epic blighter gains another use of undead wild shape every 4 levels.
Spellcasting: At each class level the epic Blighter continues to increase in divine caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Leadership, Epic Prowess, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Weapon Focus, Focused Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Toughness, Fast Healing, Great Wisdom, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Overwhelming Critical, Perfect Health, Tenacious Magic, Superior Initiative.

具体细节：上述职业可以使用搜索技能来定位难度等级高于 20 的陷阱。找到非魔法陷阱的 DC 至少为 20，如果隐藏得很好则更高。找到魔法陷阱的 DC 为 25 + 用于创建它的法咒等级。

拥有此职业能力的角色可以使用解除陷阱技能来解除魔法陷阱。魔法陷阱通常具有 DC 25 + 用于创建它的法咒等级。

如果角色在解除陷阱检定中超过陷阱的 DC 10 或更多，则可以研究陷阱，弄清楚其工作原理，并在不解除它的情况下绕过它（与盟友一起）.

使用：自动。
src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Beguiler 1, Factotum 1, Ninja 1, Psychic Rogue 1, Rogue 1 or Scout 1.

Specifics: The aformentioned classes can use the Search skill to locate traps when the task has a Difficulty Class higher than 20. Finding a nonmagical trap has a DC of at least 20, or higher if it is well hidden. Finding a magic trap has a DC of 25 + the level of the spell used to create it.

Characters with this class ability can use the Disable Trap skill to disarm magic traps. A magic trap typically has a DC of 25 + the level of the spell used to create it.

A character who beats a trap's DC by 10 or more with a Disable Trap check can study a trap, figure out how it works, and bypass it (with his allies) without disarming it.

Use: Automatic.

dst:
变形蛛常被误认为是蛛化狼人，它们是智能的，能变形的蜘蛛，拥有魔法力量。在其自然形态下，变形蛛形似一只大蜘蛛，其驼背的身体比人类躯干稍大。它像普通蜘蛛一样拥有带毒牙的颚。颚下方有两条约2英尺长的小手臂。每条手臂都有一只手，有四根多关节的手指和一个双关节的拇指。

尽管外表可怕，变形蛛是一个和平的种族。它们以动物为食，并不捕食有智慧的生物为生。它们倾向于远离文明社会居住，因为它们常被那些不了解它们的人猎杀。


变形蛛属性调整：+4 敏捷，+4 体质，+4 智力，+2 感知，+4 魅力

天赋职业（术士）：在判断兼职经验值惩罚时，兼职变形蛛的术士职业不计入其中。

种族特性：
- 变形蛛的基础陆地速度在蜘蛛形态下为50英尺，在混合或类人形态下为30英尺。
- 种族生命骰：变形蛛初始拥有三级变形者，提供3d8生命骰。
- 中型：作为中型生物，变形蛛没有因体型而获得的特殊加值或减值。
- 天生武器：变形蛛在蜘蛛和混合形态下可以啮咬造成1d6点伤害。
- 毒素：变形蛛的啮咬带有毒性，造成1d6力量初始伤害和2d6后续伤害。
- 天生护甲：变形蛛拥有+1天生护甲加值。
- 黑暗视觉：变形蛛能够在黑暗中如同在白昼中一样视物。
- 术士施法：变形蛛以其生命骰（3级）作为术士施展法咒。
- 简易武器：变形蛛擅长所有简易武器。
- 蛛网：变形蛛可以纺出并投掷粘性的网。
- 奖励专长：变形蛛获得警觉，精通先攻和武器娴熟作为奖励专长。
- 技能：变形蛛在跳跃，聆听和侦察检定上获得+2种族加值。他们在攀爬检定上获得+8种族加值。
- 变形者：变形蛛是变形者。

等级调整：+4
src:
Often confused for werespiders, araneas are intelligent, shapechanging spiders with sorcerous powers. In its natural form, an aranea resembles a big spider, with a humpbacked body a little bigger than a human torso. It has fanged mandibles like a normal spider. Two small arms, each about 2 feet long, lie below the mandibles. Each arm has a hand with four many-jointed fingers and a double-jointed thumb.

Despite their terrifying appearance, the aranea are a peaceful race of beings. They feed on animals and do not prey upon sapient creatures to live. They tend to live far from civilized society, as they are often hunted by those who do not understand them.


Aranea Ability Adjustments: +4 Dex, +4 Con, +4 Int, +2 Wis, +4 Cha

Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass aranea's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- An aranea's base land speed is 50 feet in spider form, 30 in hybrid or humanoid forms.
- Racial Hit Dice: An aranea begins with three levels of shapechanger, which provide 3d8 Hit Dice.
- Medium: As Medium creatures, aranea have no special bonuses or penalties due to their size.
- Natural Weapons:  An aranea can bite 1d6 points of damage in spider and hybrid form.
- Poison: An aranea's bite is poisonous and does 1d6 STR initial damage and 2d6 secondary damage.
- Natural Armor: Aranea have +1 natural armor bonus.
- Darkvision:  Aranea are able to see in the dark as well as daylight.
- Sorcerous Casting: Aranea cast spells as a Sorcerer of their hit dice (3rd level)
- Simple Weapons: Aranea are proficient with all simple weapons.
- Web: Aranea can spin and throw a sticky net-like webbing.
- Bonus Feats: Aranea gain Alertness, Improved Initiative and Weapon Finesse as bonus feats.
- Skills: Araneas have a +2 racial bonus on Jump, Listen, and Spot checks. They have a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks.
- Shapechanger: Aranea are shapechangers.

Level Adjustment: +4

src: This book was written in about -3500 DR by the dwarven historian Barun Tharuk, chronicling the history of the Dwarven realm of Shanater up to that point in time. It contains much historical information about early Shanatar that was lost to later generations after that nation's fall, as well as being itself an example of the viewpoint of what is now a long-lost era.\n\nWhile other extant ancient works have on occasion referred to or quoted extensively from this book, insuring that its existence was not forgotten, this is the only complete copy known to exist, making it quite valuable, and something in which the librarians of Candlekeep would be sure to be interested.

src: This amulet has a number of magical powers imbued in it, but the most important is its teleporting function. Indeed, if the servant is killed, the amulet can be teleported back without him, preventing theft, making it relatively safe to entrust it even to a low-level minion.

Wyrmbane Helm Wielder Requirements 
Ability to cast 2nd-level arcane spells
Base attack bonus +3
Proficient with martial weapons
2,000 gold
  
LEGACY RITUALS 
Least: 1,500 gp. 
Lesser: 11,500 gp.
Greater: 39,000 gp.

LEGACY ITEM PENALTIES (These do not stack. Highest takes precedence).
Attack Penalty: -1 at 8th, -2 at 12th, -3 at 18th
Hit Point Penalty: -2 at 6th, -4 at 7th, -6 at 9th, -8 at 13th, -10 at 15th, -12 at 19th
Spell Slot Lost: 1st at 6th, 2nd at 8th, 3rd at 10th, 4th at 14th, 5th at 16th, 6th at 20th
  
LEGACY ITEM BONUSES
None
  
LEGACY ITEM ABILITIES
Cause Fear (Sp): Starting at 5th level, you can use cause fear as a spell-like ability five times per day (caster level 5th). The save DC is 11 or 11 + your Cha modifier, whichever is higher.
Courage (Su): Starting at 6th level, you gain a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.
Lightning Bolt (Sp): Starting at 8th level, you can use lightning bolt as a spell-like ability once per day (caster level 7th). The save DC is 14 or 13 + your Cha modifier, whichever is higher.
Dragonbane (Su): Any melee weapon you wield gains a +2 enhancement bonus and deals an extra 2d6 points of damage when you attack a creature of the dragon type. 

In addition, any spell you cast that deals damage to a dragon deals an extra 2d6 points of damage to that dragon. If the spell allows a saving throw, the DC of the saving throw increases by 2. A single spell can never deal this extra damage more than once per casting. However, if a spell deals damage for more than 1 round, it deals the extra damage in each round.
Blindsense (Su): You gain Blindsense.
Charisma Boost (Su): Starting at 14th level, you gain a +4 enhancement bonus to your Charisma as long as you wear the Wyrmbane Helm.
Sudden Empower (Su): At 16th level, you gain the ability to apply the Empower Spell metamagic feat to any spell you cast without increasing the level of the spell or preparing it ahead of time. You can use this ability three times per day.
Frightful Presence (Su): When you charge, attack, or cast a spell while wearing the helm, you force nearby enemies to make a fear check.
Immune to Electricity: Starting at 18th level, you are immune to electricity damage as long as you wear the Wyrmbane Helm.
Strength Boost (Su): Starting at 19th level, you gain a +6 enhancement bonus to your Strength as long as you wear the helm.
Lightning Breath (Su): At 20th level, you gain a breath weapon that you can use three times per day and never in consecutive rounds. Your lightning breath deals I2d8 points of damage in a 100-foot line(DC25 or 20 + your Con modifier, whichever is higher).

在过去的两千年里，暗影之城一直存在于暗影位面，由从该位面以及费伦捕获的奴隶维持着良好的状态。统治这座城市的耐色瑞尔法师们还与由与该位面相同的幽暗物质构成的恶魔生物进行交易。有时，这些恶魔会强迫奴隶；这些交配所生的后代是一个被称为克林斯的独特种族。
  
克林斯以其身体坚忍，专一和急躁的脾气而闻名。由于前两个特质，他们是优秀的战士和仆人，但第三个特质往往意味着他们在两种角色中都寿命短暂。

克林斯属性调整：-2 魅力，+2 体质
偏好职业（战士）：在决定兼职的克林斯是否因兼职而受到 XP 惩罚时，其战士职业不计入。

特殊能力：

黑暗视觉 60 尺。
所有意志豁免 +1 种族加值。
对抗具有暗影描述符的法咒和类法咒能力的所有豁免 +1 加值。
躲藏检定 +2 种族加值
对抗恐惧的豁免 +4 种族加值
克林斯不会变得战栗，且忽略战栗状态的效果

克林斯在法咒和能力方面被视为人类
src:
For the past two thousand years, the City of Shade has existed on the Plane of Shadow, kept in good condition by slaves captured from that plane as well as from Faer�n. The Netherese wizards who rule the city also trafficked with demonic creatures made of the same tenebrous substance as the plane itself. On occasion, these demons would force themselves on the slaves; the offspring from these couplings are a unique race known as the krinth. 
  
Krinth are known for their physical endurance, their singlemindedness, and their quick tempers. They make excellent warriors and servants because of the first two traits, but the third often means they are short-lived at both roles.

Krinth Ability Adjustments: -2 Cha, +2 Con
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass krinth's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

Darkvision out to 60 feet. 
+1 racial bonus on all Will saves. 
+1 bonus on all saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities with the shadow descriptor. 
+2 racial bonus on Hide checks
+4 racial bonus on saving throws against fear
Krinth cannot become shaken, and they ignore the effects of the shaken condition

Krinth count as human for spells and abilities

我见到了可怕的扎加什，一个巫妖，我竟然发现他住在沙漠巨龙客栈的一个房间里。他向我提出了一个有趣的提议。显然，那些似乎在策划对卡林杉发动战争的变形蛛不知怎么发现了他的命匣。他们利用对命匣的控制削弱了扎加什并降低了他的力量，并打算用摧毁命匣（从而彻底消灭他）的威胁来勒索他为他们的事业服务。然而扎加什无意让他们摆布，并想出了一个计划，伪装成一群冒险者去对抗他们。因此，他准备加入我在城外对抗变形蛛各种类人盟友的任务。

我接受了他的提议，扎加什现在将作为同伴与我同行。我期待他会是一个有价值的盟友。

在与扎加什穿越镜之森林时，我们遇到了他以前的巢穴，那里已被变形蛛和地精占据。我们清除了这些入侵者，但当我们到达扎加什存放命匣的地方时，却找不到它。变形蛛一定把它转移到了别处。然而扎加什并没有放弃寻找它。
src:
I have met with Zagash the Terrible, a lich who I discovered occupying a room at the Desert Dragon Inn, of all places. He had an interesting offer to make me. Apparently the aranea who are seemingly orchestrating a war against Calimshan somehow discovered his phylactery. They have used their control of it to weaken Zagash and reduce his power, and intend to use the threat of destroying it (and therefore him) for good to blackmail him into serving their cause. Zagash however has no intention of letting them order him around and has conceived a plan to travel in disguise with a group of adventurers to fight against them. As a result, he is prepared to join with me on my quests outside the city to fight the various humanoid allies of the aranea.

I have accepted his offer, and Zagash will now be traveling with me as a companion. I expect he will be a valuable ally.

While traveling with Zagash in the Forest of Mir, we came across his former lair, which had been taken over by aranea and goblins. We cleared the place of these intruders, but upon reaching the place within where Zagash stored his phylactery, it was not to be found. The aranea must have transported it elsewhere. Zagash has by no means given up on finding it, however.

dst: 在米尔森林中与地精战斗时，我遇到了一些小妖精。他们的首领泽帕警告我，北边有一片树林，里面住着一些树精。不幸的是，地精首领乌拉斯的副官戈拉夫也在那里，他威胁要砍倒树精赖以生存的树木，除非他们与地精并肩作战。泽帕请求我不要杀死那些被迫违背意愿与地精合作的树精。树精位于树林中央，所以泽帕建议我绕到边缘，找到东北方戈拉夫的营地，然后杀死他。一旦戈拉夫死了，树精就不再敌对，甚至可能帮助我们。无论如何，泽帕都会给予奖励。\n\n我解决了戈拉夫，但泽帕拒绝给我奖励，因为我也杀了一些树精。
src: While fighting through the Forest of Mir against the goblins within it, I came across some pixies. Their leader, Zeepa, warned me that to the north there is a grove with some Dryads in it. Unfortunately, Gorav, a lieutenant of the goblin leader Ulaz, is also there and is threatening to cut down the dryad's trees, which they need to survive, if they do not fight alongside the goblins. Zeepa has asked me not to kill the dryads, who are being forced to work with the goblins against their will. The dryads are found in the center of the grove, so Zeepa suggests I sneak around the edges to locate Gorav's camp in the northeast, and kill him. Once Gorav is dead the dryads will no longer be hostile and may even assist us. In any case, Zeepa will have a reward.\n\nI dealt with Gorav, but Zeepa refused to reward me because I slew some of the dryads as well.

如果你选择造成伤害，区域内任何因任何来源受到生命值伤害的人必须进行强韧豁免。失败表示受术者获得一个负向等级。成功则防止负向等级，但如果该人在区域内再次受到伤害，必须重新尝试豁免。这些负向等级在每施法者等级1小时后消退，且永远不会造成永久等级损失。

src:
Initiate, Darkened Alleys
Level/School: 6th/Necromancy [Darkness]
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area: 30-ft.-radius emanation
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates; see text
Spell Resistance: Yes

Tendrils of darkness flow from the ground like smoke, filling the area with writhing, shifting darkness. A cold draft washes over your soul even as the tendrils rise.

The area of deadly shade is filled with shadowy illumination, as per darkness (PH 216). In addition, each time you invoke this mystery, decide if you wish the spell to deal or absorb damage.

If you choose to deal damage, anyone within the area who suffers hit point damage from any source must make a Fortitude save. Failure indicates that the subject gains a negative level. Success prevents the negative level, but if the individual is damaged again within the area, he must attempt a new save. These negative levels fade in 1 hour per caster level, and they never cause permanent level loss.

If you choose instead to have the deadly shade absorb damage, all creatures within the area gain DR 4/- and energy resistance 4 against all energy types.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Anima mages give binders a bad name. Greedy and ambitious, they exploit the powers of the vestiges to which they bind to advance their own abilities. Anima mages see such displaced entities as mere tools, no different from spell component pouches or a wand of fireball. With the power of a vestige, an anima mage can tap a resource all but unknown to his rivals to gain an edge against other spellcasters. The anima mage is a loner, an outsider, and a potential enemy to both binders and witch slayers. But the way others classify him matters little to him, for power is at hand.

- Hit Die: d4
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Any nongood
Skills: Intimidate 4 ranks, Lore 4 ranks
Feat: Any metamagic feat

Special: Ability to bind a 2nd-level vestige, soul binding class feature

6:

Soul Binding/Spellcasting: At each level, you gain new soul binds and spells per day and an increase in caster level (and spells known, if applicable) as if you had gained a level in both your soul binding-using class and your arcane spellcasting class.

dst:
那些听说过混血人的人都知道他们是粗野，丑陋的生物，带有他们所有亲代种族最糟糕的特征。而这正是混血人所喜欢的。实际上，混血人可以冒充他们亲代种族中的任何一员。事实上，当某人遇到一个混血人时，他总是会认为这个新认识的人是其他主要类人种族之一的成员--只是不是他自己的种族。矮人把混血人看作异常高大，宽肩的精灵，而精灵可能认为他们是出奇高大，苗条的矮人。兽人视他们为古怪矮小，丑陋的人类，而人类可能视他们为高大，奇怪地俊美或兽人。对每个种族来说，混血人看起来都像是另一个种族的成员，因为他们具有几个物种共有的特征。混血人利用这种无法确定他们血统的特点来为自己谋利。毕竟，如果目击者甚至无法确定罪犯的种族，就很难描述罪犯。那些少数天生具有明显非人类特征的混血人，则充当了分散对种族其他成员注意力的角色。他们从小就知道自己会被其他种族唾弃，但会被自己的族人暗中尊敬。这些明显畸形的混血人会确保该地区的人知道他们是谁，在哪里，从而强化关于他们种族整体的刻板印象。在这种情况下，外表普通的混血人往往能够更自由地行动，因为没有人会把那个略高的矮人或略矮壮的精灵与附近树林中隐藏的可怕畸形生物联系起来。
  
混血人种族特性：
+4 体质，-2 智力，-4 魅力：混血人强壮坚韧，但他们缺乏适当的教育，而且其他人觉得他们的外表令人厌恶，或至少隐约令人不安。
 类人生物（人类）：混血人是具有人类亚种的类人生物。
中型：作为中型生物，混血人没有因体型而获得的特殊加值或减值。
混血人基础陆地速度为 30 英尺。
微光视觉：混血人在星光，月光和类似微弱光照条件下能看到的距离是人类的两倍。
免疫睡眠法咒和类似魔法效果。
扩散血脉：混血人在对抗任何针对特定种族或忽略特定种族的法咒时获得 +2 种族豁免加值，前提是所选种族是其总体血统的一部分（人类，半身人，
矮人，精灵，侏儒，地精或兽人）.
+1 种族豁免加值，对抗附魔系法咒或效果以及幻象法咒或效果。
+1 种族豁免加值，对抗毒素。
+1 种族加值，用于估价，攀爬，跳跃，聆听，潜行，搜索和侦察检定。
+4 种族加值，用于躲藏，扒窃和使用魔法装置检定。
天赋职业：游荡者。混血人多职业时，其游荡者职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。
等级调整 +0。
src:
Those people who have heard of mongrelfolk know them as brutish, ugly creatures who bear the worst features of all their parent races. And that is exactly how the mongrelfolk like it. In actuality, mongrelfolk can pass for members of their parent races-any of them. In fact, when someone meets a mongrelfolk, he always assumes the new acquaintance is a member of one of the other major humanoid races-just not his own. Dwarves see mongrelfolk as unusually tall and broadshouldered elves, while elves might consider them to be surprisingly tall and slender dwarves. Orcs view them as oddly short and ugly humans, while humans might see them as tall and strangely comely orcs. To each race, a mongrelfolk looks like a member of another race, because they have features common to several species. Mongrelfolk use this inability to pin down their ancestry to their advantage. After all, it is difficult to describe the culprit of a crime if a witness cannot even identify her race with certainty. Those few mongrelfolk who are born with clearly nonhuman features serve as a distraction from the rest of the race. They grow up knowing that they will be spat upon by the other races, but secretly honored by their own kin. These visibly misshapen mongrelfolk make sure that people in the area know who they are and where they are, thus reinforcing the stereotype about their race in general. In such a situation, ordinary-appearing mongrelfolk are often able to move about more freely, because no one associates the slightly tall dwarf or slightly stocky elf with the hideously deformed creature hiding in the woods nearby.
  
Mongrelfolk Racial Traits:
+4 Constitution, -2 Intelligence, -4 Charisma: Mongrelfolk are hardy, but they lack proper education and others find their appearance repulsive or at least vaguely unsettling.
 Humanoid (human): Mongrelfolk are humanoid creatures with the human subtype.
Medium: As Medium creatures, mongrelfolk have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Mongrelfolk base land speed is 30 feet.
Low-Light Vision: Mongrelfolk can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. 
Immunity to sleep spells and similar magical effects.
Diffuse Blood: Mongrelfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against any spell that targets a particular race or ignores a particular race, provided the selected race is part of their general ancestry (human, halfling,
dwarf, elf, gnome, goblin, or orc).
+1 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells or effects and illusion spells or effects.
+1 racial bonus on saving throws against poison.
+1 racial bonus on Appraise, Climb, Jump, Listen, Move Silently, Search, and Spot checks.
+4 racial bonus on Hide, Pickpocket, and Use Magical Device checks.
Favored Class: Rogue. A multiclass mongrelfolk's rogue class does not count when determining whether she takes an experience point penalty for multiclassing.
Level adjustment +0.

src:
School: Conjuration [Healing[
Components: V, S
Range: Personal
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

In the heat of battle, there are times when odds begin to stack against you. These odds climb exponentially higher if allies begin to fall. With a casting of this powerful spell, you will restore all deceased allies to full life and vigor. In addition, any allies (including yourself), that may have sustained injuries are healed to complete health. You do not have to be in the vicinity of your allies for them to receive the benefits of this spell. However, while all allies are either healed or resurrected, this spell does not save them from whatever situation might have caused their demise; Fallen allies are raised where they fell, the injured are healed where they stand.

dst: "我看得出你对泽法德之剑的相关传说并不陌生。你当然明白，当人们说一个恶魔被‘杀死’时，那只是一种说法。这类生物从未真正被毁灭，只是暂时被放逐到更深的位面。在阿兹古尔卡的情况中，这种放逐呈现出一种奇特的形式。不知何故，剑的力量使他被困在一个口袋位面中，一个与剑相关、或许由剑创造的位面。自那以后，他一直在努力寻找出路并返回主物质位面，而他现在即将实现这个目标。"
src: "I see you are not unfamiliar with the lore surrounding the Sword of Zefad. You realize, of course, that when one talks of a demon being 'slain' that is just a manner of speaking. Such creatures are never truly destroyed, simply banished further into the planes for a time. In Azghulkar's case this banishment took a peculiar form. Somehow the powers of the sword caused him to become trapped in a pocket plane, one associated with the sword and perhaps created by it. He has been struggling ever since to find his way out and back to the Prime Material, and he is now on the verge of accomplishing that aim."

Epic Brimstone Speakers are divine orators of sacred flame, their voices echoing with the resonance of celestial truth. Their mastery of truenames reaches apocalyptic potency, capable of invoking divine conflagrations that sear away corruption and summon angelic paragons from the farthest reaches of the Upper Planes. Spellcasting: At each odd class level the epic Brimstone Speaker continues to increase in divine caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

For a fee, I will permit you to pass through it, travel to the far plane that lies beyond, brave its hazards, and, perhaps, return with magnificent treasures. 扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的大图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识，这样一把重铸的剑也许是阿兹古尔卡重返此位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。

在前往烛堡的途中，我们绕道去了小镇纳什凯尔，遇到了一位名叫伊扎多·夸巴克斯的侏儒，他原来是一名竖琴手，一直在寻找我们以提供帮助，同时还遇到了一些追捕我们的赏金冒险者，不得不解决他们。其中一名冒险者原来是我们的老对头加拉德·阿沙勒，他显然一直在秘密与伊扎多合作，而这次他转换了阵营，显然打算帮助我们。

据伊扎多说，通往烛堡的路线被更多被扎拉拉和我的人头悬赏吸引而来的冒险者以及巨龙克拉卡奇’弗拉兹’塔尔严密把守，要到达那里并不容易。他声称有一个解决这个问题的计划，但这取决于他与冒险者中一名显然是双重间谍的人的合作。这名联络人会转换阵营为我们工作，前提是支付750000金币。伊扎多建议我们可以通过杀死绿龙格拉’阿扎’乌库尔来获得这笔钱中的至少很大一部分，这条龙巢穴在尖牙森林的某处，这样既可以掠夺他的宝藏，也可以领取他头上的赏金。要找到这条龙，我们应该和一群在森林边缘扎营的竖琴手游侠谈谈，他们由一位名叫塔布伦·卡什滕的人领导。他还建议我们和纳什凯尔一个名叫奥布莱克的人谈谈，以获取这条龙的赏金，也许还有其他一些赏金。
src:
Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.

Diverted to the small town of Nashkel on our way to Candlekeep, we encountered a gnome named Izado Quabax, who turned out to be a Harper who has been looking for us in order to give us aid, as well as some bounty-hunting adventurers seeking us who had to be dealt with. One of these adventures turned out to be our old foe Garad Ashaler, who apparently has been secretly working with Izado, and on this occasion switched sides and apparently is going to help us. 

According to Izado, the routes to Candlekeep are guarded well by more adventurers lured by bounties on the heads of Zarala and myself, as well the the dragon Krackach'vraz'tar, and it will not be easy to get there. He claims to have a plan for dealing with this problem, but it depends on the cooperation of an apparent double agent among the adventurers wtih whom he is in contact. This contact will switch sides and work for us if paid 750000 gold. Izado suggested we could get at least a large percentage of this sum by slaying the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, who lairs somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, in order both to loot his hoard and collect a bounty on his head. To find the dragon, we should talk to a group of Harper rangers who have made camp on the outskirts of the Wood, led by one Tabrun Carshten. He also suggested we talk to someone named Oublek, in Nashkel, to get the bounty on the dragon and perhaps some other bounties as well.

dst: 每日法咒：哈斯兰的训练专注于奥术或神术。每两级，哈斯兰获得新的每日法咒，如同她在其最高奥术和神术职业上也提升了一级。然而，她不会通过此能力学习任何新的奥术法咒。她也不会获得该职业角色本应获得的任何其他好处（控制或驱散不死生物的几率提升，超魔或物品制造专长等等）.这基本上意味着她将哈斯兰等级添加到角色拥有的其他施法职业等级上，然后据此确定每日法咒和施法者等级。由于所有哈斯兰都是多职业施法者，有些选择扩展其奥术技能，另一些选择神术，其余的则在两者之间取得平衡。
src: Spells per Day: A hathran's training focuses on arcane or divine spells. Every second level, the hathran gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in her highest arcane and divine classes. She does not learn any new arcane spells through this ability, however. She does not, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (improved chance of controlling or rebuking undead, metamagic or item creation feats, and so on). This essentially means that she adds the level of hathran to the level of whatever other spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day and caster level accordingly. Since all hathrans are multiclasss spellcasters, some choose to expand their skill in arcane, others the divine, and the remainder strike a balance between the two.

dst:
在穿过维尔达斯森林时，我遇到了一位名叫赛亚拉的树精。她最近被穿行于森林中的豺狼人和牛头人所困扰，它们彼此交战，而她尤其担心自己两个姐妹的命运，她们最近为了躲避这样一场战斗而逃离。这两位树精中，一位逃进了附近的洞穴，另一位则逃向了东边的区域。两人都没有回来，赛亚拉担心她们遇到了某种危险。她请求我调查这两个区域，先从洞穴开始，以救出她的姐妹，或至少查明她们遭遇了什么。

我发现赛亚拉的姐妹被囚禁在洞穴中。与此同时，我身后的门砰然关闭，断绝了退路。随后我面临两条道路的选择：一条会杀死被囚禁的树精，另一条则会释放她，但代价是我自身危险增加。不幸的是，后者似乎风险太大，所以我选择了导致树精死亡的那条路。我预计赛亚拉不会对此感到高兴，但这是糟糕选项中最好的一个。现在我必须充分利用已经为我打开的道路。

赛亚拉果然很不高兴，起初不愿给我任何奖励，但我成功改变了她的想法。
src:
While proceeding through the Wealdath forest, I came across a dryad named Saiala. She has been inconvenienced by the gnolls and minotaurs who have recently been moving through the forest, battling each other, and is particularly concerned with the fate of her two sisters, who recently fled in order to avoid becoming caught up in one such battle. One of these two dryads fled into a nearby cave, and the other to the regions to the east. Neither has returned and Saiala fears they have run into some sort of danger. She has asked that I investigate both areas, starting with the cave, in order to rescue her sisters or at least discover what became of them.

I found Saiala's sister held captive in the cave. At the same time, the door behind me snapped shut, preventing retreat. I was then given a choice of two paths to follow, one of which would slay the captive dryad, while the other would set her free at the cost of increasing my own danger. Unfortunately, the latter seemed too great a risk, so I chose to take the path resulting in the dryad's death. I expect Saiala will not be happy about that, but it was the best of set of bad options. Now I must make the best of the path that has now been opened for me.

Saiala was indeed unhappy and initially unwilling to give me any reward, but I was able to change her mind.

dst:
在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队开始搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续书籍时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，此人住在贵族区西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了任何线索，我可以去塞卡娅在商业区东北部的家中向她报告。

我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他让我去找水手科拉努·乌马尔。现在我已经和科拉努谈过了，他告诉了我阿拉达尔可能调查过的两条线索：第一，他以前的一个船友德拉沙姆·埃纳尔，科拉努认为他曾是符文的特工，现在住在商业区西南部；第二，一个隐藏的房间，通过贵族区东北部一堵墙上的暗门进入，科拉努认为那是符文使用的藏身处。既然我已经知道该往哪里找，这扇门应该不会太难找到。

我已经搜查了那个隐藏的房间，它似乎早已被废弃，我发现了一块守护石，里面似乎有某种魔法。它很可能对这次调查有一定价值或关联，尽管目前还不清楚具体是什么。无论如何，我在那里找不到其他东西了。

我已经和德拉沙姆·埃纳尔谈过了，他又把我引向了一个叫费亚尔·泰塞纳尔的人。泰塞纳尔曾是符文的特工，他告诉了我其中一名成员：泰罗兹·甘，他利用自己精湛的幻术将自己伪装成一个普通的中等实力人类法师，但实际上他是一名巫妖和大法师。甘住在学者角区的一座小塔里。如果我要找到阿拉达尔，那就是我接下来必须去的地方，尽管我不确定如果真的打起来，我能对一个强大的巫妖做什么。好吧，我一直都知道冒险不是最安全的工作。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

I spoke to Lamash Kasat, who in turn sent me to seek out the sailor Kolanu Umal. Now I have spoken to Kolanu, and he in turn has told me of two paths that Aladar might have investigated: first, a former shipmate of his, Drasham Enar, who Kolanu believes was an agent of the Rune, and who now lives in the southwest part of the Merchant District, and secondly, a hidden chamber accessed through a secret door in a wall in the northeastern part of the Noble District, that Kolanu believes to be a hideout used by the Rune. This door should not be too difficult to find now that I have been directed where to look.

I have searched through the hidden chamber, which seems to be long abandoned, and found a wardstone that seems to have some sort of magic in it. lt may well turn out to have some value or relevance to this investigation, though at the moment it is not clear what that would be. At any rate, I could find nothing else there.

I have spoken to Drasham Enar, who in turn led me to one Feyar Tesenal. Tesenal was once an agent of the Rune, and has told me of one of its members: Teroz Gan, who uses his mastery of illusion to disguise himself as a conventionally human wizard of moderate power, but who is in fact a lich and an archmage. Gan lives in a small tower in the Scholar's Corner District. That is where I must go next if I am to find Aladar, though I am not sure what I could do against a powerful lich if it comes to a fight. Well, I always knew adventuring wasn't the safest job around.

src:
Starting at 3rd level, you can call up hellfire to surround yourself with a protective barrier. Whenever someone directs a melee attack against you, you can, as an immediate action, aim a blast of hellfire at that creature. This blast deals damage equal to your eldritch blast (including bonus damage from the hellfire blast ability). This blast automatically strikes the target, which can attempt a Reflex saving throw for half damage (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Cha modifier).

Each time you use this ability, you take 1 point of Constitution damage. Because the diabolical forces behind the power of hellfire demand part of your essence in exchange for this granted power, if you do not have a Constitution score or are somehow immune to Constitution damage, you cannot use this ability.

Aym曾是矮人君主，她的贪婪导致她的帝国覆灭。作为一个魂灵，她赋予宿主穿戴护甲而不受阻碍的能力，以触碰点燃生物，抵抗火焰效果，并以重击驱散物体。

魂灵等级：1级
绑定DC: 15
特殊要求：无

Aym授予你反映其矮人血统和她给王国带来毁灭的力量。

火焰光环：随意，你可以将自己笼罩在火焰花环中。任何在近战中攻击你的对手受到1d6点火焰伤害。你还可以用每次近战触碰攻击造成1d6点火焰伤害。

src:
Aym, Queen Avarice
  
Once a monarch of dwarves, Aym allowed her greed to bring an end to her empire. As a vestige, she gives her host the ability to wear armor without impedance, to set creatures alight with a touch, to resist the effects of fire, and to scatter objects with heavy blows.

Vestige Level: 1st
Binding DC: 15
Special Requirement: None

Granted Abilities: 
Aym grants you powers that reflect her dwarven heritage and the ruin she brought to her kingdom.

Dwarven Step: You can move at normal speed (without the usual reduction) while wearing medium or heavy armor.

Halo of Fire: At will, you can shroud yourself in a wreath of flame. Any opponent that strikes you in melee takes 1d6 points of fire damage. You can also deal 1d6 points of fire damage with each melee touch attack you make.

Improved Disarm: You gain the benefit of the Improved Disarm feat.

Medium Armor Proficiency: You are proficient with medium armor.

Resistance to Fire: You have resistance to fire 10.

Ruinous Attack: If your effective binder level is at least 10th, your melee attacks are treated as +5 for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

墓触食尸鬼会说它生前所说的所有语言（通常是通用语）. 它拥有基础生物的所有统计数据与特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型 啮咬伤害 爪击伤害
超微型       1     -

小型      1d4   1d3

特殊攻击：墓触食尸鬼保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下描述的能力。除非另有说明，豁免 DC 为 10 + 1/2 墓触食尸鬼的生命骰 + 墓触食尸鬼的魅力调整值。
食尸鬼腐热（Su）：墓触食尸鬼的啮咬攻击传播食尸鬼腐热疾病

驱散抗力（Ex）：墓触食尸鬼拥有 +2 驱散抗力。

专长：墓触食尸鬼保留其所有专长，并获得多重攻击作为奖励专长。

�Gravetouched ghoul?is an acquired template that can be added to any corporeal aberration, fey, giant, humanoid, or monstrous humanoid with Intelligence and Charisma scores of 3 or higher (referred to hereafter as the base creature).

A gravetouched ghoul speaks all the languages it spoke in life (usually Common). It has all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type: The creature's type changes to undead. Do not recalculate base attack bonus, saves, or skill points. Size is unchanged.

Hit Dice: Increase to d12.

Armor Class: The base creature's natural armor bonus improves by 2.

Attack: A gravetouched ghoul retains all the attacks of the base creature and also gains a bite and two claw attacks if it didn't already have them. If the base creature uses weapons, the gravetouched ghoul retains this ability. 

Damage: Gravetouched ghouls have bite and claw attacks. 

Size Bite Damage Claw Damage
Fine       1     -
Diminutive 1d2   1
Tiny       1d3   1d2
Small      1d4   1d3
Medium     1d6   1d4
Large      1d8   1d6
Huge       2d6   1d8
Gargantuan 2d8   2d6
Colossal   4d6   2d8

Special Attacks: A gravetouched ghoul retains all the special attacks of the base creature and gains those described below. Saves have a DC of 10 + 1/2 the gravetouched ghoul's HD + gravetouched ghoul's Cha modifier unless otherwise noted.
Ghoul Rot (Su): The gravetouched ghoul's bite attack delivers the ghoul rot disease 
Paralysis (Ex): Victims hit by a gravetouched ghoul's bite or claw attack must make a successful Fortitude save or be paralyzed for 1d4+1 rounds. Elves have immunity to this paralysis.

Special Qualities: A gravetouched ghoul retains all the special qualities of the base creature and gains those described below.
Turn Resistance (Ex): A gravetouched ghoul has +2 turn resistance.

Abilities: Increase from the base creature as follows: Str +2, Dex +4, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +2. As an undead creature, a gravetouched ghoul has no Constitution score.

Feats: A gravetouched ghoul retains all its feats, and it gains Multiattack as a bonus feat.

Alignment: Base creature's alignment changes to chaotic evil.

Level Adjustment: Same as base creature +2.

src:
Beyl Van Yoren was a young student in the monastery of the Dark Moon who was seduced away from her order by a local transmuter named Vergol. 

To punish Beyl for her desertion, the Order's elder monks contracted a rival spellcaster to arm several of their best remaining students with these bracers, hoping the bracers would prove a match to Vergol's haste-inducing spells. However, the Order did not foresee Vergol's equal expertise with hindering spells, and the students have not been seen since.

Note that while the celerity these bracers provide is very useful, continual movement at such speeds does tend to put strains on the wearer's metabolism, sapping vitality.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Henshin Mystics are members of a monastic order that teaches what they consider to be a great mystery of the universe: that humanity is capable of a transformation (henshin) into divinity. Their training and discipline is aimed toward the ultimate perfection not only of themselves, but of all humanity. They believe this perfection is the future of the world and of humanity. This belief fills them with a hopeful peace.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: No additional proficiencies are gained.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any Lawful
Base Attack Bonus: +7
Skills: Lore 13 Ranks
Feats: Purity of Body

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Riddle of Awareness - The Henshin Mystic can use scrying as a spell-like ability once per day. This grants the Henshin Mystic a +4 insight bonus on all Listen, Search and Spot checks for 1 minute per level. Scrying isn't in Neverwinter Nights but the bonuses are translated.
2: Blind Fight - Character gets to roll her miss chance percentile to see if it actually hits, as well invisible creatures get no bonus to hit the character in melee.
  Diamond Body - Henshin Mystic in control of his metabolism that he gains immunity to poison of all kinds.

CLASS FEATURES:

The Henshin mystic continues to gain levels as a monk with regard to unarmed damage.

src: Spells per Day/Spells Known: A true necromancer gains new spells per day (and spells known, if applicable) as if she had also gained a level in either an arcane spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class, a divine spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class, or both, according to the accompanying table. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (metamagic or item creation feats and so on; but see Improved Rebuking and Necromantic Prowess, below). If she had more than one arcane or divine spellcasting class before becoming a true necromancer, she must decide to which class she adds the levels for purposes of determining spells per day and spells known.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Thrall of Graz'zt
Starting at 3rd level, a Thrall of Graz'zt can add an enhancement bonus on certain Charisma based skill checks.  This bonus applies to all Animal Empathy, Bluff, Persuade, and Perform checks.

This bonus starts at +1 at 3rd level, and increases by one at level 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 21, 25, and 29 for maximum bonus of +9.

（进阶职业）
宣誓保卫大森林并侍奉莱斯之环的德鲁伊统治者南提亚，南提亚猎人游荡在东部荒野，根除邪恶与污秽之物。南提亚猎人精通钢铁与魔法，是一位足智多谋，自给自足的英雄，学会了相信自己的判断，对抗那些会伤害森林的人。南提亚猎人数量稀少，但即使一个猎人也能够为她所爱的土地成就伟业。

野蛮人和巡林客是最常见的南提亚猎人，因为这个进阶职业提供了强大的森林魔法来补充他们的战斗技能。德鲁伊较少被这个职业吸引，因为南提亚猎人的许多法咒是德鲁伊法咒，而南提亚猎人宣誓保护德鲁伊并执行他们的法令。偏好荒野技能的战士和游荡者有时会成为南提亚猎人，但牧师，术士和法师不常选择这条道路。

- 生命骰：d6
- 武器和防具擅长：南提亚猎人获得简易和军用武器擅长以及轻甲擅长

要求：

阵营：非邪恶

4：鹰眼 - +4 侦察
5：狮心 - 免疫恐惧

从1级开始，南提亚猎人获得施放少量神术的能力，如同德鲁伊施法，尽管她有自己的独特法咒列表，最高到5级法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Sworn to defend the great forests and serve the Nentyarch, druidic ruler of the Circle of Leth, the Nentyar hunters roam the wild lands of the East, uprooting foul and evil things. Skilled with both steel and magic, a Nentyar hunter is a resourceful, self-reliant hero who has learned to trust her own judgment, confronting those who would harm the forest. The Nentyar hunters are few in number, but even a single hunter is capable of achieving great things in the service of the lands she loves. 

Barbarians and rangers are the most common Nentyar hunters, as the prestige class offers access to powerful forest magic to complement their skill at fighting. Druids are less commonly drawn to the class, since many of the Nentyar hunter's spells are druid spells, and the Nentyar hunters are sworn to protect druids and carry out their edicts. Fighters and rogues with a preference for wilderness skills sometimes become Nentyar hunters, but clerics, sorcerers, and wizards do not often choose this path. 

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A nentyar hunter gains simple and martial weapon proficiencies and light armor proficiency
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Alignment: Nonevil
Feats: Alertness, Combat Casting, Track
Skills: Spot 8, Search 4

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Woodland Stride
2: Swift Tracker - +1 Spot, Search Listen
3: Swiftness of the Stag - +10 ft movement speed in light or no armor
4: Eyes of the Hawk - +4 Spot
5: Heart of the Lion - Immune to Fear

 Beginning at 1st level, a Nentyar hunter gains the ability to cast a small number of divine spells, as per druid casting, although she has her own unique spell list that goes to 5th level spells.

src: While traveling through the Underdark, I came across a priestess of the drow goddess Lolth. She was standing over the corpse of another priestess, who she informed me had been killed by a very powerful drider. This drider stole a key and a holy symbol from the dead priestess, and is using the former to enter what was once a temple of Lolth and center of powerful magic. He presumably intends to use the holy symbol within in some magical ritual, perhaps one meant to remove the curse making him a drider. Whatever his motives, the priestess considers his actions to be blasphemy against Lolth, and has asked me to track down the drider and recover the stolen holy symbol. I will be rewarded by her with an item of magical gear, some gold and a special blessing from Lolth if I succeed in this.

dst: "古尔古穆克受到兽人的崇敬，被其他所有人憎恨，所以当他去世时，他的部落将他埋葬在一座巨大而广阔的陵墓中，据称有许多宝藏，作为他伟大的纪念碑。兽人萨满在陵墓上施加了各种结界和诅咒，这样他的敌人就无法亵渎和掠夺它。由于古尔古穆克深受兽人诸神的眷顾，这些保护被证明相当强大。这些结界会阻止任何没有大量兽人血统的人进入，但看起来你的血统足够。至于你为什么想进去？据说与古尔古穆克一起埋葬的宝藏中有一本他写的功绩编年史。"
src: "Gurgumuk was revered by orcs, and hated by most everyone else, so when he died his tribe buried him in a large and extensive tomb, allegedly with many treasures, meant to serve as a monument to his greatness. Orcish shamans laid various wards and curses on the tomb, so that none of his enemies would be able to defile and loot it. Since Gurgumuk was high in the favor of the orcish gods, these protections proved to be quite powerful. These wards will prevent anyone who does not have a lot of orcish blood from entering at all, but it seems you have enough. As for why you would want to enter? It is said that one of the treasures buried with Gurgumuk was a copy of a chronicle he had written of his deeds."

dst:
扎拉拉觉得她在魔法和历史研究上花了太多时间，想要拓展一些不同的活动。具体来说，她认为自己的武器技能需要提高，想要一些武术训练。由于她无法离开庄园，她让我找一个合适的教练能来庄园，并建议我去看看位于贵族区的卡拉达尔·科拉德的学校。科拉德只收精选的学生，不会训练扎拉拉，但她的想法是，既然他的学生都相当厉害，可以雇一个。她让我向潜在的教练提供每节课250金币的报酬，外加500金币的预付款，并给了我一些金币来支付这笔预付款。我不需要花的钱可以自己留着。

我找到了科拉德的一个学生，一个叫加拉德·阿沙勒的人，他表示愿意接受这份工作。然而，他对金钱报酬不太感兴趣，反而要求我为他完成一项任务。他让我去拜访他的兄弟，塔兰·阿沙勒，目前被关押在城市守卫队总部附近的地牢里。这个塔兰知道阿沙勒之戒的位置，这是家族传家宝，加拉德想要得到它，并愿意告诉他兄弟它的位置。然而，加拉德决定不和他兄弟说话，因为他认为兄弟是家族的耻辱，所以他想让我代替他去和他兄弟谈谈，并做任何必要的事情来取回戒指。看来如果我要完成扎拉拉的这个任务，就必须这么做。

阿沙勒之戒已经找到并还给了加拉德。他现在愿意担任扎拉拉所需的教练。我应该向她报告这件事。
src:
Zarala feels that she has been spending too much time in magical and historical research, and wants to branch out into some different activities. Specifically, she thinks her skill with weapons needs improvement and wants some martial training. Since she cannot leave the estate, she has asked me to locate an approrpriate instructor who could come there, and suggested I look at Khaladar Korad's school, located here in the Noble district. Korad only accepts select students, and would not train Zarala, but her thinking is that since even his students are quite formidable, one of them could be hired. She has told me to offer potential instructors an incentive of 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 up front, and given me some gold to pay this latter advance. I can keep whatever I don't need to spend.

I have found one of Korad's students, one Garad Ashaler, who has expressed some willingness to take on this job. He is not much interested in monetary compensation, however, and has instead demanded that I perform a task for him instead. He has asked me to visit his brother, Taran Ashaler, who is currently detained in the City Watch's dungeons, near their headquarters. This Taran knows the location of the Ashaler Ring, an heirloom of the family that Garad wishes to have, and has offered to tell his brother its location. Garad, however, has resolved not to speak to his brother who he regards as a disgrace to the family, so he wants me to speak to him instead and do whatever else is necessary to recover the ring. It seems I must do this if I am to complete this assignment from Zarala.

The Ashaler Ring has been found and returned to Garad. He is now willing to act as the instructor Zarala requires. I should report this to her.

扎拉拉觉得她在魔法和历史研究上花了太多时间，想要拓展一些不同的活动。具体来说，她认为自己的武器技能需要提高，想要一些武术训练。由于她无法离开庄园，她让我找一个合适的教练来庄园，并建议我去看看位于贵族区的卡拉达尔·科拉德的学校。科拉德只接受精选的学生，不会训练扎拉拉，但她的想法是，既然他的学生都相当厉害，可以雇佣其中一个。她让我向潜在的教练提供每节课250金币的报酬，外加500金币的预付款，并给了我一些金币来支付这笔预付款。我不需要花掉的部分可以自己留着。

我找到了科拉德的一个学生，一个叫加拉德·阿沙勒的人，他表示有些愿意接受这份工作。然而，他对金钱报酬不太感兴趣，反而要求我为他完成一项任务。他让我去拜访他的兄弟，塔兰·阿沙勒，目前被关押在城市守卫队总部附近的地牢里。这个塔兰知道阿沙勒戒指的位置，这是加拉德想要的家庭传家宝，并愿意告诉他的兄弟它的位置。然而，加拉德决定不和他兄弟说话，因为他认为兄弟是家族的耻辱，所以他想让我代替他去和他说话，并做任何其他必要的事情来取回戒指。看来我必须这样做才能完成扎拉拉交给我的这个任务。

我已经和塔兰·阿沙勒谈过了。他向我指出了下水道中一个藏身处的具体位置，他把戒指藏在那里。（注意：要到达塔兰的藏身处，从任意地点进入下水道系统，寻找一扇门或通道带你深入。你现在的一个选项将是前往藏身处）。戒指在下水道这一部分下层的箱子里，被一扇上锁且设有结界的门保护着。打开这扇门的拉杆在一个隐藏的房间里，需要通过一扇密门进入，但有了塔兰关于在哪里找到它的指示，应该不会太难找到。我还需要提防一个叫希拉尔·内姆的人，塔兰的前搭档，他也在寻找戒指，并准备为此杀人。
src:
Zarala feels that she has been spending too much time in magical and historical research, and wants to branch out into some different activities. Specifically, she thinks her skill with weapons needs improvement and wants some martial training. Since she cannot leave the estate, she has asked me to locate an approrpriate instructor who could come there, and suggested I look at Khaladar Korad's school, located here in the Noble district. Korad only accepts select students, and would not train Zarala, but her thinking is that since even his students are quite formidable, one of them could be hired. She has told me to offer potential instructors an incentive of 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 up front, and given me some gold to pay this latter advance. I can keep whatever I don't need to spend.

I have found one of Korad's students, one Garad Ashaler, who has expressed some willingness to take on this job. He is not much interested in monetary compensation, however, and has instead demanded that I perform a task for him instead. He has asked me to visit his brother, Taran Ashaler, who is currently detained in the City Watch's dungeons, near their headquarters. This Taran knows the location of the Ashaler Ring, an heirloom of the family that Garad wishes to have, and has offered to tell his brother its location. Garad, however, has resolved not to speak to his brother who he regards as a disgrace to the family, so he wants me to speak to him instead and do whatever else is necessary to recover the ring. It seems I must do this if I am to complete this assignment from Zarala.

I have spoken to Taran Ashaler. He has indicated to me the location of a hideaway in the sewers where has stashed the ring. (Note: To reach Taran's hideaway, enter the sewer system at any point and look for a door or transition taking you further in. One of your options will now be to go to the hideaway). The ring is in a chest on the lower level of this part of the sewers, protected by a locked and warded gate. The lever to open this gate is in a hidden chamber accessed by a secret door, but with Taran's instructions about where to find it, it should not be too difficult to find. I also need to watch out for one Silar Neym, Taran's former partner, who also seeks the ring, and who is prepared to kill to get it.

src:
Athasian halflings are masters of the jungles of the Ringing Mountains.  They are small, quick, and agile, and have a ancient culture that goes back far before the start of the current desolation.  They are a insular and xenophobic race, worried more about their own kind than members of other races, and easily become frustrated with the other "uncivilized" races who don't know all the nuances and other aspects of halfling culture.  They are also very uncomfortable with change, but still some leave their mountain home and journey into the Tablelands.  Physically they are like the halflings of other worlds, but they tend to paint their skin in bright reds and greens.

Athasian Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass Athasian halfling's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Penalty (Persuade): -2 racial penalty to Persuade checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +4 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Hardiness vs Spells: +2 racial bonus to saving throws vs spells and spell-like abilities.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Athasian Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

src:
Halflings are clever, capable, and resourceful survivors. They are notoriously curious, and show a daring that many larger people can't match. They can be lured by wealth, but tend to spend rather than hoard. Halflings have ruddy skin, hair that is black and straight, and brown or black eyes. Halfling men often grow long sideburns, but rarely beards or moustaches. They prefer practical clothing, and would rather wear a comfortable shirt than jewelry. Halflings stand about 3 feet tall, and commonly live to see 150.

Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.

Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass halfling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.
Packages: Halfling characters should only choose the default package for their class, as the other packages may give the halfling weapons they cannot use.

Some, thanks to a stronger spiritual link to their totem, learn a more advanced method of wielding draconic power: the invocations normally associated with dragonfire adepts. 学术传说中关于魔蝠人的起源有两种不同的说法。一种说法是，魔蝠人是很久以前魔蝠与某种不确定的类人种族结合所生的异界生物后裔。另一种则是关于一个狂妄自大的法师试图将自己的本质烙印在另一个种族上的更黑暗的故事。

事实是，魔蝠人偶尔会出生于魔蝠父母。魔蝠人比他们的魔蝠祖先更弱小，被魔蝠社群视为不受欢迎的劣种而抛弃。他们被遗弃在恶劣位面的 mercy 中。厌恶自己类人孩子的魔蝠父母会将婴儿留在充满敌意的位面。善良的父母则会将孩子放在一个宜居的位面，让其他生物容易发现。有时其他生物会收养被遗弃的婴儿，并将其抚养至成年。

作为由与自己截然不同的父母抚养长大的弃儿，魔蝠人常常感到格格不入。他们通常是渴望 elusive 归属感的独行者。尽管如此，他们迷人且讨人喜欢，通常受到周围人的喜爱。

魔蝠人总体看起来像是他们魔蝠父母不那么丑陋的版本，翅膀发育不全。典型的魔蝠人身高不到3英尺，体重约30磅，女性比男性略高略重。气魔蝠人看起来像一个矮小的，云白色的人类。

气魔蝠人属性调整：+2 敏捷，-2 智力，+2 魅力。气魔蝠人行动迅速。

天赋职业（吟游诗人）：在判断兼职气魔蝠人是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其吟游诗人职业等级不计入。

种族特性：
- 气魔蝠人的基础陆地速度为30英尺，飞行速度为10。
- 类人生物：魔蝠人原生于元素位面。他们具有类人生物类型，当不在各自祖先位面时获得异界生物亚种。与他们的魔蝠祖先不同，魔蝠人没有元素亚种。
- 小型：作为小型生物，魔蝠人在防御等级上获得+1加值，攻击检定获得+1加值，躲藏检定获得+4加值。
- 喷吐武器：每个魔蝠人都有一种喷吐武器，其效果因魔蝠人的血统而异。
- 元素施法：魔蝠人施放与其种类（气，土，火或水）相匹配的元素描述符法咒时，施法者等级+1。
- 简易武器：魔蝠人擅长所有简易武器。

等级调整：+1
src:
Scholarly lore contains two different origin stories for the mephlings. In one, mephlings are planetouched offshoots of long-ago unions between mephits and an indeterminate race of humanoids. The other is a darker tale of a megalomaniacal mage seeking to imprint his essence on another race.

What is true is that a mephling will occasionally be born to mephit parents. Weaker than their mephit ancestors, mephlings are put out of mephit communities as undesirable runts. They're left to the mercies of the inhospitable planes. Mephit parents revolted by their humanoid child will leave the babe on a hostile plane. Kindly parents will place the child on a habitable plane where it will easily be found by other creatures. Sometimes other creatures adopt the abandoned baby and it grows to reach adulthood.

As foundlings raised by parents very different from themselves, mephlings frequently feel out of place. They usually are loners who desire an elusive sense of belonging. Nevertheless, they're attractive and personable, generally liked by people around them.

Mephlings in general look like less homely versions of their mephit parents with stunted wings. A typical mephling stands less than 3 feet tall and weighs around 30 pounds, with females slightly taller and heavier than males.  An air mephling looks like a short, cloud-white human.

Air Mephling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Int, +2 Cha.  Air mephlings are quick in action.

Favored Class (Bard): A multiclass air mephling's bard class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- An air mephling's base land speed is 30 feet and they also have a fly speed of 10.
- Humanoid: Mephlings are native to the Elemental Planes. They have the humanoid type and gain the extraplanar subtype when not on their respective ancestral plane. Unlike their mephit ancestors, mephlings do not have an elemental subtype.
- Small: As Small creatures, mephlings have a +1 bonus to Armor Class, a +1 bonus on attack rolls, and a +4 bonus on Hide checks.
- Breath Weapon: Each mephling has a breath weapon, the effect of which varies by the mephling's heritage. 
- Elemental Casting: Mephlings cast spells with an elemental descriptor that matches their kind (air, earth, fire, or water) at +1 caster level.
- Simple Weapons: Mephlings are proficient with all simple weapons.

Level Adjustment: +1

dst: "我不确定蛇人是否像恶魔那样邪恶。诚然，他们大多数都服务于邪恶的事业，但那是他们的选择，或者是虚假而有害的宗教与意识形态的产物，而不是他们本性中固有的东西。你自己就是证据，证明只要有不同的教养，蛇人根本不必邪恶。我恶魔本性中的邪恶更加根深蒂固，不那么容易避免。"
src: "I am not sure if Yuan-ti are evil in the same way that demons are. Most of them serve an evil cause, to be sure, but that is their choice, or the product of a false and pernicious religion and ideology, not something inherent in their very nature. You yourself are evidence that with a different upbringing a Yuan-ti need not be evil at all. The evil of my demonic nature is more deep-seated, and not so easily avoided."

dst:
你可以利用你在城邦内的权威命令奴隶听从你的吩咐，征用军队，进入自由民和贵族的家中并逮捕他们。
先决条件：魅力13，交涉6级，谈判专家，被城邦的圣殿骑士团接纳。
益处：此专长赋予交涉技能四种新用途。它们都不能在战斗中使用。
征用：你可以动用你城市的资源，获得任何奴隶的使用权，无视其主人的意愿。
侵入：你可以随时搜查奴隶的家，人身或财产。你可以搜查并扣押任何发现的犯罪证据。你的权威不扩展到为个人使用而没收物品。
指控：你可以无限期监禁一名奴隶，等待收集对其不利的证据。你只能以这种方式监禁一名嫌疑人。
审判：你可以对奴隶作出判决。这包括设定罚款，监禁，死刑或任何你想要的，在城邦法律范围内。
随着你在交涉技能上获得更多等级，你获得对越来越高的社会阶层采取这些行动的权威，如下表所述。

等级 能力
2   征用奴隶
3   侵入奴隶
4   指控奴隶
5   征用军队
6   侵入自由民
7   审判奴隶
8   指控自由民
9   征用装备
10  侵入贵族
11  审判自由民
12  指控贵族
13  征用施法者/显能者
14  侵入圣殿骑士
15  审判贵族
16  指控圣殿骑士
17  征用财产
18+ 审判圣殿骑士

不遵守这些要求通常会受到罚款，监禁，剥夺法律保护，甚至可能处决。任何拥有世俗权威专长的人都可以质疑此能力，并通过对抗交涉检定来撤销该行动。如果挑战者赢得对抗检定，防御圣殿骑士的行动被撤销（例如，被监禁的自由民被释放）.如果防御者赢得对抗检定，则无事发生。世俗权威在特定情况下只能被质疑一次。输掉对抗检定的防御角色不能质疑结果。他也不能使用世俗权威对同一目标重复被质疑的行动。
你每获得四级可以每天使用世俗权威一次（但见特殊），但仅限在你的城邦内。
特殊：圣殿骑士自动获得世俗权威作为奖励专长。他无需选择它。圣殿骑士每天可以使用世俗权威的次数等于其圣殿骑士等级，加上每四级其他职业等级每天额外一次。
src:
You can use your authority within your city-state to order slaves to do your bidding, requisition troops, enter the homes of freemen and nobles, and have them arrested.
Prerequisites: Cha 13, Diplomacy 6 ranks, Negotiator, accepted into city-state's templarate.
Benefits: This feat grants four new uses for the Diplomacy skill. None of them functions during combat.
Requisition: You can draw upon the resources of your city, gaining the use of any slave, overriding the wishes of its owner.
Intrude: You can, at any time, search the home, person or possessions of a slave. You may search and impound any evidence of wrongdoing, if found. Your authority does not extend to confiscating items for personal use.
Accuse: You may have a slave imprisoned indefinitely, awaiting the gathering of evidence against him. You may only imprison one suspect in such a manner.
Judge: You may pass judgment on a slave. This includes setting fines, prison sentences, death sentences or anything else you wish, within the laws of your city-state.
As you gain more ranks in the Diplomacy ranks, you gain the authority to take these actions against progressively higher social rankings, as described on the table below.

Ranks Ability
2   Requisition slave
3   Intrude on slave
4   Accuse slave
5   Requisition troops
6   Intrude on freeman
7   Judge slave
8   Accuse freeman
9   Requisition gear
10  Intrude on noble
11  Judge freeman
12  Accuse noble
13  Requisition spellcaster/manifester
14  Intrude on templar
15  Judge noble
16  Accuse templar
17  Requisition property
18+ Judge templar

Failure to comply with these demands is usually sanctioned with fines, imprisonment, outlaw status, and possibly execution. Any of this ability can be contested by another person with the Secular Authority feat, and move to have the action reversed with an opposed Diplomacy check. If the challenger wins the opposed roll, the defending templar's action is reversed (for example an imprisoned freeman is set free). If the defender wins the opposed roll nothing happens. Secular Authority can be contested in a particular case only once. A defending character who loses the opposed roll may not contest the result. Nor can he use Secular Authority to repeat the action that was contested against the same target.
You may use Secular Authority once per day for every four levels you have attained (but see Special), but only within your city-state.
Special: A templar automatically gains Secular Authority as a bonus feat. He need not select it. A templar may use Secular Authority a number of times per day equal to his templar level, plus one more time per day for every four levels he has in classes other than templar.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Red Avenger is the master of ki, an ancient and formidable discipline that allows the user to accomplish the extraordinary. Through study and training, the Red Avengers learn to channel and release the ki energy in their own bodies.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: The Red Avenger is proficient will all simple weapons, light armor, medium armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +5
Feats: Improved Unarmed Strike, Stunning Fist.
Skills: Listen 8 or more ranks, Tumble: 8 or more ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Stunning Shout - Stun enemies by releasing ki in a shout once a day. All enemies within the cone of effect are stunned for two full rounds unless they make a successful Fortitude save (DC 15 + Wisdom Modifier).
2: Ki Save - Add wisdom bonus to saving throws for a short time once a day. This bonus lasts for 2 rounds.
3: Ki Skill - Add wisdom bonus to skill checks for a short time once a day. This bonus lasts for 2 rounds.
4: Ki Healing - Use ki energy to heal once a day. By laying hands on any creature, the Red Avenger may heal a number of hit points equal to her level multiplied by her Wisdom bonus.
5: Deadly Shout - Injure enemies by releasing ki in a shout once a day. Any enemies within the affected cone take 3d6 + Wisdom Modifier damage. A successful Fortitude save (DC 15 + Wisdom Modifier) halves the damage.
  Stunning Shout - Gain another shout a day.
6: Ki Save 2 - Gain another use per day.
7: Ki Skill 2 - Gain another use per day.
8: Ki Healing 2 - Gain another use per day.
9: Deadly Shout 2 - Gain another use per day.
  Stunning Shout 3 - Gain another shout per day.
10: Free Ki - Double wisdom modifier when using ki abilities.

This elegant, stoppered glass bottle holds a dark, viscous fluid.

One round after you apply this elixir to your skin, it creates an invisible cloud of gas in a 10-foot radius that moves with you and persists for 1 minute. You are immune to the cloud's effects, but every other creature in the area that has 3 Hit Dice or fewer immediately dies (no save). A creature that has 4-6 Hit Dice must succeed on a DC 17 Fortitude save each round it remains in the area or die. A creature that has 7 Hit Dice or more takes 1d4 points of Constitution damage (Fort DC 17 half) per round of exposure.

dst:
机械人是其祖先可追溯到机械境位面上奇异发条生物的异界生物。

机械人外表大多像人类，但具有一个或多个机械或无机特征。大多数机械人皮肤光滑，带有微弱的金属光泽。他们行为冷酷理性，对生活持务实态度。正如其天性，机械人对各种机械物体有亲和力。他们对工程和各种手艺有天生的理解。更具战斗倾向的机械人会成为优秀的攻城工程师。像其他异界生物一样，机械人从未真正融入任何社会。大多数人类社会排斥他们，而来自机械境位面的人则认为他们受污染且不纯。因此，他们常常独来独往，但很少因缺乏社交接触而烦恼。

大多数机械人坚定信仰法律，尽一切努力对抗混乱，为动荡地区带来秩序。

机械人属性调整：-2 敏捷，+2 体质，+2 智力

天赋职业（战士）：兼职机械人的战士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

种族特性：
- 机械人的基础陆地速度为 30 英尺。
- 黑暗视觉：机械人在黑暗中如同在日光下一样视物。
- 武器熟练：机械人熟练使用所有简易和军用武器，轻甲，中甲和盾牌。
- 电爪（类法咒）：机械人每天可以使用一次电爪，如同 1 级术士或机械人的角色等级（取较高者） 施放。
- 电疗（特异）：由于机械人的电亲和力，任何针对它的电攻击每本应造成 3 点伤害就治疗 1 点伤害。机械人对电效果没有豁免检定。
- 火焰和寒冷抗力 5：由于其身体构成，机械人对极端炎热和寒冷不太敏感。
- 技能：机械人在侦察检定上有 +2 种族加值，在学识检定上有 +4 种族加值。
- 异界生物：就法咒和先决条件而言，机械人属于异界生物。

等级调整：+1
src:
Mechanatrixes are planetouched who can trace their ancestry to one of the bizarre clockwork beings that reside on the plane of Mechanus.

Mechanatrixes are mostly human in appearance, but they have one or more mechanical or inorganic features. Most mechanatrixes have smooth skin with a faint metallic sheen.  They behave with cold rationality and have a no-nonsense attitude toward life.  As befitting their nature, mechanatrixes have an affinity for mechanical objects of all kinds. They have an innate understanding of engineering and all sorts of crafts. The more martial-minded mechanatrixes become excellent siege engineers.  Like other planetouched beings, mechanatrixes never quite fit into any society. Most human societies shun them, while those from the plane of Mechanus believe them to be tainted and impure. As a result, they are often loners, but they are rarely bothered by this lack of social contact.

Most mechanatrixes are firm believers in law and do whatever they can to fight chaos and bring order to tumultuous areas.

Mechanatrix Ability Adjustments: -2 Dex, +2 Con, +2 Int

Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass mechanatrix's fighter class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- An mechanatrix's base land speed is 30 feet.
- Darkvision:  Mechanatrixes are able to see in the dark as well as daylight.
- Proficiencies: Mechanatrixes are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, medium armor & shields.
- Shocking Grasp (Sp): A mechanatrix can use shocking grasp once per day as cast by a sorcerer of 1st level or the mechanatrix's character level, whichever is higher.
- Electricity Healing (Ex): Because of a mechanatrix's electricity affinity, any electricity attack directed at it cures 1 point of damage for each 3 points of damage it would otherwise deal. The mechanatrix gets no saving throw against electricity effects.
- Fire & Cold Resistance 5: Due to their body composition, Mechanatrixes are less susceptible to extremes of heat & cold.
- Skills: Mechanatrixes have a +2 racial bonus on Spot checks and a +4 racial bonus on Lore checks.
- Outsider: Mechanatrixes are outsiders for the purposes of spells and prerequisites.

Level Adjustment: +1

dst: "那么帕夏加尔哈德尔的先见之明帮了我们大忙，因为要不是你出现，我不确定堡垒能否守住。当然，对付任何普通的怪物劫掠队我们都不在话下，但这次猛攻可不是普通的劫掠队。这些兽人似乎比我们之前遇到的任何兽人都更训练有素、装备精良，而且数量极其庞大。我不知道他们是怎么集结起如此庞大的部落的。无论如何，感谢你的援助。"
src: "Pasha Galhadr's foresight has served us well then, for I am not sure that the fort would have held out had you not shown up. We are more than a match for any normal raiding party of monsters, of course, but this onslaught was no mere raiding party. These orcs seemed more skilled and better equipped than any we had encountered before, and they were present in tremendous numbers. I do not know how they ever assembled so vast a horde. In any case, you have my thanks for the assistance you gave."

dst: "我必须警告你，半身人冒险者偶尔曾试图探索那个村庄，但至今无人生还。不过我相信，你是一位足够强大的<CUSTOM104>，足以胜任这项任务。无论如何，这里是你能找到村庄的地方。" 他显然已经找到了他要找的地图，把它摊开，指着一个地点。"村庄就在这里。它靠近星塔山脉，从山脉南侧进入，所以你需要从南门出城（别被名字搞混了，虽然它是最靠南的城门之一，但实际上几乎在码头的正东方向），先沿着苏达斯孔河向东走，然后向北朝山脉前进。旅程漫长，但终点处你应该能找到你所寻找的东西。"
src: "I must warn you that halfling adventurers have occasionally attempted to explore the village, and so far none have ever returned. I trust however, that you are a sufficiently powerful <CUSTOM104> for the task. At any rate, here is where you can find the village." He has now apparently found the map he was looking for and lays it out, pointing out a location. "Here is where the village is located. It is near the Starspire mountains, accessed from their southern face, so you will need to head out of the city through the South Gate (don't let the name confuse you, though it is one of the more southerly gates, it is actually almost due east of the docks), heading east initially along the path of the Sulduskoon river, and then heading north towards the mountains. A long journey, but at its end you should find what you seek."

哈达恩·斯滕里夫特伯爵正在寻找吟游诗人，为他即将举办的宴会表演，最终请来了扎拉拉，由我协助，为此目的。我们现在已经完成了表演，伯爵让我们跟他上楼，以便支付报酬。

我们在楼上见到伯爵时，他正被一个神秘的面具刺客对峙，还有一些变形怪显然打算取代伯爵和他的一些客人。既然我们偶然发现了他们的阴谋，他们自然不能让我们活着，所以必须与他们一战。

这些不速之客已经解决了。我想我应该和伯爵谈谈这件事。
src:
Count Hadarn Stenrift was seeking to hire bards to perform at a banquet he is putting on, and ended up bringing in Zarala, assisted by myself, for this purpose. We have now completed our performance and the count has asked us to follow him upstairs so he can give us our payment.

When we met with the count upstairs, he was being confronted by some mysterious masked assassin and some doppelgangers apparently intended to replace the count and some of his guests. Naturally they cannot permit us to live now that we have stumbled upon their plot, so they will need to be fought.

These uninvited guests have been dealt with. I suppose I should talk to the Count about this.

src:
Frostblood orcs trace their ancestry to ancient tribes that hunted and revered white dragons.  After a successful hunt, the hunters would performa  ritual where they drank the blood of their fallen foe, and over time this somehow managed to impart some traits of the white dragon into their bloodline.  They are physically similar to other orcs, but sport pale white skin, catlike eyes, and stringy white or grey hair that grows quickly.

Frostblood Orc Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, -2 Int, -2 Cha, -2 Wis.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass frostblood orc's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Frostblood Orcs are able to see in the dark.
- Cold Resistance: Cold Resistance 10.
- Vulnerability to Fire: 50% more damage from fire.
- Endurance: Frostblood Orcs gain Endurance as a bonus feat.
- Light Sensitivity: Frostblood Orcs suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Dragonblooded: Frostblood Orcs have the Dragonblood subtype.
- Orcish: Orcs are considered Orcish for the purpose of spells.

src:
Goliaths are massive creatures unafraid of throwing their weight around in a fight. Highly competitive, these strong nomads can prove to be powerful allies and welcome additions to any adventuring party. 
  
Goliaths are known for their almost foolhardy daring. In their mountain homes, they leap from precipice to precipice, heedless of the fatal consequences of a misstep. They place great stock in clan and family; life in the mountains teaches even the youngest goliath to rely completely on his fellows for a hand across a crevasse. Because most goliaths are hunter-gatherers, they tend to be inquisitive, always curious about whether better hunting lies over the next ridge or a good water source can be found in the next canyon. 

Goliath Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, -2 Dex, +2 Con
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass Goliath's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

+2 racial bonus on Sense Motive
Powerful Build - The Goliath is treated as a Large creature for wielding weapons and combat maneuvers such as grappling and tripping
Running Jump - Goliaths treat all jump checks as running

Goliath count as monstrous humanoid for spells and abilities. They have a Level Adjustment of +1
