src:
A nobleman named Ronar Raythan owes 30000 gold to various merchant captains, and is overdue in paying it. The harbormaster has asked me to track down Raythan and induce him to produce this quantity of gold, which I can then take to the harbormaster who will see that it is properly distributed to his creditors. Raythan's estate can be found in the area north of the docks and west of the markets.

It turns out Raythan has sold his estate and plans to flee with the proceeds of the sale to escape his creditors. I have no clue where he might be found. However, when I reported this to the harbormaster he suggested that there was a good chance Raythan would be at the Winsome Repose Inn, and that I should ask the staff there if they have recently had a customer matching Raythan's description.

src:
(BASE CLASS)
The Favoured Soul follows the path of the cleric but is able to channel divine power with surprising ease. She is able to perform the same tasks as her fellow divine spellcasters but with virtually no study; to her, it comes naturally. Scholars wonder if Favoured Souls have traces of outsider blood from unions. holy or unholy, centuries ago and generations removed. Others suggest that divine training of the proper type awakens the ability, or that Favoured Souls are simply imbued with their gifts by their gods when they begin the cleric's path. In any case, Favoured Souls cast their spells naturally, as much through force of personality as through study. Though this gives them extraordinary divine abilities no normal person could ever match, they see their gift as a call to action, and so in some ways lag behind their more studious colleagues.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Favoured Soul gains proficiencies with Simple Weapons, Light and Medium Armour, and Shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

dst: 每日法咒/已知法咒：一个先前是施法者的虔心祈者，在遵循虔心祈者之道的同时，继续获得更强大的神术魔法。因此，当获得一个新的虔心祈者等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒（以及已知法咒，如果适用），如同她在添加该进阶职业之前所属的施法职业上也获得了一个等级。然而，她不会获得该职业角色本应获得的任何其他好处（提高控制或斥喝不死生物的机会，更频繁的移除疾病等等）.这基本上意味着她将虔心祈者的等级加到角色所拥有的任何其他施法职业等级上，然后据此确定每日法咒。
src: Spells per Day/Spells Known: A contemplative who was previously a spellcaster continues to gain access to more powerful divine magic while following the contemplative path. Thus, when a new contemplative level is gained, the character gains new spells per day (and spells known, if applicable) as if she had also gained a level in the spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (improved chance of controlling or rebuking undead, more frequent remove disease, and so on). This essentially means that she adds the level of contemplative to the level of whatever other spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day accordingly.

dst:
哈马德派我加入对蜘蛛沼泽中变形蛛总部的军事进攻。随后，我一路战斗穿过沼泽和总部，最终找到了一条通往卡林港下水道的界门，在那里我解决了敌对的鼠人，他们原来与变形蛛勾结。之后，我一路打进了吞噬火焰教团的营地，他们现在似乎也参与了摧毁卡林杉的联盟。

然而，即使经历了这一切，我们似乎仍未揭开这个阴谋的真相。在吞噬火焰的文件中，我发现了证据表明卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔是武僧、变形蛛以及我一直对抗的其他敌人的盟友。一封信表明，泽法德之剑的主人（卡洛玛斯）打算用它最初的目的——释放巨灵卡利姆和火巨灵门农，他们很可能会利用这种自由恢复他们的魔法战争，造成毁灭性后果。信中还表明，他期望这一事件导致的位面边界削弱能帮助他将一支恶魔大军释放到卡林港。这些信息可信吗？泽卡尔为什么会参与如此疯狂和毁灭性的阴谋？无论这些问题的答案是什么，我认为应该尽快将这一信息带给哈马德·加尔哈德尔。希望他能弄清楚这里发生了什么。

我离开前往蜘蛛沼泽后的进展已报告给哈马德，这个任务现在可能已经完成。变形蛛及其各种盟友构成的威胁应该不复存在了。然而，关于泽卡尔的信息无疑会带来新的麻烦。
src:
Hamad sent me to join the military assault being launched upon the headquarters of the aranea in the Spider Swamp. Subsequently, I fought my way through the swamp and the headquarters, eventually finding my way to a portal leading to the Calimport sewers, where I dealt with the hostile wererats who turned out to be in league with the aranea. After that I fought my way up into the compound of the Consuming Fire Order, who now also appear to have been part of this alliance to destroy Calimshan.

Even after all this, though, it seems we have not gotten to the bottom of this conspiracy. Amongst the papers of the Consuming Fire, I have found evidence implicating Kalomas Zekar as an ally of the monks, aranea, and other enemies I have been fighting. A letter indicates that the owner of the Sword of Zefad (Kalomas) intends to use it for its original purpose of freeing the djinni Calim and the efreeti Memnon, who presumably would use such freedom to resume their magical warring, with destructive consequences. The letter also indicates that he also expects the weakening of planar boundaries this event should cause to aid him in unleashing an army of demons upon Calimport. Can this information be trusted? Why would Zekar participate in such a wild and destructive plot? Whatever the answers to these questions, I think this information should be brought to Hamad Galhadr as soon as possible. Hopefully he can sort out whatever is happening here.

My progress since departing for the Spider Swamp has been reported to Hamad, and this quest may now be completed. The threat posed by the aranea and their various allies should be no more. The information about Zekar will doubtless lead to new troubles however.

src: While fighting through the Forest of Mir against the goblins within it, I came across some pixies. Their leader, Zeepa, warned me that to the north there is a grove with some Dryads in it. Unfortunately, Gorav, a lieutenant of the goblin leader Ulaz, is also there and is threatening to cut down the dryad's trees, which they need to survive, if they do not fight alongside the goblins. Zeepa has asked me not to kill the dryads, who are being forced to work with the goblins against their will. The dryads are found in the center of the grove, so Zeepa suggests I sneak around the edges to locate Gorav's camp in the northeast, and kill him. Once Gorav is dead the dryads will no longer be hostile and may even assist us. In any case Zeepa will have a reward.

src:
Deep gnomes, known also as svirfneblin, have become understandably distrustful of all strangers after centuries of living with the everyday perils the Underdark. With strangers, most deep gnomes are sullen, reserved and suspicious, almost to a fault. Their skin is the color of the rocks among which they live. They have dark gray eyes, tending towards black. Their hair is of similar color, although it's only seen in a woman as the men are entirely bald and beardless.

Svirfneblin Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Wis, -2 Str, -4 Cha.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass svirfneblins wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Svirfneblin are able to see in the dark.
- Small Stature
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Hardiness vs. Illusions: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Reptilians: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against reptilian humanoids.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Dodge +4: +4 racial dodge armor class bonus.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Concentration): +2 racial bonus to Concentration checks.
- Skill Affinity (Hide Underground): +2 racial bonus to Hide checks; +4 when underground.
- Spell Focus (Illusion): Svirfneblin add +2 DC to any Illusion spells they cast. This is identical to the feat.
- Very Heroic: +2 racial bonus to all saving throws.
- Spell Resistance: Spell Resistance of 11, plus 1 per level.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Blindness and Deafness (DC 16), Blur, Disguise Self. Caster level is equal to the svirfneblin's character level, DC is Charisma-based with +4 racial bonus.
- Gnomish: Svirfneblin count as Gnomes for the purpose of spells.

You solidify extraplanar shadow, creating a solid prison of darkness.

This mystery immobilizes the subject in a prison of shadowstuff. This prison blocks both line of effect and line of sight to the creature inside it, and is impenetrable from the outside. The creature inside the prison takes 3d6 points of cold damage at the beginning of each round that it remains inside the prison. Once each round as a standard action, a creature caught in the prison can attempt a Fortitude saving throw against the spell's original DC to break out of the prison. 等级：圣武士 3，术士 3，法师 3,
成分：言语，姿势，材料，

持续时间：1 轮/等级
豁免检定：意志无效（物体）

你在护甲上多次挥手，最后触碰它。这样做时，你感到手掌中升起一股温暖。温暖传入护甲，表现为闪耀的光泽。

钻石钢增强一套金属护甲的强度。护甲提供等于其 AC 加值一半的伤害减免。此伤害减免只能被 +5 武器克服。例如，一套全身甲将提供伤害减免 4/+5，而一件 +1 胸甲（+6 AC）将提供伤害减免 3/+5。
src:
Transmutation
Level: Paladin 3, Sorcerer 3, Wizard 3,
Components: V, S, M,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Suit of metal armor touched
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (object)
Spell Resistance: Yes (object)

You pass your hand over the suit of armor several times before finally touching it. As you do so, you feel a warmth grow in the palm of your hand. The warmth passes into the armor and manifests as a sparkling shine.

Diamondsteel enhances the strength of one suit of metal armor. The armor provides damage reduction equal to half the AC bonus of the armor. This damage reduction can be overcome only by +5  weapons. For example, a suit of full plate would provide damage reduction 4/+5, and a +1 breastplate (+6 AC) would provide damage reduction 3/+5.

src: A nobleman named Ronar Raythan owes 30000 gold to various merchant captains, and is overdue in paying it. The harbormaster has asked me to track down Raythan and induce him to produce this quantity of gold, which I can then take to the harbormaster who will see that it is properly distributed to his creditors. Raythan's estate can be found in the area north of the docks and west of the markets.\n\nI tracked down Raythan and have now acquired 30000 gold from him. I can now take it to the harbormaster to complete this quest. Alternatively I could just forget about the harbormaster, who I doubt has anything else for me to do that would prove equally profitable, and just take the money for my own use.

dst: 埃尔加姆是一名战士，当他从一群暴徒手中保护他认为是无辜受害者的人时，陷入了麻烦。一旦“受害者”安全了，他显露出自己实际上是暴徒们追捕的凶残罪犯，并击打埃尔加姆的头部，以便带着他的装备逃走。这只是埃尔加姆麻烦的开始，因为不久之后，一个善良阵营神殿的审判官出现了，并逮捕了他，由于他先前的辩护，他们认为他是罪犯的同谋。他遭受了长时间的拘留、激进的审讯和其他侮辱，一段时间后事情才得以澄清。由于这次经历，埃尔加姆得出结论，善良和邪恶的极端都应该避免，并致力于平衡和中立。他让人打造了这把反映他新哲学的刀刃，并挥舞它多年，对抗善良和邪恶事业的冠军。他的职业生涯最终结束，当他听说一个偏远小镇将自身的统治权提供给任何哲学能在战斗审判中胜出的冠军。一名圣武士和一名黑暗卫士都出现了，试图赢得比赛，埃尔加姆也来了，希望击败他们两人，从而为平衡事业赢得一场伟大的胜利。对埃尔加姆（以及小镇）来说不幸的是，尽管他战胜了圣武士，但他败给了黑暗卫士，后者随即让这个地方陷入了恐怖统治。当然，黑暗卫士无法使用埃尔加姆的剑，所以他扔掉了它，它丢失了许多年。
src: Elgarm was a warrior who got into trouble when he defended what he took to be an innocent victim from a rampaging mob. Once the "victim" was safe, he revealed himself to be in fact the vicious criminal the mob was after, and struck Elgarm on the head so he could make off with his equipment. This was only the beginning of Elgarm's troubles, for soon after inquisitors from a good-aligned temple showed up, and placed him under arrest, assuming him to be an accomplice of the criminal due to his earlier defense. He was subjected to prolonged detention, aggressive interrogation, and other indignites for some time before the matter was cleared up. As a result of this experience Elgarm concluded that the extremes of both good and evil were to be avoided and dedicated himself to balance and neutrality. He had this blade, reflecting his new philosophy, crafted, and wielded it for many years against champions of both good and evil causes. His career finally came to an end when he heard of a remote town offering rulership of itself to the champion of whatever philosophy could prevail in a trial by combat. A paladin and a blackguard both showed up attempting to win the contest, and Elgarm came as well, hoping to defeat them both and so win a great victory for the cause of balance. Unfortunately for Elgarm (and for the town), though he prevailed over the paladin, he fell against the blackguard, who promptly subjected the place to a reign of terror. The blackguard was unable to make use of Elgarm's sword, of course, so he threw it away, and it was lost for many years.

特内布罗斯，昔日之影
  
特内布罗斯，曾是强大的恶魔王子，赐予对黑暗与死亡的统治权。

契灵等级：4级
绑定DC:21
特殊要求：你必须在夜晚绘制特内布罗斯的印记。

影响：当受特内布罗斯影响时，你充满一种超然感以及失去与被遗弃的痛苦感觉。特内布罗斯要求你绝不能在战斗中第一个行动。如果你的先攻检定结果最高，你必须延迟直到其他人行动。

授予能力：
特内布罗斯授予你控制不死生物和暗影的力量。他赋予你冻结敌人的能力。

深层黑暗：你可以如同使用深层黑暗法咒一样将一片区域笼罩在暗影中（施法者等级等于你的有效契灵等级），效果始终以你为中心。再次使用此能力将取消黑暗效果。两次使用均为标准动作。

黑暗中视物：你可以完美地看穿任何类型的黑暗。

虚空之触：作为一个迅捷动作，你可以为一次近战攻击充能寒冷能量。你的下一次近战攻击造成额外1d8点寒冷伤害，外加每超过7级的每四个有效契灵等级额外1d8点寒冷伤害。当你达到11级有效契灵等级时，你可以为武器充能一整轮。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内不能再次使用。

驱散/叱喝术不死生物：你可以如同有效契灵等级的牧师一样驱散或叱喝术不死生物。与牧师一样，如果你善良则驱散，如果邪恶则叱喝术。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内不能再次使用。

空虚之器：你可以每天使用一次闪烁暗影魔法秘术。在13级时，你可以每天使用此能力两次，在19级时，你可以每天使用三次。
src:
Tenebrous, the Shadow That Was
  
Tenebrous, once a powerful demon prince, offers dominion over darkness and death.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 21
Special Requirement: You must draw Tenebrous's seal at night.

Influence: While influenced by Tenebrous, you are filled with a sense of detachment and an aching feeling of loss and abandonment. Tenebrous requires that you never be the first to act in combat. If your initiative check result is the highest, you must delay until someone else takes a turn.

Granted Abilities: 
Tenebrous grants you power over undead and shadows. He gives you the ability to chill your foes.

Deeper Darkness: You can cloak an area in shadows as though using the deeper darkness spell (caster level equals your effective binder level), with the effect always centered on you. Using the ability again will cancel the darkness effect. Both uses are a standard action.

See in Darkness: You can see perfectly through darkness of any kind.

Touch of the Void: As a swift action, you can charge a melee attack with cold energy. Your next melee attack deals an extra 1d8 points of cold damage, plus 1d8 points of cold damage for every four effective binder levels beyond 7th that you possess. When you attain an effective binder level of 11th, you can charge your weapon for an entire round. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Turn/Rebuke Undead: You can turn or rebuke undead as a cleric of your effective binder level. As with a cleric, you turn if you are good and rebuke if you are evil. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Vessel of Emptiness: You can use the flicker shadow magic mystery once per day. At 13th level, you can use this ability two times per day, and at 19th level, you can use it three times per day.

Assassins, of course, are evil by their nature and the nature of what they do: committing murder for money is a completely evil act. Claiming the power of the paragorn archon Domiel, the Slayers of Domiel are a disciplined, secretive order of stealthy spies and - when the need arises - assassins who serve the cause of law and good. Rather than rely entirely on stealth and poison, the Slayers of Domiel use supernatural means to dispatch evil foes.

dst: 拉贾尔又给我指派了一项任务。我要偷取塞尔哈德圣甲虫，它位于塞尔哈德贵族庄园的宝库中。为了进去，我应该进入贵族庄园下方的下水道，在那里我会找到通往这座庄园地下室的通道。进去之后，我需要搜查庄园，找到两把钥匙，一把用于宝库外门，一把用于内门。找到这些后，我就能进入庄园地下室里的宝库，但我必须迅速找到圣甲虫并离开，因为内门在打开一分钟后会自动锁上。我还必须确保不伤害庄园里的任何人，因为如果这种事发生在一座显赫贵族的庄园里，当局绝不会轻描淡写地处理。\n\n我已经拿到了塞尔哈德圣甲虫。现在我需要把它交还给拉贾尔。
src: Rajar has assigned me yet another mission. I am to steal the Serkhad Scarab, located in the treasure vault of the Serkhad Noble Estate. To get in I should enter the sewers beneath the noble estates, where I will find a passage to the basement of this estate. Once in, I will need to search the estate for two keys, one for the outer, and one for the inner door to the vault. Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.\n\nI have acquired the Serkhad Scarab. Now I need to return it to Rajar.

dst: “这当然是真的，但情况比你想象的还要糟糕。我父亲只在乎增加自己的权力和财富，而我只是帮助他实现这一目标的棋子。他打算把我嫁入某个他想结盟的贵族的后宫：一个愚蠢又残忍的畜生，但我父亲不在乎这些，只在乎他的政治关系。”

LEGACY ITEM ABILITIES
Drowseeker (Su): At 5th level and higher, while wielding the Bow of the Black Archer, you can detect any drow within 60 feet, although you must concentrate (a standard action) to do so. 
Eyes of Shadow (Sp): Beginning at 6th level, once per day on command, you can use darkvision as the spell. Caster level 5th. 
Longstrider (Sp): At 8th level and higher, three times per day on command, you can use longstrider as the spell. Caster level 5th. 
Hidden Hunter (Su): At 9th level, you gain a +5 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks. 
Solace from Weakness (Sp): You gain power against the poisons and necromancy so commonly used by drow. Starting at 12th level, two times per day on command, you can use lesser restoration as the spell (self only). Caster level 5th. 
Friend to Shadows (Sp): In near-lightless conditions, you can strike with relative impunity and then vanish without a trace. At 13th level and higher, once per day on command, you can use teleport as the spell. Caster level 11th. 
Shocking Shot (Su): Beginning at 14th level, as a standard action, you can imbue an arrow nocked on the Bow of the Black Archer with electricity. If your shot with this arrow hits, the arrow deals an extra 5d6 points of electricity damage. This ability can be used five times per day, and a use is wasted if the charged arrow misses. 
Deny the Demonweb Pits (Sp): Lolth's servants have many powerful allies in the Abyss. At 16th level and higher, you gain a measure of defense against them. Two times per day on command, you can use protection from evil as the spell. Caster level 10th. 
Escape the Spider's Bonds (Su): Webs and other entanglements hold no more fear for a wielder of the Bow of the Black Archer. Starting at 17th level, you constantly benefit from the effects of freedom of movement while you hold the bow in hand. Caster level 15th.
Mindarmor (Su): At 18th level, you gain a +3 insight bonus on Will saving throws to resist mindaffecting and compulsion effects. 
Fast Movement (Su): Once you attain 18th level, your base land speed increases by 10 feet. 
Pierce the Black Heart (Su): You and the Bow of the Black Archer become the ultimate expression of Shevarash's fury. At 20th level and higher, once per day, you can fire an arrow from the Bow of the Black Archer that kills any drow struck by it, as if by a finger of death spell. You must declare that you are using this ability before making the attack. If the arrow misses, the effect is wasted for the day. The save DC is 20, or 17 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. Caster level 15th.

dst: "我知道比那更好的事情：原版在哪里可以找到。它应该仍在塔佐克的实验室里，就在泰瑟尔这里。由于围绕他日志的类似担忧，曾有人试图摧毁这个地方，但发现它有魔法防护，禁止任何非侏儒进入。此外，实验室显然由奇怪而强大的魔像和精巧的陷阱保护着。由于那些想要摧毁它的人缺乏足够熟练的侏儒来应对这些危险，实验室只是被封锁了起来，而不是被摧毁。而那些守卫无疑非常强大。在随后的几个世纪里，包含侏儒冒险者的探险队试图进入这个实验室，结果都很快被赶了出来——如果他们还能回来的话。"
src: "I know something better than that: where the original can be found. This should still be within Tazoc's laboratory, which can be found here in Tethyr. Due to fears similar to those surrounding his journal, there were those who attempted to destroy this place, but found that it had magical protections barring access to anyone not a gnome. Furthermore, the lab was apparently protected by strange and powerful golems and ingenious traps. As those seeking its destruction lacked gnomes sufficiently skilled to deal with those dangers, the lab was simply sealed up, rather than destroyed. And the guardians are surely formidable. In subsequent centuries expeditions containing gnomish adventurers tried to enter this lab, only to be quickly driven out - when they came back at all."

By the time we come through in force, you will no doubt have left this region and traveled far away.  Furthermore, I do not expect the portal to remain open indefinitely without the lich maintaining it, so only a few Tanar'ri would make it through. We would doubtless spread much delightful destruction, but there would hardly be enough of us to ravage your whole plane, much as we might like to, and we would prefer to seek out weaker prey than a powerful <CUSTOM104> such as you. The chance of our paths crossing again would be remote. It would not be you who suffered from our unleashed fury."

src: "No doubt much of his behavior seems peculiar for a man. Whereas for a demon, it would appear perfectly natural. If he succeeds, the consequences could be most unfortunate. He was a powerful demon to begin with, and the millennia since his defeat, since he had little else to occupy him, have been mostly spent finding ways to increase his might."

src: The message reads as follows: "Greetings, <FullName>. This message has been left by Ramel Ganirb, one of the Abbalayar, a seer of Ul'Sahab, who, foreseeing that you would do him a great service in the future, and also foreseeing that you would pass this way, arranged to leave you a reward in advance (knowing that those in the adventuring profession usually expect rewards required no special foresight). You will dobutless be confused to receive a reward before performing the action that earned it, but this seemed a small price to pay for the convenience of placing it close to home. Under these stones you will find some gold, a couple of healing potions, and a Rune of Reinvigoration. Enjoy."

dst:
哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动袭击，因为我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，他还有另一个任务要我在此期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采取何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我拜访他的庄园而受到启发，联系了哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服在卡洛玛斯涉及的一件事上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多询问他们的情况）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命未知。哈马德正派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。要到达营地，我应先去卡洛玛斯的庄园见他。他将能够打开一个魔法界门，将我传送到营地，或许还能告诉我更多关于情况的信息。

卡洛玛斯将我传送到了营地，在那里我遇到了贾拉尔·马卡希，一位巡林客兼竖琴手成员，负责管理这个地方。我们一起追踪到了袭击营地的源头：一个龙教使用的基地，被那些变成吸血鬼的教徒占据，以便更永久地服务于该教派试图使其统治降临的不死龙类。吸血鬼袭击营地是为了获取血液。我们已与吸血鬼战斗过，但似乎前方某处仍有一条龙类，也许我们之间还有更多爪牙。我们发现了一些信息，表明这条龙相对年轻，尚未转化为龙巫妖，这意味着如果发生战斗，我们或许有机会对抗他。

我们面对了那条龙类，名叫瓦拉夏兹·卡尔夫佐尔，并幸存了下来。那条龙在受重伤时逃走了，不想在这种状态下冒险继续战斗。我认为我们已经尽力结束了营地的威胁，龙已逃走恢复，基地中其他人均已被杀。我们应返回营地，然后我应通过界门回去向卡洛玛斯和哈马德报告。
src:
Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.

Kalomas teleported me to the camp, where I met up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place. Together we have tracked down the source of the raids upon the camp: a base used by the Cult of the Dragon, occupied by cultists who had become vampires so as to more permanently serve the undead dragons whose rule the cult seeks to bring about. The vampires were raiding the camp as a source of blood. We have fought through the vampires, but it seems there is still a dragon to be found somewhere ahead of us, perhaps with further minions still between us as well. We have found some information indicating that this dragon is relatively young, and not yet transformed into a dracolich, which means that we might have a chance in combat against him, if it comes to that.

We have faced the dragon, one Varaxazh'kalvzor by name, and survived. The dragon fled when he became severely wounded, not wanting to risk further combat in such a state. I think we have done what we can to end the threat to the camp, with the dragon gone to recover and everyone else in the base slain. We should return to the camp, and then I should return through the portal to report to Kalomas and Hamad.

src: "I must say that I do not care for your attitude. You do not seem to appreciate the extraordinary honor that I am about to bestow on you. I have arranged my lair so that only the most powerful and intelligent intruders can get this far. Only they are worthy of what I give them: immortality, and indeed immortality as a vampire, which in my humble opinion constitutes the pinnacle of undeath."

dst: “你没听说过我？来这里的人大多都知道我的名声。我是塞穆·内拉卡，来自楚尔特。我是个冒险者，目前受雇于卡查尔帕夏。我为他刺探他感兴趣却难以获取的情报，并消除……他的麻烦。作为回报，他帮我完成我真正的使命。卡查尔帕夏并不真正理解或欣赏我的神圣目标，但在实际事务上，我们的利益常常一致，所以能合作得很好。”
src: "You have not heard of me? Most who come here know me by the reputation I have acquired. I am Semu Neraka, once of Chult. I am an adventurer, currently employed by Pasha Khachar. I ferret out difficult-to-acquire information in which he takes an interest and eliminate...problems that he has. In return he helps me carry out my true mission. Pasha Khachar does not really understand or appreciate my holy purpose, but on practical matters our interests converge often enough that we can work together quite well."

dst: "森卡尔确实提到过一本关于泽法德之剑的书，是几个世纪前一位名叫达尔泽斯·谢马尔的学者写的，那本书应该包含比他所能查到的更多的信息，包括关于泽法德的后裔如何利用其全部力量的更多细节。不幸的是，已知现存的那本书只有一本，而且它在前段时间被捐赠给了烛堡图书馆。烛堡位于数百英里之外的北方，而且并不是个容易进去的地方，所以我认为我们不能指望从那个来源得到多少帮助。我想我们只能希望有更多信息出现了。"
src: "Senkhar does mention a book on the Sword of Zefad written by some scholar called Darzeth Shemal a couple centuries ago, that should have even more information than what he could find out, including more details about how a descendant of Zefad could utilize its full powers. Unfortunately there's only one copy of that book known to exist, and it was donated to the Library of Candlekeep some time ago. Candlekeep lies hundreds of miles to the north, and isn't exactly the easiest place to get into, so I don't think we can expect to do much with that source. I guess we'll just have to hope some more information turns up."

Of course, though we had the dagger, we didn't have anyone competent enough to dare use it, until you showed up. All you have to do is jab the tiger anywhere and it should put him into a deep sleep. That will enable us to return him to his cage. So if you'll take it and deal with the tiger, I'd be willing to give you a few hundred gold."

dst: 既然我们已经掌握了变形蛛总部的信息，哈马德正准备对其发动袭击。然而，在此期间他还有另一个任务要我去完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔——两人曾因在反对奴隶贸易应采取何种方法上的分歧而闹翻——因我最近造访他的庄园而受到启发，主动联系哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服，愿意协助卡洛玛斯处理一桩事务。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据说是为了帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多打听他们的事）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。要到达营地，我应先去他的庄园见卡洛玛斯。他能够打开一个魔法界门将我送到营地，或许还能告诉我更多关于当前局势的情况。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.

src: Rajar has assigned me yet another mission. I am to steal the Serkhad Scarab, located in the treasure vault of the Serkhad Noble Estate. To get in I should enter the sewers beneath the noble estates, where I will find a passage to the basement of this estate. Once in, I will need to search the estate for two keys, one for the outer, and one for the inner door to the vault. Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.\n\nI acquired the Serkhad Scarab, but when I attempted to leave, I found the route through which I entered securely locked and guarded. Perhaps the guards detected some sign of my presence on the estate and have taken measures to insure I will not escape. I will have to find some alternative means of getting out.

Incarnum forms a metallic blue-green torc around your neck. The ends of the torc resemble black or copper dragons facing each other in front of your throat. A constant bitter taste floods your mouth, but it seems to make the flavor of certain foods more enjoyable - particularly well-cooked meat.

Instead of a torc around your neck, the writhing shape of a twoheaded dragon arcs around your throat in blue-green scales. Tendrils of midnight blue extend up your neck and down into your shoulders like diseased veins.

When you use your ability to spit acid at an opponent, you also roll again for damage 1 round later.

In Eberron, magic is almost technology. Spellcasters specialize in certain forms of that technology, while artificers tinker with its fundamental workings. Artificers understand magic on a different level from spellcasters, and do not cast spells as wizards and clerics do. They have an amazing facility with magic items and constructs, and in many ways, they keep the magical world of Eberron running.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: All simple Weapons, Light and Medium Armour, Shield Proficiency.

Infusions: An artificer is not a spellcaster, but he does have the ability to imbue items with magical infusions. Infusions are neither arcane nor divine; they are drawn from the artificer infusion list. They function just like spells and follow all the rules for spells. For example, an infusion can be dispelled, it will not function in an antimagic area, and an artificer must make a Concentration check if injured while imbuing an item with an infusion.

An artificer can imbue an item with any infusion from the list without preparing the infusion ahead of time. Unlike a sorcerer or bard, he does not select a subset of the available infusions as his known infusions; he has access to every infusion on the list that is of a level he can use.

To imbue an item with an infusion, an artificer must have an Intelligence score equal to at least 10 + the infusion level. Infusions never allow saving throws.

Like spellcasters, an artificer can use only a certain number of infusions of a particular level per day. In addition, he receives extra infusions per day if he has a sufficiently high Intelligence score.

An artificer's infusions can only be imbued into an item or a construct (including warforged). He cannot, for example, simply imbue an ally with bull's strength. He must instead imbue that ability into an item his ally is wearing. The item then functions as a belt of giant strength for the duration of the infusion. He can, however, imbue bull's strength directly on a construct or a character with the living construct subtype, and infusions such as repair light damage and iron construct function only when imbued on such characters.

Like a spellcaster, an artificer can apply item creation feats and metamagic feats to his infusions.

效果：你可以使用黑暗之语给他人带来憎恶和恐惧，帮助施放晦暗法咒和制造晦暗魔法物品，并削弱物理对象。

等级     （阵营）     结果
1-4级   （非晦暗）      聆听者战栗 10 轮，并且必须逃离你直到你离开其视线。
1-4级   （晦暗）        聆听者恐惧地畏缩 10 轮。
5-10级  （非晦暗）      聆听者战栗 10 轮。
5-10级  （晦暗）        聆听者被你魅惑（如同魅惑怪物） 10 轮。
11级以上 （非晦暗）      聆听者对你充满憎恶，但不受其他影响。
11级以上 （晦暗）        聆听者印象深刻，你在未来尝试改变其态度的检定上获得 +2 能力加值。

力量：每当你以这种方式使用黑暗之语时，你受到 1d4 点魅力伤害。通过将黑暗之语融入法咒的言语成分，你将其有效施法者等级提高 1。

特殊：当有人对你使用黑暗之语时，你在豁免检定上获得 +4 环境加值。

特殊：如果你不能承受属性伤害，你不能选择此专长。
src:
Type of Feat: Vile
You learn a smattering of the language of truly dark power.
Prerequisites: Will save bonus +5, Int 15, Cha 15.
Benefit: You can use the Dark Speech to bring loathing and fear to others, to help cast evil spells and create evil magic items, and to weaken physical objects.

Dread: Whenever you use Dark Speech in this manner, you take 1d4 points of Charisma damage, and every other creature in a 30-foot radius must attempt a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Cha modifier). The result of a failed save by a listener depends on the listener's character level and alignment, as detailed in the table below.
Level      (Alignment)     Result
1st-4th    (non-evil)      Listener is shaken for 10 rounds and must flee from you until you are out of sight.
1st-4th    (evil)          Listener cowers in fear for 10 rounds.
5th-10th   (non-evil)      Listener is shaken for 10 rounds.
5th-10th   (evil)          Listener is charmed by you (as charm monster) for 10 rounds.
11th+      (non-evil)      Listener is filled with loathing for you but is not otherwise influenced.
11th+      (evil)          Listener is impressed, and you gain a +2 competence bonus on attempts to change its attitude in the future.

Power: Whenever you use Dark Speech in this manner, you take 1d4 points of Charisma damage. By incorporating the Dark Speech into the verbal component of a spell, you increase its effective caster level by 1.

Special: You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on saving throws made when someone uses the Dark Speech against you.

Special: If you cannot take ability damage, you cannot select this feat.

src: An aura of strange magic surrounds this forge. Looking within, you see a suit of dark armor that is somehow held in mid-air amidst the flames. As you look at it, a voice emanates from the forge. "Your armor awaits, <CUSTOM104>. By fighting your way here, you have proven your worthiness. Take it, as a gift from the demons of the Abyss." You sense, perhaps as a revelation from your deity, that despite the source this offer is basically honest: if you wish you can indeed acquire armor of great value, albeit tainted with evil, to use or sell.

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psion/wilder 9
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature touched
Duration: Instantaneous and 1 hour; see text
Saving Throw: Fortitude half
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 17
Metapsionics: Empower, Maximize, Twin

Your pointing finger turns black as obsidian. A creature touched by you is partially assimilated into your form and takes 20d6 points of damage. Any creature reduced to 0 or fewer hit points by this power is killed, entirely assimilated into your form, leaving behind only a trace of fine dust. An assimilated creature's equipment is unaffected.

A creature that is partially assimilated into your form (that is, a creature that has at least 1 hit point following your use of this power) grants you a number of temporary hit points equal to half the damage you dealt for 1 hour.

A creature that is completely assimilated grants you a number of temporary hit points equal to the damage you dealt and a +4 bonus to each of your ability scores for 1 hour. If the assimilated creature knows psionic powers, you gain knowledge of one of its powers for 1 hour.

dst:
（基础职业）
凡人之年代带来了一种新的魔法，这种环境魔法贯穿于创世以及其人民的思想和心智之中。克莱恩的居民并非唯一受此魔法影响的生物；甚至死者的灵魂也存在于这错综复杂的生命之网中，那些敢于寻找它们的人可以感受到它们的存在。那些勇敢地在灵魂的阴暗世界中追求生活的神秘主义者被称为夜行者。

- 生命骰：d6
- 擅长武器和防具：夜行者擅长使用简易武器，细剑，短弓和短剑。他还擅长使用轻型盔甲和盾牌。
- 技能点：4 + 智力调整值

施法

src:
(BASE CLASS)
The Age of Mortals brought with it a new kind of magic, the ambient magic threaded through Creation and the minds and hearts of its people. The living were not the only inhabitants of Krynn to be touched by this magic; even the souls of the dead exist within this intricate web of life, and their presence may be felt by those fearless enough to look for it. Those mystics who courageously pursue a life in the shadowy world of spirits are known as nightstalkers.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Nightstalker gains proficiencies with Simple Weapons, rapier, shortbow and short sword. He is also proficient with light armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

SPELLCASTING

You cast divine spells as a mystic does, drawn from the list of nightstalker spells. Like a mystic, you can cast any spell you know without preparing it in advance. To cast a spell, you must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against your spell is 10 + the spell level + your Charisma modifier.

Like other spellcasters, you can only cast a certain number of spells per day. Your base daily allotment is given on the table below. In addition, you receive bonus spells per day if you have a high Wisdom score. When the table indicates that you get 0 spells per day of a given spell level, you gain only the bonus spells you would be entitled to based on your Wisdom score for that spell level.

dst:
纳西拉克希望我击败泰坦。这其实并不像听起来那么困难，因为他们并非真正的泰坦，只是一个以此为名的犯罪团伙，但肯定少不了要打上几场硬仗。这些泰坦的藏身处位于伊尔梅特神殿的东南方。

利用我拼凑出的密码，我现在已经进入了泰坦的主要总部。希望他们很快就会被解决掉。

结果发现，大多数泰坦已经不在他们的总部了，他们逃进了下水道。他们正在攻击腐败的济贫所，该机构直到最近一直在资助他们的犯罪活动，如今因为不赞成他们过度的暴力而遭到报复。我听说他们还在从这儿到那里的下水道通道上布下了大量陷阱，指望在我追击他们时把我干掉。尽管如此，如果我要完成这项任务，还是必须追进下水道。我最近获得的同伴应该有一把能让我进去的钥匙。

我在下水道里杀死了“大泰坦”，也就是这个团伙的首领。这应该基本消除了伊尔梅特神殿所面临的威胁，但我想我还是应该去上面的济贫所看看，解决掉任何残余的团伙成员，并确认没有其他与这项任务相关的事情。
src:
Nasirak wants me to defeat the Titans. This actually shouldn't be as difficult as it sounds, since they are not really Titans, just a criminal gang using that as their name, but it will surely involve a good bit of fighting. The hideouts of these Titans can be found southeast of the Temple of Ilmater.

Using the password I pieced together, I have now gained access to the main Titan headquarters. Hopefully they will soon be finished off.

It turns out most of the Titans are no longer to be found in their headquarters, having fled into the sewers. They are attacking the corrupt Poverty Relief Office, which until recently was subsidizing their criminal activities, in retaliation for its disapproval of their excessive violence. I have heard that they have also heavily trapped the path through the sewers between here and there, in hopes that this would kill me when I pursued them. Nevertheless, I must still pursue them into the sewers if I am to complete this mission. My recently acquired companion should have a key allowing me access.

I have slain the "Big Titan," leader of the gang, in the sewers. This should largely eliminate the threat posed to the Temple of Ilmater, but I suppose I should still check out the Poverty Relief Office above, to finish off any remaining gang members and make sure there is nothing else relevant to this mission.

dst:
我得到警告，贫民区东北部的一栋房子据说被危险的幽灵所萦绕，那些进入这座古老破败建筑的人有时再也无法出来。这似乎是一个需要提防的危险，或者，对于像我这样的冒险追寻者来说，也许是一个机会。

我进入了这栋房子，到达二楼后，被困在了一个幻象迷宫中——据我与之交谈的一个幽灵所说。要逃脱，我必须在我进入任何门后随机被传送到的某个房间里找到一个界门，并在受益于真知术效果的情况下进入它。要施放这样的法咒，我应该寻找某种魔法神器的四块碎片，并找到一个有铁砧的房间，在那里我可以将它们组装起来。

我已经组装好了神器——真理之印，现在必须前往界门以逃脱。
src:
I have been warned that a house in the northeast of the Slums district is believed to be haunted by dangerous spirits, and that those who enter this old and decrepit structure sometimes fail to come out again. This would seem a danger to beware, or perhaps, for seekers of adventure such as myself, an opportunity.

I have entered the house, and upon reaching the second floor have become trapped in what according to a ghost I talked to is a maze of illusions. To escape, I must find a portal in one of the rooms to which I am randomly transported upon entering any door and enter it while benefitting from the effects of a True Seeing spell. To cast such a spell, I should look for four fragments of some kind of magical artifact, and find a room with an anvil in which I can assemble them.

I have assembled the artifact, the Seal of Truth, and now must go to the portal to escape.

Marked by their fiendish blood, fey'ri are rare among most planetouched in that they have a self-sustaining community, so they are raised among their kind. src:
(BASE CLASS)
Some spellcasters care for only one thing: war. They dream of steel and mighty blasts of devastating magic, the march of troops, and the unleashed destruction found on battlefields everywhere. Graduates of special arcane war colleges, those known as warmages are drilled only and utterly in the casting of spells most useful for laying down destruction, confusing an enemy, or screening an allied action. The utilitarian spells used by wizards and sorcerers have little importance to a warmage's way of thinking. What are support casters for, after all? A warmage cares only for success on the battlefield, or, in some cases, in a series of smaller campaigns favoured by adventuring companies.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Warmage gains proficiencies with Simple Weapons, Light Armour, and Shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

dst: "不，泽法德是胜利者，杀死了阿兹古尔卡。嗯，不管怎么说，是把他放逐回了深渊。要真正杀死一个恶魔是相当困难的。但他不得不在战斗中使用他那把强大的剑才得以取胜，而显然杀死那个恶魔不知怎么玷污或耗尽了剑的力量。从留存下来的史料中并不完全清楚问题究竟出在哪里，但无论那把剑发生了什么，他都无法按计划使用它了。而此后不久，泽法德本人也在与那些试图清除巨灵和其他异界麻烦的人类和精灵的战斗中被杀（嗯，其实是被放逐了，就像那个恶魔一样）。"
src: "No, Zefad was the victor, and killed Azghulkar. Well, banished him back to the Abyss, anyway. It's pretty hard to truly kill a demon. But he had to use his powerful sword in the fight to prevail, and apparently slaying the demon somehow tainted or depleted its powers. It's not entirely clear from the surviving histories just what the problem was, but whatever happened to the sword he wasn't able to use it as planned. And shortly after that Zefad himself was killed (well, banished really, just like the demon) in a fight with the humans and elves who were trying to clear out the djinn and other extra-planar nuisances."

dst: "在发动攻击之前，他们在等待某个他们称为‘解放’的事件。我无法确定这指的是什么，但无论是什么，他们都期望它会造成相当大的破坏，从而分散并削弱卡林杉的力量。也许他们指的是释放某个强大的恶魔？无论如何，我推测他们结盟的那个法师应该会促成此事。目前我不确定这还有没有意义，因为我上次和他谈话时，扎伊内姆中尉正准备带领守卫突袭这个地方，而你又在这里攻击他们，我想他们很快就无法攻击任何人了。"
src: "Before striking they were awaiting some event they call 'The Freeing.' I was unable to determine what this refers to, but whatever it is they expected it to cause considerable destruction that would distract and weaken the power of Calimshan. Perhaps they refer to the release of some powerful demon? At any rate, I gathered that the mage they are allied with was supposed to bring it about. I am not sure at this point that it matters, since when I last spoke to him, Lieutenant Zaynem was getting ready to lead the Watch in a raid on this place, and with you here assailing them as well, I expect they will soon be in no position to attack anyone."

dst: <StartHighlight>[邪恶 +1]</Start> 他似乎仍然因最近的创伤经历而茫然。“这怎么会发生在我身上？我有一把很大的剑。”
src: <StartHighlight>[Evil +1]</Start> He still seems dazed by his recent traumatic experiences. "How could this happen to me? I have a really big sword."

dst: "谢谢你，但我真正需要的是一个专注的战士，一个受过大量武艺训练的人。我承认你在那方面有些天赋，但那似乎不是你的主要专长。我不确定你具备我正在寻找的技能。你看，我的问题是我制造的一批魔像。它们本应是我，壮丽的马扎尔，最伟大的造物之一。不幸的是，我在建造它们时似乎犯了一些错误。它们失控了，攻击任何看到的东西，包括我。我把它们造得完全免疫魔法和元素伤害，还能解除魔法防护，所以只有直接的战斗才能阻止它们。我暂时把它们困在我的塔里，但想要一个更令人满意的长期解决方案。"
src: "Thank you, but what I really need is a dedicated fighter, someone with lots of martial training. I grant you have some talents in that area, but it doesn't appear to be your primary focus. I'm not sure you have quite the skillset I'm looking for. You see, my problem is a batch of golems I made. They were to be one of the greatest creations of myself, Mazar the Magnificent. Unfortunately I seem to have made some error in constructing them. They are out of control and attacking anything they see, including me. I made them to be completely immune to magic and elemental damage, and able to dispel magical protections, so only straightforward fighting can stop them. I've contained them within my tower for now, but would like a more satisfactory long-term solution."

卷宗学者是神圣魔法的使用者，仅在所掌控魔法的类型和性质上与牧师相似。事实上，卷宗学者与法师的共同点比与标准的神圣仆从更多，因为他以学术方式收集和维护他的法咒选择。卷宗学者寻找神圣知识的秘传来源，无论这些来源可能在哪里，为自己和同行学者保护这些秘密。

卷宗学者是一个比牧师或圣武士更学术化的职业，但比普通的隐修法师更强壮，更世故。由于他们工作的探索性和常常危险的性质，卷宗学者发展出保护自己和盟友免受经常围绕和伴随他们寻找的失落或禁忌知识的邪恶污染的技术。因此，卷宗学者是出色的支援角色，支持那些协助他们学术追求的人的努力。

src:
(BASE CLASS)
An archivist is a wielder of divine magic, similar to a cleric only in the type and nature of the magic at his command. Indeed, the archivist has more in common with the wizard than he does with the standard servant of the divine, due to the scholarly way in which he collects and maintains his spell selection. Archivists seek out esoteric sources of divine lore, wherever those sources might be, securing those secrets for themselves and their fellow scholars.

The archivist is a more academic profession than the cleric or paladin but hardier and more worldly than the average cloistered wizard. Due to the exploratory and often dangerous nature of their work, archivists develop techniques for safeguarding themselves and their allies from the foul taint that so often surrounds and accompanies the lost or forbidden lore they seek. Archivists are thus exceptional support characters, bolstering the efforts of those who aid them in their scholarly pursuits.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: Archivists are proficient with all simple weapons and with light and medium armor, but not with shields.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
  1: Dark knowledge (tactics) 3/day, Scribe Scroll
  2: Lore mastery
  3: Dark knowledge 4/day
  4: Still mind
  5: Dark knowledge (puissance)

  7: Lore mastery

18: Dark knowledge 9/day

SPELLCASTING

An archivist casts divine spells, drawn primarily from the cleric spell list although he can eventually uncover, learn, and prepare noncleric divine spells spells. Unlike clerics, archivists prepare spells from a prayerbook, a collection of copied divine spells. To learn, prepare, or cast a spell, an archivist must have an Intelligence score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against an archivist's spell is 10 + the spell level + the archivist's Int modifier.

Even if they don't I can maybe come up with some little treasures for a brave <CUSTOM104> who kills that cruel monster."

心智感应 [影响心智]
等级：心灵术士/狂念者 4
显能时间：1 标准动作
距离：近距（25 尺 + 5 尺/2 等级）
目标：一个生物
持续时间：立即
豁免检定：无
抗力：无
灵能点：7, XP；见正文
超能：无

当此灵能被显现时，受术者可以选择重新做出与其最近获得的等级相关的所有决定。

如果受术者和显能者都同意在此灵能显现前支付必要的 XP（见下文），受术者可以撤销在较低等级时做出的此类决定。

XP 消耗：此灵能消耗 50 XP 来显现，以重塑角色达到当前等级时所做的选择。每额外追溯一个先前等级，此灵能额外消耗 50 XP.显能者和受术者平均分摊所有 XP 消耗。

增幅：每额外消耗一个灵能点，重塑可追溯一个更早的等级。XP 消耗相应增加，如上所述。


实现说明：此灵能可选地通过一个开关进行削弱，将其行为改为仅允许重新选择在重塑等级中获得的心智异能。
src:
Telepathy [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Psion/wilder 4
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: No
Power Points: 7, XP; see text
Metapsionics: None

When this power is manifested, the subject can choose to make again all the decisions related to the latest level it has gained.

The subject can undo decisions of these sorts that were made at lower levels, if both the subject and the manifester agree to pay the necessary XP before this power is manifested (see below).

XP Cost: This power costs 50 XP to manifest to reformat choices made when the character reached her current level. For each additional previous level into which the revision reaches, the power costs an additional 50 XP. The manifester and subject split all XP costs evenly.

Augmentation: For every additional power point you spend, the revision reaches one level further. The XP cost is accordingly increased, as specified above.


Implementation Note: This power may optionally be nerfed via a switch, changing it's behaviour to only allow reselection of psionic powers gained in the reformed levels.

护甲皮肤，致盲速度，制造传奇魔法武器和护甲，制造传奇法杖，制造传奇物，毁灭性重击，传奇伤害减免，传奇能量抗力，传奇威能，传奇反射，传奇声望，传奇卓越先攻，传奇坚韧，传奇武器专攻，传奇意志，压倒性重击，传奇法术专攻，传奇强韧，传奇反射，卓越先攻，传奇领导力，能量抗力，传奇坚韧，锻造传奇戒指，传奇指挥官，奖励灵魂融合，传奇精髓，额外脉轮束缚，开启心脉轮，开启灵魂脉轮，快速塑魂，重绑灵魂融合。
src:
At epic levels, your mastery of meldshaping and dwarven craft reaches legendary heights. Your forge burns with divine purpose, shaping weapons and armor infused with the very essence of your soul. As a true master of your art, you stand as an unyielding guardian of dwarven heritage, wielding arms that embody both ancient tradition and unmatched power.

Hit Die: d8
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Ironsoul Forgemaster gains a bonus feat every three levels

Special:
Meldshaping: At each ironsoul forgemaster level after 10th, you increase your meldshaper level, the number of soulmelds you can shape, the number of chakra binds you can create, and your essentia pool as if you had gained a level in a meldshaping class to which you belonged prior to gaining the soulcaster level. You do not, however, gain any other abilities of that class, such as new tiers of chakra binds.

Epic Ironsoul Forgemaster Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Craft Epic Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Epic Staff, Craft Epic Wondrous Item, Devastating Critical, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Prowess, Epic Reflexes, Epic Reputation, Epic Superior Initiative, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Will, Overwhelming Critical, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Fortitude, Epic Reflexes, Superior Initiative, Epic Leadership, Energy Resistance, Epic Toughness, Forge Epic Ring, Legendary Commander, Bonus Soulmeld, Epic Essentia, Extra Chakra Bind, Open Heart Chakra, Open Soul Chakra, Rapid Meldshaping, Rebind Soulmeld.

src:
Driders are bloodthirsty creatures that lurk in the depths of the earth, seeking warm-blooded prey of any kind. These strange beings have the head and torso of a drow elf and the legs and lower body of a giant spider. Failed of Lolth, driders are outcast from their own communities. Drow and driders hate one another passionately.

Drider Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +4 Dex, +6 Con, +4 Int, +6 Wis, +6 Cha
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass drider's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether he or she suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- Darkvision: Driders can see in the dark.
- Natural Armor: +6 racial bonus to natural armor.
- Spell Resistance: Spell Resistance equal to 11 + hit dice.
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +4 Racial bonus to Hide checks
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 Racial bonus to Move Silently checks
- Poison bite: Fortitude save (DC 18), initial and secondary damage 1d6 temporary strength
- Spell-like Abilities: darkness, detect good, detect law, faerie fire - 1/day, Caster level 6th
- Aberration: Driders count as Aberrations for the purposes of spells and effects.
- Sorcerer Casting: Driders cast spells as a Sorcerer of their hit dice (6th level)

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)
Level Adjustment: +4
Racial Hit Dice/Class: 6 of Aberration

dst:
纳西拉克告诉过我一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特信徒，他是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他武僧提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名武僧，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅，我之前没有理由注意到它，它通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通向隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我这也可能很危险。

我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他开始了我的训练计划，并要求我在与他交谈时，穿上他洞穴西南角一个袋子里的刚毛衬衣。

我已经完成了伊拉姆大师交给我的多项任务，并在他的指导下进行了一些训练和对练。现在他要我出去，冲进他洞穴南边池塘的中央。
src:
Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.

I have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and requires that, when speaking to him, I be wearing the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave.

I have completed a number of tasks given me by Master Iram, and carried out some exercises and sparring under his direction. Now he wants me to go out and charge into the middle of the pond to the south outside his cave.

Spells and spell-like effects targeted on you are turned back upon the original caster. The abjuration turns only spells that have you as a target. Effect and area spells are not affected. Spell turning also fails to stop touch range spells.
From seven to ten (1d4+6) spell levels are affected by the turning.
When you are targeted by a spell of higher level than the amount of spell turning you have left, that spell is partially turned. You and the caster each has a proportional chance to be affected.
If you and a spellcasting attacker are both warded by spell turning effects in operation, both you and the caster have a proportional chance to be affected.

dst: "卡林港的下水道长期以来一直受到鼠人种群的困扰，他们躲在那里，以垃圾为食。那些强盗一定是遇到了一些，这很可能是一场不幸。强盗们担心他们会传播自己的苦难，担心他们所有人都会变成鼠人，所以这些人被关了起来。讽刺，不是吗？当然，这不过是这些罪犯应得的，非常恰当，但奇怪的是，他们竟然因为自己同伴残忍的私心而遭遇如此公正的天命，这确实是个笑话。"
src: "The sewers of Calimport have long been troubled by a population of wererats, they hide there and feed on waste. The bandits must have encountered some, it is all too likely a misfortune. The bandits feared they would spread their affliction, that all of them would become wererats, so these were locked up. Ironic, is it not? It is no more than such criminals deserve, of course, quite fitting, but it is strange that they should meet so just a fate because of the cruel self-interest of their own comrades, indeed it is quite a joke."

你将魂能塑造成一件精美的长袖长袍。如果你是善良阵营，它是纯银色；如果你是邪恶阵营，它是灰色；如果你是守序阵营，它是红色；如果你是混乱阵营，它是绿色--但原始的魂能像优雅的刺绣一样在袖口和脚边下摆处舞动。

通过将手放在一个活物身上（一个标准动作），你治疗被触碰的生物，每融塑者等级1点生命值。同时，你受到等于治疗量一半的伤害。你每小时不能使用此能力超过一次。

魂能：你每在生命纽带法衣中投入一点魂能，使用法衣时你能提供的治疗上限增加5点生命值。
 
脉轮绑定（手臂）

你的生命纽带法衣的袖子紧紧扣在你的手腕上，由发光的蓝色魂能环束缚在那里。你每次挥手都会向空中发送闪烁的蓝色火花。

你可以治疗30英尺内的生物，而不是通过触碰。

脉轮绑定（心脏）

额外的刺绣图案，不是由线而是由魂能形成，出现在你的生命纽带法衣前面，当你使用法衣的力量时发出明亮的光芒，否则看起来只是装饰性的。

你可以随意治疗任何给定的生物。
src:
Lifebond Vestments

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Incarnate  
Chakra: Arms, Heart
Saving Throw: None

You shape incarnum into a fine, long-sleeved robe. It is a solid color-silver if you are good, gray if you are evil, red if you are lawful, or green if you are chaotic-but raw incarnum dances like elegant embroidery at the ends of the sleeves and the hem by your feet.

By laying your hands upon a living creature (a standard action), you heal the touched creature 1 hit point per meldshaper level. At the same time, you take damage equal to one-half the amount healed. You may not use this ability more than once per hour. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your lifebond vestments adds 5 hit points to the limit of healing you can bestow when using the vestments. 
 
Chakra Bind (Arms)

The sleeves of your lifebond vestments clasp tightly around your wrists, bound there by glowing rings of blue incarnum. Every wave of your hands sends shimmering blue sparks into the air.

You can bestow healing upon a creature up to 30 feet away, instead of by touch. 

Chakra Bind (Heart) 

Additional embroidered designs, formed not of thread but of incarnum, appear down the front of your lifebond vestments, glowing brightly when you use the powers of the vestments but otherwise appearing simply decorative.

You can bestow healing at will on any given creature.

src: "In the north of town, you can find a general store. Probably doesn't have anything as magical as the gear you're sporting now, but you could restock on basic supplies there. Nearby is the inn, if you need a place to rest. There's a temple of Helm in the center of town that can provide healing services and clerical supplies. However, the main thing you should check out is our famous fair. You can generally find all sorts of merchants there, among entertainers and other interesting stuff. It used to be we just had a big midsummer fair, but it was so popular we've been having them at other times of year as well. The most recent was the harverst fair. It's starting to wind down a bit, but many of the acts and merchants are still there."

dst: 显然，卡迪加一直在收集一些人类囚犯，作为通过某种仪式吸取他们的生命来增强自身力量计划的一部分。不过，他似乎因为对其效果有所怀疑而推迟了实际执行。你读到以下内容："我已经设置了一个拉杆，可以启动生命吸取。它应该能将力量从囚犯转移到操作者身上，但我不确定它对我能起多大作用。与地狱领域有适当联系的人，比如某个黑暗神祇的牧师或黑卫，应该能按设计使用它，但可能需要进一步改进才能有效地将力量转移给我。有必要进一步研究。如果我不能让它可靠地运作，囚犯总还能当食物用。"
src: Apparently Kadigar has been collecting some human prisoners as part of a plan to drain their life in some sort of ritual to increase his own power. He appears to have delayed actually carrying it out, however, due to some doubts about its effectiveness. You read the following: "I have set up a lever that will initiate the life-draining. It should transfer power from the prisoners to the operator, but I am unsure how well it will work for me. Someone with proper connections with the infernal realms, such as a cleric or blackguard of a dark power, should be able to use it as designed, but it may require further refinements to transfer power efficiently to me. Further study is necessary. If I cannot get it to work reliably, the prisoners can always be used as food."

dst:
大巫妖是转化的人类施法者--通常是牧师或吟游诗人，也有法师--他们故意且小心地完成了自己转化为巫妖的过程。他们将不死之身奉献于推进促使转化的任何高贵目标。
大巫妖看起来像普通巫妖。他们拥有普通巫妖的所有特征，包括生前拥有的法咒能力和其他职业能力。此外，他们可以像善良牧师一样驱散不死生物（每天驱散尝试次数等于3+其魅力调整值）.他们还拥有操纵死尸的能力，以及对善良或中立牧师驱散的免疫。

大巫妖拥有基础生物的所有统计数据和特殊能力，除非在此注明。

体型和类型
生物的类型变为不死生物。不要重新计算基础攻击加值，豁免或技能点。体型不变。

生命骰
将所有当前和未来的生命骰增加到d12。

防御等级
大巫妖拥有+5天生防御加值或基础生物的天生防御加值，取较高者。

攻击
大巫妖拥有一次触碰攻击，每轮可以使用一次。如果基础生物可以使用武器，大巫妖保留此能力。拥有天生武器的生物保留那些天生武器。徒手战斗的大巫妖使用其触碰攻击或其主要天生武器（如果有）.持武器的大巫妖根据意愿使用触碰或武器。

伤害
没有天生武器的大巫妖拥有一次触碰攻击，使用负能量对活体生物造成1d8+5点伤害；意志豁免（DC 10 + 1/2 大巫妖的生命骰 + 大巫妖的魅力调整值）减半伤害。拥有天生武器的大巫妖可以根据偏好使用触碰攻击或天生武器。如果选择后者，它在一次天生武器攻击中造成1d8+5点额外伤害。

特殊攻击
大巫妖保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下描述的能力。除非另有说明，豁免DC等于10 + 1/2 大巫妖的生命骰 + 大巫妖的魅力调整值。

恐惧灵光（超自然）
大巫妖笼罩在死亡和邪恶的可怕灵光中。60英尺半径内生命骰少于5的生物看到大巫妖必须成功通过意志豁免，否则如同受到大巫妖等级术士施放的恐惧术影响。成功通过豁免的生物在24小时内不会再受同一大巫妖的灵光影响。

麻痹触碰（超自然）
任何被大巫妖触碰攻击击中的活体生物必须成功通过强韧豁免，否则永久麻痹。移除麻痹或任何可以移除诅咒的法咒可以解放受害者（见降咒法咒描述）.

该效果不能被解除。被大巫妖麻痹的人看起来像死了，但DC 20的侦察检定或DC 15的医疗检定可以揭示受害者还活着。

法咒
大巫妖可以施放其生前能施放的任何法咒。

特殊品质
大巫妖保留基础生物的所有特殊品质，并获得以下描述的能力。

驱散抗力（特异）
大巫妖拥有+4驱散抗力。

伤害减免（超自然）
大巫妖的不死身体坚韧，给予生物伤害减免15/钝击和魔法。其天生武器在克服伤害减免时视为魔化武器。

免疫（特异）
大巫妖免疫冷，电，变形（尽管它们可以对自己使用变形效果）和影响心智攻击。

属性
从基础生物增加如下：智力+2，感知+2，魅力+2.作为不死生物，大巫妖没有体质值。

技能
大巫妖在躲藏，聆听，潜行，搜索，察言观色和侦察检定上获得+8种族加值。其他与基础生物相同。

挑战等级
与基础生物相同+2。

阵营
任何善良。

等级调整
与基础生物相同+4。
src:
Archliches are transformed human spellcasters-as often clerics or bards as wizards-who have deliberately and carefully accomplished their own transformation into liches.  They devote their undeath to the furtherance of whatever noble purpose motivated the transformation.
Archliches appear as normal liches. They have all the characteristics of normal liches, including the spell ability and other class abilities they possessed in life. In addition, they can turn undead as good clerics (entitled to a number of turning attempts per day equal to 3 + their Charisma modifier). They also have the ability to animate dead as well as an immunity to Turning by good or neutral clerics. 

A Archich has all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to undead. Do not recalculate base attack bonus, saves, or skill points. Size is unchanged.

Hit Dice
Increase all current and future Hit Dice to d12s.

Armor Class
A Archich has a +5 natural armor bonus or the base creature's natural armor bonus, whichever is better.

Attack
A Archich has a touch attack that it can use once per round. If the base creature can use weapons, the Archich retains this ability. A creature with natural weapons retains those natural weapons. A Archich fighting without weapons uses either its touch attack or its primary natural weapon (if it has any). A Archich armed with a weapon uses its touch or a weapon, as it desires.

Damage
A Archich without natural weapons has a touch attack that uses negative energy to deal 1d8+5 points of damage to living creatures; a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2  Archich's HD + Archich's Cha modifier) halves the damage. A Archich with natural weapons can use its touch attack or its natural weaponry, as it prefers. If it chooses the latter, it deals 1d8+5 points of extra damage on one natural weapon attack.

Special Attacks
A Archich retains all the base creature's special attacks and gains those described below. Save DCs are equal to 10 + 1/2  Archich's HD + Archich's Cha modifier unless otherwise noted.

Fear Aura (Su)
Archiches are shrouded in a dreadful aura of death and evil. Creatures of less than 5 HD in a 60-foot radius that look at the Archich must succeed on a Will save or be affected as though by a fear spell from a sorcerer of the Archich's level. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by the same Archich's aura for 24 hours.

Paralyzing Touch (Su)
Any living creature a Archich hits with its touch attack must succeed on a Fortitude save or be permanently paralyzed. Remove paralysis or any spell that can remove a curse can free the victim (see the bestow curse spell description).

The effect cannot be dispelled. Anyone paralyzed by a Archich seems dead, though a DC 20 Spot check or a DC 15 Heal check reveals that the victim is still alive..

Spells
A Archich can cast any spells it could cast while alive.

Special Qualities
A Archich retains all the base creature's special qualities and gains those described below.

Turn Resistance (Ex)
A Archich has +4 turn resistance.

Damage Reduction (Su)
A Archich's undead body is tough, giving the creature damage reduction 15/bludgeoning and magic. Its natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Immunities (Ex)
Archiches have immunity to cold, electricity, polymorph (though they can use polymorph effects on themselves), and mind-affecting attacks.

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +2. Being undead, a Archich has no Constitution score.

Skills
Archiches have a +8 racial bonus on Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Sense Motive, and Spot checks. Otherwise same as the base creature.

Challenge Rating
Same as the base creature + 2.

Alignment
Any good.

Level Adjustment
Same as the base creature +4.

Swordflight. 
Chapter Two: Calimshan

Version 1.15

After your adventures in the Calim Desert, you have returned to Calimport, ready to assume your new duties as one of a noble's personal guards. This will produce a Demonflesh Golem loyal to you!\n\nTo accomplish this, you must target a spell doing fire damage on the device surrounded by red lights, target the device with white lights with a spell doing cold damage, target the device with green lights with a spell doing acid damage, target the device with blue lights with a spell doing electrical damage, and then return to operate these controls. The elemental damage done must be significant (i.e., more than a cantrip would generate).

你可以感知邪恶的存在。揭示的信息量取决于你研究特定区域或目标的时间：
第1轮：邪恶存在与否。
第2轮：区域内邪恶灵光（生物，物体或法咒）的数量以及最强邪恶灵光的强度。如果你为善良阵营，最强邪恶灵光的强度为“压倒性”（见下文），且强度至少为你角色等级的两倍，你将被震慑1轮且法咒结束。当你被震慑时，你无法行动，你失去任何敏捷AC加值，攻击者获得+2攻击加值。
第3轮：每个灵光的强度和位置。如果灵光在你的视线之外，你只能辨别其方向而非确切位置。

灵光强度：灵光的邪恶力量与强度取决于你正在侦测的邪恶生物或物体的类型及其HD，施法者等级，或（对于牧师）职业等级。

生物/物体         邪恶力量
邪恶生物           HD / 5
不死生物           HD / 2
邪恶元素生物       HD / 2
邪恶异界生物       HD
邪恶神祇的牧师     施法者等级

邪恶力量              灵光强度
残留                  昏暗
1 或更低              微弱
2 - 4           中等
5 - 10          强烈
11+             压倒性
如果灵光属于多个强度类别，法咒显示两者中较强的。

记住动物，陷阱，毒素和其他潜在危险并非邪恶；此法咒无法侦测它们。

注意：每轮你可以转向侦测新区域中的事物，但如果你移动超过2米法咒将结束。
src:
School: Divination
Level: Clr 1, Rgr 2
Components: V, S, DF
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 60 ft.
Area: Quarter circle emanating from you
to the extreme of the range
Duration: Concentration, up to 10
minutes/level (D)
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

You can sense the presence of evil. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area or subject:
1st Round: Presence or absence of evil.
2nd Round: Number of evil auras (creatures, objects, or spells) in the area and the strength of the strongest evil aura present. If you are of good alignment, the strongest evil auras strength is "overwhelming" (see below), and the strength is at least twice your character level, you are stunned for 1 round and the spell ends. While you are stunned, you cant act, you lose any Dexterity bonus to AC, and attackers gain +2 bonuses to attack you.
3rd Round: The strength and location of each aura. If an aura is outside your line of sight, then you discern its direction but not its exact location.

Aura Strength: An auras evil power and strength depend on the type of evil creature or object that you're detecting and its HD, caster level, or (in the case of a cleric) class level.

Creature/Object         Evil Power
Evil creature           HD / 5
Undead creature         HD / 2
Evil elemental          HD / 2
Evil outsider           HD
Cleric of an evil deity         Caster Level

Evil Power              Aura Strength
Lingering               Dim
1 or less               Faint
2 - 4           Moderate
5 - 10          Strong
11+             Overwhelming
If an aura falls into more than one strength category, the spell indicates the stronger of the two.

Remember that animals, traps, poisons, and other potential perils are not evil; this spell does not detect them.

Note: Each round, you can turn to detect things in a new area but if you move more than 2 meters the spell ends.

dst:
我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎杀海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向纳兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭海盗。据船员说，这些海盗是一群牛头人，他们一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次袭击。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗海盗。

船长在即将到来的袭击中利用我才华的计划是，让扎拉拉和我以及几名船员乘坐一艘小船，在隐形法术的掩护下绕到岛屿北侧，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则攻击南侧的海盗主力。我们登陆并开始了袭击，但在与牛头人战斗的过程中触发了一个陷阱，向我们投下巨石，同时把我们扔到了下层。我们队伍中的一些人在此过程中丧生，现在我们需要在击退牛头人和可能在下方的其他东西的攻击的同时，找到离开这个似乎是某种迷宫的方法。

在岛屿下方更深处寻找出路时，我们遇到了一个巫妖的投影，他自称是扭曲符文会的伊尔库泽拉姆，显然是海盗的某种盟友或赞助者。他要求我把扎拉拉和泽法德之剑的碎片交给他，以便符文会可以用它们来挑战阿兹古尔卡。当我拒绝时，他迫使我们通过一系列由他的各种仆从守卫的房间，最后我们面对了巫妖本人。我们能够击败他，但如果没有他的命匣，巫妖无法被永久杀死。伊尔库泽拉姆威胁说他很快就会回来，我不确定如何才能阻止此事。然而，附近有一个传送门可能值得调查。
src:
Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.

The captain's plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault called for Zarala and me, along with several of the crew, to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, under cover of an invisibility spell, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We landed and commenced our assault, but in the process of fighting the minotaurs ended up springing a trap, which dropped heavy rocks on us while dumping us into a lower level. Some of our party was lost in the process, and now we will need to find our way out of what appears to be some sort of maze, while fending off attacks from minotaurs and whatever else might be down here.

Going deeper beneath the island in search of a way out, we encountered the projection of a lich who identified himself as Ilkuzeram of the Twisted Rune, apparently some sort of ally or sponsor of the pirates. He demanded that I turn over Zarala and the fragments of the Sword of Zefad to him, so that the Rune could use them to challenge Azghulkar. When I refused, he forced us to fight through a series of chambers guarded by various minions of his, and at the end we faced the lich himself. We were able to defeat him, but without access to his phylactery a lich cannot be slain permanently. Ilkuzeram threatened that he would soon return, and I am not certain how this can be prevented. However, there is a portal nearby that might merit investigation.

dst: "这个地方曾经是人类经营的矿坑，但在他们的一场战争中被摧毁了。奥布格隆，一群食人魔和兽人的首领，随后接管了它，把它当作一个隐秘基地，偶尔袭击路过的商队和附近的人类定居点。要我说，他花太多时间躲藏，袭击却不够多……不过我想你对此可能有不同看法。总之，奥布格隆长期以来一直鼓励食人魔和兽人杂交，繁衍出许多食人魔混血兽。不知这是因为他认为这种混血儿正好兼具力量和愚蠢，是理想的爪牙，还是某种实验，我不确定。无论如何，很可能令他后悔的是，我就是他那些勾当所产出的食人魔混血兽之一。"
src: "This place was once a mine run by humans, but it was destroyed in one of their wars. Obgron, leader of a band of ogres and orcs then took it over, using it as a hidden base to occasionally raid passing caravans and nearby human settlements. If you ask me he spends too much time hiding and not enough raiding...though I suppose you might feel differently about that. Anyway, Obgron has long encouraged interbreeding among the ogres and orcs, spawning many ogrillons. Whether this is because he thinks such half-breeds have just the right combination of strength and stupidity to make ideal minions, or as some sort of experiment, I am not sure. At any rate, and likely to his regret, I was one of the ogrillons produced by whatever he was about."

dst: 德鲁伊对不死生物这种异常和不自然的现象有着特殊的仇恨。曾经，当一片森林受到一群狂暴僵尸的威胁时，保护它的德鲁伊圈子通过在森林外围种植特殊的树木来回应，这些树木被德鲁伊们执行的强大仪式所附魔。亡灵无法忍受靠近这些树木。那群僵尸从森林中撤退，放过了它，去别处制造麻烦。然而，从长远来看，德鲁伊们开始后悔他们选择的保护方法，因为人们发现用这些树木的木材制成的法杖是对抗亡灵非常有效的武器。森林最终被那些试图通过从魔法树木中廉价获得魔法武器来发财的人所毁坏。
src: Druids have a special hatred for the aberrant and unnatural phenomenon that is Undeath. Once, when a forest was threatened with ravaging by a horde of rampaging zombies, the circle of druids protecting it responded by planting special trees on its outskirts, trees enchanted by powerful rituals the druids had performed. Undead could not stand to go near these trees. The horde turned back from the forest, sparing it, and went off to cause trouble elsewhere. In the long run, though, the druids came to regret the method of protection they chose, for it was discovered that staves fashioned from the wood of these trees made very effective weapons against the undead. The forest ended up being decimated by people seeking to make a fortune from the sale of magical weapons obtained cheaply from its magical trees.

dst:
专长类型：职业特定
先决条件：奇械师等级 1
具体效果：奇械师即使无法获得制造物品所需的法咒，也能制造魔法物品。奇械师必须成功通过使用魔法装置检定（DC 20 + 施法者等级） 来模拟制造该物品通常所需的每个法咒。

奇械师必须为他制造的每件物品的每个先决条件成功通过检定。如果检定失败，他可以每天重试，直到物品完成。如果制作时间结束而仍未成功模拟其中一项能力，他可以做最后一次检定 - 这是他最后的努力，即使他当天已经做过检定。如果该检定也失败，则制造过程失败，用于制造该物品的时间，金钱和经验值都将损失。

为满足物品先决条件，奇械师的有效施法者等级等于其奇械师等级 +2.然而，如果物品复制法咒效果，则使用奇械师的实际等级作为其施法者等级。费用始终根据物品的最低施法者等级或奇械师的实际等级（如果更高） 来确定。

奇械师还可以进行使用魔法装置检定来模拟非法咒要求，包括阵营和种族，使用该技能的常规 DC.然而，他不能模拟技能或专长要求，包括物品制造专长先决条件。他必须满足施法者等级先决条件，包括施放他储存在药水，魔杖或卷轴中的法咒所需的最低等级。

奇械师的注法不满足制造魔法物品的法咒先决条件。

src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Artificer level 1
Specifics: An artificer can create a magic item even if he does not have access to the spells that are prerequisites for the item. The artificer must make a successful Use Magic Device check (DC 20 + caster level) to emulate each spell normally required to create the item.

The artificer must make a successful check for each prerequisite for each item he makes. If he fails a check, he can try again each day until the item is complete. If he comes to the end of the crafting time and he has still not successfully emulated one of the powers, he can make one final check - his last-ditch effort, even if he has already made a check that day. If that check also fails, then the creation process fails and the time, money, and XP expended to craft the item are lost.

For purposes of meeting item prerequisites, an artificer's effective caster level equals his artificer level +2. If the item duplicates a spell effect, however, it uses the artificer's actual level as its caster level. Costs are always determined using the item's minimum caster level or the artificer's actual level (if it is higher).

An artificer can also make Use Magic Device checks to emulate nonspell requirements, including alignment and race, using the normal DCs for the skill. He cannot emulate skill or feat requirements, however, including item creation feat prerequisites. He must meet the caster level prerequisite, including the minimum level to cast a spell he stores in a potion, wand, or scroll.

An artificer's infusions do not meet spell prerequisites for creating magic items.

dst:
卡达斯和他的探险队正在卡林沙漠中发掘一些古代遗迹。然而，在地下探索中，他们遭遇了巨型蜘蛛和亡灵带来的麻烦。由于没有准备好应对这些障碍，卡达斯请我替他探索遗迹。如果可能的话，我应该清除其中的怪物，或者，如果做不到，至少留意那些有助于他研究的重要历史文物。

在探索遗迹时，一扇受魔法控制的门在我身后砰然关闭。从这一侧似乎无法打开它：看来我可能被困在遗迹中了！我唯一能想到的就是继续深入，希望能在某处遇到另一个出口。

深入遗迹后，我遇到了一个幽灵幻影，结果他态度友善。他告诉我，我必须走北面的通道（离开我们相遇的那个房间）才能逃出遗迹，但这条路有亡灵严密守卫，其中一些无法被非魔化武器伤害。他建议我先摧毁散布在遗迹各处的三颗死灵法球。这既能让他摆脱束缚他成为亡灵的诅咒，还能赋予他力量，为我具现出一把魔化武器，一把对亡灵特别有效的武器。我想我会照他说的做。也该是我弄到一把魔化武器的时候了！

我们按照幽灵幻影的建议摧毁了那些法球。他已经消失了，留下一个奇怪的箱子，可以从里面选择一件武器。我会拿一件，然后继续深入遗迹寻找出口。
狂念者预知优势：技能
src: Wilder Precognitive Edge: Skills

src: The Blazing Axes Tribe of Orcs has developed a primitive alchemy allowing them to create the blazing blades from which they take their name. Typically this involves a temporary application of alchemist's fire that will only last for a single battle, but in some cases, such as this one, it is accompanied by magical spells that make the effect permanent. Due to the crudity of their techniques for magical forgings, the enhanced fire damage comes at the price of somewhat degrading the quality of the metal, reducing the conventional damage done.
