“半吸血鬼”是一个遗传性模板，可以添加到任何类人生物或人形怪物（以下称为基础生物）上。生物的体积和类型不变。

半吸血鬼使用基础生物的所有属性和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

防御等级：半吸血鬼的天生防御加值提高2。

攻击：半吸血鬼保留基础生物的所有攻击，并且如果它还没有猛击攻击，则获得一次猛击攻击。如果基础生物能使用武器，半吸血鬼保留此能力。拥有天生武器的生物保留那些天生武器。半吸血鬼徒手战斗时使用其猛击攻击或其主天生武器（如果它有的话）.半吸血鬼持用武器时，按其意愿使用其猛击或武器。半吸血鬼的天生武器在克服伤害减免时视为魔化武器。

特殊攻击：半吸血鬼保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下所述之一。除非另有说明，豁免DC为10 + 1/2半吸血鬼的HD + 半吸血鬼的魅力调整值。

吸血（Ex）：某些半吸血鬼可以通过成功的擒抱检定用尖牙从活体受害者身上吸血。如果半吸血鬼压制住敌人，它便吸血，在维持压制的每一轮造成1d4点体质吸取。半吸血鬼在单小时内吸取的体质点数不能超过其体质值。当半吸血鬼吸取受害者的体质时，它获得5点临时生命值，无论它吸取了多少点。以此方式获得的临时生命值最多持续1小时。如果半吸血鬼拥有此能力，它还会获得以下所述的血液依赖特殊性质。

魅惑凝视（Su）：某些半吸血鬼仅通过注视类人生物或人形怪物对手的眼睛就能魅惑他们。这类似于凝视攻击，不同之处在于半吸血鬼必须使用一个标准动作，而仅仅看着半吸血鬼的人不受影响。半吸血鬼瞄准的任何人必须成功通过意志豁免，否则就会落入半吸血鬼的影响之下，如同受到魅惑怪物法咒影响一般（施法者等级等于HD）.任何成功对抗半吸血鬼魅惑凝视的生物，在24小时内不能再受该半吸血鬼的魅惑凝视影响。此能力的范围为30尺。

暗夜之子（Su）：某些半吸血鬼可以命令世界上的弱小生物。每天一次，拥有此特殊攻击的半吸血鬼可以以一个标准动作召唤1d4群老鼠，1d3群蝙蝠或一群1d6只狼。（如果基础生物不是陆生的，此能力可能召唤其他同等力量的生物。）这些生物在2d6轮后到达，并为半吸血鬼服务最多1小时。

特殊性质：半吸血鬼保留基础生物的所有特殊性质，并且还获得以下所述。

血液依赖（Ex）：如果半吸血鬼每天没有对至少一个活体生物使用其吸血特殊攻击，它必须成功通过DC 15的强韧豁免，否则会陷入疲乏。在半吸血鬼没有直接从活体生物身上吸血的第一天之后，每一天DC增加1，直到它豁免失败并陷入疲乏。此后，如果它没有使用其吸血，它必须每周成功通过DC 20的强韧豁免（此后每周DC增加1），否则会陷入力竭。

由血液依赖造成的疲乏或力竭无法通过休息消除（尽管魔法可以抵消该状态，直到吸血鬼再次豁免失败）.使用其吸血能力会立即消除半吸血鬼的疲乏，或将力竭降低为疲乏。

只有拥有吸血特殊攻击（见上文）的半吸血鬼才获得此特殊性质。

伤害减免（Su）：半吸血鬼拥有伤害减免5/银或魔法。

快速医疗（Ex）：只要半吸血鬼至少有1点生命值但低于其正常满生命值的一半，它每轮治疗1点伤害。只要吸血鬼拥有超过其正常满生命值的一半，其快速医疗便不生效（但其他形式的治疗仍正常生效）.

抗力（Ex）：半吸血鬼拥有寒冷抗力5和电击抗力5。

属性：从基础生物增加如下：力量+2，敏捷+2，魅力+2。
技能：半吸血鬼在唬骗，躲藏，聆听，潜行和侦察检定上获得+2种族加值。除此之外，与基础生物相同。

专长：半吸血鬼获得精通先攻，如果基础生物尚未拥有该专长。

环境：任意，通常与基础生物相同。

组织：单独。

挑战等级：与基础生物相同+1

等级调整：与基础生物相同+2
src:
"Half-vampire" is an inherited template that can be added to any humanoid or monstrous humanoid (referred to hereafter as the base creature). The creature's size and type do not change.

A half-vampire uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Armor Class: A half-vampire's natural armor bonus improves by 2.

Attack: A half-vampire retains all the attacks of the base creature and also gains a slam attack if it didn't already have one. If the base creature can use weapons, the half-vampire retains this ability. A creature with natural weapons retains those natural weapons. A half-vampire fighting without weapons uses either its slam attack or its primary natural weapon (if it has one). A half-vampire armed with a weapon uses its slam or a weapon, as it desires. A half-vampire's natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Special Attacks: A half-vampire retains all the special attacks of the base creature and gains one of those described below. Saves have a DC of to + 1/2 half-vampire's HD + half-vampire's Cha modifier unless otherwise noted.

Blood Drain (Ex): Some half-vampires can suck blood from a living victim with their fangs by making a successful grapple check. If the half-vampire pins the foe, it drains blood, dealing 1d4 points of Constitution drain each round the pin is maintained. A half-vampire can't drain more points of Constitution in a single hour than its Constitution score. When a half-vampire drains a victim's Constitution, it gains 5 temporary hit points, no matter how many points it drains. Temporary hit points gained in this way last for up to 1 hour. If a half-vampire has this ability, it also gains the blood dependency special quality described below.

Charm Gaze (Su): Some half-vampires can charm humanoid or monstrous humanoid opponents just by looking into their eyes. This is similar to a gaze attack, except that the half-vampire must use a standard action, and those merely looking at the half-vampire are not affected. Anyone the half-vampire targets must make a successful Will save or fall under the half-vampire's influence as though affected by a charm monster spell (caster level equal to HD). Any creature that successfully saves against a half-vampire's charm gaze cannot be affected by that half-vampire's charm gaze for 24 hours. The ability has a range of 30 feet.

Children of the Night (Su): Some half-vampires can command the lesser creatures of the world. Once per day, a half-vampire that has this special attack can call forth 1d4 rat swarms, 1d3 bat swarms, or a pack of 1d6 wolves as a standard action. (If the base creature is not terrestrial, this ability might summon other creatures of equivalent power.) These creatures arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve the half-vampire for up to 1 hour.

Special Qualities: A half-vampire retains all the special qualities of the base creature and also gains those described below.

Blood Dependency (Ex): If a half-vampire does not use its blood drain special attack against at least one living creature each day, it must make a DC 15 Fortitude save or become fatigued. Each day after the first that the half-vampire does not drink blood directly from a living creature, the DC increases by 1 until it fails the save and becomes fatigued. After that, it must make a DC 20 Fortitude save each week (with the DC increasing by 1 each week thereafter) that it does not use its blood drain or become exhausted.

The fatigue or exhaustion caused by blood dependency cannot be eliminated by rest (though magic can offset the condition until the vampire fails another save). Using its blood drain ability eliminates a half-vampire's fatigue immediately, or reduces exhaustion to fatigue.

Only half-vampires with the blood drain special attack (see above) gain this special quality.

Damage Reduction (Su): A half-vampire has damage reduction 5/silver or magic.

Fast Healing (Ex): A half-vampire heals 1 point of damage each round so long as it has at least 1 hit point but less than half its full normal hit points. As long as the vampire has more than half its full normal hit points, its fast healing does not function (but other forms of healing still function normally).

Resistances (Ex): A half-vampire has resistance to cold 5 and electricity 5.

Abilities: Increase from the base creature as follows: Str +2, Dex +2, Cha +2.

Skills: Half-vampires have a +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, and Spot checks. Otherwise, same as the base creature.

Feats: A half-vampire gains Improved Initiative, if the base creature doesn't already have that feat.

Environment: Any, usually same as base creature.

Organization: Solitary.

Challenge Rating: Same as the base creature +1

Level Adjustment: Same as the base creature +2

dst:
林灾审判者是处理那些不光彩之事--通常涉及清除人类--的首选之人。当精灵的敌人无论在物理，魔法还是政治上都有周全保护时--而那些伟大的领主和贵妇们又不敢为了从人类侵占中保护精灵家园的核心而弄脏自己的手--他们便会求助于你，林灾审判者。你手持长弓，自然之力听你号令，你出击，一个无声无息的狙击手，解决掉二十个外交官一百年也解决不了的问题--然后在敌人残余势力还没意识到你曾在那里之前，就已融回森林之中。

需求：
基础攻击加值：+6
技能：制造武器 8，躲藏 8，学识 4，潜行 8
专长：近程射击，武器专攻（长弓）

职业特性：
生命骰：d8

施法：你按照以下表格获得每日法咒。你不会在任何已有施法职业上获得每日法咒。你只能从正义法咒列表中选择法咒。

      1级    2级    3级   4级
1     0      -      -     -
2     1      -      -     -
3     2      0      -     -
4     3      1      -     -
5     3      2      0     -
6     3      3      1     -
7     3      3      2     0
8     3      3      3     1
9     3      3      3     2
10    3      3      3     3

奖励专长：在第2级和第8级时，你获得一个奖励弓术专长。当你获得一个新的奖励专长时，你必须从以下列表中选择：拨挡箭矢，远射，精通重击（长弓），精通精准射击，多重射击，骑乘射击，精准射击，快速射击，移动射击，抓取箭矢，武器专精（仅限长弓），高等武器专攻（仅限长弓），高等武器专精（仅限长弓）.你必须满足奖励专长的所有先决条件。在判断你是否满足最低战士等级的先决条件时，使用你的正义等级。例如，一个8级巡林客/8级正义会满足高等武器专攻的要求（战士等级8级），但不满足高等武器专精的要求（战士等级12级）.

林地 stride (Ex)：在第2级时，你可以穿过任何类型的灌木丛。

偷袭（Ex）：从第3级和第7级开始，当你攻击一个失去敏捷加值到护甲的对手时，你造成额外1d6点伤害，例如当它被突袭且措手不及时，或当你从侧翼位置攻击时，如同游荡者的偷袭能力。你的伤害骰与你可能从先前职业获得的任何偷袭伤害骰叠加。

幸运射击（Su）：每天一次，作为一个自由动作，你可以用你的长弓在一次攻击骰上获得+10洞察加值。

无痕步（Ex）：在第4级及更高时，你在自然环境中不留下痕迹，并且无法被追踪。如果你愿意，你可以故意留下痕迹。

用毒（Ex）：在第5级时，你学会制造和/或提取天然毒药，并将其应用于你的武器而没有任何伤害自己的危险。

视线内躲藏（Ex）：在第9级时，你获得在视线内躲藏的能力。

死亡攻击（Ex）：在第10级时，你获得研究你的受害者3轮的能力，然后用长弓进行一次偷袭，如果成功造成伤害，则具有可能使目标麻痹或杀死目标的额外效果（由你选择）.

毒素免疫（Ex）：在第10级时，你获得对毒药和动物毒液的免疫。

dst: 一位名叫罗纳尔·雷森的贵族欠了多位商船船长共计30000金币，且已逾期未还。港务长要求我找到雷森并迫使他交出这笔金币，然后我可以将其交给港务长，由他妥善分配给债权人。雷森的宅邸位于码头以北、市场以西的区域。\n\n我找到了雷森，并已从他那里获得了30000金币。然而，我不认为港务长还能给我什么与这笔财富相当的后续奖励，所以我选择干脆把这笔钱据为己有。
src: A nobleman named Ronar Raythan owes 30000 gold to various merchant captains, and is overdue in paying it. The harbormaster has asked me to track down Raythan and induce him to produce this quantity of gold, which I can then take to the harbormaster who will see that it is properly distributed to his creditors. Raythan's estate can be found in the area north of the docks and west of the markets.\n\nI tracked down Raythan and have now acquired 30000 gold from him. However, I did not believe that any further rewards the harbormaster had for me would equal this bounty, so I chose to simply keep the money for myself.

dst:
呼唤怯魔群
咒法系（呼唤） [邪恶]
等级：恶魔学者 3，凡人猎手 4，术士/法师 5
成分：言语 姿势，灵魂
施法时间：1 分钟
距离：近距（25 英尺 + 5 英尺/2 等级）
效果：2d4 只怯魔
持续时间：一年
豁免检定：无
法术抗力：否

施法者从深渊中呼唤 2d4 只怯魔到她的所在之处，向它们献上她准备好的灵魂。作为交换，它们将为施法者服务一年，
充当守卫，奴隶，或她需要的任何其他用途。它们极其愚蠢，因此施法者无法给它们分配比大约十个词能描述的任务更复杂的工作。

无论施法者施放此法咒多少次，她控制的外层界生物总生命骰数不能超过每施法者等级 2 HD. 如果她超过此数量，所有新
呼唤的生物都归施法者控制，而之前施法所召唤的多余生物则变为不受控制。施法者选择释放哪些生物。
src:
Call Dretch Horde
Conjuration (Calling) [Evil]
Level: Demonologist 3, Mortal Hunter 4, Sor/Wiz 5
Components: V S, Soul
Casting Time: 1 minute
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect: 2d4 dretches
Duration: One year
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

The caster calls 2d4 dretches from the Abyss to where she is, offering them the soul that she has prepared. In exchange, they will serve the caster for one year
as guards, slaves, or whatever else she needs them for. They are profoundly stupid, so the caster cannot give them more complicated tasks than can be described in about ten words.

No matter how many times the caster casts this spell, she can control no more than 2 HD worth of fiends per caster level. If she exceeds this number, all the newly
called creatures fall under the caster's control, and any excess from previous castings become uncontrolled. The caster chooses which creatures to release.

dst:
先决条件：能够忽略盔甲的奥术法咒失败几率。

基于你现有的训练，你可以避免穿着比正常更重的盔甲时的奥术法咒失败几率。
 
益处：你能够穿着比正常可穿类别重一级的盔甲，同时仍避免奥术法咒失败几率。例如，如果你通常能够穿着轻甲而不引发法咒失败几率，你可以穿着中甲并继续正常施法。此能力不适用于盾牌，也不适用于从提供在盔甲中施放奥术法咒能力的职业以外的施法职业获得的法咒。
src:
Prerequisite: Ability to ignore arcane spell failure chance from armor.

Building on your existing training allows you to avoid the chance of arcane spell failure when you wear armor heavier than normal. 
 
Benefit: You are able to wear armor one category heavier than you can normally wear while still avoiding the chance of arcane spell failure. For example, if you have the ability to normally wear light armor without incurring a chance of spell failure, you can wear medium armor and continue to cast spells as normal. This ability does not extend to shields, nor does it apply to spells gained from spellcasting classes other than the class that provides the ability to cast arcane spells while in armor.

src:
An epic Suel Archanamach is a living relic of an empire that once challenged the gods themselves. Blade and spell move as one in their hands ,  seamless, relentless, unstoppable. They slip through magical wards as if they were cobwebs, unraveling spells and spellcasters alike with practiced ease. Masters of dispelling, cloaked in illusions, and steeped in ancient arcane warfare, these elusive warriors are nightmares whispered among archmages ,  for when a Suel Archanamach comes, even the most powerful wizard may find no sanctuary.

Hit Die: d6
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Suel Archanamach gains a bonus feat every four levels.

Special:
Dispelling Strike: The epic Suel Archanamach continues to gain a use of their Dispelling Strike ability every four class levels.
Ignore Spell Failure: the epic Suel Archanamach continues to increase the amount of spell failure they can overcome by 5% every three class levels.
Spellcasting: The epic Suel Archanamach continues to increase in arcane caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Epic Suel Archanamach Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Epic Prowess, Epic Reputation, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Weapon Focus, Great Charisma, Improved Combat Casting, Overwhelming Critical, Superior Initiative.

src:
Changelings are a true-breeding race descended from human and doppelganger ancestry.  while they lack the full shifting capability of a doppelganger, they are still able to significantly alter their form, up to changing genders.  Also, unlike doppelgangers, they have a defined gender in their natural form.  This ability to assume another's shape makes them excellent at subterfuge.  In their true form, they stand between 5 and 6 feet, with pale grey skin, and thin, fair hair.  Their limbs are long and slightly out of proportion, and their facial features appear melted or somewhat unfinished, including blank white eyes.

Changeling Ability Adjustments: None.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass changeling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Base movement of 30.
- Slippery Mind: Changelings gain a +2 racial bonus to save vs mind-affecting abilities due to their slippery minds.
- Body Language: Changelings are adept at reading body language and attitude, and gain a +2 to all Bluff, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks.
- Minor Shape Change: Changelings can physically alter their form to mimic someone of a similar size and mass, as if using a Disguise Self spell.
- Shapeshifter: Changelings are considered Shapeshifters for the purpose of spells.

I must consider whether I wish to take advantage of this opportunity, however, for the caves are said to be filled with Rust Monsters, capable of destroying metal weapons and armor. If I go there, I should either equip myself with non-metallic gear, or devise some other strategy for dealing with this threat.\n\nI have passed beyond the secret door, through a series of caves, and have now found some dwarven ruins. Now to see if I can find some treasure within.

dst: 据信这把剑是在天界位面锻造的。它如何流落到主物质位面已无从知晓，不过有记载的首次使用是在对抗暗影魔入侵的战斗中，由于剑上附有强大的天界之力，对付这类敌人本应极为有效。这把武器的一个奇特之处在于，它常常会让被击中的人发出光芒。有人推测这是出于战术考量，比如让敌人更容易被瞄准或分散其注意力，不过实际效果如何尚不清楚。也可能只是这把武器在针对偏好黑暗的敌人时格外有效而产生的意外副作用。
src: This sword is believed to have been forged on the Celestial Planes. It is unknown how it ended up on the Prime Material, though its first recorded use there was in a battle against an incursion of Shadow Fiends, a type of foe against which it would have been quite potent as a result of its Celestial powers. A peculiar feature of the weapon is that it often causes those struck with it to glow with light. It has been speculated that this was done for tactical reasons such as making foes easier targets or distracting them, though it is unclear how useful it actually is for such purposes. Possibly it was simply an accidental side effect of making the weapon especially effective against enemies with an affinity for darkness.

src:
A race of simianlike humanoids, hadozee are often referred to as "winged deck apes." It's easy to see where they would come by such a moniker: they are covered in light brown fur, with a slightly stooped posture, a shaggy mane, and a fanged muzzle. And they have flaps of skin that hang beneath their arms that enable gliding, if not true flight. Because they're also good climbers and balancers, hadozee are particularly suited for life aboard a ship sailing the seas of adventure.

Hadozee Ability Adjustments: -2 Cha, +2 Dex
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass hadozee's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

+4 bonus on Climb and Balance checks
Gliding: All jump checks have their distance doubled

Hadozee count as human for spells and abilities

src:
Epic Ravagers are avatars of pure slaughter, exalting in the chaos and horror they sow. As they ascend beyond mortal limits, their every blow spreads agony, their presence breaks wills, and their cruelty transcends mere violence-becoming a divine expression of Erythnul's madness. 

Hit Die: d10.
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Intelligence modifier.
Bonus Feats: The epic Ravager gains a bonus feat every five levels.

Special:
Pain Touch - At 11th level you gain a 4th use of Pain Touch and that increases by 1 use per day every five Ravager levels past 11th.	
Aura of Fear - At 12th level you gain a 4th use of Aura of Fear and that increases by 1 use per day every five Ravager levels past 12th.	
Cruelest Cut - At 13th level you gain a 4th use of Aura of Fear and that increases by 1 use per day every five Ravager levels past 13th.
Visage of Terror - At 10th level you gain Visage of Terror and that increases by 1 use per day every five Ravager levels past 10th.

Epic Ravager Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Prowess, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Great Charisma, Great Dexterity, Great Strength, Improved Sneak Attack, Overwhelming Critical, Superior Initiative.

dst: 许多武僧满足于留在修道院中，向本派所信奉的神祇或哲学祈祷或冥想，而另一些则游历诸国度，或前往本派圣地朝圣，或更广泛地传播本派信仰。由于修行生活的禁欲苦修，这类武僧大多外表不起眼，身着破旧衣物，又因旅途艰辛而更加褴褛，看起来像是强盗或劫掠怪物的容易目标。然而，许多这样的朝圣武僧都装备着像这样的武器。它外表不过是一根没有魔法属性的普通手杖，实际上却与那些在身心灵魂完美和谐的修行目标上有所进展的人相调谐，在合适的人手中是极其强大的武器。强盗和劫掠者常常发现它是一个令人不快的惊喜。正如其持有者所受的许多训练一样，这把武器隐藏的魔法依赖于不同力量与元素之间的平衡。\n\n注意：这个版本的朝圣者“法杖”似乎是为一位半身人、侏儒或类似小型种族的武僧制作的。对大多数武僧来说，它只能当作木棒使用。
src: While many monks are content to reside in their monasteries, praying to or meditating upon whatever deity or philosophy their Order is committed to, others wander the realms, either on pilgrimages to special sites sacred to their Order or to spread the Order's beliefs more widely. Due to the asceticism of their way of life, most such Monk present an unimpressive appearance, dressed in poor garments made worse by the rigors of travel, and appear to be easy targets for bandits or raiding monsters. Many such pilgrim monks, however, are equipped with weapons like this. In appearance no more than a simple walking staff without magical properties, it is in fact attuned to those who have made progress in the monastic goal of perfection and harmony of body, mind and soul, and is a most formidable weapon in the right hands. Bandits and raiders have often found it to be an unpleasant surprise. Like much of the training of its wielders, the hidden magicks of the weapon depend on a balance of different forces and elements.\n\nNOTE: This version of the Pilgrim's "Staff" appears to have been made for a monk who was a halfling, gnome or similar small race. It would only serve as a club to most monks.

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psion/wilder 1, psychic warrior 1
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 10 min./level
Power Points: 1
Metapsionics: Extend

You receive one kind of sensory input when a different sense is stimulated. In particular, you can feel light and sound on the skin of your face. Your senses continue to work normally as well, unless they are impaired for some reason.

By feeling light by absorbing ambient light onto your skin, you have your normal visual abilities, even if your eyes are closed or you are blinded. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on all Spot and Search checks.

By feeling sound by absorbing sound onto your skin, the expanded audio input provides you with a +4 circumstance bonus on Listen checks.

Psionic or magical displacement effects, invisibility effects, illusions, and other similar effects confuse your synesthete senses just as they would your normal senses.

You can also use this power to see sound if you are deafened, or hear light if you are blinded, thus removing all penalties associated with either condition.

“当箭矢不足够，当法咒无法克服，一颗勇敢的心和一把锋利的剑或许能取胜。有柯瑞隆的恩典，我不惧任何在我剑锋所及之敌。”

许多邪恶战士认为精灵在远程战斗中虽然危险，但近战却毫无胆量。他们以为一旦战斗变成刀剑与斧头的较量，而非弓箭与法咒，精灵就会像秋风中的落叶般倒下。这些战士从未遇到过科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安的斗士。
科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安的斗士是高贵精灵战士，是能对抗任何兽人或人类战士的精灵骑士或领主。所有精灵都钦佩成为剑术大师所需的恩典，纪律和技巧，而科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安的斗士正是精灵剑术的典范。身着闪亮的精灵锁甲或板甲，勇士依赖的是敏捷，灵巧以及对剑术近乎学术性的研究，而非蛮力。
顾名思义，科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安的斗士在精灵社会中占有特殊地位。大型柯瑞隆·拉瑞斯安神庙常驻有成群的勇士，他们担任精英神庙守卫，精灵统治者的顾问与保镖，以及为整个精灵种族服务的任务骑士。

前柯瑞隆勇士
很少有科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安的斗士转向邪恶，但偶尔也会发生。如果你的阵营变为邪恶，你将被逐出教团，并失去源自此职业的超自然能力（柯瑞隆的祝福和柯瑞隆的愤怒）.然而，如果你愿意，你并不被禁止在此职业中继续获得等级。你可以继续精进你已学的战斗技巧，但无法使用该职业的超自然能力。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
"When an arrow will not suffice, when no spell will overcome, a stout heart and a sharp blade may prevail. With Corellon's grace, I fear no foe who stands within reach of my sword."

Many evil warriors believe that elves, while dangerous in ranged combat, have no stomach for melee. They expect that elves would fall like leaves in an autumn windstorm once the battle becomes the work of sword and axe rather than arrow and spell. These warriors have never encountered a Champion of Corellon Larethian.
The Champion of Corellon Larethian is a noble elf fighter, an elf knight or lord who can stand up to any orc or human warrior. All elves admire the grace, discipline, and skill necessary to become a swordmaster, and the Champion of Corellon Larethian is the very paragon of elven swordmanship. Clad in shining elven mail or plate, the Champion relies on quickness, agility, and an almost scholarly study of swordplay instead of brute power.
As the name suggests, a Champion of Corellon Larethian holds a special place in elf society. Large temples of Corellon Larethian often host groups of Champions who serve as elite temple guards, advisors and bodyguards to elf rulers, and questing knights in the service of the whole elf race.

Ex-Champions or Corellon
Few Champions of Corellon Larethian ever turn to evil, but it occasionally happens. If your alignment changes to evil, you are expelled from the order and lose the supernatural abilities derived from this class (Corellon's Blessing and Corellon's Wrath). However, you are not barred from gaining more levels in this class if you so desire. You can continue to refine the combat techniques you have learned, but you cannot make use of the class's supernatural abilities.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: The Champion of Corellon gains no weapon or armor proficiency.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

Race: Any elven or half-elven.

Skills: Lore 2, Persuade 4.
Base Attack Bonus: +7.
Special: Must worship Corellon Larethian. (Clerics taking this class must have two of the following domains: Chaos, Good, Magic, Protection, War)

src: Upon entering the lair of the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, we were met by Semu Naraka, the assassin employed by Calishite noble Olim Khachar. He told us that Gra'azha'ukul was an ally of his, and would prefer that we not fight him. Since he and Khachar are also apparently opposed to Azghulkar, he did not want to get in the way of our opposition to that tanar'ri either. As an alternative to attacking Gra'azha'ukul, he offered to open a portal that would take us to the keep of Tarakondazum, a silver dragon. We could probably find loot at least as valuable from the one dragon as the other, and, in addition, Tarakondazum is apparently acting as the jailer of some powerful entity who is also an enemy of Azghulkar. Freeing this prisoner could thus gain us a valuable ally in our primary objective. \n\nSeeing no downside to this alternative, I agreed. I have now fought my way through the keep and freed the prisoner contained there.

dst:
（进阶职业）
石龙流派起源于一个古老的矮人教团，他们利用大地的力量来增强自己的战斗风格。深岩哨兵沉浸于那些古老教义中，将自己与岩石的力量相连。大多数深岩哨兵用这种力量来保卫矮人同胞，尽管有些会采取更积极的方式来对抗他们人民的敌人。在战斗中，深岩哨兵是一座活山，一座石质堡垒，为盟友提供庇护，同时像雪崩一样冲击敌人。地面在他脚下移动和翻腾。一会儿他站在一个小土丘上阻挡敌人 - 下一刻他召唤地震将敌人击倒在地。

- 生命骰：d10
- 擅长：深岩哨兵不获得额外擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

种族：矮人。
基础攻击加值：+10。
技能：平衡 13级。
专长：猛力攻击或石之力量。
招式：必须知道至少两个石龙招式和一种石龙姿态。

职业特性：

等级
1：山堡姿态 - 创建一个小型石堡
2：崩山巨兽 - 冲锋敌人时将敌人击倒在地
3：不屈堡垒 - 使用第二种石龙姿态
4：岩石诅咒 - 将敌人钉在地上
   龙牙 - 形成一根石柱
5：启蒙术石龙类 - 引发局部地震

招式

深岩哨兵只能从石龙流派中选择招式。他将自己的完整职业等级加到他的发起者等级上。他在指定等级获得新的已知招式和准备招式。

等级  已知招式   准备招式
1      1                 0
2      0                 0
3      1                 1
4      0                 0
5      1                 0
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Stone Dragon discipline traces its root back to an ancient order of dwarves that used the power of the earth to enhance their combat style. A deepstone sentinel immerses himself in those ancient teachings to link himself to the power of stone. Most deepstone sentinels use this power in the defense of their fellow dwarves, although some take a more active approach to battling the enemies of their people. In combat, a deepstone sentinel is a living mountain, a stony redoubt that provides shelter to his allies while crashing like an avalanche upon his enemies. The ground shifts and churns under his feet. One moment he stands atop a small, earthen mound that blocks his enemies - the next he summons an earthquake to knock his foes to the ground.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: A Deepstone Sentinel gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Dwarf.
Base Attack Bonus: +10.
Skills: Balance 13 ranks.
Feats: Power Attack or Stone Power.
Maneuvers: Must know at least two Stone Dragon maneuvers and one Stone Dragon stance.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Mountain Fortress Stance - Create a small fortress of stone
2: Crashing Mountain Juggernaught - Knock enemies to the ground charging a foe
3: Indomitable Redoubt - Use a second Stone Dragon stance
4: Stone Curse - Pin an enemy to the ground
   Dragon's Tooth - Form a pillar of rock
5: Awaken the Stone Dragon - Cause a localized earthquake

Maneuvers

The Deepstone Sentinel may only select maneuvers from the Stone Dragon discipline. He adds his full class level to his initiator level. He gains new maneuvers known and readied at the indicated levels.

Level  Maneuvers Known   Maneuvers Readied
1      1                 0
2      0                 0
3      1                 1
4      0                 0
5      1                 0

src: The harbormaster of Zazesspur has rewarded me dealing with some "statues" being stored in a harbor warehouse that were actually gargoyles, who went berserk. Now he wants me to deal with the irresponsible noble who ordered this collection of "statues" in the first place, a Count Arndon Dalt. His estate can be found by going north to the markets and then west to an area north of the docks. I am expected to demand a fine of 5000 gold from him, of which I am to take 1000 gold for my own use, delivering the rest to the harbormaster.\n\nThe count has paid the fine. I need only deliver the gold, minus my reward, to the harbormaster. I suppose I could just keep the entire sum, instead, but in that case I would lose the opportunity to carry out any further quests the harbormaster might have for me.

As you should already know, if you are not completely ignorant of planar lore, I am a Tanar'ri of the Abyss, what many from your plane refer to as a demon. As such I seek to spread death, destruction, pain and terror wherever I may, and I have been doing so for many millenia. Most of that time I have spent in the Blood War, leading hordes of lesser Tanar'ri against our enemies, the Baatezu, or devils as some Primes call them, of the Nine Hells. But on occasion I have found pathways to your plane, where I occupied myself torturing <race> creatures like you to death. Woud you like to hear detailed accounts of their torments? That is a subject I might willingly converse on."

src:
Illithid, known commonly as mind flayers, are so insidious, diabolical and powerful that all denizens of the dark fear them. They bend others to their will and shatter enemies' minds. Despite their strange appearance, with greenish-mauve rubbery flesh and tentacled head, illithids are quite charismatic and able to persuade others to follow their demands. This is due to their innate psionic ability to read and control the thoughts or lesser creatures. Illithids are utterly self-serving and do not make for loyal companions. They congregate in small underground cities where the population is swollen by the overwhelming number of slaves. The centre of every illithid community is a powerful elder brain.

Illithid Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, +4 Dex, +8 Int, +6 Cha, +6 Wis, +2 Con.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass illithid's wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Illithid are able to see in the dark.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 25, plus 1 per character level.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 3.
- Weapon Proficiency (Creature): Illithid can make an unarmed attack with their tentacles.
- Spell-like Abilities: At will - Mind blast, Caster level 4th; 5/day - Charm Monster, Caster level 8th. The DC is Charisma-based.
- Extract: Illithid have a chance to extract the brain of a victim on a successful hit.
- Aberration: Illithid are considered Aberrations for the purpose of spells.

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)
Level Adjustment: +7
Racial Hit Dice/Class: 8 of Aberration

神圣净化者是专门消灭不死生物的祭司角色。他们隶属于一个与培罗教会（或其他类似信仰）有关的松散组织，尽管他们鄙视等级官僚制度，更崇尚行动和直率。许多人奉行“先行动，后提问”的方式，这有时会让教会指挥体系中思想更传统的牧师感到沮丧。

大多数神圣净化者是牧师（通常是培罗的牧师），但圣武士也有响应这一召唤的。战士/牧师也能成为优秀的神圣净化者，野蛮人/牧师（他们欣赏该组织的直率本性）同样如此。

- 生命骰：d8 
- 擅长：神圣净化者不会获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础意志豁免加值：+5。

特殊：能够驱散不死生物。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Sacred purifiers are priestly characters who specialize in destroying undead. They belong to a loose-knit order affiliated with the church of Pelor (or another similar faith), though they disdain hierarchical bureaucracy in favor of action and forthrightness. Many pursue an "act first, ask questions later" approach, which occasionally frustrates the more traditionalminded clerics in the church's chain of command. 

Most sacred purifiers are clerics (often of Pelor), but paladins have also been known to take up the call. Fighter/clerics also make good sacred purifiers, as do barbarian/clerics (who appreciate the order's forthright nature). 

- Hit Die: d8 
- Proficiencies: A sacred purifier does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies. 
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Alignment: Any good
Skills: Lore 8 ranks 
Feats: Extra Turning 
Base Will Save Bonus: +5.
Spells: Able to cast 2nd-level divine spells.
Special: Able to turn undead.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Greater Turning, Turn Undead
2: 
3: Sacred Strike - Spend a turning attempt to deal 2d6 damage to an undead creature
4: 
5: Positive Energy Burst - Do massive damage burst to undead

dst: "这事关我的兄弟，塔兰·阿沙勒，一个无赖，我们家族名声的耻辱，目前正关押在城市地牢里。我早就下定决心再也不跟他说话。然而最近，他写信给我，说他想为之前的一些行为做出弥补，并请我去见他，好告诉我阿沙勒戒指的下落——那是我们家族的一件传家宝，被他偷走有一段时间了。这让我不知该如何是好，因为我急于找回戒指，但又不确定怎样才能在不跟兄弟说话、违背我之前决心的前提下得知它的位置。"
src: "The matter concerns my brother, Taran Ashaler, a scoundrel and a disgrace to our family name, who is currently languishing in the city dungeons. I long ago resolved never to speak to him again. Recently, however, he corresponded with me, telling me that he wished to make amends for some of his previous behavior, and asking me to visit him so that he could tell me where to find the Ashaler Ring, an heirloom of our family that he stole away some time ago. This left me uncertain how to proceed, for I am eager to recover the ring, but I was not sure how I could learn of its location without speaking to my brother, in violation of my earlier resolve."

dst: "如果你们的目的地是那座堡垒，那你们来得可不是时候。正如我所说，它已经被一支兽人大军包围了。烈焰之斧部落倾巢而出。他们一直是个庞大而强大的部落，但我们从没意识到他们有这么大的实力。还有许多食人魔也在和他们合作。正面交战我们绝无胜算，所以守军已经退守堡垒墙内。围城开始前我被派出来，去报告我们的情况，并希望能带回援军。"
src: "If your destination is the fort, you have not arrived in good time. It is surrounded by an army of orcs, as I said. The Blazing Axes tribe is out in force. They have always been a large and powerful tribe, but we never realized they had this much strength. Many ogres are working with them as well. They are more than we could ever hope to face in open battle, and so the garrison has retired behind the walls of the fort. I was sent off just before the siege commenced, to report our situation and it is hoped return with reinforcements."

src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nI have found an old fortress that the goblins are using as a base. Unfortunately the only way in is blocked by a field of magical force. I will need to find some way past it. I will have to explore the forest further in hopes of finding some means of egress.

天界生物居住在上层位面，即善良的领域，尽管它们的外表类似于物质位面中的生物。它们比凡间的同类更加高贵，更加美丽。

天界生物通常呈现金属色泽（通常是银色，金色或铂金色）. 它们可能被误认为是半 天界生物，即天界生物与非天界生物交配后产生的更强大的生物。

“天界”是一个遗传模板，可以添加到任何善良或中立阵营的实体异怪，动物，龙类，精类，巨人，类人生物，魔法兽，人形怪物，植物或虫类（以下称为基础生物）.

体型与类型
拥有此模板的动物或虫类变为魔法兽，但除此之外生物类型不变。体型不变。在物质位面遇到的天界生物具有跨位面亚种。

特殊攻击
天界生物保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下攻击。
破邪斩（Su）
每天一次，天界生物可以对邪恶敌人进行普通近战攻击，造成等于其HD的额外伤害（最大+20）.

特殊性质
天界生物保留基础生物的所有特殊性质，并获得以下性质：
黑暗视觉。
伤害减免。4-11 HD, 5/+1. 12+ HD 10/+1。
对酸，冷和电的抵抗 1-7 HD 5. 8+ HD 10
法术抗力等于HD + 5（最大25）.

属性
与基础生物相同，但智力至少为3。

等级调整
与基础生物相同 +2.
src:
Celestial creatures dwell on the upper planes, the realms of good, although they resemble beings found on the Material Plane. They are more regal and more beautiful than their earthly counterparts.

Celestial creatures often come in metallic colors (usually silver, gold, or platinum). They can be mistaken for half-celestials, more powerful creatures that are created when a celestial mates with a non-celestial creature.

"Celestial" is an inherited template that can be added to any corporeal aberration, animal, dragon, fey, giant, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, plant, or vermin of good or neutral alignment (referred to hereafter as the base creature).

Size and Type
Animals or vermin with this template become magical beasts, but otherwise the creature type is unchanged. Size is unchanged. Celestial creatures encountered on the Material Plane have the extraplanar subtype.

Special Attacks
A celestial creature retains all the special attacks of the base creature and also gains the following attack.
Smite Evil (Su)
Once per day a celestial creature can make a normal melee attack to deal extra damage equal to its HD (maximum of +20) against an evil foe.

Special Qualities
A celestial creature retains all the special qualities of the base creature and also gains the following qualities:
Darkvision.
Damage reduction. 4-11 HD, 5/+1. 12+ HD 10/+1.
Resistance to acid, cold, and electricity 1-7 HD 5. 8+ HD 10
Spell resistance equal to HD + 5 (maximum 25).

Abilities
Same as the base creature, but Intelligence is at least 3.

Level Adjustment
Same as the base creature +2.

dst: 我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎杀海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向纳兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭海盗。据船员说，这些海盗是一群牛头人，一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次袭击。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗海盗。\n\n船长计划在即将到来的袭击中利用我的才能，要求扎拉拉和我，以及几名船员，在隐形法术的掩护下乘坐一艘小船绕到岛屿北侧，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则在南面攻击海盗的主力。我们现在已经登陆并开始了袭击，以突然出现让海盗措手不及。在清除这个岛屿北半部敌人的过程中，我们追赶一个似乎是某种首领的牛头人进入附近的一个洞穴，他在那里触发了一个陷阱，把沉重的岩石砸向我们，同时把我们扔到了下层。我们队伍中的一些人在此过程中丧生了，现在我们需要找到出路，离开这个看起来像是某种迷宫的地方，同时抵御牛头人和这里可能存在的其他东西的攻击。
src: Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.\n\nThe captain's plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault called for Zarala and me, along with several of the crew, to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, under cover of an invisibility spell, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We have now landed and commenced our assault, surprising the pirates with our sudden appearance. In the process of clearing the northern half of this island of foes, we chased one minotaur who seems to be some sort of leader into a nearby cave, where he sprung a trap, dropping heavy rocks on us while dumping us into a lower level. Some of our party was lost in the process, and now we will need to find our way out of what appears to be some sort of maze, while fending off attacks from minotaurs and whatever else might be down here.

Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Duskblade level 3
Beginning at 3rd level, the Duskblade can use a standard action to cast any touch spell he knows and deliver the spell through his weapon with a melee attack. Casting a spell in this manner does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If the melee attack is successful, the attack deals damage normally; then the effect of the spell is resolved.

At 13th level the Duskblade can cast any touch spell he knows as part of a full attack action, and the spell affects each target you hit in melee combat that round.

src: This merchant is a Svirfneblin. Svirfneblin, or deep gnomes, are a subrace of gray-skinned gnomes who reside in the Underdark, and are one of the few peoples to be found in that dangerous region who are not thoroughly cruel and untrustworthy, though they typically are suspicious of and withdrawn around strangers (usually with good reason, in the Underdark). Skilled at the arts of stealth and illusion, they generally survive the many dangers of their environment by evading them, rather than through violent confrontation.

LEGACY ITEM PENALTIES (These do not stack. Highest takes precedence).
Attack Penalty: -1 at 6th, -2 at 13th
Fortitude Save Penalty: -1 at 7th, -2 at 9th, -3 at 15th, -4 at 20th

Intimidating Strike (Ex): At 5th level, you can use the sapphire nightmare blade maneuver five times per day.
Diamond Strike (Su): Beginning at 7th level, you gain a +1 insight bonus on any attack roll made as part of a Diamond Mind strike delivered with Supernal Clarity.
Psychic Poise (Su): At 8th level, you add your Concentration modifier to Balance for one round, three times per day.
Haste (Su): Beginning at 11th level, you can tap into the inherent speed held within Supernal Clarity. You can use haste (self only) for 1 round as a swift action. This ability is usable up to five times per day. Caster level 10th.

Freedom of Movement (Sp): Starting at 16th level, you can cast freedom of movement on yourself once per day as an immediate action. This ability functions as the spell, except that the duration is 1 minute. Caster level 10th.
Time Stop (Sp): When you unlock the final legacy power of Supernal Clarity at 20th level, you gain the ability to move so quickly that time seems to halt in place. Once per day on command, you can use time stop as the spell. Caster level 20th.

src:
School: Necromancy [Evil]
Caster Level: Clr 5, sor/wiz 5
Components: V, S, F
Range: Medium
Target: Living creature with necrotic cyst
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial
Spell Resistance: No

You cause the cyst of a subject already harboring a necrotic cyst (see spell of the same name) to explosively enlarge itself at the expense of the subject's body tissue. If the subject succeeds on her saving throw, she takes 1d6 points of damage per level (maximum 15d6), and half the damage is considered vile damage (see necrotic bloat). The subject's cyst-derived saving throw penalty against effects from the school of necromancy applies.

If the subject fails her saving throw, the cyst expands beyond control, killing the subject.

Focus: The caster must possess a Mother Cyst.

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·寻宝者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地表的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他所认识的一支由另外六名斯涅布力侏儒组成的队伍，曾在附近调查各个派系和近期事件，如今已经失踪。他希望我要么找到并（必要时）营救这些失踪的深侏儒，要么至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒分别是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到其中任何一人或他们遭遇的证据，都应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我找到了凯齐布·煤切者被肢解的尸体碎块，他显然是被一队卓尔俘虏并折磨致死。我还找到了施纳巴·凿岩者，他显然遭遇了一些眼魔并被它们石化。我已将他从石化状态中恢复，他表示可以自行前往幽暗地域集市。泽布利普·铁足也被找到了，就在一个底栖魔鱼要塞的深处。不幸的是，他已被转化为受精神控制的奴隶，我们被迫杀死了他。至少他的命运已经查明。还有3名斯涅布力侏儒下落不明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found pieces of the mutilated body of Kezib Coalcutter, who was apparently captured and tortured to death by a party of Drow. I also found Schnabar Rockhewer, who apparently fell afoul of some Beholders and was petrified by them. I have restored him from his petrified state, and he has indicated he can make his own way to the Underdark Market. Zeblip Ironfoot has also been found, deep in the stronghold of an Aboleth. Unfortunately, he had been transformed into a mind-controlled slave and we were forced to slay him. At least his fate has been discovered. 3 Svirfneblin remain unaccounted for.

src: "I am acquainted with Mr. Kenemen, and he was indeed here not too long ago. He came to buy a healing kit. He spoke briefly and indicated that he also wanted to purchase a new hammer. I believe there is a merchant to the southwest of this temple who sells common tools like that. You might want to go there to find him, assuming he has not already made his way home."

dst: “嗯，听到这个真是太好了。这对我们来说是个大麻烦。幸运的是有你在帮我们。不过对你来说就没那么幸运了。事实上，我并没有我承诺给你的75000金币。我当时走投无路，所以说了需要的话来获取你的帮助。现在你已经完成了你的使命，就没有理由再让你活下去了。我不指望你在与那些恶魔战斗耗尽体力后还能与我们抗衡。”他伸手去拿武器。
src: "Well, that is very good to hear. It was quite a problem for us. Lucky for us you were around to help us out. It wasn't so lucky for you though. As it happens, I don't actually have the 75000 gold I promised you. I was desperate so I said what I needed to get your help. Now that you've served your purpose, there's no more reason to keep you alive. I don't expect you'll be any match for us after exhausting yourself fighting all those demons." He goes for his weapon.

革律翁，被废黜的领主
  
革律翁曾是一位强大的魔鬼，如今仅以缚灵的形式存在。他赋予缚灵者与其眼睛相关的能力，以及瞬间飞行的能力。

缚灵等级：5级
缚灵DC: 25
特殊要求：革律翁只回应那些表现出理解灵魂与位面之间关系的召唤者。因此，你必须拥有至少5级知识技能才能召唤他。

影响：在受革律翁影响期间，你会过度信任并忠于你视为盟友的人，即使面对公然的背叛。因为他重视信任，如果你进行察言观色检定或使用任何读取思想或侦测谎言的能力，你会反抗革律翁的影响。

授予能力：
革律翁赋予你他的眼睛和邪恶凝视，以及飞行的能力。

酸性凝视：你魔鬼般的眼睛凝视能使敌人喷发酸液。当你使用此能力时，你30英尺内的每个对手都必须通过意志豁免，否则受到2d6点酸伤害。

全方位视觉：你额外的眼睛允许你看向任何方向，使你在侦察和搜索检定上获得+4加值。对手在夹击你时不会获得好处。

黑暗中视物：你能在任何黑暗中完美视物，即使是深幽黑暗术创造的黑暗。

迅捷飞行：你可以通过使用跳跃能力飞行1轮。一旦你使用了迅捷飞行，你5轮内无法再次使用。
src:
Geryon, the Deposed Lord
  
Once a devil of great power, Geryon now exists only as a vestige. He gives binders powers associated with his eyes, as well as the ability to fly at a moment's notice.

Vestige Level: 5th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: Geryon answers the calls of only those summoners who show an understanding of the relationship between souls and the planes. Thus, you must have at least 5 ranks in Lore to summon him.

Influence: While influenced by Geryon, you become overly trusting of and loyal to those you see as allies, even in the face of outright treachery. Because he values trust, if you make a Sense Motive check or use any ability to read thoughts or detect lies, you rebel against Geryon's influence.

Granted Abilities: 
Geryon gives you his eyes and his baleful gaze, as well as the ability to fly.

Acidic Gaze: The gaze of your devilish eyes can cause foes to erupt with acid. When you use this ability, each opponent within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Will save or take 2d6 points of acid damage. 

All-Around Vision: Your extra eyes allow you to look in any direction, granting you a +4 bonus on Spot and Search checks. Opponents gain no benefits when flanking you.

See in Darkness: You can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, even that created by a deeper darkness spell.

（进阶职业）
旅法师向导专注于磨练其瞬间魔法传送的技能。与其他著名协会的施法者不同，旅法师向导无需将生命中的数年奉献给传送术，也无需过分专注于追求完美。尽管如此，她仍能学到只有通过受雇于旅法师工会才能获得的行业秘密。该工会本质上是一项由专业施法者为愿意付费者提供的运输服务。

大多数旅法师向导是法师或术士，不过也有少数能访问旅行领域的牧师从事此职业。此类角色通常有一两级吟游诗人，巡林客或法师等级，以便更快满足知识要求。

- 生命骰：d6
- 武器和防具擅长：旅法师向导不获得额外擅长
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

技能：知识 10

职业特性：

等级
1：增强容量 - 群体传送时每职业等级可多带一个角色
2：传送 - 每天可施放一次传送术
3：增强精准 - 传送失误时投掷两次并取较好结果
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The wayfarer guide focuses on honing her skill at instantaneous magical transportation. Unlike spellcasters of other prestigious associations, a wayfarer guide need not devote years of her life to the art of teleportation nor focus her attention overmuch on the pursuit of perfection. Still, she learns secrets of the trade that are available only through employment with the Wayfarers Union. The Union is, at its heart, a transportation service that specialty spellcasters provide for those willing to pay. 

Most wayfarer guides are wizards or sorcerers, though a few clerics with access to the Travel domain have been known to pursue this class. Such characters typically have a level or two in bard, ranger, or wizard to meet the Knowledge requirements more quickly.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Wayfarer Guide gains no additional proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Spells: Must be able to cast teleport
Skills: Lore 10

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Enhanced Capacity - Take one more character per class level when group teleporting
2: Teleport - Cast teleport once per day
3: Enhanced Accuracy - Roll twice and take the better result on teleport mishaps

src:

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Brow (totem)

You shape incarnum into a large mask that surrounds your whole head, resembling the head of a giant eagle or a giant owl. The feathered plumage is brown and white with the faintest tinge of purple-blue, and the mask's large, glassy eyes gleam sky blue.

You gain a +2 competence bonus on Spot checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your great raptor mask increases the competence bonus by 2. 

Chakra Bind (Brow) 

Your great raptor mask has large eyes that gather every scrap of light and reflect it as a pale, blue-green glow. The mask is fused to your forehead, and your eyes are melded into the eyes of the mask-which no longer look glassy, but very much alive.

You gain darkvision. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) Your head transforms to take on the appearance of a giant eagle, becoming one with your great raptor mask. While still enhancing your vision, this soulmeld also heightens your reflexive reaction to danger, allowing you to dodge entirely out of the way of dangerous effects.

You gain evasion.

dst:
（进阶职业）
夏芮丝是一位矛盾的神祇。最初，她是穆尔霍兰德神系中的战争女神 - 对抗赛特及其邪恶势力的斗士。然而现在，她是一位激情与性爱的女神，更常被称为欢愉大厅的女主人而非赛特的敌人。她的大多数祭司忘记了她辉煌的过去，将时间花在经营妓院和庆祝无尽的生命狂欢上，那几乎是为纪念他们的女神而不断举行的节日游行。但夏芮丝的庆典者不同。他们不忽视夏芮丝目前作为欢愉与欲望女神的面向，但也不忘记古老的赛特之敌，安胡尔的副官。夏芮丝的庆典者是诱惑者与战士，享乐主义者与虔诚的善良斗士。虽然女神的许多追随者是混乱中立，有些甚至倾向邪恶，但庆典者始终提醒着人们，邪恶是敌人，而欢愉应作为善行被享受并与所有人分享。尽管夏芮丝的庆典者不是牧师，但在许多方面，他们比许多她的牧师更真实地体现了他们神祇的本质。

- 生命骰：d6
- 武器防具擅长：夏芮丝的庆典者不获得任何武器防具擅长
- 技能点：6+ 智力调整值。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Sharess is a paradoxical deity. Originally, she was a war goddess of the Mulhorandi pantheon - a champion in the war against Set and his forces of evil. Now, however, she is a goddess of passion and sex who is more often referred to as the Festhall Madam than as the Foe of Set. Most of her priests forget her glorious past and spend their time running brothels and celebrating the Endless Revel of Life, a nearly constant parade of festivals in their goddess's honor. But the celebrants of Sharess are different. They do not neglect Sharess in her present aspect as the goddess of pleasure and lust, but neither do they forget the ancient Foe of Set, who was Anhur's lieutenant. Celebrants of Sharess are seducers and warriors, hedonists and pious champions of good. While many of the goddess's followers are chaotic neutral and some even lean toward evil, the celebrants are an ever-present reminder that evil is the enemy, and that pleasure is to be enjoyed and shared with all as an act of good. Though celebrants of Sharess are not clerics, in many ways they represent a truer embodiment of their deity's nature than many of her clerics do. 

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: Celebrants of Sharess gain no proficiencies
- Skill Points: 6+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Alignment: Chaotic good
Skills: Persuade 7 ranks , Perform 7 ranks 
Feats: Sacred Vow, Vow of Purity

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Cat Familiar - Gain a cat as a familiar
   Flirtation (Fascinate) - Once per day per class level, Fascinate creatures
2: Fury of the Tigress: Rage - As barbarian
3: 
4: Flirtation (Confusion) - Confuse fascinated creature
5: Pounce of the Tigress - Gain Pounce at the end of charge
6: Fury of the Tigress 2/day
7: Sanctuary - You and allies gain sanctuary
8: Swiftness of the Tigress - Gain haste once a day
9: 
10: Fury of the Tigress 3/day
    Flirtation (Dominate) - Dominate fascinated creature
	
	Spells: Beginning at 1st level, a celebrant of Sharess gains the ability to cast a number of arcane spells. To cast a spell, a celebrant must have a Charisma score of ate least 10 + the spell's level, so a celebrant with a Charisma of 10 or lower cannot cast these spells. Celebrant of Sharess bonus spells are based on Charisma, and saving throws against these spells have a DC of 10 + spell level + the celebrant's Charisma bonus (if any). When the celebrant gets 0 spells per day of a given spell level (for instance, 1st-level spells for a 1st-level celebrant), she gains only the bonus spells she would be entitled to based on her Charisma score for that spell level. The celebrant's spell list appears below. A celebrant of Sharess casts spells just as a bard does.

- 对巨人的防御训练：对抗巨人时 AC 获得 +4 闪避加值。

src:
Whisper gnomes are creatures of stealth and suspicion. In profession and behavior they range from peaceful recluses to dangerous spies, lacking their cousins' jovial nature and easy outlook on life. Whisper gnomes are slightly taller than other gnomes, standing 3 1/2 to 4 feet tall, with a thin, almost gaunt build.  Their skin ranges from light grey to light green, though the variation is rarely noticeable without careful attention. Their hair is dark, and their eyes are often some shade of blue or grey, though rarely bright or striking. Gnomes live 350 to 500 years.

Whisper Gnomish Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Str, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass whisper gnome's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature
+1 size bonus to attack rolls.
+1 size bonus to AC.
+4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- 30' base speed
- Darkvision: Whisper gnomes are able to see in the dark.
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +4 racial bonus to Hide checks.

src:
Nixies are aquatic sprites who dwell in and protect pristine ponds and lakes.  They are not bound to the water though, and can survive on land indefinitely.  They are more reclusive than most fey and treat intruders to their territory with hostility and suspicion.  Physically they resemble slim and comely humanoids, with lightly scaled, pale green skin and dark green hair.  They stand about 4' tall, and typically wear clothes made of seaweed.

Nixie Ability Adjustments: Dex +6, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +8, Str -4.
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass nixie's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Base movement of 20'
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Lesser Fey Damage Reduction: DR 5/cold iron
- Wild Empathy: +6 racial bonus to animal empathy checks.
- Spell Resistance 16: Spell resistance of 16 + 1 per level.
- Amphibious: Immune to drowning.
- Spell-like Abilities: Waterbreathing on other 1/day, Charm Person 3/day
- Fey: Nixies count as Fey for the purpose of spells.

在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给莎尔神殿的首席女祭司费拉莎看时，她认出这是提尔的一件神圣神器的一部分，该神器不久前被盗。她因我交给她找到的碎片而奖励了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，她也想要，以便莎尔神殿可以亵渎他们敌人提尔的这件神器。

在找到圣环的第二块碎片后，费拉莎告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，她可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。她还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖励。我接受了这个任务，现在已经从亡灵守卫手中取回了提尔圣环的最后一块碎片。回到神殿后，我被告知我的奖励就是这枚戒指本身，它已被重铸但被莎尔的力量腐化，并注入了一组我可以自己选择的力量。
 
在选择了我希望戒指拥有的力量后，它通过神圣力量被重铸和腐化，并作为对我努力的奖励交给了我。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Ferazha, the head priestess of the Temple of Shar, she recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. She rewarded me for giving her the piece I found, and has told me that she would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find, so that the Temple of Shar might defile this artifact of their enemy Tyr.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Ferazha that with two pieces of the ring, she could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. She also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I accepted this quest and have now recovered the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr from its undead guardians. Returning to the temple, I was informed that my reward would be this very ring, reforged but corrupted by the power of Shar, and infused with a set of powers that I myself can choose.
 
After choosing what powers I wished the ring to have, it was reforged and corrupted through divine power and given to me as a reward for my efforts.

dst:
塑能系 [力场]
等级：牧师 2，圣杯骑士 2，战争 2
成分：言语，姿势，法器
施法时间：1 标准动作
距离：中距（100 英尺 + 10 英尺/等级）
效果：力场魔化武器
持续时间：1 轮/等级（可解消）
豁免检定：无
法术抗力：是

一把由纯粹力场构成的武器凭空出现，并按照你的指示在远处攻击对手，每次命中造成 1d8 点力场伤害，每三个施法者等级 +1 点（15 级时最高 +5）.该武器呈现为你神祇所偏好的武器形状，或对你具有某种精神意义或象征的武器形状（见下文），并具有与其形态相符的真实武器相同的威胁范围和重击倍率。它攻击你指定的对手，在施法当轮开始一次攻击，此后每轮在你的回合继续攻击。它使用你的基础攻击加值（可能在后续轮次中允许它每轮多次攻击） 加上你的感知调整值作为其攻击加值。它作为法咒而非武器进行攻击，因此，例如，它可以伤害具有伤害减免的生物。作为一种力场效果，它可以攻击虚体生物，而无需承受通常与虚体相关的失手几率。该武器总是从你的方向进行攻击。它不会获得夹击加值，也不会帮助战斗者获得夹击加值。你的专长（如武器专攻） 或战斗动作（如冲锋） 不会影响该武器。如果武器超出法咒范围，如果它离开你的视线，或者如果你没有指挥它，武器会回到你身边并悬浮。

在第一轮之后的每一轮，你可以使用一个移动动作将武器重定向到新目标。如果你不这样做，武器会继续攻击上一轮的目标。在武器切换目标的任何轮次中，它获得一次攻击。后续轮次攻击该目标时，如果你的基础攻击加值允许，武器可以进行多次攻击。即使灵能武器是远程武器，也使用法咒的范围，而不是武器的正常射程增量，并且切换目标仍然是一个移动动作。

灵能武器不能被物理攻击攻击或伤害，但解除魔法，解离术，湮灭球或抵消权杖会影响它。灵能武器对抗接触攻击的 AC 为 12 (10 + 微型物体的体型加值).

如果被攻击的生物具有法术抗力，你在灵能武器第一次击中它时进行施法者等级检定（1d20 + 施法者等级） 对抗该法术抗力。如果武器被成功抵抗，法咒被解除。如果没有，武器在法咒持续时间内对该生物具有正常的完整效果。
src:
Evocation [Force]
Level: Cleric 2, Knight of the Chalice 2, War 2
Components: V, S, DF,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect: Magic weapon of force
Duration: 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

A weapon made of pure force springs into existence and attacks opponents at a distance, as you direct it, dealing 1d8 force damage per hit, +1 point per three caster levels (maximum +5 at 15th level). The weapon takes the shape of a weapon favored by your deity or a weapon with some spiritual significance or symbolism to you (see below) and has the same threat range and critical multipliers as a real weapon of its form. It strikes the opponent you designate, starting with one attack in the round the spell is cast and continuing each round thereafter on your turn. It uses your base attack bonus (possibly allowing it multiple attacks per round in subsequent rounds) plus your Wisdom modifier as its attack bonus. It strikes as a spell, not as a weapon, so, for example, it can damage creatures that have damage reduction. As a force effect, it can strike incorporeal creatures without the normal miss chance associated with incorporeality. The weapon always strikes from your direction. It does not get a flanking bonus or help a combatant get one. Your feats (such as Weapon Focus) or combat actions (such as charge) do not affect the weapon. If the weapon goes beyond the spell range, if it goes out of your sight, or if you are not directing it, the weapon returns to you and hovers.

Each round after the first, you can use a move action to redirect the weapon to a new target. If you do not, the weapon continues to attack the previous round's target. On any round that the weapon switches targets, it gets one attack. Subsequent rounds of attacking that target allow the weapon to make multiple attacks if your base attack bonus would allow it to. Even if the spiritual weapon is a ranged weapon, use the spell's range, not the weapon's normal range increment, and switching targets still is a move action.

A spiritual weapon cannot be attacked or harmed by physical attacks, but dispel magic, disintegrate, a sphere of annihilation, or a rod of cancellation affects it. A spiritual weapon's AC against touch attacks is 12 (10 + size bonus for Tiny object).

If an attacked creature has spell resistance, you make a caster level check (1d20 + caster level) against that spell resistance the first time the spiritual weapon strikes it. If the weapon is successfully resisted, the spell is dispelled. If not, the weapon has its normal full effect on that creature for the duration of the spell.

src: "So you see I'll need to look elsewhere. I think I know just the place too. There's a fencing school not far from the estate, run by one Khaladar Korad. Korad himself would never train me, he only takes on select students. But for that very reason, even his students are as formidable as most warriors one could find, so I was thinking I could hire one of them as an instructor. I'd be preprared to pay 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 gold up front. Why don't you head on over there and see if one of the students is interested?"

dst: 在穿越一个夺心魔要塞时，当我们接近统治它的主脑时，我们穿过一扇门，突然发现自己身处一个完全不同的地方——似乎回到了卡林港的加尔哈德尔庄园，正在参加一场宴会，周围是与加尔哈德尔家族有关联的各种人，其中一些人本应已经死了，而没有人应该在这里。看来我们被困在了主脑的灵能所创造的某种幻象中。这个幻象似乎主要集中在扎拉拉身上，并从她的记忆中汲取素材，所以她可能是打破这个幻象的关键。\n\n扎拉拉被说服不相信第一个幻象，结束了它，但我们现在似乎被困在了另一个幻象中。在这里，我们遇到了一个看起来是塞穆·内拉卡的人，我在卡林杉见过他。扎拉拉显然怀疑他是杀害她兄弟的凶手，这使他在她的情感上具有重大意义，这也解释了为什么他会出现在基于她记忆的幻象中。他似乎准备攻击我们，看来我们必须设法通过他才能逃脱。
src: While advancing through an Illithid stronghold, and as we were approaching the Elder Brain governing it, we passed through a door and suddenly found ourselves someplace completely different - seemingly back at the Galhadr estate in Calimport, attending a banquet in the company of various people associated with the Galhadr family, some of whom should be dead and none of whom should be here. It would seem we are trapped in some sort of illusion created by the Elder Brain's psionic powers. The illusion seems to be focused primarily on Zarala and drawing from her memories, so she may be the key to breaking out of this.\n\nZarala was convinced to disbelieve in the first illusion, ending it, but we seem now to be trapped in another. Here we have encountered someone who appears to be Semu Neraka, who I met in Calimshan. Zarala apparently suspects him as the murderer of her brother, giving him great emotional significance for her, and this accounts for his presence in an illusion based on her memories. He appears to be ready to attack us, and it seems we will have to somehow get past him to escape.

dst: 在尖牙森林中，我遇到了一些充满敌意的精类生物。我与一只曾与那些敌对精类生物战斗过的动物交谈，得知了如何找到一些显然正与这些精类生物合作的德鲁伊的藏身之处。在森林西部的山脊以东区域，可以找到一条通往他们的隐秘路径的入口。既然我知道了位置，找到并使用它应该不难。\n\n利用那只动物提供的信息，我找到了一个暗影德鲁伊的隐秘据点。这些暗影德鲁伊向我承诺，如果我杀死一个名叫黛娜拉的树精来证明我对他们事业的忠诚——她可以在森林西部山脊以南找到——他们就能让这个区域的精类生物停止攻击我，还有其他奖励。我必须把黛娜拉的头带给阿玛兰德，暗影德鲁伊的首领，作为此事的证据。
src: In the Wood of Sharp Teeth, I had some encounters with hostile Fey. I talked to one of the animals who had been fighting with the hostile fey, and was informed of how to reach the hiding place of some Druids who are apparently working with these Fey. A entrance to a hidden path to reach them can be found in the area east of the ridge in the western part of the forest. It should not be difficult to locate and use now that I know where it.\n\nUsing the information provided by the animal, I was able to locate a hidden enclave of Shadow Druids. These Shadow Druids have promised me that if I demonstrate loyalty to their cause by killing a dryad named Dainala, who can be found south of the ridge in the western part of the woods, they will be able to get the Fey in this region to stop attacking me, among other rewards. I must bring Dainala's head to Amarande, the leader of the Shadow Druids, as proof of this deed.

src: Ben Kenemen gave me a map he won from an adventurer in a card game. It indicates the location in the sewers of a secret door, beyond which allegedly lies access to a series of subterranean caves in which treasure-filled dwarven ruins can be somewhere found. With this map in hand it should not be too difficult to locate the secret door. It lies within the sewer system accessed from the nearby Markets, and can now be marked on my own maps. I must consider whether I wish to take advantage of this opportunity, however, for the caves are said to be filled with Rust Monsters, capable of destroying metal weapons and armor. If I go there, I should either equip myself with non-metallic gear, or devise some other strategy for dealing with this threat.

dst: “我来检查一下这根石柱。”她花了几分钟检查。“看来这根石柱是维持附近传送门开启的几根石柱之一。既然有塔纳厘从里面出来，我猜那传送门一定连接着深渊。如果我们想关闭传送门，就需要关闭所有石柱，但其他的石柱似乎位于传送门的另一侧，所以要关闭它，你得先进入传送门找到它们。这样的行动当然极其危险。自然，如果我们真要尝试，位于物质界的这个传送门应该最后关闭，这样我们在深渊时传送门就不会关闭，把我们困在里面。”
src: "I shall examine the pillar." She spends a few minutes doing so. " It appears this pillar is one of several that is keeping open the nearby portal, which I presume must connect to the Abyss, given the Tanar'ri coming out of it. If we wanted to close the portal we would need to shut down all the pillars, but the others appear to be located on the other side of the portal, so to shut it down you would first need to enter it to find them. Such a course of action would of course be extremely dangerous. Naturally if we do make the attempt, this portal, on the Prime Material Plane, should be shut down last so the portal will not close while we are in the Abyss, trapping us."

dst:
愚者王子伊波斯
  
契术师们称伊波斯为愚者王子，因为他头戴王冠，以及他转变为残魂的悲伤传说。他赐予召唤者寒铁利爪以撕扯敌人，看穿生物和物体真实面貌的力量，以及他魅力的一小部分。

残魂等级：6级
契术DC: 26
特殊要求：伊波斯拒绝回应任何在他看来对神秘学研究兴趣不够认真的召唤者。任何希望契术伊波斯的人必须在学识上至少有5级，在法咒造诣上至少有5级。

影响：你高度评价自己的智力，并对质疑你假设或结论的人表现出轻蔑。如果你遇到一个对你所掌握知识的话题表现出兴趣的生物，伊波斯要求你如实地教导那个人。

授予能力：
伊波斯赐予你敏锐的视觉和威严的气场，以及寒铁利爪，用以撕扯无知的面纱。

寒铁利爪：你的指甲硬化成寒铁，赋予你两次爪击。每次爪击的基础伤害如下表所示。这些利爪能克服+3或更低的伤害减免。
体型 基础伤害
微型 1
超微型 1d2
极小 1d3
小型 1d4
中型 1d6
大型 1d8
超大型 2d6
巨型 2d8
超巨型 4d6

洞察闪光：作为一个迅捷动作，你获得真实视觉效果（如同该法咒），持续1轮。一旦你使用了此能力，你5轮内不能再次使用。

伊波斯的影响：你与伊波斯的联系使你能够从你所契术的残魂中汲取更多力量。你的残魂授予的每个特殊能力的豁免DC（如果有）增加1.在确定残魂特殊能力效果时，将你的有效契术师等级视为比正常高一级。

撕扯：当你用两次或更多爪击命中一个敌人时，你自动造成一次普通爪击伤害的两倍（包括你的力量调整值），外加你的正常伤害。
src:
Ipos, Prince of Fools
  
Binders call Ipos the Prince of Fools because of the crown he wears and the sad legend of his transformation into a vestige. He grants his summoners cold iron claws with which to rend foes, the power to see creatures and objects as they are, and a fraction of his charisma.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 26
Special Requirement: Ipos refuses to answer the call of any summoner who, in his judgment, has not taken a serious enough interest in occult studies. Anyone wishing to bind Ipos must have at least 5 ranks in Lore and 5 ranks in Spellcraft.

Influence: You think highly of your intellect and show contempt toward those who question your assumptions or conclusions. If you encounter a creature that shows interest in a topic about which you have knowledge, Ipos requires that you truthfully edify that individual.

Granted Abilities: 
Ipos grants you his discerning sight and commanding presence, as well as claws of cold iron with which to rend the veil of ignorance.

Cold Iron Claws: Your fingernails harden into cold iron, granting you two claw attacks. The base damage for each claw attack is as given on the following table. These claws overcome damage reduction of +3 or less.
Size Base Damage
Diminutive 1
Fine 1d2
Tiny 1d3
Small 1d4
Medium 1d6
Large 1d8
Huge 2d6
Gargantuan 2d8
Colossal 4d6

Flash of Insight: As a swift action, you gain a true seeing effect (as the spell) for a duration of 1 round. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Ipos's Influence: Your affiliation with Ipos allows you to draw more power from the vestiges to which you are bound. The saving throw DC (if any) of each special ability granted by your vestiges increases by 1. Treat your effective binder level as one higher than normal for the purpose of determining the effects of vestige special abilities.

Rend: When you hit one foe with two or more claw attacks, you automatically deal double the damage of a normal claw attack (including your Strength modifier) in addition to your normal damage.

当毒手手套绑定到你的手部脉轮时，毒素还造成等于感知伤害量的力量伤害（一次豁免抵抗两种效果）.
src:
Gloves of the Poisoned Hand

Descriptors: Evil
Classes: Soulborn
Chakra: Hands

Slick green gloves slide over your hands. They appear moist but are dry to the touch.

Once per round, you can attempt to inflict a terrible, mind-wracking poison on a foe with a melee touch attack. The poison deals 1 point of Wisdom damage immediately and another 1 point of Wisdom damage 1 minute later. Each instance of damage can be negated by a Fortitude save. No creature can be affected by the gloves more than once in a 24-hour period. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your gloves increases the Wisdom damage dealt (both primary and secondary damage) by 1 point. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

The gloves merge with your hands, giving your hands a green cast. Your fingertips drip with viscous slime.

When gloves of the poisoned soul are bound to your hands chakra, the poison also deals Strength damage equal to the amount of Wisdom damage dealt (one save resists both effects).

src:
Blues are a subrace of goblins with an innate knack for psionics. Their bluish skin sets them apart from other goblins immediately - which often makes them a target not just of goblin enemies but also of other goblins. Enlightened goblin communities attempt to preserve their blues, since those that survive to adulthood augment the tribe. A blue is often smaller than an average goblin, standing just about 3 feet tall and weighing about 40 pounds. Blues have noticeably blue-tinged skin, and their eyes are less dull than those of a common goblin. Otherwise, they resemble their kin. They generally dress in short leather robes, dyed black.

Goblin Ability Adjustments: +2 Int, -2 Str, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Psion): A multiclass blue's psion class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Small Stature:
- +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
- +1 size bonus to AC.
- +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Darkvision: Goblins are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Goblinoid: Blues count as Goblinoids for the purpose of spells.

src: I have heard tales of something called the "Blackguard's Throne," which can supposedly be found in the Realm of Orcus in the Abyss. According to what I have heard, it can only be reached by someone "worthy." What "worthiness" entails is not clear but l suspect it means at least someone with the moral qualities associated with Blackguards (perhaps among other requirements). If it can be found, sitting in should increase one's powers in some undefined way, especiallly so if one is a Blackguard.\n\nI have used the master key to free Nathkar. I suspect I would also have needed it to reach this Blackguard's Throne, and thus will not now ever find it. I doubt it was that important anyway.

（进阶职业）
忍者密探是一个神秘而难以捉摸的角色。虽然大多数忍者不过是刺客，但忍者密探运用潜行，狡诈和神秘力量为其主人完成几乎任何任务。

忍者密探似乎能随意出现和消失，在敌军行列中隐形移动。无论任务是什么--渗透，破坏还是冷血谋杀--这个黑衣死亡之影的出现对所有挡路者都意味着灾难。

忍者密探笼罩在秘密之中，发誓保守自己职业的秘密，并保护其氏族其他成员的身份。路边的盲眼乞丐，踉跄回家的醉酒战士，掩面而笑的艺妓--他们中的任何一个都可能是伪装，隐藏着忍者密探黑暗而致命的秘密身份。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Ninja Spy is an enigmatic and mysterious character. While most ninja are little more than assassins, the Ninja Spy uses stealth, cunning and mystical powers to accomplish almost any task for their master.

Appearing and disappearing seemingly at will, the Ninja Spy moves invisibly through enemy ranks.  No matter the mission - be it infiltration, sabotage or cold-blooded murder - the presence of this black-garbed shadow of death spells disaster for all who stand in the way.

Shrouded in secrecy, the Ninja Spy is sworn to keep his or her profession a secret and to protect the identity of other members of their clan.  A blind beggar by the roadside, a drunken fighter staggering homeward, a giggling geisha hiding her face - any one of them could be a disguise, hiding the dark and deadly secret identity of the Ninja Spy.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Ninja Spy gains proficiency with shurikens
- Skill Points: 6+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment Restrictions: Any non-chaotic, non-good.
Skills: Bluff (10 ranks), Hide (10 ranks), Tumble (10 ranks).
Feats: Dodge, Evasion.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Use Poison - The Ninja Spy can apply poison to weapons.
   Feat - Weapon Proficiency: Exotic.
2: Feat - Sneak Attack (+1d6).
   Feat - Improved Evasion.
3: Feat - Epic Skill Focus: Tumble - Player gains +3 bonus to all skill checks with Tumble.
4: Feat - Hide in Plain Sight.
5: Feat - Sneak Attack (+2d6).
7: Thousand Faces - The Ninja Spy gains the ability to change their appearance at will.
8: Venom Immunity - The Ninja Spy becomes immune to all forms of poison.
   Feat - Sneak Attack (+3d6).
9: Feat - Slippery Mind.
10: Improved Invisibility - 1/day (spell-like ability).

dst: "满足你的好奇心是对你所做之事的一种简单回报。我是一个被派来调查此地以西不远处一些奇特位面扰动的队伍的一员。似乎正在进行某种强大的魔法，我们认为是在地表，它导致了位面扰动。位面之间的边界变得比应有的更加多孔，元素生物一直在穿过。带领我们的女祭司派我在周围地区侦察，而其他人则直接调查扰动。我相信那是因为她认为我是我们队伍中最无用和可牺牲的。她甚至懒得警告我可能有石化蜥蜴，这就是你发现我时我所处状态的原因。"
src: "Satisfying your curiosity is a simple enough repayment for what you have done. I am part of a party sent to investigate some peculiar planar disturbances a little to the west of here. Some great magic seems to be in process, we think on the surface, and it is causing planar disruptions. The borders between planes are becoming more porous than they should, and elementals have been coming through. The priestess leading us sent me to scout out the surrounding area while the rest of them looked into the disturbances directly. I believe that is because she regarded me as the most worthless and expendable of our group. She did not even bother to warn me that there might be basilisks about, which accounts for the condition in which you found me."

dst: 在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了关于一个名叫拉贾尔的人的一些信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的联系人。目前尚不完全清楚这个拉贾尔究竟是谁，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他位于下水道的藏身处的路线，并注意到我应该使用密码“Jaraj”来进入那里。只要我随身保留这张纸以供参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。然而，我必须决定，是应该独自去寻找这个拉贾尔，还是把我发现的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能利用这些信息来终结他的犯罪活动。\n\n我已经把我发现的信息交给了守卫，由达沙尔·扎伊内姆中尉代表。他很高兴，期望这能帮助他将这名罪犯绳之以法，并给了我一点小奖励。
src: During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.\n\nI have turned over the information I found to the Watch, represented by Lieutenant Dashar Zaynem. He was pleased, expecting it would help him bring this criminal to justice, and gave me a small reward.

dst: 扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角落”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。森卡尔要求我找到对历史研究有价值的东西作为他完成这项工作的代价，而我也在黑暗卡林港找到了一块写有文字的古碑，他认为这令人满意。\n\n森卡尔花了几天时间研究此事，并交给我一个据称装有研究结果的包裹。然而，当我把它送给扎拉拉时，却发现我拿到的东西是给别人的，并不是她想要的研究。森卡尔一定是把我的包裹和别的东西弄混了。我必须回去找他，换成正确的那一份。
src: Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. Senkhar demanded that I find something of value to historical research as his price to carry out this job, and I duly found an ancient tablet with some writing on it in Dark Calimport, which he accepted as satisfactory.\n\nSenkhar took a couple of days to research the matter and presented me with a packet allegedly containing the results. When I delivered it to Zarala, however, it turned out what I was given was intended for someone else and was not the research she wanted. Senkhar must have gotten my packet mixed up with something else. I will have to return to him and exchange it for the correct one.

dst: 工具和材料摆放在这个铁砧上。你可以用它们尝试以各种方式升级你装备的武器、护甲或盾牌。你必须装备一件相应类型的物品才能选择升级它，而且，一旦你选择了要升级什么，你就必须避免卸下或更换你装备的物品，直到你完成为止（即，直到在选择对话选项的过程中你选择一个让你回到本段的选项），否则可能会破坏升级过程。请记住，你必须支付材料费用，如果你的技能不足，这笔钱可能会损失。此外，由于物资有限，你总共最多只能对任意数量的武器、护甲或盾牌进行十次升级（只有成功的升级才计入此限制——你可以重复使用失败尝试中的材料）。弹药制造有单独的限制。达到此限制后，除非索里克补货，否则你将无法再进行更多升级。
src: Tools and materials are laid out on this anvil. You can use them in attempts to upgrade your equipped weapon, armor or shield in various ways. You must have an item of the appropriate type equipped to have the option of upgrading it, and, once you have chosen what to upgrade, you must avoid unequipping or switching out your equipped item until you are finished with it (i.e., until in the course of selecting conversational options you choose one returning you to this paragraph) or risk sabotaging the upgrade process. Keep in mind that you must pay for materials, and this money may be lost if your skills prove insufficient. In addition, due to limited supplies, you can make no more than ten upgrades in total to any number of weapons, armor, or shields (only successful upgrades count against this limit - you can reuse materials from botched attempts). Manufacture of ammunition has a separate limit. After hitting this limit, you will be able to make no more upgrades unless Thorik restocks.

dst: 我在幽暗地域市场遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·寻宝者表示，他可能知道一条我可以返回地表的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他认识的一支由六名斯涅布力侏儒组成的队伍，曾在附近调查各个派系和近期事件，现已失踪。他要我找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深地侏儒，或至少查明他们的命运。涉及的斯涅布力侏儒是凯齐布·煤切、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿石、施内拉·影潜和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到这些人中的任何一个或有关他们遭遇的证据，应向弗兰泽布报告。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.

纳西拉克希望我击败泰坦。这其实并不像听起来那么困难，因为他们并非真正的泰坦，只是一个以此为名的犯罪团伙，但肯定少不了要打上几场硬仗。这些泰坦的藏身处位于伊尔梅特神殿的东南方。

利用我拼凑出的密码，我现在已经进入了泰坦的主要总部。希望他们很快就会被解决掉。

结果发现，大多数泰坦已经不在他们的总部了，他们逃进了下水道。他们正在攻击腐败的济贫所，该机构直到最近一直在资助他们的犯罪活动，如今因为不赞成他们过度的暴力而遭到报复。我听说他们还在从这儿到那里的下水道通道上布下了大量陷阱，指望在我追击他们时把我干掉。尽管如此，如果我要完成这项任务，还是必须追进下水道。我最近获得的同伴应该有一把能让我进去的钥匙。
src:
Nasirak wants me to defeat the Titans. This actually shouldn't be as difficult as it sounds, since they are not really Titans, just a criminal gang using that as their name, but it will surely involve a good bit of fighting. The hideouts of these Titans can be found southeast of the Temple of Ilmater.

Using the password I pieced together, I have now gained access to the main Titan headquarters. Hopefully they will soon be finished off.

It turns out most of the Titans are no longer to be found in their headquarters, having fled into the sewers. They are attacking the corrupt Poverty Relief Office, which until recently was subsidizing their criminal activities, in retaliation for its disapproval of their excessive violence. I have heard that they have also heavily trapped the path through the sewers between here and there, in hopes that this would kill me when I pursued them. Nevertheless, I must still pursue them into the sewers if I am to complete this mission. My recently acquired companion should have a key allowing me access.
