dst:
（进阶职业）
异形学家与来自空间和时间恐怖遥远角落的力量和实体打交道。对他们来说，魔法力量是心智战胜维度，距离，以及常常是理智的粗鲁边界的胜利。凭借知识和决心，他们刺穿时间边缘的屏障。如果远界，在时间之外，海格力斯般的心智漂流，沉浸在疯狂的沉思中。不可言说的存在向那些敢于交流的人低语可怕的秘密。这些秘密本不是为凡人准备的，但异形学家跳入混沌和熵的深渊，这会摧毁较弱的心智。异形学家疯狂的确定性有时足够强大，使他人相信她自己未来的超越。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 熟练：异形学家不获得任何额外的武器或护甲熟练。
- 技能点：2+智力调整值。

要求：

技能：知识8级。
专长：警觉。
施法：能够施放3级奥术。
特殊：之前接触过异形学家或伪自然生物。

职业特性：

等级
1：召唤异界生物 - 当施放任何召唤生物法咒时，异形学家召唤生物的“伪自然”版本。
2：异界祝福 - 所有豁免+1洞察加值，但永久失去2点感知。
3：超魔法秘密 - 奖励超魔法专长。
4：疯狂确定性 - 对特定种类的生物，豁免，攻击掷骰和基于魅力的技能和属性检定-2惩罚。
5：伪自然魔宠 - 异形学家的魔宠获得伪自然模板。
6：额外召唤 - 每天一次，异形学家可以以其最高法术等级施放召唤生物法咒。
7：超魔法秘密 - 奖励超魔法专长。
8：疯狂确定性 - 惩罚增加到-6。
9：永恒秘密 - 异形学家学习永葆青春的秘诀。她不再因衰老而遭受属性惩罚，也不能被魔法老化。
10：超越 - 异形学家超越她的凡人形态，成为异界生物。她的类型变为“异界生物”，这意味着（除其他外）她不再受专门针对类人生物的法咒影响，如魅惑人类，但她可以被针对其阵营的魔法圈法咒阻挡。此外，异形学家获得伤害减免20/+1和电击抗力20。

奖励法咒

在异形学家获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他也在其最高奥术施法职业中获得等级。他不通过能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Alienists deal with powers and entities from terrifyingly remote reaches of space and time. For them, magical power is the triumph of the mind over the rude boundaries of dimension, distance, and often, sanity. With knowledge and determination, they pierce the barrier at the edge of time itself. If the Far Realm, outside of time, Herculean minds drift, absorbed in contemplations of madness. Unspeakable beings whisper terrifying secrets to those who dare communication. These secrets were not meant for mortals, but the alienist plunges into abysses of chaos and entropy that would blast a weaker mind. An alienist's mad certainty is sometimes strong enough to sway others to believe in her own future transcendence.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: An Alienist does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Lore 8 ranks.
Feats: Alertness.
Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd level arcane spells.
Special: Prior contact with an alienist or a pseudonatural creature.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Summon Alien - when casting any summon creature spell, Alienist summons "pseudonatural" version of a creature.
2: Alien blessing - +1 insight bonus on all saving throws, but permanently loses 2 points of Wisdom.
3: Metamagic secret - bonus metamagic feat.
4: Mad certainty - -2 penalty to saving throws, attack rolls, and Charisma based skill and ability checks against specified kind of creatures.
5: Pseudonatural familiar - Alienists familiar gains the pseudonatural template.
6: Extra summoning - once pre day Alienist can cast summon creature spell at her highest spell level.
7: Metamagic secret - bonus metamagic feat.
8: Insane certainty - penalties increase to -6.
9: Timeless secret - The Alienist learns the secret of perpetual youth. She no longer suffers ability penalties for aging and cannot be magically aged.
10: Transcendence - The Alienist transcends her mortal form and becomes an alien creature. Her type changes to "outsider," which means (among other things) that she is no longer affected by spells the specifically target humanoids, such as charm person, but she can be hedged out by a magic circle spell against her alignment. Additionally, the alienist gains damage reduction 20/+1 and electricity resistance 20. 

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Alienist, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest arcane caster class. He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

src: Blimfin Zemquin, proprietor of a Calimport magic shop, has told about a machine he set up in the sewers to process the sewer water, extract useful material from it, and pump it up to his shop. Unfortunately, the machine appears to have stopped working recently, and because of the danger of wererats in the sewers, Blimfin dare not check on it himself. He has asked me to investigate the problem for him. He will pay me something simply for information about what the problem is, but even more if I somehow manage to repair the machine and get it working again.\n\nThe machine appears to have had several parts ripped out of it by the sewer's wererats, who apparently wanted to lure any would-be repairmen into an ambush. I could simply report this to Blimfin and be done with it, but no doubt he would reward me further if I could recover the missing parts, and particularly if I were able to actually repair his contraption.

受术者及其所有装备变为虚体，雾状且半透明。其物质护甲（包括天生护甲）变得毫无价值，但其体型，敏捷，偏斜加值以及来自力场效果的护甲加值仍然有效。受术者获得伤害减免 10/魔法，并免疫毒素和重击。在气化形态下，它不能攻击或施放带有言语，姿势，材料或法器成分的法咒。（这不排除使用受术者可能通过法术默发，法术定发和免材超魔专长准备的法咒。）受术者在气化形态下也会失去超自然能力。如果它准备了一个接触法术，当气化形体法咒生效时，该法咒会无害地消散。

气化生物不能飞跑，但能以 10 英尺的速度飞行（机动性完美）.只要法咒持续，它就能穿过小洞或狭窄开口，甚至仅仅是裂缝，并携带其穿戴或手中持有的所有物品。该生物会受到风的影响，且不能进入水或其他液体。它也不能操纵物体或激活物品，即使这些物品随其气化形态一同携带。持续激活的物品保持激活，但在某些情况下其效果可能无意义。
src:
Level: Brd 3, Sor/Wiz 3
Components: S
Range: Touch
Target: Willing corporeal creature touched
Duration: 2 min./level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No
The subject and all its gear become insubstantial, misty, and translucent. Its material armor (including natural armor) becomes worthless, though its size, Dexterity, deflection bonuses, and armor bonuses from force effects still apply. The subject gains damage reduction 10/magic and becomes immune to poison and critical hits. It can't attack or cast spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components while in gaseous form. (This does not rule out the use of certain spells that the subject may have prepared using the feats Silent Spell, Still Spell, and Eschew Materials.) The subject also loses supernatural abilities while in gaseous form. If it has a touch spell ready to use, that spell is discharged harmlessly when the gaseous form spell takes effect.

A gaseous creature can't run, but it can fly at a speed of 10 feet (maneuverability perfect). It can pass through small holes or narrow openings, even mere cracks, with all it was wearing or holding in its hands, as long as the spell persists. The creature is subject to the effects of wind, and it can't enter water or other liquid. It also can't manipulate objects or activate items, even those carried along with its gaseous form. Continuously active items remain active, though in some cases their effects may be moot.

src:
Luhix: Powdered stalks of plants that grow only in the Abyss, luhix is normally sprinkled onto a bleeding, self-inflicted wound. Then the wound is sealed either with magical healing or tightly wound bandages.
Initial Effect: 1 point of ability score damage to all ability scores.
Secondary Effect: The imbiber gains a +2 alchemical bonus to all ability scores for 1d2 hours.
Side Effects: For the first minute of application, the user feels intense pain. During the time that the secondary effect is in effect, the user is immune to pain (including the effects of spells such as symbol of pain). The character takes damage as normal, but may not react normally to that damage.
Overdose: Those who take this drug more than once in 24 hours must make a separate save (Fort DC 25 negates) or die in terrible pain.
Addiction: Luhix has an addiction rating of Vicious (DC 36). Failing to take a drug you are addicted to once per 24 hours and failing the resulting Fort save results in ability damage.

dst: "有一件事严峻地考验了我是否愿意为我的神承受苦难：在我们的冒险途中，维兰爵士战死了。虽然他的死让我悲痛欲绝，但我也感到受激励要继续他与邪恶势力战斗的事业，并决定要妥善做到这一点，我自己需要成为一名圣武士。而这，我想，就解释了为何你看到我今天的样子。我们还有任务要完成，我想我们已经花了足够的时间来讲述故事了。"
src: "An event that sorely tested my willingness to embrace suffering on behalf of my god: in the course of our adventures, Sir Veran fell in battle. While grief-stricken by his death, I also felt inspired to carry on his work of battling the forces of evil, and decided that to do so properly I would need to become a paladin myself. And, this, I think, explains how you find me as what I am today. We have a quest to accomplish, and I think we have spent enough time recounting tales."

That provided to elves or half-elves will be quite significant, but the benefits to those of other races will be nominal. Note also that only those who are naturally elven will benefit, not those who have temporarily shifted or somehow polymorphed themselves into an elven form. There is also a slight bonus to those with a high lore skill.

Once we go through, we can keep heading downwards, and will eventually reach a large Underdark cavern. There we should proceed northeast until we reach the dark barrier. There are glowing lights that appear and disappear around it regularly. Approach one, and I can use the Rogue Stone to transport to the other side. If you need a some rest before we proceed, you can use the little camp I set up here. Oh, there is one more thing we should discuss before doing anything else, something you should know about me, as I would not like it to surprise you at an inconvenient moment."

dst: 这本书是一本关于开锁、扒窃、解除陷阱和潜行绕过守卫等活动的有效技巧指南。许多商店不会出售这样的书，因为他们认为对此类知识感兴趣的人必定不怀好意。一直在寻求发展此类才能的冒险者会发现这本书很有用，相当于在实际盗窃中通过冒险经历所能学到的经验。然而，那些已经拥有丰富经验的人，或者并未专注于书中所述技能类型的人，不会发现多少既新颖又与他们相关的内容。\n\n注意：使用这本书将给予玩家一些经验值，其数量与玩家的等级成反比。这本特定的书将主要惠及拥有许多游荡者类能力的职业：游荡者、刺客、影舞者和吟游诗人，其他职业只能获得少量经验值。
src: This book is a guide to effective techniques for such activities as picking locks and pockets, disabling traps, and sneaking past guards. Many stores will not sell such a book, assuming that anyone interested in such knowledge must be up to no good. An adventurer who has been seeking to develop such talents would find this book useful, an equivalent to the lessons that can be learned through risky experience in actual thievery. However, those who already possess much experience, or who are not concentrating on the kind of skills the book deals with, will not find much that is both new and relevant to them.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide some experience to the player, the amount being inversely proportional to his level. This particular book will primarily benefit classes with many thief-like abilities: rogues, assassins, shadowdancers, and bards, with other classes receiving only a slight XP gain.

一个扭曲的，不和谐的，闪烁的彩色图纹在空气中编织，影响其中的生物。

6 或更少：昏迷 1d4 轮，然后震慑 1d4 轮，然后困惑 1d4 轮。（对非活物将昏迷结果视为震慑。）

7 到 12：震慑 1d4 轮，然后困惑 1d4 轮。

13 或更多：困惑 1d4 轮。

src:
Scintillating Pattern
Illusion (Pattern) [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Sor/Wiz 8
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect: Colorful lights in a 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration: Concentration + 2 rounds
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

A twisting pattern of discordant, coruscating colors weaves through the air, affecting creatures within it.
The spell affects a total number of Hit Dice of creatures equal to your caster level (maximum 20). Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first; and, among creatures with equal HD, those who are closest to the spell's point of origin are affected first. Hit Dice that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted. The spell affects each subject according to its Hit Dice.

6 or less: Unconscious for 1d4 rounds, then stunned for 1d4 rounds, and then confused for 1d4 rounds. (Treat an unconscious result as stunned for nonliving creatures.)

7 to 12: Stunned for 1d4 rounds, then confused for 1d4 rounds.

13 or more: Confused for 1d4 rounds.

Sightless creatures are not affected by scintillating pattern.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisites: Soulknife 3rd
Specifics: As a move action, a soulknife of 3rd level or higher can imbue his mind blade with destructive psychic energy. This effect deals an extra 1d8 points of damage to the next living, nonmindless target he successfully hits with a melee attack (or a ranged attack, if he is using the throw mind blade ability). Creatures immune to mind-affecting effects are immune to psychic strike damage. (Unlike the rogue's sneak attack the psychic strike is not precision damage and can affect creatures otherwise immune to extra damage from critical hits or more than 30 feet away, provided they are living, nonmindless creatures not immune to mind-affecting effects.)
 A mind blade deals this extra damage only once when this ability is called upon, but a soulknife can imbue his mind blade with psychic energy again by taking another move action. Once a soulknife has prepared his blade for a psychic strike, it holds the extra energy until it is used. Even if the soulknife drops the mind blade (or it otherwise dissipates, such as when it is thrown and misses), it is still imbued with psychic energy when the soulknife next materializes it.
 At every four levels beyond 3rd, the extra damage from a soulknife's psychic strike increases by 1d8.
Use: Selected

直觉闪避：即使措手不及或被隐形攻击者击中，你仍保留AC上的敏捷加值（如果有）.

src:
Paimon, the Dancer
  
Paimon whirls into reality with grace and style. He gives his summoners the ability to see combat as a dance and makes them masters of its steps and hidden meter.

Vestige Level: 3rd
Binding DC: 20
Special Requirement: No

Influence: Paimon's influence makes you lascivious and bold. In addition, Paimon requires that you dance (moving at half speed) whenever you hear music.

Granted Abilities: 
Paimon gives you the ability to dance in and out of combat, and to make whirling attacks against multiple foes.

Dance of Death: When you use this ability as a standard action, you move up to your speed in a line and make a single attack against any creature you move past, provoking attacks of opportunity normally. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Paimon's Blades: You gain proficiency with the rapier and short sword, and the benefit of the Weapon Finesse feat when you wield such weapons.

Paimon's Dexterity: You gain a +4 bonus to Dexterity.

Paimon's Skills: You gain a +4 bonus on Tumble checks and Perform checks.

Uncanny Dodge: You retain your Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.

Whirlwind Attack: You gain the benefit of the Whirlwind Attack feat.

Shadow Hand (Strike)
Level: Swordsage 8
Prerequisite: Three Shadow Hand maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates

Your weapon becomes cloaked in an inky, black nimbus. As you strike your opponent, that energy flows into the wound and leaves him pale, weak, and shaking.

As part of this maneuver, you make a single melee attack. If this attack hits, the target must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 18 + your Wis modifier) or gain 1d4 negative levels. This maneuver is a supernatural ability.

dst: "我们创造了一座坚不可摧的堡垒，一件极具价值的东西。贪婪之神的门徒自然会贪婪地想要将如此宝贵的东西据为己有。守护升起后，他们便发动袭击，企图消灭所有其他神祇的信徒。虽然对外部威胁有防护，但内战却在我们的大厅中肆虐。双方又升起了更多祈祷，这一次是向其他矮人降下诅咒，而我们确实被诅咒了。最终这里所有人都被杀死，却仍被诅咒以不自然的亡灵形态萦绕此地，注定要在一场无人能赢的无尽战争中永远互相厮杀，因为当我们被击倒后，只会回归不死状态。"

Once the ward was raised, they struck, seeking to eliminate followers of all the other gods. While protected against external threats, civil war raged through our halls. Yet more prayers were raised on both sides, this time calling down curses on other dwarves, and cursed we were. Eventually all here were slain, yet remained cursed to still haunt the place in unnatural undeath, doomed to keep fighting each other indefinitely in an endless war that none could win, as when struck down we only returned to unlife."

dst:
哈马德一直在筹备对变形蛛总部的进攻，如今我们已掌握其位置情报，进攻几乎准备就绪，军队正集结于蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结地。哈马德指示我前往该集结地，为进攻贡献我的能力。抵达后，我需向那里的指挥官——卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以其认为合适的方式提供协助。该前往城门了，在那里带上我想带的任何随从，然后出发前往沼泽。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结地，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已与服务于我们变形蛛敌人的类人生物（此处多为蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会获胜，但担心等到胜利之时，我们敌人的首领早已逃离总部，以便从其他地点继续他们的战争。为防止这种情况，他计划派我沿斥候发现的一条向北的小路前进，这条小路能让我绕过敌军主力抵达基地。我将沿此路行进，并与驻扎在小路开始再次向南拐弯处之前的军队斥候会合。随后，我和斥候们将一路杀穿敌军后方——希望那里抵抗薄弱——以抵达基地。一旦到达，我需在变形蛛首领策划逃脱之前将其杀死。

虽然与军队斥候的会合并未按计划进行，但我仍抵达了基地并深入其中。是时候执行将军的计划了，在变形蛛及其可能在场的任何盟友设法逃脱之前，将他们尽数杀死。

抵达基地下层后不久，我用来到达那里的通道在我身后坍塌了。看来此时我只能继续前进。这次坍塌很可能是变形蛛为阻止追击、便于自己逃脱而制造的，因此抢在他们前面可能对完成此任务至关重要。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

While the rendezvous with the army's scouts did not go as planned, I have nevertheless reached the base and penetrated within. It is time to proceed with the general's plan by killing the aranea here, along with any of their allies who may be present, before they can effect some sort of escape.

Soon after reaching the lower level of the base, the passage I took to reach it collapsed behind me. It would appear I can only go forward at this point. Likely this collapse was engineered by the aranea to block pursuit while they escape, so getting ahead of it may well have been crucial to the accomplishment of this quest.

dst:
穆尔霍兰德叛逆巫师打开的一道界门通向一个由野蛮兽人居住的世界。这些兽人利用界门入侵费伦，席卷了许多北方定居点，杀害了数千人。穆尔霍兰德与恩瑟两地的神王化身与兽人交战，兽人则召唤自己神祇的神力化身进行报复。在这些被称为兽人门战争的冲突中，兽人神祇格乌什杀死了穆尔霍兰德的太阳神雷，这是已知的国度中第一起弑神事件。许多恩瑟神祇也被杀害。人类神祇最终获胜，兽人被杀或被迫北迁。

神祇赛特与奥西里斯争夺继承雷之位，赛特谋杀了他的对手。荷鲁斯吸收了雷的神力，成为荷鲁斯-雷，击败了赛特，并将这位邪神抛入沙漠。伊西斯复活了奥西里斯。除赛特外，穆尔霍兰德万神殿全体联合支持荷鲁斯-雷。这两个古老国家暂停下来重建力量、舔舐伤口。在此期间，劳玛萨与纳菲尔帝国在北方的战场领土上崛起。在恩瑟，他们的主神恩利尔让位给其子吉尔吉姆后消失，而伊什塔尔，唯一幸存的另一位恩瑟神祇，将她的化身之力交给伊西斯后也消失了。吉尔吉姆作为恩瑟的统治者，开始了长达2000年的衰落，沦为专制暴君。
src:
One portal opened by Mulhorand's rebellious wizards led to a world populated by savage orcs. These orcs used the portal to invade Faer�n, overrunning many northern settlements and slaying thousands. The manifestations of the god-kings of both Mulhorand and Unther battled the orcs, and the orcs retaliated by summoning divine avatars of their own deities. During these conflicts, known as the Orcgate Wars, the orc god Gruumsh slew the Mulhorandi sun god Re, the first known deicide in the Realms. Many of the Untheric deities were slain as well. The human deities eventually prevailed and the orcs were slain or driven northward.

The deities Set and Osiris battled to succeed Re, and Set murdered his rival. Horus absorbed the divine power of Re and became Horus-Re, defeated Set, and cast the evil god into the desert. Isis resurrected Osiris. All of the Mulhorandi pantheon but Set united in support of Horus-Re. The two old nations paused to rebuild their power and lick their wounds. During this time the empires of Raumathar and Narfell rose in the battlefield territories to the north. In Unther, their chief god Enlil abdicated in favor of his son Gilgeam and vanished, and Ishtar, the only other surviving Untheric deity, gave the power of her manifestation to Isis and vanished as well. Gilgeam began his 2,000-year decline into despotic tyranny as the ruler of Unther.

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·宝石探寻者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地面的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他认识的一队六名斯涅布力侏儒在附近调查各个派系和近期事件时失踪了。他要我找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深侏儒，或者至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到这些人中的任何一个或他们遭遇的证据，应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我找到了施纳巴·凿岩者，他显然遭遇了一些眼魔并被它们石化。我已将他从石化状态中恢复，他表示可以自行前往幽暗地域集市。我还在一个底栖魔鱼的据点深处找到了泽布利普·铁足。不幸的是，他已被转化为受精神控制的奴隶，我们被迫杀死了他。至少他的命运已被查明。还有4名斯涅布力侏儒下落不明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found Schnabar Rockhewer, who apparently fell afoul of some Beholders and was petrified by them. I have restored him from his petrified state, and he has indicated he can make his own way to the Underdark Market. I also found Zeblip Ironfoot deep in the stronghold of an Aboleth. Unfortunately, he had been transformed into a mind-controlled slave and we were forced to slay him. At least his fate has been discovered. 4 Svrifneblin remain unaccounted for.

dst:
我已经和达伦·索尔伯爵谈过，他试图雇佣佣兵来对抗其领地上的怪物入侵。比大多数同类怪物更强大的熊地精和大地精团伙频繁出现在伯爵的乡间庄园周围的土地上，他悬赏每带回一个熊地精或大地精的头颅就奖励100金币，希望能减少它们的数量。我可以通过伯爵在城市住所中的传送门前往乡间庄园，该住所位于码头以北、市场以西的区域。到达后，我可以开始巡逻乡村，寻找地精类生物。伯爵还让我和那里的资深仆人，一位名叫林·梅伦多斯的人交谈，以交付头颅或处理此事引发的任何其他问题。

目前尚不清楚我是否有可能消灭所有地精类生物，但尽力减少它们的威胁很可能有利可图。此外，如果我停止巡逻并返回城市，我可以在方便时通过传送门回来继续猎杀怪物，所以如果我需要，这有可能成为一项固定的收入来源。

在巡逻过程中，我在一具大地精的尸体上发现了一块地图碎片。如果我能找到足够多的碎片拼出完整的地图，它可能会揭示一个有趣的地点，也许是这些地精类生物的主要基地，或者可能是一些重要的宝藏。
src:
I have spoken to Count Daren Thorl, who sought to hire mercenaries in order to combat monstrous incursions on his lands. Bands of Bugbears and Hobgoblins, more powerful than most such monsters, have been appearing frequently in the lands surrounding the Count's country estate, and he has offered a bounty of 100 gold for every Bugbear or Hobgoblin head adventurers can bring back, in hopes of thinning their numbers. I can travel to the country estate through a portal found in the Count's residence in the city, which is in an area north of the docks and west of the markets. Once there, I can commence to patrol the countryside in search of goblinoids. The Count has also told me to speak to the senior servant there, one Rin Merendos, to turn in heads or deal with any other questions raised by this matter.

It is not clear that it will be possible for me to ever eliminate all the goblinoids, but doing what I can to reduce their threat could well prove profitable. Furthermore, if I leave off patrolling and return to the city, I will be able to return by the portal for more monster hunting whenever it is convenient, so this has the potential to be a regular source of income, if I find myself in need of such.

In the course of patrolling, I found a piece of a map on the body of a Hobgoblin. If I could find enough pieces to assemble the whole map, it might reveal a location of interest, the main base of these goblinoids, perhaps, or possibly some significant treasure.

奥喀斯之仆将自己奉献给了不死生物的恶魔王子。在为他服务的过程中，她成为了痛苦，谋杀和复仇的工具。她沉醉于不死生物的陪伴，更喜欢它们腐烂的触碰而非活物的血肉。奥喀斯之仆通常以小团体行动。这些死灵法师和恋尸癖者的阴谋集团与不死生物和恶魔勾结，形成隐藏在繁华城市和宁静村庄中的堕落邪恶小团体。奥喀斯之仆仇恨并对抗狄摩高根和格拉兹特的奴仆。

- 武器和防具擅长：奥喀斯之仆获得简易武器和军用武器，所有类型的护甲和盾牌的擅长。

等级

5：召唤不死生物 - 奥喀斯之仆可以每日一次召唤一个莫尔格。

奖励法咒

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Thrall of Orcus has devoted himself to the demon prince of undeath. In his service, she becomes a tool of misery, murder, and revenge. She revels in the company of the undead, preferring their decaying touch to that of living flesh. Thralls of Orcus often work in small groups. These cabals of necromancers and necrophiliacs consort with undead creatures and demons to form small cells of depraved evil hiding amid bustling cities and quiet villages. Thralls of Orcus hate and war against the thralls of Demogorgon and Graz'zt.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Thrall of Orcus gains proficiencies in simple and martial weapons, all types of armor, and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Divine Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level spells.
Feats: Lich Loved, Thrall to Demon
Skills: Lore 4 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Carrion Stench - Fort Save or suffer -2 penalty to all scores.
2: Touch of Fear - Cause Fear spell 3/day
4: Massive Girth/Skeletal Visage - +2 con/-2 dex or +2 dex/-2 con.

dst:
当被称为卡苏斯的残魂还作为强大的法师活着时，他在奴隶和恳求者中生育了许多子女。后来他试图从魔法之神那里窃取力量失败，摧毁了他族人的帝国，使他们流散到世界各地。因此，在一千多年里，他的血脉几乎污染了每一个人类族群，有时它变得足够强大，使一个人类能够生下一个卡赛特。当两个卡赛特交配时，他们能稳定遗传。卡赛特人整体上看起来像人类，但他们有两个显著特征。首先，每个人都有一只淡蓝色的眼睛和一只人类常见的其他颜色的眼睛。卡赛特人的头上还有一撮白发。这些特征在普通人类中很少出现，而且几乎从不同时出现。在卡赛特人只彼此交配的社群中，其他特征也变得常见，例如直的金发或黑发，明显的寡妇峰以及小巧的鼻子和嘴巴。卡赛特婴儿看起来像正常人类，但随着他们成熟，他们奇怪的外貌和力量就会出现。大多数卡赛特人在进入青春期时获得他们的天赋权利，但对某些人来说会更早或更晚。迷信的人类常常将正在显现的卡赛特人外貌变化视为祝福或诅咒的迹象，但很少有人怀疑它两者皆是。卡苏斯的血脉使成熟的卡赛特人能够抵抗非魔法打击，并将针对他施放的法咒转化为治疗魔法，但这也阻止他施放任何法咒。在人类中出生的卡赛特人可能一生都不知道他们不寻常的外貌伴随着奇妙的能力，但其他人在尝试走上施法者之路时，或在暴力使他们受到的伤害比应有的少时，会发现他们的天赋权利。卡赛特人的社群常常寻找这样的“弃儿”来灌输他们的哲学，希望壮大他们的人数并推进他们邪恶的议程。
  
卡赛特种族特性：
人类特性：卡赛特人是人类，获得人类奖励专长和额外技能点
+2 体质，+2 魅力：卡赛特人异常坚韧，他们的血脉赋予他们威严的存在感。
伤害减免：卡赛特人拥有伤害减免 5/+1。
法术抗力：卡赛特人的法术抗力等于 10 + 他的职业等级。
魔法吸取攻击（Su）：卡赛特人的近战攻击可以削弱敌人的魔法护甲，武器或盾牌。如果一个生物被卡赛特人近战击中且未通过意志豁免（DC 10 + 魅力调整值），其拥有的一件战斗导向魔法物品（护甲，盾牌或武器）将被压制 1 轮。
法咒治疗（Su）：每当卡赛特人的法术抗力阻止一个法咒影响他时，他每法术等级治疗 2 点伤害。
无法施法：卡赛特人不能施放奥术或神术，即使他们在授予施法能力的职业中升级。他们可以正常使用灵能能力和魔法物品。
擅长：卡赛特人擅长轻甲和中甲，以及军用武器。
 favored 职业：缚灵者。
等级调整：+2
src:
When the vestige called Karsus yet lived as a powerful wizard, he fathered many children among his slaves and supplicants. Then his failed attempt to steal power from the deity of magic shattered his people's empire and spread them across the world. Thus, over more than a thousand years, his bloodline has tainted nearly every human population, and at times it grows strong enough for a human to give birth to a karsite. When two karsites mate, they breed true. Karsites appear human overall, but they have two distinguishing traits. First, each has one pale blue eye and one eye of another color common to humans. A karsite also has a shock of white hair on his head. These traits appear infrequently among normal humans, and almost never at the same time. In communities where karsites mate exclusively with one another, other features also become common, such as straight blond or black hair, a sharp widow's peak, and a small nose and mouth. Karsite infants appear as normal humans, but as they mature, their strange appearances and powers appear. Most karsites gain their birthright by the time they reach puberty, but for some it comes sooner or later. Superstitious humans often view the change in an emerging karsite's appearance as a sign of a blessing or curse, but few suspect that it is both. Karsus's bloodline allows a matured karsite to resist nonmagical blows and to turn spells cast against him into healing magic, but it also prevents him from ever casting any spell. Karsites born among humans might live and die without ever knowing that their unusual appearance comes with wondrous abilities, but others discover their birthright when they attempt to take up the path of a spellcaster, or when violence leaves them less harmed than it should. Communities of karsites often seek out such �foundlings?to indoctrinate into their philosophy, hoping to swell their numbers and advance their evil agenda.
  
Karsite Racial Traits:
Human Traits: Karsites are humans, and gain the human bonus feat and extra skill point
+2 Constitution, +2 Charisma: Karsites are exceptionally hardy, and their bloodline gives them a commanding presence.
Damage Reduction: A karsite has damage reduction 5/+1.
Spell Resistance: A karsite's spell resistance equals 10 + his class levels.
Magic Draining Attacks (Su): A karsite's melee attacks can weaken a foe's magic armor, weapon, or shield. If a creature struck in melee by a karsite fails a Will save (DC 10 + Cha modifier), one of the combat-oriented magic items (armor, shield, or weapon) in its possession is suppressed for 1 round. 
Spell Healing (Su): Whenever a karsite's spell resistance prevents a spell from affecting him, he heals 2 points of damage per spell level.
Spellcasting Inability: Karsites cannot cast arcane or divine spells, even if they take levels in a class that grants spellcasting ability. They can use psionic powers and magic items normally.
Proficiencies: Karsites are proficient with light and medium armor, and with martial weapons.
Favored Class: Binder.
Level Adjustment: +2

src:
(BASE CLASS)
  The warblade was born for conflict. Swift, strong, enduring, and utterly confident in his martial skills, he seeks to test himself against worthy foes. Battle is beautiful to him - a perfect moment in which life hangs suspended on the edge of a sword. Sheer combat skill is important to a warblade, so he trains intensely with his chosen weapons. But even more important are his athleticism, endurance, daring, recklessness, and joy in the hour of danger. Warblades, often called sword princes, live for the chance to test themselves in battle - the stronger the foe, the greater the glory once an enemy is defeated.

dst:
变化系
等级：       吟游诗人 2，术士/法师 2
成分：  语言，姿势
施法时间：1 标准动作
距离：       个人
目标：   自身
持续时间：   10 分钟/等级（可解消）

你变成与你正常形态同类型的生物形态。新形态必须在你正常体型的1个体型类别之内。所采用形态的最大生命骰等于你的施法者等级，在5级时最大为5生命骰。你可以变成你自己种族的一员，甚至变成你自己。

你保留自己的能力值。你的职业和等级，生命值，阵营，基础攻击加值和基础豁免加值都保持不变。你保留正常形态的所有超自然和类法咒特殊攻击和特性，除了那些需要新形态没有的身体部位（例如喷吐武器需要嘴或凝视攻击需要眼睛）.

你保留所有来自职业等级的非凡特殊攻击和特性，但失去任何非来自职业等级的正常形态特性。

如果新形态能够说话，你可以正常交流。你保留原始形态的任何施法能力，但新形态必须能够清晰说话（即说一种语言）才能使用语言成分，并且必须有能够精细操作的分肢才能使用姿势或材料成分。

你获得新形态的物理特性，同时保留自己的心智。物理特性包括自然体型，天生防御加值，天生武器（如爪，咬等）以及任何总体物理特性（有无翅膀，肢体数量等）.有额外肢体的身体不允许你进行比正常更多的攻击（或更有利的双武器攻击）.

你不会获得任何上述物理特性中未注明的非凡特殊攻击或特殊特性，如黑暗视觉，微光视觉，盲视，盲视，快速治疗，再生，灵敏嗅觉等。

你不会获得新形态的任何超自然特殊攻击，特殊特性或类法咒能力。你的生物类型和亚种（如果有）无论新形态如何都保持不变。你不能变成任何有模板的生物形态，即使该模板不改变生物类型或亚种。

当变化发生时，你的装备（如果有）要么保持穿戴或由新形态持有（如果能够穿戴或持有该物品），要么融入新形态并变得无法使用。当你恢复真实形态时，任何先前融入新形态的物品会重新出现在你身体上它们先前占据的相同位置，并再次可用。你在所采用形态中穿戴但在正常形态中不能穿戴的任何新物品会脱落并落在你脚下；任何你在两种形态中都能穿戴或在恢复时两种形态共有的身体部位携带的物品仍以相同方式持有。任何与整体分离的身体部位或装备部分恢复其真实形态。
src:
Transmutation
Level:        Brd 2, Sor/Wiz 2
Components:   V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range:        Personal
Target:    You
Duration:    10 min./level (D)

You assume the form of a creature of the same type as your normal form. The new form must be within one size category of your normal size. The maximum HD of an assumed form is equal to your caster level, to a maximum of 5 HD at 5th level. You can change into a member of your own kind or even into yourself.

You retain your own ability scores. Your class and level, hit points, alignment, base attack bonus, and base save bonuses all remain the same. You retain all supernatural and spell-like special attacks and qualities of your normal form, except for those requiring a body part that the new form does not have (such as a mouth for a breath weapon or eyes for a gaze attack).

You keep all extraordinary special attacks and qualities derived from class levels, but you lose any from your normal form that are not derived from class levels.

If the new form is capable of speech, you can communicate normally. You retain any spellcasting ability you had in your original form, but the new form must be able to speak intelligibly (that is, speak a language) to use verbal components and must have limbs capable of fine manipulation to use somatic or material components.

You acquire the physical qualities of the new form while retaining your own mind. Physical qualities include natural size, natural armor bonus, natural weapons (such as claws, bite, and so on), and any gross physical qualities (presence or absence of wings, number of extremities, and so forth). A body with extra limbs does not allow you to make more attacks (or more advantageous two-weapon attacks) than normal.

You do not gain any extraordinary special attacks or special qualities not noted above under physical qualities, such as darkvision, low-light vision, blindsense, blindsight, fast healing, regeneration, scent, and so forth.

You do not gain any supernatural special attacks, special qualities, or spell-like abilities of the new form. Your creature type and subtype (if any) remain the same regardless of your new form. You cannot take the form of any creature with a template, even if that template doesn't change the creature type or subtype.

When the change occurs, your equipment, if any, either remains worn or held by the new form (if it is capable of wearing or holding the item), or melds into the new form and becomes nonfunctional. When you revert to your true form, any objects previously melded into the new form reappear in the same location on your body they previously occupied and are once again functional. Any new items you wore in the assumed form and can't wear in your normal form fall off and land at your feet; any that you could wear in either form or carry in a body part common to both forms at the time of reversion are still held in the same way. Any part of the body or piece of equipment that is separated from the whole reverts to its true form.

烟雾形态：你可以随意变成烟雾云形态，如同气化形体法咒。你可以作为一个标准动作压制或激活此能力。一旦你从烟雾形态返回正常形态，5轮内不能再次使用。

无声而确定：你在躲藏和潜行检定上获得+16能力加值。
src:
Marchosias, King of Killers
    
A legendary assassin in life, Marchosias now grants his summoners his supernatural charm, plus the ability to kill or paralyze with one startling attack and to disappear in a puff of smoke.
  
Vestige Level: 7th
Binding DC: 30
Special Requirement: No
  
Influence: Marchosias's influence makes you debonair and sly, as though you have some trick up your sleeve and the knowledge of it makes you confident. In addition, Marchosias requires that you use the death attack he grants you against any foe you catch unawares.
  
Granted Abilities: 
Marchosias gives you an assassin's skill at killing, plus the ability to assume gaseous form and the power to charm foes.

Death Attack: If you have sneak attack, you gain the Death Attack ability, as per the assassin class.

Fiery Retribution: You deal an extra 3d6 points of fire damage when you strike an opponent who can deal extra damage through a sneak attack, sudden strike, or skirmish attack. This extra damage applies to ranged attacks only if the opponent is within 30 feet.

Smoke Form: You can assume the form of a smoke cloud at will, like the gaseous form spell. You can suppress or activate this ability as a standard action. Once you have returned to your normal form from smoke form, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Silent and Sure: You gain a +16 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.

dst: 我在商业区遇到一个憎恨矮人的人。为了表达他对这个种族的敌意，他雇我进入经营这里铁匠铺的钢塑矮人的家，砸碎他们家中六件家具。他给了我一把钥匙，应该能让我轻松进入，通过铁匠铺附近一个通往他们地下住所的活板门，但他警告我那里有一个土元素守卫，我需要击败它或偷偷绕过。他承诺完成任务后给我100金币，外加我能在里面找到的任何战利品。
src: I met a man in the Merchant District who hates dwarves. To express his antagonism towards the race, he has hired me to enter the home of the Steelshaper dwarves who run the smithy here and smash to pieces half a dozen pieces of furniture in their home. He has given me a key that should make it easy to get in, through a trap door near the smithy that leads to their subterranean home, but has warned me of an Earth Elemental guarding the place that I will need to either defeat or sneak past. He has promised me 100 gold when I complete this task, plus anything I can find to loot within.

The nathri are a crude and savage race native to the ethereal plane, living in hunting packs that hunt intruders to their realm.  Rumors say they sprung from the deep ethereal itself.  Physically they are small, standing around 4' tall, with green skin and dark unruly hair.  They have wide faces with flat noses and long pointed ears.  The only clothing they wear is that scavenged from their victims, with many pouches and bags for their few possessions.

Nathri Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass nathri's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
- +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
- +1 size bonus to AC.
- +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- 20' base speed
- Darkvision: Nathri are able to see in the dark.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 5 + 1 per character level.
- Spell-like Abilities: 3/day - Expeditious Retreat.
- Outsider: Nathri count as Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

Descriptors: Evil, necrocarnum
Classes: Incarnate, soulborn
Chakra: Hands

Shadowy threads of necrocarnum bind to your melee weapon. This dark energy seems to ripple beneath the surface of the weapon, pulsing irregularly from your hands to the tip of the weapon and back again.

（进阶职业）
矮人战狂，或称库尔德贾格（斧头白痴），是传说中的狂战士，能通过仪式性的歌唱进入战斗狂怒。

据信他们曾受矮人战神触碰，战神教导他们，战死沙场将作为公正的奖赏，让他们以更强大的姿态回归。因此，这些战士无惧死亡。

战狂在矮人社会中赢得勉强（且恐惧）的尊重，并被认为创造了诸如“头朝前！”和“会动就杀！”等哲学复杂的矮人格言。

大多数战狂过着短暂而荣耀的一生。

- 生命骰：d12。
- 武器防具擅长：战狂不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

职业特性：狂暴
阵营：任意非守序
种族：矮人
专长：顺势斩，坚忍，猛力攻击
基础攻击加值：+5
技能：威吓（8级），学识（2级），表演（2级）

职业特性：

等级
1：战斗狂怒 - 每日1次（如野蛮人狂暴）.
   抗毒 - 对毒素的所有强韧豁免检定获得+4加值。
   专长 - 技能专攻：威吓 - 所有涉及威吓的技能检定获得+3加值。
2：勇气光环 - 战狂免疫恐惧。
   专长 - 精通绊摔。
3：战斗狂怒 - 每日2次。
   专长 - 精通徒手击打。
4：专长 - 大顺势斩。
   专长 - 献身攻击。
5：战斗狂怒 - 每日3次。
   天生防御 - 战狂的皮肤硬化，天生防御获得+2加值。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Dwarven Battleragers, or Kuldjargh (Axe Idiots), are legendary berserkers who can enter a battle frenzy through ritualistic singing.

They are believed to have been touched by the dwarven gods of war, who taught them that by dying in battle they will return even stronger than before as a just reward. As a consequence, these warriors have no fear of death.

Battleragers command a grudging (if fearful) respect within dwarven society and are credited with having coined such philosophically complex dwarven maxims as "Head first!" and "If it moves, kill it!"

Most Battleragers live short, glorious lives.

- Hit Die: d12.
- Proficiencies: A Battlerager does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Class Feature: Rage
Alignment: Any non-lawful
Race: Dwarven
Feats: Cleave, Endurance, Power Attack
Base Attack Bonus: +5
Skills: Intimidate (8 ranks), Lore (2 ranks), Perform (2 ranks)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Battle Rage - 1/day (as per Barbarian Rage).
   Resist Poison - Bestows a +4 bonus to all Fortitude saving throws vs. poison.
   Feat - Skill Focus: Intimidate - Provides a +3 bonus to all skill checks involving Intimidate.
2: Aura of Courage - The Battlerager becomes immune to fear.
   Feat - Improved Trip.
3: Battle Rage - 2/day.
   Feat - Improved Unarmed Strike.
4: Feat - Great Cleave.
   Feat - Reckless Offense.
5: Battle Rage - 3/day.
   Natural Armor - The Battlerager's skin hardens, granting a +2 bonus to natural AC.

But in Kara-Tur exotic weapons and fighting styles are common, so it is not surprising that it would produce kamas displaying masterful craftsmanship and powerful enchantments, as this one does. Nor is it too surprising to find weapons from all over the globe in a huge and bustling port city.

dst: 当我最近从死亡中归来时，那个在这种场合迎接我的神秘实体要求我提供额外的服务。显然，恶魔阿兹古尔卡的爪牙正在入侵气元素位面，试图获取某种强大的魔法物品，而那个实体希望我协助对抗他们。这些敌人来自一个火焰传送门，我要用“风之力”战斗并关闭它（我猜这意味着我要对传送门施放“造风术”，因为那个实体还给了我一件可以释放这个法术的物品）。\n\n那个实体已经将我传送到了战斗现场，我成功关闭了火焰传送门，从而完成了这里最重要的任务。我可能还想调查那个被争夺的奇怪魔法宝珠。
src: When I was recently returned from death, the mysterious entity that greets me on such occasions asked for an additional service from me. Apparently minions of the demon Azghulkar are invading the Plane of Air, seeking to acquire some powerful magical object, and the entity wants me to assist in fighting them. These enemies are coming from a fiery portal that I am to fight to and close with "the power of the wind" (which I assume means that I am to cast a "Gust of Wind" spell on the portal, since the entity also gave me an item that can unleash this spell). \n\nThe entity has transported me to the scene of the battle, and I was able to close the flaming portal, thereby accomplishing my most important task here. I may still want to investigate the strange magical orb that was being fought over.

src:
Type of Feat: Metapsionic
Prerequisites: None
Specifics: To use this feat you must expend your psionic focus. You can chain any power that affects a single target and deals either acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic damage. After the primary target is struck, the power can arc to a number of secondary targets equal to your manifester level (maximum twenty). The secondary arcs each strike one target and deal half as much damage as the primary one did (round down). Each target gets to make a saving throw, if one is allowed by the power, You choose secondary targets as you like, but they must all be within 30 feet of the primary target, and no target can be struck more than once. You can choose to affect fewer secondary targets than the maximum (to avoid allies in the area, for example).
Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 6. The power's total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.
Use: Selected

dst: 我正在探索的废墟大厅中，游荡着一些曾守卫此地的矮人战士的幽灵。据其中一个幽灵说，这是因为他们的尸体被焚烧，而没有按照矮人的习俗妥善埋葬于地下。这个幽灵请求我收集他们遗体仅存的几块骨头，并将每一副骨头放入我能在此区域北部、离我最初入口不远处的一个下层房间中找到的每一口棺材里。这显然是让幽灵永久安息的唯一方法。他警告我说这可能很危险，因为其他幽灵已经疯狂到危险的程度，并拥有诡异的幽灵力量。不过，既然我无论如何都要探索这个区域，沿途处理这件事也许并不困难。
src: The ruined halls I am exploring are haunted by ghosts of some of the dwarven warriors who once defended them. According to one of the ghosts, this is because their bodies were burned rather than being properly buried in the earth as dwarves should be. This ghost has asked me to collect the few bones that are all that remain of their bodies and place a set of bones in each of the coffins I can find in a lower chamber in the north of this area, not far from my initial entry point. This is apparently the only way the ghosts can be put permanently to rest. He warned me that this might be dangerous, since the other ghosts are dangerously insane and possesed of uncanny ghostly powers. Since I am going to be exploring this area anyway, though, it might not be difficult to attend to this along the way.

dst: "我对这件事一无所知。我当时在外面做另一份活儿……也就是说，那本书被拿走的时候，我正在这里自己的房间里安安静静地睡觉。关于这件事我就说这么多。你要是不信，那也没办法。现在除非你想打架，否则你最好离开这里。"
src: "I don't know anything about this. I was out working another job...that is, I was sleeping peacefully in my own room here when that book was taken. That's all I'm going to say on the subject. If you don't believe me, tough. Now unless you're looking for a fight, you'd best get out of here."

dst:
学徒，夜之长指 
等级/学派：3级/变化系 
范围：个人 
目标：你 
持续时间：1分钟/等级

你的手变成漆黑，似乎闪烁不定，因为微小的阴影缕缕不断从你的手指间泄漏并消失。

在此秘术持续期间，你可以作为一个标准动作，对中距（100英尺 + 10英尺/等级）内的任何敌人进行特殊攻击。你必须对目标有视线。你可以进行以下特殊攻击之一：冲撞，卸除武器或绊摔。为了裁定这些攻击，如有必要，正常进行你的接触攻击。然而，在实际解决对抗掷骰时，用你的施法者等级代替你的基础攻击加值，并用你的智力或魅力调整值（你的选择）代替你的力量。因为攻击是在远处进行的，它不会引起正常情况下此类攻击会引起的借机攻击，你的敌人也不能反过来对你执行同样的招式，即使通常允许如此。

你将在你的职业径向菜单中获得一个专长，允许你进行这些攻击。
src:
Apprentice, Night's Long Fingers 
Level/School: 3rd/Transmutation 
Range: Personal 
Target: You 
Duration: 1 minutes/level

Your hand turns jet black and seems to flicker as tiny wisps of shadow constantly leak from between your fingers and disappear.

For the duration of this mystery, you can, as a standard action, make a special attack against any foe within medium range (100 ft. + 10 ft./level). You must have line of sight to the target. You can make any one of the following special attacks: bull rush, disarm, or trip. For purposes of adjudicating these attacks, make your touch attack as normal, if one is necessary. When actually  resolving the opposed roll, however, substitute your caster level for your base attack bonus and either your Intelligence or Charisma modifier (your choice) for your Strength. Because the attack is made at a distance, it does not draw an attack of opportunity that such an attack would draw under normal circumstances, nor can your foe attempt to perform the same maneuver on you in turn, even if such is normally allowed.

You will be given a feat on your class radial to allow you to make these attacks.

src: Beneath the House of Tears, a Temple of Ilmater in Zazesspur, I encountered one Nierva Var'cheza, a Paladin of Ilmater who is standing guard against a menace originating in the underdark caverns below the city. There she found a dark barrier of negative energy that is expanding and transforming creatures of the Underdark into Undead monstosities. She has determined that penetrating this barrier to reach the presumed source of this evil beyond it will require a Rogue Stone, a rare gem often used in teleportation magics. If I come across a Rogue Stone in the course of my adventures, it might be a good idea to bring it to her.\n\nI brought Nierva a Rogue Stone. Now possessed of the ability to penetrate the dark barrier she described, she has asked me accompany her and aid her against whatever evil lies beyond.

施法者创造一个略微凹陷的圆形力场平面，它会跟随施法者并承载放置其上的物品。该圆盘每施法者等级可承载100磅重量（若用于运输液体，容量为2加仑）.圆盘始终漂浮在离地约3英尺，施法者身后5英尺处，并保持水平。在楼梯或其他情况下可进行一些调整（施法者需集中精神指挥圆盘），但圆盘将保持水平且无法改变大小，因此狭窄陡峭的竖井可能无法通过圆盘。

当法咒持续时间结束时，圆盘将消失，所有物品返回施法者物品栏。圆盘每轮移动30英尺，若施法者离开圆盘超过法咒最大距离，法咒也会结束。施法者需确保法咒有稳定的路径，因为若圆盘下方地面突然消失，圆盘将消失。

src:
Evocation [Force] 
Level: Sor/Wiz 1
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Close (25' + 5'/2 levels)
Effect: 3 foot diameter disk of force
Duration: 1 hour per caster level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

The caster creates a slightly concave circular plane of force that will follow him carrying what is placed upon it. The disk can hold 100 pounds of weight per caster level (if used to transport a liquid, the capacity is 2 gallons). The disk floats approximately 3 feet above the ground and 5 feet behind the caster at all times and remains level. Some adjustment can occur due to stairs or other consideration (concentration necessary for caster to direct disk), but the disk will remain level and cannot change in size, so that tight steep shaft might not be accessibly by the disk.

The disk will wink out of existence when the spell duration expires, returning all items to casters inventory. The disk moves at 30 feet per round, and the spell also ends if the caster moves away from the disk further than the maximum range of the spell. The caster needs to assure a stable path for the spell, as the disk will wink out if the floor suddenly drops away beneath it.

Material Component: A drop of mercury.

我得到警告，贫民区东北部的一栋房子据说被危险的幽灵所萦绕，那些进入这座古老破败建筑的人有时再也无法出来。这似乎是一个需要提防的危险，或者，对于像我这样的冒险追寻者来说，也许是一个机会。

我进入了这栋房子，到达二楼后，被困在了一个幻象迷宫中——据我与之交谈的一个幽灵所说。要逃脱，我必须在我进入任何门后随机被传送到的某个房间里找到一个界门，并在受益于真知术效果的情况下进入它。要施放这样的法咒，我应该寻找某种魔法神器的四块碎片，并找到一个有铁砧的房间，在那里我可以将它们组装起来。

我已经通过界门逃脱，最初将我困在那个幻象迷宫中的强大幽灵也已被击败。我只需与协助我的幽灵交谈，并找到这里可能散落的任何宝藏，即可完成此事。
src:
I have been warned that a house in the northeast of the Slums district is believed to be haunted by dangerous spirits, and that those who enter this old and decrepit structure sometimes fail to come out again. This would seem a danger to beware, or perhaps, for seekers of adventure such as myself, an opportunity.

I have entered the house, and upon reaching the second floor have become trapped in what according to a ghost I talked to is a maze of illusions. To escape, I must find a portal in one of the rooms to which I am randomly transported upon entering any door and enter it while benefitting from the effects of a True Seeing spell. To cast such a spell, I should look for four fragments of some kind of magical artifact, and find a room with an anvil in which I can assemble them.

I have escaped through the portal, and the mighty spectre who entrapped me within that maze of illusions to begin with has been defeated. I need only speak with the ghost who assisted me, and find whatever treasures may be lying about here, to complete this matter.

dst:
萨曼·瓦拉迪告诉我，如果我想找活干，就应该去找一个叫纳马尔·萨拉坎的人，他是“闪耀探寻者”号的船长，目前可以在码头区找到他。这位萨拉坎船长显然想找一位冒险者帮忙调查他发现的一件神秘神器。萨曼已经向他提过我可能是合适的人选，所以他应该准备好在我提出愿意帮忙时接受我的协助。

我已经和萨拉坎船长谈过，并了解了一些他交给我的任务。他找到了一种魔法手段，可以创造一道通往某处水下废墟的界门，并希望我帮忙探索那里。我和任何穿过界门（或之后被召唤）的同伴都会获得防溺水的魔法保护。这种保护会持续四个小时，而且在完成任务之前我不应该从界门返回，因为那会打断法咒。在水下行动会让我变慢并降低攻击效果，阻止使用远程武器，并使任何涉及火焰的法咒效果有限（最多如此）。我只要准备好就可以直接进入界门。当我穿过时，必要的法咒会自动施放。

不幸的是，在有限的时间内，我未能找到任何能满足萨拉坎船长要求的东西，因此无法领取奖励。至少这个任务是一次有趣的经历，即使它以失败告终。
src:
Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.

I have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should simply enter the portal whenever I am ready. The necessary spells will be automatically cast as I go through.

Unfortunately I was unable to locate anything that would meet Captain Sarakan's requirements in the limited time available, and so will not be able to claim the reward. At least this quest was an interesting experience, even if it ended in failure.

dst: 夺心魔，又称灵吸怪，是一支拥有强大灵能的心灵感应异怪种族。他们与其他物种打交道时，完全没有任何道德顾忌，只把对方视为可供利用的资源。他们那令人不安的习惯——要么用心灵感应奴役任何不幸遭遇他们的人，要么吃掉对方的大脑——使他们几乎被所有人恐惧和憎恨，甚至包括幽暗地域中那些通常同样冷酷无情的居民。夺心魔长老是异常强大的夺心魔，构成了灵吸怪社会的贵族阶层。
src: Mindflayers, also known as illithids, are a race of telepathic aberrations possessed of formidable psionic powers. Their dealings with members of other species, who they see purely as resources to be exploited, are marked by a complete lack of any sort of moral scruple. Their disturbing habit of either telepathically enslaving or eating the brains of anyone unfortunate enough to encounter them has made them almost universally feared and hated, even by most other denizens of the routinely ruthless Underdark. Ulitharids are exceptionally powerful mindflayers, and form the nobility of illithid society.

银龙以化为人形并生活在人类中而闻名。很久以前，人类社区欢迎银龙进入他们的家园，不知道这些伪装访客的本性。在这些通常与世隔绝的小社区中，半龙孩子变得常见，因为龙与人类朋友结婚。银龙尽力保护这些孩子不被发现，最终教会他们用魔法变成完全的人类形态，因此人类与银龙的血统混合继续下去。随着时间推移，龙族特征消失了，龙也离开了，留下了具有龙血遗产的人类社区。由于这些后代头发中显示出白色条纹或挑染，他们被称为银眉人类。在生理上，他们与普通人类无法区分。

src:
Silver dragons are well known for taking humanoid form and living among them.  Long ago, communities of humans welcomed silver dragons into their homes, not knowing the nature of their disguised visitors.  In these communities, often secluded and small, half-dragon children became common as the dragons married their human friends.  The silvers did their best to protect these children form discovery, eventually teaching them to assume full human form magically, and thus the mingling of human and silver dragon blood continued.  Over time, the draconic features disappeared, and the dragons moved on as well, leaving communities of humans with dragonblood heritage.  They came to be known as Silverbrow humans due to the white streaks or highlights displayed in the hair of these descendants.  Physically they are otherwise indistinguishable from normal humans.

Silverbrow Human Ability Adjustments: None
Favored Class (Any): A multiclass silverbrow human's highest class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Quick To Master: Silverbrow Humans gain a bonus feat at first level.
- Dragonblooded: Silverbrow Humans have the dragonblood subtype.
- Human: Silverbrow Humans count as Human for the purpose of spells.

src:
These dragonets are known for their habit of following ships in order to feed on the fish disturbed by the vessel's passing, much like sea gulls. Sailors sometimes call them crow's nest dragons, since they tend to swoop around the crow's nest of a ship and sometimes perch on it. In Sharn, they build their nests on the very tops of the city's towers, giving them their local name. They are often encountered as companions or familiars.  A spiretop dragon is about 18 inches long, with an additional 18 inches of tail. Its wingspan is about 3 feet, and it weighs about 2 pounds.

Spiretop Dragon Ability Adjustments: -4 Str, +8 Dex, +2 Con, -4 Int, -2 Cha.  Spiretop Dragons are quick in action but fairly dim.

Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass spiretop dragon's rogue class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- A spiretop dragon's base land speed is 10 feet and they also have a fly speed of 60.
- Dragon: Spiretop dragons are dragons and thus are not subject to sleep and paralysis effects.
- Tiny: As tiny creatures, spiretop dragons have a +2 bonus to Armor Class, a +2 bonus on attack rolls, and a +8 bonus on Hide checks.
- Breath Weapon: A spiretop dragon can exhale a Fog Cloud as if cast by a 3rd level sorcerer.  The spiretop dragon must wait 1d4 rounds between uses of this breath weapon. 
- Natural Armor: Spiretop dragons receive a +2 natural armor bonus due to their hard scales.
- Evasion: If a spiretop dragon is exposed to any effect that normally allows it to attempt a Reflex saving throw for half damage, it takes no damage with a successful saving throw.
- Bite Attack: A spire dragon can inflict a nasty (1d3) bite for their size.

Level Adjustment: +2
Racial Hit Dice: 2 levels of dragon

src: A monk from the Order of the Long Death named Laguron can be found not far from Nashkel on the north side of the Cloudpeaks, and might be sought out to collect the 20000 gold bounty on his head (he is apparently wanted for murder). However. Laguron has protected himself with wards that apparently prevent anyone from approaching him if carrying weapons, and reputedly has other protections that would be difficult to overcome without the talents of a monk. Apparently he seeks to challenge other monks to single combat in a test of worthiness, and to this end has contrived to make it difficult for anyone other than monks to reach him. If I wish to face whatever tests he has set up, I could try to collect this bounty.\n\nLaguron has been slain. I can bring his head to Oublek to collect the bounty.

（进阶职业）
每个眼魔都相信自身代表着一种真正的完美状态。在堕落城市的绝望流浪者和地下幽暗地域的堕落探索者中，可以找到一些同意这一观点的人形生物，他们与眼魔种族达成了一项手术契约，试图获得哪怕一丝那样的完美。

这些所谓的眼魔侍者，被自己的社会所抛弃，已宣誓效忠于一个或多个眼暴君，并将自己的宗教虔诚奉献给被称为伟大母亲的外来实体，即所有眼魔的神祇母亲。

- 生命骰：d6。
- 武器和防具擅长：眼魔侍者不会获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

需求：

阵营：守序邪恶或中立邪恶
技能：专注 8 级
专长：坚忍
基础豁免加值：强韧 +4

职业特性：

等级
1：魅惑人类射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
2：睡眠射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
3：造成中度伤射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
4：缓慢射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
5：恐惧射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
6：魅惑怪物射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
7：心灵遥控射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
8：石化射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
9：解离射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.
10：死亡一指射线 - 2/天（类法术能力）.

施法：眼魔侍者如同同等职业等级的牧师一样知晓法咒并拥有每日法咒位，但他不能自发施放治疗或造成伤害法术。他从以下列表中获得两个领域：邪恶，仇恨，力量或暴政。如果他未选择这些领域，他将无法在此职业中升级。这些领域不会与从牧师职业获得的领域叠加。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Each beholder believes that it represents a state of true perfection. Among the desperate wastrels of decadent cities and debased explorers of the subterranean Underdark can be found humanoids who agree, and who have entered into a surgical pact with the beholder race in an attempt to achieve even a sliver of that perfection.

These so-called Ocular Adepts, outcasts to their own societies, have pledged their services to one or more eye tyrants and pledged their religious devotion to the alien entity known as the Great Mother, the deity matron of all beholders.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: An Ocular Adept does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Lawful Evil or Neutral Evil
Skills: Concentration 8 ranks
Feats: Endurance
Base Save Bonus: Fort +4

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Charm Person Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
2: Sleep Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
3: Inflict Moderate Wounds Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
4: Slow Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
5: Fear Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
6: Charm Monster Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
7: Telekinesis Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
8: Flesh to Stone Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
9: Disintegrate Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
10: Finger of Death Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).

Spellcasting: The Ocular Adept knows spells and has spells per day as if he was a cleric of equivalent class level, except that he cannot spontaneously cast Cure or Inflict spells. He gains two domains from the following list: Evil, Hatred, Strength, or Tyranny. If he does not select these domains, he will not be able to level in this class. These domains will not stack with those gained from the Cleric class.

src: Zarala reads out: "If you would pass beyond the gate before you, you must prove that you are a friend who knows of these halls. If you are, you will know of the four golems, of iron, stone, bone and clay, who once guarded them. Each golem occupied a certain position in the defensive line, fought with a particular weapon different from the others, and was infused with a particular spell, different from the others, to unleash upon intruders. If each golem is put in his proper position, with the correct weapon and spell, the gate can be opened by the lever."

dst: "当然，即使是龙的宝库大概也不会有750000金币那么多，但加上你平时搜刮所得，应该有望凑够。说到筹钱，纳什克尔这里还有个人你大概想谈谈。他叫奥布莱克。他负责处理赏金。他可以告诉你关于那条龙的悬赏。如果你想多赚些金币，他很可能还有其他赏金任务可提供。你大概能在驻军塔楼附近找到他。等你解决了那条龙，可以再来找我，我们就能启动我的计划了。说真的，即使你有金币，先对付一些较小的威胁，也许还能获得一些有用的装备，并练习与强大敌人战斗，可能也是个好主意。"
src: "Of course even a dragon's hoard probably doesn't have as much as 750000 gold in it, but on top of what you make from your normal looting it should hopefully provide enough. On the subject of raising funds, there's also a guy here in Nashkel you probably want to talk to. Name's Oublek. He handles bounties. He can tell you about the bounty on the dragon. Quite possibly he will have some other bounties to offer if you want to make some additional gold. You can probably find him somewhere near the tower housing the garrison. Once you have dealt with the dragon you can talk to me again and we can set my plan in motion. Really, even if you had the gold it might have been a good idea to deal with some lesser threats first, and perhaps acquire some useful gear and get in practice for fighting powerful enemies."

dst:
在探索卡林港地下的废墟时，我从一只恐蛛手中救下了一个不寻常的半兽人，名叫赫兰加拉克。这个赫兰加拉克是海姆的牧师，看起来直到最近，他的部落“血刃”一直崇拜这位神祇，并试图避免像半兽人通常那样与其他种族交战。然而最近部落的领导层发生了变化，前任领袖冈克鲁泽尔公主被驱逐，并被卖给了一个邪教，他们需要拥有皇室血统的人进行某种奇怪的仪式献祭。新领袖是格鲁扎尔，他试图恢复对格乌什的崇拜，并与鼠人结盟对抗卡林港的人类。赫兰加拉克希望我与他联手救出冈克鲁泽尔，并让她重新领导部落，挫败这个计划。

我同意了赫兰加拉克的计划。拯救公主是冒险者的经典任务，即使老故事里的公主通常不是半兽人。与赫兰加拉克一起，我应该向西前往血刃镇，然后向南找到邪教巢穴。

我们已经找到并救出了冈克鲁泽尔，并处理了邪教徒，他们不再构成威胁。我们还杀死了格鲁扎尔，让冈克鲁泽尔重新成为她人民的领袖。任务完成。与这些半兽人的现任领袖成为朋友后，如果愿意，我可以将他们的城镇作为休息或交易的地方。
src:
While exploring the subterranean ruins beneath Calimport, I rescued from a dire spider an unusual orc named Hrangarak. This Hrangarak is a cleric of Helm, and it seems that until recently his tribe, the Bloody Blades, was worshiping this deity and seeking to avoid warring with other races as is typical of orcs. Recently however the tribe has had a change of leadership, with their former leader Princess Gunkruzelle being ousted and sold to a cult who needed someone with royal blood for some sort of strange ritual sacrifice. Its new leader is Gruzhaur, who seeks to restore worship of Gruumsh and form an alliance with the wererats against the humans of Calimport. Hrangarak wants me to join with him to rescue Gunkruzelle and restore her to leadership of the tribe, frustrating this plan.

I have agreed to Hrangarak's plan. Rescuing a princess is a classic quest for adventurers, even if the princess is not usually an orc in the old stories. Together with Hrangarak, I should head west towards the Bloody Blades town, but then head south to find the Cultist's Lair.

We have found and rescued Gunkruzelle, and dealt with the cultists, who will no longer be any threat. We have also slain Gruzhaur, restoring Gunkruzelle as leader of her people. Mission accomplished. Having befriended the current leaders of these orcs, I can use their town as a place to rest or trade, if I wish.

具体效果：在战斗中，你抛开战斗的混乱，达到一种专注状态，使你获得对战斗的敏锐，清晰的画面。当你只专注于击败敌人时，恐惧和痛苦逐渐消退。在遭遇战中第一次成功攻击时，你获得你的战斗专注。在这种状态下，你的身心合一，使你能够克服平凡的生理极限。你可以在进入战斗专注后维持10轮，每拥有一个除本专长外的战斗形态专长则额外+1轮。每次遭遇你只能获得一次战斗专注。当你维持战斗专注时，你在意志豁免上获得+2加值。如果你有三个或更多战斗形态专长，此加值增加至+4。
使用：自动。
特殊：战士可以选择战斗专注作为其战士奖励专长之一。
src:
Type of Feat: Combat Form, Fighter Bonus Feat.

The way of the warrior requires more than simple, brute strength. Some warriors bring their minds to such keen focus during the heat of battle that they can attain superhuman levels of endurance, perception, and mental toughness. Through intense mental exercise and training, you learn to enter a state of perfect martial clarity.

Prerequisite: WIS 13
Specifics: In battle, you push aside the chaos of the fight and attain a focused state that grants you a keen, clear picture of the battle. Fear and pain ebb away as you focus solely on defeating your enemy. The first time you make a successful attack during an encounter, you gain your combat focus. In this state, your mind and body become one, allowing you to overcome mundane physical limits. You can maintain your combat focus for 10 rounds after entering it, +1 additional round per combat form feat you possess aside from this one. You can only gain your combat focus once per encounter. While you are maintaining your combat focus, you gain a +2 bonus on Will saves. If you have three or more combat form feats, this bonus increases to +4.
Use: Automatic.
Special: A fighter can select Combat Focus as one of his fighter bonus feats.

商人特隆·兰纳告诉我们，附近有一座废弃的采矿村庄，位于他营地东北方，沿商贸之路即可找到，据称闹鬼，村民都在最近的內战中惨遭屠杀。结果那地方并非真的闹鬼，而是一群食人魔和兽人的藏身处。显然是首领的食人魔法师制造出幽灵幻象，以吓退不速之客。我们决定清除这群危险的人形生物，这既有收益，也有益于该地区，于是继续深入废弃矿坑，却触发了某种魔法陷阱，被传送到了这片矿坑与洞穴地下网络的更下层。

我们与一个叫科尔佐布的兽人食人魔会合，他曾是占据这座矿坑的人形生物团伙的一员，但与团伙首领——名叫奥布格隆的食人魔法师——发生了争执。他告诉我们，要逃离这个陷阱进入真正的矿坑，必须往南走，然后往东北，再往上，然后往西。通往上方真正矿坑的门就隐藏在这条路线的尽头，需要仔细搜寻。
 
要继续前进面对奥布格隆，我们需要通过他设置的传送陷阱。据科尔佐布说，办法是在奥布格隆最初找到各种装置和奥术知识以设置陷阱的同一处废墟中，找到一根魔法金杖。要找到这处废墟——显然曾是夺心魔的据点，如今已被他们遗弃并被亡灵占据——我们应该前往矿坑最底层，然后穿过一堵隔开怪物横行洞穴网络的墙门，往东北走到一条向下的路，再往西。科尔佐布相信我们需要的物品就在其中某处，一旦拿到它，我们就能去对付奥布格隆。我不确定这位新盟友能信任到什么程度，但似乎我们有共同的敌人，而且我也没有比他更好的计划，所以目前我们会合作。
src:
The merchant trader Teron Lanner has told us of a nearby ruined mining village, found northeast of his camp along the Trade Way, and allegedly haunted by its inhabitants who were slaughtered in the recent civil wars. It turns out that the place is not actually haunted, but a hideout for a band of ogres and orcs. The ogre mage who is apparently their leader maintains illusions of ghosts to deter unwanted visitors. Deciding it would be both profitable and helpful to the region to clear out this dangerous group of humanoids, we proceeded to advance into the ruined mine, only to trigger some sort of magical trap that has teleported us to some lower section of this underground network of mines and caves.

We have joined up with one Korzob, an ogrillon who was part of the humanoid band occupying this mine, but who had a disagreement with the band's leader, an ogre mage named Obgron. He has told us that to escape this trap into the mine proper we must go down to the south, then northeast, up again, and then west. The door up and into the mine proper is concealed at the end of this route and will need to be searched out.
 
To then go on and face Obgron, we will need to get past the teleportation traps set up by him. According to Korzob, the way to do this is to find a magical golden rod in the same ruins where Obgron found the various devices and arcane knowledge required to set up his various traps in the first place. To find this ruin, apparently once an Illithid stronghold but now abandoned by them and taken over by undead, we should head to the lowest level of the mines, then past a gate walling off a network of monster-infested caves, head northeast to a path down, and then west. Korzob believes the item we need can be found somewhere within, and once we posses it we can go after Obgron. I am not certain how far our new ally can be trusted, but it seems we have a common enemy, and I have no better plan than his to follow, so for now we will work together.

src:

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round/level
Power Points: 15

You make lightning-fast deductions based on only the slightest clue, pattern, or scrap of memory resident in your mind. You can make reasonable statements about a person, place, or object, seemingly from very little knowledge. However, your knowledge is in fact the result of a rigorously logical process that you force your mind to undertake, digging up and correlating every possible piece of knowledge bearing on the topic (possibly even extracting echoes of knowledge from the Astral Plane).

dst: 我遇到了法师伊纳尔·梅卡赞，他告诉我他得知了一种咒语，可以将我们传送到伟大的巫师扎塔罗斯曾经居住过的一处失落已久的避难所。这样的地方肯定充满了魔法宝藏，但伊纳尔发现获取它们会有一些困难。首先，打破入口处的结界需要同时施放一个破除法咒和一个解除魔法。因此伊纳尔认为有必要招募第二个施法者，也就是我。其次，这个地方据说有守卫魔像保护。伊纳尔是个学者，几乎没有战斗魔法经验，因此也希望我为他清除这些魔像，以及我可能遇到的任何其他危险。作为报酬，我可以优先挑选在里面找到的任何宝藏，伊纳尔只想要扎塔罗斯关于魔法研究的笔记和文件，我应该把它们带给他。\n\n伊纳尔用魔法把我们传送到了扎塔罗斯的这个隐秘避难所。我现在已经探索了这个地方，我相信已经清除了危险，也找到了一些扎塔罗斯的笔记和文件。然而，当我把它们带给伊纳尔时，他攻击了我！原来他想把这里的所有宝藏都据为己有，而我只是一个被带来做获取宝藏苦工的傻瓜。不过，我笑到了最后，因为我击败并杀死了他。
src: I have met the mage Ynal Mekazhan, who tells me that he has learned of an incantation that can teleport us to a long-lost refuge once occupied by the great wizard Zataroth. Such a place is sure to be full of magical treasures, but Ynal has discovered that there will be some difficulties to obtaining them. Firstly, breaking the wards on the entrance requires the simultaneous casting of both a breach spell and one dispelling magic. Therefore Ynal has found it necessary to recruit a second spellcaster, myself. Secondly, the place is supposed to be protected by guardian golems. Ynal is a scholar with little experience of battle magic and thus also wants me to clear these out out for him, along with any other hazards I might encounter. As a reward, I will get first pick of any treasures I find within, Ynal wants only Zataroth's notes and papers on magical research, which I should bring to him.\n\nYnal has magically transported us to this hidden refuge of Zataroth. I have now explored the place and I believe cleared it of dangers, as well as locating some of Zataroth's notes and papers. However, when I brought them to Ynal, he attacked me! It turns out he wanted all the treasures here for himself, and I was just a dupe brought on to do the hard work of obtaining them. I have the last laugh, however, having defeated and slain him.

dst: "别误会，我并非不同情这些不幸生物的困境，但重要的是要认识到，其中相当一部分是他们自己造成的。我怀疑这个位面上没有人能完全不受来自魔鬼与恶魔领域的影响，人类历史确实充满了罪行，但事实仍然是，我们所对抗的这些生物的历史更是如此。他们憎恨自己被憎恨这一事实，只会让他们的处境更糟，并犯下与他们所谴责的同样严重的罪行。不如接受世界永远不完美、充满苦难，并现实地努力减轻我们所能减轻的。"
src: "Don't misunderstand me, I am not unsympathetic to the plight of these unfortunate creatures, But it is important to realize that a considerable part of it is of their own making. I suspect no one on this plane is entirely free of influences stemming from the devilish and demonic realms, and it is certainly true that human history is full of crimes, but the fact remains that the history of these creatures we fight is even more so. By hating the fact that they are hated, they have only made their situation worse, and carried out crimes as great as any they condemn. Better to accept that the world will always be imperfect and full of suffering, and work realistically to alleviate what we can."

src:
Deep halflings are shorter, stockier versions of their lightfoot cousins. The are miners by trade and take pleasure in gems and fine masonry. They rarely mix with humans or elves, but enjoy the company of dwarves, with whom they share much in common. Deep halflings stand a little less than half as high as humans, and have stocky builds with ruddy skin, black hair and dark eyes.

Deep Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass deep halfling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Darkvision: Deep halflings are able to see in the dark.
- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor and Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Deep Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

dst: "哈马德的态度与你的并无太大不同。他决心在法律框架内行事，但他也不愿为了通过这种手段真正获得政治影响力而虚与委蛇。我不太愿意遵循这种愚蠢而矛盾的道路，所以我们走上了不同的路。但你提起过去的回忆，让我分心了。我想我已经说得比你需要知道的更多了。"他转向他的仆人。"去通知卡齐娅我们有客人。"
src: "Hamad's attitude was not too different from yours. He was determined to work within the law, yet he also had no stomach for the dissembling needed if one is actually to gain political influence by such means. I was less willing to follow such a foolish and contradictory course, and so we went on different paths. But you have distracted me by bringing up memories of the past. I think I have already said more than you need to know. He turns to his servant. "Go inform Kadzia of our guest."

dst: "我想，有必要简要讲述一下我们悲惨的历史。如果你知道来寻找这个地方，也许你就知道，我们曾是沙纳塔帝国的一个前哨站。像沙纳塔其余大部分领地一样，我们深受卓尔以及幽暗地域各种其他敌对生物的袭击威胁。为了保护自己免受这些威胁，我们踏上了自认为是智慧之路的旅途。结果它却成了骄傲之路，并导致了我们的覆灭。我，摩拉丁的高阶祭司，为带领大家走上这条路承担全部责任。"
src: "I suppose a brief recounting of our sad history is called for. As perhaps you know if you knew to seek out this place, we were once an outpost of the empire of Shanatar. Like most of the rest of the Shanatarian realms, we were much threatened by attacks from the Drow and various other hostile creatures native to the Underdark. In order to protect ourselves from these threats we embarked on what we thought to be the path of wisdom. It turned out instead to be the path of pride and led to our downfall. I, the high priest of Moradin, take full responsibility for leading us down it."

src:
Prismatic Wall
Abjuration
Level: Sor/Wiz 8
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect: Wall 4 ft./level wide, 2 ft./level high
Duration: 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw: See text
Spell Resistance: See text

Prismatic wall creates a vertical, opaque wall; a shimmering, multicolored plane of light that protects you from all forms of attack. The wall flashes with seven colors, each of which has a distinct power and purpose. The wall is immobile, and you can pass through and remain near the wall without harm. However, any other creature with less than 8 HD that is within 20 feet of the wall is blinded for 2d4 rounds by the colors if it
looks at the wall.

Each color in the wall has a special effect. The accompanying table shows the seven colors of the
wall, the order in which they appear, their  effects on creatures trying to attack you or pass
through the wall, and the magic needed to negate each color.

Spell resistance is effective against a prismatic wall, but the caster level check must be repeated for each
color present.

Color   Order   Effect of Color

Red     1st     Deals 20 points of fire damage (Reflex half).
Orange  2nd     Deals 40 points of acid damage (Reflex half).
Yellow  3rd     Deals 80 points of electricity damage (Reflex half).
Green   4th     Poison (Kills; Fortitude partial for 1d6 points of Con damage instead).
Blue    5th     Turned to stone (Fortitude negates).
Indigo  6th     Will save or become insane (as insanity spell).
Violet  7th     Creatures sent to another plane (Will negates).

心灵异能集束
描述符：无
职业：化身，魂生

一条绿松石水晶项链环绕在你的脖子上。当你展现一道造成伤害的心灵异能时，水晶会散发出微弱的光芒，并随着心灵异能的展现而增强亮度。

借助使用心灵异能者的灵魂能量，展现心灵异能力量的融魂塑造者可以利用魂能能量来强化对他人造成伤害的心灵异能。

你将魂能塑造成一个护身符或其他小饰品，称为心灵异能集束，然后将其佩戴在脖子上。当你展现一道造成伤害的心灵异能时，你的心灵异能伤害增加1点。将伤害分配给多个目标的心灵异能，例如能量速度爆发，会对每个受影响的目标造成额外伤害。

此魂融不影响不造成伤害的心灵异能。

魂质：你投入心灵异能集束的每点魂质使伤害增加1点。

脉轮束缚（喉）

几乎看不见的魂能细丝从你的心灵异能集束中扭动而出，这些灵魂能量的卷须在你展现心灵异能时扭曲成心灵异能符文。当你展现一道造成伤害的心灵异能时，该心灵异能会伴随着一股蓝绿色的原始魂能能量速度爆发。

你攻击性心灵异能背后的能量可以暂时压制你的对手。每当你展现一道对单个活物造成伤害的心灵异能时，该生物必须成功通过强韧豁免（使用魂融的豁免DC，而非心灵异能的），否则会晕眩1轮。如果该心灵异能对多个生物造成伤害，或者目标生物未受到该心灵异能的伤害（无论是因为成功通过豁免，灵能抗力，还是对该心灵异能造成的伤害有抗力），则此效果无效。

Psychic Focus
Descriptors: None
Classes: Incarnate, soulborn
Chakra: Throat
Saving Throw: See text

A necklace of turquoise crystals fits around your neck. The crystals shed a faint glow that increases in brightness when you manifest a damaging power.

Drawing upon soul energy of those using psionics, meldshapers who manifest psionic powers can use the incarnum energy to intensify powers that cause harm to others.

You shape incarnum into a periapt or other trinket, known as a psychic focus, which you then wear about your neck. When you manifest a psionic powers that deal damage, your power's damage is increased by 1 point. Powers that divide their damage among multiple targets, such as energy burst, deal the extra damage to each affected target.

This soulmeld does not affect powers that do not deal damage.

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your psychic focus increases the damage by 1 point.

Chakra Bind (Throat)

Barely visible wisps of incarnum writhe from your psychic focus, and these tendrils of soul energy twist into psionic glyphs as you manifest psionic powers. When you manifest a damaging power, the power is accompanied by a blue-green burst of raw incarnum energy.

The energy behind your offensive powers can temporarily overcome your opponents. Whenever you manifest a power that deals damage to a single living creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save (using the soulmeld's save DC, not the power's) or be dazed for 1 round. If the power deals damage to more than one creature, or if the target creature takes no damage from the power (whether because of a successful saving throw, power resistance, or resistance to the damage dealt by the power), this has no effect.

Minotaurs are strong, fiercely territorial creatures often found in vast underground labyrinths. They are bipedal, with the head of a bull, and weigh over 700 pounds. A minotaur's natural cunning and feral instincts enable it to find its way easily though even the most confusing tunnel complexes. Because of the acuity of their sense, minotaurs are seldom surprised and never caught flat-footed.

Minotaur Ability Adjustments: +8 Str, +4 Con, -4 Int, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass minotaur's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Minotaurs are able to see in the dark.
- Scent: Keen Senses and +4 racial bonus to Search, Spot and Listen checks.
- Track: +1 racial bonus to Search, Spot and Listen checks.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 5.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All Minotaurs are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Martial): All Minotaurs are proficient with Martial Weapons.
- Natural Weapon: Minotaurs can make an unarmed gore attack with their horns.
- Powerful Charge: Minotaurs can make a charging gore attack at +2 to hit, -2 to AC for an additional 4d6+6 damage.
- Uncanny Dodge: Minotaurs retain their dexterity bonus to AC, even if caught flat-footed or attacked by a hidden or invisible creature.
- Large Creature: Minotaurs suffer -1 penalties to their Attack and Armor Class, and -4 to their Hide skill.
- Monstrous: Minotaurs count as Monstrous Humanoids for the purpose of spells.

dst: 在城市下方的某些洞穴中探索时，我遇到了一位名叫巴拉兹的矮人雇佣兵战士，他在与一些石化蜥蜴的战斗中被石化了。我成功将他恢复。他已经离开，去向他以前的冒险伙伴复仇，因为他们背叛了他，把他丢给了石化蜥蜴。但他告诉我，鉴于我给予他的帮助，如果我们再次相遇，他愿意以优惠的价格为我提供雇佣兵战士的服务。我不知道未来是否还能再遇到他，但我会记住这一点，以防万一。\n\n我在沙漠巨龙酒馆再次遇到了巴拉兹。他已经追踪到他以前那些背信弃义的伙伴，他们就在那家酒馆的二楼。他想要我帮忙对付他们，并提出了一项交易：如果我在这里协助他，我就可以以更便宜的价格——只需300金币——半永久性地雇佣他作为雇佣兵，这比他原先计划的还要便宜。我接受了这个提议。是时候上楼去处理他以前的伙伴了。
src: While exploring some caverns beneath the city, I came across a dwarven mercenary warrior named Barazh who had been petrified in combat with some basilisks. I was able to restore him. He has departed to seek vengeance against his former adventuring companions who betrayed him and left him for the basilisks, but has told me that on account of the assistance I gave him, he will be willing to offer his services as a mercenary warrior to me at a bargain rate, should we ever meet again. I do not know if I can expect to run into him again at some future date, but I will keep this in mind in the event I do.\n\nI met Barazh again at the Desert Dragon Tavern. He has tracked down his former treacherous partners to the second floor of that establishment. Desiring my help in dealing with them, he has proposed a deal whereby I can hire him on as a mercenary semi-permanently for an even cheaper rate, only 300 gold, than he had already planned, if I assist him here. I accepted this offer. Time for us to head upstairs and see about his former companions.

dst: 我再次见到了我以前的雇主萨曼·瓦拉迪，并因在沙漠中从强盗手中救下他而得到了丰厚的报酬。他还请我为他完成另一项小任务：与城市守卫总部的海关检查员交谈，并从他那里取得官方文件，证明萨曼正在运送的一些货物已通过检查。据萨曼说，我只需提到他的名字，并出示他给我的盖有他印章的文件，因为一切都已经安排好了。\n\n事实证明，这件事比萨曼所说的要稍微复杂一些，因为海关检查员期望得到一笔贿赂，作为完成安排的条件。我不愿意支付，因此未能完成这项任务。萨曼不太高兴，但也理解这不是我的错。
src: I have again met my former employer, Saman Waladi, and been generously rewarded for saving him from the bandits in the desert. He has also asked me to perform another small task for him: speaking to the Customs Inspector at City Watch Headquarters, and obtaining from him official papers indicating that some goods Saman is shipping have passed his inspection. According to Saman, I need only mention his name and display a paper he has given me with his seal, as arrangements have already been made.\n\nThe matter has proved to be a bit more complicated than Saman indicated, as the Customs Inspector expected a bribe as a condition of completing the arrangement. I was unwilling to pay it, and so was not able to complete this mission. Saman was not happy, but understood that it was not my fault.
