src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Most of those who find themselves blessed (or cursed) with magic burning in their fiendish blood become warlocks, but a rare few study formal magic to better understand and control their powers. The result is the eldritch theurge, a master of both spells and invocations, a mage with the terrifying combination of potent spells and a reserve of abilities he can't possibly exhaust.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: An Eldritch Theurge does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Lore (8 ranks).
Spells: Ability to cast 2nd-level arcane spells.
Invocations: Ability to use least invocations.
Special: Eldritch blast +2d6.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
 1: Damage Reduction (Su) (1/cold iron)
 2: Fiendish Resilience 1 (Su)
 3: Spellblast (Sp)
 4: Damage Reduction (Su) (2/cold iron)
 5: Eldritch Spellweave (Su)
 6: -
 7: Damage Reduction (Su) (3/cold iron)
 8: -
 9: Fiendish Resilience 2 (Su)
10: Damage Reduction (Su) (4/cold iron)
    Greatreach Blast (Sp)

Invocations: At each level, you gain new invocations known and an increase in caster level as if you had also gained a level in an invocation-using class to which you belonged before adding the prestige class level. (This includes eldritch blast.) You do not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained.

Spellcasting: At each level, you gain new spells per day and an increase in caster level (and spells known, if applicable) as if you had also gained a level in an arcane spellcasting class (but not an invocation-using class) to which you belonged before adding the prestige class level. You do not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained.

专长类型：崇高
先决条件：光晕，善良阵营*.
具体效果：你可以用自己的生命能量治愈他人的伤口和疾病。当你激活此能力时，作为一个自由动作，你立即受到至少 2 点临时体质伤害。你可以承受任意点数的体质伤害**，只要你保持存活和清醒。
 一旦你激活了圣痕，你可以触碰你的盟友，为你承受的每 2 点体质伤害治愈他们每等级 1 点体质伤害。此外，你触碰的任何患有疾病的角色都会被治愈。***
 你每承受 1 点体质伤害，就可以对一个盟友使用此触碰。***
 当你使用此能力时，你身上的伤口会按照你承受的体质伤害成比例地流血。流血持续 1 小时，在流血停止之前，体质伤害无法通过任何方式恢复。一旦流血停止，你可以自由地再次激活你的圣痕，无论你是否恢复了失去的体质，只要你有足够的体质来使用该能力并存活。
使用：选择。

注意：
*：即使你是邪恶或中立阵营也可以选择此专长，但它不会给你任何好处，所以聪明点，如果你不能用就不要选它。
**：由于技术限制，限于 2,4,6 和 8 点。
***：由于技术限制，无法“保持充能”圣痕。为了弥补这一点，疾病将总是被治愈。
src:
Type of Feat: Exalted
Prerequisite: Nimbus of Light, Good Alignment*.
Specifics:  You can heal the wounds and ailments of others' using your own life energy. When you activate this ability, as a free action, you immediately take at least 2 points of temporary Constitution damage. You can take as many points of Constitution damage as you wish**, as long as you remain alive and conscious.
 Once you have activated your stigmata, you can touch your allies to heal them of 1 point of constitution damage per level they possess for every 2 points of Constitution damage you take. In addition, any character you touch who is suffering from a disease is cured of it.***
 You can use this touch on one ally per point of Constitution damage you take.***
 When you use this ability, the wounds on your body bleed in proportion to the Constitution damage you take. The bleeding persists for 1 hour and the Constitution damage cannot be restored by any means until the bleeding has stopped. Once the bleeding has stopped, you can freely activate your stigmata again, whether or not you have recovered your lost constitution, as long as you have enough Constitution to use the ability and survive.
Use: Selected.

Notes:
*: You can select this feat even when evil or neutral, but it will not give you any benefits, so be smart and don't choose it if you can't use it.
**: Limited to 2, 4, 6 and 8 points due to technical limits.
***: Due to technical limits, one cannot "hold the charge" on the stigmata. To make up for that, diseases will always be cured.

dst: 我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎捕海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向耐兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭那些海盗。据船员说，那些海盗是一群牛头人，一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次劫掠。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗这些海盗。\n\n船长计划在即将到来的袭击中利用我的才能，要求扎拉拉和我，以及几名船员，乘坐一艘小船绕到岛屿北侧，在隐形术的掩护下行动，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则从南面攻击海盗的主力。我们登陆并开始了进攻，但在与牛头人战斗的过程中触发了一个陷阱，重石砸向我们，同时把我们抛到了下层。我们队伍中有些人在此过程中牺牲了，但我们一路杀出迷宫，接着又击败了一个自称是扭曲符文会伊尔库泽拉姆的巫妖的爪牙。最后我们与巫妖本人交战并击败了他，关闭了他本可用来再次返回的传送门。完成这一切后，我们找到了出路，与其余船员会合，他们已经清剿了岛上其余的地方。海盗被清除后，瓦尔库尔之剑号很快就要启程了。我可以花一点时间完成我还想进行的探索和搜刮。等我准备好离开时，我可以回去和船长谈谈。
src: Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.\n\nThe captain's plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault called for Zarala and me, along with several of the crew, to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, under cover of an invisibility spell, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We landed and commenced our assault, but in the process of fighting the minotaurs ended up springing a trap, which dropped heavy rocks on us while dumping us into a lower level. Some of our party was lost in the process, but we fought our way through the maze, and then through the minions of a lich who identified himself as Ilkuzeram of the Twisted Rune. Finally we fought and defeated the lich himself, and closed the portal he would have used to return again. With all that accomplished we were able to find our way out and meet up with the rest of the crew, who had cleared the rest of the island. With the pirates cleared out, the Sword of Valkur will soon be departing. I can take a little time to finish up any exploring and looting I still wish to do. Whenever I am ready to leave, I can return and talk to the captain.

Spellcasting: The epic Slayer of Domiel continues to increase in divine caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Epic Dodge, Epic Prowess, Epic Reputation, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Weapon Focus, Great Charisma, Great Dexterity, Great Wisdom, Improved Sneak Attack, Lingering Damage, Self-Concealment, Superior Initiative.

You empathically share your pain and suffering with your attacker. Each time a creature strikes you in melee, it takes damage equal to the amount it dealt to you or 5 points, whichever is less. 这是大学者卡帕达尔的《卡林杉史》第六卷，也是最后一卷，旨在成为该主题的权威著作。

 本卷将卡林杉的历史叙述到几乎当今，主要关注该国自舒恩王朝以来的衰落。在此期间，该国饱受苦难，1018 DR 蓝龙萨菲拉克塔对该领域的蹂躏或许是最严重的灾难。
 尽管它仍是该地区最杰出的强权，卡林杉已不再是曾经的伟大帝国。其边界已大幅收缩，如今大多数卡林杉人对商业的兴趣远大于战争与膨胀术。毕竟，卡林杉一直是一个商业强权，是南越闪耀海通往楚尔特与费伦北方之间的天然十字路口。
 其早期帝国主义的明显放弃并未完全解决与外国势力的紧张关系。最大的问题可能是卡林杉商人拒绝放弃奴隶贸易，这一活动为许多北方国家所憎恶。 
 尽管经济实力是当今卡林杉精英的主要关注点，过去的帝国荣耀并未被遗忘。
src:
This is the sixth and final volume of the great scholar Kapadal's History of Calimshan, intended to be the definitive work on the subject.

 This volume, which brings the history of Calimshan down almost to the present day, is primarily concerned with that nation's decline since the days of the Shoon Dynasty. The nation has suffered in this period, with the ravaging of the realm by the blue dragon Sapphiraktar in 1018 DR being perhaps the worst disaster.
 Although it remains the preeminent regional power, Calimshan is no longer the great empire that it once was. It borders have contracted considerably, and most Calishites today are far more interested in commerce than in war and expansion. Calimshan has after all always been a mercantile power, being a natural crossroads between Chult, to the South across the Shining Sea, and the North of Faerun.
 The apparent abandonment of its earlier imperialism has not altogether resolved tensions with foreign powers. The biggest problem is probably the refusal of Calishite merchants to abandon the slave trade, an activity despised by many of the nations to the north. 
 While economic power is the primary focus of Calimshan's elites at the present day, the imperial glories of the past have not been forgotten.

dst: 哈马德正在准备对阿然尼亚的总部发动袭击，因为我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，在此期间他还有另一个任务要我去完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采用何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我造访他的庄园而受到启发，主动联系哈马德试图和解。哈马德已被说服协助处理卡洛玛斯卷入的一件事。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多打听他们的事）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往调查此事。要到达营地，我应先到他的庄园去见卡洛玛斯。他能够打开一道魔法界门将我送到营地，或许还能告诉我更多关于当前局势的信息。\n\n卡洛玛斯将我传送到了营地，在那里我遇到了贾拉尔·马卡希，一位巡林客，也是竖琴手同盟的成员，负责管理这个地方。贾拉尔告诉我，几天前他曾与营地的一名神秘袭击者遭遇，对方将他击倒后逃走，并掳走了一名难民。贾拉尔追踪他的足迹足够远，确定他向东逃往山区，但在没有支援的情况下不愿追得太远。现在他已与我同行，并提议我们一起向东进发，试图追踪这一威胁的源头。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.\n\nKalomas teleported me to the camp, where I met up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place. Jalar told me that a few days ago he had an encounter with one of the camp's mysterious assailants, who knocked him down and fled, carrying off one of the refugees. Jalar followed his tracks long enough to determine that he fled east towards the mountains, but was unwilling to go too far in pursuit without support. Now he has joined with me, and proposed that together we head east in an attempt to track down the source of this menace.

dst:
蜘蛛般的奇提恩体现了借助邪恶魔法对人形生物所能造成的非自然改变。他们的祖先曾是人形形态，但他们对卓尔的强制奴役不仅仅意味着简单履行职责。切德·纳萨德的卓尔对其奴隶进行选择性繁殖和魔法干预，融入了可怕的“改进”以及失败实验的结果。最终这些改变成为永久性的，产生了一支蜘蛛般，四臂的人形种族，能像人类使用石头或木材一样用蛛网建造。奇提恩原先只存在于费伦西北地区，在逃离卓尔压迫者的过程中已遍布幽暗地域。

奇提恩属性调整：+2 敏捷，+2 体质，+2 智力，-4 魅力。奇提恩迅捷，坚韧且聪明，但并不特别讨人喜欢。
偏好职业（游荡者）：兼职奇提恩的游荡者职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

- 小型体型
- 奇提恩的基础陆地速度为30英尺
- 攀爬检定获得 +8 种族加值
- 擒抱加值（Ex）：奇提恩的四臂在擒抱检定上提供 +4 加值
- 难以卸武（Ex）：由于奇提恩手掌中的钩子，他在避免被卸武的对抗检定中获得 +4 加值
- 阳光敏感（Ex）：在阳光或明亮魔法光（如昼明术）下，奇提恩会目眩。
- 种族生命骰：奇提恩角色起始拥有两级怪物人形生物
- 种族专长：奇提恩角色拥有双武器战斗和双手灵巧作为奖励专长
- 武器熟悉：奇提恩将短剑视为简易武器而非军用武器
- 偏好职业：游荡者
- 等级调整：+2
src:
The spiderlike chitines exemplify the unnatural changes that can be incorporated into a humanoid with the aid of evil-inspired magic. Once their ancestors were humanoid in form, but their enforced slavery to the drow entailed more than simple execution of duty. The drow of Ched Nasad selectively bred and magically meddled with their slaves, incorporating ghastly "improvements" as well as the results of fumbled experiments. Eventually these alterations became permanent, resulting in a race of spiderlike, four-armed humanoids that can build with webbing in the same way that humans employ stone or wood. Formerly found only in the northwest regions of Faer�n, chitines have spread throughout the Underdark in the course of their flight from their drow oppressors. 

Chitine Ability Adjustments: +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, -4 Charisma. Chitines are quick, tough, and smart, but not particularly endearing. 
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass chitine's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Small size
- A chitine's base land speed is 30 feet
- +8 racial bonus on Climb checks
- Grappling Bonus (Ex): A chitine's four arms grant a +4 bonus on grapple checks
- Difficult to Disarm (Ex): Because of the hooks in a chitine's palm, he gains a +4 bonus on his opposed check to avoid being disarmed
- Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex): In sunlight or bright magical light (such as a daylight spell), chitines are dazzled. 
- Racial Hit Dice: A chitine character begins with two levels of monstrous humanoid
- Racial Feats: A chitine character has Two-Weapon Fighting and Ambidexterity as bonus feats
- Weapon Familiarity: A chitine treats short swords as simple weapons rather than martial weapons
- Favored Class: Rogue
- Level Adjustment: +2

Prerequisite: Truenamer level 17
Specifics: You can choose to affect all creatures of a racial type within 30' of the target. This only affects utterances from the Lexicon of the Evolving Mind.
When you do so, the DC to speak the utterance changes as follows:
The racial type chosen is that of the creature targeted.
The DC becomes 15 + (2 * The highest CR creature of the chosen racial type in the area) + (2 * The number of targets beyond the first).
For example, you target a Goblin, and within the area are three other Goblins and one Goblin Shaman, for a total of five creatures.
The DC is 15 + (2 * 4 [The Shaman's CR]) + (2 * 4 [The four other creatures in the area]), for a total of 31.
Use: Selected.

src: "Greetings, I am Oublek, and I have the important duty of handling public relations between the guard and the public. Specifically, I publicize bounties on wanted criminals and such. As you appear to be adventurers, you would perhaps be interested in seeking some of these bounties...actually you look a little familiar. I think I might have seen your faces posted somewhere, perhaps? I was never good at remembering faces. Anyway, given the large number of powerful adventurers we have had moving through lately, the authorities have offered some bounties on unusually powerful targets, that would be beyond the power of most hunters, since many of these adventurers seem powerful enough to tackle such foes, and with so many about most of the more routine bounties are being rapidly dealt with. Not much low hanging fruit left. Some might only be appropriate for hunters with specific skills as well.  Accept these offers at your own risk! If you are interested, however, I can let you know what bounties are available."

dst:
扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的大图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识，这样一把重铸之剑也许是阿兹古尔卡重返此位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。

在前往烛堡的途中，我们绕道来到了小镇纳什凯尔，遇到了一位名叫伊扎多·夸巴克斯的侏儒，他原来是一名竖琴手，一直在寻找我们以提供援助，同时还有一些为了赏金而追捕我们的冒险者，必须加以对付。其中一名冒险者竟然是我们的老对头加拉德·阿沙勒，他显然一直在暗中与伊扎多合作，而这一次他转换了阵营，看来是要帮助我们。

据伊扎多说，通往烛堡的路线被更多冒险者严密把守着，他们是被扎拉拉和我本人以及巨龙克拉卡奇'弗拉兹'塔尔的悬赏所吸引，要到达那里并不容易。他声称有一个解决这个问题的计划，但这取决于他与一名冒险者中的双面间谍的合作。这名联络人如果得到750000金币就会转投我们这边为我们效力。伊扎多建议我们可以通过杀死一条盘踞在尖牙森林某处的龙来获得这笔款项的至少一大部分，既能掠夺它的宝藏，又能领取它头上的赏金。他把我们派去了一群在森林边缘扎营的竖琴手游侠那里，由一位名叫塔布伦·卡什滕的人带领，帮助我们寻找那条龙，而那群人又告诉我们，我们需要与一位名叫冈德·迅矛的矮人合作，攻打附近的一个地精营地。作为我们对抗地精的回报，冈德告诉了我们龙穴的位置。

我们获得了龙穴中的宝藏，将伊扎多要求的款项交给了他，并让他去把金币交给那名双面间谍。我们随后亲自与这名间谍会面，结果发现他是我们以前的一位同伴，他协助我们穿过了烛堡周围的冒险者封锁线。如今，我们终于抵达了图书馆本身，并通过捐赠一本珍贵的书籍获准进入。
src:
Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.

Diverted to the small town of Nashkel on our way to Candlekeep, we encountered a gnome named Izado Quabax, who turned out to be a Harper who has been looking for us in order to give us aid, as well as some bounty-hunting adventurers seeking us who had to be dealt with. One of these adventures turned out to be our old foe Garad Ashaler, who apparently has been secretly working with Izado, and on this occasion switched sides and apparently is going to help us. 

According to Izado, the routes to Candlekeep are guarded well by more adventurers lured by bounties on the heads of Zarala and myself, as well the the dragon Krackach'vraz'tar, and it will not be easy to get there. He claims to have a plan for dealing with this problem, but it depends on the cooperation of an apparent double agent among the adventurers wtih whom he is in contact. This contact will switch sides and work for us if paid 750000 gold. Izado suggested we could get at least a large percentagethis sum by slaying a dragon who lairs somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, in order both to loot his hoard and collect a bounty on his head. He sent us to a group of Harper rangers who have made camp on the outskirts of the Wood, led by one Tabrun Carshten to help find the dragon, and that group, in turn, has told us we needed to work with a dwarf named Gund Swiftspear to fight a nearby goblin encampment. In return for our aid against the goblins, Gund told us where the dragon's lair was to be found.

We gained access to a dragon's hoard, delivered to Izado the sum he requested, and let him go to deliver it to the double agent. We then met up with this agent ourselves, who turned out to be a former companions of ours, and who assisted us in getting through the cordon of adventurers around Candlekeep. We have now, at long last, reached the library itself, and gained admittance to it by our donation of a valuable book.

Through some curse of the master's, or for some other reason I do not know, I am tormented by nightmares and painful dreams of the life I once had but have now lost."

“我的刀刃和我的魔法合二为一。”

暮刃模糊了施法者和战士之间的界限，将魔法的力量与近战格斗能力结合在一起。
作为奥术施法技巧的学生，暮刃将奥术施法与战士的战斗技能相结合。虽然穿着盔甲施展奥术的能力起源于精灵，但数千年来暮刃的秘密已经传播到其他种族，如今任何种族的成员都可以成为暮刃。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长：暮刃擅长简易武器和军用武器，所有盔甲和盾牌。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要施展法咒，暮刃必须拥有 10 + 法术等级的智力值。暮刃的法咒 DC 为 10 + 法术等级 + 智力调整值。暮刃的施法者等级等于其职业等级。他像术士一样施法。他最初在穿着轻型盔甲施法时不会遭受奥术失败几率，后来他学会在穿着中型盔甲和持盾时施法无奥术失败几率，但重型盔甲的失败几率正常适用。

src:
(BASE CLASS)
"My blade and my magic are one and the same."

The Duskblade blurs the line between spellcaster and warrior, marrying the power of magic with hand-to-hand combat prowess.
A student of arcane spellcasting techniques, the Duskblade combines arcane spellcasting with the combat skills of a fighter. While the ability to cast arcane spells in armor originated with the elves, over the millenia the secrets of the Duskblade have been disseminated to the other races, and today members of any race can become a Duskblade.

- Alignment Restrictions: none
- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Duskblade is proficient with Simple and Martial Weapons, all Armor and Shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
 1: Armored Mage (light)

This enabled him to feel confident that he could always find an appropriate weapon no matter what the nature of his latest assignment, as he was sometimes tasked to kill quickly, sometimes slowly, sometimes quietly and sometimes with great spectacle. This short sword is one of the weapons he commissioned.

src: An orcish insciption on this shield indicates that it once belonged to Nulbish, a half-orc ranger who became a champion of the northern orc clans during their fateful Goblin Wars. Despite his half-human heritage, they appreciated his ferocity in battle and the rousing speeches he gave from atop his piled victims. When Nulbish was killed by a member of his father's own clan, the orcs squabbled for months over who should bear his shield, the dispute eventually splintering the fragile orc alliance. Numerous forgeries were crafted during this time. There is probably no way to conclusively determine whether this particular shield is the original or one such forgery, but it is powerful enough to be the former.

dst:
战俑最初被建造为无意识的战争机器，一支无需食物和水就能战斗的构装体军队。然而，作为创造它们所用过程的副作用，它们获得了自我意识。起初这是一种恩惠，因为现在不再需要活着的将军随行，但最终战争结束了，正如所有战争一样。由于无法摧毁这个如今已有意识的活体构装体种族，它们反而被释放，任由自己在世界上寻找出路。在外观上它们类似魔像，金属和矿物制成的装甲板覆盖着活体木质框架。它们被创造时没有性别，尽管少数具有更典型女性思维方式的个体修改了自己的设计和装甲板，以拟形怪类人女性的体形。战俑无法繁殖，只能在使用被发掘的古代图纸建造的特殊创造熔炉中制造。它们也不会衰老，它们的心态有时使类人种族的活动对它们来说是个谜。

战俑属性调整：+2 体质，-2 感知，-2 魅力。
偏好职业（战士）：兼职战俑的战士职业在决定他是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 30 英尺基础速度
- 复合装甲板：护甲等级 +2，不能穿戴护甲，5% 奥术法咒失败几率。
- 活体构装体亚种：
  免疫睡眠，麻痹，毒素，能量吸取和疾病
- 轻度护命（Ex）：当战俑受到重击或偷袭时，有 25% 几率该重击或偷袭被抵消，伤害改为正常掷骰。
  不能自然治疗，治疗法咒只能治疗正常量的一半。
- 构装体：就法咒而言，战俑被视为构装体。
src:
Warforged were originally built as mindless war machines, an army of constructs able to fight without food and water.  As a side-effect of the processes used to create them, however, they gained sentience.  At first this was a boon, as now there was no need for a living general to travel with them, but eventually the war came to an end, as all wars do.  As they couldn't destroy the now-sentient race of living constructs, they were instead freed and left to find their own way in the world.  Physically they look similar to golems, with plating made of metal and mineral covering a living wooden frame.  They were created without gender, though a few with a more typically feminine mindset have modified their design and plating to mimic a humanoid female's shape.  Warforged cannot reproduce, but can only be made at special Creation Forges built using uncovered ancient plans.  They do not age either, and their mindset sometimes leaves the activities of the humanoid races a puzzle to them.

Warforged Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Wis, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass warforged's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Composite Plating: +2 to AC, cannot wear armor, and 5% arcane spell failure chance.
- Living Construct subtype:
  Immune to sleep, paralyze, poison, energy drain, and disease
- Light Fortification (Ex): When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on a warforged, there is a 25% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.  
  Does not heal naturally, healing spells only heal half the normal amount.
- Construct: Warforged count as Constructs for the purpose of spells.

src:
School: Necromancy [Evil]
Caster Level: Clr 2, sor/wiz 2
Components: V, S, F
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

The subject develops an internal spherical sac that contains fluid or semisolid necrotic flesh. The internal cyst is noticeable as a slight bulge on the subject's arm, abdomen, face (wherever you chose to touch the target) or it is buried deeply enough in the flesh of your target that it is not immediately obvious-the subject may not realize what was implanted within her.

From now on, undead foes and necromantic magic are particularly debilitating to the subject-the cyst enables a sympathetic response between free-roaming external undead and itself. Whenever the victim is subject to a spell or effect from the school of necromancy, she makes saving throws to resist at a -2 penalty. Whenever the subject is dealt damage by the natural weapon of an undead (claw, bite, or other attack form), she takes an additional 1d6 points of damage.

Protection from evil prevents the necrotic cyst from forming. Once a necrotic cyst is implanted, spells that manipulate the cyst and its bearer are no longer thwarted by protection from evil.

Focus: The caster must possess a Mother Cyst.

dst:
在扎泽斯普尔的伊尔梅特神殿——泪之屋的地下，我遇到了一个名叫涅尔瓦·瓦尔切扎的人，她是伊尔梅特的圣武士，正守卫着城市下方幽暗地域洞穴中出现的威胁。在那里，她发现了一道由负能量构成的黑暗屏障，它正在扩张，并将幽暗地域的生物转化为亡灵怪物。她请求我为她找到一块游荡者之石，因为拥有它就能穿透这道屏障。如今我已获得此物，也同意陪伴她，帮助她对抗黑暗屏障之后的任何邪恶。

穿过黑暗屏障后，我们遇到了显然是造成它存在的生物：一位前矮人圣武士，如今已堕落的亡灵末日骑士。他的家园显然很久以前被卓尔入侵者摧毁，他现在寻求向所有卓尔复仇。为了实现复仇，他与黑暗力量达成了某种契约，释放出一圈不断扩张的负能量，将落入其中的人转化为亡灵。他声称它最终会扩张到覆盖整个扎泽斯普尔城，给他一支亡灵大军，他计划率领这支大军对卓尔发动灭绝战役。告诉我们这些之后，他就消失了。想必他就在他所盘踞的废墟深处，我们需要找到并击败他，以阻止他所释放的一切。

我们再次遇到了那位前圣武士，他正奋力保卫一座奇怪的祭坛，结果那正是扩散负能量的源头。这座祭坛已被摧毁，因此黑暗屏障现在应该开始收缩，并最终崩塌。
src:
Beneath the House of Tears, a Temple of Ilmater in Zazesspur, I encountered one Nierva Var'cheza, a Paladin of Ilmater who is standing guard against a menace originating in the underdark caverns below the city. There she found a dark barrier of negative energy that is expanding and transforming creatures of the Underdark into Undead monstosities. She asked that I find a Rogue Stone for her, as possession of this would allow the barrier to be pentrated. Having now acquired such an item, I have also agreed to accompany her and aid her against whatever evil lies beyond the dark barrier.

Having passed through the dark barrier, we encountered the creature apparently responsible for its presence: a former dwarven paladin, now a corrupted, undead Doom Knight. His home was apparently destroyed by Drow invaders long ago, and he now seeks vengeance against all Drow. To obtain it, he has made some compact with dark powers that unleashed an expanding orbit of negative energy that transforms into undead those who fall within it. He claims that it will eventually grow to encompass the entire city of Zazesspur, giving him an army of undead that he plans to lead on a campaign of extermination against the Drow. Having told us this, he disappeared. Presumably he can be found deeper in the ruin over which he presides, and we will need to find and defeat him to stop whatever he has unleashed.

We have again encountered the former paladin, fighting to defend a strange altar that turned out to be the source of the spreading negative energy. This altar has been destroyed, and so the dark barrier should now begin to contract and eventually collapse.

Show of Force (Sp): Beginning at 5th level, once per day on command, you can use mirror image as the spell. Caster level 5th.

Gather the Horde (Su): At 8th level, you gain a +5 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks made to influence orcs.

The bonus is cumulative, so if your next attack hits, you gain a +2 morale bonus on your following attack against that opponent, and so on.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Master Harpers are elite members of the Harpers, which is a secret society that battles evil and tyranny, preserves lore, and works to balance civilization and the wild. Master Harpers study spells and develop many skills to help them in their duties of preserving lore by imparting it to others, raising morale, and aiding Harpers and others who promote similar aims.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: A Master Harper gains no proficiency with any armor or weapons.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any non evil.
Spells: Able to cast 2nd-level spells of the appropriate type.
Skills: Bluff 8 ranks, Persuade 8 ranks, Lore 12 ranks, Perform 12 ranks, Spellcraft 8 ranks.
Feats: Alertness, Iron Will.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Harper Knowledge- Bonus for item identification
  Harper Secret - 1 bonus feat: favored enemy, metamagic or bard feats
2: Craft Master Harper Item - May create potions
3: Mielikki's Truth - Once per day, can remove effect on an animal
5: Lycanbane - +5 bonus to the AC vs. Shapechanger, and you may transmit this bonus
  Harper Secret
  Musical Instrument Craft - Can use Craft Master Harper Item to create Musical Instrument
6: Milil's Ear - +4 bonus to the Listen Skill.
7: Lliira's Aura - Create an aura that gives allies a +4 bonus to saving throws against Mind Affecting spell..
8: Deneir's Orel - +4 bonus to the Spellcraft Skill.
9: Tymora's Smile - +2 bonus on all saves, twice per day.
10: Harper Secret


BONUS SPELLS
Upon gaining a level in Master Harper, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class. He does not learn any new spells through this ability.

dst: 这本书是关于探索古代废墟时应遵循程序的指南。虽然它是为考古学家读者所写，但其中大部分信息对深入地下城的冒险者同样有用，因为它包含了避开陷阱、寻找战利品、应对怪物等方面的技巧。读过这本书的冒险者会发现所学内容相当有用，相当于在真实地下城中通过危险经历所能学到的经验。然而，虽然缺乏经验的冒险者肯定能从这本书中学到很多，但那些已经拥有丰富经验的人会发现其中几乎没有他们不知道的内容。
src: This book is a guide to the procedures that should be followed when exploring ancient ruins. While written with an audience of archaeologists in mind, much of the information within would be useful to a dungeon-crawling adventurer as well, as it includes tips on avoiding traps, finding loot, dealing with monsters, and the like. An adventurer who reads this book will find what he learns quite useful, the equivalent of the lessons that can be learned through dangerous experience in real dungeons. However, while an inexperienced adventuerer would surely learn much from this book, those who already possess extensive experience will find little in it which they do not already know.

dst: 在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了关于一个叫拉贾尔的人的一些信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的一个联系人。这个拉贾尔究竟是谁并不完全清楚，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他藏身处的方向，位于下水道中，并注意到我应该使用密码“Jaraj”来进入那里。只要我保留这张纸作为参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。然而，我必须决定，是应该自己去找这个拉贾尔，还是把我发现的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能利用这些信息来终结他的犯罪活动。\n\n我已经找到了通往拉贾尔藏身处的路。我想我会记住来这里的路，应该不再需要我为那个目的而找到的那张纸了。我已经进入了公会，现在可以在其黑市商店购物。如果我愿意，我也可以考虑加入它。有人告诉我，在这个阶段去找城市守卫是浪费时间，因为公会收买了一些守卫，既然他们现在知道我是谁，就会留意我泄露的任何关于公会的事情，并且有能力确保不会有什么结果。
src: During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout, located in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.\n\nI have found my way to Rajar's Hideout. I think I will remember my way here, and should have no more need for the paper I found for that purpose. I have gained entrance to the guild, and can now shop at its blackmarket store. I can also look into joining it if I so desire. I've been told that going to the City Watch at this stage would be a waste of time, as the guild has some Watchmen in its pay, who, now that they know who I am, will be on the lookout for anything I let slip about it, and are in a position to see that nothing much comes of it.

dst: "原来存放在这个仓库里的一批‘雕像’其实是一群石像鬼。它们不满一些工人搬动它们，现在正在四处作乱。不过，你可能也听说了，我们最近的内战刚刚结束，新政权上台，这导致了一些希望只是暂时的官僚混乱。似乎没人确定该由谁负责处理这个问题。我试着叫来的军队和警察都认为这是对方的任务，所以现在我只能雇佣兵了。"
src: "It turns out that a collection of 'statues' being stored in this warehouse was actually a group of gargoyles. They took exception to some workers handling them, and are now running amok. However, as you may have heard, our recent civil war recently concluded with a new regime in place, and this has led to some hopefully temporary bureaucratic confusion. No one seems sure whose responsibility it is to address this problem. The military and police forces I tried to call in each seem to think this is the other's task, so now it seems I am reduced to hiring mercenaries."

src:

Epic Iaijutsu Master Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Epic Dodge, Epic Prowess, Epic Reflexes, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Weapon Specialization, Improved Iaijutsu Focus (Epic), Improved Whirlwind Attack, Overwhelming Critical, Superior Initiative.

dst: "我想可以……" 扎拉拉花了一些时间研究这扇门。"看来要解除它，需要有人对它施放五个法术，每个法术造成不同类型的伤害。过于强大的法术也不行，所以我们在这里只能使用戏法和一环法术。不过，与我们之前发现的装置不同，这里的法术需要按特定顺序施放。遗憾的是，我通过研究这扇门没能找出那个顺序。"
src: "I think so..." Zarala takes some time to study the door. "It appears that to bring it down someone will need to cast five spells on it in, each spell doing a different type damage. Unlike the device we found earlier, though, here the spells need to be cast in a specific order. Unfortunately I couldn't find out what that order from studying the door."

dst: "是的，精灵族是许多被短命种族遗忘的传说的继承者，而这些传说若落入不当之手，可能造成极大的危害。我们的职责就是确保远古怪物仍被束缚，被诅咒的器物仍被藏匿，黑暗魔法的源头仍未被触及，危险的知识不被那些无法明智运用它的人所得。因此，当听说这些卓尔试图进入这个蕴藏远古魔法的地方时，我们便设法阻止，因为此地的守护结界本意是阻挡人类，而我们的黑暗表亲是否会被它们挡住尚不清楚。如今必须判定是否也该阻止你进入。你寻找塞里姆·加卢伦的失传论著，究竟是为了什么目的？"
src: "Yes, the elven people are heirs to much lore forgotten by the short-lived races, and much of this lore could do great harm in the wrong hands. It is our task to see that ancient monsters remain bound, cursed artifacts remain hidden away, sources of dark magic remain untapped, and dangerous knowledge be kept from those who cannot use it wisely. Thus, upon hearing that these Drow were seeking entrance to this place, containing ancient magic, we sought to prevent it, for the wards about it were meant to keep out humans, and it is not clear if our dark cousins would be stopped by them. Whether your entrance should not be prevented as well must now be determined. For what purpose do you seek Seriem Galuren's lost treatise?"

dst: "这次闯入是什么意思……哦，我明白了。你听说了我对控制和变异软泥怪的研究，想夺取成果据为己有。好吧，别以为我，伟大的纳西利库斯·哈威利格·尼恩，会容忍这种事！"
src: "What is the meaning of this intrusion...oh, I understand. You heard of my research into controlling and mutating slimes, and wanted to seize the results for your own benefit. Well, don't think that I, the great Narcillicus Harwilliger Neen, am going to stand for that!"

dst: "我完全不知道。我当时正让伊纳斯帮我做点研究，一些古代军事史，那是我的兴趣所在，但他把本该给我的那包材料和一个打算给别人的人弄混了。我想他年纪大了，有点糊涂了。总之，我回来是想把事情理清楚，结果正和伊纳斯说着话，一群恶魔突然就出现在这里。太不可思议了！能进行如此大规模召唤的力量……好吧，这么说吧，看来老伊纳斯不知怎么惹上了一个非常强大的敌人。顺便说一句，我是杰拉因将军。如果你想正式一点，卡拉德·因·达雷什·埃尔·杰拉因。"
src: "I have no idea. I was having Inas do a little research for me, some ancient military history, which is an interest of mine, but he mixed up the packet of materials he was supposed to be giving me with one intended for someone else. He's getting a little confused in his old age, I think. Anyway, I came back to straighten the matter out, and right in the middle of talking to Inas, a bunch of demons suddenly materialized here. Most extraordinary! The power to carry out such a massive summoning...well let's just say that it seems old Inas has somehow made a very powerful enemy. I am General Jra'ein, by the way. Kalad yn Daresh el Jra'ein if you want to be very formal."

dst:

先决条件：必须信仰莎尔。（选择此职业的牧师必须拥有以下领域中的两个：黑暗，邪恶，火。）*
具体效果：你施放的附魔系，幻象和死灵系法咒，以及带有黑暗描述符的法咒，其所有豁免检定DC获得+1加值。你在克服这些学派和法咒的法术抗力的施法者等级检定上获得+1加值。你施放的塑能系或变化系法咒（带有黑暗描述符的法咒除外） 的有效施法者等级降低1级。降低的施法者等级会影响法咒的射程，持续时间，伤害以及法咒可能具有的任何其他等级相关变量，包括针对你的驱散检定。无论你的等级如何，你都不能再施放带有光亮描述符的法咒。此类法咒会自动失败。
使用：自动。

(*如果你作为牧师选择此专长但没有合适的领域，你将被要求重新选择专长。如果你作为1级牧师选择此专长但没有合适的领域，你将无法升级。)
src:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Must worship Shar. (Clerics taking this class must be have two of the following domains: Darkness, Evil, Fire.)*
Specifics: Add a +1 bonus to the DC for all saving throws of spells you cast from the schools of Enchantment, Illusion, and Necromancy, and spells with the darkness descriptor. You get a +1 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance for these schools and spells. Your effective caster level for spells you cast from the schools of Evocation or Transmutation (except spells with the darkness descriptor) is reduced by one. The reduced caster level affects the spell's range, duration, damage, and any other level-dependent variables the spell might have, including dispel checks against you. You can no longer cast spells with the light descriptor, no matter what your level is. Such spells automatically fail.
Use: Automatic.

(*If you take this feat as a cleric without the proper domains, you will be asked to retake your feats. If you take this feat as a first level cleric without the proper domains, you will be unable to level up.)

With this map in my possession, I now have the option of traveling to this stronghold if I decide to do so. I only need to find paths east and use the map instead of wandering randomly.

Faseph in turn wants to speak to me personally about my extra-planar encounter, I suppose to guide his activities. Hamad has therefore dispatched me to talk to him. Faseph can be found in the northeast tower of the Temple of Tyr. I should go to that temple (in the Temple District, naturally) and find an upward-leading staircase in the northeast. dst:
现已查明，卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔参与了变形蛛与噬火武僧及其各方盟友蹂躏卡林杉的计划。他还打算利用泽法德之剑或其最初的目的——释放卡利姆与门农，这很可能会给这片土地带来巨大的灾难。他的女儿卡齐娅对他的计划感到不安，将此事告知了我们，并提出如果我们能穿过下水道和黑暗卡林港抵达泽卡尔塔，就让我们进入。

卡齐娅让我们进入了泽卡尔塔，但事先要我们发誓不杀她父亲，只从他手中夺走那把剑。此后我们便一路向塔顶前进寻找他。途中，我们遇到了乌尔·萨哈卜的阿巴亚拉之一拉梅尔·加尼尔布，据说他们能预见未来，而他正被囚禁着。他告诉了我们许多关于泽卡尔和那把剑的有趣信息。显然，当那把剑被用来击败恶魔阿兹古尔卡时，它将他困在了某种口袋位面中。此后他一直待在那里，但仍保留了一些通过那把剑影响这个位面的能力（并且保留了更多能力去影响各种与火相关的位面的事件，因为他在那里早已有联系）。这意味着剑的持有者往往会受到恶魔的影响并最终被其控制。这就是泽卡尔的天命，也很大程度上解释了他那些疯狂毁灭性的行为。他还告诉我们，恶魔即将挣脱其位面牢笼并返回主物质位面，一旦发生，很可能会带来灾难。希望我们按计划从泽卡尔手中夺走那把剑，能阻止此事，也能阻止泽卡尔和恶魔利用那把剑挑起的其他麻烦。拉梅尔提到的最后一点，是关于阿巴亚拉们对扎拉拉的各种预言（泽卡尔绑架她是为了了解更多关于这些预言的信息），根据预言，她注定会干扰泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡两人的阴谋，这也导致两人都想要她死。

当我们在他的塔顶与泽卡尔对峙时，结果发现恶魔阿兹古尔卡已部分返回这个位面，并能将其力量施加于此。尽管如此，我们还是成功夺走了泽法德之剑，尽管在此过程中它断成了两截，现在由扎拉拉持有。任务完成后，我们便传送回了加尔哈德尔庄园。
src:
It has now been revealed that Kalomas Zekar was involved in the plans of the aranea and the Consuming Fire monks and their various allies to ravage Calimshan.  He also plans to use the Sword of Zefad or its original purpose of freeing Calim and Memnon, likely unleashing considerable devastation upon the land. His daughter Kadzia, disturbed by his plans, inofrmed us of this and has offered to give us access to the Zekar tower, if we can reach it by traversing a route leading through the sewers and Dark Calimport.

Kadzia has let us into the Zekar tower, first extracting from us an oath not to kill her father, but only take the sword from him. Since then we have been proceeding to the very top of the tower to find him. Along the way, we came across one Ramel Ganirb, one of the Abbayalar of Ul'Sahab, who are reputed to be able to see the future, being held prisoner. He told us much interesting information about Zekar and the sword. Apparently when the sword was used to defeat the demon Azghulkar, it trapped him in some sort of pocket plane. There he has been ever since, but has retained some ability to influence this plane through the sword (and retained even more ability to influence events of various fire-related planes where he already had connections). This means that wielders of the sword tend to come under the demon's influence and eventually control. This has been the fate of Zekar, and explains much about his otherwise madly destructive actions. He has also told us that the demon is on the verge of breaking free of his planar prison and returning to the Prime, an event likely to be disastrous if it occurs. Hopefully taking the sword from Zekar, as we already plan, will prevent this as well as the other trouble Zekar and the demon are using the sword to stir up. A final point Ramel made concerned various prophecies of the Abbalayar concerning Zarala (Zekar kidnapped him to find out more about these), according to which she is fated to interfere with the schemes of both Zekar and Azghulkar, and which has caused both to desire her death.

When we confronted Zekar at the top of his tower, it turned out that the demon Azghulkar was partially returned to this plane and able to exert his power into it. Nevertheless, we succeeded in taking the Sword of Zefad, although it was broken into two pieces, now held by Zarala, in the process. Our mission accomplished, we then teleported back to the Galhadr Estate.

此法咒使受害者从附魔，变化和诅咒中解脱。它甚至可以逆转立即效果，如石化术。对于每个此类效果，你进行施法者等级检定（1D20 + 施法者等级，最大 +15） 对抗 DC 11 + 效果的施法者等级。成功意味着该生物摆脱了法咒，诅咒或效果。对于诅咒物品，DC 是 25.如果法咒是无法被解除魔法驱散的，破除附魔只有在那个法咒是 5 级或更低时才有效。如果效果来自永久魔法物品，如诅咒之剑，破除附魔不会从该物品上移除诅咒，但它确实使受害者从物品的效果中解脱。

This spell frees victims from enchantment, transmutations and curses. It can reverse even an instantaneous effect, such as Flesh to Stone. For each such effect, you make a caster level check (1D20 + caster level, maximum +15) against a DC of 11 + caster level of the effect. Success means that the creature is free of the spell, curse, or effect. For a cursed item, the DC is 25. If the spell is one that cannot be dispelled by Dispel Magic, Break Enchantment  works only if that spell is 5th level or lower. If the effect comes from a permanent magic item, such as a cursed sword, Break Enchantment does not remove the curse from that item, but it does free the victim from the item's effect.

dst:
学术传说中关于魔蝠人的起源有两种不同的说法。一种说法是，魔蝠人是很久以前魔蝠与某种不确定的类人种族结合所生的位面后裔。另一种则是关于一个狂妄自大的法师试图将自己的本质烙印在另一个种族上的更黑暗的故事。

事实是，魔蝠人偶尔会由魔蝠父母所生。魔蝠人比他们的魔蝠祖先更弱小，因此被魔蝠社群视为不受欢迎的劣种而驱逐。他们被遗弃在恶劣的位面中自生自灭。厌恶自己类人孩子的魔蝠父母会将婴儿留在充满敌意的位面上。善良的父母则会将孩子放在一个适宜居住的位面上，以便容易被其他生物发现。有时其他生物会收养这个被遗弃的婴儿，并将其抚养至成年。

作为由与自己截然不同的父母抚养长大的弃儿，魔蝠人常常感到格格不入。他们通常是孤独者，渴望一种难以捉摸的归属感。尽管如此，他们富有魅力且讨人喜欢，通常受到周围人的喜爱。

魔蝠人总体上看起来像是他们魔蝠父母的较不丑陋版本，但翅膀发育不全。典型的魔蝠人身高不到3英尺，体重约30磅，女性比男性略高略重。水魔蝠人形似一个长有鱼鳞的小型人类，眼睛呈黑色且凸出。

火魔蝠人属性调整：+2 体质，-2 智力，+2 魅力。水魔蝠人健壮而耐久。

天赋职业（武僧）：在判断兼职经验值惩罚时，兼职水魔蝠人的武僧职业不计入其中。

种族特性：
- 水魔蝠人的基础陆地速度为30英尺。
- 类人生物：魔蝠人原生于元素位面。他们属于类人生物类型，当不在各自祖先的位面时获得跨位面亚种。与他们的魔蝠祖先不同，魔蝠人没有元素亚种。
- 小型：作为小型生物，魔蝠人获得+1护甲等级加值，+1攻击检定加值，以及+4躲藏检定加值。
- 喷吐武器：每个魔蝠人都拥有一种喷吐武器，其效果因魔蝠人的血统而异。
- 元素施法：魔蝠人施展带有与其种类相符（风，土，火或水）的元素描述符的法咒时，施法者等级+1。
- 简易武器：魔蝠人擅长所有简易武器。

等级调整：+1
src:
Scholarly lore contains two different origin stories for the mephlings. In one, mephlings are planetouched offshoots of long-ago unions between mephits and an indeterminate race of humanoids. The other is a darker tale of a megalomaniacal mage seeking to imprint his essence on another race.

What is true is that a mephling will occasionally be born to mephit parents. Weaker than their mephit ancestors, mephlings are put out of mephit communities as undesirable runts. They're left to the mercies of the inhospitable planes. Mephit parents revolted by their humanoid child will leave the babe on a hostile plane. Kindly parents will place the child on a habitable plane where it will easily be found by other creatures. Sometimes other creatures adopt the abandoned baby and it grows to reach adulthood.

As foundlings raised by parents very different from themselves, mephlings frequently feel out of place. They usually are loners who desire an elusive sense of belonging. Nevertheless, they're attractive and personable, generally liked by people around them.

Mephlings in general look like less homely versions of their mephit parents with stunted wings. A typical mephling stands less than 3 feet tall and weighs around 30 pounds, with females slightly taller and heavier than males.  A water mephling resembles a small, fish-scaled human with black, bulbous eyes.

Fire Mephling Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Int, +2 Cha.  Water mephlings are sturdy and durable.

Favored Class (Monk): A multiclass water mephling's monk class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- A water mephling's base land speed is 30 feet.
- Humanoid: Mephlings are native to the Elemental Planes. They have the humanoid type and gain the extraplanar subtype when not on their respective ancestral plane. Unlike their mephit ancestors, mephlings do not have an elemental subtype.
- Small: As Small creatures, mephlings have a +1 bonus to Armor Class, a +1 bonus on attack rolls, and a +4 bonus on Hide checks.
- Breath Weapon: Each mephling has a breath weapon, the effect of which varies by the mephling's heritage. 
- Elemental Casting: Mephlings cast spells with an elemental descriptor that matches their kind (air, earth, fire, or water) at +1 caster level.
- Simple Weapons: Mephlings are proficient with all simple weapons.

Level Adjustment: +1

圣化心智协会由精英牧师，战士，武僧，圣武士，心灵术士，心灵武士，魂刃者等组成，他们认为邪恶心灵异能生物的存在和目标对当今文明种族构成最严重的威胁。
    该组织的成员将他们的使命视为一场十字军东征，旨在清除世界上那些试图腐化和扭曲个人独立思考权利的可怕而无形的势力。圣化心智相信所有邪恶阵营的心灵异能生物都必须被粉碎。所有成员都共享这一信念，而该组织最狂热的精英战士以协会本身的名字作为自己的名字。他们说，这样他们永远不会忘记所选使命的至关重要性。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长：圣化心智不获得额外擅长。
- 技能点：4 + 智力调整值

要求：

专长：所有军用武器擅长，钢铁意志。

基础攻击加值：+4。
特殊：必须拥有至少 1 点心灵异能点的心灵异能点储备。

职业特性：

等级
1：分割心智 - 你每天短时间内获得对心智法咒的免疫。
2：净化打击 - 你可以制裁心灵异能生物
3：愁思剑 1/天 - 成功命中时，目标生物在 1d4 轮内无法使用心灵异能。
4：难以擒抱 - 你在抵抗或逃脱擒抱时加上你的职业等级。
5：愁思剑 2/天
6：灵能抗力 - 你获得等于 5 + 角色等级的灵能抗力。


额外显能

达到 2,3,4,5,6 级时，圣化心智获得新的显能者等级，增加他的心灵异能点，已知异能总数和最高异能等级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Society of the Sanctified Mind is a collection of elite clerics, fighters, monks, paladins, psions, psychic warriors, soulknives, and others who view the threat posed by the presence and goals of evil psionic using creatures to be the most dire menace facing civilized races today.
    Members of this organization consider their cause to be a crusade to rid the world of the awful and invisible influence of those who seek to corrupt and pervert an individual's right to think for herself. A Sanctified Mind believes that all evil-aligned psionic-using creatures must be crushed. All members share this devotion, and the most fervent of the order's elite warriors take the name of the society itself as their name. this way, they say, they can never forget the vital importance of their chosen mission.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: An Sanctified Mind gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non-Evil.
Feats: All Martial Weapon Proficiencies, Iron Will.
Skills: Lore 4 ranks.
Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Special: Must possess a power point reserve of at least 1 power point.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Partition Mind - You gain immunity to mind spells for a short time per day.
2: Cleansing Strike - You may smite a psionics using creature
3: Disrupting Blow 1/day - On a successful hit, the target creature cannot use psionics for 1d4 rounds.
4: Hard to Hold - You add your class level to resist or escape a grapple.
5: Disrupting Blow 2/day
6: Power Resistance - You gain Power Resistance equal to 5 + character level.


BONUS MANIFESTING

Upon reaching levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 the Sanctified Mind gains a new manifester level, increasing his power points, total powers known, and maximum power level.

dst: “即便现在，恶魔阿兹古尔卡仍在牢笼的边界挣扎。等他挣脱束缚——他很快就会做到——我们符文会必须拥有击败他的手段，这样他才有理由以平等的身份与我们谈判。否则，他会带来巨大的混乱。你们带来了这样的手段：泽法德之剑的碎片，以及命中注定要执掌它的气之裔。把这两样都交给我，剑会被重铸，而元素裔将成为我的奴隶（如果我能确定她对剑的掌控力能在这种转变后存留下来，或许会做成亡灵仆从，但若不能，就用魔法支配她），然后我就让你们安然撤退。否则，等待你们的将是痛苦的死亡。”

Hand over both to me, the sword to be reforged and the genasi to become my slave (perhaps an undead servant, if I determine her powers over the sword would survive such a transition, but if not she can be magically dominated), and I shall let you retreat unharmed. Otherwise a painful death awaits you."

dst:
（进阶职业）
阿斯莫蒂尔斯信徒是傲慢专横，渴望无限权力的一类人。他行事冷酷无情，不在乎任何可能挡路的人。他利用自己的权力和影响力获取秘密，进而获得更多权力，操纵和命令他人，并强化自己的肉体。

- 生命骰：d6
- 武器与防具擅长：阿斯莫蒂尔斯信徒不获得额外的武器与防具擅长。
- 技能点：4 + 智力调整值

要求：

阵营：守序邪恶或中立邪恶。
专长：邪恶烙印，黑暗信徒，领导力
技能：唬骗 4 级，游说 5 级。

职业特性：

等级
1：魅惑 - 如同该法咒
   学习秘密 1/天 - 为学识提供 +10 加值
2：命令 - 如同该法咒
3：学习秘密 2/天
4：召唤地狱猫 - 召唤一只地狱猫。
5：学习秘密 3/天
6：邪恶权威 - 获得对 50 尺内所有邪恶生物的控制权。
7：学习秘密 4/天
8：召唤高等魔鬼 - 召唤五只魔鬼之一。
9：学习秘密 5/天，高等命令术 - 如同该法咒
10：恐怖之力 - 获得 +2 攻击，防御，豁免。

施法

阿斯莫蒂尔斯信徒每提升两个等级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高施法职业（吟游诗人，术士或法师）上也提升了等级。他不会通过此能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Disciple of Asmodeus is a lordly, domineering sort who craves unlimited power. He is ruthless in his pursuits and uncaring of any who might get in his way. He uses his power and influence to gain secrets, which in turn gain him more power, manipulate and command others, and enhance his own physical aspect.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Disciple of Asmodeus gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Lawful Evil or Neutral Evil.
Feats: Evil Brand, Disciple of Darkness, Leadership
Skills: Bluff 4 ranks, Persuade 5 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Charm - As the spell
   Learn Secret 1/day - Grants a +10 bonus to lore
2: Command - As the spell
3: Learn Secret 2/day
4: Summon Hellcat - Summons a hellcat.
5: Learn Secret 3/day
6: Evil Authority - Gain control of all evil creatures within 50 feet.
7: Learn Secret 4/day
8: Summon Major Devil - Summon one of five devils.
9: Learn Secret 5/day, Greater Command - As the spell
10: Dread Might - Gain +2 Attack, Armour, Saves.

SPELLCASTING

Every other level in Disciple of Asmodeus, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (bard, sorcerer, or wizard). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

dst: 我为了寻找一本珍贵的书而前往的那座对非矮人设有结界保护的废墟，有着一段有趣的历史。显然，这道结界是由矮人神系中善良诸神与邪恶之神阿巴索尔的牧师们联手设下的。然而，结界设立之后，阿巴索尔的追随者却试图将这座如今坚不可摧的堡垒据为己有，引发了一场内战，最终导致所有居民死亡。然而，在战争过程中，各种诅咒被降下，导致那些居民以不死生物的状态徘徊不去，进行着一场永远无法结束的战争，因为他们被击倒后只会重新复活。不过，看来这些诅咒可以通过一位活着的矮人——也就是我——的到来而终结。击倒其中一个派系的大祭司将结束诅咒，让战争得以了结。作为回报，另一个派系的大祭司会给我一把钥匙，我需要用它进入这里的图书馆，取得我要的书。\n\n按照要求，其中一位大祭司已被击倒，另一位则奖赏了我所需的钥匙。
src: The ruin warded against non-Dwarves to which I have traveled in search of a valuable book has an interesting history. Apparently the ward was raised by an alliance of the clerics of the good gods of the Dwarven pantheon and those of the evil Abbathor. After the ward was raised, however, the followers of Abbathor attempted to seize the now impregnable fortress for themselves, resulting in a civil war which ultimately ended in the death of all inhabitants. In the course of the war, however, various curses were called down resulting in those inhabitants remaining about in an undead state, waging a war that could never be ended as they simply re-animated when struck down. It appears, however, that these curses can be ended by the arrival of a living dwarf, myself. Striking down the high priest of one of the factions will end the curse and allow the war to be resolved. In return, the high priest of the other faction will give me a key that I will need to enter the library here and acquire the book I need.\n\nAs required, one of the high priests has been struck down, and the other has rewarded me with the key I require.

src: Izado has told us that the Harpers have discovered a portal in this region that can be used to return to Calimport, presumably our next destination after Candlekeep. This portal is located in the ruins of the Ulcaster mage academy, a school for the study of magic destroyed some time ago by rival mages form Calimshan. Now that we have reforged the Sword of Zefad at Candlekeep, we should go to the ruins of the Ulcaster school to meet Izado and determine our next move, which might well be to return to Calimport\n\nThe dragon Krakach'vraz'tar will surely bar our way to the ruins. He will be a dangerous opponent, as he is said to possess a healing artifact rendering him almost impossible to kill. However, it may now be possible to defeat him. One of my former comrades, Quord Dannareb, met me as I was departing Candlekeep and told me that he was on a quest to brind down this dragon. To do so, he had acquired a special cursed battleaxe that will counteract the dragon's healing artifact, and perhpas weaken him in other ways as well. For the curse to take effect, Quord will need to strike the dragon with the axe at least ten times. We have joined with Quord once more, and now go to confront the dragon with his aid.

src: While exploring the Underdark, I came across some Duergar who have a problem with a portal to the Abyss that was somehow opened in a mine they were running. They offered to hire me to close the portal for them. dst:
在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个叫布利夫敏·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取有魔法用途的试剂。他所说的“中央收集区”周围四个分站的机器一直出问题，他承诺如果我能帮忙解决他遇到的各种问题，就会给我报酬。

东北方的机器出了故障，在自身周围释放了一团毒气。我需要穿过这团毒气，承受它造成的任何伤害，关掉机器以便修理。

东南方的机器似乎有类似的问题，喷出了一些黏液，可能也有某种毒性。我也得冒险穿过它来关掉这台机器。

西北方的机器运转正常，但所在的房间里现在有食腐虫。这些怪物应该被清除掉。

西南方的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被某个不明人士扯走了。泽姆昆怀疑是某个罪犯偷走它去卖金子。他希望我能设法追查到肇事者并找回丢失的部件。我应该在这台机器附近调查，希望能找到一些线索。

完成上述任务后，我应该向泽姆昆汇报。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast is malfunctioning, and has released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I will need to move through this cloud, enduring whatever harm it inflicts, to shut off the machine so it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast has what appears to be a similar problem, having spewed forth some kind of slime, also likely toxic in some way. I shall have to risk moving through it to shut down this machine as well.

The machine to the northwest is functional, but in a room now occupied by otyughs. These monsters should be cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some unknown party. Zemquin suspects some criminal type stole this in order to sell the gold. He hopes I can somehow track down the perpetrator and recover the missing part. I should investigate in the vicinity of this machine in hopes of finding some clue.

When the above tasks have been accomplished, I should report back to Zemquin.

You reach out with shadowy energies, banishing your foe's spell or mystery into the Plane of Shadow while replacing it with its dark reflection.

You can cast this mystery as an immediate action to warp another caster's spell or mystery. In this case, warp spell must be used at the moment of the other caster's casting. To be successful, you must beat the other caster on an opposed caster level check (1d20 + caster level). If you do not, you have failed to take control of his spell or mystery, and it manifests normally. If you succeed on the opposed check, the other caster's mystery or spell is countered, and you gain one additional use of an apprentice-path mystery that you know. You can keep this additional use until a later turn (requiring a standard action to activate), but it must be used within 1 hour or it is lost.

dst:
纳什凯尔集市上一个名叫泽鲁博·泽德洛的侏儒设置了一台机器，有可能用来制造有用的灵药。要使用它，必须将炼金试剂放入机器，然后操作附近的一个拉杆，使用需要花费100金币。如果机器中放入了合适的试剂组合，里面就会生成一瓶灵药，我可以自由取用。然而，不合适的组合会消耗试剂和金币而毫无效果，甚至可能产生危险的爆炸。适合尝试的试剂包括火甲虫腹、妖精尘、食人魔蛛腺体、软泥或泥怪的脓液、沼莓、石化蜥蜴的眼睛、石像鬼头骨和蓝石英水晶。

泽鲁博要么不知道，要么不愿透露哪些具体组合会奏效，但他给了我两条提示：任何时候都不要将同类型的试剂放入机器超过一份，也不要放入超过组合所需数量的试剂，并尝试三种不同试剂的组合。

不幸的是，泽鲁博的机器发生了故障，无法再使用了。他预计最终会修好它，但这需要一些时间，而且很可能在我需要继续下一次冒险之前无法完成。大概我再也无法用它制造灵药了。
src:
A gnome at the Nashkel Fair named Zerubo Zedelo has set up a machine that can potentially be used to produce useful elixirs. To use it, one must place alchemcial reagents into the machine, and then operate a nearby lever, which requires the expendinture of 100 gold to use. If an appropriate combination of reagents was present in the machine, an elixir will be created within, which I would be free to take for my own use. However, an inappropriate combination will consume the reagents and gold to no useful effect, and might even produce a dangerous explosion. Appropriate reagents to attempt for this purpose include fire beetle bellys, fairy dust, ettercap glands, the ichor from a slime or ooze, fenberries, basilisk's eyes, gargoyle skulls and blue quartz crystals.

Zerubo either does not know or prefers to conceal which specific combinations will work, but has given me two hints: do not put more than one reagent of the same type into the machine at any given time or put in more reagents than are necessary for the combination, and attempt combinations of three separate reagents.

Unfortunately Zerubo's machine malfuntioned and will no longer work. He expects to repair it eventually, but it will take some time and will probably not be completed before I need to move on to my next adventure. Probably I will be making no more elixirs with it.

dst: 在神殿区下方的下水道里，我遇到了一个名叫奎尔扎特的鼠人，他与周围其他鼠人的敌对倾向不同，实际上他正在寻求治愈自己的兽化症。我已同意帮助他实现这一目标。他想要我获取一些他实施治疗所需的物品：一些颠茄、一本详细说明在敢真正服用颠茄之前如何正确制备它的书，以及一些用于实际进行上述制备的炼金设备。最后一项可以从一个商人那里获得，据奎尔扎特说，这个商人名叫“布林芬·内姆昆或坦昆之类的”。我拿到了一份物品清单，找到这个布林芬时要交给他。奎尔扎特不确定另外两件物品可能在哪里找到，但建议我去城里各家商店看看。\n\n我已经把颠茄和炼金设备给了奎尔扎特。我还需要把书带给他。
src: In the sewers beneath the temple district, I have encountered a wererat named Querzat, who does not share the hostile tendencies of the other wererats about, and in fact seeks a cure for his lycanthropic condition. I have agreed to help him achieve this goal. He wants me to obtain a number of items he will need to effect a cure: some belladonna, a book detailing the proper preparation for the belladonna before he dare actually ingest it, and some alchemical equipment to actually carry out said preparations. This last can be obtained from a merchant named, according to Querzat, "Blimfin Nemquin or Temquin or something." I have been given a list of items to present to this Blimfin when I locate him. Querzat is not sure where the other two items might be found, but suggests I check out the various stores in the city.\n\nI have given Querzat the belladonna and the alchemical equipment. I still need to bring him the book.

水精灵，也被称为海精灵，是文明且善良的海洋居民。大多数水精灵来自水下城市，但也能在沿海海域发现该种族的小型定居点。水精灵的头发通常细长浓密，战士剪短，其他人则留长。海精灵的皮肤呈深绿色或蓝色，带有不规则的细棕色或白色条纹和斑块，富有光泽。水精灵的眼睛颜色有蓝色，绿色以及绿色和金色混合的色调。

水精灵属性调整：+2 敏捷，-2 智力。
偏好职业（战士）：在判断兼职水精灵是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其战士职业不计入。

特殊能力：

- 无眠：免疫'睡眠'子类型的法咒和效果。
- 附魔坚韧：对抗影响心智的法咒的豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 水下呼吸：生物可以在水下呼吸，因此免疫溺毙和群体溺毙的效果。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（侦察）：侦察检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 敏锐感官：水精灵自动进行主动搜索检定，且没有移动惩罚。
- 微光视觉：使他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 精灵：在法咒效果方面，水精灵视为精灵。

（以下内容是否使用取决于模块开关设置）
等级调整：+1

src:
The aquatic elves, also known as sea elves, are civilized and good hearted people who inhabit the seas. Most aquatic elves hail from underwater cities but small settlements of this race can be found in the seas along the coast. Aquatic elves hair is usually stringy and thick, cut short for warriors but otherwise worn long. Sea elves have radiant skin of deep green or blue with irregular thin brown or white stripes and patches. Eye colors for aquatic elves come in blue, green, green and gold shades.

Aquatic Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Int.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass aquatic elf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Water Breathing: Creature can breath water and is therefore immune to the effects of Drown and Mass Drown.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Aquatic Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Aquatic Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)
Level Adjustment: +1
Racial Hit Dice/Class: NA

dst: “哈哈！终于自由了！只要我能到达传送门并穿过废墟就行。别担心，我的拷问者为了让我在他们的折磨下不死而赋予我的防护和再生不会立刻消失。我已经给了你承诺的钥匙。虽然舍不得，但此刻我一刻也不想在这个位面多待，所以它对我没用了。要找到通往巫妖命匣的路径，你得在塔楼正门入口处一个高台上寻找隐藏的活板门。可能还有其他密门、需要的其他钥匙之类的，我只探索了一小部分。总之，我现在要走了。”纳斯卡尔开始跑开。
src: "Ha ha! Free at last! If I can make it to the portal and through the ruins at any rate. Don't think it will be a problem, the protections and regenerattion my torturers gave me so I wouldn't die under their treatment won't wear off immediately. You already have the key I promised. Hated to part with it, but I'm not staying on this plane any longer than I have to at this point, so it's no use to me. To find the path to the lich's phylactery you'll have to look for a hidden trap door on a raised platform in the tower's main entrance. There could be other secret doors, other keys needed, or whatnot too, I only made a little progress. Anyway, I'm leaving now." Nathkar starts to run off.

Level: Clr 3

Range: Touch
Targets: One undead creature

This spell causes an undead creature to explode in a burst of powerful energy when struck for at least 1 point of damage, or at a set time no longer than the duration of the spell, whichever comes first. The explosion is a 10-foot radius burst that deals 1d6 points of damage for every two caster levels (maximum 10d6).

While this spell can be an effective form of attack against an undead creature, necromancers often use unliving weapon to create undead capable of suicide attacks (if such a term can be applied to something that is already dead). Skeletons or zombies with this spell cast upon them can be very dangerous to foes that would normally disregard them.

Material Component: A drop of bile and a bit of sulfur.

dst: "泰坦帮本该只是扰乱伊尔梅特信徒的活动并削弱他们的影响力，而不是烧杀抢掠一切。如此暴力的袭击自然招来了暴力的回应。先是这个泰夫林，1 级武者试图潜入并杀死大泰坦——他们老大的称呼——现在你又出现了。扶贫办公室里那些监督并付钱给泰坦帮的探员显然认定他们的钱花得不值。于是他们切断了泰坦帮的供给，并拒绝再与他们有任何瓜葛。大泰坦以他一贯的冷静和克制回应了这件事：他带着帮里的一大帮人穿过下水道里一条连接扶贫办公室的隧道，目的是杀死那里的所有人。"
src: "The Titans were supposed to disrupt Ilmaterian activities and reduce their effectiveness, not burn and pillage everything. Such a violent attack naturally provoked a violent response. First this Tiefling tries to sneak in and kill the Big Titan, as their boss is called, and now you show up. The agents in the Poverty Relief Office who were supervising and paying the Titans apparently decided they weren't getting their money's worth. So they cut the Titans off and refused to have anything further to do with them. The Big Titan responded to this with his usual calm and restraint: He's taken a good part of his gang through a tunnel in the sewers that connects to the Relief Office with the objective of killing everyone there."

src: In the course of my adventures, I earlier acquired a stange orb, with writing on it that it belongs to someone called Sathras, and a request to return it to this entity if possible. It might well be dangerous to keep it on this plane, so perhaps I should indeed return it if an opportunity to do so presents itself.\n\nI have found passage to what appears to be the Plane of Shadow, and a tower advertised as belonging to Sathras. src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Artificer level 4
Specifics: At 4th level, an artificer can create a homunculus as if he had the Craft Construct feat. He must emulate the spell requirements (arcane eye, mending, and mirror image) as normal for making a magic item, and he must pay all the usual gold and XP costs (though he can spend points from his craft reserve). An artificer can also upgrade an existing homunculus that he owns, adding 1 Hit Die at a cost of 2,000 gp and 160 XP.

If an artificer gives his homunculus more than 6 Hit Dice, it becomes a Small creature and advances as described in the Monster Manual (+4 Str, -2 Dex, damage increases to Id6). The homunculus also gains 10 extra hit points for being a Small construct.

An artificer's homunculus can have as many Hit Dice as its master's Hit Dice minus 2. No matter how many Hit Dice it has, a homunculus never grows larger than Small.

Use: Selected

They will not tolerate any direct attack against him on my part, and my own code requires that I respect their wishes on this matter, at least to a point. Unfortunately some action is required, for he has recently come into possession of a dangerous magical artifact, one that he stole from me, in fact, while I was taking it to a temple to be destroyed: a dark orb that breaks down the boundaries between this plane and another, a dark realm of shadow."

魂能形成一顶蓝白色头盔，形似霜虫的怪异头部。它漂浮在你头顶上方，其奇怪的块状形状在前方和顶部升起成一个高耸的结节。

佩戴霜冻头盔时，你获得寒冷坚忍专长。

魂质：如果你将魂质投入霜冻头盔，它还能保护你免受寒冷伤害。你获得等于你投入该灵魂融合体的魂质点数的5倍的寒冷抗力。

脉轮绑定（头部） 

你的霜冻头盔融合到你头顶，实际上在头盔顶部的奇怪结节中打开了一条呼吸通道。

作为一个标准动作，你可以从额头投射一道寒冷能量射线，令人联想到霜虫的喷吐武器。你必须进行一次远程接触攻击才能用此射线击中生物。如果击中，射线造成1d6点寒冷伤害，外加每点投入霜冻头盔的魂质额外1d6点。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

你的霜冻头盔融合到你的头部并似乎向下蔓延，改变你上半张脸的外观，使其类似霜虫的头部。你的眼睛融入头盔的奇怪结节，你的脸颊扭曲成块状突起，你面部的皮肤变得厚实且呈蓝白色。

作为一个标准动作，你可以发出一种颤音，使20英尺内的对手震慑。你可以瞄准一个生物，外加每点投入霜冻头盔的魂质额外一个生物。目标必须成功通过意志豁免，否则被震慑1d4轮。
src:
Frost Helm

Descriptors: Cold, sonic
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Crown (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms into a bluewhite helm resembling the bizarre head of a frost worm. It floats above the top of your head, its strange lumpy shape rising to a tall nodule at the front and top.

While wearing a frost helm, you gain the Cold Endurance feat.

Essentia: If you invest essentia in your frost helm, it also protects you from cold damage. You gain resistance to cold equal to 5 times the number of points of essentia you invest in this soulmeld. 

Chakra Bind (Crown) 

Your frost helm fuses to the top of your head, actually opening a breathing channel in the strange nodule at the helm's crown.

As a standard action, you can project a ray of cold energy from your forehead, reminiscent of a frost worm's breath weapon. You must make a ranged touch attack to hit a creature with this ray. If you hit, the ray deals 1d6 points of cold damage plus an additional 1d6 points for every point of essentia you invest in your frost helm. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your frost helm fuses to your head and seems to spread downward, changing the appearance of your upper face to resemble the head of a frost worm. Your eyes meld into the helm's strange nodule, your cheeks twist into lumpy protrusions, and the skin of your face grows thick and blue-white.

As a standard action, you can produce a trilling sound that stuns opponents within 20 feet. You can target one creature plus one additional creature per point of essentia you invest in your frost helm. Targets must succeed on a Will save or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

src: While exploring an abyssal plane, I found one Nathkar Notten, an adventurer who had earlier come to the same plane, only to be defeated and imprisoned by the Tanar'ri there. He has asked me to free him. In order to do so, I must exit the halls in which he is imprisoned to the east, where I should find a balor carrying a "master key" that can open his cell. The balor will need to be defeated and this key recovered. Apparently the key in question can open multiple doors in the Abyss, but can only be use one time, so I should make sure not to use it for anything else if I wish to free Nathkar. Nathkar claims to have another key, necessary to reach the pylactery of a lich residing in a tower to the west, that he will give me in rerturn for freeing him.\n\nI recovered the master key, but ended up using it for something else. Unfortunately for Nathkar, that means there is no longer any way to free him.

src: I have met with Zagash the Terrible, a lich who I discovered occupying a room at the Desert Dragon Inn, of all places. He had an interesting offer to make me. Apparently the aranea who are seemingly orchestrating a war against Calimshan somehow discovered his phylactery. They have used their control of it to weaken Zagash and reduce his power, and intend to use the threat of destroying it (and therefore him) for good to blackmail him into serving their cause. Zagash however has no intention of letting them order him around and has conceived a plan to travel in disguise with a group of adventurers to fight against them. As a result, he is prepared to join with me on my quests outside the city to fight the various humanoid allies of the aranea.\n\nI am not certain if I want to work with such a creature. I have turned down his offer for now, but may reconsider.

This invocation (Lesser; 4th; Eldritch Essence), learned at 3rd level, allows you to place an arcane spell that affects an area upon your eldritch blast. If the eldritch blast hits its target, the spell's area is centered on any corner of the target's space, even if the spell could normally be centered only on the caster. If the eldritch blast misses its target, the spell is lost with no effect.

It takes a full-round action to cast the spell and fire the eldritch blast. Only an area spell with a casting time no greater than 1 standard action can be placed upon your eldritch blast.

Only the first target of your eldritch blast is affected by the spell (for example, an eldritch chain spellblast centers the spell on the initial target, not on any of the secondary targets). If your eldritch blast doesn't specify a target, you can't apply this invocation to the blast.

Treat spellblast as a spell whose level is equal to the area spell placed upon the eldritch blast (minimum 4th level).

src:
Psychokinesis [see text]
Level: Psion/wilder 3
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal and close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels); see text
Targets: You and creature or object attacking you; see text
Duration: 1 min./level
Saving Throw: Reflex half or Fortitude half; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 5
Metapsionics: Chain, Empower, Extend, Maximize

Upon manifesting this power, you choose cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You weave a field of potential energy of the chosen type around your body. The first successful attack made against you in each round during the power's duration prompts a response from the field without any effort on your part. The attack may be physical, the effect of a power, or the effect of a spell (including spell-like, supernatural, and extraordinary abilities). An 'ectoburst' discharges from the field, targeting the source of the attack and dealing 4d6 points of damage of the chosen energy type. To be affected, a target must be within close range. The ectoburst is a ranged touch attack.

Cold: A field of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die. The saving throw to reduce damage from a cold retort is a Fortitude save instead of a Reflex save.
Electricity: Manifesting a field of this energy type provides a +2 bonus to the save DC and a +2 bonus on manifester level checks for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
Fire: A field of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.
Sonic: A field of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, this power's duration increases by 1 minute.

Brownies are benign and exceedingly nimble creatures that may be related very distantly to halflings. Peaceful and friendly, brownies live in pastoral regions, foraging and gleaning their food.

A brownie stands no taller than 2 feet and weighs about 6 pounds. Their garments are usually made of wool or linen and dyed bright colors and decorated with elaborate embroidery or trimmed with silver or gold studs and buttons.

Brownie Ability Adjustments: -6 Strength, +10 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass Brownie's wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Brownies are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Bonus (Craft Weapon): +2 racial bonus to Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Bonus (Craft Armor): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor checks.
- Skill Bonus (Craft Trap): +2 racial bonus to Craft Trap checks.
- Skill Bonus (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Bonus (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Uncanny Dodge: Brownies retains his Dex bonus to AC, even if caught flat-footed or attacked by a hidden or invisible creature.
- Evasion: Whenever a Reflex save is allowed for half damage, Brownies instead takes no damage if they succeed at the save.
- Hide in Plain Sight: Brownies are able to use the Hide skill even while being observed.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Confusion. Caster level 7th plus character level. The DC is Charisma-based.
- Fey: Brownies are considered Fey for the purpose of spells.

This decrease changes the creature's size category to the next smaller one. The target gains a +2 size bonus to Dexterity, a -2 size penalty to Strength (to a minimum of 1), and a +1 bonus on attack rolls and AC due to its reduced size.
A Small humanoid creature whose size decreases to Tiny has a space of 2-1/2 feet and a natural reach of 0 feet (meaning that it must enter an opponent's square to attack). A Large humanoid creature whose size decreases to Medium has a space of 5 feet and a natural reach of 5 feet. This spell doesn't change the target's speed.  Multiple magical effects that reduce size do not stack.

Reduce person counters and dispels enlarge person.
Reduce person can be made permanent with a permanency spell.

Transmutation

Satyrs are a hedonistic race of creatures that frolic in the wilds.  They love fine food, strong drink, and passionate romance. 精灵民是人类和各种自然精灵的后裔。他们分为三个特定亚种，每个亚种对不同的元素有轻微亲和，提供对抗该元素的豁免加值和另一个额外能力。他们往往宁静平和，与周围环境和谐相处，很少表现出用魔法操控它们的欲望。在身体上他们看起来像人类，有小嘴和细长的眼睛。他们往往有白皙或金色的肤色，没有体毛，尽管头上的头发相当华丽。

- 人类：精灵民在法咒效果上被视为人类。

选择一种精灵民类型：
- 竹：学识+2加值，对抗酸液法咒豁免+2，无痕步。在野外环境中躲藏+4。
- 河：免疫溺水，对抗寒冷法咒豁免+2。
- 海：免疫溺水，对抗火焰法咒豁免+2。
- 山：攀爬+8加值，平衡，跳跃，和翻滚+2加值。
src:
Spirit folk are the descendants of humans and various spirits of nature.  They come in three specific subtypes, each of which has a slight affinity to a different element, granting a bonus to saves vs that element and another additional ability.  They tend to be serene and calm, in tune with their surroundings, and show little desire of manipulating them with magic.  Physically they look human, with small mouths and slender eyes.  They tend to have a fair or golden complexion, and no body hair, though the hair on their head is fairly luxurious.

Spirit Folk Ability Adjustments: None.
Favored Class (Any): A multiclass spirit folk's highest class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Human: Spirit Folk are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

Choose one type of Spirit Folk:
- Bamboo: +2 bonus to Lore, +2 saves against acid spells, Trackless Step. +4 to hide in wilderness settings.
- River: Immune to drowning, +2 to save vs cold spells.
- Sea: Immune to drowning, +2 to save vs fire spells.
- Mountain: +8 bonus to Climb, +2 bonus to Balance, Jump, and Tumble.

src:
Epic Talons of Tiamat are the chosen claws of dragonkind's darkest queen, spreading her wrath and dominion across the realms. Empowered by draconic fury and ancient magic, they become living engines of destruction, breathing elemental death, sowing terror with their presence, and turning even mighty dragons into pawns of their will. Whether clad in steel or shrouded in sorcery, they are avatars of chromatic vengeance, feared by all who stand with metallic dragons and loathed as heretics by the righteous. Wherever they walk, Tiamat's shadow follows.

Hit Die: d8
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Talon of Tiamat gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:

Spellcasting: At each odd class level the epic Talon of Tiamat continues to increase in arcane caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

src:
Zagan, Duke of Disappointment
  
On the cusp of deification, Zagan lost all he had worked for. As a vestige, he offers his summoners a snake's sense of smell, the power to cause an enemy flee his presence, the ability to immobilize an opponent, and more effective combat abilities against snakes and their ilk.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: No

Influence: While influenced by Zagan, you become domineering and aggressive. Zagan requires that you slay any snake or snakelike being you meet, and deface any representations of snakes or snakelike beings other than Zagan that you find.

Granted Abilities: 
Zagan grants you a snake's ability to detect creatures by scent, the ability to grapple and constrict as a snake, increased combat ability against snakes and their cousins, and the power to cause your foes to avoid your mere presence.

Aversion: As a standard action, you can create a compulsion effect targeting any creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a Will save or gain an aversion to you. An affected creature must stay at least 20 feet away from you; if already within 20 feet, the target moves away. Aversion is a mind-affecting compulsion ability. After using this ability, you must wait 5 rounds before using it again.

Improved Grapple: You gain the benefit of the Improved Grapple feat. In addition, you are considered to be of Large size for the purpose of making grapple checks.

Scent: You gain the scent special quality.

Constrict: You gain a giant constrictor's ability to crush the life from its prey. You deal damage equal to 1d8 + 1-1/2 * your Str modifier with a successful grapple check, in addition to your normal unarmed damage.

Reptile Bane: Zagan's grants you +2 melee attack and +2d6 damage on melee attacks against reptilian creatures.

src: "Well, whether that reputation was fair or not, he certainly conducted many magical experiments whose results were quite interesting in spite of his alleged insanity. Or perhaps they were interesting because of it? But that is really beside the point at the moment. What you need to know is that Zeko wrote up a journal detailing the results of his various experiments, copies of which at one time circulated freely. Various authorities, however, decided that the magical knowledge he had uncovered was too dangerous to fall into just any hands, and went about seizing and destroying copies of his journal. As a result copies are hard to come by and considered quite valuable."

src:
Type of Feat: Binding
Prerequisite: None
Benefit: To contact a vestige, you must draw its unique seal visibly on a surface (generally the ground), making the image at least 5 feet across. Drawing a seal requires the ability to mark a surface and 1 minute of concentration, and the act provokes attacks of opportunity. A vestige might also have other requirements for contact, as noted in its entry.

Once the seal is drawn, you must perform a ritual requiring a full-round action to summon the corresponding vestige. The ritual fails if you cannot be heard (for example, if you are within the area of a silence spell).

To make a pact with your summoned vestige, you must make a binding check (1d20 + your effective binder level + your Cha modifier). This process requires 1 minute, but you can choose to make a rushed binding check as a full-round action at a -10 penalty. The DC for this check is provided in the description of each vestige.

Whether the binding check succeeds or fails, you gain the powers granted by the vestige for 24 hours. During that time, you cannot rid yourself of the vestige unless you possess the Expel Vestige feat. Success or failure does, however, determine other aspects of the pact. If you fail the binding check, you have made a poor pact, and take a -1 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and checks until that vestige leaves you. If you fail multiple binding checks, the penalties stack.

The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against any power granted by a vestige is 10 + 1/2 your effective binder level + your Cha modifier.
Special: Binding a vestige via this feat only grants one vestige ability

等级：心灵术士 3
