你迫使目标在一次速度爆发性的呼气中排空其全部空气，从而扰乱目标的自主呼吸循环。在异能持续时间内，目标的肺不会自动恢复功能。

如果目标在呼吸危机显能时通过意志豁免，则不受此异能影响。如果意志豁免失败，它仍可以通过留在原地喘气来继续呼吸。

受影响的生物可以尝试正常行动（而不是有意识地控制呼吸），但从意志豁免失败的那一轮开始，它每这样做一轮，目标就有因缺氧而昏厥的风险。在它没有有意识地呼吸的任何回合结束时，它必须通过强韧豁免。在第一次没有呼吸之后的每一连续轮中，此豁免的 DC 增加 1；如果目标花费一个动作来呼吸，DC 降回其原始值。

如果目标强韧豁免失败，它降至 1 点生命值。在下一轮，它降至 -1 点生命值并濒死。

增幅：你可以通过以下一种或多种方式增幅此异能。
1. 如果你额外花费 2 点异能点，此异能也可以影响动物，精类，巨人，魔法兽或人形怪物。
2. 如果你额外花费 4 点异能点，此异能除上述生物类型外，还可以影响异怪，龙类，元素或异界生物。
3. 如果你额外花费 6 点异能点，此异能可以影响至多四个生物，全部位于 20 尺半径速度爆发范围内。
此外，你每额外花费 2 点异能点来实现上述任何效果，此异能的豁免 DC 增加 1。
src:
Telepathy (Compulsion) [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Telepath 3
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./ level)
Target: One breathing humanoid
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates, Fortitude partial; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 5
Metapsionics: Extend, Twin, Widen

You compel the subject to purge its entire store of air in one explosive exhalation, and thereby disrupt the subject's autonomic breathing cycle. The subject's lungs do not automatically function again while the power's duration lasts.

If the target succeeds on a Will save when crisis of breath is manifested, it is unaffected by this power. If it fails its Will save, it can still continue to breathe by remaining in place and gasping for breath.

An affected creature can attempt to take actions normally (instead of consciously controlling its breathing), but each round it does so, beginning in the round when it failed its Will save, the subject risks blacking out from lack of oxygen. It must succeed on a Fortitude save at the end of any of its turns in which it did not consciously take a breath. The DC of this save increases by 1 in every consecutive round after the first one that goes by without a breath; the DC drops back to its original value if the subject spends an action to take a breath.

If a subject fails a Fortitude save, it falls to 1 HP. In the following round, it drops to -1 hit points and is dying.

Augment: You can augment this power in one or more of the following ways.
1. If you spend 2 additional power points, this power can also affect an animal, fey, giant, magical beast, or monstrous humanoid.
2. If you spend 4 additional power points, this power can also affect an aberration, dragon, elemental, or outsider in addition to the creature types mentioned above.
3. If you spend 6 additional power points, this power can affect up to four creatures all within a 20-ft.-radius burst.
In addition, for every 2 additional power points you spend to achieve any of these effects, this power's save DC increases by 1.

dst:
你存在于以太位面。在以太位面时，生物被称为灵体生物。与非实体生物不同，灵体生物不存在于物质位面。

对于物质位面上的生物而言，灵体生物是隐形的，无声的，无形的，无气味的。甚至大多数魔法攻击对它们也无效。识破隐形和真知术可以揭示灵体生物。

灵体生物无法影响物质位面，即使是魔法也不行。然而，灵体生物与其他灵体生物和物体的互动方式，就像物质生物与物质生物和物体的互动方式一样。

即使物质位面上的生物能看到灵体生物，灵体生物仍处于另一个位面。只有力场效果可以影响灵体生物。另一方面，如果两个生物都是灵体生物，它们可以正常地相互影响。
src:
You exist on the Ethereal Plane. While on the Ethereal Plane, a creature is called ethereal. Unlike incorporeal creatures, ethereal creatures are not present on the Material Plane.

Ethereal creatures are invisible, inaudible, insubstantial, and scentless to creatures on the Material Plane. Even most magical attacks have no effect on them. See invisibility and true seeing reveal ethereal creatures.

An ethereal creature can't affect the Material Plane, not even magically. An ethereal creature, however, interacts with other ethereal creatures and objects the way material creatures interact with material creatures and objects.

Even if a creature on the Material Plane can see an ethereal creature the ethereal creature is on another plane. Only force effects can affect the ethereal creatures. If, on the other hand, both creatures are ethereal, they can affect each other normally.

I fear they have even worse planned for the future."

dst: 在扎泽斯普尔下方的下水道中，我遇到了一位名叫贾尔凯西·扎鲁的冒险者，随后一路杀穿了一个蛇人藏身处，将她从陷阱中救出。据她说，蛇人来到这里是为了在城下更深处矮人沙纳塔的废墟中寻找某件有价值的东西。她不知道他们在寻找什么，但如果它重要到值得付出如此努力，那么无论它是什么，落入这些可疑之人手中都绝非好事。附近有一条向下通往这些废墟的道路，无疑有更多蛇人把守。我决定陪她一起沿这条路前进，挫败蛇人的计划。该下去了。\n\n看来蛇人来到这里是为了重新打开一道通往深渊的传送门，这道门是矮人很久以前发现并封印的。自然，阻止他们这样做是明智的，或者如果我们来不及阻止它被打开，就设法关闭传送门。矮人的一些铭文表明，传送门由位于传送门另一侧深渊中一座塔内的某种魔法维持开启，而矮人存放在一个“谜题室”中的钥匙或许能帮助我们进入那里。
src: In the sewers beneath Zazesspur, I came across an adventurer named Jalkesi Tzaru, and then fought through a Yuan-Ti hideout to free her from a trap. According to her, the Yuan-Ti are here to seek out something of value in some ruins of dwarven Shanatar that can be found further beneath the city. She does not know what they seek, but if it is important enough to be worth such effort, it can hardly be desirable for whatever it might be to fall into such dubious hands. A path leading down and eventually to these ruins lies nearby, doubtless guarded by additional Yuan-Ti. I have decided to accompany her as she seeks to follow this path and foil the plans of the Yuan-Ti. Time to head down.\n\nIt appears that the Yuan-Ti are here to reopen a portal to the Abyss that the dwarves uncovered, but then sealed, long ago. Naturally it would be desirable to prevent them from doing this, or somehow close the portal if we are too late to prevent it from being uncovered. Some inscriptions of the dwarves suggest that the portal is kept open by some magic located in a tower in the Abyss on the far side of the portal, and that a key stored by the dwarves in a "Puzzle Room" might aid us in entering it.

dst: 住在码头附近一所房子里的凯拉·肯尼曼请求我找到她的丈夫本，并让他回家。据她说，我可以在欢憩客栈找到他，他正和朋友克拉夫·德尔森一起喝酒。\n\n克拉夫·德尔森让我去泪之屋（伊尔梅特的一座神殿）找本·肯尼曼，那里的一位祭司告诉我本去市场购买工具了。那里的一位商人告诉我他去了家具店。家具店的店主告诉我，本从那里离开后去拜访了一位名叫伦斯·门纳德的朋友，而门纳德又告诉我，他已经回到欢憩客栈再次与克拉夫会面。回到客栈后，我终于追上了本，并转达了他妻子的口信。然后我回到肯尼曼家，得到了一张旧地图作为报酬，上面标出了下水道中一扇暗门的位置，在应对各种危险之后，我最终应该能在那里找到一些宝藏。
src: Kyra Kenemen, who resides in a house near the docks, has asked me to locate her husband, Ben, and ask him to return home. According to her, I can expect to find him at the Winsome Repose Inn, drinking with his friend Clav Derlson.\n\nClav Derlson told me to look for Ben Kenement at the House of Tears (a temple of Ilmater), and a priest there told me Ben had gone shopping for tools in the markets. A merchant there told me that he went to the furniture store. The proprietor of the furniture store informed me that Ben had gone on from there to visit a friend of his named Rence Mennald, and Mennald, in turn, told me that he had headed back to the Winsome Repose Inn to meet with Clav again. Returning to the inn, I finally caught up with Ben, and  delivered his wife's message. I then returned to the Kenemen home, and was rewarded with an old map pointing the way to a secret door in the sewers behind which I should eventually, after dealing with various hazards, find some treasure.

src:
An epic Swift Wing is more than a servant of the divine, they are the very breath, muscle, and will of the sacred dragon they revere. Their connection to draconic divinity becomes seamless, a fusion of holy purpose and ancient power. Their breath heals armies and scours the undead from the battlefield in blazing waves of divine flame. With wings unfurled and energy flowing through every fiber, they strike with celestial fury and soar above mortal bounds. In body and spirit, the epic swift wing is the swift vengeance and swift salvation of their god, wreathed in light, cloaked in scales, and unstoppable in purpose.

Hit Die: d8
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Swift Wing gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:
Breath of Life: The epic Swift Wing's Breath of Life continues to gain +1d6 damage vs undead every class level.
Spellcasting: At each class level the epic Swift Wing continues to increase in divine caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Epic Swift Wing Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Epic Divine Might, Epic Divine Shield, Epic Divine Resistance, Epic Divine Vigor, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Prowess, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Toughness, Epic Reputation, Fast Healing, Focused Spell Penetration, Great Charisma, Great Intelligence, Great Wisdom, Improved Combat Casting, Invoke Divine Wrath, Perfect Health, Planar Turning, Superior Initiative, Tenacious Magic, Zone Of Animation.

dst: 这种史莱姆是奥术实验的产物，拥有极强的再生能力，被设计为战士的克星。对于非施法者来说，它们可能相当难以对付。它们不仅完全免疫物理伤害，而且任何物理攻击都有很大几率导致史莱姆的一部分分裂出来，变成新的敌人。相比之下，它们对魔法攻击没有特别的防护，并且极易受到元素伤害。然而，没有强大施法者的冒险队伍，最好还是避开它们。
src: The product of arcane experiments, slimes of this type have extremely high regenerative powers and are intended to be the bane of warriors. They can be quite difficult for non-casters to fight. Not only are they completely immune to physical damage, but any physical attack has a good chance of causing part of the slime to split off and become a new enemy. By contrast, they have no particular protections against magical attack, and are highly vulnerable to elemental damage. Adventuring parties without powerful casters, however, might do better to simply avoid them.

变形者是兽化人与人类的远亲后裔，有时被称为兽触者。他们不再能完全变形，而是通过一种名为变形的独特能力获得其某些特征。他们是一个独特的种族，能够稳定遗传，更倾向于在野外形成小型社区和村庄，而非居住在城市中。他们的性格往往受到与其相关的动物的影响。他们基本上是人形，但以蹲伏的姿势移动，跳跃奔跑，而同伴则正常行走。他们的面容带有兽性，鼻子宽而扁平，眼睛大，耳朵尖，两性都有长鬓角。他们的前臂和小腿长出长毛，头发浓密而长。

变形者属性调整：+2 敏捷，-2 智力，-2 魅力。
偏好职业（巡林客）：兼职变形者的巡林客职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 基础移动速度 30。
- 变形：变形者可以获得其兽化人血统的特征。这使他们在 3+体质 轮内获得一项属性加值，每天可使用一次。变形者专长可以延长时间，增加每日使用次数，并添加其他效果。
- 微光视觉：变形者在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 兽性血统：变形者因其野性血统在跳跃和平衡上获得 +2 加值。
- 变形生物：在法咒效果上，变形者被视为变形生物。
src:
Shifters are the distant descendants of lycanthropes and humans, sometimes called the weretouched.  They can no longer fully change form, but instead take on aspects of it in a unique ability called shifting.  They are a unique race that breeds true, and prefer to form small communities and villages out in the wilds rather than live in cities.  Their personality tends to be influenced by the animal they relate to.  They are basically humanoid in shape, but move in a crouched posture, springing and leaping while their companions walk alongside normally.  Their faces have a bestial cast, with wide, flat noses, large eyes, pointed ears, and long sideburns on both genders.  Their forearms and lower legs grow long hair, and they wear their hair on their head thick and long.

Shifter Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Int, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass shifter's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Base movement of 30.
- Shifting: Shifters can assume aspects of their lycanthropic heritage.  This grants them a bonus to one stat for 3+Con rounds, usable once per day.  Shifter feats can extend the time and add uses per day, as well as add other effects.
- Low-Light Vision: Shifters can see better than normal in the dark.
- Animalistic Heritage: Shifters gain a +2 to Jump and Balance from their feral heritage.
- Shapeshifter: Shifters are considered Shapeshifters for the purpose of spells.

dst: "这份悬赏适合像你这样拥有奥术才能的人。我们最近发现，臭名昭著的法师戴尔拉格伪造了自己的死亡，并且就在我们纳什凯尔这里的墓地正下方建造了一个藏身之处！对某个‘已死’的人来说，这倒也算是个合适的地方，我想。无论如何，既然现在已经知道戴尔拉格还活着，他的脑袋上就还挂着一份20000金币的悬赏。不过，要拿到它恐怕并不容易。当他在这里的藏身处被发现时，他通过某种传送门逃走了，而那传送门在他过去之后就关闭了。他的巢穴里显然有一些魔法装置可以用来再次打开这个传送门，但没人能弄明白它们是怎么运作的。据说那是一套相当复杂的魔法程序。也许你可以去看看？"
src: "This is a bounty appropriate for someone with arcane talents like you. We recently discovered that the notorious mage Daer'Ragh had faked his death and had constructed a hideout of sorts just beneath our cemetery here in Nashkel! An appropriate place for someone who was 'dead,' I suppose. At any rate, now that Daer'Ragh is known to be alive, there is an outstanding bounty on his head of 20000 gold. It might not prove easy to collect, however. When his hiding place here was discovered, he fled through some sort of portal that closed after he went through it. There are apparently some magical devices in his lair that could be used to open this portal again, but no one has been able to figure out how they work. Apparently it is a rather complicated magical procedure. Perhaps you could take a look?"

dst: 扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角落”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。森卡尔要求我找到对历史研究有价值的东西作为他完成这项工作的代价，而我也在黑暗卡林港找到了一块写有文字的古碑，他认为这令人满意。\n\n森卡尔花了几天时间研究此事，现在交给我一个包裹，里面装着研究结果。我应该把它送给扎拉拉。
src: Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. Senkhar demanded that I find something of value to historical research as his price to carry out this job, and I duly found an ancient tablet with some writing on it in Dark Calimport, which he accepted as satisfactory.\n\nSenkhar took a couple of days to research the matter and has now presented me with a packet containing the results. I should deliver it to Zarala.

Type of Feat: Spell List
Prerequisite: Shadowlord.
Specifics: He may cast some spells (Confusion, Invisibility Sphere).

Confusion
Range: Medium
Area of Effect / Target: Large
Duration: 1 Round / Level
Save: Will Negates
Spell Resistance: Yes
Affected creatures either wander randomly, attack a random target, or simply stand still.

Invisibility Sphere
Range: Personal
Area of Effect / Target: Caster, 15ft Radius
Duration: 1 Turn / Level
Save: Harmless
Spell Resistance: No
The caster brings into being a zone of invisibility that travels with him for the duration of the spell. All allies within the spell's area of effect are rendered invisible, but not to each other. Those that leave the sphere are visible once more.

src: The Temple of Tyr has dispatched a group of clerics and paladins into the sewers beneath the temple district in an attempt to fight the newly aggressive wererats causing trouble there. They have yet to report back. Adaras Efzen, a high-ranking cleric in the Temple of Tyr, has asked me to enter the sewers and determine what has happened to them, assisting them if necessary. Ferazha, priestess at the temple of Shar, wants me to follow in their wake, determine their fate, and insure that none of them make it out of the sewer alive. I will have to decide whether I wish to assist these Tyrrans or kill them.\n\nI have located the Tyrran party and provided them some assistance in a battle with wererats. They have decided they will need to rest and regroup before heading further into the sewers, and plan to return to the temple. I can either report this to Adaras, or kill them before they have a chance to depart.

dst:
我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎捕海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向纳兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭海盗。据船员说，这些海盗是一群牛头人，他们一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次袭击。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗海盗。

船长计划在即将到来的袭击中利用我的才能，要求扎拉拉和我，以及几名船员，乘坐一艘小船绕到岛屿北侧，在隐形法术的掩护下，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则攻击南边的主力海盗。我们登陆并开始了袭击，但在与牛头人战斗的过程中，我们触发了一个陷阱，重石砸向我们，同时把我们丢到了下层。我们的一些队员在这个过程中牺牲了，现在我们需要找到出路，离开这个似乎是某种迷宫的地方，同时抵御牛头人和这里可能存在的其他东西的攻击。

在岛屿深处寻找出路时，我们遇到了一个巫妖的投影，他自称是扭曲符文会的伊尔库泽拉姆，显然是海盗的某种盟友或赞助者。他要求我把扎拉拉和泽法德之剑的碎片交给他，以便符文会可以利用它们来挑战阿兹古尔卡。当我拒绝时，他迫使我们穿过一系列由他的各种爪牙守卫的房间，最后我们面对了巫妖本人。我们能够击败他，但如果没有他的命匣，巫妖无法被永久杀死。尽管如此，我能够关闭他本来会用来返回战斗的传送门，所以我们应该不会受到他的威胁。是时候继续前进，找到离开这个地方的路了。
src:
Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.

The captain's plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault called for Zarala and me, along with several of the crew, to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, under cover of an invisibility spell, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We landed and commenced our assault, but in the process of fighting the minotaurs ended up springing a trap, which dropped heavy rocks on us while dumping us into a lower level. Some of our party was lost in the process, and now we will need to find our way out of what appears to be some sort of maze, while fending off attacks from minotaurs and whatever else might be down here.

Going deeper beneath the island in search of a way out, we encountered the projection of a lich who identified himself as Ilkuzeram of the Twisted Rune, apparently some sort of ally or sponsor of the pirates. He demanded that I turn over Zarala and the fragments of the Sword of Zefad to him, so that the Rune could use them to challenge Azghulkar. When I refused, he forced us to fight through a series of chambers guarded by various minions of his, and at the end we faced the lich himself. We were able to defeat him, but without access to his phylactery a lich cannot be slain permanently. Nevertheless, I was able to close the portal he would have used to return to the fray, so we should be safe from him. Time to move on and find a way out of this place.

src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a human mage named Mavereth Tharapen, who has taken up temporary residence in an underground cave while he conducts research into the exotic magics peculiar to the Underdark. He asked me to find three items of significance to his research: an eye from a Basilisk, ichor from a Gelatinous Cube or similar slime, and brain matter from an Intellect Devourer. All are creatures that it should be possible to find somewhere in the Underdark. He has promised to pay me 4000 gold for each of these items, and to give me a special magical item in addition if I collect all three. Time to go hunting I suppose.

dst:
巨魔是食肉生物，从苔原到沙漠的各种气候中都能找到。它们缺乏恐惧，这使它们成为优秀的战士，毫不犹豫地投入战斗。巨魔以贪婪的食欲闻名，常常在定居点附近建立巢穴，以便猎食在那里居住的生物。典型的巨魔身高 9 英尺，体重约 500 磅，雌性略大于雄性。它们橡胶般的皮肤呈苔绿色或腐灰色，头发通常为绿黑色或铁灰色。

巨魔属性调整：+12 力量，+4 敏捷，+12 体质，-4 智力，-4 魅力，-2 感知。
天赋职业（战士）：兼职巨魔的战士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

src:
Trolls are carnivorous creatures found in all climates, from tundra to desert. Their lack of fear makes them excellent fighters, launching into combat without hesitation. Known for their ravenous appetites, trolls will often establish lairs near settlements in order to hunt the creatures that make their dwelling there. A typical troll stands 9 feet tall and weighs about 500 pounds, with females being slightly larger than males. Their rubbery hide is moss green or putrid gray, and their heir is generally greenish black or iron gray in color.

Troll Ability Adjustments: +12 Str, +4 Dex, +12 Con, -4 Int, -4 Cha, -2 Wis.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass troll's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Trolls are able to see in the dark.
- Track: +1 racial bonus to Spot, Search and Listen checks.
- Natural Weapon: Trolls can make an natural bite attack and attack with claws.
- Rend: It a troll hits with both its claws, it deals additional damage.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 5.
- Regeneration: Innate ability to regenerate 5 hit points per round.
- Large Creature: Trolls suffer -1 penalties to their Attack and Armor Class, and -4 to their Hide skill.
- Giant: Trolls count as Giants for the purpose of spells.

They have learned of the existence of a powerful artifact associated with their god, an ancient idol of the Netherese god known as Kozah, who appears to have been what Talos called himself in those times. This idol can apparently be found in some old ruin nearby, and these Talosians believe that recovering it will bring them great power. Given their beliefs, such power will surely be used to bring death and destruction upon the land. They must be stopped, and I do not think I am powerful enough to fight them all, especially after the power I have expended defeating those I have encountered so far. It seems you might be, though."

src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.\n\nKalomas has teleported me to the camp. Now I should meet up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
 Prerequisite: Ironsoul Forgemaster 9
 Specifics: At 9th level, you create a special bond with any weapon that you craft. This bond allows you to invest essentia in the weapon as if it were a soulmeld. Doing so grants you a bonus equal to twice the invested essentia on your damage rolls. If you have at least 1 point of essentia invested in the weapon, it also dazes any living opponent you strike with it for 1 round (Fortitude negates, DC 10 + invested essentia + Con modifier). You gain this ability only while using the weapon. If you unequip the weapon, you lose the soulmeld.
Use: Selected

Speaking of which, the letter indicates that you had a direct encounter with one of these monks. The letter describes what happened, but I'd like you to detail the incident in your own words, if you please. I find it's best, where possible, to get information directly from eyewitnesses."

src:
An epic Iron Mind stands as an unbreakable bastion against psychic assault, her will as tempered as the armor she wears. With unshakable focus and hardened discipline, she deflects enchantments and mind control with effortless resolve. Her presence radiates mental fortitude, empowering allies and punishing those who dare probe her thoughts. In the epic tiers, the Iron Mind becomes the embodiment of pure, unyielding resistance.

Hit Die: d10
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Iron Mind gains a bonus feat every five levels

Special:
Armoured Mind: The epic Iron Mind continues to gain a use of Armoured Mind every three class levels.
Damage Reduction: The epic Iron Mind's Damage Reduction continues to grow by +1 every three class levels.
Mind Over Body: The epic Iron Mind continues to gain a use of Mind Over Body every three class levels.
Manifesting: At each class level the epic Iron Mind continues to increase in manifester level (and powers known, if applicable).

Epic Iron Mind Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Prowess, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Overwhelming Critical, Epic Psionic Feats, Great Wisdom, Great Constitution, Superior Initiative.

src:
Water genasi are patient and independent, used to solving problems on their own and not afraid to take a lot of time doing so. At times they are fierce and destructive like terrible storms, but more often than not they present a tranquil appearance, despite whatever emotions run underneath that quiet surface. Water genasi look human except one distinguishing feature related to their elemental ancestor like: blue-green skin or hair, large black-blue eyes or clammy flesh.

Air Genasi Ability Adjustments: +2 Con. -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass water genasi's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Note: Genasi clerics must have the relevant elemental domain.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Water Genasi can see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Water: +1 racial bonus on saving throws against water and cold spells (additional +1 for every 5 levels).
- Water Breathing: Creature can breath water and is therefore immune to the effects of Drown and Mass Drown.
- Outsider: Water Genasi are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.
- Human: Water Genasi are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

src:
Claws of the Wyrm

Descriptors: Draconic
Classes: Soulborn, totemist
Chakra: Arms, hands (totem)
Saving Throw: None

A pair of dragonlike units, wreathed in blue fire, hover above your own arms and mimic your actions. The arms have long, sharp talons of cerulean light.

This soulmeld draws on the most basic of draconic attack forms, granting you claws that deal damage of 1d6 points if you are Medium. 1d4 if you are Small, or 1d8 if you are Large.

Essentia: For every point of essentia invested in your claws of the wyrm, you gain a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls made with the claws.

Chakra Bind (Arms)

The dragon arms settle onto your forearms, though the claws remain loose from your hands. The fire of the arms is reduced, but they glow with a dull inner light.

The threat range of your claws of the wyrm doubles (to 19-20).

Chakra Bind (Hands)

The dragon claws bind to your hands, lengthening and growing serrated spines.

The damage dealt by your claws of the wyrm improves by one step (from 1d6 to 1d8, if you are Medium).

Chakra Bind (Totem)

dst: 在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给提尔神殿的首席祭司阿达拉斯看时，他认出这是不久前被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。他因我归还找到的碎片而奖赏了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，他也想要。\n\n找到圣环的第二块碎片后，阿达拉斯告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，他可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。他还承诺如果我完成这次取回任务，将给予丰厚的奖励。我接受了这个任务，并被传送到某处一座隐藏的陵墓。最后一块戒指碎片无疑就在附近，但和前两块一样由不死生物守卫，所以我必须谨慎行事。我还必须记住，我返回时界门会崩塌，所以在取回最后一块碎片之前我不应该返回。
src: In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Adaras, the head priest of the Temple of Tyr, he recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. He rewarded me for returning the piece I found, and has told me that he would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find.\n\nHaving found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Adaras that with two pieces of the ring, he could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. He also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I have accepted this quest and been transported to a hidden tomb somewhere. The final ring fragment is doubtless about, but is guarded by undead as the first two were so I must proceed with caution. I must also remember that the portal will collapse when I return, so I should not do so until the final piece is recovered.

dst: 在探索黑暗卡林港时，我遇到了一群狗头人。这群狗头人没有攻击我，看起来相当和平，但他们的首领告诉我，他们可能不会一直如此。看来他们一直受到一只巨魔的困扰，这只巨魔杀死了他们许多人，于是他们与肆虐卡林港下水道的凶猛鼠人做了一笔交易。鼠人告诉狗头人，他们会帮忙对付巨魔，但作为回报，狗头人必须加入他们，一起向卡林港开战。狗头人首领觉得别无选择，只能同意。不过，我主动提出由我来杀死那只巨魔。如果我能做到这一点，并把巨魔的头带给他，首领承诺他不会与鼠人结盟，还会把他收集的一些财宝作为报酬送给我。这只巨魔在狗头人营地以西的区域游荡。我应当确保自己拥有能造成足够火焰或强酸伤害以克服其再生能力的手段后，尽快出发去猎杀它。
src: While exploring Dark Calimport, I came across a group of kobolds. This particular group did not attack me and seemed peaceful enough, but their chief told me that they might not remain that way. It seems they have been having a problem with a troll who has been killing many of them, and they made a deal with the aggressive wererats infesting Calimport's sewers. The wererats told the kobolds that they would help deal with the troll, but in return the kobolds are to join them in making war against Calimport. The kobold chief felt he had no choice but to agree with this. However, I have offered to slay the troll myself. If I can accomplish this and bring the troll's head to him, the chief has promised that he will not ally with the wererats, and reward me with some treasure he has collected as well. This troll wanders the regions to the west of the kobold encampment. I should set out to hunt it down as soon as I have made certain I possess some means of delivering enough fire or acid damage to overcome its regenerative powers.

哈马德一直在筹备对阿然尼亚总部的进攻，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报，这次进攻几乎已经准备就绪，军队正集结在蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结地。哈马德指示我前往这个集结地，为进攻贡献我的能力。到达后，我需向那里的指挥官——卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以他认为合适的方式提供协助。是时候前往城门，带上我想带的任何随从，然后出发前往沼泽。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结地，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已经在与服务于我们阿然尼亚敌人的类人生物（这里主要是蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会取得胜利，但担心等到胜利时，我们敌人的首领已经逃离总部，以便从其他地方继续他们的战争。为了防止这种情况，他计划让我沿着斥候发现的一条向北的小路前进，这条小路可以让我绕过他们的主力部队，直达基地。我将沿着这条小路前进，并与驻扎在小路开始再次向南拐弯之前的一支军队斥候会合。然后，我和斥候们将一路杀过敌人后方区域，那里希望抵抗较弱，以抵达基地。一旦到达那里，我将在阿然尼亚首领策划逃跑之前杀死他们。

我到达了北边小路上本应与军队斥候会合的地点，但他们不见踪影。环顾四周，我发现其中一人被蛛网缠住，以便周围的巨型蜘蛛进食。他讲述了侦察小队如何击退怪物的多次攻击，直到蜘蛛和伊特怪最终压倒了他们。不清楚有多少人幸存，我可能想四处寻找更多幸存者，但我怀疑我找到的任何人都无法协助我。如果杰拉因将军的计划要奏效，看来我必须在没有军队支援的情况下进攻阿然尼亚基地。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

I reached the point along the northern path where I was supposed to rendezvous with the army's scouts, but they are nowhere to be seen. Looking around, I found one of them webbed up so as to be fed on by the giant spiders around. He told how the group of scouts fended off multiple attacks by monsters until the spiders and ettercaps finally overwhelmed them. It is not clear how many survived, and I might want to look around for more survivors, but I doubt any I find will be in any condition to assist me. If General Jra'ein's plan is to work it seems I will have to assault the aranea base without support from the army.

dst:
哈尔法克斯，角落中的天使
    
侏儒很少因其军事力量而闻名，但哈尔法克斯是这一规则少数的例外之一。他授予召唤者防御堡垒和囚禁敌人的能力，以及石头的硬度。
  
契灵等级：8级
绑定DC:32
特殊要求：哈尔法克斯的印记必须画在建筑物内。
  
影响：在他作为契灵的时间里，哈尔法克斯似乎失去了所有关于他生活的记忆，以及对他行为的任何内疚或羞耻感。因此，当你受他影响时，你失去任何正常的羞耻或尴尬感。然而，如果有人威胁你关心的一个人质--无论是生物还是物品--哈尔法克斯要求你同意人质劫持者的要求。
  
授予能力：
哈尔法克斯授予你机械艺术的高深知识，以及囚禁敌人，建造防御和用石头硬度武装身体的力量。

伤害减免：你获得伤害减免 10/+5。

哈尔法克斯的知识：你在学识检定上获得 +16 加值。

囚禁：作为一个标准动作，你可以进行近战接触攻击来囚禁你的目标。如果你击中，目标必须进行强韧豁免检定，否则被囚禁。此能力如同法咒囚禁术，除了囚禁持续轮数等于你的有效契灵师等级。如果目标通过豁免，你必须等待 1d4 轮才能再次使用此能力。当你已经囚禁了另一个生物时，你不能使用此能力囚禁一个生物。

钢铁防御：作为一个标准动作，你可以使一系列咬合防御突然出现。这如同法咒剑刃屏障。一旦你使用了此能力，你5轮内不能再次使用。

安全庇护所：随意作为一个标准动作，你可以施放魔邓肯豪宅术。
src:
Halphax, the Angel in the Angle
    
Gnomes rarely earn a reputation for their military might, but Halphax is one of the few exceptions to that rule. He grants his summoners the ability to defend a fortress and imprison foes, as well as the hardness of stone.
  
Vestige Level: 8th
Binding DC: 32
Special Requirement: Halphax's sign must be drawn inside a building.
  
Influence: In his time as a vestige, Halphax seems to have lost all memory of his life as well as any feeling of guilt or shame for his actions. Thus, when you are under his influence, you lose any normal sense of shame or embarrassment. However, if someone threatens a hostage you care about-be it a creature or an item-Halphax requires that you accede to the hostage taker's demands.
  
Granted Abilities: 
Halphax grants you great knowledge of mechanical arts as well as the power to imprison foes, build defenses, and gird your body with the hardness of stone.

Damage Reduction: You gain damage reduction 10/+5. 

Halphax's Knowledge: You gain a +16 bonus on Lore checks.

Imprison: As a standard action, you can make a melee touch attack to imprison your target. If you hit, the target must make a Fortitude saving throw or be imprisoned. This ability functions like the imprisonment spell, except that the imprisonment lasts for a number of rounds equal to your effective binder level. If a target makes its save, you must wait 1d4 rounds before using the ability again. You cannot imprison a creature while you already have another imprisoned from the use of this ability.

Iron Defenses: As a standard action, you can cause a series of gnashing defenses to spring into place. This functions as a blade barrier spell. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Secure Shelter: At will as a standard action, you can cast Mordenkainen's Magnificient Mansion.

(BASE CLASS)
If a cleric's basic creed is that the handiwork of the deities is everywhere, a shaman's simple assertion is that the deities themselves are everywhere. Shamans are intermediaries between the world of the living and the realm of spirits - the vast multitude of living beings that infuse the world with a divine essence. The shaman offers prayers, sacrifices and services to the spirits, and in return gains the favour of patron spirits who bestow spells and other magical abilities upon him.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Shaman gains proficiencies with simple weapons and light armour.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

To cast a spell, the Shaman must have a Wisdom score of 10 + the spell level. The DC of a Shaman's spell is 10 + Spell Level + Wisdom Modifier. A Shaman's caster level is equal to his class level. He has access to any spell from the Shaman spell list, and casts spells as a Cleric does.

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·寻宝者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地表的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他所认识的一支由另外六名斯涅布力侏儒组成的队伍，当时正在附近调查各个派系和近期事件，如今已经失踪。他希望我要么找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深地侏儒，要么至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒分别是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到其中任何一人或他们遭遇的证据，都应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我找到并营救了施内拉·潜影者，她曾被囚禁在一座夺心魔据点中。据她说，弗雷博·渔夫和塔克塞维克·钢手与她一同被俘，但死于夺心魔强迫他们参加的角斗中。我还找到了施纳巴·凿岩者，他显然遭遇了一些眼魔并被它们石化。我已将他从石化状态中恢复，他表示可以自行前往幽暗地域集市。仍有2名斯涅布力侏儒下落不明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found and rescued Schnella Shadowsneaker, who was being held captive in a Mind-Flayer stronghold. According to her, Frebo Fisher and Taxevek Steelhand were captured along with her, but perished in gladiatorial combats in which the Mind Flayers forced them to participate. I also found Schnabar Rockhewer, who apparently fell afoul of some Beholders and was petrified by them. I have restored him from his petrified state, and he has indicated he can make his own way to the Underdark Market. 2 Svrifneblin remain unaccounted for.

dst:
伊扎多告诉我们，竖琴手们在该地区发现了一道传送门，可以用来返回卡林港，这大概是我们离开烛堡后的下一个目的地。这道传送门位于乌尔卡斯特法师学院的废墟中，那是一座研习魔法的学校，不久前被来自卡林杉的敌对法师摧毁。既然我们已经在烛堡重铸了泽法德之剑，就应该前往乌尔卡斯特学院的废墟与伊扎多会合，并决定下一步行动，很可能就是返回卡林港

强大的巨龙克拉卡奇’弗拉兹’塔试图阻挡我们前往废墟的道路，但我们借助前同伴夸德的帮助将其击败，他特地回来协助我们进行这场战斗。现在我们可以继续前往乌尔卡斯特学院的残骸了。

我们已经到达乌尔卡斯特学院的废墟，并在那里与伊扎多会合。他指引我们前往一道传送门，它将带我们前往卡林港地下的竖琴手基地营地。从那里我们可以继续推进击败塔纳里恶魔阿兹古尔卡的下一阶段计划。
src:
Izado has told us that the Harpers have discovered a portal in this region that can be used to return to Calimport, presumably our next destination after Candlekeep. This portal is located in the ruins of the Ulcaster mage academy, a school for the study of magic destroyed some time ago by rival mages form Calimshan. Now that we have reforged the Sword of Zefad at Candlekeep, we should go to the ruins of the Ulcaster school to meet Izado and determine our next move, which might well be to return to Calimport

The mighty dragon Krakach'vraz'tar sought to bar our path to the ruins, but we brought him down, with the aid of our former companion Quord, who returned to aid us in this specific fight. Now we can proceed to what remains of the Ulcaster school.

We have reached the ruins of the Ulcaster Academy, and met up with Izado there. He has directed us to a portal that will take us to a Harper base camp beneath Calimport. From there we can proceed to the next phase of our plans to defeat the Tanar'ri Azghulkar.

dst:
我一直听到报告说，卡林港下水道里的鼠人种群最近不知为何变得极具攻击性，成群结队地组织起来，袭击任何进入下水道的人。这可能值得调查，不过这也意味着我进入下水道时要小心，因为那里已经变成了一个非常危险的地方。

这些新近变得具有攻击性的鼠人给一个盘踞在下水道里的盗贼公会带来了麻烦。公会的首领拉贾尔提出，如果我能对鼠人的威胁采取行动，他将给予非常丰厚的报酬。遗憾的是，我究竟能做什么还不完全清楚，但也许机会会出现。

看来这些鼠人属于变形蛛正在集结的敌对生物联盟的一部分。我想这并不太令人意外，因为如果它们代表的是另一个同时在制造麻烦的派系，那也太巧合了。我已经杀死了敌对鼠人的首领，并攻占了它们在下水道里的主要基地。虽然可能还有一些敌对鼠人团伙在下水道里游荡，但我预计它们构成的威胁现在将会逐渐消退。此外，我已经向拉贾尔报告了我的功绩，并领取了他提供的报酬。
src:
I have been hearing reports that the wererat population of Calimport's sewers has recently, for unknown reasons, become very aggressive, organizing in bands and attacking anyone entering the sewers. This may be something worthy of investigation, though it also means I should be careful about entering the sewers, as they have become a very dangerous place.

The newly aggressive wererats are causing problems for a thieves' guild based in the sewers. The head of the guild, Rajar, has offered a very substantial reward if I can do something about the wererat threat. Unfortunately it is not entirely clear what I can do, but perhaps an opportunity will turn up.

It appears the wererats were part of the coalition of hostile creatures being assembled by the aranea. Not too much of a surprise, I suppose, as it would have been quite a coincidence if they represented some other faction causing trouble at the same time. I have slain the leader of the hostile wererats and overrun their main base within the sewers. While some bands of hostile wererats might still be wandering the sewers, I expect the threat they pose will now be receding. Furthermore, I have reported my accomplishments to Rajar and claimed his offered reward.

Jarlzin even indicated that having a Rogue Stone might open up the opportunity for a further quest I might do for him, though he did not want to give any details about this.

dst: 角斗士罗加瓦斯以在竞技场中生存的能力而闻名，尽管他不被允许穿戴多少护甲。不止一个过于自信的对手未能打出致命一击，最终倒在他的剑下。罗加瓦斯的对手常常没有注意到他的护符，那上面附有魔法，能提高他的生存几率。他穿戴的其他所有装备都更加华丽多彩，这是刻意选择的装扮，用来掩盖他成功的秘密。
src: The gladiator Rogavas was renowned for his ability to survive in the arena despite the fact that he was not permitted to wear much in the way of armor. More than one overconfident opponent failed to land a tellling blow and ultimately fell to his blade. src:
The wood elves do not view their homelands as a land apart. They understand better than their kindred that, for better or for worse, their fates are bound up with the fates of the humans, dwarves and halflings of the land. Also known as copper or sylvan elves, these people have coppery skin tinged with green, and brown, green or hazel eyes. Hair is usually brown or black, occasionally blond or coppery-red.

Wood Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, +2 Dex, -2 Int, -2 Cha, -2 Con.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass wood elf's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Bonus Proficiencies (Longsword, Rapier, Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Wild Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Wood Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

dst: “当然，我们苦修实践的原因多种多样，我不知道我们是否有时间对伊尔梅特神学的所有细节进行深入讨论。然而，最重要的是，我们倾向于自我施加匮乏，源于我们相信苦难具有精神价值，其根源在于正义与善的超越性价值。你大概知道，伊尔梅特的追随者尽可能减轻他人的苦难，但尽管我们努力，世界仍然充满了不应得的苦难所带来的恐怖。当然，如果正义与善不是终极价值，那就没有特别的理由让我们关心这些，善与恶就只是不同的观点，彼此并无高下之分。但如果它们是终极价值，那么如此多的邪恶与不义的存在又怎么可能？我们相信，我们所看到的一切不义都必须在某个时刻得到补偿，遭受苦难的人将在日后获得相称的回报。同样，那些现在从邪恶行为中获利的人最终也必须为此受苦。宇宙的平衡要求如此。既然我们清楚地看到这在物质世界中没有发生，那么它必定发生在来世。”
src: "Of course, there are many and various reasons for our ascetical practices, and I do not know if we have time for an extended discussion of all the ins and outs of Ilmaterian theology. More than anything else, however, our proclivity for self-inflicted privations stem from our belief that suffering has spritual value, rooted in the transcendental value of justice and good. As you probably know, followers of Ilmater seek to mitigate the sufferings of others where possible, but despite our efforts the world remains full of the horror of unmerited suffering. If justice and good are not ultimate values, of course, there is no particular reason this should concern us, good and evil would then simply be different points of view, neither inherently superior to the other. But if they are of ultimate value, how can the existence of so much evil and injustice be possible? It is our belief that all the injustices we see must at some point be made good, with those who suffer them receiving proportionate benefits at some later time. Likewise those who now profit from evil actions must eventually suffer for them. The balance of the universe demands no less. Since we can clearly see that this does not happen in the material world, it must occur in the afterlife."

Naturally he was happy to see them gone. Now the land is ruled by humans, so it makes sense for a demon planning to wage war upon it to open up another front, so to speak, to divide the forces of those who would oppose him, even if that means helping his old enemies."

dst:
专长类型：异能
先决条件：能够显能。
具体效果：当此专长激活时，增幅评估代码将尝试自动花费异能点进行增幅，超出你的增幅配置所指定的数量，直至显能者等级上限。
自动分配的工作方式是，它首先尝试将所有异能点花费在异能的第一个增幅选项上。如果在第一个增幅选项后还有未分配的异能点，则对第二个增幅选项执行相同操作，依此类推。

请注意，此自动分配不考虑任何可能增加异能花费的效果，例如抑能术。这可能导致异能的总花费超过显能者等级上限，从而导致异能失败。
另请注意，如果异能的花费因（基础花费 + 超能 + 正常增幅配置） 而被提升至显能者等级上限以上，这不会将其降回上限以下。

使用：选择可切换开/关。使用增幅关闭也可切换为关闭。
src:
Type of Feat: Psionics
Prerequisite: Ability to manifest powers.
Specifics: When this feat is active, the augmentation evaluation code will attempt to automatically spend PP on augmentation beyond the amount specified by your augmentation profile, up to the manifester level cap.
The automatic allocation works such that it first attempts to spend all of the PP on the power's first augmentation option. If any PP is left unallocated after the first augmentation option, the same operation is performed on the second augmentation option, etc.

Note that this automatic allocation does not account for any effects that might increase the power's cost, such as Catapsi. This may result in the power's total cost exceeding the manifester level cap and thus causing the power to fail.
Also note that if the power's cost was brought above the manifester level cap by (base cost + metapsionics + normal augmentation profile), this will not reduce it back below the cap.

Use: Selecting toggles on/off. Also toggled off by use of Augment Off.

dst:
（进阶职业）
大多数人以为当兽人野蛮人咆哮着冲过山顶时，他们就已经见识了兽人所能繁衍出的最恶劣的东西 - 至少直到他们看见一个独眼兽人野蛮人咆哮着冲过山顶。这个生物很可能就是格乌什之眼，一个对他的邪恶神祇如此虔诚的兽人，以至于他以格乌什之名自毁容貌。

在时间之初的一场传奇战役中，精灵神祇柯瑞隆·拉瑞斯安刺出了格乌什的左眼。充满愤怒和仇恨的兽人神祇召唤足够忠诚的追随者以他的形象服务。那些响应这一召唤的人被称为格乌什之眼。他们牺牲自己的右眼而不是左眼，这样他们受损的视力就能与他们的神祇相平衡。因此，至少在象征意义上，他们能看到他所不能看到的。这些格乌什的活殉道者是世界上最坚韧的兽人和半兽人。

- 生命骰：d12。
- 武器和防具擅长：格乌什之眼不获得任何武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

种族：任何兽人种族。
阵营：混乱邪恶，混乱中立或中立邪恶。
基础攻击加值：+6。
专长：武器擅长（双头斧），武器专攻（兽人双头斧）.
特殊：格乌什的追随者，在仪式中挖出了自己的右眼。（选择此职业的牧师必须拥有以下领域中的两个：战争，力量，邪恶。）

职业特性：

等级：
 1：盲斗，命令部落，狂暴
 2：盲目挥击
 3：仪式疤痕 +1
 4：致盲唾液 每日 2 次
 5：盲视，5 英尺半径
 6：仪式疤痕 +2
 7：致盲唾液 每日 4 次
 8：盲视，10 英尺半径
 9：仪式疤痕 +3
10：格乌什之视
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Most people think they've seen the worst that orcs can breed when an orc barbarian comes raging over a hilltop - at least until they see a one-eyed orc barbarian come raging over a hilltop. This creature may well be an eye of Gruumsh, an orc so devoted to his evil deity that he has disfigured himself in Gruumsh's name.

In an epic battle at the dawn of time, the elven deity Corellon Larethian stabbed out Gruumsh's left eye. Filled with rage and hatred, the orc deity called for followers loyal enough to serve in his image. Those who heed this call are known as the eyes of Gruumsh. They sacrifice their right eyes instead of their left ones so that their impaired vision balances that of their deity. Thus, symbolically at least, they can see what he cannot. These living martyrs to Gruumsh are some of the toughest orcs and half-orcs in the world.

- Hit Die: d12.
- Proficiencies: Eye of Gruumsh's gain no weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: any Orcish race.
Alignment: Chaotic Evil, Chaotic Neutral, or Neutral Evil.
Base Attack Bonus: +6.
Feats: Weapon Proficiency (Double-Axe), Weapon Focus (Orc Double-Axe).
Special: Follower of Gruumsh that has put his own right eye out during a ritual. (Clerics taking this class must have two of the following domains: War, Strength, Evil.)

CLASS FEATURES:

Levels:
 1: Blind-Fight, Command the Horde, Rage
 2: Swing Blindly
 3: Ritual Scarring +1
 4: Blinding Spittle 2X day
 5: Blindsight, 5-foot radius
 6: Ritual Scarring +2
 7: Blinding Spittle 4X day
 8: Blindsight, 10-foot radius
 9: Ritual Scarring +3
10: Sight of Gruumsh

Unfortunately, almost all these northerners are too poor to afford Gadaran quality goods. As you were one of our customers in Calimport, perhaps you would be interested? No bags of holding for sale, I'm afraid, I need all of those to carry the stock. But I have lots of other items of interest to <CUSTOM106> like you."

dst:
（进阶职业）
魔鬼学者是将自己的命运与地狱势力捆绑在一起的人。与阿斯莫蒂尔斯或其他大魔鬼的信徒不同，魔鬼学者并非某个特定强大邪魔的仆从，而通常是凡人，将黑暗之路视为获取强大力量的手段。她不侍奉魔鬼--她想成为魔鬼。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 擅长：魔鬼学者不获得任何武器，护甲或盾牌擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：守序晦暗
技能：唬骗 3 级，威吓 3 级，学识 8 级
专长：晦暗烙印
法咒：必须能够施放至少 3 级奥术法咒。

职业特性：

等级
1：魔鬼术 1d6 - 为法咒增加 1d6 腐化（神圣）伤害
2：小魔鬼魔宠 - 任何非小魔鬼魔宠在召唤时死亡
5：魔鬼术 2d6 - 为法咒增加腐化（神圣） 2d6 伤害
8：晦暗魔鬼术 - 魔鬼术伤害变为晦暗伤害（正能量）.这将使造成的伤害减半。
10：魔鬼术 3d6 - 为法咒增加 3d6 腐化（神圣）伤害

奖励法咒：

在魔鬼学者职业上获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在最高施法者职业（吟游诗人，术士或法师）上也获得了等级。然而，他不会获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处（例如，强化魔宠，奖励专长）.
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Diabolist is one who has thrown his lot in with the forces of Hell. Unlike the disciples of Asmodeus or the other archdevils, the diabolist is not a servant of a specific powerful fiend, but instead is usually a mortal being who has seen the dark path as a means to gaining great power. She does not serve devils - she wants to be one.

- Hit Dice: d4.
- Proficiencies: Diabolists gain no weapon, armor or shield proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Lawful Evil
Skills: Bluff 3 ranks, Intimidate 3 ranks, Lore 8 ranks
Feats: Evil Brand
Spells: Must be able to cast at least 3rd level Arcane spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Diabolism 1d6 - Adds 1d6 Corrupt (Divine) damage to a spell
2: Imp Familiar - Any non-imp familiar dies when summoned
5: Diabolism 2d6 - Adds Corrupt (Divine) 2d6 damage to a spell
8: Vile Diabolism - Diabolism damage to Vile damage (Positive). This will cut the damage dealt in half.
10: Diabolism 3d6 - Adds 3d6 Corrupt (Divine) damage to a spell

BONUS SPELLS:

Upon gaining a level in Diabolist, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (bard, sorcerer, or wizard). He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (e.g., improved familiar, bonus feats).

I shall have to consider whether this venture is worth the cost and the risks.\n\nApparently Radamur's portal leads to Cania, the Eighth Hell. I survived my sojourn there and have now returned.

dst: 瓦拉多是位强大的战士，对自己的武器技巧极为自豪。然而，他在与一名法师的较量中最终受辱，法师用一道简单的法咒定住了他，然后嘲讽他的无助，宣称他甚至不值得被了结。然而，未能给予致命一击被证明是法师的错误，因为瓦拉多后来前来复仇。当然，瓦拉多首先花了一些时间获取能保护他免受敌人法咒伤害的物品，比如这面盾牌。虽然它对物理攻击提供的保护很少，但对任何计划对抗施法者的人来说都非常有价值。
src: Varador was a mighty warrior, immensely proud of his skill with weaponry. However, he ended up being humiliated in a contest against a wizard, who immobilized him with a simple spell, and then taunted him with his helplessness, declaring that he was not even worth finishing off. Failing to deliver the coup de grace, however, proved to be a mistake on the wizard's part, for Varador later came seeking revenge. Of course, Varador had first spent some time acquiring items that would protect him from his foe's spells, such as this shield. While it provides little protection against physical attack, it would be very valuable to anyone planning on going up against a spellcaster.

dst: "要到达这里，你必定经过了巴托的一座堡垒。在那座堡垒里，有一个被称为瓦塔科的深狱炼魔，他经常与我们作战，并屡次挫败我们促进正义与公理的尝试。你是拥有非凡力量的<CUSTOM106>，我相信你能击败他。这样的行动当然会有危险，所以如果你成功，给予你丰厚的奖赏才公正。因此，如果瓦塔科被杀，我会给你一件应该非常有用的魔法装备。有一个麻烦：瓦塔科躲在一扇有守卫的门后，无法轻易绕过。不过，我们设法获得了一把能进入的钥匙。如果你同意执行这个任务，我会把它给你。"
src: "To reach this point, you will have passed through a fortress in Baator. Within that fortress can be found a Pit Fiend known as Vartakor, who has often fought against us and frequently thwarted our attempts to promote justice and right. You are <CUSTOM106> of exceptional power, and I believe you would be able to defeat him. There would of course be some danger in such an undertaking, so if you succeed it would only be just to reward you well. Therefore if Vartakor is slain, I will give you a piece of magical gear that should be of great use. There is one complication: Vartakor hides behind a warded door that cannot be easily bypassed. However, we were able to acquire a key that will grant access. If you agree to undertake this misison, I will give it to you."

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·寻宝者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地表的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他所认识的一支由另外六名斯涅布力侏儒组成的队伍，当时正在附近调查各个派系和近期事件，如今已经失踪。他希望我要么找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深地侏儒，要么至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒分别是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到其中任何一人或他们遭遇的证据，都应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我在一只底栖魔鱼的据点深处找到了泽布利普·铁足。不幸的是，他已被转化为受精神控制的奴隶，我们被迫杀死了他。至少他的命运已经查明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found Zeblip Ironfoot deep in the stronghold of an Aboleth. Unfortunately, he had been transformed into a mind-controlled slave and we were forced to slay him. At least his fate has been discovered.

dst: "泽卡尔也曾与我长久对抗，但如今他已是我意志的奴隶。恶魔是无法被击败的，因为要与我们对战，你就必须杀戮和毁灭，使用我们自己的工具，从而无论你是否意识到，都在侍奉我们。你们凡人永远不会明白，重要的不是你们的目的，因为总有比你们更强大的力量来决定你们能否达成目的。只有你们为达成目的所选择的手段——是荣耀而仁慈，还是无情而奸诈——才是重要的，因为那决定了这些更强大的力量中，哪一个愿意与你结盟，而深渊的手段才是最实用的。"
src: "Zekar fought me long as well, but now he is a slave to my will. Demons cannot be defeated, for to fight us you must kill and destroy, employing our own tools and thus serving us whether you realize it or not. You mortals will never understand that it is not your ends that matter, for greater powers than you will always determine whether you accomplish them or not. Only the means you choose to secure them, honorable and compassionate or ruthless and treacherous, matter, for that decides which of these greater powers will be willing to ally with you, and it is the methods of the Abyss that are the most practical."

dst:
（进阶职业）
死亡交易者和灵魂折磨者，死灵魂能者是任何世界中最邪恶的生物之一。精通融合塑造技艺，这些扭曲的存在曾汲取魂能的灵魂能量。他们对力量不计代价的无限渴望引导他们进行黑暗仪式，将灵魂能量腐化为死灵魂能。

死灵魂能是魂能的黑暗倒影，其使用甚至让最邪恶的魂能者和图腾师都为之踌躇。邪恶的魂能者可能汲取邪恶生物和位面的灵魂能量，但死灵魂能的使用者从折磨善良灵魂中获取力量。事实上，死灵魂能者使纯洁的灵魂遭受远超凡人生命极限的痛苦和折磨，在追求其可憎力量的过程中榨干它们的本质。

- 生命骰：d6
- 擅长：死灵魂能者不获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：任意邪恶
技能：知识 5级，专注 5级，法术辨识 10级。
专长：尸魂侍僧。
融合塑造：塑造灵魂融合的能力，将灵魂融合绑定到冠轮，足轮和手轮的能力。

职业特性：

等级
1： 收割灵魂（1分钟） - 从刚死亡的尸体中收割魂能
    改善融合塑造者等级 - 将死灵魂能者等级加到融合塑造者等级（不获得魂能，轮穴绑定，融合）
2： 死灵魂能灵魂护盾 - 获得等于已塑造死灵魂能融合数量的豁免加值
3： 轮穴绑定（臂，眉，肩）
4： 额外轮穴绑定，额外塑造灵魂融合
5： 魂能陷阱 - 敌人死亡时给予临时魂能
6： 死灵魂能僵尸大师 - 从死灵魂能头环受到一半伤害
7： 额外塑造灵魂融合
8： 轮穴绑定（喉，腰），额外轮穴绑定
9： 扩展死灵魂能融合容量 - 你塑造的每个死灵魂能融合的魂能容量增加1。

12：额外轮穴绑定
13：轮穴绑定（魂），额外塑造灵魂融合，死灵魂能僵尸大师 - 创造两个死灵魂能僵尸
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Dealers in death and torturers of souls, necrocarnates number among the most evil creatures in any world. Skilled in the arts of meldcraft, these twisted beings once drew upon the soul energy of incarnum. Their unbridled lust for power at any price has led them into dark rituals that corrupt soul energy into necrocarnum.

Necrocarnum is a dark reflection of incarnum, whose use gives even the most evil incarnates and totemists pause. An evil incarnate might draw upon the soul energies of evil creatures and planes, but a user of necrocarnum gains her power from the torture of good souls. Indeed, the necrocarnate subjects pure souls to agony and torment far beyond the limits possible in mortal life, draining them of their very essence in pursuit of her hideous power.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Necrocarnate does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any evil
Skills: Lore 5 ranks, Concentration 5 ranks, Spellcraft 10 ranks.
Feat: Necrocarnum Acolyte.
Meldshaping: Ability to shape soulmelds, ability to bind soulmelds to the crown, feet, and hands chakras.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Harvest Soul (1 minute) - Harvest essentia from recently dead corpses
    Improved Meldshaper Level - Add necrocarnate to meldshaper level (do not gain essentia, chakra binds, melds)
2:  Necrocarnum Soulshield - Gain a bonus on saving throws equal to shaped necrocarnum melds
3:  Chakra binds (arms, brow, shoulders)
4:  Extra chakra bind, extra shaped soulmeld
5:  Essentia Trap - Enemies dying grants temporary essentia
6:  Necrocarnum zombie master - Take half damage from Necrocarnum Circlet
7:  Extra shaped soulmeld
8:  Chakra binds (throat, waist), extra chakra bind
9:  Expanded Necrocarnum Meld Capacity - The essentia capacity of each necrocarnum meld you shape increases by 1.
10: Extra shaped soulmeld, Harvest Soul (full-round action) 
11: Chakra bind (heart)
12: Extra chakra bind
13: Chakra bind (soul), extra shaped soulmeld, Necrocarnum zombie master - Create two necrocarnum zombies

dst:
（进阶职业）
腐败的祭司沉溺于腐朽之中，塔洛娜的枯萎领主在不可接近的东部地区令人恐惧和憎恶。他们的瘟疫已将罗林斯森林的西部边缘变成了一片充满患病怪物和致命毒药的恶臭绿色地狱。更糟糕的是，枯萎领主试图用同样的疾病感染附近健康的森林和土地。在可怕的腐烂之人的指导下，塔洛娜枯萎领主集结了罗林斯森林的黑暗部落，带领他们被感染的仆从洗劫附近的土地。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 熟练：塔洛娜枯萎领主不会获得任何额外的武器或盔甲熟练。
- 技能点：2+智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：邪恶
神术施法：能够施放4级法咒。
专长：强韧加强，军用武器熟练（戟）.
特殊：必须信仰塔洛娜。选择此职业的牧师必须拥有灰飞烟灭和邪恶领域。

职业特性：

等级
1：枯萎使者进阶领域，枯萎之血 - 免疫疾病
2：疾病大师 - 动物伙伴获得枯萎滋生模板
3：枯萎之触 1次/天 - 近战接触攻击以使受害者感染塔洛娜的枯萎
4：
5：枯萎之触 2次/天
6：黑色长刃 - 枯萎领主挥舞的任何戟获得1d6寒冷伤害。
7：枯萎之触 3次/天
8：腐蚀打击 - 枯萎领主挥舞的任何戟获得DC 20的创伤。
9：枯萎之触 4次/天
10：寒冬之心 - 类型变为“植物”，这意味着她不再受毒素，睡眠，影响心智的效果，麻痹，变形，重击，偷袭或仅影响人形生物的法咒和效果的影响

枯萎使者进阶领域：

神祇：塔洛娜
授予力量：斥责或命令枯萎滋生生物和邪恶阵营的动物。你可以每天使用此能力的次数等于3+你的魅力调整值。

奖励法咒

在塔洛娜枯萎领主职业上获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高神术施法职业上也获得了等级一样。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Corrupt priests who revel in decay, the blightlords of Talona are feared and reviled through out the Unapproachable East. Their plagues have transformed the western reaches of the Rawlinswood into a foul green hell of diseased monsters and deadly poisons. Worse yet, the blightlords seek to infect the healthy forests and lands nearby with the same sickness. Under the tutelage of the horrible Rotting Man, the Talontar Blightlords marshal the Rawlinswood's black horde, leading their infect minions forth to scourge the nearby lands.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A talontar blight does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Evil
Divine Spellcasting: Able to cast 4th-level spells.
Feats: Great Fortitude,  Martial Weapon Proficiency(Halberd).
Special: Must worship Talona. A cleric who takes this class must have the Destruction and Evil domains.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Blightbringer Prestige Domain, Blightblood - Immune to Disease
2: Illmaster - Animal companions gain the blightspawned template
3: Blight Touch 1/day - Melee touch attack to infect a victim with Talona's Blight
4:
5: Blight Touch 2/day
6: Black Glaive - Any Halberd the blightlord wields gains 1d6 cold damage.
7: Blight Touch 3/day
8: Corrupting Blows - Any Halberd the blightlord wields gains a DC 20 Wounding.
9: Blight Touch 4/day
10: Winterheart - type changes to "plant" which means that she is no longer subject to poison, sleep, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, polymorphing, critical hits, sneak attacks, or spells and effects that affect humanoids only

Blightbringer Prestige Domain:

Deity: Talona
Granted Power: Rebuke or command blightspawned creatures and evil-aligned animals. You may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3+ your Charisma Modifier.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in talontar blightlord, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

dst: “我结束退休，来完成最后一个任务：击败一位吸血鬼领主。我成功了，但也受了伤。我不知情的是，在我如此粗心且无礼地击倒那位伟大存在之前，他已将他的伟大传给了我。不朽的种子已植入我自己的血液！我再次回到村庄，但很快，至少看起来如此，就病倒并死去。事实上，我只是在升华为伟大与不朽。我很快便以现在的形态从临终之榻上起身。”
src: "I came out of retirement to complete one last quest: to defeat a Vampire lord. In this I succeeded, but not without taking wounds. Unbeknowst to me, before falling, the great being I had so carelessly and ungraciously struck down had passed his greatness on to me. The seeds of immortality had been planted in my own blood! I returned again to my village, but soon, or so it seemed, took sick and died. In fact I was simply ascending to greatness and immotality. I soon rose from my deathbed in my current form."

dst: 是的，我正要说这个。我打算开启的传送门通往天界的一个地点。这非常危险，因为那里的天使生物不太可能对我们这种与他们所代表的事物并不完全一致的人作出友善反应，或者说，对任何他们认为是偷窃的人也是如此，所以你必须与遇到的任何敌人战斗。他们相当强大，我自己都不愿面对他们，但<CUSTOM106>像你这样强大的人应该能保护好<his/her>自己。一旦你到达那个位面，就向西北方向前进，你应该很快就会看到一座塔。在这座塔的某处，你应该能找到一根注入魔法力量的金色法杖。这就是我想要的。拿到它，然后回到你进入的传送门。
src: "Yes, I am getting to that. The portal I intend to open leads to a point on the celestial planes. This presents great danger since the angelic creatures there are unlikely to react well to those like ourselves who are not exactly aligned with what they represent, or for that matter anyone engaged in what they would consider theft, so you will need to fight any you encounter. They are quite powerful, and I would hesitate to face them myself, but <CUSTOM106> as powerful as you should be able to hold <his/her> own. Once you arrive on the plane, head to the northwest, where you should soon come across a tower. Somewhere in this tower, you should find a golden rod infused with magical power. This is what I want. Take it and return to the portal where you entered."

dst: <StartHighlight>[邪恶 +2]</Start> "好极了。我们现在应该带着巫妖的钥匙回到传送门。哦，记住，这个停战协议只适用于我，因为我无法说服我的任何塔纳里同胞与一个<race>主物质者合作的益处。你遇到的其他恶魔很可能会攻击你，但我会帮你与他们战斗。他们未能看到我计划的智慧，理应如此。"
src: <StartHighlight>[Evil +2]</Start> "Excellent. We should now return to the portal with the lich's key. Oh, remember that this truce applies only to me, as I could not persuade any of my fellow Tanar'ri of the merits of working with a <race> Prime. Any other demons you encounter will most likely attack you, but I will help you fight them as well. They deserve no less for failing to see the wisdom of my plan."

dst: "嗯，也许有一件事。我正在市场上寻找一种叫做游荡者之石的稀有宝石。这些宝石对多种传送魔法很有帮助，我心中有一个法术需要用到它。不幸的是，正如我所说，它相当稀有，我不知道哪里能找到。我想，像你这样的冒险者也许会在你所谓的‘任务’过程中偶然发现一块。如果你碰巧找到了，把它带给我，我会好好奖赏你。事实上，一旦我有了这块石头，可能会为你带来进一步的任务机会……但我暂时不想谈那个，等第一阶段，也就是游荡者之石完成之后再说。"
src: "Hmn, well there might be one thing. I am in the market for the rare gem known as a Rogue Stone. These are quite helpful in many kinds of teleportation magic and there is a spell I have in mind that requires one. Unfortunately, being quite rare as I said, I have no idea where one could be found. I suppose it is possible an adventurer like you might stumble across one in the course of one of your 'quests,' as you call them. If perchance you do, I will reward you well for bringing it to me. Indeed, once I have the stone, it might create the opportunity for a further task you could do for me...but l prefer not to speak of that yet, not until the first stage, the Rogue Stone, is accomplished."

dst: "不完全是。我遇到一个披着斗篷、戴着兜帽的人形身影，正带走这里的人，一个名叫德尔谢拉的年轻女子。自然，我发起了攻击，但那个男人，或者可能是某种生物，能够抵挡住我。我知道我现在听起来像是在自夸，但我当冒险者已经很久了，战胜过许多危险的怪物。不是随便什么人都能面对我并活下来。事实上，他做得更好。他把我打倒在地，带着德尔谢拉跑了。那就是最近一次失踪。"
src: "Not exactly. I came across a cloaked and hooded humanoid figure, carrying off one of the people here, a young woman named Delshera. Naturally, I attacked, but the man, or creature as it may have been, was able to hold his own. I know I now seem to be boasting, but I have been an adventurer for a long time, and have overcome many dangerous monsters. Not just anyone could have faced me and survived. In fact, he did better. He knocked me down and ran off with Delshera. That was the latest disappearance."

src: Founded in distant Thay, the Monastic Order of the Long Death celebrates the passage from life to lifelessness in all of its forms. It is said by those who have survived encounters with the Order that the grip of its adherents is like the icy touch of death itself, not soon to be forgotten. Its members indeed frequently use gloves enchanted to boost their fists with the power of frost. This set of gloves is a particularly powerful one produced by the order, that boths freezes and drains its targerts of life. Some of the drained life is then transfered to the wearer, boosting his constitution. A few sets of these gloves are known to have been made and given to some of the most competent monks of the orders.

src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found and rescued Schnella Shadowsneaker, who was being held captive in a Mind-Flayer stronghold. According to her, Frebo Fisher and Taxevek Steelhand were captured along with her, but perished in gladiatorial combats in which the Mind Flayers forced them to participate. This accounts for three of the missing Svrifneblin.

你必须对目的地的位置和布局有清晰的了解。你的心理图像越清晰，传送越可能成功。强物理或魔法能量区域可能会使传送更加危险甚至不可能。**

要查看传送效果如何，投掷 d% 并参考传送表。有关表中术语的定义，请参考以下信息。

准确：
  你出现在你想要的位置。
偏离：

严重偏离：
  你最终到达一个完全不同的地方。
事故：

src:
Psychoportation (Teleportation)
Level: Nomad 5
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal and touch
Target or Targets: You and touched objects or other touched willing creatures
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: No
Power Points: 9
Metapsionics: None

This power instantly transports you to a designated destination, which may be as distant as 100 miles per manifester level. Interplanar travel is not possible. You may also bring one additional willing Medium or smaller creature or its equivalent (see below) per three caster levels. A Large creature counts as two Medium creatures, a Huge creature counts as two Large creatures, and so forth. All creatures to be transported must be in contact with one another, and at least one of those creatures must be in contact with you. *

You must have some clear idea of the location and layout of the destination. The clearer your mental image, the more likely the teleportation works. Areas of strong physical or magical energy may make teleportation more hazardous or even impossible. **

To see how well the teleportation works, roll d% and consult the Teleport table. Refer to the following information for definitions of the terms on the table.

On Target:
  You appear where you want to be.
Off Target:
  You appear safely a random distance away from the destination in a random direction.
Far Off Target:
  You wind up somewhere completely different.
Mishap:
  You and anyone else teleporting with you have gotten scrambled. You each take 1d10 points of damage, and you reroll on the chart to see where you wind up. For these rerolls, roll 1d20+80. Each time Mishap comes up, the characters take more damage and must reroll.

On Target Off Target Way Off Target Mishap
0190     9194      9598          99100


Notes:
 *  Implemented as within 10ft of you due to the lovely quality of NWN location tracking code.
 ** Implemented as you having to have marked the location beforehand using the "Mark Location"
    feat, found under the Teleport Options radial.Teleport

（进阶职业）
并非所有武僧都追求超脱于其他一切学问的形而上学之完美。有些武僧将严谨的学术研究与武术和身体锻炼相结合。对这些武僧而言，这种研究包括魔法的修习以及将某些奥术技巧融入其徒手战斗风格。这些启迪之拳精通接触法术的运用，创造出全新的战斗形式，使他们的拳头以令人目眩的速度，惊人的力量和魔法能量进行打击。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 武器与防具擅长：启迪之拳不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

需求：

法咒或类法咒能力：奥术施法者等级 3。
专长：战斗施法，精通徒手打击，震慑拳。
技能：专注 8 级，学识 5 级，法咒辨识 5 级。

奖励法咒

启迪之拳每升一级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同其最高奥术施法者职业也提升了一级。

职业特性：

等级
1： 徒手伤害 - 启迪之拳的等级与其武僧等级叠加。
    开悟速度 - 启迪之拳的等级与其武僧等级叠加。
    震慑攻击 - 获得等于启迪之拳等级的额外每日震慑拳次数。
    气击 - 启迪之拳的拳头在穿透伤害减免时视为 +1。
2： 能量之拳 - 使用震慑尝试在一轮内造成 1d6 额外火焰/电击伤害。
3： 奥术之拳 - 使用震慑尝试在全回合攻击中通过徒手打击传递接触法术。
4： -

6： 能量之拳（速度爆发） - 能量灌注的攻击在重击时造成 1d10 额外伤害。
7： 持握射线 - 将具有射线效果的法咒作为接触法术使用。

10：-
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Not all monks pursue metaphysical perfection to the exclusion of all other study. Some monks combine a rigorous discipline of academic study with martial arts and development of the body. For these monk, that study includes the practice of magic and the implementation of certain arcane tricks into their unarmed combat styles. These enlightened fists master the use of touch spells, creating new forms of combat where their fists strike with blinding speed, phenomenal power, and magical energy.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: An enlightened fist does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spells or Spell-like Abilities: Arcane caster level 3rd.
Feats: Combat Casting, Improved Unarmed Strike, Stunning Fist.
Skills: Concentration 8 ranks, Lore 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks.

BONUS SPELLS

Every level in Enlightened Fist, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest arcane caster class.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Unarmed Damage - Enlightened Fist's levels stack with his monk level.
    Enlightened speed - Enlightened Fist's levels stack with his monk level.
    Stunning Attacks - Gain extra stunning fist uses/day equal to Enlightened Fist level.
    Ki Strike - Enlightened Fist's fists count as +1 for piercing damage reduction.

3:  Arcane fist - Use stunning attempt to deliver touch spell with unarmed strikes as part of a full attack.

6:  Fist of energy (burst) - Energy imbued attacks deal 1d10 extra damage on a critical hit.
7:  Hold ray - Use spells with a ray affect as touch spells.
8:  -

dst:
我们必须设法获得一本价值连城的书，作为进入烛堡的代价。当我们抵达扎泽斯普尔时，特法拉姆船长建议我们去见一位名叫登萨斯·韦莱本的人，他在码头以北的市场区开了一家书店。他的想法是，作为一名珍稀书籍经销商，登萨斯或许有合适的书可供出售，如果没有，他应该也知道我们该去哪里找。

我们照做了，登萨斯向我们讲述了一处古沙纳塔的废墟，它受到一道魔法屏障的保护，只有像我这样的矮人才能通过。记录表明，这处废墟中藏有一本巴伦·萨鲁克的《沙纳塔列王纪》，这是一本稀有而珍贵的书，应该足以让我们进入烛堡。废墟中到处都是几个世纪未经维护而发狂的守卫魔像，或许还有其他危险。无论如何，之前前往此地的探险队都没有成功返回，所以我们需要小心。这座陵墓位于远处星尖山脉南麓的某个地方，具体位置现已标记在我的地图上。要到达那里，我们必须从码头区向东出去，前往“南门”，然后先沿苏杜斯昆河向东行进，再向北朝山脉方向前进。

一旦我们成功找到合适的书，就应该回来与特法拉姆船长谈谈（他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停留数周进行整修），他或许能在下次猎捕海盗时带我们更靠近烛堡。
src:
We must somehow acquire a book of great value as the price of admittance to Candlekeep. When we arrived in Zazesspur, Captain Tefaram advised us to speak to one Densath Wayleben, owner of a bookstore that can be found in the market district north of the docks, on the theory that, as a dealer in rare volumes, he might have had an appropriate book available for sale, and if not could be expected to know where we can go to find one.

We did as suggested, and Densath told us of a ruin of ancient Shanatar protected by a magical barrier that only a dwarf such as myself, would be able to pass. Records indicate that this ruin contains a copy of Barun Tharuk's Chronicle of the Kings of Shanatar, a rare and valuable book that should serve to gain entrance to Candlekeep. The ruin is overrun with guardian golems that have gone berserk after centuries without maintenance, and perhaps other dangers. At any rate no previous expedition to this location managed to return successfully, so we will need to be careful This tomb is located some distance away along the southern face of the Starspire mountains, at a location now marked on my maps. To reach it we must exit the Docks going east, head to the "South Gate," and from there travel initially east along the Sulduskoon river, and then head north towards the mountains.

Once we succeed in finding an appropriate book, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram (who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting), who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.

src: In the process of defeating the minotaur pirates, the Sword of Valkur's crew discovered some charts indicating the locations of other pirate bases. One of them was the base of a group of human pirates they have long been hoping to put out of business, so our next stop was the island where they can be found. Zarala and I participated in the assault on this second group of pirates, which has now been brought to a victorious conclusion, although we did learn that they were working for a group of Yuan-ti who still maintains a base hidden somewhere in the city of Zazesspur.\n\nWe have reported our activities to the captain. We can return to speak with him when we are ready to leave. In the meantime we can see if Ochiram will buy any of the loot we found, and perhaps explore any parts of the island we may have missed earlier.

活力腰带

描述符：无
职业：化身
脉轮：腰部
豁免检定：无

魂能形成一条坚固的金属腰带，束在你的腰间。金属闪耀着银蓝色光芒；蔚蓝色的链环将板片连接在一起。生命和健康从这条腰带涌入你的身体。

佩戴活力腰带时，你在体质检定和基于体质的技能检定上获得+4士气加值（但不包括强韧豁免）.

脉轮绑定（腰部）

一颗巨大的星光蓝宝石装饰在活力腰带的中央，在任何光线下都闪耀着鲜艳的光芒。每当你受到会吸取你活力的攻击时，蓝宝石中心的星星会暂时变暗，但你的健康不受影响。

你免疫体质伤害和体质吸取。
src:
Vitality Belt

Descriptors: None
Classes: Incarnate
Chakra: Waist
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms a stout metallic belt that girds your waist. The metal gleams silver-blue; links of azure chain bind the plates together. Life and health well up from this belt into your body.

While wearing your vitality belt, you gain a +4 morale bonus on Constitution checks and Constitution-based skill checks (but not on Fortitude saves). 

Essentia: For every point of essentia you invest in your vitality belt, you gain temporary hit points equal to your meldshaper level. 

Chakra Bind (Waist) 

A large star sapphire adorns the center of your vitality belt, gleaming vibrantly in any light. Any time you are subjected to an attack that would drain your vitality, the star at the heart of the sapphire dims momentarily, but your health does not suffer.

You are immune to Constitution damage and Constitution drain.

dst: “让我们看看你有什么……是的，这些看起来相当合适。作为奖励，我会让你从我冒险岁月中留下的几件物品中选一件。它们大多有相似的属性，都能显著提高你移动和反应的速度，不过代价是通常会削弱你的一些韧性和活力。不过，我想你可能想从你已有的物品中选一件，来替换掉我加入你物品栏的那件。那么你想要什么，头盔、链甲衫、轻型衬垫甲、护腕还是靴子？”他向你展示了他拥有的物品。
src: "Let's see what you have there...yes, these look to be quite suitable. As a reward, I'll offer you a choice of one of several items left over from my adventuring days. They mostly have similar properties, all significantly increase the speed at which you can move and react, though at a price, usually sapping your toughness and vitality somewhat. Still, I expect you might want a choice, among the items you already possess, as to which will need replacing for the sake of my addition to your inventory. So what do you want, a helm, a set of chainmail, light padded armor, bracers or boots?" He shows you the items he has.

dst:
“诅咒生物”是一个获得性模板，可以添加到任何类人生物（以下称为“基础生物”）.它使用基础生物的所有统计数据和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

防御等级：诅咒生物的天生防御加值比基础生物提高3。

伤害：诅咒生物有一个猛击攻击作为主要天生武器。

体型	基础伤害
小型	1d3
中型	1d4
大型	1d6

特殊品质：诅咒生物保留基础生物的所有特殊品质，并获得以下描述的那些。
快速治疗（Ex）：只要诅咒生物至少有1点生命值，它每轮治疗1点伤害。
免疫寒冷和火焰（Ex）：诅咒生物不受寒冷或火焰攻击的伤害。
法术抗力（Ex）：诅咒生物的法术抗力等于12 + 其角色等级。
驱散免疫（Ex）：诅咒生物不能被驱散，斥责，摧毁或命令。

属性：从基础生物改变如下：力量 +2，智力 -4（最低3），感知 -6（最低1），魅力 -2（最低1）.作为一个不死生物，诅咒生物没有体质值。

进阶：按角色职业。

等级调整：+3。
src:
"Curst" is an acquired template that can be added to any humanoid creature (referred to hereafter as the "base creature"). It uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Armor Class: The curst's natural armor bonus improves by 3 over that of the base creature.

Damage: A curst has a slam attack as a primary natural weapon.

Size	Base Damage
Small	1d3
Medium	1d4
Large	1d6

Special Qualities: A curst retains all the special qualities of the base creature and gains those described below.
Fast Healing (Ex): A curst heals 1 point of damage each round so long as it has at least 1 hit point. 
Immunity to Cold and Fire (Ex): A curst takes no damage from cold or fire attacks.
Spell Resistance (Ex): A curst has spell resistance equal to 12 + its character level.
Turning Immunity (Ex): Cursts cannot be turned, rebuked, destroyed, or commanded.

Abilities: Change from the base creature as follows: Str +2, Int -4 (minimum 3), Wis -6 (minimum 1), Cha -2 (minimum 1). As an undead creature, a curst has no Constitution score. 

Advancement: By character class.

Level Adjustment: +3.

dst: 我一直听到报告说，卡林港下水道中的鼠人种群最近不知为何变得非常具有攻击性，成群结队地组织起来，袭击任何进入下水道的人。这也许值得调查，但这也意味着我进入下水道时应该小心，因为那里已经变成了一个非常危险的地方。\n\n看来这些鼠人是变形蛛正在集结的敌对生物联盟的一部分。我想这并不太令人意外，因为如果它们代表的是另一个同时制造麻烦的势力，那也太巧了。我已经杀死了敌对鼠人的首领，并攻占了它们在下水道中的主要基地。虽然仍有一些敌对鼠人团伙可能还在下水道中游荡，但我预计它们造成的威胁现在会逐渐消退。
src: I have been hearing reports that the wererat population of Calimport's sewers has recently, for unknown reasons, become very aggressive, organizing in bands and attacking anyone entering the sewers. This may be something worthy of investigation, though it also means I should be careful about entering the sewers, as they have become a very dangerous place.\n\nIt appears the wererats were part of the coalition of hostile creatures being assembled by the aranea. Not too much of a surprise, I suppose, as it would have been quite a coincidence if they represented some other faction causing trouble at the same time. I have slain the leader of the hostile wererats and overrun their main base within the sewers. While some bands of hostile wererats might still be wandering the sewers, I expect the threat they pose will now be receding.

src: Spells per Day: A mighty contender of Kord continues the divine spellcasting training he began, but more slowly. For every two contender levels gained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had gained one level of the spellcasting class he belonged to before he added the prestige class. He does not gain any other benefit of the level (such as turning undead) that the character would have gained. This essentially means that he adds half his mighty contender level to the level of some other spellcasting class he has, then determines spells per day and caster level accordingly.

魂能：如果你将魂能投入凤凰腰带，它还能保护你免受火焰伤害。你获得火焰抗力，数值等于你投入此魂能的魂能点数乘以5. 

脉轮绑定（腰） 

你的霜冻头盔融合到你头顶，实际上在头盔顶部的奇异结节处打开了一个呼吸通道。

你可以将火焰伤害转化为快速治疗。每当你的火焰抗力减少基于火焰的法咒对你造成的伤害时，你获得快速治疗1，持续轮数等于你的抗力所抵消的伤害量。例如，如果你被火球击中受到22点伤害且有火焰抗力10，你将获得快速治疗1持续10轮（因为你的抗力抵消了10点伤害）.如果你被燃烧之手击中受到6点伤害，你只获得快速治疗1持续6轮（因为你的抗力只抵消了6点伤害）. 

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

你的霜冻头盔融合到你的头部并似乎向下蔓延，将你的上半面部外观变为类似霜虫的头部。你的眼睛融入头盔的奇异结节，你的脸颊扭曲成块状突起，你面部的皮肤变得厚实且呈蓝白色。

作为一个标准动作，你可以创造一圈瞬间的火焰环绕自己。与你相邻的生物受到每点投入凤凰腰带的魂能1d6点火焰伤害。成功的反射豁免将此伤害减半。

Phoenix Belt

Descriptors: Fire
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Waist (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

You shape a belt made of feathers the color of flame-various reds, oranges, and yellows. The feathers seem to shift in color, pulsing softly, like the embers of a dying fire.

While wearing a frost helm, you gain the Heat Endurance feat.

Essentia: If you invest essentia in your phoenix belt, it also protects you from fire damage. You gain resistance to fire equal to 5 times the number of points of essentia you invest in this soulmeld. 

Chakra Bind (Waist) 

Your frost helm fuses to the top of your head, actually opening a breathing channel in the strange nodule at the helm's crown.

You can turn fire damage into fast healing. Whenever your resistance to fire reduces the damage dealt to you by a fire-based spell, you gain fast healing 1 for a number of rounds equal to the amount of damage negated by your resistance. For example, if you were hit with a fireball for 22 points of damage and had resistance to fire 10, you would gain fast healing 1 for 10 rounds (since your resistance negated 10 points of damage). If instead you were hit with burning hands for 6 points of damage, you would gain fast healing 1 for only 6 rounds (since your resistance negated only 6 points of damage). 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your frost helm fuses to your head and seems to spread downward, changing the appearance of your upper face to resemble the head of a frost worm. Your eyes meld into the helm's strange nodule, your cheeks twist into lumpy protrusions, and the skin of your face grows thick and blue-white.

As a standard action, you can create a momentary ring of fire that surrounds you. Creatures adjacent to you take 1d6 points of fire damage per point of essentia you invest in your phoenix belt. A successful Reflex save reduces this damage by half.
