src:
Amber Sarcophagus
Evocation
Level: Sorcerer/wizard 7
Components: V,S,M
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 day/level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

You infuse an amber sphere with magical power and hurl it toward the target.  If you succeed on a ranged touch attack, the amber strikes the target and envelops it in coruscating energy that hardens immediately, trapping the target within a translucent, immobile amber shell.  The target is perfectly preserved and held in stasis, unharmed yet unable to take any actions.  Within the amber sarcophagus, the target is protected against all attacks, including purely mental ones.

The amber sarcophagus has hardness 5 and 10hp per caster level(maximum 200hp). If it is reduced to 0 hp, it shatters and crumbles to worthless amber dust, at which point the target is released from stasis (although it is flat footed until next
turn).  Left alone, the amber sarcophagus traps the target for the duration of the spell, then disappears before releasing the target from captive stasis.

Material Component: An amber sphere worth at least 500 gp.

src:

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Waist (totem)
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms a belt of spotted fur around your waist. At your back, short spines emerge from the belt. You note a marked increase in your appetite while you wear the belt.

While wearing your manticore belt, you gain a +2 enhancement bonus on Jump and Spot checks. 

Essentia: For every point of essentia you invest in your manticore belt, your enhancement bonus on Jump and Spot checks increases by 2.  

Chakra Bind (Waist)

Your manticore belt sprouts a pair of large, draconic wings. Though they are perched at your waist and flap awkwardly, these wings give you a reasonable ability of flight.

You can jump unlimited distances, and you gain the Spring Attack feat. 
 
Chakra Bind (Totem)

A long, thick tail emerges from the back of your manticore belt, writhing and lashing at your command. At its tip is a cluster of spikes. Like a manticore, you can propel those spikes at your foes.

As a standard action, you can snap your tail to loose a volley of spikes equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in your manticore belt. Make a ranged attack roll for each spike using your full base attack bonus. A successful hit deals 1d6 points of damage plus one-half your Strength modifier.

Good: if an evil creature succeeds on a melee attack against a warded creature, the offending attacker is blinded (Fortitude save negates, as blindness/deafness, but against holy aura's save DC).

Evil: if a good creature succeeds on a melee attack against a warded creature, the offending attacker takes 1d6 points of temporary Strength damage (Fortitude negates).

Law: if a chaotic creature succeeds on a melee attack against a warded creature, the attacker is slowed (Will save negates, as the slow spell, but against shield of law's save DC).

Chaos: if a lawful creature succeeds on a melee attack against a warded creature, the offending attacker is confused for 1 round (Will save negates, as with the confusion spell, but against the save DC of cloak of chaos).

dst: 德鲁伊对不死生物这种反常而不自然的现象怀有特殊的仇恨。曾经，当一片森林受到一群狂暴僵尸的威胁时，保护它的德鲁伊结社在外围种下了特殊的树木，这些树经过了德鲁伊们举行的强大仪式附魔。不死生物无法忍受靠近这些树。僵尸群从森林折返，放过了它，转而去别处制造麻烦。然而从长远来看，德鲁伊们最终后悔选择了这种保护方式，因为人们发现用这些树的木材制成的棍棒是对抗不死生物非常有效的武器。森林最终被那些想从这些魔法树木上廉价获取魔法武器并出售牟利的人砍伐殆尽。
src: Druids have a special hatred for the aberrant and unnatural phenomenon that is Undeath. Once, when a forest was threatened with ravaging by a horde of rampaging zombies, the circle of druids protecting it responded by planting special trees on its outskirts, trees enchanted by powerful rituals the druids had performed. Undead could not stand to go near these trees. The horde turned back from the forest, sparing it, and went off to cause trouble elsewhere. In the long run, though, the druids came to regret the method of protection they chose, for it was discovered that clubs fashioned from the wood of these trees made very effective weapons against the undead. The forest ended up being decimated by people seeking to make a fortune from the sale of magical weapons obtained cheaply from its magical trees.

dst:
（进阶职业）
传奇无畏舰是终极步兵，纯粹的灰飞烟灭力量，一位在纯粹战斗能力上出类拔萃的全面战士。有些人依靠战斗中的狡诈和反应，有些人遵守荣誉准则或进行马上战斗，而传奇无畏舰只是简单地涉入战斗，完全专注于无情，稳定的灰飞烟灭。当战斗的潮流对他不利时，他坚如磐石。正是传奇无畏舰拥有突破看似不可突破之门的力量。

- 生命骰：d12。
- 武器熟练：所有简易和军用武器，所有盔甲和盾牌。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求

基础攻击加值：+23
技能：威吓 15级。
专长：闪电反射，大顺劈，精通冲撞，精通重击。

职业特性：

等级
1：不可阻挡 - 每天一次，攻击检定获得20+加值，持续1轮。
2：不可移动 - 每天一次，纪律检定获得20+加值，并无法移动。
3：传奇坚韧。* - 角色获得20点生命值。
4：传奇伤害减免。* - 无畏舰获得3/-伤害减免。
5：奖励专长。
6：不可阻挡 - 每天两次。
7：不可移动 - 每天两次。
8：传奇强韧。
9：传奇伤害减免。* - 无畏舰获得6/-伤害减免。
10：奖励专长。
11：不可阻挡 - 每天三次。
12：不可移动 - 每天三次。
13：传奇坚韧。* - 角色获得额外20点生命值。
14：传奇伤害减免。* - 无畏舰获得9/-伤害减免。
15：奖励专长。

*Bioware使得无法通过自定义方法添加永久生命值。因此，在3级时角色将获得传奇坚韧1，在8级时获得传奇强韧，在13级时获得传奇坚韧2.这将总共提供40点生命值，而在PnP中总获得生命值将等于36.此外，为了使伤害减免与野蛮人和矮人防御者职业当前使用的伤害减免叠加，该职业获得传奇伤害减免，请适当规划你的角色构建。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Legendary Dreadnought is the ultimate foot soldier, an absolute force of destruction, a total warrior who excels at sheer combat prowess. While some rely of cunning and reflexes in a fight, and others uphold a code of honor or engage in combat from horseback, the Legendary Dreadnought simply wades into battle, completely bent on relentless, steady destruction. When the tide of combat flows against him, he stands like a rock. It is the Legendary Dreadnought who has the might to breach the seemingly unbreachable gates.

- Hit Die: d12.
- Proficiencies: All simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS

Base Attack Bonus: +23
Skills: Intimidate 15 ranks.
Feats: Lightning Reflexes, Great Cleave, Improved Bullrush, Improved Critical.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Unstoppable - Once per day, gains a 20+ bonus to attack rolls for 1 round.
2: Unmovable - Once per day, gains a 20+ bonus to Discipline checks, and is immobile.
3: Epic Toughness.* - Character gains 20 HP.
4: Epic Damage Reduction.* - Dreadnought gains 3/- damage reduction.
5: Bonus Feat.
6: Unstoppable - Twice per day.
7: Unmovable - Twice per day.
8: Epic Fortitude.
9: Epic Damage Reduction.* - Dreadnought gains 6/- damage reduction.
10: Bonus Feat.
11: Unstoppable - Three times per day.
12: Unmovable - Three times per day.
13: Epic Toughness.* - Character gains an additional 20 HP.
14: Epic Damage Reduction.* - Dreadnought gains 9/- damage reduction.
15: Bonus Feat.

*Bioware has made it impossible to add permanent HP by custom methods. Therefore, at 3rd level the Character will gain Epic Toughness 1, at 8th, Epic Fortitude, and at 13 Epic Toughness 2. This will grant a total of 40hp while in PnP the total gained HP would equal 36. Additionally to get the Damage Reduction to stack with current damage reduction used by the Barbarian and Dwarven Defender Classes the class gains Epic Damage Reduction, plan your character builds appropriately.

src:
A silver aura surrounds the touched shield for a moment before it appears to transform into the chosen type of energy. The shield hums with power.

When this spell is cast, the shield touched appears to be made entirely out of one type of energy (fire, cold, electricity, acid, or sonic). Whoever bears the shield gains resistance 5 against the chosen energy type. Additionally, if the wielder successfully hits someone with the shield with a shield bash attack, the victim takes 1d6 points of the appropriate energy damage in addition to the normal shield bash damage. The energy type must be chosen when the spell is cast and cannot be changed during the duration of the spell. The energy resistance overlaps (and does not stack) with resist elements. A given shield cannot be the subject of more than one lesser energized shield or energized shield spell at the same time.

The descriptor of this spell is the same as the energy type you choose when you cast it.

dst:
唤起蔚蓝印记
塑能系
等级：吟游诗人 3，牧师 3，德鲁伊 2，圣武士 3，巡林客 2，术士/法师 3
成分：姿势
施法时间：1 标准动作
距离：30 尺
区域：从角色向外扩散至距离极限的区域内，总生命骰数不超过施法者等级两倍的多个异怪
持续时间：立即
豁免检定：强韧，通过则无效
法术抗力：无

蔚蓝印记是一个古老的符号，据说体现了自然世界的纯净，因此对异怪来说是一种诅咒。虽然德鲁伊和巡林客是最常被知道施放这个古老法咒的职业，但它的魔法几乎具有普遍性，可以被所有施法职业掌握。

当你施放这个法咒时，你用手在空中描绘蔚蓝印记，在空中留下一个发光的蓝色符文，短暂片刻后它闪烁并释放出一道蔚蓝光芒的脉冲，充满效果区域。区域内的任何异怪必须进行强韧豁免检定，否则遭受以下不良效果。较近的异怪先受影响。

异怪生命骰            效果
至多施法者等级 +10          无
至多施法者等级 +5           恶心
至多施法者等级             反胃
至多施法者等级 -5           眩晕
至多施法者等级 -10          震慑

每个效果持续 1 轮。

无：异怪不受任何不良效果影响，即使它豁免检定失败。

恶心：异怪在攻击检定，豁免检定，技能检定和属性检定上受到 -2 减值，持续 1 轮。

反胃：异怪不能攻击，施放法咒，集中精神施法，或做任何事，只能进行一个移动动作，持续 1 轮。

眩晕：异怪不能采取任何动作，但对其防御等级没有减值，持续 1 轮。

震慑：异怪掉落所有持握的物品，不能采取动作，防御等级受到 -2 减值，并失去其防御等级上的敏捷加值（若有），持续 1 轮。

一旦生物从某个效果中恢复，它在表格上向上移动一级。因此，被此法咒震慑的生物在下一轮变为眩晕，再下一轮变为反胃，再下一轮变为恶心，然后在下一轮完全恢复。
src:
Invoke The Cerulean Sign
Evocation
Level: Bard 3, cleric 3, druid 2, paladin 3, ranger 2, sorc/wiz 3
Components: S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 30 ft.
Area: Multiple aberrations whose combined total Hit Dice do not exceed twice caster level in a spread emanating from the character to the extreme of the range
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates
Spell Resistance: No

The cerulean sign is an ancient symbol said to embody the purity of the natural world, and as such it is anathema to aberrations. While druids and rangers are the classes most often known to cast this ancient spell, its magic is nearly universal and can be mastered by all spellcasting classes.

When you cast this spell, you trace the cerulean sign in the air with a hand, leaving a glowing blue rune in the air for a brief moment before it flashes and fills the area of effect with a pulse of cerulean light. Any aberration within the area must make a Fortitude saving throw or suffer the following ill effects. Closer aberrations are affected first.

Aberration Hit Dice            Effect
Up to caster level +10          None
Up to caster level +5           Sickened
Up to caster level              Nauseated
Up to caster level -5           Dazed
Up to caster level -10          Stunned

Each effect lasts for 1 round.

None: The aberration suffers no ill effect, even if it fails the saving throw.

Sickened: The aberration takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round.

Nauseated: The aberration cannot attack, cast spells, concentrate on spells, or do anything but take a single move action for 1 round.

Dazed: The aberration can take no actions, but has no penalty to its Armor Class, for 1 round.

Stunned: The aberration drops everything held, can't take actions, takes a -2 penalty to AC, and loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) for 1 round.

Once a creature recovers from an effect, it moves up one level on the table. Thus, a creature that is stunned by this spell is dazed the round after that, nauseated the round after that, sickened the round after that, and then recovers fully
the next round.

dst:
我与一位塞露涅的牧师谈过，他正试图在卡林港为这位神祇建立一座神殿，希望以此对抗莎尔在世界这一地区过大的影响力。他告诉我，神殿的建造工作正受到破坏者的干扰，他们夜间出动，捣毁白天建好的一些部分。他请求我设法处理此事。他建议我从神殿后门出去，那里堆放着大量建筑材料，找些板条箱躲在后面。从那里我可以在夜间（破坏行为发生时）进行监视，运气好的话，我会看到破坏者靠近，并能够阻止他们。如果可能的话，最好还能找到一些确凿的证据，查明幕后主使是谁。

我看到一个可疑的身影靠近神殿，在他造成任何破坏之前把他吓跑了。然而，如果我想查明他是谁或他的目的是什么，我就必须动身追赶。他跑得很快，如果我不尽快追上他，很可能会在这个错综复杂的巷弄迷宫中跟丢他。我需要朝他离开的方向追去，并希望在各个岔路口找到他往哪个方向去的线索。如果几分钟内还没找到他，很可能就再也追不上了。

我花了几分钟试图追赶这个可疑的身影，却没能追上。此时我只能认为他已经成功逃脱了。真可惜，但至少我可以回到神殿，报告我成功挫败了今晚的恶行。
src:
I spoke to a priest of Selune who is attempting to establish a temple to that deity in Calimport, in hopes of counteracting the excessive influence of Shar in this region of the world. He told me that construction work on the temple is being disrupted by vandals, who strike at night and wreck some of the building done during the day. He has asked me to try and do something about this. He suggests I go out the back entrance of the temple, where a lot of constuction materials are piled up, and find some crates to hide behind. From there I can watch during the night (when the vandalism occurs) and with any luck I will see the perpetrators approach and be able to stop them. It would be good as well to find some solid evidence about who is behind this, if possible.

I saw a suspicious figure approaching the temple and scared him off before he could do any damage. If I wish to find out anything about who he is or what his purposes are, however, I will have to set out in pursuit. He can run quickly and I will likely lose him in this complicated maze of alleys if I do not catch up to him soon. I need to head off in the direction he went and hope to find clues as to which direction he took at any intersections. If I have not found him within a few minutes it will likely be too late to ever do so.

I have been unable to catch this suspicious figure after some minutes spent trying to do so. By this time I can only assume he had made good his escape. Too bad, but at least I can report my success in frustrating toninght's mischief back at the temple.

Eligor, Dragon's Slayer
    
A champion both against and for evil dragons, Eligor grants martial prowess both in and out of the saddle, as well as supernatural strength.
  
Vestige Level: 7th
Binding DC: 30
Special Requirement: No
  
Influence: You feel pity for all outcasts, particularly half-elves and half-orcs, and you make every effort to befriend any such beings you meet. Because Eligor desires revenge on the deities who abandoned him, he requires that you attack a human, elf, or dragon foe in preference to all others whenever you enter combat.
  
Granted Abilities: 
In his first life, Eligor was a skilled horseman, and in his second, he served the primary deity of chromatic dragons. Thus, the powers he grants tend to reflect those associations.
 
Chromatic Strike: As a free action, you can charge a melee attack with acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Your next melee attack deals an extra 1d6 points of damage of the chosen energy type. You can charge a single melee attack only once.
 
Eligor's Skill in the Saddle: You gain the benefits of the Mounted Combat and Mounted Archery feats.
 
Eligor's Strength: You gain a +4 bonus to Strength.
 
Eligor's Resilience: You gain a +3 enhancement bonus to natural armor. This bonus improves to +4 at 16th level and to +5 at 20th level.
 
Heavy Armor Proficiency: You are proficient with heavy armor.

dst:
渊蛇是人类与蛇类血脉混合的后裔。他们的狡诈和无情是传奇般的，他们根据情况与任何种族结盟的能力也是如此。在渊蛇社会中，纯血构成贵族，而憎恶则是战斗力量。所有渊蛇都表现出不同程度的蛇类特征，并且所有渊蛇都能说深渊语。由于他们的智力，渊蛇纯血能够组织自己并以与任何种族相当的技能战斗。他们偏好远程攻击和法咒而非近战，并会在肉搏战中牺牲社区中最不受欢迎的成员。渊蛇纯血乍看之下像人类，只有非常微妙的蛇类特征。

渊蛇纯血属性调整：+2 敏捷，+2 智力，+2 魅力。
天赋职业（巡林客）：在决定兼职渊蛇是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其巡林客职业不计入。

特殊能力：

- 黑暗视觉：渊蛇纯血能够在黑暗中视物。
- 警觉：由于精细的感官，侦察和聆听检定获得+2加值。
- 盲斗：渊蛇在目盲或对抗隐形生物时能够良好战斗。
- 武器熟练（简易）：所有渊蛇都熟练使用简易武器。
- 护甲熟练（轻型）：所有渊蛇都熟练使用轻型护甲。
- 盾牌：所有渊蛇都熟练使用盾牌。
- 法术抗力：天生法术抗力14，每角色等级+1。
- 天生防御加值：种族天生防御加值为1。
- 类法咒能力：每日1次 - 魅惑人类，黑暗术，纠缠术，恐惧术。施法者等级3级。豁免DC基于魅力。
- 怪物：在法咒效果方面，渊蛇纯血视为怪物人形生物。

（以下内容可能使用也可能不使用，取决于模组开关设置）
等级调整：+2
种族生命骰/职业：4级怪物人形生物
src:
Yuan-ti are descended from humans whose bloodlines have been mixed with those of snakes. Their cunning and ruthlessness are legendary, as are their ability to allied with any race as the situation suits. In Yuan-ti society, Purebloods comprise the nobility while Abominations are the fighting force. All yuan-ti exhibit snake-like features in varying degrees, and all yuan-ti are able to speak Abyssal. Because of their intelligence, yuan-ti purebloods are able to organize themselves and fight with skill comparable to that of any race. The prefer ranged attacks and spells to melee and will sacrifice the least desirable members of the community in hand-to-hand combat. Yuan-ti purebloods appear human at first glance, with only very subtle snakelike features.

Yuan-ti Pureblood Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Int, +2 Cha.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass yuan-ti's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Yuan-ti Purebloods are able to see in the dark.
- Alertness: +2 bonus to Spot and Listen checks due to finely tuned senses.
- Blind Fighting: Yuan-ti have the ability to fight well if blinded or against invisible creatures.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All yuan-ti are proficient with simple weapons.
- Armor Proficiency (Light): All yuan-ti are proficient with light armor.
- Shield: All yuan-ti are proficient with shields.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 14, plus 1 per character level.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 1.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Charm Person, Darkness, Entangle, Fear. Caster level 3rd. The DC is Charisma-based.
- Monstrous: Yuan-ti Purebloods count as Monstrous Humanoids for the purpose of spells.

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)
Level Adjustment: +2
Racial Hit Dice/Class: 4 of Monstrous Humanoid

src: "So it is said. My understanding is that most of those who have some gift for prophecy can see only bits and pieces of the future, whether because of some limitation to their talent or because the future is still in flux and only some of it is there to be seen I do not know. It is claimed that the Abbalayar have advanced their art to a point where it does not suffer such common deficiencies, but who knows? It may be someone thought their reputation exaggerated, and sought to prove it, for I have heard rumors that there was some sort of disturbance there a year or so ago. I do not know exactly what happened though. In any case, these tracks suggest that Ul'Sahab is not relevant to our current quest."

dst: "没错，我们不太会说他们的语言，可能有些沟通不畅，但说真的，他们应该比那更懂我们的意思。我猜人住得那么靠北，脑子都冻住了。其中一个被抓的人懂一点当地语言，能解释我们想要什么，所以我们最终还是得到了雪人，不过那真是对我耐心的一大考验。把它们运到文明地区也是件大工程，不过那也许是另一天的故事了。"
src: "True, we didn't speak their language very well and there could have been some miscommunication, but really, they should have understood us better than that. I guess people's brains freeze when they live that far north. One of those captured people knew a bit more of the local tongues and was able to explain what we wanted, so we did finally get our yetis, though it turned out to be quite a test of my patience. Transporting them to civilization was also quite a task, but perhaps that's a story for another day."

src:
Arcane Focus

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Incarnate, Soulborn 
Chakra: Throat 
Saving Throw: See text

A necklace of blue crystals fits around your neck. The crystals shed a faint glow that increases in brightness when you cast a damaging spell.

When you cast an arcane spell that deals damage, your spell's damage is increased by 1 point. Spells that divide their damage among multiple targets, such as magic missile, deal the extra damage once to each affected target. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your arcane focus increases the extra damage by 1 point. 

Chakra Bind (Throat) 

Barely visible wisps of incarnum writhe from your arcane focus, tendrils of soul energy that twist into arcane symbols as you cast arcane spells. When you cast a damaging spell, the spell is accompanied by a blue-white burst of raw incarnum energy.

Whenever you cast a spell that deals damage to a single living creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save (using the soulmeld's save DC, not the spell's) or be dazed for 1 round.

dst:
（进阶职业）
泰尔法姆的暗影大师是费伦最臭名昭著的游荡者公会之一，一个与西门城暗夜面具或安姆暗影游荡者同样贪婪和残忍的秘密社团。在他们微妙而隐蔽的统治下，塞斯克的港口城市泰尔法姆是合法和非法商品的主要贸易中心。暗影大师由窃贼，杀手和暴徒组成，拥有各种才能，包括刺客，专家，战士，游荡者，影舞者和武士。少数献身于马斯克的牧师属于该公会，还有一些贪婪胜过良知的奥术施法者。在这些罪犯之上是泰尔法姆暗影领主，罪恶的秘密首领，要求他们众多手下无条件服从。其他职业的角色可能在公会中担任重要职位，但暗影领主发号施令。

- 生命骰：d6。
- 熟练：泰尔法姆暗影大师不获得任何武器和护甲熟练。
- 技能点：4+智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：任何非善良。
专长：盲斗，闪避，灵活移动，跳跃攻击。
技能：躲藏10级，潜行10级，学识2级。
偷袭：2d6。
特殊：必须至少拥有以下之一：
  1) 证明向泰尔法姆公会捐赠10,000金币的令牌

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Shadowmasters of Telflamm are one of Faerun's most notorious thieves' guilds, a secret society every bit as grasping and ruthless as the Night Masks of Westgate or the Shadow Thieves of Amn. Under their subtle and cloaked rule, Thesk's port city of Telflamm is a prime center of trade in both legal and illicit goods. The Shadowmasters are made up of burglars, murderers, and thugs with a variety of talents, including assassins, experts, fighters, rogues, shadowdancers, and warriors. A small number of clerics devoted to Mask belong to the guild, as do some arcane spellcasters whose greed outweighs their scruples. Above all these criminals stand the Telflammar shadowlords, the secret captains of iniquity who demand unquestioned obedience from their numerous minions. Characters of other classes may hold important positions in the guild, but the shadowlords call the shots.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: The Shadowmasters of Telflammar gains no proficiency in any weapons and armors.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any Non-Good.
Feats: Blind-Fight, Dodge, Mobility, Spring Attack.
Skills: Hide 10 ranks, Move Silently 10 ranks, Lore 2 ranks.
Sneak Attack: 2d6.
Special: Must have at least ONE of the following:
  1) A token proving a donation of 10,000 gold to the Telflamm Guild
  2) The ability to cast Level 4 Arcane Spells
  3) Shadowdancer Level 1

src: In the sewers beneath Zazesspur, I came across an adventurer named Jalkesi Tzaru, and then fought through a Yuan-Ti hideout to free her from a trap. According to her, the Yuan-Ti are here to seek out something of value in some ruins of dwarven Shanatar that can be found further beneath the city. She does not know what they seek, but if it is important enough to be worth such effort, it can hardly be desirable for whatever it might be to fall into such dubious hands. A path leading down and eventually to these ruins lies nearby, doubtless guarded by additional Yuan-Ti. I have decided to accompany her as she seeks to follow this path and foil the plans of the Yuan-Ti. Time to head down.\n\nIt appears that the Yuan-Ti were here to reopen a portal to the Abyss that the dwarves uncovered, but then sealed, long ago. It took a lot of fighting and a brief foray through that portal into the Abyss, but their plans have been frustrated, and most or all of them slain. Jalkesi was pleased with this result, but having accomplished the task for which she asked our aid we have now parted ways.

dst:
阴影之手（打击）
等级：贤者之剑 9
先决条件：五项阴影之手招式
发动动作：1 标准动作
距离：近战攻击
目标：一个生物
持续时间：1 分钟
豁免检定：强韧部分；见文本

一次突刺，你刺穿了敌人的核心。终极寒冷的暗影笼罩他的心脏，并开始沿着他的血管蔓延至他身体的五个点。

作为此招式的一部分，你进行一次近战攻击。如果命中，你造成正常近战伤害外加额外15d6点伤害，并且一道暗影从你的敌人心脏扩散，冻结他血管中的血液。

掷一个d20并参考以下信息来确定冻结暗影向他的身体哪个点蔓延。即使你的对手不是类人生物，此效果也生效；一旦你击中了敌人的心脏，即使生物解剖结构不同，暗影也会产生相同的效果。
结果 1-7：蔓延至腿部。属性伤害：2d6 敏捷。特殊效果：速度降低至0英尺。
结果 8-14：蔓延至手臂。属性伤害：2d6 力量。特殊效果：攻击检定和专注检定-6减值。
结果 15-20：击中心脏。属性伤害：2d6 敏捷，2d6 力量。特殊效果：2d6点体质伤害。

被此攻击击中的敌人必须成功通过强韧豁免（DC 19 + 你的感知调整值）来抵抗其效果。豁免成功时，目标忽略攻击的任何特殊效果，并只承受所列属性伤害的一半（但仍承受正常近战伤害以及额外15d6点伤害）.每个特殊效果持续1d6轮。
此招式是超自然能力。
src:
Shadow Hand (Strike)
Level: Swordsage 9
Prerequisite: Five Shadow Hand maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 minute
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial; see text

With a single lunge, you pierce your enemy to the core. A shadow of ultimate cold falls over his heart and begins to worm through his veins to the five points of his body.

As part of this maneuver, you make a single melee attack. If you hit, you deal normal melee damage plus an extra 15d6 points of damage, and a shadow spreads out from your enemy's heart, freezing the blood in his veins.

Roll a d20 and refer to the information below to determine toward which point of his body the freezing shadow spreads. This effect functions even if your opponent is not humanoid; once you have struck your foe's heart, the shadow produces the same effects even in a creature with a different anatomy.
Result of 1-7: Spreads out to legs. Ability damage: 2d6 Dex. Special effect: Speed is reduced to 0 feet.
Result of 8-14: Spreads out to arms. Ability damage: 2d6 Str. Special effect: -6 penalty on attack rolls and Concentration checks.
Result of 15-20: Struck in the heart. Ability damage: 2d6 Dex, 2d6 Str. Special effect: 2d6 points of Constitution damage.

A foe struck by this attack must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 19 + your Wis modifier) to resist its effects. On a successful save, the target ignores any special effect from the attack and takes half the indicated ability damage (but still takes normal melee damage as well as the extra 15d6 points of damage). Each of the special effects lasts for 1d6 rounds.
This maneuver is a supernatural ability.

Righteous Smite
Evocation [Good]
Level: Clr 7, exalted arcanist 7, Wrath 7
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area: 20-ft. radius spread
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will partial; see text
Spell Resistance: Yes

You draw down holy power to smite your enemies. Only evil and neutral creatures are harmed by the spell; good creatures are unaffected.

The spell deals 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) to evil creatures (or 1d8 points of damage per caster level, maximum 20d8, to evil outsiders) and blinds them for 1d4 rounds. A successful Will saving throw reduces damage to half and negates the blinding effect.

The spell deals only half damage against creatures that are neither good nor evil, and they are not blinded. They can reduce that damage by half (down to one quarter of the roll) with a successful Will save.

src: "Besides even if it is true that the possibility of an actual conquest of Calimshan can be dismissed, such an army might kill many and destroy much before it was stopped. It is the responsibility of the pashas to guard against such dangers. The only thing that can possibly justify the nobility's privileges and wealth is its willingness to do its duty in the defense of the realm. Unfortunately too many pashas seem no longer to understand this, and cannot be made to care unless their own safety or wealth is threatened, and indeed threatened in a crudely obvious way. They anticipate no more than the loss of few peasants, and that apparently means nothing to them."

托洛丁的杀戮之风旨在杀死大量生物，并且效果显著；一次施法就能消灭整个部落。托洛丁本人最初的法咒覆盖了许多英里，持续了许多小时。关于托洛丁正朝你的城市前进的谣言让你脊背发凉。据说他独自走向战场，又独自离开。幸运的是，其传奇般的广阔范围在许多时代前就已失传，但我们现在所拥有的形式仍然是一种不容小觑的强大力量。被云团笼罩的生物有权进行强韧豁免检定，-4减值，否则被法咒杀死。留在云团内的生物每连续一轮都需要再次豁免，直到离开云团。施放此法咒会自动暂时吸取施法者两个等级（给予他负向等级），以及两点体质，直到法咒消散。
src:
School: Necromancy (Death)
Components: V, S
Range: Long
Target: AOE: Colossal - 40' radius
Duration: 10 rounds
Saving Throw: Fortitude at -4.
Spell Resistance: Yes

Tolodine's killing wind was designed to kill large numbers of creatures, and it worked well; wiping out whole tribes in a single cast. The original spell by Tolodine himself, covered many miles and lasted many hours. The rumor that Tolodine was headed toward your city put a sheer chill up your spine. It was said he walked solo to the battle field, and left solo. Fortunately, the epic vastness of its reaches was lost many ages ago, but the form we have now is still a vast power to be reckoned. Creatures caught within the cloud were entitled a saving throw vs. fortitude at a penalty of -4 or be killed by the spell. Those who remain within the cloud will need to make another save each successive round until they exit the cloud. The casting of this spell automatically temporarily drains the caster of two levels (bestowing negative levels upon him), and two constitution points until the spell evaporates.

dst: "是的。由于与阿巴索合作，这里的每个人都在某种程度上被他的邪恶所污染，因此没有人能完全克服他的诅咒。然而，我们的神祇告诉我们，如果有一个活着的矮人回到这些大厅，<he/she>就能做到这一点。当这样一位勇士对抗阿巴索的信徒时，他们的死亡将变为永久。而随着战争最终解决，我们的诅咒也会被解除，我们就能像几个世纪前本该做的那样前往来世。他们预言，终有一天，这样一位救世主真的会到来。而你就在这里，一个活生生的矮人，而且相当有能力与强大的敌人战斗。"
src: "Yes. Having worked with Abbathor, everyone here was to some extent tainted by his evil, and thus none could ever fully overcome his curses. Our gods told us, however, that if ever a living dwarf returned to these halls, <he/she> would be able to do so. When such a champion went up against Abbathor's followers, their deaths would now be permanent. And with the war finally resolved, our curse too would be lifted and we could proceed to the afterlife as we should have centuries ago. They prophecied that one day, such a savior would indeed come. And here you are, a living dwarf, and one quite capable of battling powerful foes."

dst: 进入绿龙格拉阿扎乌库尔的巢穴时，我们遇到了卡林杉贵族奥利姆·卡查尔雇用的刺客塞穆·纳拉卡。他告诉我们，格拉阿扎乌库尔是他的盟友，希望我们不要与他交战。由于他和卡查尔显然也反对阿兹古尔卡，他也不想妨碍我们对抗那个塔纳厘。作为攻击格拉阿扎乌库尔的替代方案，他提出开启一道传送门，将我们送往银龙塔拉孔达祖姆的堡垒。我们从那条龙身上大概也能找到至少同样值钱的战利品，而且，塔拉孔达祖姆似乎还在充当某个强大存在的狱卒，而那存在也是阿兹古尔卡的敌人。因此，释放这名囚犯或许能为我们首要目标赢得一位宝贵的盟友。\n\n见这个替代方案没有坏处，我便同意了。纳拉卡开启传送门后便跑走了。
src: Upon entering the lair of the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, we were met by Semu Naraka, the assassin employed by Calishite noble Olim Khachar. He told us that Gra'azha'ukul was an ally of his, and would prefer that we not fight him. Since he and Khachar are also apparently opposed to Azghulkar, he did not want to get in the way of our opposition to that tanar'ri either. As an alternative to attacking Gra'azha'ukul, he offered to open a portal that would take us to the keep of Tarakondazum, a silver dragon. We could probably find loot at least as valuable from the one dragon as the other, and, in addition, Tarakondazum is apparently acting as the jailer of some powerful entity who is also an enemy of Azghulkar. Freeing this prisoner could thus gain us a valuable ally in our primary objective. \n\nSeeing no downside to this alternative, I agreed. Naraka opened a portal and then ran off.

But for now, I am sure he has given you tasks of your own to attend to, as he has for me, so perhaps we should be about them."

dst: 半炼狱生物是魔鬼与凡人结合的后代。由于这种结合中的凡人一方很少能长久存活，大多数半炼狱生物最终落入其炼狱父母在地狱（半恶魔则为深渊）的“照料”之下，在那里受到残酷对待。与真正的炼狱生物相比，他们被视为低等存在，几乎无望在下层位面的无尽战争中晋升为超越低阶仆从或高度消耗性突击部队的存在。只有非凡的才能才能使他们免于这样的命运。他们通常对自己的处境心怀怨恨，这种态度虽然可以理解，却大大增加了他们屈服于自身炼狱本性的可能性，从而讽刺性地最终成为那些如此虐待他们的怪物父母邪恶目标的忠实仆从。
src: Half-fiends are the offspring of a devil and a mortal parent. Since the mortal half of such unions rarely survives for long, most half-fiends end up under the "care" of their fiendish parent in the Hells (or the Abyss in the case of half-demons), where they are brutally treated. Considered of low status compared to true fiends, they have little hope of ever becoming anything beyond low-level minions or highly expendable shock troops in the endless wars of the lower planes. Only extraordinary prowess can save them from such fates. Typically they are resentful of their situation, an attitude which, however understandable, greatly increases the likelihood that they wil succumb to the fiendish half of their natures and thus ironically end up as devoted servants of the evil goals of the monstrous parent who so mistreated them.

dst: "你说得对，当然。从某种意义上说，我们才刚刚开始。我们还得想办法去烛堡。我研究过这一带的地理。如果我们就在云峰山脉以北，烛堡大概在西北方向几天的路程。如果我们朝那个方向走，应该不难找到那座大图书馆。我们只需要一直走，直到抵达海岸或一条路，然后再调整方向。但首先我们可能想找个城镇之类的地方休息和补给。纳什凯尔是云峰山脉以北的一个安姆城镇。它可能就在我们现在的位置附近。如果我们往北走，应该就能找到它，或者找到通往那里的路或小径。"
src: "You're right, of course. In a sense we're just getting started. We still need to get to Candlekeep somehow. I've studied the geography of this region a bit. If we're just north of the Cloudpeak mountains, Candlekeep will be a couple days' journey or so to the northwest. If we go in that direction, it shouldn't be hard to locate the great library. All we'd need to do is travel until we hit the coast or a road, and adjust from there. But first we probably want to find a town or some place like that where we can rest and resupply. Nashkel is an Amnian town just north of the Cloudpeaks. It's probably near where we are now. If we just go north we should find it, or a road or trail leading to it."

The epic artificer remains a master of item creation, gaining an increasing craft reserve and plenty of bonus feats to learn the craft of epic item creation.

Hit Die: d6
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4+ Int Modifier
Bonus Feats:  The epic artificer gains a bonus epic item creation feat every three levels after 20th

Infusions: An epic artificer's caster level is equal to his class level. The artificer's number of infusions per day does not increase after 20th level.
An epic artificer doesn't automatically gain infusion slots above 6th level, though he can select the Improved Spell Capacity feat to gain infusion slots above 6th level (which can be used to hold lower-level infusions or infusions whose level has been increased above 6th by the use of metamagic feats).
Craft Reserve: An epic artificer's craft reserve increases by 1,000 points per level beyond 20th (6,000 points at 21st level. 7,000 points at 22nd level, and so on).

dst: 我找到了一张纸，是一个叫佐拉克·乌斯-卡拉格的人写的，他是我们之前击败的牛头人海盗船长托斯·乌斯-卡拉格的兄弟。显然佐拉克不知怎么得知我们对他兄弟的死负有责任，并悬赏要扎拉拉和我的项上人头。这张纸的副本显然正在泰瑟尔乡间的各种劫掠类人生物中分发。\n\n佐拉克·乌斯-卡拉格和他的一些手下终于找到了我，但我击败了他们。佐拉克逃进了一个似乎是附近洞穴系统的地方，挑衅我跟着他。我想，如果我想从他的复仇企图中获得安宁，我别无选择，只能跟进去并试图猎杀他。
src: I have found a paper written by one Zorak Uth-Karag, the brother of Toth Uth-Karag, the captain of the minotaur pirates we defeated earlier. Apparently Zorak has somehow learned that we were responsible for his brother's death, and is offering a reward for the heads of Zarala and myself. Copies of this paper are apparently being distributed among various raiding humanoids in the Tethyrian countryside.\n\nZorak Uth-Karag and some of his minions finally found me, but I defeated them. Zorak fled into what appears to be a nearby cave system, daring me to follow after him. I expect that if I am ever to know peace from his attempts at vengeance, I have little choice but to do so and attempt to hunt him down.

This has become a place of horror."

src: Spells per Day: At each indicated forest master level, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class to which he belonged before adding the prestige class level. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (such as an improved chance of turning or rebuking undead). If the character had more than one divine spellcasting class before becoming a forest master, the player must decide to which class to add each forest master level for the purpose of determining spells per day.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
A Blackguard epitomizes evil. They are nothing short of a mortal fiend, a black knight with the foulest sort of reputation. Many refer to Blackguards as anti-paladins due to their completely evil nature. No one class makes the best Blackguard, all that is required is a willingness to serve the forces of darkness.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: All simple and martial weapons, all types of armor, and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any evil.
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Hide 5 ranks.
Feats: Cleave.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Use Poison - Automatic success when coating a weapon with poison.
2: Smite Good - Add Charisma modifier to attack roll. 1/day
  Dark Blessing - Add Charisma modifier to saving throws.
3: Turn Undead - Make undead flee.
  Aura of Despair
4: Sneak Attack +1d6.
5: Summon Fiend - summons a fiendish ally.
7: Sneak Attack +2d6.
10: Sneak Attack +3d6.

Spells: A blackguard has the ability to cast a small number of divine spells. To cast a blackguard spell, a blackguard must have a Wisdom score of at least 10 + the spell's level, so a blackguard with a Wisdom of 10 or lower cannot cast these spells. Blackguard bonus spells are based on Wisdom, and saving throws against these spells have a DC of 10 + spell level + the blackguard's Wisdom modifier. The blackguard's spell list appears below. A blackguard has access to any spell on the list and can freely choose which to prepare, just as a cleric. A blackguard prepares and casts spells just as a cleric does (though a blackguard cannot spontaneously cast cure or inflict spells).

猫人是一个游牧的猫科类人生物种族，通常漫游在草原上。在身体上，他们类似人类和大型掠食性猫科动物的混合体，拥有覆盖轻毛的类人身体以及猫科动物的头部和鬃毛。他们没有尾巴和真正的爪子，只是有更厚的指甲，但他们用脚趾行走，而不是像其他类人生物那样平足行走。最常见的猫人类似狮子，但也有其他部落类似豹，虎或猎豹。猫人的寿命与人类相似。

猫人属性调整：+4 敏捷，+2 魅力
天赋职业（巡林客）：在判断兼职猫人是否承受 XP 惩罚时，其巡林客职业不计入。

特殊能力：

- 微光视觉：允许他们在黑暗中比正常看得更好。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（潜行）：潜行检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 天生防御加值：种族天生防御加值为 1。
- 怪物：在法咒效果上，猫人视为人形怪物。

种族生命骰/职业：无
src:
Catfolk are a race of nomadic feline humanoids who typically roam grassy plains.  Physically they resemble a cross between a human and a large predatory cat, with a lightly furred humanoid body and the head and mane of a feline.  They lack a tail and actual claws, simply having thicker nails instead, but they do walk on their toes rather than flatfooted like other humanoids.  The most common catfolk resemble lions, but there are other tribes that resemble leopards, tigers, or cheetahs.  Catfolk have a lifespan similar to that of humans.

Catfolk Ability Adjustments: +4 Dexterity, +2 Charisma
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass catfolk's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 1.
- Monstrous: Catfolk count as Monstrous Humanoids for the purpose of spells.

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)

dst: 在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给莎尔神殿的首席女祭司费拉莎看时，她认出这是不久前被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。她因我交给她找到的碎片而奖赏了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，她也想要，以便莎尔神殿可以玷污他们敌人提尔的这件圣物。\n\n我找到了圣环的第二块碎片。费拉莎告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，她可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。费拉莎希望我去完成这次取回任务，并承诺如果我成功，将给予丰厚的奖励。最后这块碎片很可能和前两块一样由不死生物守卫，而且我返回时界门会崩塌，所以在取回最后一块碎片之前我不能返回。当我准备好执行这个任务时，应该再和费拉莎谈谈。
src: In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Ferazha, the head priestess of the Temple of Shar, she recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. She rewarded me for giving her the piece I found, and has told me that she would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find, so that the Temple of Shar might defile this artifact of their enemy Tyr.\n\nI have found a second piece of the holy ring. Ferazha has informed me that with two pieces of the ring, she can cast a divination spell that will locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that will transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. Ferazha would like me to effect this recovery, and has promised a substantial reward should I accomplish it. This final fragment is liikely to be guarded by undead as the first two were, and I the portal will collapse when I return, so I will not be able to do so until the final piece is recovered. I should speak to Ferazha again when I am prepared to carry out this quest.

src:
Abjuration
Level: Blackguard 4, Cleric 4, Paladin 4,
Components: V, S, DF,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 20 ft. or 60 ft.
Area: 20-ft.-radius emanation or 60-ft.-radius burst, centered on you
Duration: 1 round/level or until discharged
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial
Spell Resistance: Yes

A rush of divine energy flows through your holy symbol, infusing your body with the essence of the divine ethos. When you cast this spell, choose one non-neutral aspect of your own alignment-chaos, evil, good, or law. (If you are neutral, you can select whichever alignment you wish each time you cast this spell). You are immediately surrounded in a 20-foot aura of invisible energy associated with the chosen alignment component. Anyone in that area who shares that alignment component gains a bonus, and anyone with the opposed alignment component must make a Fortitude save or take a penalty. The values of these modifiers and the features to which they apply are given on the following table. These modifiers end when the affected creature leaves the spell's area.

Chaos          +1 on attack rolls          -1 on saving throws
Evil                +1 on damage rolls      -1 to AC
Good             +1 on saving throws     -1 on attack rolls
Law               +1 on Armor Class        -1 on damage rolls

At any point before the duration expires, you can choose to unleash the spell's remaining power in a 60-foot burst that deals 1d4 points of damage per round of duration remaining (maximum 15d4) to each creature of the opposed alignment in the area. Each affected creature can attempt a Fortitude save for half damage. The burst also heals 1 point of damage per round of duration remaining (maximum 15 points) for each creature of the same alignment in the area. Once this option is invoked, the spell ends immediately.

Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Drunken Master Level 1
Specifics: Your body handles alcohol differently from other people. You can drink a large tankard of ale, a bottle of wine, or a corresponding amount of stronger alcohol as a move-equivalent action. Use: Automatic.

Benefit: You can create a scepter that holds any spell of 7th level or lower that you know. Unlike a magic wand, a scepter can contain up to two spells, each of which has a cost in charges to use. Both spell effects draw from a common pool of charges, so they can be used in any combination. 

Crafting a scepter takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price. The base price of a scepter is its caster level ?the spell level ?750 gp for the highest-level spell included, plus the caster level ?the spell level ?375 gp for the second spell, if any. To craft a scepter, you must spend 1/25 of this base price in XP and use up raw materials costing one-half of this amount. A newly created scepter has 50 charges. Any scepter that stores a spell with a costly material component or an XP cost also carries a commensurate cost. In addition to the cost derived from the base price, you must expend fifty units of the material component or pay fifty times the XP cost.

dst: 卡齐娅警告过我，一旦到达泽卡尔塔的底层，我穿过那里时就会被传送到我之前待过的火焰位面陷阱中。她指导了我必须遵循的逃脱程序。要重新打开界门，我需要按下界门西北和东南方的两个发光的魔法球。不幸的是，我最初会发现它们被锁定在原地。要解锁它们，我需要向西走，并按正确的顺序多次扳动那里的拉杆。要确定正确的顺序，我必须找到界门东北方的未点燃的火盆。对它施放涉及火焰的法咒，比如燃烧之手或火球术，会使它亮起来，当它亮起时，我会看到火焰呈现出数字的形状。这些数字对应拉杆上的数字，并指示扳动它们的正确顺序。卡齐娅给了我一张燃烧之手卷轴用于此目的。如果我不能使用，扎拉拉应该能够使用它。
src: Kadzia has warned me that upon reaching the ground floor of the Zekar tower, I will be transported as I traverse it to the fiery planar trap I was in earlier. She has instructed me in the procedure I must follow to escape. To re-open the portal, I will need to press down the two glowing magical globes to the northwest and southeast of the portal. Unfortunately I will initially find them to be locked in place. To unlock them, I will need to head west, and flip the levers there a number of times in the correct order. To determine the correct order, I must locate the unlighted brazier, to the northeast of the poratl. Casting a spell on it that involves fire, such as Burning Hands or Fireball, will cause it to light up, and as it does I will see the flames take on the shape of numbers. These correspond to the numbers on the levers, and will indicate the correct sequence in which to flip them. Kadzia has given me a Burning Hands scroll to use for this purpose. Zarala should be able to use it if I am not.

棘民人是强壮，精练且富有智慧的战士。与鳞族一样，他们是消失的米什泰先祖种族的后裔，很久以前米什泰人将灵魂魔法注入所有米什泰人体内，试图达到形态的完美。棘民人外表与人类无异，只是每只前臂的前侧，每条小腿的后侧以及上背部都突出着五到六根垂直排列的爬行动物棘刺。棘民人社会封闭排外，要求精神和肉体上的双重成就。他们是一个骄傲的种族--有些人会说傲慢--他们拥有灵魂降生者，圣武士，巡林客以及其他体现身心完美之混合职业的战士。

棘民人属性调整：+2 力量，-2 敏捷
天赋职业（降生者）：兼职棘民人的降生者职业在判定兼职经验惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

威吓和攀爬+2种族加值
天生武器 - 棘民人可以随意装备一件天生武器，作用相当于短剑

在法咒和能力方面，棘民人视为爬行类人形生物
src:
Skarn are strong, sophisticated warriors of intellect. Like the rilkans, they are descended from the vanished mishtai progenitor race, which long ago infused all mishtai with incarnum in an attempt to achieve perfection of form. Skarn appear human except for the five or six vertically aligned reptilian spines that project from the anterior of each forearm, posterior of each calf, and the upper back. Skarn society is insular and demands both mental and physical achievement. They are a proud race - some would say arrogant - and they boast soulborns, paladins, rangers, and fighters of other hybrid classes that exemplify perfection of both mind and body. 

Skarn Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, -2 Dex
Favored Class (Incarnate): A multiclass Skarn's incarnate class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

+2 racial bonus on Intimidate and Climb 
Natural Weapon - The skarn can equip a natural weapon that acts as a short sword at will

Skarn count as reptilian humanoid for spells and abilities

src:
Type of Feat: General

Prerequsites:
CHA 11+, This feat can only be taken at 1st level.

Benefit:
Your latent power of psionics flares to life, conferring upon you the designation of a psionic character. As a psionic character, you gain a reserve of 2 power points, and you can take psionic feats, metapsionic feats, and psionic item creation feats. If you have or take a class that grants power points, the power points gained from Hidden Talent are added to your total power point reserve.

When you take this feat, choose one 1st-level power from any psionic class list. You know this power (it becomes one of your powers known). You can manifest this power with the power points provided by this feat if you have a Charisma score of 11 or higher. If you have no psionic class levels, you are considered a 1st-level manifester when manifesting this power. If you have psionic class levels, you can manifest the power at the highest manifester level you have attained. (This is not a manifester level, and it does not add to any manifester levels gained by taking psionic classes.) If you have no psionic class levels, use Charisma to determine how powerful a power you can manifest and how hard those powers are to resist.

你将目标放逐到一个由力场位面构成的超维度迷宫中。每轮在其回合，它可以作为一个整轮动作尝试一次DC 20的智力检定以逃离迷宫。如果目标没有逃脱，迷宫在10分钟后消失，迫使目标离开。*

在逃脱或离开迷宫时，目标重新出现在施放迷宫术时它所在的位置。如果此位置被固体物体占据，目标出现在最近的开放空间。在位面内移动生物的法咒和能力，如传送术和任意门，不能帮助生物逃离迷宫术，尽管异界传送法咒允许它离开到该法咒指定的任何位面。
牛头人不受此法咒影响。


* 实现方式为NPC总是尝试逃脱，而PC可以选择是否尝试逃脱。
src:
School: Conjuration (Teleportation)
Level: Sor/Wiz 8
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: See text
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

You banish the subject into an extradimensional labyrinth of force planes. Each round on its turn, it may attempt a DC 20 Intelligence check to escape the labyrinth as a full-round action. If the subject doesn't escape, the maze disappears after 10 minutes, forcing the subject to leave. *

On escaping or leaving the maze, the subject reappears where it had been when the maze spell was cast. If this location is filled with a solid object, the subject appears in the nearest open space. Spells and abilities that move a creature within a plane, such as teleport and dimension door, do not help a creature escape a maze spell, although a plane shift spell allows it to exit to whatever plane is designated in that spell.
Minotaurs are not affected by this spell.


* Implemented such that NPCs always try escape and PCs are given a choice whether to attempt escape or not.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Witchborn Binder 4
Specifics: Beginning at 4th level, as a standard action you can shape a set of shackles from incarnum. With a successful melee touch attack, you can use these shackles to bind a creature capable of arcane spellcasting, as long as it is within one size category or smaller of you. You must overcome any spell resistance the target creature might have with a successful caster level check, using your meldshaper level as your caster level, or the attack fails. Once so bound, the target creature is considered entangled by the mage shackles and is also effectively barred from planar movement, as if affected by a dimensional anchor spell. In addition, the affected creature must succeed on a caster level check (DC 10 + your meldshaper level + essentia invested in the mage shackles) to cast an arcane spell. A creature incapable of casting arcane spells is unaffected by the mage shackles.
Use: Selected

Neither one of us has any clue where such a rare object might be found, but I should keep this in mind in the event I happen to stumble across this type of gem. Jarlzin even indicated that having a Rogue Stone might open up the opportunity for a further quest I might do for him, though he did not want to give any details about this.\n\nI have now found a Rogue Stone, and can bring it to Jarlzin.

src:
At epic heights, the Blood Magus is no mere spellcaster; they are blood given will, a living paradox of life dancing on the edge of death. Their veins pulse with raw arcane potential, and their mastery over their own mortality is unmatched. To them, blood is not just life, it is power, memory, and magic itself. 

Hit Die: d6
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Blood Magus gains a bonus feat every three levels

Special:
Durable Casting: the epic Blood Magus continues to gain +1 bouns per class level to Concentration checks.
Homunculus: the epic Blood Magus' Homunculus continues to scale in power with the Blood Magus' class level.
Spellcasting: At every even level, the epic Blood Magus continues to increase in arcane caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Epic Blood Magus Bonus Feat List:
Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Craft Epic Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Epic Staff, Craft Epic Wondrous Item, Epic Leadership, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Toughness, Fast Healing, Focused Spell Penetration, Forge Epic Ring, Great Charisma, Great Constitution, Great Intelligence, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Tenacious Magic, Eldritch Sculptor, Lord of All Essences, Master of the Elements, Morpheme Savant, Paragon Visionary, Shadowmaster, Verminlord, Epic Eldritch Blast, Epic Extra Invocation, Epic Fiendish Resilience.

dst: "直到最近，这里都相当平静，但就在最近，有很多全副武装的人和类似的冒险者经过镇子。不太清楚那是怎么回事，但他们显然在找某个人。既然你自己也是<CUSTOM106>冒险者，你可能比我更了解。还有报告说看到龙在周围飞行。希望它们只是打算飞飞而已，否则可能意味着大麻烦，自从一年多前铁危机解决以来，我们这里还没遇到过那种事。"
src: "Things were pretty quiet until recently, but just lately we've had a lot of heavily armed people and similar adventuring types moving through town. Not sure what that's all about but they're apparently looking for someone. As you're <CUSTOM106> and adventurer yourself, you might know more about that than I do. dst:
我们寻找的那本书所在的古墓里有一个谜题，必须解开才能深入其中。登萨斯·维莱本的学术研究指出，这个谜题基于桑达尔·卡达辛（墓主）的四名主要随从所使用的装备，并且还发现了以下线索，应该有助于解开谜题：

第1名随从施放冰风暴。
第2名随从使用战斧。
第3名随从没有穿板甲。
第4名随从穿鳞甲。
锁子甲释放连环闪电。
战锤持有者释放涌火之泉。
弯刀持有者穿皮甲。
弯刀持有者和钉头锤持有者都不释放酸雾术。

谜题已解开，一扇活板门打开了。
src:
The ancient tomb containing the book we seek contains a puzzle that must be solved to advance sufficiently deep into it. Densath Wayleben's scholarship indicates that the puzzle is based on the equipment employed by the four chief henchmen of Sandar Kadathin (whose tomb it is) and also uncovered the following clues, which should be helpful in solving it:

The 1st henchman casts Ice Storm.
The 2nd henchman wields a battleaxe.
The 3rd henchman does NOT don plate armor.
The 4th henchman dons armor of scale.
From chain mail Chain Lightning is unleashed.
The warhammer wielder unleashes a Firebrand.
The scimitar wielder dons armor of leather.
Neither the scimitar wielder nor the morningstar wielder unleashes Acid Fog.

The puzzle has been solved, unlocking a trap door.

src:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Bard Song, Perform 6
Specifics: When you use Bardic Music, any bonus granted by your music increases by +1. Thus, a 15th-level bard with this feat grants his allies a +4 bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws against fear when he uses Bardic Music, rather than the +3 he would normally grant. If he uses Bardic Musics, the same bard grants up to three allies 3 bonus Hit Dice, a +3 bonus on attack rolls, and a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves. Also, when you use fascinate, suggestion, or mass suggestion, the saving throw DC increases by 1. If you have the Haunting Melody feat, the saving throw DC for that effect also increases by 1. If you have the Music of Growth feat, the bonus bestowed by that feat increases to +6. If you have the Music of Making feat, the bonus on Craft checks bestowed by that feat increases to +6. If you have the Soothe the Beast feat, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Perform check to improve the attitude of an animal or magical beast.

专长类型：职业
先决条件：异形学家 10

在 10 级时，异形学家通过与异界存在的长期交往和对疯狂秘密的深入研究，超越了凡人之躯，成为异界生物。她的类型变为“异界生物”，这意味着（除其他事项外） 她不再受专门针对类人生物的法咒影响，例如魅惑人类，但她可以被针对其阵营的魔法阵法咒阻挡。此外，异形学家获得伤害减免 20/+1 和电击抗力 20. 

在达到超凡入圣时，异形学家的外貌经历轻微的身体变化，通常长出一根触手或其他奇怪的附加或缺失，例如额外的附肢，器官，眼睛或神秘肿块。异形学家可以用长袍或兜帽隐藏这种异常，但异界生长不受异形学家的控制，有时会自行移动，抽搐，张开或以其他方式活动。

任何与异形学家一样偏爱研究遥远国度的人会立即认出她的超凡本质，她在与此类存在互动时，所有基于魅力的技能和属性检定获得 +2 环境加值。她向所有其他生物显露其异常本质时，威吓检定获得 +2 环境加值。

实现说明：如果角色头部物品栏未穿戴任何物品，她获得所有基于魅力的技能 +2 加值。
src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Alienist 10

At 10th level, the alienist, through long association with alien entities and intense study of insane secrets, transcends her mortal form and becomes an alien creature. Her type changes to "outsider," which means (among other things) that she is no longer affected by spells the specifically target humanoids, such as charm person, but she can be hedged out by a magic circle spell against her alignment. Additionally, the alienist gains damage reduction 20/+1 and electricity resistance 20. 

Upon achieving transcendence, the alienist's appearance undergoes a minor physical change, usually growing a tentacle or other strange addition or subtraction, such as an extra appendage, organ, eye, or enigmatic lump. The alienist can hide this abnormality in a robe or hood, but the alien growth is not under the alienist's control and sometimes moves, twitches, opens, or otherwise animates of its own accord. 

Anyone who shares the alienist's predilection for study of the Far Realms immediately recognizes her transcendent nature, and she gains a +2 circumstance modifier on all Charisma-based skill and ability checks when interacting with such beings. She gains a +2 circumstance modifier on Intimidation checks against all other creatures to whom she reveals her abnormal nature. 

Implementation notes: if character is not wearing anything in head inventory slot, she gains bonus +2 to all charisma based skills.

Fire Shield
Evocation [Fire or Cold]
Level: Fire 5, Sor/Wiz 4, Sun 4
Components: V, S, M/DF
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round/level (D)

This spell wreathes you in flame and causes damage to each creature that attacks you in melee. The flames also protect you from either cold-based or fire-based attacks (your choice).

Any creature striking you with its body or a handheld weapon deals normal damage, but at the same time the attacker takes 1d6 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +15). This damage is either cold damage (if the shield protects against fire-based attacks) or fire damage (if the shield protects against cold-based
attacks). If the attacker has spell resistance, it applies to this effect. Creatures wielding weapons with exceptional reach are not subject to this damage if they attack you.

When casting this spell, you appear to immolate yourself, but the flames are thin and wispy, giving off light equal to only half the illumination of a normal torch (10 feet). The special powers of each version are as follows:

Warm Shield: The flames are warm to the touch. You take only half damage from cold-based attacks. If such an attack allows a Reflex save for half damage, you take no damage on a successful save.

Chill Shield: The flames are cool to the touch. You take only half damage from fire-based attacks. If such an attack allows a Reflex save for half damage, you take no damage on a successful save.

dst: 当我接近行进山脉中的阿哈兹堡时，我遇到了一名从那里赶来的信使，带来了可怕的消息：堡垒正被炽焰斧部落的兽人大军及其食人魔盟友围攻。我能否突破围困的封锁线抵达堡垒尚存疑问，因此如果我在这里要做些有用的事，最好是在兽人大军的侧翼行动，可以通过向西沿着附近的河流或向东穿过森林到达，袭击巡逻队和外围部队。我也许还能向北前进，突袭兽人最初来源的洞穴，因为大部分兽人都不在，都聚集在堡垒周围。这应该会促使兽人主力派出分遣队来追捕我，或许能削弱他们到足以打破围困的程度。\n\n在兽人群的侧翼以及他们后方的洞穴中行动，我杀死了许多敌人，并大大扰乱了他们的活动。最终这削弱了他们，使我能够与从堡垒出击的士兵一起攻击主要的围困部队，杀死他们的酋长并击溃他们。炽焰斧兽人部落的力量已被粉碎，我认为他们不再是一个重大威胁了。此时我或许应该继续去做其他任务了。
src: As I was approaching Fort Akhaz in the Marching Mountains, I came across a messenger traveling from there with dire news: the fort is being besieged by a horde of orcs of the Blazing Axes tribe and their ogre allies. It is doubtful that I could break through the siege cordon to reach the fort, so if I am to do anything useful here it would be best to operate on the flanks of the orc army, reached either by traveling along the nearby river to the west or the woods to the east, attacking patrols and outlying forces. I also might be able to make my way to the north and raid the caves the orcs came from in the first place, with most of them absent and around the fort. This should induce the main orc army to send out detachments to try to hunt me down, and perhaps weaken it enough that the siege could be broken.\n\nOperating on the flanks of the orc horde, and in the caves to their rear, I killed many and did much to disrupt their activities. Eventually this weakened them to the point that I was able to assail the main besieging force, along with soldiers sallying from the fort, slay their chieftan and rout them. The power of the Blazing Axes Orc tribe has been shattered and I do not think they will be a major threat anymore. I should probably move on to some other task at this point.

战蜥人是令人厌恶的蜥蜴生物，像最邪恶的恶魔一样邪恶。他们非常好战，喜欢品尝敌人的味道 - 尤其是类人生物。战蜥人不是特别聪明，但他们的凶猛和天生的狡猾足以弥补这一缺陷。他们经常对类人生物定居点发动血腥袭击，或在温暖气候中伏击商队。他们积极守卫自己的巢穴，对任何靠近的人猛烈攻击。
战蜥人身高约5英尺，体重约150磅。它比典型的人类矮，手臂长。它用短腿直立行走，有一条长而窄的尾巴用于平衡。战蜥人说龙语。他们通常进阶牧师职业，尽管许多选择成为战士。

src:
Troglodytes are revolting lizard creatures as evil as the foulest of demons. They are very warlike and savor the taste of their enemies - especially humanoids. Troglodytes are not especially intelligent, but their ferocity and natural cunning more than compensate for this deficiency. They often launch bloody raids against humanoid settlements or ambush caravans in warm climates. They guard their lairs aggressively, lashing out at anyone who comes too near.
A troglodyte stands about 5 feet tall and weighs about 150 pounds. It is shorter than a typical human and has long arms. It walks erect on squat legs and has a long, narrow tail that it uses for balance. Troglodytes speak Draconic. They most often advance in the cleric class, though many choose to be fighters.

Troglodyte Ability Adjustments: +4 Con, -2 Dex, -2 Int
Favored Class (Cleric): A multiclass troglodyte's cleric class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All troglodytes are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Natural Weapon: Troglodytes can make an natural bite attack.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 6.
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +4 racial bonus to Hide checks (+8 in underground areas).
- Darkvision: Troglodytes are able to see in the dark.
- Stench: Troglodytes carry a repulsive odor which causes harm to those around them.
- Reptilian: Troglodytes count as Reptilian for the purpose of spells.

预知让你的心智瞥见潜在未来事件的片段 - 你所看到的很可能会发生，如果没有人采取行动改变它。然而，你的视觉是不完整的，并且在你瞥见的实际事件开始展开之前，它没有真正的意义。那时一切开始汇集，你可以根据你之前显能此异能时收到的信息行动，如果你行动迅速。

实际上，显能此异能赋予你一个'预知优势'. 通常，你一次只能有一个预知优势。你必须在不超过每等级 10 分钟的时间内使用你的优势，此时你的预知消退，你失去你的优势。

你可以以多种方式使用你的预知优势。本质上，优势转化为一个 +2 洞察加值，你可以随时应用于攻击检定，伤害检定，豁免检定或技能检定。要将此加值应用一轮，按径向菜单上的攻击，豁免，技能或伤害选项。
src:
Clairsentience
Level: Seer 1
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 10 min./level
Power Points: 1
Metapsionics: Extend

Precognition allows your mind to glimpse fragments of potential future events - what you see will probably happen if no one takes action to change it. However, your vision is incomplete, and it makes no real sense until the actual events you glimpsed begin to unfold. That's when everything begins to come together, and you can act, if you act swiftly, on the information you previously received when you manifested this power.

In practice, manifesting this power grants you a 'precognitive edge.' Normally, you can have only a single precognitive edge at one time. You must use your edge within a period of no more than 10 minutes per level, at which time your preknowledge fades and you lose your edge.

You can use your precognitive edge in a variety of ways. Essentially, the edge translates into a +2 insight bonus that you can apply at any time to either an attack roll, a damage roll, a saving throw, or a skill check. To apply this bonus for one round, press either the Attack, Save, Skill, or Damage option on the radial menu.

dst: 哈马德派我加入对蜘蛛沼泽中变形蛛总部的军事进攻。随后，我一路战斗穿过沼泽和总部，最终找到了一条通往卡林港下水道的界门，在那里我解决了敌对的鼠人，他们原来与变形蛛勾结。之后，我一路打进了吞噬火焰教团的营地，他们现在似乎也参与了摧毁卡林杉的联盟。\n\n然而，即使经历了这一切，我们似乎仍未揭开这个阴谋的真相。在吞噬火焰的文件中，我发现了证据表明卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔是武僧、变形蛛以及我一直对抗的其他敌人的盟友。一封信表明，泽法德之剑的主人（卡洛玛斯）打算用它最初的目的——释放巨灵卡利姆和火巨灵门农，他们很可能会利用这种自由恢复他们的魔法战争，造成毁灭性后果。信中还表明，他期望这一事件导致的位面边界削弱能帮助他将一支恶魔大军释放到卡林港。这些信息可信吗？泽卡尔为什么会参与如此疯狂和毁灭性的阴谋？无论这些问题的答案是什么，我认为应该尽快将这一信息带给哈马德·加尔哈德尔。希望他能弄清楚这里发生了什么。
src: Hamad sent me to join the military assault being launched upon the headquarters of the aranea in the Spider Swamp. Subsequently, I fought my way through the swamp and the headquarters, eventually finding my way to a portal leading to the Calimport sewers, where I dealt with the hostile wererats who turned out to be in league with the aranea. After that I fought my way up into the compound of the Consuming Fire Order, who now also appear to have been part of this alliance to destroy Calimshan.\n\nEven after all this, though, it seems we have not gotten to the bottom of this conspiracy. Amongst the papers of the Consuming Fire, I have found evidence implicating Kalomas Zekar as an ally of the monks, aranea, and other enemies I have been fighting. A letter indicates that the owner of the Sword of Zefad (Kalomas) intends to use it for its original purpose of freeing the djinni Calim and the efreeti Memnon, who presumably would use such freedom to resume their magical warring, with destructive consequences. The letter also indicates that he also expects the weakening of planar boundaries this event should cause to aid him in unleashing an army of demons upon Calimport. Can this information be trusted? Why would Zekar participate in such a wild and destructive plot? Whatever the answers to these questions, I think this information should be brought to Hamad Galhadr as soon as possible. Hopefully he can sort out whatever is happening here.

在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队派人搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续著作时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。如果我发现了什么，我可以去商业区东北部她家中向她报告。

经过大量调查，我发现了阿拉达尔·哈辛的下落。他被巫妖泰罗兹·甘抓走了，后者显然是扭曲符文的成员，反对他的调查。然而，同样属于该符文的另一条龙巫妖辩称，他的死亡或失踪只会引来不必要的关注，比仅仅允许他发表他的故事所引来的关注更多，因为如果没有像失踪这样的事件所引发的宣传，他的故事很可能会被忽视或不被相信。两个巫妖同意直接放了他。

我已经和阿拉达尔谈过了，他动身回家了。我应该跟着他去那里，从他妻子那里领取我的报酬。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

After much investigation, I have discovered the fate of Aladar Hasin. He was captured by the lich Teroz Gan, apparently a member of the Twisted Rune, who objected to his investigation. However, a dracolich also belonging to the Rune argued that his death or disappearance would only bring unwanted attention, more than would be brought on if he were simply permitted to publish his stories, which are likely to be ignored or disbelieved absent the publicity that would be generated by something like a disappearance. The two liches agreed to simply free him.

I have spoken to Alader, who departed for his home. I should follow him there to collect my reward from his wife.

src: While exploring the subterranean ruins beneath Calimport, I rescued from a dire spider an unusual orc named Hrangarak. This Hrangarak is a cleric of Helm, and it seems that until recently his tribe, the Bloody Blades, was worshiping this deity and seeking to avoid warring with other races as is typical of orcs. Recently however the tribe has had a change of leadership, with their former leader Princess Gunkruzelle being ousted and sold to a cult who needed someone with royal blood for some sort of strange ritual sacrifice. Its new leader is Gruzhaur, who seeks to restore worship of Gruumsh and form an alliance with the wererats against the humans of Calimport. Hrangarak wants me to join with him to rescue Gunkruzelle and restore her to leadership of the tribe, frustrating this plan.\n\nI have not decided yet whether I wish to do as Hrangarak suggests. I can find him where I left him if I determine that I do.

src:
Native from mountains at the heart of the great glacier and other northerly regions, arctic dwarves are little known to the outside world. Unlike other dwarves, arctic dwarves have little interest in mining or crafts, instead devoting themselves to hunting, raising children and leisure. Traditional dwarven strictures, such as those imposed by family and clan hold little weight in arctic dwarf society. Arctic Dwarves are squat and hardy, with blocky bodies, pinched faces and
stubby legs. They rarely exceed 3 feet in height and are nearly as broad as they are tall. They eyes are bright blue and their skin white, almost bluish.

Arctic Dwarven Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +2 Con, -2 Cha, -2 Dex.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass arctic dwarf's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Poisons: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Orcs: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor and Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Immunity to Cold: Arctic Dwarves are immunity to the effects of cold and cold-based spells.
- Level Adjustment: +2
- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Dwarven: Arctic Dwarves count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

Fiendish creatures dwell on the lower planes, the realms of evil, although they resemble beings found on the Material Plane. They are more fearsome in appearance than their earthly counterparts.

"Fiendish" is an inherited template that can be added to any corporeal aberration, animal, dragon, fey, giant, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, ooze, plant, or vermin of nongood alignment (referred to hereafter as the base creature).

A fiendish creature uses all the base creature's statistics and abilities except as noted here. Do not recalculate the creature's Hit Dice, base attack bonus, saves, or skill points if its type changes.

Size and Type
Animals or vermin with this template become magical beasts, but otherwise the creature type is unchanged. Size is unchanged. Fiendish creatures encountered on the Material Plane have the extraplanar subtype.

Special Attacks
A fiendish creature retains all the special attacks of the base creature and also gains the following special attack.
Smite Good (Su)
Once per day the creature can make a normal melee attack to deal extra damage equal to its HD total (maximum of +20) against a good foe.

Special Qualities
A fiendish creature retains all the special qualities of the base creature and also gains the following.
Darkvision
Damage reduction. 4-11 HD, 5/+1. 12+ HD 10/+1.
Resistance to cold and fire. 1-7 HD 5, 8+ HD 10
Spell resistance equal to the HD + 5 (maximum 25).

Abilities
Same as the base creature, but Intelligence is at least 3.

Level Adjustment
Same as the base creature +2.

提尔神殿派遣了一队牧师和圣武士进入神殿区下方的下水道，试图对抗最近变得极具攻击性、在那里制造麻烦的鼠人。他们至今仍未回报。提尔神殿的高阶牧师阿达拉斯·埃夫森要求我进入下水道，查明他们的遭遇，并在必要时协助他们。莎尔神殿的女祭司费拉莎则要我跟随他们的踪迹，查明他们的天命，并确保他们无一能活着离开下水道。我必须决定是协助这些提尔信徒，还是杀死他们。

被派往下水道的整支提尔小队都已丧命。费拉莎听到这个消息会很高兴。阿达拉斯则不会，但我想我仍然可以把他们的天命报告给他。
src:
The Temple of Tyr has dispatched a group of clerics and paladins into the sewers beneath the temple district in an attempt to fight the newly aggressive wererats causing trouble there. They have yet to report back. Adaras Efzen, a high-ranking cleric in the Temple of Tyr, has asked me to enter the sewers and determine what has happened to them, assisting them if necessary. Ferazha, priestess at the temple of Shar, wants me to follow in their wake, determine their fate, and insure that none of them make it out of the sewer alive. I will have to decide whether I wish to assist these Tyrrans or kill them.

The entire party of Tyrrans dispatched to the sewers has met its end. Ferazha will be happy to hear this. Adaras will not, but I suppose I could still report their fate to him.

src:
I have learned of several notorious criminals who have prices on their heads:

Jacho Kralow, the leader of a gang of violent criminals that have long plagued the city of Zazesspur. It seems he has recently gone into hiding, no one knows where.

Obgron the Ogre Mage, the leader of a band of humanoid raiders who have been attacking caravans traveling north along the Trade Way. I encountered him in an old mine off the Trade Way and have been rewarded for his head.

Haryan Krow, the leader of a band of mercenaries who turned to banditry when the end of Tethyr's civil wars led to their unemployment. They have been conducting raids along the roads east of the city.

The head of any of the above is worth 1800 gold, and the heads can be taken to Captain Tanendt, commander of the harbor fort just west of the Winsome Repose Inn.

dst: 在探索黑暗卡林港时，我遇到了一群狗头人。这群狗头人没有攻击我，看起来相当和平，但他们的首领告诉我，他们可能不会一直保持这样。看来他们一直受到一只巨魔的困扰，这只巨魔杀死了他们许多人，于是他们与侵扰卡林港下水道的凶暴鼠人达成了协议。鼠人告诉狗头人，他们会帮忙对付巨魔，但作为回报，狗头人必须加入他们，一同向卡林港发动战争。狗头人首领觉得别无选择，只能同意。不过，我主动提出由我来杀死那只巨魔。如果我能做到，并把巨魔的头带给他，首领承诺他不会与鼠人结盟，还会把他收集的一些财宝奖赏给我。这只巨魔在狗头人营地以西的区域游荡。我应当确保自己拥有能造成足够火焰或强酸伤害、以克服其再生能力的手段后，尽快出发去猎杀它。\n\n巨魔已被杀死。我应当取下它的头，带回去交给狗头人酋长。虽然我希望狗头人仍能被争取到更好的道路上，但我先前感觉到，他们并不像假装的那样和平。我回到他们那里时应当提防背叛。
src: While exploring Dark Calimport, I came across a group of kobolds. This particular group did not attack me and seemed peaceful enough, but their chief told me that they might not remain that way. It seems they have been having a problem with a troll who has been killing many of them, and they made a deal with the aggressive wererats infesting Calimport's sewers. The wererats told the kobolds that they would help deal with the troll, but in return the kobolds are to join them in making war against Calimport. The kobold chief felt he had no choice but to agree with this. However, I have offered to slay the troll myself. If I can accomplish this and bring the troll's head to him, the chief has promised that he will not ally with the wererats, and reward me with some treasure he has collected as well. This troll wanders the regions to the west of the kobold encampment. I should set out to hunt it down as soon as I have made certain I possess some means of delivering enough fire or acid damage to overcome its regenerative powers.\n\nThe troll has been slain. I should take its head and return it to the kobold chieftan. Though I hope the kobolds can still be won over to a better path, I sensed earlier that they are not so peaceful as they pretend. I should be prepared for treachery when I return to them.

src: In return for providing him with all three pieces of Maghaurezh's Beholder Band, the Beholder merchant Gaurash has told me that he can start me on a path leading out of the Underdark, leading through various extraplanar realms. He will initially transport me to a fortress in Baator. If I make my way through it I will eventually find a portal taking me to another extraplanar realm, containing a forest filled with strange beasts, and by making my way through that I can reach a portal to a fortress in the Celestial Realm. Within this fortress, I can find a portal that will return me to the Prime, in a cave from which I can easily return to the surface, north of the Cloudpeaks and closer to my ultimate destination of Candlekeep. Gaurash will transport me whenever I wish, though once I set out I will not be able to return to this part of the Underdark. The route is likely to be dangerous as well, since the inhabitants of these extraplanar realms are powerful, and might prove hostile to me, depending on my alignment. I will have to consider if I wish to take this route or look for another.\n\nI chose to take this route, and have now been transported out of the Underdark. I must now locate the portals that will take me onwards.

dst:
“巫妖”是一个后天模板，可以添加到任何类人生物（以下称为基础生物）上，前提是它能够制造所需的命匣。

除非另有说明，巫妖拥有基础生物的所有数据和特殊能力。

体型和类型
该生物的类型变为不死生物。不要重新计算基础攻击加值，豁免或技能点。体型不变。

生命骰
将所有当前和未来的生命骰提升为d12。

防御等级
巫妖拥有+5天生防御加值或基础生物的天生防御加值，取较高者。

攻击
巫妖拥有一次接触攻击，每轮可以使用一次。如果基础生物能够使用武器，巫妖保留此能力。拥有天生武器的生物保留那些天生武器。不使用武器战斗的巫妖使用其接触攻击或其主天生武器（如果有的话）.装备武器的巫妖可以根据意愿使用其接触攻击或武器。

伤害
没有天生武器的巫妖拥有一次接触攻击，使用负能量对活物造成1d8+5点伤害；一次意志豁免（DC 10 + 1/2 巫妖的生命骰 + 巫妖的魅力调整值）可以减半伤害。拥有天生武器的巫妖可以根据偏好使用其接触攻击或天生武器。如果它选择后者，它可以在一次天生武器攻击中造成1d8+5点额外伤害。

特殊攻击
巫妖保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下描述的能力。除非另有说明，豁免DC等于10 + 1/2 巫妖的生命骰 + 巫妖的魅力调整值。

恐惧灵光（超自然）
巫妖被死亡和邪恶的可怕灵光所笼罩。60英尺半径内生命骰少于5的生物如果看到巫妖，必须成功通过意志豁免，否则将如同受到巫妖等级术士施展的恐惧术影响。成功通过豁免的生物在24小时内不会再次受到同一巫妖灵光的影响。

麻痹之触（超自然）
任何被巫妖的接触攻击击中的活物必须成功通过强韧豁免，否则将永久麻痹。移除麻痹或任何可以移除诅咒的法咒可以解救受害者（见降咒法咒描述）.

该效果无法被驱散。被巫妖麻痹的人看起来像死了，但DC 20的侦察检定或DC 15的医疗检定可以揭示受害者仍然活着。

法咒
巫妖可以施展其生前能施展的任何法咒。

特殊品质
巫妖保留基础生物的所有特殊品质，并获得以下描述的能力。

驱散抗力（特异）
巫妖拥有+4驱散抗力。

伤害减免（超自然）
巫妖的不死躯体坚韧，赋予该生物伤害减免15/钝击和魔法。其天生武器在克服伤害减免时视为魔化武器。

免疫（特异）
巫妖免疫寒冷，电击，变形（尽管它们可以对自己使用变形效果）和影响心智攻击。

属性
从基础生物提升如下：智力+2，感知+2，魅力+2.作为不死生物，巫妖没有体质值。

技能
巫妖在躲藏，聆听，潜行，搜索，察言观色和侦察检定上拥有+8种族加值。其他方面与基础生物相同。

挑战等级
与基础生物相同+2。

阵营
任意邪恶。

等级调整
与基础生物相同+4。

巫妖角色
成为巫妖的过程邪恶得难以言表，只能由自愿的角色进行。巫妖保留其生前拥有的所有职业能力。

巫妖的命匣
成为巫妖的一个关键部分是制造一个魔法命匣，角色在其中储存其生命力量。通常，确保摆脱巫妖的唯一方法是摧毁其命匣。除非找到并摧毁其命匣，否则巫妖会在其表面死亡后1d10天重新出现。
每个巫妖必须制造自己的命匣，这需要制造奇物专长。角色必须能够施展法咒并且施法者等级达到11级或更高。制造命匣需要花费120,000金币和4,800经验值，其施法者等级等于创造者在创造时的等级。
最常见的命匣形式是一个密封的金属盒子，里面装有羊皮纸条，上面抄录着魔法短语。盒子为微型，拥有40点生命值，硬度20，破坏DC 40.其他形式的命匣也可能存在，例如戒指，护符或类似物品。
src:
"Lich" is an acquired template that can be added to any humanoid creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature), provided it can create the required phylactery.

A lich has all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to undead. Do not recalculate base attack bonus, saves, or skill points. Size is unchanged.

Hit Dice
Increase all current and future Hit Dice to d12s.

Armor Class
A lich has a +5 natural armor bonus or the base creature's natural armor bonus, whichever is better.

Attack
A lich has a touch attack that it can use once per round. If the base creature can use weapons, the lich retains this ability. A creature with natural weapons retains those natural weapons. A lich fighting without weapons uses either its touch attack or its primary natural weapon (if it has any). A lich armed with a weapon uses its touch or a weapon, as it desires.

Damage
A lich without natural weapons has a touch attack that uses negative energy to deal 1d8+5 points of damage to living creatures; a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2  lich's HD + lich's Cha modifier) halves the damage. A lich with natural weapons can use its touch attack or its natural weaponry, as it prefers. If it chooses the latter, it deals 1d8+5 points of extra damage on one natural weapon attack.

Special Attacks
A lich retains all the base creature's special attacks and gains those described below. Save DCs are equal to 10 + 1/2  lich's HD + lich's Cha modifier unless otherwise noted.

Fear Aura (Su)
Liches are shrouded in a dreadful aura of death and evil. Creatures of less than 5 HD in a 60-foot radius that look at the lich must succeed on a Will save or be affected as though by a fear spell from a sorcerer of the lich's level. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by the same lich's aura for 24 hours.

Paralyzing Touch (Su)
Any living creature a lich hits with its touch attack must succeed on a Fortitude save or be permanently paralyzed. Remove paralysis or any spell that can remove a curse can free the victim (see the bestow curse spell description).

The effect cannot be dispelled. Anyone paralyzed by a lich seems dead, though a DC 20 Spot check or a DC 15 Heal check reveals that the victim is still alive..

Spells
A lich can cast any spells it could cast while alive.

Special Qualities
A lich retains all the base creature's special qualities and gains those described below.

Turn Resistance (Ex)
A lich has +4 turn resistance.

Damage Reduction (Su)
A lich's undead body is tough, giving the creature damage reduction 15/bludgeoning and magic. Its natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Immunities (Ex)
Liches have immunity to cold, electricity, polymorph (though they can use polymorph effects on themselves), and mind-affecting attacks.

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +2. Being undead, a lich has no Constitution score.

Skills
Liches have a +8 racial bonus on Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Sense Motive, and Spot checks. Otherwise same as the base creature.

Challenge Rating
Same as the base creature + 2.

Alignment
Any evil.

Level Adjustment
Same as the base creature +4.

Lich Characters
The process of becoming a lich is unspeakably evil and can be undertaken only by a willing character. A lich retains all class abilities it had in life.

The Lich's Phylactery
An integral part of becoming a lich is creating a magic phylactery in which the character stores its life force. As a rule, the only way to get rid of a lich for sure is to destroy its phylactery. Unless its phylactery is located and destroyed, a lich reappears 1d10 days after its apparent death.
Each lich must make its own phylactery, which requires the Craft Wondrous Item feat. The character must be able to cast spells and have a caster level of 11th or higher. The phylactery costs 120,000 gp and 4,800 XP to create and has a caster level equal to that of its creator at the time of creation.
The most common form of phylactery is a sealed metal box containing strips of parchment on which magicalphrases have been transcribed. The box is Tiny and has 40 hit points, hardness 20, and a break DC of 40.  Other forms of phylacteries can exist, such as rings, amulets, or similar items.

I have learned of several notorious criminals who have prices on their heads:

Jacho Kralow, the leader of a gang of violent criminals that have long plagued the city of Zazesspur. It seems he has recently gone into hiding, no one knows where.

Obgron the Ogre Mage, the leader of a band of humanoid raiders who have been attacking caravans traveling north along the Trade Way.

Haryan Krow, the leader of a band of mercenaries who turned to banditry when the end of Tethyr's civil wars led to their unemployment, who were conducting raids along the roads east of the city. I encountered him and his band while traveling through Tethyr, and have been rewarded for his head.
