dst: 这本书包含了许多关于费伦常见怪物种族的信息，重点在于最有效地杀死它们的方法。因此，对于任何能接受作者争议性论点的冒险者来说，这本书将非常有帮助：作者认为他所讨论的种族本质上是邪恶的，应当被彻底消灭——这种极端观点使这本书不受欢迎且难以找到。当然，人们不必一定同意书中更激进的提议，也能从其提供的知识中受益。\n\n注意：使用这本书将给予玩家一些经验值，其数量与玩家的等级成反比。
src: This book contains much information on some of the common monstrous races of Faerun, with the emphasis being on the most effective ways to kill them. As a result, it would be very helpful to any adventurer who can stomach the author's controversial thesis that the races he discusses are inherently evil and should be utterly exterminated: an extreme view that has made this book unpopular and hard to find. Of course, one need not necessarily agree with the book's more radical proposals to benefit from the knowledge it provides.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide some experience to the player, the amount being inversely proportional to his level.

Saint's Grace (Su): At 5th level, you gain a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws.

Pelor's Gaze (Sp): At 7th level and higher, once per day on command, you can cause Durindana to shed daylight as the spell. Caster level 5th.
Pelor's Baleful Eye (Su): Starting at 13th level, as long as you carry Durindana before you, you turn undead as though you were four levels higher in the class that grants you the ability.
Pelor's Protecting Grasp (Sp): At 14th level and higher, once per day on command, you can use death ward as the spell. Caster level 7th.
Hallowed Ground (Su): Beginning at 18th level, once per day, you can drive Durindana's blade into the surface on which you stand, creating the effects of a hallow spell with a daylight spell tied to it. Caster level 9th.
Pelor's Dazzling Beneficence (Su): At 19th level and higher, as a swift action, you can call down Pelor's gaze on yourself, which manifests as a dazzling golden light. src: Runes identify this fine weapon as having been forged by the dwarven Daraz clan some 500 years ago. Waraxes of this type were created for the defense of their homes against encroaching goblins and orcs, and each was wound with mighty spells. Unfortunately, fine weapons and dwarven courage were no match for the sheer number of orc invaders. The clan was extinguished, and their weapons were scattered throughout the known world. Ironically, they often turn up in the hands of goblin or orc warriors, since many were captured in the clan's defeat.

src:
An epic Disciple of Asmodeus becomes a true architect of tyranny, his will an unbreakable chain upon the minds of lesser beings. His commands echo with infernal authority, bending even the strongest to his purpose. Secrets fall into his hands like ripe fruit, and with each one, his dominion grows. Surrounded by devils and cloaked in dread majesty, he no longer merely serves Asmodeus, he embodies his dark doctrine.

Hit Die: d6
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Disciple of Asmodeus gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:
Learn Secret: The epic Disciple of Asmodeus continues to gain a use of Learn Secret every odd class level.
Spellcasting: Every other level the epic Disciple of Asmodeus continues to increase in arcane caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Craft Epic Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Epic Staff, Craft Epic Wondrous Item, Epic Leadership, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Toughness, Fast Healing, Focused Spell Penetration, Forge Epic Ring, Great Charisma, Great Constitution, Great Intelligence, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Tenacious Magic, Eldritch Sculptor, Lord of All Essences, Master of the Elements, Morpheme Savant, Paragon Visionary, Shadowmaster, Verminlord, Epic Eldritch Blast, Epic Extra Invocation, Epic Fiendish Resilience.

dst: "神龛位于这片森林的北部。我们会向东前往森林中心，然后向北走。沿途甚至可能遇到一些地精巡逻队，但只要我们在离营地足够远的地方袭击他们，就不会惊动莫古兹。他们会以为有些巡逻队遭遇了战斗，可能回不来了。不过一旦进入营地……但我有点说远了。一旦我们开始向北走，就会接近营地，但我们得避免直接冲进去，给莫古兹太多预警。幸运的是，侦察时我在营地附近发现了一片茂密的灌木丛。看起来无法通过，地精们也认为过不去，但我找到了一条狭窄的通道。如果我们走那条路，而不是任何明显的路线，就能在他们发现我们之前深入他们的营地。"
src: "The shrine is located in the northern part of these woods. We'll head east towards the center of the woods, and then go north. We may even encounter some goblin patrols along the way, but if we hit them far enough from the camp, it won't raise an alarm for Moguz. They'd expect some of their patrols to get into fights and maybe not come back. Once in the camp though...but I'm getting ahead of myself. Once we start heading north, we'll be approaching the camp, but we'll want to avoid charging directly in and giving Moguz lots of advance warning. Fortunately, while scouting, I found a patch of thick underbrush near the camp. It appears to be impassable, and the goblins think it is, but I found a narrow way through it. If we use that route, rather than any obvious approach, we can penetrate deep into their camp before they know we're there."

src: "Exactly! Probably don't, anyway. Occasionally divinely aided magic can work to some extent even in a dead magic zone, but it's the best chance I'm likely to get at taking out one of Ulaz's lieutenants. I defeated this Moguz once before, but he just got teleported away. If we can hit him while he's in a dead magic zone we have a good chance of killing him for good. What's more, if we do that, I should be able to take the stone he carries from him, and bring it to arcane researchers who might be able to figure out a way to counter-act them. This could be the key to bringing down Ulaz and his schemes once and for all."

src: "If you are to maintain even your delusional hopes of escape, you must follow the path leading through this fiery cavern. As you do so, you will enter several small chambers, each defended by minions of various types. Only by defeating them can you hope to obtain the key that will allow you to continue. Even my minions, I suspect, will prove too powerful for you to defeat, but if by some chance you do win past them, you will have to face me in person, no longer a mere projection. You will not be able to defeat me. Even if by some divine intervention you strike me down once, I shall keep returning to the fray, for my phylactery is nowhere near, and without access to it you cannot slay me for good."

src:
In most lands, half-drow are quite rare. Since many drow are irredeemably evil, they only mate with humans by way of rape or slavery. Half-drow are often as dark-hearted as their elven parents, but with a bitter resentment that comes from being treated as inferior members of drow society. Despite this, good half-drow are much less rare than good drow. Half-drow have dusky skin, silver or white hair and a broad range of eye colors.

Half-Drow Ability Adjustments: none
Favored Class: Any

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Listen): +1 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Search): +1 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Spot): +1 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Darkvision: Half-Drow can see in the dark.
- Elven: Half-Drow are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

However, the commander started receiving reports of goblin activity from other villages, too. He didn't know where the goblins would ultimately strike and didn't want to weaken his force by spreading it all over, so not too long ago, he decided to march into the woods and hunt the goblins down."

src:
Sunmantle
Abjuration
Level: Sanctified 4
Components: S, Sacrifice
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: One creature touched
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

This spell cloaks the target in a wavering cloak of light that illuminates an area around the target (and dispels darkness) as a daylight spell. However, its ability to generate bright light is not the spell's primary function.

The sunmantle grants the target damage reduction 5/-. Furthermore, if the target is struck by a melee attack that deals hit point damage, a tendril of light lashes out at the attacker, striking unerringly and dealing 5 points of damage.

Because of the brilliance of the sunmantle, creatures sensitive to bright light (such as dark elves) take the usual attack penalties when in the light radius of the sunmantle.

Sacrifice: 1d4 points of Strength damage.

Casters of evil alignment cannot cast Sanctified spells.

dst: 桌上摊着各种书籍和纸张，其中许多显然涉及各种类型的魔法实验。翻阅这些资料时，你看到一份讨论与你有关之事的文件：“主人能够利用气元素裔和她的剑打开传送门，从元素位面汲取力量。若不是那把剑已损坏，这本会更有效率，而且必须让那元素裔活着也很麻烦，但通过进一步研究，我们也许能克服这些问题。即便如此，主人的力量已大大增强，正如预言所说。在他目前的状态下，除了也许神祇的力量，没有什么能伤害他。主人的无敌依赖于多颗元素水晶。我们想要一种更简单、更便于携带的系统，研究仍在继续，以期也实现这一点。”
src: Various books and papers have been laid out on this desk, many of them apparently concerned with magical experiments of various types. Looking through them you see one discussing a matter of some concern to you: "The master was able to use the Air Genasi and her sword to open portals drawing power from the elemental planes. This would have been more efficient were the sword not broken, and the necessity of keeping the Genasi alive is annoying, but with further research we may be able to overcome these problems. As it is, the master's power has been greatly increased, just as was prophesied. In his current state, nothing, save perhaps the power of a god, can harm him. The master's invulnerability depends upon multiple elemental crystals. A simpler and more portable system is desired, and our research continues in hope of achieving this as well."

src: <StartHighlight>[Good +1]</Start> "Anyway, the dragon in question is a green one, who goes by the name of Gra'azha'ukul. He has a large and formidable group of kobolds who work for him, too. He's got a lair somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth. We don't know exactly where it is yet, but we are working on finding out. There's a camp on the fringes of the Wood where some Harpers, mostly rangers and the like, have gathered. That group is led by a veteran Harper named Tabrun Carshten. I suggest you go there and meet with him. He may have found out where the lair is by now. At the very least, he will be able to give you some clues as to where to look. Here's where you can find his camp." Izado marks a location on your map.

dst: 抵达米尔森林附近的特布纳斯村，准备增援本应保护该村的军团时，我发现此地已陷入火海，正遭到一大群地精的袭击。我击败了附近的地精，并与村长交谈。他告诉我，我本应增援的军团已经进入森林，显然已被周围异常庞大且强悍的地精部队击败，因为不久之后村庄就遭到了攻击。然而，森林中仍能听到战斗的声音，想必是军团残部仍在进行抵抗。看来我必须深入森林，营救军团的幸存者，并希望能找到办法阻止地精对这个防御薄弱的地区采取侵略行动。\n\n我已攻入地精用作基地的旧堡垒，并迫使他们的首领乌拉斯和戈拉夫逃走。不幸的是，我无法将他们永久杀死，因为他们拥有乌拉斯所称的“召回石”。这些石头，或者不管它们是什么，必定代表着某种非常强大的魔法。我担心这对危险的家伙可能还会卷土重来。然而，尽管我未能杀死这些大地精首领，我相信我已对地精军队造成了足够的打击，使其在很长一段时间内不会构成重大威胁。很可能我已在此地区做了我能做的一切，应该转向其他任务了。
src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nI have penetrated the old fortress the goblins were using as a base and forced their leaders, Ulaz and Gorav. to flee. Unfortunately I was unable to slay them permanently due to their possession of what Ulaz referred to as "recall stones." These stones, or whatever they are, must reperesent some very powerful magic. I fear I may not have heard the last of this dangerous pair. However, though I failed to slay the hobgoblin leaders, I expect I have done enough damage to the goblin army that it will not constitute a signficant threat for a long time. Likely I have done all I can do in this region and should move on to some other task.

dst: "卡洛玛斯似乎因此受到启发，试图重新与我建立联系，寻求和解。我们曾经是遏制卑劣奴隶制行径斗争中的盟友，但后来在应采用的方法上产生了分歧。我不愿像他那样绕开法律。现在卡洛玛斯希望多年的失败，以及多年目睹这里所谓法律的腐败和不公，已经在一定程度上改变了我的观点。我必须承认，我对自己的立场不如从前那样确定了。无论如何，卡洛玛斯请求我在他涉及的某件事上提供帮助。我被说服应该提供帮助。"
src: "Kalomas seems to have been inspired by this to attempt to reopen communications with me, seeking a reconciliation. We were once allies in the struggle to curb the vile practice of slavery, but came to disagree about the methods to be employed. I was not prepared to skirt the law as he was. Now Kalomoas hopes that years of failure, and years of witnessing the corruption and injustice of what passes for law here has modified my views somewhat. I must admit I am less certain of my position than I once was. At any rate, Kalomas has asked for my help on a certain matter with which he is involved. I am persuaded that I should provide it."

奴役牧者操纵他人的思想，如同雕塑家手中的黏土。有些生物比其他生物更容易受到奴役牧者无意识但持续的服役召唤。于是它们来了，渴望被领导，乐于追随，并完全处于奴役牧者的控制之下。通过这种方式，奴役牧者保持着一小群被奴役的仆从，它们急于执行其意志。

特殊：必须是心灵术士心智感应流派且能够显能心智感应流派异能。

职业特性：

等级
1：奴役牧者 - 获得一个奴仆，其等级基于奴役牧者的领导力分数。
2：
3：心智魅惑 - 将心智魅惑添加到奴役牧者可以显能的异能列表中。每天一次，他可以以降低的花费显能此异能。

6：
7：高等支配 - 奴役牧者不再需要为动物，精类，巨人，魔法兽或类人怪物增幅支配。
8：
9：超级支配 - 奴役牧者不再需要为异怪，龙类，元素和异界生物增幅支配。
10：双重大师 - 获得一个比奴役牧者等级低 2 级的奴仆。

奖励显能

达到 2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 级时，奴役牧者获得一个新的显能者等级，增加其异能点，已知异能总数和最高异能等级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Thrallherds manipulate the minds of others as if they were clay in the hands of a sculptor. some creatures are more susceptible than others to the thrallherd's unconscious, but continual, call to service. And so they come, eager to be led, happy to follow, and completely under the thrallherd's control. In this way, thrallherds keep a minor menagerie of enthralled servants that are anxious to do their will.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Thrallherd gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Feats: Narrow Mind (This feat requires 13 Wisdom)
Skills: Persuade 4 ranks, Lore 8 ranks.
Manifesting: Must be able to manifest 3rd level powers.
Special: Must be a Telepath Discipline Psion and able to manifest a Telepath Discipline Power.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Thrallherd - Gain a thrall whose level is based upon Thrallherd's leadership score.
2:
3: Psionic Charm - Add Psionic Charm to the list of powers the Thrallherd can manifest. Once per day, he can manifest this power at a reduced cost.
4:
5: Psionic Dominate - Add Psionic Dominate to the list of powers the Thrallherd can manifest. Once per day, he can manifest this power at a reduced cost.
6:
7: Greater Dominate - Thrallherd no longer has to augment Dominate for animals, fey, giants, magical beasts, or monstrous humanoids.
8:
9: Superior Dominate - Thrallherd no longer has to augment Dominate for aberrations, dragons, elementals, and outsiders.
10: Twofold Master - Gain a thrall of a level 2 lower than the Thrallherd's level.

BONUS MANIFESTING

Upon reaching levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, the Thrallherd gains a new manifester level, increasing his power points, total powers known, and maximum power level.

src:
Wild elves, also known as green elves, are insular and savage. As a result they are rarely seen outside their forest homes. The green elves were always close to nature, even more than other elves, but they have forgotten many of the high arts and lore of their people, choosing stealth and survival over learning and enlightenment. Their skin tends to be brown and their hair ranges from black to light brown, lightening to silvery white with age.

Wild Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Int
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass wild elf's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Bonus Proficiencies (Longsword, Rapier, Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Wild Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Wild Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

dst: "在我们上次分道扬镳后，我试图将奥布格隆团伙中幸存的兽人和食人魔组织成一支新的劫掠部队，由我自己担任首领。然而，许多人不信任我，再加上其他问题，事情进展得不太顺利。到了某个时候，我决定，如果打不过人类国家，那就加入他们，也许像你一样成为一名冒险者。毕竟，如果半兽人，甚至据说还有豺狼人和狗头人这样的生物都能做到，为什么一个半食人魔不行呢？在寻找这类工作时，我很快听说有人悬赏你的人头，便同意去追捕。但鉴于我们之前的合作对双方都有利，我希望尽可能避免杀死你。我还听说有竖琴手试图帮助你，所以我联系了他们，告诉他们我愿意倒戈，当然前提是我放弃的赏金能得到补偿。如果可能的话，我更愿意站在你这边战斗，但我确实需要谋生。"
src: "After we parted ways before, I tried to organize the surviving orcs and ogres of Obgron's band into a new raiding force, with myself as their leader. Many did not trust me, however, and between that and other problems things did not go too well. At a certain point, I decided that if I could not beat the human nations I should join them, perhaps becoming an adventurer like you. After all, if creatures like half-orcs, and by some accounts even gnolls and kobolds, can do that, why not an ogrillon? While looking for such work, I soon heard that there was a bounty offer on you, and agreed to seek it. But as our previous association had been mutually profitable, I hoped to avoid killing you if possible. I had also heard there were Harpers trying to assist you, so I contacted them and told them I would switch sides, provided of course that I was compensated for the bounty I was giving up. I would prefer to fight on your side if possible, but I do need to make a living."

Otherwise, alchemical spark functions like alchemist's fire except that it deals 1d8  points of electricity damage on a direct hit (and 1 point of electricity damage to those it splashes), rather than fire damage. dst: 不清楚这面奇特的盾牌当初为何被制造出来。有人说它是由一个现已消失、拥有三只手臂的传奇种族所造。也有人更平淡地认为，其制作者在锻造它时喝醉了。无论原因如何，施加在这面盾牌上的附魔使持有者能够熟练地同时使用两件武器战斗。当然，困难在于，如果一个人装备这面盾牌以获得此附魔的益处，他就没有空余的手来持握第二件武器。就实际用途而言，它对冒险者的价值并不比一面普通的非魔法盾牌更高。然而，它仍能卖出一个可观的价钱，因为某些收藏家会把它当作奇物而感兴趣。
src: It is unclear why this bizarre shield was ever made. Some say it was built by a now vanished legendary race of creatures with three arms. Others, more prosaically, suggest that its crafter was intoxicated at the time of its forging. Whatever the reason, the enchantment placed on this shield provides the bearer with the ability to fight skillfully with two weapons wielded simultaneously. Of course, the difficulty is that if someone were to equip the shield to gain the benefit of this enchantment, he would not have a free hand for wielding the second weapon. As far as actual use goes, it is of no more value to an adventurer than an ordinary, non-magical shield. However, it could still be sold for a respectable sum since it is of interest to certain collectors as a curiousity.

dst: 哈马德对我向他讲述的我在气元素位面的经历的意义感到好奇，在那里我得知有些存在想要保护他的女儿扎拉拉免受某种神秘威胁。他请他的一位法师朋友，名叫拉达扎尔·法塞夫的人，通过询问各种可召唤的位面存在来调查此事。法塞夫则想亲自与我谈谈我的位面外遭遇，我猜是为了指导他的行动。因此哈马德派我去和他谈谈。法塞夫可以在提尔神殿的东北塔楼找到。我应该去那座神殿（自然是在神殿区），在东北方找到向上的楼梯。法塞夫在等我，必要的门应该已经解锁，等待我的到来。\n\n我已经与拉达扎尔会面，并参与了他对几个被召唤的位面生物的询问。我不确定我们是否真的从他们那里了解到很多，但我们已经做了目前能做的，我应该把结果，不管怎样，报告给哈马德。
src: Hamad is curious about the significance of what I related to him concerning my experiences on the Plane of Air, where I was informed that some entities there wished to protect his daughter Zarala against some mysterious threat. He has asked a mage fried of his, one Radazal Faseph, to investigate the matter by inquiring among various summonable planar entities. Faseph in turn wants to speak to me personally about my extra-planar encounter, I suppose to guide his activities. Hamad has therefore dispatched me to talk to him. Faseph can be found in the northeast tower of the Temple of Tyr. I should go to that temple (in the Temple District, naturally) and find an upward-leading staircase in the northeast. Faseph is expecting me and the necesary doors should be unlocked in anticipation of my arrival.\n\nI have met with Radazal and participated in his inquiries directed to a couple of summoned planar creatures. I am not sure we have actually learned all that much from them, but we have done what we can for the time being and I should report the results, such as they are, to Hamad.

dst: "是的，而且东境的历史之所以有趣有两个原因。其一是在维多的冒险历程中某个时候，他发现了一件魔法神器，并用它在自己的村庄周围设立了一道防护魔法场，以保护村庄免受兽人、地精以及其他类似人形生物的袭击。这道场使得除了半身人之外任何人都无法进入那个地方。其二是，在维多退休并回到他的村庄后不久，尽管有这道场和他的存在，某种灾难还是降临了那里，大多数居民被杀，其余的人逃走了，留下了关于某种怪物袭击的含糊不清的报告。那个地方从此就一直荒废着。"
src: "Yes, and the history of Eastmarch is interesting for two reasons. One is that at some point in his adventures Vido found a magical artifact that he used to set up a protective magical field around his village to protect it from raids by orcs, goblins, and other such humanoids. This field made it impossible for anyone but a halfling to enter the place. The second is that shortly after Vido retired and returned to his village, and in spite of both this field and his presence, some disaster overtook it, most of the inhabitants were slain, with the rest fleeing, giving garbled reports of some sort of attack by a monster. The place has remained abandoned ever since."

Level: Psychic warrior 1
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Weapon touched
Duration: 1 min./level
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: No
Power Points: 1

Metaphysical weapon gives a weapon a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls.

src:
Bugbears are the biggest and the strongest of the goblinoid races, and are more aggressive than their smaller relatives. They survive primarily by hunting weaker creatures. Although not related to bears, it has hide and claws that resemble those of its namesake. Bugbears are muscular and stand 7 feet tall. They prefer to dwell in temperate, mountainous regions, living in small tribal units.

Bugbear Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +2 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass bugbear's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Bugbears are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All bugbears are proficient with simple weapons.
- Armor Proficiency (Light): All bugbears are proficient with light armor.
- Shield: All bugbears are proficient with shields.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 3.
- Goblinoid: Bugbears count as Goblinoids for the purpose of spells.

dst: 变形怪是以其非凡的变形能力而闻名的怪物，它们能够完美模仿任何类人生物的外貌，并因其取代权贵人物的倾向而令人恐惧。变形怪常被邪恶组织雇佣，冒充他人身份以充当有效的间谍或破坏者。变形怪通常会花时间研究目标，当准备就绪、学会如何行事而不引起怀疑后，便杀死目标并取而代之。即使变形怪未能完全完成任务，仅仅知道有变形怪在暗中作祟，就足以散播偏执的猜疑，因为任何人都可能被怀疑是冒牌货。当不以伪装身份行动时，变形怪通常呈现为灰色且几乎没有特征的类人生物形态。在这种形态下，它们非常强壮敏捷，并能显现出致命的爪子进行战斗。
src: Doppelgangers are monsters known for their extraordinary shapeshifting powers, as they are able to perfectly mimic the appearance of any humanoid, and feared for their tendency to replace influential individuals. Often hired by nefarious organizations to assume identities allowing them to act as effective spies or saboteurs, a Doppelganger will typically spend some time studying a target and when ready, having learned how to act without arousing suspicion, kill him and take over his life. Even if a doppelganger falls short of complete success on a mission, the mere knowledge that Doppelgangers are working against one can serve to spread paranoid mistrust, as anyone and everyone comes under suspicion of being a double. When not acting under an assumed identity, Doppelgangers normally appear as gray and mostly featureless humanoids. In this form they are very strong and agile, and able to manifest deadly claws with which to fight.

dst:
在击败牛头人海盗的过程中，瓦尔库尔之剑号的船员发现了一些海图，上面标明了其他海盗基地的位置。其中一处是一群人类海盗的基地，他们早就想除掉这群人，所以我们的下一站就是他们所在的那座岛。扎拉拉和我自然要参加这次进攻。我们已经航行了好几天，很快就要接近目标了。我去找船长打听我们在即将到来的战斗中担任什么角色，得知我们将乘坐小船进行夜间偷袭。扎拉拉和我将加入船员主力，一起进攻海盗的船，而船长本人则率领另一队人马进攻海岸。

我们悄悄摸上了海盗船，等那边的事看起来已经稳操胜券，便离船登岸去支援船长的进攻。船长那一队人已经烧毁了看起来是海盗主营地的地方，并在我们的帮助下击败了一些海盗。完事之后，船长建议我们探索岛上其余的地方，看看还有没有别的海盗。在探索过程中，我们发现了一系列洞穴，看起来被海盗用作基地。这值得进一步调查，因为很可能还有海盗幸存者仍在附近（更别提还有大量海盗宝藏了）。

探索洞穴时，我们发现这群海盗的头目是一个纯血蛇人，这个基地被用来推进蛇人的图谋。那个头目和一些其他蛇人已经被杀，大部分或全部海盗也已丧命，所以这群海盗应该不再构成威胁了。不过，我们还发现了一个传送门，显然通往另一个蛇人基地。也许应该去调查一下，以确保不会再有敌人从那里过来。
src:
In the process of defeating the minotaur pirates, the Sword of Valkur's crew discovered some charts indicating the locations of other pirate bases. One of them is the base of a group of human pirates they have long been hoping to put out of business, so our next stop will be the island where they can be found. Naturally Zarala and I will be taking part in this assault. We have been sailing for several days and will soon be approaching our target. Upon speaking to the captain to discover our part in the upcoming battle, I learned that we would be making a stealthy night assault in small craft. Zarala and I will join the main body of the crew in an assault on the pirates' ship, while the captain himself leads a secondary attack on the shore.

We snuck on board the pirate vessel and, once that work seemed well in hand, swung off the ship and went to the shore to support the captain's assault. The captain's party had burned what appeared to be the main pirate encampment, and defeated some of the pirates about with our help. With that done, the captain suggested that we explore the rest of the island to see if there are any more pirates to be found. In the process of doing so, we have discovered a series of caves that appears to be used as a base by the pirates. This merits further investigation, as there may well be some pirate survivors still about (not to mention a lot of pirate treasure).

Exploring the caves, we discovered that this group of pirates is captained by a Yuan-ti pureblood, and was being used to further the ends of the Yuan-ti. The captain and and some other Yuan-Ti have been killed, along with most or all of the pirates, so this group of pirates should no longer be a threat. However, we also found a portal that apparently connects to some other Yuan-ti base. Perhaps it should be investigated to insure no more enemies will come through.

src: While exploring a lost and ruined shrine, I found an open portal to the Abyss. It might be a good idea to close it, lest Tanar'ri keep pouring through. It is being kept open by several pillars, some on each side of the portal, so to close it I will have to go through and shut down the pillars on the other side as well. These, furthermore, should be shut down first, lest the portal close while I am on the other side. They should not be too far away from the portal, but I may have to look around a bit to find them.\n\nThree pillars has been shut down. Now I only need to return to the Prime Material through the portal and shut down the last remaining one on that side.

dst: "贾尔津把宝球保存在他的塔里，塔就在这些码头以北的市场东边。想要闯进去可没那么简单，因为那座塔布有严密的防护。不过贾尔津本人经常离开塔到城里去，事实上他现在就在这家酒馆里，靠着北墙。他身上带着一把钥匙，能让你进入他的塔——只要你能在不被察觉的情况下把它弄到手。所以，你该用你们这类人惯用的手法，从他身上扒走这把钥匙，然后用它进入塔中。进去之后，你必须仔细搜寻，直到找到宝球，把它拿走，带回来给我。"
src: "Jarlzin keeps the orb within his tower, which you will find just to the east of the markets north of these docks. There is no simple way to break in, for the tower is warded well. Jarlzin himself, however, often leaves it to go about the city, and in fact is in this very tavern right now, along the northern wall. He carries a key on his person that will enable you to enter his tower, if you can take it off him without being noticed. So you should pickpocket this key from him, by the normal methods those of your talents employ, and use it to enter the tower. Once within you must search until you find the orb, take it, and bring it to me."

Conjuration (Creation) [Evil]
Level: Clr 2, Demonologist 1
Components: V S, M/DF
Casting Time: 1 full round
Area: 5-ft. radius, centered on caster
Duration: Instantaneous

Arcane Material Component: The feathers of an
avian creature with an intelligence score of at
least 3 (a harpy, achaierai, or similar creature).

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Part reconnaissance expert, part border guard, part spy and part diplomat, the vigilant is a highly trained warrior who can be confidently sent into any situation, no matter how grim the odds. Recruits who survive the harsh training and deadly initiation tests required to become a vigilant are assigned to one of the elite corps of these warriors, called a Vigil.

- Hit Die: d12.
- Proficiencies: A vigilant does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non-evil
Base Attack Bonus: +5
Feats: Endurance, Track
Skills: Lore 4 ranks, Listen 5 ranks, Persuade 5 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Sprint - Can move for a brief period of time as Hasted, three times per day.
2: Favored Enemy - Gains a Favored Enemy as the Ranger ability.
4: Great Fortitude - A character with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining a +2 bonus to all Fortitude saving throws.
5: Iron Will - The character's strong presence of mind gives him a +2 bonus to all Will saving throws.
6: Lightning Reflexes - The character's reflexes are faster than normal, granting him a +2 bonus to all Reflex saving throws.
7: Toughness - A character with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining one bonus hit point per level.
9: Vigilant Natural Armor - Gains plus 2 to his natural armor class.
10: Vigilant Natural Healing - Regenerates hit points at a rate of one per round.

dst: "你应该已经注意到，你上来的楼梯在你身后消失了，而且这个房间并不像楼下那些那样破败不堪、到处是垃圾。你看到的不是真实的，而是由盘踞此地的恐怖幽灵所创造的精心幻象，你想逃出去可不容易。每当你穿过一扇门或一段楼梯，你只会被传送到另一个像这样的房间，这个幻象迷宫的某个随机区域。当年我也像你一样来到这里，想要清除此地的邪恶，却发现自己无法逃脱，在绝望地游荡时不断遭到幻影袭击，最终倒下了。如今我的尸体在楼下腐烂，我的灵魂则被困在这里。"
src: "You will have noticed how the stairs you came up by vanished behind you and that this room is not falling apart and littered with rubbish, like those downstairs. What you see is not real, but an elaborate illusion, created by the dread spirit who haunts this place, and you will not find it easy to escape. Every time you enter a door or staircase, you will simply be transported to some other room like this, some other random section of this maze of illusions. Once I came here as you, seeking to purge this place of evil, but found myself unable to escape, and as I wandered hopelessly was continually assaulted by phantoms until I eventually fell. Now my corpse rots downstairs and my spirit is trapped here."

dst:
在尖牙森林扎营的竖琴手向我们介绍了一位名叫冈德·迅矛的矮人游侠。这位冈德显然知道在哪里可以找到巨龙格拉阿扎乌库尔的巢穴，但只有我们帮助他完成击败效忠于大地精法师乌拉斯的类地精劫掠者的任务，他才会告诉我们。乌拉斯和他的副官们拥有魔法“召回石”，一旦他们有死亡危险，召回石就会将他们传送走，使得最终击败他们似乎不可能。

然而，冈德发现了一个他认为的机会。其中一位名叫莫古兹的副官正在研究这片森林中的一座古老地精神殿。这座神殿位于一个死魔法区，这意味着莫古兹拥有的召回石在那里很可能无法生效。如果我们能在区域内攻击他，我们或许能够彻底杀死他，让冈德拿走他的召回石，并将其交给奥术研究者，他们有望想出反制它的方法。

不幸的是，我们对地精营地的攻击太慢了，给了莫古兹时间得知我们的逼近并离开死魔法区。因此，他被我们击败时被传送到了安全的地方。冈德的计划失败了。虽然他很失望，但他仍然承认我们帮助了他，并仍然告诉我们在哪里可以找到格拉阿扎乌库尔的巢穴。
src:
The Harpers camped in the Wood of Sharp Teeth introduced us to a dwarven ranger named Gund Swiftspear. This Gund apparently knows where to find the lair of the dragon Gra'azha'ukul, but will only tell us if we aid him in his quest to defeat the goblinoid raiders loyal to the Hobgoblin mage Ulaz. Ulaz and his lieutenants posses magical "recall stones" which will teleport them away if they are in danger of death, making it seemingly impossible to finally defeat them.

Gund, however, had found what he believed to be an opportunity. One of these lieutenants, named Moguz, was researching an old goblin shrine in these woods. This shrine was located in a dead magic zone, meaning that the recall stone possessed by Moguz would most likely not work there. If we could have attacked him while in the zone, we might have been able to kill him for good, allowing Gund to take his recall stone and take it to arcane researchers who can hopefully come up with a way to counter-act it.

Unfortunately, our attack on the goblin camp was too slow, giving Moguz time to be warned of our approach and leave the dead magic zone. Thus, he was teleported to safety upon being defeated by us. Gund's plan failed. While obviously he was disappointed, he neverthelss acknowledged that we had assisted him, and still let us know where to find Gra'azha'ukul's lair.

Though you may have a little time to attend to any lingering matters in this region once you are done at Candlekeep. Make sure when you leave you bring the book you need to get into Candlekeep with you. Also, you'll pass by the town of Beregost on the way to Candlekeep, but you had best avoid it. According to reports, many of the bounty-hunting adventurers seeking you are staying in the inns there, in addition to those searching the countryside or guarding Candlekeep. Hopefully we can avoid any trouble along the way with this plan, but there's no guarantee of that."

dst: "这片区域到处都是蛛化精灵，你可能已经注意到了。我们的一位女祭司被一个特别强大的蛛化精灵袭击了，你看到躺在这里的就是她的尸体。这个蛛化精灵偷走了她携带的一把钥匙，那能让他进入一座罗丝的古老神殿。这座神殿曾是至邪魔法的中心，我们伊莉丝翠的信徒将其封印了起来，以遏制它。如今我们的努力似乎就要白费了。更糟的是，那个蛛化精灵还偷走了她的圣徽，大概是要在神殿里进行某种邪恶仪式。也许他希望能以某种方式重获罗丝的宠爱，解除把他变成怪物的诅咒？不管他的动机是什么，他都是一个邪恶、凶残的生物，会带来极大的危害。不幸的是，他可能太强大了，我们无法阻止。"
src: "This region is infested by driders, as you may have noticed. One of our priestesses was attacked by a particularly powerful drider, and it is her body you see lying here. This drider stole a key she carried, that will allow him to enter an old temple of Lolth. This temple was a center of magic of the foulest sort, and we followers of Eilistraee sealed it off to contain it. Now our work seems likely to be undone. What's more, the drider also stole her holy symbol, presumably to use in some foul ritual in the temple. Perhaps he hopes to somehow regain Lolth's favor and undo the curse transforming him into a monster? Whatever his motives, he is an evil, murderous creature who threatens much harm. Unfortunately, he may be too powerful for us to stop."

dst:
幻象（虚假幻觉，魅影幻觉）
等级：吟游诗人 5，幸运 6，术士/法师 6，诡术 6
成分：姿势
施法时间：1 标准动作
距离：近距（8M）
目标/效果：你/一个幻影替身
持续时间：1 轮/等级（可解消） 和 专注 + 3 轮；见文本
豁免检定：无 或 意志不相信（若互动）；见文本
法术抗力：否

你变为隐形（如同进阶隐形，一种魅影幻觉），同时，一个你的幻影替身（如同高等幻影，一种虚假幻觉） 出现。然后你可以自由地去别处，而你的替身则移开。替身出现在范围内，但此后按你的指示移动。你可以使虚假幻觉完美地叠加在你自己的身体上，以便观察者不会注意到一个影像出现而你变为隐形。替身以你的速度移动，可以像真的一样说话和做手势，但它不能攻击或施法，尽管它可以假装这样做。

你可以像给随从一样给它下达动作指令：“跟随” “什么都不做（原地待命）” “攻击（假装攻击）”.

幻影替身持续到你专注于它为止，再加上额外的 3 轮。在你停止专注后，幻影替身继续执行相同的活动直到持续时间结束。进阶隐形持续每等级 1 轮，无论是否专注。
src:
Illusion (Figment, Glamer)
Level: Brd 5, Luck 6, Sor/Wiz 6, Trickery 6
Components: S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (8M)
Target/Effect: You/one illusory double
Duration: 1 round/level (D) and concentration + 3 rounds; see text
Saving Throw: None or Will disbelief (if interacted with); see text
Spell Resistance: No

You become invisible (as improved invisibility, a glamer), and at the same time, an illusory double of you (as major image, a figment) appears. You are then free to go elsewhere while your double moves away. The double appears within range but thereafter moves as you direct it. You can make the figment appear superimposed perfectly over your own body so that observers don't notice an image appearing and you turning invisible. The double moves at your speed and can talk and gesture as if it were real, but it cannot attack or cast spells, though it can pretend to do so.

Actions you can give it as a henchmen is "Follow" "Do nothing (stand ground)" "Attack (Pretend to attack)".

The illusory double lasts as long as you concentrate upon it, plus 3 additional rounds. After you cease concentration, the illusory double continues to carry out the same activity until the duration expires. The improved invisibility lasts for 1 round per level, regardless of concentration.

Azer are dwarf-like beings native to the Elemental Plane of Fire. They wear kilts of brass, bronze or copper and speak an ancient language known as Ignan. Although unfriendly and taciturn, Azer rarely provoke a fight except to relieve a foe of much-treasured gems. Their society is a heavily-regimented one wherein everyone has a designated place. Somewhat xenophobic, only fighters among their kind are likely to venture out among the other planes.

Azer Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, +2 Dex, +2 Con, +2 Int, +2 Wis, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass azers fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Azer are able to see in the dark.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 13, plus 1 per character level.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 6.

- Immunity to Fire: Azer are immune to the effects of fire.
- Vulnerability to Cold: Azer take 50% more damage from cold and cold-based spells.
- Outsider: Azer count as Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

（进阶职业）
丹塔利安之裔的血统可追溯到一个古老，被长久遗忘的人类帝国--一个正义，爱与艺术至高无上的文明。他们坚称这个国度的统治者将其人民引领到如此美丽与正义的高度，以至于他们所激发的敬畏可与天堂的星辰匹敌。诸神看到了他们的成就并心生嫉妒。在嫉妒的狂怒中，诸神摧毁了帝国并诅咒其贵族，下令该血脉中的任何人都永远无法在死后加入他们。丹塔利安之裔相信自己属于这一血脉，被诸神诅咒，但因与丹塔利安--所有祖先灵魂的集合体残魂--的关联而受到祝福。这些后裔相信他们的命运是有一天戴上王冠，手持统治权杖，重建那个可与星辰匹敌的帝国。

- 生命骰：d8
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：
种族：人类，半精灵或半兽人
技能：学识2级
特殊：能够绑定丹塔利安

职业特性：
等级
1：丹塔利安之宠 - 与丹塔利安始终达成良好契约
    丹塔利安之学识 - 每天一次，将丹塔利安授予的学识加值翻倍，持续一轮
2：迅捷丹塔利安之威 - 丹塔利安之威现在是迅捷动作而非移动动作
3：压倒性思想 - 使读取思想的目标晕眩
4：丹塔利安之凝视 - 致盲30英尺锥形范围内的生物
    精通思想旅行 - 思想旅行现在是移动动作
5：读取多重思想 - 使用读取思想和压倒性思想同时瞄准多个敌人

灵魂绑定：每升一级，你获得新的灵魂绑定，如同你在使用灵魂绑定的职业上也提升了一级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Scions of Dantalion trace their lineage to an ancient, long-forgotten human empire-a civilization in which justice, love, and art reigned supreme. They maintain that the rulers of this realm led their people to such a height of beauty and righteousness that they rivaled the stars of the heavens in the awe they could inspire. The gods saw their accomplishments and grew envious. In their jealous rage, they destroyed the empire and cursed its nobility, decreeing that no one from that line could ever join them in the afterlife. Scions of Dantalion believe themselves to be part of this line, cursed by the gods but blessed by association with Dantalion, the vestige that is the conglomeration of all their ancestors' souls. The scions believe that their destiny is to one day take up the crown, bear the scepter of rulership, and rebuild the empire that could rival the stars.

- Hit Die: d8
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Race: Human, Half-elf, or Half-orc
Skills: Lore 2 ranks
Special: Ability to bind Dantalion

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Favored of Dantalion - Always make a good pact with Dantalion
    Scholarship of Dantalion - Once per day, double the Lore bonus Dantalion grants for one round
2:  Swift Awe of Dantalion - Awe of Dantalion is now a swift action instead of a move action
3:  Overwhelming Thoughts - Daze target of Read Thoughts
4:  Dantalion's Glare - Blind creatures in 30 ft. cone
    Improved Thought Travel - Thought Travel is now a move action
5:  Read Multiple Thoughts - Target multiple enemies at a time with Read Thoughts and Overwhelm Thoughts

Soul Binding: At each level, you gain new soul binds as if you had gained a level in both your soul binding-using class.

dst: 在穿过维尔达斯森林时，我遇到了一位名叫赛亚拉的树精。她受到了最近穿过森林、彼此交战的豺狼人和牛头人的困扰，尤其担心她两个姐妹的命运，她们最近为了躲避这样一场战斗而逃离。这两位树精中，一位逃进了附近的洞穴，另一位则逃往东边的地区。两人都没有回来，赛亚拉担心她们遇到了某种危险。她请求我调查这两个区域，先从洞穴开始，以营救她的姐妹，或至少查明她们遭遇了什么。\n\n我发现赛亚拉的姐妹被囚禁在洞穴中。与此同时，我身后的门突然关闭，阻止了撤退。这让我别无选择，只能继续前进，而为了做到这一点，我面临两条道路的选择。其中一条会杀死被囚禁的树精，但为我提供一条更安全的前进道路，另一条则会释放她，但代价是增加我自身的危险。我选择释放她。我预计赛亚拉至少会对此感到高兴，尽管这也可能意味着我无法活着领取她的奖励。尽管如此，我必须充分利用已经为我打开的道路，无论它有多么危险。
src: While proceeding through the Wealdath forest, I came across a dryad named Saiala. She has been inconvenienced by the gnolls and minotaurs who have recently been moving through the forest, battling each other, and is particularly concerned with the fate of her two sisters, who recently fled in order to avoid becoming caught up in one such battle. One of these two dryads fled into a nearby cave, and the other to the regions to the east. Neither has returned and Saiala fears they have run into some sort of danger. She has asked that I investigate both areas, starting with the cave, in order to rescue her sisters or at least discover what became of them.\n\nI found Saiala's sister held captive in the cave. At the same time, the door behind me snapped shut, preventing retreat. This left no choice but to press onward, and to do so I was then given a choice of two paths to follow. One of these would slay the captive dryad, but provide me with a safer path onward, while the other would set her free at the cost of increasing my own danger. I chose to set her free. I expect Saiala will be happy about that at least, though it might also mean I will now not survive to collect her reward. Nevertheless I must make the best of the path that has now been opened for me, however hazardous it may be.

通过施放太阳灵光，你用温暖，闪耀的光芒充满你周围的区域，消除自然阴影并阻碍魔法黑暗。任何生物试图在太阳灵光内施放暗影子学派的法咒或带有黑暗描述符的法咒时，必须成功通过施法者等级检定（DC 11 + 你的施法者等级），否则法咒失败。源自 3 级或更低法咒和效果的魔法黑暗区域与太阳灵光重叠时会被暂时压制。在强光中受到惩罚的生物在太阳灵光内也会受到惩罚，不死生物在法咒区域内每轮在其回合结束时受到 1d6 点正能量伤害。此外，任何试图在灵光内躲藏的生物在躲藏检定上受到 -4 惩罚。

此效果以你为中心并随你移动。

任何进入灵光的生物立即受到其效果影响，但离开的生物不再受影响。
src:
Aura of the Sun
Abjuration [Light]
Level: Cleric 4, Paladin 4,
Components: V, S, DF,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 10 ft.
Area: 10-ft.-radius emanation centered on you
Duration: 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw: No
Spell Resistance: None

By casting aura of the sun, you fill the area around you with warm, glowing light that eliminates natural shadows and hampers magical darkness. Any creature attempting to cast a spell from the shadow subschool or a spell with the darkness descriptor within an aura of the sun must succeed on a caster level check (DC 11 + your caster level), or the spell fails. Areas of magical darkness originating from 3rd-level or lower spells and effects are temporarily suppressed when overlapping with an aura of the sun. Creatures that take penalties in bright light also take them while within an aura of the sun, and an undead creature takes 1d6 points of positive energy damage at the end of its turn every round that it spends within the spell's area.Furthermore, any creature attempting to hide within the aura takes a -4 penalty on Hide checks.

This effect is centered on you and moves with you.

Anyone who enters the aura immediately becomes subject to its effect, but creatures that leave are no longer affected.

Luminous Armor
Abjuration
Level: Sanctified 2
Components: Sacrifice
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: 1 good creature touched
Duration: 1 hour/level

This spell, favored among eladrins visiting the Material Plane, envelops the target in a protective, shimmering aura of light.  The luminous armor resembles a suit of dazzling full plate, but it is weightless and does not restrict the target's movement or mobility in any way.  In addition to imparting the benefits of a breastplate (+5 armor bonus to AC), the luminous armor has no maximum Dexterity restriction, no armor check penalty, and no chance for arcane spell failure. You cannot wear other armor while wearing luminous armor.

Luminous armor sheds light equivalent to a daylight spell and dispels darkness spells of 2nd level or lower with which it comes into contact.  In addition, the armor causes opponents to take a -4 penalty on melee attacks made against the target.  This penalty stacks with the penalty suffered by creatures sensitive to bright light (such as dark elves).

Sacrifice: 1d2 points of Strength damage.

狮身人面兽爪

描述符：影响心智

一套强大的可伸缩猫爪状爪子在你手上形成。这些魔法爪子似乎几乎有生命，它们完美地跟随你手和手指的每一个动作。

脉轮绑定（手）

你的手与环绕它们的爪子融为一体，相对于你的体型过大。然而，最深刻的变化在于你的战斗熟练度--一种强大的冲动在你内心增长，想要扑向敌人，用爪子和牙齿撕咬，直到你的猎物在你野蛮的抓握中一动不动。

当你使用冲锋动作时，在冲锋结束时，你可以使用你拥有的任何天生武器进行全力攻击。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

你的手与环绕它们的爪子融为一体，相对于你的体型过大。你发现你可以用它们撕咬敌人，伴随着这种能力而来的是一种强烈的欲望，想要使用这些工具。你会用雌狮身人面兽的智慧或雄狮身人面兽的高贵来调和这种嗜血吗？还是你会完全屈服于它，像鹰狮身人面兽一样狂暴？

你可以将你的狮身人面兽爪用作天生武器，造成1d8点伤害加上你的力量调整值。你投入狮身人面兽爪的每一点魂能，你都会在爪子的攻击检定和伤害检定上获得+1增强加值。
src:
Sphinx Claws

Descriptors: Mind-Affecting  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Hands (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

A powerful set of retractable, catlike claws forms over your hands. These magical claws seem almost alive, and they perfectly follow every move of your own hands and fingers.

While wearing sphinx claws, you gain a +1 competence bonus on Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks, such as Climb and Jump checks and checks made to bull rush an opponent. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your sphinx claws increases the competence bonus by 1. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

Your hands become one with the claws that surround them, overlarge for your size. The most profound change, however, is in your proficiency in combat-a powerful urge grows within you to leap at your foes, tearing with claws and teeth until your prey lies motionless in your savage grip.

When you use the charge action, at the end of your charge you can make a full attack using any natural weapons you possess.

Chakra Bind (Totem)

Your hands become one with the claws that surround them, overlarge for your size. You find you can use them to tear at your foes, and with that ability comes a powerful desire to put these tools to use. Will you temper that bloodlust with the wisdom of the gynosphinx or the nobility of the androsphinx? Or will you give in to it completely, rampaging like a hieracosphinx?

You can use your sphinx claws as natural weapons that deal 1d8 points of damage plus your Strength modifier. For every point of essentia you invest in your sphinx claws, you gain a +1 enhancement bonus on your attack rolls and damage rolls with the claws.

dst: “像你这样的地表人没听说过泽克斯卡顿，也许？他是一位强大的卓尔巫师，生活在很久以前。他制造了魔法宝珠：它们蕴含着强大的魔法，很少有人知道用途。我们试图收集它们，研究它们。但发现它们的地方都有守卫，亡灵充斥着那里，非常危险。我们的数量现在减少了。我们可能无法成功完成任务，也许。如果你替我们进入废墟并带回一颗泽克斯卡顿宝珠，我可以付你16000金币。对像你这样强大的人来说不会太难，也许？这是笔好买卖，不是吗？”

We might not be able to succeed in our mission, maybe. If you go in the ruin for us and return with an orb of Xerxkatun, I can pay you 16000 gold. Not be too hard for someone as strong as you, maybe? src:
Psychokinesis [see text]
Level: Psion/wilder 2
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./ level)
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half or Fortitude half; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 3
Metapsionics: Chain, Empower, Maximize, Twin

Upon manifesting this power, you choose cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You project a solid blast of energy of the chosen type at a target, dealing it 2d6 points of damage. In addition, if a subject of up to one size category larger than you fails a Strength check (DC equal to the save DC of this power), the driving force of the energy blast pushes it back 5 feet plus another 5 feet for every 5 points of damage it takes. If a wall or other solid object prevents the subject from being pushed back, the subject instead slams into the object and takes an extra 2d6 points of damage from the impact (no save).

Cold: A blast of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die (damage from impact remains at 2d6 points). The saving throw to reduce damage from a cold push is a Fortitude save instead of a Reflex save.
Electricity: Manifesting a blast of this energy type provides a +2 bonus to the save DC and a +2 bonus on manifester level checks for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
Fire: A blast of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die (damage from impact remains at 2d6 points).
Sonic: A blast of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die (damage from impact remains at 2d6 points) and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: For every 2 additional power points you spend, this power's damage increases by one die (d6) and its save DC increases by 1. The damage increase applies to both the initial blast and any damage from impact with an object.

src: Hamad has finally turned his attention to the plot I discovered of aranea raising armies of evil humanoids to attack Calimshan. He has received reports confirming my discoveries: goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs in the Marching Mountains. He has suggested two threatened points that I could travel to in order to reinforce the soldiers already there: the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, and Fort Akhaz, in the foothills of the Marching Mountains. I should make my way to the city gates and from there travel east to one or the other of these locations, and in time perhaps both.\n\nBoth the goblins in the Forest of Mir and the orcs coming from the Marching Mountains have been dealt with, and neither group should pose much of a threat anymore. What's more, amongst the wreckage of one of these armies, I found a map marking a location in the Spider Swamp that is indicated as the main base of the aranea orchestrating this war. With this information, I may be able to take out the aranea leaders and perhaps end this threat once and for all. I should bring this intelligence to Hamad and see what he wants me to do with it.

The prospects for expanding our domination seemed most promising. Of course we knew that a chaotic creature of that type would turn on us eventually, but the ancestor believed this contingency was accounted for. This Darzeth guy didn't just give a history, like everything else I'd read up to that point, he actually explains technical details about the sword. I guess he was some sort of arcane caster himself, and not just a historian...anyway I now know what spells to perform, and I have most of the reagents I need too, since we got them from that aboleth. The process is mostly magical, but not entirely, so we'll need some smithing equipment too. Tethtoril has agreed to let me use the Candlekeep Smithy for that, though, so there's only one thing I'm lacking at this point."

dst: 在探索幽暗地域时，我遇到了一位名叫马弗瑞斯·萨拉彭的人类法师，他在一个地下洞穴中临时居住，研究幽暗地域特有的奇异魔法。他让我寻找三件对他的研究有重要意义的物品：一只石化蜥蜴的眼睛，一块胶质怪或类似软泥怪的灵液，以及一只囚魂魔的脑组织。我成功找到了全部三件物品并交给了他，得到了大量金币和一个魔法宝珠作为奖励，马弗瑞斯声称这个宝珠会让我更强大。
src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a human mage named Mavereth Tharapen, who had taken up temporary residence in an underground cave while conducting research into the exotic magics peculiar to the Underdark. He asked me to find three items of significance to his research: an eye from a Basilisk, ichor from a Gelatinous Cube or similar slime, and brain matter from an Intellect Devourer. I successfully found and brought all three items to him, and was rewarded with a lot of gold and a magical orb that Mavereth claims will make me more powerful.

src: "Candlekeep? We won't be going that far north, but we can get you closer. When we leave, we're heading out towards the Nelanther Isles to raid a pirate base whose location we've recently discovered. You might even want to help us with that, seeing as you're adventurers. Once we've taken care of that, we'll head to Zazesspur in Tethyr. We could drop you off there if you like and you could make your own way north from there. I don't know where we'll be headed after that, though, depends on what news we hear and what bounties on pirates get posted. So we might be able to get you even further north than that."

dst: <StartHighlight>[愿意使用道德上可疑的手段：无序邪恶 +1]</Start> "我不得不对这种态度表示同情。为了改革这座城市，我几乎没有什么不愿意做的。哈马德的想法不同。他决心在法律框架内行事，但他也不愿为了通过这种手段真正获得政治影响力而虚与委蛇。我不太愿意遵循这种愚蠢而矛盾的道路，所以我们走上了不同的路。但你提起过去的回忆，让我分心了。我想我已经说得比你需要知道的更多了。"他转向他的仆人。"去通知卡齐娅我们有客人。"
src: <StartHighlight>[For a willingness to use morally dubious methods: Lawless Evil +1]</Start> "I cannot but sympathize with such an attitude. There is very little I would not be willing to do to reform this city. Hamad felt differently. He was determined to work within the law, yet he also had no stomach for the dissembling needed if one is actually to gain political influence by such means. I was less willing to follow such a foolish and contradictory course, and so we went on different paths. But you have distracted me by bringing up memories of the past. I think I have already said more than you need to know." He turns to his servant. "Go inform Kadzia of our guest."

src: The Blazing Axes Tribe of Orcs has developed a primitive alchemy allowing them to create the blazing blades from which they take their name. Typically this involves a temporary application of alchemist's fire that will only last for a single battle, but in some cases, such as this one, it is accompanied by magical spells that make the effect permanent. Usually the enhanced fire damage comes at the price of somewhat degrading the quality of the metal, due to the crudity of their techniques for magical forgings, but in the case of this blade that appears to have been avoided. Both the craftsmanship and the power of the enchantments on this weapon are above average for the tribe. Perhaps it represents the masterpiece of some unusually talented orc smith.

dst: 这个柜子的门上刻着一座复杂的迷宫，起点处有一个奇怪的部件，你发现它可以沿着构成迷宫的凹槽移动。你猜想，要打开柜门，必须解开迷宫，把这个可移动的部件从起点带到终点。然而，稍加尝试就很快暴露出一个问题：一旦你深入迷宫一段距离，握住这个部件就会开始给你带来一种奇怪的、魔法引发的疼痛，越接近终点就越严重。而且，当疼痛变得太剧烈、迫使你松开部件时，它会弹回迷宫的起点，逼你重新开始。要把它带到迷宫终点并打开这个箱子绝非易事。
src: Engraved into the door of this cabinet is a complex maze, with an odd fixture at its starting point, which you discover can be moved along the grooves forming the maze. You assume that, to open the cabinet doors, the maze must be solved, by bringing this movable fixture through it to the end. However, a little experimentation soon reveals a problem: Once you get a little way into the maze, holding on to the fixture starts to cause you a strange, magically induced pain, that gets worse as you get closer to the end. Furthermore, when this pain becomes too much and forces you to release your hold on the fixture, it will shoot back to the starting point of the maze, forcing you to begin again. It will not be easy to bring it to the end of the maze and open the box.

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Incarnate, Soulborn

Incarnum forms into a cerulean tunic that covers your torso, fitting comfortably over any other clothing or armor you wear. Except for its unusual color, it seems like a relatively mundane garment-until you are subjected to any spell effect. When that happens, the color of the shirt comes alive, forming intricate patterns of swirls, bursts, and spirals as the shirt attempts to deflect the magical energy.

While worn, the spellward shirt grants you spell resistance 5.

Chakra Bind (Heart) 

The soul energy of your spellward shirt is bound into your flesh, its cerulean color tinting your skin all over your body.

You become immune to the first 24 levels of spell that affect you each day of 6th level and lower spells.

src:

Innate Level: 9

Descriptor(s): [see text]
Component(s): Verbal, Somatic, Material
Range: Short
Area of Effect / Target: Large
Duration: Permanent until discharged
Additional Counter Spells: 
Save: Reflex 1/2
Spell Resistance: Yes

This powerful inscription harms those who enter, pass, or open the warded area or object. An elder glyph of warding can guard a bridge or passage, ward a portal, trap a chest or box, and so on. You set the conditions of the ward. Glyphs respond to invisible creatures normally but are not triggered by those who travel past them ethereally.

When casting the spell, you weave a tracery of faintly glowing lines around the warding sigil.  When the spell is completed, the glyph and tracery become nearly invisible. Glyphs cannot be affected or bypassed by such means as physical or magical probing, though they can be dispelled.

An elder glyph deals 1d8 points of damage per caster level (maximum 30d8) to the intruder and to all within 5 feet of him or her. This damage is acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic (caster's choice, made at time of casting). Each creature affected can attempt a Reflex save to take half damage. Spell resistance applies against this effect.

Material Component: You trace the glyph with incense, which must first be sprinkled with powdered diamond worth at least 1000 gp.

Use of this item will provide the benefits of resting (healing of injury and restoration of spells) to the user and acompanying henchmen, familiars and animal companions (if any), at the cost of reducing the user's experience points a small amount (the amount is somewhat random, but will never be more than double the user's level). It can affect a maximum of 7 henchmen, so if you have more it is possible not all will benefit (note that mountable horses technically count as "henchmen" - having many with you is the only way you should be able to exceed this limit). Note also that like resting use of this item will remove the temporary effects of beneficial buffing spells. For this reason, as well as the above-mentioned concentration check, trying to use it during combat will usually be a bad idea.

瓦拉格，也被称为血逐者，是比他们的同类更快，更强壮，更原始的地精类生物。瓦拉格不如其他地精类聪明，但具有掠食性的狡猾。他们是凶猛的生物，能够通过突袭或直接对抗来击败对手。瓦拉格作为雇佣兵斥候和劫掠者为大地精战团工作。

瓦拉格的行为明显像犬类，这是特殊繁殖的结果。他们是大地精和凶暴狼交配的魔法产物。由此产生的种族从此纯种繁殖。瓦拉格在战斗时站立约7英尺高，平均体重320磅。瓦拉格用四肢移动和飞跑，在这种姿势下肩高3到4英尺。雌性比雄性小，但速度不慢。瓦拉格的身体语言拟形怪狼的行为。

+4力量，+4敏捷，+2体质，-4智力。

src:
Varags, also known as blood chasers, are goblinoids that are faster, stronger, and more primitive than their kin. Less intelligent than other goblinoids, varags have predatory cunning. They are vicious creatures, capable of taking opponents by surprise or by direct confrontation. Varags work as mercenary scouts and raiders for hobgoblin warbands.

Varags' behavior is distinctly canine, the result of special breeding. They are the magical product of commingling hobgoblins and dire wolves. The resulting race has bred true ever since. Varags stand approximately 7 feet tall when fighting and weigh 320 pounds on average. Varags move and run on all fours, in which posture they are 3 to 4 feet high at the shoulder. Females are smaller than males, but no less fleet of foot. Varag body language mimics the behavior of wolves.
  
Varag Racial Traits:
+4 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, -4 Intelligence.
Humanoid (goblinoid): A varag is a humanoid that has the goblinoid subtype.
Medium size: Varags have no special bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Varag base land speed is 60 feet.
Darkvision out to 60 feet.
Racial Hit Dice: A varag begins with three levels of humanoid.
Racial Skills: Varags gain a +8 racial bonus on Move Silently checks.
Racial Feats: A varag gains Spring Attack as a bonus feat.
Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A varag is automatically proficient with simple weapons, martial weapons, light armor, and shields.
+3 natural armor.
Scent.
Favored Class: Scout.
Level Adjustment: +2.

- 异界生物：在法咒效果上，邪兽鬼被视为异界生物。

src:
Rakshasa are decadent, arrogant creatures who prides themselves on their ability to deceive. These creatures resemble tigers or bears, although they are humanoid and are unmistakable in their expensive silks and jewels. Generally malevolent, rakshasa are masters of the magical arts. They have an incredibly high innate resistance to spells and many are completely immune to lower level magics. Having a disdain for combat, these creatures prefer spellcasting classes.

Rakshasa Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, +4 Dex, +2 Int, +6 Cha, +2 Wis, +6 Con.
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass rakshasa's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Rakshasa are able to see in the dark.
- Base movement of 40.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All rakshasa are proficient with simple weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Martial): All rakshasa are proficient with martial weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Creature): Rakshasa can make an unarmed attack with their claws.
- Skill Affinity (Bluff): +2 racial bonus to all Bluff checks.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 27, plus 1 per character level.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 9.
- Damage Reduction: Innate damage reduction of 15/+1
- Spell-like Abilities: At will - Disguise.
- Outsider: Rakshasa are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.
- Sorcerer Casting: Rakshasa cast spells as a Sorcerer of their hit dice (7th level)

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)
Level Adjustment: +7
Racial Hit Dice/Class: 7 of Outsider

dst:
无论其形态如何，半恶魔总是丑陋不堪，拥有黑暗鳞片，角，发光的红眼，
蝙蝠翅膀，恶臭，或其他明显迹象表明其被邪恶污染。

“半恶魔”是一个遗传模板，可添加到任何智力值为4或更高且非善良阵营的活体，有形生物（以下称为基础生物）.

半恶魔使用基础生物的所有统计数据和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型和类型
该生物的类型变为异界生物。不要重新计算生命骰，基础攻击加值或豁免。体型不变。半恶魔通常是本地异界生物。

速度
半恶魔有蝙蝠翅膀。除非基础生物有更好的飞行速度，否则该生物能以基础生物的基础陆地速度飞行（平均机动性）.

护甲等级
天生护甲提高+1（这与基础生物拥有的任何天生护甲加值叠加）.

攻击
半恶魔有两次爪抓攻击和一次啮咬攻击，爪抓是主要天生武器。如果基础生物能使用武器，半恶魔保留此能力。半恶魔徒手战斗时，在攻击动作中使用爪抓。当它有武器时，通常使用武器代替。

全力攻击
半恶魔徒手战斗时，在全力攻击中使用双爪和啮咬。如果持有武器，它通常使用武器作为主要攻击，啮咬作为天生次要攻击。如果它有一只手空闲，它使用爪抓作为额外的天生次要攻击。

伤害
半恶魔有啮咬和爪抓攻击。如果基础生物没有这些攻击形式，使用表中的伤害值。否则，使用表中的值或基础生物的伤害值，以较大者为准。

体型    啮咬伤害  爪抓伤害
超微型        1       -
微型  1d2     1
超小型        1d3     1d2
小型       1d4     1d3
中型      1d6     1d4
大型      1d8     1d6
超大型        2d6     1d8
巨型  3d6     2d6
超巨型    4d6     3d6

特殊攻击
半恶魔保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下特殊攻击。

制裁善良（Su）
每天一次，该生物可进行正常近战攻击，对善良敌人造成等于其生命骰的额外伤害（最大+20）.

类法咒能力
智力或感知值为8或更高的半恶魔根据其生命骰拥有类法咒能力，如表所示。能力是累积的。除非另有说明，能力每天可使用一次。施法者等级等于该生物的生命骰，豁免DC基于魅力。

生命骰      能力
1-2     黑暗术 3/天
3-4     亵渎术
5-6     邪光击
7-8     毒素 3/天
9-10    疫病术
11-12   渎神之语
13-14   邪魔光环 3/天，邪居术
15-16   凋死术
17-18   召唤怪物IX（仅限恶魔）
19-20   灰飞烟灭术

特殊品质
半恶魔拥有基础生物的所有特殊品质，外加以下特殊品质。

    * 60英尺黑暗视觉。
    * 免疫毒素。
    * 酸抗力10，寒冷抗力10，电抗力10，火焰抗力10。
    * 伤害减免：5/魔法（如果生命骰11或更少）或10/魔法（如果生命骰12或更多）.
    * 半恶魔的天生武器在克服伤害减免时视为魔化武器。
    * 法术抗力等于生物的生命骰 + 10（最大35）.

属性
从基础生物增加如下：力量+4，敏捷+4，体质+2，智力+4，魅力+2。

技能
半恶魔作为异界生物获得技能点，技能点等于（8 + 智力调整值）?（生命骰 + 3）.在此计算中不包括来自职业等级的生命骰，半恶魔仅为其种族生命骰获得异界生物技能点，并为其职业等级获得正常数量的技能点。将基础生物列表中的技能视为本职技能，其他技能视为跨职技能。

挑战等级
生命骰4或更少，基础生物+1；生命骰5到10，基础生物+2；生命骰11或更多，基础生物+3。

阵营
总是邪恶（任何）.

等级调整
+4。
src:
No matter its form, a half-fiend is always hideous to behold, having dark scales, horns, glowing red eyes, 
bat wings, a fetid odor, or some other obvious sign that it is tainted with evil.

"Half-fiend" is an inherited template that can be added to any living, corporeal creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or more and nongood alignment (referred to hereafter as the base creature).

A half-fiend uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to outsider. Do not recalculate Hit Dice, base attack bonus, or saves. Size is unchanged. Half-fiends are normally native outsiders.

Speed
A half-fiend has bat wings. Unless the base creature has a better fly speed, the creature can fly at the base creature's base land speed (average maneuverability).

Armor Class
Natural armor improves by +1 (this stacks with any natural armor bonus the base creature has).

Attack
A half-fiend has two claw attacks and a bite attack, and the claws are the primary natural weapon. If the base creature can use weapons, the half-fiend retains this ability. A half-fiend fighting without weapons uses a claw when making an attack action. When it has a weapon, it usually uses the weapon instead.

Full Attack
A half-fiend fighting without weapons uses both claws and its bite when making a full attack. If armed with a weapon, it usually uses the weapon as its primary attack and its bite as a natural secondary attack. If it has a hand free, it uses a claw as an additional natural secondary attack.

Damage
Half-fiends have bite and claw attacks. If the base creature does not have these attack forms, use the damage values in the table. Otherwise, use the values in the table or the base creature's damage values, whichever are greater.

Size    Bite Damage  Claw Damage
Fine        1       -
Diminutive  1d2     1
Tiny        1d3     1d2
Small       1d4     1d3
Medium      1d6     1d4
Large       1d8     1d6
Huge        2d6     1d8
Gargantuan  3d6     2d6
Colossal    4d6     3d6

Special Attacks
A half-fiend retains all the special attacks of the base creature and gains the following special attack.

Smite Good (Su)
Once per day the creature can make a normal melee attack to deal extra damage equal to its HD (maximum of +20) against a good foe.

Spell-like Abilities
A half-fiend with an Intelligence or Wisdom score of 8 or higher has spell-like abilities depending on its Hit Dice, as indicated on the table. The abilities are cumulative. Unless otherwise noted, an ability is usable once per day. Caster level equals the creature's HD, and the save DC is Charisma-based.

HD      Abilities
1-2     Darkness 3/day
3-4     Desecrate
5-6     Unholy blight
7-8     Poison 3/day
9-10    Contagion
11-12   Blasphemy
13-14   Unholy aura 3/day, unhallow
15-16   Horrid wilting
17-18   Summon monster IX (fiends only)
19-20   Destruction

Special Qualities
A half-fiend has all the special qualities of the base creature, plus the following special qualities.

    * Darkvision out to 60 feet.
    * Immunity to poison.
    * Resistance to acid 10, cold 10, electricity 10, and fire 10.
    * Damage reduction: 5/magic (if HD 11 or less) or 10/magic (if HD 12 or more).
    * A half-fiend's natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
    * Spell resistance equal to creature's HD + 10 (maximum 35).

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +4, Cha +2.

Skills
A half-fiend gains skill points as an outsider and has skill points equal to (8 + Int modifier) ?(HD + 3). Do not include Hit Dice from class levels in this calculation the half-fiend gains outsider skill points only for its racial Hit Dice, and gains the normal amount of skill points for its class levels. Treat skills from the base creature's list as class skills, and other skills as cross-class.

Challenge Rating
HD 4 or less, as base creature +1; HD 5 to 10, as base creature +2; HD 11 or more, as base creature +3.

Alignment
Always evil (any).

Level Adjustment
+4.

dst:
半身魔是源自半身人和恶魔的异界生物。

凭借受恶魔之火与混乱影响的传承，这一半身人种族的分支体现了所有小巧，迅捷和狡诈的特质。半身魔很少安静坐着，他们的恶作剧和玩笑从残忍到致命不等。半身魔的浅棕色皮肤，鲜红头发和棱角分明的五官使其有别于其他小型类人生物。尽管他们的恶魔血统赋予了他们超越许多其他种族的潜行能力，半身魔却偏爱鲜艳的衣着，这使他们在任何人群中都很显眼。

半身魔属性调整：-2 力量，+4 敏捷，+2 智力

天赋职业（游荡者）：兼职半身魔的游荡者职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

种族特性：
- 半身魔的基础陆地速度为 20 英尺。
- 黑暗视觉：半身魔在黑暗中如同在日光下一样视物。
- 武器熟练：半身魔熟练使用所有简易和军用武器，轻甲和盾牌。
- 改变自身（超自然）：半身魔每天可以使用一次变身术，如同 2 级术士施放的法咒，他们可以变成任何体型类别相差不超过一级的类人生物形态。
- 无畏：半身魔对抗恐惧法咒和效果的豁免检定有 +2 加值。
- 幸运：半身魔的所有豁免检定有 +1 种族加值。
- 精准投掷：半身魔使用投掷武器攻击时获得 +1 攻击加值。
- 技能：半身魔在攀爬，跳跃，聆听和潜行检定上有 +2 种族加值。
- 异界生物：就法咒和先决条件而言，半身魔属于异界生物。

等级调整：+1
src:
Wisplings are planetouched descended from halflings and demons.

With a heritage touched by demonic fire and chaos, this offshoot of the halfling race embodies everything that is small, quick, and deceptive. Wisplings rarely sit still, and their pranks and jokes range from cruel to murderous.  A wispling's light brown skin, bright red hair, and angular features set it apart from other Small humanoids. Although their demonic heritage grants them abilities of stealth beyond those of many other races, wisplings have a taste for bright clothing that marks them in any crowd.

Wispling Ability Adjustments: -2 Str, +4 Dex, +2 Int

Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass wispling's rogue class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- An wispling's base land speed is 20 feet.
- Darkvision:  Wisplings are able to see in the dark as well as daylight.
- Proficiencies: Wisplings are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor & shields.
- Change Self (Su): Wisplings can use alter self once per day, as the spell cast by a 2nd-level sorcerer, they make take take the form of any humaniod within one size category of their own.
- Fearless: Wisplings have a +2 bonus on saving throws against fear spells and effects.
- Lucky: Wisplings have a +1 racial bonus to all saving throws.
- Good Aim: Wisplings recieve a +1 attack bonus on attacks made with throwing weapons.

Gorzhun spent so much building these tombs and vaults there wasn't as much left to put in them as one might expect: kind of idiotic. As you can see, I didn't think much of Gorzhun when he was alive, and serving as his undead slave for centuries hasn't improved my opinion of him. I wouldn't mind too much if you defeated me. In fact, I could probably tell you a few things that would help you if you do get past me. This place has got difficult locks and deadly traps all over the place. Maybe you can deal with that. You must have some skills along those lines or you couldn't have gotten in here in the first place. But there are other guardians deeper in who might be even more dangerous than me."

Deathmark condemns a creature to an inevitable yet shortcoming death. The creature(s) that inevitably die, however, may not only be the initial subject of this spell. This spell instead promotes even more death by cursing the subject (on a failed Fortitude save) with an impending doom, which is highly contagious. After the one minute duration of the epidemic-like spread of the curse, all affected creatures must make a Fortitude save or else die.

src: Traversing various portals in an attempt to find a way out of the Underdark, I initially entered a fortress in Baator, and later made my way to another fortress on the Celestial Planes. There I met a Celestial Avenger named Danaron, who made me an offer. In the fortress in Baator through which I passed earlier can be found a Pit Fiend known as Vartakor. This fiend is a troublesome foe to the Celestials, but Danaron believes that I would be powerful enough to slay him. If I can accomplish this, he has promised to reward me with a powerful magical item. He has furthermore given me the key I will need to reach Vartakor, as he resides behind a locked and warded door.

dst: "我是纳斯卡尔·诺顿，一名冒险者，我想你也是。我来到这个位面是为了寻找所谓的黑暗卫士之座……但我不知道自己能否找到，我来这里主要是为了通过与恶魔和巫妖之类的战斗来赢得财富和荣耀。但我被恶魔击败了，他们把我囚禁在这里，为了取乐而折磨我。没有出路，我甚至无法被杀，这本来算是一种解脱，因为他们对我施用了再生魔法。"
src: "I am Nathkar Notten, an adventurer, as I suppose you are as well. I came to this plane on a quest to find what is called the Blackguard's throne...but I did not know if I ever would, mostly I was just here to win wealth and glory by battling demons and liches and such. But I was defeated by the demons, who imprisoned me here, where they torture me for their amusement. No way out, and I cannot even be killed, which would be an escape of sorts, due to the regenerative magic they employ on me."

src: "Then it is possible there is a service you could provide for me. Deep beneath this city around us are the ruins of its incarnations earlier in history, 'Dark Calimport' as it is popularly known. Doubtless there is much of historical value to be found there. Unfortunately, they are also monster-infested, as such places seem inevitably to become, and would be far too dangerous for someone like me to explore. But not I think, for <CUSTOM106> like you. If you could venture into these ruins and find something of value to historical scholarship, then in return I would be willing to reaserch this other matter of interest to this Zarala Galhadr."

dst: "你知道多少座沉没的城市，尤其是在世界这一带？当然，界门可能通向任何地方……我只是真心希望如此，如果过了这么久我们还能找到阿朱塔尔，那会非常令人兴奋。这其实正是我想雇你的原因：我需要有人穿过界门，找到一些能告诉我们另一侧究竟是什么的证据。"
src: "How many sunken cities do you know of, especially in this part of the world? Of course the portal could go anywhere...I'm just hoping really, it would be quite exciting if we were to find Ajhuutal after all this time. This is actually exactly what I want to hire you for: I need someone to go through the portal and find some evidence that would tell us just what is on the other side."

dst:
在沙漠中跋涉数日后，萨曼的商队遭到了一群强盗的袭击。当我冲上去加入战斗时，我的随从扎拉拉用弩箭射中了我的后背，使我身负重伤，无法协助击退他们。濒死之际，我被一个神秘的存在拉入了气元素位面。不用说，以如此不光彩的方式被带离战斗，我一点也不高兴。

我回到商队营地，发现所有人都已死亡，货车在燃烧。显然强盗们获胜了。然而，我也遇到了一位欧格玛的牧师，卡达斯·奥拉祖尔，他从附近的营地赶来调查浓烟。他告诉我，强盗们带着两名俘虏离开了，萨曼和扎拉拉。由于最近被委以保护扎拉拉的责任，我想我必须尝试营救她，而营救萨曼似乎是我从这次冒险中获得任何收益的唯一希望。强盗们向西逃去，我应该能够沿着他们的踪迹找到他们的基地。如果我的营救成功，我应该去商队东边卡达斯的营地，因为那是这片沙漠中唯一附近的避难所。

我一路杀穿了强盗的基地，杀死了所有挡路的人，包括他们的首领。在我给他们造成的损失之后，这群强盗似乎不太可能再威胁商队路线了。现在我需要释放他们的两名俘虏，并返回卡达斯的营地。
"是的，我现在准备好离开了。"
src: "Yes, I am ready to leave now."

src:
You have embraced a perilous pact with infernal power, binding a living demon's skin to your own. As your bond deepens, you gain supernatural defenses along with elemental resistances and a fearsome gaze.

Hit Die: d4.
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Intelligence modifier.
Bonus Feats: The epic Acolyte of the Skin gains a bonus feat every four levels after 8th.

Special:
Spells: The epic acolyte's caster level increases by 1 every even-numbered level gained above 10th. In addition, at every even-numbered level, the epic acolyte of the skin gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in whatever spellcasting class he belonged to before he added the prestige class, up to the number of spells per day possessed by a 20th-level character of that class.
Physical Power (Ex): At 11th level, and every 10 levels thereafter, the epic acolyte of the skin gains a permanent +2 bonus to Strength or Constitution (character's choice).
Poison Immunity (Ex): The epic acolyte of the skin becomes immune to poison at 11th level.
Fiendish Heritage (Sp): At 13th level, and every 4 levels thereafter (17th, 21st, and so on), the acolyte of the skin gains one daily use of each of the following powers: desecrate, unholy blight, and blasphemy. Use the character's acolyte of the skin level as the caster level.
Acid Resistant (Ex): At 14th level, the fiendish skin grants acid resistance 20.
Improved Symbiosis: At 15th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, the enhancement bonus needed to bypass the damage reduction of the epic acolyte of the skin increases by +1 (to DR 20/+2 at 15th level, DR 20/+3 at 20th level, and so forth).
Mental Power (Ex): At 16th level, and every 10 levels thereafter, the epic acolyte of the skin gains a permanent +2 bonus to Intelligence or Charisma (character's choice).
Electricity Resistant (Ex): At 18th level, the fiendish skin grants electricity resistance 20.
Telepathy (Su): A 19th-level acolyte of the skin can communicate telepathically with any creature within 100 feet that has a language. 

Epic Acolyte of the Skin Bonus Feat List:
Arcane Defense, Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Combat Casting, Energy Resistance, Epic Prowess, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Toughness, Greater Spell Focus, Improved Combat Casting, Spell Focus, Spell Penetration, Toughness, Eldritch Sculptor, Lord of All Essences, Master of the Elements, Morpheme Savant, Paragon Visionary, Shadowmaster, Verminlord, Epic Eldritch Blast, Epic Extra Invocation, Epic Fiendish Resilience.

dst:
扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的大图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识，而这样一把重铸之剑也许是阿兹古尔卡重返此位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。

在前往烛堡的途中，我们转道去了小镇纳什凯尔，遇到了一位名叫伊扎多·夸巴克斯的侏儒，他原来是一名竖琴手，一直在寻找我们以便提供援助，同时还有一些为了赏金而追捕我们的冒险者，必须加以对付。其中一名冒险者竟然是我们的老对头加拉德·阿沙勒，他显然一直在暗中与伊扎多合作，而这一次他转换了阵营，看来是要帮助我们。

据伊扎多说，通往烛堡的路线被更多被扎拉拉和我本人以及巨龙克拉卡奇'弗拉兹'塔尔的悬赏所吸引的冒险者严密把守，要到达那里并不容易。他声称有一个解决这个问题的计划，但这取决于他与冒险者中一名显然是双重间谍的人的合作。只要支付750000金币，这名联络人就会转换阵营为我们效力。伊扎多建议我们至少可以通过杀死一条巢穴在尖牙森林某处的龙来获得这笔款项的一大部分，这样既能掠夺他的宝藏，又能领取他头颅上的赏金。他把我们派去了一群在森林外围扎营的竖琴手游侠那里，由一位名叫塔布伦·卡什滕的人带领，帮助我们找到那条龙，而那群人又告诉我们，我们需要与一位名叫冈德·迅矛的矮人合作，去攻打附近的一个地精营地。作为我们帮助他们对抗地精的回报，冈德告诉了我们龙穴的位置。

我们现在已经获得了一条龙的宝藏，并把伊扎多索要的款项交给了他。他已经出发去把这笔钱交给那名双重间谍，并在我们的地图上标出了这名间谍显然所在的雇佣兵营地。我们应该尽快前往那里，与伊扎多和那名间谍会合。
src:
Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.

Diverted to the small town of Nashkel on our way to Candlekeep, we encountered a gnome named Izado Quabax, who turned out to be a Harper who has been looking for us in order to give us aid, as well as some bounty-hunting adventurers seeking us who had to be dealt with. One of these adventures turned out to be our old foe Garad Ashaler, who apparently has been secretly working with Izado, and on this occasion switched sides and apparently is going to help us. 

According to Izado, the routes to Candlekeep are guarded well by more adventurers lured by bounties on the heads of Zarala and myself, as well the the dragon Krackach'vraz'tar, and it will not be easy to get there. He claims to have a plan for dealing with this problem, but it depends on the cooperation of an apparent double agent among the adventurers wtih whom he is in contact. This contact will switch sides and work for us if paid 750000 gold. Izado suggested we could get at least a large percentage this sum by slaying a dragon who lairs somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, in order both to loot his hoard and collect a bounty on his head. He sent us to a group of Harper rangers who have made camp on the outskirts of the Wood, led by one Tabrun Carshten to help find the dragon, and that group, in turn, has told us we needed to work with a dwarf named Gund Swiftspear to fight a nearby goblin encampment. In return for our aid against the goblins, Gund told us where the dragon's lair was to be found.

We have now gained access to a dragon's hoard, and delivered to Izado the sum he requested. He has gone off to deliver it to the double agent, and has marked on our map the mercenary camp where this agent is apparently to be found. We should travel there as soon as we can to meet up with Izado and the agent.

人类与巨人的杂交种族，由一群沙漠术士国王培育而成，想要一个战士和劳工的种族。然而少数人发现，培育过程以某种方式在他们体内唤醒了灵能力量的萌芽，并利用它逃脱了奴役，为自己开创了新生活。在生理上他们身高约 7-8 英尺，有时被误认为是打扮整洁的丘陵巨人。尽管外表如此，他们的思维和任何人类一样敏捷，并且通常保留人类的感知力。

半巨人属性调整：+2 力量，+2 体质，-2 敏捷。
偏好职业（心灵武士）：兼职半巨人的心灵武士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 基础速度 30 英尺
- 微光视觉：半巨人能在昏暗光照下看得更远。
- 火焰适应：对基于火焰的法咒和效果豁免获得 +2 加值。
- 强力体型：在擒抱，绊摔和类似能力上，半巨人被视为大型。他们可以像大型生物一样使用武器。
- 天生心智异能：半巨人在 1 级时获得 2 点免费异能点。
- 类灵能能力：重踏术 - 1/天
- 巨人：在法咒效果上，半巨人被视为巨人。

（以下内容可能使用也可能不使用，取决于模组开关设置）
等级调整：+1
种族生命骰/职业：不适用
src:
A cross between humans and giants, this race was bred into existence by a group of desert sorcerer-kings wanting a race of warriors and laborers.  A few however found that the breeding had somehow awakened a spark of psionic power within them, and used it to escape their slavery and forge a new life for themselves.  Physically they stand about 7-8' tall, sometimes being mistaken for a well-groomed Hill Giant.  Despite their appearance, they are as quick of mind as any human, and usually retain human sensibilities.

Half-Giant Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, +2 Con, -2 Dex.
Favored Class (Psychic Warrior): A multiclass half-giant's psychic warrior class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Low-Light Vision: Half-Giants can see farther in dim lighting.
- Fire-Acclimated: +2 to save vs fire-based spells and effects.
- Powerful Build: Half-giants count as Large for purposes of grapples, trips, and similar abilities.  They can wield weapons as if they were Large size.
- Naturally Psionic: Half-giants gain 2 free power points at first level.
- Psi-like Ability: Stomp - 1/day
- Giant: Half-giants are considered Giants for the purpose of spells.

src: "I have heard of this Nomog-Geaya. More than 3000 years ago, before even my time, the people of Calimshan waged a war against a great army of hobgoblins who were from someplace they called Nomog-Geaya, or worshipped a deity named that or some such thing. Ultimately the goblins were defeated, and the great idol they worshipped, inspiring their efforts, was destroyed. It may be that this place is something left over from those times? The final confrontation with those hobgoblins occured in the Omlarandin Mountains in what is today Tethyr, having rebelled against our rightful rule. I do not think that portal took us as far as the Omlarandins, but doubtless the hobgoblins of that era had some bases elsewhere."
