dst:
内兰瑟群岛是一个由至少数百座、甚至可能超过一千座岛屿组成的群岛（从未被详尽编目），位于安姆、泰瑟尔和卡林杉海岸以西。这些岛屿是众多凶残海盗团伙的居所，他们靠劫掠往返于这些国家的船只维生。虽然其中一些海盗是人类，但大多数是亚人，如蜥蜴人、兽人或牛头人，且大多数都拥有名副其实的残忍名声。

海盗猎手很难应对这一威胁，因为内兰瑟群岛的海图绘制极差。在周边航行很容易导致船只撞上隐藏的暗礁而失事，而分散的海盗团伙有许多藏身之处。

除了目前的海盗居民外，内兰瑟群岛的一些岛屿上还有宏伟的塔楼和类似遗迹，属于一个现已衰落并被遗忘的文明。其中一些废墟已被海盗占据为基地，而另一些则成了比海盗更糟糕的东西的巢穴。
src:
The Nelanther Isles constitute an archipelago of at least many hundreds and perhaps more than a thousand islands (they have never been exhaustively catalogued) that can be found west of the coasts of Amn, Tethyr, and Calimshan. The islands are the abode of numerous bands of vicious pirates who support themselves by raids upon ships traveling to or from those nations. While some of these pirates are human, most are demihumans such as lizardfolk, orcs, or minotaurs, and most can boast of a well-deserved reputation for cruelty.

It is difficult for pirate hunters to deal with this threat, since the Nelanthers are poorly charted. Sailing about them can easily result in one's ship being wrecked upon hidden reefs, while the scattered bands of pirates have many places to hide.

In addition to its current piratical inhabitants, some of the Nelanther islands boast mighty towers and similar remnants of a now fallen and forgotten civilization. Some of these ruins have been taken over as bases by the pirates, while others have become the lairs of things even worse than pirates.

src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. According to the dryad, these Talosians seek to acquire an idol of the ancient Netherese god of storms and destruction Kozah, who is believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos. The Talosians can apparently gain great power from this idol, which given the nature of their beliefs they will doubtless use for destructive ends. The dryad has asked me to head to these ruins, a little ways to the north, and recover the idol myself, in order to prevent this. This may be dangerous, as it will put me in conflict with these Talosians, and the idol itself is said to have mind-warping powers. Nevertheless, it seems a worthy quest.\n\nI fought through some Talosians to reach the ruins and recover the idol. Upon informing the dryad of my success, she suggested I take the idol to the temple of Helm in Nashkel, as only a temple is likely to have the resources to properly deal with such a dangerous object. While I had hoped to avoid Nashkel, that may not now be possible, as it would not do to keep this idol in my possession longer than necessary, both because of the corrupting power it exerts and all the powerful forces apparently looking for it.

dst:
锐眼晶片

描述符：无 
职业：化身 
脉轮：眉间，灵魂 
豁免检定：无

魂能形成一对透明的蓝色晶片，悬浮在你眼前。当你透过它们观察时，世界并不会呈现蓝色，但你发现自己更容易注意到微小的细节，即使在很远的距离也是如此。

当你塑造了锐眼晶片后，你在侦察检定上获得 +4 洞察加值。

魂能点：你投入到锐眼晶片中的每一点魂能点使洞察加值增加 2. 
 
脉轮绑定（眉间） 

不再是悬浮在你面前的蓝色晶片，而是你眼睛的实际晶状体获得了魂能的蓝色色调。对外部观察者来说，你的眼睛看起来像实心的蓝色球体，尽管蓝色“眼白”，虹膜和瞳孔之间仍能看出一些区别。对你来说，世界只是显得锐利而清晰--甚至那些肉眼无法看见的东西也是如此。

你获得正常看见隐形生物和物体的能力（如同处于识破隐形法咒的效果之下）. 

脉轮绑定（灵魂） 

你的外貌和锐眼晶片的外貌都没有任何变化，但你观察世界的方式发生了巨大的改变。就好像你看到了现实的另一个层面，穿透了某种遮蔽的面纱，看到了超越表象的东西。

你看到所有事物的真实面貌，如同你始终处于真知术法咒的效果之下。
src:
Keeneye Lenses

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Incarnate 
Chakra: Brow, soul 
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms a pair of transparent blue lenses that hover in front of your eyes. As you peer through them, the world does not take on their blue color, but you find yourself more easily able to notice small details, even at long distances.

While you have keeneye lenses shaped, you gain a +4 insight bonus on Spot checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your keeneye lenses increases the insight bonus by 2. 
 
Chakra Bind (Brow) 

Instead of blue lenses hovering before you, the actual lenses of your eyes gain the blue tinge of incarnum. To an outside observer, your eyes look like solid blue orbs, although some distinction between the blue �white,?the iris, and the pupil of your eyes is still noticeable. To you, the world simply seems sharp and clear-even things that are invisible to unaided sight.

You gain the ability to see invisible creatures and objects normally (as if under the effect of a see invisibility spell). 

Chakra Bind (Soul) 

Neither your appearance nor that of your keeneye lenses changes at all, but the way you see the world changes dramatically. It is as though you are seeing into a different layer of reality, piercing some veil of obscurity to see beyond mere appearances.

You see all things as they truly are, as if you were constantly under the effect of a true seeing spell.

dst:
在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了关于一个名叫拉贾尔的人的一些信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的联系人。目前尚不完全清楚这个拉贾尔究竟是谁，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他位于下水道的藏身处的路线，并注意到我应该使用密码“Jaraj”来进入那里。只要我随身保留这张纸以供参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。然而，我必须决定，是应该独自去寻找这个拉贾尔，还是把我发现的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能利用这些信息来终结他的犯罪活动。

我已经把我发现的信息交给了守卫，由达沙尔·扎伊内姆中尉代表。原来拉贾尔是卡林港其中一个盗贼公会的首领。扎伊内姆中尉请求我协助将拉贾尔绳之以法，因为他担心让太多可能腐败的守卫卷入此事，并且可以用上一个有些偷窃技能的人。他的计划要求我去拉贾尔公会的区域，但避开入口。相反，我应该向左转，寻找一扇密门，它提供了一条通往公会用作潜在成员测试的迷宫的替代路线。如果我能设法通过迷宫中的锁、陷阱和其他挑战，我将从一个出人意料的方向进入公会。我还得到了一根法杖，一旦我进入公会，它就会召唤一个魔像来协助我对抗盗贼。扎伊内姆中尉还建议我和卡姆·赛特夫谈谈，他是城市守卫地牢中的一名囚犯，一名线人，也是关于这个迷宫的信息来源。他也许能给我一些提示，帮助我通过迷宫。我应该把拉贾尔的头带回给扎伊内姆中尉以领取奖赏。

注意：要到达拉贾尔的藏身处，请从任意地点进入下水道系统，并寻找一扇门或通往更深处的通道。你的选项之一应该是前往藏身处。
src:
During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.

I have turned over the information I found to the Watch, represented by Lieutenant Dashar Zaynem. It turns out Rajar is the head of one of Calimport's Thieves' Guilds. Lt. Zaynem has asked for my assistance in bringing Rajar to justice, as he fears involving too many of the possibly corrupt Watchmen in this matter, and could use someone with a few thieving skills. His plan calls for me to go to the area of Rajar's guild, but avoid the entrance. Instead, I should turn to the left and search for a secret door that provides an alternative route into a maze the guild uses as a test for prospective members. If I can work my way through the locks, traps and other challenges of the maze, I will gain entrance to the guild from a surprsing direction. I have also been given a rod that, once I gain access to the guild, will summon a golem to assist me in fighting the thieves. Lt. Zaynem has also suggested that I talk to Kam Saitef, a prisoner in the City Guard's dungeon, an informant who is the source of this information about the maze. He may be able to give me a few tips to help me get through it. I should bring Rajar's head back to Lt. Zaynem to be rewarded.

Note: To reach Rajar's hideout, enter the sewer system at any point and look for a door or transition taking you further in. One of your options should be to go to the hideout.

dst:
一个名叫维蒂亚雷的扒窃高手偷走了我所有的金币，然后消失了，当时我正被他同伙的其他冒险者分散了注意力。如果这是永久性的损失，那可是一笔不小的数目，但也许还有希望找到这个维蒂亚雷并追回我的金币。看来他的脑袋上还悬赏，可以从奥布莱克那里领取。我应该看看能否找到关于维蒂亚雷现在可能在哪里的线索。他似乎经常在纳什kel一带活动，所以也许那个镇上的某个人会知道一些关于他的事情。

在镇上时，维蒂亚雷经常被看到在打嗝龙酒馆喝酒， accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn, presumably a friend or associate. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. I learned where to meet this Frago from a farmer named Hodgent, one of his customers, and from Frago I learned the location of Vitiare's hideout: an old abadoned house, sunk under water, a little to the south of Beregost. Vitiare and some associates have sealed off the basement from the water, and can be reached there from a secret door near some rocks to the south of the house.

I located and defeated Vitiare, and recovered a percentage of the gold he stole from me, and turned in his head to Oublek for a bounty.
src:
An expert pickpocket known as Vitiare stole all my gold and then disappeared, while I was distracted by the rest of the adventuring party he was working with. This represents a considerable loss, if it is permanent, but perhaps there is some hope of locating this Vitiare and recovering my gold. It appears there is also a bounty on his head, that can be collected from Oublek. I should see if I can find any clues as to where Vitiare might now be found. He seems to commonly operate around Nashkel, so perhaps someone in that town would know something about him.

When in town, Vitiare is often seen drinking at the Belching Dragon accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn, presumably a friend or associate. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. I learned where to meet this Frago from a farmer named Hodgent, one of his customers, and from Frago I learned the location of Vitiare's hideout: an old abadoned house, sunk under water, a little to the south of Beregost. Vitiare and some associates have sealed off the basement from the water, and can be reached there from a secret door near some rocks to the south of the house.

I located and defeated Vitiare, and recovered a percentage of the gold he stole from me, and turned in his head to Oublek for a bounty.

src:
Whenever you use your eldritch blast ability, you can change your eldritch blast into a hellfire blast. A hellfire blast deals your normal eldritch blast damage plus an extra 2d6 points of damage per class level. If your blast hits multiple targets (for example, the eldritch chain or eldritch cone blast shape invocations), each target takes the extra damage. This damage is not fire damage. src:
Type: Class
Prerequisite: Healer level 8
When a Healer attains 8th level, the deities recognize her devotion and grant her a Celestial Unicorn Companion as her aide. The Unicorn, a symbol of healing and purity, serves the Healer willingly and unswervingly.
Once per day, the Healer may magically call her companion from the celestial realms in which it resides. The companion immediately appears adjacent to the Healer and remains for 2 hours per Healer level. It may be dismissed at any time as a free action. The companion is the same creature each time it is called, though the Healer may release a particular companion from service to gain a companion of a different kind. Each time the companion is called, it appears in full health, regardless of any damage it may have taken previously.
A Healer of 12th level or higher may select a Lammasu as her companion. Should she do so, the creature gains abilities, as if the character's Healer level was 4 levels lower than it actually is.
A Healer of 16th level or higher may select an Androsphinx as her companion. Should she do so, the creature gains abilities, as if the character's Healer level was 8 levels lower than it actually is.

And of course it is not a long journey from Baldur's Gate to Candlekeep, so we could drop you two off there after dealing with the pirates. We don't normally operate so far north, and it does take us a little bit out of our way, but you gave us enough help on our last expedition to have more than earned such a favor."

dst: 我同意为我遇到的一位旅行商人完成一项小任务。他给了我一个包裹，要送给一位名叫巴莫特·哈罗扬的提尔牧师，他住在神殿区的提尔神殿以北。这有点偏离商人的路线，所以如果我为他完成这项任务，他准备付给我一些金币。\n\n当我把包裹带给哈罗扬时，发现他并没有期待这个包裹，而且里面实际上装的是非法的黑莲花样本！更糟的是，城市守卫作为圈套的一部分得到消息，正好在我们处理这些罪证时出现。看来那位旅行商人参与了某种阴谋，意图陷害哈罗扬，或者我，或者两者兼有，大概是为了败坏提尔神殿和/或加尔哈德尔帕夏的名声。幸运的是，我们两人成功让赶来的守卫中尉心中产生了足够的疑虑，他愿意放我们走，但幕后黑手是谁仍然是个谜。不过我实在不知道能去哪里查，因为我想等我回到商人区时，那个商人肯定已经走了。也许某天会出现一些线索。在此期间，我还有别的任务要处理。
src: I have agreed to carry out a small task for a traveling merchant I came across. He has given me a package to be delivered to one Bamot Harojan, a priest of Tyr, who lives north of the Temple of Tyr, in the Temple District. This was a bit out of the merchant's way and so he is prepared to pay me some gold if I complete this task for him.\n\nWhen I brought the package to Harojan, it turned out that he was not expecting it, and that it in fact contained samples of illegal Black Lotus! On top of that, the City Watch, tipped off as part of the set-up, showed up just at the moment we were handling the incriminating evidence. It appears that traveling merchant was part of some conspiracy to frame Harojan, or me, or both, presumably in an attempt to discredit the Temple of Tyr and/or Pasha Galhadr. Fortunately, the two of us managed to raise enough doubts in the mind of the Watch Lieutenant who showed up that he was willing to let us go, but the mystery of who was behind this remains. I do not really know where I could look to find out though, since I assume that merchant will be gone by the time I get back to the Merchant District. Perhaps some clue will eventually turn up. In the meantime, I have other tasks to attend to.

dst: "显然，我不能公开与他们战斗，否则他们轻易就能摧毁我。因此，以我的大智慧和聪明才智，我想出了这个计划：我将与一小队冒险者同行。我会打扮得与我和他们打交道时不同，并用魔法伪装任何他们可能试图通过预言术追踪的特征。这样他们就认不出我，一个骷髅看起来都差不多。他们也绝不会想到像我这种地位的巫妖会与普通冒险者同行。我会看起来只是另一个冒险法师，只是比大多数稍微强大一点。因此，有你的陪同，我将出发去粉碎他们的爪牙，无论他们在哪里。最终我们将追踪到他们的巢穴，彻底摧毁他们，并找回我的命匣。"
src: "Obviously, I cannot fight them openly, or they would simply destroy me. Therefore, in my great wisdom and cleverness, I have conceived this plan: I shall travel with a small band of adventurers. I shall be differently dressed than when I dealt with them, and magically disguising any signature they might seek to trace through divination. Thus they will not recognize me, one skull looking much like another. Nor would they ever expect a lich of my stature to travel with common adventurers. I will seem just another adventuring wizard, only a little more powerful than most. Thus, with your accompaniment, I shall head out to crush their minions wherever they are found. Eventually we shall track them to their lair, destory them utterly, and recover my phylactery."

你必须对目的地的位置和布局有一些清晰的了解。你的心理图像越清晰，传送越可能成功。强物理或魔法能量区域可能使传送更危险甚至不可能。**

src:
School: Conjuration (Teleportation)
Level: Sor/Wiz 5, Travel 5
Components: V
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal and touch
Target: You and touched objects or other touched willing creatures
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

This spell instantly transports you to a designated destination, which may be as distant as 100 miles per caster level. Interplanar travel is not possible. You may also bring one additional willing Medium or smaller creature or its equivalent (see below) per three caster levels. A Large creature counts as two Medium creatures, a Huge creature counts as two Large creatures, and so forth. All creatures to be transported must be in contact with one another, and at least one of those creatures must be in contact with you. *

You must have some clear idea of the location and layout of the destination. The clearer your mental image, the more likely the teleportation works. Areas of strong physical or magical energy may make teleportation more hazardous or even impossible. **

To see how well the teleportation works, roll d% and consult the Teleport table. Refer to the following information for definitions of the terms on the table.

On Target:
  You appear where you want to be.
Off Target:
  You appear safely a random distance away from the destination in a random direction.
Far Off Target:
  You wind up somewhere completely different.
Mishap:
  You and anyone else teleporting with you have gotten scrambled. You each take 1d10 points of damage, and you reroll on the chart to see where you wind up. For these rerolls, roll 1d20+80. Each time Mishap comes up, the characters take more damage and must reroll.

On Target Off Target Way Off Target Mishap
0190     9194      9598          99100


Notes:
 *  Implemented as within 10ft of you due to the lovely quality of NWN location tracking code.
 ** Implemented as you having to have marked the location beforehand using the "Mark Location"

dst: "奥林·吉西亚，在通用语中意为‘秘密守护者’，是一支精灵法师教团，致力于守护那些最好永远不被发现的知识的秘密。精灵族是许多被短命种族遗忘的传说的继承者，而这些传说若落入不当之手，可能造成极大的危害。我们的职责就是确保远古怪物仍被束缚，被诅咒的器物仍被藏匿，黑暗魔法的源头仍未被触及，危险的知识不被那些无法明智运用它的人所得。你如今接近的这座古老堡垒，正蕴藏着这类危险，所以在我允许你继续前进之前，我必须知道你的意图。"
src: "The Olin Gisiae, or 'secret keepers' in the common tongue, are an order of elven mages dedicated to maintaining the secrecy of knowledge best left undiscovered. The elven people are heirs to much lore forgotten by the short-lived races, and much of this lore could do great harm in the wrong hands. It is our task to see that ancient monsters remain bound, cursed artifacts remain hidden away, sources of dark magic remain untapped, and dangerous knowledge be kept from those who cannot use it wisely. The ancient fortress you now approach contains perils of just this kind, so before I let you proceed, I must know your intentions."

src: In addition to the trouble with the Titan gang, Nasirak has told me of a number of mysterious disappearances of people who live in the slums. The Titan gang is not known for its subtlety, so Nasirak suspects that someone or something else is behind this. He would like me to try to determine who or what that might be. I am not really sure where to start. Perhaps if I explore the area surrounding the temple some clue will turn up.\n\nI have located these mysteriously missing people. They were being held captive in the sewers by wererats, who intended to infect them with lycanthropy so that they could be added to their wererat army. I decided to kill them all, for fear they had indeed been infected. When I reported this to Nasirak I simply told him that they had kidnapped by wererats, and ultimately did not survive the experience. No need to let slip certain details that might upset him.

（进阶职业）
圣印骑士从不孤单，因为她与单一残魂建立了真正的伙伴关系。她的誓言要求她拥护并保护她的主残魂，将其印记作为自己的象征，并在世上推进其目标。随着她与主残魂的关系加深，圣印骑士能汲取其他契魂师无法获得的能力之泉，变得比以往更强大。尽管她可以契结其他残魂，但她选择不这样做，因为她与同伴共享的联系提供了奇异的新力量。

要求：

阵营：任何非混乱
基础攻击加值：+4
技能：学识 5级
专长：武器专攻（任意武器）
特殊：灵魂契结职业能力

- 生命骰：d10。
- 擅长：你获得所有简易武器和军用武器，以及所有护甲和盾牌的擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

职业能力：

等级
 1：阵营打击，主残魂，灵魂契结 +1
 2：残魂防护，灵魂契结 +2
 3：残魂防护灵光，灵魂契结 +3
 4：残魂之力，灵魂契结 +4
 5：神化，残魂涌动，灵魂契结+5
 
灵魂契结：
在每个圣印骑士等级，你的灵魂契结能力提升，如同你也获得了契魂师职业的一个等级。因此，你的圣印骑士等级和契魂师等级在确定你的契结检定加值，残魂赋予能力的效力，你契结更高级残魂的能力，以及你能契结的残魂数量时叠加。然而，你不会获得契魂师本应获得的任何其他好处。

阵营打击（Ex）：你的武器克服DR +3。

神化（Su）：在第5级，你的类型变为异界生物。你还获得伤害减免 10/+1。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
A knight of the sacred seal is never alone because she has formed a true partnership with a single vestige. Her oath requires her to champion and protect her patron vestige, to take its seal as her symbol, and to advance its goals in the world. As her relationship with her patron vestige deepens, a knight of the sacred seal taps a well of abilities unavailable to other binders, becoming more than she once was. Though she can bind other vestiges, she chooses not to because the connection she shares with her companion offers strange new powers.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any nonchaotic
Base Attack Bonus: +4
Skills: Lore 5 ranks
Feat: Weapon Focus (any weapon)
Special: Soul binding class feature

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: You gain proficiency with all simple and martial weapons, and with all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
 1: Aligned Strike, patron vestige, soul binding +1
 2: Vestige's protection, soul binding +2
 3: Vestige's protection aura, soul binding +3
 4: Vestige's power, soul binding +4
 5: Apotheosis, vestige's surge, soul binding+5
 
Soul Binding: 
At each knight of the sacred seal level, your soul binding ability improves as if you had also gained a level in the binder class. Thus, your knight of the sacred seal levels and binder levels stack for the purpose of determining your bonus on binding checks, the effectiveness of your vestige-granted abilities, your ability to bind higher-level vestiges, and the number of vestiges you can bind. You do not, however, gain any other benefit a binder would have gained. 

Aligned Strike (Ex): Your weapons overcome DR +3.

Apotheosis (Su): At 5th level, your type changes to outsider. You also gain damage reduction 10/+1.

dst: "有人可能会认为她会，考虑到当时的情况，但幸运的是对我来说似乎并非如此。你必须明白，在闪耀之海对岸的那些国家——我来自的楚尔特，以及萨玛拉奇、辛多尔和塔沙拉尔——来自附近丛林中蛇人的威胁非常之大。纯血蛇人间谍同样构成威胁，他们尤其令人不安，因为你永远无法确定周围没有他们，那些土地上许多人对蛇人相关之事都相当偏执，这是可以理解的。许多人会毫不犹豫地杀了我，哪怕我只是个孩子，仅仅因为我是蛇人。"

Threatened as well by the pureblood spies, who are particularly unsettling as one can never be sure that there are none about, many people in those lands are understandably quite paranoid where the snake people are concerned. There are many who would not have hesitated to kill me, even as a child, simply because I was a Yuan-ti."

dst:
我们必须设法获得一本价值连城的书，作为进入烛堡的代价。当我们抵达扎泽斯普尔时，特法拉姆船长建议我们去见一位名叫登萨斯·韦莱本的人，他在码头以北的市场区开了一家书店。他的想法是，作为一名珍稀书籍经销商，登萨斯或许有合适的书可供出售，如果没有，他应该也知道我们该去哪里找。

我们照做了，登萨斯向我们讲述了一座古老的陵墓，它受到结界的保护，只有像我这样完全的人类才能通过。这是早已逝去的英雄桑达尔·卡达辛的陵墓，据说里面藏有一本他的回忆录，这是一本极其珍贵的书，应该足以让我们进入烛堡。据说它还受到一个谜题和未知性质与意图的守卫保护，因此可能很危险。这座陵墓位于远处的威尔迪斯森林中，具体位置现已标记在我的地图上。要到达那里，我们必须从市场区向北出去，前往商贸门，然后沿商贸之路向北行进，直到越过星尖山脉，再向东进入威尔迪斯森林。

一旦我们成功找到合适的书，就应该回来与特法拉姆船长谈谈（他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停留数周进行整修），他或许能在下次猎捕海盗时带我们更靠近烛堡。
src:
We must somehow acquire a book of great value as the price of admittance to Candlekeep. When we arrived in Zazesspur, Captain Tefaram advised us to speak to one Densath Wayleben, owner of a bookstore that can be found in the market district north of the docks, on the theory that, as a dealer in rare volumes, he might have had an appropriate book available for sale, and if not could be expected to know where we can go to find one.

We did as suggested, and Densath told us of an ancient tomb protected by wards that only someone fully human, such as myself, would be able to pass. This is the tomb of the long dead hero Sandar Kadathin, and is said to contain a copy of his memoirs, a most valuable book that should serve to gain entrance to Candlekeep. It is also said to be protected by a puzzle and guardians of unknown nature and disposition, and thus may prove hazardous. This tomb is located some distance away in the Wealdeath Forest, at a location now marked on my maps. To reach it we must exit the Market District to the north, going to the Trade Gate, and from there travel north along the Trade Way until we pass over the Starspire mountains, and then head east into the Wealdeath.

Once we succeed in finding an appropriate book, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram (who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting), who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.

雷霆的随机疯狂和史拉蟾的不可预测性在狂怒野蛮人的灵魂中结合在一起。与大多数其他角色不同，她战斗不是为了实现某种英雄目标或击败可憎的恶棍。那些只是借口 - 吸引她的是战斗的刺激。对于狂怒野蛮人来说，战斗的疯狂很像一种上瘾的药物 - 她必须不断寻找更多冲突来满足她对战斗的渴望。

- 生命骰：d12。
- 擅长：狂怒野蛮人不获得武器或盔甲擅长。

要求：

1：疯狂 - 增加力量 +6 (+10 在8级)，减少防御等级 -4，每轮受到2点伤害并攻击最近的目标（包括朋友），每天可使用一次。
2：大劈砍 - 类似劈砍，但杀死敌人后后续攻击没有限制。
  保持清醒 - 玩家在生命值降至-10前保持存活。

4：不死疯狂 - 玩家在疯狂结束前不会死亡。此能力不能防止法咒效果造成的死亡，如杀戮活物或解离。
5：疯狂 - 每天可使用三次。
  精通猛力攻击 - 增加伤害 +10，但攻击惩罚 -10。
6：激励疯狂 - 使10英尺半径内的友好队友进行意志豁免，否则进入疯狂。
7：疯狂 - 每天四次。

  激励疯狂 - 增加到每天两次。
9：疯狂 - 每天五次。

疯狂时不能对你施放加速术。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The random madness of the thunderstorm and the unpredictability of the slaadi come together in the soul of the Frenzied Berserker. Unlike most other characters, she does not fight to achieve some heroic goal or defeat a loathsome villain. Those are mere excuses - it is the thrill of combat that draws her. For the Frenzied Berserker, the insanity of battle is much like an addictive drug - she must constantly seek out more conflict to feed her craving for battle.

- Hit Die: d12.
- Proficiencies: Frenzied Berserkers gain no weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non-lawful
Base Attack Bonus: +6.
Feats: Cleave, Intimidating Rage, Power Attack.

CLASS FEATURES:

Levels
1: Frenzy - Increases strength +6 (+10 at 8), reduces AC -4, takes 2 damage per round and attacks nearest target (friends included), useable once per day.
2: Great Cleave - Like Cleave, except upon killing an enemy there is no limit to subsequent attacks.
  Remain Conscious - Player is alive until they hit -10 HP.
3: Frenzy - Can be used twice a day.
4: Deathless Frenzy - Player can not die until their frenzy is over. This ability does not prevent death from spell effects such as slay living or disintegrate.
5: Frenzy - Can be used three times a day.
  Improved Power Attack - Increases damage by +10, but gives a -10 attack penalty.
6: Inspire Frenzy - Causes friendly party members within a 10 ft radius to make a will save or enter a frenzy.
7: Frenzy - Four uses a day.
8: Greater Frenzy
  Inspire Frenzy - Increases to two uses a day.
9: Frenzy - Five uses a day.
10: Inspire Frenzy - Three uses a day.
  Supreme Power Attack - Gives a -10 penalty to attack, but gives +10 bonus to damage.
  No longer winded after a frenzy

NOTE:
Cannot have haste cast on you while frenzied.

厄兰人是被制造出来的，而非天生的。活着的人类由厄兰人议会从申请者中挑选，被选中者会经历一个秘密的灵能仪式，从而转变他们并赋予他们一种新的充满灵能的存在。由于某种神秘的原因，只有人类能够经历这个过程，虽然他们保留了基本的记忆和个性，但总体上他们变成了一个全新的人。在生理上他们仍然保持旧有的外貌，但他们不再受衰老影响，实际上变得不朽。他们也不再需要睡眠，而是以类似于精灵冥想的方式入定。

厄兰人属性调整：-2 魅力。
偏好职业（心灵术士）：兼职厄兰人的心灵术士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 基础速度 30 英尺
- 天生心灵异能：厄兰人在 1 级时获得 2 点免费异能点。
- 抗力：厄兰人可以花费 1 点异能点，作为一个自由动作，使他们在下一轮之前的所有豁免检定获得 +4 加值。
- 韧性：厄兰人可以花费异能点来保护自己免受伤害。每以此方式花费 1 点异能点，他们获得 2 点临时生命值，所有这些在 1 轮后消失。
- 异怪：在法咒效果上，厄兰人被视为异怪。
src:
Elans are made, not born.  Living humans are selected from a pool of applicants by a council of elan, and those chosen undergo a secret psionic ritual, transforming them and giving them a new psionically-charged existence.  For some arcane reason only humans are able to undergo the process, and while they retain their basic memories and personality, on the whole they become a completely new person.  Physically they still keep their old appearance, but they are no longer subject to aging, becoming effectively immortal.  They also no longer require sleep, instead meditating in a fashion similar to the elven reverie.

Elan Ability Adjustments: -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Psion): A multiclass elan's psion class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Naturally Psionic: Elans gain 2 free power points at first level.
- Resistance: Elans can spend 1 power point to give them a +4 to all saving throws until the next round as a free action.
- Resilience: Elans can spend power points to protect themselves from damage.  For each power point spent in this way, they gain 2 temporary hit points, all of which fade after 1 round.
- Aberration: Elans are considered Aberrations for the purpose of spells.

岩石侏儒是费伦大陆上该种族中最常见的一种。虽然许多冒险的侏儒都从事幻术魔法，但大多数侏儒更喜欢吟游诗人的生活方式。侏儒喜爱动物，宝石和笑话，尤其是恶作剧。他们喜欢通过亲身经历来学习，并且总是尝试新的方法来建造东西。侏儒身高 3 到 3 1/2 英尺，皮肤从深褐色到木棕色不等。他们的头发颜色浅，眼睛通常是某种深浅的蓝色。侏儒通常穿着大地色系的衣服，但会精心装饰他们的服装。男性偏爱仔细修剪的胡须。侏儒寿命为 350 到 500 年。

岩石侏儒属性调整：+2 体质，-2 力量。
偏好职业（吟游诗人）：兼职岩石侏儒的吟游诗人职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

- 小型体型
 攻击检定获得 +1 体型加值。
 AC 获得 +1 体型加值。
 躲藏检定获得 +4 体型加值。
- 对幻术的坚韧：对抗影响心智的法咒时豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 对爬虫类的攻击训练：对抗爬虫类人形生物时攻击检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 对地精类的攻击训练：对抗地精类生物（地精，大地精和熊地精）时攻击检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 对巨人的防御训练：对抗巨人时 AC 获得 +4 闪避加值。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（专注）：专注检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 法术专攻（幻术）：岩石侏儒施展的任何幻术法咒 DC 增加 +2. 这与专长相同。
- 微光视觉：使他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 侏儒：就法咒而言，岩石侏儒视为侏儒。

特殊：岩石侏儒是小型生物，因此他们永远无法使用以下大型武器：重剑，巨锤，双刃剑，双头斧，巨斧，巨剑，戟，重型连枷，长棍，巨镰和矛。
src:
Rock gnomes are the most common of their race in Faerun. Although many adventuring gnomes have taken up illusionary magic, most gnomes prefer the bardic life. Gnomes adore animals, gems, and jokes, especially pranks. They love to learn by personal experience, and are always trying new ways to build things. Gnomes stand 3 to 3 1/2 feet tall, with skin that ranges from dark tan to woody brown. Their hair is fair, and their eyes are often some shade of blue. Gnomes generally wear earth tones, but decorate their clothes intricately. Males favor carefully-trimmed beards. Gnomes live 350 to 500 years.

Rock Gnomish Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Bard): A multiclass rock gnome's bard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Hardiness vs. Illusions: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Reptilians: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against reptilian humanoids.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Concentration): +2 racial bonus to Concentration checks.
- Spell Focus (Illusion): Rock Gnomes add +2 DC to any Illusion spells they cast. This is identical to the feat.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Gnomish: Rock Gnomes count as Gnomes for the purpose of spells.

Special: Rock Gnomes are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

Nevertheless, he has been convinced that cooperating with our plans is in his best interests. He claims that he is not yet ready to begin the transition to undeath, but I think will soon be persuaded..."

dst: 塔加斯
src: Targath

dst: "首先，从庄园的一个后门出去，找到通往地下下水道的铁栅。拿着这把钥匙，它能打开从下水道通往庄园的那扇门。进入主下水道系统后，向南走。你会来到一个房间，里面有一扇通往黑暗卡林港废墟的活板门。下去进入它通向的密室，再向南走到另一扇通往更深处的活板门。穿过那扇门，穿过那些下层废墟，直到你找到一条向东的出口。那会带你进入一条穿过幽暗地域的通道。沿着它向南走，直到你来到西侧的一扇洞穴门前。穿过去，穿过你发现的废墟，向上走。最终你会来到泽卡尔之塔正下方的一个密室。通往那里的门应该已被卡齐娅打开。穿过去，向上进入塔下的下水道，然后进入塔内。"
src: "First, go out through one of the rear exits of the estate and find the grate leading to the sewers. Here, take this key, it will open the door barring access to the estate from the sewers. Once out in the main sewer system, head south. You will come to a room containing a trap door leading down into the ruins of Dark Calimport. Go down into the chamber it leads to, and head south to another trap door, leading deeper. Go through that, and travel through those lower ruins until you find an exit to the east. That will take you out into a passage through the Underdark. Follow it south, until you come to a cave door on the western side. Go through and travel through the ruins you find, heading up. Eventually you will come to a chamber directly beneath the Zekar tower. The door to it should be unlocked by Kadzia. Go through, up into the sewers beneath the tower, and then into the tower itself."

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
While the Red Wizards of Thay are not opposed to blasting their opponents with deadly spells or shredding the minds of their enemies with dark magic, there are times when they need protectors who have mastered the art of swordplay. These protectors are the Thayan Knights, familiar with magic, and loyal to none but the tattooed mages. The Thayan Knights act as bodyguards and enforcers for the Red Wizards. They lead common Thayan troops into battle and help guard the wizard enclaves. Although they are referred to as knights, they have no code of conduct, and the only rule that binds them is that their lives are worth nothing compared to the safety of the Red Wizards.

Classes: Incarnate  
Chakra: Hands

Incarnum forms into a pair of metallic gloves that hover around your hands and any other gloves or gauntlets you wear. Blue arcs of electricity crackle between the fingers and spark between the gloves when you bring your hands close to each other.

While wearing lightning gauntlets, you can deal 1d6 points of electricity damage with a successful melee touch attack (a standard action).

You can add the electricity damage dealt by lightning gauntlets to one attack per round made with a handheld weapon.

契灵等级：6级
绑定DC:25
特殊要求：无

影响：受豪瑞斯影响时，你变得古怪，经常自言自语并与想象中的朋友交谈。此外，豪瑞斯要求如果你遇到并识破了一个并非你自己创造的幻象，你不得自愿进入其区域。

授予能力：
豪瑞斯用他的疯狂保护你的心智，允许你如幽灵般移动，赋予你愚弄感官的力量，并授予你用他人最深的恐惧杀死他们的能力。

不可触及的心智：你受到保护，免受任何探测，影响或读取你情绪或思想的企图，并且你免疫任何影响心智的法咒和能力。

虚体移动：移动时，你变得近乎虚体，可以忽略困难地形的影响。你甚至可以穿过敌人的空间，但不能穿过墙壁或其他固体障碍。

高等幻影：你可以随意创造幻象，如同你施放了假象术（施法者等级等于你的有效缚灵师等级）.一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内不能再次使用。

魅影杀手：此能力的功能如同魅影杀手法咒。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内不能再次使用。
src:
Haures, the Dreaming Duke
  
Haures grants his summoners the power to create illusions, protect their thoughts, and move through objects like a ghost.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: No

Influence: When influenced by Haures, you become an eccentric, often speaking to yourself and to imaginary friends. In addition, Haures requires that if you encounter and disbelieve an illusion not of your own making, you must not voluntarily enter its area.

Granted Abilities: 
Haures shields your mind with his madness, allows you to move like a ghost, gives you the power to fool the senses, and grants you the ability to kill others with their deepest fears.

Inaccessible Mind: You are protected from any effort to detect, influence, or read your emotions or thoughts, and you have immunity to any mind-affecting spells and abilities.

Incorporeal Movement: When moving, you become nearly incorporeal and can ignore the effects of difficult terrain. You can even move through an enemy's space, but not through walls or other solid barriers. 

Major Image: You can create an illusion at will, as though you had cast mislead (caster level equals your effective binder level). Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Phantasmal Killer: This ability functions like the phantasmal killer spell. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

dst: <StartHighlight>[混乱 +1]</Start> "泽卡尔曾像你现在这样说话，但看看他现在的样子，已是我意志的奴隶。你赞美自由，但没有人能长久拥有自由，除非他愿意为了保护自由而杀戮和毁灭。你必须使用恶魔的工具来捍卫你的自由，而这样做时，无论你是否意识到，你都在侍奉我们。你们凡人永远不会明白，重要的不是你们的目的，因为总有比你们更强大的力量来决定你们能否达成目的。只有你们为达成目的所选择的手段——是荣耀而仁慈，还是无情而奸诈——才是重要的，因为那决定了这些更强大的力量中，哪一个愿意与你结盟，而深渊的手段才是最实用的。"
src: <StartHighlight>[Chaotic +1]</Start> "Zekar once spoke as you do now, but look at him now, a slave to my will. You praise freedom, but no one can long possess freedom without being willing to kill and destroy to protect it. You must use the tools of demons to defend your freedom, and in so doing you serve us, whether you realize it or not. You mortals will never understand that it is not your ends that matter, for greater powers than you will always determine whether you accomplish them or not. Only the means you choose to secure them, honorable and compassionate or ruthless and treacherous, matter, for that decides which of these greater powers will be willing to ally with you, and it is the methods of the Abyss that are the most practical."

dst:
许多蜥蜴人因与黑龙的栖息地相似而与其结盟。随着时间推移，这导致了血统的混合，有时产生整个部落，有时则是一个邪齿蜥蜴人诞生于普通蜥蜴人部落中。在生理上，他们比更典型的同类要瘦弱得多，有时甚至骨瘦如柴。他们身上有黑色斑块，甚至全身覆盖着乌木般的鳞片。他们有大眼睛，并经常长出与其龙族祖先相似的短而弯曲的角。

邪齿蜥蜴人属性调整：+2 体质
天赋职业（德鲁伊）：兼职邪齿蜥蜴人的德鲁伊职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 武器熟练（简易）：所有邪齿蜥蜴人擅长简易武器。
- 天生武器：邪齿蜥蜴人可以进行一次天生咬击，造成1d6点酸液伤害，外加1d4点普通伤害。
- 盾牌：所有邪齿蜥蜴人擅长盾牌。
- 技能亲和（跳跃）：跳跃检定获得+4种族加值。
- 天生防御加值：种族天生防御加值为5。
- 黑暗视觉：邪齿蜥蜴人能在黑暗中视物。
- 水下呼吸：邪齿蜥蜴人对溺水免疫。
- 龙血：邪齿蜥蜴人具有龙血亚种。
- 爬虫类：在法咒效果上，邪齿蜥蜴人视为爬虫类。

src:
Many lizardfolk forge alliances with black dragons due to their races' similar habitats.  Over time this led to a mingling of bloodlines, sometimes resulting in entire tribes, and other times a single viletooth being born to a tribe of normal lizardfolk.  Physically they are much thinner than their more typical brethren, sometimes even scrawny.  They have patches of black on their body, up to and including their entire body being covered in ebony scales.  They have large eyes and frequently grow short, curved horns similar to those of their draconic ancestor.

Viletooth Lizardfolk Ability Adjustments: +2 Con
Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass viletooth lizardfolk's druid class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All Viletooth Lizardfolk are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Natural Weapon: Viletooth Lizardfolk can make an natural bite attack that deals 1d6 acid damage in addition to 1d4 normal damage.
- Shield: All Viletooth Lizardfolk are proficient with shields.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +4 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 5.
- Darkvision: Viletooth Lizardfolk are able to see in the dark.
- Waterbreathing: Viletooth Lizardfolk are immune to drowning.
- Dragonblooded: Viletooth Lizardfolk have the dragonblood subtype.
- Reptilian: Viletooth Lizardfolk count as Reptilian for the purpose of spells.

Pyrotechnics
Transmutation
Level: Brd 2, Sor/Wiz 2
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target: Area
Duration: 1d4+1 rounds, or 1d4+1 rounds after creatures leave the smoke cloud; see text
Saving Throw: Will negates or Fortitude negates; see text
Spell Resistance: Yes or No; see text

Pyrotechnics turns a fire into either a burst of blinding fireworks or a thick cloud of choking smoke, depending on the version you choose.

Fireworks: The fireworks are a flashing, fiery, momentary burst of glowing, colored aerial lights. This effect causes creatures within 120 feet of the fire source to become blinded for 1d4+1 rounds (Will negates). These creatures must have line of sight to the fire to be affected. Spell resistance can prevent blindness.

Smoke Cloud: A writhing stream of smoke billows out from the source, forming a choking cloud. The cloud spreads 20 feet in all directions and lasts for 1 round per caster level. All sight, even darkvision, is ineffective in or through the cloud. All within the cloud take -4 penalties to Strength and Dexterity (Fortitude negates). These effects last for 1d4+1 rounds after the cloud dissipates or after the creature leaves the area of the cloud. Spell resistance does not apply.

陆鲨靴

描述符：无
职业：图腾师
脉轮：脚部（图腾）
豁免检定：无

你将魂能塑造成一双靴子，类似于鲨蜥兽沉重的带爪脚。皮革般的皮肤包裹你的腿直到膝盖，巨大的爪子从你的脚前部伸出。

穿着陆鲨靴时，你的跳跃检定获得+4能力加值。

魂能：你每在陆鲨靴中投入一点魂能，跳跃检定的能力加值增加2。
 
脉轮绑定（脚部）

你的陆鲨靴的皮革皮肤向上延伸到你的大腿中部，你的腿变粗变强。靴子将来自大地的振动传递到你的脚上，让你能感知附近生物的运动。

你可以采取移动动作来感知最近的生物及其方向。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

你的手和脚都获得鲨蜥兽的沉重爪子，包括一个突出的中央爪和两侧两个较小的爪。这些巨大的爪子从你的手背伸出，这样你握拳时就能使用它们。

你可以将手上的爪子用作造成1d6点伤害的天生武器。当这些爪子存在时，你不能使用盾牌。你每在陆鲨靴中投入一点魂能，使用这些爪子的攻击检定和伤害检定获得+1增强加值。如果你的跳跃检定结果足够好，可以跳过对手，你可以作为一个标准动作用全部四个爪子攻击该对手。你在同一轮中不能进行任何其他攻击，无论是天生武器还是制造武器。
src:
Landshark Boots

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Totemist  
Chakra: Feet (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You shape incarnum into a pair of boots that resemble the heavy clawed feet of a bulette. Leathery skin encases your legs up to your knees, and enormous claws extend from the front of your feet.

While wearing the landshark boots, you gain a +4 competence bonus on Jump checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in the landshark boots increases the competence bonus on Jump checks by 2. 
 
Chakra Bind (Feet)

The leathery skin of your landshark boots extends up to the middle of your thighs, and your legs thicken and grow stronger. The boots transmit vibrations from the earth into your feet, allowing you to sense the movement of nearby creatures.

You can take a move action to sense the closest creature and the direction to it. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your hands as well as your feet gain the heavy claws of a bulette, including one prominent central claw and two smaller claws on the sides. These massive claws emerge from the backs of your hands so you can bring them to bear while making a fist.

You can use the claws on your hands as natural weapons that deal 1d6 points of damage. You cannot use a shield while these claws are in place. For every point of essentia you invest in your landshark boots, you gain a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with these claws. If you achieve a Jump check result good enough to jump over an opponent, you can attack that opponent with all four claws as a standard action. You cannot make any other attacks in the same round, whether from natural weapons or manufactured weapons.

dst:
在探索卡林港地下的废墟时，我从一只恐蛛手中救下了一个不寻常的半兽人，名叫赫兰加拉克。这个赫兰加拉克是海姆的牧师，看起来直到最近，他的部落“血刃”一直崇拜这位神祇，并试图避免像半兽人通常那样与其他种族交战。然而最近部落的领导层发生了变化，前任领袖冈克鲁泽尔公主被驱逐，并被卖给了一个邪教，他们需要拥有皇室血统的人进行某种奇怪的仪式献祭。新领袖是格鲁扎尔，他试图恢复对格乌什的崇拜，并与鼠人结盟对抗卡林港的人类。赫兰加拉克希望我与他联手救出冈克鲁泽尔，并让她重新领导部落，挫败这个计划。

我同意了赫兰加拉克的计划。拯救公主是冒险者的经典任务，即使老故事里的公主通常不是半兽人。与赫兰加拉克一起，我应该向西前往血刃镇，然后向南找到邪教巢穴。

我们已经找到并救出了冈克鲁泽尔，并处理了邪教徒，他们不再构成威胁。我们还杀死了格鲁扎尔，让冈克鲁泽尔重新成为她人民的领袖。我应该和她谈谈以完成这个任务。
src:
While exploring the subterranean ruins beneath Calimport, I rescued from a dire spider an unusual orc named Hrangarak. This Hrangarak is a cleric of Helm, and it seems that until recently his tribe, the Bloody Blades, was worshiping this deity and seeking to avoid warring with other races as is typical of orcs. Recently however the tribe has had a change of leadership, with their former leader Princess Gunkruzelle being ousted and sold to a cult who needed someone with royal blood for some sort of strange ritual sacrifice. Its new leader is Gruzhaur, who seeks to restore worship of Gruumsh and form an alliance with the wererats against the humans of Calimport. Hrangarak wants me to join with him to rescue Gunkruzelle and restore her to leadership of the tribe, frustrating this plan.

I have agreed to Hrangarak's plan. Rescuing a princess is a classic quest for adventurers, even if the princess is not usually an orc in the old stories. Together with Hrangarak, I should head west towards the Bloody Blades town, but then head south to find the Cultist's Lair.

We have found and rescued Gunkruzelle, and dealt with the cultists, who will no longer be any threat. We have also slain Gruzhaur, restoring Gunkruzelle as leader of her people. I should speak to her to finish off this quest.

dst: 在探索幽暗地域时，我遇到了一位名叫马弗瑞斯·萨拉彭的人类法师，他在一个地下洞穴中临时居住，研究幽暗地域特有的奇异魔法。他让我寻找三件对他的研究有重要意义的物品：一只石化蜥蜴的眼睛，一块胶质怪或类似软泥怪的灵液，以及一只囚魂魔的脑组织。这些生物都应该能在幽暗地域的某处找到。他承诺每件物品支付我4000金币，如果集齐三件，还会额外给我一件特殊的魔法物品。我想是时候去打猎了。\n\n我已经把灵液和囚魂魔的脑组织交给了马弗瑞斯。他还需要一只石化蜥蜴的眼睛。
src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a human mage named Mavereth Tharapen, who has taken up temporary residence in an underground cave while he conducts research into the exotic magics peculiar to the Underdark. He asked me to find three items of significance to his research: an eye from a Basilisk, ichor from a Gelatinous Cube or similar slime, and brain matter from an Intellect Devourer. All are creatures that it should be possible to find somewhere in the Underdark. He has promised to pay me 4000 gold for each of these items, and to give me a special magical item in addition if I collect all three. Time to go hunting I suppose.\n\nI have given Mavereth the ichor and an Intellect Devourer's brain. He still requires a Basilisk's eye.

心灵转化系 [见说明]
等级：操能者 5
显能时间：1 标准动作
距离：近距（25 英尺 + 5 英尺/2 等级）

持续时间：专注，最多 1 轮/等级
豁免检定：反射减半或强韧减半；见说明
灵能抗力：是
灵能点：9
超能：强效，延时，极效

显能此异能时，你选择寒冷，电击，火焰或音波。你身体由灵能驱动的生物能量流产生所选类型的能量弧，以你指定为主要敌人的生物为目标，在异能持续期间每轮造成 9d6 点伤害。能量也从主要敌人弧向一个额外敌人，该敌人最初在主要敌人 15 英尺内，或在持续期间随后移动到主要敌人 15 英尺内。在持续期间，次要敌人每轮受到主要敌人所受伤害的一半。

如果主要或次要敌人生命值降至 0 以下（或目标以特殊能力或异能完全避开效果），能量流的弧在持续期间随机重新指定另一个主要和/或次要敌人。被指定的敌人可以正常移动，可能移出效果范围，但每轮被指定且仍在范围内时，必须进行豁免检定以避免在该轮受到全额伤害。

专注维持能量流是一个整轮动作。如果在维持能量流时受到伤害，你必须成功通过专注检定（DC 10 + 所受伤害） 以避免失去对此异能的专注。

寒冷：此能量类型的流造成每骰 +1 点伤害。减少寒冷流伤害的豁免检定是强韧豁免而非反射豁免。
电击：显能此能量类型的流为豁免 DC 提供 +2 加值，并为克服灵能抗力的显能者等级检定提供 +2 加值。
火焰：此能量类型的流造成每骰 +1 点伤害。
音波：此能量类型的流造成每骰 -1 点伤害，并忽略物体的硬度。

此异能的子类型与你显能的能量类型相同。

增幅：你可以以下列一种或两种方式增幅此异能。
1. 你每额外花费 1 点灵能点，此异能的伤害增加一骰（d6）.每额外两骰伤害，此异能的豁免 DC 增加 1。
2. 你每额外花费 4 点灵能点，此异能可以影响一个额外的次要目标。任何额外的次要目标不能距离此异能的另一个目标超过 15 英尺。
src:
Psychokinesis [see text]
Level: Kineticist 5
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: Any two creatures no more than 15 ft. apart
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Reflex half or Fortitude half; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 9
Metapsionics: Empower, Extend, Maximize

Upon manifesting this power, you choose cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. Your body's psionically fueled bioenergetic currents produce an arc of energy of the chosen type that targets a creature you designate as the primary foe for 9d6 points of damage in every round when the power remains in effect. Energy also arcs off the primary foe to strike one additional foe that is initially within 15 feet of the primary foe, or that subsequently moves within 15 feet of the primary foe while the duration lasts. Secondary foes take half the damage that the primary foe takes in every round while the duration lasts.

Should either the primary or secondary foe fall to less than 0 hit points (or should a target completely evade the effect with a special ability or power), the energy current 's arc randomly retargets another primary and/or secondary foe while the duration lasts. Targeted foes can move normally, possibly moving out of range of the effect, but each round they are targeted and remain in range they must make a saving throw to avoid taking full damage in that round.

Concentrating to maintain energy current is a full-round action. If you take damage while maintaining energy current, you must make a successful Concentration check (DC 10 + damage dealt) to avoid losing your concentration on the power.

Cold: A current of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die. The saving throw to reduce damage from a cold current is a Fortitude save instead of a Reflex save.
Electricity: Manifesting a current of this energy type provides a +2 bonus to the save DC and a +2 bonus on manifester level checks for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
Fire: A current of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.
Sonic: A current of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: You can augment this power in one or both of the following ways.
1. For every additional power point you spend, this power's damage increases by one die (d6). For each extra two dice of damage, this power's save DC increases by 1.
2. For every 4 additional power points you spend, this power can affect an additional secondary target. Any additional secondary target cannot be more than 15 feet from another target of the power.

Forms of harm that do not involve hit points, such
as charm effects, temporary ability damage, level 
draining, and disintegration, are not affected.
If a subject suffers a reduction of hit points 
from a lowered Constitution score, the reduction 
is not split with you because it is not hit point damage.
When the spell ends, subsequent damage is no 
longer divided between you and the subjects, but 
damage already split is not reassigned to the 
subjects.

If you die while this spell is in effect, the spell 
ends in a burst of positive energy that restores 1d8
hit points to each subject.

If a subject moves out of range of the spell, that
subject's connection to you is severed but the spell 
continues as long as there is at least one subject
remaining and you remain alive.

Focus: A platinum ring (worth at least 50 gp) worn 
by you and each subject of the spell.

dst:
（基础职业）
武士是专业的战士；属于贵族阶层，接受过战争艺术的训练。武士出生于一个将坚定不移的忠诚和荣誉看得高于一切的社会，从童年起就接受一套影响生活方方面面的价值体系的训练。

一个蒙羞或没有主人的武士被从这个无处不在的价值体系中剥离出来，便不再被视为武士，而只是一个普通的雇佣兵战士 - 一个没有荣誉，没有社会地位的浪人。

- 阵营限制：任意守序。
- 生命骰：d10。
- 武器防具擅长：所有简易和军用武器，外加武士刀。中型和轻型护甲。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

职业特性：

先古双刃
所有武士都携带两把精制武器 - 一把武士刀和一把胁差。这些武器由武士的祖先世代相传，保护它们是武士荣誉的重要一环。从第4级开始，他可以通过献祭物品来增强它们，从而启蒙术武器中潜藏的超自然能力。
src:
(BASE CLASS)
Samurai are professional warriors; members of the noble class, trained in the art of warfare. Born into a society which values unswerving loyalty and honour above all else, the Samurai is trained from childhood in a value system that influences every area of life.

A disgraced or masterless Samurai cut loose from this all-pervading value system is no longer considered a Samurai, but rather a common mercenary fighter - a Ronin with no honour and no standing in society.

- Alignment Restrictions: Any lawful.
- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: All simple and martial weapons, plus katana.  Medium and light armor.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Ancestral Daisho
All Samurai carry two masterwork weapons - a katana and a wakizashi.  These weapons have been handed down over generations from the Samurai's ancestors, and protecting them is an important point of honor for the Samurai. Starting at level 4, he can awaken the supernatural abilities latent in the weapons by sacrificing items to enhance them.

dst: "嗯，最近这个地区有一些有趣的进展，主要是一股强大的寇涛鱼人势力，也许还有其他生物，在从这里往东的地方建立了基地，并且一直在周围的洞穴中积极搜寻古老魔法。我所隶属的斯涅布力侏儒社区对此感到担忧，并试图了解更多关于这一进展的情况。因此，我们派出了六名最强大的冒险者组成的小队去调查周围的洞穴。不幸的是，这支小队失踪了。这非常令人不安，因为只有最强大的敌人才可能对他们构成威胁。我希望你能找到他们，帮助他们摆脱可能遇到的困难，或者，如果他们已倒下，至少查明他们的命运。"
src: "Well, there have been some interesting developments in this region of late, mainly the emergence of a powerful force of Kuo Toa, and perhaps other creatures, who have set up a base to the east of here, and who have been aggressively searching the surrounding caverns for old magic. The Svirfneblin community of which I am a member was concerned and sought to learn more about this development. In consequence, we dispatched a party of six of our most powerful adventurers to investigate the surrounding caverns. Unfortunately, this party has gone missing. Most disturbing, since only the most powerful foes should have been a threat to them. I would like you to find them, assist them out of any difficulties they might be in, or, if they have fallen, at least discover their fate."

src: Spells per Day/Powers Known: When a new cerebremancer level is attained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also attained a level in any one arcane spellcasting class he belonged to before he added the prestige class. He gains additional power points per day and access to new powers as if he had also gained a level in any one manifesting class he belonged to previously. src: "For now, the earth crystal (identified by the green arcane energies it emits) provides immunity to Petrification, to Acid and Bludgeoning weapons, and also to any especially powerful blows that might strike if the other immunities are somehow removed. The air crystal (white energy) provides regeneration as well as immunity to electrical, sonic and positive damage. The fire crytal (red energy) provides immunity to fire and slashing weapons, as well as to level or ability draining effects. The water crystal (blue energy) provides immunity to cold and piercing weapons, as well as to paralysis, attacks trying to knock one down, or other assaults on mobility. A final crystal, drawing from multiple planes (identified by purple energies) provides immunity to negative and miscellaneous magical energies, as well as to Death magic."

dst: 在穿越一个夺心魔要塞时，当我们接近统治它的主脑时，我们穿过一扇门，突然发现自己身处一个完全不同的地方——似乎回到了卡林港的加尔哈德尔庄园，正在参加一场宴会，周围是与加尔哈德尔家族有关联的各种人，其中一些人本应已经死了，而没有人应该在这里。看来我们被困在了主脑的灵能所创造的某种幻象中。这个幻象似乎主要集中在扎拉拉身上，并从她的记忆中汲取素材，所以她可能是打破这个幻象的关键。\n\n扎拉拉被说服不相信第一个幻象，结束了它，但我们现在似乎被困在了另一个幻象中。
src: While advancing through an Illithid stronghold, and as we were approaching the Elder Brain governing it, we passed through a door and suddenly found ourselves someplace completely different - seemingly back at the Galhadr estate in Calimport, attending a banquet in the company of various people associated with the Galhadr family, some of whom should be dead and none of whom should be here. It would seem we are trapped in some sort of illusion created by the Elder Brain's psionic powers. The illusion seems to be focused primarily on Zarala and drawing from her memories, so she may be the key to breaking out of this.\n\nZarala was convinced to disbelieve in the first illusion, ending it, but we seem now to be trapped in another.

dst:
在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个名叫布利夫明·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取有魔法用途的试剂。他所说的“中央收集区”周围的四个分站的机器一直出问题，他承诺如果我帮他解决各种问题，就会给我报酬。

东北方向的机器发生了故障，在自身周围释放了一团毒气。我现在已经将其关闭，以便进行维修。

东南方向的机器似乎有类似的问题，喷出了一些软泥，可能也有某种毒性。我得冒险穿过它来关闭这台机器。

西北方向的机器所在的房间被食腐虫占据了。这些怪物已经被清除了。

西南方向的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被某个未知方扯掉了。泽姆昆怀疑是某个罪犯偷走了它，以便卖掉金子。他希望我能设法追查肇事者并找回丢失的部件。我应该在这台机器附近调查，希望能找到一些线索。

我已经将我的进展告知了泽姆昆。完成的其他任务也应该向泽姆昆报告。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast was malfunctioning, and released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I have now shut this down so that it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast has what appears to be a similar problem, having spewed forth some kind of slime, also likely toxic in some way. I shall have to risk moving through it to shut down this machine as well.

The machine to the northwest was in a room occupied by otyughs. These monsters have been cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some unknown party. Zemquin suspects some criminal type stole this in order to sell the gold. He hopes I can somehow track down the perpetrator and recover the missing part. I should investigate in the vicinity of this machine in hopes of finding some clue.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

这块刻有符文的小石头是由矮人卡拉丁·亮刃制作的，他是摩拉丁的圣武士，也是一位大师级武器匠和符文师。卡拉丁经常担心他锻造的武器可能被用来对付无辜者，因此他倾向于为他的武器制作附魔，使它们更容易被善良的使用者使用，并且对邪恶敌人更有效。

每次使用这个特定的符文能够永久地赋予一把近战武器神圣复仇者属性，使这类武器在圣武士手中更加强大。

注意：这个符文有多次使用次数。与其用它们来附魔多件物品，不如明智地保存符文，以便在你找到更好的武器（也许在未来的模组中）来替换你当前使用的武器时再次使用。但如果你更愿意同时拥有多把具有神圣复仇者属性的武器，那也是一个选择。
src:
This small, rune-carved stone was fashioned by the dwarf Karadin Brightblade, a Paladin of Moradin who was also a master weaponsmith and runecaster. Karadin often worried that the weapons he forged might be turned against the innocent, and as a result he tended to fashion enchantments for his weapons that would make them more easily used by good wielders, and more effective against evil foes than others.

Each use of this particular rune is able to permanently confer the Holy Avenger property on a melee weapon, making such weapons more powerful when wielded by paladins.

NOTE: This rune has multiple charges. Instead of using these to enchant multiple items, it might be wise to save the rune to be used again when you find a better weapon (perhaps in future modules) to replace that which you are currently using. But if you prefer to have multiple weapons with the Holy Avenger property at one time, that is also an option.

Hound Archons look like well-muscled humans with canine heads.  They are the hunters and stalkers among the Lawful Good celestials.  They try to avoid harming good and innocent creatures, and only attack when provoked.  Their extreme lawful good tendencies however often facilitates that.  They generally meet a foe head-on, but if the odds are against them they will take steps to even the odds, such as hit-and-run tactics.

src: When I was recently returned from death, the mysterious entity that greets me on such occasions asked for an additional service from me. Apparently minions of the demon Azghulkar are invading the Plane of Air, seeking to acquire some powerful magical object, and the entity wants me to assist in fighting them. These enemies are coming from a fiery portal that I am to fight to and close with "the power of the wind" (which I assume means that I am to cast a "Gust of Wind" spell on the portal, since the entity also gave me an item that can unleash this spell). \n\nThe entity has transported me to the scene of the battle. I investigated the magical orb being fought over, and something Zarala did caused us to be infused with power by it. It is indeed most powerful, though its precise nature is unclear. I must now locate the flaming portal of which it spoke and close it.

src:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Troglodyte

When a troglodyte is angry or frightened, it secretes an oily, musk-like chemical that nearly every form of animal life finds offensive. All living creatures (except troglodytes) within 30 feet of a troglodyte must succeed on a Fortitude save or be sickened for 10 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based. Creatures that successfully save cannot be affected by the same troglodyte's stench for 24 hours. A delay poison or neutralize poison spell removes the effect from the sickened creature. Creatures with immunity to poison are unaffected, and creatures resistant to poison receive their normal bonus on their saving throws.

dst: 我为了寻找一本珍贵的书而前往的那座对非矮人设有结界的废墟有着一段有趣的历史。显然，这道结界是由矮人神系中善神牧师与邪恶之神阿巴索尔的牧师结盟设立的。然而，在结界设立之后，阿巴索尔的追随者试图将这座如今坚不可摧的堡垒据为己有，结果引发了一场内战，最终以所有居民死亡而告终。然而在内战过程中，各种诅咒被降下，导致那些居民以不死生物的状态留存下来，进行着一场永远无法结束的战争，因为他们被击倒后只会重新复活。然而，看来这些诅咒可以通过一个活着的矮人——也就是我——的到来而终结。击倒其中一个派系的大祭司将终结诅咒，让这场战争得以了结。作为回报，另一个派系的大祭司会给我一把钥匙，我需要用它进入这里的图书馆，取得我需要的书。\n\n按照要求，其中一位大祭司已被击倒。现在我需要回到另一位那里去取钥匙。
src: The ruin warded against non-Dwarves to which I have traveled in search of a valuable book has an interesting history. Apparently the ward was raised by an alliance of the clerics of the good gods of the Dwarven pantheon and those of the evil Abbathor. After the ward was raised, however, the followers of Abbathor attempted to seize the now impregnable fortress for themselves, resulting in a civil war which ultimately ended in the death of all inhabitants. In the course of the war, however, various curses were called down resulting in those inhabitants remaining about in an undead state, waging a war that could never be ended as they simply re-animated when struck down. It appears, however, that these curses can be ended by the arrival of a living dwarf, myself. Striking down the high priest of one of the factions will end the curse and allow the war to be resolved. In return, the high priest of the other faction will give me a key that I will need to enter the library here and acquire the book I need.\n\nAs required, one of the high priests has been struck down. Now I need to return to the other for the key.

作为石巨人种族的一个小型分支，野性加贡在寒冷的北方地区以牙齿和利爪谋生。野性加贡源自石巨人和巨人的血统。这些大型，野蛮的人形生物以快速，狂暴的能量速度爆发进行战斗。在北方贫瘠的地区，几乎没有仁慈的余地，野性加贡不得不学会侵略性以求生存。
  
甚至比他们的石巨人亲族更甚，野性加贡觉得城市和文明的种种令人困惑和畏惧。尽管个别野性加贡找到了适应其他种族城市和村庄的方法，但大多数更喜欢遥远北方简单，游牧的生活方式。

野性加贡属性调整：+4 力量，+2 敏捷，+4 体质，-2 智力，-2 魅力
偏好职业（野蛮人）：在决定兼职的野性加贡是否因兼职而受到 XP 惩罚时，其野蛮人职业不计入。

特殊能力：
黑暗视觉
天生防御 +2
寒冷抗力 5
强力体格 - 野性加贡在持用武器和进行诸如擒抱和绊摔等战斗动作时被视为大型生物
奔跑跳跃 - 野性加贡将所有跳跃检定视为奔跑
爪击 - 野性加贡有 2 次主要爪击，每次造成 1d6 点伤害

野性加贡在法咒和能力方面被视为怪物人形生物。他们的等级调整为 +2，并有 2 个怪物人形生物种族生命骰，赋予所有简易武器的熟练
src:
A small offshoot of the goliath race, feral garguns tear their livelihood out of the frigid northern regions with tooth and claw. Feral garguns derive from goliath and giant parentage. These large, savage humanoids fight in quick, furious bursts of energy. In the barren areas of the north, there is little room for mercy, and the feral garguns have had to learn to be aggressive just to survive. 
  
Even more than their goliath kindred, feral garguns find cities and the trappings of civilization confusing and intimidating. Although individual feral garguns have found ways to adapt to the cities and villages of other races, the majority prefers the simple, nomadic lifestyle of the far north. 

Feral Gargun Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +2 Dex, +4 Con, -2 Int, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass Feral Gargun's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
Darkvision
Natural Armor +2
Cold Resistance 5
Powerful Build - The Feral Gargun is treated as a Large creature for wielding weapons and combat maneuvers such as grappling and tripping
Running Jump - Feral Gargun treat all jump checks as running
Claw Attacks - The Feral Gargun has 2 primary claw attacks dealing 1d6 damage each

Feral Gargun count as monstrous humanoid for spells and abilities. They have a Level Adjustment of +2, and 2 racial hit dice of Monstrous Humanoid that grants proficiency with all simple weapons

src:
Goblins are small creatures that many consider to be little more than a nuisance. Standing just over 3 feet and weighing less than 50 pounds, these creatures are seldom intimidating on their own but can be cunningly lethal in larger numbers. Their skin tone ranges from yellow to deep red, and they prefer to wear colors that blend into their natural surroundings of dark caverns. Often bullied by the larger races, goblins have learned to exploit their advantages, usually in the form of sheer numbers and ingenuity.

Goblin Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass goblin's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
- +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
- +1 size bonus to AC.
- +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Darkvision: Goblins are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Goblinoid: Goblins count as Goblinoids for the purpose of spells.

dst: 在稀有书籍专家登萨斯·韦莱本的建议下，我们经过漫长的任务，成功获得了一本价值足以作为进入烛堡的通行费的书。既然此事已完成，我们应回去与特法拉姆船长谈谈，他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停泊数周进行整修，而他或许能在下次猎捕海盗的出击中带我们更接近烛堡。\n\n特法拉姆船长告知我们，瓦尔库尔之剑号的下一次远征将攻击云峰山脉以西海岸的一个海盗基地，该地位于泰瑟尔以北很远，且正好在前往烛堡的路上。我们接受了他随行此次远征的提议，被他之后将我们送到博德之门港的承诺所吸引，那里离烛堡相当近。现在瓦尔库尔之剑号正接近我们打算消灭的海盗基地，船长已叫我们上甲板讨论攻击计划。我们应尽快与船长谈谈。
src: We have succeeded in acquiring a book of sufficient value to serve as the price of admittance to Candlekeep, after a long quest suggested to us by Densath Wayleben, an expert on rare volumes. With that accomplished, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram, who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting, and who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.\n\nCaptain Tefaram informed us that the Sword of Valkur's next expedition will be an attack on a pirate base on the coast west of the Cloud Peak mountains, a good distance north of Tethyr and well on the way to Candlekeep. We accepted his offer to go along on this expedition, lured by his promise to drop us off afterwards at the port of Baldur's Gate, quite near to Candlekeep. Now the Sword of Valkur is approaching the pirate base we mean to eliminate, and the captain has called us up on deck to discuss our plan of attack. We should speak to the captain as soon as convenient.

dst:
在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个名叫布利夫明·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取具有魔法用途的试剂。他所说的"中央收集区"周围的四个分站的机器一直出问题，他承诺如果我能够帮忙解决他遇到的各种问题，就会给我报酬。

东北方向的机器发生了故障，在自身周围释放了一团毒气。我现在已经将其关闭，以便进行修理。

东南方向的机器不知为何喷出了危险的软泥，但现在已经关闭了。

西北方向的机器所在房间被食腐虫占据了。这些怪物已经被清除了。

西南方向的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被某个不明身份的人拆走了。泽姆昆怀疑是某个罪犯偷走了它，以便出售黄金。他希望我能设法追查到罪犯并找回丢失的部件。我应该在这台机器附近调查，希望能找到一些线索。

我已经向泽姆昆汇报了我的进展。完成的其他任务也应该向泽姆昆汇报。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast was malfunctioning, and released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I have now shut this down so that it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast was somehow spewing forth dangeous slimes. but has now been shut down.

The machine to the northwest was in a room occupied by otyughs. These monsters have been cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some unknown party. Zemquin suspects some criminal type stole this in order to sell the gold. He hopes I can somehow track down the perpetrator and recover the missing part. I should investigate in the vicinity of this machine in hopes of finding some clue.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

A knight is a proud, skilled melee combatant who fights in the name of honour and chivalry. A knight relies on more than a sharp sword and stout suit of armour to defeat his foes. His drive, determination, and fighting spirit allow him to control the battlefield in ways that others cannot match. Some savants of the Nine Disciplines believe that none of the paths are complete, true disciplines in and of themselves. They believe that the nine disciplines are more appropriately termed the Nine Steps, each a single portion of a whole, true Way. These few masters strive to learn the secrets of each path, and in doing some become the masters of nine, using a martial style that combines all of the techniques of the Temple of Nine Swords. There is one thing that got my attention, though: to use the sword at its full power, one needs to be a descendant of Zefad himself."

src:
School:    Necromancy (Evil)
Level:  Cleric 7, Sorc/Wiz 7
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving throw: Fortitude negates

This spell functions like enervation except that the creature struck gains negative levels over an extended period. You point your finger and utter the incantation, releasing a black needle of crackling negative energy that suppresses the life force of any living creature it strikes. You must make a ranged touch attack to hit. If the attack succeeds, the subject immediately gains one negative level, then continues to gain another each round thereafter as her life force slowly bleeds away. The drain can only be stopped by application of a heal, restoration, or greater restoration spell.

If the black needle strikes an undead creature, that  creature gains 4d4 * 5 temporary hp that last for up to 1 hour.

src:
Tasloi are a race of small jungle dwellers that live among the trees.  These green-skinned creatures walk in a crouching posture, their catlike eyes enabling them to see in the gloom of the canopy.  Cowardly, they will flee when outmatched, and prefer ambushes, feasting on any humanoids they kill.

Tasloi Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass tasloi's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
- +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
- +1 size bonus to AC.
- +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Light Sensitivity: Tasloi suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Goblinoid: Tasloi count as Goblinoids for the purpose of spells.

森林侏儒非常热爱自然，尤其是远离文明甚至远离任何人居所的幽深而宁静的森林。因此，许多人，包括他们同族的其他侏儒，从未见过森林侏儒。与其他侏儒不同，森林侏儒留着长发和长胡须，散开时常常几乎垂到脚边。男性通常将胡须修剪成尖细的形状，或卷成角状的尖刺，延伸到脸的两侧。他们的皮肤是树皮的颜色，眼睛通常是棕色或蓝色。他们的头发是棕色或黑色，随着年龄增长会变成灰色或白色。

偏好职业（法师）：兼职森林侏儒的法师职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 小型体型
 攻击检定获得 +1 体型加值。
 AC 获得 +1 体型加值。
 躲藏检定获得 +4 体型加值。
- 对幻术的坚韧：对抗影响心智的法咒时豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 对爬虫类的攻击训练：对抗爬虫类人形生物时攻击检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 对地精类的攻击训练：对抗地精类生物（地精，大地精和熊地精）时攻击检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 对巨人的防御训练：对抗巨人时 AC 获得 +4 闪避加值。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（专注）：专注检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（森林躲藏）：躲藏获得 +4 种族加值，在森林中时 +8。
- 法术专攻（幻术）：岩石侏儒施展的任何幻术法咒 DC 增加 +2. 这与专长相同。
- 微光视觉：使他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 侏儒：就法咒而言，森林侏儒视为侏儒。
src:
Forest Gnomes have a great love for nature, particularly deep and quiet forests far from civilization or even anyone's home. For this reason many people, including others of their kind, have never seen a forest gnome. Unlike other gnomes, forest gnomes wear their hair and beards long, often to the almost to their feet when unbound. The males often trim their beards to a fine point or curl them into hornlike spikes extending to either side of their faces. Their skin is the color of bark, and their eyes are usually brown or blue. Their hair is brown or black, becoming gray or white with age.

Forest Gnomish Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass forest gnome's wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Hardiness vs. Illusions: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Reptilians: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against reptilian humanoids.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Concentration): +2 racial bonus to Concentration checks.
- Skill Affinity (Hide Forest): +4 racial bonus to Hide, +8 when in the forest.
- Spell Focus (Illusion): Rock Gnomes add +2 DC to any Illusion spells they cast. This is identical to the feat.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Gnomish: Forest Gnomes count as Gnomes for the purpose of spells.

src:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: none

Benefit: When you cast a spell that deals damage against a specific creature type, you deal an extra 2d6 points of damage. For example, a giant bane lightning bolt cast by an 8th-level caster would deal the usual 8d6 points of damage to any nongiant in its path but would deal 10d6 points of damage against giants. This feat has no effect on spells that do not deal hit point damage, and the source and type of the damage remains the same. This feat cannot be used to increase the amount of healing dealt to undead by inflict light wounds and similar spells, but it can add to the damage dealt by casting cure light wounds on an undead creature.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, you must apply its effects to a different type of creature: aberrations, animals, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, giants, humanoids, magical beasts, monstrous humanoids, oozes, outsiders, plants, undead, or vermin. If you choose humanoids, you must select a particular type of humanoid, such as dwarf or orc.

dst: "再说一次，你暴露了你没能理解我反对你绑架那个愚蠢作家哈辛时想向你传达的意思。想想看。一个作家宣布计划出版一本书揭露扭曲符文会的秘密。他出发去做一些研究，然后神秘失踪，或者被发现死了，或者变成僵尸，或者你计划让他发生的任何事。大家会怎么想？确实有有趣的秘密可找，否则没必要为此杀人。然后他们中一些更爱冒险的人会追随他的脚步。你还需要什么比这个<CUSTOM104>在我们正讨论此事时闯进来更好的证据呢？"
src: "Again, you reveal your failure to understand what I was trying to get across to you when I objected to you kidnapping that silly author, Hasin. Think. An author announces plans to publish a book exposing secrets of the Twisted Rune. He sets out to do some research for it and then mysteriously disappears, or turns up dead, or as a zombie or whatever you planned to have happen. What is everyone going to think? That there are indeed interesting secrets to be found, or there would be no need to kill someone over them. Then some of the more adventurous among them are going to follow in his footsteps. What more proof of this do you require than this <CUSTOM104> bursting in on us just as we were discussing the matter?"

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psychic warrior 6
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal; see text
Target: You
Duration: 1 round/level
Power Points: 11
Metapsionics: Extend

You wrench from your subconscious a terrifying visage of deadly hunger and become one with it. You are transformed into a nightmarish version of yourself, complete with an ooze-sleek skin coating, lashing tentacles, and a fright-inducing countenance. You retain your basic shape and can continue to use your equipment. This power cannot be used to impersonate someone; while horrible, your form is recognizably your own.

You gain the frightful presence extraordinary ability, which takes effect automatically. Opponents within 30 feet of you that have fewer Hit Dice or levels than you become shaken for 5d6 rounds if they fail a Will save (DC 16 + your Cha modifier). An opponent that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to your frightful presence for 24 hours. Frightful presence is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Your horrific form grants you a natural armor bonus of +5, damage reduction 5/-, and a +4 bonus to your Strength score. In addition, you gain +33% to your land speed as well as a +10 bonus on Jump checks.

A nest of violently flailing black tentacles sprout from your hair and back. You can make up to four additional attacks with these tentacles in addition to your regular melee attacks. You can make tentacle attacks within the space you normally threaten. Each tentacle attacks at your highest base attack bonus with a -5 penalty. These tentacles deal 2d8 points of damage plus one-half your Strength bonus on each successful strike.

This power functions only while you inhabit your base form (for instance, you can't be metamorphed or polymorphed into another form, though you can use, claws of the beast, and bite of the wolf in conjunction with this power for your regular attacks), and while your mind resides within your own body.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, this power's duration increases by 2 rounds.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Oozemaster is not a class for stable individuals. It involves relating one-on-one with things that relate to nothing at all. Unlike the animal lord's kindred creatures, the Oozemaster's charges have nothing to say. No one has yet developed a speak with ooze spell- or if someone has, the oozes haven't responded. Given that Oozemasters exude everything but confidence, most of them have few sentient friends and even fewer guests. Thus, they tend to gibber and talk to themselves a lot.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: Oozemasters gain no weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd-level arcane or divine spells.
Skills: Lore 7 ranks.
Feats: Great Fortitude.

CLASS FEATURES:

Levels
1: Minor Oozy Touch - Can secrete a specific minor ooze for a touch attack often as desired.
2: Charisma Penalty -1
  Oozy Glob - Can use any learned minor oozy touch as a grenade weapon once per day.
3: Minor Oozy Touch - Can choose another minor ooze.
4: Charisma Penalty -2
  Oozy Glob - Can use twice per day
5: Major Oozy Touch
6: Charisma Penalty -3
  Oozy Glob - Can use three times per day.
  Indiscernible Anatomy - The oozemaster gains Light Fortification.
7: Major Oozy Touch - Can choose a major ooze for a touch attack or another minor ooze.
8: Charisma Penalty -4
  Oozy Glob - Can use four times a day.
  Slime Wave
9: Major Oozy Touch - Can choose another major or minor ooze.
10: Charisma Penalty -5
  Oozy Glob - Can use five times a day.
  One with the Ooze - Type changes to ooze; gains the blind-fight feat; gains immunity to mind spells, poisons, and paralysis.

BONUS SPELLS

Every other level in Oozemaster, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class. He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

我已与达伦·索尔伯爵谈过，他正寻求雇佣兵来对抗其领地上的怪物入侵。比大多数同类怪物更强大的熊地精和大地精团伙频繁出现在伯爵乡间庄园周围的土地上，他悬赏每带回一个熊地精或大地精的头颅便支付100金币，希望能借此削减它们的数量。我可以通过伯爵城中住所内的传送门前往那座乡间庄园，该住所位于码头以北、市场以西的区域。到达那里后，我便可以开始巡视乡间，搜寻地精类生物。伯爵还让我与那里的资深仆人，一位名叫林·梅伦多斯的人交谈，以便上交头颅或处理此事引发的其他问题。

目前尚不清楚我是否有可能彻底消灭所有地精类生物，但尽我所能减轻它们的威胁很可能有利可图。此外，如果我停止巡视并返回城中，我随时都能通过传送门回来继续猎杀怪物，因此只要我有需要，这有可能成为一项稳定的收入来源。

在巡视过程中，我在大地精的尸体上发现了一些地图碎片。将它们全部拼合后，显现出一个标记地点，如今我已前往那里。在那里，我发现了一个似乎是大地精核心营地的所在，由该地区地精类势力的首领们占据，而他们正是曾在卡林杉组建强大地精军队的乌拉斯和戈拉夫。被击败后，他们直接传送离开了，因此他们所构成的威胁是否已被永久终结，似乎值得怀疑。但希望他们的败亡，以及我在此区域遭遇的众多其他地精类生物的覆灭，已经减轻了这里的威胁。
src:
I have spoken to Count Daren Thorl, who sought to hire mercenaries in order to combat monstrous incursions on his lands. Bands of Bugbears and Hobgoblins, more powerful than most such monsters, have been appearing frequently in the lands surrounding the Count's country estate, and he has offered a bounty of 100 gold for every Bugbear or Hobgoblin head adventurers can bring back, in hopes of thinning their numbers. I can travel to the country estate through a portal found in the Count's residence in the city, which is in an area north of the docks and west of the markets. Once there, I can commence to patrol the countryside in search of goblinoids. The Count has also told me to speak to the senior servant there, one Rin Merendos, to turn in heads or deal with any other questions raised by this matter.

It is not clear that it will be possible for me to ever eliminate all the goblinoids, but doing what I can to reduce their threat could well prove profitable. Furthermore, if I leave off patrolling and return to the city, I will be able to return by the portal for more monster hunting whenever it is convenient, so this has the potential to be a regular source of income, if I find myself in need of such.

In the course of patrolling, I found pieces of a map on the bodies of Hobgoblins. Assembling them all revealed a marked location, to which I have now traveled. There I discovered what seems some central Hobgoblin camp, occupied by the leaders of the goblinoid forces in this area, who turned out to be the same Ulaz and Gorav who were raising powerful goblin armies in Calimshan. Upon being defeated, they simply teleported away, so it seems doubtful whatever threat they pose has been ended for good. But hopefully their defeat, as well as that of the numerous other goblinoids I have encountered in this region, has reduced it.

提亚马特之爪推进邪恶龙类的目标。他尤其乐于伤害金属龙及其盟友。
