(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The talon of Tiamat furthers the goals of evil dragonkind.  He takes particular delight in causing harm to metallic dragons and their allies.
The talons of Tiamat welcome characters from any class or background, as long as they share a dedication to evil.  Former fighters and barbarians rub shoulders with those who practice sorcery or divine magic.  Even ex-paladins can find a home among the talons.
Talons of Tiamat may work individually or in groups, as befits their plans.  They work well with evil characters of any stripe, and ally with evil dragons when possible.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Talon of Tiamat gains proficiency with all armors, shields, and all simple and martial weapons.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Any evil.
Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Skills: Bluff 4 ranks, Intimidate 4 ranks, Lore 4 ranks.
Feats: Dragonthrall

CLASS FEATURES:
1: Breath Weapon - You can breathe a cone of cold that does 3d6 cold damage, with a Reflex save of DC 10 + class level + Con modifier for half damage.  You can only use this breath weapon once every 1d4 rounds.
2: Voice of the Dragon +2 - You gain a +2 bonus on Intimidate and Bluff checks.
3: Breath Weapon - 8d4 line of acid
4: Keen Senses - Low-light Vision
5: Breath Weapon - 10d6 cone of acidic gas
6: Immunities - You gain immunity to sleep and paralysis.  In addition, you can choose fire, cold, acid, or electricity, and gain immunity to that element.
Voice of the Dragon +4
7: Breath Weapon - 12d8 line of lightning
8: Keen Senses - Darkvision
Frightful Presence - You can project an aura of fear much like that generated by dragons.  This can be turned off or on at will.
9: Breath Weapon - 14d8 cone of fire
10: Voice of the Dragon +6
Dominate Dragon - Once per day you can attempt to dominate a dragon as the spell Dominate Monster.   The DC is 10 + class level + Cha modifier.

SPELLCASTING
Every other level the Talon of Tiamat gains spells per day and a caster level in an arcane caster class, as if they had leveled in that class.

阿斯塔罗斯，不义堕落者
  
一位从不为自己罪行承担责任的堕落天使，阿斯塔罗斯赋予其召唤者影响他人行为，知晓隐秘之事以及使敌人患病的能力。

契灵等级：4级
绑定DC:22
特殊要求：无

影响：阿斯塔罗斯的影响使你无法为自己的行为承担责任。你无法承认任何过错，承认任何错误，或为任何错误做出补偿或道歉，无论后果如何或证据多么确凿。

授予能力：
阿斯塔罗斯曾指引凡人，他仍然授予基于知识与教育的能力。作为堕落天使，后来又成为契灵，他的魔法变得愈发阴森可怖；他还授予基于直接控制和冒犯他人的力量。

天使学识：阿斯塔罗斯不断在你脑海深处低语现实的秘密，让你能够利用他近乎无限的知识。这使你的学识获得等同于你有效缚灵师等级的加值。

阿斯塔罗斯之息：每5轮一次，你可以呼出一道60尺锥形的恶臭气体。锥形范围内的生物必须通过强韧豁免，否则反胃1轮，并在额外1d4轮内恶心。通过豁免者仅恶心1轮。免疫毒素或疾病的生物免疫此效果。

蜜舌：你在唬骗，说服和威吓检定上获得+4能力加值。

大师工匠：与阿斯塔罗斯绑定时，你在所有手艺检定上获得+4能力加值。此外，每次与阿斯塔罗斯绑定，你可以选择一个物品制造专长作为临时奖励专长。只要你继续与阿斯塔罗斯绑定，你就可以如同正常拥有该专长一般使用它；你仍然必须为你制造的物品支付所有标准金币和XP，并且仍然必须为特定物品提供所有必需的法咒。如果你的有效缚灵师等级未达到获得特定物品制造专长所需的施法者等级，则你不能选择该专长。例如，4级缚灵师不能选择任何需要施法者等级5级或更高的物品制造专长。

阿斯塔罗斯之言：你可以用你闪耀的言语魅惑一个生物。你必须等待5轮才能再次尝试。
src:
Astaroth, Unjustly Fallen
  
A fallen angel who would never accept responsibility for his own transgressions, Astaroth grants his summoners influence over the behavior of others, knowledge of hidden things, and the ability to sicken enemies.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 22
Special Requirement: No

Influence: Astaroth's influence renders you incapable of taking responsibility for your own actions. You cannot admit any fault, acknowledge any mistake, or make reparations or apologies for any wrong, no matter the consequences or the evidence against you.

Granted Abilities: 
Astaroth guided mortals, and he still grants abilities based in knowledge and education. As a fallen angel, and then a vestige, his magics have grown ever grimmer and more distasteful; he also grants powers based on directly controlling and offending others.

Angelic Lore: Astaroth constantly whispers the secrets of reality in the back of your mind, allowing you to draw on his own nigh-infinite knowledge. This grants a bonus to Lore equal to your effective binder level.

Astaroth's Breath: Once every 5 rounds, you can exhale a 60-foot cone of foul-smelling gas. Creatures within the cone must make a Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1 round and sickened for an additional 1d4 rounds. Those who make the save are merely sickened for 1 round. Creatures immune to poison or disease are immune to this effect.

Honeyed Tongue: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Bluff, Persuade, and Intimidate checks.

Master Craftsman: While bound to Astaroth, you gain a +4 competence bonus on all Craft checks. In addition, each time you bind with Astaroth, you may select one item creation feat as a temporary bonus feat. So long as you continue to bind with Astaroth, you may use that feat as though you possessed it normally; you must still spend all standard gold and XP for any item you create, and you must still provide all necessary spells for a given item. If your effective binder level is not at least as high as the necessary caster level to take a specific item creation feat, you cannot choose that feat. For instance, a 4th-level binder could not choose any item creation feat with a prerequisite of caster level 5th or higher.

Word of Astaroth: You may charm a single creature with your glowing words. You must wait 5 rounds before making another attempt.

dst: 这尊神像描绘的是风暴之星科扎，一位早已消亡的神祇，在古代耐瑟瑞尔社会较弱势的阶层中受到崇拜和畏惧。对这位掌管风暴、地震、纷争和叛乱的神祇的崇拜，被该文明的许多强大大法师所禁止。因此，许多科扎神龛和神庙都建在隐秘的地下地点，以便信徒更好地躲避侦查。\n\n当今时代的许多学者认为，科扎是当代神祇塔洛斯的一个化身或别名，后者拥有相似的神职。
src: This idol depicts Kozah the Stormstar, a long-extinct god who was venerated and feared among the less-powerful strata of ancient Netherese society. Worship of this god of storms, earthquakes, strife, and rebellion was outlawed by many of the civilization's powerful archwizards. Many Kozahyn shrines and temples were therefore built in secretive, underground locations where the devout were better able to escape detection.\n\nMany scholars of the present era believe Kozah was an aspect or alias of the modern deity Talos, who has a similar portfolio.

dst: 我清除了旅店里的老鼠，却又遇到了另一个麻烦。显然，住在附近下水道里的一只发狂的鼠人自封为老鼠的保护者，对我的干预很不高兴。他自称瓦古，显然就是他杀死了萨鲁德在地下室放出的猫，还偷走了他的灭鼠药。他宣称，绝不容忍再有人干涉那些想靠旅店储备粮过活的老鼠，还让我把他的警告带给旅店老板。\n\n我说服瓦古喝下了萨鲁德给我的治疗药剂。这治好了他的疯狂，他已经出发去寻找治愈自己兽化症的方法。他不会再给旅店带来麻烦了。我该去找萨鲁德领取报酬。

“欢迎来到卡尼亚，第八层地狱。你应该高兴地得知，我们最近针对像你这样的擅入者采取了新政策。斯纳提拉'查夫'赞领主，卡尼亚的统治者大魔鬼墨菲斯托费利斯将这片领域的控制权委托给了他，以前他乐于让入侵者四处游荡，直到他们最终死于恶劣环境或试图练习战斗技能的巴特兹的攻击。然而最近，你们中的一个趁他不在时溜进了斯纳提拉'查夫'赞领主的要塞，并抢劫了他。因此，我们制定了更有序的程序来处理通过这个传送门的旅行者。”
src: "Welcome to Cania, the Eighth Hell. You should be pleased to learn that we have recently adopted a new policy with regards to trespassers such as yourself.  Lord Snatylar'charv'zen, to whom the Archdevil Mephistopheles, ruler of Cania, has delegated control of this sector of his realm, was formerly amused to let intruders wander about until they eventually succumbed to the elements or to attacks from Baatezu who sought to practice their combat skills. Recently, however, one of your kind managed to slip into Lord Snatylar'charv'zen's fortress while he was away, and robbed him. Hence a more orderly procedure for processing travelers through this portal has been instituted."

独角兽之角

描述符：无
职业：图腾师
脉轮：眉（图腾）
豁免检定：无

你将独角兽纯净的灵魂能量塑造成一根象牙色的角，仿佛从你的额头长出。它的颜色是纯洁无瑕的白色，似乎散发着柔和的蓝白色光芒。它的纯净流入你体内，当角如此靠近你的心智时，很难产生邪恶的念头。

你在动物感受情绪和潜行检定上获得+2能力加值。

魂能：你每投入一点魂能，动物感受情绪和潜行检定的加值增加2。

脉轮绑定（眉）

你的头发中靠近独角兽之角的地方出现一道白色条纹，你的眼睛颜色改变--变成深海蓝，紫罗兰色或炽热的金色。

你获得每轮一次以标准动作侦测邪恶的能力。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

一簇白发从你的额头垂下，环绕着你的独角兽之角，同时你的额头本身略微增厚以支撑所承载的角。你所有的头发变成倾泻的白色鬃毛，如果你是男性，下巴会长出白胡须。你能感觉到纯净和能量通过你的角流入身体。

你可以用独角兽之角作为天生武器进行抵撞，造成1d6点伤害。你在角的攻击检定和伤害检定上获得增强加值，数值等于你投入其中的魂能点数。如果你用角攻击命中不死生物，你额外造成1d6点伤害。
src:
Unicorn Horn

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Brow (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You shape the pure soul energy of a unicorn into an ivory-colored horn that seems to sprout from your forehead. Its color is an unblemished white, and it seems to glow with a soft blue-white radiance. Its purity flows into you, and it is difficult to conceive of an evil thought with the horn so close to your mind.

You gain a +2 competence bonus on Animal Empathy and Move Silently checks. 

Essentia: Your bonus on Animal Empathy and Move Silently checks increases by 2 for every point of invested essentia. 

Chakra Bind (Brow) 

A streak of white appears in your hair near the unicorn horn, and your eyes change color-becoming deep sea-blue, violet, or fiery gold.

You gain the ability to detect evil once per round as a standard action. 

Chakra Bind (Totem)

A tuft of white hair hangs down from your forehead around your unicorn horn, while your forehead itself thickens somewhat to support the horn it bears. All of your hair transforms into a cascading white mane, and if you are male a white beard sprouts from your chin. You can feel purity and energy flowing into your body through your horn.

You can gore with the unicorn horn as a natural weapon that deals 1d6 points of damage. You gain an enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with your horn equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in it. If you hit an undead creature with your horn attack, you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage.

dst:
暗影披风

描述符：黑暗
职业：图腾师
脉轮：肩部（图腾）
豁免检定：无

魂能形成一件粗糙的灰石色斗篷，环绕在你的肩膀和背部。当你移动时，斗篷在你身后扭动，暗示着触手的运动。它似乎能收集暗影，总是显得比周围区域更暗。

引导暗影披风强大盲视的微弱暗示，你在聆听检定上获得 +4 能力加值。

魂能：你投入到暗影披风中的每一点魂能都会使聆听检定上的能力加值增加 2。

脉轮绑定（肩部）

你披风的暗影加深，颜色变得更暗。黑暗似乎附着在每一个褶皱中，有时从披风的物质中飘散成缕。你开始听到大多数人无法察觉的高频声音，偶尔也能听到低频声音。

作为一个迅捷动作，你可以用魔法黑暗球体包围自己，并获得紫外视觉的好处。你可以作为一个迅捷动作结束黑暗效果；结束黑暗效果也会结束你的紫外视觉。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

你的暗影披风实际上将暗影吸引到自身，并改变颜色以匹配你的周围环境。你发现通过将斗篷裹在身上并将头缩进其膜状领口中，更容易隐藏自己。

你在躲藏检定上获得的能力加值等于魂能融合在聆听检定上提供的加值（+4 加上每点投入魂能额外 +2）.
src:
Shadow Mantle

Descriptors: Darkness  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Shoulders (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms a rough cloak of stony gray around your shoulders and back. As you move, the cloak writhes behind you, suggesting the movement of tentacles. It seems to collect shadow, always appearing darker than the surrounding area.

Channeling the merest suggestion of a darkmantle's powerful blindsight, you gain a +4 competence bonus on Listen checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your shadow mantle increases the competence bonus on Listen checks by 2. 

Chakra Bind (Shoulders) 

The shadows of your mantle deepen, and its coloration grows darker. Blackness seems to cling in every fold and sometimes trail off in wisps from the mantle's substance. You start to hear sounds too high for most humans to detect, and occasionally sounds too low, as well.

As a swift action, you can surround yourself with a globe of magical darkness and gain the benefits of ultravision. You can end the darkness effect as a swift action; ending the darkness effect also ends your ultravision. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your shadow mantle literally draws shadows to itself, and it changes color to match your surroundings. You find it much easier to hide from view by drawing the cloak around your body and ducking your head into its membranous collar.

You gain a competence bonus on Hide checks equal to the bonus the soulmeld grants on Listen checks (+4 plus an additional +2 per point of invested essentia).

dst: 施法：随着你获得更多等级，你将继续在你所选择的施法领域接受训练。你每天获得新的法咒，已知法咒，并且施法者等级提升，如同你在任何包含治疗轻伤在其法咒列表中的施法职业上也获得了一个等级，前提是你之前属于该职业。然而，你不会获得该职业角色本应获得的任何其他职业特性。这基本上意味着你将战地医生的等级加到你所拥有的任何符合条件的施法职业等级上，然后据此确定每日法咒和施法者等级。如果你在成为战地医生之前拥有多个符合条件的施法职业，你必须决定将战地医生的等级加到哪个职业上，以确定每日法咒，已知法咒和施法者等级。
src: Spellcasting: As you attain more levels, you continue your training in your chosen spellcasting field. You get new spells per day, spells known, and an increase in caster level as if you had also gained a level in any one spellcasting class that includes cure light wounds on its spell list, provided you belonged to that class previously. You do not, however, gain any other class feature a character of that class would have gained. This essentially means that you add the level of combat medic to the level of whatever eligible spellcasting class you have, and then determine spells per day and caster levels accordingly.  If you had more than one eligible spellcasting class before becoming a combat medic, you must decide to which class you add levels of combat medic for the purposes of determining spells per day, spells known, and caster level.

“你了解我。我言出必行，我的生活就像一本打开的书。”
- 半精灵欺愚者 Anastria Nailo 面无表情地说道

有些人认为诚实是最大的恩赐，但它可能比虚构造成更大的伤害。每个人都生活在不断的欺骗中。善意的谎言，虚假的微笑和秘密的想法让社会顺利运转。诚实只是一种恩赐，直到某个程度。欺愚者比任何人都更了解这些想法，他们像士兵使用战争武器一样熟练地使用欺骗，误解和秘密。

欺愚者将撒谎和操纵视为工具。就像锤子可以用来建造房屋或砸碎头骨一样，欺骗和控制他人的能力可以用于善或恶。在正确的耳朵里低语一个谎言可以毁掉生命，但一个不诚实的微笑和甜言蜜语可以打开大门，化敌为友，甚至结束战争。欺愚者有着浪子，小偷，间谍和傀儡大师的名声，但他们也可以是外交官，和平缔造者或在绝望情况下给予希望的英雄领袖。

如果你喜欢操纵他人，无论是为了他们的不利还是为了他们自己的好处，那么欺愚者就是适合你的职业。比其他任何类型的角色都更依赖基于魅力的技能来改变他人的反应，而你的其他职业能力使你能够用毁灭性的法咒攻击让其他人措手不及。

(BASE CLASS)
"You know me. I'm as good as my word, and my life is an open book."
- said with a straight face by Anastria Nailo, half-elf beguiler

Some hold truth to be the greatest virtue, but it can do more damage than fiction. Everyone lives in a constant state of deception. White lies, false smiles, and secret thoughts keep society running smoothly. Honesty is a virtue only up to a certain point. Beguilers understand these ideas better than anyone, and they use deception, misunderstanding, and secrets as skillfully as a soldier employs weapons of war.

Beguilers see lying and manipulation as tools. Just as a hammer can be used to build a house or crack a skull, deceit and the ability to control others can be used for good or ill. A lie whispered in the right ear can ruin lives, but a dishonest smile and honeyed words can open doors, turn foes into friends, and even end wars. Beguilers have reputations as rakes, thieves, spies, and puppet masters, but they can also be diplomats, peacemakers, or heroic leaders who give hope in desperate situations.

If you delight in manipulating others, either to their disadvantage or for their own good, then the beguiler is the class for you. More than any other kind of character, you rely on Charisma-based skills to change the reactions of others, while your other class abilities enable you to catch others off guard with devastating spell-based attacks.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: Beguilers are proficient with all simple weapons plus the rapier, shortbow, and short sword. Beguilers are proficient with light armor, but not with shields.
- Skill Points: 6 + Int Modifier

CLASS FEATURES:

  2: Cloaked casting (+1 DC), surprise casting

SPELLCASTING

A beguiler casts arcane spells, which are drawn from the beguiler spell list. When you gain access to a new level of spells, you automatically know all the spells for that level on the beguiler's spell list. You can cast any spell you know without preparing it ahead of time. Essentially, your spell list is the same as your spells known list. You also have the option of adding to your existing spell list through your advanced learning class feature as you increase in level.

To cast a beguiler spell, you must have an Intelligence score of 10 + the spell's level (Int 10 for 0-level spells, Int 11 for 1st-level spells, and so forth). The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a beguiler's spell is 10 + the spell's level + the beguiler's Int modifier. Like other spellcasters, a beguiler can cast only a certain number of spells of each spell level per day. The base daily spell allotment is given on the accompanying table. In addition, you receive bonus spells for a high Intelligence score.

A beguiler need not prepare spells in advance. You can cast any spell you know at any time, assuming you have not yet used up your spells per day for that spell level.

（进阶职业）
并非所有龙族秘密都与魔法有关。 除了广为人知的色彩龙和金属龙真龙之外，还有宝石龙类。 这些水晶与思维之兽更倾向于中立，精通心智之力而非奥术力量。 正如贤者认为更知名的龙族最先掌握奥术魔法一样，心灵异能学者认为宝石龙最先解锁了心智的巨大潜能。 其中最勇敢者研究宝石龙与心灵异能之间的联系，学习利用他们所称的“龙族心灵异能集合体”.  他们视自己为从心灵异能龙族能量中汲取力量，并以最稀有的宝石命名，自称钻石龙类。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长：钻石龙不获得额外擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

技能：学识3级。
显能：必须能够显能3级异能。
基础攻击加值：+3。
阵营：任意中立。

职业特性：

等级
1：龙族强化 - 钻石龙可以选择获得力量，敏捷或体质+1，以变得更像龙类。
免疫睡眠和麻痹 - 通过汲取宝石龙的精神力量，钻石龙能够克服魔法睡眠和麻痹效果。
2：引导龙爪 - 钻石龙可以引导宝石龙的力量形成爪子。 这些爪子消耗1点心灵异能点，持续每显能者等级1分钟。 每2点强化获得魔法+1加值，最高+5。
4：心灵异能喷吐武器 - 钻石龙可以显能类似各种龙的喷吐武器。 它消耗5点心灵异能点，造成寒冷，电击，火焰或音波伤害，由显能者选择，范围为30英尺锥形，或电击为60英尺线形。 豁免DC为10 + 职业等级 + 智力调整值，并且你可以每点强化增加一个伤害骰。
5：龙族强化
6：引导龙翼 - 消耗7点心灵异能点，显能者可以创造心灵异能能量之翼，持续每显能者等级1分钟，并给予跳跃+10。
8：引导龙尾 - 消耗9点心灵异能点，显能者可以创造心灵异能能量之龙尾，持续每显能者等级1分钟。 每2点强化获得魔法+1加值，最高+5。
10：龙族强化
心灵异能恐惧存在 - 消耗11点心灵异能点，显能者可以投射类似龙创造的恐惧存在光环。 通常持续5轮，但每点强化可延长1轮。

奖励显能

达到2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9和10级时，钻石龙获得新的显能者等级，增加其心灵异能点，已知异能和最大异能等级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Not all draconic secrets are about magic.  In addition to the well-known chromatic and metallic true dragons, there are the gem dragons.  Clinging more closely to neutrality, these beasts of crystal and thought are masters of the power of the mind, rather than of arcane forces.  Much as sages believe the better-known dragons were the first to harness arcane magic, psionic scholars think the gem dragons were the first to unlock the vast potential of the mind.  The boldest of them study the link between gem dragons and psionics, learning to tap into what they refer to as the "draconic psionic collective."  They see themselves as drawing power from psionic dragon energy and call themselves diamond dragons, after the rarest of gemstones.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Diamond Dragon gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Lore 3 ranks.
Manifesting: Must be able to manifest 3rd level powers.
Base Attack Bonus: +3.
Alignment: Any Neutral.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Dragon Augmentation - The Diamond Dragon can choose to gain a +1 in either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution as they work to become more dragonlike.
Immunity to Sleep and Paralysis - By drawing on the mental powers of gem dragons, Diamond Dragons are able to overcome magical sleep and paralyzation effects.
2: Channel Dragon Claws - The Diamond Dragon can channel the power of gem dragons to form claws.  These claws costs 1 power point and last one minute per manifester level.  For each 2 points of augmentation they gain a magical +1 bonus, to a maximum of +5.
4: Psionic Breath Weapon - The Diamond Dragon can manifest a breath weapon similar to those of various dragons.  It costs 5 power points and deals cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage as chosen by the manifester in a 30 foot cone, or 60 foot line for electricity.  The save DC is 10 + Class Level + Int modifier, and you can increase the damage by one die for every point of augmentation.
5: Dragon Augmentation
6: Channel Dragon Wings - For 7 power points, the manifester can create wings of psionic energy lasting one minute per manifester level, and granting a +10 to jump.
8: Channel Dragon Tail - For 9 power points, the manifester can create a dragon tail made of psionic energy lasting one minute per manifester level.  For each 2 points of augmentation it gains a magical +1 bonus, to a maximum of +5.
10: Dragon Augmentation
Psionic Frightful Presence - For 11 power points the manifester can project a frightful presence aura similar to those created by dragons.  It lasts for 5 rounds normally, but can be extended by 1 round for each point of augmentation.

BONUS MANIFESTING

Upon reaching levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, and 10 the Diamond Dragon gains a new manifester level, increasing his power points, powers known, and maximum power level.

src: "Somewhere deep in the vault there's a magical orb pumping out a steady supply of negative energy to most of the guardians here. It will heal any wounds you inflict on them, and maybe blast anyone in their vicinity as well. I would advise just sneaking past them and not trying to fight. Probably no chance of destroying them, unless you could find the orb and destroy or deactivate it somehow. I don't know where it's hidden away though. You'll still have a chance against me, though. I'm too far away, or not attuned to the orb, or something. Maybe Gorzhun just didn't like me so he left me out of its effects as a punishment? Don't know."

在扎泽斯普尔下方的下水道中，我遇到了一位名叫贾尔凯西·扎鲁的冒险者，随后一路杀穿了一个蛇人藏身处，将她从陷阱中救出。据她说，蛇人来到这里是为了在城下更深处矮人沙纳塔的废墟中寻找某件有价值的东西。她不知道他们在寻找什么，但如果它重要到值得付出如此努力，那么无论它是什么，落入这些可疑之人手中都绝非好事。附近有一条向下通往这些废墟的道路，无疑有更多蛇人把守。我决定陪她一起沿这条路前进，挫败蛇人的计划。该下去了。

看来蛇人来到这里是为了重新打开一道通往深渊的传送门，这道门是矮人很久以前发现并封印的。自然，阻止他们这样做是明智的，或者如果我们来不及阻止它被打开，就设法关闭传送门。矮人的一些铭文表明，传送门由位于传送门另一侧深渊中一座塔内的某种魔法维持开启，而矮人存放在一个“谜题室”中的钥匙或许能帮助我们进入那里。

我们一路杀入了深渊中的那座塔，并摧毁了一颗显然对维持传送门稳定至关重要的魔法宝珠。这应该能阻止一场大规模的恶魔入侵，并挫败蛇人的计划。现在我们只需在传送门关闭前离开。
src:
In the sewers beneath Zazesspur, I came across an adventurer named Jalkesi Tzaru, and then fought through a Yuan-Ti hideout to free her from a trap. According to her, the Yuan-Ti are here to seek out something of value in some ruins of dwarven Shanatar that can be found further beneath the city. She does not know what they seek, but if it is important enough to be worth such effort, it can hardly be desirable for whatever it might be to fall into such dubious hands. A path leading down and eventually to these ruins lies nearby, doubtless guarded by additional Yuan-Ti. I have decided to accompany her as she seeks to follow this path and foil the plans of the Yuan-Ti. Time to head down.

It appears that the Yuan-Ti are here to reopen a portal to the Abyss that the dwarves uncovered, but then sealed, long ago. Naturally it would be desirable to prevent them from doing this, or somehow close the portal if we are too late to prevent it from being uncovered. Some inscriptions of the dwarves suggest that the portal is kept open by some magic located in a tower in the Abyss on the far side of the portal, and that a key stored by the dwarves in a "Puzzle Room" might aid us in entering it.

We have fought our way into the tower in the Abyss, and destroyed a magical orb that was apparently important in keeping the portal stable. This should prevent a major demonic incursion and frustrate the plans of the Yuan-ti. Now we only need to get out before the portal closes.

src:
The Temple of Tyr has dispatched a group of clerics and paladins into the sewers beneath the temple district in an attempt to fight the newly aggressive wererats causing trouble there. They have yet to report back. Adaras Efzen, a high-ranking cleric in the Temple of Tyr, has asked me to enter the sewers and determine what has happened to them, assisting them if necessary. Ferazha, priestess at the temple of Shar, wants me to follow in their wake, determine their fate, and insure that none of them make it out of the sewer alive. I will have to decide whether I wish to assist these Tyrrans or kill them.

The entire party of Tyrrans dispatched to the sewers has met its end. This has been reported to Adaras, who gave me a small reward for the information. Ferazha still needs to hear of this, and will doubtless be happy to do so.

dst: “很久以前，我就被自己恶魔本性所激起的欲望吓坏了，但发现抵抗它们绝非易事。像饥饿的人渴望食物一样渴望他人的痛苦和死亡，同时又足够人性化地意识到这些冲动有多么卑劣……这绝不是什么舒适的生活。如果不是我发现了伊尔梅特的信仰，我确实早就迷失了。它使我能够在我处境必然带来的痛苦和挫折中找到意义，认识到侍奉他人比满足自己的欲望更重要，并且通过其苦修实践中严格的纪律，它给了我控制邪恶冲动的手段。”
src: "I was long ago horrified by the desires my demonic nature inspired, but found it no easy matter to resist them. To yearn for the suffering and death of others like a starving man yearns for food, while still being human enough to realize how vile these impulses were...it was by no means a comfortable existence. Were it not for my discovery of the Ilmaterian faith, I would have been lost indeed. It enabled me to find meaning in the sufferings and frustrations my situation inevitably entails, to realize that service to others is more important than satisfying my own desires, and, through the rigid discipline of its ascetical practices, it gave me the means to control my evil impulses."

对于传奇心灵神术师而言，信仰与思维之间的界限不过是一层轻易便可刺穿的面纱。他们以无缝的和谐驾驭神术奇迹与心灵之力，是超凡目的活体导管。他们的祈祷回荡着灵能之力，而他们的灵能则由神术洞察所引导。这些罕见的远见者立于意志与奇迹的交汇点，开辟出一条没有任何法咒或力量无法触及的道路。

生命骰：d4
每额外等级技能点：2 + 智力调整值
奖励专长：传奇心灵神术师每六级获得一个奖励专长。

特殊：
施法：每提升一个职业等级，传奇心灵神术师的神术施法者等级（以及已知法咒，如适用）继续提升。
显能：每提升一个职业等级，传奇心灵神术师的显能者等级（以及已知异能，如适用）继续提升。

传奇心灵神术师奖励专长列表：
护甲皮肤，自动法术瞬发，自动法术默发，自动法术定发，致盲速度，传奇神能，传奇神盾，传奇神术抗力，传奇神术活力术，传奇能量抗力，传奇施法，传奇法术专攻，传奇法术穿透，专攻法术穿透，高等魅力，高等智力，高等感知，精通战斗施法，祈求神怒，跨位面驱散，传奇灵能专长，顽强法咒，操控死域。
src:
To the epic Psychic Theurge, the boundary between faith and thought is a veil easily pierced. Wielding divine miracles and mental might in seamless harmony, they are living conduits of transcendent purpose. Their prayers echo with psionic force, and their psionic power is guided by divine insight. These rare visionaries stand at the nexus of will and wonder, forging a path where no spell nor power is beyond reach.

Hit Die: d4
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Psychic Theurge gains a bonus feat every six levels.

Special:
Spellcasting: At each class level the epic Psychic Theurge continues to increase in divine caster level (and spells known, if applicable).
Manifesting: At each class level the epic Psychic Theurge continues to increase in manifester level (and powers known, if applicable).

Epic Psychic Theurge Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Epic Divine Might, Epic Divine Sheild, Epic Divine Resistance, Epic Divine Vigor, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Focused Spell Penetration, Great Charisma, Great Intelligence, Great Wisdom, Improved Combat Casting, Invoke Divine Wrath, Planar Turning, Epic Psionic Feats, Tenacious Magic, Zone Of Animation.

dst: 这个箱子上刻着一个复杂的迷宫，起点处有一个奇怪的装置，你发现它可以沿着构成迷宫的凹槽移动。你认为要打开箱子，必须解决迷宫，将这个可移动的装置从起点带到终点。然而，稍加试验很快就发现了一个问题：一旦你进入迷宫一段距离，握住装置就会开始给你带来一种奇怪的、魔法引发的疼痛，越接近终点就越严重。此外，当疼痛变得太剧烈，迫使你松开装置时，它会弹回迷宫的起点，迫使你重新开始。要将它带到迷宫终点并打开箱子并不容易。
src: Engraved into this chest is a complex maze, with an odd fixture at its starting point, which you discover can be moved along the grooves forming the maze. You assume that, to open the chest, the maze must be solved, by bringing this movable fixture through it to the end. However, a little experimentation soon reveals a problem: Once you get a little way into the maze, holding on to the fixture starts to cause you a strange, magically induced pain, that gets worse as you get closer to the end. Furthermore, when this pain becomes too much and forces you to release your hold on the fixture, it will shoot back to the starting point of the maze, forcing you to begin again. It will not be easy to bring it to the end of the maze and open the chest.

src: "Well, he comes into town occasionally, but I haven't seen him for a while. Like I said, he's a ranger or something like that so he apparently lives out in the wilderness. You might want to talk to some of the people he sells healing services too. Presumably they have some way of finding or contacting him. Come to think of it, Farmer Hodgent was just in here recently, and talking about how much cheaper it was to get cures and such from Frago than the temple. He's a guy who operates a farm in the general region, but still a good ways off from the town, so I don't see him all that often. He said he was going to check out the Fair though, so maybe you can find him there?" He briefly describes the farmer.

dst: 当我接近行军山脉中的阿哈兹堡时，我遇到了一位从那里赶来的信使，带来了可怕的消息：这座堡垒正被炽焰斧部落的兽人部落及其食人魔盟友围攻。我恐怕无法突破围困线抵达堡垒，所以如果我想在这里做点有用的事，最好在兽人大军的侧翼行动，可以沿西边的附近河流或东边的森林前往，袭击巡逻队和外围部队。我也许还能向北前进，突袭兽人最初出发的洞穴，因为大多数兽人都离开了洞穴，聚集在堡垒周围。这应该会促使兽人主力派出分遣队来追捕我，或许能削弱他们到足以打破围困的程度。\n\n在兽人部落的侧翼以及他们后方的洞穴中行动，我杀死了许多敌人，并大大扰乱了他们的围困。很可能围攻的兽人已经被削弱到足以让我尝试直接向他们推进，或许还能抵达堡垒。
src: As I was approaching Fort Akhaz in the Marching Mountains, I came across a messenger traveling from there with dire news: the fort is being besieged by a horde of orcs of the Blazing Axes tribe and their ogre allies. It is doubtful that I could break through the siege cordon to reach the fort, so if I am to do anything useful here it would be best to operate on the flanks of the orc army, reached either by traveling along the nearby river to the west or the woods to the east, attacking patrols and outlying forces. I also might be able to make my way to the north and raid the caves the orcs came from in the first place, with most of them absent and around the fort. This should induce the main orc army to send out detachments to try to hunt me down, and perhaps weaken it enough that the siege could be broken.\n\nOperating on the flanks of the orc horde, and in the caves to their rear, I have slain many and done much to disrupt their siege. It may well be that the besieging orcs have been sufficiently weakened for me to attempt moving on them directly, and perhaps reaching the fort.

dst: "要成为一名有成就的武僧，需要心与身两方面的训练，这两者我都会讲到。我会布置若干练习，帮你养成必要的思维习惯，每项练习之后都跟上体能锻炼与战斗训练。我们先说心：武僧的一生是献身于戒律、受规矩约束的一生。本质的心境是超脱——超脱于物质财产，超脱于安逸舒适的生活，也超脱于自己的欲望与目的。真正的武僧不会让<him/her>自己为这些事分心，只专注于<his/her>教团的目标。"
src: "To become an accomplished monk requires training of both mind and body, and I shall address both. I shall assign several exercises to help develop the necessary habits of thought, and follow each with physical exercise and combat training. Let us first address the mind: the life of a monk is one devoted to discipline, regulated by rule. The essential state of mind is one of detachment, detachment from material possessions, from a life of ease and comfort, and from our own desires and purposes. The true monk concerns <him/her>self with none of these things, being focused solely on the goals of <his/her> order."

src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found and rescued Schnella Shadowsneaker, who was being held captive in a Mind-Flayer stronghold. According to her, Frebo Fisher and Taxevek Steelhand were captured along with her, but perished in gladiatorial combats in which the Mind Flayers forced them to participate. I also found Zeblip Ironfoot deep in the stronghold of an Aboleth. Unfortunately, he had been transformed into a mind-controlled slave and we were forced to slay him. At least his fate has been discovered. 2 Svirfneblin remain unaccounted for.

src: "We have defeated the plans of this unfortunate fallen paladin. I sensed that this altar was the source of the expanding barrier of negative energy that we came to stop. This, no doubt, is where whatever dark magical ritual unleashed this horror was performed. Wtih the altar's destruction, I believe it is only a matter of time before the barrier begins to contract and fade away. Our quest may be considered complete, and your aid much appreciated. Soon I shall need to go report to the temple, while you no doubt need to return to your own business. Shall we return at once to my camp below the temple, where we can part ways, or do you wish to continue exploring these halls?"

src:
Type of Feat: Shadowcasting
Prerequisite: Noctumancer 2
Specifics: Starting at 2nd level, you can attempt to counter the next spell the target casts without expending an action. You must identify the spell (Spellcraft 15 + spell level), then expend a spell slot (if you prepare spells), or a spell use (if you are a spontaneous caster) of the same level as the spell to be countered. 

At 7th level, when you successfully counter a spell using this ability, you retain some of the magical essence of the countered dweomer. You gain one additional use of a mystery. The level of the mystery you gain is equal to one-half the level of the spell you countered (rounded down, minimum 1). 

You can use innate counterspell once per day at 2nd level, two times at 5th, and three times at 8th. 
Use: Selected.

src:
An epic totem rager is the living embodiment of primal fury and spiritual instinct. At this level, rage and soulmeld are no longer separate forces, they are one. Her body channels the raw power of magical beasts, while her spirit roars with ancestral might. As she charges into battle, the ground trembles and the air thickens with incarnum, a visible aura of bestial power surrounding her.

Hit Die: d10.
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Intelligence modifier.
Bonus Feats: The epic Totem Rager gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:
Meldshaping: Meldshaper level increases as if gaining a level in your meldshaper class at each totem rager class level.

Epic Totem Rager Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Bonus Soulmeld, Devastating Critical, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Essentia, Epic Prowess, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Extra Chakra Bind, Fast Healing, Legendary Wrestler, Mighty Rage, Open Heart Chakra, Open Soul Chakra, Overwhelming Critical, Rapid Meldshaping, Rebind Soulmeld, Terrifying Rage, Thundering Rage.

dst: 一支在楚尔特丛林中探险的卡林杉探险队与一支原住民突袭队发生了冲突，尽管他们的武器原始，却打了一场出色的战斗。尽管遭遇了意外的困难，卡林杉人最终还是取得了胜利，他们检查了敌人的武器，发现这些武器被施予了强大的魔法。队伍中的少数成员被指派将这些珍贵的武器带回海岸，最终运往卡林港的市场，但探险队的大部分人继续深入丛林，希望能找到赋予这些长棍和类似粗糙武器魔力的源头，以为这样能让他们更加富有。此后他们便杳无音信。
src: A Calimshan expedition exploring the jungles of Chult clashed with a native raiding party who put up a remarkable fight despite the primitive nature of their weapons. Ultimately victorious despite the unexpected difficulty, the Calishites investigated the weapons of their foes and found them to be heavily enchanted. A few members of the group were charged with the task of taking these valuable weapons back to the coast and eventually on to the markets of Calimport, but the bulk of the expedition pressed on into the jungle in the hope of finding the source of whatever magic had empowered the staves and similar crude weapons found, assuming this would enrich them even further. They were never heard from again.

心智试炼

武僧力求完善身体、心智与灵魂。尽管在实践中身体可能最受重视，但武僧也不应完全缺乏智慧。

在附近的箱子里，你会发现各种物品。将其中恰好两件物品分别放入这个房间里的每个瓮中。每一对物品都应被选择来共同象征武僧在训练过程中学到的某种精通技艺。将通常最早在训练和实践中掌握的才能的象征物放入第1个瓮中，将接下来会学到的第2项技艺放入下一个瓮中，依此类推。如果所有瓮中都装有正确的一对物品，就可以使用拉杆打开远端的门并继续前进。
src:
Test of Mind

The monk strives to perfect body, mind and soul. While the body may get the most attention in practice, a monk should still not be wholly devoid of wit.

In the chest nearby, you will find various objects. Place precisely two of these objects in each of the urns in this room. Each pair should be chosen to together symbolize some feat of mastery learned by monks in the course of their training. Place the symbols for the talent one ordinarily masters earliest in training and practice in the 1st urn, the 2nd feat that would be learned in the next, and so forth. If all urns contain the correct pair, the lever may be used to open the door at the far end and proceed.

src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found pieces of the mutilated body of Kezib Coalcutter, who was apparently captured and tortured to death by a party of Drow. 5 Svirfneblin remain unaccounted for.

src:
Ascended beyond mortal constraints, the Epic Sapphire Hierarch becomes an avatar of perfect order, an unyielding force against the encroaching tide of chaos. Guided by the will of the Sapphire Eidolon, these champions refine their meldshaping, divine magic, and unwavering discipline to an absolute pinnacle. 

Hit Die: d8
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Sapphire Hierarch gains a bonus feat every five levels

Special:
Damage Reduction: Increases by 1 every three class levels.
Caster Level: Increases as if gaining a level in your divine spellcasting class.
Meldshaping: At each Sapphire Hierarch level after 10th, you increase your meldshaper level, the number of soulmelds you can shape, the number of chakra binds you can create, and your essentia pool as if you had gained a level in a meldshaping class to which you belonged prior to gaining the soulcaster level. You do not, however, gain any other abilities of that class, such as new tiers of chakra binds.

Epic Sapphire Hierarch Bonus Feat List:
Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Bonus Soulmeld, Epic Divine Might, Epic Divine Resistance, Epic Divine Shield, Epic Divine Vigor, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Essentia, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Extra Chakra Bind, Focused Spell Penetration, Great Charisma, Great Intelligence, Great Smiting, Great Wisdom, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Open Heart Chakra, Open Soul Chakra, Planar Turning, Rapid Meldshaping, Rebind Soulmeld, Tenacious Magic.

As a full-round action, he can change his mind blade to replicate a longsword (damage 1d8) or a bastard sword (damage 1d10, but he must wield it as a two-handed weapon unless he knows the Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat).
 Alternatively, a soulknife can split his mind blade into two identical short swords, suitable for fighting with a weapon in each hand. (The normal penalties for fighting with two weapons apply.) src: I have met with Zagash the Terrible, a lich who I discovered occupying a room at the Desert Dragon Inn, of all places. He had an interesting offer to make me. Apparently the aranea who are seemingly orchestrating a war against Calimshan somehow discovered his phylactery. They have used their control of it to weaken Zagash and reduce his power, and intend to use the threat of destroying it (and therefore him) for good to blackmail him into serving their cause. Zagash however has no intention of letting them order him around and has conceived a plan to travel in disguise with a group of adventurers to fight against them. As a result, he is prepared to join with me on my quests outside the city to fight the various humanoid allies of the aranea.\n\nWhile I expect Zagash would be a valuable ally, and wanted to accept his offer, not everyone in my party was willing to work with such a creature. I may have to ask some of them to leave first.

dst:
在杀穿塔拉孔达祖姆的堡垒时，我发现了一些信息，或许有助于解救他的囚犯并进入他的宝库。我找到的一张字条上写着：

“虽然方尖碑几乎坚不可摧，但每一座都易受某一种特定元素伤害的破坏，具体类型因碑而异。但愿任何攻击者都不会碰巧找对类型、未能将其破坏，便认定无法可施。此外，它们能否抵挡神祇之力也值得怀疑，尽管这一点尚未得到验证。如果方尖碑被摧毁，那根石柱也会随之变得脆弱。倘若三根石柱都被摧毁，那么关押囚犯的密室便可进入。一旦进入其中，便可解除魔法屏障外那最后一根石柱。若真如此，他便能再次自由地将腐化散播四方。还有最后一道守卫，只可惜这道守卫极不可靠。通往最后一根石柱的道路并不明显，很可能需要信念与勇气才能踏上。我们只能指望那些企图释放囚犯的恶徒缺乏这些美德。”

另一张字条上写着：

“通往我们主人宝藏的大门由五座金属龙雕像守卫。要解封大门，需对每座雕像施放两个法术，分别代表该种龙所拥有的每一种吐息武器。两个法术必须按正确顺序施放，每座雕像也必须按正确顺序激活。要记住这个顺序，请严格遵守以下箴言：‘最先者将居末，最后者将居首。’”

上述两项任务均已完成，此信息已不再重要。
src:
While fighting my way through Tarakondazum's keep, I found some information that might prove useful in freeing his prisoner and gaining access to his hoard. One note I found reads:

"While the obelisks are almost indestructible, each is vulnerable to a single type of elemental damage, the specific type varying with each one. Hopefully any attacker will not stumble on the correct type, fail to damage them, and assume there is no way to do so. In addition, it is doubtful if any could stand up against the power of a god, though this has not been tested. If the obelisks are destroyed, the pillar will become vulnerable as well. If somehow all three pillars are destroyed, then the chamber containing the prisoner could be entered. Once within, one could deactivate the final pillar just outside the magical barriers. Should that happen, he will once more be free to spread his corruption everywhere. There is one final guard, if unfortunately a very unreliable one. The path to the final pillar is not obvious, and might well require faith and courage to tread. We may hope any evildoers seeking the prisoner's freedom will lack these virtues."

Another note reads:

"The door to our lord's treasure is gaurded by five statues of metallic dragons. To unseal the door, cast on each statue two spells, one representing each breath weapon that type of dragon possesses. The two spells must be cast in the correct order, and each statue must also be activated in the correct order. To remember this order, strictly adhere to the following maxim: 'The first shall be last and the last shall be first.'"

With both the above tasks accomplished, this information is no longer relevant.

日精灵，或称金精灵，以其对奥术和神术魔法的精通而闻名，超越了任何其他现存的种族。数千年前精灵高等魔法的造物至今仍存留在日精灵隐秘的避难所中。日精灵拥有古铜色的皮肤，金色，铜色或黑色的头发，以及绿色或金色的眼睛。他们偏爱沉思，学识和研究，而非其他精灵的轻快游戏和轻松歌曲，但似乎体现了精灵族超凡脱俗的美丽，恩典和气质。

日精灵属性调整：+2 智力，-2 体质。
天赋职业（法师）：在判断兼职日精灵是否遭受兼职经验值惩罚时，其法师职业不计入其中。

特殊能力：

- 无眠：免疫'睡眠'子类型的法咒和效果。
- 附魔坚韧：对抗影响心智的法咒时豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 额外武器熟练（长剑，细剑，短弓，长弓）
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（侦察）：侦察检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 敏锐感官：日精灵自动进行主动搜索检定，且没有移动惩罚。
- 微光视觉：使他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 精灵：就法咒而言，日精灵被视为精灵。
src:
Sun elves, or gold elves, are famed for their command of both arcane and divine magic, which exceeds that of any other living race. Works of elven high magic thousands of years old still survive in the hidden refuges of sun elves. Sun elves have bronze skin, hair of golden blond, copper or black, and eyes of green or gold. They favor contemplation, lore and study over the quick games and light-hearted songs of other elves, but seem to embody the unearthly beauty, grace and presence of elven folk.

Sun Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Int, -2 Con.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass sun elf's wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Bonus Proficiencies (Longsword, Rapier, Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Sun Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Sun Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

增幅：你可以通过以下一种或多种方式增幅此异能。
1. 如果你额外花费 6 点异能点，此异能将你的体型增加两个体型类别而非一个。你获得 +4 体型加值到力量，-4 体型减值到敏捷（有效敏捷值最低为 1）, -2 体型减值到攻击检定，以及由于体型增加而获得的 -2 体型减值到防御等级。

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psychic warrior 1
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round./level
Power Points: 1
Metapsionics: Extend

This power causes instant growth, doubling your height, length, and width and multiplying your weight by 8. This increase changes your size category to the next larger one. You gain a +2 size bonus to Strength, a -2 size penalty to Dexterity (to a minimum effective Dexterity score of 1), a -1 size penalty on attack rolls, and a -1 size penalty to Armor Class due to your increased size.

This power doesn't change your speed.

Multiple effects that increase size do not stack, which means (among other things) that you can't use a second manifestation of this power to further expand yourself.

Augment: You can augment this power in one or more of the following ways.
1. If you spend 6 additional power points, this power increases your size by two size categories instead of one. You gain a +4 size bonus to Strength, a -4 size penalty to Dexterity (to a minimum effective Dexterity score of 1), a -2 size penalty on attack rolls, and a -2 size penalty to Armor Class due to your increased size.
2. If you spend 2 additional power points, this power's duration is 10 minutes per level rather than 1 round per level.

dst: 扎拉拉和我逃离了加尔哈德尔庄园，穿过下水道前往一个码头，据说那里有一艘友好的船在等我们。虽然我们眼前的目的地是这艘船“瓦尔库尔之剑”所前往的地方，但扎拉拉认为我们最终应该设法进入烛堡的大图书馆。烛堡内有一本学者达尔泽斯·谢马尔所著的书，其中包含了关于泽法德之剑最完整的信息。扎拉拉相信这本书能让她重铸目前断裂的剑，然后以最大力量挥舞它。我们很可能需要剑的力量来面对阿兹古尔卡，他很快就会自由并寻求扎拉拉的死亡。\n\n要进入烛堡，我们首先需要找到一本价值极高的书卷捐赠给图书馆，因为这是进入的条件。目前还不清楚在哪里能找到合适的书，但我们必须先做到这一点，才能实现我们的目标。现在，我们只能登上瓦尔库尔之剑，看看有什么机会出现。我应该去和船长谈谈。
src: Zarala and I have fled the Galhadr Estate, heading through the sewers to a dock where, I am told, we will find a friendly ship waiting for us. While our immediate destination will be wherever this ship, the Sword of Valkur, is headed, Zarala believes that ultimately we should seek to enter the Great Library of Candlekeep. Within Candlekeep is a book by the scholar Darzeth Shemal that constitutes the most complete repository of information concerning the Sword of Zefad. Zarala believes that this book will enable her to reforge the currently broken sword, and then wield it at maximum power. We are likely to need the power of the sword to face Azghulkar, who will soon be free and seeking Zarala's death.\n\nTo get into Candlekeep we will first need to find a tome of great value we can donate to the library, since that is a requirement of entrance. It is not clear where we can find a suitable book, but we will have to do this first before we can can gain access to our objective. For now, we can only board the Sword of Valkur and see what opportunities develop. I should go speak to the ship's captain.

This spell enables you to make a snare that functions as a magic trap. When you cast this spell, a cordlike object blends with its surroundings (Search DC 23 for a character with the trapfinding ability to locate). One end of the snare is tied in a loop that contracts around one or more of the limbs of any creature stepping inside the circle.

When triggered, the cordlike object tightens around the creature, dealing no damage but causing it to be entangled.

The snare is magical. To escape, a trapped creature must make a DC 23 Strength check that is a full-round action. A successful escape from the snare breaks the loop and ends the spell.

我们寻找的那本书所在的古墓里有一个谜题，必须解开才能深入其中。登萨斯·维莱本的学术研究指出，这个谜题基于桑达尔·卡达辛（墓主）的四名主要随从所使用的装备，并且还发现了以下线索，应该有助于解开谜题：

第1名随从施放冰风暴。
第2名随从使用战斧。
第3名随从没有穿板甲。
第4名随从穿鳞甲。
锁子甲释放连环闪电。
战锤持有者释放涌火之泉。
弯刀持有者穿皮甲。
弯刀持有者和钉头锤持有者都不释放酸雾术。
src:
The ancient tomb containing the book we seek contains a puzzle that must be solved to advance sufficiently deep into it. Densath Wayleben's scholarship indicates that the puzzle is based on the equipment employed by the four chief henchmen of Sandar Kadathin (whose tomb it is) and also uncovered the following clues, which should be helpful in solving it:

The 1st henchman casts Ice Storm.
The 2nd henchman wields a battleaxe.
The 3rd henchman does NOT don plate armor.
The 4th henchman dons armor of scale.
From chain mail Chain Lightning is unleashed.
The warhammer wielder unleashes a Firebrand.
The scimitar wielder dons armor of leather.
Neither the scimitar wielder nor the morningstar wielder unleashes Acid Fog.

This spell causes instant growth of a humanoid creature, doubling its height and multiplying its weight by 8. This increase changes the creature's size category to the next larger one. The target gains a +2 size bonus to Strength, a -2 size penalty to Dexterity (to a minimum of 1), and a -1 penalty on attack rolls and AC due to its increased size.
A humanoid creature whose size increases to Large has a space of 10 feet and a natural reach of 10 feet. This spell does not change the target's speed.
If insufficient room is available for the desired growth, the creature attains the maximum possible size and may make a Strength check (using its increased Strength) to burst any enclosures in the process. If it fails, it is constrained without harm by the materials enclosing it - the spell cannot be used to crush a creature by increasing its size.  Multiple magical effects that increase size do not stack.

dst:
在扎泽斯普尔的伊尔梅特神殿——泪之屋的地下，我遇到了一个名叫涅尔瓦·瓦尔切扎的人，她是伊尔梅特的圣武士，正守卫着城市下方幽暗地域洞穴中出现的威胁。在那里，她发现了一道由负能量构成的黑暗屏障，它正在扩张，并将幽暗地域的生物转化为亡灵怪物。她请求我为她找到一块游荡者之石，因为拥有它就能穿透这道屏障。获得此物后，我也同意陪伴她，帮助她对抗黑暗屏障之后的任何邪恶。

穿过黑暗屏障后，我们遇到了显然是造成它存在的生物：一位前矮人圣武士，如今已堕落的亡灵末日骑士。他的家园显然很久以前被卓尔入侵者摧毁，他现在寻求向所有卓尔复仇。为了实现复仇，他与黑暗力量达成了某种契约，释放出一圈不断扩张的负能量，将落入其中的人转化为亡灵。他声称它最终会扩张到覆盖整个扎泽斯普尔城，给他一支亡灵大军，他计划率领这支大军对卓尔发动灭绝战役。

我们成功挫败了他的计划，一路杀过破败的矮人大厅，最终击败了末日骑士，并摧毁了一座奇怪的祭坛，结果那正是扩散负能量的源头。黑暗屏障现在应该开始收缩，并最终崩塌。

我们的任务完成了，我们已回到涅尔瓦的营地。我应该和她谈谈，正式了结此事。
src:
Beneath the House of Tears, a Temple of Ilmater in Zazesspur, I encountered one Nierva Var'cheza, a Paladin of Ilmater who is standing guard against a menace originating in the underdark caverns below the city. There she found a dark barrier of negative energy that is expanding and transforming creatures of the Underdark into Undead monstosities. She asked that I find a Rogue Stone for her, as possession of this would allow the barrier to be pentrated. Having acquired such an item, I then also agreed to accompany her and aid her against whatever evil lies beyond the dark barrier.

Having passed through the dark barrier, we encountered the creature apparently responsible for its presence: a former dwarven paladin, now a corrupted, undead Doom Knight. His home was apparently destroyed by Drow invaders long ago, and he now sought vengeance against all Drow. To obtain it, he made some compact with dark powers that unleashed an expanding orbit of negative power that transformed into undead those who fall within it. He claimed that it would eventually grow to encompass the entire city of Zazesspur, giving him an army of undead that he planned to lead on a campaign of extermination against the Drow. 

We were able to frustrate his plans, fighting our way through the ruined dwarven halls, eventually defeating the Doom Knight and destroying a strange altar that turned out to be the source of the spreading negative energy. The dark barrier should now begin to contract and eventually collapse.

Our quest accomplished, we have returned to Nierva's camp. I should speak with her to formally complete this matter.

Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Incarnate 3
Specifics: You can activate this ability as a free action once per day at 3rd level, twice per day at 8th level, and one additional time per day for every five levels thereafter (3/day at 13th level and 4/day at 18th). This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 round). 
Good: You gain a +1 bonus to AC; this bonus improves by 1 for every five levels gained (+2 at 5th level, +3 at 10th, +4 at 15th, and +5 at 20th level). 
Evil: You gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls; this bonus improves by 2 for every five levels gained (+4 at 5th level, +6 at 10th, +8 at 15th, and +10 at 20th level). 
Lawful: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls; this bonus improves by 1 for every five levels gained (+2 at 5th level, +3 at 10th, +4 at 15th, and +5 at 20th level). 
Chaotic: You gain a 10-foot increase to your base land speed. This increase improves by 10 feet for every five levels gained (+20 at 5th level, +30 at 10th, +40 at 15th, and +50 at 20th level). 

Beginning at 7th level, when you activate your incarnum radiance, its benefit affect all allies within 30 feet of you. When you share your incarnum radiance with allies in this fashion, you become fatigued at the end of the power's duration (this fatigue fades in 10 minutes). Allies who do not share your alignment cause cannot gain the benefit of your incarnum radiance. 
Beginning at 17th level, sharing your incarnum radiance with allies does not fatigue you.

化身圣像

描述符：混乱，邪恶，善良，或秩序  
职业：化身 
脉轮：灵魂 
豁免检定：无

你在自己周围聚集魂能，形成一个包裹你自身的第二躯体，一个叠加在你身体，衣物和护甲之上的实体形态。在形态上，它类似于你阵营中最强大的勇士之一：史拉蟾，制裁者，天使，或尤格罗斯。它的动作--甚至面部表情--都与你的完美同步，因此在各方面你都显得是你阵营理想的威严化身。

与其他魂融物不同，化身圣像在不投入魂能时不会提供任何好处。

魂能：将魂能投入你的化身圣像会根据你的阵营给予你特定的好处。
混乱：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的远程攻击检定获得+1洞察加值。
邪恶：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的近战伤害检定获得+2洞察加值。
善良：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的护甲等级获得+1洞察加值。
秩序：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的近战攻击检定获得+1洞察加值。

脉轮绑定（灵魂） 

你的身体转变为你的化身圣像的外观。它的手与你的手，它的脚与你的脚，它的心与你的心之间不再有任何区别。你被灌注了你阵营最纯粹的本质--它充满你的灵魂并激励你行动。同时，它赋予你更强大的力量来帮助你践行你的信念。

你根据你的阵营获得一项能力。
混乱：你的基础陆地速度获得+30英尺的增强加值。
邪恶：你的基础陆地速度获得+30英尺的增强加值。
善良：你的基础陆地速度获得+30英尺的增强加值。
秩序：你获得对眩晕，麻痹和震慑的免疫，以及对任何会使你减速的魔法效果的免疫。
src:
Incarnate Avatar

Descriptors: Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful  
Classes: Incarnate 
Chakra: Soul 
Saving Throw: None

You gather incarnum around you to form a second body encasing your own, a physical form superimposed over your body, clothing, and armor. In form, it resembles one of the most powerful champions of your alignment: a slaad, inevitable, angel, or yugoloth. Its movements-even its facial expressions-are in perfect synchronization with your own, so that in every way you appear to be the imposing avatar of your alignment's ideals.

Unlike other soulmelds, the incarnate avatar provides no benefit without the investment of essentia. 

Essentia: Investing essentia in your incarnate avatar gives you a specific benefit depending on your alignment. 
Chaos: You gain a +1 insight bonus on ranged attack rolls for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld. 
Evil: You gain a +2 insight bonus on melee damage rolls for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld. 
Good: You gain a +1 insight bonus to your Armor Class for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld. 
Law: You gain a +1 insight bonus on melee attack rolls for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld.

Chakra Bind (Soul) 

Your body transforms into the appearance of your incarnate avatar. There is no longer any distinction between its hands and yours, its feet and yours, its heart and yours. You are imbued with the purest essence of your alignment-it fills your soul and spurs you to action. At the same time, it grants you greater power to help you live out your convictions.

You gain an ability based on your alignment. 
Chaos: You gain an enhancement bonus of +30 feet to your base land speed. 
Evil: You gain an enhancement bonus of +30 feet to your base land speed. 
Good: You gain an enhancement bonus of +30 feet to your base land speed. 
Law: You gain immunity to daze, paralysis, and stun, as well as to any magical effect that would slow you.

School: Abjuration
Descriptor(s): [see text]
Component(s): Verbal, Somatic, Material
Range: Short
Area of Effect / Target: Large
Duration: Permanent until discharged
Additional Counter Spells: 
Save: Reflex 1/2
Spell Resistance: Yes

This powerful inscription harms those who enter, pass, or open the warded area or object. A greater glyph of warding can guard a bridge or passage, ward a portal, trap a chest or box, and so on. You set the conditions of the ward. Glyphs respond to invisible creatures normally but are not triggered by those who travel past them ethereally.

When casting the spell, you weave a tracery of faintly glowing lines around the warding sigil.  When the spell is completed, the glyph and tracery become nearly invisible. Glyphs cannot be affected or bypassed by such means as physical or magical probing, though they can be dispelled.

A greater glyph deals 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 10d8) to the intruder and to all within 5 feet of him or her. This damage is acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic (caster's choice, made at time of casting). Each creature affected can attempt a Reflex save to take half damage. Spell resistance applies against this effect.

Material Component: You trace the glyph with incense, which must first be sprinkled with powdered diamond worth at least 400 gp.

dst: "这个镇子的主要产业是东南方不远处的铁矿。一年多前，有人策划关闭它并人为制造铁短缺。我自己一直没真正弄明白那有什么意义，但自然在这里引起了很多麻烦，因为作为阴谋的一部分，一群狗头人杀害矿工，并使用某种特殊酸液之类的东西毁坏那些尽管他们百般阻挠仍被开采出来的矿石。直到一些冒险者经过并制止了这一切。那个队伍的领袖后来被证明是巴尔之子，信不信由你。"
src: "The main business of this town is the iron mine a little ways to the southeast. A little more than a year ago there was a plot to shut it down and artificially create an iron shortage. Never really learned what the point of that was, myself, but naturally it caused a lot of trouble around here, since, as part of the plot, a band of kobolds was killing miners and using some special acid or such to ruin the ore that got mined in spite of their other efforts. That was until some adventurers came through and put a stop to it. The leader of that group later turned out to be a Bhaalspawn, if you can believe that."

src: Spells per Day: A Red Wizard's training focuses on arcane spells. Thus, when a new Red Wizard level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in whatever arcane spellcasting class he belonged to before he added the prestige class. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (bonus metamagic or item creation feats, bard or assassin abilities, and so on). This essentially means that he adds the level of Red Wizard to the level of whatever other arcane spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day and caster level accordingly.

src:
School: Evocation [Force]
Caster Level: Sor/Wiz 4
Components: V, S
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect: Sphere, centered around a creature
Duration: 1 min./level
Saving Throw: Reflex negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

A globe of shimmering force encloses a creature. The sphere contains its subject for the spells duration. The sphere is not subject to damage of any sort except from a rod of cancellation, a rod of negation, a disintegrate spell, or a targeted dispel magic spell. These effects destroy the sphere without harm to the subject. Nothing can pass through the sphere, inside or out, though the subject can breathe normally. The subject may struggle, but the sphere cannot be physically moved either by people outside it or by the struggles of those within.

src:

to the extreme of the range

minutes/level (D)

You can sense the presence of law. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area or subject:
1st Round: Presence or absence of law.
2nd Round: Number of law auras (creatures, objects, or spells) in the area and the strength of the strongest law aura present. If you are of chaotic alignment, the strongest law auras strength is "overwhelming" (see below), and the strength is at least twice your character level, you are stunned for 1 round and the spell ends. While you are stunned, you cant act, you lose any Dexterity bonus to AC, and attackers gain +2 bonuses to attack you.
3rd Round: The strength and location of each aura. If an aura is outside your line of sight, then you discern its direction but not its exact location.

Aura Strength: An auras lawful power and strength depend on the type of lawful creature or object that you're detecting and its HD, caster level, or (in the case of a cleric) class level.

Creature/Object         Law Power
Lawful creature                 HD / 5
Lawful elemental        HD / 2
Lawful outsider                 HD
Cleric of an lawful deity       Caster Level

Law Power               Aura Strength
Lingering               Dim
1 or less               Faint
2 - 4           Moderate
5 - 10          Strong
11+             Overwhelming
If an aura falls into more than one strength category, the spell indicates the stronger of the two.

Note: Each round, you can turn to detect things in a new area but if you move more than 2 meters the spell ends.

dst:
论龙族：费伦最常见龙类物种的简要指南。

在费伦发现的大多数龙都属于两大类别之一：色彩龙，因其鳞片具有鲜明独特的颜色而得名，它们几乎总是邪恶的；以及金属龙，因其鳞片的颜色和整体外观类似各种金属而得名，它们几乎总是善良的。

色彩龙的主要类型有：

红龙通常是色彩龙中最强大的（尽管确切实力可能因年龄和其他因素而异。一只 lesser breed 的远古龙很可能比一只 greater one 的年轻龙更强大），并且能够长到异常巨大。除了颜色之外，它们最显著的身体特征是其头上长有两只向后弯曲的角。它们通常喜欢在山区筑巢。它们喷吐火焰作为对抗敌人的武器。

蓝龙通常是第二强大的色彩龙。除了颜色之外，它们可以通过头上突出的单只大角以及巨大的褶边耳朵来辨认。它们偏好沙漠和贫瘠地区的巢穴。它们能从口中释放强大的闪电冲击。

绿龙是中等实力的色彩龙。它们以从鼻子开始沿身体长度延伸的巨大鳍而闻名。它们通常在茂密的森林地区筑巢。它们能喷出剧毒的毒气云。

黑龙通常是最弱小的品种之一（当然是相对而言——即使是一只弱小的龙也比大多数非龙类怪物强大！）。它们的特征是头上长有两只弯曲、朝前的角。它们最常见于沼泽和丛林。它们能从口中喷出腐蚀性酸液流。

白龙通常是色彩龙中最弱的。除了颜色之外，它们的外貌可以通过下巴下方的刺状肉垂来辨认。它们最常见于极地环境，其吐息武器是令人衰弱的寒冷冲击。

其他类型的色彩龙，如棕龙和黄龙，确实存在，但相当罕见。对此感兴趣的读者应寻找更专业的文献。

金属龙以使用两种吐息武器而著称，一种对敌人造成伤害，另一种造成某种衰弱效果。金属龙的主要类型有：

金龙，通常是最强大的，其面部特征为向后弯曲的角以及悬垂的须状棘刺。它们在各种不同的环境中筑巢。它们的主要吐息武器是火焰，次要吐息则能使敌人虚弱。

银龙是第二强大的金属龙类型。它们以沿身体长度延伸的褶边而闻名。它们通常生活在寒冷环境中（当不使用变形能力混入类人生物中时，它们似乎比大多数龙类更热衷于这种活动）。它们的主要吐息武器是致命的寒霜，次要吐息则能造成麻痹。

青铜龙是中等实力的金属龙。它们每侧脸颊突出三只向后弯曲的角，头顶还有两只。它们经常生活在沿海地区。它们能从口中释放强大的闪电冲击，并通过次要吐息武器造成令人迷失方向的精神效果。

铜龙是另一种中等实力的品种。它们头上有两只大的向后弯曲的角。它们喜欢在岩石和丘陵地区筑巢。它们的主要吐息武器喷吐酸液，而次要吐息则能减缓敌人。

黄铜龙是金属龙中最弱的。它们的头部覆盖着一块向上向后弯曲的甲片，下巴向下突出两只尖角。像蓝龙一样，它们偏好干旱环境。它们偏好的吐息武器是能令敌人陷入睡眠的气体锥，尽管它们也能喷吐火焰冲击，但威力不如红龙或金龙。

其他类型的金属龙存在但极为罕见。冒险者遇到中立宝石龙或任何不属于正常类别的古怪品种也并非闻所未闻。这些也非常罕见，同样，对这些稀有类型感兴趣的读者需要寻找更专业的文献。
src:
On Dragons: A brief guide to the most common draconic species of Faerun.

Most dragons found in Faerun fall into one of two general categories: Chromatic dragons, so called because their scales are of clear and distinctive colors, who are almost always evil, and Metallic Dragons, so called because the color and general appearance of their scales resembles that of various metals, who are almost always good.

The major types of Chromatic dragons are:

Red dragons are usually the most powerful of the Chromatics (though the precise power can vary depending on age and other factors. An ancient dragon of a lesser breed might well be more powerful than a young dragon of a greater one), and can grow to be exceptionally large. Aside from their color, their most distincitve physcial feature is the presence of two backwards-pointing horns on their heads. They generally like to make their lairs in moutainous regions. They breath fire as a weapon against their enemies.

Blue dragons are typically the next most powerful Chromatic. Aside from their color, they can be recognized by the single large horn protruding from their head, and large, frilled ears. They prefer lairs in deserts and barren regions. They can release powerful blasts of lightning from their mouths.

Green dragons are chromatics of moderate power. They are noted for having a large fin running the length of their body starting from their nose. They generally make their lairs in thickly forested regions. They can breath out a highly poisonous cloud of gas.

Black dragons are typically one of the less powerful breeds (in relative terms of course - even a weak dragon is stronger than most non-draconic monsters!). They are distinguished by having two curving, forward-facing horns on their heads. They are most commonly found in swamps and jungles. They can spew a stream of corrosive acid from their mouths.

White dragons are typically the weakest of the chromatics. Aside from their color, their physical appearance can be distinguished by the spiny dewlaps beneath their chins. They are most commonly found in arctic environmets, and their breath weapon is a blast of debilitating cold.

Other types of chromatic dragons, such as browns and yellows, do exist, but are quite rare. Readers interested in these should seek out more specialized literature.

Metallic dragons are noted for employing two breath weapons, one dealing damage to foes and another that inflicts some sort of debilitating effect. The major types of metallic dragon are:

Gold dragons, typically the most powerful, whose faces are distinguished by backwards-pointing horns, and dangling, whisker-like spines. They make lairs in a variety of different environments. They deploy fire in their primary breath weapon, and can inflcit weakness on foes with a secondary one.

Silver dragons are the next most powerful metallic type. They are noted for a frill running the length of their bodies. They generally live in cold environments (when not employing their polymorphing powers to mingle among humanoids, an activity of which they seem more fond than most draconic breeds). They have a primary breath weapon of deadly frost, and a secondary one that can inflict paralysis.

Bronze dragons are metallics of medium power. They have three backwards pointing horns protruding from each cheek, and two more on the top of their heads. They are frequently found living in coastal regions. They can release powerful blasts of lightning from their mouths, and inflict disorienting mental effects by means of a secondary breath weapon.

Copper dragons are another breed of medium power. They have two large backward-pointing horns on their heads. They like to lair in rocky and hilly regions. Their primary breath weapon spews acid, while a secondary one can slow enemies.

Brass dragons are the weakest of the metallics. Their heads are covered by a plate curving upwards and back, and two sharp horns protrude downward from their chins. Like blue dragons, they prefer arid environments. Their preferred breath weapon is a cone of gas that can induce sleep in foes, though they can also breath blasts of fire that are less powerful than those of Red or Gold dragons.

Other types of metallic dragons exist but are extremely rare. It is also not unheard of for adventurers to encounter one of the neutral Gem Dragons or any of a number of various eccentric breeds that do not fit into any of the normal categories. These too are quite rare, and again, readers interested in these rarer types will need to seek out more specialized literature.

Using nonvisual senses, such as acute smell or hearing, a creature with blindsense notices things it cannot see. The creature usually does not need to make Spot or Listen checks to pinpoint the location of a creature within range of its blindsense ability, provided that it has line of effect to that creature. Any opponent the creature cannot see still has total concealment against the creature with blindsense, and the creature still has the normal miss chance when attacking foes that have concealment. dst: “你可以躲藏，但你无法逃脱！”这是一名致命的剑湾刺客的招牌口号，据称他的行动速度之快，以至于他的目标即使骑在马上也无法做出反应。这双靴子就是他能力的来源，不过也有人认为他组建了一个精英公会，其中每个成员都配备相同的装备，这也就解释了为什么他不仅速度极快，而且似乎能同时出现在好几个地方。
src: "You can hide, but you cannot run!" This was the calling card of a deadly Sword Coast assassin who purportedly moved with such speed that his targets couldn't respond, even if on horseback. These boots were the source of his ability, though it is also believed that he formed an elite guild wherein each member was equipped identically, thus explaining why he was not just fast, but could seemingly appear in several places at once.

等级：贤者之剑 6，军道之剑 6
先决条件：两个虎爪派招式
发动动作：1 标准动作
距离：近战攻击
目标：一个生物

伴随着凶猛的咆哮，你像野兽般扑向敌人，以疯子的狂怒将武器砸向她。

你将原始狂怒凝聚为一次攻击，以粉碎骨骼和钢铁的强力一击击倒对手。作为此招式的一部分，你进行一次近战攻击。你在这次攻击检定上获得 +4 加值并造成额外 10d6 点伤害。完成此招式后，你的 AC 受到 -4 减值，直到你下一回合开始。
src:
Tiger Claw (Strike)
Level: Swordsage 6, warblade 6
Prerequisite: Two Tiger Claw maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature

With a ferocious roar, you leap upon your enemy like a wild beast, slamming your weapon into her with a madman's fury.

You focus your primal fury into a single attack, laying an opponent low with a mighty blow that splinters bones and shatters steel. As part of this maneuver, you make a single melee attack. You gain a +4 bonus on this attack roll and deal an extra 10d6 points of damage. After completing this maneuver, you take a -4 penalty to AC until the start of your next turn.

dst: “好，好，事情正按我的计划发展……这到底是怎么发生的，我也纳闷？啊，算了，我是说事情当然正按计划进行……现在，我们，呃……我说到哪儿了？哦，对了，你有 750000 金币。既然我拿到了这笔钱，正如我们那个双重间谍所要求的，计划的下一阶段就可以实施了。我会拿走这些金币交给那个间谍，他会设法在守卫通往烛堡之路的冒险者队伍中打开一个缺口。我现在就要前往其中一个佣兵营地。你可以稍后跟来，在那里和我会合，还有那个间谍。来，我把营地位置标在你的地图上。”
src: "Good, good, things are going just as I planned...how did that happen I wonder? Ah, never mind, I mean of course things are going according to plan...and now, we, um...where was I? Oh, yes, you have 750000 gold. Now that I have that, as demanded by our double agent, the next phase of the plan can be implemented. I'll take the gold and give it to the agent, who will see that a hole is opened in the ranks of the adventurers guarding the way to Candlekeep. I'll be heading to one of the mercenary camps right now. You can follow along a little later, and meet me and the agent there. Here, let me mark where the camp is on your map."

He makes some sort of signal, and the gates of Candlekeep are opened in response.

dst: “也许你知道他是一位强大的卓尔巫师，生活在很久以前，他制造了魔法宝珠。它们蕴含着强大的魔法，很少有人知道用途。我们试图收集它们，研究它们。但发现它们的地方都有守卫，亡灵充斥着那里，非常危险。我们的数量现在减少了。我们可能无法成功完成任务，也许。如果你替我们进入废墟并带回一颗泽克斯卡顿宝珠，我可以付你16000金币。对像你这样强大的人来说不会太难，也许？这是笔好买卖，不是吗？”
src: "Perhaps you know he was a mighty Drow wizard, who lived long ago, and that he made magical orbs. Great magic they contain, few know what for. We seek to collect them, study them. But the places where they are to be found are guarded, undead fill them, very dangerous. Our numbers are less now. We might not be able to succeed in our mission, maybe. If you go in the ruin for us and return with an orb of Xerxkatun, I can pay you 16000 gold. Not be too hard for someone as strong as you, maybe? This is a good bargain, is it not?"

dst: “是的，它似乎是一件极其令人印象深刻的魔法神器。我很自豪能为其重铸尽一份微薄之力，也为我希望它未来在挫败阿兹古尔卡的计划中所扮演的角色感到自豪。我想你很快就需要离开这里去应对塔纳厘构成的威胁了，不过如果你愿意，当然欢迎你在图书馆多待一段时间，继续阅读我们的藏书。我担心你离开时会面临巨大的危险，尤其是那条一直在这一带飞来飞去找你的强大巨龙。如果你还没有读过，我建议你读一些我们关于对抗龙类的书籍：你可以在二楼西北区找到它们。唉，恐怕这是我能提供的最后一点帮助了。我已经用我所做的事考验了乌尔朗特的耐心。”
src: "Yes, it appears to be a most impressive magical artifact. I am proud to have been able to play a small part in its reforging, and in what I hope will be its future role in thwarting Azghulkar's plans. I expect you will soon need to move on from here to address the threat that Tanar'ri poses, though if you wish, you are of course welcome to stay here at the library for a bit longer and continue reading from our collection. I fear you will face great danger when you depart, particularly from that powerful dragon that has been flying around this area looking for you. If you have not already, I suggest you read some of the books we have about fighting dragons: you'll find them in the northwest section on the first floor. Alas, I fear that is the last bit of help I can offer you. I've tested Ulraunt's patience with what I've already done."

src:
Githyanki are tall, gaunt humanoids from an ancient line of being from the Astral Plane. Built roughly like humans, they are elaborate dressers and have a passion for fine weapons. They have yellowish skin and russet hair, with pointed ears that resemble those of an elf but are serrated at the back. The gith empire arose from slave rebellion against their master mind flayers. Once free, the gith split into two distinct races - the githyanki and githzerai. The githyanki live within massive fortresses adrift in the Astral Plane and have been known to form alliances with Red Dragons.

Githyanki Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Wis
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass githyanki's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Githyanki are able to see in the dark.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 5, plus 1 per character level.
- Spell-like Abilities: 3/day - Blur, Daze. Caster level 3rd. The DC is Charisma-based.
- Outsider: Githyanki are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.
- Human: Githyanki are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

A sheath of incarnum energy surrounds your body and is slowly absorbed into your skin. As healing magic is applied to you, the affected area sparkles with tiny blue motes.

src:
Leraje, the Green Herald
  
Once a favored servant of the primary deity of the elves, Leraje allowed her pride to become her downfall. Leraje gives her summoners the ability to bring a bow to hand at will, to fire it with accuracy, and to damage a foe's sense of self with it. In addition, she gives her hosts keen vision in darkness and skill at hiding.

Vestige Level: 1st
Binding DC: 15
Special Requirement: To summon Leraje, you must break an arrow (by having one in your arrow slot). In addition, Leraje hates Amon for some unknown reason and will not answer your call if you are already bound to him.

Influence: While influenced by Leraje, she requires that you not attack any elf or creature of elven blood, including half-elves and members of the various elf subraces, such as drow.

Granted Abilities: 
You gain supernatural powers related to Leraje's skills in life, as well as the ability to fire arrows that literally wound your target's pride.

Hide Bonus: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Hide checks.

Low-Light Vision: You gain low-light vision. 

Point Blank Shot: You gain the benefit of the Point Blank Shot feat.

Ricochet: As a standard action, you can make a ranged attack against two adjacent targets. 

Weapon Proficiency: While bound to Leraje, you are proficient with the longbow and shortbow. If you were already proficient with any of these weapons, you instead gain a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls with them.

阿加雷斯，被背叛的真相

特殊要求：你必须在土地或一片未加工的石地上绘制阿加雷斯的印记。

授予能力：
阿加雷斯赋予你提升自己和盟友的力量，使你脚下的土地震颤，并让敌人变得虚弱。

土与气精通：你在攻击检定和武器伤害检定上获得+1加值。

震地之踏：作为一个标准动作，你可以跺脚，使10尺范围内的所有生物进行反射豁免，否则倒地。一旦你使用了此能力，5轮内无法再次使用。你和你召唤的土元素（见下文）永远不会因使用此能力而倒地。

元素伙伴：你可以召唤一个土元素来陪伴你并为你战斗。如果你失去了你的元素，1小时内无法再次召唤。你能召唤的土元素体型取决于你的有效缚灵者等级。11级以下，小型。15级以下，中型。19级以下，大型。19级及以上，超大型。

恐惧免疫：你免疫恐惧。
src:
Agares, Truth Betrayed
  
Agares died at the hands of his allies for a wrong he did not commit. As a vestige, not only does he give binders the ability to weaken foes and knock them prone, but he also makes his summoner fearless.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 22
Special Requirement: You must draw Agares's seal upon either the earth or an expanse of unworked stone.

Influence: Agares's loyalty in life and his anger at the betrayal perpetrated by his lieutenants has become a hatred of falsehood. When influenced by Agares, you speak forthrightly and with confidence. You cannot use the Bluff skill, and when asked a direct question, you must answer truthfully and directly.

Granted Abilities: 
Agares gives you the power to exalt yourself and your allies, to make the earth tremble beneath your feet, and to render foes weak.

Earth and Air Mastery: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls.

Earthshaking Step: As a standard action, you can stomp on the ground, causing every creature within 10 feet of you to make a Reflex save or fall prone. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds. You and your summoned earth elemental (see below) are never knocked prone by the use of this ability.

Elemental Companion: You can summon an earth elemental to accompany you and fight for you. If you lose your elemental, you cannot summon it again for 1 hour. The size of the earth elemental you can summon depends on your effective binder level. Below 11th, small. Below 15th, medium. Below 19th, large. 19th and above, huge.

Fear Immunity: You have immunity to fear.

偏好职业（巡林客）：兼职苔原半身人的巡林客职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 小型体型：
 攻击检定获得 +1 体型加值。
 AC 获得 +1 体型加值。
 躲藏检定获得 +4 体型加值。
- 技能亲和（潜行）：潜行检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（跳跃）：跳跃检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 幸运：所有豁免检定获得 +1 幸运加值。
- 无畏：对抗 '恐惧' 子学派的法咒和效果的豁免检定获得 +2 士气加值。
- 精准投掷：使用投掷武器进行的攻击检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 半身人：在法咒效果方面，苔原半身人被视为半身人。

特殊：半身人是小型生物，因此他们永远无法使用以下大型武器：重剑，巨锤，双刃剑，双头斧，巨斧，巨剑，戟，重型连枷，长棍，镰刀和矛。
src:
Halflings native to the frostfell and far northern regions are known as tundra halflings.  They are like the typical halfling in both appearance and lifestyle, but supplement their nomadic ways with permanent structures along their normal paths of wandering.  It's not uncommon for tundra halflings to move from empty village to empty village along with the change in seasons.

Tundra Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass tundra halfling's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Tundra Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

dst:
在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个名叫布利夫敏·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取有魔法用途的试剂。他在他称之为“中央收集区”周围的四个分站的机器上遇到了问题，并承诺如果我能够帮助解决他遇到的各种问题，就会给我奖励。

东北方向的机器发生了故障，并在其周围释放了一团有毒气体。我需要穿过这团气体，承受它造成的任何伤害，关闭机器以便进行维修。

东南方向的机器不知怎么地喷出了危险的软泥怪，但现在已经被关闭了。

西北方向的机器可以正常工作，但位于一个现在被食腐兽占据的房间里。这些怪物应该被清除掉。

西南方向的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被藏在下水道里的罪犯扯掉了。然而，我能够找回这个部件，这应该会让维修容易得多。

我已经告知泽姆昆我的进展。任何其他完成的任务也应该向泽姆昆报告。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast is malfunctioning, and has released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I will need to move through this cloud, enduring whatever harm it inflicts, to shut off the machine so it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast was somehow spewing forth dangeous slimes. but has now been shut down.

The machine to the northwest is functional, but in a room now occupied by otyughs. These monsters should be cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some criminals hiding in the sewers. However, I was able to recover the part, which should make its repair much easier.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

尽管魂能是一种强大的工具，但它仍然是一种物质媒介--一种介于使用者与灵魂真正力量之间的抽象物。炽魂勇士试图摒弃有形和无形的屏障与阻碍，以便她能以未遮蔽的身体，心智和精神接触宇宙灵魂。通过这种方式拥抱多元宇宙终极，不可再分的能量，她成为一团活生生的火焰--一个灿烂的灵魂，其身体不过是她真实形态的外壳。她灵魂的力量使她能够承受几乎任何危险，以致命的光辉冲击净化敌人，并克服周围世界的物理束缚，从而完成奇迹般的壮举。炽魂勇士承认每个生物都怀有宇宙精神的一丝火花，她相信被称为神祇的存在只是比大多数其他生物拥有更多这种珍贵火花。她崇敬并尊重诸神，但不向他们献上崇拜。炽魂勇士认为保护和帮助较不开化的生物，并作为世界上善良的力量，是她的责任。
