src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Though incarnum is a potent tool, it is still a physical medium-an abstraction that stands between its wielder and the true power of the soul. The incandescent champion seeks to dispense with barriers and obstacles both tangible and intangible so that she can touch the cosmic soul with her unveiled body, mind, and spirit. By embracing the ultimate, irreducible energy of the multiverse in this manner, she becomes a living flame-a brilliant spirit whose body is little more than a shell for her true form. The strength of her soul allows her to withstand almost any peril, scour her foes with deadly luminous blasts, and overcome the physical shackles of the world around her toaccomplish miraculous feats. An incandescent champion acknowledges that every creature harbors a spark of the universal spirit, and she believes that the beings known as deities simply possess a greater share of this precious spark than most others. She reveres and respects the gods but does not offer them worship. The incandescent champion considers it her responsibility to protect and aid less enlightened creatures and to serve as aforce for good in the world.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Incandescent Champions gain no new proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Any good
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Essentia Pool: 1
Skills: Concentration 4 ranks

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Incandescent Strike - Invest essentia to increase damage
2:  Fast Healing (self) - Invest essentia to heal self
3:  Unbearable Countenance - Invest essentia to shake enemies
4:  Incarnum Overload 1/day - Increase max essentia capacity by charisma modifier 
5:  Incandescent Ray - Invest essentia to shoot ray
6:  
7:  Incarnum Overload 2/day
8:  Incandescent Aura - Invest essentia to damage enemies every round
9:  Fast Healing (allies) - Invest essentia to heal self and allies
10: Transcendence - Change race to outsider, become incorporeal 1/day
    Incarnum Overload 3/day
    
Essentia: The Incandescent Champion gains one extra point of essentia at 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 6th, 7th, 9th, and 10th levels, for a total of 8 points at level 10. It does not increase meldshaping level, melds known, meld binds, or any other aspect of meldshaping.

提尔神殿已派遣一队牧师和圣武士进入神殿区下方的下水道，试图对抗最近变得具有攻击性、在那里制造麻烦的鼠人。他们至今未归。提尔神殿的高级牧师阿达拉斯·埃夫岑要求我进入下水道，查明他们遭遇了什么，并在必要时协助他们。莎尔神殿的女祭司费拉莎希望我跟随他们之后，查明他们的天命，并确保他们无一能活着离开下水道。我必须决定是帮助这些提尔信徒还是杀死他们。

被派往下水道的提尔信徒队伍已全军覆没。费拉莎听到这个消息很高兴，并给了我丰厚的奖励。此事仍可报告给阿达拉斯。
src:
The Temple of Tyr has dispatched a group of clerics and paladins into the sewers beneath the temple district in an attempt to fight the newly aggressive wererats causing trouble there. They have yet to report back. Adaras Efzen, a high-ranking cleric in the Temple of Tyr, has asked me to enter the sewers and determine what has happened to them, assisting them if necessary. Ferazha, priestess at the temple of Shar, wants me to follow in their wake, determine their fate, and insure that none of them make it out of the sewer alive. I will have to decide whether I wish to assist these Tyrrans or kill them.

The entire party of Tyrrans dispatched to the sewers has met its end. Ferazha was happy to hear of this, and rewarded me well. It could still be reported to Adaras.

He is staying in Room 17, on the floor above us. Go there, contrive some excuse to speak with him, and, once he has let you into his room, slay him."

Specifics: At 2nd level, you learn how to use a bound vestige to boost your arcane spellcasting. With this ability, you can choose to forego gaining one of the vestige's granted abilities in order to gain one additional arcane spell of the highest you can cast. Vestiges react poorly to your use of this ability, so you take a -5 penalty on your binding check. If you make a good pact despite this penalty, you gain the bonus spell in exchange for the ability you gave up. dst:
“黑暗”是一个后天或先天模板，可以添加到任何生物（以下称为基础生物）. 

黑暗生物的颜色通常比其物质位面版本暗淡得多，皮肤色调和毛发高光更偏灰色和黑色。一般来说，它们的重量也更轻，仿佛其本体的一部分只是阴影物质。

黑暗生物拥有基础生物的所有统计数据和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型和类型：类型和体型不变。

速度：所有移动方式 +10 英尺。

特殊性质：黑暗生物保留基础生物的所有特殊性质，并获得以下内容。
- 黑暗视觉 60 英尺。
- 在视线内躲藏（Ex）
- 寒冷抗力 10
- 微光视觉。

技能：躲藏 +8 和潜行 +6. 

等级调整：+1。
src:
"Dark" is an acquired or inherited template that can be added to any creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature). 

Dark creatures tend to be much duller in color, with more gray and black skin tones and hair highlights, than their Material Plane versions. In general, they also weigh less, as if part of their very substance was mere shadow stuff. 

A dark creature has all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here. 

Size and Type: Type and size are unchanged. 

Speed: +10 feet to all modes of movement. 

Special Qualities: A dark creature retains all the special qualities of the base creature and also gains the following. 
- Darkvision 60 ft. 
- Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)
- Resistance to cold 10
- Low-light vision. 

Skills: Hide +8 and Move Silently +6. 

Level Adjustment: +1.

受术者的身体被扭曲变形，永远遭受着极度痛苦的折磨。受术者陷入无助状态，但只要法咒持续，它就会被维持生命，无需食物，饮水或空气。受术者不会衰老--这更能确保真正永恒的难以想象的折磨。受术者直到所有属性值降至 0（除了体质，保持在 1）.受术者无法治疗或再生。最后，受术者完全无法感知周围环境，除了极度的痛苦外对一切毫无感觉。

一次强韧豁免检定就是目标与这个可怕法咒之间的唯一屏障。然而，即使豁免检定成功，目标
仍会感到可怕（但暂时）的痛苦。目标立即受到 5d6 点伤害，并在攻击检定，豁免检定，
技能检定和属性检定上承受 -4 环境减值，持续每施法者等级 1 轮。
src:
Eternity of Torture
Necromancy [Evil]
Level: Pain 9
Components: V, S, DF
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: Permanent
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial
Spell Resistance: Yes

The subject's body is twisted and warped, wracked forever with excruciating pain. The subject is rendered helpless, but-as long as the spell continues -it is sustained and has no need for food, drink, or air. The subject does not age-all the better to ensure a true eternity of unimaginable torture. The subject until all scores are reduced to 0 (except Constitution, which stays at 1). The subject cannot heal or regenerate. Lastly, the subject is completely unaware of its surroundings, insensate to anything but the excruciating pain.

A single Fortitude saving throw is all that stands between a target and this horrible spell. However, even if the saving throw is successful, the target
still feels terrible (but temporary) pain. The target takes 5d6 points of damage immediately and takes a -4 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saving throws,
skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round per level of the caster.

Level: Crusader 5, swordsage 5, warblade 5
Prerequisite: Two Stone Dragon maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 swift action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: Stance

You swing your weapon in an wide, deadly arc that slams into your foe with incredible force. Only your mastery of the Stone Dragon techniques allows you to make such reckless blows without losing your footing.

While you are in this stance, you deal damage as if you were one size larger than normal, to a maximum of Large. This benefit improves your weapon and unarmed strike damage. 任何以天生武器或徒手击打攻击你的生物，每点你投入烈焰之心的魂能点受到1d6点火焰伤害。擒抱你的生物在你的回合结束时每轮受到此伤害。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

腰间炽热石头的热量蔓延全身，通过你的攻击向任何面对的对手爆发。当你进入战斗时，你的皮肤因奔涌于血管中的火焰之力而泛红。

src:
Heart of Fire

Descriptors: Fire 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Waist (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

A rough stone of blazing red hangs at the center of a loose belt around your waist. You feel warmth spreading from the stone into your body, though it is not enough to ward off extreme cold. At the sight of a frost giant or some other creature of cold, however, that warmth surges through your body like consuming fire, eager to sear your opponents' flesh.

You gain a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls against elementals. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your heart of fire increases your insight bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls by 1. 

Chakra Bind (Waist) 

A red glow suffuses your body, concentrated in your abdomen. Rather than a blazing red stone at your waist, your heart of fire is subsumed into your flesh, filling your body with its fiery fury.

Any creature striking you with a natural weapon or unarmed strike takes 1d6 points of fire damage per point of essentia you invest in your heart of fire. Creatures grappling you take this damage every round at the end of your turn. 

Chakra Bind (Totem)

The heat of the blazing stone at your waist spreads through your body, lashing out through your attacks at any opponent you face. When you enter combat, your skin glows red with the fiery power coursing through your veins.

Your natural weapons or unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d4 points of fire damage per point of essentia you invest in your heart of fire.

While it is not entirely clear from this information just who Rajar is, it does include directions to his hideout in the Calimport sewers, and tells that anyone wishing to make contact with him should use "Jaraj" as a password or risk being treated as an enemy. It might be good to hold on to this paper. The information it contains would surely be of interest to the Calimport authorities. Alternatively, it would help someone expecting to be involved in illegal activities in that city to make a useful contact.

dst:
这是一本由冒险者保存的日志，而这位冒险者现在想必已经变成了发现日志时所在的那具骷髅。日志的作者似乎曾是科米尔的一位圣武士兼紫龙骑士。他远离家乡，从日志中读到的内容来看，显然是在执行一项任务，寻找并净化一座失落已久的提尔神殿——这座神殿在某个时候沉入地下，并被邪恶的卓尔女神罗丝的手下占据和亵渎。最近几则记录引起了你的注意：

“1369年凯索恩月2日

我发现了一个市场，幽暗地域的各种居民在此互相交易，在这个被诅咒的地下领域里，这是一片罕见的和平绿洲，尽管并不安稳。我得以补充了药水，并且通过询问各种商人，发现了线索，表明我正在寻找的神殿就在附近，往西不远。

1369年凯索恩月3日

我确实在市场以西不远处找到了似乎是神殿入口的地方，但罗丝似乎不会轻易放弃它，我还发现它被一大群蛛化精灵和巨蛛守卫着。我战胜了他们，但战斗十分艰难，所以我想我应该休息一下，明天再进攻。

1369年凯索恩月3日，补记

休息时遭到寇涛鱼人袭击，但击退了他们。明天的计划不变。

1369年凯索恩月4日

我进攻了被亵渎的神殿，里面满是巨蛛和陷阱。不幸的是，我未能清除它。当我深入时，一只狩魔蛛出现了。我想我本可以击败它，如果不是它爪子的超自然力量摧毁了我的盔甲和盾牌。没有它们的保护，我被迫撤退，身负重伤。我将不得不返回市场，再次补充药水，并更换盔甲。提尔最终会胜利的，即使不是今天。

1369年凯索恩月4日，补记

似乎一大群蛛化精灵已经在我和市场之间占据了位置。希望我能在没有盔甲的情况下击败他们。”

以上是日志的最后一条记录。
src:
This is a journal that was being kept by an adventurer, who has now presumably been reduced to the skeleton on which it was found. The journal's author appears to have been a Paladin and Purple Dragon Knight of Cormyr. He was far from his home, and from what you read in the journal apparently on a quest to find and purify a long-lost shrine to Tyr that at some point sank into the earth and was taken over and defiled by minions of the evil Drow goddess, Lolth. A few recent entries catch your attention:

"2 Kythorn 1369

I have found a market where various denizens of the Underdark meet to trade with each other, a rare oasis of peace, however uneasy, in this accursed underground realm. I was able to restock my potions, and, by questioning various merchants, discovered clues that the shrine I am seeking is nearby, just a little way to the west.

3 Kythorn 1369

I have indeed found what appears to be the entrance to the shrine just a little ways west of the market, but it seems Lolth will not surrender it easily, and I also found it guarded by a large force of Driders and monstrous spiders. I prevailed against them, but the fight was a difficult one, so I believe I shall rest and assail it on the morrow.

3 Kythorn, addendum

Attacked by Kuo Toa while resting, but fought them off. Plans for tomorrow unchanged.

4 Kythorn 1369

I assailed the defiled shrine, filled with monstrous spiders and traps. Unfortunately I was unable to clear it. As I pressed deeper in a Bebilith emerged. I expect I could have defeated it if the unnatural powers of its claws had not destroyed my armor and shield. Without their protection I was forced to retreat, badly wounded. I shall have to return to the market and again restock my potions, and replace my armor. Tyr shall prevail in the end, even if it not today.

4 Kythorn, addendum

It seems a large force of Driders has taken position between me and the market. Hopefully I can defeat them without my armor."

The above is the final entry in the journal.

dst: 当一个古老的王国受到一名指挥着骷髅战士军团的巫妖威胁时，一队英雄被派出去寻找一件神器。根据更古老的传说，这件神器能赋予王国击退亡灵大军所需的力量。寻找这件神器的任务十分危险。只有一位英雄返回，而他很快就因伤势过重而死。临终前，他声称任务成功了，尽管他什么也没带回来。人们认为他因磨难而发疯，王国陷入绝望。直到这位英雄被抬往坟墓时，他的部分血液碰巧洒在了田里的一把连枷上。连枷立刻燃起火焰，显示出它新获得的力量。虽然英雄无法带回神器本身，但它的力量不知怎么转移到了他的体内。由于冒险队伍中无人生还，神器本身为何无法被带回，以及为何找到了这种替代方法，确切原因永远无法查明。无论如何，许多士兵纷纷将武器浸入英雄的血液中，装备了这些被转化的武器后，王国的军队得以将巫妖的骷髅砸成碎片。王国得救了，尽管这仅仅是通过牺牲它最伟大的勇士们换来的。
src: When an ancient kingdom was threatened by a lich commanding legions of skeletal warriors, a band of heroes was sent out on a quest to recover an artifact that, according to an even more ancient legend, would give the kingdom the power needed to fight off an undead army. The quest for this artifact proved perilous. Only one hero returned, and he soon died of his wounds. Before his death, he claimed that the quest had succeeded, even though he had brought nothing back with him. It was assumed that he had been driven mad by his ordeals, and the kingdom despaired, until, while the hero was being carried to his grave, some of his blood happened to spill onto a threshing flail left lying in the fields. The flail burst immediately into flame, a sign of its new powers. While the hero was unable to bring back the artifact itself, its power had somehow been transferred into his body. As there were no survivors of the adventuring party, the precise reasons why the artifact could not itself be returned, and how this alternative was found instead, could never be determined. Regardless, many more soldiers came to dip their weapons in the hero's blood, and, armed with these transformed implements, the kingdom's armies were able to bash the lich's skeletons to pieces. The realm was saved, albeit only by the sacrifice of its greatest champions.

src:
Eye of the Beholder
Transmutation [Evil]
Level: Sor/Wiz 7
Components: V S
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Personal
Target: Caster
Duration: 1 round/level

One of the caster's eyes grows out of her head on an eyestalk, becoming like that of a beholder. Due to the mobility of the eye, the caster gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Spot checks. More important, the eye has one of the beholder's eye powers,
determined randomly. The caster can use this power as a standard action during the spell's duration.

Each type of eye produces an effect identical to that of a spell cast by a 13th level caster, but it follows the rules for a ray (see Aiming a Spell in Chapter 10 of the Player's Handbook). All of these effects have a range of 150 feet and a save
DC of 18.

Roll 1d10 to see which eye the caster gains.

1d10     Eye Effect

1        Charm Person: Target must make a Will save
         or be affected as though by the spell.

2        Charm Monster: Target must make a Will save
         or be affected as though by the spell.

3        Sleep: As the spell, except that it affects
         one creature with any number of Hit Dice.
         Target must make a Will save to resist.

4        Flesh to Stone: Target must make a Fortitude
         save or be affected as though by the spell.

5        Disintegrate: Target must make a Fortitude
         save or be affected as though by the spell.

6        Fear: As the spell, except that it targets
         one creature. Target must make a Will save
         or be affected as though by the spell.

7        Slow: As the spell, except that it affects
         one creature. Target must make a Will save
         to resist.

8        Inflict Moderate Wounds: As the spell, dealing
         2d8+10 points of damage (Will half).

9        Finger of Death: Target must make a Fortitude
         save or be slain as though by the spell. The
         target   takes 3d6+13 points of damage if his
         save succeeds.

如果你和法咒受术者彼此移出范围，法咒结束。

src:
Abjuration
Level: Clr 2, Pal 2, Protection 2
Components: V, S, F
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

This spell wards the subject and creates a mystic connection between you and the subject so that some of its wounds are transferred to you. The subject gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC and a +1 resistance bonus on saves. Additionally, the subject takes only half damage from all wounds and attacks (including that dealt by special abilities) that deal hit point damage. The amount of damage not taken by the warded creature is taken by you. Forms of harm that do not involve hit points, such as charm effects, temporary ability damage, level draining, and death effects, are not affected. If the subject suffers a reduction of hit points from a lowered Constitution score, the reduction is not split with you because it is not hit point damage. When the spell ends, subsequent damage is no longer divided between the subject and you, but damage already split is not reassigned to the subject.

If you and the subject of the spell move out of range of each other, the spell ends.

Focus: A pair of platinum rings (worth at least 50 gp each) worn by both you and the warded creature.

NOTE: This spell does not stack and applies damage to the last caster (I think, actually depends on the order of the applied effects).

src: As I was approaching Fort Akhaz in the Marching Mountains, I came across a messenger traveling from there with dire news: the fort is being besieged by a horde of orcs of the Blazing Axes tribe and their ogre allies. It is doubtful that I could break through the siege cordon to reach the fort, so if I am to do anything useful here it would be best to operate on the flanks of the orc army, reached either by traveling along the nearby river to the west or the woods to the east, attacking patrols and outlying forces. I also might be able to make my way to the north and raid the caves the orcs came from in the first place, with most of them absent and around the fort. This should induce the main orc army to send out detachments to try to hunt me down, and perhaps weaken it enough that the siege could be broken.

盲视：你获得盲视。

旋风吐息：作为一个标准动作，你可以呼出一道60尺锥形的蚀骨风暴。你的旋风吐息造成每束缚者等级1d6点伤害。区域内的每个生物都可以尝试反射豁免以减半伤害，并且还必须成功通过强韧豁免，否则被击倒并远离你1d4?0尺。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内无法再次使用。
src:
Orthos, Sovereign of the Howling Dark
    
Ancient and unknowable, Orthos gives its summoners the power to sense what they cannot see, to fool the sight of others, and to turn their breath into wind that can speak or scour flesh from bones.
  
Vestige Level: 8th
Binding DC: 35
Special Requirement: You must summon Orthos within an area of bright illumination.
  
Influence: While influenced by Orthos, you are averse to darkened areas and loud noises. Although you can endure such conditions, they give you a sense of panic and make you short of breath. Orthos requires that you always carry an active light source with a brightness at least equal to that of a candle, and that you not cover it or allow it to be darkened for more than 1 round. Additionally, Orthos requires that you speak only in a whisper.
  
Granted Abilities: 
Orthos gives you blindsight, displacement, and a breath weapon that you can use as a weapon.

Blindsight: You gain blindsight.

Displacement: You surround yourself with a light-bending glamer that makes it difficult for others to surmise your true location. Any melee or ranged attack directed at you has a 50% miss chance.

Whirlwind Breath: As a standard action, you can exhale a scouring blast of wind in a 60-foot cone. Your whirlwind breath deals 1d6 points of damage per binder level you possess. Every creature in the area can attempt a Reflex save to halve the damage, and must also succeed on a Fortitude save or be knocked prone and moved 1d4?0 feet away from you. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

School: Transmutation
Level: Earth 8, Sor/Wiz 8
Components: V, S, M/DF
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 min./level (D)

This spell transforms your body into living iron, which grants you several powerful resistances and abilities.
You gain damage reduction 15/adamantine. You are immune to blindness, critical hits, ability score damage, deafness, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning, and all spells or attacks that affect your physiology or respiration, because you have no physiology or respiration while this spell is in effect. You take only half damage from acid and fire of all kinds. However, you also become vulnerable to all special attacks that affect iron golems.
You gain a +6 enhancement bonus to your Strength score, but you take a -6 penalty to Dexterity as well (to a minimum Dexterity score of 1), and your speed is reduced to half normal. You have an arcane spell failure chance of 50% and a -8 armor check penalty, just as if you were clad in full plate armor. You cannot drink (and thus can't use potions) or play wind instruments.
Your unarmed attacks deal damage equal to a club sized for you (1d4 for Small characters or 1d6 for Medium characters), and you are considered armed when making unarmed attacks.
Your weight increases by a factor of ten, causing you to sink in water like a stone. However, you could survive the crushing pressure and lack of air at the bottom of the ocean - at least until the spell duration expires.

Arcane Material Component: A small piece of iron that was once part of either an iron golem, a hero's armor, or a war machine.

dst: 在击败牛头人海盗的过程中，瓦尔库尔之剑号的船员发现了一些海图，上面标明了其他海盗基地的位置。其中一处是一群人类海盗的基地，他们一直希望能除掉这群海盗，所以我们的下一站就是可以找到他们的那座岛。扎拉拉和我参与了对这第二群海盗的突袭，如今已经取得了胜利，尽管我们得知他们是在为一群蛇人效力，这些蛇人仍在扎泽斯普尔城的某处隐藏着一个基地。\n\n成功完成了这第二轮猎杀海盗的行动后，我们随瓦尔库尔之剑号来到了泰瑟尔国的扎泽斯普尔港。现在我们将暂时离开这艘船和它的船员。不过，在离开之前和船长谈谈也许是个好主意，因为他说过，他或许能给我们一些建议，告诉我们该如何着手下一个等待我们的任务——寻找一本珍贵的书。
src: In the process of defeating the minotaur pirates, the Sword of Valkur's crew discovered some charts indicating the locations of other pirate bases. One of them was the base of a group of human pirates they have long been hoping to put out of business, so our next stop was the island where they can be found. Zarala and I participated in the assault on this second group of pirates, which has now been brought to a victorious conclusion, although we did learn that they were working for a group of Yuan-ti who still maintains a base hidden somewhere in the city of Zazesspur.\n\nHaving successfully completed this second episode of pirate-hunting, we have traveled with the Sword of Valkur to the port of Zazesspur, in the nation of Tethyr. Now we shall take our leave of this ship and its crew, at least for the time being. It might however be a good idea to speak with the Captain before departing, as he said that he might be able to give us some ideas as to how we might go about the next task awaiting us, finding a valuable book.

身着骨白色盔甲，身披正义信念，影敌审判官不断与任何形式的邪恶战斗。每个影敌审判官都属于一个名为光明骑士团的宗教骑士团。该骑士团主张对邪恶进行无情打击，其成员训练以侦测和摧毁邪恶生物及个人。充满热忱的审判者只知道一种解决邪恶泛滥的方法：剑。净化之焰和神圣之剑的洁净切割是他的工具。与他们的同志（骑士团成员彼此如此称呼）影敌行者一起，审判者找到并直面邪恶，无论它藏身何处。然而，与影敌行者不同，审判者强调清除邪恶而非寻找邪恶。他们无情的热情和对自身正义的压倒性信念使影敌审判官能够干净利落地根除邪恶，即使牺牲一些善良生物的生命，也不会像其他骑士那样感到道德上的疑虑。光明骑士团阐述道，牺牲一个藏有强大恶魔的村庄，总比冒险让恶魔逃脱或邪恶蔓延要好。尽管审判者仍然献身于善良事业，这种信念使他们能够对敌人使用能力，无论其阵营如何。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Clad in bone-white armor and wreathed in righteous conviction, shadowbane inquisitors battle incessantly against evil in whatever form it takes. Every shadowbane inquisitor belongs to a fellowship of religious knights called the Order of Illumination. The order advocates merciless aggression against evil, and its members train to detect and destroy evil creatures and individuals. Filled with fervor, an inquisitor knows only one solution to an infestation of evil: the sword. The purifying flame and the clean cut of a holy blade are his tools. Along with their comrades (as members of the order refer to one another) the shadowbane stalkers, inquisitors find and confront evil wherever it hides. Unlike shadowbane stalkers, however, inquisitors emphasize purging evil rather than finding it. Their relentless zeal and their overwhelming belief in their own righteousness allow shadowbane inquisitors to root out evil cleanly, even if it costs the lives of a few good creatures, without the moral doubt that other knights might feel. The Order of Illumination expounds that it is better to sacrifice a village that hides a powerful demon than it is to risk letting the demon escape or the evil spread. Although inquisitors remain devoted to the cause of good, this conviction allows them to use their  abilities against enemies regardless of their alignment. 

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Shadowbane inquisitors are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor, and with shields.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

 Alignment: Lawful good. 
 Base Attack: +5. 
 Skills: Persuade 4 ranks, Lore 2 ranks, Sense Motive 8 ranks. 
 Feats: Power Attack. 
 Special: Detect evil class feature or ability to cast detect evil as a divine spell. 
 Special: Turn undead class feature. 
 Special: Sneak attack class feature.

src:
I have learned of several notorious criminals who have prices on their heads:

Jacho Kralow, the leader of a gang of violent criminals that have long plagued the city of Zazesspur, who had recently gone into hiding. I found him in the sewers and have been rewarded for his head.

Obgron the Ogre Mage, the leader of a band of humanoid raiders who have been attacking caravans traveling north along the Trade Way.

Haryan Krow, the leader of a band of mercenaries who turned to banditry when the end of Tethyr's civil wars led to their unemployment. They have been conducting raids along the roads east of the city.

The head of any of the above is worth 1800 gold, and the heads can be taken to Captain Tanendt, commander of the harbor fort just west of the Winsome Repose Inn.

水妖精-宁芙是自然界形体之美的化身，也是荒野圣地的守护者。她们憎恨邪恶，对破坏自然者持鄙夷态度。然而，尊重荒野者往往会受到善待，但水妖精-宁芙的性情变幻莫测，随时可能改变。她们对精灵，半精灵和德鲁伊最为友善，视其为自然之友。从外表上看，水妖精-宁芙的体型与体重与女性精灵相仿，且始终为女性。她们美得令人难以承受，若不采取预防措施，足以令旁观者目盲，而愤怒水妖精-宁芙的一瞥几乎能震慑任何生物。

水妖精-宁芙属性调整：敏捷 +6，体质 +2，智力 +6，感知 +6，魅力 +8。
天赋职业（德鲁伊）：在判断兼职水妖精-宁芙是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其德鲁伊职业等级不计入其中。

- 基础移动速度 30 英尺
- 微光视觉：使其在黑暗中比正常情况看得更清楚。
- 精类伤害减免：伤害减免 10/寒铁
- 野性认同：动物认同检定获得 +6 种族加值。
- 超凡恩典：水妖精-宁芙的魅力调整值会加到其 AC 和所有豁免检定上。
- 夺目之美：30 英尺内所有生物必须通过 DC 13+魅力 的强韧豁免，否则目盲。
- 震慑一瞥：30 英尺内一个生物必须通过 DC 13+魅力 的强韧豁免，否则被震慑 2d4 轮。
- 类法咒能力：每日 1 次任意门
- 精类：在法咒效果方面，水妖精-宁芙视为精类。

src:
Nymphs are nature's embodiment of physical beauty, and are the guardians of the sacred places of the wild.  They hate evil, and take a dim view on those who despoil nature.  Those who respect the wilds however are often shown kindness, but a nymph's demeanor is mercurial and could change at a moment's notice.  They are most friendly towards elves, half-elves, and druids, knowing them for friends of nature.  Physically nymphs are about the size and weight of a female elf, and are always female themselves.  They are so unbearably lovely they can blind onlookers if the nymph does not take precautions, and the glance of an angry nymph can stun almost any creature.

Nymph Ability Adjustments: +6 Dex, +2 Con, +6 Int, +6 Wis, +8 Cha.
Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass nymph's druid class does not count when determining whether she suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Base movement of 30'
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Fey Damage Reduction: DR 10/cold iron
- Wild Empathy: +6 racial bonus to animal empathy checks.
- Unearthly Grace: A nymph's Charisma modifier is added to their AC and all saving throws.
- Blinding Beauty: All creatures within 30' must make a Fort save vs DC 13+Cha or be blinded.
- Stunning Glare: One creature within 30' must make a Fort save vs DC 13+Cha or be stunned for 2d4 rounds.
- Spell-like Abilities: Dimension Door 1/day
- Fey: Nymphs count as Fey for the purpose of spells.

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)
Level Adjustment: +7
Racial Hit Dice/Class: 6 of Fey

迪斯帕特信徒是邪恶的好战将领。他注重防御，乐于让他人为自己而战。当他必须战斗时，他会按照自己的条件，在自己选择的战场上作战。迪斯帕特信徒近乎偏执，因此不信任任何人。他们对铁拥有神秘力量，使自己在战斗中能获得更强大的能力。

- 生命骰：d10
- 武器防具熟练：迪斯帕特信徒熟练所有简易和军用武器，所有盔甲和盾牌。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：任意邪恶
基础攻击加值：+6
专长：黑暗信徒，专攻武器，猛力攻击。

职业特性：

等级
1：装置知识 - 解除装置检定获得+2加值。
2：铁劈 - 每天一次，迪斯帕特信徒可以在等于体质调整值的轮数内，使攻击伤害获得+3神圣加值。
3：锈蚀之握 - 每天一次，信徒可以尝试抓住对手的武器，如果该武器大部分是金属，则将其摧毁。
4：铁之力 - 使用铁或钢制武器时，攻击和伤害检定获得+1加值。此外，他的威胁范围翻倍，如同武器具有锋锐属性。8级时加值提升至+2.此效果不与锋锐武器叠加，但与精通重击专长叠加。
5：召唤厄里倪厄斯 - 信徒每天可以召唤1个厄里倪厄斯。
6：高等铁劈 - 每天每点体质加值一次，迪斯帕特信徒可以在该轮进行的攻击伤害上增加+6神圣加值。
7：铁肤：每天一次，迪斯帕特信徒可以产生与石肤术相同的效果。
10：钢筋铁骨 - 每天一次，信徒可以产生与钢筋铁骨相同的效果。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Disciple of Dispater is a war-like general of evil. He is defensively minded and eager to have others fight for him. When he must fight, he does so on his terms and on his chosen battleground. Disciples of Dispater verge on paranoia and are thus distrustful of everyone. They have mystical power over iron that allows them to grant themselves even greater abilities in battle.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Disciple of Dispater is proficient in all simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any Evil
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Feats: Disciple of Darkness, Expertise, Power Attack.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Device Lore - A +2 Bonus to Disable Device checks.
2: Iron Hews - Once per day the Disciple of Dispater may add a +3 divine bonus on damage from attacks for 1 round per Constitution modifier.
3: Rusting Grasp - Once per day, Disciple can attempt to grab an opponents weapon and if it is mostly metal destroy it.
4: Iron Power - When using an iron or steel weapon, gain +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Furthermore his threat range is doubled as if the weapon were keen. At 8th level the bonus improves to +2. This does not stack with Keen Weapons but does with the Improved Critical feat.
5: Summon Erinyes - Disciple can summon 1 erinyes once per day.
6: Greater Iron Hews - Once per day per point of Constitution bonus a Disciple of Dispater may add a +6 divine bonus on damage from attacks made that round.
7: Iron Skin: Once per day a Disciple of Dispater can produce an effect identical to the stone skin spell.
10: Iron Body - Once per day a disciple can produce an effect identical to that on an Iron Body spell.

dst: 贫民窟中一位贫穷的平民为我指了她地板上一个洞，我可以从那里下到一个坍塌的地下室。她最近一直听到那里传来奇怪的声响，担心有某种怪物搬了进去。我应当调查此事。\n\n看来那些声响实际上并非由任何怪物造成，而是贫民窟的一位居民，当上面他的房子在一场火灾中坍塌时，他被困在了这个区域。我已将他从困住他的瓦砾中救出，并告知了上面房子里的那位女人，她所听到的声响实际上是由什么造成的。
src: A poor commoner in the slums pointed me towards a hole in her floor through which I could descend into a collapsed basement. She has been hearing strange noises coming from there recently and fears a monster of some kind may have moved in. I should investigate this matter.\n\nIt seems the noises were actually not being caused by any monster, but by an inhabitant of the slums who was trapped in this area when his house above collapsed in a fire. I have freed him from the rubble he was trapped behind, and informed the woman in the house above has been informed of what was actually causing the noises she heard.

src:
COMBAT MANEUVER
You can bash an opponent with a light shield or heavy shield, using it as an off-hand weapon. Small shields deal 1d3, heavy shields deal 1d4. Both add 1/2 Srength modifier as an off-hand weapon. Used this way, a shield is a martial bludgeoning weapon. For the purpose of penalties on attack rolls, treat a heavy shield as a one-handed weapon and a light shield as a light weapon. If you use your shield as a weapon, you lose its AC bonus for one round. An enhancement bonus on a shield does not improve the effectiveness of a shield bash made with it.

dst: "哦，你是那种冒险者，对吧？我们住在码头附近，时不时就有从船上下来的这种人。总觉得自己哪儿都得插一脚，还问有没有人能给他们任务。我猜你就是为这个来的？我可没什么你要找的那种任务，不过你要是非要做点什么，大可以去‘惬意安息’旅店的酒馆，告诉我丈夫本回家。他一直跟他朋友克拉夫·德尔森在那儿喝酒。"她接着描述了这两个人的样貌。"他出去够久了，这儿还有活儿等着他干呢。"
src: "Oh, you're one of those adventurers are you? Living down by the docks as we do, we get them coming off the ships every now and then. Always feel they have to poke their noses in everywhere, and ask if anyone has quests to give them. I suppose that's why you're here? Can't say I really have any quests of the sort you'd be looking for, but if you're determined to do something I suppose you could always head over to the tavern at the Winsome Repose Inn and tell my husband Ben to come home. He's been drinking there with his friend Clav Derlson." She proceeds to describe both men. "He been gone quite long enough and there's work for him to do here."

dst: "我明白了。虽然你可能是一名武僧，但我不确定你是否是我通常愿意指导的那种武僧。有些教团所信奉的原则与伊尔梅特所教导的任何东西都截然不同，而你似乎就是这样一个教团的成员。尽管如此，我对纳西拉克极为敬重，所以如果他认为你能从我所能提供的这点微薄指导中受益，我会尽力而为。我曾听人说，修行的训练本质上必定会增长智慧，即便对那些出于愚蠢目的而修行的人也是如此。我希望在你身上也能证明这一点。"
src: "I see. While you may be a monk, I am not sure you are the kind of monk I would normally be willing to instruct. Some orders are devoted to principles radically divergent from anything Ilmater teaches, and you seem to be a member of one such. Nevertheless, I have great respect for Nasirak, so if he thinks you would benefit from such meager instruction as I can provide, I will do what I can. I have heard it said that the discipline of monastic training must by its nature increase wisdom even in those who undertake it for foolish purposes. I shall hope that proves to be true in your case."

dst: “因为那儿几乎所有东西都靠钱，这就是原因。就说最基本的，为什么有人有房子住、有饭吃？因为他们用钱换来了这些。几乎所有做过的好事都是因为有人付了钱才做的，否则根本不会有人去做。贪婪为这个世界做的事，比所有那些说教的、反对贪婪的傻瓜们多得多。”

施法者将一个自愿的受术者转化为波达克。忽略受术者所有旧有特征，改用怪物图鉴中的波达克描述。

在施放该法咒之前，施法者必须制作一个代表受术者的微型雕像，然后将其浸泡在至少三只小型或更大动物的血液中。法咒施放后，任何持有该雕像的人都可以尝试与波达克进行心灵沟通并控制它，但该生物可以通过一次成功的意志豁免检定来抵抗这种控制。如果波达克失败，它必须服从雕像持有者，但它每天获得一次新的豁免检定以打破控制。如果雕像被摧毁，波达克会解体。

器材：受术者的雕像，浸泡在动物血液中。

药物成分：痛苦
src:
Bodak Birth
Transmutation [Evil]
Level: Clr 8
Components: V S, F, Drug
Casting Time: 1 minute
Range: Touch
Target: One creature touched
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None (see text)
Spell Resistance: No

The caster transforms one willing subject into a bodak. Ignore all of the subject's old characteristics, using the bodak description in the Monster Manual instead.

Before casting the spell, the caster must make a miniature figurine that represents the subject, then bathe it in the blood of at least three Small or larger animals. Once the spell is cast, anyone that holds the figurine can attempt to mentally communicate and control the bodak, but the creature resists such control with a successful Will saving throw. If the bodak fails, it must obey the holder of the
figurine, but it gains a new saving throw every day to break the control. If the figurine is destroyed, the bodak disintegrates.

Focus: Figurine of subject, bathed in animal blood.

Drug Component: Agony

Contingent Reunion teleports you to any target when certain conditions arise. Once cast, the spell remains quiescent until triggered, at which point you will instantaneously teleport directly to the location of your target, wherever it may be. You may decide on a variety of trigger conditions, varying from you or your targets death, poisoning, incapacitation, wounded level, etc. Your choices of targets include nearly anything: A spot on the ground, a fellow adventurer, a door, a rock, a tree, etc. While the spell remains quiescent, you lose access to one epic spell slot per day. Once the spell triggers, you regain the reserved spell slot. In addition, you may willfully dispel the contingency to regain the spell slot, at any time before the contingency triggers.

Andras, the Gray Knight
  
A great warrior in life, Andras is an enigma as a vestige. He gives binders prowess in combat and skill in the saddle.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 22
Special Requirement: No.

Influence: Andras's influence causes you to become listless and emotionally remote. Because Andras wearies of combat quickly, you become exhausted after only 10 rounds of battle, and flee from the fight for 1d4 rounds.

Mount: As a full-round action, you can summon a heavy warhorse. You can use this ability once per day.

Sow Discord: Andras grants you the ability to sow discord among your enemies. As a standard action, you can force an enemy that fails a Will save to attack a randomly determined ally within reach on his next action. Sow discord is a mind-affecting compulsion ability. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Sure Blows: You gain the benefit of the Improved Critical feat with any weapon you wield.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Duelist is a nimble, intelligent fighter trained in making precise attacks with light weapons, such as the rapier. Also known as the swashbuckler, the Duelist always takes full advantage of his quick reflexes and wits in a fight. Rather than wearing bulky armor, Duelists feel that the best way to protect themselves is to not get hit at all.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: A Duelist is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, but does not gain any armor or shield proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +6
Feats: Dodge, Weapon Finesse, Mobility.
Skills: Tumble 5 ranks. Perform 3 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
 1: Canny Defense - Dodge bonus to AC based on intelligence bonus, limited by class level.
 2: Thug - +2 initiative, +2 Persuade
 3: Spring Attack - No longer incurs Attacks of Opportunity for moving in combat.
 4: Grace - +2 Bonus to reflex saves.
 5: Precise Strike +1d6 - Bonus damage while wielding a light piercing weapon.
 6: Acrobatic Charge - Ignore impediments while charging
 7: Elaborate Parry - Bonus to Armor Class when Fighting Defensively
 8: Blooded - +2 initiative, +2 Spot
 9: Deflect Arrows
10: Precise Strike +2d6

NOTES:

Duelist loses Canny Defense, Precise Strike, and Grace while wearing any armor or shield.

Could not implement PnP's Improved Reaction, +2 bonus to initiative. So I gave them the Thug and Blooded feats, as they are very close in bonus.

Could not implement PnP's Enhanced Mobility, +4 AC vs. Attacks of Opportunity. That bonus would stack with mobility... I gave them Spring Attack instead as that was the closest thing to it.

dst: 在穿过尖牙森林中一些充满敌意的精类生物后，我遇到了一位名叫黛娜拉的树精，她显然代表着另一个精类生物派系，希望避免与外来者发生冲突。黛娜拉告诉我，敌对派系正受到暗影德鲁伊的煽动。除了煽动对外来者的暴力行为外，这些暗影德鲁伊还囚禁了一些树精。黛娜拉承诺，如果我能找到或消灭这些暗影德鲁伊（对于德鲁伊，我应该取回他们的首领大德鲁伊阿玛兰德所佩戴的一枚独特戒指，作为他死亡的证据），解救被囚禁的树精，或两者兼而有之，她就会奖励我。她建议，拥有我这般才能的人或许可以通过赢得与敌对精类生物并肩作战的动物的好感并与它们交谈，从而找到德鲁伊的藏身之处。\n\n我与其中一只曾与敌对精类生物并肩作战的动物交谈，得知了如何到达暗影德鲁伊的藏身之处。通往他们的隐秘小径入口可以在森林西部山脊以东的区域找到。既然我知道了位置，找到并使用它应该不难。
src: After getting past some hostile Fey in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, I met a dryad named Dainala who apparently represents another faction of Fey, who wish to avoid conflict with outsiders. Dainala told me that the hostile faction is being encouraged by Shadow Druids. In addition to encouraging violenece against outsders, these Shadow Druids are also holding some dryads captive. Dainala has promised to reward me if I can either find or elimnate these Shadow Druids  (in the case of the druids, I should recover a distinctive ring carried by the archdruid Amarande, their leader,, as proof of his death), free the captive dryads, or both. She has suggested that someone with my talents might be able to locate the hiding place of the druids by winning over and talking to the animals fighting with the hostile fey.\n\nI talked to one of the animals who had been fighting with the hostile fey, and was informed of how to reach the hiding place of the Shadow Druids. A entrance to a hidden path to reach them can be found in the area east of the ridge in the western part of the forest. It should not be difficult to locate and use now that I know where it is.

dst:
底栖魔鱼是高度智慧、长寿的异怪，通常生活在幽暗地域深处。外表上，它们像长着触手的鱼。它们是两栖的，偏好水域环境。它们通过产卵繁殖，是雌雄同体（同时拥有雄性和雌性性器官）。据说它们并非费伦原生物种，而是从某个遥远位面来到此地。

底栖魔鱼拥有强大的灵能，类似于夺心魔，甚至可能更强大。与夺心魔一样，它们也是残忍的种族，追求自身利益时不受任何道德约束。如果遇到其他种族成员，它们很可能会试图奴役或消灭对方，尽管偶尔也会与其他水生或半水生种族（如寇涛鱼人）结盟。它们奴役他人的尝试得益于一种特殊能力，似乎部分属于灵能，部分属于生物性，使它们能分泌一种黏液，覆盖其他生物，并在此过程中以某种方式将其转化为无意识的奴隶。

也许底栖魔鱼最显著的特征是它们的种族记忆。底栖魔鱼继承祖先的记忆，有时还会吸收所吞噬生物的记忆。因此，即使是最年轻的底栖魔鱼也拥有大量各个领域的知识和专长。再加上它们的灵能和残忍，使它们极其危险。
src:
Aboleths are highly intelligent, long-lived aberrations typically found living deep in the Underdark. In appearance, they resemble a fish with tentacles. They are amphibious, and prefer watery environments. They reproduce by laying eggs, and are hermaphroditic (possessing both male and female sex organs). It is said that they are not native to Faerun, but came here from some distant plane.

Aboleths possess great psionic powers, similar to, and perhaps even mightier than, those of Illithids. Also like Illithids, they are a cruel race, pursuing their self-interest unencumbered by any moral restraint. If they encounter members of other races, they will most likely attempt to either enslave or exterminate them, though on occasion they have been known to form alliances with other aquatic or semi-aquatic races, such as the Kuo Toa. Their attempts at enslavement are aided by a special power, apparently part psionic and part biological, allowing them to secrete a slimy fluid that can cover other creatures and in the process somehow transform them into mindless slaves.

Perhaps the most distinctive trait of Aboleths is their racial memory. Aboleths inherit the memories of their ancestors, and sometimes assimilate memories from creatures they consume. As a result, even the youngest Aboleths possess a wealth of knowledge and expertise in numerous areas. Coupled with their psionic powers and ruthlessness, this makes them dangerous in the extreme.

影迅是带有影界血统的异界生物。他们性情多变，喜欢活在当下。因此，他们不擅长计划，对策略缺乏耐心。影迅与其他种族外貌差异很大，尽管他们身材精瘦，五官轮廓分明，很像精灵。男性平均身高约6英尺，体重165磅。他们的皮肤从棕色到黑色不等，眼睛呈黑色且倾斜--这种体型非常适合隐藏在暗影中。与大多数物种不同，影迅对大多数其他种族都很友好，认为个人行为比血统更重要。

src:
Shadowswyft are planetouched beings with ancestry from the Plane of Shadow. They are mercurial in temperament and delight in living in the moment. As a result, they are poor planners and have little patience for strategy. Shadowswyfts bear little resemblance to other races, although they are lean with chiseled features, much like elves. The average male stands about 6 feet tall and weights 165 pounds. They have skin ranging from brown to black, with blackened, slanted eyes - a build perfectly suited for hiding amongst shadows. Unlike most species, shadowswyfts are amiable towards most other races, seeing individual actions as more important than blood lineage.

Shadowswyft Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Con.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass shadowswyft's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Shadowswyfts can see in the dark.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All shadowswift are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Martial): All shadowswift are proficient with Martial Weapons.
- Armor Proficiency (Lightl): All shadowswift are proficient with Light armor.
- Base movement of 40.
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +4 racial bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Blooded: +2 racial bonus to Initiative and Spot checks.
- Light Blindness: Abrupt exposure to light blinds a shadowswyft for 1 round. In addition shadowswyft suffer -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Outsider: Shadowswyfts are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

dst: "这份悬赏涉及的情况有些不同寻常。你大概听说过暗影盗贼团吧？就是那个控制安姆地下世界的公会？他们一直试图把势力扩张到云峰山脉以北，该组织的一名代表已经在那些山脉和海岸附近的一座旧塔里设立了据点。我们自然不希望这种犯罪组织出现在这一带，所以已经为这名代表的脑袋开出了20000金币的悬赏。可惜，事实证明这赏金并不那么容易拿到。那座塔戒备森严，还有各种结界、陷阱、锁具等等保护着。显然，它是被设计来考验那些有盗贼才能之人的，大概是认为任何有本事闯过那座塔并真正见到那名代表的人，都足以证明自己是值得被暗影盗贼团招募的合适人选。"
src: "This bounty involves a somewhat unusual situation. You've probably heard of the Shadow Thieves? The guild that controls the underworld in Amn? They've been trying to expand their operations north of the Cloudpeaks, and a representative of that organization has set up station in an old tower near those mountains and the coast. Naturally, we don't want a criminal organization like that around here, so a bounty of 20000 gold has been placed on this representative's head. Unfortunately, it hasn't proven that easy to collect. The tower is well-guarded and protected by all sorts of wards, traps, locks and so forth. Apparently it was designed to test those with thieving talents, the expectation being that anyone good enough to get through the tower and actually meet with the representative would have proven himself to be a suitable candidate to be recruited by the Shadow Thieves."

dst:
贝希尔护喉

描述符：电击 
职业：图腾师 
脉轮：喉部（图腾） 
豁免检定：见正文

魂能在你脖子上形成一个大而深蓝色的护领，就像板甲的一部分。背面的颜色较深，前面渐变为淡蓝色，顶部和底部有灰棕色的条纹。护喉在胸骨上方逐渐变细成一个尖点。

你的贝希尔护喉使你在抵抗冲撞或绊摔时获得+4加值。

魂能点：你获得等于你投入此魂能融合中的魂能点数量5倍的电击抗力。

脉轮绑定（喉部） 

你的装甲护领融入你的喉咙，你的脖子略微变长。你能感觉到脖子两侧持续刺痛，说话时嘴里偶尔会喷出小火花--尤其是当你兴奋或愤怒时。

你获得以一个标准动作投射一道电击线的能力。每分钟一次，你可以发射一道5英尺长加每点投入魂能点5英尺长的电击线。线中的目标受到2d6点电击伤害加每点投入魂能点1d6点伤害。他们可以通过成功的反射豁免将伤害减半。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

当你将贝希尔护喉绑定到你的图腾脉轮时，其坚硬的蓝色甲片沿着你的脖子向上蔓延，覆盖你的整个头部。你的脸变长，下颚变得巨大。锋利的牙齿充满你的口腔，让你能在战斗中野蛮地咬噬敌人。每当你张嘴咬噬--甚至说话时，嘴里都会噼啪作响。

你获得一次造成1d8点伤害的咬噬攻击。你可以将此咬噬作为主要攻击使用。投入此魂能融合中的每点魂能点使你的咬噬伤害增加1d4点电击伤害。
src:
Behir Gorget

Descriptors: Electricity 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Throat (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms a large, deep blue collar around your neck, like part of a suit of plate armor. The color is darker on the back and fades to pale blue in the front, and bands of gray-brown line the top and bottom. The gorget tapers to a sharp point above your breastbone.

Your behir gorget gives you a +4 bonus to resist being bull rushed or tripped. 

Essentia: You gain resistance to electricity equal to 5 times the number of points of essentia you invest in this soulmeld. 

Chakra Bind (Throat) 

Your armored collar merges into your throat, and your neck lengthens very slightly. You can feel a constant tingling in the sides of your neck, and tiny sparks occasionally spit from your mouth when you speak - particularly when you get excited or angry.

You gain the ability to project a line of electricity as a standard action. Once per minute, you can emit a line of acid that is 5 feet long plus 5 feet per point of invested essentia. Targets in the line take 2d6 points of electricity damage plus 1d6 points for every point of invested essentia. They can reduce this damage by half with a successful Reflex save. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

As you bind your behir gorget to your totem chakra, its hard blue plating spreads up your neck to incorporate your entire head. Your face lengthens, and your jaw grows monstrous. Sharp teeth fill your mouth, allowing you to bite your foes savagely in combat. Sparks crackle in your mouth whenever you open it to bite-or even to speak.

You gain a bite attack that deals 1d8 points of damage. You can use this bite as a primary attack. Every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld adds 1d4 points of electricity damage to your bite damage.

在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个名叫布利夫明·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取具有魔法用途的试剂。他所说的"中央收集区"周围的四个分站的机器一直出问题，他承诺如果我能够帮忙解决他遇到的各种问题，就会给我报酬。

东北方向的机器发生了故障，在自身周围释放了一团毒气。我现在已经将其关闭，以便进行修理。

东南方向的机器似乎有类似的问题，喷出了一些软泥，可能也有某种毒性。我必须冒险穿过它来关闭这台机器。

西北方向的机器所在房间被食腐虫占据了。这些怪物已经被清除了。

西南方向的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被藏在下水道里的罪犯拆走了。不过，我成功找回了这个部件，这应该会让修理容易得多。

我已经向泽姆昆汇报了我的进展。完成的其他任务也应该向泽姆昆汇报。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast was malfunctioning, and released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I have now shut this down so that it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast has what appears to be a similar problem, having spewed forth some kind of slime, also likely toxic in some way. I shall have to risk moving through it to shut down this machine as well.

The machine to the northwest was in a room occupied by otyughs. These monsters have been cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some criminals hiding in the sewers. However, I was able to recover the part, which should make its repair much easier.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

dst: "然而阿兹古尔卡不知怎的占了上风，那位备受尊崇的祖先被杀害了。当然，他关于那一确切时刻的记忆无法被传承下来，所以此事如何发生至今仍是个谜。查明真相至关重要，因为我预计不久就能重现那位祖先的成就。到那时我就没什么好怕的了，或许除了那些塔纳厘——他们不知怎的曾击败过这些手段，如今又蠢蠢欲动。难道阿兹古尔卡不知怎的获得了某位神祇的协助，而我们尚不知如何完全对抗其力量？要是能找到办法阻止这些低等种族崇拜此类存在并获取其援助就好了。这大概是他们唯一能战胜我们的依仗。不过，我怀疑此事与此无关。据我们所能判断，阿兹古尔卡和我们一样鄙视诸神，不太可能与这样的力量合作。"
src: "Yet somehow Azghulkar prevailed and the revered ancestor was slain. Of course his memories of that precise moment could not be handed on, so it remains a mystery how this happened. It is vital that we find out, for I expect soon to replicate the ancestor's achievement. Then I will have little to fear, except perhaps from the same Tanar'ri, who somehow defeated these measures before and who now stirs again. Could it be that Azghulkar somehow gained the assistance of a deity, whose power we do not yet know how to fully combat? If only some way could be found to discourage these inferior races from worshipping such entities and gaining their aid. It is probably the only thing that allows them to ever prevail against us. Nevertheless, I have doubts it was relevant in this case. Azghulkar, as best we could tell, despises the gods as much as we do, and would be unlikely to work with such a power."

dst: 这本书记录了各种制造锁具和陷阱的方法，据称能够挫败任何试图通过的盗贼。它还提供了给哨兵的指导，旨在帮助他们发现任何试图潜行经过的人，以及如何避免成为扒手的受害者的提示。当然，了解用来对付他们的技术也可能对盗贼自身有益。\n\n注意：使用这本书将提供经验值。其中包含的信息对具有一定潜行和盗窃才能的职业最为相关：盗贼、刺客、影舞者和吟游诗人。
src: This book records various methods of constructing locks and traps that are claimed to be able to frustrate any theives attempting to get past them. It also provides guidance to sentinels intended to aid them in spotting anyone trying to stealthily sneak past them, and tips on how to avoid being victimized by pick-pockets. Of course, knowing about the techniques being used to counter them could also benefit thieves themselves.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide experience. The information it contains will be most relevant to classes with some aptitude for stealth and thievery: rogues, asssassins, shadowdancers and bards.

Your body and all your equipment are subsumed by your shadow. As a living shadow, you drift in and out of the shadow plane, giving you total concealment (50% miss chance).

While affected by this power, you can be detected by powers that read thoughts, life, or presences (including true seeing).

If you take any hostile actions, you will return fully to the Prime Material plane for a round.

dst: 觉醒之年，即DR 1001年，随着寻宝的探险者在多处发掘废墟，许多古老的邪恶再度现世。其中一处被打开的封印释放了塞克图尔，一个被囚禁在米尔森林地下的巫妖。他前往某个未知的据点，但他被打开的墓穴很快便污染了该地区的树木。德鲁伊们用火焰净化了这片区域，但其中一些木材被当地一名法师取走，制成了这些长矛。尽管相当强大，但德鲁伊以及同情德鲁伊世界观的人会犹豫是否使用这些长矛所引导的非自然能量。
src: The Year of the Awakening, 1001 DR, saw the reemergence of many ancient evils as treasure-hungry explorers unearthed ruins in several locations. One such breach freed Sek'coTul, a lich imprisoned beneath the Forest of Mir. He left for some unknown hold, but his opened tomb quickly tainted trees in the area. Druids cleansed the area with fire, but some of the wood was taken by a local mage and made into these spears. Though quite powerful, druids and those sympathetic to the druidic worldview would hesitate to use the unnatural energies these spears channel.

src: Rajar has assigned me yet another mission. I am to steal the Serkhad Scarab, located in the treasure vault of the Serkhad Noble Estate. To get in I should enter the sewers beneath the noble estates, where I will find a passage to the basement of this estate. Once in, I will need to search the estate for two keys, one for the outer, and one for the inner door to the vault. Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.\n\nI acquired the Serkhad Scarab and returned it to Rajar for a reward. A most profitable task.

（进阶职业）
自组织成立以来，法师和术士一直是竖琴手不可或缺的一部分。事实上，如今许多资深成员都是强大的法师。

该组织的主要盟友中有几位有影响力的法师和术士，他们将自己积累的一些知识提供给竖琴手。

魔法女神密斯特拉是竖琴手的守护神之一；她的前任是几个世纪前在舞动之地会面以启发竖琴手组织成立的守护神之一。拥有如此丰富的魔法传统，竖琴手发展出一些自己的魔法知识和技巧传给他们的特工是不可避免的。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 武器和防具擅长：竖琴手法师擅长简单武器。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

专长：警觉，法术延时。
阵营：任意非邪恶。
技能：专注（4 级），法咒辨识（8 级），学识（8 级），说服（2 级）.
法咒：能够施放 3 级奥术。

职业特性：

等级
1：专长 - 技能专攻：学识 - 为所有学识技能检定提供 +3 加值。
2：专长 - 技能专攻：法咒辨识 - 为所有法咒辨识技能检定提供 +3 加值。
3：专长 - 法术定发。
4：专长 - 法术默发。
5：法咒抗力 - 竖琴手法师获得 +2 加值到对抗法咒的豁免检定。

奖励法咒

在竖琴手法师职业上获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他们在其最高奥术施法职业上也获得了等级一样。然而，通过此能力不会学习到新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Wizards and sorcerers have been an integral part of the Harpers since the organization's inception. Indeed, many of its senior members today are powerful mages.

Among the organization's principal allies are several influential wizards and sorcerers who have made some of their accumulated knowledge available to the Harpers.

Mystra, the deity of magic, is one of the patron deities of the Harpers; her predecessor being one of the deities who met at the Dancing Place centuries ago to inspire the founding of the Harpers organization. With such a rich magical tradition, it was inevitable that the Harpers would develop some of their own magical lore and techniques to pass on to their agents.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: A Harper Mage is proficient with simple weapons.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Feats: Alertness, Extend Spell.
Alignment: Any non-evil.
Skills: Concentration (4 ranks), Spellcraft (8 ranks), Lore (8 ranks), Persuade (2 ranks).
Spells: Able to cast 3rd level arcane spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Feat - Skill Focus: Lore - Provides a +3 bonus to all Lore skill checks.
2: Feat - Skill Focus: Spellcraft - Provides a +3 bonus to all Spellcraft skill checks.
3: Feat - Still Spell.
4: Feat - Silent Spell.
5: Hardiness vs. Spells - The Harper Mage gains a +2 bonus to saving throws vs spells.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Harper Mage, the character gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their highest Arcane spellcasting class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

- 小型体型：
 +1 体型加值到攻击检定。
 +1 体型加值到防御等级。
 +4 体型加值到躲藏检定。
- 技能亲和（搜索）: +2 种族加值到搜索检定。
- 技能亲和（侦察）: +2 种族加值到侦察检定。
- 技能亲和（聆听）: +2 种族加值到聆听检定。
- 敏锐感知：高个半身人自动进行主动搜索检定，且没有移动惩罚。
- 幸运：+1 幸运加值到所有豁免检定。
- 无畏：+2 士气加值到对抗'恐惧'子类法咒和效果的豁免检定。
- 精准投掷：+1 种族加值到使用投掷武器的攻击检定。
- 半身人：在法咒效果上，高个半身人被视为半身人。

特殊：半身人是小型生物，因此他们永远无法使用以下大型武器：重剑，巨锤，双刃剑，双头斧，巨斧，巨剑，戟，重型连枷，长棍，镰刀和矛。
src:
Tallfellow halflings are slightly bigger than their lightfoot cousins. They stand more than half as high as humans, and have athletic builds, fair skin and fair hair. Tallfellows are somewhat rare among halfling folk, generally preferring the company of elves where they are known to exist. They are less athletic than their kin, despite their builds, and share some of the traits of their elf companions.

Tallfellow Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass tallfellow halfling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Keen Sense: Tallfellow Halflings make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Tallfellow Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

src: Kyra Kenemen, who resides in a house near the docks, has asked me to locate her husband, Ben, and ask him to return home. According to her, I can expect to find him at the Winsome Repose Inn, drinking with his friend Clav Derlson.\n\nClav Derlson told me to look for Ben Kenement at the House of Tears (a temple of Ilmater), and a priest there told me Ben had gone shopping for tools in the markets. A merchant there told me that he went to the furniture store. The proprietor of the furniture store informed me that Ben had gone on from there to visit a friend of his named Rence Mennald, and Mennald, in turn, told me that he had headed back to the Winsome Repose Inn to meet with Clav again. I shall be heading back there, fervently hoping that I will not need to run through this circuit all over again.

持续时间：专注 + 1 轮/等级（可解消）
豁免检定：意志，通过则无效
法术抗力：是

一个发光的，彩虹色调的，交织色彩的图纹会迷住其中的生物。虹彩图纹最多能迷住 24 个生命骰的生物。生命骰最少的生物先受影响。在生命骰相同的生物中，最靠近法咒源点的生物先受影响。受影响且豁免失败的生物会被图纹迷住。
通过一个简单的手势（一个自由动作），你可以让虹彩图纹每轮移动最多 30 英尺（移动其有效源点）.所有被迷住的生物会跟随移动的彩虹光芒，试图进入或保持在效果范围内。被迷住但被束缚并移出图纹的生物仍会试图跟随它。如果图纹将其目标引入危险区域，每个被迷住的生物获得第二次豁免。如果光芒的视线被完全阻挡，看不见光芒的生物不再受影响。
该法咒不影响无视觉的生物。

言语成分：法师或术士无需发出声音来施放此法咒，但吟游诗人必须唱歌，演奏音乐或朗诵韵文作为言语成分。
材料成分：一块磷光石。
器材：一个水晶棱镜。

School: Illusion (Pattern) [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Brd 4, Sor/Wiz 4
Components: V (Brd only), S, M, F; see text
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect: Colorful lights with a 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration: Concentration +1 round/ level (D)
Saving Throw: Will negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

A glowing, rainbow-hued pattern of interweaving colors fascinates those within it. Rainbow pattern fascinates a maximum of 24 Hit Dice of creatures. Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first. Among creatures with equal HD, those who are closest to the spell's point of origin are affected first. An affected creature that fails its saves is fascinated by the pattern.
With a simple gesture (a free action), you can make the rainbow pattern move up to 30 feet per round (moving its effective point of origin). All fascinated creatures follow the moving rainbow of light, trying to get or remain within the effect. Fascinated creatures who are restrained and removed from the pattern still try to follow it. If the pattern leads its subjects into a dangerous area each fascinated creature gets a second save. If the view of the lights is completely blocked creatures who can't see them are no longer affected.
The spell does not affect sightless creatures.

Verbal Component: A wizard or sorcerer need not utter a sound to cast this spell, but a bard must sing, play music, or recite a rhyme as a verbal component.
Material Component: A piece of phosphor.
Focus: A crystal prism.

dst:
（进阶职业）
元素学者研究存在的基本构成 - 空气，土，火，水 - 学习驾驭它们的力量。最终他们超越凡人之躯，成为元素生物。大多数元素学者最初是法师，不过牧师和德鲁伊也不少见。术士偶尔会选择这个进阶职业，但由于超魔专长对他们用处不大，他们很难充分发挥这个职业的优势。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 擅长：元素学者不会获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

施法：能够施放3级奥术
技能：知识8级。

职业特性：

等级
1：元素转化1 - 获得免疫睡眠。
  抗力+5 - 获得对所选元素的5点抗力。
2：元素专攻+1 - 使所选元素法咒的DC提高。
3：元素穿透+1 - 使所选元素法咒的法术穿透提高。
4：元素转化2 - 获得黑暗视觉和免疫麻痹。
  抗力+10 - 获得对所选元素的10点抗力。
5：元素专攻+2 - 法咒DC提高增加。
6：元素穿透+2 - 法术穿透加值提高。
7：元素转化3 - 获得免疫震慑。
  抗力+15 - 获得对所选元素的15点抗力。
8：元素专攻+3 - 法咒DC提高增加。
9：元素穿透+3 - 法术穿透加值提高。
10：元素完美 - 获得作为元素生物的所有好处，包括免疫毒素，睡眠，麻痹，震慑，重击和偷袭。获得所选类型中型元素的特殊攻击和特殊品质。获得对所选元素的免疫，但受到对立元素的所有法咒伤害加倍。

奖励法咒

在元素学者提升等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在最高施法职业（吟游诗人，术士或法师）上也提升了等级。他不会通过此能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Elemental Savants study the basic building blocks of existence - air, earth, fire, water - learning to harness their powers. Eventually they transcend their mortal form and become elemental beings. Most Elemental Savants start out as wizards, although clerics and druids are not unknown. Sorcerers occasionally take this prestige class, but since metamagic feats are of less utility to them, they have difficulty using the class's strengths to the fullest.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: An Elemental Savant does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd-level arcane spells
Skills: Lore 8 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Elemental Transition 1 - Grants Immunity to Sleep.
  Resistance +5 - Grants 5 resistance to chosen element.
2: Elemental Focus +1 - Grants a DC increase for spells of the chosen element.
3: Elemental Penetration +1 - Grants a Spell Penetration increase for spells of the chosen element.
4: Elemental Transition 2 - Grants Darkvision and Immunity to Paralysis.
  Resistance +10 - Grants 10 resistance to chosen element.
5: Elemental Focus +2 - Spell DC increase improves.
6: Elemental Penetration +2 - Spell Penetration bonus improves.
7: Elemental Transition 3 - Grants Immunity to Stun.
  Resistance +15 - Grants 15 resistance to chosen element.
8: Elemental Focus +3 - Spell DC increase improves.
9: Elemental Penetration +3 - Spell Penetration bonus improves.
10: Elemental Perfection - Gain all benefits of being an elemental, including immunity to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, critical hits and sneak attacks. Gain the special attacks and special qualities of a medium elemental of the chosen type. Gain immunity to the chosen element, but take double damage from all spells of the opposing element.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Elemental Savant, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (bard, sorcerer, or wizard). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

dst: 这件武器上的铭文表明它是由古代法师达里乌斯·梅内斯制造的。据说梅内斯喜欢说：“元素的平衡是关键。”后来有人争论他这句话是一般性的哲学陈述，还是关于操作某些种类奥术魔法的技术指南。虽然不知道是出于象征还是实际原因，但梅内斯在这把重锤上施加的附魔确实涉及元素的平衡。一个锤头从被击中的任何人身上吸取热量，将其冻结并将能量吸收到武器中，而另一个锤头则以耀眼的闪光释放这些窃取的热量。
src: An inscription on this weapon indicates that it was made by the ancient mage Darius Meneth. Meneth is reputed to have been fond of saying: "A balance of elements is the key." In later times some have disputed whether he meant this as a general philiosophical statement or a technical guide to working certain kinds of arcane magic. While it may not be known whether it was done for symbolic or practical reaons, the enchantments Meneth placed on this dire mace certainly involve a balance of elements. One macehead drains heat from anyone struck, freezing him and absorbing the energy into the weapon, while the other macehead releases this stolen heat in a blinding flash.

  作为一个标准动作，咒火持有者可以消耗储存的咒火能量作为近战或远程接触攻击（最大射程400英尺），每消耗一级造成1d6点咒火伤害（反射减半，DC 20）.咒火伤害一半是火焰伤害，一半是纯粹魔法力量。对火焰效果免疫，抵抗或保护的生物只对一半伤害生效，另一半不生效。生物也可以选择“咒火”作为武器专攻专长的武器。
  咒火持有者可以通过接触治疗目标，每为此目的消耗一级咒火能量恢复2点生命值。这不被视为正能量，因此不会伤害不死生物。

src:
Type of Feat: General
  Prerequisite: Can only take this feat at 1st-level.
  Specifics: You can use spellfire to absorb spell energy, fire destructive blasts, or heal others.
  A spellfire wielder can ready an action to absorb spells targeted at her as if she were a rod of absorption. She gains one level of spellfire energy for every spell level absorbed and can store a number of spellfire energy levels equal to her Constitution. If she has reached her limit, she cannot absorb spells until she expends some of her stored spellfire levels. If her Constitution decreases so that her number of stored spellfire levels is greater than her current Constitution, the excess levels discharge at a random creature in range as destructive spellfire.
  As a standard action, a spellfire wielder may expend stored spellfire energy as a melee or ranged touch attack (maximum range 400 feet), dealing 1d6 points of spellfire damage per level expended (Reflex half, DC 20). Spellfire damage is half fire damage and half raw magical power. Creatures with immunity, resistance, or protection against fire effects apply these to only half the damage, but not the other half. A creature can also choose "spellfire" as a weapon for the purpose of the Weapon Focus feat.
  A spellfire wielder can heal a target by touch, restoring 2 hitpoints per spellfire energy level expended for this purpose. This is not considered positive energy, so it does not injure undead.
  Use: Selected.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Holy Liberator is a holy warrior, a distant cousin of the paladin, who is dedicated to overthrowing tyranny wherever it may be found. These champions of freedom and equality are strong-willed, independent-minded, and virtuous.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: The Holy Liberator is proficient will all simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

Alignment: Chaotic Good
Base Attack Bonus: +5
Skills: Persuade 5 or more ranks
Feats: Iron Will
Class: Paladin (Must be in first class slot)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Detect Evil - May sense evil at will.
  Resist Enchantment - +2 bonus to saving throws versus mind-affecting spells.
2: Smite Evil - Use smite evil as per the paladin ability.
  Divine Grace - May add charisma bonus to all saving throws.
3: Turn Undead - May turn undead as a paladin or cleric.
  Immune to Charm - Immune to mind-affecting spells.
5: Celestial Companion - May summon a special celestial animal companion.
7: Subversion - Can attempt to remove any mind-affecting spells from a creature at will.

BONUS SPELLS
Upon gaining a level in Holy Liberator, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (paladin or cleric). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

src:
The following is inscribed on this pillar:

"If you would pass beyond the gate before you, you must prove that you are a friend who knows of these halls. If you are, you will know of the four golems, of iron, stone, bone and clay, who once guarded them. Each golem occupied a certain position in the defensive line, fought with a particular weapon different from the others, and was infused with a particular spell, different from the others, to unleash upon intruders. If each golem is put in his proper position, with the correct weapon and spell, the gate can be opened by the lever. Eight clues are given to refresh your memory:

The golem first in position fought with a spear.
The Iron Golem occupied the second position.
The golem third in position unleashed a Negative Energy Burst.
The golem fourth in position fought with a heavy flail.
The golem that fought with a halberd unleashed a Lightning Bolt.
The Clay Golem unleashed a Cone of Cold.
The golem fourth in position did NOT unleash a Fireball.
The Bone Golem did NOT fight with a greatsword."

此祈唤（高级；5级；邪术精华）允许你将一个射程为接触的法咒置于你的邪术冲击上。如果邪术冲击命中其目标，该法咒对该目标生效，如同你已接触它。如果邪术冲击未命中其目标，法咒失消且无效果。

施放该法咒并发出邪术冲击需要一个整轮动作。只有施法时间不超过1个标准动作的接触法术才能置于你的邪术冲击上。

只有你邪术冲击的第一个目标会受到该法咒影响（例如，邪术远触连锁将接触法术传递到初始目标，而非任何次要目标）.如果你的邪术冲击未指定目标，你不能将此祈唤应用于该冲击。

将远触冲击视为一个法咒，其等级等于置于邪术冲击上的接触法术等级（最低5级）.
src:
This invocation (Greater; 5th; Eldritch Essence) allows you to place an arcane spell with a range of touch upon your eldritch blast. If the eldritch blast hits its target, the spell takes effect on that target as if you had touched it. If the eldritch blast misses its target, the spell is lost with no effect.

It takes a full-round action to cast the spell and fire the eldritch blast. Only a touch spell with a casting time no greater than 1 standard action can be placed upon your eldritch blast.

Only the first target of your eldritch blast is affected by the spell (for example, an eldritch greatreach chain delivers the touch spell on the initial target, not on any of the secondary targets). If your eldritch blast doesn't specify a target, you can't apply this invocation to the blast.

Treat greatreach blast as a spell whose level is equal to the touch spell placed upon the eldritch blast (minimum 5th level).

dst: "这是你的报酬。你知道，如果你有兴趣多赚点金币，我可能还有另一个任务给你。我们当时还运送了一群闪现犬。已经安排这些犬为某位贵族工作，我们正把它们带给他……总之当老虎挣脱时，它们惊慌失措传送走了。它们一直在码头区域到处传送。如果你能在附近搜索并把它们都收集起来，那就太好了。哦，你需要这个。这会让犬知道是我派你来的。把它拿在手里，告诉它们老虎的问题已经解决了。总共有七只犬要找。"
src: "And here's your pay. You know, if you're interested in earning more gold, I might have another task for you. We were also transporting a pack of blink dogs. Arrangements had been made for the dogs to work for a certain noble and we were bringing them to him...anyway when the tiger broke free they panicked and teleported away. They've been teleporting all over the docks area. If you could search around the area and collect them all, that would be good. Oh, you'll need this. That will let the dogs know you've come from me. Hold it in your hand and tell them that the tiger problem has been attended to. There are seven dogs to find, all told."

dst: "是的。总结一下，我们汇合后，向东前往森林中心，然后向北前进，击败沿途遇到的任何地精巡逻队或其他怪物（实际上可能相当多，到达中心有一段路——不过对于经验丰富的冒险者来说，可能不是什么大问题）。然后我们找到那片茂密的灌木丛，从那里进入。我们向北穿过那里进入营地，然后在莫古兹发出警告之前冲向神殿入口。一旦进入，猎杀他并杀死他，然后杀出营地。"
src: "Yes. To recap, we join up, head east to the center of the woods, then head north, defeating any goblin patrols or other monsters we encounter along the way (might be a fair number of those, actually, it's a bit of a way to reach the center - probably nothing that's too big a problem for experienced adventurers though). Then we find the mass of underbrush and enter through that. We go north through that into the camp, then rush to the shrine entrance before Moguz can get a warning. Once in, hunt him down and kill him, then fight our way back out through the camp."

圣堂武士是城邦政府组织中的公务员，该组织通常被称为“神殿”, “局”或“教团”. 每位圣堂武士宣誓服从他的神殿，并绝对效忠于他的术士王。作为回报，术士王赐予他们从元素位面窃取的法咒力量。

在大多数城邦中，圣堂武士是最高权威 法官，陪审团和刽子手。圣堂武士维持治安并管理城邦，并担任其他民事角色，从将军到狱卒，从税吏到清洁工。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长：圣堂武士擅长所有简易武器。由于圣堂武士的训练涉及一些战争教育，圣堂武士获得两项军用武器擅长。圣堂武士擅长轻甲，中甲和盾牌（塔盾除外）.

施法

你施展神术，这些法咒来自圣堂武士法咒列表。当你获得一个新等级的法咒时，你自动知晓圣堂武士法咒列表上该等级的所有法咒。你可以施展任何你知晓的法咒，无需提前准备。本质上，你的法咒列表与你的已知法咒列表相同。
要施展圣堂武士法咒，你的魅力值必须达到 10 + 法术等级。对抗圣堂武士法咒的豁免检定难度等级为 10 + 法术等级 + 圣堂武士的魅力调整值。与其他施法者一样，圣堂武士每天只能施展每个等级一定数量的法咒。此外，你因高魅力值获得奖励法咒。

"Against the law? The law is a convenience, a tool for us to use as we will, not a yoke bound to our necks. Laws are guidelines, not rules cast in iron. Stretching them is not the same as breaking them, my young apprentice. Take that to heart, for if you accuse me again, I will have your heart served cold."
- Zelgado De'Draigee, human templar

Templars are civil servants within a city-state's government organization commonly referred to as a "temple", "bureau" or "order". Each templar swears obedience to his temple, and absolute fealty to his sorcerer-king. In return, the sorcerer-king grants them spell power stolen from the elemental planes.

In most city-states, templars are the ultimate authority judge, jury, and executioner. Templars police and administer the city-states, and serve other civil roles ranging from general to jailor and from tax collector to garbage collector.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: Templars are proficient in all simple weapons. Since templar training involves some education in warfare, templars receive two martial weapons proficiencies. Templars are proficient in light and medium armor and shields (except tower shields).
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

SPELLCASTING

You cast divine spells, which are drawn from the templar spell list. When you gain access to a new level of spells, you automatically know all the spells for that level on the templar's spell list. You can cast any spell you know without preparing it ahead of time. Essentially, your spell list is the same as your spells known list.
To cast a templar spell, you must have a Charisma score of 10 + the spell's level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a templar's spell is 10 + the spell's level + the templar's Cha modifier. Like other spellcasters, a templar can cast only a certain number of spells of each level per day. In addition, you receive bonus spells for a high Charisma score.
You can also cast one domain spell of each spell level per day, as a cleric does. The domain spell is chosen at the time of casting from the spells associated with your assumed domains (see below), as you cast spells spontaneously and need not prepare spells ahead of time. A templar need not prepare spells in advance. You can cast any spell you know at any time, assuming you have not yet used up your spells per day for that spell level.
You use your sorcerer-king's sigil as divine focus.

src: Harwald, a ranger and woodsman, always claimed to be a peace-loving man, saying that he chiefly valued his favorite handaxe for its efficiency in chopping wood. Despite this, Harwald could fight fiercely when his region of the woods suffered monster incursions, and on such occasions his axe, which could indeed cut through wood with remarkable speed, also served him well in battle. It did so most notably when he cleared the nearby forest of a group of aggressive werewolves. After many battles, however, Harwald eventually fell in battle against a horde of marauding orcs. The orc champion who then took up the blade made no pretence to being peace-loving, and from then on the axe was never used to chop wood.

dst: "是的，那会是一个通往由耶诺古统治的深渊层的传送门。根据我能辨认出的柱上文字，以及我对这类魔法的了解，它实际上是两根维持着这个位面与深渊之间传送门开启的柱子之一。不幸的是，第二根柱子会在这个传送门的另一侧，就在深渊里。如果我们想关闭传送门，阻止这些恶魔来骚扰我们，我们就得穿过它，摧毁或以某种方式使另一侧的柱子失效，然后回到这里摧毁这根柱子。当然，如果我们先摧毁这一根，处理完另一根后就会被困在深渊里，所以那是要避免的情况。"
src: "Yes, that would be a portal to the layer of the Abyss ruled by Yeenoghu. From what I can make out of the writing on the pillar, and what I know about magic like this, it's actually one of two pillars holding open a portal between this plane and the Abyss. Unfortunately, the second pillar is going to be on the other side of this portal, in the Abyss itself. If we wanted to close the portal and keep these demons from bothering us, we'd have to go through it, destroy or somehow deactivate the pillar on the other side, and then come back here and destroy this pillar. Natturally, if we destroyed this one first, we'd be trapped in the Abyss after dealing with the other one, so that's something to avoid."

扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的宏伟图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识，这样一把重铸之剑或许是阿兹古尔卡重返此位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。

在前往烛堡的途中，我们绕道来到了小镇纳什凯尔，遇到了一位名叫伊扎多·夸巴克斯的侏儒，他原来是一名竖琴手，一直在寻找我们以提供援助，同时还有一些为了赏金而追捕我们的冒险者，必须加以对付。其中一名冒险者竟是我们的老对头加拉德·阿沙勒，他显然一直在暗中与伊扎多合作，而这一次他转换了阵营，看来是要帮助我们。

据伊扎多说，通往烛堡的路线被更多被扎拉拉和我本人以及巨龙克拉克奇'弗拉兹'塔尔的悬赏所吸引的冒险者严密把守，要到达那里并不容易。他声称有一个解决这个问题的计划，但这取决于他与冒险者中一名明显的双重间谍的合作。这名联络人如果得到750000金币就会转投我们这边为我们效力。伊扎多建议我们可以通过杀死绿龙格拉'阿扎'乌库尔来获得这笔款项的至少一大部分，这条龙巢穴在尖牙森林的某处，这样既能掠夺他的宝藏，又能领取他头颅的赏金。他把我们派往一群在森林边缘扎营的竖琴手游侠那里，由一位名叫塔布伦·卡什滕的人带领，帮助我们找到那条龙，而那群人又告诉我们，我们需要与一位名叫冈德·迅矛的矮人合作，去攻打附近的一个地精营地。作为帮助我们对付地精的回报，冈德告诉了我们龙穴的位置：我们可以从森林中心向东走，穿过一片蜘蛛出没的区域就能找到。我们现在可以出发去杀死那头怪物并掠夺他的宝藏了。
src:
Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.

Diverted to the small town of Nashkel on our way to Candlekeep, we encountered a gnome named Izado Quabax, who turned out to be a Harper who has been looking for us in order to give us aid, as well as some bounty-hunting adventurers seeking us who had to be dealt with. One of these adventures turned out to be our old foe Garad Ashaler, who apparently has been secretly working with Izado, and on this occasion switched sides and apparently is going to help us. 

According to Izado, the routes to Candlekeep are guarded well by more adventurers lured by bounties on the heads of Zarala and myself, as well the the dragon Krackach'vraz'tar, and it will not be easy to get there. He claims to have a plan for dealing with this problem, but it depends on the cooperation of an apparent double agent among the adventurers wtih whom he is in contact. This contact will switch sides and work for us if paid 750000 gold. Izado suggested we could get at least a large percentage this sum by slaying the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, who lairs somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, in order both to loot his hoard and collect a bounty on his head. He sent us to a group of Harper rangers who have made camp on the outskirts of the Wood, led by one Tabrun Carshten to help find the dragon, and that group, in turn, has told us we needed to work with a dwarf named Gund Swiftspear to fight a nearby goblin encampment. In return for our aid against the goblins, Gund told us where the dragon's lair was to be found: we can find it by going east from the center of the wood, and passing beyond a spider-infested area. We can now set out to slay the monster and loot his hoard.

dst: "听你这么说很好。这应该意味着你们可以阻止我父亲的计划而不伤害他。不过，我不确定能多大程度上信任你们。我知道你们有充分的理由杀死我父亲，而我也正要给你们一个这样做的机会。在我放你们进来之前，我必须坚持要求你们发誓，你们此处的闯入不会超出你们所说的范围：你们会从我父亲那里拿走泽法德之剑，然后离开，不会以任何严重的方式伤害他。我不会为任何没有立下这种誓言的人开门。"
src: "That is good to hear. It should mean that you can stop my father's plans without hurting him. I am not certain how much I can trust you, however. I know you have good reason to kill my father, and that I am about to give you an opportunity to do just that. Before I let you in, I must insist that you swear an oath that your intrusion here will do no more than you have said: you will take the Sword of Zefad from my father, and then depart, without harming him in any serious way. I will not unlock the door for anyone who has not taken such an oath."

src: While traveling towards the Starspire mountains, I encountered a halfling adventurer named Brego Broadfoot. He was seeking assistance in bringing down a group of mercenaries turned bandits run by one Haryan Krow. Apparently Brego's cousin, Brena, was a member of this bandit group but thought better of it, and was working to undermine them from within. Unfortunately, communications from her recently ceased, and Brego fears the bandits may have discovered her betrayal. He now seeks to assail the bandits and either rescue or avenge his cousin, depending on which proves necessary. I have agreed to help Brego, and he has said that in return, once we are finished with this matter, he will assist us on our own quest. The bandits have occupied a fortress that can be found to the west.

Transmutation [Earth]
Level: Sorcerer/wizard 1, warmage 1
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 minute

You transform one of your hands into a mighty fist of living stone, gaining a +6 enhancement bonus to Strength. In addition, you gain the ability to make one natural slam attack as a standard action, dealing 1d6 points of damage plus your new Strength bonus.  You can make the slam attack as a natural secondary attack with the normal -5 penalty as part of a full attack action.

Your fist undergoes no change in size or form, remaining as flexible and responsive as it would normally be while under the spell's effect.
