src:
At epic levels, the Shadowmind becomes a whisper in the mind and a ghost in the dark. Blending silent footfalls with psychic sabotage, she can unravel thoughts before they are spoken, cloud perceptions before danger is noticed, and strike where no defense can reach. With powers that distort memory and stealth refined to supernatural precision, the epic Shadowmind is the perfect infiltrator; unseen, unknown, and unforgettable only to those who survive.

Hit Die: d6
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Shadowmind gains a bonus feat every other level.

Special:
Sneak Attack: the epic Shadowmind's sneak attack continues to gain +1d6 damage every three levels.
Manifesting: At each class level the epic Shadowmind continues to increase in manifester level (and powers known, if applicable).

Epic Shadowmind Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Epic Dodge, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Prowess, Epic Reputation, Epic Skill Focus, Great Charisma, Great Dexterity, Great Intelligence, Great Wisdom, Improved Sneak Attack, Lingering Damage, Epic Psionic Feats, Self-Concealment, Superior Initiative.

dst:
进入扎泽斯普尔的一户普通人家时，一个女人拦住了我，让我帮她清理地下室里的老鼠，并承诺完成这项任务后给我500金币作为报酬。对于我这种身份的冒险者来说，这任务相当可笑，但我想保持一下灭鼠技能不生疏，顺便赚点小钱也无妨。

现在真相大白，这个所谓的灭鼠任务其实是个圈套。地下室的出口被堵住了，一大群元素敌人从下方的下水道闯了进来。显然这一切都是精心策划的阴谋，想要杀死我们，但为什么？也许我们可以从下水道逃出去。如果是这样，我们应该回到那栋房子，质问那个用虚假借口派我们执行这个任务的女人。

我一路杀出下水道，回到那栋房子，在那里与那个把我们引入陷阱的女人战斗并杀死了她。看来她实际上是卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔雇来的刺客。
src:
Entering a common home in Zazesspur, I was confronted by a woman who asked me to clear some rats out of her basement, offering a reward of 500 gold for the accomplishment of this task. A rather ridiculous task for an adventurer of my stature, but I suppose it would not hurt to keep my vermin-clearing skills from getting rusty and make a small profit as well.

It now emerges that this supposed rat-hunting quest was actually some kind of set-up. Exit from the basement has been blocked, and a mass of elemental foes has broken in from the sewers below. Apparently this is all an elaborate plot to kill us, but why? Perhaps we can get out throught the sewers. If so, we should return to the house and confront the woman who sent us on this quest under false pretenses.

I fought my way out of the sewers and returned to the house, there to fight and slay the woman who steered us into this trap. It appears she was actually an assassin hired by Kalomas Zekar.

src: "I do not expect that they will. Normally we followers of Ilmater bear insults and offenses with patience and forbearance. We do not fear, indeed we rejoice, to suffer ourselves, and yet would never lightly inflict suffering on anyone else, even an enemy. Such are the commands of our god. Yet sometimes not resisting evil can cause so much suffering itself that we must make an exception. I must warn you though, that even though I think forceful measures justifiable in these circumstances, they have already been attempted with less than satisfactory results. I hesitate to send you into such grave danger."

描述符：无
职业：图腾师
脉轮：喉部（图腾）

魂能形成一张面具，形似钢甲公牛的头颅，配有长而弯曲的银色犄角。面具的眼睛是空洞的黑色深坑。

佩戴石化牛面具时，你在强韧豁免上获得+1抗力加值，在对抗冲撞，绊摔，践踏或碾压的任何检定或豁免上获得+2抗力加值。

魂能点：你投入石化牛面具的每点魂能点使你的抗力加值增加1。

脉轮绑定（喉部）

石化牛面具暗沉的金属鳞片沿你的颈部向下延伸，沿上脊柱形成一道锐利的脊。缕缕绿烟从你口中逸出。

你获得对相邻敌人喷吐石化毒气云的能力。若目标强韧豁免失败，则化为石头，如同石化术。你每天可使用此能力一次。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

石化牛面具的金属鳞片向下延伸覆盖你的双肩，使你的体格更显魁梧坚实。你感到力量在双腿中奔涌，赋予你冲倒敌人并将其踏碎的能力。

你获得发动践踏攻击的能力。作为一个整轮动作，你可以移动至多两倍速度，并直接碾过任何与你体型相同或更小的生物。你的践踏攻击造成1d8点钝击伤害（若你为小型则为1d6点） 加上1-1/2倍你的力量调整值。对手可进行反射豁免使伤害减半。
src:
Gorgon Mask

Descriptors: None
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Throat (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms a mask resembling the head of a steel-plated bull, complete with long, arcing silver horns. The mask's eyes are empty black pits.

While wearing a gorgon mask, you gain a +1 resistance bonus on Fortitude saves and a +2 resistance bonus on any check or saving throw to resist being bull rushed, tripped, overrun, or trampled. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your gorgon mask increases your resistance bonuses by 1.

Chakra Bind (Throat)

The dusky, metallic scales of your gorgon mask extend down your neck, forming a sharp ridge along your upper spine. Wisps of green smoke escape from your mouth.

You gain the ability to breathe a cloud of petrifying gas on an adjacent foe. If the target fails a Fortitude save, it turns to stone, as the flesh to stone spell. You can use this ability once per day.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

The metallic scales of your gorgon mask extend down over your shoulders, lending bulk and solidity to your frame. You feel strength coursing through your legs in particular, giving you the ability to run down your foes and crush them beneath your feet.

You gain the ability to make a trample attack. As a full-round action, you can move up to twice your speed and literally run over any creature equal to your own size or smaller. Your trample attack deals 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage (or 1d6 points if you are Small) plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier. Opponents have a Reflex save for half damage.

dst: 住在码头附近一所房子里的凯拉·肯尼曼请求我找到她的丈夫本，并让他回家。据她说，我可以在欢憩客栈找到他，他正和朋友克拉夫·德尔森一起喝酒。\n\n克拉夫·德尔森让我去泪之屋（伊尔梅特的一座神殿）找本·肯尼曼，那里的一位祭司告诉我本去市场购买工具了。那里的一位商人告诉我他去了家具店。家具店的店主告诉我，本从那里离开后去拜访了一位名叫伦斯·门纳德的朋友，而门纳德又告诉我，他已经回到欢憩客栈再次与克拉夫会面。回到客栈后，我终于追上了本，并转达了他妻子的口信。我想接下来我应该回到肯尼曼家，从她那里领取无疑微不足道的报酬。
src: Kyra Kenemen, who resides in a house near the docks, has asked me to locate her husband, Ben, and ask him to return home. According to her, I can expect to find him at the Winsome Repose Inn, drinking with his friend Clav Derlson.\n\nClav Derlson told me to look for Ben Kenement at the House of Tears (a temple of Ilmater), and a priest there told me Ben had gone shopping for tools in the markets. A merchant there told me that he went to the furniture store. The proprietor of the furniture store informed me that Ben had gone on from there to visit a friend of his named Rence Mennald, and Mennald, in turn, told me that he had headed back to the Winsome Repose Inn to meet with Clav again. Returning to the inn, I finally caught up with Ben, and have delivered his wife's message. I suppose I should next return to the Kenemen home to collect my doubtless insignificant reward from her.

施法者召唤出一种晦暗天气。其效果如晦暗之书第 2 章所述，但区域和持续时间按本法咒所列。

血雨：浓稠的血滴倾泻而下，持续 2d10 分钟。区域内任何活着的非晦暗角色必须通过意志豁免（DC 20），否则在攻击和伤害检定，检定和豁免上承受 -1 士气罚值，持续 24 小时。不死生物在攻击和伤害检定，检定和豁免上获得 +1 士气加值，持续 24 小时。

紫雨：一旦紫雨开始落下，神术法咒在 24 小时内无法施放。

绿雾：深绿色雾气滚滚掠过乡野。任何被雾气触碰的生物必须通过强韧豁免（DC 17），否则被变形为随机生物。雾气持续 10 分钟。

蛙雨或鱼雨：成千上万的动物从天而降，每轮造成 1d3 点伤害。雨持续 2d6 轮。

堕落代价：3d6 点体质伤害。

src:
Evil Weather
Conjuration (Creation) [Evil]
Level: Corrupt 8
Components: V, S, M, XP, Corrupt (see below)
Casting Time: 1 hour
Range: Personal
Area: 1-mile/level radius, centered on caster
Duration: 3d6 minutes
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

The caster conjures a type of evil weather. It functions as described in Chapter 2 of the Book of Vile Darkness, except that area and duration are as given for this spell.

Rain of Blood: Blood pours down in thick drops for 2d10 minutes.  Any living, non-evil character in the area must succeed on a will save (DC 20) or take a -1 morale penalty on attack and damage rolls, checks, and saves for 24 hours. Undead gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls, checks, and saves for 24 hours.

Violet Rain: Once violet rain begins to fall, divine spells are uncastable for 24 hours.

Green Fog: Clouds of dark greenish mist roll across the countryside.  Any creature touched by a mist must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 17) or be polymorphed into a random creature.  The fog lasts for 10 minutes.

Rain of Frogs or Fish: Thousands of animals fall from the sky, causing 1d3 pts per round of damage.  The rain lasts 2d6 rounds.

Corruption Cost: 3d6 points of Constitution damage.

Casters of good alignment cannot cast Corrupt spells.

Apparently it was thought to have some significance, so perhaps it will be useful for unlocking something I come across later.\n\nApparently the key opens the door to a major stronghold of Kuo Toa and perhaps other creatures allied with them found in the eastern part of this region of the Underdark. dst: "是的，幸运的是，我和这里的达雷夫得以保住了一些我们这里出售的精品武器和防护装备，这些东西强大而昂贵，连最富有的贵族都还觉得负担不起。装备上这些，即使像我这样的老商人也能有些许生存希望去面对恶魔……嗯，也许我该在我们下一次的广告宣传里提一提这个。不过回到恶魔的话题，它们最初为什么会被派来袭击我们，仍是个谜。我只知道，要在我们的防护结界内召唤它们，需要一位非常强大的施法者。"

学派：咒法系（传送）
等级：吟游诗人4，术士/法师4，旅行4
成分：言语
施法时间：1个标准动作
距离：远距（400英尺+40英尺/等级）
目标：你和其他接触的自愿生物（即，你10英尺内的队伍成员）
持续时间：立即
豁免检定：无
法术抗力：否

你瞬间将自己从当前位置传送到范围内的任何其他地点。你总是准确到达 desired 地点 - 无论是通过简单地想象区域还是通过说明方向**.你还可以每三个施法者等级携带一个额外的自愿中型或更小生物或其等效物。大型生物算作两个中型生物，巨型生物算作两个大型生物，以此类推。所有要传送的生物必须与你接触。*

注意：
* 由于NWN位置跟踪代码的可爱质量，实现为在你10英尺内。
** 方向与你相对于你目标法咒的方向相同。将创建一个监听器，以便你可以说出距离。
src:
School: Conjuration (Teleportation)
Level: Brd 4, Sor/Wiz 4, Travel 4
Components: V
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target: You and other touched willing creatures (i.e.. party members within 10ft of you)
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

You instantly transfer yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You always arrive at exactly the spot desired - whether by simply visualizing the area or by stating direction**. You may also bring one additional willing Medium or smaller creature or its equivalent per three caster levels. A Large creature counts as two Medium creatures, a Huge creature counts as two Large creatures, and so forth. All creatures to be transported must be in contact with you. *

Notes:
* Implemented as within 10ft of you due to the lovely quality of NWN location tracking code.
** The direction is the same as the direction of where you target the spell relative to you. A listener will be created so you can say the distance.

src: An expert pickpocket known as Vitiare stole all my gold and then disappeared, while I was distracted by the rest of the adventuring party he was working with. This represents a considerable loss, if it is permanent, but perhaps there is some hope of locating this Vitiare and recovering my gold. It appears there is also a bounty on his head, that can be collected from Oublek. I should see if I can find any clues as to where Vitiare might now be found. He seems to commonly operate around Nashkel, so perhaps someone in that town would know something about him.\n\nWhen in town, Vitiare is often seen drinking at the Belching Dragon accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn. Presumably they are friends or associates. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. A farmer named Hodgent who is know to benefit from those services has been seen in town recently, and is apparently now at the Fair. Perhaps I should talk to him to find out how to locate this halfling, who might in turn be able to provide a clue as to Vitiare's current whereabouts.

法律的存在是有原因的。如果没有法律以及维护和执行法律的人，社会乃至生命本身将迅速崩溃为无政府状态。混乱在战场上迅速滋生，通常光荣的士兵有时会在战斗的欲望中失去理智。这个法咒通过迫使区域内所有混乱生物暂时被震慑，同时秩序者恢复应有的秩序，来消散这种火花。
对混乱影响的施法者的一句警告：你可能会开始注意到，每次施放这个法咒，你的无政府主义倾向都会减弱。
src:
School: Evocation [Law]
Components: V, S
Range: Personal
Target: Self
Area: 40' Radius
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates(special, see below)
Spell Resistance: Yes

Laws are in place for a reason. Society, and life in general, would quickly crumble into anarchy were it not for the laws and the ones who uphold them and see to their maintain. Chaos breeds quickly on the battlefield, where normally honorable soldiers sometimes begin losing their minds in the lust of the fight. This spell diffuses the spark, by forcing all chaotic creatures in the area to stand stunned for a time, while the lawful restore what should be.
A word of caution to the caster of a chaotic influence: You may begin to notice a lessening of your anarchist tendencies with each casting of this spell.

dst: 在穿越卡林杉的旅途中，我遇到了一辆商队残骸，它曾遭到不明劫掠者的袭击。这些劫掠者残忍地杀害了商队成员，似乎更热衷于单纯的破坏而非抢劫。在继续我的旅程之前，追踪并解决他们或许是个好主意。\n\n事实证明，这次袭击是萨达拉什所为，他是一位信奉以暴力推进德鲁伊议程的暗影德鲁伊。我会见了他并试图避免战斗，因为我同情他的目标。萨达拉什要求我袭击我发现被毁商队所在道路南边的一座农场，并杀死那里所有人，以此证明我对他事业的忠诚。我照做了，他给了我丰厚的奖赏，包括一些金币和一把装有非常贵重物品的箱子的钥匙。今天我们俩都找到了一个新盟友，自然秩序的福祉无疑将从中受益。
src: While traveling through Calimshan, I came across the wreckage of a caravan that had been attacked by unknown raiders. These raiders had savagely killed the caravan members, and seemed more interested in simple destruction than in robbery. It might be a good idea to track them down and deal with them before continuing on my journey.\n\nIt turns out the attack was the work of Sadarash, a shadow druid who believes in using violence to advance the druidical agenda. I met with him and tried to avoid fighting, as I sympathize with his goals. Sadarash asked me to attack a farm to the south of the road on which I found the destroyed caravan and kill everyone there, thereby proving my commitment to his cause. I have done this and he has rewarded me well, with some gold and the key to a chest containing some very valuable items. Both of us have found a new ally this day, and the well-being of the natural order will doubtless benefit from this.

dst: "是的，正是如此。我不愿让我的女儿身陷如此险境，但我们的选择有限，而且我们自己的庄园即将遭到攻击，无论如何对她来说都已没有安全之处。基于你迄今为止的卓越成就，我倾向于认为你或许是为我效力的最有能力的冒险者，而且你之前也有与我女儿共事的经验。综合考虑，你显然是这项任务的不二人选。"
src: "Yes, precisely. I am reluctant to send my daughter into such danger, but our options are limited and with our own estate about to be attacked there is no longer any safe place for her in any event. Based on your remarkable accomplishments to date, I am inclined to regard you as perhaps the most competent adventurer working for me, and you also have previous experience working with my daughter. All things considered you are the obvious choice for this mission."

（进阶职业）
法师杀手是一个稀有的群体，专精于设计用来对抗其他施法者的魔法。法师杀手不仅像战士一样训练，还精通法咒以利用他们奥术敌人的弱点。有些人使用陷阱，另一些人偏好武器，但所有人都将他们的魔法技能磨练到极致 - 因为正是这些魔法能力使法师杀手区别于大多数普通的猎人和杀手。

法师杀手会与各种各样的人交往以帮助他们定位并接触他们的敌人，但克服这些敌人并终结他们悲惨生命的肮脏工作则牢牢地由法师杀手自己承担。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 武器和防具擅长：法师杀手不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

法咒：能够施放 4 级奥术。
专长：强韧加强，闪电反射，战斗施法，任意军用武器擅长。
技能：法咒辨识（10 级）.

职业特性：

等级
1：强化豁免 - 法师杀手可以选择获得 +1 加值到反射或强韧豁免。
2：强效召唤 - 任何用召唤法咒召唤出的生物都略微增强，获得一个额外生命骰以及攻击和伤害检定 +1 加值。
3：强化豁免。
4：专长 - 法术专攻：塑能 - 为所有塑能学派的法咒提供 +2 豁免 DC 加值。
5：强化豁免。
6：专长 - 法术专攻：死灵。
7：强化豁免。
8：专长 - 法术专攻：咒法。
9：强化豁免。
10：专长 - 法术专攻：变化。

奖励法咒

在法师杀手职业上获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他们在其最高奥术施法职业上也获得了等级一样。然而，通过此能力不会学习到新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Mage Killers are a rare breed, specializing in magic designed to combat other spellcasters. The Mage Killer not only trains like a warrior, but also masters spells to exploit the weaknesses of their arcane foes. Some use traps, others prefer weapons, but all hone their magical skills to a fine point - for it is these magical abilities that distinguish Mage Killers from the majority of mundane hunters and killers.

A Mage Killer will fraternize with all sorts of people to help them locate and gain access to their enemies, but the dirty business of overcoming those foes and putting an end to their miserable lives is kept firmly on the Mage Killer's own shoulders.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: A Mage Killer does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spells: Able to cast 4th-level arcane spells.
Feats: Great Fortitude, Lightning Reflexes, Combat Casting, Any Martial Weapon Proficiency.
Skills: Spellcraft (10 ranks).

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Improved Saves - The Mage Killer can choose to gain a +1 bonus to either Reflex or Fortitude saves.
2: Augment Summoning - Any creatures called forth with summoning spells are slightly enhanced, gaining one extra hit die and a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls.
3: Improved Saves.
4: Feat - Spell Focus: Evocation - Provides a +2 bonus to the DC for all spells in the Evocation school.
5: Improved Saves.
6: Feat - Spell Focus: Necromancy.
7: Improved Saves.
8: Feat - Spell Focus: Conjuration.
9: Improved Saves.
10: Feat - Spell Focus: Transmutation.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Mage Killer, the character gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their highest Arcane spellcasting class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

dst: 我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎杀海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向纳兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭海盗。据船员说，这些海盗是一群牛头人，一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次袭击。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗海盗。\n\n船长计划在即将到来的袭击中利用我的才能，要求扎拉拉和我，以及几名船员，在隐形法术的掩护下乘坐一艘小船绕到岛屿北侧，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则在南面攻击海盗的主力。我们现在已经登陆并开始了袭击，以突然出现让海盗措手不及。我们应该继续清除这个岛屿北半部的敌人。特别是一个似乎是某种首领的牛头人逃到了附近的一个洞穴，显然是为了召集增援。我们应该在解决掉外面能找到的任何海盗后，追击并阻止他。
src: Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.\n\nThe captain's plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault called for Zarala and me, along with several of the crew, to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, under cover of an invisibility spell, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We have now landed and commenced our assault, surprising the pirates with our sudden appearance. We should continue and clear the northern half of this island of foes. In particular one minotaur who seems to be some sort of leader has fled to a nearby cave, apparently to rally reinforcements. We should pursue and stop him once we have dealt with any pirates who can be found outside.

src: "Not quite, for it is through my service as a paladin that I channel the dubious elements of my fiendish heritage into appropriate paths. I found I could not completely extirpate the demonic element, it was part of who I was, but Ilmater taught me that all evils come from the corruption or perversion of something good, and that with his aid I could return to that original good. My demonic bloodlust could be transformed into the paladin's fight for justice, and my fiendish aptitude for devious cunning need not be devoted to thievery, as it so often is among other tieflings, but used to scout and infiltrate evil, protect against its devious traps, liberate its prisoners...but I am getting a little ahead of things, for it was only later that I learned these lessons. At first I found the demon in me to be wholly evil, and no easy thing to deal with."

哈根提授予你一些斯里姆的武器和护甲技巧，加上她自己对变形的厌恶以及使他人陷入困惑状态的能力。

盾牌熟练：你熟练使用盾牌，包括塔盾。

src:
Haagenti, Mother of Minotaurs
  
Haagenti tricked the god of frost giants and paid a terrible price for that deed. She girds her summoners for battle and gives them the power to confuse foes.

Vestige Level: 2nd
Binding DC: 17
Special Requirement: To summon Haagenti, you must be Large.

Influence: You feel ashamed and occasionally bashful in the presence of beautiful creatures. In addition, Haagenti requires that you give deference to any creature you perceive as more attractive or charismatic than yourself. This deference might take the form of a bow, a salute, opening a door for the creature in question, not speaking until spoken to, or any other gesture that acknowledges the creature as superior to you. In any case, you must constantly treat any such creature with respect or suffer the penalty for defying Haagenti's influence.

Granted Abilities: 
Haagenti grants you some of Thrym's skill with arms and armor, plus her own aversion to transformation and the ability to inflict a state of confusion upon others.

Confusing Touch: You can confuse by touch. The target of your touch attack must succeed on a Will save or become confused for 1 round per three effective binder levels you possess. When you attain an effective binder level of 19th, this ability functions as a maze spell. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Immunity to Transformation: No mortal magic can permanently affect your form while you are bound to Haagenti. You are immune to polymorph and petrification effects.

Shield Proficiency: You are proficient with shields, including tower shields.

Weapon Proficiency: You are proficient with the battleaxe, greataxe, handaxe, and throwing axe.

dst:
半龙生物总是比同族中没有龙类血统的生物更为强大，它们的外表也暴露了其本性 - 鳞片，细长的特征，爬虫类的眼睛，以及夸张的牙齿和爪子。有时它们还长有翅膀。

创建半龙类

“半龙类” 是一种遗传模板，可添加到任何活着的，有实体的生物（以下称为基础生物） 上。
半龙使用基础生物的所有数据和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型与类型
该生物的类型变为龙类。体型不变。不要重新计算基础攻击加值或豁免。

生命骰
将基础生物的种族 HD 增加一个骰子等级，最大为 d12. 不要增加职业 HD.

速度
体型为大型或更大的半龙长有翅膀，能以两倍于其基础陆地速度飞行（最大 120 尺），机动性为普通。体型为中型或更小的半龙没有翅膀。

防御等级
天生防御提高 +4。

攻击
半龙有两次爪抓攻击和一次啮咬攻击，爪子是主要天生武器。如果基础生物能使用武器，半龙保留此能力。半龙徒手战斗时，进行攻击动作时使用爪子。当它持有武器时，通常改用武器。

全力攻击
半龙徒手战斗时，进行全力攻击时使用双爪和啮咬。如果持有武器，它通常将武器作为主要攻击，将啮咬作为天生次要攻击。如果它有一只手空闲，则使用爪子作为额外的天生次要攻击。

伤害
半龙有啮咬和爪抓攻击。如果基础生物没有这些攻击形式，使用下表中的伤害值。否则，使用下表中的值或基础生物的伤害值，取较高者。

半龙伤害体型 啮咬伤害 爪抓伤害
超微型                      1           -
微型            1d2         1
超小型                      1d3         1d2
小型                     1d4         1d3
中型                 1d6         1d4
大型                    1d8         1d6
超大型                     2d6         1d8
巨型          3d6         2d6
超巨型                4d6         3d6

特殊攻击
半龙保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并根据其龙类品种获得一种喷吐武器（见表格），每天可使用一次。半龙的喷吐武器造成 6d8 点伤害。成功的反射豁免（DC 10 + 1 半龙的种族 HD + 半龙的体质调整值） 可将伤害减半。

半龙特殊攻击：
龙类品种  喷吐武器
黑           60 尺酸液线
蓝           60 尺闪电线
绿           30 尺腐蚀（酸） 气体锥
红           30 尺火焰锥
白           30 尺寒冷锥
黄铜       60 尺火焰线
青铜       60 尺闪电线
赤铜       60 尺酸液线
金           30 尺火焰锥
银           30 尺寒冷锥

特殊性质
半龙拥有基础生物的所有特殊性质，外加 60 尺黑暗视觉和昏暗视觉。半龙免疫睡眠和麻痹效果，并根据其龙类品种获得一项额外免疫。

半龙免疫：
龙类品种 免疫
黑           酸
蓝             电
绿           酸
红             火
白           寒
黄铜           火
青铜         电
赤铜        酸
金             火
银           寒

属性
从基础生物开始增加如下：力量 +8，体质 +2，智力 +2，魅力 +2。

技能
半龙以龙类身份获得技能点，其技能点等于（6 + 智力调整值） ?(HD + 3). 不要将职业等级的生命骰计入此计算。半龙仅为其种族生命骰获得龙类技能点，并为其职业等级获得正常数量的技能点。将基础生物技能列表中的技能视为本职技能，其他技能视为跨职技能。

环境
与基础生物或龙类品种相同。

挑战等级
与基础生物相同 + 2（最低 3）.

阵营
与龙类品种相同。

等级调整
与基础生物相同 +3。
src:
Half-dragon creatures are always more formidable than others of their kind that do not have dragon blood, and their appearance betrays their nature - scales, elongated features, reptilian eyes, and exaggerated teeth and claws. Sometimes they have wings. 

Creating A Half-Dragon

"Half-dragon" is an inherited template that can be added to any living, corporeal creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature).
A half-dragon uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to dragon. Size is unchanged. Do not recalculate base attack bonus or saves.

Hit Dice
Increase base creature's racial HD by one die size, to a maximum of d12. Do not increase class HD.

Speed
A half-dragon that is Large or larger has wings and can fly at twice its base land speed (maximum 120 ft.) with average maneuverability. A half-dragon that is Medium or smaller does not have wings.

Armor Class
Natural armor improves by +4.

Attack
A half-dragon has two claw attacks and a bite attack, and the claws are the primary natural weapon. If the base creature can use weapons, the half-dragon retains this ability. A half-dragon fighting without weapons uses a claw when making an attack action. When it has a weapon, it usually uses the weapon instead.

Full Attack
A half-dragon fighting without weapons uses both claws and its bite when making a full attack. If armed with a weapon, it usually uses the weapon as its primary attack and its bite as a natural secondary attack. If it has a hand free, it uses a claw as an additional natural secondary attack.

Damage
Half-dragons have bite and claw attacks. If the base creature does not have these attack forms, use the damage values in the table below. Otherwise, use the values below or the base creature's damage values, whichever are greater.

Half-Dragon DamageSize Bite Damage Claw Damage
Fine                      1           -
Diminutive            1d2         1
Tiny                      1d3         1d2
Small                     1d4         1d3
Medium                 1d6         1d4
Large                    1d8         1d6
Huge                     2d6         1d8
Gargantuan          3d6         2d6
Colossal                4d6         3d6

Special Attacks
A half-dragon retains all the special attacks of the base creature and gains a breath weapon based on the dragon variety (see table), usable once per day. A half-dragon's breath weapon deals 6d8 points of damage. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1 half-dragon's racial HD + half-dragon's Con modifier) reduces damage by half.

Half-Dragon Special Attacks:
Dragon Variety  Breath Weapon
Black           60-foot line of acid
Blue            60-foot line of lightning
Green           30-foot cone of corrosive (acid) gas
Red             30-foot cone of fire
White           30-foot cone of cold
Brass           60-foot line of fire
Bronze          60-foot line of lightning
Copper          60-foot line of acid
Gold            30-foot cone of fire
Silver          30-foot cone of cold

Special Qualities
A half-dragon has all the special qualities of the base creature, plus darkvision out to 60 feet and low-light vision. A half-dragon has immunity to sleep and paralysis effects, and an additional immunity based on its dragon variety.

Half-Dragon Immunities:
Dragon Variety Immunity
Black           Acid
Blue             Electricity
Green          Acid
Red             Fire
White          Cold
Brass           Fire
Bronze         Electricity
Copper        Acid
Gold             Fire
Silver           Cold

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Str +8, Con +2, Int +2, Cha +2.

Skills
A half-dragon gains skill points as a dragon and has skill points equal to (6 + Int modifier) ?(HD + 3). Do not include Hit Dice from class levels in this calculation. The half-dragon gains dragon skill points only for its racial Hit Dice, and gains the normal amount of skill points for its class levels. Treat skills from the base creature's list as class skills, and other skills as cross-class.

Environment
Same as either the base creature or the dragon variety.

Challenge Rating
Same as the base creature + 2 (minimum 3).

Alignment
Same as the dragon variety.

Level Adjustment
Same as base creature +3.

dst:
在杀穿塔拉孔达祖姆的堡垒时，我发现了一些可能有助于释放他的囚犯并进入他的宝库的信息。我找到的一张笔记写道：

“虽然方尖碑几乎坚不可摧，但每一座都易受一种特定类型的元素伤害，具体类型各不相同。希望任何攻击者都不会碰巧发现正确的类型，未能对其造成伤害，并认为无法做到。此外，能否抵挡神的力量也值得怀疑，尽管这尚未被测试。如果方尖碑被摧毁，柱子也会变得脆弱。如果三根柱子都被摧毁，那么关押囚犯的房间就可以进入。一旦进入，就可以在魔法屏障外停用最后一根柱子。如果那发生，他将再次自由地传播他的腐败。还有最后一个守卫，如果很不幸的话，是一个非常不可靠的守卫。通往最后一根柱子的路径并不明显，很可能需要信仰和勇气才能踏上。我们只能希望任何寻求释放囚犯的恶徒都缺乏这些美德。”

另一张笔记写道：

“通往我们领主宝藏的门由五座金属龙雕像守卫。要打开门，对每座雕像施放两个法术，每个法术代表该类型龙所拥有的一种吐息武器。这两个法术必须按正确顺序施放，每座雕像也必须按正确顺序激活。要记住这个顺序，严格遵守以下格言：‘第一个将是最后一个，最后一个将是第一个。’”
src:
While fighting my way through Tarakondazum's keep, I found some information that might prove useful in freeing his prisoner and gaining access to his hoard. One note I found reads:

"While the obelisks are almost indestructible, each is vulnerable to a single type of elemental damage, the specific type varying with each one. Hopefully any attacker will not stumble on the correct type, fail to damage them, and assume there is no way to do so. In addition, it is doubtful if any could stand up against the power of a god, though this has not been tested. If the obelisks are destroyed, the pillar will become vulnerable as well. If somehow all three pillars are destroyed, then the chamber containing the prisoner could be entered. Once within, one could deactivate the final pillar just outside the magical barriers. Should that happen, he will once more be free to spread his corruption everywhere. There is one final guard, if unfortunately a very unreliable one. The path to the final pillar is not obvious, and might well require faith and courage to tread. We may hope any evildoers seeking the prisoner's freedom will lack these virtues."

Another note reads:

"The door to our lord's treasure is gaurded by five statues of metallic dragons. To unseal the door, cast on each statue two spells, one representing each breath weapon that type of dragon possesses. The two spells must be cast in the correct order, and each statue must also be activated in the correct order. To remember this order, strictly adhere to the following maxim: 'The first shall be last and the last shall be first.'"

dst:
翼人是阿塔斯本土的爬虫类种族，具体来说，是称为腹地的地区。他们很少离开家乡村庄，但最近的自然灾害促使不少少数人进入表土之地。他们在不熟悉的人面前通常沉默谨慎，但在朋友中间则乐观，开放，友好且好奇。每个翼人选择一条定义其个性的生活道路，或者也许反过来。战士翼人对表土之地的残酷最不以为意，并从军事策略中获得乐趣。德鲁伊翼人最关心自然，在消除对自然的威胁时获得最大乐趣。灵能翼人最善于社交，在解决谜题和争端等智力追求中获得最大乐趣。身体上，他们身高在5英尺到6英尺6英寸之间，有浅棕色鳞状皮肤。他们穿着很少，喜欢腰带和缠腰布，后脑有鳍状生长物。雄性和雌性之间没有可见区别。

翼人属性调整：+2 感知，+2 魅力，-2 敏捷
偏好职业（心灵术士）：兼职翼人的心灵术士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 30英尺基础速度
- 听力不佳：聆听获得-2种族惩罚。
- 天生武器：可进行天生咬击（1d4）和爪击（各1d3）.
- 爬虫类：在法咒效果上，翼人视为爬虫类。

（以下内容可能使用，也可能不使用，取决于模组开关设置）
等级调整：+0
种族生命骰/职业：4级变形者
src:
Pterrans are a reptilian race native to Athas, specifically to the region called the Hinterlands.  They rarely leave their home villages, but recent natural disasters have inspired more than the rare few to enter the Tablelands.  They are typically subdued and cautious among unfamiliar people, but when among friends they are optimistic, open, friendly, and inquisitive.  Each Pterran chooses a life path that defines their personality, or perhaps the other way around.  Warrior pterrans are the least disturbed by the brutality of the Tablelands, and take pleasure in military strategy.  Druidic pterrans are most concerned with nature, and take the greatest pleasure when they eliminate a threat to it.  Psionic pterrans are the most social, and take the greatest pleasure in intellectual pursuits such as solving riddles and resolving disputes.  Physically they are anywhere between 5' and 6'6" tall, with light brown scaly skin.  They wear little clothing, preferring sashes and loincloths, and have a finlike growth on the back of their head.  There is no visible distinction between males and females.

Pterran Ability Adjustments: +2 Wis, +2 Cha, -2 Dex
Favored Class (Psion): A multiclass pterran's psion class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Poor Hearing: -2 racial penalty to Listen.
- Natural Weapon: Can make natural bite(1d4) and claw attacks(1d3 each).
- Reptilian: Pterrans count as Reptilian for the purpose of spells.

(The following may or may not be in use, depending on the module switch settings)
Level Adjustment: +0
Racial Hit Dice/Class: 4 of Shapechanger

dst:
阿瑞忒，第一位厄兰人
  
阿瑞忒，一位寻求永生的强大心灵术士，创造了一个新种族，却注定自己永无止境地重生。他授予的能力为缚灵者提供了几种强化身心的特性。

缚灵等级：4级
缚灵DC: 21
特殊要求：阿瑞忒不喜欢被提醒厄兰人被某些人视为憎恶，如果你已经缚灵于丘波克洛普斯或欧律诺墨，他不会回应你的召唤。

影响：在缚灵于阿瑞忒期间，你不会感到饥饿或疲倦，但如果你在缚灵持续期间不吃不睡，你会遭受负面效果。如果需要进行研究，阿瑞忒坚持要求你也寻找关于他和他对永生研究的传说，这通常会使你寻找信息的时间加倍甚至三倍。

授予能力：
在缚灵于阿瑞忒期间，你获得阿瑞忒在寻求永生过程中曾拥有的力量。

灵能恩惠：当你缚灵于阿瑞忒时，你获得13点灵能点。如果你已经拥有灵能，这些点加入你的灵能池，或者它们创建一个灵能池，并且在此缚灵持续期间你成为一个灵能生物。

抗力：你选择的一项豁免检定获得+4加值。你可以用一个移动动作将其改为另一项豁免检定。

伤害减免：你的身体变得异常坚韧，获得伤害减免5/-.

充盈：在缚灵持续期间，你获得灵能身体调整和身体净化的使用权。你可以像心灵术士一样展现每个灵能，并视其为你所知的灵能。你可以像心灵术士通常那样增幅每个灵能，用你的有效缚灵者等级代替显能者等级。
src:
Arete, the First Elan
  
Arete, a powerful psion who sought immortality, created a new race but doomed himself to never-ending rebirths. His granted abilities provide binders with access to several qualities that toughen the body and mind.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 21
Special Requirement: Arete does not like to be reminded that the elan are considered abominations by some, and he does not answer your summons if you are already bound to Chupoclops or Eurynome.

Influence: You do not get hungry or tired while bound to Arete, but you do suffer negative effects if you do not eat or sleep for the duration that the vestige is bound. If faced with a need to do research, Arete insists that you seek out lore regarding him and his research into immortality as well, which can often double or even triple the time you spend seeking information.

Granted Abilities: 
While bound to Arete, you gain powers that Arete had at some point in his search for immortality.

Psionic Boon: You gain 13 power points when you bind to Arete. These are added to your pool of power if you already possess psionic power, or they create a pool and you become a psionic creature for the duration of this binding.

Resistance: Your gain a +4 bonus on a saving throw of your choice. You may change this to another saving throw as a move action.

Damage Reduction: Your body becomes unnaturally tough as you gain damage reduction 5/-.

Repletion: You gain access to the psionic powers body adjustment and body purification for the duration of the binding. You may manifest each power as a psion would and as if it is a power known by you. You may augment each power as a psion normally could, substituting your effective binder level in place of manifester level.

src: Most elves disdain heavy armor, considering it a poor complement for their innate agility and aptitude for the arcane arts. A few knightly elves, however, do find a use for armor that gives them all the protection they need to engage in toe-to-toe melees in the forefront of battle. This armor must have been crafted for such elite warriors, and has been heavily enchanted to not only increase basic armor protection but also compensate for the weak constitutions that elves often suffer from, so that even hits powerful enough to penetrate are more likely to be survived. As is typical of the products of elven craftsmanship, it has also been provided with exquisitely beautiful decoration, and seems to weigh less than it should.

dst: 进入绿龙格拉阿扎乌库尔的巢穴后，我们遇到了卡林杉贵族奥利姆·卡查尔雇用的刺客塞穆·纳拉卡。他告诉我们，格拉阿扎乌库尔是他的盟友，希望我们不要与他战斗。由于他和卡查尔显然也反对阿兹古尔卡，他也不想妨碍我们对抗那个塔纳厘。作为攻击格拉阿扎乌库尔的替代方案，他提出开启一个传送门，将我们带到银龙塔拉孔达祖姆的堡垒。我们很可能从这条龙身上找到至少与另一条龙同样有价值的战利品，此外，塔拉孔达祖姆显然在充当某个强大实体的狱卒，而这个实体也是阿兹古尔卡的敌人。因此，释放这个囚犯可能会为我们的主要目标赢得一个宝贵的盟友。\n\n看到这个替代方案没有坏处，我同意了。我现在已经一路杀穿堡垒，释放了关押在那里的囚犯，原来是一个名叫卡加什瓦尔的巴特兹。不再受我摧毁的结界束缚后，他得以传送离开并逃离此地。想必他会去对付他的老敌人阿兹古尔卡，这应该对我们也有帮助。
src: Upon entering the lair of the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, we were met by Semu Naraka, the assassin employed by Calishite noble Olim Khachar. He told us that Gra'azha'ukul was an ally of his, and would prefer that we not fight him. Since he and Khachar are also apparently opposed to Azghulkar, he did not want to get in the way of our opposition to that tanar'ri either. As an alternative to attacking Gra'azha'ukul, he offered to open a portal that would take us to the keep of Tarakondazum, a silver dragon. We could probably find loot at least as valuable from the one dragon as the other, and, in addition, Tarakondazum is apparently acting as the jailer of some powerful entity who is also an enemy of Azghulkar. Freeing this prisoner could thus gain us a valuable ally in our primary objective. \n\nSeeing no downside to this alternative, I agreed. I have now fought my way through the keep and freed the prisoner contained there, who turned out to be a Baatezu named Kagashvar. No longer contstrained by the wards I brought down, he was able to teleport away and escape this place. Presumably he will be working against his old enemy Azghulkar, which should help us as well.

dst: 在探索幽暗地域时，我遇到了一位神秘兜帽人，他自称是某种商人。他让我去收集三件他需要的魔法材料：移位兽的皮、噬脑怪的大脑和一颗钻石。我把三件物品都带给了他，作为回报，我得到了一点金币和一颗据说能赋予我知识与力量的魔法宝珠。然而，这颗宝珠已经裂了，效果如何尚不确定。\n\n完成这项任务后，那个奇怪的商人现在又让我给他一颗泽克斯卡顿宝珠，并承诺如果我给他一颗，就付给我25000金币。为了一件用途不明的物品出这么高的价钱，确实是个诱人的提议，但我怀疑把从泽克斯卡顿旧巢穴中取出的这种神秘物品送出去是否明智，于是拒绝接受这项任务。不过，如果我改变主意，这个提议仍然有效。
src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a mysterious hooded figure who claims to be a merchant of some sort. He asked me to acquire three items he needs as magical reagents: the hide of a displacer beast, the brain of an intellect devourer, and a diamond. I brought him all three items and in return received a little gold and a magical orb that is supposed to infuse me with knowledge and power. The orb is cracked, however, and it is uncertain how well it will work.\n\nHaving accomplished this task, the strange merchant has now asked me to provide him with an Orb of Xerxkatun, promising to pay me 25000 gold if I give him one. Such a large sum for an item of unclear purpose makes for a tempting offer, but I had my doubts as to whether it would be a good idea to give away one of these mysterious objects retrieved from Xerxkatun's old lairs, and declined to accept this task. However, the offer remains open if I ever change my mind.

At epic levels, the dragon shaman becomes a living embodiment of draconic majesty. Their auras grow stronger, their breath weapon rivals that of ancient wyrms, and their resilience is all but unshakable. With wings unfurled and power drawn directly from their totem dragon's essence, they stride through battle as a paragon of scaled might and unwavering purpose.

Hit Die: d10.
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Intelligence modifier.
Bonus Feats: The epic Dragon Shaman gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:
Draconic Armor: The epic Dragon Shaman's Natural Armor bonus grows to +4 at level 22 and continues to increase by +1 every 5 levels thereafter.
Draconic Aura: The epic Dragon Shaman's draconic aura power continues to increase, becoming +6 at 25 and growing by 1 every 5 levels thereafter.

Epic Dragon Shaman Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Fortitude, Epic Leadership, Epic Prowess, Epic Reflexes, Epic Reputation, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Will, Fast Healing, Great Charisma, Great Constitution, Improved Whirlwind Attack, Legendary Commander, Superior Initiative.

At epic levels, the True Necromancer transcends the boundaries between life and death, becoming a living conduit of necrotic power. No longer merely a manipulator of the dead, they embody death itself, an enduring presence whose will animates entire graveyards. Necromancer:  The epic True Necromancer continues to count all spellcasting levels for the purposes of necromancy spells.

Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Focused Spell Penetration, Great Intelligence, Great Wisdom, Great Charisma, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Undead Mastery, Zone of Animation.

dst: 最初的夺魂者是一件传奇武器，拥有自我意识，据说能够随意变形为持有者想要的任何形态。它有时会以一把由残暴黑暗卫士挥舞的巨剑出现，有时又会以一把谋杀刺客手中的匕首现身。有些人相信这把武器实际上是一个以某种方式被困在剑刃中的邪恶恶魔。当然，这把武器自我意识和奇异力量的来源必定是彻底邪恶的。它之所以得名，不仅因为其吸取生命的力量，还因为它倾向于腐化任何触碰它的人。一些高尚的战士从邪恶持有者手中夺得此武器后，试图用它行善，却发现自己只要持有它，就会被不可抗拒地引向邪恶。\n\n有一次，当夺魂者落入一位精通锻造的战士手中时，它诱使这位战士制造了许多不同形态的复制品，并以某种方式将这些新武器注入了一些自身的特性。这把刀刃就是这些武器之一：它缺乏原版的自我意识和变形能力，威力也远不如原版，但仍保留了相同的基本特征：包括腐化持有者的能力。
src: The original Soulstealer was a legendary weapon that was sentient and said to be able to transform itself into whatever shape its wielder desired. It would make its appearance on one occasion as a mighty sword swung by a brutal blackguard, and on another as a dagger in the hands of a murderous assassin. Some believed that the weapon was actually a vile demon who had somehow been trapped within a blade. Certainly the source of the weapon's sentience and strange powers must have been thoroughly evil. It earned its name not only through its life-draining powers, but its proclivity to corrupt anyone who so much as touched it. Some noble warriors who captured the weapon from its evil wielders attempted to use it for good, only to find themselves irresistibly drawn to evil as long as they kept it in their possession.\n\nOnce when the Soulstealer came into the possession of a warrior with extensive knowledge of crafting, it induced him to make numerous copies of itself in various forms, and somehow infused these new weapons with some of its own properties. This blade is one of these weapons: it lacks the original's sentience and transformative abilities, and is much less powerful, but still retains the same basic characteristics: including the ability to corrupt its possessor.

dst: 哨兵斧在费伦各地有多种形态，包括这种双刃版本。顾名思义，它们在守卫中很受欢迎。这种武器不仅能在魔法上增强使用者发现入侵者的能力，而且在击中目标时会释放出具有破坏性的音爆，既伤害目标，又发出声响召唤其他守卫前来出事地点。似乎这还不够，刀刃上装饰的精工金镀层还能让使用者在站岗时显得威风凛凛。当然，这一切都不便宜，所以通常只有非常富有的雇主的守卫才能得到这些武器。
src: Sentinel axes can be found in various forms throughout Faerun, including this double-bladed version. As the name might suggest, they are popular among guards. This version of the weapon not only magically boosts one's ability to spot intruders, but when striking will release a damaging sonic blast that will both hurt the target and create a noise summoning other guards to the trouble spot. As if that were not enough, the finely worked gold plating decorating the blade helps one look impressive while standing on watch. Of course, none of this comes cheaply, so it is generally guards of very wealthy patrons who end up with these weapons.

dst:
扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角落”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。她告诉我，除了把详细说明她愿望的信交给他之外，我还可以提供最多5000金币（稍后由扎拉拉支付）以确保他协助。

我已经和伊纳斯·森卡尔谈过，但他不愿意仅仅为了钱而帮助扎拉拉。相反，他要我去被称为“黑暗卡林港”的古老废墟中寻找对历史研究有价值的东西，最好是一些书面记录（如果它能保存这么久，也许可以在石碑之类的东西上找到）。我听说人们可以在下水道的多个地点进入黑暗卡林港。也许在下水道系统的某处可以进入一处合适的废墟，让我找到森卡尔所要的东西。无论如何，如果想在这件事上取得任何进展，看来我必须这么做。

我设法找到了一件合适的物品，伊纳斯·森卡尔已经答应进行扎拉拉所要求的研究，并写出结果让我带给她。不过，这需要几天时间，所以我至少应该在接下来的48小时里找点别的事做。过了这段时间后，我应该计划返回。
src:
Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. She has told me that in addition to taking him the letter detailing her wishes, I can offer him up to 5000 gold (to be paid later by Zarala) to secure his assistance.

I have spoken to Inas Senkhar, but he is not willing to assist Zarala solely in exchange for money. Instead he wants me to search the old ruins known as "Dark Calimport" for something of value to historical research, preferably some kind of written record (perhaps to be found on a stone tablet or the like if it has survived this long). I am told that one can gain access to Dark Calimport at various points in the sewers. Perhaps somewhere in the sewer system there is access to a suitable set of ruins where I can find what Senkhar seeks. At any rate, it seems I must if any progress is to be made on this matter.

I managed to locate an appropriate item, and Inas Senkhar has promised to do the research Zarala has requested and write up the results for me to take to her. This will take a couple of days, however, so I should find something else to occupy myself for at least the next 48 hours. After that period I should plan to return.

src:
Over time, the petitioners (spirits of the departed) who arrive in the Wilderness of the Beastlands acquire animal traits, eventually becoming celestial beasts or animals. Some instead mingle with the beasts they will one day become, creating new races that are perpetually half-animal, half-humanoid. Prominent among these are the wildren, beings descended from the union of partially transformed dwarf petitioners and celestial badgers.
  
Prowling the darkest forests of Karasuthra, the Beastlands' lowest layer, wildren build elaborate underground burrows, which they defend, out of a commingled racial memory, to the death. Often short-tempered and vengeful, wildren generally live solitary lives, emerging only occasionally from their burrows to hunt and seek mates.

Ability Adjustments: +4 Constitution, -2 Dexterity, -2 Charisma
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass wildren's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Medium creature
- 20' base speed. He can move at this speed even when wearing medium or heavy armor
- Level Adjustment: +1
- Darkvision
- Scent
- Two 1d4 claw attacks
- Stability - +4 bonus to resist being bull rushed or tripped
- Fury (Ex) - Once per day, a wildren who has taken at least 1 point of damage can choose to enter a brief state of fury. The wildren gains +4 to Strength and -2 to Armor Class. The fury lasts for 1 round.
- Outsider: Wildren count as outsiders for the purpose of spells.

dst: "现在看来确实如此，事后回想起来也确实如此，但当时我以为手头有足够的资源来应对那些危险。比如，我随身带了几瓶隐形药水，以为一旦事情失控，我总能隐身逃走。不幸的是，那个巫妖有一件能赋予他真知术之力的物品，此外他还能施展其他强大的魔法。我那点可怜的装备简直可笑地不够用。要不是你出现，我真不敢想象我的天命会是什么。"
src: "So it doubtless seems, and in retrospect so it turned out to be, but at the time I thought I had sufficient resources at hand to deal with the dangers. For example, I had a few potions of invisibility with me, and imagined I could always vanish and escape if things got out of hand. Unfortunately the lich had an item granting him the power of True Seeing, among other forms of powerful magic at his command. My paltry devices were laughably inadequate. Had you not shown up, I shudder to think what my fate would have been."

dst: "自从你送出我的第一封信后，我一直在和卡齐娅·泽卡尔通信，<FirstName>。她发现她父亲最近的行为越来越令人不安。他一直在和奇怪的人进行许多秘密会面，而且每次会面后都不太高兴。她还看到越来越多证据表明他参与了恶魔召唤。这一切都在泽法德之剑上达到了顶点。据卡齐娅说，他对这把剑痴迷了相当一段时间，但最近她寄给我一封信，表明他打算将其用于最初的目的：让它飞向希尔瓦德詹要塞，并粉碎囚禁卡利姆和门农的结界。"
src: "Since you delivered my first letter I've been corresponding with Kadzia Zekar, <FirstName>. She's been finding her father's behavior of late increasingly disturbing. He's been having a lot of secret meetings with strange people, and generally not coming out of them happy. And she's been seeing more and more evidence that he's involved in demon summoning. This has all come to a head with the Sword of Zefad. He's had a strange obsession with it for some time, according to Kadzia, but recently she sent me a letter indicating that he intends to use it for its original purpose: sending it flying to the Keep of Sir'wadjen, and shattering the wards that hold Calim and Memnon captive."

Prerequisite: Dread Necromancer 3.
Specifics: Beginning at 3rd level, a dread necromancer gains the ability to emit a burst of negative energy from her body, harming living creatures within 10 feet of her. This burst deals 1d4 points of damage per class level. A successful Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 her class level + Cha modifier) reduces damage by half. Undead creatures within this burst are healed the same amount of hit points as the damage she deals to living creatures. A dread necromancer can use this ability once per day at 3rd level, and one additional time per day for every five levels she attains beyond 3rd (2/day at 8th level, 3/day at 13th level, and 4/day at 18th level).

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市上遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·寻宝者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地面的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他所认识的一支由另外六名斯涅布力侏儒组成的队伍，曾在附近调查各个派系和近期事件，如今已经失踪。他要我找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深地侏儒，或者至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒分别是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到其中任何一人或他们遭遇的证据，都应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我找到并营救了施内拉·潜影者，她曾被囚禁在一座夺心魔要塞中。据她说，弗雷博·渔夫和塔克塞维克·钢手与她一同被俘，但在夺心魔强迫他们参加的角斗中丧生。凯齐布·煤切者残缺不全的尸体也被发现了，他显然是被一队卓尔俘虏并折磨致死。我还在一座底栖魔鱼要塞深处找到了泽布利普·铁足。不幸的是，他已被转化为受精神控制的奴隶，我们被迫杀死了他。至少他的命运已经查明。失踪的斯涅布力侏儒中，只剩下施纳巴·凿岩者仍下落不明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found and rescued Schnella Shadowsneaker, who was being held captive in a Mind-Flayer stronghold. According to her, Frebo Fisher and Taxevek Steelhand were captured along with her, but perished in gladiatorial combats in which the Mind Flayers forced them to participate. The mutilated body of Kezib Coalcutter, who was apparently captured and tortured to death by a party of Drow, has been found as well. I also found Zeblip Ironfoot deep in the stronghold of an Aboleth. Unfortunately, he had been transformed into a mind-controlled slave and we were forced to slay him. At least his fate has been discovered. Only one of the missing Svirfneblin, Schnabar Rockhewer, remains unaccounted for.

dst: "大多是豺狼人留下的。虽然这不关我们的事，但据说它们有时会和地精结盟，所以路上顺手杀几个我也不太反对。"
src: "Mostly left by gnolls. Not really any part of our business here, though they've been known to sometimes forge alliances with goblins, so I wouldn't object too strongly to killing a few of them along the way."

dst: "是的。神力帮助了双方，因此谁也无法彻底克服各种诅咒。然而阿巴索尔告诉我，如果有一天一个活着的矮人回到这些大厅，<he/she>就能做到。当这样一位勇士对抗阿巴索尔的敌人时，他们的死亡将变为永久。战争终于了结后，我们这些他的信徒，仍保留着不死之身，就能接管这个地方，将其变成我们神祇的权力基地，正如我们几个世纪前计划的那样。有预言说，终有一天，这样一位盟友会到来。而你就在这里，一个活着的矮人，而且相当有能力与强大的敌人战斗。"
src: "Yes. Divine power aided both sides, and thus none could ever fully overcome the various curses. Abbathor told me, however, that if ever a living dwarf returned to these halls, <he/she> would be able to do so. When such a champion went up against Abbathor's enemies, their deaths would now be permanent. With the war finally resolved, we followers of his, still retaining our undeath, would be able to take over this place and make it a base of power for our god, as we had planned centuries ago. It was prophecied that one day, such an ally would indeed come. And here you are, a living dwarf, and one quite capable of battling powerful foes."

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Hexblade level 1
Once per day + the Hexblade's CHA modifier, as a free action, a hexblade can unleash a curse upon a foe. The target must be visible to the Hexblade and within 60 feet. The target of a Hexblade's curse takes a -2 penalty on attacks, saves, ability checks, skill checks and weapon damage rolls for one hour thereafter. A successful Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 Hexblade's class level + Hexblade's CHA mod)negates the effect. At every 4th level beyond 1st, a Hexblade gains the ability to use his curse one additional time per day.

Greater Hexblade's Curse

When a Hexblade attains 7th level, the penalties incurred by a target of his curse become -4 instead of -2.

Dire Hexblade's Curse

When a Hexblade attains 19th level, the penalties incurred by a target of his curse become -6 instead of -4.

Epic Hexblade's Curse

When a Hexblade attains 37th level, the penalties incurred by a target of his curse become -8 instead of -6.

School: Necromancy [Evil]
Caster Level: Clr 9, sor/wiz 9
Components: V, S, F, XP
Range: Medium
Target: Living creature with necrotic cyst
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial
Spell Resistance: No

You cause the cyst of a subject already harboring a necrotic cyst (see spell of the same name) to physically and spiritually enlarge itself at the expense of the subject's body and soul. If the subject succeeds on her saving throw, she takes 1d6 points of damage per level (maximum 25d6), and half the damage is considered vile damage (see necrotic bloat). The subject's cyst-derived saving throw penalty against effects from the school of necromancy applies.

If the subject fails her saving throw, the cyst expands beyond control, killing the subject and digesting her soul. Raise dead, resurrection, true resurrection, wish, and miracle cannot return life to the subject once her soul is digested-she is gone forever.

Focus: Caster must possess a Mother Cyst.
XP Cost: 1,000 XP.

模糊了神术与奥术的界限，秘术师从神术来源和古老典籍中汲取力量。大多数施法者只选择一条魔法力量之路，而秘术师选择同时行走两条道路，精通牧师和法师共有的法咒。这种奥术与神术的交织使秘术师拥有无与伦比的法咒多样性，随着时间的推移，秘术师可以学会施放几乎任何法咒。

奥术施法：能施放2级或更高法咒。
神术施法：能施放2级或更高法咒。

奖励法咒：

每级，秘术师获得新的每日法咒，如同在奥术施法职业和神术施法职业上各提升了一级。然而，通过此能力不会学习新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Blurring the line between divine and arcane, the Mystic Theurge draws power from divine sources and musty tomes alike. While most spellcasters choose but one path to magical power, the Mystic Theurge chooses to walk two roads at once, mastering spells common to both cleric and wizard.  This weaving of both the arcane and the divine allows the Mystic Theurge an unparalleled diversity of spells and, in time, a Mystic Theurge can learn to cast almost any spell.

Mystic theurges are often obsessed with magical lore, and will travel to the ends of the earth to gain access to some new arcane secret or divine insight.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: A Mystic Theurge does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Lore (6 ranks), Concentration (6 ranks), Spellcraft (6 ranks).
Arcane Spellcasting: Can cast level 2 spells or higher.
Divine Spellcasting: Can cast level 2 spells or higher.

BONUS SPELLS:

Each level, the Mystic Theurge gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in both their arcane spellcasting class and their divine spellcasting class.  No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

dst: 扎拉拉觉得她在魔法和历史研究上花了太多时间，想要拓展一些不同的活动。具体来说，她认为自己的武器技能需要提高，想要一些武技训练。由于她无法离开庄园，她请我找一位合适的教官来庄园，并建议我去看看位于贵族区的卡拉达尔·科拉德学校。科拉德只接收特定的学生，不会训练扎拉拉，但她的想法是，既然连他的学生都相当厉害，那么可以雇佣其中一位。她让我向潜在的教官提供每节课250金币的报酬，外加500金币的预付款，并给了我一些金币来支付这笔预付款。我不需要花掉的部分可以自己留着。
src: Zarala feels that she has been spending too much time in magical and historical research, and wants to branch out into some different activities. Specifically, she thinks her skill with weapons needs improvement and wants some martial training. Since she cannot leave the estate, she has asked me to locate an approrpriate instructor who could come there, and suggested I look at Khaladar Korad's school, located here in the Noble district. Korad only accepts select students, and would not train Zarala, but her thinking is that since even his students are quite formidable, one of them could be hired. She has told me to offer potential instructors an incentive of 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 up front, and given me some gold to pay this latter advance. I can keep whatever I don't need to spend.

dst: 在前往烛堡的途中，我遇到了一位树精，她正与一群信奉风暴与毁灭之神塔洛斯的人发生冲突。双方最终都死了，但我在一名塔洛斯信徒的尸体上找到了一张地图，上面标明了某处废墟的位置，他们希望在那里找到科扎的雕像——科扎是一位耐瑟瑞尔神祇，据信是塔洛斯的一个化身或别名——根据地图上的笔记，这些塔洛斯信徒希望从这尊雕像中获得强大的力量。塔洛斯的各种敌人试图阻止此事，所以也许我应该亲自前往这些废墟取回雕像，尤其是前往烛堡似乎可能没有我希望的那么简单。如果我获得雕像，我可以把它带给塔洛斯的一位风暴先驱，名叫马尔扎克，目前可以在附近城镇纳什凯尔的旅店里找到他，希望他会奖励我。\n\n我杀过了一些试图阻挡我的天界生物，成功从废墟中取回了雕像。下一步是前往纳什凯尔，找到等待它的风暴先驱。我本打算避开纳什凯尔，但鉴于有如此多强大的势力对它感兴趣，我不确定长期持有这尊雕像是否明智。
src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. Both parties ended up dead, but I found a map on the body of one of the Talosians, indicating the location of some ruins where they hope to find an idol of Kozah, a Netherese deity believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos, and an object from which these Talosians hope to gain great power, based on notes written on the map. Various enemies of Talos seek to prevent this, so perhaps I should head to these ruins myself and recover the idol, especially as it seems going to Candlekeep will may not be as simple as I hoped. If I acquire the idol I can bring it to a Stormherald of Talos known as Marzak, currently to be found in the inn of the nearby town of Nashkel, who will hopefully reward me.\n\nI fought through some Celestials who sought to bar my way, and successfully recovered the idol from the ruins. The next step would be to go to Nashkel and find the Stormherald waiting for it. I had intended to avoid Nashkel, but given how many powerful forces are interested in it, I am not sure it would be wise to retain possession of this idol for too long.

dst:
再次乘坐瓦尔库尔之剑号出发时，我们遭到了一头强大蓝龙的袭击，它显然与泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡勾结，意图杀死扎拉拉。那头龙摧毁了船只，杀死了大部分船员，船搁浅后，扎拉拉和我逃进了一个附近的小洞穴，龙无法进入。那头龙的反应是砸碎周围的岩壁，把我们封在洞里，指望我们饿死在里面。然而，我们找到了一条通往更大洞穴网络的下行路径，现在正在探索这个地下区域，希望能最终找到回到地面的路。

下行后，我们发现自己身处另一个有两个分支路径的洞穴中，并短暂分开，我走北边的路，扎拉拉往南走，以确定哪条路更有探索价值。我走的这条路刚刚到了死胡同，所以我需要去找扎拉拉，看看她是否运气更好。

扎拉拉走的路似乎继续向下延伸。我们现在已经重新会合，并将继续沿着这条路线前进，因为没有其他选择。
src:
Upon setting out once again aboard the Sword of Valkur, we were attacked by a powerful Blue Dragon, apparently working with Zekar and Azghulkar, and seeking to slay Zarala. The Dragon destroyed the ship and killed most of its crew, and Zarala and I escaped, after the ship ran aground, only by fleeing into a nearby cave too small for the dragon to enter. The Dragon responded by smashing the surrounding rockface, sealing us into the cave in the expectation we would starve within. However, we found a path heading down into a larger cave network, and are now exploring this underground region in the hope of eventually finding some way back to the surface.

Upon descending, we found ourselves in another cave with two branching paths, and briefly split up, with me taking the path to the north, while Zarala went south, to determine which seemed more promising to explore. The path I have taken just came to a dead end, so I need to go find Zarala and see if she has had better luck.

Zarala's path appears to continue on and downward. We have now joined up again and will continue along this route, having no other options.

dst: 纳西拉克告诉过我，有一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特修士，是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他修士提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名修士，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅，我之前没有理由注意到它，它通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通向隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我说这也可能很危险。\n\n我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他已经开始了我的训练计划，并给了我几项任务：我要去他洞穴西南角的一个袋子里拿到粗毛衬衣，我在训练期间要穿着它；我还要回到我来这里时穿过的隧道，去取一具尸体上的几件修士装备。
src: Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.\n\nI have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and given me a couple of tasks: I am to get the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave, which I am to wear during my training, and I am also to go back to the tunnel I traveled through to get here in order to obtain several items of monk gear found on a corpse therein.

src: The Beholder Merchant Gaurash Vraktar has indicated he might know of a way for me to return to the surface, but will not release this information for free. He expects me to find the three pieces of a broken magical item known as Maghaurezh's Beholder Band. One of these pieces can currently be found in a Beholder Colony to the south, and another is in the possession of Mind Flayers who can be found in a stronghold to the north. The third has been acquired by Kuo Toa who have a base to the east. None of these factions is likely to be willing to part with their piece of the item, or indeed to react to my appearance with anything other than full-fledged hostility, so recovering the pieces will surely require some fighting.\n\nAll three pieces of Maghaurezh's Beholder Band have been found. Once all are returned to Gaurash, he should proved me with a means of escaping the Underdark.

dst: 斯瓦特曾是侏儒。被弗摩尔人奴役并带到幽暗地域后，那里的奇异魔法加上环境适应使他们变成了现在的形态。大多数斯瓦特弱小且胆小，尽管他们也以恶毒狡猾著称，但通常冒险者并不害怕他们作为敌人，除非他们数量极多。然而，这群斯瓦特似乎比该种族通常更为强大，所以低估他们可能并不明智。
src: Xvarts were once gnomes. Enslaved by Fomorians and carried off to the Underdark, a combination of the strange magics of that place plus environmental adaptation caused them to assume their current form. Most Xvarts are weak and cowardly, and, despite that they are also known for vicious cunning, as a rule adventurers have no fear of them as enemies unless they are present in very large numbers. This group seems more formidable than is typical of the race, however, so it might not be wise to underestimate them.

dst:
重击护手

描述符：无  
职业：魂裔 
脉轮：臂，手
豁免检定：无

魂能形成护手包裹你的双手（包括你已佩戴的任何手套或护手）并沿手臂延伸至肘部。金属闪烁着抛光后的蓝色光泽。尖刺和刀刃从护手的各处突出，每一个都在你脑海中低语着古老的战吼。

佩戴重击护手时，你在力量检定（但不包括基于力量的技能检定）上获得+2士气加值，例如冲撞对手时。

魂能：你投入重击护手的每点魂能使士气加值增加2.  

脉轮绑定（臂） 

你的重击护手延伸出蜿蜒的蓝色钢带，向上越过肘部，几乎到达肩部。在某些地方，这些金属带似乎与你的皮肤融合。

你的重击护手使你持用的任何近战武器的重击威胁范围翻倍。

脉轮绑定（手） 

这并非实际的护手，而是将你的双手转化为坚硬的蓝色金属。每当你弯曲手指，战场的回响便掠过你的脑海，直至形成持续的战歌和战吼低鸣，激励你在战斗中取得更大的成就。

你在徒手打击伤害上获得士气加值，数值等于重击护手提供的力量检定士气加值。你还获得精通徒手打击专长的好处。
src:
Mauling Gauntlets

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Soulborn 
Chakra: Arms, hands
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms gauntlets that surround your hands (including any gloves or gauntlets you already wear) and extend up your arms to your elbows. The metal gleams a burnished blue. Spikes and blades jut out in various places from these gauntlets, each one whispering an ancient battle cry in your mind.

While wearing mauling gauntlets, you gain a +2 morale bonus on Strength checks (but not on Strength-based skill checks), such as those to bull rush an opponent. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your mauling gauntlets increases the morale bonus by 2.  

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

Your mauling gauntlets extend winding bands of blue steel up past your elbows, almost to your shoulders. In places, these bands of metal seem fused with your skin.

Your mauling gauntlets double the critical threat range of any melee weapon you wield. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

Rather than actual gauntlets, this soulmeld transforms your hands into hard blue metal. Whenever you bend your fingers, echoes of the battlefield flit through your mind, until they form a constant undertone of war chants and battle cries inspiring you to greater accomplishments in battle.

You gain a morale bonus on unarmed strike damage equal to the morale bonus on Strength checks granted by the mauling gauntlets. You also gain the benefit of the Improved Unarmed Strike feat.

传奇天佑者与她的神祇越来越亲近，获得越来越多的神圣特征和抗力。真正高等级的传奇天佑者很容易被误认为天使，魔鬼，恶魔或类似的异界生物。

生命骰：d8。

每额外等级技能点：2 + 智力调整值。

法咒：天佑者的施法者等级等于其职业等级。天佑者的每日法咒数量在 20 级后不再增加。天佑者不会学习额外法咒。

精通能量抗力（Ex）：从 22 级开始，此后每四级，天佑者将她的三种能量抗力之一增加 +10。

神圣恩赐（Ex）：在 25 级及此后每五级，天佑者与她的神祇之间的纽带变得更加强大并显现于肉体。此时她可以选择以下任意一项好处。

伤害减免（Ex）：天佑者的伤害减免增加 +2。

飞行提升：天佑者的飞行速度增加 +10 英尺。

天生护甲：天佑者的天生护甲加值增加 +2。

神圣属性：天佑者选择一项属性获得 +1 加值。每次选择此恩赐时，天佑者必须选择一项新的属性进行修改。

神圣技能：天佑者在一项技能上获得 +4 神圣加值。每次选择此恩赐时，天佑者必须选择一项新的技能进行修改。

神圣法咒：天佑者选择一项她已知的法咒；所选法咒的等级必须等于或低于她的天佑者等级除以 10. 她可以每天施放此法咒一次而不消耗法术位，且每次施放此法咒时都以施法者等级 +2 结算。每次选择此恩赐时，天佑者必须选择一项新的法咒使其成为神圣法咒。

这些好处会带来某种与天佑者神祇相称的肉体变化。这可以简单到发光的眼睛，也可以惊人到由液态火焰构成的皮肤。在所有情况下，除了神圣恩赐赋予的实际游戏好处之外，这种变化仅是肉体上的。

奖励专长：传奇天佑者在 23 级获得一个奖励专长（从传奇天佑者专长列表中选择），此后每三级再获得一个。

传奇天佑者奖励专长列表：制造传奇魔法武器和护甲，毁灭性重击，传奇坚忍，传奇勇武，传奇速度，传奇法术专攻，传奇法术穿透，传奇法咒施法，传奇武器专攻，传奇武器专精，忽略材料成分，精通战斗施法，压倒性重击，完美健康，法咒偷渡，顽强魔法。
src:
An epic favored soul continues to grow closer to her deity, gaining more and more divine characteristics and resistances. A truly high level epic favored soul is easily mistaken for an angel, devil, demon, or similar outsider.

Hit Die: d8.

Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Spells: The favored soul's caster level is equal to her class level. The favored soul's number of spells per day does not increase after 20th level. The favored soul does not learn additional spells.

Improved Energy Resistance (Ex): Starting at 22nd level, and every four levels thereafter, the favored soul adds +10 to one of her three energy resistances.

Divine Gift (Ex): At 25th level and every five levels thereafter, a favored soul's bond with her deity grows stronger and manifests physically. She can choose any one of the following benefits at this time.

Damage Reduction (Ex): The favored soul's damage reduction increases by +2.

Increased Flight: The favored soul's flying speed increases by +10 ft.

Natural Armor: The favored soul's natural armor bonus increases by +2.

Sacred Ability: The favored soul gains a +1 bonus to an ability score of her choice. Each time this gift is chosen, the favored soul must select a new ability to modify.

Sacred Skill: The favored soul gains a +4 sacred bonus on one skill. Each time this gift is chosen, the favored soul must select a new skill to modify.

Sacred Spell: The favored soul selects one spell she knows; the selected spell's level must be equal to or less than her favored soul level divided by 10. She can cast this spell one time each day without expending a spell slot, and each time she casts this spell it resolves at caster level +2. Each time this gift is chosen, the favored soul must select a new spell to make sacred.

These benefits carry with them some form of physical change appropriate to the favored soul's deity. This can be something as simple as glowing eyes, or it can be something as impressive as skin made of liquid fire. In all cases, apart from the actual game benefit granted by the divine gift, this change is physical only.

Bonus Feats: The epic favored soul gains a bonus feat (selected from the list of epic favored soul feats) at 23rd level and again every three levels after that.

Epic Favored Soul Bonus Feat List: Craft Epic Magic Arms and Armor, Devastating Critical, Epic Endurance, Epic Prowess, Epic Speed, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Weapon Specialization, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Overwhelming Critical, Perfect Health, Spell Stowaway, Tenacious Magic.

At 1st level, whenever you cast a healing spell on an ally, you can choose to imbue the spell with a Sanctuary effect (as the spell). The Will save DC to overcome this effect is equal to 15 + class level + Wisdom modifier. This effect lasts for one round.

You can use your Healing Kicker ability once per round, up to a total number of times per day equal to your class level + your Wisdom modifier (minimum once per day). Only one secondary effect can be imbued into any single spell, and it cannot be applied to yourself.

dst: 哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动袭击，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，他还有另一个任务要我在期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采用何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我拜访了他的庄园而受到启发，联系了哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服在一件与卡洛玛斯有关的事情上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多询问他们的情况）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。\n\n结果发现，营地遭到了与龙教有关的吸血鬼的袭击。我们追踪吸血鬼到了他们的基地，杀死了他们，并赶走了他们合作的那条龙类，从而解决了此事。我已向卡洛玛斯报告了此事。哈马德仍需要被告知。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. \n\nIt turned out the camp was being attacked by vampires associated with the Cult of the Dragon. We tracked the vampires to their base and slew them, and drove off the dragon they were working with, thereby resolving this matter. I have reported this to Kalomas. Hamad still needs to be informed.

Now that I have your support, however, I hope to continue on and follow those tracks wherever they lead. Even if we somehow fail, Kalomas will be keeping this portal open over the next few day, giving the refugees an avenue of escape if need be, which will set my mind at ease. 解魔者面具

描述符：光 
职业：图腾师
脉轮：眉（图腾）

你将魂能塑造成一个银色的面具，有着长长的口鼻，冠部有棒状突起，以及一条长长的分叉舌头。面具上的银色鳞片在光线下闪闪发光，舌头似乎自行摇摆。

你可以使用侦测魔法效果，如同该法咒，距离为10英尺。

魂质：每投入一点魂质到这道魂融中，距离增加10英尺。

脉轮绑定（眉）

你的解魔者面具绑定到你的前额，你的眼睛取代了面具眼窝中的玻璃般黑眼。颜色在你的视觉中似乎更加生动 - 尤其是你知道是魔法的法咒效果和物品的颜色。

使用这道魂融的侦测魔法能力时，你可以立即确定每个魔法灵光的数量，强度和位置，如同你已经专注了3轮。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

你的脸拉长并塑造成你所戴的面具，面具上垂下的舌头变成你自己的舌头。当你伸出它时，你几乎能尝到空气中的魔法，当你用舌头吸取魔法时，它尝起来浓烈而甜美，几乎像利口酒。

你可以用解魔者面具的长舌头以标准动作进行近战接触攻击。如果命中，你压制对手的主要武器（如果有的话） 十轮。
src:
Disenchanter Mask

Descriptors: Light 
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Brow (Totem)
Saving Throw: None

You shape incarnum into a silvery mask with a long snout, clubbed protrusions at the crown, and a long, forked tongue. The silver scales of the mask glint and gleam in the light, and the tongue seems to sway of its own accord.

You can use a detect magic effect as the spell, with a range of 10 feet.

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld increases the range by 10 feet.

Chakra Bind (Brow)

Your disenchanter mask binds to your forehead, and your eyes replace the glassy black eyes in the mask's sockets. Colors seem somehow more alive to your sight-particularly the colors of spell effects and items that you know to be magical.

When using this soulmeld's detect magic ability, you can instantly determine the number, strength, and location of each magical aura present as if you had been concentrating for 3 rounds. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your face lengthens and shapes into the mask you wear, and the dangling tongue of the mask becomes your own tongue. As you extend it, you can practically taste magic in the air, and when you use the tongue to drain magic, it tastes strong and sweet, almost like a liqueur.

You can use the long tongue of your disenchanter mask to make a melee touch attack as a standard action. If it hits, you suppress the opponent's primary weapon, if any, for ten rounds.

dst:
死亡三神的历史，或“指节骨、滚头骨与空王座”：

在远古时代，只有一位争斗、死亡与死者之神，他被称为杰加尔，万物终结之主。杰加尔煽动并滋养凡人与神力之间的不和。当众生在追求权力或仇恨中互相残杀时，他欢迎他们进入他永恒阴郁的阴影王国。万物皆死，一切最终都归于他，随着时间的推移，他将自己的力量建立成一个其他神祇无法挑战的王国。然而，最终他厌倦了自己的职责，因为他太了解它们了。没有挑战就什么都没有，而在虚无中只有阴郁。在这种状态下，绝对权力与绝对无力之间的区别是无法察觉的。

在这个黑暗时代，出现了三个强大的凡人——班恩、巴尔和米尔寇——他们渴望杰加尔所掌握的力量。三人缔结了邪恶的契约，同意他们敢于寻求这种终极力量，否则就在尝试中死去。他们走遍诸国，寻找强大的魔法和法术，处处挑战死亡。无论面对什么怪物或勇敢面对什么法术，这三个凡人每次都能毫发无伤地脱身。最终三人摧毁了七位失落神祇之一，各自夺取了他神圣本质的一部分。

三人随后前往灰色荒原，寻找白骨城堡。他们与成群的骷髅、成群的僵尸、成群的虚体不死生物以及一排巫妖战斗。最终他们到达了他们一生追寻的目标——白骨王座。

“我宣称拥有这邪恶的王座，”暴君班恩喊道。

“我会在你动一根手指之前摧毁你，”刺客巴尔威胁道。

“而我将永远囚禁你的本质，”死灵法师米尔寇承诺道。

杰加尔带着疲惫的表情从王座上站起来说：“王座是你的。我已经厌倦了这空虚的力量。如果你愿意就拿去吧——我承诺作为你的总管服务和引导你，直到你适应这个位置。”在惊呆的三人反应过来之前，死者之主继续说道：“你们中谁来统治？”

三人立刻陷入内斗，而杰加尔冷漠地看着。当最终看来他们要么都会因疲惫而死，要么永远战斗下去时，万物终结之主介入了。“毕竟你们牺牲了这么多，难道要空手而归吗？为什么不把职责分开，通过技巧游戏来决定呢？”杰加尔问道。

班恩、巴尔和米尔寇考虑了这个神的提议并同意了。杰加尔取来他最强大的三个巫妖的头颅，交给三人，让他们通过滚头骨来竞争。每个凡人将头骨滚过灰色荒原，同意滚得最远的人获胜。

兽王玛拉此时前来拜访杰加尔。在迅速确定比赛的获胜者将获得杰加尔所有的力量后，他追赶三个头骨，以确保比赛暂停，直到他有机会参与争夺部分奖品。班恩、巴尔和米尔寇再次陷入战斗，因为他们的游戏显然被破坏了，杰加尔再次介入。“为什么不让机运女士来决定，这样你们就不必与野兽分享了？”

三人同意了，杰加尔折断他的指骨交给玩家们。当玛拉追赶头骨回来时，他发现三人刚刚完成了一局指节骨游戏。

班恩胜利地喊道：“作为赢家，我选择作为终极暴君永远统治。我可以随心所欲地引发仇恨和争斗，在我的王国里所有人都将向我屈服。”

获得第二名的米尔寇宣布：“但我选择死者，这样做我才是真正的赢家，因为班恩，你所统治的一切最终都将属于我。万物皆死——即使是神。”

获得第三名的巴尔表示异议：“我选择死亡，正是通过我的手，班恩领主你所统治的一切最终将传给米尔寇领主。你们两人都必须向我表示敬意并服从我的意愿，因为我可以杀死你的臣民来摧毁你的王国，班恩，我也可以通过收手来让你的王国饥荒，米尔寇。”

玛拉沮丧地咆哮，但无能为力，又一次只有野兽留给了他。

而杰加尔只是微笑，因为他已经解脱了。
src:
History of the Dead Three, or "Knucklebones, Skull Bowling, and the Empty Throne":

In ages past there was but one god of strife, death, and the dead, and he was known as Jergal, Lord of the End of Everything. Jergal fomented and fed on the discord among mortals and powers alike. When beings slew each other in their quest for power or in their hatred, he welcomed them into his shadowy kingdom of eternal gloom. As all things died, everything came to him eventually, and over time he built his power into a kingdom unchallenged by any other god. Eventually, however, he grew tired of his duties for he knew them too well. Without challenge there is nothing, and in nothingness there is only gloom. In such a state, the difference between absolute power and absolute powerlessness is undetectable.

During this dark era, there arose three powerful mortals - Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul - who lusted after the power Jergal wielded. The trio forged an unholy pact, agreeing that they would dare to seek such ultimate power or die in the attempt. Over the length and breadth of the Realms they strode, seeking powerful magic and spells and defying death at every turn. No matter what monster they confronted or what spells they braved, the three mortals emerged unscathed at every turn. Eventually the trio destroyed one of the Seven Lost Gods, and they each seized a portion of his divine essence for themselves.

The trio then journeyed into the Gray Waste and sought out the Castle of Bone. Through armies of skeletons, legions of zombies, hordes of noncorporeal undead, and a gauntlet of liches they battled. Eventually they reached the object of their lifelong quest - the Bone Throne.

"I claim this throne of evil," shouted Bane the tyrant.

"I'll destroy you before you can raise a finger," threatened Bhaal the assassin.

"And I shall imprison your essence for eternity," promised Myrkul the necromancer.

Jergal arose from his throne with a weary expression and said, "The Throne is yours. I have grown weary of this empty power. Take it if you wish - I promise to serve and guide you as your seneschal until you grow comfortable with the position." Before the stunned trio could react, the Lord of the Dead continued: "Who among you shall rule?"

The trio immediately fell to fighting amongst themselves while Jergal looked on with indifference. When eventually it appeared that either they would all die of exhaustion or battle on for an eternity, the Lord of the End of Everything intervened. "After all you have sacrificed, would you come away with nothing? Why don't you divide the portfolios of the office and engage in a game of skill for them?" asked Jergal.

Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul considered the god's offer and agreed. Jergal took the heads of his three most powerful liches and gave them to the trio that they would compete by bowling the skulls. Each mortal rolled a skull across the Gray Waste, having agreed that the winner would be he who bowled the farthest.

Malar the Beastlord arrived to visit Jergal at this moment. After quickly ascertaining that the winner of the contest would get all of Jergal's power, he chased off after the three skulls to make sure that the contest would be halted until he had a chance to participate for part of the prize. Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul again fell to fighting as it was obvious their sport was ruined, and again Jergal intervened. "Why don't you allow Lady Luck to decide so you don't have to share with the Beast?"

The trio agreed, and Jergal broke off his skeletal finger bones and gave them to the players. When Malar returned from chasing the skulls, he found that the trio had just finished a game of knucklebones.

Bane cried out triumphantly, "As winner, I choose to rule for all eternity as the ultimate tyrant. I can induce hatred and strife at my whim, and all will bow down before me while in my kingdom."

Myrkul, who had won second place, declared, "But I choose the dead, and by doing so I truly win, because all you are lord over, Bane, will eventually be mine. All things must die - even gods."

Bhaal, who finished third, demurred, "I choose death, and it is by my hand that all that you rule Lord Bane will eventually pass to Lord Myrkul. Both of you must pay honor to me and obey my wishes, since I can destroy your kingdom, Bane, by murdering your subjects, and I can starve your kingdom, Myrkul, by staying my hand."

Malar growled in frustration but could do nothing, and yet again only the beasts were left for him.

And Jergal merely smiled, for he had been delivered.

dst: "我来自楚尔特的丛林，那里蛇人很常见，也令人极为恐惧。考虑到我后来走的道路，也许有些讽刺的是，我和我的族人有时会被怀疑拥有蛇人血统，因为我们一直有些不同，不完全是普通人类。但实际上，我们完全没有蛇人血统的污点。我们的奇特之处来自精灵血统。成长过程中，我听过许多关于野精灵藏在丛林某处的故事，我们的祖先就来自他们。这些故事后来证明比我当时所能猜到的要重要得多。"
src: "I come from the jungles of Chult, where Yuan-ti are common and greatly feared. It is perhaps ironic, considering the path I later took, that I and those of my line were sometimes suspected of having Yuan-ti blood, for we have always been somewhat different, not quite normal humans. In fact, though, we are wholly free of any taint of Yuan-ti blood. It is from elven blood that our oddity came. When growing up, I was told many stories of the wild elves hiding somewhere in the jungle, from whom our ancestor came. These stories proved more important than I would ever have guessed at the time."

src: The mighty longsword-wielding warrior Gurdoc Marthal, upon hearing rumors that an exceptionally powerful longsword, that once belonged to a famous hero of a past era named Lanzan, could be found in a subterranean ruin, assembled a party of adventurers to raid the ruin in question to recover this treasure. The dungeon proved to be filled with Beholders and powerful undead, and was not easily traversed. Indeed, not all of the party made it back. Despite the difficulties and sacrifices, Gurdoc did ultimately find the weapon he was looking for. Unfortunately, he turned out to be quite disappointed with what he recovered, despite the fact that the enchantments on it were indeed as immensely potent as the relevant legends proclaimed. His research, however, had not been thorough enough to uncover the information that the renowned Lanzan had in fact been a tiny pixie, and the weapon considered a "longsword" by members of that race was in fact no more than a dagger in the hands of adventurers of more normal size.

src: A mage known as Radamur the Conjurer offers an intriguing opportunity: He has set up a portal that leads to some far plane, apparently guarded by fiendish monstrosities but also allegedly containing great wealth for the taking. For a price, he will permit adventurers who wish to test their mettle to pass through the portal. Unfortunately the price he demands for two adventurers to enter is quite high: 100000 gold. I shall have to consider whether this venture is worth the cost and the risks.\n\nI have learned that an adventurer known as Achillan Arndry recently took up Radamur on his offer, and successfully returned after braving whatever hazards could be found on the portal's far side. It might be wise to talk to this Arndry about his experiences before going through. I have heard he can be found at the Winsome Repose Inn.
