dst:
阿塔斯世界的原生矮人是一群固执而专注的种族。他们偏好有意义的工作，并以其他种族罕见的热情投入其中。每个矮人都有一个“专注”，一个他们全身心投入直至完成的目标，并且很少让任何事情阻挡他们。矮人只与他们最亲密的朋友和盟友分享他们的专注主题，而一个在完成专注前死去的矮人会缠着其专注的对象直到它完成。在身体上，他们与其他位面的矮人很像，但与他们的远亲不同，他们完全没有毛发，并且觉得毛发的概念令人厌恶。他们的皮肤通常晒得很黑，并装饰着纹身。

阿塔斯矮人属性调整：+2 体质，-2 魅力。
偏好职业（战士）：在决定兼职阿塔斯矮人是否遭受兼职经验值惩罚时，其战士职业不计入。

- 黑暗视觉：阿塔斯矮人能够在黑暗中视物。
- 抗毒：对毒素的豁免检定获得+2种族加值。
- 抗法咒：对法咒的豁免检定获得+2种族加值。
- 矮人：在法咒效果上，阿塔斯矮人视为矮人。
src:
Dwarves native to the world of Athas are a stubborn, devoted lot.  They prefer meaningful tasks, and dive into them with an intensity seldom seen in other races.  Every dwarf has a "focus" a goal that they devote their entire being to until it is accomplished, and seldom let anything stand in their way.  Dwarves only share the subject of their focus with their closest friends and allies, and a dwarf who dies before completing their focus haunts the object of it until it is finished.  Physically they are much like dwarves of other planes, but unlike their distant kin they are completely hairless, and find the idea of hair repulsive.  Their skin is usually deeply tanned, and decorated with tattoos.

Athasian Dwarf Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (fighter): A multiclass Athasian dwarf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Athasian Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Poisons: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Dwarven: Athasian Dwarves count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

Our warrior spirit was good, I learned, but needed to be subordinated to the duty of guarding and protecting one's people, not wasted on pointless cruelty and barbarity."

卓尔是原始黑皮肤亚种伊利斯瑞的后裔，也被称为黑暗精灵，因跟随女神罗丝走上邪恶与堕落的道路而被善良的精灵神祇诅咒成现在的模样。他们生活在幽暗地域，建立了一个基于权力和欺骗的母权社会。卓尔拥有类似抛光黑曜石的黑皮肤和纯白或淡黄色的头发。他们通常有非常苍白的眼睛（苍白到常被误认为白色），呈淡紫色，银色，粉色和蓝色。他们也往往比大多数精灵更小更瘦。

卓尔女性往往比男性更大更强壮。卓尔社会是神权政治和强烈的母权制，女性在政府，民兵和家庭中担任所有权力和责任的职位。她们的首选职业是牧师。
卓尔男性往往比女性更小更弱。在社会中，他们往往填补战士，巡林客和游荡者的低级职位，尽管他们的魔法天赋与其他精灵亚种相等，甚至更优越。他们的首选职业是法师。

卓尔属性调整：+2 敏捷，+2 智力，+2 魅力，-2 体质。
首选职业 女性（牧师）：在确定女性卓尔是否因兼职而受到 XP 惩罚时，兼职女性卓尔牧师职业不计入。
首选职业 男性（法师）：在确定男性卓尔是否因兼职而受到 XP 惩罚时，兼职男性卓尔法师职业不计入。

特殊能力：

- 无眠：免疫 '睡眠' 子类型的法咒和效果。
- 附魔坚韧：对抗影响心智法咒的豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 钢铁意志：对抗意志的豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（侦察）：侦察检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 敏锐感官：卓尔自动进行主动搜索检定，且无移动惩罚。
- 黑暗视觉：卓尔可以在黑暗中视物。
- 法术抗力：先天法术抗力 11 加每等级 1。
- 光盲：突然暴露在光线下会使卓尔目盲 1 轮。此外，卓尔在明亮光线下行动时，攻击检定，豁免和检定受到 -1 环境惩罚。
- 类法咒能力：每天 1 次 - 黑暗术，妖火。施法者等级 3。
- 精灵：就法咒而言，卓尔被视为精灵。

src:
Descended from the original dark-skinned subrace called the Illythiiri, the drow also known as dark elves, were cursed into their present appearance by the good elven deities for following the goddess Lolth down the path to evil and corruption. Living in the Underdark, they built a matriarchal society based on power and deceit. The drow have black skin that resembles polished obsidian and stark white or pale yellow hair. They commonly have very pale eyes (so pale as to be often mistaken for white) in shades of lilac, silver, pink and blue. They also tend to be smaller and thinner than most elves.

Drow females tend to be bigger and stronger than males. Drow society is theocratic and strongly matriarchal with females holding all positions of power and responsibility in the government, the militia and in the home. Their preferred class is cleric.
Drow males tend to be smaller and weaker than females. In society they tend to fill the lower ranks as fighters, rangers and rogues although their aptitude for magic is equal, if not superior, to that of other elven subraces. Their preferred class is wizard.

Drow Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Int, +2 Cha, -2 Con.
Favored Class  Females (Cleric): A multiclass female drows cleric class does not count when determining whether she suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.
Favored Class  Males (Wizard): A multiclass male drows wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Iron Will: +2 racial bonus on savings throws versus will.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Drow make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Darkvision: Drow can see in the dark.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 11 plus 1 per level.
- Light Blindness: Abrupt exposure to light blinds a drow for 1 round. In addition drow suffer -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Darkness, Faerie Fire. Caster level 3rd.
- Elven: Drow are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

src: While fighting through the Forest of Mir against the goblins within it, I came across some pixies. Their leader, Zeepa, warned me that to the north there is a grove with some Dryads in it. Unfortunately, Gorav, a lieutenant of the goblin leader Ulaz, is also there and is threatening to cut down the dryad's trees, which they need to survive, if they do not fight alongside the goblins. Zeepa has asked me not to kill the dryads, who are being forced to work with the goblins against their will. The dryads are found in the center of the grove, so Zeepa suggests I sneak around the edges to locate Gorav's camp in the northeast, and kill him. Once Gorav is dead the dryads will no longer be hostile and may even assist us. In any case, Zeepa will have a reward.\n\nGorav has been dealt with, and Zeepa has rewarded me for this.

dst: 12000多年前，从东方迁徙而来的矮人在费伦西南的地底区域建立了后来被称为沙纳塔的诸王国。有一段时间，后来构成沙纳塔的各个矮人王国之间彼此交战的可能性，与同外来者交战的可能性一样大，但在DR -8137年，他们共同的敌人——卓尔——所构成的威胁变得如此严重，以至于该地区所有矮人都同意联合为一个统一政体。经过一段时间，它发展成为一个强大的帝国，同时拥有地面领土（被称为上沙纳塔）和地下领土（被称为深沙纳塔），而其居民则演化为一个独特的亚种，被称为盾矮人。它最强盛繁荣的时期大约始于DR -6000年，就在它帮助卡林杉的人类驱逐其巨灵领主之后不久，这一事件开辟了许多可供扩张的新地区。维持这个帝国需要频繁作战，既对抗地表的人类和巨人敌人，也对抗地下的夺心魔、卓尔和灰矮人。最终，沙纳塔被这些形形色色的敌人压垮，其最后的地表领地于DR -2600年落入卡林杉军队之手，而它的大多数地下城市则到DR -1800年时已落入灰矮人之手。只有伊尔特卡扎城作为这个帝国残余存续至今。逃离沙纳塔毁灭的矮人后裔，如今散布在费伦北部和西部各地，这一离散范围如此之广，以至于盾矮人已成为大多数费伦人心中矮人种族最典型的代表。\n\n沙纳塔的中心位于今天的泰瑟尔国一带，而泰瑟尔的达罗玛、米拉特玛和扎泽斯普尔等城市，曾经不过是主要由庞大地下隧道网络构成的矮人城市在地表上的延伸。随着沙纳塔的覆灭，这些隧道的多数入口都已被掩埋和遗忘，几乎没有任何入口曾遭到这些城市较晚近的人类居民侵入，或者至少，没有人类侵入后还能活着讲述此事，因为尽管矮人早已离去，但据信他们留下的宝藏仍受到强大陷阱和构装体的保护。
src: More than 12000 years ago, dwarves emigrating from the east set up the kingdoms that became known as Shanatar, in the Underdark regions in the southwest of Faerun. For some time, the dwarven kingdoms that became Shanatar were as likely to be fighting against each other as outsiders, but in -8137 DR the threat posed by their common enemy, the Drow, had grown so serious that all the dwarves of the region agreed to unite in a single polity. In due course, this grew into a mighty empire holding territory both above the ground (known as High Shanatar) and below it (known as Deep Shanatar), while its inhabitants developed into a distinct sub-race known as Shield Dwarves. The period of its greatest power and prosperity began in about -6000 DR, shortly after it had aided the humans of Calimshan in expelling their djinn overlords, an event that opened up many new areas for potential expansion. Maintaining this empire required frequent wars against both human and giant enemies on the surface, and Illithids, Drow and Duergar below it. Eventually, Shanatar was overwhelmed by these various enemies, with its last holdings on the surface falling to Calishite armies in -2600 DR, while most of its underground cities had fallen to Duergar by -1800 DR. Only the city of Iltkazar has survived to the present day as a remnant of this empire. Descendants of the dwarves who fled the ruin of Shanatar are today scattered all over the north and west of Faerun, a diaspora so extensive that a Shield Dwarf has become what most Faerunians think of as the most typical example of the dwarven race. \n\nShanatar was centered around what is today the nation of Tethyr, and the Tethyrian cities of Darromar, Myratma and Zazesspur were at one time merely the extensions on the surface of dwarven cities composed primarily of a massive network of underground tunnels. With Shanatar's fall, most of the entrances to these tunnels have been buried and forgotten, with hardly any of them seeing intrusions by the more recent human inhabitants of these cities, or, at least, no intrusions by humans who lived to tell of it, for though the dwarves are long gone it is believed that the treasures they left behind are still protected by powerful traps and constructs.

I must enter a maze, and find my way through the locks, traps and other challenges within to reach the end. I have also been given several hints: I should avoid combat with any golems within, using stealth if necessary; I can seek out several optional challenges in side-rooms for extra benefits; if a particular door proves to have a lock too difficult for me to pick I should not despair, as an alternative path may have easier locks.\n\nI have made it through the maze, and talked to Rajar to be admitted to the guild, but it turns out I must first pay 500 gold in guild dues! 无论形态如何，半天界生物总是俊美动人，赏心悦目，拥有金色皮肤，闪亮眼眸，天使翅膀或其他彰显其高等本质的特征。

“半天界生物”是一个遗传模板，可添加到任何活体，有形，智力值4或更高且非邪恶阵营的生物上（以下称为基础生物）.

半天界生物使用基础生物的所有属性和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型与类型
生物的类型变为异界生物。不要重新计算生物的生命骰，基础攻击加值或豁免。体型不变。半天界生物通常是本地异界生物。

速度
半天界生物拥有羽翼，能以基础生物基础陆地速度的两倍飞行（良好机动性）.如果基础生物已有飞行速度，则改用该速度。

防御等级
天生防御提升+1（此加值与基础生物拥有的任何天生防御加值叠加）.

特殊攻击
半天界生物保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下特殊能力。
昼明术（Su）
半天界生物可随意使用昼明术效果（如同该法咒）.
破邪斩（Su）
每天一次，半天界生物可进行一次普通近战攻击，对邪恶敌人造成等于其HD的额外伤害（最多+20）.

类法咒能力
智力或感知值8或更高的半天界生物拥有两个或更多类法咒能力，取决于其生命骰，如下表所示。这些能力是累积的。除非另有说明，每个能力每天可使用一次。施法者等级等于生物的HD，豁免DC基于魅力。

1+ HD，防护邪恶 3/天，祝福
3+ HD，援助，侦测邪恶
5+ HD，治疗重伤，中和毒素
7+ HD，圣光击，移除疾病
9+ HD，驱散邪恶
11+ HD，圣言
13+ HD，圣洁灵光 3/天，圣化
15+ HD，群体魅惑怪物
17+ HD，召唤怪物 IX
19+ HD，复生

特殊性质
半天界生物拥有基础生物的所有特殊性质，外加以下特殊性质。
黑暗视觉
免疫疾病。
对酸 10，寒冷 10 和电击 10 的抗力。
伤害减免：5/+1（如果HD为11或更低）或10/+1（如果HD为12或更高）.
法术抗力等于生物的HD + 10（最多35）.
对抗毒素的强韧豁免获得+4种族加值。

属性
从基础生物提升如下：力量+4，敏捷+2，体质+4，智力+2，感知+4，魅力+4。

等级调整
与基础生物相同+4。
src:
No matter the form, half-celestials are always comely and delightful to the senses, having golden skin, sparkling eyes, angelic wings, or some other sign of their higher nature.

"Half-celestial" is an inherited template that can be added to any living, corporeal creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or higher and nonevil alignment (referred to hereafter as the base creature).

A half-celestial uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to outsider. Do not recalculate the creature's Hit Dice, base attack bonus, or saves. Size is unchanged. Half-celestials are normally native outsiders.

Speed
A half-celestial has feathered wings and can fly at twice the base creature's base land speed (good maneuverability). If the base creature has a fly speed, use that instead.

Armor Class
Natural armor improves by +1 (this stacks with any natural armor bonus the base creature has).

Special Attacks
A half-celestial retains all the special attacks of the base creature and also gains the following special
abilities.
Daylight (Su)
Half-celestials can use a daylight effect (as the spell) at will.
Smite Evil (Su)
Once per day a half-celestial can make a normal melee attack to deal extra damage equal to its HD (maximum of +20) against an evil foe.

Spell-like Abilities
A half-celestial with an Intelligence or Wisdom score of 8 or higher has two or more spell-like abilities, depending on its Hit Dice, as indicated on the table below. The abilities are cumulative. Unless otherwise noted, an ability is usable once per day. Caster level equals the creature's HD, and the save DC is Charisma-based.

1+ HD, Protection from evil 3/day, bless
3+ HD, Aid, detect evil
5+ HD, Cure serious wounds, neutralize poison
7+ HD, Holy smite, remove disease
9+ HD, Dispel evil
11+ HD, Holy word
13+ HD, Holy aura 3/day, hallow
15+ HD, Mass charm monster
17+ HD, Summon monster IX
19+ HD, Resurrection

Special Qualities
A half-celestial has all the special qualities of the base creature, plus the following special qualities.
Darkvision
Immunity to disease.
Resistance to acid 10, cold 10, and electricity 10.
Damage reduction: 5/+1 (if HD 11 or less) or 10/+1 (if HD 12 or more).
Spell resistance equal to creature's HD + 10 (maximum 35).
+4 racial bonus on Fortitude saves against poison.

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +4.

Level Adjustment
Same as base creature +4.

src: "You first put several reagents into the machine, then go to the lever to commence operations. You will note that you first have to put some coins into a slot on the lever to operate it, I do need to fund my research after all, but a hundred gold is sufficient, and that shouldn't be too much for someone like you. At any rate, if you operate the lever, and also have the right combinations of reagents, a useful elixir may be created, which you will be free to take for your own use. Oh, you will also need to supply the reagents. Fire beetle bellys, fairy dust, ettercap glands, the ichor from a slime or ooze, fenberries, basilisk's eyes, gargoyle skulls and blue quartz crystals are all items that might be combined to produce something useful, and all are things an adventurer like you has a good chance of coming across."

豺狼人是长着鬣狗头的人形生物，以松散的部落形式游荡。大多数有肮脏的黄色或红色皮毛和灰色皮肤。作为夜行食肉动物，豺狼人是天生的掠食者，倾向于用胃思考。虽然他们会与其他类人种族结盟，但如果符合他们的需要，他们也会毫无遗憾或警告地撕毁盟约。豺狼人社会通常由最强壮的成员统治，他利用恐惧，恐吓和力量来维持权力。豺狼人身高超过 7 英尺，体重通常超过 300 磅。

天赋职业（巡林客）：在判断兼职豺狼人是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其巡林客职业等级不计入其中。

特殊能力：
- 黑暗视觉：豺狼人能够在黑暗中视物。
- 天生防御加值：种族天生防御加值为 1。
- 怪物：在法咒效果方面，豺狼人被视为怪物人形生物。
- 武器熟悉：豺狼人将战斧和短弓视为简易武器。
- 种族生命骰：豺狼人初始拥有 2 级人形生物等级。
- 等级调整：+1
src:
Gnolls are hyena-headed humanoids that wander in loose tribes. Most have dirty yellow or reddish fur and grayish skin. As nocturnal carnivores, gnolls are natural predators and tend to think with their stomachs. Although they will form alliances with other humanoid races, they are just as soon to break them without regret or warning if it suits their need. Gnoll society if usually ruled by its strongest member who uses fear, intimidation and strength to remain in power. Gnolls are in excess of 7 feet tall and typically weigh over 300 pounds.

Gnoll Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +2 Con, -2 Int, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass gnoll's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- Darkvision: Gnolls are able to see in the dark.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 1.
- Monstrous: Gnolls count as Monstrous Humanoids for the purpose of spells.
- Weapon Familiarity: Gnolls treat battleaxes and shortbows as simple weapons. 
- Racial Hit Dice: A gnoll begins with two levels of humanoid.
- Level Adjustment: +1

dst:
在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队开始搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文会的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前在着手研究一本后续书籍时失踪了。我已同意寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，那人住在贵族区的西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了什么，可以去商人区东北部塞卡娅的家中向她报告。

我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他转而让我去找水手科拉努·乌马尔。现在我已经和科拉努谈过，他又告诉我阿拉达尔可能调查过的两条线索：第一，他以前的一个船友德拉沙姆·埃纳尔，科拉努认为他曾是符文会的密探，现在住在商人区的西南部；第二，贵族区东北部一堵墙上的密门通往一个隐藏的房间，科拉努认为那是符文会的一个藏身处。既然已经有人告诉我该去哪里找，这扇门应该不会太难找到。

我已经搜查了那个隐藏的房间，它似乎早已被废弃，我发现了一块似乎带有某种魔法的守卫石。它很可能对这次调查有价值或关联，尽管目前还不清楚会是什么。无论如何，我在那里找不到其他东西了。

我已经和德拉沙姆·埃纳尔谈过了。埃纳尔否认自己是符文会的密探，但曾为某个神秘组织做过线人。阿拉达尔·哈辛早些时候找过他，从他那里得知了他所汇报的联系人的名字：费亚尔·泰塞纳尔，此人现在住在神殿区，提尔神殿以南。我接下来应该去找他。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

I spoke to Lamash Kasat, who in turn sent me to seek out the sailor Kolanu Umal. Now I have spoken to Kolanu, and he in turn has told me of two paths that Aladar might have investigated: first, a former shipmate of his, Drasham Enar, who Kolanu believes was an agent of the Rune, and who now lives in the southwest part of the Merchant District, and secondly, a hidden chamber accessed through a secret door in a wall in the northeastern part of the Noble District, that Kolanu believes to be a hideout used by the Rune. This door should not be too difficult to find now that I have been directed where to look.

I have searched through the hidden chamber, which seems to be long abandoned, and found a wardstone that seems to have some sort of magic in it. lt may well turn out to have some value or relevance to this investigation, though at the moment it is not clear what that would be. At any rate, I could find nothing else there.

I have spoken to Drasham Enar. Enar denies being an agent of the Rune, but once worked as an informant for some mysterious organization. Aladar Hasin had earlier sought him out, and learned from him the name of the contact he reported to: Feyar Tesenal, who now lives in the Temple District, south of the Temple of Tyr. I should speak to him next.

曾经是一个古老帝国中低等种姓的成员，那些后来成为堕民的人类通过一种魔法仪式退出了世界，该仪式固化了他们“不可接触”的地位。仪式赋予了他们天生的伪装能力，使堕民能完美融入周围环境。堕民在人类社区内或附近以小群体聚集。当夜幕降临时，他们发动袭击，导致流血事件，因为堕民对人类天生的仇恨表现为杀戮的狂怒。他们利用伏击，欺骗和数量优势来压倒受害者。
  
堕民种族特性：
+4 敏捷，-2 感知，-4 魅力：堕民身手敏捷优雅，但意志薄弱且性格温顺。
类人生物（人类）：堕民是具有人类亚种的类人生物。
中型：作为中型生物，堕民没有因体型而获得特殊加值或减值。
堕民基础陆地速度为 30 英尺。
种族生命骰：堕民初始拥有两个类人生物等级，提供 2d8 生命骰，基础攻击加值 +1，基础豁免加值为强韧 +0，反射 +3，意志 +0。
潜行检定 +8 种族加值，躲藏检定 +15 种族加值：堕民擅长隐匿于阴影中。这些加值仅在堕民穿着轻甲或不穿甲时适用。
天生回避侦测（超自然）：如果对堕民尝试施放预言系法咒，预言系施法者必须成功通过 DC 20 的施法者等级检定。
无与伦比的伪装（特异）：堕民可以在躲藏时全速移动（甚至飞跑），不会因移动而在躲藏检定上受到减值。
天赋职业：游荡者。在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值减值时，兼职堕民的游荡者职业不计入。
等级调整 +1。
src:
Once members of an underprivileged caste of an ancient empire, the humans who would become skulks withdrew from the world through a magical ceremony that solidified their �untouchable?status. The ritual granted them natural camouflage, allowing skulks to blend in perfectly with their surroundings.  Skulks gather in small bands within or near human communities. When night falls, they engage in raids that result in bloodshed as the skulks' innate hatred for humans manifests itself in murderous rage. They use ambush, deception, and superior numbers to overwhelm their victims. 
  
Skulk Racial Traits:
+4 Dexterity, -2 Wisdom, -4 Charisma: Skulks are agile and graceful, but have weak wills and subdued personalities.
Humanoid (human): Skulks are humanoid creatures with the human subtype.
Medium: As Medium creatures, skulks have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Skulk base land speed is 30 feet.
Racial Hit Dice: A skulk begins with two levels of humanoid, which provide 2d8 Hit Dice, a base attack bonus of +1, and base saving throw bonuses of Fort +0, Ref +3, and Will +0.
+8 racial bonus on Move Silently checks and a +15 racial bonus on Hide checks: Skulks excel at keeping to the shadows. These bonuses apply only when a skulk is wearing light armor or no armor.
Innate Nondetection (Su): If a divination spell is attempted upon a skulk, the caster of the divination must succeed on a DC 20 caster level check.
Peerless Camouflage (Ex): Skulks can move at full speed (and can even run) while hiding, taking no penalties on Hide checks due to movement.
Favored Class: Rogue. A multiclass skulk's rogue class does not count when determining whether he takes an experience point penalty for multiclassing.
Level adjustment +1.

（进阶职业）
魔法是宇宙中所有自然或超自然力量中最反复无常，最难预测的一种。试图通过奥术公式将施法编纂成典，或是以意志之力为魔法强加秩序，本质上都是徒劳的 - 至少错乱法师们如此认为。相反，那些真正想要精通魔法的人必须忘却已知，放弃对奥术的任性掌控。正是在这种悖论之中，蕴藏着狂野魔法的可怖力量。

错乱法师追求的是无结构地施放法咒。通过承担引入随机元素的风险，她放弃了其他奥术施法者所拥有的安全可预测性。这种风险带来了其他施法者无法企及的力量潜力。当然，她也冒着力量减弱的风险，但魔法若非冒险，又算什么？混沌强大，她的魔法常将她带至其他施法者无法触及的力量巅峰 - 但混沌同样无常，她的法咒有时也会达不到预期。此外，她的法咒偶尔会以壮观的狂野波动展开，可能对错乱法师及其同伴造成灾难性的后果。错乱法师将此视为她信念的代价。

- 生命骰：d4
- 擅长：错乱法师不获得额外擅长
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

需求：

阵营：任意混乱
技能：学识 4 级，法咒辨识 8 级，使用魔法装置 4 级
专长：魔法天赋，任意超魔专长

职业特性：

等级
1：狂野魔法 - 施法者等级降低 3，施法者等级增加 1d6
2：随机偏转 1次/天 - 以错乱法师为目标的法咒在1轮内改为以20尺内任意人为目标
3：混沌学徒 - 使用惊奇法杖时，投掷两次并取较好结果
4：
5：随机偏转 2次/天
6：混乱心智 - 错乱法师免疫困惑，并永久处于防探知效果之下以对抗探知
7：
8：随机偏转 3次/天

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Magic is one of the most capricious and unpredictable of all natural or supernatural forces in the universe. Attempts to codify spellcasting through arcane formulas, or to impose order on magic through the force of will, are essentially pointless - or so wild mages believe. Instead, those who would truly master magic must forget what they know and abandon their willful control of the arcane. Within this paradox lies the awesome power of wild magic. 

The wild mage aspires to cast spells without structure. By taking the risk of substituting an element of randomness, she gives up the safe predictability of other arcane spellcasters. This risk allows for the potential of power greater than other casters can hope for. Of course, she also risks the potential for less power, but what is magic if not risky? Chaos is strong, and her magic often carries her to heights of power that other casters cannot reach - but chaos is also fickle, and her spells sometimes fall short of her expectations. In addition, from time to time her spells unfold in spectacular wild surges that might prove catastrophic to the wild mage 
and her companions. The wild mage accepts this as the price of her convictions.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Wild Mage gains no additional proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Alignment: any chaotic
Skills: Lore 4 ranks, Spellcraft 8 ranks, Use Magic Device 4 ranks 
Feats: Magical Aptitude, Any metamagic feat 

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Wild Magic - Reduce caster level by 3, add 1d6 to caster level
2: Random Deflector 1/day - Spells targeting the Wild Mage target anyone within 20 ft for one round
3: Student of Chaos - When using a rod of wonder, roll twice and take the better result
4: 
5: Random Deflector 2/day
6: Chaotic Mind - The wild mage is immune to confusion, and is permanently under the effects of non-detection for scrying
7: 
8: Random Deflector 3/day
9: Reckless Dweomer - Turn any spell into a rod of wonder.
10: Wildstrike 1/day - Target spellcaster has a 50% chance of spell turning into a rod of wonder

dst: 为了路边旅店店主博兰·特拉扎尔的利益击败了一些巨人后，我在旅店里睡着了，结果发现自己在昏迷期间被转移到了某个地下密室，武器也被夺走了。从附近的一张字条来看，旅店老板似乎打算和我玩某种虐待狂式的游戏，逼我挺过一系列障碍或攻击才能离开这里。字条还表明，我可以从起点正北方的一扇门离开来开始逃跑，但上面警告说那会更困难；或者从这点稍往西的一扇门离开。要进入后一扇门，字条告诉我必须拉动一个拉杆，打开通往那里的路，但代价是杀死被困在另一边的另一位旅店客人。\n\n看来我目前别无选择，只能配合这场游戏。我选择从正北方的那扇门离开，从而避免拿另一名囚犯的性命冒险。
src: After defeating some giants for the benefit of the proprietor of a roadside inn, Boran Trazal, I slept at the inn only to find that during my unconsciousness I had been transported to some underground chamber, stripped of my weaponry. From a nearby note, it appears the inn owners plan to play some sort of sadistic game with me, forcing me to survive some series of obstacles or attacks in order to get out of here. The note also indicates I can start my escape either by exiting through a door immediately to the north of my starting point, which I am warned will be more difficlut, or by exiting to a door a bit west of this point. To access this latter door, I am informed that I must pull a lever that will open a path to it, but at the cost of killing another inn guest trapped beyond.\n\nIt seems I have little choice for now but to play along with this game. I have chosen to exit through the door immediately to the north, and thus avoid risking the life of the other prisoner.

src:
The avariel are the most reclusive and least numerous of the elven subraces on Faerun. This elusiveness, along with their natural beauty, has instilled within them condescension and pity for their land-bound kin. They are, by nature, free spirits who possess and irrepressible zest for life. The most striking feature of the avariels is their soft, striking wings. Their skin is pale, often porcelain white, with tinges of blue of faint silver. They generally have silver-white or black hair, and are considered the most beautiful of the elven races.

Avariel Ability Adjustments: +4 Dex, +2 Int, +2 Wis, -2 Con.
Favored Class (Cleric): A multiclass avariel's cleric class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Bonus Proficiencies (Longsword, Rapier, Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.

（进阶职业）
武术学生面临令人眼花缭乱的武术学校，每所都有自己的追随者和批评者。但很少有学校像醉拳一样不寻常--或一样有争议。通过像醉酒一样摇晃和蹒跚，醉拳手避开许多打击。同样，他们跌跌撞撞，东倒西歪的攻击让对手措手不及。此外，当他们真正饮酒时，醉拳大师可以表演真正惊人的力量和勇气壮举。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长：醉拳大师不获得武器或盔甲擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础攻击加值：+4。
职业：反射闪避职业能力
专长：强韧加强，闪避。
翻滚：6 级。

职业特性：

1：如魔饮酒 - 你的身体处理酒精的方式与他人不同。每瓶或每大杯你消耗的酒精使你的敏捷，感知和智力各降低 1 点，但使你的力量和体质各增加 1 点。然而，你的反射豁免加值，敏捷对翻滚的加值和 AC 加值保持在其原始水平，无论你的新敏捷调整值如何。
  瓶子擅长 - 你可以使用瓶子作为武器，使用你的徒手基础攻击加值。
2：蹒跚 - 通过绊倒，踉跄和蹒跚，你可以进行冲锋攻击，让对手惊讶。
3：摆腰 - 你在攻击时摇摆晃动。在你的回合中，你对任何一个对手获得 +2 闪避 AC 加值。
4：卸除武器 - 角色可以尝试卸除对手的武器，攻击受到 -6 惩罚。
5：醉怒 - 醉拳大师可以像野蛮人一样狂暴，持续 1 小时。你获得 +4 力量，+4 体质，意志豁免 +2 士气加值，AC 受到 2 惩罚。此能力在你饮用酒精饮料时生效。
6：蹒跚 - 你的蹒跚动作让你每轮进行一次战斗虚招唬骗检定（对抗对手的智力调整值 + 魅力调整值）.虚招成功后，对手的敏捷调整值不会加到其 AC 上，针对醉拳大师的下一次攻击。你只能对其他人形生物使用蹒跚。
7：醉抱 - 醉拳大师可以擒抱对手而不引发借机攻击，并且你在所有对抗擒抱检定上获得 +4 能力加值。
8：药用目的 - 通过将你的气与酒精结合，你可以将酒精饮料转化为治疗药水，每天最多三次。药水只对创造它的角色有效。
9：精通卸除武器 - 角色在尝试卸除武器时不再引发借机攻击，惩罚降至 -4。
10：火焰之息 - 你可以使用你的气点燃体内的酒精，并从嘴里喷出火焰之息。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Martial arts students face a bewildering array of martial arts schools, each with its own adherents and detractors. But few schools are as unusual -- or as controversial -- as Drunken Boxing. By weaving and staggering about as if inebriated, drunken boxers avoid many blows. Likewise, their stumbling, lurching attacks catch their opponents off guard. Moreover, when they actually imbibe alcohol, Drunken Masters can perform truly prodigious feats of strength and bravery.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: The Drunken Master gains no proficiencies in weapons or armor.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Class: Evasion class ability
Feats: Great Fortitude, Dodge.
Tumble: 6 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

1: Drink Like a Demon - Your body handles alcohol differently from other people. Every bottle or tankard of alcohol you consume reduces your Dexterity, Wisdom, and Intelligence by 1 point each, but increases your Strength and Constitution by 1 point. However, your Reflex save bonus, Dexterity bonus to Tumble, and AC bonus remain at their original levels regardless of your new Dexterity modifier.
  Bottle Proficiency - You can use bottles as weapons using your unarmed base attack bonus.
2: Stagger - By tripping, stumbling, and staggering, you can make a charge attack that surprises your opponents.
3: Swaying Waist - You weave and bob about as you attack. You gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC against any one opponent during your turn.
4: Disarm - Character can attempt to disarm an opponent at a -6 penalty to their attack.
5: Drunken Rage - Drunken Master can rage just as a barbarian does, with duration of 1 hour. You gain +4 to Strength, +4 to Constitution, a +2 morale bonus on Will saves, and a 2 penalty to AC. This ability works when you drink an alcoholic beverage.
6: Lurch - Your lurching movements let you make one feinting-in-combat Bluff check (opposed by opponents Intelligence modifier + Charisma modifier) per round. On a successful feint, the opponents Dexterity modifier is not added to his AC on the Drunken Masters next attack. You can only lurch other humanoids.
7: Drunken Embrace - The Drunken Master can grapple an opponent without provoking an attack of opportunity, and you gain a +4 competence bonus on all opposed grapple checks.
8: For Medicinal Purposes - By combining your ki power with alcohol, you can convert an alcoholic drink to a potion of heal up to three times per day. Potion only works on character creating it.
9: Improved Disarm - Character no longer incurs an attack of opportunity while attempting to disarm and the penalty drops to -4.
10: Breath of Flame - You can use your ki to ignite the alcohol within you and spew it forth from your mouth in a breath of flame.

dst: "灰飞烟灭只是重生的必要前奏。而它是必要的。你以为以前没有人尝试过和平改革吗？它取得了什么成就？这片土地仍然是一个邪恶的地方，充满了腐败的官员、受虐待的奴隶、被赶到荒野并被剥夺与人类平等权利的‘怪物’种族，以及人类智慧在良好秩序的伪装下所能犯下的所有其他邪恶。除了灰飞烟灭它，还有什么选择？火焰必须吞噬一切，以便一个更美好的世界能从灰烬中崛起！" 说到最后，他大喊大叫，疯狂地挥舞着手臂。

What alternative is left but its destruction? The fire must consume all, that a better world may rise from the ashes!" By the end of this speech, he is yelling and waving his arms wildly.

dst: 本·肯尼曼给了我一张地图，是他从一次牌局中从一位冒险者那里赢来的。地图上标出了下水道中一扇密门的位置，据说密门之后通往一系列地下洞穴，在那里某处可以找到满是宝藏的矮人废墟。有了这张地图，找到那扇密门应该不会太难。它位于从附近市场进入的下水道系统中，现在可以标注在我自己的地图上了。不过，我必须考虑是否要利用这个机会，因为据说那些洞穴里满是锈蚀怪，能够摧毁金属武器和护甲。如果我去那里，要么装备非金属的装备，要么想出其他策略来应对这一威胁。\n\n我已经穿过密门，经过一系列洞穴和矮人废墟，现在找到了一间满是所承诺宝藏的密室。
src: Ben Kenemen gave me a map he won from an adventurer in a card game. It indicates the location in the sewers of a secret door, beyond which allegedly lies access to a series of subterranean caves in which treasure-filled dwarven ruins can be somewhere found. With this map in hand it should not be too difficult to locate the secret door. It lies within the sewer system accessed from the nearby Markets, and can now be marked on my own maps. I must consider whether I wish to take advantage of this opportunity, however, for the caves are said to be filled with Rust Monsters, capable of destroying metal weapons and armor. If I go there, I should either equip myself with non-metallic gear, or devise some other strategy for dealing with this threat.\n\nI have passed beyond the secret door, through a series of caves, and the dwarven ruins, and have now found a chamber full of the promised treasure.

Anyway, I've also been hearing rumors about a troll seen wandering around in the sewers nearby. You might want to hunt that down if you're equipped for troll-killing (which is to say, if you've some means of dispensing fire or acid on hand, as you most likely won't have much luck against a troll otherwise). In fact a couple of adventurers already went down after it, boasting about how no troll was a match for them. Haven't heard from them since, though, so maybe that was just a lot of talk."

古老的苏尔帝国以其强大的大法师所掌握的伟大而可怕的力量而闻名。苏尔巫师深入探索其他人避开的奥术知识，在此过程中发现了许多黑暗而危险的秘密。苏尔帝国由高贵的家族统治，这些家族的首领是拥有无与伦比力量的法师，而这些家族之间无数的竞争和仇杀导致了一个精英战斗训练学校的兴起：奥术战士之道。奥术战士被训练为忠诚，坚定和绝对服从，他们是熟练的战士，研究奥术魔法，专门为了学习如何杀死强大的巫师。
    在苏尔帝国时代，奥术战士是他们大法师主人的守卫，用剑和法咒为最伟大的苏尔巫师服务。他们也是刺客和间谍，被训练来杀死敌对家族的强大巫师，以及保卫自己家族的巫师。在数百次法咒和钢铁的秘密决斗中，奥术战士与同类练习他们的技艺，从隐藏的奥术战士学院学习他们的技能。

- 生命骰：d8
- 武器和防具擅长：苏尔奥术战士不获得额外的武器和防具擅长。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The ancient Suel Empire was known for the great and terrible power wielded by its mighty archmages. Suloise sorcerers delved deep into arcane lore that other folk avoided, unearthing many dark and dangerous secrets in the process. The Suel Empire was ruled by noble families headed by mages of unsurpassed power, and the countless rivalries and vendettas between these families led to the rise of an elite school of combat training: the way of the Archanamach. Conditioned for loyalty, determination, and absolute obedience, Archanamachs were skillful warriors who studied arcane magics for the express purpose of learning how to slay powerful wizards.
    In the days of the Suel Empire, the Archanamachs were guards for their archmage masters, serving the greatest Suel wizards with sword and spell. They were also assassins and spies trained to slay powerful wizards of rival families, as well as defend the wizards of their own families. In hundreds of secret duels of spell and steel, Archanamachs practiced their art against others of their kind, learning their skills from hidden Archanamach academies.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Suel Archanamach gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +6.
Feats: Any 4 Martial or Exotic Weapon Proficiencies, Combat Casting, Iron Will
Skills: Concentration 4 ranks, Jump 4 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks, Tumble 4 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Ignore Spell Failure 5%, Tenacious Spells - Add 6 to the DC to dispel a Suel Archanamach spell.
2: Dispelling Strike 1/day - Subject is the target of a Greater Dispel Magic.
3: Extended Spellstrength - All Suel Archanamach spells cast on himself are extended.
4: Ignore Spell Failure 10%
5:
6: Dispelling Strike 2/day
7: Ignore Spell Failure 15%
8:
9:
10: Dispelling Strike 3/day, Ignore Spell Failure 20%

SPELLCASTING

To cast a spell, the Suel Archanamach must have a Charisma score of 10 + the spell level. A Suel Archanamach's caster level is equal to his class level. He has access to any spell from the Abjuration, Divination, Illusion, or Transmutation school on the Sorcerer spell list, and casts spells as a Sorcerer does.

Resident in this part of the Celestial realm is a powerful Deva named Valendur, who however resided behind a warded door I could not normally expect to pass. However, Garzagon has sold me a key that should allow me to do so, and suggested that defeating and looting such a powerful entity is likely to be a valuable opportunity.\n\nValendur has been slain, and some valuable loot gained as a result.

src:
Hobgoblins are the larger cousins of goblins, and far more aggressive. They are at constant war with elves and harbor a deep hatred of them. Hobgoblins stand over 6 feet tall, with reddish-brown hair and fur-covered hide. These creatures have a strong grasp of strategy and tactics, and are capable of developing sophisticated battle plans. Their society is geared toward military activities, with young being raised for battle. Under the leadership of a skilled warrior, hobgoblin bands can be formidable opponents.

Hobgoblin Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Con

在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给莎尔神殿的首席女祭司费拉莎看时，她认出这是不久前被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。她因我交出找到的碎片而奖赏了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，她也想要，以便莎尔神殿可以玷污他们敌人提尔的这件圣物。

找到圣环的第二块碎片后，费拉莎告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，她就能施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。她还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖赏。我接受了这个任务，并被传送到了某个隐蔽的墓穴。最后一块戒指碎片无疑就在附近，但和前两块一样由不死生物守卫着，所以我必须谨慎行事。我还必须记住，当我返回时界门会崩塌，所以在取回最后一块碎片之前我不应该回去。

我已经找到了这枚提尔圣环的最后一块碎片。我现在可以返回神殿了。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Ferazha, the head priestess of the Temple of Shar, she recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. She rewarded me for giving her the piece I found, and has told me that she would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find, so that the Temple of Shar might defile this artifact of their enemy Tyr.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Ferazha that with two pieces of the ring, she could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. She also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I have accepted this quest and been transported to a hidden tomb somewhere. The final ring fragment is doubtless about, but is guarded by undead as the first two were so I must proceed with caution. I must also remember that the portal will collapse when I return, so I should not do so until the final piece is recovered.

I have found the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr. I can now return to the temple.

dst: 当我接近行进山脉中的阿哈兹堡时，我遇到了一名从那里赶来的信使，带来了可怕的消息：堡垒正被炽焰斧部落的兽人大军及其食人魔盟友围攻。我能否突破围困的封锁线抵达堡垒尚存疑问，因此如果我在这里要做些有用的事，最好是在兽人大军的侧翼行动，可以通过向西沿着附近的河流或向东穿过森林到达，袭击巡逻队和外围部队。我也许还能向北前进，突袭兽人最初来源的洞穴，因为大部分兽人都不在，都聚集在堡垒周围。这应该会促使兽人主力派出分遣队来追捕我，或许能削弱他们到足以打破围困的程度。\n\n在兽人群的侧翼以及他们后方的洞穴中行动，我杀死了许多敌人，并大大扰乱了他们的活动。最终这削弱了他们，使我能够与从堡垒出击的士兵一起攻击主要的围困部队，杀死他们的酋长并击溃他们。炽焰斧兽人部落的力量已被粉碎，我认为他们不再是一个重大威胁了。我应该确保在酋长的尸体上或他的帐篷里搜寻任何关于这些人形军队的情报，但除此之外，我想我在这里的工作差不多完成了。
src: As I was approaching Fort Akhaz in the Marching Mountains, I came across a messenger traveling from there with dire news: the fort is being besieged by a horde of orcs of the Blazing Axes tribe and their ogre allies. It is doubtful that I could break through the siege cordon to reach the fort, so if I am to do anything useful here it would be best to operate on the flanks of the orc army, reached either by traveling along the nearby river to the west or the woods to the east, attacking patrols and outlying forces. I also might be able to make my way to the north and raid the caves the orcs came from in the first place, with most of them absent and around the fort. This should induce the main orc army to send out detachments to try to hunt me down, and perhaps weaken it enough that the siege could be broken.\n\nOperating on the flanks of the orc horde, and in the caves to their rear, I killed many and did much to disrupt their activities. Eventually this weakened them to the point that I was able to assail the main besieging force, along with soldiers sallying from the fort, slay their chieftan and rout them. The power of the Blazing Axes Orc tribe has been shattered and I do not think they will be a major threat anymore. I should make sure to search for any intelligence concerning these humanoid armies I can find on the chieftan's body or in his tent, but aside from that, I think my work here is just about done.

Type of Feat: Draconic
Prerequisite: Dragonblood subtype*, Cha 11 or Swift Wing 2

Your draconic blood grants you great sensory powers.  If you have 2 or less draconic feats, you gain low-light vision.  If you have 3 or more, you gain darkvision.  If you have 4 or more, you also gain Blindsense.  You also are granted a bonus on Listen, Search, and Spot checks equal to the number of Draconic feats you have.

*Note: In addition to race, you can gain the dragonblood subtype through the Dragon Devotee or Dragon Disciple classes, or through the Dragontouched or Dragon Heritage feats.  If you take this feat and are not dragonblooded or a Swift Wing, you will be deleveled or unable to level.

dst: "嗯，是的，那很不幸，我没预料到会发生这种事。我不知道你是否能找回那些金币。维蒂亚雷显然在纳什克尔一带活动了很久，所以也许你四处打听一下，可能会找到他藏身之处的线索。不管那事结果如何，我想我知道另一个能弄到我们所需金币的办法，而且还能顺便做些好事。在尖牙森林深处住着一条强大的龙，他最近变得活跃起来，飞出来偷牛，攻击任何挡路的人。我们认为他是被那条和追捕你们的赏金猎人合作、叫什么克拉克的龙给激怒才现身的。大概把他当成了竞争对手，想标记领地之类的。总之，由于他造成的麻烦，他的脑袋上也被悬赏了一大笔钱。即使没有赏金，击败一条龙并洗劫他的宝库本身也应该能提供大量金币。"
src: "Hmn, yes, that's unfortunate, I didn't anticipate that happening. I don't know if you will be able to recover that gold. Vitiare apparently has been operating around the Nashkel area for a long time, so perhaps if you asked around you might find some clue as to where he might be hiding. However that works out, I think I know another way you could come up with the gold we need, and do some additional good in the process. There's a powerful dragon living somewhere deep in the Wood of Sharp Teeth who has recently become active, flying out and stealing cattle and attacking anyone who gets in his way. We think he's been stirred up by that dragon working with the bounty hunters after you, Krak-whatever, showing up. Probably sees him as a rival and wants to mark his territory or something. Anyway, due to the trouble he's caused, a large bounty has been placed on his head as well. Even without that, defeating a dragon and looting his hoard should provide plenty of gold by itself."

dst: 在穿越幽暗地域的旅途中，我遇到了一位伊莉丝翠的女祭司，她是那些试图抛弃本族典型邪恶行径的卓尔精灵的守护神。她站在另一位女祭司的尸体旁，并告诉我死者是被一个非常强大的蛛化精灵杀死的。这个蛛化精灵从死去的女祭司身上偷走了一把钥匙和一个圣徽，并利用前者进入了一座曾经是罗丝神殿和邪恶魔法中心的建筑。他大概打算在里面用圣徽进行某种魔法仪式，也许是为了移除使他变成蛛化精灵的诅咒。鉴于蛛化精灵的邪恶和那个地方的性质，女祭司不认为这会带来任何好结果，并请求我追踪那个蛛化精灵并找回被偷走的圣徽。如果我成功，她会奖励我一件魔法装备、一些金币以及来自伊莉丝翠的特别祝福。\n\n我已经找回了伊莉丝翠的圣徽，现在需要把它还给女祭司。
src: While traveling through the Underdark, I came across a priestess of Eilistraee, the patron deity of drow seeking to abandon the evil ways typical of that race. She was standing over the corpse of another priestess, who she informed me had been killed by a very powerful drider. This drider stole a key and a holy symbol from the dead priestess, and is using the former to enter what was once a temple of Lolth and center of foul magic. He presumably intends to use the holy symbol within in some magical ritual, perhaps one meant to remove the curse making him a drider. Given the evil of the drider and the location, the priestess does not expect any good to come of this, and has asked me to track down the drider and recover the stolen holy symbol. I will be rewarded by her with an item of magical gear, some gold and a special blessing from Eilistraee if I succeed in this.\n\nI have recovered the holy symbol of Eilistraee, and now need to return it to the priestess.

一点光芒悬浮在你的肩头。虽然它没有五官，但似乎能通过自身的光辉来表达情绪，从愤怒的灼烧到满足的辉光。

你塑造出一小团被称为最小灵魂火花的灵魂能量微粒。灵魂火花的存在使你获得警觉专长。如果灵魂火花的生命值降至0或更低，该融合解散。

魂能：当你将魂能分配到你的灵魂火花魔宠时，你可以选择以下效果之一。所有投入的魂能必须用于同一效果。

攻击加值：每点魂能使灵魂火花在其攻击检定和伤害检定上获得+1加值。
偏斜加值：每点魂能使灵魂火花在防御等级上获得+1偏斜加值。
治疗：每点投入的魂能使灵魂火花获得一定量的快速治疗。最小灵魂火花获得的快速治疗等于1乘以投入的魂能点数，次级
灵魂火花获得的快速治疗等于2乘以投入的魂能点数，标准灵魂火花获得的快速治疗等于3乘以投入的魂能点数，而高等灵魂火花获得
的快速治疗等于4乘以投入的魂能点数。
豁免检定加值：每点魂能使灵魂火花在所有豁免检定上获得+1抗力加值。

dst:
萨曼·瓦拉迪告诉我，如果我想找活干，就应该去找一个叫纳马尔·萨拉坎的人，他是“闪耀探寻者”号的船长，目前可以在码头区找到他。这位萨拉坎船长显然想找一位冒险者帮忙调查他发现的一件神秘神器。萨曼已经向他提过我可能是合适的人选，所以他应该准备好在我提出愿意帮忙时接受我的协助。

我已经和萨拉坎船长谈过，并了解了一些他交给我的任务。他找到了一种魔法手段，可以创造一道通往某处水下废墟的界门，并希望我帮忙探索那里。我和任何穿过界门（或之后被召唤）的同伴都会获得防溺水的魔法保护。这种保护会持续四个小时，而且在完成任务之前我不应该从界门返回，因为那会打断法咒。在水下行动会让我变慢并降低攻击效果，阻止使用远程武器，并使任何涉及火焰的法咒效果有限（最多如此）。我只要准备好就可以直接进入界门。当我穿过时，必要的法咒会自动施放。

我在水下废墟中找到了一块上面有文字的泥板。虽然我不认识这种语言，但无疑有学者能翻译它，并揭示一些关于发现它的那座城市的信息。这应该能满足萨拉坎船长的要求。我现在应该回去找他。
src:
Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.

I have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should simply enter the portal whenever I am ready. The necessary spells will be automatically cast as I go through.

I have located a tablet with writing on it in the undersea ruin. While the language is unknown to me, there are doubtless scholars who could translate it and reveal something about the city where it was found. This should meet Captain Sarakan's requirements. I should return to him now.

src:
You are the living embodiment of Gruumsh's savage fury, a one-eyed martyr whose terrible sacrifice has unlocked epic levels of brutal power. Your scarred visage and impaired sight serve as a constant reminder of your oath, granting you a glimpse into your deity's blind rage. In the heat of battle, your ferocity and unholy devotion enable you to strike terror into the hearts of your foes, as you channel the very essence of an orcish legend.

Hit Die: d12
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Intelligence modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Eye of Gruumsh gains a bonus feat every three levels
Special:
Blinding Spittle: Your venomous saliva continues to blind your enemies. Its frequency and potency increase as you grow in power, marking you as a scourge upon the battlefield.
Ritual Scarring: The cursed marks of your sacrifice persist, evolving with each level to further empower your savage abilities.

Epic Eye of Gruumsh Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin,  Blinding Speed, Damage Reduction, Devastating Critical, Great Constitution, Epic Prowess, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Fast Healing, Legendary Wrestler, Mighty Rage, Overwhelming Critical, Terrifying Rage, Thundering Rage.

没有其他契灵像特内布罗斯这样。作为奥喀斯曾拥有的神性残余，特内布罗斯也许是唯一仍在某些地方被当作神崇拜的契灵，并且与一个活着的--如果不是凡人的--存在紧密相连。这种独特的地位赋予特内布罗斯以其他契灵无法做到的方式操纵世界的能力。一些特内布罗斯变节崇敬奥喀斯，将特内布罗斯视为他们被撕裂的神的一部分，以及他有朝一日将重新萌发的种子。其他人则将这个肥胖的恶魔视为特内布罗斯堕落的化身。这些追随者相信特内布罗斯是一个独立的神祇，试图通过奥喀斯显现，却因恶魔被证明不配而遭到贬低。

- 生命骰：d8
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：
阵营：任何非善良
技能：专注5级，学识8级
特殊：能够绑定特内布罗斯
特殊：能够驱散或叱喝术不死生物
特殊：必须将特内布罗斯作为神崇拜（牧师只能拥有混乱，死亡，邪恶和诡术领域）

职业特性：
等级
1：永恒束缚 - 你始终绑定于特内布罗斯
    特内布罗斯的叱喝术 - 通过消耗一次驱散不死生物使用次数来伤害或治疗不死生物
2：亡者面容 - 闪避AC，威吓和翻滚+1加值，无心智不死生物将你视为友方
3：摧毁/强化不死生物 - 消耗驱散不死生物尝试次数对无心智不死生物造成额外伤害，或治疗它们
4：幽影之躯 - 随意施放幽影之躯
5：虚空冲击 - 对所有活物造成每驱散等级1d8点伤害

灵魂绑定/施法：除第1级外，每级你获得新的灵魂绑定和每日法咒，以及施法者等级提升（以及已知法咒，如适用），如同你在使用灵魂绑定的职业和神术施法职业上各提升了一级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
No other vestige is quite like Tenebrous. The remnant of the divinity once possessed by Orcus, Tenebrous is perhaps the only vestige still worshiped in some places as a god, and so tightly bound to a living-if not mortal-being. This unique status grants Tenebrous the ability to manipulate the world in ways that other vestiges cannot. Some Tenebrous apostates revere Orcus, seeing Tenebrous as part of their sundered god and the seed from which he will one day sprout anew. Others see the corpulent fiend as the embodiment of Tenebrous's downfall. These followers believe that Tenebrous is a separate deity who attempted to manifest through Orcus, only to be laid low when the demon proved unworthy.

- Hit Die: d8
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Any nongood
Skills: Concentration 5 ranks, Lore 8 ranks
Special: Ability to bind Tenebrous
Special: Able to turn or rebuke undead
Special: Must worship Tenebrous as a god (clerics can only have Chaos, Death, Evil, and Trickery domains)

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Eternal Bondage - You are always bound to Tenebrous
    Tenebrous's Rebuke - Damage or heal undead by spending a turn undead use
2:  Visage of the Dead - +1 bonus to dodge AC, Intimidate, and Tumble, and mindless undead treat you as friendly
3:  Destroy/Empower Undead - Spend turn undead attempts to do extra damage to mindless undead, or heal them
4:  Umbral Body - Cast umbral body at will
5:  Blast of the Void - Deal 1d8 damage per turning level to all living creatures

Soul Binding/Spellcasting: At each level except 1st, you gain new soul binds and spells per day and an increase in caster level (and spells known, if applicable) as if you had gained a level in both your soul binding-using class and your divine spellcasting class.

我们必须设法获得一本价值连城的书，作为进入烛堡的代价。当我们抵达扎泽斯普尔时，特法拉姆船长建议我们去见一位名叫登萨斯·韦莱本的人，他在码头以北的市场区开了一家书店。他的理论是，作为稀有书籍的经销商，他可能有一本合适的书可供出售，如果没有，他应该知道我们可以去哪里找到一本。

我们照做了，登萨斯向我们讲述了维多·斯托特的事迹，他是一位著名的半身人冒险家，几个世纪前生活在泰瑟尔，以及他的家乡东境村。斯托特安排了一个魔法场来保护他的村庄，阻止除半身人以外的任何人进入，然而尽管如此，这个地方还是被某种亡灵恐怖所摧毁，现在已被废弃。魔法场仍然存在，但显然不应该阻止我，而且在村庄的某个地方，如果那里潜伏的威胁能够被克服，我们应该能找到维多的冒险回忆录，被称为《东境绿皮书》。这些回忆录只有一本，其价值足以引起烛堡历史学家的兴趣。这个村庄位于星尖山脉南面附近，距离较远，位置已在我的地图上标出。要到达那里，我们必须从码头区向东出去，前往“南门”，然后从那里先沿着苏杜斯昆河向东走，再向北朝山脉方向前进。

一旦我们成功找到合适的书，我们应该返回并与特法拉姆船长交谈（他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停留几周进行改装），他可能会在他下一次猎捕海盗的出击中带我们更接近烛堡。
src:
We must somehow acquire a book of great value as the price of admittance to Candlekeep. When we arrived in Zazesspur, Captain Tefaram advised us to speak to one Densath Wayleben, owner of a bookstore that can be found in the market district north of the docks, on the theory that, as a dealer in rare volumes, he might have had an appropriate book available for sale, and if not could be expected to know where we can go to find one.

We did as suggested, and Densath told us of Vido Stout, a famous halfling adventurer who lived a few centuries ago in Tethyr, and his home, the village of Eastmarch. Stout arranged for his village to be protected by a magical field that prevented anyone but a halfling from entering, yet despite this the place was wiped out by some sort of undead horror and is now abandoned. The field remains in place, but obviously should not stop me, and within the village somewhere, if the menace presumably still lurking there can be overcome, we should find Vido's memoir of his adventures, known as the "Green Book of Eastmarch." Only one copy of these memoirs exists, making it valuable enough to interest Candlekeep's historians. This village is located some distance away near the southern face of the Starspire mountains, at a location now marked on my maps. To reach it we must exit the Docks going east, head to the "South Gate," and from there travel initially east along the Sulduskoon river, and then head north towards the mountains.

Once we succeed in finding an appropriate book, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram (who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting), who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.

src:
Descended from a dwarf clan enslaved by mind flayers, duergar (a.k.a. gray dwarves) suffered for generations under enslavement and cruel experimentation at the hand of their cruel masters. Finally they managed to recover their freedom as a bitter and evil race with limited psionic powers. Male and female duergar are bald, and women do not grow beards. They are much thinner than other dwarves, with severe facial expressions, gray hair and gray skin.

Duergar Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -4 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass duergar's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Duergar are able to see in the dark.
- Immunity to Poisons: racial immunity to poisons.
- Immunity to Paralysis: racial immunity to paralysis.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Orcs: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids.
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently
- Skill Affinity (Craft): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor and Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Listen): +1 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Spot): +1 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Immunity to Phantasms: Duergar are immune to phantasms such as Weird and Phantasmal Killer
- Light Sensitivity: Duergar suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Invisibility. Caster level 3rd.
- Naturally Psionic: Duergar gain 3 bonus power points at 1st level.
- Dwarven: Duergar count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.
- Level adjustment +1

在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个名叫布利夫敏·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取有魔法用途的试剂。他在他称之为“中央收集区”周围的四个分站的机器上遇到了问题，并承诺如果我能够帮助解决他遇到的各种问题，就会给我奖励。

东北方向的机器发生了故障，并在其周围释放了一团有毒气体。我需要穿过这团气体，承受它造成的任何伤害，关闭机器以便进行维修。

东南方向的机器不知怎么地喷出了危险的软泥怪，但现在已经被关闭了。

西北方向的机器位于一个被食腐兽占据的房间里。这些怪物已经被清除了。

西南方向的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被某个未知方扯掉了。泽姆昆怀疑是某个罪犯偷走了它，以便出售黄金。他希望我能设法追踪到罪犯并找回丢失的部件。我应该在这台机器附近调查，希望能找到一些线索。

我已经告知泽姆昆我的进展。任何其他完成的任务也应该向泽姆昆报告。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast is malfunctioning, and has released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I will need to move through this cloud, enduring whatever harm it inflicts, to shut off the machine so it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast was somehow spewing forth dangeous slimes. but has now been shut down.

The machine to the northwest was in a room occupied by otyughs. These monsters have been cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some unknown party. Zemquin suspects some criminal type stole this in order to sell the gold. He hopes I can somehow track down the perpetrator and recover the missing part. I should investigate in the vicinity of this machine in hopes of finding some clue.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

在烛堡图书馆下方的地下墓穴中，我遇到一个幽灵，他显然曾是图书馆的一名读者，并且为弄丢了一本名为《深渊之钟》的书而忧心。我在地下墓穴中找到了这本书的一本，并把它交给了那个幽灵。他很高兴能拿回它，随后不久就消失了。我无法确定他是否永久消失了，但也许那正是他斩断与这个世界的最后联系、前往来世所需要的一切。

在消失之前，他给了我另一本书《死亡三神》，并让我把它交给一位名叫乔达瑟的法师，此人显然来自乌尔卡斯特学院。由于那座学院在几个世纪前就被摧毁了（这让人不禁怀疑那个幽灵到底在这里待了多久），我似乎不太可能找到这位乔达瑟，但也许这本书在某个时候会派上用场。

我在乌尔卡斯特学院的废墟中找到了一个自称是乔达瑟的幽灵。他很高兴收到了烛堡幽灵交给我的那本《死亡三神》。
src:
In the catacombs beneath the library of Candlekeep, I came across a ghost who was apparently once a Reader of the library, and who was concerned about having misplaced a copy of a book titled "The Bell in the Depths." I found a copy of the book in the catacombs, and delivered it to the ghost. He was pleased to get it, and soon after disappeared. I cannot be certain he has permanently vanished, but perhaps that was all he needed to break his last ties to this realm and go on to the afterlife.

Before vanishing, he gave me another book, "The Dead Three" and asked me to deliver it to a mage named Jodathur, who was apparently from the Ulcaster Academy. As that academy was destroyed centuries ago (which raises the question of just how long that ghost has been here), it seems unlikely that I will be able to find this Jodathur, but perhaps the book will turn out to have some use at some point.

I found a ghost at the ruins of the Ulcaster Academy who claimed to be Jodathur. He was happy to receive the copy of "The Dead Three" given me by the ghost at Candlekeep.

dst:
炼金大师是专精于制作药水和灵药以重现 4 级或更高法咒效果的施法者。即使是涉猎炼金术的施法者也能提高制作药水的速度，对于冒险的施法者来说，这可以减少他们为下一次任务做准备所花费的时间。在其最高等级，炼金大师进阶职业允许施法者制作能重现一些最强大魔法效果的药水。

要求：

技能：炼金术 10 级，法咒辨识 10 级。
专长：调制药水，魔法工匠，技能专攻（炼金术）.
施法：能够施放 4 级奥术。

生命骰：d4
每级技能点：2 + 智力调整值。

职业特性：
每日法咒：炼金大师的训练侧重于魔法。因此，当角色获得新的炼金大师等级时，她获得新的每日法咒，如同她在添加此进阶职业之前所属的任意奥术施法职业也提升了一级。

1级：每日调制 2 次：炼金大师完善了调制药水的艺术。因此，她可以在一天（8 小时周期）内调制两瓶药水，而不是一瓶。

2级：调制药水（4级）：从 2 级开始，炼金大师对炼金术和魔法的深入研究允许她调制 4 级法咒的药水。

3级：调制药水（5级）：炼金大师可以调制 5 级法咒的药水。

4级：调制药水（6级）：炼金大师可以调制 6 级法咒的药水。

5级：每日调制 3 次：炼金大师可以在一天内调制三瓶药水。

7级：调制药水（7级）：炼金大师可以调制 7 级法咒的药水。

8级：调制药水（8级）：炼金大师可以调制 8 级法咒的药水。

9级：每日调制 4 次：炼金大师可以在一天内调制四瓶药水。

10级：调制药水（9级）：炼金大师可以调制 9 级法咒的药水。
src:
The master alchemist is a spellcaster who specializes in producing potions and elixirs that reproduce the effects of spells of 4th level or higher. Even spellcasters who dabble in alchemy gain the ability to improve the rate at which they can produce potions, which for adventuring spellcasters can reduce the amount of time they must spend preparing for their next quest. At its highest levels, the alchemist prestige class allows spellcasters to create potions that reproduce some of the most powerful magical effects available.

Requirements:

Skills: Alchemy 10 ranks, Spellcraft 10 ranks.
Feats: Brew Potion, Magical Artisan, Skill Focus (Alchemy).
Spellcasting: Ability to cast 4th level arcane spells.

Hit die: d4
Skill points at each level: 2 + Int modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:
Spells per Day: A master alchemist's training focuses on magic. Thus, when a character gains a new level of master alchemist, she gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in whatever arcane spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class.

1st: Brew 2/day: The master alchemist has perfected the art of brewing potions. As such, she can brew two potions in one day(an 8-hour period) instead of one.

2nd: Brew Potion (4th): Beginning at 2nd level, the master alchemist's advanced study of alchemy and magic allows her to brew potions of 4th-level spells.

3rd: Brew Potion (5th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 5th-level spells.

4th: Brew Potion (6th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 6th-level spells.

5th: Brew 3/day: The master alchemist may brew three potions in one day.

7th: Brew Potion (7th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 7th-level spells.

8th: Brew Potion (8th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 8th-level spells.

9th: Brew 4/day: The master alchemist may brew four potions in one day.

10th: Brew Potion (9th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 9th-level spells.

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·宝石探寻者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地面的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他认识的一队六名斯涅布力侏儒在附近调查各个派系和近期事件时失踪了。他要我找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深侏儒，或者至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到这些人中的任何一个或他们遭遇的证据，应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我找到了凯齐布·煤切者被肢解的尸体碎片，他显然是被一队卓尔俘虏并折磨致死。我还在一个底栖魔鱼的据点深处找到了泽布利普·铁足。不幸的是，他已被转化为受精神控制的奴隶，我们被迫杀死了他。至少他的命运已被查明。还有4名斯涅布力侏儒下落不明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found pieces of the mutilated body of Kezib Coalcutter, who was apparently captured and tortured to death by a party of Drow.  I also found Zeblip Ironfoot deep in the stronghold of an Aboleth. Unfortunately, he had been transformed into a mind-controlled slave and we were forced to slay him. At least his fate has been discovered. 4 Svirfneblin remain unaccounted for.

在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个名叫布利夫明·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取有魔法用途的试剂。他所说的“中央收集区”周围的四个分站的机器一直出问题，他承诺如果我帮他解决各种问题，就会给我报酬。

东北方向的机器发生了故障，在自身周围释放了一团毒气。我现在已经将其关闭，以便进行维修。

东南方向的机器不知怎么地喷出了危险的软泥，但现在已经关闭了。

西北方向的机器运转正常，但所在的房间现在被食腐虫占据了。这些怪物应该被清除掉。

西南方向的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被某个未知方扯掉了。泽姆昆怀疑是某个罪犯偷走了它，以便卖掉金子。他希望我能设法追查肇事者并找回丢失的部件。我应该在这台机器附近调查，希望能找到一些线索。

我已经将我的进展告知了泽姆昆。完成的其他任务也应该向泽姆昆报告。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast was malfunctioning, and released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I have now shut this down so that it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast was somehow spewing forth dangeous slimes. but has now been shut down.

The machine to the northwest is functional, but in a room now occupied by otyughs. These monsters should be cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some unknown party. Zemquin suspects some criminal type stole this in order to sell the gold. He hopes I can somehow track down the perpetrator and recover the missing part. I should investigate in the vicinity of this machine in hopes of finding some clue.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

dst:
在稀有书籍专家登萨斯·韦莱本的建议下，我们经过漫长的任务，成功获得了一本价值足以作为进入烛堡的通行费的书。既然此事已完成，我们应回去与特法拉姆船长谈谈，他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停泊数周进行整修，而他或许能在下次猎捕海盗的出击中带我们更接近烛堡。

特法拉姆船长告知我们，瓦尔库尔之剑号的下一次远征将攻击云峰山脉以西海岸的一个海盗基地，该地位于泰瑟尔以北很远，且正好在前往烛堡的路上。我们接受了他随行此次远征的提议，被他之后将我们送到博德之门港的承诺所吸引，那里离烛堡相当近。然而，在我们到达目的地之前，船遭到了一条龙的攻击，它声称是阿兹古尔卡派来消灭扎拉拉的。那条龙不知怎地召来了一场巨大的闪电风暴，摧毁了船，船不久后搁浅，并杀死了大部分船员。扎拉拉和我安全地被冲上岸，但那条龙现在找到了我们，仍打算杀死我们。扎拉拉声称在离此以东不远处看到一个洞穴，并建议我们逃进去，因为龙应该太大而无法跟进。我没有更好的主意，因为那条龙似乎太强大，无法成功对抗。

我们成功到达了洞穴，那条龙确实无法跟进来。然而，它反而弄塌了洞穴周围的岩壁，从而将我们困在这里，指望我们会因此窒息或饿死。附近似乎有一条路通向一个更大的洞穴系统。看来我们必须走那条路，并希望最终能找到回到地面的路。
src:
We have succeeded in acquiring a book of sufficient value to serve as the price of admittance to Candlekeep, after a long quest suggested to us by Densath Wayleben, an expert on rare volumes. With that accomplished, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram, who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting, and who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.

Captain Tefaram informed us that the Sword of Valkur's next expedition will be an attack on a pirate base on the coast west of the Cloud Peak mountains, a good distance north of Tethyr and well on the way to Candlekeep. We accepted his offer to go along on this expedition, lured by his promise to drop us off afterwards at the port of Baldur's Gate, quite near to Candlekeep. Before we could reach our destination, however, the ship was attacked by a dragon, who claimed to have been sent by Azghulkar to eliminate Zarala. The dragon somehow called down a massive lightning storm which wrecked the ship, which ran aground soon thereafter, and killed much of its crew. Zarala and I were safely washed ashore, but the dragon has now found us and still means to kill us. Zarala claims to have seen a cave a little ways to the east of here, and has suggested we flee inside as the dragon should be too large to follow. I do not have a better idea, as the dragon seems far too powerful to be successfully fought.

We successfully reached the cave, and the dragon was indeed unable to follow us inside. However, he collapsed the rockface around the cave instead, thus trapping us here in the expectation that this would result in our suffocation or starvation. There seems to be a path nearby leading down into a larger cave system. It seems we must go that way and hope to eventually find a way back to the surface.

dst:
扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的大图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识，而这样一把重铸之剑也许是阿兹古尔卡重返此位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。

在前往烛堡的途中，我们转道去了小镇纳什凯尔，遇到了一位名叫伊扎多·夸巴克斯的侏儒，他原来是一名竖琴手，一直在寻找我们以便提供援助，同时还有一些为了赏金而追捕我们的冒险者，必须加以对付。其中一名冒险者竟然是我们的老对头加拉德·阿沙勒，他显然一直在暗中与伊扎多合作，而这一次他转换了阵营，看来是要帮助我们。

据伊扎多说，通往烛堡的路线被更多被扎拉拉和我本人以及巨龙克拉卡奇'弗拉兹'塔尔的悬赏所吸引的冒险者严密把守，要到达那里并不容易。他声称有一个解决这个问题的计划，但这取决于他与冒险者中一名显然是双重间谍的人的合作。只要支付750000金币，这名联络人就会转换阵营为我们效力。伊扎多建议我们至少可以通过杀死绿龙格拉'阿扎'乌库尔来获得这笔款项的一大部分，那条龙巢穴在尖牙森林的某处，这样既能掠夺他的宝藏，又能领取他头颅上的赏金。他把我们派去了一群在森林外围扎营的竖琴手游侠那里，由一位名叫塔布伦·卡什滕的人带领，帮助我们找到那条龙，而那群人又告诉我们，我们需要与一位名叫冈德·迅矛的矮人合作，去攻打附近的一个地精营地。作为我们帮助他们对抗地精的回报，冈德告诉了我们龙穴的位置：从森林中心向东走，穿过一片蜘蛛出没的区域就能找到。

我们现在已经获得了一条龙的宝藏。希望在我们找到的其他战利品之外，这能提供伊扎多所需的金币。
src:
Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.

Diverted to the small town of Nashkel on our way to Candlekeep, we encountered a gnome named Izado Quabax, who turned out to be a Harper who has been looking for us in order to give us aid, as well as some bounty-hunting adventurers seeking us who had to be dealt with. One of these adventures turned out to be our old foe Garad Ashaler, who apparently has been secretly working with Izado, and on this occasion switched sides and apparently is going to help us. 

According to Izado, the routes to Candlekeep are guarded well by more adventurers lured by bounties on the heads of Zarala and myself, as well the the dragon Krackach'vraz'tar, and it will not be easy to get there. He claims to have a plan for dealing with this problem, but it depends on the cooperation of an apparent double agent among the adventurers wtih whom he is in contact. This contact will switch sides and work for us if paid 750000 gold. Izado suggested we could get at least a large percentage this sum by slaying the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, who lairs somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, in order both to loot his hoard and collect a bounty on his head. He sent us to a group of Harper rangers who have made camp on the outskirts of the Wood, led by one Tabrun Carshten to help find the dragon, and that group, in turn, has told us we needed to work with a dwarf named Gund Swiftspear to fight a nearby goblin encampment. In return for our aid against the goblins, Gund told us where the dragon's lair was to be found: we can find it by going east from the center of the wood, and passing beyond a spider-infested area.

We have now gained access to a dragon's hoard. Hopefully, on top of the other loot we have found, it will provide the gold Izado needs.

 几个你的幻影复制品突然出现，使敌人难以分辨该攻击哪个目标。这些幻影留在你附近，被击中时消失。

镜影术创造 1d4 个影像，每三个施法者等级额外增加一个影像（最多总共八个影像）.这些幻影与你分离并保持聚集，每个幻影至少与另一个幻影或你相距 5 英尺内。你可以移动进入并穿过一个镜影。当你和镜影分离时，观察者无法用视觉或听觉分辨哪个是你，哪个是影像。幻影也可以互相穿过。幻影拟形怪你的动作，当你施法时假装施法，当你喝药水时喝药水，当你漂浮时漂浮，等等。

试图攻击你或对你施法的敌人必须从无法区分的多个目标中选择。任何对影像的成功攻击都会摧毁它。影像的 AC 为 10 + 你的体型调整值 + 你的敏捷调整值。幻影似乎对区域法咒有正常反应（例如被火球击中后看起来像被烧焦或死亡）.
src:
Caster Level(s): Bard 2, Wizard 2, Sorcerer 2
Innate Level: 2
School: Illusion
Component(s): Verbal, Somatic
Range: Personal
Area of Effect / Target: Self
Duration: 1 min/level
Save: harmless
Spell Resistance: harmless

 Several illusory duplicates of you pop into being, making it difficult for enemies to know which target to attack. The figments stay near you and disappear when struck.

Mirror image creates 1d4 images plus one image per three caster levels (maximum eight images total). These figments separate from you and remain in a cluster, each within 5 feet of at least one other figment or you. You can move into and through a mirror image. When you and the mirror image separate, observers cant use vision or hearing to tell which one is you and which the image. The figments may also move through each other. The figments mimic your actions, pretending to cast spells when you cast a spell, drink potions when you drink a potion, levitate when you levitate, and so on.

Enemies attempting to attack you or cast spells at you must select from among indistinguishable targets. Any successful attack against an image destroys it. An images AC is 10 + your size modifier + your Dex modifier. Figments seem to react normally to area spells (such as looking like they're burned or dead after being hit by a fireball).

蔚蓝印记是一个古老的符号，据说体现了
自然世界的纯净，因此它对异怪而言
是极为可憎之物。
虽然德鲁伊和巡林客是最常被知晓施放
这个古老法咒的职业，但它的魔法几乎
是通用的，可以被所有施法职业掌握。
当你施放这个法咒时，你用手在空中
描绘蔚蓝印记，在空中留下一个发光的蓝色符文，
短暂片刻后它闪烁并
以一道蔚蓝光芒的脉冲充满效果区域。
区域内的任何异怪必须进行强韧
豁免检定，否则遭受以下不良效果。
较近的异怪先受影响。
每个效果持续 1 轮。

无：异怪不受任何不良效果影响，即使它未通过
豁免检定。
恶心：异怪在攻击
检定，豁免检定，技能检定和属性检定上承受 -2 罚值，持续 1 轮。
反胃：异怪无法攻击，施放法咒，集中
于法咒，或做任何事，只能进行一个移动动作，持续 1 轮。
眩晕：异怪无法进行任何动作，但其护甲等级
不受罚值，持续 1 轮。
震慑：异怪掉落所有持握之物，无法进行动作，
AC 承受 -2 罚值，并失去其 AC 上的敏捷加值（若有）,
持续 1 轮。

一旦生物从某个效果中恢复，它在表格上上升一级。
因此，被此法咒震慑的生物在之后一轮变为眩晕，
再之后一轮变为反胃，再之后一轮变为恶心，
然后在下一轮完全恢复。

Evocation
Level: Druid 2, Ranger 2, Bard 3, Cleric 3, Paladin 3, Sorcerer 3, Wizard 3,
Components: S,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 30 ft.
Area: Multiple aberrations whose combined total Hit Dice do not exceed twice 
caster level in a spread emanating from the character to the extreme of the range
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates
Spell Resistance: No

The cerulean sign is an ancient symbol said to embody
the purity of the natural world, and as such it is 
anathema to aberrations.
While druids and rangers are the classes most often
known to cast this ancient spell, its magic is nearly 
universal and can be mastered by all spellcasting classes.
When you cast this spell, you trace the cerulean sign
in the air with a hand, leaving a glowing blue rune
in the air for a brief moment before it flashes and fills
the area of effect with a pulse of cerulean light.
Any aberration within the area must make a Fortitude 
saving throw or suffer the following ill effects.
Closer aberrations are affected first.
Each effect lasts for 1 round.

None: The aberration suffers no ill effect, even if it fails the
saving throw.
Sickened: The aberration takes a -2 penalty on attack 
rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round.
Nauseated: The aberration cannot attack, cast spells, concentrate
on spells, or do anything but take a single move action for 1 round.
Dazed: The aberration can take no actions, but has no penalty to
its Armor Class, for 1 round.
Stunned: The aberration drops everything held, can't take actions, 
takes a -2 penalty to AC, and loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any)
for 1 round.

Once a creature recovers from an effect, it moves up one level on the table.
Thus, a creature that is stunned by this spell is dazed the round after
that, nauseated the round after that, sickened the round after that, and
then recovers fully the next round.

You can readjust your body to boost one physical ability score at the expense of one or more other scores. When the duration of this power expires, your ability boost also ends, but your ability burn remains until it is healed naturally.

dst: 在获得烛堡的进入权限后，扎拉拉在烛堡首席读者泰斯托瑞尔的帮助下，得以找到一些学术资源，特别是一本由达泽斯·谢马尔所著的稀有书籍，她需要这些资源来学习如何以魔法重铸泽法德之剑。她现在相信自己能够完成重铸。还有一个遗留的复杂问题，即重铸需要某种源自强大位面力量或实体的东西作为试剂。然而，泰斯托瑞尔告诉我们，图书馆里有应该合适的东西：巴尔后裔的血液。不幸的是，图书馆馆长乌尔朗特只允许我们在先为图书馆完成一项服务后才能使用它，即清除最近出现在图书馆地下墓穴中的非常强大的亡灵侵扰。\n\n看来这些亡灵是由死灵法师赛伦达·塔拉尔释放到墓穴中的，她是冒险者格玛拉克·科尔兹的同伴，而后者是泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡的盟友。亡灵已被消灭，赛伦达被击退。当此事报告给泰斯托瑞尔后，他将巴尔后裔的血液交给了扎拉拉，她得以完成剑的重铸。我们现在拥有了一件强大的武器，可以用来对抗阿兹古尔卡。
src: Having gained access to Candlekeep, Zarala was, with the aid of Tethtoril, First Reader of Candlekeep, able to find some of the scholarly resources, in particular a rare book by one Darzeth Shemal, that she needed to learn how to magically reforge the Sword of Zefad. She now believes that she will be able to complete the reforging. There is one remaining complication, in that the reforging requires something derived from a mighty planar power of entity as a reagent. However, Tethtoril has told us that the library has something that should be suitable: blood from a Bhaalspawn. Unfortunately, Ulraunt, the head of the library, will only let us use this if we first perfom a service for the libary by clearing out an infestation of very powerful Undead who recently showed up in the catacombs beneath the library.\n\nIt appears the Undead were released into the catacombs by the necromancer Sylenda Talar, a companion of the adventurer Gemarak Korz, who is an ally of Zekar and Azghulkar. The Undead have been eliminated and Sylenda driven off. When this was reported to Tethtoril, he gave Zarala the Bhaalspawn blood, and she was able to complete the reforging of the sword. We now have a powerful weapon able to be used to combat Azghulkar.

dst: 进入扎泽斯普尔的一户普通人家时，一个女人拦住了我，让我帮她清理地下室里的老鼠，并承诺完成这项任务后给我500金币作为报酬。对于我这种身份的冒险者来说，这任务相当可笑，但我想保持一下灭鼠技能不生疏，顺便赚点小钱也无妨。\n\n现在真相大白，这个所谓的灭鼠任务其实是个圈套。地下室的出口被堵住了，一大群元素敌人从下方的下水道闯了进来。显然这一切都是精心策划的阴谋，想要杀死我们，但为什么？也许我们可以从下水道逃出去。如果是这样，我们应该回到那栋房子，质问那个用虚假借口派我们执行这个任务的女人。
src: Entering a common home in Zazesspur, I was confronted by a woman who asked me to clear some rats out of her basement, offering a reward of 500 gold for the accomplishment of this task. A rather ridiculous task for an adventurer of my stature, but I suppose it would not hurt to keep my vermin-clearing skills from getting rusty and make a small profit as well.\n\nIt now emerges that this supposed rat-hunting quest was actually some kind of set-up. Exit from the basement has been blocked, and a mass of elemental foes has broken in from the sewers below. Apparently this is all an elaborate plot to kill us, but why? Perhaps we can get out throught the sewers. If so, we should return to the house and confront the woman who sent us on this quest under false pretenses.

dst:
丹塔利安，星辰皇帝
  
丹塔利安，因其传说与外貌而被称为星辰皇帝，是众多灵魂的集合体。他赋予缚灵者短距离传送，读取思想和阻止敌人的能力。

残魂等级：5级
缚灵DC:25
特殊要求：无

影响：丹塔利安的影响会使你变得冷漠并使用威严的手势。丹塔利安忍不住对当今的领袖感到好奇，因此每当你在100英尺内遇到明显是（或自称是）他人领袖的人时，丹塔利安要求你尝试读取那个人的思想。一旦你尝试过，无论成功与否，你都不需要再尝试读取那个人的思想。

授予能力：
契约魔法魔典证明了丹塔利安深邃的智慧和他对所有主题的广博知识。因为他知晓一切思想，他可以将那份力量的一部分授予你，以及仅凭思考就能旅行的能力。你还获得他威严气场的一部分，许多缚灵者将此归因于他的王室血统。

丹塔利安之威：当你调用此能力时（一个移动动作），任何看到你的生物在1轮内无法攻击你或以敌对法咒瞄准你。如果你尝试任何敌对行动，例如对受影响的生物或其盟友进行攻击检定或施放攻击性法咒，效果结束。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内无法再次使用。

丹塔利安所知：与丹塔利安绑定时，你在学识检定上获得+8加值。

读取思想：随意作为整轮动作，你可以尝试读取任何你能看到的生物的表层思想。如果目标成功通过意志豁免，你在1分钟内无法读取其思想。如果你尝试读取智力属性比你高10点以上的生物的思想，你自动失败并震慑1轮。

思想旅行：作为一个标准动作，你可以瞬间将自己传送到任何你能看到的，在你所拥有的每个有效缚灵者等级5英尺范围内的位置。思想旅行是一种传送效果，每天可使用次数等于你的有效缚灵者等级。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内无法再次使用。
src:
Dantalion, the Star Emperor
  
Dantalion, called the Star Emperor for his legend and appearance, is a composite of many souls. He grants binders the ability to teleport short distances, read thoughts, and stop foes.

Vestige Level: 5th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: No

Influence: Dantalion's influence causes you to be aloof and use stately gestures. Dantalion can't help but be curious about the leaders of the day, so anytime you are within 100 feet of someone who clearly is (or professes to be) a leader of others, Dantalion requires that you try to read that person's thoughts. Once you have made the attempt, regardless of success or failure, you need not try to read that person's thoughts again.

Granted Abilities: 
Pact magic grimoires attest to Dantalion's profound wisdom and his extensive knowledge about all subjects. Because he knows all thoughts, he can grant you a portion of that power, as well as the ability to travel just by thinking. You also gain a portion of his commanding presence, which many binders ascribe to his royal origins.

Awe of Dantalion: When you invoke this ability (a move action), any creature that sees you is unable to attack you or target you with a hostile spell for 1 round. If you attempt any hostile action, such as making an attack roll or casting an offensive spell against the affected creature or its allies, the effect ends. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Dantalion Knows: While bound to Dantalion, you have a +8 bonus on Lore checks.

Read Thoughts: At will as a full-round action, you can attempt to read the surface thoughts of any creature you can see. If the target makes a successful Will save, you cannot read its thoughts for 1 minute. If you attempt to read the thoughts of a creature with an Intelligence score 10 points higher than your own, you automatically fail and are stunned for 1 round.

Thought Travel: As a standard action, you can instantly transport yourself to any location you can see that is within 5 feet per effective binder level you possess. Thought travel is a teleportation effect and is usable a number of times per day equal to your effective binder level. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

dst: "我们的入会流程是这样的。我们设置了一个小迷宫。你从我附近的东墙那扇门进去，如果你能通过，就会从南边的门回到这里，准备被引入公会。迷宫里布满了锁住的门、陷阱和其他考验盗贼技能的测试。我们也不会手把手地指导那些梦想发财却没什么真本事的准盗贼。如果你没能走到迷宫的尽头，就永远别想活着出来：入口会在你身后封死。我们发现这样能减少我们不得不浪费时间的笨手笨脚之辈的数量。"
src: "Here's how our initiation process works. We've set up a bit of a maze. You enter through the door near me, on the east wall, and if you make it through you'll come back here through the door to the south, ready to be inducted into the guild. The maze is loaded with locked doors, traps, and other tests of a thief's skills. We're also not going to handhold would-be thieves with more dreams of wealth than actual abilities. If you don't make it to the end of the maze, you'll never get out of it alive: the entrance is sealed behind you. We find that cuts down on the number of bunglers we have to waste our time on."

dst: "此外，阿兹古尔卡在面对泽法德时，就已经在试图与火焰的代理人结盟，并学习指挥火焰的力量。当他被放逐时，他的这些联系并未全部失去，尽管他只能通过非常间接的影响返回这个位面，但他能够在火元素位面及相关领域采取远为有力的行动。他一直在那里较易被腐化的派系中忙于结交盟友。这赋予了他与火焰相关的力量，而他又能通过剑来引导这些力量。这就是为什么这把剑的力量——它汲取所有元素，但最初当然偏重空气——多年来似乎变得更加偏向火焰。"
src: "Furthermore, Azghulkar had already been attempting to make alliances with agents of fire and learning to command powers of flame when he faced Zefad. These connections of his were not all lost when he was banished, and though he was not able to return to this plane save through very indirect influences, he was able to act far more forcefully on the Plane of Fire and associated realms. He has been busy making allies among the more easily corruptible factions there. That has given him fire-related powers that he in turn has been able to channel through the sword. This is why the sword's powers, which drew on all elements but of course originally emphasized air, have seemed to become more fire-oriented over the years."

dst: "好，非常好，这至关重要……哦，对了，这是你的金币。现在，也许你想知道我为什么如此急切地想要获得这块游荡者之石：它能让我打开一道通往异界区域的传送门，那里有一件我想获得的物品，对我的魔法研究至关重要。不幸的是，这个区域的居民很强大，很可能反对任何夺取他们财产的行为。因此，我需要一位能干且经验丰富的<CUSTOM104>的才能。我想雇你在我打开传送门后穿过去，带回我需要的物品。"
src: "Good, very good, this is crucial...oh, yes, here is your gold. Now, perhaps you would like to know why I was so eager to acquire this Rogue Stone: it will enable me to open a portal to an extra-planar region containing an object I wish to acquire, one most important to my magical research. Unfortunately the inhabitants of this region are powerful and likely to object to any attempt to take their property from them. Therefore, I could use the talents of a capable and experienced <CUSTOM104>. I would like to hire you to go through the portal once I open it, and bring back the object I require."

src: A representative of the Shadow Thieves, the criminal guild from Amn, has appeared on the Sword Coast seeking to expand that organization's influence in that region. This representative has taken up residence in a tower on the coast, southwest of Nashkel, and has guarded it with all sorts of wards, traps. and locks that are meant to serve as a test of the thieving talents of anyone seeking to meet with this representative, the assumption being that anyone who can get past these obstacles will have proven he possesses appropriate talents and is a suitable recruit for the organization. These tests have the side effect of making it hard for anyone seeking the 20000 gold bounty on the representative's head to actually get to him. Someone with appropriate talents, however, might be able to reach the representative and collect his head.
