dst:
在击败牛头人海盗的过程中，瓦尔库尔之剑号的船员发现了一些海图，上面标明了其他海盗基地的位置。其中一处是一群人类海盗的基地，他们早就想除掉这群人，所以我们的下一站就是他们所在的那座岛。扎拉拉和我自然要参加这次进攻。我们已经航行了好几天，很快就要接近目标了。我去找船长打听我们在即将到来的战斗中担任什么角色，得知我们将乘坐小船进行夜间偷袭。扎拉拉和我将加入船员主力，一起进攻海盗的船，而船长本人则率领另一队人马进攻海岸。

我们悄悄摸上了海盗船，等那边的事看起来已经稳操胜券，便离船登岸去支援船长的进攻。船长那一队人已经烧毁了看起来是海盗主营地的地方，并在我们的帮助下击败了一些海盗。完事之后，船长建议我们探索岛上其余的地方，看看还有没有别的海盗。在探索过程中，我们发现了一系列洞穴，看起来被海盗用作基地。这值得进一步调查，因为很可能还有海盗幸存者仍在附近（更别提还有大量海盗宝藏了）。

探索洞穴时，我们发现这群海盗的头目是一个纯血蛇人，这个基地被用来推进蛇人的图谋。那个头目和一些其他蛇人已经被杀，大部分或全部海盗也已丧命，所以这群海盗应该不再构成威胁了。不过，我们还发现了一个传送门，显然通往另一个蛇人基地。也许应该去调查一下，以确保不会再有敌人从那里过来。

在传送门的另一侧，我们发现了一间位于某个蛇人藏身处的房间，显然是在扎泽斯普尔。遗憾的是，似乎没有办法穿过那间房的门，所以我们无法继续探索，也无法阻止蛇人在那里搞什么名堂。不过，我们已经解决了海盗，所以现在应该回去向船长报告。
src:
In the process of defeating the minotaur pirates, the Sword of Valkur's crew discovered some charts indicating the locations of other pirate bases. One of them is the base of a group of human pirates they have long been hoping to put out of business, so our next stop will be the island where they can be found. Naturally Zarala and I will be taking part in this assault. We have been sailing for several days and will soon be approaching our target. Upon speaking to the captain to discover our part in the upcoming battle, I learned that we would be making a stealthy night assault in small craft. Zarala and I will join the main body of the crew in an assault on the pirates' ship, while the captain himself leads a secondary attack on the shore.

We snuck on board the pirate vessel and, once that work seemed well in hand, swung off the ship and went to the shore to support the captain's assault. The captain's party had burned what appeared to be the main pirate encampment, and defeated some of the pirates about with our help. With that done, the captain suggested that we explore the rest of the island to see if there are any more pirates to be found. In the process of doing so, we have discovered a series of caves that appears to be used as a base by the pirates. This merits further investigation, as there may well be some pirate survivors still about (not to mention a lot of pirate treasure).

Exploring the caves, we discovered that this group of pirates is captained by a Yuan-ti pureblood, and was being used to further the ends of the Yuan-ti. The captain and and some other Yuan-Ti have been killed, along with most or all of the pirates, so this group of pirates should no longer be a threat. However, we also found a portal that apparently connects to some other Yuan-ti base. Perhaps it should be investigated to insure no more enemies will come through.

On the other side of the portal we found a room in some Yuan-ti hideout, apparently in Zazesspur. Unfortunately there seems no way to get past the door of that room, so we cannot explore further or stop whatever the Yuan-ti are up to there. We have dealt with the pirates, however, so should now go back and report to the captain.

从虚无中，死亡的幽灵出现，一个装甲阴影高举着闪亮的刀刃。一瞬间，武士刀落下，以血腥的弧线将生命从肢体上分离。四周，恐怖的尖叫和恐惧的呼喊爆发，颤抖的手拔出刀刃与蒙面凶手战斗。目标已死，鬼面杀手平静地走开，剑和拳头无害地穿过他几乎透明的身体。
    很久以前，一个受迫害的危险战士氏族寻求报复压迫者的方法。通过巫术，氏族的施法者恳求黑暗精灵揭示一种方法，使他们的氏族能够在即将到来的冲突中生存，并报复试图粉碎他们的皇帝。氏族成员达成了一项黑暗交易，他们联系的恶魔精灵为氏族提供了一种实现他们渴望的血腥结局的手段。戴上可怕的 面具 以隐藏身份，氏族的战士潜入皇宫，通过他们所做契约的邪恶力量，无形无质地进入皇室，谋杀了整个皇族，再次使国家陷入血腥内战。没有人发现氏族的不光彩行为，直到今天，没有人知道鬼面杀手来自哪个氏族。
    如今，鬼面杀手作为雇佣刺客和间谍，一个隐藏在公开和荣誉行为幌子下的雇佣兵氏族。在执行任务时，他们戴着幽灵般白色的瓷恶魔面具以隐藏身份，并作为他们氏族与恶魔精灵所订契约的象征。通过训练和纪律，鬼面杀手学会最致命和最可怕的方式攻击敌人，并通过与精灵的神秘联系，鬼面杀手学会隐形，穿墙，甚至用精灵自己的眼睛看。

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
From out of nothing the spectre of death appears, an armoured shadow with a brilliant blade held high. In a flash the katana falls, severing life from limb in a bloody arc. All around, screams of terror and shouts of fear erupt, as quaking hands draw blades to fight the masked murderer. His target dead, the ghost-faced killer walks calmly away as swords and fists pass harmlessly through his nearly transparent body.
    Long ago, a persecuted clan of dangerous warriors sought a way to take revenge against their oppressors. Through sorcery, the spellcasters of the clan beseeched dark spirits to reveal a way that their clan might survive the coming strife and take revenge on the emperor who sought to crush them. The clan members struck a dark bargain, and the demon-spirits they had contacted provided the clan with a means to the bloody end they desired.Donning terrifying masks to hide their identities, warriors of the clan crept into the imperial palace, and through the evil power of the pact they had made, passed invisibly and intangibly into the imperial household and murdered the entire imperial family, plunging the country into bloody civil war once again. No one ever discovered the clan's honourless actions, and to this day, no one knows what clan the ghost-faced killers came from.
    Today ghost-faced killers act as assassins and spies for hire, a mercenary clan that hides behind a guise of open and honourable conduct. When on a mission, they wear porcelain demon-masks of ghostly white to hide their identity and as a symbol of the pact their clan made with the demon spirits. Through training and discipline, ghost-faced killers learn to the deadliest and most terrifying way to attack foes, and through their mystic connection with spirits, ghost-faced killers learn to turn invisible, walk through walls, and even see with the eyes of the spirits themselves.

dst: "也许没你想的那么幸运。在大裂谷时，我们有时会炸塌隧道，以保护自己免受来自幽暗地域的攻击。虽然等到最后一刻，好把天花板砸到一群进攻的卓尔或其他威胁头上很诱人，但实际上很难把时机掐得那么准，而且很多事情都可能出错，比如你的陷阱被拆掉，只要时机不对。通常我们发现，最好在接近的敌人靠近之前就炸塌隧道。当然，这些变形蛛没有矮人那种经验。他们等得太久，让我们通过了。"
src: "Maybe not as lucky as you might think. Back in the Great Rift, we would sometimes collapse tunnels to protect ourselves from attacks coming out of the Underdark. While it was tempting to wait for the last moment so you could dump a ceiling onto a horde of assualting drow, or whatever the threat might be, in practice it was very difficult to time it that precisely, and lots of things that could go wrong, like your trap getting dismantled, if your timing wasn't just right. Usually we found it was better to collapse tunnels before the approaching enemies even got near. Of course these aranea don't have the kind of experience with this sort of thing that dwarves do. They waited too long and let us get through."

src:
Tieflings are the distant descendant of some evil outsider, such as a demon, devil, night hag, rakshasa or even some servant of an evil deity. Elves and orcs with fiendish heritage are known to exist but those are distinct lines and are not true tieflings. Tieflings look human except for one or two distinguishing features: small horns, fangs, hooves, forked tongue, goat-like legs, tail, glowing red or cat eyes or furry, leathery, scaly, red or bruised blue skin.

Tiefling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Int, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass tieflings rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Tieflings are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +2 racial bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Bluff): +2 racial bonus to Bluff checks.
- Resist Cold: Innate cold resistance of 5.
- Resist Fire: Innate fire resistance of 5.
- Resist Electrical: Innate electrical resistance of 5.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Darkness. Caster level 3rd.
- Outsider: Tieflings are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.
- Human: Tieflings are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

- 精灵：就法咒而言，雪精灵被视为精灵。
src:
Snow elves are much like their southern brethren.  They make their home within nature, building grand cities of ice on the tops of distant mountaintops, only rarely leaving them to visit the outside world.  They have no special resistance to the cold, but their cities and magic protects them.  One of their few differences is their eyes and hair, both white as the snow surrounding them.

Snow Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass snow elf's wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Bonus Proficiencies (Longsword, Rapier, Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Snow Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Snow Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

dst:
受折磨者达尔弗-纳尔
  
达尔弗-纳尔曾是一个人类契灵师，现在像其他残灵一样授予力量。他赋予召唤者坚韧的皮肤，令人恐惧的呻吟，对疯狂的防护，以及与盟友分担伤害的能力。

残灵等级：2级
绑定DC: 17
特殊要求：无

影响：你迅速地从分心转为极度专注，然后又转回来。有时你茫然地凝视空中，有时你专注地凝视眼前的人或任务。由于达尔弗-纳尔不喜欢任何需要超过1轮集中注意力的任务（例如某些施法，专注于某个效果，或任何需要专注检定的动作），他要求你在他的影响下不进行此类活动。

授予能力：
达尔弗-纳尔为你提供护甲，并将他的疯狂与你的理智混合，借给你一些他自私的力量。

疯狂灵魂：绑定达尔弗-纳尔授予你免疫感知伤害，感知吸取和困惑效果。

疯狂呻吟：你可以作为一个标准动作发出令人恐惧的呻吟。30尺扩散范围内的每个生物必须成功通过意志豁免，否则晕眩1轮。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内不能再次使用。疯狂呻吟是一个影响心智的声音能力。

天生护甲：你的天生护甲获得等于你体质加值一半（如果有）的增强加值。

护盾自身：随意作为一个标准动作，你可以指定每有效契灵等级10尺内的一个生物来分担你受到的伤害。只要目标生物保持在范围内，你从所有造成生命值伤害的效果中只受到一半伤害，它受到其余伤害。如果你指定另一个生物，或者你或目标死亡，该效果立即结束。效果结束后对你造成的任何伤害不再在你和目标之间分配，但已经分配的伤害不会重新分配给你。你一次只能以此能力影响一个生物。不愿成为此能力目标的生物可以尝试意志豁免来抵消该效果。
src:
Dahlver-Nar, the Tortured One
  
Once a human binder, Dahlver-Nar now grants powers just as other vestiges do. He gives his summoners tough skin, a frightening moan, protections against madness, and the ability to share injuries with allies.

Vestige Level: 2nd
Binding DC: 17
Special Requirement: None

Influence: You shift quickly from distraction to extreme focus and back again. Sometimes you stare blankly off into space, and at other times you gaze intently at the person or task at hand. Since Dahlver-Nar dislikes any task that requires more than 1 round of concentration (such as some spellcasting, concentration on an effect, or any action that requires a Concentration check), he requires that you undertake no such activities while under his influence.

Granted Abilities: 
Dahlver-Nar armors you and blends his madness with your sanity, lending you some of his selfish powers.

Mad Soul: Binding to Dahlver-Nar grants you immunity to Wisdom damage, Wisdom drain, and confusion effects.

Maddening Moan: You can emit a frightful moan as a standard action. Every creature within a 30-foot spread must succeed on a Will save or be dazed for 1 round. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds. Maddening moan is a mind-affecting sonic ability.

Natural Armor: You gain an enhancement bonus to your natural armor equal to one-half your Constitution bonus (if any).

Shield Self: At will as a standard action, you can designate one creature within 10 feet per effective binder level to share the damage you take. As long as the subject creature remains within range, you take only half damage from all effects that deal hit point damage, and it takes the rest. The effect ends immediately if you designate another creature or if either you or the subject dies. Any damage dealt to you after the effect ends is no longer split between you and the subject, but damage already split is not reassigned to you. You can affect one creature at a time with this ability. An unwilling target of this ability can attempt a Will save to negate the effect.

src: While traveling through the Underdark, I came across a priestess of the drow goddess Lolth. She was standing over the corpse of another priestess, who she informed me had been killed by a very powerful drider. This drider stole a key and a holy symbol from the dead priestess, and is using the former to enter what was once a temple of Lolth and center of powerful magic. He presumably intends to use the holy symbol within in some magical ritual, perhaps one meant to remove the curse making him a drider. Whatever his motives, the priestess considers his actions to be blasphemy against Lolth, and has asked me to track down the drider and recover the stolen holy symbol.  I will be rewarded by her with an item of magical gear, some gold and a special blessing from Lolth if I succeed in this.\n\nI have recovered the holy symbol of Lolth, and now need to return it to the priestess.

src: An expert pickpocket known as Vitiare stole all my gold and then disappeared, while I was distracted by the rest of the adventuring party he was working with. This represents a considerable loss, if it is permanent, but perhaps there is some hope of locating this Vitiare and recovering my gold. It appears there is also a bounty on his head, that can be collected from Oublek. I should see if I can find any clues as to where Vitiare might now be found. He seems to commonly operate around Nashkel, so perhaps someone in that town would know something about him.\n\nWhen in town, Vitiare is often seen drinking at the Belching Dragon accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn, presumably a friend or associate. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. I learned where to meet this Frago from a farmer named Hodgent, one of his customers, and from Frago I learned the location of Vitiare's hideout: an old abadoned house, sunk under water, a little to the south of Beregost. Vitiare and some associates have sealed off the basement from the water, and can be reached there from a secret door near some rocks to the south of the house.

dst: 在前往烛堡的途中，我遇到了一位树精，她正与一群信奉风暴与毁灭之神塔洛斯的信徒发生冲突。双方最终都死了，但我在其中一名塔洛斯信徒的尸体上找到了一张地图，上面标明了某处废墟的位置，他们希望在那里找到科扎的偶像。科扎是一位耐瑟瑞尔神祇，据信是塔洛斯的一个化身或别名，根据地图上的笔记，这些塔洛斯信徒希望从这尊偶像中获得强大的力量。塔洛斯的各种敌人试图阻止此事，所以也许我应该亲自前往这些废墟取回偶像，尤其是因为前往烛堡似乎可能不像我希望的那样简单。如果我获得偶像，我可以将其带给塔洛斯的一位风暴先驱，名叫玛尔扎克，目前可以在附近城镇纳什凯尔的旅店中找到他，希望他会奖励我。\n\n我一路杀过一些试图阻挡我的天界生物，成功从废墟中取回了偶像。下一步是前往纳什凯尔，找到等待它的风暴先驱。我本打算避开纳什凯尔，但鉴于有如此多强大的势力对它感兴趣，我不确定长期持有这尊偶像是否明智。
src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. Both parties ended up dead, but I found a map on the body of one of the Talosians, indicating the location of some ruins where they hope to find an idol of Kozah, a Netherese deity believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos, and an object from which these Talosians hope to gain great power, based on notes written on the map. Various enemies of Talos seek to prevent this, so perhaps I should head to these ruins myself and recover the idol, espectially as it seems going to Candlekeep will may not be as simple as I hoped. If I acquire the idol I can bring it to a Stormherald of Talos known as Marzak, currently to be found in the inn of the nearby town of Nashkel, who will hopefully reward me.\n\nI fought through some Celestials who sought to bar my way, and successfully recovered the idol from the ruins. The next step would be to go to Nashkel and find the Stormherald waiting for it. I had intended to avoid Nashkel, but given how many powerful forces are interested in it, I am not sure it would be wise to retain possession of this idol for too long.

dst:
我得到警告，据说贫民区东北部有一栋房子被危险幽灵萦绕，进入这座古老破败建筑的人有时再也无法出来。这似乎是一个需要提防的危险，或者，对于像我这样的冒险追寻者来说，也许是一个机会。

我进入了那栋房子，到达二楼后，我困在了根据我交谈过的一个幽灵所说，是由幻象构成的迷宫中。要逃脱，我必须在我进入任何门后随机传送到的某个房间里找到一个界门，并在受益于真知术效果时进入它。要施放这样的法咒，我应该寻找某种魔法神器的四块碎片，并找到一个有铁砧的房间，在那里我可以将它们组装起来。

我已经通过界门逃脱，最初将我困在幻象迷宫中的强大幽灵已被击败，帮助我的幽灵也已从将他困在这里的诅咒中解脱。这件事似乎已经了结。
src:
I have been warned that a house in the northeast of the Slums district is believed to be haunted by dangerous spirits, and that those who enter this old and decrepit structure sometimes fail to come out again. This would seem a danger to beware, or perhaps, for seekers of adventure such as myself, an opportunity.

I have entered the house, and upon reaching the second floor have become trapped in what according to a ghost I talked to is a maze of illusions. To escape, I must find a portal in one of the rooms to which I am randomly transported upon entering any door and enter it while benefitting from the effects of a True Seeing spell. To cast such a spell, I should look for four fragments of some kind of magical artifact, and find a room with an anvil in which I can assemble them.

I have escaped through the portal, the mighty spectre who entrapped me within that maze of illusions to begin with has been defeated, and the ghost who assisted me has been freed from whatever curse was holding him here. This matter would seem to be concluded.

src: "I guess we don't have too many opportunities to do that, with all the fighting we're doing? I'm starting to get used to it, but beating off an assassin targeting me specifically is still something different. I'd almost started to forget about our larger problems amidst the day to day struggles but that's certainly a pointed reminder."

src:
Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric 6, Druid 5
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

With a touch of your hand, you boost the subject's life energy, granting him or her the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.  This healing applies only to damage sustained during the spell's duration, not to that from previous injuries.  The subject heals 4 hit point per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.

Regenerate critical wounds does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts. The effects of multiple regenerate spells do not stack, only the highest-level effect applies.  Applying a second regenerate spell of equal level extends the first spell's duration by the full duration of the second spell.

dst:
地底人是那些选择--或被迫--生活在地下世界的洞穴和蜿蜒通道中的人类群体的后裔。经过几代人，这些人类适应了这个充满自然奇观和危险生物的陌生世界。一些地底人社会已经几代没有冒险到地表，而其他人已经完全忘记了他们的真正起源。然而，那些生活在通往地下领域的洞穴附近的人偶尔会到地表探险，甚至与地表人类进行有限的贸易。地底人是一个简单，氏族化的人民，致力于他们的家园和种族的安全。由于他们称之为家的洞穴和隧道中有大量邪恶和掠食性种族和生物，地底人变得迅速，隐秘且以生存为导向。尽管在技术方面相当原始和质朴，但地底人通过在地下生存的卓越知识弥补了这一不足，尽管他们甚至避开地下领域的最深处。

地底人种族特性：
类人生物（人类）：地底人是类人生物，具有人类亚种。
中型：作为中型生物，地底人没有因体型而获得特殊奖励或惩罚。
地底人基础陆地速度为30英尺。
黑暗视觉：地底人可以在黑暗中看到60英尺远。
1级时额外4个技能点，每增加一个等级额外1个技能点，因为地底人（像他们的人类祖先一样）多才多艺且有能力。(1级时的4个技能点作为奖励添加，不乘以倍数。)
聆听检定+2种族加值：作为地下猎人生活了几代人，使地底人拥有敏锐的听力。
伪装（特异能力）：地底人可以随意改变皮肤颜色以拟形怪周围地形，在躲藏检定上获得+4种族加值。在自然地形中，此加值增加到+10。
光线敏感（特异能力）：地底人在明亮阳光下或日光术半径内会目眩。
天赋职业：任意。
src:
The underfolk are descendants of bands of humans who chose-or were forced-to live in the caves and twisting passageways of the underground world. Over generations, these humans adapted to this strange world, filled with natural wonders and dangerous creatures. Some underfolk societies have not ventured to the surface in generations, and others have forgotten their true origins altogether. However, those who live close to the caves that give entry to the underground realms make occasional forays to the surface and even engage in limited trade with surfacedwelling humans. Underfolk are a simple, clannish people dedicated to their homes and the safety of their race. Because of the multitude of evil and predatory races and creatures in the caves and tunnels they call home, underfolk have become quick, stealthy, and survival-oriented. Although rather primitive and rustic when it comes to technology, underfolk make up for this lack with a superior knowledge of how to survive beneath ground, although even they avoid the deepest depths of the subterranean realms.

Underfolk Racial Traits:
Humanoid (human): Underfolk are humanoid creatures with the human subtype.
Medium: As Medium creatures, underfolk have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Underfolk base land speed is 30 feet.
Darkvision: Underfolk can see in the dark out to 60 feet.
4 extra skill points at 1st level and 1 extra skill point at each additional level, since underfolk (like their human ancestors) are versatile and capable. (The 4 skill points at 1st level are added on as a bonus, not multiplied in.)
+2 racial bonus on Listen checks: Living as underground hunters for generations has given underfolk keen hearing.
Camouflage (Ex): Underfolk can change their skin coloration at will to mimic the surrounding terrain, giving them a +4 racial bonus on Hide checks. In natural terrain, this bonus increases to +10.
Light Sensitivity (Ex): Underfolk are dazzled in bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.
Favored Class: Any.

src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. According to the dryad, these Talosians seek to acquire an idol of the ancient Netherese god of storms and destruction Kozah, who is believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos. The Talosians can apparently gain great power from this idol, which given the nature of their beliefs they will doubtless use for destructive ends. The dryad has asked me to head to these ruins, a little ways to the north, and recover the idol myself, in order to prevent this. This may be dangerous, as it will put me in conflict with these Talosians, and the idol itself is said to have mind-warping powers. Nevertheless, it seems a worthy quest.

dst:
在穿过维尔达斯森林时，我遇到了一位名叫赛亚拉的树精。她最近被穿行于森林中的豺狼人和牛头人所困扰，它们彼此交战，而她尤其担心自己两个姐妹的命运，她们最近为了躲避这样一场战斗而逃离。这两位树精中，一位逃进了附近的洞穴，另一位则逃向了东边的区域。两人都没有回来，赛亚拉担心她们遇到了某种危险。她请求我调查这两个区域，先从洞穴开始，以救出她的姐妹，或至少查明她们遭遇了什么。

我发现赛亚拉的姐妹被囚禁在洞穴中。与此同时，我身后的门砰然关闭，断绝了退路。随后我面临两条道路的选择：一条会杀死被囚禁的树精，另一条则会释放她，但代价是我自身危险增加。不幸的是，后者似乎风险太大，所以我选择了导致树精死亡的那条路。我预计赛亚拉不会对此感到高兴，但这是糟糕选项中最好的一个。现在我必须充分利用已经为我打开的道路。

赛亚拉果然很不高兴，并明确表示在这种情况下，我不能指望从她那里得到任何奖励。
src:
While proceeding through the Wealdath forest, I came across a dryad named Saiala. She has been inconvenienced by the gnolls and minotaurs who have recently been moving through the forest, battling each other, and is particularly concerned with the fate of her two sisters, who recently fled in order to avoid becoming caught up in one such battle. One of these two dryads fled into a nearby cave, and the other to the regions to the east. Neither has returned and Saiala fears they have run into some sort of danger. She has asked that I investigate both areas, starting with the cave, in order to rescue her sisters or at least discover what became of them.

I found Saiala's sister held captive in the cave. At the same time, the door behind me snapped shut, preventing retreat. I was then given a choice of two paths to follow, one of which would slay the captive dryad, while the other would set her free at the cost of increasing my own danger. Unfortunately, the latter seemed too great a risk, so I chose to take the path resulting in the dryad's death. I expect Saiala will not be happy about that, but it was the best of set of bad options. Now I must make the best of the path that has now been opened for me.

Saiala was indeed unhappy and made clear that under the circumstances I can expect no reward from her.

dst: "别那么肯定。我一直在收到证实你所发现之事的报告。斥候注意到大批地精在米尔森林集结，兽人则在行军山脉聚集。这些也不是普通的劫掠队伍。它们行动时带着大多数此类人生物部落所极度缺乏的精准和军事纪律，并且装备了数量异常之多的魔法增强武器。诚然，过去这样的类人生物队伍对大型文明社区几乎不构成威胁，但那是因为它们传统上恰恰缺乏这些家伙似乎拥有的东西：团结、纪律、适当的训练和装备。"
src: "Don't be so sure. I've been receiving reports that confirm what you discovered. Scouts have noticed large bands of goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs assembling in the Marching Mountains. These are not normal raiding parties, either. They operate with a precision and military discipline that is singularly lacking in most such tribes of humanoids, and are equipped with an unusually large number of magically enhanced weapons. It is true that in the past such humanoid bands have posed little threat to large civilized communities, but that is because they have traditionally lacked precisely what these seem to possess: unity, discipline, proper training and equipment."

src: "Here's a little gold to compensate you for keeping things under control there. Since you've been so helpful, there's another thing you might be able to assist me with. A lot of the merchant captains I've been dealing with are demanding that I do something to collect the debts of a wealthy noble named Ronar Raythan. Apparently he's been ordering a lot of luxury items on credit: the finest clothes and wines, exotic spices, magical knick-knacks...well, the list isn't important. What matters is that payment is long overdue. Raythan owes 30000 gold to various captains. I'd like you to go collect it and bring it to me. His estate can be found in the vicinity of Dalt's..." He indicates a location on your map, in the area north of the docks."

src:
(BASE CLASS)
A specialist wizard who calls himself a necromancer or a cleric with the Death domain has significant power over undead and the forces of negative energy, but a dread necromancer is their true master. A practitioner of vile and forbidden arts, the dread necromancer roots about in graveyards, searching out moldering components for her obscene spells. She calls upon restless, tormented spirits of the dead, seeking their arcane secrets. She might be a consummate villain, or perhaps a tortured hero whose obsession with death leads her along questionable moral paths.

- Hit Die: d6
- Alignment: any non-good
- Proficiencies: A Dread Necromancer gains proficiencies with Simple Weapons, and Light Armour.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Charnel Touch - Negative energy touch
Rebuke Undead
2: Lich Body - DR 2
3: Negative Energy Burst 1/day
4: Mental Bastion +2 - +2 Saves against poison and disease
5: Fear Aura
6: Scabrous Touch 1/day - Contagion on touch
7: Lich Body - DR 4
8: Negative Energy Burst 2/day
Undead Mastery - Add your charisma modifier to the number of undead you can control
9: Negative Energy Resistance - +4 saves against negative energy
10: Immunity to Sneak Attack
11: Lich Body - DR 6
Scabrous Touch 2/day
12: Enervating Touch - Negative level touch
13: Negative Energy Burst 3/day
14: Mental Bastion +4
15: Lich Body - DR 8
16: Scabrous Touch 3/day
17: Enervating Touch - Double uses
Immunity to Critical Hits
18: Negative Energy Burst 4/day
19: Craft Wondrous Item
20: Lich Transformation - Gain Lich template.

SPELLCASTING

To cast a spell, the Dread Necromancer must have a Charisma score of 10 + the spell level. The DC of a Dread Necromancer's spell is 10 + Spell Level + Charisma Modifier. A Dread Necromancer's caster level is equal to his class level. He is a spontaneous caster who knows all his spells.

Spells per day:

A dim, blue glow surrounds the subjects, protecting them from attacks, granting them resistance to spells cast by chaotic creatures, and slowing chaotic creatures when they strike the subjects. This abjuration has four effects.

First, each warded creature gains a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saves. Unlike protection from chaos, this benefit applies against all attacks, not just against attacks by chaotic creatures.

Second, a warded creature gains spell resistance 25 against chaotic spells and spells cast by chaotic creatures.

Third, the abjuration blocks possession and mental influence, just as protection from chaos does.

Finally, if a chaotic creature succeeds on a melee attack against a warded creature, the attacker is slowed (Will save negates, as the slow spell, but against shield of law's save DC).

A tiny reliquary containing some sacred relic, such as a scrap of parchment from a lawful text. The reliquary costs at least 500 gp.

src: This is a history of the oricsh chieftan Gurgumuk, who was so successful as a warlord that he is said to have died of old age (a most unusual end for an orc chieftan). He also brought his tribe sufficient wealth and power to afford the luxury of training some of its members to be literate so as to serve as scribes. This accounts for their being a history written of his reign, also an unusual accomplishment for an orc chieftan.\n\nWhile other extant ancient works have on occasion referred to or quoted extensively from this book, insuring that its existence was not forgotten, this is the only complete copy known to exist, making it quite valuable, and something in which the librarians of Candlekeep would be sure to be interested.

src:
Beginning at 5th level, you can apply an eldritch essence invocation you know (other than greatreach blast or spellblast) to any arcane spell that affects a target or that requires a melee or ranged touch attack. The spell's level must be at least as high as the level of the eldritch essence (for example, you can apply hellrime blast only to a spell of 4th level or higher). If the essence requires a saving throw, use the normal save DC for that essence. If an eldritch essence invocation changes the damage of the spell, it can be applied only to a spell that deals damage (you can't add brimstone blast to charm monster).

If the spell has more than one target or allows more than one attack, you choose one target to be affected by the invocation; all other targets take only the normal effect of the spell.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Cha modifier (minimum 1).

NOTE: If you have Lord of All Essences feat, only the essence from first slot will be used.

src: I have again met my former employer, Saman Waladi, and been generously rewarded for saving him from the bandits in the desert. He has also asked me to perform another small task for him: speaking to the Customs Inspector at City Watch Headquarters, and obtaining from him official papers indicating that some goods Saman is shipping have passed his inspection. According to Saman, I need only mention his name and display a paper he has given me with his seal, as arrangements have already been made.\n\nThe matter proved a bit more complicated than Saman indicated, as the Customs Inspector expected a bribe as a condition of completing the arrangements. However, I now have the necessary certificate, and should take it to Saman.

dst:
（进阶职业）
对于任何神祇的仆人来说，没有比那些罕见时刻更大的喜悦了，当她守护神的存在成为一种真实，可触的力量，将力量的颤栗传遍她的身体，让她的灵魂翱翔。对于一些人来说，这种体验的滋味是如此强大的吸引力，以至于他们开始献身于培养它，希望通过沉思的生活更接近他们的神祇。这些虔诚的追随者花费数小时祈祷和冥想，净化他们的灵魂，使他们值得与神性更紧密的接触。虽然一些虔心祈者退出世界进入私人静修，但其他人保持活跃，甚至冒险，发现真正接近他们的神祇来自于在世界上实现神祇的意志。作为回报，他们发现自己的思想，身体和灵魂被净化，完善，并最终与他们的神祇接近合一。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
For any servant of a deity, no joy is greater than at those rare moments when the presence of her patron deity is a real, tangible force, sending shivers of power through her body and sending her soul soaring. For some, the taste of this experience is such a powerful attraction that they begin devoting their lives to cultivating it, hoping to attain a greater closeness to their deity through a life of contemplation. Spending hours in prayer and meditation, these devoted followers purify their souls, making them worthy of closer contact with the divine. While some contemplatives withdraw from the world into private retreats, others remain active, even adventuring, finding that true nearness to their deity comes from living out their deity's will in the world. In return, they find their minds, bodies, and souls purified, perfected, and finally brought close to union with their deity.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: A Contemplative does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level divine spells.
Skills: Lore 13 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Bonus Domain - The contemplative gains access to an additional domain.
    Divine Health - The contemplative is immune to disease.
2: Slippery Mind - The contemplative gains the slippery mind feat.
3: Divine Wholeness - Once per day, the contemplative can heal herself 4 times her contemplative level in hit points.
4:
5: Divine Body - The contemplative becomes immune to poison.
6: Bonus Domain
7: Divine Soul - The contemplative gains SR of 15 + Contemplative level.
8:
9:
10: Mystic Union - The contemplative changes racial type to outsider and gains DR of 10/+1

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in contemplative, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

src:
The Tuladhara are among the rarest of planetouched; a crossbreed between humans and the enigmatic rilmani, the neutral exemplars.  To them, balance is everything.  They are not emotionless, but almost always consider all sides of an issue, acting without bias.  Unlike some rumors may have you believe, however, they do not betray trust and friendship easily.  Physically they resemble lithe and graceful humans, and are sometimes mistaken at a distance for half-elves.  Up close, metallic-colored skin and opalescent eyes give them away.  They are balanced in dress as in all things; not too flashy, but still fashionable.

Tuladhara Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, +2 Wis
Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass tuladhara's druid class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Darkvision: Tuladhara are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Persuade): +2 racial bonus to Persuade checks.
- Skill Affinity (Sense Motive): +2 racial bonus to Sense Motive checks.
- Resist Acid: Innate acid resistance of 5.
- Resist Sonic: Innate sonic resistance of 5.
- Resist Electrical: Innate electrical resistance of 5.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Magic Circle vs Alignment.
- Outsider: Tuladhara count as Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

src: The Temple of Tyr has dispatched a group of clerics and paladins into the sewers beneath the temple district in an attempt to fight the newly aggressive wererats causing trouble there. They have yet to report back. Adaras Efzen, a high-ranking cleric in the Temple of Tyr, has asked me to enter the sewers and determine what has happened to them, assisting them if necessary.\n\nUnfortunately the entire party of Tyrrans met their deaths in the sewers. The bad news has been reported to Adaras, who gave me a small reward for the information.

dst: "如果你想帮忙，可以从这里的后门出去（就是那个用布遮住的地方，我们还没装上正式的门），去看看那里所有的建筑材料。有木材、绳索、一桶桶的东西……总之，你大概能找到什么东西躲在后面守着。我想那边有一些堆起来的板条箱，应该能派上用场。运气好的话，你就能看到是谁来捣乱并阻止他们。如果你能吓跑他们或打退他们，那就很好。如果你还能找到关于幕后黑手的可靠证据，那就更好了。我说过，我们的资金有限，但如果你完成其中任何一项任务，我肯定能凑出某种报酬。哦，还有一件事，破坏行为总是在夜里发生，所以你大概不该在白天浪费时间盯着。"
src: "If you want to help, you could go out through the back entrance here (the one covered by a cloth, we haven't put a proper door up yet), and take a look at all the construction materials there. There's lumber, rope, barrels of stuff...anyway, you could probably find something to hide behind and keep watch. I think there are some stacked up crates out there that would serve the purpose. With any luck, you'll be able to see who's coming to disrupt things and stop them. If you can scare or fight them off, that would be good. If you can find some solid evidence about who is behind this as well that would be even better. We have limited funds, as I said, but if you accomplish either of those tasks I'm sure I could scrape up some sort of reward. Oh, one other thing, the vandalism always occurs at night, so you probably shouldn't waste time watching during the day."

src: While traveling through the Underdark, I came across a priestess of Eilistraee, the patron deity of drow seeking to abandon the evil ways typical of that race. She was standing over the corpse of another priestess, who she informed me had been killed by a very powerful drider. This drider stole a key and a holy symbol from the dead priestess, and is using the former to enter what was once a temple of Lolth and center of foul magic. He presumably intends to use the holy symbol within in some magical ritual, perhaps one meant to remove the curse making him a drider. Given the evil of the drider and the location, the priestess does not expect any good to come of this, and has asked me to track down the drider and recover the stolen holy symbol. I will be rewarded by her with an item of magical gear, some gold and a special blessing from Eilistraee if I succeed in this.

src:
(BASE CLASS)
The striking fist or flashing sword pales beside a psion's focused stare. Psionic powers arise from a regimen of strict mental discipline developed over months and years of self-scrutiny and subconscious discovery. Those who overcome their personal demons, fears, and other pitfalls of intense self-reflection learn to call upon an internal reservoir of psionic power. Psions depend on a continual study of their own minds to discover an ever wider range of mental powers. They meditate on memories and the nature of memory itself, debate with their own fragment personalities, and delve into the dark recesses of their minds' convoluted corridors. "Know thyself" is not just a saying for a psion - it's the road to power.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: Psions gain wizard weapon proficiency.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Base Attack Bonus: +1/2
Strong Saves: Will
Psionics: Intelligence is the key stat of a Psion.
Bonus Feats: A Psion gets a bonus feat at level 1, and every 5 levels thereafter (5, 10, 15, 20).
Discipline: Every Psion must decide at first level which discipline he will specialize in. Choosing a discipline provides a psion with access to the powers that are restricted to that discipline.

dst: "基本上是的。通常我们伊尔梅特的信徒以耐心和宽容忍受侮辱和冒犯。我们不惧怕，甚至乐于自己受苦，但绝不会轻易给任何人带来痛苦，即使是敌人。这是我们神的命令。然而有时不抵抗邪恶本身会造成太多苦难，以至于我们必须破例。但我必须警告你，尽管我认为在这种情况下武力措施是合理的，但已经尝试过，结果并不令人满意。我不愿把你送入如此严重的危险中。"
src: "Basically, yes. Normally we followers of Ilmater bear insults and offenses with patience and forbearance. We do not fear, indeed we rejoice, to suffer ourselves, and yet would never lightly inflict suffering on anyone else, even an enemy. Such are the commands of our god. Yet sometimes not resisting evil can cause so much suffering itself that we must make an exception. I must warn you though, that even though I think forceful measures justifiable in these circumstances, they have already been attempted with less than satisfactory results. I hesitate to send you into such grave danger."

dst: 我与一位塞露涅的牧师谈过，他正试图在卡林港为这位神祇建立一座神殿，希望以此对抗莎尔在世界这一地区过大的影响力。他告诉我，神殿的建造工作正受到破坏者的干扰，他们夜间出动，捣毁白天建好的一些部分。他请求我设法处理此事。他建议我从神殿后门出去，那里堆放着大量建筑材料，找些板条箱躲在后面。从那里我可以在夜间（破坏行为发生时）进行监视，运气好的话，我会看到破坏者靠近，并能够阻止他们。如果可能的话，最好还能找到一些确凿的证据，查明幕后主使是谁。\n\n我看到一个可疑的身影靠近神殿，在他造成任何破坏之前把他吓跑了。然而，如果我想查明他是谁或他的目的是什么，我就必须动身追赶。他跑得很快，如果我不尽快追上他，很可能会在这个错综复杂的巷弄迷宫中跟丢他。我需要朝他离开的方向追去，并希望在各个岔路口找到他往哪个方向去的线索。如果几分钟内还没找到他，很可能就再也追不上了。
src: I spoke to a priest of Selune who is attempting to establish a temple to that deity in Calimport, in hopes of counteracting the excessive influence of Shar in this region of the world. He told me that construction work on the temple is being disrupted by vandals, who strike at night and wreck some of the building done during the day. He has asked me to try and do something about this. He suggests I go out the back entrance of the temple, where a lot of constuction materials are piled up, and find some crates to hide behind. From there I can watch during the night (when the vandalism occurs) and with any luck I will see the perpetrators approach and be able to stop them. It would be good as well to find some solid evidence about who is behind this, if possible.\n\nI saw a suspicious figure approaching the temple and scared him off before he could do any damage. If I wish to find out anything about who he is or what his purposes are, however, I will have to set out in pursuit. He can run quickly and I will likely lose him in this complicated maze of alleys if I do not catch up to him soon. I need to head off in the direction he went and hope to find clues as to which direction he took at any intersections. If I have not found him within a few minutes it will likely be too late to ever do so.

此法咒仅影响邪恶阵营的类人生物，人形怪物和巨人。

真复活术或奇迹术可以正常复活被此法咒杀死的生物。复活术只有在施法前能从下层位面找回该生物遗体的情况下才有效。
src:
Last Judgment
Necromancy [Death, Good]
Level: Clr 8, Sor/Wiz 8, Wrath 8
Components: V, Celestial (caster must be good outsider)
Casting Time: 1 round
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One evil humanoid, monstrous humanoid, or
giant/2 levels
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will partial
Spell Resistance: Yes

Reciting a list of the targets' evil deeds, you call down the judgment of the heavens upon their heads. Creatures that fail their saving throw are struck
dead and bodily transported to the appropriate Lower Planes to suffer their eternal punishment. Creatures that succeed nevertheless take 3d6 points of temporary Wisdom damage as guilt for their misdeeds overwhelms their minds.

This spell affects only humanoids, monstrous humanoids, and giants of evil alignment.

A true resurrection or miracle spell can restore life to a creature slain by this spell normally. A resurrection spell works only if the creature's body can be recovered from the Lower Planes before the resurrection is cast.

You invoke healing energy over a group of creatures, granting each the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.
Each subject heals 1 hit point per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.
Mass lesser vigor does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts.
The effects of multiple vigor spells do not stack; only the highest-level effect applies.

I want something of the same sort: Maghaurezh's Beholder Band! It is a powerful magical item designed for my kind, with various powers of protection and enhancement, meant to be worn around an eyestalk. Unfortunately, this particular item has been broken into three pieces, with each of the three being held by different powerful factions. One piece is in the possession of a rival group of Beholders, who have a colony to the south of here. Another is held by a group of Mind Flayers who have a stronghold to the north. The third was recently acquired by a group of Kuo Toa who seem to have set themselves up to the east of here. None of these groups is likely to negotiate with <race> creatures like you, and all are quite powerful, so it will be no trivial task to recover the three pieces. If you do, however, I will assist you in returning to the surface."

你可以侦测环绕不死生物的光环。揭示的信息量取决于你研究特定区域的时间。
第1轮：不死生物光环的存在或缺失。
第2轮：区域内不死生物光环的数量以及最强不死生物光环的强度。如果你为善良阵营，且最强不死生物光环的强度为压倒性（见下文），并且该生物的生命骰至少为你角色等级的两倍，你将被震慑1轮且法咒结束。
第3轮：每个不死生物光环的强度和位置。如果光环在你的视线之外，则你能辨别其方向但无法确定其确切位置。
光环强度：不死生物光环的强度由不死生物的生命骰决定，如下表所示：

生命骰              强度
1 或更低      微弱
2 - 4           中等
5 - 10          强烈
11 或更高    压倒性
残留光环：不死生物光环在其原始来源被摧毁后会残留。如果侦测不死生物被施放并指向这样的位置，法咒会显示光环强度为暗淡（甚至比微弱光环更弱）. 光环在此暗淡等级下残留的时间取决于其原始强度：

原始强度   残留光环持续时间
微弱   1d6 轮
中等    1d6 分钟
强烈  1d6x10 分钟
压倒性    1d6 天
每轮，你可以转向侦测新区域的不死生物。法咒可以穿透障碍，但 1 英尺厚的石头，1 英寸厚的普通金属，一张薄铅片，或 3 英尺厚的木头或泥土会阻挡它。

You can detect the aura that surrounds undead creatures. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area.
1st Round: Presence or absence of undead auras.
2nd Round: Number of undead auras in the area and the strength of the strongest undead aura present. If you are of good alignment, and the strongest undead aura's strength is overwhelming (see below), and the creature has HD of at least twice your character level, you are stunned for 1 round and the spell ends.
3rd Round: The strength and location of each undead aura. If an aura is outside your line of sight, then you discern its direction but not its exact location.
Aura Strength: The strength of an undead aura is determined by the HD of the undead creature, as given on the following table:

HD              Strength
1 or lower      Faint
2 - 4           Moderate
5 - 10          Strong
11 or higher    Overwhelming
Lingering Aura: An undead aura lingers after its original source is destroyed. If detect undead is cast and directed at such a location, the spell indicates an aura strength of dim (even weaker than a faint aura). How long the aura lingers at this dim level depends on its original power:

Original Strength   Duration of Lingering Aura
Faint   1d6 rounds
Moderate    1d6 minutes
Strong  1d6x10 minutes
Overwhelming    1d6 days
Each round, you can turn to detect undead in a new area. The spell can penetrate barriers, but 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks it.

Arcane Material Component: A bit of earth from a grave.

He asked me to find three items of significance to his research: an eye from a Basilisk, ichor from a Gelatinous Cube or similar slime, and brain matter from an Intellect Devourer. All are creatures that it should be possible to find somewhere in the Underdark. He has promised to pay me 4000 gold for each of these items, and to give me a special magical item in addition if I collect all three. Time to go hunting I suppose.\n\nI have given Mavereth the Basilisk eye and the ichor. He still requires an Intellect Devourer's brain.

You are then to assist his forces in their assualt in whatever way he thinks appropriate. LEGACY ITEM ABILITIES
Sturdy Grip (Su): At 5th level, while wearing Bullybasher's Gauntlets, you gain a +4 bonus on grapple checks.
Knock Silly (Su): At 6th level and higher, when you deal damage to an opponent with Bullybasher's Gauntlets, that opponent is affected as if by the touch of idiocy spell. You must decide whether or not to use this ability before making the attack roll, and if you miss, the attempt is wasted for the day. This ability is usable two times per day. Caster level 5th.
Solitary Warrior (Su): Starting at 7th level, when you are adjacent to at least two foes, your armor class increases by 1 and you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage with each successful attack made with the gauntlets.
Cheat Death (Su): At 8th level and higher, you automatically heal 1 hit point if your hit points drop to between -1 and -9. This ability functions once per day.
Power of One (Su): At 10th level, Bullybasher's Gauntlets grant a +2 enhancement bonus to your Constitution score. At 14th level, the bonus rises to +4. It rises to +6 at 18th level.
Rough and Tumble (Su): At 11th level, you gain damage reduction 5/magic.
Giant Bearing (Su): Beginning at 13th level, you gain a +2 bonus to Strength, a -2 penalty to Dexterity (to a minimum of 1), a -1 penalty on attack rolls, and a +4 bonus on grapple checks. 
Stone Gathering (Su): At 15th level and higher, you can hurl rocks. The rocks deal 2d6 (plus Strength modifier) points of bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence (Su): Starting at 17th level, you unsettle surrounding foes when you are attacking or charging. Creatures within a radius of 30 feet are subject to the effect if they have fewer Hit Dice than you. A potentially affected creature that succeeds on a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier) suffers no ill effect and is immune to your frightful presence for 24 hours. Those who fail the save become shaken for 4d6 rounds.
No Wound Too Big (Su): At 18th level and higher, while wearing Bullybasher's Gauntlets, you heal 2 points of damage every hour.
Lightning Punch (Su): Beginning at 19th level, once per day on command, you can charge Bullybasher's Gauntlets with chain lightning. The next creature struck by the gauntlets is the target of the spell, and secondary bolts can strike other foes within 30 feet. A charge is maintained until the gauntlets strike a creature. The save DC is 19, or 16 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. Caster level 15th.

dst:
哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动攻击，因为我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。不过，他还有另一项任务要我在此期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，曾因在反对奴隶贸易应采取何种手段上的分歧与他闹翻，如今因我最近造访他的庄园而受到触动，主动联系哈马德试图和解。哈马德已被说服，愿意在卡洛玛斯牵涉的一件事上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠维持一个营地，据我所知，他在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多打听他们的事）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我以及他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。要到达营地，我应先到他的庄园去见卡洛玛斯。他能够打开一道魔法界门将我送到营地，或许还能告诉我一些关于当前局势的更多情况。

卡洛玛斯将我传送到了营地，在那里我遇到了贾拉尔·马卡希，一位巡林客，也是竖琴手同盟的成员，负责管理这个地方。贾拉尔告诉我，几天前他曾与营地的一名神秘袭击者遭遇，对方将他击倒后逃走，并掳走了一名难民。贾拉尔追踪他的足迹足够远，确定他向东逃往山区，但在没有支援的情况下不愿追得太远。现在他已与我同行，并提议我们一起向东进发，试图追查这一威胁的源头。

向东行进时，我们发现了从营地被绑架者之一的尸体。检查显示有迹象表明他是被吸血鬼杀死的。如果我们要对付的是吸血鬼，我应该四处寻找可以劈成木桩的木质物品，因为要永久杀死一个吸血鬼需要用到这些。

我们已经找到并潜入了一处神秘绑架者使用的隐藏据点。在探索该地时，我们发现了证据表明这是龙巫教的基地，该组织帮助龙转化为不死龙巫妖，他们最终意图让整个费伦臣服于其统治。一些教徒显然将自己转化为吸血鬼，以便在永久的不死状态下继续侍奉他们的龙族领主，这很可能解释了我们发现的吸血鬼出没的证据。我们必须谨慎，因为面对这个教派，很可能在前方某处会遇到一条龙类，甚至一条龙巫妖。
src:
Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.

Kalomas teleported me to the camp, where I met up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place. Jalar told me that a few days ago he had an encounter with one of the camp's mysterious assailants, who knocked him down and fled, carrying off one of the refugees. Jalar followed his tracks long enough to determine that he fled east towards the mountains, but was unwilling to go too far in pursuit without support. Now he has joined with me, and proposed that together we head east in an attempt to track down the source of this menace.

Traveling east, we came across the body of one of the people kidnapped from the camp. Examination revealed signs that he had been slain by vampires. If we are dealing with vampires, I should look around for wooden objects I can break up into stakes, since these will be needed to kill a vampire permanently.

We have located and penetrated some hidden stronghold being used by the mysterious kidnappers. Exploring the place, we have come across evidence that it is a base of the Cult of the Dragon, an organization that helps dragons transform themselves into undead dracoliches, to whose rule they ultimately intend to subject all Faerun. Some cultists apparently transform themselves into vampires so that they may keep serving their draconic lords in permanent undeath, which likely explains the evidence we have come across that vampires are about. We must be cautious, for with this cult it is quite possible that a dragon or even a dracolich is to be encountered somewhere further in.

dst:
一个名叫维蒂亚雷的扒窃高手偷走了我所有的金币，然后消失了，当时我正被他同伙的其他冒险者分散了注意力。如果这是永久性的损失，那可是一笔不小的数目，但也许还有希望找到这个维蒂亚雷并夺回我的金币。看来他的脑袋上还悬着赏金，可以从欧布勒克那里领取。我应该看看能否找到任何线索，查明维蒂亚雷现在可能在哪里。他似乎经常在纳什kel一带活动，所以也许那个镇上有人会知道他的消息。

在镇上时，维蒂亚雷经常被人看到在打嗝龙酒馆喝酒，身边跟着一个名叫弗拉戈·赫奇索恩的半身人。想必他们是朋友或同伙。这个赫奇索恩也许是个游侠，显然住在周边的荒野中。他为能找到他的人出售治疗服务。一个名叫霍奇特的农夫已知受益于这些服务，最近有人在镇上见过他，现在显然在集市上。也许我该跟他谈谈，弄清楚如何找到这个半身人，他或许又能提供维蒂亚雷当前下落的线索。

我找到了农夫霍奇特，他告诉我，弗拉戈有时可以在纳什kel东北方不远处一处显眼地标——两块巨大的岩石露头附近找到。不过他只是偶尔出现在那里，所以我不能保证任何时候去都能找到他。
src:
An expert pickpocket known as Vitiare stole all my gold and then disappeared, while I was distracted by the rest of the adventuring party he was working with. This represents a considerable loss, if it is permanent, but perhaps there is some hope of locating this Vitiare and recovering my gold. It appears there is also a bounty on his head, that can be collected from Oublek. I should see if I can find any clues as to where Vitiare might now be found. He seems to commonly operate around Nashkel, so perhaps someone in that town would know something about him.

When in town, Vitiare is often seen drinking at the Belching Dragon accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn. Presumably they are friends or associates. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him.  A farmer named Hodgent who is know to benefit from those services has been seen in town recently, and is apparently now at the Fair. Perhaps I should talk to him to find out how to locate this halfling, who might in turn be able to provide a clue as to Vitiare's current whereabouts.

I located Farmer Hodgent, and he told me that Frago can sometimes be found near a couple of large rock outcroppings that from a prominent landmark a little way to the northesast of Nashkel. He only shows up there occasionally, however, so there is no guarantee I will find him there at any given time.

dst: 卡林港是一座古老的城市，而悠久的岁月通常意味着城市当前的建筑是建立在更古老建筑的废墟之上的。在卡林港阳光照耀的街道和闪闪发光的塔楼之下，隐藏着大量的下水道、废墟、墓穴和洞穴。这个“地下城”被统称为“黑暗卡林港”，据传那里既有巨大的危险，也有巨大的宝藏，其中一些甚至可以追溯到卡林杉最早的起源时期，那时它由巨灵统治。关于人们在这些黑暗通道中可能发现什么，流言四起：盗贼的藏身处、 monstrous vermin、亡灵恐怖、黑暗穴居类人生物部落、隐藏的神庙。那些试图揭开这些传闻真相的人，并不总能回来。
src: Calimport is an ancient city, and great age usually means that a city's current structures are built atop the ruins of older ones. Beneath the sunlit streets and gleaming towers of Calimport lies a mass of sewers, ruins, tombs and caverns. This "undercity" is collectively described as "Dark Calimport," and is rumored to be home to both great dangers and great treasures, some of which may even date to the earliest origins of Calimshan, when it was ruled by djinn. Rumors abound as to what one may find in these dark passages: hideouts of thieves, monstrous vermin, undead horrors, tribes of dark-dwelling humanoids, hidden temples. Those who seek to uncover the truth of such reports do not always return.

These wild, nearly feral halflings rarely leave the confines of the deep forests. Strange and reclusive, they form close-knit communities because of their telekinetic talents and are uncomfortable with strangers. Physically, they share similar builds and characteristics with their halfling kin, and many of their abilities as well.

Ghostwise Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass ghostwise halfling's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Ghostwise Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

src: Upon entering the lair of the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, we were met by Semu Naraka, the assassin employed by Calishite noble Olim Khachar. He told us that Gra'azha'ukul was an ally of his, and would prefer that we not fight him. Since he and Khachar are also apparently opposed to Azghulkar, he did not want to get in the way of our opposition to that tanar'ri either. As an alternative to attacking Gra'azha'ukul, he offered to open a portal that would take us to the keep of Tarakondazum, a silver dragon. We could probably find loot at least as valuable from the one dragon as the other, and, in addition, Tarakondazum is apparently acting as the jailer of some powerful entity who is also an enemy of Azghulkar. Freeing this prisoner could thus gain us a valuable ally in our primary objective.\n\nI rejected Naraka's offer, preferring to stick to the original plan of slaying Gra'azha'ukul and looting his hoard.

dst:
沙漠民族的传说讲述了一颗很久以前从天而降的星辰，它触碰到大地，引发了一场巨大的爆炸，将这片土地化为废墟。当火焰熄灭，烟雾从曾经翠绿而生机勃勃的土地上散去后，只剩下一个荒凉的陨石坑和四周数英里的荒地。
 
尽管陨石坑周围是一片空旷无情的景象，这个地方仍然吸引着访客。第一批探索这个地洞的人报告了无法解释的现象和萦绕不去的影像，但无法指出其来源。无论是奥术还是神术魔法（甚至灵能辐射）似乎都没有从盆地中散发出来，但显然有某种奇怪的力量在起作用。
 
一位名叫阿玛瓦鲁的富有进取心的法师，她的众多兴趣包括天球，资助了一次更大规模的探险。阿玛瓦鲁和她众多的儿女们前往盆地建立了一个永久前哨站。有传言说她希望从陨石坑及附近地区开采残留的星金属，有时可以从这些金属中熔炼和精炼出奇异的合金和纯金属。
 
不幸的是，事情对阿玛瓦鲁来说并不顺利。采矿工具经常无缘无故地损坏，没人能立即查明原因。役畜和奴隶会突然陷入恐慌，每个人都报告说梦到越来越强烈的恐惧，通常涉及被微小沙粒的压倒性重量缓慢埋葬而死。有一天，阿玛瓦鲁发回给资助者的报告突然中断了。被指派传递消息的信使再也没有回来，资助者雇佣的新信使也未能返回。最终，阿玛瓦鲁的冒险被当作代价高昂的损失注销，这个地方也被遗忘了。

这是一个4级遭遇区域，取自沙暴资料书。因此，它包含一些技能使用，有限的休息和合理的战斗。它也很短，可以在一小时或更短时间内完成。请注意，此遭遇区域使用了沙暴的炎热危险，因此适应这种环境的种族如布卡和阿舍拉提，以及拥有耐热专长的角色将表现最佳。角色在尝试此遭遇区域之前应装备齐全。
src:
Histories of the desert people tell of a star that fell from heaven long ago and touched the earth, creating a great explosion that laid waste to the lands. After the fires had gone out and the smoke had cleared over the formerly green and vibrant land, there remained only a bleak crater and miles of waste on all sides.
 
Despite the empty, unforgiving landscape all around the crater, the location still drew visitors. The first to explore the hole in the earth reported unexplained phenomena and haunting images, but couldn't specify a source. Neither arcane nor divine magic (or even psionic emanations) seemed to radiate from the basin, yet clearly some strange force was at work.
 
An enterprising wizard named Ammavaru, whose many interests included the celestial sphere, financed a larger expedition. Ammavaru and her large family of sons and daughters headed to the basin to set up a permanent outpost. The story circulated that she hoped to mine the crater and nearby areas for residual starmetals, from which exotic alloys and pure metals are sometimes smelted and refined.
 
Unfortunately, things did not go well for Ammavaru. Mining implements broke on a regular basis, for no reason anyone could immediately determine. Work animals and slaves were given to sudden panics, and everyone reported dreams of ever-increasing dread, usually involving a slow death from being buried under a crushing weight of tiny sand particles. One day, the reports from Ammavaru back to her financiers simply ceased. The courier assigned to run messages never returned, and new couriers hired by the financiers also failed to return. Eventually, Ammavaru's venture was written off as a costly loss, and the location was forgotten.

This is a 4th level encounter area, taken from the Sandstorm sourcebook. As such, it features some skill use, limited resting, and reasonable combat. It is also short, and can be completed in an hour or less. Please note that this encounter area uses Sandstorm's heat dangers, and therefore races adapted to that such as Bhuka and Asherati and characters with the Heat Endurance feat will do best. Characters should be fully equipped before attempting the encounter area.

src: An expert pickpocket known as Vitiare stole all my gold and then disappeared, while I was distracted by the rest of the adventuring party he was working with. This represents a considerable loss, if it is permanent, but perhaps there is some hope of locating this Vitiare and recovering my gold. It appears there is also a bounty on his head, that can be collected from Oublek. I should see if I can find any clues as to where Vitiare might now be found. He seems to commonly operate around Nashkel, so perhaps someone in that town would know something about him.

src: "We've got a wizard, who's usually alone in his room, and a cleric, who's usually in the little shrine we set up near the end of the corridor. There'll proabably be a few other people wandering about, I can't be sure where. And of course, there's the boss. He's really tough and could probably take on half dozen or more of the rest of us in a fight. His quarters are at the end of the corridor."

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Cerebremancers access both the arcane mysteries of spellcasting and the psionic powers of the mind. Cerebremancers tend to be driven, ambitious sorts, willing to sacrifice more subtle abilities in exchange for pure power. Many continuously hunt for further knowledge that will enhance their mastery of both arcane spells and psionic powers.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Cerebremancer gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spellcasting: Able to cast 2nd level Arcane spells.
Manifesting: Able to cast 2nd level Powers.
Skills: Concentration 6 ranks, Lore 6 ranks.

BONUS CASTING AND MANIFESTING

Upon gaining a level in Cerebremancer, the character gains new spells, powers, and power points as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class and manifester class.

dst: 这把武器是在白骨之战中被发现的。1090 DR 年，一支以人类为主的军队与一支以类地精为主的军队在那里展开了一场大规模战斗。自那场可怕的流血杀戮之后，该地便充斥着大量亡灵。目前尚不清楚这把武器是由最初参战者之一所持，还是由后来前往那里并倒下的某个人所持，也许是一名试图消灭亡灵的冒险者。柄上刻着如下文字："取之于生者，予之于死者。"这把钉头锤显然拥有从活物身上吸取生命能量，并在之后将其有害地转移给亡灵的力量，因此对两者而言都是一件有效武器。
src: This weapon was found at the Battle of Bones, a site on which a predominantly human army and a predominantly goblinoid army fought a massive battle in 1090 DR. Ever since that terrible blood-letting, the site has been infested with masses of Undead. It is not known whether this weapon was wielded by one of the original participants in the battle, or by someone, perhaps an adventurer seeking to destroy the Undead, who went and fell there at a later time. Inscribed on the haft is the following: "Take from the living, give to the dead." The mace apparently has the power to leech life energy from living beings and later transfer it harmfully to Undead, making it an effective weapon against both.

dst:

src:
Deep Orcs, also known as orogs, revel in the spoils of war. They are quick to rise to battle, but afterward they fall back to enjoy the fruits of their victories. The concept of leading a horde of raging orcs on a pointless crusade is alien to the mindset of the orog. Orogs looks similar to a large mountain orc, except that the ears are somewhat larger and their eyes are huge and pale.

Orog Ability Adjustments: +6 Str, +2 Cha, -2 Dex, -2 Wis.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass orog's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Orogs are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Craft): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor and Craft Weapon checks.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 2.
- Resist Cold: Innate cold resistance of 5.
- Resist Fire: Innate fire resistance of 5.
- Light Blindness: Abrupt exposure to light blinds an orog for 1 round. In addition orogs suffer -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Orcish: Orogs are considered Orcish for the purpose of spells.

dst: 住在码头附近一所房子里的凯拉·肯尼曼，请求我找到她的丈夫本，并让他回家。据她说，我可以在欢憩旅店找到他，他正和他的朋友克拉夫·德尔森在那里喝酒。\n\n克拉夫·德尔森让我去泪之屋（伊尔梅特的一座神殿）找本·肯尼曼。神殿的一位牧师告诉我，本确实来过那里，但后来离开了，说他想买一把锤子。这个区域的西南部应该有个商人出售这类普通工具。我应该找到他，因为本可能就在附近，或者，就算找不到，那个商人也许更清楚本可能去了哪里。
src: Kyra Kenemen, who resides in a house near the docks, has asked me to locate her husband, Ben, and ask him to return home. According to her, I can expect to find him at the Winsome Repose Inn, drinking with his friend Clav Derlson.\n\nClav Derlson told me to look for Ben Kenemen at the House of Tears (a temple of Ilmater). A priest at the temple told me that Ben had been there, but had since left, saying he was interested in purchasing a hammer. There is supposed to be a merchant in the southwest part of this district who sells such common tools. I should locate him, as Ben may be nearby, or, failing that, he might have more information about his likely whereabouts.

dst: "我们将尽一切努力帮助这里的人们，因为伊尔梅特命令我们援助任何受苦的人。我们为那些负担不起的人提供治疗法咒和其他必需品，并试图鼓励人们练习自我控制和节制生活，缺乏这些是他们贫穷的主要原因之一：如果一个人第二天就把一百万金币喝光赌光，那么给他一百万金币也不会让他富有。我们在寺庙周围建立了一个小型的信徒社区，他们仍然贫穷，但不像否则那样绝望。"
src: "We will do anything we must to assist the people here, as Ilmater commands us to aid any who suffer. We provide healing spells and other necessities to those who cannot afford them, and try to encourage people to practice self-control and temperate living, the lack of which is one of the major reasons they are poor in the first place: giving someone a million gold pieces would not make him rich if by the next day he has drunk and gambled them all away. We've built up a little community of believers around the temple here, who are still poor, but not quite as hopeless as they would otherwise be."

dst:
在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给提尔神殿的首席祭司阿达拉斯看时，他认出这是前些时候被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。他因我归还了找到的碎片而奖励了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，他也想要。

在找到圣戒的第二块碎片后，阿达拉斯告诉我，有了戒指的两块碎片，他可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。他还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖励。我接受了这个任务，现在已经从它的不死守卫那里取回了这枚提尔圣戒的最后一块碎片。回到神殿后，我得知我的奖励就是这枚戒指本身，它将再次变得完整，并注入一套我可以自己选择的力量。一旦我准备好并知道我想选择什么力量，阿达拉斯就会着手为戒指注入力量。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Adaras, the head priest of the Temple of Tyr, he recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. He rewarded me for returning the piece I found, and has told me that he would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Adaras that with two pieces of the ring, he could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. He also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I accepted this quest and  have now recovered the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr from its undead guardians. Returning to the temple, I was informed that my reward would be this very ring, made whole once more, and infused with a set of powers that I myself can choose. As soon as I am ready and know what powers I wish to select, Adaras will proceed to empower the ring.

dst: 在穿过维尔达斯森林时，我遇到了一位名叫赛亚拉的树精。她受到了最近穿过森林、彼此交战的豺狼人和牛头人的困扰，尤其担心她两个姐妹的命运，她们最近为了躲避这样一场战斗而逃离。这两位树精中，一位逃进了附近的洞穴，另一位则逃往东边的地区。两人都没有回来，赛亚拉担心她们遇到了某种危险。她请求我调查这两个区域，先从洞穴开始，以营救她的姐妹，或至少查明她们遭遇了什么。\n\n我发现赛亚拉的姐妹被囚禁在洞穴中。与此同时，我身后的门突然关闭，阻止了撤退。随后我面临两条道路的选择，其中一条会杀死被囚禁的树精，另一条则会释放她，但代价是增加我自身的危险。不幸的是，后者似乎风险太大，所以我选择了导致树精死亡的那条路。我预计赛亚拉不会对此感到高兴，但这是一系列糟糕选项中最好的一个。现在我必须充分利用已经为我打开的道路。
src: While proceeding through the Wealdath forest, I came across a dryad named Saiala. She has been inconvenienced by the gnolls and minotaurs who have recently been moving through the forest, battling each other, and is particularly concerned with the fate of her two sisters, who recently fled in order to avoid becoming caught up in one such battle. One of these two dryads fled into a nearby cave, and the other to the regions to the east. Neither has returned and Saiala fears they have run into some sort of danger. She has asked that I investigate both areas, starting with the cave, in order to rescue her sisters or at least discover what became of them.\n\nI found Saiala's sister held captive in the cave. At the same time, the door behind me snapped shut, preventing retreat. I was then given a choice of two paths to follow, one of which would slay the captive dryad, while the other would set her free at the cost of increasing my own danger. Unfortunately, the latter seemed too great a risk, so I chose to take the path resulting in the dryad's death. I expect Saiala will not be happy about that, but it was the best of a set of bad options. Now I must make the best of the path that has now been opened for me.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
All warlocks harbor at least a grudging respect for the entities responsible for their powers. They are clearly beings of great mystical might, and thus worthy of regard. A rare few warlocks go beyond this attitude to actual reverence or worship of the fiendish, fey, or extraplanar powers that have made them far more than mortal. Such is the life of an eldritch disciple devoted to a deity who granted her the arcane talents of the warlock. Though her powers might take different forms, she knows that the source is the same.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: An Eldritch Disciple does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Lore (8 ranks).
Spells: Ability to cast 2nd-level divine spells.
Invocations: Ability to use least invocations.
Special: Ability to turn or rebuke undead, must worship a chaotic or evil deity.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
 1: Gift of the Divine Patron (Su)
    Turn/Rebuke Undead
 2: -
 3: -
 4: Gift of the Divine Patron (Su)
 5: Eldritch Spellweave (Su)
 6: -
 7: Gift of the Divine Patron (Su)
 8: -
 9: -
10: Gift of the Divine Patron (Su)
    Timeless Body (Ex)

Invocations: At each level, you gain new invocations known and an increase in caster level as if you had also gained a level in an invocation-using class to which you belonged before adding the prestige class level. (This includes eldritch blast.) You do not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained.

Spellcasting: At each level beyond 1st, you gain new spells per day and an increase in caster level (and spells known, if applicable) as if you had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class to which you belonged before adding the prestige class level. You do not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained.

等级
1：武士刀娴熟 - 角色在使用武士刀时可以使用敏捷调整值代替力量调整值进行攻击加值。
  精明防御 - 当不穿盔甲时，居合大师在使用武士刀时可以将智力调整值加到AC上。
4：奖励专长。
5：居合攻击 - 如果居合大师在对手的近战范围内开始战斗，他们可以在攻击时拔刀并同时打击，根据居合专注检定获得额外伤害。
8：一击两断 - 居合大师可以用武士刀作为标准动作进行两次攻击。
9：奖励专长。
10：虚空打击 - 角色将魅力调整值加到从使用居合攻击获得的每个额外伤害骰上。

*注意，由于无法正确实现居合决斗，为了使职业更符合NWN游戏引擎，5级时的无念打击专长被替换为居合攻击，虚空打击被移至10级。居合专注提供的伤害与职业来源书中给出的伤害一致。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Iaijutsu is the martial art of drawing a weapon, almost always a katana and attacking with it in the same fluid motion. It is the foundation of some forms of dueling, and its masters are feared and respected throughout the world.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Iaijutsu Masters are proficient in all simple and martial weapons, gain no proficiencies in armor or shields.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any Lawful
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Iaijutsu Focus 9 Ranks
Feats: Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus: Katana

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Katana Finesse - Character can use their Dexterity modifier instead of Strength for attack bonuses while using a katana.
  Canny Defense - While wearing no armor, the Iaijutsu Master can add their Intelligence modifier to their AC while using a katana.
4: Bonus Feat.
5: Iaijutsu Attack - If an Iaijutsu Master begins combat within melee range of an opponent, they can make an attack drawing the weapon at the same time as striking which grants bonus damage depending upon an Iaijutsu Focus Check.
8: One Strike, Two Cuts - An Iaijutsu Master can make two attacks with a katana as a standard action.
9: Bonus Feat.
10: Strike from the Void - Character adds her Charisma modifier to each extra damage die gained from using the Iaijutsu Attack.

*Note, since there is no way to properly implement Iaijutsu Duels, to make the class more inline with the NWN game engine the Strike with No Thought feat is replaced with the Iaijutsu Attack at level 5, and Strike from the Void is moved to 10th level. Damage granted from the Iaijutsu Focus is inline with those given in the source book from which the class came.

dst:
专长类型：职业特定。
先决条件：符文师等级3。
具体效果：符文师在3级时获得向物品添加更多充能的能力。为此，调整计数器直到你选择了所需的充能数量，然后按下符文充能选项将其打开。最后，施放你想铭刻的法咒。必须打开铭刻符文才能生效。充能物品的成本是法术等级 * 施法者等级 * 充能数 * 50，而XP成本是金币成本/25。

在8级时，符文师获得铭刻具有每日使用次数而非充能的符文的能力。遵循与充能相同的步骤，但选择符文每日使用次数。每日使用次数物品的成本是法术等级 * 施法者等级 * 充能数 * 400，而XP成本是金币成本/25。

打开充能或每日使用次数中的任何一个都会关闭另一个选项，因为它们不叠加。最大充能数是50，而最大每日使用次数是5.符文计数 +1 将充能或使用次数增加1，而符文计数 +10 将数量增加10.符文清除将数量重置为1，即最小值。
使用：选定。
src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific.
Prerequisite: Runecaster Level 3.
Specifics: The Runecaster gains the ability to add more charges to an item at level 3. To do this, adjust the counter till you have selected the desired number of charges, then press the Rune Charges option to turn it on. Finally, cast the spell you wish to Inscribe. Inscribe Rune must be turned on for this to work. The cost for a charged item is Spell level * Caster Level * Charges * 50, while the XP cost is the gold cost/25.

At level 8, the Runecaster gains the ability to Inscribe runes that have Uses per day instead of charges. Follow the same procedure as for Charges, except select Rune Uses Per Day. The cost for a uses per day item is Spell level * Caster Level * Charges * 400, while the XP cost is the gold cost/25.

Turning on either Charges or Uses Per Day will turn off the other option, as they do not stack. The maximum number of charges is 50, while the maximum uses per day is 5. Rune Count +1 increases the number of charges or uses by 1, while Rune Count +10 increases the number by 10. Rune Clear resets the number to 1, the minimum.
Use: Selected.

dst: 我得知灰矮人矿坑中有一道通往深渊的界门被打开了。最好把它关上，以免塔纳厘恶魔不断涌出。它由四根柱子维持开启，界门两侧各有几根，所以要关闭它，我必须穿过界门，把另一侧的柱子也关掉。而且，这些柱子应该先被关闭，以免我在另一侧时界门关闭。它们应该离界门不太远，但我可能得四处找一找才能发现它们。
src: I have learned of a portal to the Abyss opened in a Duergar mine. It might be a good idea to close it, lest Tanar'ri keep pouring through. It is being kept open by four pillars, some on each side of the portal, so to close it I will have to go through and shut down the pillars on the other side as well. These, furthermore, should be shut down first, lest the portal close while I am on the other side. They should not be too far away from the portal, but I may have to look around a bit to find them.

Range: Personal
Target: You

Using concealing amorpha, you weave a quasi-real membrane around yourself. You remain visible within the translucent, amorphous enclosure. This distortion grants you concealment (opponents have a 20% miss chance), thanks to the rippling membrane encasing your form. You can pick up or drop objects, easily reaching through the film. src:
Psychoportation
Level: Nomad 4
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./ level)
Effect: Ray
Duration: 1 min./level
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 7
Metapsionics: Extend, Split Psionic Ray, Twin

A green ray springs from your outstretched hand. You must make a ranged touch attack to hit the target. Any creature or object struck by the ray is covered with a shimmering emerald field that completely blocks extradimensional travel. Forms of movement barred by a dimensional anchor include astral projection, blink, dimension door, ethereal jaunt, etherealness, gate, maze, plane shift, shadow walk, teleport, and similar spell-like or psionic abilities. The spell also prevents the use of a gate or teleportation circle for the duration of the spell.

A dimensional anchor does not prevent summoned creatures from disappearing at the end of a summoning spell.

dst: "我只能把告诉阿拉达尔的故事再讲给你听。几年前，我和一个相当古怪的船友一起航行，他叫德拉沙姆·埃纳尔。在港口时，经常有人看见他和神秘陌生人交谈，甚至因为某些古怪的事情消失好几天。当被问及他的所作所为时，他的回答总是闪烁其词，令人不满。他引起了我的好奇心，所以我决定看看能不能查出他到底在隐瞒什么。因此，当我们的船停靠在卡林港时，我偷偷跟着他，看他去了哪里。"
src: "I can only tell you the tale I told Aladar. Some years ago, I was sailing with a rather eccentric shipmate, Drasham Enar by name. When in port, he would often be seen conversing with mysterious strangers, or even disappearing for days on some peculiar business of his. When questioned about his doings, his answers were evasive and unsatisfactory. He excited my curiousity and so I decided to see if I could not find out whatever it was he was hiding. Consequently, when our ship docked at Calimport, I followed him stealthily to see where he went."

dst: 我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎杀海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向纳兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭海盗。据船员说，这些海盗是一群牛头人，一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次袭击。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗海盗。\n\n船长已经告诉我他计划如何在即将到来的袭击中利用我的才能。扎拉拉和我，以及几名船员，将乘坐一艘小船绕到岛屿北侧，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则在南面攻击海盗的主力。我们要清理北部，并阻止任何朝我们方向逃跑的海盗逃脱。船上的法师使我们能够乘坐这艘小船在隐形状态下接近，让我们偷偷登上岛屿。我准备好出发时随时可以和船长谈谈。
src: Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.\n\nThe captain has told me of his plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault. Zarala and I, along with several of the crew, are going to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We are to clear the north and prevent the escape of any pirates who flee in our direction. The ship's wizard has made it possible for us to approach in this small craft while invisible, allowing us to sneak onto the island. I can speak to the captain whenever I am ready to depart.

（进阶职业）
宿敌猎手生活中只有一个目的：杀死她所仇恨类型的生物。她愿意付出任何代价或冒任何危险来战胜这个可恨的敌人。她的刀刃是此类生物的克星，而她的身体往往能抵御它们的攻击。尽管她对这个敌人的仇恨无边无际，永无止境，但并非不加思考或鲁莽。她活着是为了终结她可恨的敌人，但她不会无谓地抛弃自己的生命。

- 生命骰：d10。
- 武器和盔甲熟练：宿敌猎手不获得任何武器或盔甲熟练。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Foe Hunter has but one purpose in life: to kill creatures of the type she hates. She is willing to pay any price or risk any danger to prevail against this hated foe. Her blade is anathema to such creatures, and her body is more often than not proof against their attacks. Though her hatred of this enemy is boundless and unending, it is not unthinking or rash. She lives to put an end to her hated foe, but she does not throw away her own life needlessly.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: Foe Hunters gain no weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +7.
Feats: Favored Enemy, Trackless Step, Weapon Focus (any).

CLASS FEATURES:

Levels
1: Hated Enemy - The Foe Hunter gains all bonuses against their hated enemy.
  Rancor +1d6 - First attack of the round deals bonus damage to hated enemies. Bonus damage even works on enemies immune to criticals.
2: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 3/- - Character gains damage reduction from all hated enemies.
3: Rancor +2d6
4: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 5/-
  Hated Enemy Spell Resistance
5: Rancor +3d6
6: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 7/-
7: Rancor +4d6
8: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 9/-
9: Rancor +5d6
10: Death Attack - The Foe Hunter can make a death attack against a hated enemy that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.
  Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 11/-

NOTES:
Hated Enemy Damage Reduction - Could not properly implement damage reduction vs. a specific race due to game engine limitations. The player regenerates the HP instead of having it resisted.
Death Attack - The foe hunter can make a death attack against a hated enemy that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.
