dst: 这个问题问得好。另一个主要选择是去洛山达神殿，就在此地往北不远的贝雷戈斯特，但那里对罪犯分子来说也会遇到类似的困难。我想，甚至会更麻烦，因为那里的首席祭司凯尔达斯·奥姆利尔还兼任该镇的镇长，负责执法。如今，我想人们或许可以找那些一直在该地区旅行的众多冒险队伍之一。他们中许多人都有牧师，而且信仰各异，所以即使是小偷也可能找到一个有同情心的，尽管这很难指望得上。我不确定还能做什么……实际上，我想到还有另一种可能。
src: "A good question. The chief alternative would be to go to the Temple of Lathander, in Beregost a little way to the north of here, but that would present similar difficulties to the criminal element. Even more so, I suppose, since Kelddath Ormlyr, the head priest there, wears a 'second hat' as that town's governor and is responsible for law enforcement. These days, I suppose, one might seek out one of the numerous adventuring parties who have been traveling through the region. Many of them include clerics, and from a wide variety of faiths, so even a thief might find a sympathetic one, though it would be difficult to count on that. I'm not sure what else one could do...actually there is one other possiblity that comes to mind."

src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Ghost-Faced Killer Level 3
Specifics: Once per day a Ghost-Faced Killer can panic onlookers and even frighten his victim to death by making a sudden strike attack.  The ghost-faced killer must use his power attack feat on the attack.
The victim must make a Will save (DC 10 + ghost-faced killer class level + ghost-faced killer Cha modifier) or die.  If the victim succeeds at the save, the victim becomes shaken for 1 round per class level of the ghost-faced killer.
Onlookers within a 30 foot radius (not including the victim, the ghost-faced killer, or allies of the ghost-faced killer) must make a Will save (DC 10 + ghost-faced killer class level + ghost-faced killer's Cha modifier + damage bonus from power attack on the frightful attack).
If the onlooker fails this save, she will become panicked (if her hit dice are less than the ghost-faced killer's class level + the ghost-faced killer's Cha modifier) or shaken.
The Ghost-Faced Killer gains another use per day every 3 levels.

- 武器防具熟练：坦帕斯战斗守卫获得简易武器和军用武器，所有护甲和盾牌的熟练。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：任意非守序。
专长：战斗施法，武器专攻（任意近战武器），领导力。
技能：手艺（武器） 5 级，手艺（护甲） 5 级，学识 5 级。
基础攻击加值：4
神术施法：等级 2
特殊：必须信仰坦帕斯。（牧师必须拥有战争领域，以及力量或保护领域之一）

职业特性：

等级
1：军队之力 - 能够激励 30 英尺内的盟友，给予他们 +2 的豁免，攻击检定，属性检定（驱散），技能检定和伤害检定。盟友必须能听到你。
  知识学识 - 学识技能加值等于战斗守卫等级 + 智力调整值。
  选择武器 - 特定武器获得额外好处。
2：附魔武器 +1 - 战斗守卫可以暂时增强他的选择武器，每等级一分钟，具有相当于 +1 的特殊能力。
3：战斗锻造者 - 手艺（武器和护甲） 获得 +2 加值。
5：学识武器 - 他每天可以施放鉴定术三次。
6：附魔武器 +2。
7：顽强 - 在 -1 到 -9 生命值之间，你自动稳定。
9：鉴定武器 - 他每天可以鉴定一件护甲或武器，三次。
10：附魔武器 +3。

奖励法咒

在坦帕斯战斗守卫中每提升两级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高施法职业（德鲁伊，牧师） 中也提升了一级。他不通过此能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Battleguards of Tempus are the soldier-priests of Tempus who specialize in military affairs.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: The Battleguard of Tempus gains proficiency in simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any Non-Lawful.
Feats: Combat Casting, Weapon Focus (any melee weapon), Leadership.
Skills: Craft (Weapon) 5, Craft (Armor) 5 ranks, Lore 5 ranks.
Base Attack Bonus: 4
Divine Spellcasting: Level 2
Special: Must worship Tempus. (Clerics must have the War domain, as well as one of Strength or Protection)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Army Power - Able to inspire allies within 30 feet, giving them +2 on saving throws, attacks rolls, ability checks (turning), skill checks and damages rolls. Allies must be able to hear you.
  Knowledge Lore - Bonus to the Lore skill of Battleguard's level + Intelligence modifier.
  Weapon of Choice - A specific weapon gains additional benefit.
2: Enchant Weapon +1 - The battleguard may temporarily enhance his Weapon of Choice, one minute per level, with a equivalent +1 special ability.
3: Battle Forger - Bonus +2 to Craft (weapon and armor).
5: Lore Arms - He may cast the Identify Spell three times a day.
6: Enchant Weapon +2.
7: Die Hard - Between -1 to -9 HP, you automatically become stable.
9: Identify Arms - He may identify an armor or a weapon, three times a day.
10: Enchant Weapon +3.

BONUS SPELLS

Each two levels in Battleguard of Tempus, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (druid, cleric). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

dst: 恶魔低沉的声音介入了这场争斗。"泽卡尔充满了我的力量，这力量在数百年间已与那把剑的力量交织在一起。即便是泽法德的后裔也无法与之抗衡。你所有那些徒劳的阻挠，只会确保当我重返你们位面时，你将第一个被杀死。说起来你还真帮了大忙，因为我早就想杀死这个风之子的后裔了。凡人的事情往往就是如此。无论他们策划出多么宏大的阴谋，最终都不过是在侍奉他们理所应当的主人——深渊的领主们。这个泽卡尔如此，你也将如此。看着这一切真是有趣极了。"
src: The booming voice of the demon intrudes upon the struggle. "Zekar is filled with my power, which has entwined itself with that of the sword over many centuries. Even this descendant of Zefad cannot prevail against it. All your feeble attempts to frustrate me have done is insure that you will be the first to be slain when I return to your plane. Quite helpful of you, actually, as I have long desired the death of this child of air. So often that is the way of things with mortals. Whatever grand schemes they hatch, in the end they simply end up serving their rightful masters, the lords of the Abyss. So it was with this Zekar, and so it will be with you. It is most amusing to watch."

dst: 在穿过维尔达斯森林时，我遇到了一位名叫赛亚拉的树精。她最近被穿行于森林中的豺狼人和牛头人所困扰，它们彼此交战，而她尤其担心自己两个姐妹的命运，她们最近为了躲避这样一场战斗而逃离。这两位树精中，一位逃进了附近的洞穴，另一位则逃向了东边的区域。两人都没有回来，赛亚拉担心她们遇到了某种危险。她请求我调查这两个区域，先从洞穴开始，以救出她的姐妹，或至少查明她们遭遇了什么。\n\n我发现赛亚拉的姐妹被囚禁在洞穴中，并成功将她释放。作为回报，两姐妹准备给我从她们自己的树上取下、并注入了精类力量的木块。如果我能找到第三位姐妹——很可能在我自己路线的东边某处——她应该能给我第三块木块，其数量足以制成一件强大的物品。
src: While proceeding through the Wealdath forest, I came across a dryad named Saiala. She has been inconvenienced by the gnolls and minotaurs who have recently been moving through the forest, battling each other, and is particularly concerned with the fate of her two sisters, who recently fled in order to avoid becoming caught up in one such battle. One of these two dryads fled into a nearby cave, and the other to the regions to the east. Neither has returned and Saiala fears they have run into some sort of danger. She has asked that I investigate both areas, starting with the cave, in order to rescue her sisters or at least discover what became of them.\n\nI found Saiala's sister held captive in the cave, and was able to set her free. In return, both sisters are prepared to give me pieces of wood taken from their own trees and infused with the power of the fey. If I can find the third sister, likely somewhere to the east along my own route, she should be able to give me a third piece of wood which will be a sufficient quantity to form an item of great power.

dst: 扎拉拉觉得她在魔法和历史研究上花了太多时间，想要拓展一些不同的活动。具体来说，她认为自己的武器技能需要提高，想要一些武术训练。由于她无法离开庄园，她让我找一个合适的教练来庄园，并建议我去看看位于贵族区的卡拉达尔·科拉德的学校。科拉德只接受精选的学生，不会训练扎拉拉，但她的想法是，既然他的学生都相当厉害，可以雇佣其中一个。她让我向潜在的教练提供每节课250金币的报酬，外加500金币的预付款，并给了我一些金币来支付这笔预付款。我不需要花掉的部分可以自己留着。\n\n我找到了科拉德的一个学生，一个叫加拉德·阿沙勒的人，他表示有些愿意接受这份工作。然而，他对金钱报酬不太感兴趣，反而要求我为他完成一项任务。他让我去拜访他的兄弟，塔兰·阿沙勒，目前被关押在城市守卫队总部附近的地牢里。这个塔兰知道阿沙勒戒指的位置，这是加拉德想要的家庭传家宝，并愿意告诉他的兄弟它的位置。然而，加拉德决定不和他兄弟说话，因为他认为兄弟是家族的耻辱，所以他想让我代替他去和他说话，并做任何其他必要的事情来取回戒指。看来我必须这样做才能完成扎拉拉交给我的这个任务。
src: Zarala feels that she has been spending too much time in magical and historical research, and wants to branch out into some different activities. Specifically, she thinks her skill with weapons needs improvement and wants some martial training. Since she cannot leave the estate, she has asked me to locate an approrpriate instructor who could come there, and suggested I look at Khaladar Korad's school, located here in the Noble district. Korad only accepts select students, and would not train Zarala, but her thinking is that since even his students are quite formidable, one of them could be hired. She has told me to offer potential instructors an incentive of 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 up front, and given me some gold to pay this latter advance. I can keep whatever I don't need to spend.\n\nI have found one of Korad's students, one Garad Ashaler, who has expressed some willingness to take on this job. He is not much interested in monetary compensation, however, and has instead demanded that I perform a task for him instead. He has asked me to visit his brother, Taran Ashaler, who is currently detained in the City Watch's dungeons, near their headquarters. This Taran knows the location of the Ashaler Ring, an heirloom of the family that Garad wishes to have, and has offered to tell his brother its location. Garad, however, has resolved not to speak to his brother who he regards as a disgrace to the family, so he wants me to speak to him instead and do whatever else is necessary to recover the ring. It seems I must do this if I am to complete this assignment from Zarala.

dst: 在穿越卡林杉的旅途中，我发现了一支商队的残骸，它曾遭到不明袭击者的攻击。这些袭击者残忍地杀害了商队成员，似乎更热衷于单纯的破坏而非抢劫。在继续旅程之前，追踪并解决他们或许是个好主意。\n\n原来这次袭击是萨达拉什所为，他是一位暗影德鲁伊，信奉用暴力推进德鲁伊的目标。我会见了他，并试图避免战斗，因为我同情他的目标。萨达拉什要求我袭击我发现被毁商队所在道路南边的一座农场，杀死那里所有人，以此证明我对他事业的忠诚。他承诺如果我这样做，会给予我奖励。
src: While traveling through Calimshan, I came across the wreckage of a caravan that had been attacked by unknown raiders. These raiders had savagely killed the caravan members, and seemed more interested in simple destruction than in robbery. It might be a good idea to track them down and deal with them before continuing on my journey.\n\nIt turns out the attack was the work of Sadarash, a shadow druid who believes in using violence to advance the druidical agenda. I have met with him and tried to avoid fighting, as I sympathize with his goals. Sadarash has asked me to attack a farm to the south of the road on which I found the destroyed caravan and kill everyone there, thereby proving my commitment to his cause. He has promised to reward me if I do this.

dst: "奥林·吉西埃，通用语中意为'秘密守护者'，是一个由精灵法师组成的教团，致力于保守那些最好永远不被发现的知识的秘密。精灵民族继承了许多短命种族早已遗忘的学识，其中许多若落入歹人之手将造成极大的危害。我们的职责是确保远古怪物仍被束缚、被诅咒的器物仍被藏匿、黑暗魔法的源头仍未被触及，并让危险的知识远离那些无法明智运用它的人。因此，当听说这些卓尔试图进入这个蕴含远古魔法的地方时，我们便设法阻止，因为此地的结界本意是阻挡人类，而我们的黑暗表亲是否会被它们挡住尚不清楚。至于是否也不应阻止你进入，现在必须做出判断。你寻找塞里姆·加卢伦的失传论著，究竟是为了什么目的？"
src: "The Olin Gisiae, or 'secret keepers' in the common tongue, are an order of elven mages dedicated to maintaining the secrecy of knowledge best left undiscovered. The elven people are heirs to much lore forgotten by the short-lived races, much of which could do great harm in the wrong hands. It is our task to see that ancient monsters remain bound, cursed artifacts remain hidden away, sources of dark magic remain untapped, and dangerous knowledge be kept from those who cannot use it wisely. Thus, upon hearing that these Drow were seeking entrance to this place, containing ancient magic, we sought to prevent it, for the wards about it were meant to keep out humans, and it is not clear if our dark cousins would be stopped by them. Whether your entrance should not be prevented as well must now be determined. For what purpose do you seek Seriem Galuren's lost treatise?"

src: "Do not be overconfident. Many powerful opponents thought they could face him, yet failed.  With the compass, this challenge is now open to you if you wish to take it up, and risk your life against the formidable Tazakar. Also remember that he is a demon, so though he speaks of 'single combat,' it may be assumed he will cheat and bring in lesser Tanar'ri to aid him (fortunately our diviners confirmed he does indeed control access to a powerful weapon, so you should not be cheated out of that if you win). Note too that you can only use the compass once, so do not depart to the Abyss until you are prepared to face Tazakar and any other Tanar'ri who bar your path, as you will not be able to retreat and return some other time. It is your choice what you do with this opportunity. The gold should be useful to you regardless."

src:
Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric 3, Druid 2
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

With a touch of your hand, you boost the subject's life energy, granting him or her the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.  This healing applies only to damage sustained during the spell's duration, not to that from previous injuries.  The subject heals 2 hit points per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.

Regenerate moderate wounds does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts. The effects of multiple regenerate spells do not stack, only the highest-level effect applies.  Applying a second regenerate spell of equal level extends the first spell's duration by the full duration of the second spell.

src:
Clairsentience
Level: Psion/wilder 7
Display: None
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature or one object (up to a 2-ft. cube/level) touched
Duration: One day/level (D)
Saving Throw: None or Will negates (object)
Power Resistance: No or Yes (object)
Power Points: 13
Metapsionics: Extend

When cast, this spell not only prevents divination spells from working to detect or locate the creature or object affected by sequester, it also renders the affected creature or object invisible to any form of sight or seeing (as the invisibility spell). The spell does not prevent the subject from being discovered through tactile means or through the use of devices. Creatures affected by sequester become comatose and are effectively in a state of suspended animation until the spell wears off or is dispelled.

Note: The Will save prevents an attended or magical object from being sequestered.
There is no save to see the sequestered creature or object or to detect it with a divination spell.

Material Component: A basilisk eyelash, gum arabic, and a dram of whitewash.

dst:
（进阶职业）
乍看之下，这似乎自相矛盾 -- 一个奥术施法者竟然会在盲目的狂怒中“失去自我”.然而，狂暴法师是一个有趣的案例，因为她对待魔法的方式基于魔法的原始激情，而非那种学究式的准科学方法。

狂暴法师挖掘魔法的原始本质，利用自身天生的愤怒和狂乱，以华丽，张扬的方式引导奥术力量。如同野蛮人一样，狂暴法师往往是较不文明社会的产物。所有狂暴法师都必须至少有一些野蛮人（或其他提供狂怒或狂乱能力的职业）的背景，以及作为法师，术士或 -- 极为罕见地 -- 吟游诗人的训练。

狂暴法师通常与野蛮人一起行动。他们倾向于避开传统施法者，并回避这类人通常聚集的学院和公会。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 武器和防具擅长：狂暴法师不获得任何武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：
要成为狂暴法师，角色必须满足以下所有条件。

阵营：任何非守序。
基础攻击加值：+4。
专长：战斗施法。
法咒：能够施放2级奥术。
特殊：狂怒或狂乱能力。

职业特性：

等级
1：法咒狂怒 1次/天 - 在狂怒状态下施放防护，咒法，塑能，死灵或变化学派的法咒时，狂暴法师使用她的角色等级作为施法者等级。暂时受到-2护甲等级惩罚。狂怒结束时，角色会陷入疲乏。
2：克服法咒失败 - 穿着轻甲或中甲时，奥术法咒失败率降低10%.
3：狂怒 +1次/天 - 额外使用狂怒能力。
4：-
5：法咒狂怒 2次/天
    愤怒法咒 - 防护，咒法，塑能，死灵或变化学派法咒的豁免DC获得+2加值。
6：-
7：法咒狂怒 - 每次狂怒期间可使用一次即时强效法咒。
8：狂怒 +1次/天 - 额外使用狂怒能力。
9：不倦狂怒 - 狂怒结束时不再陷入疲乏。
10：战士之吼 - 角色获得谭森变形术的好处，但不会失去施法能力，1次/天。
    法咒狂怒 3次/天

额外法咒

狂暴法师每提升两个等级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同她在其最高奥术施法职业上也提升了一级。然而，通过此能力不会学到新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
At first, it seems like a contradiction -- an arcane spellcaster that "loses herself" in a blind fury. Yet, the rage mage makes for an interesting case, since her approach to magic is based on the primal passion of magic more than the studious quasi-scientific approach.

A rage mage taps into the primal essence of magic, using her own natural anger and frenzy to channel the arcane power in flashy, flamboyant ways. Like the barbarian, the rage mage is often the product of a less civilized society. All rage mages must have at least some background as a barbarian (or some other class that grants a rage or frenzy ability), as well as training as a wizard, sorcerer, or -- very rarely -- a bard.

Rage mages are usually found working with barbarians. They tend to shy away from traditional spellcasters and avoid the colleges and guilds where such individuals usually gather.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: Rage mages gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
To qualify to become a rage mage, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Alignment: Any nonlawful.
Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Feat: Combat Casting.
Spells: Able to cast 2nd-level arcane spells.
Special: Rage or frenzy ability.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Spell Rage 1/day - When casting a spell from abjuration, conjuration, evocation, necromancy or transmutation school while in a rage, the rage mage uses her character level as her caster level. Temporarily takes -2 penalty to Armor Class. At the end of the rage, the character is fatigued.
2: Overcome Spell Failure - arcane spell failure reduced by 10% while wearing light or medium armor.
3: Rage +1 use/day - additional use of rage ability.
4: -
5: Spell Rage 2/day
    Angry Spell - +2 bonus to the save DC for spells form abjuration, conjuration, evocation, necromancy or transmutation school.
6: -
7: Spell Fury - sudden empower spell usable once during each rage.
8: Rage +1 use/day - additional use of rage ability.
9: Tireless Rage - no longer fatigued at the end of the rage.
10: Warrior Cry - the character receives benefits of the Tenser's Transformation spell, but without losing her spellcasting ability, 1/day.
    Spell Rage 3/day

BONUS SPELLS

Every other level in Rage Mage, the character gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their highest Arcane spellcasting class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

dst: 这本书既试图记录为善良阵营神祇和崇高事业而使用军事力量的历史，也试图反驳那些声称这种使用本质上自相矛盾或至少作为一般规则不可取的人。作者认为，邪恶仆从的暴力活动必将要求善良一方出于自卫而做出回应，而且如果我们接受战争可以为国家存亡——在作者看来是相对微不足道的事情——而合理化，那么当它被用于侍奉神祇或推进恩赐这样神圣而崇高的目标时，无疑就更加合理了。自然，有许多人对圣战的想法感到不安，因此出现了许多官方和非官方的压制此书的尝试。结果，此书的副本很难获得。愿意以近乎狂热的热情投身于并为之战斗的冒险者可能会发现这本书是一本有用的指南。\n\n注意：使用这本书将给予玩家一些经验值，其数量与玩家的等级成反比。这本特定的书将主要惠及以对神祇或事业极度虔诚为特征的职业：牧师、武僧、圣武士、托姆勇士和矮人防御者，其他职业只能获得少量经验值。
src: This book seeks both to record the history of the use of military force in the service of good-aligned deities and noble causes, and refute those who claim that such use is inherently self-contradictory or at least undesirable as a general rule. The author argues that the violent activities of servants of evil will inevitably require those of good to respond in self-defense, and that if we accept that war can be justified for the survival of nations, in the author's view a comparatively trivial matter, surely it is even more justified when employed for causes as holy and noble as service to a deity or the advancement of virtue. Naturally there are many who are uncomfortable with the idea of holy wars and as a result there have been a number of attempts, both official and unofficial, to suppress this work. Copies of it are hard to come by as a result. Adventurers with a willingness to devote themselves to, and fight for, a cause greater than themselves with something approaching fanaticism may find this book a helpful guide.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide some experience to the player, the amount being inversely proportional to his level. This particular book will primarily benefit classes characterised by intense devotion to a deity or cause: clerics, monks, paladins, Champions of Torm, and Dwarven Defenders, with other classes receiving only a slight XP gain.

src: "Well, again, maybe I shouldn't be the one saying this, but sometimes there are more choices available than one might think. I've often gotten into arguments with my fellow Harpers when I've tried to point out that there's more than one approach to a problem than the obvious one they've decided on. You might want to be alert for opportunities along those lines. Speaking of which, I have one minor opportunity to offer myself. I have some contacts among the shadier elements of society, some people not all my Harper comrades would accept dealing with, but you seem like someone who isn't excessively rigid about how you get things done, so perhaps you would. I have some things for sale that you might not find in more respectable markets, as well as contacts who will buy most anything. Perhaps you would be interested in doing a little trading?"

dst: 哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动袭击，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，他还有另一个任务要我在期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采用何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我拜访了他的庄园而受到启发，联系了哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服在一件与卡洛玛斯有关的事情上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多询问他们的情况）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。\n\n结果发现，营地遭到了与龙教有关的吸血鬼的袭击。我们追踪吸血鬼到了他们的基地，杀死了他们，并赶走了他们合作的那条龙类。此事已报告给哈马德，他因我解决了此事而奖励了我。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. \n\nIt turned out the camp was being attacked by vampires associated with the Cult of the Dragon. We tracked the vampires to their base and slew them, and drove off the dragon they were working with. This has been reported to Hamad, who rewarded me for resolving this matter.

Descriptors: None

Incarnum coalesces around your body into a sheath of gray mist. It hangs about you like a thick fog that moves with you, creating the illusion that you are drifting over the ground rather than walking. This robe of mist masks your true location, protecting you from ranged attacks.

Your fellmist robe provides you with minor concealment (10% miss chance) against ranged attacks.

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested in your fellmist robe improves the concealment slightly, increasing the miss chance by 5% (up to a maximum of 50%).

Your fellmist robe draws closer to your body, at the same time growing denser and shrouding your form more effectively-even against adjacent foes.

Your fellmist robe provides its concealment against melee and ranged attackers.

dst:
在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队派人搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续著作时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。如果我发现了什么，我可以去商业区东北部她家中向她报告。

经过大量调查，我发现了阿拉达尔·哈辛的下落。他被巫妖泰罗兹·甘抓走了，后者显然是扭曲符文的成员，反对他的调查。然而，同样属于该符文的另一条龙巫妖辩称，他的死亡或失踪只会引来不必要的关注，比仅仅允许他发表他的故事所引来的关注更多，因为如果没有像失踪这样的事件所引发的宣传，他的故事很可能会被忽视或不被相信。两个巫妖同意直接放了他。

阿拉达尔动身回家了。我跟着他去了那里，并从他妻子那里领取了我的报酬。经过许多波折，这件事已经解决了。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

After much investigation, I have discovered the fate of Aladar Hasin. He was captured by the lich Teroz Gan, apparently a member of the Twisted Rune, who objected to his investigation. However, a dracolich also belonging to the Rune argued that his death or disappearance would only bring unwanted attention, more than would be brought on if he were simply permitted to publish his stories, which are likely to be ignored or disbelieved absent the publicity that would be generated by something like a disappearance. The two liches agreed to simply free him.

Aladar departed for his home. I followed him there and collected my reward from his wife. After many complications, this matter has been resolved.

src:
The epic Warchief becomes the stuff of legend, feared and revered by entire nations. His warcries shake enemy lines, and his presence alone can rally tribes to conquer cities and kingdoms. As he grows in power, his influence spreads like wildfire, turning even the most fractured clans into an unstoppable force. Epic Warchiefs inspire absolute loyalty and demand unquestioning obedience, forging empires from chaos and blood.

Hit Die: d8
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Int Modifier

Ability Boost: the epic Warchief's Charisma bonus continues to grow by +2 every four levels.

Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Leadership, Epic Prowess, Epic Reputation, Epic Superior Initiative, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Fast Healing, Great Constitution, Legendary Commander, Mighty Rage, Overwhelming Critical, Terrifying Rage, Thundering Rage.

src: The harbormaster has told me that there is some sort of trouble brewing on a merchant vessel named the Wave Runner, with some of its crew apparently threatening violence and mutiny. Upon speaking to the captain, I found that some of the sailors feel they should be paid extra on account of the unusual troubles the Wave Runner ran into on its last voyage. One of them has a Fireball scroll and is threatening to set the sails on fire if the captain fails to comply with his demands.\n\nThe disgruntled sailor proved uncooperative and I had to use force to stop him. Not ideal, but the best I could do. This should be reported to the harbormaster.

dst: "是的。我曾与精灵们一起生活过一段时间，学到了许多精灵的技艺。我学会了魔法的基础，以及歌唱和诗歌的基本功。但最重要的是，我学会了箭术，并证明自己相当擅长。当我在弓术上达到了一定程度的精通后，我决定出发去追猎蛇人，无论它们可能在哪里，因为我希望不再有其他村庄遭受我村庄所遭遇的命运。精灵们试图劝阻我走上这条路，担心这只会导致我的死亡，但当他们清楚我的决心不可动摇时，他们帮助了我，给了我至今仍携带的这把弓。从那以后，我一直用它来杀死蛇人。"
src: "Yes. I spent some time living with the elves, gaining much knowledge of the elven arts. I learned the rudiments of magic, as well as the basics of song and poetry. But most important of all I learned the art of archery, at which I proved quite skilled. Once I had gained some degree of mastery with the bow, I determined to set out to hunt down Yuan-ti wherever they might be found, for I hoped that no other villages would suffer the fate that befell mine. The elves tried to dissuade me from this path, fearing it would only lead to my own death, but when it was clear my resolve was unshakable, they aided me by giving me the bow I still carry. Ever since, I have been using it to slay Yuan-ti."

src: The Beholder Merchant Gaurash Vraktar has indicated he might know of a way for me to return to the surface, but will not release this information for free. He expects me to find the three pieces of a broken magical item known as Maghaurezh's Beholder Band. One of these pieces can currently be found in a Beholder Colony to the south, and another is in the possession of Mind Flayers who can be found in a stronghold to the north. The third has been acquired by Kuo Toa who have a base to the east. None of these factions is likely to be willing to part with their piece of the item, or indeed to react to my appearance with anything other than full-fledged hostility, so recovering the pieces will surely require some fighting.\n\nAll three pieces of Maghaurezh's Beholder Band have been found and returned to Gaurash. In return, the Beholder merchant has told me that he can start me on a path leading out of the Underdark, by transporting me to another plane that begins a path back here closer to the surface. He will transport me whenever I am ready.

Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: 30ft
Area: 30ft
Duration: Instantaneous

You throw your weapon through the air, sending it flying end over end to strike with uncanny accuracy and terrible force. It leaves it its wake a trail of battered enemies.

You deal damage to each creature in the maneuver's area equal to your normal melee damage (including damage from Strength modifier, feats, magical abilities on your weapon, and so forth), plus an extra 12d6 points of damage. Your weapon automatically returns to your hand at the end of the round.

dst: 在扎泽斯普尔的伊尔梅特神殿“泪之屋”地下，我遇到了一个名叫尼尔瓦·瓦尔切扎的人，一位伊尔梅特圣武士，她正守卫着抵御来自城市下方幽暗地域洞穴的威胁。在那里，她发现了一道由负能量构成的黑暗屏障，它正在扩张，并将幽暗地域的生物转化为亡灵怪物。她已确定，要穿透这道屏障到达其后方邪恶的假定源头，需要一颗游荡者之石，一种常用于传送魔法的稀有宝石。如果我在冒险途中遇到一颗游荡者之石，把它带给她可能是个好主意。\n\n我给尼尔瓦带了一颗游荡者之石，并且也同意陪伴她，帮助她对抗黑暗屏障后方的任何邪恶，既然现在它可以被穿透了。要到达屏障，我们应该穿过尼尔瓦设置的结界门，使用她持有的钥匙，并一直向下前进，直到最终到达一个巨大的幽暗地域洞穴。在那里我们应该向东北方向前进，直到到达黑暗屏障。据尼尔瓦说，屏障周围会定期出现和消失一些发光的光点。我们应该靠近其中一个并与之互动，然后尼尔瓦就可以使用游荡者之石传送到另一边。
src: Beneath the House of Tears, a Temple of Ilmater in Zazesspur, I encountered one Nierva Var'cheza, a Paladin of Ilmater who is standing guard against a menace originating in the underdark caverns below the city. There she found a dark barrier of negative energy that is expanding and transforming creatures of the Underdark into Undead monstosities. She has determined that penetrating this barrier to reach the presumed source of this evil beyond it will require a Rogue Stone, a rare gem often used in teleportation magics. If I come across a Rogue Stone in the course of my adventures, it might be a good idea to bring it to her.\n\nI brought Nierva a Rogue Stone, and have also agreed to accompany her and aid her against whatever evil lies beyond the dark barrier, now that it can be penetrated. To reach the barrier, we should go through the warded gate Nierva set up, using the key she possesses, and keep heading downwards, until we eventually reach a large Underdark cavern. There we should proceed northeast until we reach the dark barrier. According to Nierva, there are glowing lights that appear and disappear around the barrier regularly. We should approach and interact with one, and Nierva can then use the Rogue Stone to transport to the other side.

dst: 纳什凯尔集市上一个名叫泽鲁博·泽德洛的侏儒设置了一台机器，有可能用来制造有用的灵药。要使用它，必须将炼金试剂放入机器，然后操作附近的一个拉杆，使用需要花费100金币。如果机器中放入了合适的试剂组合，里面就会生成一瓶灵药，我可以自由取用。然而，不合适的组合会消耗试剂和金币而毫无效果，甚至可能产生危险的爆炸。适合尝试的试剂包括火甲虫腹、妖精尘、食人魔蛛腺体、软泥或泥怪的脓液、沼莓、石化蜥蜴的眼睛、石像鬼头骨和蓝石英水晶。\n\n泽鲁博要么不知道，要么不愿透露哪些具体组合会奏效，但他给了我两条提示：任何时候都不要将同类型的试剂放入机器超过一份，也不要放入超过组合所需数量的试剂，并尝试三种不同试剂的组合。
src: A gnome at the Nashkel Fair named Zerubo Zedelo has set up a machine that can potentially be used to produce useful elixirs. To use it, one must place alchemcial reagents into the machine, and then operate a nearby lever, which requires the expendinture of 100 gold to use. If an appropriate combination of reagents was present in the machine, an elixir will be created within, which I would be free to take for my own use. However, an inappropriate combination will consume the reagents and gold to no useful effect, and might even produce a dangerous explosion. Appropriate reagents to attempt for this purpose include fire beetle bellys, fairy dust, ettercap glands, the ichor from a slime or ooze, fenberries, basilisk's eyes, gargoyle skulls and blue quartz crystals.\n\nZerubo either does not know or prefers to conceal which specific combinations will work, but has given me two hints: do not put more than one reagent of the same type into the machine at any given time or put in more reagents than are necessary for the combination, and attempt combinations of three separate reagents.

dst:
在尖牙森林深处，人们可以找到曾经是维尔拉城的废墟。这座城市最引人注目的是它由狼人建造并居住。大多数兽化人要么隐匿在人类社会中生活，要么以同类的群体生活在荒野中，其条件仅比它们所变成的动物稍微不那么原始。因此，维尔拉构成了一个非常罕见的例子，即一群兽化人生活在高度文明的水平上。

一个名叫维尔拉的狼人将尖牙森林的所有狼群统一为一个国家，使他得以建立这座以他命名的城市。不幸的是，他在兽化人城市化方面的实验被证明是短暂的，因为这座城市适时地卷入了与神话拉哈拉斯特的战争。这场战争最终导致该城于DR 720年被摧毁。

关于城市废墟的谣言经常在附近地区流传。有人说城市的一部分在另一个位面存留，并且在满月的夜晚，通往那里的界门会出现在废墟中。还有关于通往不同地方的界门或其他形式的奇怪魔法的模糊传闻。人们还经常听到声称，继续居住在森林中的狼人打算重建这座城市，并以此为基础建立一个侵略性的国家。鉴于尖牙森林有多么危险，很少有人前往废墟去查明这些传说是否有任何真实性。
src:
Deep in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, one can find the ruins of what was once the city of Vehlarr. This city was most remarkable in that it was constructed and inhabited by werewolves. Most lycanthropes either live concealed in human society, or live in the wilderness in bands of their own kind, and in conditions only slightly less primitive than those of the animals into which they transform. Vehlarr thus constitutes a very rare examples of a community of lycanthropes living at a high level of civilization.

A werewolf named Vehlarr united all the werewolf packs of the Wood of Sharp Teeth into one nation, allowing him to found the city, which was named after him. Unfortunately, his experiment in lycathropic urbanization proved short-lived, as the city in due course became embroiled in a war with Myth Lharast. This war ultimately resulted in the city's destruction in 720 DR.

Rumors concerning the ruins of the city often circulate in nearby regions. Some say that a portion of the city survives on another plane, and that a portal to it appears in the ruins on nights with a full moon. Vaguer rumors of portals to different places or other forms of strange magic also appear. One also regularly hears claims that the werewolves who continue to inhabit the forest intend to rebuild the city and form an aggressive nation based on it. Given how dangerous the Wood of Sharp Teeth is, it is rare that anyone travels to the ruins to determine whether there is any truth to these tales.

dst:
在击败牛头人海盗的过程中，瓦尔库尔之剑号的船员发现了一些海图，上面标明了其他海盗基地的位置。其中一处是一群人类海盗的基地，他们早就想除掉这群海盗，所以我们的下一站就是他们所在的那座岛。扎拉拉和我自然会参与这次进攻。我们已经航行了好几天，很快就要接近目标了。在与船长交谈、了解我们在即将到来的战斗中担任什么角色时，我得知我们将乘坐小船进行隐秘的夜袭。扎拉拉和我将加入船员主力，进攻海盗的船，而船长本人则率领一支分队袭击海岸。

我们偷偷登上了海盗船，等那边的事看起来已经稳操胜券，便荡下船去，前往海岸支援船长的进攻。船长的队伍已经烧毁了看起来是海盗主要营地的所在，并在我们的帮助下击败了一些海盗。此事完成后，船长建议我们探索岛上其余的地方，看看是否还能找到更多海盗。在探索过程中，我们发现了一系列洞穴，看起来被海盗用作基地。这值得进一步调查，因为很可能还有一些海盗幸存者仍在附近（更不用说还有大量海盗宝藏了）。

在探索洞穴时，我们发现了证据，表明这群海盗由一名纯血蛇人担任船长，并被用来推进蛇人的目的。船长和几个蛇人盟友仍在某处，应该将他们追捕除掉。
src:
In the process of defeating the minotaur pirates, the Sword of Valkur's crew discovered some charts indicating the locations of other pirate bases. One of them is the base of a group of human pirates they have long been hoping to put out of business, so our next stop will be the island where they can be found. Naturally Zarala and I will be taking part in this assault. We have been sailing for several days and will soon be approaching our target. Upon speaking to the captain to discover our part in the upcoming battle, I learned that we would be making a stealthy night assault in small craft. Zarala and I will join the main body of the crew in an assault on the pirates' ship, while the captain himself leads a secondary attack on the shore.

We snuck on board the pirate vessel and, once that work seemed well in hand, swung off the ship and went to the shore to support the captain's assault. The captain's party had burned what appeared to be the main pirate encampment, and defeated some of the pirates about with our help. With that done, the captain suggested that we explore the rest of the island to see if there are any more pirates to be found. In the process of doing so, we have discovered a series of caves that appears to be used as a base by the pirates. This merits further investigation, as there may well be some pirate survivors still about (not to mention a lot of pirate treasure).

Exploring the caves, we came across evidence that this group of pirates is captained by a Yuan-ti pureblood, and being used to further the ends of the Yuan-ti. The captain and a few Yuan-ti allies are still around somewhere, and should be hunted down.

dst: 索里克是一位技艺精湛的矮人铁匠，但为了谋生，他常常不得不批量生产武器和盔甲，无法在这些作品上投入他想要的时间。尽管以大多数铁匠的标准来看，即便是他的日常作品也属上乘，但索里克追求的是更高的境界。他时不时会抽出时间来打造一件真正的铁匠艺术杰作，使用精金等稀有材料。这些努力的成果之一便是这把精良的战斧，由索里克为纪念自己的矮人血统而打造。据传，摩拉丁本人对打造这把武器所展现的工艺印象深刻，便赐予了它祝福，使其对任何企图伤害矮人的人都格外致命。
src: Thorik is a skilled dwarven smith, but the demands of making a living often force him to produce weapons and armor in quantity, on which he cannot spend as much time as he would like. While even his routine work is of high-quality by the standards of most smiths, Thorik aspires to more. Every now and then he seeks out time to devote to the production a true masterpiece of the smith's art, employing rare materials like adamantine. One result of these efforts is this fine Waraxe, made by Thorik in honor of his dwarven heritage. It is rumored that Moradin himself was sufficiently impressed by the craftsmanship employed in making this weapon that he conferred a blessing upon it, making it exceptionally deadly against anyone seeking to harm a dwarf.

You can sense the presence of chaos. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area or subject:

3rd Round: The strength and location of each aura. If an aura is outside your line of sight, then you discern its direction but not its exact location.

src:
Lucky Dice

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Incarnate, Soulborn 
Chakra: Hands
Saving Throw: None

With a flick of your wrist, you send two cubes spinning out of your open palm. With a flash, the dice disappear a moment after they stop rolling, and you sense that your luck is changing.

You can use your lucky dice as a swift action, choosing an aspect of yourself to which to apply extra luck. You gain a +1 luck bonus on one of the following, at your option: attack rolls and damage rolls, saving throws, or skill and ability checks. This bonus lasts until the start of your next turn. When using this meld, roll 2d6. If the result is any combination of numbers that add up to 7, the luck bonus applies to all of the listed types of rolls. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested in the lucky dice at the time you activate its special ability increases the duration of the luck bonus by 1 round. Because lucky dice can be rolled every round, it's possible for the soulmeld to provide bonuses to more than one type of check during a given round. 
 
Chakra Bind (Hands)

Your comrades fight better when luck is on their side.

Your lucky dice provide their bonus to all allies who are within 30 feet of you when you gain the bonus.

在一场可怕的战争结束时，一位伟大的领主带领他的人民进入前古代帝国的伟大森林，以寻求庇护，躲避流浪的恶魔和肆虐大地的魔法瘟疫。古老森林的某种力量，无论是年长的树人还是更伟大的存在，面对难民并拒绝给予他们安全，除非他们放弃召唤恶魔的方式，并以森林的血液为自己的血液。领主当场同意，因此难民们为了安全放弃了人性，成为了沃洛德尼。在形状上他们仍然像人类，但他们的皮肤是松针的深橄榄绿色，木质且坚韧。他们以树液为血，头发长成浓密的发绺，像幼树上的树皮一样有鳞片。他们的眼睛是闪亮的黑色，他们往往高大瘦削。他们往往冷漠而冷静，相信目的证明手段，并以森林本身的耐心进行他们的任务。对于有时被称为“松树民”的他们来说，森林就是一切。

- 技能亲和（森林躲藏）：在森林中躲藏时+4种族加值。
- 抗穿刺：天生50%穿刺抗力。
- 植物免疫：免疫睡眠，麻痹，毒素，影响心智效果和重击。
- 植物：在法咒效果方面，沃洛德尼视为植物。

src:
At the end of a terrible war, a great lord led his people into the great forests of the former ancient empire to seek refuge from the roving demons and magical plagues ravaging the lands.  Some power of the old woods, whether an elder treant or something greater, confronted the refugees and denied them safety unless they forswore their demon-summoning ways and took on the forests' blood for their own.  The lord agreed on the spot, and thus the refugees gave up their humanity for safety, becoming the Volodni.  In shape they still resemble humans, but their skin is the deep olive green of a pine needle, and is woody and tough.  They bear sap for blood, and their hair grows in long, thick locks scaled like bark on a young tree.  Their eyes are gleaming black and they tend to be tall and wiry.  They tend to be cold and dispassionate, believing the ends serve the means, and go about their tasks with the patience of the forest itself.  To the "pine folk" as they are sometimes known, the forest is everything.

Volodni Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, +2 Wis, -2 Int, -2 Cha.

src: "Of course having our own spell-casting abilities taken out and our magical gear rendered ineffective will cause us problems too, but the goblins will have the same disadvantage. With equal gear the advantage should lie with adventurers of our experience. What's more, I've got a couple of holy runestones that'll continue to function even in the midst of dead magic, which will mitigate the effects for us a bit. There are a lot of goblins with this Moguz, though, some of them a lot more capable than average, so I didn't think I could take them all out myself. Four veteran adventurers should be enough to cut through any number of goblins, though."

dst: "我是在人类中长大的，从未与其他蛇人有过任何瓜葛。因此我没有被灌输他们的阴谋。蛇人有时会绑架人类，强迫他们参与其繁育计划。我的母亲就是这样的受害者之一。通常情况下，蛇人纯血或混血后代的父母在产下所需子嗣后就会被杀害，但我的母亲不知怎么设法逃脱了，尽管是在怀上我之后。她如何逃脱的我不太清楚，因为她不愿谈及那段往事。后来有人指责她以某种方式与蛇人合作才得以获释，但我不认为任何认识她的人会相信这种事。"
src: "I was raised among humans, and never had anything to do with other yuan-ti. Thus I was not indoctrinated into their schemes. Yuan-ti sometimes kidnap humans and force them to participate in their breeding programs. My mother was one such victim. Normally the human parents of Yuan-ti pure or halfbloods are slain after producing the desired offspring, but my mother somehow managed to escape, albeit only after becoming pregnant with me. How she escaped I am not sure, since she did not like to speak of that incident. Later some were to accuse her of cooperating with the yuan-ti in some way to effect her release, but I do not see how any who knew her could believe that."

To wander unseen, unnoticed that is the desire of all who dislike unwanted attention. With a casting of this spell, the subject gains the permanent ability to willfully turn either invisible or visible on a whim*. This ability can be used as often as wanted, and never requires anything more than a thought to activate the invisibility (or deactivate it).

src: The original version of these boots were said to be worn by the wise wanderer, Teki Jin, of Kara-Tur. As he traveled and grew in strength, Teki was joined by students who would follow in his path. When a student left to travel their own path, Teki would pass his old boots to his student, to remind them that every path under the sun should be walked in the wisdom of the past. After his death, many copies of his boots would show up in stores, each supposedly handed down from Teki to a student. Even if these copies are nothing more than clever forgeries, they do seem to assist the wearer in avoiding enemy attacks.

dst:
心灵传送（传送）
等级：心灵术士/狂念者 4，心灵武士 4
显能时间：1 标准动作
距离：远距（400 尺 + 40 尺/等级）
目标或目标：你以及接触的物体或其他接触的自愿生物
持续时间：立即
豁免检定：无
灵能抗力：否
异能点：7
超能：无

你瞬间将自己从当前位置转移到范围内任何其他地点。你总是精确到达期望的地点 - 无论是通过简单想象该区域还是通过说明方向**.你还可以每三个显能者等级携带一个额外的自愿中型或更小生物或其等效物。一个大型生物算作两个中型生物，一个超大型生物算作两个大型生物，依此类推。所有要被传送的生物必须与你接触。*

备注：
* 由于 NWN 位置追踪代码的可爱品质，实现为在你 10 尺范围内。
** 方向与你相对于你瞄准法咒的方向相同。将创建一个听众，以便你可以说出距离。
src:
Psychoportation (Teleportation)
Level: Psion/wilder 4, psychic warrior 4
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target or Targets: You and touched objects or other touched willing creatures
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: No
Power Points: 7
Metapsionics: None

You instantly transfer yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You always arrive at exactly the spot desired - whether by simply visualizing the area or by stating direction**. You may also bring one additional willing Medium or smaller creature or its equivalent per three manifester levels. A Large creature counts as two Medium creatures, a Huge creature counts as two Large creatures, and so forth. All creatures to be transported must be in contact with you. *

Notes:
* Implemented as within 10ft of you due to the lovely quality of NWN location tracking code.
** The direction is the same as the direction of where you target the spell relative to you. A listener will be created so you can say the distance.

Crafting a rune costs Spell level * Caster level * 50 in gold pieces for a normal caster (half the base cost of Spell level * Caster level * 100), and Spell level * Caster level * 25 for a Runecaster (half again). It also takes XP equal to 1/25th of the base cost. If you cannot pay the casting cost or the XP loss would drop you a level, the crafting will fail, and the spell will be lost. Crafting the rune requires a craft check vs DC 20 + Spell Level. If the craft check fails, the spell is lost, but the caster does not pay the gold and experience. A rune is permanent until used, and all spells are centred on the user.

dst: "嗯，他是几个世纪前在泰瑟尔活动的著名半身人冒险者，来自一个叫东境村的村庄。东境村的历史之所以有趣有两个原因。其一是在他冒险的某个时候，维多找到了一件魔法神器，他用它在自己的村庄周围设立了一道保护性魔法场，以抵御兽人、地精和其他这类人形生物的袭击。这道魔法场使得除半身人外任何人都无法进入那个地方。其二是，维多退休回到村庄后不久，尽管有这道魔法场和他的存在，某种灾难还是降临了那里，大部分居民被杀，其余的人逃离了，留下了关于某种不死恐怖袭击的含糊报告。那地方从此就被废弃了。"
src: "Well, he was well-known halfling adventurer who operated in Tethyr a few centuries ago, and he came from a village called Eastmarch. The history of Eastmarch is interesting for two reasons. One is that at some point in his adventures Vido found a magical artifact that he used to set up a protective magical field around his village to protect it from raids by orcs, goblins, and other such humanoids. This field made it impossible for anyone but a halfling to enter the place. The second is that shortly after Vido retired and returned to his village, and in spite of both this field and his presence, some disaster overtook it, most of the inhabitants were slain, with the rest fleeing, giving garbled reports of some sort of attack by an undead horror. The place has remained abandoned ever since."

You call upon the forces of good, and a heavy rain begins to fall
around you, its raindrops soft and warm.

A driving rain falls around you. It falls in a fixed area once 
created. The storm reduces hearing and visibility, resulting in a 
-4 penalty on Listen, Spot, and Search checks. It also applies a
-4 penalty on ranged attacks made into, out of, or through the 
storm. Finally, it automatically extinguishes any unprotected 
flames and has a 50% chance to extinguish protected flames 
(such as those of lanterns).

The rain damages evil creatures, dealing 2d6 points of damage 
per round (evil outsiders take double damage) at the beginning
of your turn.

Material Component: A flask of holy water (25 gp).

dst:
萨曼·瓦拉迪告诉我，如果我想找活干，就应该去找一个叫纳马尔·萨拉坎的人，他是“闪耀探寻者”号的船长，目前可以在码头区找到他。这位萨拉坎船长显然想要一位冒险者帮忙调查他发现的一件神秘神器。萨曼已经向他提过我可能是合适的人选，所以他应该已经准备好在我提出愿意帮忙时接受我的协助。

我已经和萨拉坎船长谈过，并了解了一些他交给我的任务。他找到了一种魔法手段，可以制造一道通往某处水下废墟的界门，并希望我帮忙探索那里。我和任何穿过界门（或之后被召唤过去）的同伴都会获得防止溺水的魔法保护。这种保护会持续四个小时，而且在完成任务之前我不应该穿过界门返回，因为那会破坏法咒。在水下行动会让我变慢，并降低攻击效果，阻止使用远程武器，并使任何涉及火焰的法咒效果变得非常有限（往好了说也是如此）。我只要准备好就可以直接进入界门。必要法咒会在穿过时自动施放。

我在那座水下废墟中找到了一块上面有文字的泥板。虽然我不认识这种语言，但无疑会有学者能够翻译它，并揭示一些关于发现它的那座城市的信息。我把这个带给了萨拉坎船长，他同意这符合他的要求，并给了我所承诺的报酬。
src:
Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.

I have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should simply enter the portal whenever I am ready. The necessary spells will be automatically cast as I go through.

I have located a tablet with writing on it in the undersea ruin. While the language is unknown to me, there are doubtless scholars who could translate it and reveal something about the city where it was found. I brought this to Captain Sarakan, who agreed that it met his requirements and gave me the promised reward.

In addition to being protected by numerous locks and traps that will require considerable skill to get past, it appears most of the Undead guardians are empowered by a magical orb dispensing negative energy. This will cause and wounds inflicted on them to be healed, perhaps damaging those nearby with the energy in the process. They will be most difficult to defeate as a result, and it might be best simply to sneak past them. Though if I can find the orb and somehow neutralize it, that might change.

src:
Abjuration 
Level: Paladin 2, Cleric 3
Components: V, S, DF,
Casting Time: 1 Standard Action
Range: Touch
Target: Shield touched
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

A silver aura surrounds the touched shield for a 
moment before it appears to transform into the chosen 
type of energy. The shield hums with power.

When this spell is cast, the shield touched appears 
to be made entirely out of one type of energy (fire,
cold, electricity, acid, or sonic). Whoever bears the
shield gains resistance 10 against the chosen energy 
type. Additionally, if the wielder successfully hits 
someone with the shield with a shield bash attack, th
e victim takes 2d6 points of the appropriate energy 
damage in addition to the normal shield bash damage.
The energy type must be chosen when the spell is cast 
and cannot be changed during the duration of the spell.
The energy resistance overlaps (and does not stack) 
with resist elements. A given shield cannot be the 
subject of more than one lesser energized shield 
or energized shield spell at the same time.

The descriptor of this spell is the same as the 
energy type you choose when you cast it.

dst:
（进阶职业）
真正明智的冒险者总是警惕徒手对手，因为这样的敌人通常不止表面看起来那样。这样的对手甚至可能是一个夺命铁拳 - 依赖武器技能取胜的角色最可怕的噩梦。任何胆敢对夺命铁拳挥舞武器的人最好迅速利用它，因为机会不会持续太久。夺命铁拳是斗坑战士中的断背者，扭肢者和拧颈者。他们是最高阶的擒抱者，在战斗中除了轻甲不穿更重的护甲以最大化灵活性，并且不使用武器来取得他们可怕的胜利，因为他们更喜欢徒手击杀的亲密感。夺命铁拳想要足够接近，以便在粉碎对手生命时用低语嘲讽它，闻到它的恐惧，并看着绝望在对手脸上蔓延，当对手意识到其武器在擒抱中多么无用时。

- 生命骰：d10
- 武器熟练：夺命铁拳不获得额外武器熟练。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础攻击加值：+5
技能：翻滚 5 级
专长：精通徒手打击

职业特性：

等级
1：精通擒抱（Ex）：当穿着轻甲或不穿护甲时，夺命铁拳获得精通擒抱专长的好处，即使他不满足先决条件。
   灵活移动（Ex）：当穿着轻甲或不穿护甲时，夺命铁拳获得灵活移动专长的好处，即使他不满足先决条件。
2：熟练摔跤（Ex）：从 2 级开始，穿着轻甲或不穿护甲的夺命铁拳在所有擒抱检定上获得 +1 加值。此加值在 4 级时增加到 +2。
3：睡眠锁（Ex）：在 3 级时，夺命铁拳学会如何通过压力使对手昏迷。如果角色在擒抱时压制对手并维持压制 1 整轮，对手必须在轮结束时进行强韧豁免（DC 10 + 夺命铁拳的职业等级 + 夺命铁拳的感知调整值） 否则昏迷 1d3 轮。没有可辨别解剖结构的生物对此效果免疫。
5：毁灭性擒抱（Ex）：如果 5 级夺命铁拳在擒抱时压制对手并维持压制连续 3 轮，对手必须在第三轮结束时进行强韧豁免（DC 10 + 夺命铁拳的职业等级 + 夺命铁拳的感知调整值） 否则死亡。没有可辨别解剖结构的生物对此能力的效果免疫
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Truly wise adventurers are always wary of unarmed opponents, for such adversaries are usually more than they seem. Such an opponent might even be a reaping mauler - the worst nightmare of a character who depends on weapon skills to win. Anyone who dares to wield a weapon against a reaping mauler had better make use of it quickly, because the opportunity won't last long. Reaping maulers are the back-breakers, the limb-twisters, and the neck-snappers among pit fighters. Grapplers of the highest order, they wear nothing heavier than light armor in combat to maximize their flexibility, and they use no weapons to achieve their gruesome victories, for they prefer the intimacy of a barehanded kill. A reaping mauler wants to be close enough to taunt his opponent with whispers while crushing the life out of it, to smell its fear, and to watch the despair creep over its face when the opponent realizes just how useless its weapons are during a grapple.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: A reaping mauler gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +5
Skills: Tumble 5 ranks 
Feats: Improved Unarmed Strike 

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Improved Grapple (Ex): When wearing light armor or no armor, a reaping mauler gains the benefit of the Improved Grapple feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites.
   Mobility (Ex): When wearing light armor or no armor, a reaping mauler gains the benefits of the Mobility feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites.
2: Adept Wrestling (Ex): Beginning at 2nd level, a reaping mauler who is wearing light armor or no armor gains a +1 bonus on all grapple checks. This bonus increases to +2 at 4th level.
3: Sleeper Lock (Ex): At 3rd level, a reaping mauler learns how to render an opponent unconscious with pressure. If the character pins his opponent while grappling and maintains the pin for 1 full round, the opponent must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + the reaping mauler's class level + the reaping mauler's Wis modifier) at the end of the round or fall unconscious for 1d3 rounds. A creature with no discernible anatomy has immunity to this effect.
5: Devastating Grapple (Ex): If a 5th-level reaping mauler pins his opponent while grappling and maintains the pin for 3 consecutive rounds, the opponent must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + the reaping mauler's class level + the reaping mauler's Wis modifier) at the end of the third round or die. A creature with no discernible anatomy is immune to the effect of this ability

dst: 现在已经揭露，卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔参与了蜘变形蛛和吞噬之火武僧及其各种盟友蹂躏卡林杉的计划。更甚的是，他最近背叛了自己的反奴隶制计划，泄露了由贾拉尔·马卡希守卫的难民营地（他们实际上是逃跑的奴隶）的位置。他将这一反奴隶制行动的责任归咎于哈马德·加尔哈德尔（后者确实有所参与，派我去帮助保护营地），现在正准备集结力量袭击加尔哈德尔庄园，并得到了城市当局的默许，后者因加尔哈德尔参与非法解救奴隶而转而反对他。泽卡尔的动机尚不清楚，但他构成的威胁很严重。我应该尽快在庄园与哈马德会面，以计划我们的防御，或许还能进一步了解泽卡尔行为背后的原因，这似乎具有莫名其妙的破坏性。
src: It has now been revealed that Kalomas Zekar was involved in the plans of the aranea and the Consuming Fire monks and their various allies to ravage Calimshan. What's more, he has recently betrayed his own anti-slavery project by revealing the location of the camp of refugees (who were in fact escaped slaves) guarded by Jalar Makashi. He has placed the blame for this anti-slavery operation on Hamad Galhadr (who was indeed somewhat involved, sending me to help protect the camp), and is now preparing to gather forces to assault the Galhadr estate, with the tacit approval of the city authorities who have turned against Galhadr due to his involvement with illegal slave-rescuing. Zekar's motives are unclear but the threat he poses is serious. I should meet with Hamad at the estate as soon as possible to plan our defense and perhaps learn more of whatever is behind Zekar's behavior, which seems inexplicably destructive.

You shoot a ray of necromantic energy from your outstretched hand, causing any living creature struck by the ray to violently purge blood vessels through its skin. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to affect the subject. If successful, the subject is reduced to half of its current hit points (rounded down) and stunned for 1 round. On a successful Fortitude saving throw the subject is not stunned.

Also, the purged blood vessels are magically animated, creating a many layered mass of magically strong, adhesive tissue that traps those caught in it... Creatures caught within a 20 foot radius become entangled unless the succeed on a Reflex save. The original target of the spell is automatically entangled.

The entangled creature takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls, -4 to effective Dex, and can't move. An entangled character that attempts to cast a spell must succeed in a concentration check. Because the avascular mass is magically animate, and gradually tightens on those it holds, the Concentration check DC is 30...Once loose, a creature may progress through the writhing blood vessels very slowly.

纳西拉克告诉过我，有一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特修士，是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他修士提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名修士，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅，我之前没有理由注意到它，它通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通向隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我说这也可能很危险。

我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他已经开始了我的训练计划，并给了我几项任务。首先，我要去他洞穴西南角的一个袋子里拿到粗毛衬衣，我在训练期间要穿着它。接下来，他要我从我来这里时穿过的隧道里一具尸体上找到的四件修士装备中拿一件，带到洞穴外的悬崖边，扔进那里的深渊。他相信这将有助于我培养对物质财富的漠不关心。

我已经扔掉了其中一件物品。现在我应该回到伊拉姆大师那里，继续我训练的下一部分。
src:
Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.

I have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and given me a couple of tasks. Firstly, I am to get the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave, which I am to wear during my training. Next, he wants me to take one of four items of monk gear I found on a corpse in the tunnel I traversed coming here, bring it to the cliff outside the cave, and throw it into the chasm there. He believes this will assist me in developing a lack of concern for material possessions.

I have thrown away one of the items. Now I should return to Master Iram for the next part of my training.

酋长领导着一个原始，好战的人形生物部落，尤其是当他们转向劫掠时。酋长凭借其不屈的存在感和可怕的面容，激励他的追随者为部落做出巨大勇气和牺牲的壮举。退缩的部落成员会亲身体会到，酋长的不悦是一种甚至超越战争苦难的恐怖 - 最好在战场上光荣战死，也不愿遭受酋长的折磨惩罚。在杀戮狂热的激励下，酋长和他的队伍将部落的敌人一扫而空。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
A Warchief leads a primitive, aggressive tribe of humanoids, especially when they turned to marauding. The Warchief calls on his indomitable presence and terrible visage to spur his followers to feats of great courage and sacrifice for the tribe. The tribe member who hangs back learns firsthand that the Warchief's displeasure is a terror eclipsing even the hardships of war - better to die in glory on the battlefield than under the Warchief's torturous punishments. Inspired into a killing frenzy, the Warchief and his band sweep the enemies of the tribe before their onslaught.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: A Warchief gains no additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Base Attack Bonus: +3.

CLASS FEATURES:
Level

4:
5: Tribal Frenzy +6
6: Ability Boost +4

9: Tribal Frenzy +10

Nevertheless, suspicions were eventually raised concerning me, I am not entirely sure how, and a magical investigation confirmed that I was indeed Yuan-ti. In some places, I might have been given a fair hearing or a chance at an explanation, but as I have said, that is not to be counted on in that region of the world where serpents are concerned. I had to flee to save my life."

当你施放地震术时，一场强烈但高度局部化的震动撕裂地面。冲击将生物击倒，使建筑倒塌，在地面打开裂缝等等。地震术影响区域内的所有地形，植被，建筑和生物。

区域内的每个生物必须始终进行 DC 15 反射豁免，否则倒地。地震术的额外效果取决于施放处地形的性质。

洞穴，巨洞或隧道；建筑：法咒使屋顶坍塌，对任何被坠落瓦砾击中的生物造成 8d6 点钝击伤害（反射 DC 15 减半）.

When you cast earthquake, an intense but highly localized tremor rips the ground. The shock knocks creatures down, collapses structures, opens cracks in the ground, and more. The earthquake affects all terrain, vegetation, structures, and creatures in the area.

Each creature standing in the area must always make a DC 15 Reflex save or fall down. Additional effects of an earthquake spell depend on the nature of the terrain where it is cast.

Open Ground: Fissures open in the earth, and every creature on the ground has a 25% chance to fall into one (Reflex DC 20 to avoid a fissure). At the end of the spell, all fissures grind shut, killing any creatures trapped within.

Cave, Cavern, or Tunnel; Structure: The spell collapses the roof, dealing 8d6 points of bludgeoning damage to any creature caught under the falling rubble (Reflex DC 15 half ).

This abjuration grants a creature limited protection from 
damage of whichever one of five energy types you select: 
acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The subject gains 
energy resistance 10 against the energy type chosen, meaning 
that each time the creature is subjected to such damage 
(whether from a natural or magical source), that damage is 
reduced by 10 points before being applied to the creature's
hit points. The value of the energy resistance granted increases
to 20 points at 7th level and to a maximum of 30 points at 11th
level. The spell protects the recipient's equipment as well.

dst: “不幸的是，这些并不是守卫通往烛堡之路的全部冒险者。西北方不远处还有另一队人。我没有直接和他们合作，所以他们不像这些人那么信任我，而且他们从不会同时睡着，所以我觉得没法独自偷偷杀光他们。但我们所有人一起应该能迅速杀穿他们，在龙出现之前赶到烛堡——那本该是终极防御。有一条名叫克拉卡奇’弗拉兹’塔尔的蓝龙经常在这附近盘旋，希望能找到你。如果我们运气好，应该能在他出现之前穿过现在已被削弱的封锁线。”
src: "Unfortunately, these weren't all the adventurers guarding the path to Candlekeep. There's another group a little way to the northwest. I wasn't direclty working with them so they didn't trust me as much as these, and they're never all asleep at the same time, so I didn't think I could sneakily kill all of them by myself. But all of us together should be able to quickly fight through them and get to Candlekeep before the dragon shows up - that was supposed to be the ultimate defense. There's a blue dragon named Krakach'vraz'tar whose been regularly hovering around here, hoping to find you. If we're lucky we should be able to get through the now weakened cordon before he shows up."

dst: 用寒铁锻造的武器对塔那厘格外有效。其中许多来自科米尔，因为该国在魔鬼龙战争期间为装备紫龙军团而大量生产它们，寒铁武器是唯一能有效对抗加兹奈斯的类型。大约200年前，当这座大图书馆被迫抵御一群邪恶生物以夺回一本详述大恶魔埃加托尔囚禁经过的巨著时，也曾为烛堡的守军生产了许多此类武器。无论来自这些还是其他来源，此类武器在剑湾一带已变得越来越常见。
src: Weapons forged from cold iron are especially effective against Tanar'ri. Many of them come from Cormyr, since that nation mass-produced them to equip the Purple Dragons in the war of the Devil Dragon, as cold iron weapons were the only type effective against ghazneths. Many were also produced for the garrioson of Candlekeep about 200 years ago, when the great library was forced to defend itself against a horde of malevolent creatures seeking to recover a tome detailing the circumstances of the imprisonment of the great fiend Aegatohl. Whether from these or other sources, such weapons have been getting increasingly common around the Sword Coast.

保护进行宗教朝圣的旅人是医护骑士的职责。多年来，这一单一职责已扩展至包括建造和管理医院及难民设施。医护骑士是一支出于需要的战斗力量，宣誓守贫，服从，并保护受其照料之人。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
It is the duty of knights Hospitaler to protect people traveling on religious pilgrimages. Over the years, this single duty has expanded to include the construction and administration of hospitals and refugee facilities. Hospitalers are a fighting force of necessity, sworn to poverty, obedience, and the defense of those in their care.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: Hospitalers are proficient in all simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS

Alignment: Any non chaotic.
Base Attack Bonus: +4
Skills: Ride 5 ranks, Heal 5 ranks.
Feats: Mounted Combat, Mounted Archery

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Lay on Hands - If Hospitaler has positive Charisma modifier, then she can cure a number of hit points equal to her Charisma modifier x Hospitaler level.
3: Turn Undead - Hospitaler's level and Charisma are used to determine how many hit die of undead are turned, can be used three times a day, plus Charisma modifier.
  Remove Disease - As per the Cleric spell once per day.
  Bonus Feat.
5: Bonus Feat
7: Bonus Feat
9: Bonus Feat

BONUS DIVINE SPELLS

Every level in Hospitaler, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

src: Humans captured by serpentfolk are sometimes put through a magical ritual intended to transform them into Yuan-Ti. When the ritual fails, as it often does (because of the unworthiness of those undergoing it, at least according to the Yuan-ti), histachii are produced instead. These are almost mindless, zombie-like reptilian monsters, used by the Yuan-Ti for guard duty or other simple tasks.

受术者的手从一只手臂上撕裂下来，留下一个血淋淋的残肢。这种创伤造成 6d6 点伤害。然后这只手被活化并漂浮在空中，开始攻击受术者。这只手在属性，特殊攻击和特殊品质方面如同一个尸妖
（见怪物图鉴） 般攻击，但它被视为微型并额外获得 +4 的 AC
加值和 +4 的攻击检定加值。这只手可以像尸妖一样被驱散或斥退。如果这只手被击败，只有再生术才能让受害者恢复正常。
src:
Grim Revenge
Necromancy [Evil]
Level: Sor/Wiz 4
Components: V, S, Undead (caster must be undead)
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: One living humanoid
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

The hand of the subject tears itself away from one of his arms, leaving a bloody stump. This trauma deals 6d6 points of damage. Then the hand, animated and floating in the air, begins to attack the subject. The hand attacks as if it were a wight
(see the Monster Manual) in terms of its statistics, special attacks, and special qualities, except that it is considered Tiny and gains a +4 bonus to AC
and a +4 bonus on attack rolls. The hand can be turned or rebuked as a wight. If the hand is defeated, only a regenerate spell can restore the victim to normal.

Likely to be dangerous. Naturally if we try that, this portal, on the Prime Material Plane, should be shut down last so the portal will not close while we're in the Abyss, trapping us."

dst:
（进阶职业）
龙类常常需要专业的仆从来充当它们在类人生物社会中的眼，耳和手。龙师之手将一生奉献给为单一龙类或为共同目标联合的龙群服务。龙主成为龙师之手的政治和精神领袖，获得他们完全的忠诚。这种服务超越了对国家，教会，家庭或朋友的服从。通常，龙师之手充当间谍和线人，但在需要时，他们也可以成为破坏者和杀手。

- 生命骰：d8
- 武器和防具擅长：龙师之手不获得额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：6 + 智力调整值

要求：
基础攻击加值：+4。
技能：唬骗4级，躲藏4级，潜行4级，学识4级，察言观色4级。
专长：龙触。
特殊：偷袭或散兵 +2d6

职业特性：
1：龙族感知 - 你获得龙族感知作为奖励专长。
2：特殊攻击 +1d6 - 你可以获得+1d6的偷袭伤害或散兵伤害，每次提升时选择。
3：龙火打击 - 你获得龙火打击作为奖励专长。
5：特殊攻击 +2d6
7：主之赠礼 - 所有施放在你身上的非伤害性奥术法咒持续时间加倍。
8：特殊攻击 +3d6
9：精通龙火打击 - 当你使用龙火打击能力时，你的每颗偷袭或散兵伤害骰造成额外一点伤害。
10：真实潜行 - 当激活并潜行时，如果你在躲藏和潜行检定上承受-10减值，你获得+50%隐蔽。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Dragons often need expert servants to be their eyes, ears, and hands in humanoid society.  A hand of the winged masters has dedicated his life to the service of a single dragon or to a group of dragons united in a common cause.  A dragon master becomes the political and spiritual leader for the hands, gaining their total loyalty.  This services rises above obedience to country, church, family, or friends.  Usually, the hands act as spies and informants, but when needed, they can also be saboteurs and killers.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Hand of the Winged Masters gains no additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 6 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:
Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Skills: Bluff 4 ranks, Hide 4 ranks, Move Silently 4 ranks, Lore 4 ranks, Sense Motive 4 ranks.
Feats: Dragontouched.
Special: Sneak Attack or Skirmish +2d6

CLASS FEATURES:
1: Draconic Senses - You gain Draconic Senses as a bonus feat.
2: Special Attack +1d6 - You can gain +1d6 to your Sneak Attack damage or to your Skirmish damage, chosen at every increase.
3: Dragonfire Strike - You gain Dragonfire Strike as a bonus feat.
5: Special Attack +2d6
7: Master's Gift - All non-harmful arcane spells are doubled in duration when cast on you.
8: Special Attack +3d6
9: Improved Dragonfire Strike - When you use your Dragonfire Strike ability, you deal one extra point of damage per sneak attack or skirmish die.
10: True Stealth - When activated and stealthed, if you take a -10 on your Hide and Move Silently checks, you gain +50% concealment.

一个新兴的强大精类种族，麒灵族将自然的耐心和力量与类人种族的野心和侵略性融为一体。世界的古老地方涌动着自身的力量。从这种力量中，麒灵族应运而生，以回应类人种族日益增长的力量。无论是某个伟大的自然神祇的杰作，还是自然本身野性力量的自发创造，麒灵族既年轻又永恒，新近被带到这个世界，但与自然的核心有着不可知的古老联系。作为精类，麒灵族与自然的联系是类人种族无法比拟的，但与其他精类不同，麒灵族不满足于在日益减少的森林的黑暗深处等待。麒灵族是自然存在和力量的侵略性，雄心勃勃的体现，他们像在郁郁葱葱的森林林间空地冥想一样轻松地走过人类的城市。与人类和其他类人种族的人口相比，世界上麒灵族还很少，但他们的数量正在迅速增长。到目前为止，这些适应性强的精类只与致力于破坏自然的邪恶势力发生了孤立的冲突，但很明显他们注定要成就更多。麒灵族已经开始在世界上彰显他们的存在，一些有远见和博学的贤者对他们日益增长的力量和数量所带来的影响感到惊奇。

麒灵族属性调整：无
天赋职业（德鲁伊）：兼职麒灵族的德鲁伊职业在决定他是否因兼职而受到 XP 惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（动物感受情绪）：动物感受情绪检定 +2 种族加值。
- 微光视觉
- 免疫魔法睡眠效果，对抗附魔法咒或效果的豁免 +2 种族加值
- 精类：就法咒而言，麒灵族被视为精类。
- 显现自然之力：每天早晨选择三种形态之一，获得技能加值或破邪斩攻击。
src:
A newly risen race of powerful fey, the killoren blend nature's patience and power with the ambition and aggression of the humanoid races. The ancient places of the world stir with a power of their own. From this power, the killoren have sprung in answer to the growing might of the humanoid races. Whether the work of some great nature deity or the spontaneous creation of the wild power of nature itself, killoren are at once young and eternal, newly brought to the world but with unknowably ancient ties to the heart of nature. As fey, killoren have a tie to nature unmatched by the humanoid races, but unlike other fey, killoren are not content to wait in the dark recesses of the dwindling forests. Killoren are aggressive, ambitious manifestations of nature's presence and power, and they walk through the cities of man as easily as they meditate in the glades of a verdant forest. There are as yet few killoren in the world compared to the population of humans and other humanoid races, but their numbers are quickly growing. So far, these adaptable fey have only come into isolated conflict with evil powers bent on despoiling nature, but it is obvious that they are destined for more. The killoren have begun to make known their presence in the world, and a few far-seeing and learned sages wonder at the implications of their growing power and numbers. 

Killoren Ability Adjustments: None
Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass Killoren's druid class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Animal Empathy): +2 racial bonus to Animal Empathy checks.
- Low Light Vision
- Immunity to magic sleep effects and a +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells or effects
- Fey: Killoren are considered fey for the purpose of spells.
- Manifest Nature's Might: Choose one of three Aspects each morning, gain either skill bonuses or a smite attack.

src:
Evocation
Level: Paladin 4,
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round/level

Charging yourself with divine energy, you bond yourself
to the ground beneath your feet and become the epitome
of stability.
The spell ends instantly if you move from your current 
position and does not work unless you are in contact 
with the ground.

You gain a +2 bonus to Strength, a +4 bonus to Constitution,
a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws, and a +4 dodge 
bonus to AC.

You gain a +10 bonus to resist a bull rush (this bonus does
not include the +4 bonus for being "exceptionally stable",
but exceptionally stable creatures do get that bonus in
addition to the bonus from this spell).

You gain a +10 bonus to resist all trip attacks (but not 
to your attempts to trip someone in return).

You gain a +10 resistance bonus on any roll made to resist
an effect that would cause you to move from your current
location.

For example, while you are not immune to enchantment 
effects, you gain a +10 resistance bonus on saving throws
(or Charisma checks, in the case of effects such as charm 
person) to resist commands that would cause you to leave
your current position.

刺修罗与刃魔（见怪物图鉴II）有相同的普遍血统。两个种族都来自修罗场，但学术推测将其起源置于巴托的九层地狱，焦炎地狱的荒芜永恒，甚至某个未知的金属位面。

  
刺修罗具有以下种族能力和特征。

无属性值调整

特殊能力

- 类人生物
- 中型体型。
- 30英尺基础速度
- 黑暗视觉
- +1 天生防御：刺修罗的金属皮肤提供对物理攻击的保护。
- 伤害减免 2/钝击：
- 酸抗力 5
- 武器熟练：刺修罗获得甲刺的军用武器熟练专长作为奖励专长。这允许它们无惩罚地将天然尖刺皮肤用作武器（见下文）.
- 天然尖刺（Ex）:刺修罗的皮肤布满尖锐，锯齿状的尖刺。刺修罗可以在成功的擒抱检定中造成额外穿刺伤害，或用近战攻击造成穿刺伤害，如同她穿着甲刺。由于其尖刺皮肤，刺修罗难以穿戴护甲。护甲的最大敏捷加值减少1，护甲检定惩罚恶化2.例如，刺修罗穿的链甲衫最大敏捷加值为+3（而非+4），护甲检定惩罚为-4（而非-2）.这些变化不影响护甲的奥术法咒失败几率，也不适用于刺修罗使用的盾牌。
- 天赋职业：战士
src:
Spikers are of the same general ancestry as bladelings (see Monster Manual II). Both races hail from Acheron, but scholarly speculation places their origins on the Nine Hells of Baator, the Bleak Eternity of Gehenna, or even some unknown metal-based plane.

  
Spikers have the following racial abilities and characteristics. 

No Ability Score Adjustments

Special Abilities

- Humanoid
- Medium size. 
- 30 feet base speed
- Darkvision
- +1 Natural Armor: A spiker's metallic hide offers protection from physical attacks . 
- Damage reduction 2/bludgeoning: 
- Resistance to acid 5
- Weapon Proficiency: Spikers receive the Martial Weapon Proficiency feat for armor spikes as a bonus feat. This allows them to use their natural spiked skin as a weapon without penalty (see below). 
- Natural Spikes (Ex): A spiker's skin is replete with sharp, jagged spikes. A spiker can deal extra piercing damage on a successful grapple check, or deal piercing damage with a melee attack, as if she wore armor spikes. Because of their spiked skin, spikers have a difficult time wearing armor. The maximum Dexterity bonus of the armor is reduced by 1, and the armor check penalty is worsened by 2. For instance, a chain shirt worn by a spiker has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +3 (instead of +4) and an armor check penalty of -4 (rather than -2). These changes don't affect the armor's arcane spell failure chance, nor do they apply to shields used by the spiker.
- Favored Class: Fighter

我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎杀海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向纳兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭海盗。据船员说，这些海盗是一群牛头人，他们一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次袭击。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗海盗。

船长在即将到来的袭击中利用我才华的计划是，让扎拉拉和我以及几名船员乘坐一艘小船，在隐形法术的掩护下绕到岛屿北侧，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则攻击南侧的海盗主力。我们现在已经登陆并开始了袭击，我们的突然出现让海盗们措手不及。在清除这座岛屿北半部敌人的过程中，我们追赶一个似乎是某种首领的牛头人进入附近的一个洞穴，他在那里触发了一个陷阱，向我们投下巨石，同时把我们扔到了下层。我们队伍中的一些人在此过程中丧生，现在我们需要在击退牛头人和可能在下方的其他东西的攻击的同时，找到离开这个似乎是某种迷宫的方法。

在岛屿下方更深处寻找出路时，我们遇到了一个巫妖的投影，他自称是扭曲符文会的伊尔库泽拉姆，显然是海盗的某种盟友或赞助者。他要求我把扎拉拉和泽法德之剑的碎片交给他，以便符文会可以用它们来挑战阿兹古尔卡。当我拒绝时，他告诉我，我需要通过一系列由他的各种仆从守卫的房间，必须击败他们才能获得继续前进的钥匙。在这条敌人组成的通道尽头，我们可以期待找到伊尔库泽拉姆本人，我担心他将是一个极其难对付的敌人。
src:
Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.

The captain's plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault called for Zarala and me, along with several of the crew, to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, under cover of an invisibility spell, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We have now landed and commenced our assault, surprising the pirates with our sudden appearance. In the process of clearing the northern half of this island of foes, we chased one minotaur who seems to be some sort of leader into a nearby cave, where he sprung a trap, dropping heavy rocks on us while dumping us into a lower level. Some of our party was lost in the process, and now we will need to find our way out of what appears to be some sort of maze, while fending off attacks from minotaurs and whatever else might be down here.

Going deeper beneath the island in search of a way out, we encountered the projection of a lich who identified himself as Ilkuzeram of the Twisted Rune, apparently some sort of ally or sponsor of the pirates. He demanded that I turn over Zarala and the fragments of the Sword of Zefad to him, so that the Rune could use them to challenge Azghulkar. When I refused, he told me that I would need to fight my way through a series of chambers guarded by various minions of his, who would need to be defeated in order to obtain a key to make further progress. At the end of this gauntlet of foes, we can expect to find Ilkuzeram himself, who I fear will be a most difficult foe.

（基础职业）
邪术师是天生的，而非后天造就的。他们的祖先用部分灵魂换取了魔法力量，而邪术师继承了这种力量。与术士或法师不同，他们不是通过法咒的规范来驾驭魔法，而是仅凭意志操纵注入他们体内的超自然能量。为了推进契约缔造者的目标，或与之对抗，驱使许多人踏上冒险之路。

- 生命骰：d6
- 擅长：邪术师擅长简易武器和轻甲。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

职业特性：

阵营：仅限混乱或邪恶。
基础攻击加值：+3/4
强韧豁免：意志

魔能爆：邪术师学习的第一个能力是魔能爆；一道 60 尺的魔法能量射线。它没有豁免检定，但受法术抗力影响，并且需要进行接触攻击。某些类型的邪术可以修改它，并且其伤害随等级提升而增加。

伤害减免：流经他身体的超自然力量强化了邪术师，在 3 级时获得伤害减免 1/寒铁。此减免每 4 级增加 1 点。

欺瞒物品：邪术师可以利用他对注入灵魂的超自然力量的掌握来弥补知识的不足。从 4 级起，邪术师可以在所有使用魔法装置检定中取 10，即使在战斗中。

恶魔韧性：从 8 级开始，邪术师掌握了恶魔韧性的诀窍。每天 2 分钟，他们获得快速治疗，其数值在 13 级和 18 级时增加。

能量抗力：从 10 级开始，邪术师选择 2 种元素能量并获得对其的抗力 5. 此抗力在 20 级时增加到 10。

灌注物品：12 级或更高的邪术师在制造魔法物品时可以 “弄虚作假”，用超自然力量灌注物品并尝试模拟所需的法咒（尽管邪术师仍必须拥有适当的专长）. 一次成功的 UMD 检定，对抗奥术法咒 DC 15 + 法术等级或神术法咒 DC 25 + 法术等级，允许通过一项法咒要求。如果任何 UMD 检定失败，邪术师不会损失金币或经验值，且制造失败。

邪术：这些是类法咒能力。任何已知的邪术都可以随意使用，但在其他方面如同法咒，例如在战斗中施法或法术抗力方面。施法者等级是邪术师的职业等级，那些允许豁免的邪术 DC 为 10 + 等效法术等级 + 邪术师的魅力调整值。
它们分为 4 个等级：次级（2nd）,  lesser(4th)，高级（6th），和黑暗（8th）. 邪术师开始时知道一个次级邪术，并如下获得更多。在 6, 11，和 16 级时，他们也解锁下一级邪术，但他们可以选择任何等级等于或低于他们最高可访问等级的邪术。
邪术也受奥术失败率影响，但邪术师在轻甲中忽略法咒失败。

src:
(BASE CLASS)
Warlocks are born, not made.  Their ancestors traded portions of their soul for magical power, and warlocks inherit this power.  Unlike sorcerers or wizards, rather than harnessing magic through the guidelines of a spell, they manipulate the supernatural energy infusing them with will alone.  The demand to further the goals of the originators of the pact, or to fight them, drives many to adventuring.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: Warlocks are proficient with simple weapons and light armor.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Alignment: Chaotic or Evil only.
Base Attack Bonus: +3/4
Strong Saves: Will

Eldritch Blast: The first ability a warlock learns is the eldritch blast; a 60' ray of magical energy.  It has no saving throw, but is affected by spell resistance and requires a touch attack.  Certain types of invocations can modify it, and it increases in damage as level increases.

Damage Reduction: Fortified by the supernatural power flowing through his body, a warlock gains damage reduction 1/cold iron at level 3.  This reduction increases by 1 point every 4 levels.

Deceive Item: A warlock can use his mastery of the supernatural forces infusing his soul to make up for lack of knowledge.  From 4th level on, a warlock can take 10 on all Use Magic Device checks, even in combat.

Fiendish Resilience: Beginning at 8th level, a warlock knows the trick of fiendish resilience.  For 2 minutes each day, they gain fast healing, with the amount increasing at levels 13 and 18.

Energy Resistance: Beginning at 10th level a warlock chooses 2 elemental energies and gains resistance 5 to them.  This resistance increases to 10 at level 20.

Imbue Item: A warlock of 12th level or higher can "fake it" when crafting magic items, suffusing the item with supernatural power and attempting to emulate the required spell(though the warlock must still have the appropriate feat).    A successful UMD check, vs DC 15 + spell level for arcane spells of DC 25 + spell level for divine spells, allows a single spell requirement to be passed.  If any of the UMD check fails, the warlock does not lose gold or xp and the crafting fails.

Invocations: These are spell-like abilities.  Any of them that are known can be used at will, but otherwise act like spells, such as in regards to casting in combat, or spell resistance.  Casting level is the warlock's class level, and those that grant saves have a DC of 10 + the equivalent spell level + the warlock's Cha modifier.
They come in 4 grades: least(2nd), lesser(4th), greater(6th), and dark(8th).  Warlocks start with knowledge of a single least invocation, and gain access to more as below.  At levels 6, 11, and 16 they also unlock the next level of invocation, but they can select invocations of any level equal to or less than their highest level of access.
Invocations are also subject to arcane spell failure, but warlocks ignore spell failure in light armor.

EPIC WARLOCK
Epic warlocks are supernatural power incarnate, retaining only the barest shred of their previous existence.  Their damage reduction increases by 1 at level 23 and every 4 levels thereafter.  They learn no new invocations normally, but their invoker level continues to increase.  Their Eldritch Blast damage increases by 1d6 at level 22, and increases every 2 levels thereafter.  They also gain a bonus feat every 3 levels.
