dst: 对于我的下一个任务，哈马德要求我将500金币送到贫民窟中由祭司纳西拉克·凯法尔管理的伊尔梅特神殿。城市的这一区域一直受到暴力犯罪活动的日益困扰，因此哈马德认为最好由像我这样全副武装、具备战斗能力的人来递送他的慈善捐款。神殿自身也一直在努力应对日益失控的犯罪，哈马德还要求我到达后听从这位纳西拉克的调遣，以他建议的任何方式协助他改善那里的状况。所以我出发前往贫民窟。\n\n我已经递送了捐款，并完成了纳西拉克交给我的所有几项任务。我现在可以向哈马德汇报，看看他接下来要我做什么。
src: For my next task, Hamad has asked me to deliver the sum of 500 gold to a Temple of Ilmater in the slums run by the priest Nasirak Kephar. This part of the city has been having increasing trouble with violent criminal activity, so Hamad thinks it would be best for his charitable contribution to be delivered by someone armed and combat-capable, such as myself. The temple has been having its own troubles trying to cope with the increasingly out-of control crime, and Hamad has also asked that when I arrive I put myself at the disposal of this Nasirak to assist him in improving conditions there in whatever manner he suggests. So I am off to the slums.\n\nI have delivered the contribution, and completed all of the several tasks given me by Nasirak. I can now report back to Hamad to see what he wants me to do next.

dst: 本书是一本关于变化系魔法使用的指南，涵盖了通用理论以及具体法咒。\n\n注意：使用本书将为玩家提供一些经验值，其数量与玩家等级成反比。这本书主要对奥术施法者有益，其中更依赖书本学习的法师将获得更大收益。其他职业仅获得象征性的经验值，可通过使用魔法装置技能略微提升。此外，使用本书还将为玩家提供若干魔法卷轴。
src: This book is a guide to the use of transmutation magic, covering both general theory as well as specific spells.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide some experience to the player, the amount being inversely proportional to his level. This particular book will primarily benefit arcane spellcasters, with wizards, who rely more on book-learning, receiving a greater benefit. Other classes receive only a nominal XP gain, which can be slightly improved with the Use Magic Device skill. In addition, use will provide the player with a number of magical scrolls.

dst: 扎拉拉有很多关于伊纳斯·森卡尔材料中发现的、有关卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔所拥有的魔法剑历史的事情要告诉我。这把剑是一件强大的魔法神器，拥有打开位面之门并通过它们引导能量的力量，由巨灵泽法德创造并使用，他是卡林随从的一部分，当时那位伟大的巨灵统治着这片土地。泽法德给他的剑附魔，使其能够飞往卡林的隐藏监狱——隐藏在希尔瓦德詹要塞内的卡林门农水晶，并将其打开，释放他的主人。然而，在他能够使用它之前，他遭到了一位名叫阿兹古尔卡的强大恶魔的袭击。泽法德凭借他强大的剑击败了阿兹古尔卡，但剑刃因与恶魔接触而受到某种污染或损耗，不再强大到足以用于其预期目的。最终，泽法德本人被逐出这个位面，留下了这把剑。扎拉拉相信自己是泽法德的后裔，根据她掌握的信息，这样的后裔将对这把剑拥有特殊力量，这可能意义重大（特别是解释为什么对这把剑感兴趣的人可能想杀她，假设这两个派系有关联）。虽然与这把剑相关的历史很有趣，但所发现的内容似乎都不足以重要到派出刺客和恶魔来压制。我们将不得不等待进一步的信息。
src: Zarala had much to tell me of what she found in Inas Senkhar's materials concerning the history of the magical sword possessed by Kalomas Zekar. The sword was a powerful magical artifact with the power to open planar gates and channel energy through them, and was created and employed by the djinn Zefad, part of the retinue of Calim when that great djinn was ruling this land. Zefad enchanted his sword to be able to fly to Calim's hidden prison, the Calimemnon Crystal hidden within the Keep of Sir'wadjen, and break it open, freeing his master. Before he was able to use it, though, he was assaulted by a powerful demon named Azghulkar. Zefad defeated Azghulkar with the aid of his powerful sword, but the blade was somehow tainted or depleted by contact with the demon, and was no longer powerful enough to be used for its intended purpose. In due course Zefad himself was driven from this plane, leaving the sword behind. Zarala believes herself to be a descendant of Zefad, and according to the information she has, such descendants would have special powers over the sword, which might turn out to be significant (particularly in explaining why people interested in the sword might want to kill her, assuming these two factions are connected). While there is much interesting history associated with this sword, none of what was found seems important enough to send out assassins and demons to suppress. We will have to wait for further information.

As if all this were not enough, it is not clear they even still worship Kossuth. Originally they claimed that their goals were consistent with and even a truer fulfillment of Kossuth's teachings, but now they are saying that established religions only serve to prop up the evils of the established order, no matter how they strive to ameliorate them, and so must be destroyed along with everything else. One wonders what precisely they think should not be destroyed. They have renounced us, no longer considering themselves Disciples of the Phoenix. Now they are calling themselves the Order of the Consuming Fire."

src: In the sewers beneath the temple district, I have encountered a wererat named Querzat, who does not share the hostile tendencies of the other wererats about, and in fact seeks a cure for his lycanthropic condition. I have agreed to help him achieve this goal. He wants me to obtain a number of items he will need to effect a cure: some belladonna, a book detailing the proper preparation for the belladonna before he dare actually ingest it, and some alchemical equipment to actually carry out said preparations. This last can be obtained from a merchant named, according to Querzat, "Blimfin Nemquin or Temquin or something." I have been given a list of items to present to this Blimfin when I locate him. Querzat is not sure where the other two items might be found, but suggests I check out the various stores in the city.\n\nI have given Querzat the belladonna. I still need to bring him the book and the alchemical equipment.

"你好，冒险者。我是尼尔瓦·瓦尔切扎，伊尔梅特的圣武士。如果你是来寻找任务的，我或许能给你一个。我感知到城市下方存在一股强大的邪恶力量。调查它让我来到了这座城市下方的幽暗地域洞穴，在那里我遇到了各种该地区原生的异怪生物，它们因不死化而变得更加扭曲。一路杀穿这些怪物以寻找腐化的源头，我最终遇到了一道充满负能量的黑暗屏障。这道屏障似乎在缓慢扩张，并在此过程中制造出越来越多的不死恐怖之物。"
src: "Greetings, adventurer. I am Nierva Var'cheza, Paladin of Ilmater. If you are here in search of a quest, I may be able to offer you one. I sensed the presence of a great evil under the city. Investigating it led me to the caverns of the Underdark beneath this city, where I encountered various aberrant creatures native to that region, who had been made even more unnatural by undeath. Fighting through these monstrosities to find the source of this corruption, I eventually came across a dark barrier suffused with negative energy. This barrier seems to be slowly expanding and creating ever more undead horrors as it does so."

dst:
哈马德一直在筹备对阿然那总部的进攻，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报，这场进攻几乎就要发动了，军队正集结于蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结点。哈马德命令我前往这处集结点，为进攻贡献我的能力。到达之后，我要向那里的指挥官卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以他认为合适的任何方式提供协助。是时候前往城门，在那里带上我想要的任何随从，然后动身前往沼泽了。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结点，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已经在与那些侍奉我们阿然那敌人的类人生物（在这里，大多是蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会取得胜利，但担心等到胜利之时，我们敌人的首领早已逃离他们的总部，以便从其他地点继续他们的战争。为了防止这种情况，他打算派我沿一条他的斥候发现的北面小路前进，这条路能让我绕过敌军主力，抵达基地。我要沿着这条路走，并与驻扎在小路再次转向南面之前的一支军队斥候会合。然后，我和斥候们要一路杀穿敌军后方——希望那里抵抗薄弱——抵达基地。一到那里，我就要在阿然那首领策划逃跑之前杀死他们。

虽然与军队斥候的会合并未按计划进行，但我还是抵达了基地并潜入其中。现在是时候执行将军的计划了，在阿然那及其可能在场的任何盟友设法逃跑之前，将他们杀死。

抵达基地下层后不久，我前来时经过的通道就在我身后坍塌了。看来此时我只能继续前进。这次坍塌很可能是阿然那为了在他们逃跑时阻止追击而制造的，所以赶在它前面很可能对完成这项任务至关重要。

原来阿然那正逃往卡林港下水道中鼠人的一处基地，这些鼠人显然是他们的盟友。我追到了那里，并已杀死了阿然那的首领泽克苏娅。随着他们的基地失守、领导层被摧毁，阿然那组建怪物大军蹂躏卡林杉的计划现在应该会土崩瓦解。等我有机会时，应当向哈马德报告我成功完成了这项任务。

一路杀穿下水道后，我现在已抵达卡林港内某座建筑的地下室。这里被噬火教团的武僧占据，他们似乎也是阿然那联盟的一部分。我想，为了离开这里，我恐怕也得杀穿他们。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

While the rendezvous with the army's scouts did not go as planned, I have nevertheless reached the base and penetrated within. It is time to proceed with the general's plan by killing the aranea here, along with any of their allies who may be present, before they can effect some sort of escape.

Soon after reaching the lower level of the base, the passage I took to reach it collapsed behind me. It would appear I can only go forward at this point. Likely this collapse was engineered by the aranea to block pursuit while they escape, so getting ahead of it may well have been crucial to the accomplishment of this quest.

It turns out that the aranea were escaping to a base of the wererats of Calimport's sewers, who were apparently their allies. I pursued them there and have now slain the leader of the aranea, Zeaxua. With their base lost and their leadership destroyed, the aranea's plans to raise an army of monsters to overrun Calimshan should now fall apart. My successful accomplishmet of this quest should be reported to Hamad when I have an opportunity.

Fighting through the sewers, I have now reached the basement of some structure within Calimport. It is occupied by monks of the Consuming Fire Order, who would appear to be part of the aranea alliance. I suppose I shall have to fight through them as well to get out of here.

dst:
在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队开始搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文会的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前在着手研究一本后续书籍时失踪了。我已同意寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，那人住在贵族区的西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了什么，可以去商人区东北部塞卡娅的家中向她报告。

我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他转而让我去找水手科拉努·乌马尔。现在我已经和科拉努谈过，他又告诉我阿拉达尔可能调查过的两条线索：第一，他以前的一个船友德拉沙姆·埃纳尔，科拉努认为他曾是符文会的密探，现在住在商人区的西南部；第二，贵族区东北部一堵墙上的密门通往一个隐藏的房间，科拉努认为那是符文会的一个藏身处。既然已经有人告诉我该去哪里找，这扇门应该不会太难找到。

我已经和德拉沙姆·埃纳尔谈过了。埃纳尔否认自己是符文会的密探，但曾为某个神秘组织做过线人。阿拉达尔·哈辛早些时候找过他，从他那里得知了他所汇报的联系人的名字：费亚尔·泰塞纳尔，此人现在住在神殿区，提尔神殿以南。我接下来应该去找他。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

I spoke to Lamash Kasat, who in turn sent me to seek out the sailor Kolanu Umal. Now I have spoken to Kolanu, and he in turn has told me of two paths that Aladar might have investigated: first, a former shipmate of his, Drasham Enar, who Kolanu believes was an agent of the Rune, and who now lives in the southwest part of the Merchant District, and secondly, a hidden chamber accessed through a secret door in a wall in the northeastern part of the Noble District, that Kolanu believes to be a hideout used by the Rune. This door should not be too difficult to find now that I have been directed where to look.

I have spoken to Drasham Enar. Enar denies being an agent of the Rune, but once worked as an informant for some mysterious organization. Aladar Hasin had earlier sought him out, and learned from him the name of the contact he reported to: Feyar Tesenal, who now lives in the Temple District, south of the Temple of Tyr. I should speak to him next.

I would like you to take this route as well, and join them. Together, you can attack the base while most of its defenders are absent fighting us, and hopefully slay their leaders before they can escape."

That was quite a force the orcs put together, a lot more than we were prepared for. Anyway I was wondering if you needed to restock some of your supplies or something? Since you did so much to help us out, I'd be willing to make some of our surplus inventory available to you at a good price."

dst: 在前往星尖山脉的途中，我遇到了一位名叫布雷戈·宽脚的半身人冒险者。他正在寻求帮助，想要打倒一群由哈扬·克罗率领的、从雇佣兵变成强盗的家伙。显然，布雷戈的表亲布蕾娜曾是这群强盗的一员，但她改变了主意，正从内部暗中破坏他们。不幸的是，最近她的联络中断了，布雷戈担心强盗们可能已经发现了她的背叛。他现在打算袭击强盗，并根据情况营救或为他的表亲复仇。我已同意帮助布雷戈，他说作为回报，一旦我们了结此事，他会协助我们完成自己的任务。强盗们占据了一座堡垒，位于西边。\n\n我们成功进入了堡垒，救出了布蕾娜，并击败了强盗，包括他们的首领哈扬·克罗。现在是时候回到我们最初的任务了，而且还有我们新的半身人朋友相助。
src: While traveling towards the Starspire mountains, I encountered a halfling adventurer named Brego Broadfoot. He was seeking assistance in bringing down a group of mercenaries turned bandits run by one Haryan Krow. Apparently Brego's cousin, Brena, was a member of this bandit group but thought better of it, and was working to undermine them from within. Unfortunately, communications from her recently ceased, and Brego fears the bandits may have discovered her betrayal. He now seeks to assail the bandits and either rescue or avenge his cousin, depending on which proves necessary. I have agreed to help Brego, and he has said that in return, once we are finished with this matter, he will assist us on our own quest. The bandits have occupied a fortress that can be found to the west.\n\nWe successfully entered the fortress, rescued Brena, and defeated the bandits, including their leader Haryan Krow. Now it is time to return to our original quest, with added help from our new halfling friends.

（进阶职业）
晨曦之主在许多方面都是牧师职业原型的典范--他们是仁慈的治疗者和顾问，坚定的保护者，以及不死生物的克星。因为晨曦之主相信将洛山达的光芒带到世界上所有黑暗之处是他们的职责，他们经常游历费伦大陆，向任何愿意倾听的人宣扬其神的荣耀，并在敌人出现时予以打击。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 武器与防具擅长：洛山达的晨曦之主不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：任何善良。
技能：武器制作4级，防具制作4级，知识8级，说服7级。
专长：额外驱散。
施法：能够施展3级神术。
特殊：必须信仰洛山达。（牧师必须拥有善良，贵族，保护，复原，太阳或力量领域中的两个）

职业特性：

等级
1：不眠者之灾 - 在驱散不死生物时，角色的洛山达晨曦之主等级与其牧师和圣武士等级叠加。
   洛山达之光：每当角色施展带有光亮描述符的法咒时，其范围加倍。
2：创造之火 - 角色在所有手艺和表演检定上获得等于其晨曦之主等级的加值。
3：昼明术 - 角色可以每天以自身施法者等级施展一次昼明术。
4：灼热射线 - 角色可以每天以自身施法者等级施展一次灼热射线。
5：强力驱散 - 角色可以进行强力驱散，如同普通驱散，但将被驱散的不死生物改为被摧毁，每天一次，每4个额外晨曦之主等级再增加一次。
6：黎明祝福 - 意志豁免+2，持续1分钟。仅当晨曦之主能看到太阳时有效。
7：驱散极效 - 每天一次，晨曦之主可以在驱散伤害骰上自动取得最大可能结果。
8：清晨复苏 - 如果角色虔诚祈祷，不受干扰地持续一小时（游戏时间，非现实时间），他获得以下法咒对自身的益处：移除疾病，次级复原术，中和毒素和治愈重伤。
10：光辉光环 - 角色获得黑暗视觉，并对抗不死生物攻击时获得+2闪避防御等级加值。

奖励法咒

当在洛山达晨曦之主职业上获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高神术施法职业上也获得了等级。他不会通过此能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Morninglords are, in many ways, the epitome of the class cleric archetype--they are kind healers and advisors, stalwart protectors, and implacable foes of the undead.  Because morninglords believe it is their duty to bring Lathander's light to all the dark places of the world, they often travel the breadth of Faerun, preaching the glories of their god to any who will listen and smiting his foes when they appear.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Morninglord of Lathander does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment:  Any good.
Skills:  Craft Weapon 4 ranks, Craft Armor 4 ranks, Lore 8 ranks, Persuade 7 ranks.
Feats: Extra Turning.
Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd level divine spells.
Special:  Must worship Lathander. (Clerics must have two of Good, Nobility, Protection, Renewal, Sun or Strength domains)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Bane of the Restless - the character's Morninglord of Lathander levels stack with her cleric and paladin levels for the purposes of turning undead.
   Lathander's Light:  Whenever the character casts a spell with the light descriptor, its area is doubled.
2: Creative Fire - the character gains a bonus equal to his morninglord level to all craft and perform checks.
3: Daylight - the character may cast a Daylight spell once per day at her caster level.
4: Searing Ray - the character may cast a searing ray spell once per day at her caster level.
5: Greater Turning - the character may perform a greater turning, which is like a normal turning except that the undead creatures that would be turned are destroyed instead, once per day plus one for every 4 additional morninglord levels.
6: Blessing of Dawn - +2 to Will Saves for 1 minute.  Only works when the sun is visible to the morninglord.
7: Maximize Turning - Once per day, the morninglord may automatically achieve the maximum possible result on a turning damage roll.
8: Rejuvenation of the Morn - If the character prays faithfully, undisturbed for one hour (game time, not real time), he receives the benefits of the following spells on himself: Remove Disease, Lesser Restoration, Neutralize Poison, and Cure Serious Wounds.
10: Aura of Radiance - The character gains Darkvision and a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks from undead creatures.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Morninglord of Lathander, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class. He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

I shall take these papers you have found and return at once. You should follow as soon as possible, <LastName>, though I know from my own days as an adventurer that you will most likely wish to visit the merchants first. But do not tarry overlong. I do not know how long it will take Zekar to assemble the forces with which he intends to assail us, but when they strike your assistance may be more necessary than ever."

dst: "我了解到拉贾尔的公会设置了一个迷宫之类的测试，用来考验潜在成员。里面布满了锁、陷阱和其他考验盗贼能力的测试。人从公会的一扇门进入，如果成功穿过迷宫，就会从另一扇门回到公会。有趣的是，根据我们的线人所说，这个迷宫还有另一个隐蔽入口，供公会首领使用，可以让人从公会外面进入。我想，拥有你这样能力的人也许能从这条路线进入迷宫，找到穿过它的路，然后从一个意想不到的方向闯入公会。"
src: "I've learned that Rajar's guild has set up a maze of sorts as a test for prospective members. It is full of locks, traps and other tests of a thief's abilities. One enters through one door in the guild, and, if the maze is successfully navigated, returns to it through another. What's interesting is that, according to our informant, there is another, concealed entrance to this maze used by the guild leaders, that allows one access to it from outside the guild. I'm thinking that someone with your abilities might be able to get into the maze from this route, find your way through it, and break into the guild from an unexpected direction."

在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个叫布利夫敏·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取有魔法用途的试剂。他所说的“中央收集区”周围四个分站的机器一直出问题，他承诺如果我能帮忙解决他遇到的各种问题，就会给我报酬。

东北方的机器出了故障，在自身周围释放了一团毒气。我现在已经关掉了它，以便进行修理。

东南方的机器似乎有类似的问题，喷出了一些黏液，可能也有某种毒性。我也得冒险穿过它来关掉这台机器。

西北方的机器运转正常，但所在的房间里现在有食腐虫。这些怪物应该被清除掉。

西南方的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被某个不明人士扯走了。泽姆昆怀疑是某个罪犯偷走它去卖金子。他希望我能设法追查到肇事者并找回丢失的部件。我应该在这台机器附近调查，希望能找到一些线索。

我已经向泽姆昆汇报了我的进展。完成的其他任务也应该向泽姆昆汇报。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast was malfunctioning, and released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I have now shut this down so that it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast has what appears to be a similar problem, having spewed forth some kind of slime, also likely toxic in some way. I shall have to risk moving through it to shut down this machine as well.

The machine to the northwest is functional, but in a room now occupied by otyughs. These monsters should be cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some unknown party. Zemquin suspects some criminal type stole this in order to sell the gold. He hopes I can somehow track down the perpetrator and recover the missing part. I should investigate in the vicinity of this machine in hopes of finding some clue.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

src: At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

dst: “好。那所学校离我们这儿不远，往东走一小段路就到了。你来来往往的时候大概已经见过了。他们可能不太愿意让你进去，但既然你在那儿确实有事要办，应该能说服他们。这里还有1000金币。你可以用它来支付我承诺的500预付款，如果需要的话，或许还能多花一些来让相关的人更配合。没花完的你可以留着。”
src: "Good. The school is not far from us here, a little ways to the east. You've probably already seen it while you've been going back and forth. They might be reluctant to let you in, but since you've got actual business there you should be able to persuade them. Here's 1000 gold, as well. You can use it to pay the 500 advance I'm promising, perhaps more if you need it to persuade anyone involved to be more cooperative. You can keep whatever you don't spend."

src:
School: Transmutation
Components: V,S
Range: Short
Target: One creatures equipment
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will avoids
Spell Resistance: Yes

You target a creatures equipment, and attempt to destroy a single item. The spell runs through a hierarchy of different pieces of equipment, targeting the highest priority item first, and moving to the next if none exists at that level of the hierarchy. The spells initial target is always (in order) the creatures main weapon, its armor, its off-hand (shield, etc), its arms, its neck, its cloak, its boots, its belt, its helmet, its right-hand ring, its left-hand ring, its arrows, its bolts, and it bullets. If the creature has no equipped items, the spell does nothing. Once the spell has acquired a target item, the owner of the item must make a Will saving throw to avoid having that item irrevocably destroyed.

src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.

src: I have again met my former employer, Saman Waladi, and been generously rewarded for saving him from the bandits in the desert. He has also asked me to perform another small task for him: speaking to the Customs Inspector at City Watch Headquarters, and obtaining from him official papers indicating that some goods Saman is shipping have passed his inspection. According to Saman, I need only mention his name and display a paper he has given me with his seal, as arrangements have already been made.\n\nThe matter has proved to be a bit more complicated than Saman indicated, as the Customs Inspector expects a bribe as a condition of completing the arrangements. As I am unwilling to pay it, I may not be able to complete this assignment. Perhaps I should just report my failure to Saman.

dst: <StartHighlight>[邪恶 +1]</Start> "魔鬼或许会欣赏有你这样一个哭哭啼啼的谄媚者来当仆人，显然你渴望成为那样的人，但我更喜欢有点火气的仆人，那种一开始会反抗我的，就像泽卡尔曾经那样。然而，所有与恶魔战斗的人都会明白，他们必须在这个过程中杀戮和毁灭，使用我们自己的工具，从而无论他们是否意识到，都在侍奉我们。你们凡人永远不会明白，重要的不是你们的目的，因为总有比你们更强大的力量来决定你们能否达成目的。只有你们为达成目的所选择的手段——是荣耀而仁慈，还是无情而奸诈——才是重要的，因为那决定了这些更强大的力量中，哪一个愿意与你结盟，而深渊的手段才是最实用的。"
src: <StartHighlight>[Evil +1]</Start> "A devil might appreciate having as a servant a sniveling toady such as you apparently aspire to be, but I prefer servants with a bit more fire, ones who oppose me at first, as Zekar once did. All who fight demons, though, learn they must kill and destroy in the process, using our own tools and thus serving us whether they realize it or not. You mortals will never understand that it is not your ends that matter, for greater powers than you will always determine whether you accomplish them or not. Only the means you choose to secure them, honorable and compassionate or ruthless and treacherous, matter, for that decides which of these greater powers will be willing to ally with you, and it is the methods of the Abyss that are the most practical."

死灵咒缚

描述符：邪恶，死灵咒缚
职业：化身，魂裔
脉轮：灵魂或腰部
豁免检定：见正文

一个死灵咒缚的沉寂场从你身上辐射而出，在你周围的空气中充满微弱的，阴影般的卷须。

每当一个活物在你相邻时受到伤害，你在攻击检定和伤害检定上获得+1亵渎加值。此加值持续1轮。如果一个活物在你相邻时死亡，此加值改为持续等于该生物生命骰数的轮数。

魂能：如果你将魂能投入死灵咒缚，生命吸取场覆盖的区域会扩大。任何活物在5尺加上每点投入魂能5尺范围内受到伤害（或死亡）都会触发此加值。

脉轮绑定（灵魂）

当你将死灵咒缚绑定到你的灵魂脉轮时，你可以用一个标准动作以死灵咒缚的纯粹邪恶打击一个活物敌人。当你使用此能力时，你必须对预定目标进行一次成功的近战接触攻击。如果成功，你的接触给予目标1d4个负向等级（强韧减半）.每给予一个负向等级，你获得1点临时魂能和5点临时生命值。临时魂能持续到你的下一轮结束。临时生命值在1小时后消失。

脉轮绑定（腰部）

在你的回合开始时，你的生命吸取场区域内的任何生物变为战栗1轮（意志无效）.
src:
Necrocarnum Shroud

Descriptors: Evil, necrocarnum
Classes: Incarnate, soulborn
Chakra: Soul or waist
Saving Throw: See text

A deadening field of necrocarnum radiates from you, filling the air around you with faint, shadowy tendrils.

You gain a +1 profane bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls any time a living creature takes damage while adjacent to you. This bonus lasts for 1 round. If a living creature dies while adjacent to you, the bonus instead lasts for a number of rounds equal to the creature's Hit Dice.

Essentia: If you invest essentia in the necrocarnum shroud, the area encompassed by the life-draining field expands. Any living creature who takes damage (or dies) within 5 feet plus 5 feet per point of 
essentia invested triggers the bonus.

Chakra Bind (Soul)

While you have necrocarnum shroud bound to your soul chakra, you can take a standard action to strike a living foe with the raw evil of necrocarnum. When you use this ability, you must make a successful melee touch attack against the intended victim. If successful, your touch bestows 1d4 negative levels on the target (Fortitude half). For each negative level bestowed, you gain 1 temporary point of essentia and 5 temporary hit points. The temporary essentia lasts until the end of your next turn. The temporary hit points fade after 1 hour.

Chakra Bind (Waist)

At the beginning of your turn, any creature within the area of your life-draining field becomes shaken for 1 round (Will negates).

dst: 这枚符文对拥有混合种族血统的人有益，例如半精灵和半兽人。它可以赋予一种附魔，更充分地将一个人新陈代谢中不同的种族元素整合起来，使它们快速高效地协同工作。主要的实际效果是，一个人可以以极快的速度移动和反应。\n\n注意：此物品可以对其独特能力所指定的任何可装备物品（尚未具有该属性的物品）赋予永久加速术。尽量不要以非可装备物体为目标，以免浪费充能。请注意，它还会将该物品设置为仅限你的种族成员（半精灵或半兽人）使用，这有时可能会造成麻烦（例如，你可能想与随从共享的物品）。另请注意，该符文有多次充能。建议不要附魔多个物品，而是附魔一个，并保留符文，以便当你找到更好的物品（也许在未来的模组中）放入你第一个附魔物品所占据的槽位时再次使用。但如果你出于某种原因更希望拥有多个具有加速术属性的物品，那也是一种选择。
src: This rune benefits those with a mixed racial heritage, such as half-elves and half-orcs. It can confer an enchantment that more fully integrates the different racial elements in one's metabolism, getting them to work together quickly and efficiently. The chief practical effect is that one can move and react with great speed.\n\nNOTE: This item can confer permanent Haste on any equipable item (that does not already have that property) targeted by its unique power. Try not to waste charges by targeting a non-equipable object. Note that it will also set that item as only useable by members of your race (Half-elf or Half-Orc) which may sometimes cause complications (for example with an item you might want to share with a henchman). Note also that the rune has multiple charges. It is suggested that instead of enchanting multiple items you instead enchant one, and save the rune to be used again when you find a better item (perhaps in future modules) to place in the slot occupied by the first one you enchanted. But if you prefer to have multiple items with the Haste property for some reason, that is also an option.

Fire: A burst of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.
Sonic: A burst of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, this power's damage increases by one die (d6). For each extra two dice of damage, this power's save DC increases by 1.

（进阶职业）
善魂巫妖是寻求不死以服务其家族，社群或其他目的（通常是纠正错误或达成某种魔法发现或功业）的精灵。他们是类似巫妖的生物，表现为外表威严的精灵，皮肤干瘪，眼睛发出白光。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 擅长：善魂巫妖不获得额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

种族：精灵。
技能：专注 5，法咒辨识 14。
施法：必须能够施放 6 级奥术或神术。
阵营：任意善良
不得拥有任何巫妖等级。

职业特性：
等级
1： 善魂巫妖特性 I：躲藏，聆听，潜行，搜索，说服和侦察 +2 加值。
         善魂巫妖之触：接触攻击造成 1d6 + 5 点伤害并麻痹 1d4 轮。
         善魂巫妖防御： 寒冷和电击伤害减免 5，天生防御 +2。
         驱散不死生物： 可以如同同等级牧师一样每天驱散不死生物 3 次。
         智力 +2。

2： 善魂巫妖特性 II： 加值增加至 +4。
         善魂巫妖之触： 接触攻击造成 1d8 + 5 点伤害并麻痹 1d4 分钟。
         善魂巫妖防御： 伤害减免 5/+1，天生防御 +3，寒冷和电击伤害减免 10。
         操纵死尸 ： 善魂巫妖每天可以如同同名法咒一样操纵死尸 5 次。

3： 善魂巫妖特性 III： 加值增加至 +6。
         善魂巫妖之触： 麻痹持续时间增加至 1d4 小时。
         善魂巫妖防御： 伤害减免 10/+1，天生防御 +4，寒冷和电击伤害减免 20。
         投影： 善魂巫妖每天可以创造自身的投影 3 次。
         感知 +2

4： 善魂巫妖特性 IV： 加值增加至 +8。
         善魂巫妖之触： 麻痹效果变为永久。
         善魂巫妖防御： 伤害减免 15/+2，天生防御 + 5，免疫寒冷和电击，驱散抗力 +4。
         驱散免疫： 不能被善良或中立角色驱散。
         魅力 +2
         不死

     注意： 达到 4 级时，善魂巫妖完全成为不死生物，因此免疫偷袭，重击，等级吸取，毒素和疾病。不死生物没有体质属性。然而，这在无冬之夜中是不可能的。玩家将获得 +12 体质以模拟善魂巫妖的生命骰增加至 d12。

     致谢： 特别感谢 Stratovarius 的帮助和指导，Ornedan 和 Primogenitor 的脚本才能，Lord Deimos909 在模板上的工作，Silver 的出色图标，以及 Shane Hennesey 让我查看巫妖。也感谢所有提供意见和脚本建议但我未在此提及的人。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Baelnorns are elves who have sought undeath to serve their families, communities, or other purposes (usually to see a wrong righted or to achieve a certain magical discovery or deed).  They are lich-like creatures that appear as impressive-looking elves with shriveled skin and glowing white eyes.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: The Baelnorn gains no additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Elf.
Skills: Concentration 5, Spellcraft 14.
Spellcasting: Must be able to cast 6th level Arcane or Divine spells.
Alignment: Any Good
Must not have any levels in Lich.

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Baelnorn Properties I: +2 bonus to Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Persuade, and Spot.
         Baelnorn Touch: Touch attack causes 1d6 + 5 damage and paralyzation for 1d4 rounds.
         Baelnorn Defense:  Damage Resistance 5 to cold and electricity, +2 to Natural Armor.
         Turn Undead:  Can turn undead 3 times per day as a cleric of the same level.
         Intelligence +2.

2:  Baelnorn Properties II:  Bonuses increase to +4.
         Baelnorn Touch:  Touch attack causes 1d8 + 5 damage and paralyzation for 1d4 minutes.
         Baelnorn Defense:  Damage Reduction 5/+1, Natural Armor +3, and Damage Resistance 10 to cold and electricity.
         Animate Dead :  5 times per day the Baelnorn animate dead as per the spell of the same name.

3:  Balenorn Properties III:  Bonuses increase to +6.
         Baelnorn Touch:  Paralyzation duration increases to 1d4 hours.
         Baelnorn Defense:  Damage Reduction 10/+1, Natural Armor +4, and Damage Resistance 20 to cold and electricity.
         Projection:  Three times per day the Baelnorn may create a projection of itself.
         Wisdom +2

4:  Baelnorn Properties IV:  Bonuses increase to +8.
         Baelnorn Touch:  Paralyzation effect becomes permanent.
         Baelnorn Defense:  Damage Reduction 15/+2, Natural Armor + 5, immunity to cold and electricity, Turning Resistance +4.
         Turning Immunity:  Cannot be turned by Good or Neutral characters.
         Charisma +2
         Undeath

     Note:  Upon reaching level 4, the Baelnorn is fully undead, and therefore is immune to sneak attacks, critical hits, level drain, poison, and disease.  An undead creature has no Constitution score.  However, this is not possible in Neverwinter Nights.  The player will gain +12 to constitution in order to simulate the increase of the Baelnorn's HD to d12.

     Thanks:  Special thanks to Stratovarius for his help and guidance,  Ornedan and Primogenitor for their scripting prowess, Lord Deimos909 for his work on the template, Silver for his great icons, and Shane Hennesey for letting me take a look at the lich.  Thanks also to all those who helped with input and scripting advice that I haven't mentioned here.

src: In her magical researches, Zarala has come across a formula for forging a magical item known as the Lightning Lute. She wants my help in assembling the components she will need to fashion this item: an ordinary non-magical lute, a crystal of special blue quartz, and some wyvern blood. The lute should be available for purchase somewhere in the Merchant District, if I can find one nowhere else. The blue quartz might be found underground, in the upper sections of the Underdark. There is rumored to be a way to get to such regions in the sewers beneath the Merchant District. Zarala had no idea where I might find some wyverns, but it is possible I may come across such creatures at some point in my adventures. I should assemble these items and bring them to Zarala, if possible.\n\nI have delivered these materials to Zarala, who used them to fashion this special magical lute.

dst: "还不算完全自由，还没有，但进程已经启动，而且进展很大。他还无法越过你看到的那个发光的魔法边界，但它很快就会崩塌。很快我就会抽干所有用来囚禁阿兹古尔卡的力量，将其归还以强化这把剑，让它发挥真正的用途。然后我们将粉碎卡利蒙农水晶，给这片土地带来它从未见过或想象过的灰飞烟灭，尽管这是它早就该得的。整片土地都将用火与血为它的罪行付出代价！"
src: "Not quite free, not yet, but the process is in motion and far advanced. He cannot yet pass the glowing magical boundary you see, but it will collapse soon enough. Soon I will have drawn out all the power being used to imprison Azghulkar, returning it to empower the sword for its true purpose.Then we shall shatter the Calimemnon crystal and bring destruction upon this land such as it has never seen or imagined, although long deserved. All the land shall pay for its crimes in fire and blood!"

异界的奥提亚克斯赋予其召唤者打开封闭之物的力量，在云中行走，以及用如锤般落下的雾打击敌人。

缚灵等级：5级
缚灵DC: 25
特殊要求：无

影响：奥提亚克斯的动机仍然是个谜，但其影响是明确的。当面对未打开的门或大门时，你会变得焦躁不安。这种情绪状态持续到门或大门被打开，或者直到你再也看不到它。此外，奥提亚克斯无法忍受锁保持锁闭状态。因此，每当你看到钥匙时，奥提亚克斯要求你用它打开相应的锁。

授予能力：
奥提亚克斯为你开门，让你用风猛击对手，并用保护性的雾笼罩你，这雾实际上可以攻击敌人。

空气冲击：你可以将周围的空气集中成一股集中的冲击波来猛击对手。你可以将空气冲击作为近战接触攻击，对相邻的对手或10英尺内的对手使用。此攻击造成2d6点钝击伤害，但你不将力量加值加到伤害掷骰中。如果你的基础攻击加值足够高，你在进行全力攻击时可能有权每轮进行额外的空气冲击攻击。

隐蔽迷雾：不断围绕你的迷雾形成一道屏障，赋予你隐蔽效果（敌人的近战和远程攻击有20%的失手几率）.

开启界门：随意作为一个迅捷动作，你可以打开（但不能关闭）未上锁的门，箱子，盒子或其他物体。

开锁：作为一个整轮动作，你可以解锁一个你能接触到的锁，前提是其开锁DC小于或等于你有效缚灵者等级的两倍。一旦你使用了此能力，你5轮内无法再次使用。
src:
Otiax, the Key to the Gate
  
The alien Otiax gives its summoners the power to open what is closed, to walk among the clouds, and to strike foes with fog that lands like a hammer.

Vestige Level: 5th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: No

Influence: Otiax's motives remain a mystery, but its influence is clear. When confronted with unopened doors or gates, you become agitated and nervous. This emotional state lasts until the door or gate is opened, or until you can no longer see it. Furthermore, Otiax cannot abide a lock remaining secured. Thus, whenever you see a key, Otiax requires that you use it to open the corresponding lock.

Granted Abilities: 
Otiax opens doors for you, lets you batter opponents with wind, and cloaks you in a protective fog that can actually lash out at foes.

Air Blast: You can focus the air around you into a concentrated blast that batters opponents. You can use your air blast as a melee touch attack against an adjacent opponent or one that is up to 10 feet away. This attack deals 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage, but you do not add your Strength bonus to the damage roll. If your base attack bonus is high enough, you might be entitled to additional air blast attacks each round when you make a full attack.

Concealing Mist: The mist that constantly surrounds you forms a screen that grants you concealment (foes' melee and ranged attacks have a 20% miss chance).

Open Portal: At will as a swift action, you can open (but not close) an unlocked door, chest, box, or other object.

Unlock: As a full-round action, you can unlock a single lock that you can touch, provided that its Open Lock DC is less than or equal to twice your effective binder level. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

dst: 在烛堡图书馆下方的地下墓穴中，我遇到一个幽灵，他显然曾是图书馆的一名读者，并且为弄丢了一本名为《深渊之钟》的书而忧心。我在地下墓穴中找到了这本书的一本，并把它交给了那个幽灵。他很高兴能拿回它，随后不久就消失了。我无法确定他是否永久消失了，但也许那正是他斩断与这个世界的最后联系、前往来世所需要的一切。\n\n在消失之前，他给了我另一本书《死亡三神》，并让我把它交给一位名叫乔达瑟的法师，此人显然来自乌尔卡斯特学院。由于那座学院在几个世纪前就被摧毁了（这让人不禁怀疑那个幽灵到底在这里待了多久），我似乎不太可能找到这位乔达瑟，但也许这本书在某个时候会派上用场。
src: In the catacombs beneath the library of Candlekeep, I came across a ghost who was apparently once a Reader of the library, and who was concerned about having misplaced a copy of a book titled "The Bell in the Depths." I found a copy of the book in the catacombs, and delivered it to the ghost. He was pleased to get it, and soon after disappeared. I cannot be certain he has permanently vanished, but perhaps that was all he needed to break his last ties to this realm and go on to the afterlife.\n\nBefore vanishing, he gave me another book, "The Dead Three" and asked me to deliver it to a mage named Jodathur, who was apparently from the Ulcaster Academy. As that academy was destroyed centuries ago (which raises the question of just how long that ghost has been here), it seems unlikely that I will be able to find this Jodathur, but perhaps the book will turn out to have some use at some point.

源点或目标位于黑暗迷宫内的区域效果有20%的几率错误放置。如果发生这种情况，法咒以施法者预期位置为中心，向随机方向偏移1d4 x 5英尺。
所有搜索和侦察检定受到-10惩罚。
每轮，所有生物向随机方向移动。成功的意志豁免可抵消此特定效果，但每轮移动都必须重复该豁免。
任何目的地为黑暗迷宫内部的传送效果会将其乘客放置在距离预期目的地1d% x 5英尺处。在黑暗迷宫内施放的传送效果需要成功的意志豁免。

当处于你自己的黑暗迷宫中时，你对最后两种效果（移动和传送）免疫，但不对其他效果免疫。
src:
Master, Shadowscape
Level/School: 9th/Conjuration (Creation)
Range: Personal
Area: One area
Duration: 12 hours/level
Saving Throw: Will partial, see text
Spell Resistance: No

The air blackens, the shadows of the alleys lengthen, and the wind shrieks as the Shadow and Material Planes collide.

Black labyrinth causes substantial disorientation within the area it affects. Direction and distance become impossible to determine, as the world itself bends and twists.

All attacks have a 50% miss chance.
Area effects with a source or target within the black labyrinth have a 20% chance of improper placement. If this occurs, the spell is centered 1d4 x 5 feet in a random direction from where the caster intended. 
All Search and Spot checks take a -10 penalty.
Each round, all creatures are moved in a random direction. A successful Will save negates this particular effect, but that save must be repeated for each round of movement.
Any teleportation effects with a destination inside the black labyrinth deposit their passengers 1d% x 5 feet from the intended destination. A teleport effect cast within the black labyrinth requires a successful Will save. 

When within your own black labyrinth, you are immune to the last two effects (movement and teleportation), but not the others.

src: "Yes, I've been receiving reports that confirm what you discovered. Scouts have noticed large bands of goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs assembling in the Marching Mountains. These are not normal raiding parties, either. They operate with a precision and military discipline that is singularly lacking in most such tribes of humanoids, and are equipped with an unusually large number of magically enhanced weapons. It is true that in the past such humanoid bands have posed little threat to large civilized communities, but that is because they have traditionally lacked precisely what these seem to possess: unity, discipline, proper training and equipment."

（进阶职业）
很少有生物能像奥术施法者那样对人类社会的威胁如此之大。一个法师只需几个精心布置的法咒就能轻易摧毁整座城镇，颠覆一个王国，甚至扭曲自然法则本身。面对这一显而易见的威胁，一个由王室特工组成的团体站了出来，他们被称为警觉仆从，其成员以挫败女巫后裔--即术士，法师及其他奥术魔法使用者--的计划为己任。该组织的精英特工是降巫者--掌握魂能的猎法者，他们能利用灵魂能量的力量制造盾牌，陷阱和镣铐，以扼杀女巫后裔的魔法力量，使其束手无策。

- 生命骰：d6
- 武器与防具擅长：降巫者不获得新的武器与防具擅长
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：
塑魂：塑魂者等级 6。
专长：警觉，追踪。
技能：知识 4 级，搜索 4 级，察言观色 2 级，侦察 2 级。
特殊：不能拥有任何奥术施法职业等级。

职业特性：

等级
1：随意使用侦测魔法
    王室钱袋 - 每提升一级，每级降巫者获得 500 金币
    融魂盾 - 在对抗法咒的所有豁免检定上获得等于投入魂能的加值
2：解除法球 - 投掷魂能球，如同目标解除魔法
    魂能池 +1
3： 
4：法师镣铐 - 钉住奥术施法者以永久阻止其施法
5： 
6：废止真言 - 准备动作以反制附近任何施法者
    魂能池 +1
7： 
8：剥魂 - 对奥术施法者造成等于投入魂能的 d6 点伤害
9： 
10：恐怖外皮 - 将奥术施法者锁入魂能棺椁
    
奖励塑魂：

在第 1,3,5,7,9 和 10 级降巫者等级时，你的塑魂者等级，可塑造的灵魂融合数量，可创建的脉轮束缚数量以及魂能池均会提升，如同你在获得降巫者等级之前所属的塑魂职业上提升了一级。然而，你不会获得该职业的任何其他能力，例如新的脉轮束缚层级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Few creatures pose as much threat to human society as arcane spellcasters do. A single wizard can easily destroy an entire town, subvert a kingdom, or twist the very laws of nature with a few well-placed spells. Against this obvious threat stands a fellowship of royal agents known as the Vigilant Servants, whose members make it their business to frustrate the plans of the witchborn-namely sorcerers, wizards, and other users of arcane magic. The organization's elite agents are the witchborn binders - incarnum-wielding mage-hunters who can use the power of soul energy to create shields, traps, and shackles that can smother the magical powers of the witchborn and render them helpless.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: Witchborn Binders gain no new proficiencies
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Meldshaping: Meldshaper level 6th.
Feats: Alertness, Track.
Skills: Lore 4 ranks, Search 4 ranks, Sense Motive 2 ranks, Spot 2 ranks.
Special: May not possess any arcane spellcasting class levels.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Detect Magic at will
    Royal Purse - Each level, gain 500 gold per witchborn binder level
    Meldshield - Gain a bonus on all saves against spells equal to essentia invested
2:  Dispelling Orb - Throw orb of incarnum as targeted dispel magic
    Essentia pool +1
3:  
4:  Mage Shackles - Pin arcane caster to stop casting permanently
5:  
6:  Word of Abrogation - Ready action to counterspell any nearby caster
    Essentia pool +1
7:  
8:  Spiritflay - Deal invested essentia d6 to arcane caster
9:  
10: Grim Integument - Lock arcane caster in coffin of incarnum
    
BONUS MELDSHAPING:

At 1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 10th witchborn binder levels, you increase your meldshaper level, the number of soulmelds you can shape, the number of chakra binds you can create, and your essentia pool as if you had gained a level in a meldshaping class to which you belonged prior to gaining the witchborn binder level. You do not, however, gain any other abilities of that class, such as new tiers of chakra binds.

src:
School: Necromancy [Evil]
Caster Level: Clr 6, sor/wiz 6
Components: V, S, F
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium
Target: Living creature with necrotic cyst and all creatures in 20 ft. Radius spread
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial
Spell Resistance: No

You cause the cyst of a subject already harboring a necrotic cyst (see spell of the same name) to explosively enlarge itself at the expense of the subject's body tissue, harming both the subject (and nearby creatures if the subject fails his save). If the subject succeeds on his saving throw, he takes 1d6 points of damage per level (maximum 15d6), and half the damage is considered vile damage (see necrotic bloat). The subject's cyst-derived saving throw penalty against effects from the school of necromancy applies.

If the subject fails his saving throw, the cyst expands beyond control, killing the subject. All creatures within 20 feet of the subject take 1d6 points of damage per level (maximum 15d6; Reflex half), and half the damage taken is considered vile damage. All creatures in range that take this secondary damage are also exposed to the effect of the base necrotic cyst spell.

Focus: The caster must possess a Mother Cyst.

dst:
每天三次，秘法师可以利用他对怪物的广博知识，为盟友提供对抗他们所面对生物的益处。这样做算作一个移动动作。黑暗知识的秘密仅涉及异怪，元素，魔法兽，异界生物或不死生物。

随着秘法师等级的提升，他解锁新的黑暗知识能力，并且可以更频繁地使用黑暗知识，每三个秘法师等级获得一次额外的每日使用次数（3 级时 4 次/天，6 级时 5 次/天，依此类推）.

使用黑暗知识需要进行知识检定。检定的 DC 为 15. 如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 10 或更多，大多数黑暗知识能力的效果会增加。黑暗知识对任何给定生物只能使用一次。

秘法师的黑暗知识可以影响单个生物或所有同种族的生物，取决于所使用的效果。目标生物必须在 60 英尺内，且秘法师必须察觉到该生物的存在，尽管他不需要有视线。黑暗知识的效果持续 1 分钟，除非另有说明。

<c'' >战术</c>：秘法师了解该种族生物的一般战斗行为，为盟友提供对抗它们的攻击检定 +1 加值。例如，一个秘法师面对腐化吞噬者，如果他的知识（地城） 检定成功，将为其盟友提供对抗他们在该遭遇中战斗的所有腐化吞噬者的攻击加值。如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 10 或更多，则此加值增加到 +2. 如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 20 或更多，则此加值增加到 +3. 

<c'' >威力</c>：从 5 级开始，秘法师可以使用他的黑暗知识帮助盟友抵抗其他生物的腐化影响。在秘法师 60 英尺内的盟友在对抗受影响生物能力的豁免检定上获得 +1 加值。如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 10 或更多，此加值增加到 +2. 如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 20 或更多，此加值增加到 +3。

<c'' >敌人</c>：从 8 级开始，秘法师可以指导盟友攻击敌人的要害。在成功的知识检定后，他赋予他们对抗目标生物的武器伤害检定加值，等于 1d6 点伤害。如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 10 或更多，则此加值增加到 2d6. 如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 20 或更多，则此加值增加到 3d6。

<c'' >恐惧秘密</c>：通过大声说出目标生物的恐惧秘密，11 级或更高的秘法师可以使目标生物目眩 1 轮。与其他黑暗知识不同，此能力只能对单个生物使用。如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 10 或更多，则目标被晕眩 1 轮。如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 20 或更多，则目标被震慑 1 轮（如果目标免疫震慑但不免疫晕眩，例如大多数不死生物，则秘法师可以选择晕眩目标而不是震慑它）.

<c'' >预知</c>：从 14 级开始，秘法师可以更好地为盟友准备对抗受影响生物的攻击，使该生物更难命中并成功造成伤害。在秘法师 30 英尺内的盟友获得 +1 洞察 AC 加值，仅适用于受影响生物的攻击。如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 10 或更多，此加值增加到 +2. 如果秘法师的知识检定成功超过 20 或更多，此加值增加到 +3。
src:
Three times per day, an archivist can draw upon his expansive knowledge of monsters, granting his allies benefits against the creatures they face. Doing this counts as a move action. The secrets of dark knowledge pertain only to aberrations, elementals, magical beasts, outsiders, or undead.

An archivist unlocks new dark knowledge abilities as his level increases and can also call upon his dark knowledge more often, gaining one additional daily use for every three archivist levels (4/day at 3rd level, 5/day at 6th level, and so forth).

Using dark knowledge requires a Lore check. The DC of the check is 15. Most of the archivist's dark knowledge abilities increase in effectiveness if he succeeds on his Lore check by 10 or more. Dark knowledge can only be used once against any given creature.

The archivist's dark knowledge can affect a single creature or all creatures of the same race, depending on the effect used. A target creature must be within 60 feet, and the archivist must be aware of the creature's presence, although he need not have a line of sight to it. The effects of dark knowledge last for 1 minute, unless stated otherwise.

<c'' >Tactics</c>: The archivist knows the general combat behaviors of creatures of that race, granting his allies a +1 bonus on attack rolls made against them. For example, an archivist confronted by corruption eaters who succeeded on his Knowledge (dungeoneering) check would grant his allies the attack bonus against all the corruption eaters they fought in that encounter. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 10 or more, then this bonus increases to +2. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 20 or more, then this bonus increases to +3. 

<c'' >Puissance</c>: Starting at 5th level, the archivist can use his dark knowledge to help his allies fight off the corrupting influence of other creatures. Allies within 60 feet of the archivist gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against the affected creature's abilities. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 10 or more, this bonus increases to +2. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 20 or more, this bonus increases to +3.

<c'' >Foe</c>: Starting at 8th level, an archivist can direct his allies to attack vital spots of his enemies. On a successful Knowledge check, he grants them a bonus to weapon damage rolls made against the target creatures equal to 1d6 points of damage. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 10 or more, then this bonus increases to 2d6. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 20 or more, then this bonus increases to 3d6.

<c'' >Dread Secret</c>: By speaking aloud a dread secret of the target creature, an archivist of 11th level or higher can dazzle a target creature for 1 round. Unlike other dark knowledge, this ability can be used only against a single creature. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 10 or more, then the target is dazed for 1 round. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 20 or more, then the target is stunned for 1 round (if the target is immune to being stunned but not immune to being dazed, such as most undead, then the archivist can choose to daze the target instead of stunning it).

<c'' >Foreknowledge</c>: Starting at 14th level, an archivist can better prepare his allies for the attacks of the affected creature, making it harder for the creature to land blows and successfully deal damage. Allies within 30 feet of the archivist gain a +1 insight bonus to Armor Class that applies to attacks by the affected creature only. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 10 or more, this bonus increases to +2. If the archivist succeeds on his Knowledge check by 20 or more, this bonus increases to +3.

dst:
“圣徒”是一个后天模板，可以添加到任何非异界生物或元素生物的善良阵营活体生物上（以下称为“基础生物”）.

体型和类型：生物的类型变为“异界生物”.圣徒拥有本地子类型。体型不变。

防御等级：圣徒获得等于角色感知调整值的洞察加值到防御等级。

特殊攻击：圣徒保留角色的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下列出的能力。

神圣力量（超自然）：圣徒的任何及所有特殊攻击的豁免DC，包括法咒以及类法咒，超自然和特异能力，增加+2。

神圣触碰（超自然）：圣徒的整个存在充满了神圣力量，同样流入圣徒挥舞的任何武器中。圣徒使用任何武器（或徒手）的近战攻击对邪恶生物造成额外1d6点神圣伤害，对邪恶不死生物和邪恶异界生物造成1d8点。任何用天生武器攻击圣徒的邪恶生物会受到神圣伤害，如同被圣徒的攻击击中一样。

类法咒能力：随意使用 - 指引，抵抗，恩赐和祝福。圣徒的施法者等级等于其总生命骰。豁免DC基于魅力。

特殊品质：圣徒保留角色的所有特殊品质，并获得以下列出的能力，以及异界生物类型。

伤害减免（特异）：圣徒根据其生命骰（包括角色等级）获得伤害减免。
生命骰		伤害减免
1-3		-
4-7		5/魔法

src:
"Saint" is an acquired template that can be added to any living creature of good alignment that is not an outsider or an elemental (referred to hereafter as the "base creature").

Size and Type: The creature's type changes to "outsider." The saint has the native subtype. Size is unchanged.

Armor Class: A saint gains an insight bonus to AC equal to the character's Wisdom bonus.

Special Attacks: A saint retains all the character's special attacks and gains those listed below.

Holy Power (Su): The save DCs of any and all of the saint's special attacks, including spells as well as spell-like, supernatural, and extraordinary abilities, increase by +2.

Holy Touch (Su): A saint's entire being is suffused with holy power, which likewise flows into any weapon the saint wields. A saint's melee attacks with any weapon (or unarmed) deal an additional 1d6 points of holy damage against evil creatures, and 1d8 points against evil undead and evil outsiders. Any evil creature that strikes a saint with a natural weapon takes holy damage as if hit by the saint's attack.

Spell-like Abilities: At will - guidance, resistance, virtue, and bless. A saint's caster level is equal to its Hit Die total. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Special Qualities: A saint retains all the character's special qualities and gains those listed below, as well as the outsider type.

Damage Reduction (Ex): Saints gain damage reduction according to their Hit Dice (including character level).
HD		Damage Reduction
1-3		-
4-7		5/magic
8-11	5/evil
12+		10/evil

If the base creature already has damage reduction, use the better value.

Fast Healing (Ex): Each round, a saint heals damage equal to half of its Hit Dice (including character levels, to a maximum of 10 points healed). If the base creature already has fast healing, use the better value.

Immunities (Ex): A saint is immune to acid, cold, electricity, and petrification attacks.

Keen Vision (Ex): Saints have low-light vision and 60-foot darkvision.

Protective Aura (Su): As a free action, a saint can surround herself with a nimbus of light having a radius of 20 feet. This acts as a double-strength magic circle against evil and as a lesser globe of invulnerability both as cast by a cleric whose level equal to the saint's Hit Dice.

Resistances (Ex): Saints have resistance to fire 10 and receive a +4 racial bonus on Fortitude saves against poison.

Tongues (Su): A saint can speak with any creature that has a language, as though using a tongues spell cast by a 14th-level cleric. This ability is always active.

Abilities: Modify the base creature as follows: Con +2, Wis +2, Cha +4.

Alignment: Saints are always good-aligned.

Level Adjustment: Same as base creature +2.

Take warning from this, and proceed with care."

Focalor has power over storms and seas. He gives those who bind him the power to drown souls in sadness and sink ships in an ocean of tears.

Granted Abilities:

Aura of Sadness: You emit an aura of depression and anguish that overtakes even the strongest-willed creatures. Every adjacent creature is overcome with grief, which manifests as a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks, for as long as it remains adjacent to you. You can suppress or activate this ability as a standard action. Aura of sadness is a mind-affecting ability.

Focalor's Breath: As a standard action, you can exhale toward a single living target within 30 feet. That target is blinded for 1 round unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Lightning Strike: Once per round as a standard action, you can call down a bolt of lightning that strikes any target you designate, as long as it is within 10 feet per effective binder level of your position. The lightning bolt deals 3d6 points of electricity damage, plus an additional 1d6 points of electricity damage for every three effective binder levels you possess above 5th. （进阶职业）
红袍法师是塞尔的主人，征服了该地原住民拉舍米，并意图成为费伦的魔法霸主。他们比任何专精法师都更专注于一个魔法学派，在非常狭窄的焦点内达到令人难以置信的魔法精通。被托瑞尔各地的人们视为残忍和邪恶的暴君，少数人选择离开他们的地区，采用秘密身份，并在不必担心政治联盟和可能的奴隶起义的情况下练习魔法。在职业生涯早期，有抱负的红袍法师专精于一个魔法学派并获得纹身专注专长，为进入塞尔红袍法师做准备。所有红袍法师都有一些专精法师的技能，大多数人只遵循这条道路，但少数人涉猎其他类型的学习，如战斗或神术。虽然术士或吟游诗人有可能成为红袍法师，但这样的异类在他们的家乡被嘲笑，并且极为罕见。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 熟练：红袍法师不获得武器，护甲或盾牌熟练。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

种族：人类
阵营：非善良
技能：法咒辨识 8 级
专长：纹身专注和总共 3 个超魔或物品制造专长。
法咒：必须能够施放至少 3 级奥术。

职业特性：

等级
1：增强专精 - 选择此专长决定哪个法咒学派获得法咒力量和专精法师防御加值。
  专精法师防御 +1 - 此专长给予红袍法师 +1 豁免对抗其选择法咒学派的所有法咒。
2：法咒力量 +1 - 此专长给予红袍法师 +1 DC 对其选择法咒学派的所有法咒。
3：专精法师防御 +2
4：法咒力量 +2
5：奖励专长
  环之领袖
6：法咒力量 +3
7：专精法师防御 +3
8：法咒力量 +4
9：专精法师防御 +4
10：法咒力量 +5
  大环之领袖

奖励法咒：

在塞尔红袍法师中获得一级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高施法职业（吟游诗人，术士或法师） 中也获得了一级。他不通过其能力学习任何新法咒。然而，他不获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他益处（例如，改善魔宠，奖励专长）.
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Red Wizards are the masters of Thay, the conquerors of that land's native Rashemi, and the would-be magical overlords of Faerun. They focus on a school of magic more intently than any specialist, achieving incredible mastery of magic within a very narrow focus. Seen as cruel and evil tyrants by people across Toril, a few choose to leave their region, assume secret identities, and practice magic without having to worry about political alliances and possible slave uprisings. Early in their careers, would-be Red Wizards specialize in a school of magic and acquire the Tattoo Focus feat that prepares them for entry into the Red Wizards of Thay. All Red Wizards have some skill as a specialist wizard, and most follow that path exclusively, but a few dabble in other sorts of learning, such as combat or divine magic. While it is possible for a sorcerer or a bard to become a Red Wizard, such misfits are ridiculed in their homeland and are incredibly rare.

- Hit Dice: d4.
- Proficiencies: Red Wizards gain no weapon, armor or shield proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Human
Alignment: Non Good
Skills: Spellcraft 8 ranks
Feats: Tattoo Focus and a total of 3 metamagic or item creation feats.
Spells: Must be able to cast at least 3rd level Arcane spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Enhanced Specialization - Taking this feat determines which spell school has the Spell Power and Specialists defense bonus applied to it.
  Specialist Defense +1 - This feat grants a Red Wizard +1 Saving Throw against all spells from his spell school of choice.
2: Spell Power +1 - This feat grants a Red Wizard +1 DC on all spells from his spell school of choice.
3: Specialist Defense +2
4: Spell Power +2
5: Bonus Feat
  Circle Leader
6: Spell Power +3
7: Specialist Defense +3
8: Spell Power +4
9: Specialist Defense +4
10: Spell Power +5
  Great Circle Leader

BONUS SPELLS:

Upon gaining a level in Red Wizard of Thay, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (bard, sorcerer, or wizard). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (e.g., improved familiar, bonus feats).

作为守护神使无可争议的统治者，天界之狮塔利希德是一股极其强大的善良力量，纯粹而不受法律或混乱的干扰。他也是一位强大的德鲁伊，他的凡人和守护神使勇士是德鲁伊和巡林客，他们与他一样痛恨邪恶，并热爱自然世界及其生物。被称为塔利希德之狮，这些自然的保护者和善良的勇士以更具体的方式效仿他们的天界守护神：收养猫科动物伙伴，使用野性变身能力变成大型猫科动物形态，并最终像利昂纳尔一样咆哮。德鲁伊和巡林客最常成为塔利希德之狮，只有拥有动物伙伴的角色才能进入此职业。多职业德鲁伊/巡林客也常采用此职业，较少见的是战士/德鲁伊或牧师/巡林客。

像他们的守护神使守护神一样，塔利希德之狮通常独自工作或与亲密伙伴组成小团体，很少与其他狮子一起。NPC塔利希德之狮可以在荒野中游荡，与任何以邪恶玷污自然世界的人战斗。他们特别关注那些邪恶存在腐蚀自然本身的区域，表现为邪恶天气和邪恶的腐化生物。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长：塔利希德之狮不获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。
- 每日法咒：在每个塔利希德之狮等级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在添加此进阶职业等级之前所属的神术施法职业也提升了一级。然而，他不会获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处（例如改善的驱散或斥责不死生物的机会）.

要求：

阵营：中立善良。
基础攻击加值：+4。
技能：知识9级，治疗9级。
专长：圣盟恩宠。
法咒：能够施放二级召唤自然盟友.
特殊：角色必须拥有动物伙伴作为职业特性。

职业特性：
等级
1：动物伙伴（Ex）：塔利希德之狮可以将他的塔利希德之狮等级加到他的有效德鲁伊等级（他的实际德鲁伊等级或他巡林客等级的一半） 上，以确定其动物伙伴的能力。
 狮之勇气（Ex）：塔利希德之狮免疫恐惧（魔法或其他），并在对抗其他影响心智的魔法和效果的意志豁免上获得 +4 神圣加值。
2：灵敏嗅觉（Ex）：在2级时，塔利希德之狮获得灵敏嗅觉特殊品质。他可以察觉接近的敌人，嗅出隐藏的敌人，并通过嗅觉追踪。
3：野性变身（Su）：在3级时，塔利希德之狮获得将自己变成任何小型或中型动物并变回的能力，每天一次。这与德鲁伊的野性变身能力完全相同。
4：崇善同伴：在4级时，塔利希德之狮获得崇善同伴专长作为奖励专长。
 野性变身（Su） (2 / 天).
5：狮之猛扑（Ex）：在5级时，塔利希德之狮可以在冲锋结束时进行全力攻击。
 野性变身（Su） (3 / 天).
6：野性变身（Su）（大型）* 
7：狮之迅捷（Ex）：当他达到7级时，塔利希德之狮可以如同受到加速术效果影响一样行动，每天总共1轮每职业等级。这些轮数不必连续。
8：野性变身（Su） (4 / 天).
9：野性变身（Su）（微型）*
10：利昂纳尔之吼（Su）：每天三次，10级塔利希德之狮可以发出咆哮，复制利昂纳尔之吼法咒的效果。豁免检定DC为20 + 塔利希德之狮的魅力调整值。

* 未实现
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The undisputed ruler of the guardinals, Talisid the Celestial Lion is an enormously powerful force for good, and good alone, undiluted by concerns of law or chaos. He is also a mighty druid, and his mortal and guardinal champions are druids and rangers who share both his fierce hatred of evil and his passionate love of the natural world and its creatures. Called the lions of Talisid, these protectors of nature and champions of good emulate their celestial patron in more concrete ways: adopting feline animal companions, assuming great cat forms with their wild shape ability, and eventually roaring like a leonal. Druids and rangers most commonly become lions of Talisid, and only a character with an animal companion can enter the class. Multiclass druid/rangers also commonly adopt the class, and less commonly, fighter/druids or cleric/rangers.

Like their guardinal patron, lions of Talisid usually work alone or in small groups of close companions, rarely with other lions. NPC lions of Talisid can be found wandering the wilderness, fighting any who would defile the natural world with evil.  They are particularly concerned with areas where some evil presence corrupts nature itself, manifesting evil weather and vile corrupted creatures.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A lion of Talisid does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.
- Spells per Day: At each lion of Talisid level the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class to which he belonged before adding the prestige class level. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (such as an improved chance of turning or rebuking undead). 

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Neutral good.
Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Skills: Lore 9 ranks, Heal 9 ranks.
Feats: Favored of the Companions.
Spells: Able to cast Summon Nature's Ally II.
Special: The character must have an animal companion as a class feature.

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Animal Companion (Ex): A lion of Talisid can add his lion of Talisid levels to his effective druid level (his actual druid level or one-half his ranger level) to determine the capabilities of his animal companion.
 Lion's Courage (Ex): A lion of Talisid is immune to fear (magical or otherwise) and gains a +4 sacred bonus on Will saves against other mind-affecting spells and effects.
2:  Scent (Ex): At 2nd level, a lion of Talisid gains the scent special quality. He can detect approaching enemies, sniff out hidden foes, and track by sense of smell.
3:  Wild Shape (Su): At 3rd level, a lion of Talisid gains the ability to turn himself into any Small or Medium animal and back again once per day. This works exactly as the druid's wild shape ability.
4:  Exalted Companion: At 4th level, a lion of Talisid gains the Exalted Companion feat as a bonus feat.
 Wild Shape (Su) (2 / day).
5:  Lion's Pounce (Ex): At 5th level, a lion of Talisid can make a full attack at the end of a charge.
 Wild Shape (Su) (3 / day).
6: Wild Shape (Su) (Large)* 
7: Lion's Swiftness (Ex): When he reaches 7th level, a lion of Talisid can act as if under the effects of a haste spell for a total of 1 round per class level per day. These rounds need not be consecutive.
8: Wild Shape (Su) (4 / day).
9: Wild Shape (Su) (Tiny)*
10: Leonal's Roar (Su): Three times a day, a 10th-level lion of Talisid can issue a roar that duplicates the effects of the leonal's roar spell. The saving throw DC is 20 + the lion of Talisid's Charisma modifier.

* Not implemented

拉姆的指镖
变化系 [邪恶]
等级：腐化 2
成分：言语 姿势，腐化
施法时间：1 动作
距离：中距（100 尺 + 10 尺/等级）
目标：至多五个生物，其中任意两个之间的距离不得超过 15 尺
持续时间：立即
豁免检定：无
法术抗力：是

施法者的手指会变成危险的飞镖，从她手中飞出并精准地击中目标。飞镖造成 1d4 点敏捷
伤害。没有手指的生物无法施放此法咒。

飞镖会精准地击中目标，即使目标处于近战中或具有部分掩蔽或隐蔽。无生命物体（锁，门等） 无法被此法咒伤害。

施法者等级每超过 1 级三级，施法者便可通过再失去一根手指来获得一支额外的飞镖：4 级时两支，7 级时三支，10 级时四支，13 级或更高时达到最多五支飞镖。如果施法者射出多支飞镖，她可以让它们击中同一个生物或多个生物。一支飞镖只能击中一个生物。施法者必须在检查法术抗力或伤害之前指定目标。

因该法咒失去的手指可通过使用复原术或再生术重新长出。

腐化代价：每支飞镖造成 1 点力量伤害，外加每支飞镖失去一根手指。只有一根或没有手指的手无法使用。

善良阵营的施法者不能施放腐化法咒。
src:
Lahm's Finger Darts
Transmutation [Evil]
Level: Corrupt 2
Components: V S, Corrupt
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets: Up to five creatures, no two of which can
be more than 15 ft. apart
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

The caster's finger becomes a dangerous projectile that flies from her hand and unerringly strikes its target. The dart deals 1d4 points of Dexterity
damage. Creatures without fingers cannot cast this spell.

The dart strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee or has partial cover or concealment. Inanimate objects (locks, doors, and so forth) cannot be damaged by the spell.

For every three caster levels beyond 1st, the caster gains an additional dart by losing an additional finger: two at 4th level, three at 7th level, four at 10th level, and the maximum of five darts at 13th level or higher. If the caster shoots multiple darts, she can have them strike a single creature or several creatures. A single dart can strike only one creature. The caster must designate targets before checking for spell resistance or damage.

Fingers lost to this spell grow back with the use of a Restoration or Regeneration spell.

Corruption Cost: 1 point of Strength damage per dart, plus the loss of one finger per dart. A hand with one or no fingers is useless.

Casters of good alignment cannot cast Corrupt spells.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Fist of Raziel represents a knightly order dedicated to the celestial patron of holy warfare against evil. Raziel's crusaders lead the charge against evil wherever it is found. Smiting Evil is their specialty.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: The Fist of Raziel gains proficiency in simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields(except tower shield).
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Lawful Good.
Feats: Power Attack, Servant of The Heavens.
Skills: Persuade 5 ranks, Lore 5 ranks.
Divine Spellcasting: Can cast 1st level spells.
Base Attack Bonus: 6
Spell: Able to cast Divine Favor

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Magic Circle Against Evil - Constant magic circle, as the spell.
  Smite Evil (Weapon considered Divine) - Can smite evil once a day
3: Smite Evil (all threat are critical rolls) - Can smite evil twice a day.
5: Smite Evil (+2d6 Holy dmg vs. Evil) - Can smite evil three times a day.
  Sanctify Martial Strike: A specific weapon gains dmg +1 vs. Evil and +1d4 vs. Outsider and Undead ( Prerequisite: Charisma 15 and Weapon Focus).
7: Smite Evil (+2d8 Holy dmg vs. Outsider or Undead Evil) - Can smite evil four times a day. Doesn't stack with +2d6 dmg.
9: Smite Evil (Smite all targets in area to a maximum of five) - Can smite evil five times a day.
10: Holy Martial Strike - Any weapon wielded is treated as +2d6 Holy damage vs. Evil.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Fist of Raziel, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (Cleric or Paladin). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

src:
Wild dwarves are primitive inhabitant of the jungle. They have largely rejected the clan based craft- and smith-oriented culture of their dwarf cousins, choosing instead to live in hunting bands with ever shifting memberships. Wild dwarves are dark-skinned, short and stout, with dark brown eyes. Their heavenly tattooed bodies are covered with grease to ward off insects.

Wild Dwarven Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass wild dwarf's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Wild Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Improved Hardiness vs. Poisons: +3 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Resist Disease: +4 racial bonus on saving throws versus disease.
- Offensive Training vs. Orcs: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Use Poison: Wild Dwarves gain automatic success when coating a weapon with poison
- Resist Fire: Innate fire resistance of 5
- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Dwarven: Wild Dwarves count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

dst:
在维拉尔的废墟中，我们发现了一个魔法拉杆，可以打开一道通往奥喀斯领域的界门。奥喀斯是一位塔纳厘领主，有时被称为“不死亲王”，因为他推崇死灵法术。他所统治的深渊层面是一个冰封的领域，除了该位面常见的恶魔实体外，还充斥着成群的亡灵。如果我们愿意，可以利用这道界门探索他的领域。这样的探险很可能极其危险，但也可能有利可图。

我现在已经探索了界门之外深渊领域的很大一部分并返回。也许这已经足够了，不过继续深入探索或许也有价值。
src:
In the ruins of Vehlarr, we found a magical lever that can open a portal to the realm of Orcus, a lord of the Tanar'ri, sometimes referred to as the "Prince of the Undead," due to his promotion of necromantic practices. The layer of the Abyss he rules is a frozen realm filled with hordes of undead in addition to the demonic entities one would expect to find on that plane. We could use this portal to explore his realm if we wished. Such an expedition is likely to be very hazardous, but it might also be profitable.

I have now come back after exploring a significant portion of the Abyssal realm beyond the portal. Perhaps that is sufficient, though it is possible it would be worthwhile to explore further.

这里设置了一块告示板，上面列出了各种被悬赏通缉的罪犯信息，供那些有兴趣追捕赏金的人参考。以下内容引起了你的注意：

梅贾拉什·塞巴尔，一名通缉犯，据信藏匿在城市下水道系统的某处。他的首级悬赏500金币。

纳德查尔·内内布，一名通缉犯，据说藏匿在城市的贫民窟中。他的首级悬赏500金币。

“暗影刺客”，某个已经躲藏起来的犯罪组织。遗憾的是，告示上没有提供任何关于他们可能藏身之处的线索，但悬赏1000金币将他们绳之以法。

萨达拉什，一名暗影德鲁伊，一直在卡林杉的道路上领导对旅行者的袭击。除非你离开城市的范围，否则不太可能遇到他，但如果你真的遇到了，请记住他的首级悬赏1500金币。
src:
A sheet has been set up here with information on various wanted criminals who have prices on their heads, for the benefit of those with an interest in hunting bounties. The following catch your eye:

Mejalash Sebar, a wanted criminal believed to be hiding out somewhere in the city's sewer system. There is a bounty of 500 gold on his head.

Nadchar Neneb, a wanted criminal said to be hiding out in the city slums. There is a bounty of 500 gold on his head.

The "Darkshadow Assassins," a criminal organization of some sort that has gone into hiding. Unfortunately the poster offers no clues as to where they might be found, but there is a bounty of 1000 gold offered for bringing them to justice.

Sadarash, a shadow druid, who has been leading raids against travelers on the roads of Calimshan. It does not seem likely you will encounter him unless you leave the confines of the city, but if you do there is a bounty of 1500 gold on his head to keep in mind.

被称为暗影盗贼的组织是整个费伦最大且最繁荣的盗贼公会。它的成功源于其相互关联的公会体系，每个公会都致力于利润和权力这两个目标。从该组织在安姆的据点开始，这一系列公会控制着剑湾沿岸所有犯罪活动的最大份额，并且还延伸到该地区以外的费伦许多其他地方。作为暗影盗贼公会的一员，安姆影贼只知道自己的下属，同事和上级。这种保密网络保护了组织，因为任何被抓获的成员只能出卖少数其他人。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The organization known as the Shadow Thieves is the largest and most prosperous thieves guild in all of Faer�n. Its success is derived from its system of interlocking guilds, each dedicated to the twin goals of profit and power. From the organization's stronghold in Amn, this series of guilds controls the lion's share of all criminal operations along the Sword Coast, and it also reaches beyond that area into many other parts of Faer�n. As a member of a Shadow Thieves' guild, a shadow thief of Amn knows only her own minions, her coworkers, and her superior. This web of secrecy preserves the organization, because any members who are captured can sell out only a few others. 

- Hit die: d6
- Proficiencies: The Shadow Thief of Amn gains simple weapon and light armor proficiencies
- Skill points per level: 6 + Int modifier

REQUIREMENTS
Skills: Bluff 3 ranks, Hide 8 ranks, Intimidate 3 ranks, Move Silently 3 ranks 
Feats: Persuasive

CLASS SKILLS
Appraise, Bluff, Climb, Craft, Persuade, Disable Device, Intimidate, Jump, Lore, Listen, Move Silently, Open Lock, Pick Pocket, Search, Sense Motive, Spot

CLASS FEATURES:
1st - Sneak Attack 1d6, Doublespeak - +2 to Bluff and Persuade
2nd - Bonus Feat, Uncanny Dodge
3rd - Sneak Attack 2d6, Leadership Score +1
4th - Bonus Feat, Leadership Score +2

dst: 哨兵武器在费伦各地以各种形态出现。正如其名所示，它们在守卫中很受欢迎。这种版本的武器不仅能以魔法增强使用者发现入侵者的能力，而且在击中目标时会释放一道具有破坏性的音波冲击，既伤害目标，又发出声响召唤其他守卫前来出事地点。仿佛这还不够，刀刃上装饰的精工金饰还能让使用者在站岗时显得威风凛凛。当然，这一切都价格不菲，因此通常只有非常富有的雇主的守卫才能得到这些武器。\n\n这种武器的巨镰版本是为一位贵族打造的，他不知怎么设法让一个食人魔为他充当守卫。标准的哨兵战斧在食人魔巨大的手中显得小得可笑，于是贵族决定需要一件更大、更具威慑力的武器。结果便是这把巨镰（这个巨型食人魔挥舞它时，几乎就像在使用战斧一样）。
src: Sentinel weapons can be found in various forms throughout Faerun. As the name might suggest, they are popular among guards. This version of the weapon not only magically boosts one's ability to spot intruders, but when striking will release a damaging sonic blast that will both hurt the target and create a noise summoning other guards to the trouble spot. As if that were not enough, the finely worked gold plating decorating the blade helps one look impressive while standing on watch. Of course, none of this comes cheaply, so it is generally guards of very wealthy patrons who end up with these weapons.\n\nThe scythe version of the weapon was fashioned for the benefit of a noble who had somehow managed to get an ogre working for him as a guard. The standard battleaxe Sentinel looked laughably small in the ogre's massive hand and the noble decided a larger and more intimidating weapon was needed. The result was this scythe (which the giant ogre wielded much as if it were a battleaxe).

dst: "所以你一路杀到了我这里，无疑杀死了所有挡在你面前的人？我想下一个就是我了。好吧，生存斗争是自然之道，尽管我们今天遭受损失，但最终你的筛选只会让我们的目标更强大！你所为之战斗的东西注定要失败。所有文明最终都必须衰落。我身后的废墟曾经是一座高耸入云的大塔，但现在看看它。它是自然秩序最终胜利的象征。我所服务的正是那个秩序，为此我会做任何必要的事情。自然就是一切，为了她，一切都是正当的！"
src: "So you have fought your way to me, doubtless slaying all who stood before you? I suppose I am next. Well, the struggle for survival is the way of nature, and though we suffer losses today, in the end your winnowing will only make our cause the stronger! What you fight for is doomed. All civilizations must eventually fall. Once the ruin behind me was a great tower, reaching to the heavens, but look at it now. It is a symbol of the ultimate triumph of the natural order. It is that order I serve, and I do whatever is necessary in that service. Nature is all, and all is justified for her sake!"

dst: 幽暗地域的黑暗精灵所掌握的工艺和附魔力量可能相当惊人，这件强大的武器就是证明。然而，像许多卓尔的产品一样，它使用了幽暗地域独有的魔法材料，并依赖该地区不寻常的魔法才能发挥作用。如果暴露在阳光下任何一段时间，它预计会解体。\n\n注意：如果将此物品带出幽暗地域，它会解体，因此如果你使用它，最好保留一些其他武器作为备用，以备最终逃离这个地下区域。
src: The craftsmanship and powers of enchantment wielded by the dark elves of the Underdark can be quite impressive, as this powerful weapon demonstrates. However, like many products of the Drow, it employs magical materials unique to the Underdark, and dependent on the unusual magics of that region to function. It can be expected to disintegrate if exposed to sunlight for any length of time.\n\nNOTE: This item will disintegrate if removed from the Underdark, so if you use it you would be well-advised to keep some other weapon in reserve, in anticipation of eventually escaping this subterranean region.

dst: “要离开这片洞穴网络，我们必须一路打穿奥布格隆召唤来守卫这里的各种怪物：元素生物、魔像之类的。我们联合起来的力量应该足以应付。我们必须先往南走，然后往东北，再上去，然后往西。通往上面、进入矿坑本体的门隐藏在那条路的尽头，但我知道该往哪里找，当我们似乎走到死胡同时，我应该能把它找出来。然后我们还得对付矿坑里那些兽人和食人魔。我仍然认为我们所有人联手可以对付他们。不过，还有一个问题，那个可没那么容易克服。”
src: "To get out of this network of caves, we will have to fight our way through various monsters Obgron has summoned to defend them: elementals and golems and such. Our combined power should suffice for that. We must go down to the south, then northeast, up again, and then west. The door up and into the mine proper is concealed at the end of that path, but I shall know where to look and should be able to search it out when we appear to reach a dead end. We will then have to fight the various orcs and ogres who populate the mines. Again, I think all of us together can face them. There is one more problem, however, which will not be so easy to overcome."

dst: 我听说过泽克斯卡顿宝珠的传说，据说在这一带的幽暗地域废墟中可以找到不少这样的宝珠。泽克斯卡顿是许久以前的一名卓尔巫师，他制作了这些宝珠。它们蕴含着强大的魔法，但用途不明。也许找回那些能找到的宝珠会有些价值。\n\n在扎拉拉绑架者阿佐芬的巢穴中，我对这些宝珠有了更多了解。显然，这个阿佐芬建立了一套系统，可以从宝珠中汲取力量，并将其赋予一个活体目标。在阿佐芬巢穴的最底层有一个基座，会吸收放置其上的任何此类宝珠。当一个或多个宝珠被基座消耗后（力量程度显然与使用的数量成正比），任何随后操作附近拉杆的人都会获得其中蕴含的力量。目前尚不清楚这具体意味着什么，但这很可能是我自己可以利用的东西。
src: I have heard tales of the orbs of Xerxkatun, of which a number can apparently be found in ruins in this part of the Underdark. Xerxkatun was a Drow wizard who lived long ago, and fashioned these orbs. They contain great magic, but their purpose is unclear. Perhaps there is some value in recovering those that can be found.\n\nIn the lair of Azoophun, Zarala's kidnapper, I learned more about these orbs. Apparently this Azoophun has set up a system to draw power from the orbs and confer them on a living subject. On the lowest level of Azoophun's lair there is a pedestal which will absorb any of these orbs placed on it. After one or more orbs (the degree of power will apparently be proportional to the number used) are consumed by the pedestal, anyone who then operates the nearby lever will thereby acquire the power they contain. It is not clear precisely what that means, but this might well be something I could make use of myself.

dst: 在探索幽暗地域时，我遇到了一位名叫马弗瑞斯·萨拉彭的人类法师，他暂时居住在一个地下洞穴中，研究幽暗地域特有的奇异魔法。他让我寻找三件对他的研究有重要意义的物品：一枚石化蜥蜴的眼睛，一份胶质怪或类似软泥怪的灵液，以及一份囚魂魔的脑组织。这些生物应该都能在幽暗地域的某处找到。他承诺为每件物品支付我4000金币，如果我集齐全部三件，还会额外给我一件特殊的魔法物品。看来是时候去打猎了。\n\n我已经把灵液交给了马弗瑞斯。他还需要另外两件物品。
src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a human mage named Mavereth Tharapen, who has taken up temporary residence in an underground cave while he conducts research into the exotic magics peculiar to the Underdark. He asked me to find three items of significance to his research: an eye from a Basilisk, ichor from a Gelatinous Cube or similar slime, and brain matter from an Intellect Devourer. All are creatures that it should be possible to find somewhere in the Underdark. He has promised to pay me 4000 gold for each of these items, and to give me a special magical item in addition if I collect all three. Time to go hunting I suppose.\n\nI have given Mavereth the ichor. He still requires the other two items.

dst: "简而言之，有个人我想让你杀掉。我的理由是我自己的事，而且你会得到报酬，除了别的之外，还因为你不会问太多问题。我相信你有能力，也愿意执行一次秘密暗杀。如果你确实能成功做到，我会付你8000金币，此外，还会给你与我交易的机会（我出售某些在寻常市场上很难找到的物品，也能收购一些你不想随便在别处脱手的东西）。"
src: "To put the matter briefly, there is someone I want you to kill. My reasons are my own, and you will be paid, among other things, for not asking too many questions. I believe you have the skills, and the willingness, to carry out a covert assassination. If indeed you can do so successfully, I shall pay you 8000 gold, and, in addition, give you the opportunity to trade with me (I sell certain items that can be hard to find on the usual markets, and can buy some that you would not want to unload just anywhere)."

dst: “我是历史学家，不是考古学家，所以我不知道该拿那些随机的文物怎么办。我要找的是文字记录。当然，大部分都无法经受时间的流逝而保存下来，但我认为你很有机会找到一些上面有文字的泥板或石板。至于你怎么到达那里，我不太确定。我自己不怎么出门。我想你应该进入下水道系统，然后寻找继续往下走的通道。当然，那里有庞大的下水道网络，其下方还有与天然洞穴交织的庞大废墟网络。不幸的是，找到合适的入口可能需要一些时间。”
src: "I'm a historian, not an archaeologist, so I would not know what to do with random artifacts. It is written records that I seek. Of course most will not have survived the passage of time, but you stand a good chance of finding some clay or stone tablets with writing on them, I think. As to how you get to them, I'm not really sure. I don't get out much myself. I imagine you should enter the sewer system, and look for ways to go even further down. There is of course an extensive network of sewers, and an extensive network of ruins intermixed with natural caves below them. It might take a while to find a suitable access point, unfortunately."

dst: 兽人战士使用弩是罕见的，因为这种技术精密的武器的制造和维护通常超出典型野蛮兽人部落的能力。然而，像这样的偶尔例外确实会出现。这把强力弩的设计与附魔都经过精心计算，旨在帮助兽人战士将他据信拥有的巨大力量发挥到极致，同时弥补通常低于精灵等敌方种族的敏捷。目前尚不清楚它是由一位拥有非凡技艺的兽人工匠制造，还是从更先进的民族那里掠夺来并改装为兽人使用的。
src: It is unusual for orc warriors to be found using crossbows, as the construction and maintenance of such technically sophisticated arms will usually be tasks beyond the capabilities of the typical barbaric orc tribe. Occasional exceptions like this do turn up, however. Both the design and enchantments on this powerful crossbow are calculated to assist an orc warrior in using the great strength he is presumed to have to maximum effect, while compensating for a dexterity often lower than that of enemy races such as elves. It is not known whether it was made by an orc craftsman with unusual skills or looted from a more advanced people and converted to orcish use.
