dst:
银舌面具

描述符：无
职业：魂能师，魂裔
脉轮：眉部或喉部
豁免检定：见文本

一个朴素的银色面具遮住你的下半张脸，同时露出你的眼睛。面具最初没有特征，嘴部有一个简单的水平槽，但当你与他人互动时，微妙的图像会在其表面移动。

你将魂能塑造成一个银蓝色面具，戴在脸上。你的银舌面具在唬骗和交涉检定上给予你 +2 洞察加值。

魂能：你投入到银舌面具中的每一点魂能都会使洞察加值增加 2。

脉轮绑定（眉部）

蓝色水晶镜片从面具上长出，覆盖你的眼睛。这些镜片增强你对肢体语言和举止的敏感度。

你在察言观色检定上获得洞察加值，等于面具在唬骗和交涉检定上提供的加值。

脉轮绑定（喉部）

银色面具融入你的脸和脖子，从颧骨向下到衣领，仿佛你的皮肤变成了银色。当你试图胁迫一个生物时，该生物看到一张可辨认但不太熟悉的面孔。

当绑定到喉部脉轮时，银舌面具允许你随意施放魅惑人类。被此能力瞄准的生物，无论其豁免是否成功，24 小时内不能再被同一能力瞄准。
src:
Silvertongue Mask

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Incarnate, Soulborn 
Chakra: Brow or throat 
Saving Throw: See text

A plain silver mask conceals your lower face while exposing your eyes. The mask is initially featureless, with a simple horizontal slot at your mouth, but subtle images shift across its surface as you interact with others.

You shape incarnum into a silver-blue mask that you wear over your face. Your silvertongue mask grants you a +2 insight bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your silvertongue mask increases the insight bonus by 2. 

Chakra Bind (Brow) 

Blue crystalline lenses grow out from the mask, covering your eyes. These lenses enhance your sensitivity to body language and mannerisms.

You gain an insight bonus on Sense Motive checks equal to the bonus granted on Bluff and Diplomacy checks by the mask. 

Chakra Bind (Throat) 

The silver mask melds into your face and neck, from your cheekbones down to your collar, as if your skin were turned to silver. When you attempt to compel a creature, that creature sees a face that is recognizable, but not quite familiar.

When bound to the throat chakra, the silvertongue mask allows you to cast charm person at will. A creature targeted by this ability, regardless of whether or not it succeeds on its save, can't be targeted again by the same ability for 24 hours.

src: "7 Eleint 1369: I have finally found a method of mutating certain oozes into what I am provisionally calling a 'Regenerating Slime.' This new variety of ooze will be the perfect weapon to employ against dim-wittted warriors who think they can challenge their intellectual superiors among the mages just because they are musclebound and have fancy weapons. Not only is it impervious to physical attack, but such attacks frequently cause part of the creature to split off and form a new slime, as formidable as the first! My controlling spells have proven less than 100% effective, unfortunately, but as, aside of course from a high rate of regeneration, this new variant is quite vulnerable to spells, that is not too serious a concern."

dst:
战斗招式
步骤 1
借机攻击。你试图卸除的目标会对你发动一次借机攻击。（如果你有精通卸除武器专长，你尝试卸除武器时不会引发借机攻击。） 如果防御者的借机攻击命中，你的卸除尝试失败。
步骤 2
对抗检定。你和防御者用各自的武器进行对抗攻击检定。在卸除尝试中使用双手武器的持用者在此检定上获得 +4 加值，使用轻型武器的持用者受到 -4 减值。（徒手击打被视为轻型武器，因此当你试图用徒手击打卸除对手武器时，你总是受到减值。） 如果战斗双方体型不同，较大的一方在攻击检定上每相差一个体型等级获得 +4 加值。
步骤 3
结果。如果你击败防御者，防御者被卸除武器。如果你以徒手尝试卸除动作，你现在持有该武器。如果你持用武器，防御者的武器掉落在防御者所在方格的地面上。
如果你的卸除尝试失败，防御者可以立即反应，并试图以同样的对抗近战攻击检定卸除你的武器。他的尝试不会引发你的借机攻击。如果他卸除尝试失败，你也不会因此获得对他的一次免费卸除尝试。
使用：选择
src:
COMBAT MANEUVER
Step 1
Attack of Opportunity. You provoke an attack of opportunity from the target you are trying to disarm. (If you have the Improved Disarm feat, you don't incur an attack of opportunity for making a disarm attempt.) If the defender's attack of opportunity hits, your disarm attempt fails. 
Step 2
Opposed Rolls. You and the defender make opposed attack rolls with your respective weapons. The wielder of a two-handed weapon on a disarm attempt gets a +4 bonus on this roll, and the wielder of a light weapon takes a -4 penalty. (An unarmed strike is considered a light weapon, so you always take a penalty when trying to disarm an opponent by using an unarmed strike.) If the combatants are of different sizes, the larger combatant gets a bonus on the attack roll of +4 per difference in size category. 
Step 3
Consequences. If you beat the defender, the defender is disarmed. If you attempted the disarm action unarmed, you now have the weapon. If you were armed, the defender's weapon is on the ground in the defender's square. 
If you fail on the disarm attempt, the defender may immediately react and attempt to disarm you with the same sort of opposed melee attack roll. His attempt does not provoke an attack of opportunity from you. If he fails his disarm attempt, you do not subsequently get a free disarm attempt against him. 
Use: Selected

src: Elcalden Kamas, the gardener on the Galhadr Estate, has made a request of me. If I ever find myself out in the Calim Desert, he wants me to keep an eye out for any plants that are hardy enough to survive in that harsh environment, and bring him some seeds from them. He believes that he can use such seeds to assist his work in helping gardens prosper in a desert city. I do not know if or when I will find myself back in the desert, but I should remember this at such time as my adventures take me there. Elcalden has promised to reward me with a valuable piece of gear left over from his adventuring days if I do this for him.\n\nI have just been assigned a quest that will be taking me into the desert. This may be my opportunity to find some seeds from the flora there.

src:
Epic Witchborn Binders are the final bulwark against arcane tyranny. Having mastered the fusion of incarnum and anti-magic, they become living wards, nullifying spellcraft with a gesture, and shackling even the most powerful wizards in prisons of soulstuff. At this level, their presence alone can suppress magical auras, unravel arcane constructs, and seal away reality-bending threats. Vigilant and relentless, an epic Witchborn Binder is both a hunter and a sentinel, wielding pure incarnum as a weapon of justice.

Hit Die: d6.
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Intelligence modifier.
Bonus Feats: The epic Witchborn Binder gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:
Meldshaping: Meldshaper level increases as if gaining a level in your meldshaper class at each Witchborn Binder class level.

Epic Witchborn Binder Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Fortitude, Epic Prowess, Epic Reflexes, Epic Reputation, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Toughness, Epic Will, Great Constitution, Superior Initiative, Bonus Soulmeld, Epic Essentia, Extra Chakra Bind, Open Heart Chakra, Open Soul Chakra, Rapid Meldshaping, Rebind Soulmeld.

dst: 住在码头附近一所房子里的凯拉·肯尼曼，请求我找到她的丈夫本，并让他回家。据她说，我可以在欢憩旅店找到他，他正和他的朋友克拉夫·德尔森在那里喝酒。\n\n克拉夫·德尔森让我去泪之屋（伊尔梅特的一座神殿）找本·肯尼曼，那里的一位牧师告诉我，本去市场买工具了。市场的一个商人告诉我，他去了家具店。家具店的老板告诉我，本从那里离开后，去拜访了一位名叫伦斯·门纳德的朋友，那人的家在东边（现已标记在我的地图上）。看来我接下来必须去那里。我开始怀疑自己到底能不能追上这个人。
src: Kyra Kenemen, who resides in a house near the docks, has asked me to locate her husband, Ben, and ask him to return home. According to her, I can expect to find him at the Winsome Repose Inn, drinking with his friend Clav Derlson.\n\nClav Derlson told me to look for Ben Kenement at the House of Tears (a temple of Ilmater), and a priest there told me Ben had gone shopping for tools in the markets. A merchant there told me that he went to the furniture store. The proprietor of the furniture store informed me that Ben had gone on from there to visit a friend of his named Rence Mennald, whose home can be found to the east (now marked on my map). It seems I must go there next. I begin to wonder if I will ever catch up with this man.

dst:
在扎泽斯普尔下方的下水道中，我遇到了一位名叫贾尔凯西·扎鲁的冒险者，随后一路杀穿了一个蛇人藏身处，将她从陷阱中救出。据她说，蛇人来到这里是为了在城下更深处矮人沙纳塔的废墟中寻找某件有价值的东西。她不知道他们在寻找什么，但如果它重要到值得付出如此努力，那么无论它是什么，落入这些可疑之人手中都绝非好事。附近有一条向下通往这些废墟的道路，无疑有更多蛇人把守。我决定陪她一起沿这条路前进，挫败蛇人的计划。该下去了。

看来蛇人来到这里是为了重新打开一道通往深渊的传送门，这道门是矮人很久以前发现并封印的。自然，阻止他们这样做是明智的，或者如果我们来不及阻止它被打开，就设法关闭传送门。矮人的一些铭文表明，传送门由位于传送门另一侧深渊中一座塔内的某种魔法维持开启，而矮人存放在一个“谜题室”中的钥匙或许能帮助我们进入那里。

我们击溃了阻挡我们的蛇人，但不幸的是，为时已晚，未能阻止传送门开启。我们必须穿过传送门，找到那座藏有维持传送门开启之魔法的塔，否则扎泽斯普尔就有被塔纳厘大军吞没的危险。
src:
In the sewers beneath Zazesspur, I came across an adventurer named Jalkesi Tzaru, and then fought through a Yuan-Ti hideout to free her from a trap. According to her, the Yuan-Ti are here to seek out something of value in some ruins of dwarven Shanatar that can be found further beneath the city. She does not know what they seek, but if it is important enough to be worth such effort, it can hardly be desirable for whatever it might be to fall into such dubious hands. A path leading down and eventually to these ruins lies nearby, doubtless guarded by additional Yuan-Ti. I have decided to accompany her as she seeks to follow this path and foil the plans of the Yuan-Ti. Time to head down.

It appears that the Yuan-Ti are here to reopen a portal to the Abyss that the dwarves uncovered, but then sealed, long ago. Naturally it would be desirable to prevent them from doing this, or somehow close the portal if we are too late to prevent it from being uncovered. Some inscriptions of the dwarves suggest that the portal is kept open by some magic located in a tower in the Abyss on the far side of the portal, and that a key stored by the dwarves in a "Puzzle Room" might aid us in entering it.

We have crushed the Yuan-Ti who opposed us, but unfortunately did so too late to prevent the opening of the portal. We shall have to go through the portal and find the tower containing the magic keeping it open, or risk Zazesspur being engulfed by a massive onslaught of Tanar'ri.

偏好职业（任意）：在判断兼职阿塔斯半精灵是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其最高职业不计入。

特殊能力：
- 部分技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 部分技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 部分技能亲和（侦察）：侦察检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 敏锐感官：阿塔斯精灵自动进行主动搜索检定，且没有移动惩罚。
- 技能亲和（动物 empathy）：动物 empathy 检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 微光视觉：允许他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 精灵：在法咒效果方面，阿塔斯半精灵被视为精灵。
src:
Half-elves on the world of Athas are notorious loners.  Partly this stems form a lack of self-confidence due to their mixed blood.  Their elven blood makes them distrusted among humans, while elven tradition demands they be abandoned.  They will cooperate with companions, but find it difficult to rely on anyone.  Many find companionship among the animals, these skills lending themselves well to being beast handlers in human society. Physically they are bulkier than elves, standing around 6' tall.  Usually they find it easier to pass themselves off as humans, but they always have some features that hint at their heritage.

Athasian Half-Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Any): A multiclass Athasian half-elf's highest class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- Partial Skill Affinity (Listen): +1 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Search): +1 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Spot): +1 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Athasian Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Skill Affinity (Animal Empathy): +2 racial bonus to Animal Empathy checks.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Athasian Half-Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

在1级时，你从你的神圣 patron（同时也是你牧师法咒以及直接或间接地你的邪术师咒法的来源）获得一份神圣的力量恩赐。

腐化爆裂：你可以将你的邪术爆裂转变为腐化爆裂，以代替对其施加邪术精华咒法。除了其正常效果外，该爆裂对目标的下一次意志豁免施加等于你职业等级一半的减值（最低-1）.如果目标在你的下一轮结束前未尝试意志豁免，该效果消失。

伤害减免：你获得等于你职业等级一半（最低1）的临时伤害减免（由寒铁克服）.此伤害减免与邪术师职业提供的伤害减免叠加。此效果持续轮数等于3 + 你的魅力调整值（最低1轮）.

恐惧怒视：你可以使你30英尺内的一个活物战栗1轮（意志豁免无效；DC 10 + 职业等级 + 魅力调整值）.该生物的生命骰不能超过你的角色等级。

恶魔抗力：你获得等于10 + 你职业等级的强酸和火焰抗力。此抗力与邪术师职业提供的能量抗力叠加。此效果持续轮数等于3 + 你的魅力调整值（最低1轮）.你的神祇必须为邪恶，你才能选择此恩赐。

治疗爆裂：你可以将你的邪术爆裂转变为治疗爆裂，以代替对其施加邪术精华咒法。该爆裂治疗活物而非对其造成伤害（治疗的伤害等于正常造成的伤害）.对不死生物，治疗爆裂正常造成伤害；对构装体或物体，治疗爆裂无效。你的神祇必须为非邪恶，你才能选择此恩赐。

防护灵光：你以自己为中心被一个防邪恶法阵环绕。此效果持续轮数等于3 + 你的魅力调整值（最低1轮）.你的神祇必须为善良，你才能选择此恩赐。

意志之力：你在下一次抵抗影响心智的法咒或能力的豁免上获得等于你职业等级一半的加值（最低+1）.此效果持续轮数等于3 + 你的魅力调整值（最低1轮）；如果你在这段时间内未尝试相应的豁免，该效果结束。

狂野狂暴：你在近战武器和邪术爆裂的攻击检定和伤害检定上获得+2加值，同时获得等于你职业等级两倍的临时生命值。此效果持续轮数等于3 + 你的魅力调整值（最低1轮）.你的神祇必须为混乱，你才能选择此恩赐。
src:
At 1st level, you gain a sacred gift of power from your divine patron (who is also the source of your cleric spells and, directly or indirectly, your warlock invocations).

Choose one of the following abilities at 1st level, and another ability every three levels thereafter, to a maximum of four at 10th level. You can spend one of your turn/rebuke undead attempts as a swift action to activate the chosen power.

Corrupting Blast: In place of applying an eldritch essence invocation to your eldritch blast, you can change it into a corrupting blast. In addition to its normal effect, the blast applies a penalty on the target's next Will save equal to 1/2 your class level (minimum -1). If the target doesn't attempt a Will save before the end of your next turn, the effect fades.

Damage Reduction: You gain temporary damage reduction (overcome by cold iron) equal to 1/2 your class level (minimum 1).This damage reduction stacks with the damage reduction granted by the warlock class. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Cha modifier (minimum 1 round).

Fearful Glare: You can render a single living creature within 30 feet of you shaken for 1 round (Will negates; DC 10 + class level + Cha modifier). The creature's HD can't exceed your character level.

Fiendish Resistance: You gain resistance to acid and fire equal to 10 + your class level. This resistance stacks with the energy resistance granted by the warlock class. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Cha modifier (minimum 1 round). Your deity must be evil for you to select this gift.

Healing Blast: In place of applying an eldritch essence invocation to your eldritch blast, you can change it into a healing blast. The blast heals living creatures instead of dealing damage to them (the damage healed is equal to the damage normally dealt). Against undead, the healing blast deals damage as normal; against constructs or objects, the healing blast has no effect. Your deity must be non-evil for you to select this gift.

Protective Aura: You surround yourself with a magic circle against evil centered on you. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Cha modifier (minimum 1 round). Your deity must be good for you to select this gift.

Strength of Will: You gain a bonus equal to 1/2 your class level (minimum +1) on your next save to resist a mind-affecting spell or ability. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Cha modifier (minimum 1 round); if you haven't attempted an appropriate save in this time, the effect ends.

Wild Frenzy: You gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with melee weapons and eldritch blasts, along with temporary hit points equal to twice your class level. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Cha modifier (minimum 1 round). Your deity must be chaotic for you to select this gift.

(TEMPLATE CLASS)
Feared by mortal beings for their malign magic, their intelligence, and their willingness to embrace undeath for a chance to live forever, Liches are evil beings of great power.

This template class is the evolution of an Arcane or Divine caster of level 11 or greater into the feared Lich. The progression of un-death is not to be taken lightly, and it may completely destroy the one who seeks it. The Lich does not gain any spells or caster levels, yet they gain heavy defenses.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Lich does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill points: 0 + Int Modifier.
As a template class:
- No BAB increase.
- No Save increase.

Spells: Must be able to cast at least 6th level arcane spells.

Feat: Craft Wondrous Item.
Must not have any levels in Baelnorn.
Must be humanoid

To gain lich powers:
Creation of first stage of phylactery. (First level up in the Lich class, then create your phylactery using the Craft Lich Items feat to gain your Lich powers. Each level, this phylactery must be upgraded. Costs 40,000 gold and 1,600 XP.)

Level

In addition, anyone that remains within the energy wall takes 2d6 points of damage +1 point per manifester level (maximum +20).

If you manifest the wall so that it appears where creatures are, each creature takes damage as if passing through the wall.

Electricity: Manifesting a sheet of this energy type provides a +2 bonus to the save DC and a +2 bonus on manifester level checks for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
Fire: A sheet of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.
Sonic: A sheet of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

dst: 在尖牙森林扎营的竖琴手向我们介绍了一位名叫冈德·迅矛的矮人游侠。这位冈德知道在哪里可以找到巨龙格拉阿扎乌库尔的巢穴，但只有我们帮助他完成击败效忠于大地精法师乌拉斯的类地精劫掠者的任务，他才会告诉我们。乌拉斯和他的副官们拥有魔法“召回石”，一旦他们有死亡危险，召回石就会将他们传送走，使得最终击败他们似乎不可能。然而，冈德发现了一个他认为的机会。其中一位名叫莫古兹的副官正在研究这片森林中的一座古老地精神殿。这座神殿位于一个死魔法区，这意味着莫古兹拥有的召回石在那里无法生效。正如冈德计划的那样，我们在这个死魔法区内与莫古兹对峙，并成功杀死了他，而没有让石头发挥作用逃脱。冈德打算拿走这块召回石，并将其带给奥术研究者，他们有望想出反制它的方法。\n\n我们击败了莫古兹，取回了他的召回石并交给了冈德。作为回报，我们得知了格拉阿扎乌库尔巢穴的位置（我们可以从森林中心向东走，穿过一片蜘蛛出没的区域找到它），并可以前往那里进行我们的下一个任务。
src: The Harpers camped in the Wood of Sharp Teeth introduced us to a dwarven ranger named Gund Swiftspear. This Gund knew where to find the lair of the dragon Gra'azha'ukul, but would only tell us if we aided him in his quest to defeat the goblinoid raiders loyal to the Hobgoblin mage Ulaz. Ulaz and his lieutenants posses magical "recall stones" which will teleport them away if they are in danger of death, making it seemingly impossible to finally defeat them. Gund, however, had found what he believed to be an opportunity. One of these lieutenants, named Moguz, was researching an old goblin shrine in these woods. This shrine was located in a dead magic zone, meaning that the recall stone possessed by Moguz would not work there. As Gund planned, we confronted Moguz while in this dead magic zone, and were able to kill him without the stone being used to effect an escape. Gund intends to take this recall stone and bring it to arcane researchers who can hopefully come up with a way to counter-act it.\n\nWe defeated Moguz, recovered his recall stone and delivered it to Gund. In return, we have been informed of the location of Gra'azha'ukul's lair (we can find it by going east from the center of the wood, and passing beyond a spider-infested area), and can proceed there for our next quest.

dst: "嗯，它大约写于DR -3500年，由矮人历史学家巴伦·塔鲁克所著，记载了矮人国度沙纳塔截至当时的历史。据信其中包含许多关于早期沙纳塔的历史信息，这些信息在该国覆灭后便失传于后世，只要有一份完整的抄本，历史学家们定会极为珍视。然而目前并没有这样的抄本。我们仅因较晚近的历史学家引用过这部著作，才得知它的存在。无论如何，如果你能找回那座废墟中应有的那一本，烛堡肯定会很有兴趣获得一份抄本。这本书的书页是用薄金属片制成、上面压印字母的，就像某些矮人书籍那样，所以它应该能历经岁月而保存下来。"
src: "Well, it was written in about -3500 DR by the dwarven historian Barun Tharuk, chronicling the history of the Dwarven realm of Shanater up to that point in time. It is believed to contain much historical information about early Shanatar that was lost to later generations after that nation's fall, and would be quite valued by historians if only a complete copy were available. At the moment, however, no such copy is available. We only know of the work's existence on account of its being quoted by more recent historians. At any rate, Candlekeep would definitely be interested in acquiring a copy if you can recover the one that should be in this ruin. The pages of this book were made of thin sheets of metal with the letters stamped on them, as some dwarven books are, so it should have survived the passage of years."

dst:
卡达斯和他的探险队正在卡林沙漠中发掘一些古代遗迹。然而，在地下探索中，他们遭遇了巨型蜘蛛和亡灵带来的麻烦。由于没有准备好应对这些障碍，卡达斯请我替他探索遗迹。如果可能的话，我应该清除其中的怪物，或者至少留意那些有助于他研究的重要历史文物。

在探索遗迹时，一扇受魔法控制的门在我身后砰然关闭。从这一侧似乎无法打开它：看来我可能被困在遗迹里了！我唯一能想到的办法就是继续深入，希望能找到另一个出口。

深入遗迹后，我遇到了一名古代角斗士的亡灵遗骸。他出奇地健谈。他告诉我，要逃离遗迹，我必须先摧毁他，并拿走他持有的一块魔法石。这将使我能够使用附近的两座界门。如果我选对了界门，就会发现自己踏上一条通往地牢更深处的路，并有望找到另一个出口。选错界门则会把我送到他所谓的“末日之室”，那听起来是个最好避开的地方。
"我明白了。当然，我不能允许你谋杀这个可怜的女孩。"

有些人就是喜欢打架。无论是在酒馆里，为朋友的荣誉而战，还是在后巷里抢劫老人，斗殴者的主要能力就是用拳头把敌人打得失去知觉。有些人成为了职业选手，为了金钱和名声参加体育比赛。其他人则大多默默无闻，纯粹为了打架的乐趣而战。还有些人成为了冒险者，意识到自己的才能也可以用来对付怪物。所有斗殴者都有一个共同点：偏好用拳头战斗。然而，他们仍然可以拿起武器并以惊人的效率挥舞，使他们成为致命的战斗者。

注意：如果与武僧兼职，角色将使用更好的徒手伤害。它不会叠加。此外，兼职武僧会瘫痪暗示某些斗殴者奖励专长的使用（见下文。）

src:
(BASE CLASS)
Some people just like to fight. Whether it be in a pub, defending a friend's honor, or in a back alley, robbing an old man, a brawler's primary ability is using his fists to bludgeon his enemies senseless. Some become professionals, fighting in sports events for money and fame. Others remain largely unknown, fighting for the sheer pleasure of it. Yet others become adventurers, realizing their talents can be used on monsters as well. All brawlers share one thing in common: a preference for fighting with their fists. However, they can still pick up weapons and swing them with awesome efficiency, making them deadly combatants.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: The brawler is proficient in simple and martial weapons and all armor and shields
- Skill Points Per Level: 4 + Int Modifier

CLASS SKILLS

Craft, Discipline, Heal, Intimidate, Jump, Lore, Perform, Spot, Tumble

CLASS FEATURES:

Base Attack: +1 per level
Saving Throws: Fortitude - strong, Will - weak, Reflex - weak

Level
1: Brawler Fists (1d6)
  Bonus Feat
  Improved Unarmed Strike

8: Bonus Feat

  Bonus Feat

30: Brawler Fists (2d10, +5 Enhancement)
32: Bonus Feat
35: Bonus Feat
36: Brawler Fists (3d8, +6 Enhancement)
38: Bonus Feat

Brawler Fists: A brawler's fists do more damage than a normal character's, but only when fighting without weapons or a shield. In addition, the strengthening of the flesh and bone of the hand caused by constantly punching hard things has given them the ability to pierce through damage resistance, starting at level 6.

NOTE: If multiclassed with a monk, the character will use whichever unarmed damage is better. It does not stack. In addition, taking a level in monk disables the use of certain brawler bonus feats (see below.)

BONUS FEAT LIST

- All Fighter bonus feats except Weapon Specialization
- Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes
- Epic Fortitude, Epic Will, Epic Reflexes (Level 21+)
- Great Strength, Great Dexterity, Great Constitution (Level 21+)
- Brawler Blocking +1, +2, +3, +4, +5 (Unarmed blocking bonus to shield AC) (Requires Level 1+, 6+, 12+, 18+, 24+)
- Brawler Extra Attack I, II, III (Extra unarmed attacks) (Requires Level 10+, 20+, 30+, Does not stack with Monk)
- Brawler Damage Reduction 3/-, 6/-, 9/- (Requires Level 16+, 21+, 26+, Constitution 19+, Does not stack with Epic DR)

dst:
你没有物理身体。此类生物是无形的，无法被非魔法物质或能量触碰。同样，它们无法操纵物体或对物体施加物理力量。然而，非实体存在具有一种可感知的存在感，有时看起来像是对实体生物的一次物理攻击。

非实体生物与角色存在于同一位面，角色有机会影响它们。

非实体生物只能被其他非实体生物，魔化武器，或法咒，类法咒效果，或超自然效果伤害。它们免疫所有非魔法攻击形式。

即使被魔法或魔化武器击中，非实体生物也有 50% 的几率忽略来自实体来源的任何伤害。

非实体生物免疫重击和偷袭。
src:
You lack a physical body. Such creatures are insubstantial and can't be touched by nonmagical matter or energy. Likewise, they cannot manipulate objects or exert physical force on objects. However, incorporeal beings have a tangible presence that sometimes seems like a physical attack against a corporeal creature.

Incorporeal creatures are present on the same plane as the characters, and characters have some chance to affect them.

Incorporeal creatures can be harmed only by other incorporeal creatures, by magic weapons, or by spells, spell-like effects, or supernatural effects. They are immune to all nonmagical attack forms.

Even when struck by magic or magic weapons, an incorporeal creature has a 50% chance to ignore any damage from a corporeal source.

Incorporeal creatures are immune to critical hits and sneak attacks.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
In the monster-haunted wasteland of the Sulhaut Mountains, an ancient temple of weathered gray stone crowns the barren, black rock of an icy mountaintop. Within this structure stands an incredible sphere of blue, crystallized incarnum that measures a full 30 feet in diameter. Illumined from depths that no being has ever plumbed, it has a life of its own and an intelligence almost alien in its purity. This sphere is the Sapphire Eidolon, an emblem of perfect universal law that is said to be older than the cosmos. No being manifested this sphere-in fact, no being could manifest it-and yet it exists. According to legend, it fell to the ground from the stars and took up its position on the mountaintop under its own power. 

The ancient temple that houses the Sapphire Eidolon is also home to an order of fervent priests of law whose ranks include clerics, incarnates, monks, and fighters. Known as sapphire hierarchs, the elite members of this order defend the temple, contemplate the mysteries of the Sapphire Eidolon, and seek to fulfill its single command by perfecting themselves and bringing order out of chaos wherever they find it. They are zealous crusaders against supernatural chaos who battle with single-minded determination against such creatures as demons, slaadi, and the servants of chaotic deities. 

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Sapphire Hierarch does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

Essentia Pool: 3

3:  Damage Reduction 1/+5

6:  Damage Reduction 2/+5

BONUS SPELLS:

Each level, the Sapphire Hierarch gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their divine spellcasting class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

BONUS MELDSHAPING:

At each sapphire hierarch level, you increase your meldshaper level, the number of soulmelds you can shape, the number of chakra binds you can create, and your essentia pool as if you had gained a level in a meldshaping class to which you belonged prior to gaining the sapphire hierarch level. You do not, however, gain any other abilities of that class, such as new tiers of chakra binds.

深渊之钟是月海地区伟大而神秘的遗址之一，与传说中的北堡有关，那是一个岛国，是这些寒冷土地上人类的第一座伟大堡垒。北堡是一座伟大的魔法城市，正是在这些魔法的保护下，人类首次开始击退兽人部落并掌控海洋。

北堡的力量使它成为兽人、巨人和其他邪恶种族的明显目标。然而，这些生物并不倾向于海上行动，北堡似乎很安全，直到有一天（根据传说），40,000名非人法师、萨满、巫医以及所有邪恶种族的祭司聚集在月海北岸，开始吟唱，将他们神祇的复仇降于人类入侵者。神祇（至少其中一些）降临并摧毁了他们的祭司，因为他们打扰了神祇，但也将北堡沉入波浪之下。

在附近航行的船只可以在水下看到北堡的上部——它那细长、如今已破碎的尖塔。然而，这并不常被尝试，因为据说该地区闹鬼，有北堡最初的守卫者出没，在守护寒冷之地时寻求陪伴。在雾气弥漫的夜晚，最高塔楼的钟声尽管被淹没，仍能在远至希尔斯法的地方听到。
src:
One of the great and mysterious sites in the Moonsea area, the Bell in the Depths, is connected with legendary Northkeep, an island kingdom that was the first great citadel of humankind in these cold lands. Northkeep was a great and magical city, and it was under the protection of these magics that humanity first began to press back the orc hordes and take command of the sea.

The power of Northkeep made it an obvious target for orcs, giants, and other evil races. However, these creatures were not inclined towards sea actions, and Northkeep seemed safe until the day when (according to legend) 40,000 inhuman mages, shamans, witch doctors, and priests of all foul races gathered on the northern shore of the Moonsea and began to chant, bringing the vengeance of their gods down upon the human interlopers. The gods (at least some of them) came and destroyed their priests for disturbing them, but also sank Northkeep beneath the waves.

The upper reaches of Northkeep - its slender, now-broken spires - can be seen beneath the water by boats that sail nearby. This is not attempted often, however, as the region is said to be haunted by the original defenders of Northkeep, seeking company in their watch over the Cold Lands. On fog-ridden nights the bells of the tallest towers, despite being submerged, can be heard as far away as Hillsfar.

dst:
（基础职业）
魂刃者认为自己的心智是万物中最美丽 - 也最致命 - 的东西。凭借这种领悟并通过长期修炼，魂刃者学会将自己的精神力量锻造成一把由半固态灵能构成的闪耀之刃。
 每个魂刃者专属的刀刃，被称为念刃，其颜色和形状因他的个性，精神力量乃至情绪而异。尽管没有两把念刃看起来相同，但它们都拥有同样致命的特性。由于魂刃者将心智的力量转化为这样的武器，他们以暴力而臭名昭著。

- 生命骰：d10
- 擅长：魂刃者获得简易武器及其念刃的擅长，以及轻甲和盾牌的擅长
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。


职业技能

专注，制造护甲，制造陷阱，制造武器，纪律，躲藏，跳跃，学识，潜行，招架，侦察，翻滚


职业特性：

基础攻击加值：+3/4
强豁免：反射和意志

等级：
 1：念刃，武器专攻（念刃），原始天赋 *或* 隐藏天赋
 2：投掷念刃
 3：灵能打击 +1d8
 4：+1 念刃
 5：自由抽出，塑造念刃
 6：念刃增强 +1，念动之速
 7：灵能打击 +2d8
 8：+2 念刃
 9：刃风，高等武器专攻（念刃）
 10：念刃增强 +2
 11：灵能打击 +3d8
 12：+3 念刃
 13：直击魂刃者
 14：念刃增强 +3
 15：灵能打击 +4d8
 16：+4 念刃
 17：多重投掷
 18：念刃增强 +4
 19：灵能打击 +5d8
 20：+5 念刃


念刃（Su）：魂刃者可以创造一把由从自己心智中提炼的灵能构成的半固态刀刃。这把刀刃在所有方面都等同于一把短剑。就克服伤害减免而言，念刃被视为魔化武器（+1）.
 魂刃者的念刃会随着角色获得更高等级而提升。在第4级以及此后每四级，念刃在攻击检定和伤害检定上获得可累计的 +1 增强加值。
 实现说明：就与居合大师职业的互动而言，bastard sword 形态的念刃被视为等同于一把 katana.这是因为在桌面规则中，katana = 精制品 bastard sword.

投掷念刃（Ex）：第2级或更高的魂刃者可以将他的念刃作为远程武器投掷。无论攻击是否命中，投掷出的念刃随后都会消散。第3级或更高的魂刃者可以用投掷出的念刃进行灵能打击，并且可以将该刀刃与其他特殊能力结合使用。

灵能打击（Su）：作为一个移动动作，第3级或更高的魂刃者可以用毁灭性的灵能灌注他的念刃。此效果会对他成功以近战攻击命中的下一个活体，非无心智目标造成额外 1d8 点伤害（或者，如果他正在使用投掷念刃能力，则为远程攻击）.免疫影响心智效果的生物免疫灵能打击伤害。（与游荡者的偷袭不同，灵能打击不是精准伤害，并且可以影响那些原本免疫重击额外伤害或距离超过 30 尺的生物，只要它们是活体，非无心智且不免疫影响心智效果的生物。）
 当此能力被调用时，念刃只造成一次此额外伤害，但魂刃者可以通过再花费一个移动动作来再次用灵能灌注他的念刃。一旦魂刃者为灵能打击准备好了他的刀刃，它就会保留额外能量直到被使用。即使魂刃者丢下了念刃（或者它以其他方式消散，例如被投掷且未命中时），当魂刃者下次使其具现时，它仍然被灌注了灵能。
 在第3级之后每四级，魂刃者灵能打击的额外伤害增加 1d8。

自由抽出（Su）：在第5级，魂刃者能够以一个自由动作而非移动动作来具现他的念刃。然而，他每轮只能尝试具现念刃一次。

塑造念刃（Su）：在第5级，魂刃者获得改变其念刃形态的能力。作为一个整轮动作，他可以将他的念刃改变为复制一把长剑（伤害 1d8） 或一把 bastard sword（伤害 1d10，但除非他知晓异种武器擅长专长，否则必须将其作为双手武器使用）.
或者，一个魂刃者可以将他的念刃分裂成两把完全相同的短剑，适合双手各持一把武器战斗。（双武器战斗的正常惩罚适用。） 然而，两把念刃的增强加值都比魂刃者原本用单把念刃创造时低1.例如，一个12级魂刃者通常创造一把+3念刃，但他可以使用此能力改为具现两把+2念刃。

念刃增强（Su）：在第6级，魂刃者获得增强其念刃的能力。他可以添加一个增强加值价值为+1的武器特殊能力。
 在6级之后的每四级，魂刃者可以添加到其武器上的增强加值提高+1.魂刃者可以选择任何武器特殊能力组合，只要不超过其等级所允许的总值。例如，一个18级魂刃者可以添加两个+2武器特殊能力，或者一个+1武器能力和一个+3武器能力。
 每次魂刃者具现其念刃时，该武器能力或这些能力保持不变（除非他决定重新分配其能力；见下文）.该能力或这些能力适用于念刃采取的任何形态，包括使用塑造念刃或刃风职业能力时。
 魂刃者可以重新分配他已添加到其念刃上的能力或这些能力。要这样做，他必须首先花费8小时进行专注。在那段时间之后，念刃会以魂刃者所选的新能力或这些能力具现。

刃风（Su）：在第9级，魂刃者获得将其念刃瞬间碎裂成众多相同刀刃的能力，每一把都攻击附近的一个对手。
 作为一次全力攻击，当持用其念刃时，魂刃者可以放弃其常规攻击，改为碎裂其念刃，以他的完整基础攻击加值对触及范围内的每个对手进行一次近战攻击。每一块碎片的功能都与魂刃者的常规念刃相同。
 使用刃风时，魂刃者放弃由其他专长或能力（例如顺劈斩专长或加速术）授予的任何加值或额外攻击。
 念刃在刃风攻击后立即恢复为其先前的形态。

直击灵魂（Su）：从第13级开始，当魂刃者执行一次心智打击时，他可以选择以智力，感知或魅力伤害（由其选择）替代额外伤害骰。他每放弃一个额外伤害骰，就对所选属性值造成1点伤害。魂刃者可以以任意组合结合额外伤害骰和属性伤害，因此一个19级魂刃者可以选择造成3点魅力伤害和额外2d8点伤害。

多重投掷（Ex）：在第17级及更高时，魂刃者每轮可以投掷的念刃数量等于他所能进行的近战攻击次数。因此，一个17级魂刃者可以投掷两把念刃，基础攻击加值为+12/+7。


传奇魂刃者：

传奇魂刃者擅长将其全部心智力量引导到创造一把越来越强大的心智能量之刃中。
  生命骰：d10
  每额外等级技能点：4+ 智力调整值。
  念刃：在第25级及之后每五级，魂刃者在攻击检定和伤害检定上获得额外+1增强加值（第25级+6，第30级+7，依此类推）.
  念刃增强：传奇魂刃者的念刃随着魂刃者获得传奇等级而获得额外力量。在第22级及之后每四级，魂刃者可以将其念刃上的武器特殊能力价值提高1（第22级等效+5加值，第26级+6，依此类推）.如魂刃者职业描述中所述，重新分配特性仍然需要8小时专注。
  心智打击：传奇魂刃者的心智打击进展在20级之后继续，继续在高于19级后每四级授予一个额外伤害骰（d8）（第23级+6d8，第27级+7d8，依此类推）.
  奖励专长：传奇魂刃者在高于20级后每三级获得一个奖励专长（第23级，第26级，依此类推）.
奖励专长列表：所有灵能专长，护甲皮肤，宿敌克星，致盲速度，毁灭重击，传奇伤害减免，传奇闪避，传奇能量抗力，传奇强韧，传奇领导力，传奇勇武，传奇反射，传奇声望，传奇技能专攻，传奇坚韧，传奇武器专攻，传奇意志，快速治疗，超凡魅力，超凡体质，超凡敏捷，超凡智力，超凡力量，超凡感知，神圣武击，精通旋风攻击，传奇指挥官，压倒重击，完美健康，完美双武器战斗，自我隐蔽，卓越先攻，邪恶打击
src:
(BASE CLASS)
A soulknife recognizes his own mind as the most beautiful - and the most deadly - thing in all creation. With this understanding and through extended practice, a soulknife learns to forge his mental strength into a shimmering blade of semisolid psychic energy.
 Each soulknife's personal blade, referred to as a mind blade, differs in color and shape according to his personality, mental strength, and even mood. Although no two mind blades look alike, all share the same lethal qualities. Because soulknives turn the power of their minds to such weaponry, they are notorious for their violence.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Soulknives gain Proficiency with Simple weapons and their mindblades, and Light Armour and Shield proficiencies
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.


CLASS SKILLS

Concentration, Craft Armor, Craft Trap, Craft Weapon, Discipline, Hide, Jump, Lore, Move Silently, Parry, Spot, Tumble


CLASS FEATURES:

Base Attack Bonus: +3/4
Strong Saves: Reflex and Will

Level:
 1: Mind blade, Weapon Focus(mind blade), Wild Talent *or* Hidden Talent
 2: Throw mind blade
 3: Psychic strike +1d8
 4: +1 mind blade
 5: Free draw, shape mind blade
 6: Mind blade enhancement +1, Speed of Thought
 7: Psychic strike +2d8
 8: +2 mind blade
 9: Bladewind, Greater Weapon Focus(mind blade)
 10: Mind blade enhancement +2
 11: Psychic strike +3d8
 12: +3 mind blade
 13: Knife to the soul
 14: Mind blade enhancement +3
 15: Psychic strike +4d8
 16: +4 mind blade
 17: Multiple throw
 18: Mind blade enhancement +4
 19: Psychic strike +5d8
 20: +5 mind blade


Mind blade (Su): A soulknife can create a semisolid blade composed of psychic energy distilled from his own mind. The blade is identical in all ways to a short sword. A mind blade is considered a magic weapon (+1) for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
 A soulknife's mind blade improves as the character gains higher levels. At 4th level and every four levels thereafter, the mind blade gains a cumulative +1 enhancement bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
 Implementation Note: For the purposes of interaction with Iaijutsu Master class, a mindblade in bastard sword form is considered equivalent to a katana. This is due to the fact that in PnP, katana = masterwork bastard sword.

Throw mind blade (Ex): A soulknife of 2nd level or higher can throw his mindblade as a ranged weapon. Whether or not the attack hits, a thrown mind blade then dissipates. A soulknife of 3rd level or higher can make a psychic strike with a thrown mind blade and can use the blade in conjunction with other special abilities.

Psychic Strike (Su): As a move action, a soulknife of 3rd level or higher can imbue his mind blade with destructive psychic energy. This effect deals an extra 1d8 points of damage to the next living, nonmindless target he successfully hits with a melee attack (or a ranged attack, if he is using the throw mind blade ability). Creatures immune to mind-affecting effects are immune to psychic strike damage. (Unlike the rogue's sneak attack the psychic strike is not precision damage and can affect creatures otherwise immune to extra damage from critical hits or more than 30 feet away, provided they are living, nonmindless creatures not immune to mind-affecting effects.)
 A mind blade deals this extra damage only once when this ability is called upon, but a soulknife can imbue his mind blade with psychic energy again by taking another move action. Once a soulknife has prepared his blade for a psychic strike, it holds the extra energy until it is used. Even if the soulknife drops the mind blade (or it otherwise dissipates, such as when it is thrown and misses), it is still imbued with psychic energy when the soulknife next materializes it.
 At every four levels beyond 3rd, the extra damage from a soulknife's psychic strike increases by 1d8.

Free Draw (Su): At 5th level, a soulknife becomes able to materialize his mind blade as a free action instead of a move action. He can make only one attempt to materialize the mind blade per round, however.

Shape Mind Blade (Su): At 5th level, a soulknife gains the ability to change the form of his mindblade. As a full-round action, he can change his mind blade to replicate a longsword (damage 1d8) or a bastard sword (damage 1d10, but he must wield it as a two-handed weapon unless he knows the Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat).
 Alternatively, a soulknife can split his mind blade into two identical short swords, suitable for fighting with a weapon in each hand. (The normal penalties for fighting with two weapons apply.) However, both mind blades have an enhancement bonus 1 lower than the soulknife would otherwise create with a single mind blade. For example, a 12th-level soulknife normally creates a single +3 mind blade, but he could use this ability to instead materialize two +2 mind blades.

Mind Blade Enhancement (Su): At 6th level, a soulknife gains the ability to enhance his mind blade. He can add a weapon special ability that has an enhancement bonus value of +1.
 At every four levels beyond 6th, the value of the enhancement a soulknife can add to his weapon improves by +1, A soulknife can choose any combination of weapon special abilities that does not exceed the total allowed by the soulknife's level. For example, an 18th-level soulknife could add two +2 weapon special abilities, or one +1 weapon ability and one +3 weapon ability.
 The weapon ability or abilities remain the same every time the soulknife materializes his mind blade (unless he decided to reassign it's abilities; see below). The ability or abilities apply to any form the mind blade takes, including the use of the shape mind blade or bladewind class abilities.
 A soulknife can reassign the ability or abilities he has added to his mind blade. To do so, he must first spend 8 hours in concentration. After that period, the mind blade materializes with the new ability or abilities selected by the soulknife.

Bladewind (Su): At 9th level, a soulknife gains the ability to momentarily fragment his mind blade into numerous identical blades, each of which strikes at a nearby opponent.
 As a full attack, when wielding his mind blade, a soulknife can give up his regular attacks and instead fragment his mind blade to make one melee attack at his full base attack bonus against each opponent within reach. Each fragment functions identically to the soulknife's regular mind blade.
 When using bladewind, a soulknife forfeits any bonus or extra attacks granted by other feats or abilities (such as the Cleave feat or the haste spell).
 The mind blade immediately reverts to it's previous form after the bladewind attack.

Knife to the Soul (Su): Beginning at 13th level, when a soulknife executes a psychic strike, he can choose to substitute Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma damage (his choice) for extra dice of damage. For each die of extra damage he gives up, he deals 1 point of damage to the ability score he chooses, A soulknife can combine extra dice of damage and ability damage in any combination, so a 19th-level soulknife could choose to strike for 3 points of Charisma damage and an extra 2d8 points of damage.

Multiple Throw (Ex): At 17th level and higher, a soulknife can throw a number of mind blades per round equal to the number of melee attacks he could make. Thus, a 17th-level soulknife could throw two mind blades, with a base attack bonus of +12/+7.


Epic Soulknife:

The epic soulknife is adept at channeling the entirety of his psychic might into the creation of an increasingly potent blade of mental energy.
  Hit Die: d10
  Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4+ Int Modifier.
  Mind Blade: At 25th level and every five levels thereafter, the soulknife gains an additional +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls (+6 at 25th, +7 at 30th, and so on).
  Mind Blade Enhancement: The epic soulknife's mind blade gains additional powers as the soulknife gains epic levels. At 22nd level and every four levels thereafter, the soulknife can improve the value of the weapon special abilities on his mind blade by 1 (+5 equivalent bonus at 22nd, +6 at 26th, and so on). As noted in the soulknife class description, reassigning qualities still takes 8 hours of concentration.
  Psychic strike: The epic soulknife's psychic strike progression continues past 20th level, continuing to grant an additional die (d8) of damage every four levels higher than 19th (+6d8 at 23rd, +7d8 at 27th, and so on).
  Bonus Feats: The epic soulknife gains a bonus feat every three levels higher than 20th (23rd, 26th, and so on).
  Bonus Feat List: All psionic feats, Armor Skin, Bane of Enemies, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Dodge, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Fortitude, Epic Leadership, Epic Prowess, Epic Reflexes, Epic Reputation, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Will, Fast Healing, Great Charisma, Great Constitution, Great Dexterity, Great Intelligence, Great Strength, Great Wisdom, Holy Martial Strike, Improved Whirlwind Attack, Legendary Commander, Overwhelming Critical, Perfect Health, Perfect Two-Weapon Fighting, Self-Concealment, Superior Initiative, Unholy Strike

src: Spells per Day: A master Harper continues training in magic as well as Harper lore. Thus, when a new master Harper level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class. If the master Harper adds a spellcasting level to a class that keeps a personal spell list, such as bard or sorcerer, she add spells to her list as though adding a level of that class. If she adds spellcasting levels to a class that keeps spellbooks, such as wizards, she gains two new spells for her spellbooks, just as if she had gained a level in that class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (improved chance of controlling or rebuking undead, metamagic or item creation feats, and so on). This essentially means that she adds the level of master Harper to the level of some other spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day and caster level accordingly.

dst:
对于阿塔斯的精灵来说，奔跑就是生命。如果精灵受伤而无法跟上，他们会被留下等死，而骑乘动物被认为是最严重的耻辱之一。然而当没有需要时，这些精灵往往只是懒散地生活，活在当下。他们倾向于只与自己的同类为伍，除非有某种目的要追求。一旦赢得他们的信任，他们不会背叛，但如果他们被背叛，那份信任就永远消失了。作为一个种族，他们崇拜 Coraanu Star Racer，一位战士游荡者，将其视为精灵特质和荣誉的典范，并在歌曲和行动中向他致敬，以沉着进行袭击和贸易。在身体上，他们比其他位面的精灵更高，站立时在 6'-7' 之间，体格精瘦，面部特征棱角分明。

阿塔斯精灵属性调整：+2 敏捷，-2 体质。
偏好职业（游荡者）：在判断兼职阿塔斯精灵是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其游荡者职业不计入。

特殊能力：
- 40' 移动
- 奖励熟练（短弓，长弓）
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（侦察）：侦察检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 敏锐感官：阿塔斯精灵自动进行主动搜索检定，且没有移动惩罚。
- 微光视觉：允许他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 元素抗力：阿塔斯精灵对极端温度有天然抗力，允许他们忽略受到的第一点火焰或寒冷伤害。
- 精灵：在法咒效果方面，阿塔斯精灵被视为精灵。
src:
For the elves of Athas, running is life.  If an elf is injured and can't keep up, they are left behind to die, and riding an animal is considered one of the greatest dishonors.  When there is no need though, these elves tend to just laze around and live in the now.  They tend to keep to their own kind unless they have an angle to pursue.  Once their trust is earned, they do not betray it, but if they are betrayed, that same trust is gone forever.  As a race they idolize Coraanu Star Racer, a warrior-thief as the epitome of elfness and honor him in song and deed, raiding and trading with aplomb.  Physically they are taller than otherplanar elves, standing between 6'-7' with lean builds and angular facial features.

Athasian Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Con.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass Athasian elf's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- 40' Movement
- Bonus Proficiencies (Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Athasian Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Resistance to Elements: Athasian elves have a natural resistance to extreme temperatures, allowing them to ignore the first point of fire or cold damage dealt to them.
- Elven: Athasian Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

dst: “那应该不难想到。毕竟我是个佣兵冒险者，而且卡林港的当局正在招募各种这样的人来追捕你们两个。我自然也会听说悬赏的事。但我以前和你们合作得很愉快，所以其实并不太想杀你们。我知道有竖琴手在对抗卡林杉正在发生的事，所以我联系了他们，告诉他们我愿意倒戈——当然前提是我放弃的悬赏能得到补偿。我说过，我宁愿不杀你们，但我得谋生，所以我不会白白放过你们。于是我们就到了这一步。”
src: "That shouldn't be too difficult to figure out. I am a mercenary adventurer, after all, and all sorts of such people are being recruited by the authorities in Calimport to hunt you two down. Naturally I was going to hear about the bounty offer too. But I had fun working with you before, so I wasn't really too keen on killing you. I knew there were Harpers working against whatever is happening in Calimshan, so I contacted them and told them I would switch sides - provided of course that I was compensated for the bounty I was giving up. I'd rather not kill you, as I said, but I do need to make a living, so I wasn't going to let you live for free. And so here we are."

src:
Psychokinesis [see text]
Level: Kineticist 3
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 60 ft.
Area: Cone-shaped spread
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half or Fortitude half; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 5
Metapsionics: Empower, Maximize, Twin, Widen

Upon manifesting this power, you choose cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You create a cone of energy of the chosen type, extending outward from your hand, that deals 5d6 points of damage to every creature or object within the area.

Cold: A cone of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die. The saving throw to reduce damage from a cold cone is a Fortitude save instead of a Reflex save.
Electricity: Manifesting a cone of this energy type provides a +2 bonus to the save DC and a +2 bonus on manifester level checks for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
Fire: A cone of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.
Sonic: A cone of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, this power's damage increases by one die (d6). For each extra two dice of damage, this power's save DC increases by 1.

src:
An Epic Disciple of Mephistopheles becomes a living conduit of hellfire, their body and soul twisted by infernal power. Their mere presence scorches the earth, their voice echoes with embers, and flames answer their every command. No longer just a servant, they are a herald of Mephistopheles himself, incinerating armies with infernal storms, summoning greater devils as lieutenants, and walking untouched through magical and mundane flame alike. Their mastery of hellfire transcends mortal understanding, making them a terror to celestials and mortals alike.

Hit Die: d8
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 4 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Disciple of Mephistopheles gains a bonus feat every other level.

Epic Disciple of Mephistopheles Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Leadership, Epic Prowess, Epic Reflexes, Epic Reputation, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Will, Fast Healing, Great Charisma, Great Constitution, Improved Whirlwind Attack, Legendary Commander, Superior Initiative.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Music is not just a pleasant sound; it is also the expression of mathematical relationships fraught with significance. A member of the Sublime Chord prestige class sees music, even the powerful music of a skilled bard, as nothing more than a stepping-stone to true universal insight into the legendary song of creation heard at the dawn of time. Music and magic are actually one and the same, and an astute student who unravels the riddles of metre and pitch simultaneously reveals hidden secrets of great power.

- Hit die: d6
- Skill points: 4 + Int Modifier

Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd level Arcane spells
Feats: Bardic Music
Skills: Lore 13, Listen 13, Perform 10, Concentration 6, Spellcraft 6

Level
1:   Bardic Lore, Bardic Music
2:   Song of arcane power
6:   Song of timelessness
10: Song of cosmic fire

SPELLCASTING:

To cast a spell, a Sublime Chord must have a Charisma score of at least 10 + the spell's level. The DC of a Sublime Chord's spell is 10 + spell level + the Sublime Chord's Charisma modifier. The caster level of a Sublime Chord is it's class level + it's level in it's spellcasting base class. A Sublime Chord does not suffer arcane spell failure while wearing light armor.

Spells known:
A Sublime Chord has the ability to cast a small number of arcane spells, all of 4th level or higher.

src:
Type of Feat: Reserve
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 4th-level spells
Benefit: As long as you have a summoning spell of 4th level or higher available to cast, you can summon a Small elemental (air, earth, fire, or water; your choice) within a range of 30 feet. The elemental acts as if summoned by a summon creature spell. The duration of the summoning is equal to 1 round per level of the highest-level conjuration (summoning) spell you have available to cast. You can have only one summoned elemental from this feat at a time; if you use the ability a second time, the first elemental disappears. Also, you must remain close to the elemental you summon. If at the end of your turn you are more than 30 feet from the elemental, it disappears. If you have a conjuration (summoning) spell of 6th level or higher available to cast, you can summon a Medium elemental instead. If you have a conjuration (summoning) spell of 8th level or higher available to cast, you can summon a Large elemental instead. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting conjuration (summoning) I spells.
Use: Activated

src:
Neraphim are sometimes mistaken for slaad at a distance due to the two races' similarity in appearance. Although the two may share a similar lineage, they are considered distinct creatures. Neraphim are a nomadic people who hunt through the maelstrom of Limbo, tracking their elusive and ever-moving prey. Similar to drow, neraphim organize themselves into houses, each laying claim to certain hunting grounds. Although unfriendly towards other race, neraphim will team up whenever survival is at stake.

Neraph Ability Adjustments: None.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass neraph's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Neraphim can see in the dark.
- Leap: +5 racial bonus on Jump checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus on Spot checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus on Search checks.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 2.
- Outsider: Neraphim are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

Anyway, as far as providing a Letter of Recommendation I would in principle be happy to do so, but keep in mind that you haven't been working for me all that long so I don't yet know just how worthy of such a recommendation you actually are. I'm not saying you aren't, of course, just that it would be important to me to be honest and accurate in anything I wrote. I don't think this is the time to do this. 贾布林是精类，他们可怕的牙齿掩盖了顽皮的本性。他们的附魔力量，以及对这些效果的免疫，使他们成为棘手的对手和不可靠的盟友。贾布林是被放逐的流浪者，喜欢欺骗和娱乐凡人。贾布林以前是精类宫廷的小丑。精类贵族喜欢附魔贾布林表演愚蠢或怪异的动作。就他们而言，贾布林陶醉于自己的角色，将娱乐视为伟大的服务。最终他们建立了对附魔的强大耐受性。几个世纪以来，他们向主人隐瞒了这一事实，并学会假装受附魔支配。随着时间的推移，一个又一个精类贵族发现了这个诡计，对贾布林失去了兴趣。被遗弃的精类因羞愧而自我放逐。贾布林现在以商人，骗子和诈骗者的身份谋生。其他人作为吟游诗人带来欢乐，少数人通过成为术士来利用他们的才能。这样的贾布林甚至可能寻求冒险的刺激。

贾布林属性调整：-2力量，+2魅力。
天赋职业（欺愚者）：兼职贾布林的欺愚者职业在决定是否因兼职而受到XP惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 精类。贾布林不受仅影响类人生物的法咒或效果影响。
- 基础移动30。
- 昏暗视觉。
- 贾布林AC+1加值。
- 免疫附魔法咒和效果。
- 天生攻击：啮咬（1d3）.
- 贾布林施放的附魔法咒豁免DC+1种族加值。
- 估价，唬骗，表演和说服检定+2种族加值。
- 法咒辨识检定+4种族加值。
- 意志削弱（Ex）：任何被贾布林欺愚者啮咬伤害的生物必须成功通过意志豁免，否则意志豁免受到-4惩罚，持续1分钟。多次啮咬的效果不叠加。豁免DC基于体质。
- 等级调整：+1
src:
Jaebrins are fey whose fearsome teeth belie an impish nature. Their powers of enchantment, and their immunity to those same effects, make them tricky opponents and untrustworthy allies. Jaebrins are outcast drifters that enjoy tricking and entertaining mortals. Jaebrins were formerly the jesters of fey courts. Fey nobles delighted in enchanting jaebrins to perform silly or weird acts. For their part, the jaebrins reveled in their role, seeing entertainment as a great service. Eventually they built up a strong tolerance to enchantment. For a number of centuries, they hid this fact from their masters and learned to fake being under the sway of enchantment. In time, fey noble after fey noble discovered the ruse and lost interest in the jaebrins. The forsaken fey were shamed into self-imposed exile. Jaebrins now make their way as merchants, charlatans, and swindlers. Others bring merriment as bards, and a few exploit their talents by becoming sorcerers. Such jaebrins might even seek the excitement of adventuring.

Jaebrin Ability Adjustments: -2 Strength, +2 Charisma.
Favored Class (Beguiler): A multiclass jaebrin's Beguiler class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Fey. Jaebrins are not subject to spells or effects that affect only humanoids.
- Base movement of 30.
- Low-light vision.
- Jaebrins have a +1 bonus to AC.
- Immunity to enchantment spells and effects.
- Natural Attack: Bite (1d3).
- +1 racial bonus on saving throw DCs for enchantment spells the jaebrin casts.
- +2 racial bonus on Appraise, Bluff, Perform, and Persuade checks.
- +4 racial bonus on Spellcraft checks.
- Will Sapper (Ex): Any creature damaged by a jaebrin trickster's bite must succeed on a Will save or take a -4 penalty on Will saves for 1 minute. The effect of multiple bites doesn't stack. The save DC is Constitution-based.
- Level Adjustment: +1

src: During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.\n\nNote: To reach Rajar's hideout, enter the sewer system at any point and look for a door taking you further in. If you have the paper containing the directions in your possession, one of your options should be to go to the hideout.

专长类型：职业

当异形学家施放任何召唤生物法咒时，她召唤的是生物的“伪自然”版本。这会给被召唤的生物添加伪自然模板（见下文伪自然生物）. 如果所选生物通常是天界或魔界生物，伪自然模板将替换该模板。

伪自然生物：
伪自然生物栖息在星辰之间的万古之外，在我们所知的位面之间，蜷缩在疯狂的遥远国度。当被召唤到物质位面时，它们通常采取熟悉生物的形态并模仿其能力，尽管它们的外表比其凡间同类更加可怖。或者，它们可能以更符合其起源的形态出现：一团扭动的触手是最受欢迎的，尽管其他可怕形态也总是可能的。

伪自然生物保留基础生物的所有特殊性质，并获得以下能力。

真实打击（Su）：每天一次，该生物可以在单次攻击检定上以 +20 洞察加值进行普通攻击。该生物不受针对隐蔽目标的攻击所适用的失手几率影响。

 - 电击和强酸抗力（见下表）.
 - 伤害减免（见下表）. 
 - 法术抗力等于生物 HD 的两倍（最大 25）.

生命骰  电击，强酸    伤害
                 抗力            减免 
1-3                  5                      - 
4-7                  10                  5/+1 
8-11                15                  5/+2 
12+                 20                 10/+3 

如果基础生物已经拥有这些特殊性质中的一项或多项，使用更好的数值。

替代形态（Su） 
随意，伪自然生物可以采取怪诞的触手团形态，但尽管外表异样，其所有能力保持不变。改变形态是一个标准动作。其他生物对这种替代形态下的伪自然生物的攻击检定受到 -1 士气减值。

豁免 
与基础生物相同。

属性 
与基础生物相同，但智力至少为 3. 

技能 
与基础生物相同。

专长 
与基础生物相同。
src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Alienist 1

When an alienist casts any summon creature spell, she summons a "pseudonatural" version of a creature. This adds the pseudonatural template to the summoned creature (see Pseudonatural Creatures below). If the selected creature would normally be celestial of fiendish, the pseudonatural template replaces that template.

Pseudonatural Creatures:
Pseudonatural creatures dwell past the eons that lie between the stars, between the planes as we know them, nestled in far realms of insanity. When summoned to the Material Plane they often take the form of, and emulate the abilities of familiar creatures, though they are more gruesome in appearance than their earthly counterparts. Alternatively, they may appear in a manner more consistent with their origins: A mass of writhing tentacles is a favorite, although other terrible forms are always possible. 

A pseudonatural creature retains all the special qualities of the base creature and also gains the following.

True Strike (Su): Once per day, the creature can make a normal attack with a +20 insight modifier on a single attack roll. The creature is not affected by the miss chance that applies to attacks against a concealed target.

 - Electricity and acid resistance (see the table below).
 - Damage reduction (see the table below). 
 - SR equal to double the creature's HD (maximum 25).

Hit Dice  Electricity, Acid    Damage
                 Resistance       Reduction 
1-3                  5                      - 
4-7                  10                  5/+1 
8-11                15                  5/+2 
12+                 20                 10/+3 

If the base creature already has one or more of these special qualities, use the better value. 

Alternative Form (Su) 
At will, a pseudonatural creature can take the form of a grotesque, tentacled mass, but all its abilities remain unchanged despite the alien appearance. Changing shape is a standard action. Other creatures receive a -1 morale penalty to their attack rolls against pseudonatural creatures in this alternate form. 

Saves 
Same as the base creature. 

Abilities 
Same as the base creature, but Intelligence is at least 3. 

Skills 
Same as the base creature. 

Feats 
Same as the base creature.

src: "A good question. It would be most dangerous to keep it in your possession, both because of the influence it can exert on nearby minds and because of all those who are likely to come seeking it. Incarnum forms chitinous plates that hover over your shoulders and down your arms to your hands. At the backs of your hands, these plates take on long, triangular shapes like the scythe-claws of a kruthik, though these blades extend only barely beyond your fingertips.

At 10th level, the verdant lord permanently becomes a plant creature, though all forms of wild shape that the character could previously use remain available to him. His type changes to plant, and as a result he gains low-light vision, is immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and polymorphing, and is not subject to critical hits or mind-influencing effects (charms, compulsions, phantasms, patterns, or morale effects). Bonuses still accrue, and the verdant lord still dies of old age when his time is up.

Descriptor: None

You craft incarnum into a red crystal mask that has sharp edges along its many facets. The crystal has an inner crimson glow that seems to intensify when near psionic energies.

You can use a detect psionics effect as the power, with a range of 10 feet. You can use this ability as often as desired, but no more than once per round (as a standard action).

Essentia: For every point of essentia you invest in your psion-killer mask, the range of the detect psionics effect increases by 10 feet.

Chakra Bind (Brow)

Your psion-killer mask binds to your forehead, and your eyes replace the red glow in the mask's sockets. Colors seem somehow more alive to your sight -- particularly the colors of psionic displays and items you know to be psionic.

When using this soulmeld's detect psionics ability, you can instantly determine the number, strength, and location of each psionic aura present as if you had been concentrating for 3 rounds. 

Chakra Bind (Totem)

Your face is covered in crystal facets that now grow down to your chest and shoulders. As the crystal covers your face, you can almost taste and smell the psionic energy in the air, and if you extend your crystal tongue, the air tastes sweet and strong -- almost like a liqueur.

You can emit a crimson ray from the mouth of your psion-killer mask to make a ranged touch attack as a standard action. 

If you hit with the ray, you deal no damage but temporarily suppress the opponent's primary weapon, if any, for ten rounds.

dst: "嗯，你可能在其他地方听说过，我们最近的内战等麻烦导致了法律和秩序的部分崩溃。强盗和怪物袭击者变得令人烦恼地常见。我在乡下的庄园就是受害者之一。最近，周围的土地被成群的大地精和熊地精侵扰，造成了大量破坏，使该地区相当不安全。更甚的是，这些特定的类地精生物似乎异常有纪律、装备精良且能干。他们不是普通雇佣兵能对付的。"
src: "Well, as you may have heard elsewhere, our recent troubles with civil war and such have led to a partial breakdown of law and order. Bandits and monstrous raiders have become annoyingly common. My estate in the country has been one of the victims of this. Recently the surrounding lands have become infested with bands of hobgoblins and bugbears, causing a lot of destruction and making the region quite unsafe. What's more these particular goblinoids seem unusually disciplined, well-equipped, and competent. They're more than just any ordinary mercenaries can handle."

dst: "是的，在我看来也是这样。一个令人不安的可能性。我们中间有几个人一直主张，面对像阿兹古尔卡这样严峻的威胁，我们应该愿意与一些平时不会合作的派系联手，比如这条龙和他的盟友。我本以为他们中没有人会为了推动这样的议程而做到这种地步……但现在看来那是最有可能的情况。"
src: "Yes, that's what it looks like to me as well. A disturbing possibility. There've been a few among us who have been arguing that against a threat as dire as Azghulkar we should be willing to work together with some factions we normally wouldn't, like this dragon and his allies. I wouldn't have thought any of them would go so far as this to promote such an agenda...but now that seems the most likely possibility."

dst: "要不是他给了我这么多怨恨他的理由，他本不必那么怕我。总之，我学会了以狡诈和技巧作战，而不是食人魔混血兽典型的那种无脑野蛮，我还搜罗了所有我能收集到的关于魔法、陷阱和类似伎俩的知识碎片。我想，在他指派给我的角色中，我对他构成的威胁，已经不亚于我被允许学习魔法时可能构成的威胁了。"
src: "He would have less to fear from me had he not given me so many reasons to resent him. At any rate, I learned to fight with cunning and skill, rather than the mindless savagery typical of ogrillons, and also sought out whatever scraps of knowlege I could glean concerning magic, traps, and similar tricks. I think I became as much a threat to him in the role he assinged to me as I would have had I been permitted to study magic."

src:
Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Druid 5
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 20 ft.
Target: One creature/two levels, no two of which can be
more than 30 ft. apart
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/two levels
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

You invoke healing energy over a group of creatures, granting each the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell. This healing applies only to damage sustained during the spell's duration, not to that from previous injuries. Each subject heals 3 hit points per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time. Regenerate circle does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts.  The effects of multiple regenerate spells do not stack; only the highest-level effect applies. Applying a second regenerate spell of equal level extends the first spell's duration by the full duration of the second spell.

The Zenythri are a human-like race, infused with the energies of Law.  No one knows where they come from, with rumors ranging from mysterious rituals, to the effects of distant parts of the Lawful planes.  As a race they devote their lives to self-perfection, and view their role as to bring order to the universe, through example, or possibly other means.  Physically they resemble perfectly-formed humans, with even their hair falling naturally into their personal style.  Their skin is usually tinted a bluish-purple, and rarely they have other features showing their planetouched heritage such as metallic colored hair or eyes.  They usually dress in simple and elegant clothing, and tend to either set or follow the local fashion.

src:
A people known as the marru once lived and warred in the world, but their civilization has long since passed into the waste, devastated and destroyed by internecine wars of terrible magnitude. As a result of these so-called Flesh Wars, the marru turned to a little-understood art called spawncraft, and in so doing created living weapons to wage their battles. These spawncrafted creatures have come to be known collectively as the spawn of marru, but are more commonly referred to as marruspawn. The marru were advanced in other areas as well, but all their arts couldn't save them from destroying themselves. However, marruspawn linger on in forgotten and blasted wastelands across many worlds.
  
The marrutact commands by birthright, ordering the lesser marruspawn subraces as it desires. The sign of a marrutact's authority is the staff it wields, a symbol of the forgotten spawncraft lore that raised desert jackals to a race of intelligent creatures of amazing ability. Lesser marruspawn rarely question the decrees of a marrutact, though among themselves marrutacts scheme and argue, each eager to put itself forward as the supreme commander of all surviving marruspawn.

Ability Adjustments: +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +8 Intelligence, +8 Wisdom, +6 Charisma
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass Marrutact's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Medium creature
- 30' base speed
- Level Adjustment: +3
- 7 Racial Hit Dice of Monstrous Humanoid
- Low light vision
- Natural armour +4
- Fire resistance 5
- +4 Listen

dst:
我得到警告，贫民区东北部的一栋房子据说被危险的幽灵所萦绕，那些进入这座古老破败建筑的人有时再也无法出来。这似乎是一个需要提防的危险，或者，对于像我这样的冒险追寻者来说，也许是一个机会。

我进入了这栋房子，到达二楼后，被困在了一个幻象迷宫中——据我与之交谈的一个幽灵所说。要逃脱，我必须在我进入任何门后随机被传送到的某个房间里找到一个界门，并在受益于真知术效果的情况下进入它。要施放这样的法咒，我应该寻找某种魔法神器的四块碎片，并找到一个有铁砧的房间，在那里我可以将它们组装起来。

我已经通过界门逃脱，现在必须面对最初将我困在那个幻象迷宫中的强大幽灵。
src:
I have been warned that a house in the northeast of the Slums district is believed to be haunted by dangerous spirits, and that those who enter this old and decrepit structure sometimes fail to come out again. This would seem a danger to beware, or perhaps, for seekers of adventure such as myself, an opportunity.

I have entered the house, and upon reaching the second floor have become trapped in what according to a ghost I talked to is a maze of illusions. To escape, I must find a portal in one of the rooms to which I am randomly transported upon entering any door and enter it while benefitting from the effects of a True Seeing spell. To cast such a spell, I should look for four fragments of some kind of magical artifact, and find a room with an anvil in which I can assemble them.

I have escaped through the portal, and now must confront the mighty spectre who entrapped me within that maze of illusions to begin with.

src: "Can't say I have any work for someone like you, no. My basement is vermin-free. A point of pride with me, actually, as there are many inns that can't say the same. However, there are a couple of other places you could look for work around here. We have a guest staying here, who indicated he might be interested in hiring some people who know how to fight. He's staying in Room Eight, on the third floor, so you might want to go up there to talk to him. He's well, he's..." He seems a bit uncertain how to describe this guest to you. "Well, let's just say he's a bit unusual. I hope you won't be too surprised and do something rash when you see him, although he did pay for the room in advance."

src: In the Wood of Sharp Teeth, I had some encounters with hostile Fey. I talked to one of the animals who had been fighting with the hostile fey, and was informed of how to reach the hiding place of some Druids who are apparently working with these Fey. A entrance to a hidden path to reach them can be found in the area east of the ridge in the western part of the forest. It should not be difficult to locate and use now that I know where it.\n\nUsing the information provided by the animal, I was able to locate a hidden enclave of Shadow Druids who were apparently working witht he hostile Fey. I fought and killed them. Whether this makes any long-term difference to the behavior of the Fey in these woods remains to be seen.

src: The Beholder Merchant Gaurash Vraktar has indicated he might know of a way for me to return to the surface, but will not release this information for free. He expects me to find the three pieces of a broken magical item known as Maghaurezh's Beholder Band. One of these pieces can currently be found in a Beholder Colony to the south, and another is in the possession of Mind Flayers who can be found in a stronghold to the north. The third has been acquired by Kuo Toa who have a base to the east. None of these factions is likely to be willing to part with their piece of the item, or indeed to react to my appearance with anything other than full-fledged hostility, so recovering the pieces will surely require some fighting.\n\nI have found one of the pieces of Maghaurezh's Beholder Band.

I became a wandering adventurer, eventually joining a few others of that sort who were not bothered by my lineage. Unfortunately it turns out that those who defy questionable social norms are all too often the same people who defy justified ones as well. The group I took up with consisted mostly of unscrupulous mercenaries, not much interested in their paymaster's justifications or ultimate purposes. While I was able to steer them away from some of the more ethically dubious jobs they considered taking on, I was not really very comfortable with such company."

dst:
我与一位塞露涅的牧师交谈过，他正试图在卡林港建立一座该神祇的神殿，希望能抵消莎尔在世界这一地区过大的影响力。他告诉我，神殿的建造工作正受到破坏者的干扰，他们在夜间出击，破坏白天建成的部分。他请求我设法处理此事。他建议我从神殿后门出去，那里堆放着大量建筑材料，找些板条箱躲在后面。从那里我可以在夜间（破坏行为发生时）进行监视，运气好的话，我会看到肇事者靠近，并能够阻止他们。如果可能的话，最好还能找到一些确凿的证据，查明幕后主使是谁。

我看到一个可疑的身影靠近神殿，在他造成任何破坏之前把他吓跑了。然而，如果我想查明他是谁或他的目的是什么，就必须出发追赶。他跑得很快，如果我不尽快追上他，很可能会在这个复杂的迷宫般的小巷中跟丢他。我需要朝他离开的方向追去，并希望在各个路口找到他往哪个方向去的线索。如果几分钟内还没找到他，很可能就再也找不到了。

我追踪那个破坏者到了他的藏身处，在那里与他及一名同伙交战。我把两人都杀了。这应该能大大缓解神殿的麻烦，我应该尽快回去报告。关于这些破坏者的动机和所属组织仍有许多疑问，不过其中一人身上带着一张纸，可能对此事有些线索。我也应该把这个带到神殿去。
src:
I spoke to a priest of Selune who is attempting to establish a temple to that deity in Calimport, in hopes of counteracting the excessive influence of Shar in this region of the world. He told me that construction work on the temple is being disrupted by vandals, who strike at night and wreck some of the building done during the day. He has asked me to try and do something about this. He suggests I go out the back entrance of the temple, where a lot of constuction materials are piled up, and find some crates to hide behind. From there I can watch during the night (when the vandalism occurs) and with any luck I will see the perpetrators approach and be able to stop them. It would be good as well to find some solid evidence about who is behind this, if possible.

I saw a suspicious figure approaching the temple and scared him off before he could do any damage. If I wish to find out anything about who he is or what his purposes are, however, I will have to set out in pursuit. He can run quickly and I will likely lose him in this complicated maze of alleys if I do not catch up to him soon. I need to head off in the direction he went and hope to find clues as to which direction he took at any intersections. If I have not found him within a few minutes it will likely be too late to ever do so.

I tracked the vandal to his hideout, and there did battle with him and a compatriot. I have slain both. This should go far in relieving the troubles of the Temple, and I should report back there when possible. Many questions still remain about the motives and affiliations of these vandal, though one of them was carrying a paper that may have some clues concerning this matter. I should bring this to the temple as well.

dst: 这曾是被称为“荣耀者”加斯坦的冒险者所戴的头盔，他的事迹在传述中或许比现实中更加辉煌。每当加斯坦冒险归来，他都会向当地酒馆的顾客们讲述他最新的壮举，这些故事总是相当惊人，并助长了那些令人印象深刻的传说的传播。然而，事后回想加斯坦的故事时，不止一个听过的人会对它们的真实性产生怀疑，因为他讲述的许多事件即使不算荒谬，也相当不可能，并且与其他来源获得的信息相矛盾。例如，加斯坦声称杀死的一条龙后来被确凿地证实仍然活着，这给那些试图去掠夺这头怪物所谓无人看守的宝藏的人带来了不幸的后果。尽管有这些问题，每当加斯坦真正开口说话时，他的头盔稳稳地戴在头上，他的听众似乎觉得完全无法不相信他说的任何话。
src: This was once the helm of the adventurer known as Garstan the Glorious, whose deeds were perhaps more glorious in the accounting than they were in reality. Whenever Garstan returned from an adventuring foray, he would regale the patrons of local taverns with tales of his latest exploits, which were invariably quite remarkable and contributed to the spread of impressive legends. When reflecting upon Garstan's stories later on, however, more than one of those who heard them would be set to wondering about their veracity, since many of the events he recounted were quite unlikely, if not preposterous, and contradicted information obtained from other sources. One dragon Garstan claimed to have slain, for example, was later defintely revealed to still be alive, with unfortunate consequences for those seeking to plunder the monster's allegedly unguarded treasure. Despite these issues, however, whenever Garstan was actually speaking, his helm firmly in place, his listeners seemed to find it quite impossible to disbelieve anything he said.

dst: 我得知一位名叫拉达穆尔·召唤师的法师提供了一个耐人寻味的机会：他设置了一道界门，通往某个遥远的位面，那里显然有邪魔怪物守卫，但据说也有大量财富可夺。只要付出代价，他就会允许想要一试身手的冒险者穿过界门。遗憾的是，他要求两名冒险者进入的价格相当高：100000金币。我得考虑一下这次冒险是否值得付出这样的代价并承担这些风险。\n\n显然，拉达穆尔的界门通往卡尼亚，第八层地狱。这一区域似乎处于某个名为斯纳提拉尔查尔夫泽恩领主的实体控制之下。
src: I have learned of an intriguing opportunity offered by a mage known as Radamur the Conjurer: He has set up a portal that leads to some far plane, apparently guarded by fiendish monstrosities but also allegedly containing great wealth for the taking. For a price, he will permit adventurers who wish to test their mettle to pass through the portal. Unfortunately the price he demands for two adventurers to enter is quite high: 100000 gold. I shall have to consider whether this venture is worth the cost and the risks.\n\nApparently Radamur's portal leads to Cania, the Eighth Hell. This sector of the realm is apparently under the control of some entity known as Lord Snatylar'charv'zen.

src:
Dwarves are known for their skill in warfare, their ability to withstand physical and magical punishment, their hard work, and their capacity for drinking ale. Dwarves are slow to jest and suspicious of strangers, but they are generous to those who earn their trust. They stand just 4 to 4 1/2 feet tall, but are broad and compactly built, almost as wide as they are tall. Dwarven skin varies from deep tan to light brown, and their hair is black, gray, or brown. Dwarven men value their beards highly.

Dwarven Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass dwarf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Poisons: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Orcs: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft Armor): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft Weapon): +2 racial bonus to Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.

dst:
我们寻找的那本书所在的古代塔楼蕴含强大的魔法，但也有危险的守卫，正如我们被提示怀疑的那样。似乎还有进一步的复杂情况：一些卓尔试图进入以获取其宝藏，而一些维尔德斯精灵则试图阻止他们或任何其他不配进入的势力。

在塔内，我们发现了一扇有魔法守卫的门，很可能需要钥匙才能通过。也许那本书就在这扇门后，而且肯定有有价值的东西。我们应该尝试找到钥匙，它很可能在塔内的其他地方。

在塔的上方，我们发现了建在树梢上的古代精灵城市的遗迹。据说许多这类遗迹，有些被魔法保存，散布在维尔德斯各处，其中一些含有有价值的魔法。也许在这里能找到重要的东西。
src:
The ancient tower containing the book we seek contains much powerful magic, but also dangerous guardians, just as we were given reason to suspect. It appears there are further complications as well: some Drow are seeking to gain access seeking its treasures and some elves of the Wealdeath seek to prevent them or any other undeserving parties from entering.

Within the tower, we have discovered a magically warded door that likely requires a key to get past. Perhaps the book is behind this door, and surely something valuable is. We should attempt to find the key, which could well be somewhere else in the tower.

Above the tower, we have found remnants of an ancient elven city built in the treetops. It is said that many remnants of this kind, some magically preserved, are scattered throughout the Wealdeath, and some contain valuable magic. Perhaps something of significance can be found here.
