在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给提尔神殿的首席祭司阿达拉斯看时，他认出这是不久前被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。他因我归还找到的碎片而奖赏了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，他也想要。

找到圣环的第二块碎片后，阿达拉斯告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，他就能施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。他还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖赏。我接受了这个任务，并被传送到了某个隐蔽的墓穴。最后一块戒指碎片无疑就在附近，但和前两块一样由不死生物守卫着，所以我必须谨慎行事。我还必须记住，当我返回时界门会崩塌，所以在取回最后一块碎片之前我不应该回去。

我已经找到了这枚提尔圣环的最后一块碎片。我现在可以返回神殿了。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Adaras, the head priest of the Temple of Tyr, he recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. He rewarded me for returning the piece I found, and has told me that he would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Adaras that with two pieces of the ring, he could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. He also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I have accepted this quest and been transported to a hidden tomb somewhere. The final ring fragment is doubtless about, but is guarded by undead as the first two were so I must proceed with caution. I must also remember that the portal will collapse when I return, so I should not do so until the final piece is recovered.

I have found the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr. I can now return to the temple.

dst: 卡林杉的战士们偏爱弯曲的劈砍刀刃，弯刀在那里或许比费伦任何其他地方都更受欢迎。这把武器是以卡林杉弯曲风格打造的重剑，使其看起来像是一把异常巨大的弯刀。虽然这种刀刃风格是否真的优于传统重剑尚有争议，但这把特定的武器还附有显著的魔法强化，使其成为一件毫无疑问的致命武器。
src: The warriors of Calimshan have a fondness for curved, slashing blades, with scimitars being perhaps more popular there than anywhere else in Faerun. This weapon is a bastard sword made in the curving Calishite style, making it resemble an unusually large scimitar. While it is debatable whether this style of blade is really superior to a conventional bastard sword, this particular example also has significant magical enhancements, making it an unquestionably deadly weapon.

dst: 我们的交通工具，瓦尔库尔之剑号，是一艘猎捕海盗的船。船长打算在方便的时候把扎拉拉和我送到卡林杉以外的某个港口，但在此期间他有自己的事情要处理。因此，这艘船目前正驶向耐兰瑟群岛中众多岛屿之一，那里是海盗的基地，打算袭击并消灭那些海盗。据船员说，那些海盗是一群牛头人，一直在卡林杉以西的海域对商船进行多次劫掠。作为一名经验丰富的冒险者，我无疑能够协助对抗这些海盗。\n\n船长计划在即将到来的袭击中利用我的才能，要求扎拉拉和我，以及几名船员，乘坐一艘小船绕到岛屿北侧，在隐形术的掩护下行动，而瓦尔库尔之剑号则从南面攻击海盗的主力。我们登陆并开始了进攻，但在与牛头人战斗的过程中触发了一个陷阱，重石砸向我们，同时把我们抛到了下层。我们队伍中有些人在此过程中牺牲了，但我们一路杀出迷宫，接着又击败了一个自称是扭曲符文会伊尔库泽拉姆的巫妖的爪牙。最后我们与巫妖本人交战并击败了他，关闭了他本可用来再次返回的传送门。完成这一切后，我们找到了出路，与其余船员会合，并和他们一起离开了岛屿。一次成功的猎捕海盗行动就此完成。
src: Our transportation, the Sword of Valkur, is a pirate-hunting vessel. Her captain intends when convenient to drop Zarala and myself off at some port outside of Calimshan, but in the meantime has business of his own to attend to. As a result, the ship is currently on a course for one of the many islands in the Nelanther archipelago that serves as a base for pirates, intending to assault it and eliminate the pirates. According to the crew, the pirates in question are a band of minotaurs who have been carrying out many raids on merchant shipping in the seas west of Calimshan. As an experienced adventurer, I would no doubt be able to assist in fighting the pirates.\n\nThe captain's plan for utilizing my talents in the upcoming assault called for Zarala and me, along with several of the crew, to take a small craft around to the north side of the island, under cover of an invisibility spell, while the Sword of Valkur assails the main force of pirates in the south. We landed and commenced our assault, but in the process of fighting the minotaurs ended up springing a trap, which dropped heavy rocks on us while dumping us into a lower level. Some of our party was lost in the process, but we fought our way through the maze, and then through the minions of a lich who identified himself as Ilkuzeram of the Twisted Rune. Finally we fought and defeated the lich himself, and closed the portal he would have used to return again. With all that accomplished we were able to find our way out and meet up with the rest of the crew, and departed the island with them. A successful episode of pirate-hunting is now complete.

dst:
刃魔是下层位面阿刻戎的危险居民。就像他们的家园位面一样，他们主要由金属构成，类似于活体构装体。他们的形状像人类，但没有头发，皮肤上覆盖着金属尖刺。他们的眼睛通常发出蓝色或紫色的光芒。他们对肤浅的衣物不感兴趣，许多人依靠天生防御来保护自己。作为一个种族，他们排外且不信任外人，尽管他们对自己的同类有强烈的责任感和忠诚。他们也高度迷信。

刃魔属性调整：+2 敏捷。
偏好职业（战士）：在决定兼职刃魔是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其战士职业不计入。

特殊能力：

- 30英尺基础速度
- 黑暗视觉：刃魔能够在黑暗中视物。
- 天生防御：刃魔有+4天生防御加值。
- 天生武器：刃魔有主要天生爪击攻击，造成1d6伤害。
- 免疫：免疫酸伤害。
- 抗火：天生火焰抗力5。
- 抗寒：天生寒冷抗力5。
- 伤害减免：伤害减免 5/+1。
- 金属皮肤：尽管有金属皮肤，刃魔本身不会受到锈蚀攻击的伤害。由于皮肤上的尖刺，他们也不能穿戴任何比轻型盔甲更重的盔甲。
- 剃刀风暴：每天一次，刃魔可以从皮肤喷出15英尺锥形的金属碎片，对区域内目标造成2d6挥砍伤害。反射豁免对抗10 + 体质，成功则伤害减半。之后，刃魔的天生防御在24小时内降低2。
- 异界生物：在法咒效果方面，刃魔视为异界生物。

src:
Bladelings are dangerous inhabitants of the Lower Plane of Acheron.  Like their home plane they are mostly made of metal, resembling living constructs.  In shape they are human, but lack hair, and their skin is covered in patches of metallic spines.  Their eyes typically glow a blue or purple light.  They have little interest in superficial clothing, and many rely on their natural armor for protection.  As a race they are xenophobic and distrusting of outsiders, though they have a strong sense of duty and loyalty to their own kind.  They are also highly superstitious.

Bladeling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass bladeling's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Darkvision: Bladelings are able to see in the dark.
- Natural Armor: Bladelings have a +4 Natural Armor bonus.
- Natural Weapons: Bladelings have a primary natural claw attack for 1d6 damage.
- Immunities: Immune to acid damage.
- Resist Fire: Innate fire resistance of 5.
- Resist Cold: Innate cold resistance of 5.
- Damage Reduction: DR 5/+1.
- Metal Hide: Despite their metal skin, bladelings themselves cannot be damaged by rust attacks.  They also cannot wear any armor heavier than light armor due to the spikes in their skin.
- Razor Storm: Once per day, bladelings can expel a 15' cone of metallic shards from their skin, dealing 2d6 slashing to those within.  There is a reflex save vs 10 + Con for half damage.  Afterwards, the bladeling's natural armor drops by 2 for 24 hours.
- Outsider: Bladelings count as Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

Specifics: When you expend your psionic focus, you can simultaneously use two feats that require a psionic focus to be expended, instead of just one. You must still spend the requisite power points required to use each metapsionic feat, and you cannot exceed the power point limit set by your manifester level.

src: Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. 持续时间：立即

法术抗力：是

你的触碰逐渐将一个活着的受害者转变为一只贪婪的食尸鬼。受害者的身体慢慢死去，每轮受到 3d6 点伤害。当受害者达到 0 点生命值时，她的身体和心智都变成食尸鬼。

如果受害者豁免失败，移除疾病，解除魔法，莫登凯恩裂解术，移除诅咒或高等复原术可以否定这种逐渐转变。治疗法咒可以通过增加生命值暂时延长这一过程，但不会结束法咒的效果。

然而，无论你用此法咒制造出多少食尸鬼，你每施法者等级只能控制 2HD 的不死生物。如果你是牧师，你通过命令或斥喝可能控制的任何不死生物不计入此限制。
src:
School: Necromancy [Death, Evil]
Caster Level: Sorcerer/Wizard 6
Components: V, S
Range: Touch
Target: One living humaniod creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

Your touch gradually transforms a living victim into a ravening, flesh-eating ghoul.  The victim takes 3d6 points of damage per round while the body slowly dies.  When the victim reaches 0 hit points, she becomes a ghoul, body and mind.

If the victim fails her saving throw, cure disease, dispel magic, Mordenkainen's disjunction, remove curse, or greater restoration negates the gradual change.  Healing spells may temporarily prolong the process by increasing hit points, but does not end the effects of the spell.

No matter how many ghouls you generate with this spell, however, you can control only 2HD worth of undead creatures per caster level.  If you are a cleric, any undead you might control via command or rebuke do not count toward the limit.

They must still have the appropriate crafting feats to craft, however.
If you are attempting to craft a wearable item, use the appropriate feat.
If you are attempting to craft a limited use item such as a wand, scroll, potion, or staff, then use this feat on the base item and select the spell to use in the following dialog.
Use: Selected/Automatic.

By contrast, they have no particular protections against magical attack, and are highly vulnerable to elemental damage.  Adventuring parties without powerful casters, however, might do better to simply avoid them.

单一目标：如果微观世界以单个生物为目标，若该生物当前生命值为 100 或更低，其感官会与现实世界隔绝。受术者的所有感官完全由其自身心智内部虚构，尽管它可能并未意识到这一点。实际上，受术者瘫软在地，流着口水发出呜咽声，最终在无人照料下死于饥渴。受术者生活在自己的虚构世界中，直到其实际死亡之时。

区域效果：如果微观世界在一个区域显能，它会使所有受影响生物陷入共享的紧张性木僵（世界是虚构的，但在世界内部，受害者可以彼此互动）.它只影响当前生命值为 30 或更低的生物，且此类生物的总生命值上限为 300.此异能优先影响生命值最低的生物。（生命值为负的生物视为拥有 0 点生命值。）

对受影响的生物第二次显能微观世界会再次将其感官通路转向外部。

增幅：你每额外花费 1 点异能点，此异能可影响的单体与群体生命值数量增加 10。

Telepathy (Compulsion) [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Psion/wilder 9
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target or Area: One creature; or one or more creatures within a 15-ft.-radius sphere
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 17
Metapsionics: Twin, Widen

This power enables you to warp the consciousness and senses of one or more creatures, sending the victim into a catatonic state. When microcosm is manifested, you can target either a single creature within range or a group of creatures all located within the power's area.

Single Target: If microcosm targets a single creature, that creature's senses are pinched off from the real world if it currently has 100 or fewer hit points. The subject's senses are all completely fabricated from within its own mind, though it may not realize this. In reality, the subject sprawls limply, drooling and mewling, and eventually dies of thirst and starvation without care. The subject lives within its own made-up world until the time of its actual death.

Area Effect: If microcosm is manifested on an area, it sends all affected creatures into a shared catatonia (the world is a construct, but within the world, the victims can interact with each other). It affects only creatures that currently have 30 or fewer hit points, and only up to a total of 300 hit points of such creatures. The power affects creatures with the lowest hit point totals first. (Creatures with negative hit points count as having 0 hit points.)

Manifesting microcosm a second time on an affected creature turns its sensory pathways outward once more.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, the number of individual and group hit points the power can affect increases by 10.

符文师最初是由矮人和巨人开发的一项技能，创造能量符文的能力已经传播到了丘陵和山脉之外。那些选择掌握这项能力的人就是符文师，他们能创造出极其强大的符号，可以持续多次使用，并且无需触碰即可触发。一位成熟的符文师的物品通常装饰着许多符文，使他的装备看起来非常壮观，并且对盗贼来说是一个真正的威胁。

在符文师职业上获得一级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，就像他在其最高神术施法职业上也获得了一级一样。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
A skill originally developed by the Dwarves and the giants, the ability to create runes of power has spread beyond the hills and mountains. Those that choose to master this ability are runecasters, creating incredibly potent symbols that can last for multiple uses and can be triggered without being touched. An established runecaster's goods are usually adorned with many runes, making his equipment very impressive looking and a true threat to thieves.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Runecaster does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Divine Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd-level spells.
Skills: Spellcraft 8 ranks, Craft Armour 8 ranks.
Feats: Inscribe Rune (This requires 13 Int and 2nd-level divine spells)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Rune Craft +1 - The Runecaster gets a +1 bonus on checks to craft runes.
2: Rune Power +1 - Runes created by the Runecaster receive this bonus to DC and Spell Penetration.
3: Improved Runecasting - The Runecaster can now place more than 1 charge upon a rune.
4: Rune Craft +2
5: Rune Power +2
6: Maximize Rune - For a +5 increase in the DC to craft the rune, the Runecaster can attempt to maximize a rune.
7: Rune Craft +3
8: Improved Runecasting - The Runecaster can now create runes with uses per day.
9: Rune Power +3
10: Rune Chant - At the cost of being slowed, the Runecaster can now affect divine spells with his Rune Power ability.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in runecaster, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

dst: "那些据说是已故刺客之神巴尔的神子。他们中许多人变得相当强大，正如你对拥有神之血脉的人所期待的那样。他们中有些人一直在制造很多麻烦，互相竞争成为巴尔的继承人，或者类似的事情。我想到了现在，他们大多已经自相残杀殆尽了，所以可能不再是我们需要担心的事情了。就像我说的，旧闻了。但是当那个由巴尔神子领导的冒险队伍在这里时，确实大大促进了当地经济。他们不仅让矿场重新运转起来，还带来了各种魔法武器之类的东西供我们转售：据说有些甚至是从传说中的杜拉格之塔掠夺来的！自那时起，镇上很多建筑都加建了二层或其他扩建……不过像你这样的<CUSTOM106>可能对那种平凡的事情不感兴趣。"
src: "Those are people who allegedly are children of the dead god of assassins, Bhaal. Many of them became quite powerful, as you'd expect of someone with god's blood. Some of them have been causing a lot of trouble, competing with each other to become Bhaal's heir, or something like that. I think by this point they've mostly killed each other off so probably not anything we need to worry about any more. Old news, as I was saying. But while that particular Bhaalspawn-led adventuring group was here it made for quite a boost to the local economy. Not only did they get the mine going again, they brought in all sorts of magical weapons and such for us to resell: some of it even plundered from the legendary Durlag's Tower, it's said! Since that time a lot of buildings in town have added a second story or other additions...though <CUSTOM106> like you probably isn't interested in mundane stuff like that."

dst: 我答应为我遇到的一个旅行商人完成一项小任务。他给了我一个包裹，要送给一位名叫巴莫特·哈罗扬的提尔牧师，此人住在神殿区的提尔神殿以北。这有点偏离商人的路线，所以如果我为他完成这项任务，他准备付给我一些金币。\n\n当我把包裹带给哈罗扬时，结果他并没有期待这个包裹，而且里面实际上装的是非法的黑莲花样本！更糟的是，作为圈套的一部分，有人向城市守卫告了密，就在我们处理这些罪证的时候，守卫出现了。看来那个旅行商人参与了某种阴谋，目的是陷害哈罗扬，或者我，或者我们两个，大概是为了败坏提尔神殿和/或帕夏加尔哈德尔的声誉。我被带到守卫的地牢接受审问，但由于没有对我不利的确凿证据，加上帕夏加尔哈德尔和提尔神殿都抗议对我的监禁，我被释放了。幕后黑手是谁仍然是个谜。不过我实在不知道能去哪里查，因为我想等我回到商人区时，那个商人肯定已经走了。也许某天会出现一些线索。在此期间，我还有别的任务要处理。
src: I have agreed to carry out a small task for a traveling merchant I came across. He has given me a package to be delivered to one Bamot Harojan, a priest of Tyr, who lives north of the Temple of Tyr, in the Temple District. This was a bit out of the merchant's way and so he is prepared to pay me some gold if I complete this task for him.\n\nWhen I brought the package to Harojan, it turned out that he was not expecting it, and that it in fact contained samples of illegal Black Lotus! On top of that, the City Watch, tipped off as part of the set-up, showed up just at the moment we were handling the incriminating evidence. It appears that traveling merchant was part of some conspiracy to frame Harojan, or me, or both, presumably in an attempt to discredit the Temple of Tyr and/or Pasha Galhadr. I was taken to the dungeons of the Watch for questioning, but with no conclusive evidence against me, and protests about my imprisonment coming from both Pasha Galhadr and the Temple of Tyr, I was released. The mystery of who was behind this remains. I do not really know where I could look to find out though, since I assume that merchant will be gone by the time I get back to the Merchant District. Perhaps some clue will eventually turn up. In the meantime, I have other tasks to attend to.

（进阶职业）
奥法骑士同时研习武技与奥术，是一名多才多艺的战斗者，既能向敌人施放火球术，也能拔剑冲锋。奥法骑士以能针对不同情况运用正确战术为荣：对物理强悍的敌人使用法咒，对施法敌人使用武力。

- 生命骰：d6
- 武器熟练：无
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

专长：所有军用武器熟练
奥术施法：能够施展3级法咒。

职业特性：

奥法骑士在1级时获得一个奖励专长。可选择的专长是所有战士奖励专长（除了武器专精）.

每日法咒：从2级开始，每当获得一个新的奥法骑士等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同她在添加该进阶职业之前所属的任意奥术施法职业也提升了一级。然而，她不会获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处（奖励超魔或物品制造专长，吟游诗人或刺客能力，等等）.这基本上意味着她将奥法骑士等级加到角色拥有的其他奥术施法职业等级上，然后据此确定每日法咒和施法者等级。如果角色在成为奥法骑士之前有多个奥术施法职业，她必须决定将每个奥法骑士等级加到哪个职业上，以确定每日法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Studying the martial and arcane arts to equal degree, the Eldritch Knight is a versatile combatant who can cast fireball on her foes or charge them with sword drawn. The Eldritch Knight takes pride in her ability to use the right technique for the job: spells against physically tough foes and force of arms against spellcasting enemies.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: None
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Feats: All Martial Weapon Proficiencies
Arcane Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd-level spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Eldritch Knights receive a bonus feat at first level. The feats to pick from are all fighter bonus feats (except Weapon Specialization).

Spells per Day: From 2nd level on, when a new eldritch knight level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in whatever arcane spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (bonus metamagic or item creation feats, bard or assassin abilities, and so on). This essentially means that she adds the level of eldritch knight to the level of whatever other arcane spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day and caster level accordingly. If a character had more than one arcane spellcasting class before she became an eldritch knight, she must decide to which class she adds each level of eldritch knight for the purpose of determining spells per day.

dst: 这把巨锤曾是弗拉赫岑·扎雷克的武器，他是一位令人生畏的卓尔战士，在夜战期间因其武艺而声名远扬，也因他对卡林杉人民施展此技时的残暴而臭名昭著。很少有敌人能在他面前有多少胜算，因此，由于最终结果毫无悬念，弗拉赫岑常常会拖长战斗，以便缓慢而痛苦地杀死对手。正如人们所料，他那把附魔极重的锤子是一件残忍的武器，锤头上装饰着极其锋利的尖刺以刺穿敌人，还附有将腐蚀性酸液注入伤口的附魔，使伤口更加疼痛。\n\n尽管他在战场上长期所向无敌，弗拉赫岑的施虐习性最终导致了他的覆灭。有一次，在劫掠一个村庄时，他让与其中一名守卫的战斗拖得太久，给了当时是卡林杉盟友的一群变形蛛赶来的时间。当这些众多而致命的援军加入残余守卫时，就连弗拉赫岑也觉得胜算过于渺茫，他再也没能回到幽暗地域。他死亡的消息很快传遍各地，令人欢欣，但很长一段时间里，没有人知道他那把强大的巨锤在他陨落之后下落如何。
src: This dire mace was once the weapon of Vrachzen Dzarrek, a formidable Drow warrior who during the Night Wars gained fame for his skill at arms, and notoriety for the viciousness with which he exercised this skill against the people of Calimshan. Few foes stood much of a chance against him, and so, with the final outcome not in doubt, Vrachzen would frequently drag out a fight, so as to kill his opponents slowly and painfully. As might be expected, his heavily enchanted mace is a cruel weapon, the maceheads adorned with spikes of extraordinary sharpness to gouge an enemy, as well as an enchantment to pour corrosive acid into the wounds inflicted, making them that much more painful.\n\nThough for a long time he proved invincible on the battlefied, Vrachzen's sadistic habits eventually proved his downfall. Once, while raiding a village, he caused a fight against one of its defenders to drag on too long, allowing time for a band of aranea, who were at that time Calimshan's allies, to show up. Even Vrachzen found the odds too difficult when these numerous and deadly reinforcements joined the remaining defenders, and he never returned to the Underdark. The joyous news of his death soon spread throughout the land, but for a long time no human knew what had become of his powerful dire mace in the aftermath of his fall.

src:
Nasirak wants me to defeat the Titans. This actually shouldn't be as difficult as it sounds, since they are not really Titans, just a criminal gang using that as their name, but it will surely involve a good bit of fighting. The hideouts of these Titans can be found southeast of the Temple of Ilmater.

I have slain the leader of the "Big Titan," leader of the gang, and a substantial number if not most of his followers. This should eliminate whatever threat they pose. I even found some significant papers at the Poverty Relief Office, with which the gang was working before relations between them soured, though I gave these to my companion to deal with.

I have reported the defeat of the Titans to Nasirak, thus accomplishing the main task he gave me.

卡达斯和他的探险队正在卡林沙漠中发掘一些古代遗迹。然而，在地下探索中，他们遭遇了巨型蜘蛛和亡灵带来的麻烦。由于没有准备好应对这些障碍，卡达斯请我替他探索遗迹。如果可能的话，我应该清除其中的怪物，或者至少留意那些有助于他研究的重要历史文物。

在探索遗迹时，一扇受魔法控制的门在我身后砰然关闭。从这一侧似乎无法打开它：看来我可能被困在遗迹里了！我唯一能想到的办法就是继续深入，希望能找到另一个出口。

深入遗迹后，我遇到了一名古代角斗士的亡灵遗骸。他出奇地健谈。他告诉我，要逃离遗迹，我必须先杀死他，并拿走他持有的一块魔法石。这将使我能够使用附近的两座界门。如果我选对了界门，就会发现自己踏上一条通往地牢更深处的路，并有望找到另一个出口。选错界门则会把我送到一个叫做“末日之室”的地方，那听起来是个最好避开的地方。

看来我找到了通往遗迹更深处的正确界门。希望不用太久就能找到出口。

dst:
随着展现者对心灵异能的了解日益增长，他可以学会以与最初设计或学习时略有不同的方式展现异能。例如，展现者可以学会如何展现一个异能使其持续时间比正常更长，造成比正常更多的伤害，或以其他方式改进。当然，在使用超心灵异能专长时展现异能比正常展现异能花费更多。
  展现时间：使用超心灵异能专长展现的异能所需时间与正常展现异能相同，除非专长描述中另有说明，例如瞬发异能。
  展现消耗：要使用超心灵异能专长，心灵异能角色必须同时消耗其心灵异能专注并支付专长描述中给出的增加心灵异能点消耗。例如，将链式异能专长应用于一个异能会使该异能的消耗增加6点心灵异能点。
  使用限制：与所有异能一样，你在一个异能上花费的心灵异能点不能超过你的展现者等级。超心灵异能专长只是让你以不同方式展现异能；它们不会让你违反此规则。
  超心灵异能专长对异能的影响：在所有方面，超心灵异能异能以其原始异能等级运作，即使它花费额外的心灵异能点。超心灵异能专长对异能所做的修改仅具有其注明的效果。展现者不能使用超心灵异能专长来改变从异能石，多杰或其他设备中施展的异能。
展现由瞬发异能专长修改的异能不会引发借机攻击。
一些超心灵异能专长仅适用于特定异能，如每个具体专长条目中所述。
src:
As a manifesters knowledge of psionics grows, he can learn to manifest powers in ways slightly different from how the powers were originally designed or learned. For example, a manifester can learn how to manifest a power so that it lasts longer than normal, deals more damage than normal, or is improved in some other way. Of course, manifesting a power while using a metapsionic feat is more expensive than manifesting the power normally.
  Manifesting Time: Powers manifested using metapsionic feats take the same time as manifesting the powers normally unless the feat description specifically says otherwise, such as with Quicken Power.
  Manifestation Cost: To use a metapsionic feat, a psionic character must both expend his psionic focus and pay an increased power point cost as given in the feat description. For example, applying the Chain Power feat to a power increases the power's cost by 6 power points.
  Limits on Use: As with all powers, you cannot spend more power points on a power than your manifester level. Metapsionic feats merely let you manifest powers in different ways; they do not let you violate this rule.
  Effects of Metapsionic Feats on a Power: In all ways, a metapsionic power operates at it's original power level, even though it costs additional power points. The modifications to a power made by a metapsionic feat have only their noted effect on the power. A manifester can't use a metapsionic feat to alter a power being cast from a power stone, dorje, or other device.
Manifesting a power modified by the Quicken Power feat does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Some metapsionic feats apply only to certain powers, as described in each specific feat entry.

诡术师将他们的法咒知识与对阴谋，盗窃或纯粹恶作剧的品味结合起来。他们是最具适应性的冒险者之一。诡术师倾向于以即兴的方式冒险，装载能提升其潜行和机动性的法咒。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 擅长：诡术师不获得任何武器，护甲或盾牌擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：非守序
技能：学识 4 级，解除陷阱 7，开锁 7。
偷袭：2d6
法咒：必须能够施放至少 3 级奥术法咒。

职业特性：

等级
1：远程巧手 - 在 30 尺范围内进行陷阱和开锁，每天一次。
2：偷袭 1d6。
3：即兴偷袭 - 诡术师对目标造成偷袭，每天可使用一次。
4：偷袭 2d6。
5：远程巧手 - 提升为每天两次使用。
6：偷袭 3d6。
7：即兴偷袭 - 提升为每天两次使用。
8：偷袭 4d6。
9：远程巧手 - 每天三次使用。
10：偷袭 5d6。

奖励法咒：

在诡术师职业获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高施法职业（吟游诗人，术士或法师）中也获得了等级。他不会通过其能力学习任何新法咒。然而，他不会获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处（例如，进阶魔宠，奖励专长）
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Arcane Tricksters combine their knowledge of spells with a taste for intrigue, larceny or just plain mischief. They are among the most adaptable of adventurers. Arcane Tricksters tend to use a seat of the pants approach to adventuring, loading up on spells that improve their stealth and mobility.

- Hit Dice: d4.
- Proficiencies: Arcane Tricksters gain no weapon, armor or shield proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non Lawful
Skills: Lore 4 ranks, Disable Trap 7, Open Lock 7.
Sneak Attack: 2d6
Spells: Must be able to cast at least 3rd level Arcane spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Ranged Legerdemain - Trap and Open Lock at 30' range, once per day.
2: Sneak Attack 1d6.
3: Impromptu Sneak Attack - Arcane Trickster causes a sneak attack on target, can be used once per day.
4: Sneak Attack 2d6.
5: Ranged Legerdemain - Improves to two uses a day.
6: Sneak Attack 3d6.
7: Impromptu Sneak Attack - Improves to two uses a day.
8: Sneak Attack 4d6.
9: Ranged Legerdemain - Three uses a day.
10: Sneak Attack 5d6.

BONUS SPELLS:

Upon gaining a level in Arcane Trickster, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (bard, sorcerer, or wizard). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (e.g., improved familiar, bonus feats)

src:
Necromancy
Level: Paladin 4,
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: One willing creature
Duration: 1 minute/level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

Calling upon the saints of your order, you imbue the person 
in need with the power to resist the dire forces arrayed 
against you.

The subject gains immunity to nonlethal damage, charm and 
compulsion effects, and attacks that function specifically 
by causing pain, such as the wrack spell (see page 243). it
is further immune to effects that would cause it to be dazed,
exhausted, fatigued, nauseated, sickened, staggered, or stunned.
The subject remains conscious at -1 to -9 hit points and can 
take a single action each round while in that state, and does
not lose hit point for acting. If any of the above conditions 
were in effect on the subject at the time of casting, they are 
suspended for the spell's duration. (Thus, an unconscious 
subject becomes conscious and functional.)

When the spell ends, any effects suspended by the spell that
have not expired in the interim (such as the fatigued condition,
which normally requires 8 hours of rest to recover from) return.
Effects that expired during the duration of this spell do not 
resume when it ends.

In addition to these effects, the subject gains the benefit of
the Endurance feat for the duration of the spell.

dst: 这把武器是精灵铁匠维拉兰在很久以前打造的。他制作的众多魔法武器在过去数百年间随着战局的起伏，在冒险者和怪物团伙之间辗转易手。维拉兰还以在武器上镶嵌魔法宝石而闻名，这能大幅增强武器的力量。遗憾的是，虽然这把武器有一个宝石插槽，但里面是空的。这些年来，宝石一定是在某个时候掉落或被取走了。如果能找到维拉兰的魔法宝石，就可以用它让这把武器变得更加强大。

At some point over the years the gem must have fallen out or been removed. If one of Velaran's magical gems were to be found, it could be used to make this weapon even more powerful.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Diamond Dragon 4

At 4th level, you can manifest a breath weapon attack similar to that of various dragons.  Doing this costs 5 power points and deals cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage.  A successful Reflex save versus DC 10 + class level + Int bonus halves the damage. For every additional power point you spend you deal an extra die of damage.  The total cost cannot exceed your manifester level in points.

Each damage type is handled as follows:
Cold: A 30' cone that deals +1 damage per die, and requires a Fortitude save instead of Reflex.
Electricity: A 60' line that adds 2 to the save DC.
Fire: A 30' cone that deals +1 damage per die.
Sonic: A 30' cone that deals -1 damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

dst: 在探索黑暗卡林港时，我遇到了一群狗头人。这群狗头人没有攻击我，看起来相当和平，但他们的首领告诉我，他们可能不会一直保持这样。看来他们一直受到一个巨魔的困扰，这个巨魔杀死了他们许多人，于是他们与盘踞在卡林港下水道中的好斗鼠人达成了协议。鼠人告诉狗头人，他们会帮忙对付巨魔，但作为回报，狗头人必须加入他们，一起对卡林港发动战争。狗头人首领觉得别无选择，只能同意。不过，我主动提出可以替他们杀死巨魔。如果我能做到这一点，并把巨魔的头带给他，首领承诺他不会与鼠人结盟，还会把他收集的一些财宝作为奖励送给我。这个巨魔在狗头人营地以西的区域游荡。我应当确保自己拥有能造成足够火焰或强酸伤害、以克服其再生能力的手段后，尽快出发去猎杀它。\n\n我决定攻击狗头人，而不是替他们杀死巨魔。我可能仍会去猎杀那个巨魔，但已经没有人会为此给我特别奖励了。
src: While exploring Dark Calimport, I came across a group of kobolds. This particular group did not attack me and seemed peaceful enough, but their chief told me that they might not remain that way. It seems they have been having a problem with a troll who has been killing many of them, and they made a deal with the aggressive wererats infesting Calimport's sewers. The wererats told the kobolds that they would help deal with the troll, but in return the kobolds are to join them in making war against Calimport. The kobold chief felt he had no choice but to agree with this. However, I have offered to slay the troll myself. If I can accomplish this and bring the troll's head to him, the chief has promised that he will not ally with the wererats, and reward me with some treasure he has collected as well. This troll wanders the regions to the west of the kobold encampment. I should set out to hunt it down as soon as I have made certain I possess some means of delivering enough fire or acid damage to overcome its regenerative powers.\n\nI decided to attack the kobolds rather than slay the troll for them. I may still hunt down the troll, but there is no longer anyone who will give me a special reward for doing so.

src:
School: Necromancy
Level: Sor/Wiz 2
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft/2 levels)
Targets: 1 undead creature
Duration: 1 day/level
Saving Throw: See text
Spell Resistance: Yes

This spell allows you some degree of control over an undead creature. Assuming the subject is intelligent, it perceives your words and actions in the most favorable way (treat its attitude as friendly). It will not attack you while the spell lasts.

A nonintelligent undead creature gets no saving throw against this spell. When you control a mindless being, you can communicate only basic commands. Nonintelligent undead won't resist suicidal or obviously harmful orders.

Any act by you or your apparent allies that threatens the commanded undead (regardless of its Intelligence) breaks the spell.

dst:
“Alhoon”是一个后天模板，可以添加到任何illithid生物（以下称为基础生物）上，前提是它能够制造所需的护命匣。

Alhoon拥有基础生物的所有统计数据与特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型与类型

该生物的类型变为不死生物。不要重新计算基础攻击加值，豁免或技能点。体型不变。

生命骰

将所有当前和未来的生命骰提升为d12。

防御等级

Alhoon拥有+5天生防御加值或基础生物的天生防御加值，以较高者为准。

攻击

Alhoon拥有一次接触攻击，每轮可使用一次。如果基础生物能够使用武器，alhoon保留此能力。拥有天生武器的生物保留那些天生武器。徒手战斗的alhoon使用其接触攻击或其主天生武器（如果有的话）.持用武器的alhoon可根据意愿使用其接触攻击或武器。

全力攻击

徒手战斗的alhoon使用其接触攻击（见上文）或其天生武器（如果有的话）.如果持用武器，它通常将武器作为主要攻击，同时以接触攻击作为天生次要攻击，前提是它有办法进行该攻击（要么是一只空闲的手，要么是可用作次要攻击的天生武器）.

伤害

没有天生武器的alhoon拥有一次接触攻击，使用负能量对活体生物造成1d8+5点伤害；一次意志豁免（DC 10 + 1/2 alhoon的生命骰 + alhoon的魅力调整值）可使伤害减半。拥有天生武器的alhoon可根据偏好使用其接触攻击或天生武器。如果它选择后者，则可在一次天生武器攻击中造成1d8+5点额外伤害。

特殊攻击

Alhoon保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下所述能力。除非另有说明，豁免DC等于10 + 1/2 alhoon的生命骰 + alhoon的魅力调整值。

恐惧灵光（Su）

Alhoon被笼罩在死亡与邪恶的可怕灵光之中。60英尺半径内生命骰少于5的生物若看到alhoon，必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则将如同受到由与alhoon等级相同的术士施放的恐惧术影响。成功通过豁免的生物在24小时内不会再次受到同一alhoon灵光的影响。

麻痹之触（Su）

任何被alhoon的接触攻击命中的活体生物必须成功通过一次强韧豁免，否则将永久麻痹。移除麻痹或任何能够移除诅咒的法咒都可以解救受害者（见降咒法咒描述）.

该效果无法被驱散。任何被alhoon麻痹的人看起来都像死了，不过一次DC 20的侦察检定或DC 15的医疗检定可揭示受害者仍然活着。.

法咒

Alhoon可以施放其生前能够施放的任何法咒。

特殊性质

Alhoon保留基础生物的所有特殊性质，并获得以下所述能力。

驱散抗力（Ex）

Alhoon拥有+4驱散抗力。

伤害减免（Su）

Alhoon的不死躯体坚韧，赋予该生物伤害减免15/钝击与魔法。其天生武器在克服伤害减免时视为魔化武器。

免疫（Ex）

Alhoon免疫寒冷，电击，变形（尽管它们可以对自身使用变形效果）以及影响心智的攻击。

属性

从基础生物提升如下：智力+2，感知+2，魅力+2.作为不死生物，alhoon没有体质值。

技能

Alhoon在躲藏，聆听，潜行，搜索，察言观色和侦察检定上拥有+8种族加值。除此之外与基础生物相同。

组织

单独或小队（1个alhoon，外加2-4个吸血鬼和5-8个吸血鬼衍体）.

挑战等级

与基础生物相同 + 2。

宝藏

标准钱币；双倍货物；双倍物品。

阵营

任意邪恶。

进阶

按角色职业。

等级调整

与基础生物相同 +4。

Alhoon角色

成为alhoon的过程邪恶得难以言表，且只能由自愿的角色进行。Alhoon保留其生前拥有的所有职业能力。

Alhoon的护命匣
成为奥胡恩不可或缺的一部分是制造一个魔法护命匣，角色将其生命力储存在其中。通常，唯一能确保消灭奥胡恩的方法是摧毁它的护命匣。除非找到并摧毁其护命匣，否则奥胡恩在表面死亡后1d10天会重新出现。

每个奥胡恩都必须制作自己的护命匣，这需要制造奇物专长。角色必须能够施放法咒并且施法者等级达到11级或更高。护命匣制作成本为120,000 gp和4,800 XP，其施法者等级等于创造者在创造时的等级。

护命匣最常见的形式是一个密封的金属盒，里面装有羊皮纸条，上面抄录着魔法短语。盒子为微型，具有40点生命值，硬度20，破坏DC为40。

其他形式的护命匣也可能存在，例如戒指，护符或类似物品。
src:
"Alhoon" is an acquired template that can be added to any illithid creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature), provided it can create the required phylactery.

A alhoon has all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type

The creature's type changes to undead. Do not recalculate base attack bonus, saves, or skill points. Size is unchanged.

Hit Dice

Increase all current and future Hit Dice to d12s.

Armor Class

A alhoon has a +5 natural armor bonus or the base creature's natural armor bonus, whichever is better.

Attack

A alhoon has a touch attack that it can use once per round. If the base creature can use weapons, the alhoon retains this ability. A creature with natural weapons retains those natural weapons. A alhoon fighting without weapons uses either its touch attack or its primary natural weapon (if it has any). A alhoon armed with a weapon uses its touch or a weapon, as it desires.

Full Attack

A alhoon fighting without weapons uses either its touch attack (see above) or its natural weapons (if it has any). If armed with a weapon, it usually uses the weapon as its primary attack along with a touch as a natural secondary attack, provided it has a way to make that attack (either a free hand or a natural weapon that it can use as a secondary attack).

Damage

A alhoon without natural weapons has a touch attack that uses negative energy to deal 1d8+5 points of damage to living creatures; a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2  alhoon's HD + alhoon's Cha modifier) halves the damage. A alhoon with natural weapons can use its touch attack or its natural weaponry, as it prefers. If it chooses the latter, it deals 1d8+5 points of extra damage on one natural weapon attack.

Special Attacks

A alhoon retains all the base creature's special attacks and gains those described below. Save DCs are equal to 10 + 1/2  alhoon's HD + alhoon's Cha modifier unless otherwise noted.

Fear Aura (Su)

Alhoon are shrouded in a dreadful aura of death and evil. Creatures of less than 5 HD in a 60-foot radius that look at the alhoon must succeed on a Will save or be affected as though by a fear spell from a sorcerer of the alhoon's level. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by the same alhoon's aura for 24 hours.

Paralyzing Touch (Su)

Any living creature a alhoon hits with its touch attack must succeed on a Fortitude save or be permanently paralyzed. Remove paralysis or any spell that can remove a curse can free the victim (see the bestow curse spell description).

The effect cannot be dispelled. Anyone paralyzed by a alhoon seems dead, though a DC 20 Spot check or a DC 15 Heal check reveals that the victim is still alive..

Spells

A alhoon can cast any spells it could cast while alive.

Special Qualities

A alhoon retains all the base creature's special qualities and gains those described below.

Turn Resistance (Ex)

A alhoon has +4 turn resistance.

Damage Reduction (Su)

A alhoon's undead body is tough, giving the creature damage reduction 15/bludgeoning and magic. Its natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Immunities (Ex)

Alhoon's have immunity to cold, electricity, polymorph (though they can use polymorph effects on themselves), and mind-affecting attacks.

Abilities

Increase from the base creature as follows: Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +2. Being undead, a alhoon has no Constitution score.

Skills

Alhoon's have a +8 racial bonus on Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Sense Motive, and Spot checks. Otherwise same as the base creature.

Organization

Solitary or troupe (1 alhoon, plus 2-4 vampires and 5-8 vampire spawn).

Challenge Rating

Same as the base creature + 2.

Treasure

Standard coins; double goods; double items.

Alignment

Any evil.

Advancement

By character class.

Level Adjustment

Same as the base creature +4.

Alhoon Characters

The process of becoming a alhoon is unspeakably evil and can be undertaken only by a willing character. A alhoon retains all class abilities it had in life.

The Alhoon's Phylactery

An integral part of becoming a alhoon is creating a magic phylactery in which the character stores its life force. As a rule, the only way to get rid of a alhoon for sure is to destroy its phylactery. Unless its phylactery is located and destroyed, a alhoon reappears 1d10 days after its apparent death.

Each alhoon must make its own phylactery, which requires the Craft Wondrous Item feat. The character must be able to cast spells and have a caster level of 11th or higher. The phylactery costs 120,000 gp and 4,800 XP to create and has a caster level equal to that of its creator at the time of creation.

The most common form of phylactery is a sealed metal box containing strips of parchment on which magicalphrases have been transcribed. The box is Tiny and has 40 hit points, hardness 20, and a break DC of 40.

Other forms of phylacteries can exist, such as rings, amulets, or similar items.

dst: "嗯，未结悬赏中最大、可能也最难拿到的是绿龙格拉阿扎乌库尔，他最近一直在制造麻烦。他巢穴在东北方的利齿森林某处。不幸的是，我们不知道确切位置，而寻找他的尝试都撞上了显然为这条龙效力的狗头人巡逻队。总之，如果你既能找到又能杀死这条龙，就可以领取他首级的30000金币悬赏。说真的，干掉一条龙应该值更多钱，但我们能拿出的金币只有这么多。另外还有对盗贼维蒂亚雷的5000金币悬赏，他长期以来一直惹是生非。大多数时候他只是偷别人的东西，没有直接伤害他们，所以被认为优先级较低。不幸的是，我完全不知道能在哪里找到他。"
src: "Well the largest and probably most difficult to collect of the outstanding bounties is that on the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, who has been causing trouble of late. He lairs somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, to the northeast. Unfortunately we don't know exactly where, and attempts to find him have run afoul of patrols of kobolds who apparently serve the dragon. Anyway, if you can both find and kill this dragon, you could collect a bounty of 30000 gold on his head. Really, taking down a dragon should be worth more than that, but we only have so much gold available. There's also a bounty of 5000 gold on the thief Vitiare, who has long been making a nuisance of himself. Mostly he just steals from people without doing them any direct harm, so he's considered a low priority. I don't know anything about where he could be found, unfortunately."

预知让你的心智瞥见潜在未来事件的片段 - 你所看到的很可能会发生，如果没有人采取行动改变它。然而，你的视觉是不完整的，并且在你瞥见的实际事件开始展开之前，它没有真正的意义。那时一切开始汇集，你可以根据你之前显能此异能时收到的信息行动，如果你行动迅速。

实际上，显能此异能赋予你一个'预知优势'. 通常，你一次只能有一个预知优势。你必须在不超过每等级 1 小时的时间内使用你的优势，此时你的预知消退，你失去你的优势。

你可以以多种方式使用你的预知优势。本质上，优势转化为一个 +4 洞察加值，你可以随时应用于攻击检定，伤害检定，豁免检定或技能检定。要将此加值应用一轮，按径向菜单上的攻击，豁免，技能或伤害选项。
src:
Clairsentience
Level: Seer 6
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 hour/level
Power Points: 11
Metapsionics: Extend

Precognition allows your mind to glimpse fragments of potential future events - what you see will probably happen if no one takes action to change it. However, your vision is incomplete, and it makes no real sense until the actual events you glimpsed begin to unfold. That's when everything begins to come together, and you can act, if you act swiftly, on the information you previously received when you manifested this power.

In practice, manifesting this power grants you a 'precognitive edge.' Normally, you can have only a single precognitive edge at one time. You must use your edge within a period of no more than 1 hour per level, at which time your preknowledge fades and you lose your edge.

You can use your precognitive edge in a variety of ways. Essentially, the edge translates into a +4 insight bonus that you can apply at any time to either an attack roll, a damage roll, a saving throw, or a skill check. To apply this bonus for one round, press either the Attack, Save, Skill, or Damage option on the radial menu.

血爪

描述符：无 
职业：图腾师 
脉轮：手部（图腾）
豁免检定：无

魂能围绕你的双手形成一对鹰爪。它们幽灵般无形，几乎像环绕你双手的紫色薄雾，但三趾形状的轮廓如同锋利的爪子一样清晰。

塑造血爪的图腾师希望效仿这些生物凶猛的坚韧，敏锐的视力和纯粹的野蛮。你获得坚忍专长。

魂能点：每投入一点魂能点使你的侦察技能增加2点。

脉轮绑定（手部） 

你的双手本身变成深紫色，而非被紫色薄雾环绕，就像魂能的蓝色混合了浓郁的血红色。不知何故，你的双手渴望抓握和撕裂，快速越过对手的防御并撕扯他们的眼睛。

你获得武器娴熟专长的好处。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

你手部的皮肤变成红橙色且覆有鳞片，如同血鹰的爪子，你的手指变得粗壮有力，指甲伸长成带有尖点和边缘的凶猛利爪。

你可以进行两次爪击，每次造成1d4点伤害加你的力量调整值。在你用爪击命中后的下一轮，伤口会额外流血，每当你进行攻击时投入血爪中的每点魂能点造成1点伤害。非活体生物免疫此流血效果。投入血爪中的每点魂能点使爪击的攻击检定获得+1增强加值。
src:
Bloodtalons

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Hands (totem)
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms a pair of eagle talons around your hands. They are ghostly and insubstantial, almost like a violet mist surrounding your hands, but the three-toed shape is as clear as the sharp claws in their outline.

Totemists who shape bloodtalons hope to emulate the ferocious tenacity, keen eyesight, and sheer savagery of these creatures. You gain the Diehard feat.

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested increases your Spot skill by 2 points. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

Rather than being surrounded by violet mist, your hands themselves turn a deep shade of violet, like the blue of incarnum mixed with rich blood red. Somehow, your hands feel eager to grasp and tear, to speed past your opponents' defenses and tear at their eyes.

You gain the benefit of the Weapon Finesse feat.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

The skin of your hands becomes red-orange and scaly like the talons of a blood hawk, your fingers grow knobby and strong, and your nails lengthen into fierce talons with sharp points and edges.

You can make two claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage plus your Strength modifier. On the round after you hit with a claw attack, the wounds bleed for an additional 1 point of damage per point of essentia you had invested in your bloodtalons when you made the attack. Nonliving creatures are immune to this blood loss effect. Every point of essentia invested in the bloodtalons grants a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls made with the claw attacks.

dst:
这根魔杖被特别附魔以成为巫妖的克星。任何被它瞄准的亡灵生物都会受到毁灭性的伤害，并在几分钟内遭受25-50%的法术失败几率（如果用于非亡灵生物则无效）。

唯一已知的这些强力附魔魔杖的实例被提供给了一队正在袭击深渊的冒险者：具体来说是塔纳托斯，由恶魔领主奥喀斯，亡灵王子统治的层面。毫无疑问，这些魔杖在对抗该领域众多的巫妖和其他亡灵恐怖时证明是有用的，但它们一定是不够的，因为该队伍再也没有消息，魔杖也丢失了。

剩余的魔法能量只够再使用这根魔杖一次。也许不愿使用这最后的手段导致了其原主人的死亡。
src:
This wand has been specially enchanted to be a bane of liches. Any undead creature targeted by it will take devastating damage and suffer a 25-50% chance of spell failure for a few minutes (it has no effect if employed on anyone other than undead).

The only known instances of these powerfully enchanted wands were supplied to a party of adventurers that was raiding the Abyss: specifically Thanatos, the layer ruled by the demon lord Orcus, prince of undead. No doubt the wands proved useful in fighting the numerous liches and other undead horrors that populate that realm, but they must have been insufficient for the party was never heard from again, and the wands were lost.

Enough magical charge remains for only one more use of this wand. Perhaps a reluctance to use this last resort led to the death of its original owner.

dst: "嗯，进入这些废墟有两个障碍。第一个正是你问题的答案：在沙纳塔被各方敌人侵占的日子里，一些矮人牧师试图保护这个前哨站，他们向矮人诸神祈祷，禁止任何非矮人进入。这祈祷得到了回应，一道只允许拥有矮人血脉者通过的魔法屏障至今仍在那里。第二个障碍是它仍由强大的魔像守护着，这些魔像在数百年缺乏维护后已变得相当狂暴，会攻击任何试图进入的人，哪怕是矮人也不例外。因此，即使对你来说，去那里也会相当危险。此前的矮人探险队曾试图从这地方取回宝物，但无一成功。"
src: "Well, there are two obstacles to entering these ruins. The first is the answer to your question: in the days when Shanatar was being overrun by its various enemies, some dwarven clerics attempted to protect this particular outpost by calling on the dwarven gods to bar entry to anyone who was not a dwarf. This prayer was answered, and a magical barrier to anyone without dwaren blood remains there to this day. The second obstacles is that it remains protected by powerful golems, who over centuries without maintenance, have gone quite berserk and will attack anyone, even a dwarf, who attempts entrance. Thus, even for you, going here will be quite dangerous. Previous dwarven expeditions have tried to recover treasures from this place, but none succeeded."

src: I have been warned that a house in the northeast of the Slums district is believed to be haunted by dangerous spirits, and that those who enter this old and decrepit structure sometimes fail to come out again. This would seem a danger to beware, or perhaps, for seekers of adventure such as myself, an opportunity.\n\nUpon entering the second story of the house, the staircase by which I came mysteriously vanished! The second story also seems quite different from the first, less old and decrepit, yet covered in unnatural darkness. Am I still in the same house? Whatever is happening, I cannot go back the way I came, so I must press forward and hope for the best.

Of course creating that desert is only a fraction of the damage they could cause if their bodies were freed and restored to full power, and they were not constrained by the elven wards to only that region."

dst:
这是大学者卡帕达尔的《卡林杉史》第二卷，旨在成为该主题的权威著作。

 本卷接续了风巨灵统治被推翻后卡林杉的故事。在这一事件之后，谷地历-6060年，战士科拉姆建立了一个名为科拉姆杉的人类王国。科拉姆杉成为一个庞大而强大的帝国，因控制蒸汽湖周边地区而与贾姆达斯国（后称琼达斯）频繁交战。关于该地区的争端最终在谷地历-5005年通过一项休战协议解决。
 在此期间某个时候，帝国更名为卡林杉，并沿用至今。本卷记录了帝国直到谷地历-2381年的历史，当时塔维赫尔王朝的最后一位君主被一个眼魔杀死。这是未来事情的不祥预兆。

dst:
血战护手

描述符：邪恶，影响心智
职业：化身
脉轮：手部或手臂
豁免检定：见正文

魂能塑成黑色护手，包裹你的双手，并以沉重的铁环沿前臂向上延伸至肘部，末端是狰狞的尖刺。它们看起来比你的手大，实际上覆盖了你可能已戴着的任何手套或护手，但它们与你的手指和手完美同步移动。当非常安静时，你有时能听到从护手那夜黑色的金属中传来的战斗声。

当你佩戴血战护手时，你在近战攻击检定上获得+1士气加值。

魂能：你每在血战护手中投入1点魂能，你在近战伤害检定上获得+1士气加值。

脉轮绑定（手臂）

你的血战护手绑定到你的手腕和前臂。它们不再是以分离的金属环沿手臂向上延伸，而是形成一层完全无反射的金属实鞘，其中恶魔般的面容显现又消退，总是因愤怒和痛苦而扭曲。

你可以用一个标准动作释放灵魂融合的狂暴能量，形成一阵猛烈的速度爆发，在此过程中灵魂融合消散。速度爆发对20英尺半径内除你以外的所有生物造成每投入1点魂能3d6点伤害。成功的强韧豁免使伤害减半。

脉轮绑定（手部）

你的血战护手绑定到你的双手，缩小以更好地贴合。护手的金属指尖长而尖锐。它们有时似乎滴血，尽管从它们上滴落的液体几乎一触地就消失。

src:
Bloodwar Gauntlets

Descriptors: Evil, Mind-affecting 
Classes: Incarnate 
Chakra: Hands or Arms
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms into black gauntlets that encase your hands and extend in heavy iron bands up your forearms to your elbows, where they end in vicious-looking spikes. They seem large for your hands and actually cover any gloves or gauntlets you might already be wearing, but they move in perfect unison with your fingers and hands. When it is very quiet, you can sometimes hear the sounds of battle coming from the night-black metal of the gauntlets.

While you wear your bloodwar gauntlets, you gain a +1 morale bonus on melee attack rolls.

Essentia:  For every point of essentia you invest in your bloodwar gauntlets, you gain a +1 morale bonus on melee damage rolls. 

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

Your bloodwar gauntlets bind themselves to your wrists and forearms. Instead of separate rings of metal extending up your arms, they now form a solid sheath of completely unreflective metal in which fiendish visages manifest and subside, always contorted with rage and pain.

You can use a standard action to release the soulmeld's violent energy in a tumultuous blast, unshaping the soulmeld in the process. The blast deals 3d6 points of damage for every point of essentia invested to all creatures within a 20-foot radius burst, excluding you. A successful Fortitude save halves this damage. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

Your bloodwar gauntlets bind themselves to your hands, shrinking to better fit them. The metal fingertips of the gauntlets are long and sharply pointed. They sometimes seem to drip blood, though the liquid that falls from them vanishes almost as soon as it touches the ground.

Any weapon you equip gains the keen property.

dst:
学术传说中关于魔蝠人有两种不同的起源故事。其中一种说法是，魔蝠人是魔蝠与某种不确定的类人种族在很久以前结合所生的异界生物后裔。另一种则是关于一个狂妄自大的法师试图将自己的本质烙印在另一个种族上的更黑暗的传说。

事实是，魔蝠人偶尔会由魔蝠父母所生。魔蝠人比其魔蝠祖先更弱小，因此被魔蝠社群当作不受欢迎的矮小劣种而驱逐。他们被遗弃在恶劣的位面中自生自灭。对类人孩子感到厌恶的魔蝠父母会将婴儿留在充满敌意的位面上。善良的父母则会将孩子放在一个适宜居住的位面上，以便容易被其他生物发现。有时其他生物会收养这个被遗弃的婴儿，并将其抚养至成年。

作为由与自己截然不同的父母抚养长大的弃儿，魔蝠人经常感到格格不入。他们通常是孤独者，渴望一种难以捉摸的归属感。尽管如此，他们富有魅力且讨人喜欢，通常受到周围人的喜爱。

魔蝠人通常看起来像是其魔蝠父母不那么丑陋的版本，但翅膀发育不全。典型的魔蝠人身高不到3英尺，体重约30磅，女性比男性略高略重。土魔蝠人看起来类似于一个矮小，多石，无毛的矮人。

土魔蝠人属性调整：+2 力量，-2 敏捷，-2 智力，+2 魅力。土魔蝠人身体强壮但行动迟缓。

天赋职业（德鲁伊）：在判断兼职经验值惩罚时，土魔蝠人的德鲁伊职业不计入兼职。

种族特性：
- 土魔蝠人的基础陆地速度为30英尺。
- 类人生物：魔蝠人原生于元素位面。他们具有类人生物类型，当不在其各自的祖先位面时获得异界生物子类型。与其魔蝠祖先不同，魔蝠人没有元素子类型。
- 小型：作为小型生物，魔蝠人在防御等级上获得+1加值，在攻击检定上获得+1加值，在躲藏检定上获得+4加值。
- 喷吐武器：每个魔蝠人都有一种喷吐武器，其效果因魔蝠人的血统而异。
- 元素施法：魔蝠人施展与其种类（风，土，火或水）相匹配的元素描述符法咒时，施法者等级+1。
- 简易武器：魔蝠人擅长所有简易武器。

等级调整：+1
src:
Scholarly lore contains two different origin stories for the mephlings. In one, mephlings are planetouched offshoots of long-ago unions between mephits and an indeterminate race of humanoids. The other is a darker tale of a megalomaniacal mage seeking to imprint his essence on another race.

What is true is that a mephling will occasionally be born to mephit parents. Weaker than their mephit ancestors, mephlings are put out of mephit communities as undesirable runts. They're left to the mercies of the inhospitable planes. Mephit parents revolted by their humanoid child will leave the babe on a hostile plane. Kindly parents will place the child on a habitable plane where it will easily be found by other creatures. Sometimes other creatures adopt the abandoned baby and it grows to reach adulthood.

As foundlings raised by parents very different from themselves, mephlings frequently feel out of place. They usually are loners who desire an elusive sense of belonging. Nevertheless, they're attractive and personable, generally liked by people around them.

Mephlings in general look like less homely versions of their mephit parents with stunted wings. A typical mephling stands less than 3 feet tall and weighs around 30 pounds, with females slightly taller and heavier than males.  An earth mephling appears akin to a short, stony, hairless dwarf.

Earth Mephling Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, -2 Dex, -2 Int, +2 Cha.  Earth mephlings are physically strong but slow to act.

Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass earth mephling's druid class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- An earth mephling's base land speed is 30 feet.
- Humanoid: Mephlings are native to the Elemental Planes. They have the humanoid type and gain the extraplanar subtype when not on their respective ancestral plane. Unlike their mephit ancestors, mephlings do not have an elemental subtype.
- Small: As Small creatures, mephlings have a +1 bonus to Armor Class, a +1 bonus on attack rolls, and a +4 bonus on Hide checks.
- Breath Weapon: Each mephling has a breath weapon, the effect of which varies by the mephling's heritage. 
- Elemental Casting: Mephlings cast spells with an elemental descriptor that matches their kind (air, earth, fire, or water) at +1 caster level.
- Simple Weapons: Mephlings are proficient with all simple weapons.

Level Adjustment: +1

src: Spells per Day/Spells Known: When a thrall of Orcus attains 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th level, the character gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in whatever spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class. She does not gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (improved chance of controlling or rebuking undead, metamagic or item creation feats, hit points beyond those received from the prestige class, and so on), except for an increased effective level of spellcasting. This essentially means that she adds the new level to the level of whatever other spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day, spells known, and caster level accordingly. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before she became a thrall of Orcus, she must decide to which class she adds the levels to for purposes of determining spells per day.

     注意：善魂巫妖是完全不死生物，因此免疫偷袭，重击，等级吸取，毒素和疾病。不死生物没有体质值。然而，这在无冬之夜中不可能。玩家将获得+12体质以模拟善魂巫妖的生命骰增加到d12。
src:
Baelnorns are elves who have sought undeath to serve their families, communities, or other purposes (usually to see a wrong righted or to achieve a certain magical discovery or deed).  They are lich-like creatures that appear as impressive-looking elves with shriveled skin and glowing white eyes.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Living Elf.
Skills: Concentration 5, Spellcraft 14.
Spellcasting: Able to cast 6th level arcane or divine spells.
Feat: Craft Wonderous Item.
Alignment: Any Good

CLASS FEATURES:
Baelnorn Properties: +8 bonus to Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Persuade, and Spot.
         Baelnorn Touch: Touch attack causes 1d8 + 5 damage and permanent paralyzation.
         Baelnorn Defense:  Damage Reduction 15/+2, Natural Armor + 5, immunity to cold and electricity, Turning Resistance +4.
         Turn Undead:  Can turn undead 3 times per day as a cleric of the same level.
         Turning Immunity:  Cannot be turned by Good or Neutral characters.
         Projection:  Three times per day the Baelnorn may create a projection of itself.
         Wisdom +2
         Intelligence +2.
         Charisma +2
         Undeath

     Note:  The Baelnorn is fully undead, and therefore is immune to sneak attacks, critical hits, level drain, poison, and disease.  An undead creature has no Constitution score.  However, this is not possible in Neverwinter Nights.  The player will gain +12 to constitution in order to simulate the increase of the Baelnorn's HD to d12.

dst: 为了寻找离开幽暗地域的出路，我穿越了各种传送门，最初进入了巴托的一座堡垒，后来前往了天界位面上的另一座堡垒。在那里我遇到了一位名叫达纳隆的天界复仇者，他向我提出了一个提议。在我之前经过的巴托堡垒中可以找到一位名叫瓦塔科尔的深狱炼魔。这个恶魔对天界生物来说是个麻烦的敌人，但达纳隆相信我有足够的力量杀死他。如果我能做到这一点，他承诺奖励我一件强大的魔法物品。他还给了我到达瓦塔科尔所需的钥匙，因为他住在一扇锁着并有守卫的门后面。\n\n瓦塔科尔已被杀死。这可以向达纳隆报告以领取承诺的奖励。
src: Traversing various portals in an attempt to find a way out of the Underdark, I initially entered a fortress in Baator, and later made my way to another fortress on the Celestial Planes. There I met a Celestial Avenger named Danaron, who made me an offer. In the fortress in Baator through which I passed earlier can be found a Pit Fiend known as Vartakor. This fiend is a troublesome foe to the Celestials, but Danaron believes that I would be powerful enough to slay him. If I can accomplish this, he has promised to reward me with a powerful magical item. He has furthermore given me the key I will need to reach Vartakor, as he resides behind a locked and warded door.\n\nVartakor has been slain. This can be reported to Danaron to claim the promised reward.

dst:
（进阶职业）
所有活物的祸害，噬魂者是一种以生命力的本质为食的怪物般的存在。扭曲而邪恶 - 即使以眼魔，拉米亚和夺心魔等生物的标准来看也是如此 - 噬魂者被所有活着的生物所恐惧。噬魂者常被误认为吸血鬼或其他不死生物，但他们绝对是活物，这使得他们的行为更加令人发指。噬魂者总是独自行动，尽管他们可能拥有被魅惑或奴役的仆从。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 擅长：噬魂者不获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

种族：异怪，龙类，类人怪物，异界生物，精类，巨人，或元素。
阵营：任意邪恶
基础攻击加值：+5。
技能：知识 2 级。
专长：警觉，武器专攻（生物或徒手击打）

职业特性：

等级
1： 能量吸取 1
2： 灵魂之力
3： 灵魂冲击
4： 灵魂增强
5： 灵魂坚忍
6： 灵魂光辉
7： 能量吸取 2
8： 灵魂敏捷
9： 灵魂奴仆
10：灵魂威能


能量吸取（Su）：噬魂者获得吸取能量的能力，对受害者施加负向等级。从 1 级开始，噬魂者的触碰对目标施加一个负向等级。在 7 级时，噬魂者通过触碰施加两个负向等级。

灵魂之力（Su）：当 2 级噬魂者使用其能量吸取能力时，它在力量上获得 +4 加值，持续 24 小时。

灵魂冲击（Su）: 3 级噬魂者可以投射一道 100 英尺的力场射线，对一个目标造成每噬魂者等级 1d6 点伤害。目标可以进行反射豁免检定以避免伤害（DC 10 + 职业等级 + 魅力加值）.此超自然能力每天可使用一次，且只能在噬魂者吸取过等级的那一天使用。

灵魂增强（Su）：当 4 级噬魂者使用其能量吸取能力时，它在所有豁免检定和技能检定上获得 +2 增强加值，持续 24 小时。

灵魂坚忍（Su）：当 5 级噬魂者使用其能量吸取能力时，它在体质上获得 +4 加值，持续 24 小时。

灵魂光辉（Su）：如果 6 级噬魂者完全吸取了一个生物的能量，它可以采用该生物的灵魂光辉，获得受害者的形态，外貌和能力，持续 24 小时。

灵魂敏捷（Su）：当 8 级噬魂者使用其能量吸取能力时，它在敏捷上获得 +4 加值，持续 24 小时。

灵魂奴仆（Su）：如果 9 级噬魂者完全吸取了一个生物的能量，受害者会变成一个受噬魂者指挥的尸妖。

灵魂威能（Su）：在 10 级噬魂者吸取能量后，所有类法咒和超自然能力的豁免检定 DC 获得 +2 亵渎加值，持续 24 小时。此外，它可以在那 24 小时期间使用其灵魂冲击能力最多两次而非一次。
（此外，噬魂者拥有的任何及所有类法咒或超自然能力在那 24 小时期间的使用频率可以是正常的两倍。）
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Bane of all living creatures, the soul eater is a monstrous being that feeds on the very essence of life force. Twisted and evil - even by the standards of creatures such as beholders, lamias, and mind flayers - the soul eater is feared by all creatures that live. Soul eaters are often confused with vampires or other undead, but they are decidedly alive, making their actions all the more heinous. Soul eaters always work alone, although they may have enthralled or enslaved servants.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Soul Eater does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Aberration, Dragon, Monstrous Humanoid, Outsider, Fey, Giant, or Elemental.
Alignment: Any Evil
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Skills: Lore 2 ranks.
Feats: Alertness, Weapon Focus(creature or unarmed strike)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Energy Drain 1
2:  Soul Strength
3:  Soul Blast
4:  Soul Enhancement
5:  Soul Endurance
6:  Soul Radiance
7:  Energy Drain 2
8:  Soul Agility
9:  Soul Slave
10: Soul Power


Energy Drain (Su): A soul eater gains the ability to drain energy, bestowing negative levels upon it's victims. Beginning at 1st level, the touch of a soul eater bestows one negative level on it's target. At 7th level, the soul eater bestows two negative levels with a touch.

Soul Strength (Su): When a 2nd-level soul eater uses it's energy drain ability, it gains a +4 bonus to Strength for 24 hours.

Soul Blast (Su): A 3rd-level may project a 100-foot ray of force that deals 1d6 points of damage per soul eater level against one target. The target is allowed a Reflex saving throw to avoid the damage (DC 10 + class level + Cha bonus). This supernatural ability can be used once per day, and only on a day when the soul eater has drained levels.

Soul Enhancement (Su): When a 4th-level soul eater uses it's energy drain ability, it gains a +2 enhancement bonus on all saving throws and skill checks for 24 hours.

Soul Endurance (Su): When a 5th-level soul eater uses it's energy drain ability, it gains a +4 bonus to Constitution for 24 hours.

Soul Radiance (Su): If a 6th-level soul eater completely drains a creature of energy, it may adopt the creature's soul radiance, taking the victim's form, appearance, and abilities for 24 hours.

Soul Agility (Su): When a 8th-level soul eater uses it's energy drain ability, it gains a +4 bonus to Dexterity for 24 hours.

Soul Slave (Su): If a 9th-level soul eater completely drains a creature of energy, the victim becomes a wight under the command of the soul eater.

Soul Power (Su): After a 10th-level soul eater has drained energy, all spell-like and supernatural abilities gains a +2 profane bonus to their saving throw DC for 24 hours. Further, it may use it's Soul Blast ability up to two times instead of one during that 24-hour period.
(Further, any and all spell-like or supernatural abilities the soul eater possesses may be used twice as often as normal during that 24-hour period.)

dst: 在前往烛堡的途中，我遇到了一位树精，她正与一群信奉风暴与毁灭之神塔洛斯的人发生冲突。双方最终都死了，但我在其中一名塔洛斯信徒的尸体上找到了一张地图，上面标明了某处废墟的位置，他们希望在那里找到科扎的神像——科扎是一位耐瑟瑞斯神祇，据信是塔洛斯的化身或别名——根据地图上的笔记，这些塔洛斯信徒希望从这件物品中获得强大的力量。塔洛斯的各种敌人试图阻止此事，所以也许我应该亲自前往这些废墟取回神像，尤其是因为前往烛堡似乎可能不像我希望的那样简单。如果我获得神像，我可以把它带给塔洛斯的一位风暴先驱，名叫马尔扎克，目前可以在附近城镇纳什凯尔的旅店里找到他，希望他会奖励我。\n\n我杀穿了一些试图阻挡我的天界生物，成功从废墟中取回了神像。然后我去了纳什凯尔，找到了等待神像的风暴先驱，把它交给了他，换取了一笔丰厚的报酬。
src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. Both parties ended up dead, but I found a map on the body of one of the Talosians, indicating the location of some ruins where they hope to find an idol of Kozah, a Netherese deity believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos, and an object from which these Talosians hope to gain great power, based on notes written on the map. Various enemies of Talos seek to prevent this, so perhaps I should head to these ruins myself and recover the idol, especially as it seems going to Candlekeep will may not be as simple as I hoped. If I acquire the idol I can bring it to a Stormherald of Talos known as Marzak, currently to be found in the inn of the nearby town of Nashkel, who will hopefully reward me.\n\nI fought through some Celestials who sought to bar my way, and successfully recovered the idol from the ruins. I then went to Nashkel, found the Stormherald waiting for it, and gave it to him in exchange for a substantial reward.

src:
Iron Heart (Strike)
Level: Warblade 5
Prerequisite: Two Iron Heart maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial

Through focus, raw power, and expert aim, you make a mighty attack against your foe, leaving him temporarily knocked senseless by your attack.

You make a single melee attack as part of this strike. If this attack hits, the target takes melee damage normally and must make a Fortitude save (DC 15 + your Str modifier) or be dazed for 1 round.

dst:
我遇到了法师伊纳尔·梅卡赞，他告诉我他学到了一种咒语，可以将我们传送到伟大巫师扎塔罗斯曾经占据的一处失落已久的避难所。这样的地方肯定充满了魔法宝藏，但伊纳尔发现获取它们会有一些困难。首先，打破入口的结界需要同时施放一个破除法咒和一个解除魔法。因此，伊纳尔认为有必要招募第二个施法者，也就是我。其次，这个地方据说由守卫魔像保护。伊纳尔是一位学者，几乎没有战斗魔法经验，因此也希望我为他清除这些魔像，以及我可能遇到的任何其他危险。作为奖励，我将优先挑选我在里面发现的任何宝藏，伊纳尔只想要扎塔罗斯关于魔法研究的笔记和文件，我应该把它们带给他。

伊纳尔用魔法将我们传送到了扎塔罗斯的这个隐秘避难所。我现在已经探索了这个地方，我相信已经清除了危险，并找到了一些扎塔罗斯的笔记和文件。然而，当我把它们带给伊纳尔时，他攻击了我！原来他想要这里所有的宝藏，而我只是一个被带来做获取宝藏苦工的傻瓜。然而，我笑到了最后，击败并杀死了他。

我回到了卡林港，从探索扎塔罗斯的实验室中收获颇丰。
src:
I have met the mage Ynal Mekazhan, who tells me that he has learned of an incantation that can teleport us to a long-lost refuge once occupied by the great wizard Zataroth. Such a place is sure to be full of magical treasures, but Ynal has discovered that there will be some difficulties to obtaining them. Firstly, breaking the wards on the entrance requires the simultaneous casting of both a breach spell and one dispelling magic. Therefore Ynal has found it necessary to recruit a second spellcaster, myself. Secondly, the place is supposed to be protected by guardian golems. Ynal is a scholar with little experience of battle magic and thus also wants me to clear these out out for him, along with any other hazards I might encounter. As a reward, I will get first pick of any treasures I find within, Ynal wants only Zataroth's notes and papers on magical research, which I should bring to him.

Ynal has magically transported us to this hidden refuge of Zataroth. I have now explored the place and I believe cleared it of dangers, as well as locating some of Zataroth's notes and papers. However, when I brought them to Ynal, he attacked me! It turns out he wanted all the treasures here for himself, and I was just a dupe brought on to do the hard work of obtaining them. I have the last laugh, however, having defeated and slain him.

I have returned to Calimport, having gained much from my exploration of Zataroth's laboratory.

dst: 在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队派人搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续著作时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，此人住在贵族区西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了什么，可以去商人区东北部她的家中向她报告。\n\n我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他只能告诉我，他曾告诉阿拉达尔，有个水手在酒馆里讲述一个难以置信的故事，说他找到了扭曲符文的一个巢穴。阿拉达尔出发去找这个水手谈话，拉玛什此后就再没见过他。这个水手名叫科拉努·乌马尔，他常去的酒馆是码头区的海妖之腹。我想我下一步就是去找他。
src: At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.\n\nI spoke to Lamash Kasat, who could tell me only that he had informed Aladar of a sailor in a tavern who was telling an improbable tale about having located a lair of the Twisted Rune. Aladar set off to speak to this sailor and Lamash has not seen him since. The sailor is named Kolanu Umal, and the tavern he frequents is the Kraken's Belly, in the Docks District. I suppose my next step is to find him.

dst: “你想用大武器干掉大怪物，”圣武士拉尔恩·泰拉克常这么说。泰拉克圣武士生涯的大部分时间都在山区巡逻，抵御常居于此的邪恶巨人与巨龙的入侵，这把武器便是在他职业生涯后期为协助这些事业而打造并附魔的，取代了此前威力稍逊的旧版。由于并非所有巨人和巨龙都是邪恶的，泰拉克坚持在附魔中加入一项限制，使该武器只能由正义之士使用，以免有朝一日它被用来对付这些种族中的善良成员。
src: "You want a big weapon to take down big monsters," the paladin Raln Terak was fond of saying. Terak spent most of his career as a paladin patrolling mountainous regions and fighting off incursions from the evil giants and dragons who so often reside in such places, and this weapon was fashioned and enchanted to assist him in these endeavours late in his career, replacing an earlier version that was a bit less powerful. Since not all giants and dragons are evil, Terak insisted that the enchantments include one making the weapon usable only by the righteous, for fear that otherwise it might someday be used against the good members of these races.

dst: "曾经会，但最终我意识到这种想法很愚蠢。每个人的出生都是无数可能走向不同结果的机缘的产物。而且每一天，如果不是每一分钟，都有人在行邪恶之事。他们的所作所为，通常以非常间接的方式，促成了那无数机缘。我们任何人，无论什么种族，都不会出生在一个完美的世界里，因为正是这个世界的每一个细节，连同它所有的不完美，造就了每一次出生的境遇。当然，我们必须记住，人们所做的善事也促成了世界如今的模样，而且正如邪恶试图腐蚀美好的事物，善也可以从邪恶的事件中产生。我希望我们的生命将成为后一条原则的例证。"
src: "At one time it did, but eventually I came to realize that this was foolish. Everyone's birth is the product of countless chances that might have gone differently. And every day, if not every minute, some people are doing evil things. What they do contributes, usually in very indirect ways, to all those countless chances. None of us, of whatever race, would have been born in a perfect world, for it was every detail of this world, with all its imperfections, that led to the circumstances of every birth. And of course we must remember that the good things people do also contribute to making the world what it is, and that just as evil seeks to corrupt good things, good can be made to come out of evil events. I hope our lives will be examples of this latter principle."

src:
Unpossessed quori hosts, known as empty vessels, train hard for the day they receive their quori spirits. An empty vessel is taller than the average human, but lightly built, with large, almond-shaped eyes that vary in color. Common colors are black, viridian, or violet, although the eyes change color with the mood of the individual. All empty vessels have pale skin and straight hair that ranges in color from jet black to deep blue or green. By human standards, most empty vessels are strikingly handsome or beautiful, and they possess an unnatural charm and a commanding aura that helps them influence others. Most wear their hair long, and they favor ornate clothing and decorations. Humans born and raised on Sarlona to become vessels receive special training and education, and they are remarkable individuals in their own right.

Empty Vessel Ability Adjustments: None.
Favored Class (Psion): A multiclass empty vessel's psion class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Base movement of 30.
- Naturally Psionic (Ex): Empty vessels gain 1 extra power point per character level, regardless of whether they choose a psionic class.
- Skills: An empty vessel receives 4 extra skill points at 1st level and 1 extra skill point at each additional level.
- +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks. Empty vessels are masters of social interaction, influencing others through their commanding presence and subtle psychic powers.
- Bonus Feat: Empty vessels gain 1 extra feat at 1st level.
- Human: Kalashtar are considered Human for the purpose of spells.
- Level Adjustment: +1

src:
Rain of Embers
Evocation [Fire, Good]
Level: Sanctified 7
Components: V, S, Sacrifice
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area: Cylinder (40-ft. radius, 120 ft. high)
Duration: 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text
Spell Resistance: Yes

This spell causes orange, star-like embers to rain steadily from above. Each round, the falling embers deal 10d6 points of damage to evil creatures within the spell's area. Half of the damage is fire damage, but the other half results directly from divine power and is therefore not subject to being reduced by resistance to fire-based attacks, such as that granted by protection from energy (fire),
fire shield (chill shield), and similar magic. Creatures may leave the area to avoid taking additional damage, but a new saving throw is required each round a creature is caught in the Fiery downpour.

A shield provides a cover bonus on the Reflex save, depending on its size small +2, large +4, tower +7. A shield spell oriented upward provides a +4 cover bonus on the Reflex save. A creature using its shield (or shield spell) to block the rain of embers cannot use it for defense in combat.

Sacrifice: 1d2 points of Strength drain.

Casters of evil alignment cannot cast Sanctified spells.

src: "I propose to sell you something that you might find to be of value. For the nominal fee of 1000 gold, I will give you a key. If you continue on the path you are taking, you will pass through this plane, and eventually reach another fortress, held by our enemies in the Celestial Realm. This key will open a door you can find within, and behind that door you will find the mighty Deva Valendur, who has often opposed us and thwarted our plans. With the key I propose to sell you, you will have the opportunity to slay him. Such an accomplishment would bring you glory, and, more practically, one must assume that such a powerful being will surely have some valuables worth looting. There is some danger in taking on such a powerful opponent, to be sure, but surely nothing an experienced <CUSTOM104> like you has not faced before. It would be a great opportunity. What say you?"

dst:
灰精灵是所有精灵中最高贵，最庄严的。他们的外表比同族的其他精灵更高大，更宏伟，灰精灵以冷漠和傲慢著称（即使以精灵的标准来看也是如此）.他们当然比高等精灵更隐遁，居住在孤立的山地堡垒中，只允许少数外来者进入。他们要么有银发和琥珀色眼睛，要么有淡金色头发和紫色眼睛。他们喜欢白色，银色，黄色或金色的衣服，搭配深蓝色或紫色的斗篷。

    +2 敏捷，+2 智力，-2 力量，-2 体质。

     中型：作为中型生物，灰精灵没有因体型而获得的特殊加值或惩罚。

    灰精灵基础陆地速度为 30 英尺。

    免疫魔法睡眠效果，并且对附魔系法咒或效果有 +2 种族豁免加值。

    微光视觉：灰精灵在星光，月光，火炬光和类似昏暗照明条件下可以看到人类两倍远。她在这些条件下仍能分辨颜色和细节。

    武器熟练：灰精灵获得长剑，细剑，长弓（包括复合长弓）和短弓（包括复合短弓）的军用武器熟练专长作为奖励专长。

    聆听，搜索和侦察检定获得 +2 种族加值。灰精灵只要经过距离秘密或隐藏门 5 英尺内，就有权进行搜索检定来注意到它，就像她主动寻找一样。

    自动语言：通用语和精灵语。奖励语言：龙语，豺狼人语，侏儒语，地精语，兽人语和木族语。

    偏好职业：法师。在决定兼职灰精灵是否受到经验值惩罚时，其法师职业不计入。

    等级调整：+0
src:
Gray elves are the most noble and regal of all elves. Taller and grander in physical appearance than others of their race, gray elves have a reputation for being aloof and arrogant (even by elven standards). They certainly are more reclusive than high elves, living in isolated mountain citadels and allowing entry only to a select few outsiders. They have either silver hair and amber eyes or pale golden hair and violet eyes. They prefer clothing of white, silver, yellow, or gold, with cloaks of deep blue or purple.

    +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, -2 Strength, -2 Constitution.

     Medium: As Medium creatures, gray elves have no special bonuses or penalties due to their size.

    Gray elf base land speed is 30 feet.

    Immunity to magic sleep effects, and a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells or effects.

    Low-Light Vision: A gray elf can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. She retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.

    Weapon Proficiency: Gray elves receive the Martial Weapon Proficiency feats for the longsword, rapier, longbow (including composite longbow), and shortbow (including composite shortbow) as bonus feats.

    +2 racial bonus on Listen, Search, and Spot checks. A gray elf who merely passes within 5 feet of a secret or concealed door is entitled to a Search check to notice it as if she were actively looking for it.

    Automatic Languages: Common and Elven. Bonus Languages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.

    Favored Class: Wizard. A multiclass gray elf's wizard class does not count when determining whether she takes an experience point penalty for multiclassing.

    Level Adjustment: +0

Caster Level(s): Wizard 8, Sorcerer 8
Innate Level: 8
School: Transmutation
Component(s): Verbal, Somatic
Range: Self
Area of Effect / Target: Caster
Duration: 1 min/level
Save: harmless
Spell Resistance: harmless

 This spell transforms your body into living iron, which grants you several powerful resistances and abilities.

You gain damage reduction 15/+20. You are immune to blindness, critical hits, ability score damage, deafness, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning, and all spells or attacks that affect your physiology or respiration, because you have no physiology or respiration while this spell is in effect. You take only half damage from acid and fire of all kinds.

You gain a +6 enhancement bonus to your Strength score, but you take a -6 penalty to Dexterity as well (to a minimum Dexterity score of 1), and your speed is reduced to half normal. You have an arcane spell failure chance of 50% as if you were wearing full plate armor.

（进阶职业）
被许多人畏惧，被少数人理解，臭名昭著的毁灭者是将自己奉献给杀戮之神厄瑞斯努的人。毁灭者过着暴力和野蛮的生活，无论走到哪里都试图传播这位神祇的邪恶影响，从不在一个地方久留，以免善良和法律的力量追捕他。

- 生命骰：d10
- 武器防具熟练：毁灭者熟练所有简易和军用武器，所有盔甲和盾牌。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求

阵营：混乱邪恶，混乱中立，中立邪恶
基础攻击加值：+5
专长：肮脏战斗，猛力攻击，顺势斩。
威吓：3级。
学识：7级。

职业技能：威吓，学识，潜行，骑术

职业特性：

痛苦之触：毁灭者可以进行一次徒手接触攻击，造成1d8点生命值伤害，外加每毁灭者等级1点。武器也可以传递此伤害，为1d4 + 每职业等级1点。

恐惧灵光：毁灭者附近的敌人所有豁免检定受到-2惩罚，持续3轮 + 每毁灭者等级额外1轮。

最残酷切割：成功攻击时，除了攻击的正常伤害外，还对目标造成1d4点临时体质伤害。

恐怖面容：每天一次，成功进行接触攻击时，你可以触发一个类似法咒魅影杀手的类法咒能力，DC等于14 + 毁灭者等级。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Feared by many, understood by few, the infamous Ravager is an individual who has dedicated himself to the service of Erythnul, Deity of Slaughter. Living a life of violence and savagery the Ravager seeks to spread this deities malignant influence wherever he goes, never resting long in one place lest the forces of good and law pursue him.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: The ravager is proficient in all simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS

Alignment: CE, CN, NE
BAB: +5
Feats: Dirty Fighting, Power Attack, Cleave.
Intimidate: 3 Ranks.
Lore: 7 Ranks.

CLASS SKILLS: Intimidate, Lore, Move Silently, Ride

CLASS FEATURES:

Pain Touch: A Ravager can make an unarmed touch attack that causes 1d8 hit points of damage, plus one point per Ravager level. Weapons can also transmit this damage at 1d4 + 1 point per class level.

Aura of Fear: Enemies near the Ravager suffer a -2 penalty to all saving throws for 3 rounds + 1 extra round for every Ravager level.

Cruelest Cut: On a successful attack you deal 1d4 points of temporary constitution damage to your target in addition to the normal damage of the attack.

Visage of Terror: Once per day on a successful touch attack you can trigger a spell like ability similar to the spell phantasmal killer with a DC equal to 14 + Ravager levels.

1: Pain Touch 1x per day
2: Aura of Fear 1x per day
3: Cruelest Cut 1x per day
4: Pain Touch 2x per day
5: Aura of Fear 2x per day
6: Cruelest Cut 2x per day
7: Pain Touch 3x per day
8: Aura of Fear 3x per day
9: Cruelest Cut 3x per day
10: Visage of Terror 1x per day

dst: 在探索幽暗地域时，我遇到了一位名叫马弗瑞斯·萨拉彭的人类法师，他暂时居住在一个地下洞穴中，研究幽暗地域特有的奇异魔法。他让我寻找三件对他的研究有重要意义的物品：一枚石化蜥蜴的眼睛，一份胶质怪或类似软泥怪的灵液，以及一份囚魂魔的脑组织。这些生物应该都能在幽暗地域的某处找到。他承诺为每件物品支付我4000金币，如果我集齐全部三件，还会额外给我一件特殊的魔法物品。看来是时候去打猎了。\n\n我已经把石化蜥蜴的眼睛交给了马弗瑞斯。他还需要另外两件物品。
src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a human mage named Mavereth Tharapen, who has taken up temporary residence in an underground cave while he conducts research into the exotic magics peculiar to the Underdark. He asked me to find three items of significance to his research: an eye from a Basilisk, ichor from a Gelatinous Cube or similar slime, and brain matter from an Intellect Devourer. All are creatures that it should be possible to find somewhere in the Underdark. He has promised to pay me 4000 gold for each of these items, and to give me a special magical item in addition if I collect all three. Time to go hunting I suppose.\n\nI have given Mavereth the Basilisk eye. He still requires the other two items.

dst:
扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的宏伟图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识，这样一把重铸之剑或许是阿兹古尔卡重返此位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。

在前往烛堡的途中，我们绕道来到了小镇纳什凯尔，遇到了一位名叫伊扎多·夸巴克斯的侏儒，他原来是一名竖琴手，一直在寻找我们以提供援助，同时还有一些为了赏金而追捕我们的冒险者，必须加以对付。其中一名冒险者竟是我们的老对头加拉德·阿沙勒，他显然一直在暗中与伊扎多合作，而这一次他转换了阵营，看来是要帮助我们。

据伊扎多说，通往烛堡的路线被更多被扎拉拉和我本人以及巨龙克拉克奇'弗拉兹'塔尔的悬赏所吸引的冒险者严密把守，要到达那里并不容易。他声称有一个解决这个问题的计划，但这取决于他与冒险者中一名明显的双重间谍的合作。这名联络人如果得到750000金币就会转投我们这边为我们效力。伊扎多建议我们可以通过杀死绿龙格拉'阿扎'乌库尔来获得这笔款项的至少一大部分，这条龙巢穴在尖牙森林的某处，这样既能掠夺他的宝藏，又能领取他头颅的赏金。他把我们派往一群在森林边缘扎营的竖琴手游侠那里，由一位名叫塔布伦·卡什滕的人带领，帮助我们找到那条龙，而那群人又告诉我们，我们需要与一位名叫冈德·迅矛的矮人合作，去攻打附近的一个地精营地。冈德承诺，只要我们帮助他对付地精，就会告诉我们龙穴的位置。
src:
Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.

Diverted to the small town of Nashkel on our way to Candlekeep, we encountered a gnome named Izado Quabax, who turned out to be a Harper who has been looking for us in order to give us aid, as well as some bounty-hunting adventurers seeking us who had to be dealt with. One of these adventures turned out to be our old foe Garad Ashaler, who apparently has been secretly working with Izado, and on this occasion switched sides and apparently is going to help us. 

According to Izado, the routes to Candlekeep are guarded well by more adventurers lured by bounties on the heads of Zarala and myself, as well the the dragon Krackach'vraz'tar, and it will not be easy to get there. He claims to have a plan for dealing with this problem, but it depends on the cooperation of an apparent double agent among the adventurers wtih whom he is in contact. This contact will switch sides and work for us if paid 750000 gold. Izado suggested we could get at least a large percentage this sum by slaying the green dragon Gra'azha'ukul, who lairs somewhere in the Wood of Sharp Teeth, in order both to loot his hoard and collect a bounty on his head. He sent us to a group of Harper rangers who have made camp on the outskirts of the Wood, led by one Tabrun Carshten to help find the dragon, and that group, in turn, has told us we need to work with a dwarf named Gund Swiftspear to fight a nearby goblin encampment. Gund has promised to tell us where to find the dragon's lair in return for our aid against the golbins.

dst: "我需要为我的研究获取几件可能具有魔法意义的物品：一枚石化蜥蜴的眼睛、一份胶质怪或类似软泥的灵液，以及一些噬脑怪的大脑物质。这些都是幽暗地域的原生生物，所以应该有可能找到它们。遗憾的是，到目前为止我一直没有这个运气。当然，这些都是危险的生物，所以即使找到了，还要面对在不被杀的情况下杀死它们的进一步难题。如果你能四处搜寻并找到这三件物品，那对我会是极大的帮助。每找到一件，我会付给你4000金币，如果你能把三件都带给我，我还会额外奖励你一件特殊的魔法物品。"
src: "There are several items of potential magical significance that I need to acquire for my research: an eye from a basilisk, ichor from a Gelatinous Cube or similar slime, and some of the brain matter of an intellect devourer. These are all creatures native to the Underdark, so it should be possible to find them. Unfortunately, so far, I have had no luck doing so. And of course these are all dangerous creatures so even if found the further problem of killing them without being killed oneself would arise. If you could search around and find those three items it would be a great help to me. I will pay you 4000 gold for each one that you find, and if you can bring me all three, I will reward you with a special magical item as well."

dst: "想想！想想世上所犯下的一切邪恶，其人民必须忍受的一切苦难与恐怖。除了世界是一个虐待狂魔鬼的游乐场之外，这一切还能有什么别的解释？也许你相信我们生活在一个尚有可能存在善的世界里：那是错觉，维持它只是为了当我们的虚荣、虚假的希望被揭穿真面目时，我们会更加痛苦。我们被允许拥有刚好足够的幸福，以便在失去时怀念它；被允许做一点好事，以便当我们的努力最终被证明徒劳时，会更加痛苦。"
src: "Think! Think about all the evil that is done in the world, all the suffering and horror that its people must endure. What other explanation could there be for all this than that the world is the playground for a sadistic devil? Perhaps you believe that we live in a world where some good is possible: that is a delusion, maintained so that we will suffer more when our vain, false hopes are revealed for what they are. We are allowed to have just enough happiness to miss it when it is gone, allowed to do a little good so that it will hurt all the more when our efforts are shown to be ultimately futile."
