dst: 哈马德对我向他讲述的我在气元素位面的经历的意义感到好奇，在那里我得知有些存在想要保护他的女儿扎拉拉免受某种神秘威胁。他请他的一位法师朋友，名叫拉达扎尔·法塞夫的人，通过询问各种可召唤的位面存在来调查此事。法塞夫则想亲自与我谈谈我的位面外遭遇，我猜是为了指导他的行动。因此哈马德派我去和他谈谈。法塞夫可以在提尔神殿的东北塔楼找到。我应该去那座神殿（自然是在神殿区），在东北方找到向上的楼梯。法塞夫在等我，必要的门应该已经解锁，等待我的到来。\n\n我已经与拉达扎尔会面，并参与了他对几个被召唤的位面生物的询问。我不确定我们是否真的从这次行动中了解到很多，但结果，不管怎样，已经报告给哈马德，完成了这项任务。
src: Hamad is curious about the significance of what I related to him concerning my experiences on the Plane of Air, where I was informed that some entities there wished to protect his daughter Zarala against some mysterious threat. He has asked a mage fried of his, one Radazal Faseph, to investigate the matter by inquiring among various summonable planar entities. Faseph in turn wants to speak to me personally about my extra-planar encounter, I suppose to guide his activities. Hamad has therefore dispatched me to talk to him. Faseph can be found in the northeast tower of the Temple of Tyr. I should go to that temple (in the Temple District, naturally) and find an upward-leading staircase in the northeast. Faseph is expecting me and the necesary doors should be unlocked in anticipation of my arrival.\n\nI have met with Radazal and participated in his inquiries directed to a couple of summoned planar creatures. I am not sure we have learned all that much from this exercise, but the results, such as they were, have been reported to Hamad, completing this task.

贾乔·克拉洛，一个长期祸害扎泽斯普尔城的暴力犯罪团伙的首领。他似乎最近躲了起来，没人知道他在哪里。

食人魔巫师奥布格隆，一伙类人劫掠者的首领，他们一直袭击沿商贸之路北上的商队。

哈里安·克罗，一伙雇佣兵的首领，泰瑟尔内战结束后他们失业，转而沦为匪盗。他们一直在城市以东的道路上实施劫掠。

上述任何一人的首级价值1800金币，首级可交给塔南特上尉，他是怡人安息客栈以西港口要塞的指挥官。
src:
I have learned of several notorious criminals who have prices on their heads:

Jacho Kralow, the leader of a gang of violent criminals that have long plagued the city of Zazesspur. It seems he has recently gone into hiding, no one knows where.

Obgron the Ogre Mage, the leader of a band of humanoid raiders who have been attacking caravans traveling north along the Trade Way.

Haryan Krow, the leader of a band of mercenaries who turned to banditry when the end of Tethyr's civil wars led to their unemployment. They have been conducting raids along the roads east of the city.

The head of any of the above is worth 1800 gold, and the heads can be taken to Captain Tanendt, commander of the harbor fort just west of the Winsome Repose Inn.

dst:
在码头区闲逛时，我遇到了商船船长法纳斯·纳塞布。他的专长是运送异国动物。不幸的是，他货舱里的一只凶暴虎挣脱了笼子，正威胁着要祸害下面的其他动物。他请求我帮忙制服这头野兽，并给了我一把附魔匕首，专门对老虎生效，能让它们入睡。我只需击中老虎一次，而且应该注意不要杀死如此珍贵的生物。

老虎已被制服，此事已报告给纳塞布船长。不过，他又给了我另一个任务，找到在码头区域各处传送的闪现犬，告诉它们回到他的船上。原来它们最初就是从那里来的，直到被老虎吓跑。他给了我一根法杖，可以证明我是他的代理人。装备它后，我应该与犬交谈，告诉它们老虎的威胁已经结束。总共有七只犬，而且它们不断传送，要找到全部可能有点困难。我需要查看码头区域各处以及相邻建筑内部。

七只犬都已找到并劝回。我应该去找纳塞布船长领取报酬。
src:
While wandering about the Docks District, I ran into Phanas Naseb, captain of a merchant ship. His specialty is transporting exotic animals. Unfortunately, a dire tiger in his hold has broken free of its cage, and is threatening to wreak havoc amongst the other animals down there. He has asked my assistance in geting the beast under control, giving me a dagger that has been enchanted to affect tigers specifically, putting them to sleep. I should only need to score one hit on the tiger, and should make a point not to kill so valuable a creature.

The tiger has been rendered harmless, and this has been reported to Captain Naseb. He has given me another task, however, to find the various blink dogs teleporting about the docks area and tell them to return to his ship. It turns out that was where they orignally came from, until scared away by the tiger. He has given me a rod which will identify me as his agent. With it equipped, I should speak to the dogs and tell them that the threat from the tiger is over. There are seven dogs in total and it may prove a bit difficult to find them all as they keep teleporting about. I will need to look all around the docks area as well as inside adjoining structures.

All seven dogs have been found and induced to return. I should speak to Captain Naseb for my reward.

dst: 在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队派人搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续著作时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，此人住在贵族区西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了什么，可以去商人区东北部她的家中向她报告。\n\n我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他转而让我去找水手科拉努·乌马尔。现在我已经和科拉努谈过了，他又告诉我阿拉达尔可能调查过的两条线索：第一，他以前的同船伙伴德拉沙姆·埃纳尔，科拉努认为此人曾是符文的特工，现在住在商人区西南部；第二，贵族区东北部一堵墙上的暗门通往一个隐秘房间，科拉努认为那是符文使用的藏身处。既然已经有人告诉我该往哪里找，这扇门应该不会太难找到。
src: At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.\n\nI spoke to Lamash Kasat, who in turn sent me to seek out the sailor Kolanu Umal. Now I have spoken to Kolanu, and he in turn has told me of two paths that Aladar might have investigated: first, a former shipmate of his, Drasham Enar, who Kolanu believes was an agent of the Rune, and who now lives in the southwest part of the Merchant District, and secondly, a hidden chamber accessed through a secret door in a wall in the northeastern part of the Noble District, that Kolanu believes to be a hideout used by the Rune. This door should not be too difficult to find now that I have been directed where to look.

dst:
（进阶职业）
奥术决斗家是一个狡猾，善于躲避的对手，她依赖敌人对她能力的认知，就像依赖她的实际能力一样。通过魔法，奥术决斗家可以显得像决斗家一样危险，但一般来说她对对手造成的伤害并不那么多。她更喜欢通过恐吓对手使其自我击败来获胜。因此，敏捷和魅力是奥术决斗家最有价值的属性值。

- 生命骰：d8
- 武器和防具擅长：奥术决斗家不获得任何擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求
基础攻击加值：+6
技能：表演 5级，翻滚 5级。
专长：军用武器擅长（细剑或短剑），闪避，灵活移动
施法：1级奥术法咒。

职业特性：

等级
1：选定武器：由于奥术决斗家的许多表面能力与魔法相关，奥术决斗家可以将力量注入特定的近战武器，使自己显得更加熟练。奥术决斗家必须选择一种特定的近战武器作为她的选定武器。

1：附魔选定武器：奥术决斗家的选定近战武器表现得如同具有增强加值，即使它没有。如果它确实有增强加值，奥术决斗家将此加值作为有效加值加到武器上。这可以使武器的有效增强加值超过+5.然而，任何武器的总有效加值不能超过+10，因此如果添加会使武器的总有效加值超过+10，则不能将这种职业赋予的有效加值加到武器上。这种职业赋予的加值仅在奥术决斗家持用她的选定近战武器时对她有效。增强加值在1级时为+1，在4级时升至+2,6级时+3,8级时+4。

2：表面防御：由于诡计和人格力量，奥术决斗家将她的魅力加值加到她的防御等级上，此外还有她的敏捷加值。

3：灵巧攻击：因为奥术决斗家重视成功命中而非实际造成的伤害，她可以从选定近战武器的潜在伤害中减去伤害，并将相同的数值加到她的攻击加值上。然而，武器必须造成至少1点伤害。

5：朦胧：奥术决斗家可以激活一个朦胧效果，如同由她的奥术决斗家等级施法者施放的法咒。她可以每日使用此能力次数等于她的奥术决斗家等级。

7：虚假锋锐：为了制造她比实际更有效的印象，奥术决斗家可以每日使用次数等于她的奥术决斗家等级，使她的选定近战武器锋锐。要激活锋锐效果，她必须从她的攻击加值中减去武器的正常重击威胁范围。例如，如果奥术决斗家持用细剑，她必须从攻击加值中减去3，因为细剑的威胁范围为18-20，才能使其锋锐。锋锐效果持续每奥术决斗家等级1轮，并且不与锐锋术或其他使武器锋锐的魔法效果叠加。

9：镜影：奥术决斗家可以激活镜影效果，如同由她的奥术决斗家等级施法者施放的法咒。影像持续每等级一分钟。

10：剑舞 1次/日/等级：奥术决斗家力量的顶峰是对单一目标创造一阵剑击风暴。当此能力激活时，奥术决斗家每轮以她最高的基础攻击加值进行一次额外攻击，但该轮每次攻击受到-2惩罚。所有攻击必须针对同一对手。此外，奥术决斗家创造1d4个准真实影像，加上每三个奥术决斗家等级额外一个影像。每个影像使用与奥术决斗家相同的加值攻击与奥术决斗家相同的对手。影像持续每奥术决斗家等级1分钟或直到其目标死亡，以较长者为准。你每日只能对任何给定敌人使用此能力一次。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The arcane duelist is a tricky, evasive opponent who relies on her foe's perceptions of her abilities as much as her actual abilities. Through magic, the arcane duelist can appear to be as dangerous as a duelist, but in general she does not do as much damage to her opponents. She prefers to win by cowing her opponent into defeating himself. Thus, Dexterity and Charisma are the arcane duelist's most valuable ability scores.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: Arcane Duelists gain no proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Perform 5 ranks, Tumble 5 ranks.
Feats: Martial Weapon Proficiency(Rapier or Shortsword), Dodge, Mobility
Spellcasting: Level 1 Arcane spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Chosen Weapon: Since much of the arcane duelist's apparent ability is tied to magic, the arcane duelist can imbue a specific melee weapon with powers to make herself appear more skilled. The arcane duelist must choose a specific melee weapon to be her chosen weapon.

1: Enchant Chosen Weapon: The arcane duelist's chosen melee weapon acts as if it has an enhancement bonus, even if it does not. If it does have an enhancement bonus, the arcane duelist adds this bonus to the weapon as an effective bonus. This can bring a weapon's effective enhancement bonus above +5. However, no weapon can have more than a +10 total effective bonus, so this class-granted effective bonus cannot be added to a weapon if the addition would increase the weapon's total effective bonus above +10. This class-granted bonus works only for the arcane duelist when wielding her chosen melee weapon. The enhancement bonus is +1 at 1st level, and rises to +2 at 4th level, +3 at 6th level, and +4 at 8th level.

2: Apparent Defense: Due to trickery and force of personality, the arcane duelist adds her Charisma bonus to her Armor Class, in addition to her Dexterity bonus.

3: Dexterous Attack: Because the arcane duelist values successful hits over actual damage dealt, she can subtract damage from her chosen melee weapon's potential damage and add the same amount to her attack bonus. However, the weapon must do a minimum 1 point of damage.

5: Blur: The arcane duelist can activate a blur effect, as the spell cast by a caster of her arcane duelist level. She can use this power once per day per arcane duelist level.

7: False Keenness: To create the idea that she is more effective than she really is, the arcane duelist can make her chosen melee weapon keen once per day per arcane duelist level. To activate the keen effect, she must subtract the weapon's normal threat range for critical hits from her attack bonus. For example, if the arcane duelist wields a rapier, she must subtract 3 from her attack bonus, since the rapier has a threat range of 18-20, to make it keen. The keen effect lasts for 1 round per arcane duelist level, and it does not stack with the keen edge spell or other magical effects that make a weapon keen.

9: Mirror Image: The arcane duelist can activate mirror image effect as the spell cast by a caster of her arcane duelist level. The images last one minute per level.

10: Flurry of Swords 1/day/level: The pinnacle of the arcane duelist's power is to create a flurry of sword attacks against a single target. When this power is activated, the arcane duelist makes one additional attack each round at her highest base attack bonus, but each attack that round suffers a -2 penalty. All attacks must be made on the same opponent. Further, the arcane duelist creates 1d4 quasi-real images plus 1 additional image per three levels of arcane duelist. Each image attacks the same opponent as the arcane duelist herself using the same bonuses as the arcane duelist. The images last for 1 minute per Arcane Duelist Level or the demise of their target, whichever lasts longest. You may target any given enemy only once per day with this ability.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Magic is evil. Magic tempts. Magic perverts. Magic corrupts. Anyone who cannot embrace these truths has no business considering the path of the forsaker. The forsaker rebels against the magic of the fantastic world around him. It's not that he doesn't believe in it; he knows full well that magic is real. He has felt its all too tangible power burn over his skin or wrest control of his mind from him. While others may ignore the dangers of magic and succumb to its siren call of power, the forsaker knows better. To him, sorcery is nothing but a crutch that coddles and weakens its users. By depending upon his own resources alone, the forsaker becomes stronger, tougher, smarter, and more nimble than any of his companions. To that end, he treads a lonely path, deliberately depriving himself of magic's benefits and destroying any magic items he finds.

src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found Schnabar Rockhewer, who apparently fell afoul of some Beholders and was petrified by them. I have restored him from his petrified state, and he has indicated he can make his own way to the Underdark Market. 5 Svrifneblin remain unaccounted for.

src:
Xephs are a race of athletes and artisans, renowned for their feats in agility and speed, as well as their sense of humor.  They value the arts highly, similar to elves, but when betrayed are as implacable as dwarves.  Physically they stand around five and a half feet tall, with a slender build.  They typically sport dark eyes and hair, matching their brown-colored skin.

Xeph Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Soulknife): A multiclass xeph's soulknife class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Darkvision: Xephs are able to see in the dark.
- Naturally Psionic: Xephs gain 1 free power point at first level.
- Hardiness against Spells: +1 to save vs all spells and spell-like abilities.
- Burst: Three times per day, for up to 3 rounds a Xeph can increase his speed, depending on his level.  33% at levels 1-4, 66% at levels 5-8, up to a max of 100% at levels 9 and greater.
- Humanoid: Xephs are considered Humanoids for the purpose of spells.

科罗波库鲁是类似矮人人形生物，生活在不太可能与人类接触的荒凉荒野地区。他们喜欢简单的生活，住在小村庄里，有时只是一个大家庭。他们认为炫耀财富品味低下，但喜欢简单的艺术。他们在人类中以粗鲁和好斗著称，虽然他们憎恨这种看法，却也不做任何事来反驳它。他们往往看起来狂野不修边幅，身高约4英尺。他们比矮人更瘦，体重只有矮人一半。他们有明亮的蓝色，棕色或绿色眼睛，以及小而尖的耳朵。与他们的矮人表亲不同，他们不会长满胡子，但两性通常都有稀疏的胡子，或至少是胡须。

科罗波库鲁属性调整：+2 体质，-2 智力。
偏好职业（野蛮人）：兼职科罗波库鲁的野蛮人职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

- 黑暗视觉：科罗波库鲁能在黑暗中视物。
- 坚韧对抗毒素：对抗毒素的豁免检定获得+2种族加值。
- 坚韧对抗法咒：对抗法咒的豁免检定获得+2种族加值。

- 防御训练对抗巨人：对抗巨人时AC获得+4闪避加值。

src:
Korobokuru are dwarf-like humanoids who live in barren wilderness areas not likely to come into contact with humans.  They prefer a simple life, living in small villages, which are sometimes just one extended family.  They consider it poor taste to display wealth, but have a liking for simple art.  They have reputation for rudeness and belligerence among humans, but while they resent that opinion they do nothing to disprove it.  They tend to look wild and unkept, standing around 4' tall. They are leaner than dwarves, only weighing half as much.  They have bright blue, brown, or green eyes, and small, pointed ears.  Unlike their dwarven cousins they don't grow full beards, but both genders usually have sparse ones, or at least whiskers.

Korobokuru Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Int.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass korobokuru's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Darkvision: Korobokuru are able to see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Poisons: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids.
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Dwarven: Korobokuru count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

Apparently a few sailors are becoming mutinous and threatening some sort of violence. The ship is docked a little ways to the west. Perhaps you could go over there, talk to the captain, and see if there is anything you can do to resolve the situation? I will of course reward you for successfully dealing with the matter."

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Spelldancer 1
Benefit: Spelldancing is a means of increasing the effectiveness of a spell by performing a magical dance before casting. The spelldancer chooses one or more metamagic feats she knows to apply to a spell she wants to cast and begins her spelldancing. When she finishes spelldancing, she makes a Perform check with a DC of 10 + spell level (as modified by the metamagic feats). If she fails, the spell fizzles with no effect. If she succeeds, she casts the spell and it is modified by the selected metamagic feats. 

For every spell level higher than normal that a metamagic feat alters a spell, one full round of spelldancing is required to alter the spell. The spelldancer dances the required number of rounds, and on her next action she may cast a spell with the chosen metamagic feat (if she doesn't cast a spell that round, the spelldancing effect is lost). A spelldancer needs to know the metamagic feat in question to spelldance the effects of that feat. 

A spelldancer can safely spelldance a number of rounds per day equal to her Constitution modifier plus her spelldancer class level. Every spell she casts with spelldancing after that causes her to make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + total rounds spent spelldancing in the last day) to avoid taking 2 points of temporary Constitution damage and becoming fatigued (if already fatigued, the character becomes exhausted and can't spelldance again until only fatigued). 
Use: Selected

dst: 在前往烛堡的途中，我遇到了一位树精，她正与一群信奉风暴与毁灭之神塔洛斯的人发生冲突。双方最终都死了，但我在一名塔洛斯信徒的尸体上找到了一张地图，上面标明了某处废墟的位置，他们希望在那里找到科扎的雕像——科扎是一位耐瑟瑞尔神祇，据信是塔洛斯的一个化身或别名——根据地图上的笔记，这些塔洛斯信徒希望从这尊雕像中获得强大的力量。塔洛斯的各种敌人试图阻止此事，所以也许我应该亲自前往这些废墟取回雕像，尤其是前往烛堡似乎可能没有我希望的那么简单。如果我获得雕像，我可以把它带给塔洛斯的一位风暴先驱，名叫马尔扎克，目前可以在附近城镇纳什凯尔的旅店里找到他，希望他会奖励我。
src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. Both parties ended up dead, but I found a map on the body of one of the Talosians, indicating the location of some ruins where they hope to find an idol of Kozah, a Netherese deity believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos, and an object from which these Talosians hope to gain great power, based on notes written on the map. Various enemies of Talos seek to prevent this, so perhaps I should head to these ruins myself and recover the idol, especially as it seems going to Candlekeep will may not be as simple as I hoped. If I acquire the idol I can bring it to a Stormherald of Talos known as Marzak, currently to be found in the inn of the nearby town of Nashkel, who will hopefully reward me.

dst: “这是从地表的一座神龛通往古老之夜神殿的路线，那或许是献给黑暗女神莎尔的最古老、也无疑是最伟大的神殿。它位于卡林港地表之下极深的崇高黑暗中。她的信徒在那里积聚力量，以便在适当的时候让黑暗蔓延并吞没一切。既然你在这里似乎没有正当事务，你应该趁还能离开时逃离黑暗，尽管那只是暂时的缓刑。不信者在这里不受欢迎。”
src: "This is the route leading from one of our shrines on the surface to the Temple of Old Night, perhaps the oldest, and certainly the greatest temple ever constructed to honor the Dark Goddess Shar. It resides in sublime darkness deep beneath the surface of Calimport. There her followers gather power, so that in due time that darkness will spread and engulf all. Since it seems you have no proper business here, you should flee the darkness while you can, though it be only a temporary reprieve. Unbelievers are not welcome here."

通过手的接触，你增强受术者的生命能量，在法咒持续时间内赋予他或她快速治疗能力。 此治疗仅适用于法咒持续期间受到的伤害，不适用于之前的伤势。受术者每轮治疗 3 点此类伤害的生命值，直到法咒结束，并且如果在此期间因生命值损失而濒死，会自动稳定。

再生重度伤不能恢复因饥饿，口渴或窒息而失去的生命值，也不能让生物再生或接上失去的身体部位。多个再生法咒的效果不叠加，只有最高等级的效果生效。 施加第二个同等级的再生法咒会将第一个法咒的持续时间延长第二个法咒的完整持续时间。
src:
Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric 5, Druid 4
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

With a touch of your hand, you boost the subject's life energy, granting him or her the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.  This healing applies only to damage sustained during the spell's duration, not to that from previous injuries.  The subject heals 3 hit points per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.

Regenerate serious wounds does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts. The effects of multiple regenerate spells do not stack, only the highest-level effect applies.  Applying a second regenerate spell of equal level extends the first spell's duration by the full duration of the second spell.

They should be carrying some identification on them, so that might help you distinguish them from any other Svirfneblin you might come across. Aside from that, I can tell you little. They probably started investigating the Kuo Toa stronghold to the east, but they might have gone on to other points, or even split up. I expect you will be wandering about and exploring the surrounding caverns in any case, so I hope this will not prove too much of an imposition. dst: 这位不幸的冒险者像有些人那样记了日记，而这张从日记中撕下、沾满血迹的纸页记录了他最后的条目：\n\n“鼠人骗了我们！他们假扮成一名下水道工人，趁我们去猎杀巨魔时把我们关在了里面。我们之前被告知这里只有一只巨魔（很可能是鼠人散布的谣言，好引诱像我们这样的傻瓜来送死），但这里和我们一起被关着的有许多巨魔，还有其他怪物。我们本以为准备充分，也带足了杀巨魔的装备，但我们绝不可能在这种劣势下取胜。我们已经退到这间屋子里，很快就要在这里做最后的抵抗。如果有其他冒险者循着我们的足迹而来并读到这些，我祝你们比我们走运。希望你们会拿起我们白白浪费了那么多金币的武器，为我们报仇。”
src: This unforrtunate adventurer kept a journal, as some do, and this blood-stained sheet, torn from it, records his last entry:\n\n"The wererats tricked us! They were impersonating a Sewer Worker, and shut us in when we went troll-hunting. We had been told to expect a single troll (likely a rumor the wererats spread to lure fools just like us to our deaths), but there are many trolls locked in here with us, and other monsters as well. We had thought ourselves well-prepared and adequately equipped with troll-killing gear, but we shall not prevail against these odds. We have retreated to this room where we will soon make a last stand. If any other adventurers should follow in our wake and are reading this, I wish you better luck than we had. I hope you will take up the weapons on which we wasted so much gold and avenge us."

（进阶职业）
暗影法师从黑暗中汲取力量，暗影大师则统御黑暗，但没有人能像暗影匠那样真正操纵黑暗。暗影匠结合了战斗与神秘技艺，并拥有强大的意志，他从暗影物质本身塑造他的工具和武器，从空虚的夜色中引出物质。

- 生命骰：d8
- 技能点：6+ 智力调整值。

先决条件：
基础攻击加值：+5
技能：手艺（护甲） 5 级， 手艺（武器） 5 级，学识 3 级

职业特性：
等级
1： 暗影之触 - 每等级 1 分钟，你在攀爬检定上获得等于你职业等级的加值。
2： 暗影帷幕 - 你在躲藏检定和潜行检定上获得等于你职业等级的加值。暗影帷幕持续每职业等级 1 分钟。
3： 暗影手艺（基础） - 你可以用暗影制作基础的，无活动部件的武器
4： 暗影护甲 +2 - 你在护甲上获得 +2 偏斜加值
5： 扩展帷幕 - 你的暗影之触能力影响你周围 10 尺范围内的友好生物。
6： 暗影手艺（附魔） - 暗影手艺物品现在拥有等于你职业等级 - 5 的增强加值。
7： 暗影护甲 +4
8： 暗影手艺（护甲） - 你现在可以制作轻型护甲。
9： 
10：暗影护甲（加速） - 暗影护甲现在是一个迅捷动作

秘术：你获得施放一些秘术的能力，在第 1,5 和 9 级各学习一个。你在所有施法用途上使用智力。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Shadowcasters draw power from darkness, and masters of shadow command it, but no one truly manipulates the darkness as does the shadowsmith. Combining martial and mystical skills, and possessed of a driving will, the shadowsmith forms his tools and weapons from shadowstuff itself, drawing forth matter from empty night.

- Hit Die: d8
- Skill Points: 6+ Int Modifier.

PREREQUISITES:
Base Attack Bonus: +5
Skills: Craft (armor) 5 ranks,  Craft (weapon) 5 ranks, Lore 3 ranks

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Touch of Shadow - For 1 minute per level you gain a bonus on Climb checks equal to your class level. 
2:  Shroud of Shadow - You gain a bonus on Hide checks and Move Silently checks equal to your class level. Shroud of shadow lasts for 1 minute per class.
3:  Shadow Craft (basic) - you can craft basic, no-moving-parts weapons from shadow
4:  Armor of Shadow +2 - You gain a +2 deflection bonus to armor
5:  Widen Shroud - Your Touch of Shadow ability affects friendly creatures in a 10 foot area around you.
6:  Shadow Craft (enchanted) - Shadowcraft items now have an enhancement bonus equal to your class level - 5.
7:  Armor of Shadow +4
8:  Shadow Craft (armor) - You can now make light armor.
9:  
10: Armor of Shadow (quickened) - Armor of Shadow is now a swift action

Mysteries: You get the ability to cast a few mysteries, learning one at 1st, 5th, and 9th levels. You use Intelligence for all casting purposes.

Prerequisite: Cha 11, Dragonblood subtype*, bard songs

When you perform your bard song(if this feat is activated) instead of granting an attack and damage bonus, you grant a number of d6 of bonus elemental damage equal to the attack bonus you would normally give.  The element of the damage is the element related to your draconic ancestry.  If that dragon type is not associated with one of the 5 main elements, the damage type is fire.

All other effects your bard song causes are unchanged.
Use: Selected.

*Note: In addition to race, you can gain the dragonblood subtype through the Dragon Devotee or Dragon Disciple classes, or through the Dragontouched or Dragon Heritage feats.  If you take this feat and are not dragonblooded, you will be deleveled or unable to level.

dst: 在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给提尔神殿的首席祭司阿达拉斯看时，他认出这是不久前被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。他因我归还找到的碎片而奖赏了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，他也想要。\n\n我找到了圣环的第二块碎片。阿达拉斯告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，他可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。阿达拉斯希望我去完成这次取回任务，并承诺如果我成功，将给予丰厚的奖励。最后这块碎片很可能和前两块一样由不死生物守卫，而且我返回时界门会崩塌，所以在取回最后一块碎片之前我不能返回。当我准备好执行这个任务时，应该再和阿达拉斯谈谈。
src: In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Adaras, the head priest of the Temple of Tyr, he recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. He rewarded me for returning the piece I found, and has told me that he would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find.\n\nI have found a second piece of the holy ring. Adaras has informed me that with two pieces of the ring, he can cast a divination spell that will locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that will transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. Adaras would like me to effect this recovery, and has promised a substantial reward should I accomplish it. This final fragment is liikely to be guarded by undead as the first two were, and I the portal will collapse when I return, so I will not be able to do so until the final piece is recovered. dst: “是的。奥布格隆并非仅凭他自己的奥术洞察力掌握了这些魔法，不用说，那点本事远远不够。这些魔法是他从这座矿坑下方一处古老废墟中获得的装置和知识的产物。几个月前，他带我们中的一些人下去过，虽然我们很快就逃了出来，因为那里满是危险的不死生物，而我们的首领是个懦夫，但我们带走了各种奥术物品以供研究。其中一些物品让奥布格隆得以实现他的传送门之类的东西，但其中有一根小小的金色法杖，可以抵消其他物品的传送功能。我相信那些废墟里一定还有更多这样的法杖，因为我们并没有深入探索多远，而我们三个可以从矿坑到达那里。”
src: "Yes. Obgron did not master these magics solely through his own arcane insight, which, needless to say, would have been woefully inadequate. They are the product of devices and knowledge he gained from an old ruin beneath this mine. He led some of us down there some months ago and though we soon fled, since it was full of dangerous undead and our leader was a coward, we took various arcane objects with us for study. Some of these items allowed Obgron to implement his portals and such, but one of them was a small golden rod that could nullify the teleporting functions of the others. I believe there must be more such rods somewhere in those ruins, as we did not explore very far into them, and the three of us can reach them from the mines."

dst:
这是大学者卡帕达尔的《卡林杉史》第一卷，旨在成为该主题的权威著作。

 本卷讲述了卡林帝国在谷地历-7800年，即9000多年前的建立。它记录了风巨灵卡林的活动，他在现今卡林港地区建立了以其命名的帝国，此前他和许多随从的低等风巨灵从异界领域进入费伦，可能是气元素位面或相关领域。它记录了这个新生帝国对抗入侵龙类的战斗，但大部分内容涉及卡林与孟农之间的伟大斗争。
 孟农是一个火巨灵，一种类似风巨灵的异界生物，但与火而非气相关。孟农和他的火巨灵追随者在谷地历-6800年抵达这个位面，并在卡林帝国以北建立了孟农纳尔国。位于该领域边界的孟农城以他的名字命名。 
 在谷地历-6500年，这两个国家陷入了一场持续数个世纪的战争。由于卡林和孟农都是极其强大的魔法生物，他们的冲突释放了巨大的破坏力。为了阻止这一点，邻近的卓尔，1 级武者部署了强大的魔法，将卡林和孟农融合到地面和空气中，创造了被称为卡林沙漠的荒地，这两个生物被困在那里，继续他们无休止的战争，但无法伤害其他任何人。
 随着他们的领袖消失，他们的帝国崩溃，并被人类接管，人类推翻了那些留下的异界霸主。这是本卷涵盖的最后一件事。
"那是个旧地下室。你还指望有什么？"
src: "It's an old basement. What did you expect?"

dst: "记住，我们认为无端的苦难能换来精神上的益处。因此，如果我们把苦难加于自身，就会增强我们的精神力量，若我们与神合一并顺从他的旨意而行，也会增强我们神的力量。通过我们自愿承受的苦难，我们赋予伊尔梅特力量，增强他行善的能力，他会借此减少恶人加于他人的苦难。"
src: "Remember that we assume that unmerited suffering earns spiritual benefits. Therefore, if we inflict sufferings on ourselves, this increases our spiritual power, and that of our god, if we do this in union with him and obedience to his will. By our voluntary sufferings, we give power to Ilmater and increase his ability to act for good, which he will use to decrease the sufferings inflicted on others by the wicked."

src: Alhoons, also known as illithiliches, are arcane practitioners of the illithids (also known as mindflayers - a little loved race best known for its disturbing habit of either telepathically enslaving or eating the brains of anyone unfortunate enough to encounter them) who have achieved lichdom. Combining the psionic powers of a mindflayer, high levels of arcane power, and the resilience of a powerful undead, they are most formidable. They are renegades and outcasts, since, by seeking undeath, they reject the norms of illithid society by which one is expected in due course to bring individual life to an end with the feeding of one's own cerebral matter to the ruling Elder Brain of one's telepahtic commune. Since, being illithids, they were already hated and feared by everyone else, this makes their existence a lonely one: but still one that some evidently prefer to the alternatives.

卡瑟斯，血中傲慢
  
卡瑟斯因魔法而生，因魔法而死，因此他赋予束缚者统御这种力量的能力。

契灵等级：3级
束缚DC:25
特殊要求：卡瑟斯拒绝回应在活跃法咒区域内召唤他的束缚者的呼唤。此外，他只出现在至少拥有5级学识或法咒辨识的召唤者面前。他还因某种未知原因憎恨阿蒙，如果你已经束缚了那个契灵，他将不会回应你的呼唤。

影响：你会沾染上卡瑟斯在凡人之躯时著名的傲慢。他要求你使用唬骗或威吓检定而非交涉检定来影响他人。

授予能力：
生前，卡瑟斯痴迷于魔法，他的痴迷在他当前的状态下依然不减。他赋予你看见魔法，以触碰摧毁魔法，轻松使用任何魔法物品的能力。他甚至提供增强的施法能力。

强效魔法：你使用的每件魔法物品的每个效果的豁免DC增加2。

卡瑟斯之感官：你可以随意施展侦测魔法。

卡瑟斯之触：你可以通过触碰产生一个解除魔法效果。要做到这一点，你必须成功进行一次不会引发借机攻击的近战触碰攻击。然后你可以对目标身上每个正在生效的法咒进行一次解除检定（1d20 + 你的有效束缚者等级，最大+20）.你每天可以使用卡瑟斯之触的次数等于你的有效束缚者等级。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内无法再次使用。

卡瑟斯之意志：你可以像法师一样使用魔杖和法杖。
src:
Karsus, Hubris in the Blood
  
Karsus lived and died by magic, so he grants binders power over that force.

Vestige Level: 3rd
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: Karsus refuses to answer the call of a binder who attempts to summon him within the area of an active spell. In addition, he appears only to a summoner who has at least 5 ranks in either Lore or Spellcraft. He also hates Amon for some unknown reason and will not answer your call if you are already bound to that vestige.

Influence: You take on some of the arrogance for which Karsus was famous in his mortal life. He requires that you make Bluff or Intimidate checks rather than Persuade checks to influence others.

Granted Abilities: 
In life, Karsus was obsessed with magic, and his obsession continues unabated in his current state. He grants you the ability to see magic, destroy it with a touch, and use any magic item with ease. He even provides increased spellcasting power.

Heavy Magic: The save DC for each effect of every magic item you use increases by 2.

Karsus's Senses: You can cast detect magic at will.

Karsus's Touch: You can produce a dispel magic effect with a touch. To do so, you must make a successful melee touch attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You can then make a dispel check (1d20 + your effective binder level, maximum +20) against each ongoing spell currently in effect on the target. You can use Karsus's touch a number of times per day equal to your effective binder level. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Karsus's Will: You can use wands and staves as if you were a wizard.

dst: 索里克是一位技艺精湛的矮人铁匠，但为了谋生，他常常不得不批量生产武器和盔甲，无法在这些作品上投入他想要的时间。尽管以大多数铁匠的标准来看，即便是他的日常作品也属上乘，但索里克追求的是更高的境界。他时不时会抽出时间来打造一件真正的铁匠艺术杰作，使用精金等稀有材料。这把武器便是这样的作品。曾经有一位索里克的半兽人顾客抱怨说，他店里的武器太多都是“给矮小瘦弱的人戳小洞用的傻乎乎的小刀片”。这多半是讨价还价的伎俩而非挑战，但索里克似乎把它当成了后者，于是打造了这把重型连枷作为回应。这是一把能让高大魁梧的战士将对手砸扁的武器，任何人想声称对其威力不以为然都很难站得住脚。事实上，这把连枷所能留下的毁灭轨迹，很可能令人震惊——在多重意义上都是如此。
src: Thorik is a skilled dwarven smith, but the demands of making a living often force him to produce weapons and armor in quantity, on which he cannot spend as much time as he would like. While even his routine work is of high-quality by the standards of most smiths, Thorik aspires to more. Every now and then he seeks out time to devote to the production a true masterpiece of the smith's art, employing rare materials like adamantine. This weapon is one such work. Once a half-orc customer of Thorik's complained that too many of the weapons in his shop were "silly little blades, for small, puny people to poke tiny holes." This was more likely an attempt at haggling than a challenge, but Thorik seems to have taken it as the latter, and fashioned this heavy flail in response. A weapon with which big, burly warriors can smash opponents flat, it would be very difficult for anyone to make a plausible claim to being unimpressed with its power. Indeed, the swath of devastation this flail can leave in its wake is likely to be downright shocking, in multiple senses.

伤害：半巨魔拥有啮咬和爪抓攻击。如果基础生物没有这些攻击形式，则根据半巨魔的体型使用适当的伤害值。否则，使用表格中的数值或基础生物的伤害，取较高者。

撕扯（Ex）：如果半巨魔以两次或更多次爪抓攻击命中同一个对手，它会抓住对手的身体并撕扯血肉。此攻击自动造成基于半巨魔体型的额外伤害。半巨魔将其力量调整值的 1 1/2 倍加到该基础撕扯伤害上。

灵敏嗅觉（Ex）：半巨魔可以察觉接近的敌人，嗅出隐藏的敌人，并通过嗅觉追踪。

src:
"Half-troll"is an inherited template that can be added to any animal, dragon, fey, giant, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, or outsider (referred to hereafter as the base creature). The creature's type becomes giant, and a half-troll with an outsider as the base creature also gains the extraplanar subtype. The half-troll uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as
noted here.

AC: Natural armor improves by +4.

Damage: Half-trolls have bite and claw attacks. If the base creature does not have these attack forms, use the appropriate damage values based on the half-troll's size. Otherwise, use the values from the table or the base creature's damage, whichever is greater.

Special Attacks: A half-troll retains all the special attacks of the base creature. Half-trolls also gain two claw attacks (or the base creature's number of claw attacks, whichever is higher) and the special ability to rend.

Rend (Ex): If a half-troll hits with two or more claw attacks against the same opponent, it latches onto the opponent's body and tears the flesh. This attack automatically deals an additional amount of damage based on the half-troll's size. A half-troll adds 1 1/2 times its Strength modifier to this base rend damage.

Special Qualities: A half-troll has all the special qualities of the base creature, plus darkvision with a range of 60 feet, fast healing 5, and scent.

Fast Healing (Ex): A half-troll heals 5 points of damage each round so long as it has at least 1 hit point. Fast healing does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, and it does not allow a half-troll to regrow or reattach lost body parts.

Scent (Ex): A half-troll can detect approaching enemies, sniff out hidden foes, and track by sense of smell.

Abilities: Adjust from the base creature as follows: Str +6, Dex +2, Con +6, Int -2, Cha -2.

Alignment: Usually chaotic neutral or chaotic evil.

Level Adjustment: +4

Your body is disintegrated, so you cannot be raised with a raise dead spell. Spells that do not require an intact body, such as true resurrection, can be used to bring you back to life as normal.

src: "Further, think what would happen if I were to provide healing without charge to any who asked for it. dst: "面对如此冷漠，邪恶猖獗也就不足为奇了。但假设某件事确实与你有关，某个你真正珍视的理想，某项你确实希望实现的重大改革，为了它你愿意做什么？你只会把抗议局限于社会所接受的那些形式吗——当然，社会接受它们是因为它们永远不会真正改变任何事——还是会不惜一切代价？即使这意味着违抗法律和其背后的权力？"
src: "It is no surprise evil flourishes in the face of such apathy. But supposing it were some matter that did concern you, some ideal you truly held dear, some great reform you did want made, what would you be willing to do to for its sake? Would you confine your protests only to those forms that society accepts, accepted of course because they will never actually change anything, or would you do whatever was necessary? Even if it meant defying the law and the powers behind it?"

dst:
在下水道探索时，我遇到了一个名叫布利夫明·泽姆昆的侏儒发明家，他正试图建立一套机械系统，从污水中提取具有魔法用途的试剂。他所说的"中央收集区"周围的四个分站的机器一直出问题，他承诺如果我能够帮忙解决他遇到的各种问题，就会给我报酬。

东北方向的机器发生了故障，在自身周围释放了一团毒气。我现在已经将其关闭，以便进行修理。

东南方向的机器不知为何喷出了危险的软泥，但现在已经关闭了。

西北方向的机器运转正常，但所在房间现在被食腐虫占据了。这些怪物应该被清除掉。

西南方向的机器有一个关键部件，包含一些金管，被藏在下水道里的罪犯拆走了。不过，我成功找回了这个部件，这应该会让修理容易得多。

我已经向泽姆昆汇报了我的进展。完成的其他任务也应该向泽姆昆汇报。
src:
While exploring the sewers, I ran into one Bliffmin Zemquin, a gnomish inventor who is trying to set up a system of mechanism that can extract magically useful reagents from sewage. He has been having problems with the machines at four substations around what he describes as the "cental collection area," and has promised me a reward if I can assist in fixing the various issues he has been having.

The machine to the northeast was malfunctioning, and released a cloud of toxic gas around itself. I have now shut this down so that it can be repaired.

The machine to the southeast was somehow spewing forth dangeous slimes. but has now been shut down.

The machine to the northwest is functional, but in a room now occupied by otyughs. These monsters should be cleared out.

The machine to the southwest had a key component, incorporating some gold tubing, ripped out of it by some criminals hiding in the sewers. However, I was able to recover the part, which should make its repair much easier.

I have infromed Zemquin of my progress. Any other tasks accomplished should be repored to Zemquin as well.

dst:
我最近的冒险始于今年早些时候，当时我出现在卡林港的流沙旅店，寻找冒险工作。在那里我遇到了一位名叫扎拉拉·加尔哈德尔的空气元素裔吟游诗人，并最终和她一起经历了许多冒险。在这些冒险过程中，我战死沙场，显然被杀，却发现自己身处似乎是气元素位面的地方，被那里某个强大的存在复活了。这个存在告诉我，如果我再次战死（鉴于我职业的危险性，这很有可能发生），它能够并且愿意再次复活我（并将我送回我所在位面倒下的地点），尽管它在特定时间段内只能这样做有限次数。作为这项极其宝贵服务的回报，它告诉我，我将被期望充当扎拉拉的保护者。据称她拥有某种伟大的命运，这个存在希望看到它实现。显然无法或不被允许直接帮助扎拉拉，这个存在选择通过帮助我——她的同伴——来间接帮助她。

在适当的时候，我最终被扎拉拉的父亲哈马德·加尔哈德尔雇为守卫，他是一位提尔的圣武士，也是卡林杉贵族的一员。我花了几个月为哈马德执行各种任务，同时也在卡林港城中游荡时找到了其他冒险工作。这一切在我揭露帕夏卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔的一个阴谋后结束了，他是哈马德的老朋友，偶尔也是盟友，他计划与各种怪物团伙结盟摧毁卡林港，并利用一件名为泽法德之剑的古代神怪神器来制造浩劫。最终发现泽卡尔受到一个名为阿兹古尔卡的强大恶魔的影响，这个恶魔曾被泽法德之剑击败并困住，但因此能够通过它行动。还发现扎拉拉是神怪泽法德（最初锻造这把剑的人）的后裔，因此对这把剑拥有某些力量。这使我们能够挫败泽卡尔的计划并从他手中夺走剑（在此过程中将其折断），但这并没有结束我们的问题。困住阿兹古尔卡的次元壁障已经开始崩塌，最终会崩溃，释放出恶魔。此外，泽卡尔早些时候安排哈马德卷入一项释放奴隶的犯罪活动（讽刺的是，这个项目原本是泽卡尔自己的，他让哈马德间接参与其中），从而获得了攻击加尔哈德尔庄园并杀死那里所有人的权力。这包括扎拉拉和我自己，我们因此被迫逃离卡林杉，而哈马德牺牲了自己的生命为我们争取逃跑时间。

目前，我们在瓦尔库尔之剑号上，这是一艘猎杀海盗的船，船长正带我们离开卡林杉，以偿还欠哈马德·加尔哈德尔的债务。扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的大图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识。重铸后的剑可能是阿兹古尔卡返回这个位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。然而，我们必须先设法获得一本价值连城的书，作为进入烛堡的代价。
src:
My recent adventures began earlier this year when I showed up at the Shifting Sands Inn in the city of Calimport, looking for adventuring work. There I met an air genasi bard named Zarala Galhadr, and ended up having a number of adventures with her. In the course of these adventurers I fell in battle, apparently killed, only to find myself in what appeared to be the Plane of Air, having been restored to life by some powerful entity there. This entity told me that it was able and willing to restore my life (and return me to the point at which I fell on my own plane) again if I ever fell in battle (a likely enough occurence given the danger of my profession), although it could only do so a limited number of times within a given time period. In return for this extraordinarily valuable service, it told me that I would be expected to act as Zarala's protector. She allegedly has some great destiny the entity wants to see fulfilled. Apparently unable or forbidden to help Zarala directly, the entity chose to assist her by helping me, her companion, instead.

In due course, I ended up being hired as a guard by Zarala's father, Hamad Galhadr, a Paladin of Tyr and a member of Calimshan's nobility. I spent a few months performing various tasks for Hamad, among other adventuring work I found while wandering about the city of Calimport. This came to an end when I uncovered a plot by Pasha Kalomas Zekar, an old friend and occasional ally of Hamad's, to ally with various bands of monsters to destroy Calimport, as well as using an ancient djinn artifact known as the Sword of Zefad to unleash havoc. It eventually emerged that Zekar was under the influence of a powerful demon named Azghulkar, once defeated and entrapped by the sword of Zefad, but as a result able to act through it. It also emerged that Zarala was a descendant of the djinni Zefad (who had forged the sword in the first place) and thus had certain powers over it. This enabled us to foil Zekar's plans and take the sword from him (breaking it in the process), but that did not end our problems. The dimensional walls entrapping Azghulkar had begun to fall, and will eventually collapse, releasing the demon. Furthermore, Zekar had earlier arranged for Hamad to be implicated in a criminal enterprise to free slaves (a project that ironically was originally Zekar's own, and in which he had peripherally involved Hamad) and thus gained authority to attack the Galhadr estate and kill everyone there. This included Zarala and myself, and we were consequently forced to flee Calimshan, while Hamad sacrificed his life to buy time for our escape.

Currently, we are onboard the Sword of Valkur, a pirate-hunting vessel whose captain is taking us out of Calimshan to repay a debt owed to Hamad Galhadr. Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad. The reforged sword might be the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane. However, we must first somehow acquire a book of great value as the price of admittance to Candlekeep.

半梦灵是一个复合种族，是人类和一个称为库里的无形种族的融合，原生于一个梦境位面。为了逃避迫害，他们找到了逃到主物质位面的方法，并与那些愿意欢迎他们的人类结合。现在，半梦灵是一个自己的种族，每个都有一小部分与他们的祖先结合的原始库里，但由于库里的流放，半梦灵无法做梦。在物理上，他们大部分看起来像人类，但通常稍高一些，特征稍微更有棱角。当他们移动时，带着比平常更多的恩典和优美。

- 社交大师：半梦灵擅长社交场合，通过他们威严的存在和微妙的灵能影响他人。他们获得+2到所有唬骗，威吓和说服检定。

src:
Kalashtar are a compound race, a fusion of humans and an incorporeal race called the quori, native to a plane of dreams.  Fleeing persecution, they found a way to escape to the Prime, and joined with those humans willing to welcome them.  Now, kalashtar are a race of their own, each having a small portion of the original quori who joined with their ancestors, but due to the quori's exile the kalashtar cannot dream.  Physically they appear like humans for the most part, but are typically a bit taller, with slightly more angular features.  When they move, it is with more than the usual grace and elegance.

Kalashtar Ability Adjustments: None.
Favored Class (Psion): A multiclass kalashtar's psion class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Base movement of 30.
- Dual Nature: Kalashtars gain a +2 racial bonus to save vs mind-affecting abilities due to their dual spirits.
- Social Masters: Kalashtar are adept at social situations, influencing others through their commanding presence and subtle psychic powers.  They gain a +2 to all Bluff, Intimidate, and Persuade checks.
- Human: Kalashtar are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

半人羊

比人类高约半英尺，半人羊类似于半人马。它的下半身是公羊的身体，有光滑的棕色或金色皮毛和偶蹄。它的上半身类似人类，肌肉发达，头顶长有一对公羊般的角。半人羊的皮肤颜色从浅棕褐色到深坚果棕色不等。典型的雄性重近300磅，雌性约轻40磅。半人羊平均成年年龄与半精灵大致相同，该种族最年长的成员可活到200岁以上。

- 四足动物：作为四足动物，半人羊在抵抗冲撞和绊摔攻击的检定上获得+4加值。
- 异界生物：在法咒效果方面，半人羊视为异界生物。
- 强力冲锋：冲锋的半人羊可以进行一次单一的顶撞攻击，造成等于2d6 + 1-1/2倍半人羊力量调整值的钝击伤害。
- 法术抗力：半人羊的法术抗力等于11 + 职业等级。

src:
Bariaur
Native to the rolling hills and woods of Ysgard, the centaurlike bariaurs wander the lands in search of evil. When a vile foe is located, the bariaurs charge into glorious battle.

Standing roughly half a foot taller than a human, a bariaur resembles a centaur. Its lower body is that of a ram, with sleek brown or golden fur and cloven hooves. Its upper body is humanlike, powerfully muscled and sporting a pair of ramlike horns atop its head. The skin of a bariaur ranges in color from pale tan to deep nut-brown. The typical male weighs nearly 300 pounds, with females about 40 pounds lighter. The average bariaur reaches adulthood at about the same age as a halfelf, and the eldest members of the race live to well over 200 years of age.

Ability Adjustments +2 Strength, -2 Charisma

Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass Bariaur's Ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Medium creature
- 40' base speed
- Darkvision
- Quadruped: As quadrupeds, bariaurs have a +4 bonus on checks to resist bull rush and trip attacks. 
- Outsider: Barriaur count as Outsiders for the purpose of spells.
- Powerful Charge: A charging bariaur can make a single ram attack that deals bludgeoning damage equal to 2d6 + 1-1/2 times the bariaur's Str modifier.
- Spell Resistance: Bariaurs have spell resistance equal to 11 + class level.
- +2 racial bonus on Will saves against spells and spelllike abilities.
- Skills: Bariaurs have keen senses, giving them a +2 racial bonus on Listen and Spot checks
- Level Adjustment: +1

大地精经常与强大的龙结盟，互惠互利，其中蓝龙最为常见，因为它们共享领地。尽管两者之间的肉体关系极为罕见，但一个大地精部落发展了一系列仪式，使他们能够获得龙类的特征。这个原始部落早已消失，但仪式留下的特征在大地精种族中流传下来。日灼大地精的出生被视为一种预兆，他们通常是部落的领袖或领袖背后的力量。他们看起来与同类相似，但拥有明亮的蔚蓝色眼睛。他们比普通大地精更狡猾，更有耐心，但也继承了蓝龙的虚荣。

- 黑暗视觉：日灼大地精能够在黑暗中视物。
- 技能亲和（潜行）：潜行检定获得 +4 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（唬骗）：唬骗检定获得 +2 种族加值。

等级调整：+1
src:
Hobgoblins often ally with powerful dragons, to both sides' mutual benefit, with blue dragons being the most common due to shared territories.  Although physical relationships are extremely rare between the two, a tribe of hobgoblins developed a series of rituals to allow them to take on aspects of dragonkind.  This original tribe is long since gone, but the traits left behind by the rituals live on among the hobgoblin race.  The birth of a Sunscorch Hobgoblin is considered a omen, and they are often leaders or the power behind the leader of a given tribe.  They look like their fellows, but for brilliant azure eyes.  They are more cunning and patient than normal hobgoblins, but they also inherited the blue dragon's vanity.

Sunscorch Hobgoblin Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, +2 Wis
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass sunscorch hobgoblin's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Sunscorch Hobgoblins are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Bluff): +2 racial bonus to Bluff checks.
- Dragonblooded: Sunscorch Hobgoblins have the Dragonblood subtype.
- Goblinoid: Hobgoblins count as Goblinoids for the purpose of spells.

Level Adjustment: +1

壮心半身人比其他半身人更有组织，更有秩序，更勤劳。他们建造耐久的建筑，并凶猛地保卫家园，抵御那些他们的轻足亲戚只会逃离的威胁。在身体上，他们与半身人亲戚有相似的体格和特征，以及许多能力。像人类一样，他们特别擅长学习新技能。

src:
Strongheart are more organized, orderly and industrious race than other halflings. They build to last and fiercely defend their homeland against threats that their lightfoot kin would simply flee. Physically, they share similar builds and characteristics with their halfling kin, and many of their abilities as well. Like humans, they are especially adept at learning new skills.

Strongheart Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass Strongheart halfling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Quick to Master: Strongheart Halflings receive 1 extra feat at first level.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Strongheart Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

dst: "你就那样抛下我，是什么意思？我们本该是一个团队！"
src: "What do you mean by abandoning me like that? We're supposed to be a team!"

dst: "嗯，我一直作为雇佣冒险者干活，努力做一个打击罪犯而不是与罪犯为伍的人：但后来卡林港的当局宣布你们两个——把我从犯罪生涯中救出来的人——是罪犯。我自然很好奇到底怎么回事，所以就报名加入了赏金猎人来查清楚。当然，我其实并不想杀你们，而且我听说有竖琴手在试图帮你们，所以我联系了他们，告诉他们我愿意倒戈——当然前提是我放弃的赏金能得到补偿。我是说，我本来希望不必真的杀你们，但我总得谋生。于是我们就到了这一步。"
src: "Well, I've been working as a mercenary adventurer, and trying to be one that fights against criminals and not with them: but then the authorities in Calimport declared you two, who saved me from a life of crime, to be criminals yourselves. Naturally I was curious about what was going on, so I signed up with the bounty hunters to find out. I didn't actually want to kill you of course, and I heard there were Harpers trying to help you, so I contacted them and told them I would switch sides - provided of course that I was compensated for the bounty I was giving up. I mean, I was hoping I wouldn't have to actually kill you, but I do need to make a living. And so here we are."

dst: 花了一点时间让鸟明白你对什么样的事情感兴趣，但最终它告诉你，它观察到狼人在附近埋了一个箱子。有了渡鸦提供的信息，现在应该很容易找到。

dst: "我不怀疑这个教团内部潜伏着邪恶，如果它显露出来，我们最终可能被迫采取你所建议的某种应对措施。然而，正如我所说，我们目前还没有任何真凭实据来证明采取此类行动是合理的。我们谈论的是私人财产。目前我们缺乏侵入它的法律依据。"
src: "I do not doubt there is evil lurking within this order, and if it becomes manifest we may eventually be forced to some such response as you suggest. However, as I said, we have as yet no real proof of anything that would justify such an action. We are talking about private property. At the moment we lack a legal justification for intruding upon it."

dst: "如果你正确使用它们，并且不傻到去寻找不必要的战斗——这种习惯最终必然会让任何人面对一个无法战胜的敌人——那么它们会很好地为你服务。现在如果你不介意的话，我想进行一些冥想……"
src: "If you employ them correctly, and are not such a fool as to seek out unnecessary fights, a habit that must eventually lead anyone to face an overwhelming foe, than they will serve you quite well. Now if you will excuse me, I would like to perform some meditations..."

dst: "很久以前，我是守卫这些大厅的战士之一。我们遭到邪恶卓尔的袭击，并败在他们手下。卓尔最终因为我们的魔像增援而被迫逃离，但在那之前他们卑鄙地烧毁了我们的尸体。我们本应被埋葬，回归矮人所属的大地，但由于这种亵渎，我们的灵魂反而留在这里作祟。有时装备精良的入侵者会击倒我们中的一些人，但过一段时间我们总会回来。只有当我们的遗体被妥善埋葬后，我们才能获得永久的安息。"
src: "A long time ago, I was one of the warriors defending these halls. We were attacked by vile Drow, and fell against them. The Drow were eventually forced to flee as our golems reinforced us, but not before they had foully burned our bodies. We should have been buried, returned to the earth where dwarves belong, but because of this desecration, our spirits instead remain to haunt this place. Sometimes well-armed intruders have struck down some of us, but after a time we always return. Only when what is left of our bodies has been properly buried will we know permanent peace."

Level: Crusader 7, swordsage 7, warblade 7

Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature

Focusing your strength with a deep, rumbling shout, you execute an attack that sends your opponent flying through the air.

As part of this maneuver, you make a melee attack against your foe. This attack deals an extra 6d6 points of damage, and the creature struck must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 17 + your Str modifier) or be hurled 5 to 20' away from you, falling prone in that square. A creature of a smaller size category than yours gets a -2 penalty on this save; a creature of a larger size than yours gets a +2 bonus on the save. The enemy's movement doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. If an obstacle blocks the creature's movement, it instead stops in the first unoccupied square.

A swarm of scarabs surges from your outstretched hand. These insects rip and bite at all living creatures in the are, the return to you with life essence stolen from their victims. You gain these temporary hit points for each creature whose spell resistance you overcome. You never gain temporary hit points from creatures that do not have spell resistance. The temporary hit points gained from this spell last for up to 1 hour.

虫尾腰带

描述符：无  
职业：图腾师 
脉轮：腰部（图腾） 
豁免检定：见文本

魂能在你腰间形成一条由厚实紫色鳞片构成的宽腰带。虽然这条腰带并不作为护甲使用（并且能轻松套在你可能穿着的任何护甲外），但它会使你的皮肤增厚，并将其染成淡淡的紫色。

你在天生护甲上获得 +2 增强加值。

魂能：你投入虫尾腰带中的每一点魂能，都会使你的天生护甲增强加值增加 1. 

脉轮绑定（腰部） 

魂能融合并非在你腰间形成一条紫色鳞片腰带，而是在你躯干和双腿的皮肤上形成覆甲。这些鳞片背面呈深紫色，正面颜色较浅，似乎增加了你的体量，并且无疑增强了你在近战中的力量。

你获得 震慑猛击 专长，并在使用它时被视为比通常大一个体型等级（最大为 超巨型）.抵抗你震慑猛击的豁免 DC 按照你魂能融合的正常方式计算，而非基于你造成的伤害。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

一条覆有厚实紫色鳞片的尾巴从你虫尾腰带的后方伸出。它足够长，你可以将它绕到身前，用其末端的毒刺攻击敌人，毒刺上滴着毒液。

你可以使用虫尾腰带的毒刺进行天生攻击。你不能将毒刺作为天生次要武器使用--使用毒刺是你在给定轮中唯一能进行的攻击。你在攻击检定中使用你全部的基础攻击加值，毒刺造成 1d6 点伤害。此外，毒刺会传递一种弱化毒素，造成 1d4 点力量初始伤害（无后续伤害）.成功的强韧豁免可抵消毒素伤害。你投入虫尾腰带中的每一点魂能，都会使你的毒刺攻击检定获得 +1 增强加值，并增加毒素的豁免 DC.
src:
Wormtail Belt

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Waist (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms a wide belt of thick purple scales around your waist. Though the belt does not serve as armor (and easily fits around any armor you might wear), it thickens your skin and tints it a faint purple color.

You gain a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor.

Essentia: The enhancement bonus to your natural armor increases by 1 for every point of essentia you invest in your wormtail belt. 

Chakra Bind (Waist) 

Rather than forming a belt of purple scales at your waist, the soulmeld shapes plating on the skin of your torso and legs. Dark purple on the back and lighter in front, these scales seem to add to your bulk, and definitely increase your power in melee combat.

You gain the Awesome Blow feat and are treated as one size category larger than usual when using it (up to a maximum of Colossal). The save DC to resist your awesome blow is calculated as normal for your soulmelds, rather than being based on the damage you deal. 

Chakra Bind (Totem)

A thick, purple-scaled tail emerges from the back of your wormtail belt. It is long enough that you can reach it around you to attack your foes with the stinger at its end, which drips with poison.

You can use your wormtail belt's stinger to make natural attacks. You cannot use the stinger as a natural secondary weapon-using the stinger is the only attack you can make in a given round. You use your full base attack bonus for the attack roll, and the stinger deals 1d6 points of damage. In addition, the stinger delivers a weakening poison that deals initial damage of 1d4 Strength (no secondary damage). A successful Fortitude save negates the poison damage. Every point of essentia you invest in your wormtail belt gives you a +1 enhancement bonus on your attack rolls with the stinger, as well as increasing the poison's save DC.

dst: 在探索一个深渊位面时，我发现了纳斯卡·诺顿，一位早先来到同位面的冒险者，结果被那里的塔纳厘击败并囚禁。他请求我释放他。为此，我必须离开他被囚禁的东侧大厅，在那里我应该能找到一名持有能打开他牢房的“万能钥匙”的巴洛魔。必须击败巴洛魔并取回这把钥匙。显然，这把钥匙可以打开深渊中的多扇门，但只能使用一次，所以如果我想释放纳斯卡，就必须确保不将它用于其他任何用途。纳斯卡声称他还有另一把钥匙，是到达西边一座塔中巫妖的命匣所必需的，作为释放他的回报，他会把钥匙给我。\n\n我已经打开了纳斯卡的牢房，并从他那里取回了巫妖的钥匙。他告诉我，要找到通往命匣的道路，我需要在塔入口附近一个高台上寻找一扇隐藏的活动门。他警告我可能还有其他未知的障碍，也许是更多的密门或需要额外钥匙的门。
src: While exploring an abyssal plane, I found one Nathkar Notten, an adventurer who had earlier come to the same plane, only to be defeated and imprisoned by the Tanar'ri there. He has asked me to free him. In order to do so, I must exit the halls in which he is imprisoned to the east, where I should find a balor carrying a "master key" that can open his cell. The balor will need to be defeated and this key recovered. Apparently the key in question can open multiple doors in the Abyss, but can only be use one time, so I should make sure not to use it for anything else if I wish to free Nathkar. Nathkar claims to have another key, necessary to reach the pylactery of a lich residing in a tower to the west, that he will give me in rerturn for freeing him.\n\nI have both unlocked Nathkar's cell and recovered the lich's key from him. He told me that to find the path to the phylactery, I need to search for a hidden trap door on a raised platform near the tower's entrance. He warned me that there might be other, unknown obstacles, perhaps further secret doors or doors requiring additional keys.

dst: 这本书包含了大量关于魔法理论和施法的信息。阅读它可以极大地帮助一位奥术施法者精通其技艺。\n\n注意：使用这本书将提供经验值。如果一个人在奥术施法职业（吟游诗人、术士、苍白之主和法师）中每提升一个等级，经验值数量就会增加，因为这些职业与书中包含的信息最为相关；而一个人的总等级越高，经验值数量就会减少，因为高等级施法者会发现书中他们尚不知道的内容更少。吟游诗人和术士会获得轻微的惩罚，因为这些职业在施法上较少依赖书本学习。
src: This book contains a wealth of information about magical theory and spell-casting. Reading it could greatly assist an arcane caster in mastering his art.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide experience. The amount will be increased for every level one has in an arcane spellcasting class (bard, sorcerer, palemaster and wizard), since those are the classes to which the information it contains is most relevant, and decreased the higher one's total level is, since higher-level spellcasters will find less in it that they do not already know. Bards and sorcerers get a slight penalty, as these classes are less reliant on book-learning for their spell-casting.

学派：防护系
等级：牧师 8，魔法 6，保护 6，术士/法师 6
成分：言语，姿势，材料/法器
施法时间：1 标准动作
距离：10 英尺
区域：以你为中心，半径 10 英尺的散发区域
持续时间：10 分钟/等级（解消）
豁免检定：无
法术抗力：见文本

一个隐形屏障围绕着你并随你移动。该屏障内的空间不受大多数魔法效果影响，包括法咒，类法咒能力和超自然能力。同样，它阻止其范围内任何魔法物品或法咒的运作。
反魔法场压制在其中使用，带入或施放于该区域内的任何法咒或魔法效果，但不会解除它。在反魔法场内度过的时间计入被压制法咒的持续时间。
任何类型的召唤生物和虚体不死生物如果进入反魔法场就会消失。一旦该场消失，它们会在同一位置重新出现。消失期间的时间正常计入维持该生物的咒法系法咒持续时间。如果你在一个被具有法术抗力的召唤生物占据的区域施放反魔法场，你必须进行施法者等级检定（1d20 + 施法者等级） 对抗该生物的法术抗力才能使其消失。（瞬间咒法系法咒的效果不受反魔法场影响，因为咒法系法咒本身已不再生效，只有其结果存在。）
普通生物可以进入该区域，普通投射物也可以。此外，虽然魔法剑在该区域内不会发挥魔法功能，但它仍然是一把剑（而且是一把精制品剑）. 该法咒对魔像和其他在制造过程中被注入魔法并此后自我维持的构装体没有效果（除非它们是被召唤的，在这种情况下它们被视为任何其他召唤生物）. 元素生物，实体不死生物和异界生物同样不受影响，除非是被召唤的。然而，这些生物的类法咒或超自然能力可能会被该场暂时无效化。解除魔法不能移除该场。
两个或更多共享任何相同空间的反魔法场彼此之间没有效果。某些法咒，例如力场墙，虹光法球和虹光法墙，不受反魔法场影响（见各法咒描述）. 神器与神祇不受此类凡人魔法的影响。
如果生物比屏障所包围的区域更大，其位于屏障外的任何部分不受该场影响。

奥术材料成分：一撮铁粉或铁屑。
src:
School: Abjuration
Level: Clr 8, Magic 6, Protection 6, Sor/Wiz 6
Components: V, S, M/DF
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 10 ft.
Area: 10-ft.-radius emanation, centered on you
Duration: 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: See text

An invisible barrier surrounds you and moves with you. The space within this barrier is impervious to most magical effects, including spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities. Likewise, it prevents the functioning of any magic items or spells within its confines.
An antimagic field suppresses any spell or magical effect used within, brought into, or cast into the area, but does not dispel it. Time spent within an antimagic field counts against the suppressed spell's duration.
Summoned creatures of any type and incorporeal undead wink out if they enter an antimagic field. They reappear in the same spot once the field goes away. Time spent winked out counts normally against the duration of the conjuration that is maintaining the creature. If you cast antimagic field in an area occupied by a summoned creature that has spell resistance, you must make a caster level check (1d20 + caster level) against the creature's spell resistance to make it wink out. (The effects of instantaneous conjurations are not affected by an antimagic field because the conjuration itself is no longer in effect, only its result.)
A normal creature can enter the area, as can normal missiles. Furthermore, while a magic sword does not function magically within the area, it is still a sword (and a masterwork sword at that). The spell has no effect on golems and other constructs that are imbued with magic during their creation process and are thereafter self-supporting (unless they have been summoned, in which case they are treated like any other summoned creatures). Elementals, corporeal undead, and outsiders are likewise unaffected unless summoned. These creatures' spell-like or supernatural abilities, however, may be temporarily nullified by the field. Dispel magic does not remove the field.
Two or more antimagic fields sharing any of the same space have no effect on each other. Certain spells, such as wall of force, prismatic sphere, and prismatic wall, remain unaffected by antimagic field (see the individual spell descriptions). Artifacts and deities are unaffected by mortal magic such as this.
Should a creature be larger than the area enclosed by the barrier, any part of it that lies outside the barrier is unaffected by the field.

Arcane Material Component: A pinch of powdered iron or iron filings.

dst:
这是一位冒险者的日志，想必就是这具骷髅生前的身份。他最后的任务似乎涉及闯入一个叫做“萨斯拉斯之塔”的地方。其中一则记录表明，他曾听说过一个关于名为萨斯拉斯的存在的故事，据称任何能在影界之塔中找到他的人都会被赐予强大的力量。另一则记录描述了他如何能够运用某些稀有且难以获得的暗影魔法来打开大门，尽管他缺少本该是正确钥匙的东西。最后一则记录如下：

“中央房间里的迷雾再生伤口的速度太快，似乎根本无法杀死，但它们并不特别敏锐，所以我得以偷偷溜过它们。我现在需要解开谜题，以打开我希望是最后一道门。我在塔的高处门前见过与符文板相似的符号。也许每个楼层上符号出现的顺序，指示了应该按下带有对应符号的符文板的顺序？如果是这样，我现在必须返回塔中刷新记忆。我之前已清除了它的守卫，所以应该可以安全返回。”

没有记录表明可能出了什么差错，使他沦落到如今的状态。
src:
This the journal of an adventurer, presumably what this skeleton was when alive. His final quest appears to have involved penetrating some place called the "Tower of Sathras." An entry indicates that he had heard a tale about some entity known as Sathras who will allegedly confer great power on anyone who can find him within his tower on the Shadow Plane. Another entry describes how he was able to employ certain rare and difficult to obtain shadow magicks to open the door, despite lacking whatever was meant to be its proper key. The final entry reads as follows:

"The Mists in the central room regenerate wounds so quickly they cannot be killed, it seems, but they are not especially perceptive so I was able to sneak past them. I now need a solution to the puzzle to open what I hope is the final door. I saw symbols similar to those on the rune plates before the door in the upper reaches of the tower. Perhaps the order in which the symbols appear on each floor of the tower indicates the order in which the rune plates with corresponding symbols should be pressed? If so, I must now return to the tower to refresh my memory. I cleared out its guardians earlier so it should be safe to do so."

There is no record of what may have gone wrong to reduce him to his current state.

dst: "我一直在等一个武僧出现，好把这个悬赏交给他。这是对一位非常强大的武僧拉古隆的20000金币悬赏。这个拉古隆显然是长死教团的成员，他们痴迷于死亡与杀戮。拉古隆也不例外，并因谋杀而被通缉。然而，他把自己安置在某个巢穴里，由结界保护，任何携带武器的人都无法通过。这让任何非精通徒手战斗的武僧同伴都很难对付他。据报道，他还在里面设置了许多其他考验，除了武僧之外，任何人都很难通过。显然，他想挑战其他武僧，而且只挑战其他武僧，进行一场考验价值的单挑，或者类似的事情。我猜是某种疯狂的事，因为任何人做武僧做的那些事都一定是疯了……呃，无意冒犯。总之，如果你想试着领取这个悬赏，可以在云峰山脉北侧找到他的藏身处，这里。"他在地图上指出一个点。
src: "I've been waiting for a monk to show up so I can offer this bounty. It's a bounty of 20000 gold on a very powerful Monk named Laguron. This Laguron is apparently a member of the Order of the Long Death, who are obsessed with death and killing. Laguron is no exception and is wanted for murder. However, he's set himself up in some lair protected by wards that no one can get through if they are carrying weapons. That makes him a difficult target for anyone other than a fellow monk skilled in unarmed combat. By report, he's set up lots of other tests within that will be difficult for anyone but monks to get past. Apparently, he wants to challenge other monks, and only other monks, to single combat in a test of worthiness, or something like that. Something crazy I guess, since anyone would have to be crazy to do the sorts of things monks do...er, no offense. Anyway, if you want to try collecting this bounty, you can find his hideout on the north side of the Cloudpeaks, here." He indicates a point on your map.

dst: "我们就在这里分别吧。我在这里的任务已经完成了。我会留下来确认没有蛇人残兵游勇，但你没有理由再被耽搁了。你已经提供了至关重要的帮助，而且确实做得远超我所能期望甚至奢望的。"
src: "Here is where we part ways. My mission here has been accomplished. I will stay to make certain that there are no Yuan-ti stragglers about, but there is no reason why you should be detained any further. You have already provided crucial aid, and indeed done far more than I might have expected or even hoped."

- 技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定 +2 种族加值。

- 微光视觉：允许他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。

src:
Like most sylvan races, the elves are in tune with the natural world, which includes dragonkind.  In ancient times a few groups of elves forged treaties with powerful green dragons, who in turn granted those elves strange new powers.  Though the elves did not and do not worship those dragons, the peace accords they crafted last to this day, long after those who signed them died.  Every descendent of a forestlord can be one, although this is far from certain, as the traits themselves are unpredictable.  Physically, they appear much like regular elves, but can be easily distinguished by their smooth green skin, similar to green dragon scales.  Most have green hair as well, though occasionally it can be anywhere from brown to white.

Forestlord Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Con.
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass forestlord elf's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Forestlord Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Treewalk: Once per day, Forestlord Elves can step through a nearby tree and emerge by any tree up to 60' away, as the Dimension Door spell.  They can use this ability one additional time per day for every 5HD they have.
- Dragonblooded: Forestlord Elves have the dragonblood subtype.
- Elven: Forestlord Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

dst: 现已查明，卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔参与了变形蛛与噬火武僧及其各方盟友蹂躏卡林杉的计划。他还打算利用泽法德之剑或其最初的目的——释放卡利姆与门农，这很可能会给这片土地带来巨大的灾难。他的女儿卡齐娅对他的计划感到不安，将此事告知了我们，并提出如果我们能穿过下水道和黑暗卡林港抵达泽卡尔塔，就让我们进入。\n\n卡齐娅让我们进入了泽卡尔塔，但事先要我们发誓不杀她父亲，只从他手中夺走那把剑。此后我们便一路向塔顶前进寻找他。途中，我们遇到了乌尔·萨哈卜的阿巴亚拉之一拉梅尔·加尼尔布，据说他们能预见未来，而他正被囚禁着。他告诉了我们许多关于泽卡尔和那把剑的有趣信息。显然，当那把剑被用来击败恶魔阿兹古尔卡时，它将他困在了某种口袋位面中。此后他一直待在那里，但仍保留了一些通过那把剑影响这个位面的能力（并且保留了更多能力去影响各种与火相关的位面的事件，因为他在那里早已有联系）。这意味着剑的持有者往往会受到恶魔的影响并最终被其控制。这就是泽卡尔的天命，也很大程度上解释了他那些疯狂毁灭性的行为。他还告诉我们，恶魔即将挣脱其位面牢笼并返回主物质位面，一旦发生，很可能会带来灾难。希望我们按计划从泽卡尔手中夺走那把剑，能阻止此事，也能阻止泽卡尔和恶魔利用那把剑挑起的其他麻烦。拉梅尔提到的最后一点，是关于阿巴亚拉们对扎拉拉的各种预言（泽卡尔绑架她是为了了解更多关于这些预言的信息），根据预言，她注定会干扰泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡两人的阴谋，这也导致两人都想要她死。
src: It has now been revealed that Kalomas Zekar was involved in the plans of the aranea and the Consuming Fire monks and their various allies to ravage Calimshan.  He also plans to use the Sword of Zefad or its original purpose of freeing Calim and Memnon, likely unleashing considerable devastation upon the land. His daughter Kadzia, disturbed by his plans, inofrmed us of this and has offered to give us access to the Zekar tower, if we can reach it by traversing a route leading through the sewers and Dark Calimport.\n\nKadzia has let us into the Zekar tower, first extracting from us an oath not to kill her father, but only take the sword from him. Since then we have been proceeding to the very top of the tower to find him. Along the way, we came across one Ramel Ganirb, one of the Abbayalar of Ul'Sahab, who are reputed to be able to see the future, being held prisoner. He told us much interesting information about Zekar and the sword. Apparently when the sword was used to defeat the demon Azghulkar, it trapped him in some sort of pocket plane. There he has been ever since, but has retained some ability to influence this plane through the sword (and retained even more ability to influence events of various fire-related planes where he already had connections). This means that wielders of the sword tend to come under the demon's influence and eventually control. This has been the fate of Zekar, and explains much about his otherwise madly destructive actions. He has also told us that the demon is on the verge of breaking free of his planar prison and returning to the Prime, an event likely to be disastrous if it occurs. Hopefully taking the sword from Zekar, as we already plan, will prevent this as well as the other trouble Zekar and the demon are using the sword to stir up. A final point Ramel made concerned various prophecies of the Abbalayar concerning Zarala (Zekar kidnapped him to find out more about these), according to which she is fated to interfere with the schemes of both Zekar and Azghulkar, and which has caused both to desire her death.

Zeepa has asked me not to kill the dryads, who are being forced to work with the goblins against their will. The dryads are found in the center of the grove, so Zeepa suggests I sneak around the edges to locate Gorav's camp in the northeast, and kill him. Once Gorav is dead the dryads will no longer be hostile and may even assist us. In any case, Zeepa will have a reward.\n\nGorav has been dealt with. dst: 在前往烛堡的途中，我遇到了一位树精，她正与一群信奉风暴与毁灭之神塔洛斯的信徒发生冲突。据树精所说，这些塔洛斯信徒试图获取古代耐瑟瑞尔风暴与毁灭之神科扎的偶像，据信科扎是塔洛斯的一个化身或别名。塔洛斯信徒显然能从这尊偶像中获得强大的力量，鉴于他们信仰的本质，他们无疑会将其用于毁灭性的目的。树精请求我前往北边不远处的这些废墟，亲自取回偶像，以阻止此事。这可能很危险，因为这会让我与这些塔洛斯信徒发生冲突，而且据说偶像本身具有扭曲心智的力量。尽管如此，这似乎是一项值得的冒险。\n\n我一路杀过一些塔洛斯信徒，到达废墟并取回了偶像。我现在已将其存放在纳什凯尔的赫尔姆神殿，因为树精认为这是最佳行动方案。神殿应该有资源妥善处理这件危险的物品。无论如何，它现在已不在我手中。
src: While traveling towards Candlekeep, I came across a dryad who was in conflict with a group devoted to the deity of storms and destruction, Talos. According to the dryad, these Talosians seek to acquire an idol of the ancient Netherese god of storms and destruction Kozah, who is believed to have been an aspect or alias of Talos. The Talosians can apparently gain great power from this idol, which given the nature of their beliefs they will doubtless use for destructive ends. The dryad has asked me to head to these ruins, a little ways to the north, and recover the idol myself, in order to prevent this. This may be dangerous, as it will put me in conflict with these Talosians, and the idol itself is said to have mind-warping powers. Nevertheless, it seems a worthy quest.\n\nI fought through some Talosians to reach the ruins and recover the idol. I have now deposited it with the temple of Helm in Nashkel, as the dryad thought that the best course of action. The temple should have the resources to properly deal with this dangerous object. At any rate, it is now out of my hands.

It is one of two such pillars, with the other being somewhere nearby on the other side, in the Abyss. 如果你想将漩涡瞄准一个特定生物，你可以进行远程接触攻击来击中该生物。如果你成功，与漩涡的直接接触对该生物造成 8d6 点伤害（无豁免）.

无论你的远程接触攻击是否击中（即使你放弃攻击），区域内的所有生物（包括可能被直接接触伤害的那个） 都会被卷起并猛烈抛掷，对每个生物造成 17d6 点伤害。成功进行反射豁免的生物受到一半伤害。

被抛掷后，每个受影响的生物发现自己位于距离其原始位置 1d4 x 10 英尺的随机方向的新位置。墙壁和其他障碍物可以限制这种重新定位；在这种情况下，生物最终位于障碍物旁边。

增幅：你每额外花费 1 点异能点，此异能的区域伤害（不是对特定生物直接接触造成的伤害） 增加 1d6 点。每额外 2d6 点伤害，此异能的豁免 DC 增加 1。
src:
Psychokinesis
Level: Kineticist 9
Manifesting Time: 1 round
Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area: 40-ft.-radius spread
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text
Power Resistance: No
Power Points: 17
Metapsionics: Empower, Maximize, Twin, Widen

You induce the formation of a slender vortex of fiercely swirling air. When you manifest it, a vortex of air visibly and audibly snakes out from your outstretched hand.

If you want to aim the vortex at a specific creature, you can make a ranged touch attack to strike the creature. If you succeed, direct contact with the vortex deals 8d6 points of damage to the creature (no save).

Regardless of whether your ranged touch attack hits (and even if you forgo the attack), all creatures in the area (including the one possibly damaged by direct contact) are picked up and violently dashed about, dealing 17d6 points of damage to each one. Creatures that make a successful Reflex save take half damage.

After being dashed about, each creature that was affected finds itself situated in a new space 1d4 x 10 feet away from its original space in a random direction. Walls and other barriers can restrict this relocation; in such a case, the creature ends up adjacent to the barrier.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, this power's area damage (not the damage from direct contact dealt to a specific creature) increases by 1d6 points. For each extra 2d6 points of damage, this power's save DC increases by 1.

dst: 在前往星尖山脉的途中，我遇到了一位名叫布雷戈·宽脚的半身人冒险者。他正在寻求帮助，想要打倒一群由哈扬·克罗率领的、从雇佣兵变成强盗的家伙。显然，布雷戈的表亲布蕾娜曾是这群强盗的一员，但她改变了主意，正从内部暗中破坏他们。不幸的是，最近她的联络中断了，布雷戈担心强盗们可能已经发现了她的背叛。他现在打算袭击强盗，并根据情况营救或为他的表亲复仇。我已同意帮助布雷戈，他说作为回报，一旦我们了结此事，他会协助我们完成自己的任务。强盗们占据了一座堡垒，位于西边。\n\n我们通过一条穿过强盗堡垒下方洞穴的路径，进入了堡垒下方的地牢，并在那里找到了被囚禁的布蕾娜。为了救她出来，我们需要前往东南方的一个房间，并用布蕾娜给我们的钥匙进入。在这个房间里，我们可以使用拉杆解锁堡垒周围的几扇门，包括布蕾娜牢房的门。一旦那扇门解锁，我们就可以去接她，然后带她到西南方的一个房间，这个房间也由拉杆解锁，她被没收的武器和一些其他装备就藏在那里，这样她就能重新武装自己，准备战斗。之后，布蕾娜告诉我们，我们需要回到堡垒下方的洞穴，找到一条现在由拉杆解锁的、通往一座古老陵墓的路径。在那里，我们必须追捕一支意图洗劫这座陵墓的强盗探险队，并从指挥他们的军官身上取下一把钥匙。这把钥匙将让我们打开挡住通往下一层楼梯的门，我们需要到达那里，才能最终击败所有这些强盗。
src: While traveling towards the Starspire mountains, I encountered a halfling adventurer named Brego Broadfoot. He was seeking assistance in bringing down a group of mercenaries turned bandits run by one Haryan Krow. Apparently Brego's cousin, Brena, was a member of this bandit group but thought better of it, and was working to undermine them from within. Unfortunately, communications from her recently ceased, and Brego fears the bandits may have discovered her betrayal. He now seeks to assail the bandits and either rescue or avenge his cousin, depending on which proves necessary. I have agreed to help Brego, and he has said that in return, once we are finished with this matter, he will assist us on our own quest. The bandits have occupied a fortress that can be found to the west.\n\nWe have found our way into the dungeon beneath the bandit's fortress, by following a path through some caves underneath it, and there found Brena imprisoned. To get her out, we will need to proceed to a room to the southeast, and enter it using a key Brena gave us. In this room we can use levers to unlock several doors around the fortress, including that to Brena's cell. Once that door is unlocked, we can go get her and then take her to a room to the southwest, also unlocked by the levers, where her confiscated weapons and some other equipment of hers was stashed, so that she can re-equip herself and be ready for combat. After that, Brena has told us that we need to go back to the caves under the fortress, and find a path, now unlocked by the levers, that goes down to an old tomb. There we must hunt down a bandit expedition intending to loot this tomb, and take a key off the officer commanding it. This key will allow us to open the door barring the stairs to the next level, which we will need to reach to finally defeat all these bandits.

dst: "你现在已经完成了我交给你的所有任务，而且做得比我期望的还要多。你现在应该回到帕夏加尔哈德尔那里去了，因为我已经没有理由再向他借用你的效力了。哦，还有一件事我或许可以提一下，以略微报答你给予我们的帮助，因为我注意到你是一名武僧：我知道破碎者中的一员，伊尔梅特的一位武僧，一位名叫伊拉姆的隐士，住在城墙外的沙漠里。他有时会为找到他的武僧提供训练和指导。这把钥匙能帮你找到他。"
src: "You have now accomplished all the tasks I set before you, and indeed done more than I could have hoped. You should return to Pasha Galhadr now, as I no longer have any excuse to borrow your services from him. Oh, there is one other thing I might mention to in some small measure repay the aid you have given us, since I notice you are a monk: I know of one of the Broken Ones, one of the monks of Ilmater, a hermit named Iram living in the desert outside the city walls. He sometimes offers training and instruction to monks who find their way to him. Here is a key that will help you reach him."

Range: Personal
Target: You

Power Points: 1

Your posture becomes stooped forward, and you grow a muzzle complete with fangs. You gain a bite attack, that deals 1d8 points of damage (assuming you are a Medium creature) when it hits.

Your bite attack is a natural weapon, so you are considered armed when attacking with it, and it can be affected by powers, spells, and effects that enhance or improve natural weapons.

If you are not a Medium creature, your bite attack's base damage varies as follows: Fine 1d2, Diminutive 1d3, Tiny 1d4, Small 1d6, Large 2d6, Huge 2d8, Gargantuan 4d6, Colossal 6d6.

Based on your psychic warrior level, your bite increases in ferocity as noted here: at 5th level your bite deals an extra 1d8 points of damage, at 10th level an extra 2d8, at 15th level an extra 3d8, and at 20th level an extra 4d8 points.

当你接触目标生物时，它必须进行强韧豁免。如果成功，它不受此法咒影响。

如果失败，它的皮肤变得半透明并微微发光，生物被定身，无助地站立。受术者意识清醒且呼吸正常，但不能进行任何物理动作，甚至不能说话。然而，它可以执行纯粹的精神动作（例如使用类法术能力）.此效果类似于人类人类定身术。

你每轮维持此法咒，该生物必须再次尝试强韧豁免。如果豁免失败，它受到1d6点永久体质吸取。然而，你每轮维持此法咒，你受到1d6点非致命

src:
Tomb of Light
Transmutation [Good]
Level: Clr 7, Sor/Wiz 7
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 1 round
Range: Touch
Target: Evil extraplanar creature touched
Duration: Concentration
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial
Spell Resistance: Yes

When you cast this spell, you attempt to draw out the impure substance of an evil extraplanar creature and replace it with your own pure substance. The spell is draining for you to cast, but it is deadly to evil outsiders and other extraplanar creatures with the taint of evil.

When you touch the target creature, it must make a Fortitude saving throw. If it succeeds, it is unaffected by the spell.

If it fails, its skin becomes translucent and faintly radiant and the creature is immobilized, standing helpless. The subject is aware and breathes normally, but cannot take any physical actions, even speech. It can, however, execute purely mental actions (such as using a spell-like ability). The effect is similar to hold person.

Each round you maintain the spell, the creature must attempt another Fortitude save. If it fails the save, it takes 1d6 points of permanent Constitution drain. Each round you maintain the spell, however, you take 1d6 points of non-lethal
damage. If you fall unconscious, or if the creature succeeds at its Fortitude save, the spell ends.

Material Component: A pure crystal or clear gemstone worth at least 50 gp.

src: Blimfin Zemquin, proprietor of a Calimport magic shop, has told about a machine he set up in the sewers to process the sewer water, extract useful material from it, and pump it up to his shop. Unfortunately, the machine appears to have stopped working recently, and because of the danger of wererats in the sewers, Blimfin dare not check on it himself. He has asked me to investigate the problem for him. He will pay me something simply for information about what the problem is, but even more if I somehow manage to repair the machine and get it working again.\n\nI reported to Blimfin that his contraption had been sabotaged by the sewer's wererats, and he rewarded me for finding this out. Repairs to the mechanism will have to wait until the sewers are a bit safer.

dst:
我见到了可怕的扎加什，一个巫妖，我竟然发现他住在沙漠巨龙客栈的一个房间里。他向我提出了一个有趣的提议。显然，那些似乎在策划对卡林杉发动战争的变形蛛不知怎么发现了他的命匣。他们利用对命匣的控制削弱了扎加什并降低了他的力量，并打算用摧毁命匣（从而彻底消灭他）的威胁来勒索他为他们的事业服务。然而扎加什无意让他们摆布，并想出了一个计划，伪装成一群冒险者去对抗他们。因此，他准备加入我在城外对抗变形蛛各种类人盟友的任务。

我接受了他的提议，扎加什现在将作为同伴与我同行。我期待他会是一个有价值的盟友。

扎加什在变形蛛和他们的鼠人盟友的一个基地中找回了他的命匣。力量恢复后，他认为不再需要继续做我的同伴，便传送离开了。
src:
I have met with Zagash the Terrible, a lich who I discovered occupying a room at the Desert Dragon Inn, of all places. He had an interesting offer to make me. Apparently the aranea who are seemingly orchestrating a war against Calimshan somehow discovered his phylactery. They have used their control of it to weaken Zagash and reduce his power, and intend to use the threat of destroying it (and therefore him) for good to blackmail him into serving their cause. Zagash however has no intention of letting them order him around and has conceived a plan to travel in disguise with a group of adventurers to fight against them. As a result, he is prepared to join with me on my quests outside the city to fight the various humanoid allies of the aranea.

I have accepted his offer, and Zagash will now be traveling with me as a companion. I expect he will be a valuable ally.

Zagash recovered his phylactery, in a base of the aranea and their wererat allies. His power restored, he saw no further need of continuing as my companion and teleported away.
