src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)Shadowblades are martial combatants with an innate link to shadow. While some deliberately study the arts of shadow, most develop their abilities instinctively, making them more akin to shadowdancers than shadowcasters. Those who master the arts of the unseen weapon become warriors with
few equals. Their ability to manipulate darkness and shadow enhances their martial skills, allowing them to target weak points, land blows that should not strike true, and even attack foes who are paces away.

- Hit Die: d8
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Base Attack Bonus: +5
Skills: Bluff 5 ranks, Hide 5 ranks, Move Silently 5 ranks
Feats: Blind-Fight

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Unseen Weapon (Unerring Strike) - Once per day per shadowblade level, you can activate one of the powers of your unseen weapon. Your next melee attack ignores any miss chance because of concealment.
2:  Shadow and Stealth - You gain a bonus equal to half your class level (round down) on Hide and Move Silently checks.
    Sneak Attack +1d6
3:  Darkvision
    Unseen Weapon (Unexpected Strike) - Your opponent is denied its Dexterity bonus against your next melee attack.
4:  Sneak Attack +2d6
5:  Unseen Weapon (Ephemeral Weapon) - Your next melee attack deals an extra 2d6 points of damage, as extraplanar darkness momentarily replaces portions of your opponent's body.
6:  Sneak Attack +3d6
7:  Ultravision
    Unseen Weapon (Shadowy Strike) - Your next melee attack is resolved as a melee touch attack.
8:  Sneak Attack +4d6
9:  Unseen Weapon (Far Shadow) - Your melee reach is increased by 10 feet for 1 round.
10: Sneak Attack +5d6

我们已解决了泰坦帮，凯勒姆如今已经离去。我现在可以返回伊尔梅特神殿，报告此任务已完成。

我向纳西拉克报告了凯勒姆获救一事，他听闻后很是高兴。
src:
Kelem Ishadin is a paladin of Ilmater who was sent to fight the Titan gang earlier, and has not been heard from since. Likely he fell in battle against them, but this is not known with certainty, so while fighting the Titans Nasirak wants me to keep an eye out for any signs of his fate, and bring word to him if I discover what happened to him.

I have found Kelem, who had been captured by the Titan gang. Now that I have liberated him, he has joined with me to assist me in fighting the remaining Titans. He possesses a key that will open the path to the sewers down which they have fled, and should I need it can also help me in disarming the traps with which this route is said to be covered.

We have dealt with the Titan gang, and Kelem has now departed. I can now return to the Temple of Ilmater and report this mission as accomplished.

I reported Kel's rescue to Nasriak, who was pleased to hear of it.

dst:
在穿越沙漠行进了几天之后，萨曼的车队遭到了一群强盗的袭击。当我冲过去加入战斗时，我的手下扎拉拉用闪电束射中了我的后背，使我身受重伤，无法协助击退他们。濒死之际，我被一个神秘存在拉到了气元素位面。不用说，以这种丢脸的方式被赶出战斗，我可不高兴。

我回到车队所在地，发现所有人都死了，货车也在燃烧。看来强盗们赢了。不过，我还遇到了一位欧格玛的牧师，卡达斯·奥拉祖尔，他从附近的营地赶来查看浓烟。他告诉我，强盗带着两名俘虏离开了，萨曼和扎拉拉。既然我最近才受命保护扎拉拉，我想我必须设法救她，而救出萨曼似乎是我从这次冒险中获得任何收益的唯一希望。强盗们向西逃去，我应该能循着他们的踪迹追回他们的基地。如果我的营救成功，我应该去车队东边卡达斯的营地，因为那是这片沙漠附近唯一的避难处。

我循着强盗穿越沙漠的踪迹一路追击，终于来到了他们的基地。想必萨曼和扎拉拉被囚禁在里面的某处。如果我不得不杀光所有强盗才能救出他们，我希望自己能经受住这个挑战。
"所以又该我来干所有的活？唉，好吧，就当这让我能第一个挑战利品。我会立刻开始追捕剩下的海盗。"
src: "So once again I'm supposed to do all the work? Ah, well, guess it gives me the first crack at any loot.  I'll start hunting for any pirates who are left at once."

dst: 在探索黑暗卡林港时，我遇到了一群狗头人。这群狗头人没有攻击我，看起来相当和平，但他们的首领告诉我，他们可能不会一直保持这样。看来他们一直受到一只巨魔的困扰，这只巨魔杀死了他们许多人，于是他们与侵扰卡林港下水道的凶暴鼠人达成了协议。鼠人告诉狗头人，他们会帮忙对付巨魔，但作为回报，狗头人必须加入他们，一同向卡林港发动战争。狗头人首领觉得别无选择，只能同意。不过，我主动提出由我来杀死那只巨魔。如果我能做到，并把巨魔的头带给他，首领承诺他不会与鼠人结盟，还会把他收集的一些财宝奖赏给我。这只巨魔在狗头人营地以西的区域游荡。我应当确保自己拥有能造成足够火焰或强酸伤害、以克服其再生能力的手段后，尽快出发去猎杀它。\n\n我杀死了巨魔，把它的头带回去交给了狗头人酋长，但当我这么做时，才发现他之前对他们有多和平并不诚实。事实上，他们骗我替他们杀了巨魔，这样他们就能向鼠人索要更好的报酬，而他们本来就打算加入鼠人。他们还试图取下我的头，一并献给鼠人。我想我必须记住，至少在某些时候，怪物确实符合它们的名声。
src: While exploring Dark Calimport, I came across a group of kobolds. This particular group did not attack me and seemed peaceful enough, but their chief told me that they might not remain that way. It seems they have been having a problem with a troll who has been killing many of them, and they made a deal with the aggressive wererats infesting Calimport's sewers. The wererats told the kobolds that they would help deal with the troll, but in return the kobolds are to join them in making war against Calimport. The kobold chief felt he had no choice but to agree with this. However, I have offered to slay the troll myself. If I can accomplish this and bring the troll's head to him, the chief has promised that he will not ally with the wererats, and reward me with some treasure he has collected as well. This troll wanders the regions to the west of the kobold encampment. I should set out to hunt it down as soon as I have made certain I possess some means of delivering enough fire or acid damage to overcome its regenerative powers.\n\nI slew the troll and took its head back to the kobold chieftan, but when I did it turned out he had been less than honest with me about how peaceful they were. In fact, they tricked me into killing the troll for them so they could demand a better payment from the wererats, who they intended in any event to join. They also tried to take my head to present it to the wererats as well. I suppose I must remember that at least some of the time monstrous creatures actually do conform to their reputations.

On top of that, they smashed my nice new crossbow to bits."

dst: 扎拉拉的父亲哈马德·加尔哈德尔出现了。原来，与扎拉拉告诉我的相反，他并没有真的想强迫她接受包办婚姻。而且他是一位可敬的提尔圣武士，而不是我被误导相信的恶棍。他将带扎拉拉回家，所以看来我们共同的冒险已经结束了，至少暂时如此。不过，他告诉我他有一个提议要给我。如果这能让我留在扎拉拉身边，我大概应该接受，因为我认为我在气元素位面的神秘联系人仍然期望我保护她。我可以在卡达斯的营地找到他。
src: Zarala's father, Hamad Galhadr, has shown up. It turns out that, contrary to what Zarala told me, he was not really trying to force her into an arranged marriage. Furthermore he is an honorable Paladin of Tyr, not the villain I was led to believe. He will be taking Zarala home with him, so it seems our adventures together have come to an end, at least for the time being. However, he has told me that he has an offer to make me. If it allows me to stay close to Zarala, I should probably accept, for I assume my mysterious contacts from the Plane of Air still expect me to protect her. I can find him back at Kadath's camp.

dst: "谢谢你。你能告诉我这骨灰瓮有什么意义或里面装了什么吗？我很好奇。"
src: "Thank you. Can you tell me anything about the significance or contents of this urn? I am rather curious."

dst: "然而事实并非如此，原因有很多，但最重要的是我们并非没有敌人，那些敌人的力量与我们相当，甚至更强。因此我们的力量是有限的，既受制于他们能对我们施加的制约，也受制于为限制我们战争规模而订立的条约与协议，这些条约限制了我们在你们位面上所能尝试的事情。这一切意味着，如果我们直接试图夺取你们世界命运的控制权，就会遭到反对，而这种反对我们未必能够克服。"
src: "That is not the case, however, for various reasons, but most of all because we are not without enemies, enemies whose power is as great, or even greater, than our own. Our power is thus limited, both by what they could do to check us, as well as by treaties and agreements set to limit the extent of our warfare, restricting what we may attempt on your plane. What this all means is that a direct attempt on our parts to wrest control of your world's destiny would meet with opposition, opposition that we would not necessarily be able to overcome."

dst:
阿蒙，祭坛前的虚空
  
尽管阿蒙曾作为光明与正义的神祇统治，但他作为残迹的漫长存在已将他扭曲成一个被愤怒吞噬的怪物。他赐予召唤他的人他的视觉，他的火焰吐息以及他强大的冲锋。 

残迹等级：1级
束缚DC: 20
特殊要求：阿蒙特别憎恨另外四个残迹：丘波克洛普斯，欧律诺墨，卡苏斯和勒拉杰。如果你当前寄宿着这些灵魂之一，阿蒙拒绝回应你的召唤。同样，如果你已经束缚了阿蒙，这些灵魂也不会回应你的召唤。

影响：阿蒙的影响使你脾气暴躁易怒。此外，由于阿蒙鄙视火，太阳和法则的活神，他迫使你抵抗那些献身于此类力量的人施放的有益法咒。你必须进行豁免检定来抵抗这样的法咒；失败则允许你获得其益处。

授予能力：
阿蒙赐予你他的视觉和吐息，以及致命地使用他的角。

黑暗视觉：你获得60英尺的黑暗视觉。

火焰吐息：你可以作为一个标准动作喷出一道火焰。该线形区域延伸每有效缚灵者等级10英尺（最大50英尺），并对区域内的每个生物造成每缚灵者等级1d6点火焰伤害。成功的反射豁免使伤害减半。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内不能再次使用。

冲撞攻击：你可以使用从阿蒙印记获得的公羊角作为天生武器，造成1d6点伤害（加上1-1/2倍你的力量加值）.当你用冲撞攻击冲锋一个敌人时，成功命中造成额外1d8点伤害。
src:
Amon, the Void Before the Altar
  
Although Amon once ruled as a deity of light and justice, his long existence as a vestige has twisted him into a monster consumed by wrath. He grants those who summon him his sight, his fiery breath, and his powerful charge.  

Vestige Level: 1st
Binding DC: 20
Special Requirement: Amon particularly despises four other vestiges: Chupoclops, Eurynome, Karsus, and Leraje. If you currently host one of these spirits, Amon refuses to answer your call. Similarly, these spirits will not answer your call if you are already bound to Amon.

Influence: Amon's influence makes you surly and irritable. In addition, since Amon despises living deities of fire, sun, and law, he forces you to resist beneficial spells cast by those devoted to such powers. You must make a saving throw to resist such a spell; failure allows you to gain the benefit.

Granted Abilities: 
Amon grants you his sight and his breath, as well as the deadly use of his horns.

Darkvision: You gain darkvision out to 60 feet.

Fire Breath: You can vomit forth a line of fire as a standard action. The line extends 10 feet per effective binder level (maximum 50 feet) and deals 1d6 points of fire damage per binder level to every creature in its area. A successful Reflex save halves this damage. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Ram Attack: You can use the ram's horns that you gain from Amon's sign as a natural weapon that deals 1d6 points of damage (plus 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus). When you charge a foe with your ram attack, you deal an extra 1d8 points of damage on a successful hit.

dst: 在这张桌子上，你发现了一本似乎由法师纳西利库斯·哈维利格·尼恩不定期更新的日志。看起来他致力于研究用魔法手段控制各种史莱姆和软泥怪，将它们变成法师用来增强自身力量的有用仆从，同时也在研究用魔法将这些生物变异成更强大或更有用的形态的方法。粗略翻阅之下，你发现其中与你相关的内容寥寥无几，还有大量令人乏味的偏执狂言，但有几段文字确实引起了你的注意。
src: On this table, you find what appears to be an irregularly updated journal being kept by the mage Narcillicus Harwilliger Neen. It appears that he is dedicated to research into magical methods of controlling various kinds of slimes and oozes, turning them into useful minions for a mage seeking to increase his power, as well as looking into methods to magically mutate such creatures into more powerful or useful forms. Skimming through it, you find little that is relevant to you, and a tedious number of paranoid rants, but a couple of passages do catch your eye.

死灵系 [死亡]
等级：牧师 8，术士/法师 8
成分：言语，姿势，材料
施法时间：10分钟
距离：0英尺；见文本
效果：一个徽记
持续时间：见文本
豁免检定：强韧否定
法术抗力：是

此法咒允许你在表面上刻写一个强大的力量符文。当触发时，死亡徽记会杀死60英尺内一个或多个生物（视为速度爆发），其当前总生命值不超过150.死亡徽记先影响最近的生物，跳过生命值过多而无法影响的生物。一旦触发，徽记变为活跃并发光，持续每施法者等级10分钟，或直到它影响了总生命值150的生物，以先到者为准。任何在死亡徽记活跃期间进入区域的生物都会受到其影响，无论该生物在触发时是否在区域内。只要生物留在区域内，只需对徽记豁免一次，但如果它离开区域并在徽记仍活跃时返回，则必须再次豁免。

直到触发前，死亡徽记是未激活的（尽管在60英尺距离内可见且可读）.为了有效，死亡徽记必须始终放置在显眼且突出的位置。覆盖或隐藏符文会使死亡徽记无效，除非生物移除覆盖物，在这种情况下死亡徽记正常工作。

死亡徽记可以通过成功针对符文的解除魔法移除。抹消术对死亡徽记无效。摧毁刻有死亡徽记的表面会摧毁徽记但也会触发它。

材料成分
汞和磷，加上总价值至少5,000 gp的钻石和蛋白石粉末。
src:
Necromancy [Death]
Level: Clr 8, Sor/Wiz 8
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 10 minutes
Range: 0 ft.; see text
Effect: One symbol
Duration: See text
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

This spell allows you to scribe a potent rune of power upon a surface. When triggered, a symbol of death slays one or more creatures within 60 feet of the symbol (treat as a burst) whose combined total current hit points do not exceed 150. The symbol of death affects the closest creatures first, skipping creatures with too many hit points to affect. Once triggered, the symbol becomes active and glows, lasting for 10 minutes per caster level or until it has affected 150 hit points' worth of creatures, whichever comes first. Any creature that enters the area while the symbol of death is active is subject to its effect, whether or not that creature was in the area when it was triggered. A creature need save against the symbol only once as long as it remains within the area, though if it leaves the area and returns while the symbol is still active, it must save again.

Until it is triggered, the symbol of death is inactive (though visible and legible at a distance of 60 feet). To be effective, a symbol of death must always be placed in plain sight and in a prominent location. Covering or hiding the rune renders the symbol of death ineffective, unless a creature removes the covering, in which case the symbol of death works normally.

A symbol of death can be removed by a successful dispel magic targeted solely on the rune. An erase spell has no effect on a symbol of death. Destruction of the surface where a symbol of death is inscribed destroys the symbol but also triggers it.

Material Component
Mercury and phosphorus, plus powdered diamond and opal with a total value of at least 5,000 gp each.

你将魂能塑造成一对末端带有短爪的毛皮手套。这些手套可以套在你的手上，也可以套在你可能佩戴的任何其他手套或护手之上。当你握紧拳头时，你能感到一股愤怒和决心在体内涌起。

当生命值降至0时，你可以如同未处于伤残状态般行动。在0生命值时执行标准动作或其他剧烈动作不会使你失去1点生命值。当生命值降至-1到-9时，你不会陷入昏迷。在-1到-9生命值时，你不会每轮自动失去1点生命值。当你的当前生命值降至-10或更低时，你立即死亡。

魂能点：将魂能点投入怒爪会增加你可以继续活动的负生命值范围。每投入1点魂能点，有效降低你死亡的临界值3点（例如从-10降至-13）. 你可以继续无惩罚战斗直到达到该生命值总数。

脉轮绑定（手部） 

你怒爪的毛皮融入你的双手，你的指尖长出小而黑的爪子取代指甲。每一次落在你身上的打击都会激起你体内的血怒，不断积累直到你濒临死亡，然后爆发出绝望的狂怒。

当你的生命值总数低于每生命骰1点生命值时，你在近战攻击检定，近战武器伤害检定和强韧豁免上获得+2士气加值。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

你怒爪的毛皮融入你的双手，你的指尖长出长而锋利的爪子，你可以用它们撕裂敌人的血肉。

你可以将你的怒爪用作一对造成1d6点伤害加上你的力量调整值的天然武器。当你擒抱对手时，你可以用双爪攻击；这些攻击不受擒抱中使用天然武器通常的-4惩罚。每投入1点魂能点到该灵魂融合中，你的爪子在攻击检定和伤害检定上获得+1增强加值。
src:
Rageclaws

Descriptors: Mind-Affecting  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Hands (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You form incarnum into a pair of furred gloves tipped with short claws. These gloves fit over your hands as well as any other gloves or gauntlets you might wear. When you clench your hands into fists, you can feel a surge of anger and determination well up inside you.

When reduced to 0 hit points, you can act as if you weren't disabled. You do not lose 1 hit point for performing a standard or otherwise strenuous action while at 0 hit points. When reduced to -1 to -9 hit points, you do not fall unconscious. You do not automatically lose 1 hit point each round when at -1 to -9 hit points. When your current hit points drop to -10 or lower, you immediately die. 

Essentia: Investing essentia in rageclaws increases the range of negative hit points at which you can continue functioning. Every point of essentia invested effectively reduces the point at which you die by 3 (such as from -10 to -13). You can continue to fight without penalty until you reach that hit point total. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

The fur of your rageclaws merges into your hands, and your fingers become tipped with small, dark claws instead of nails. Each blow that lands on your body causes a blood rage to swell up in you, building until you are near death and then erupting in desperate fury.

While your hit point total is below 1 hit point per hit dice, you gain a +2 morale bonus on melee attack rolls, melee weapon damage rolls, and Fortitude saves. 

Chakra Bind (Totem)

The fur of your rageclaws merges into your hands, and your fingers become tipped with long, sharp claws you can use to tear the flesh of your foes.

You can use your rageclaws as a pair of natural weapons that deal 1d6 points of damage plus your Strength modifier. When you grapple an opponent, you can attack with both claws; these attacks are not subject to the usual -4 penalty for attacking with a natural weapon in a grapple. You gain a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with your claws for every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld.

BONUS DIVINE SPELLS

src:
The Temple of Tyr has dispatched a group of clerics and paladins into the sewers beneath the temple district in an attempt to fight the newly aggressive wererats causing trouble there. They have yet to report back. Adaras Efzen, a high-ranking cleric in the Temple of Tyr, has asked me to enter the sewers and determine what has happened to them, assisting them if necessary. Ferazha, priestess at the temple of Shar, wants me to follow in their wake, determine their fate, and insure that none of them make it out of the sewer alive. I will have to decide whether I wish to assist these Tyrrans or kill them.

The entire party of Tyrrans dispatched to the sewers has met its end. This has been reported to both Adaras and Ferazha, and I have been rewarded by both. The path of neutrality has its advantages.

3：
4：专长 - 奥术增幅 - 消耗一个法咒来提升某些能力。
5：专长 - 战斗奥术师 - 如果你的基础攻击加值高于施法者等级，则使用基础攻击加值作为你的施法者等级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The abjurant champion focuses his arcane abilities both to augment his personal defense and to hinder enemy spellcasters. Perfectly suited for martial stalwarts who dabble in magic, this class offers characters the ability to improve their combat skills in ways neither soldiers nor spellcasters can.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: An Abjurant Champion gains no armor or weapon proficiency.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Feats: Combat Casting.
Spellcasting: Must be able to cast 1st-level arcane spells.
Special: Must be proficient with at least one martial weapon.

CLASS FEATURES:

Spellcasting: At each level, you gain new spells per day and an increase in caster level (and spells known, if applicable) as if you had also gained a level in an arcane spellcasting class to which you belonged before adding the prestige class level. You do not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained. If you had more than one arcane spellcasting class before becoming an abjurant champion, you must decide to which class to add each level for the purpose of determining spells per day, caster level, and spells known.

Level
1: Feat - Abjurant Armor - Any time you cast an abjuration spell that grants you an armor bonus or shield bonus to AC, you can increase the value of the bonus by your abjurant champion class level.
   Feat - Extended Abjuration - Any abjuration spell you cast is extended.
2: Feat - Swift Abjuration - You cast Abjuration spells as a swift action (NOT IMPLEMENTED).
3: 
4: Feat - Arcane Boost - Expend a spell to improve some abilities.
5: Feat - Martial Arcanist - Use your base attack bonus as your caster level if it is the higher of the two.

作为少数被认为能与任何龙类快速成为伙伴的种族之一，猎石侏儒是铜龙偏爱的民族。由于铜龙喜欢恶作剧，谜语和捣蛋，这与侏儒的生活观很契合，所以他们相处融洽并不奇怪。回应这种情感的侏儒被称为猎石者，因为这两个种族经常一起狩猎。铜龙经常在猎石侏儒村庄下方筑巢，随着时间推移，侏儒在外观上变得更像龙类，而铜龙对凡人更加喜爱。在生理上，他们看起来像大多数其他侏儒，但他们的皮肤非常深，在阳光下呈现铜色光泽。

猎石侏儒属性调整：+2 体质，-2 力量。
天赋职业（巡林客）：兼职猎石侏儒的巡林客职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

- 对爬虫类的攻击训练：对爬虫类人生物的攻击检定获得+1种族加值。
- 对地精类的攻击训练：对地精类（地精，大地精和熊地精）的攻击检定获得+1种族加值。
- 对巨人的防御训练：对巨人的AC获得+4闪避加值。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得+2种族加值。
- 技能亲和（专注）：专注检定获得+2种族加值。
- 微光视觉：允许他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 龙血：猎石侏儒具有龙血亚种。
- 侏儒：在法咒效果上，猎石侏儒视为侏儒。
src:
One of the few races considered to be fast companions of any kind of dragon, stonehunter gnomes are the favored people of copper dragons.  Since the coppers' love of pranks, riddles, and mischief fit well with the gnomes' outlook on life, it should be no surprise they get along well.  The gnomes who return this sentiment are known as stonehunters, as the two races frequently meet to hunt together.  Copper dragons often make their lairs beneath stonehunter gnome villages, and over time while the gnomes become more dragonlike in appearance the coppers grow fonder of the mortals.  Physically they tend to look like most other gnomes, but for their very dark skin that takes on a coppery sheen in sunlight.

Stonehunter Gnomish Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass stonehunter gnome's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Offensive Training vs. Reptilians: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against reptilian humanoids.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Concentration): +2 racial bonus to Concentration checks.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Dragonblooded: Stonehunter Gnomes have the dragonblood subtype.
- Gnomish: Stonehunter Gnomes count as Gnomes for the purpose of spells.

Taking out Haryan Krow and Rendo Muddenleaf is a bit more than I think I could do all by myself, but with the help of a few other experienced adventurers it should be possible. So, do you think you could help me out with this? In return, I think I could stick around afterwards and lend you some help with whatever you came out here to do."

dst:
（进阶职业）
魂术师起源于最后守望法师的奥术实验，是一群擅长将灵魂能量融入魔法的奥术施法者。那些仍隶属于最后守望的魂术师居住在正能量位面的水晶宫殿中，在那里不懈地对抗邪恶恶魔王子的阴谋。然而，这个进阶职业的其他成员已将如何将魂能与奥术魔法结合的知识带到了世界上，并将其用于更实际的用途。

此职业将魂术师和灵魂显能者两个进阶职业合并为一条线。根据选择的不同，需求和能力有细微差别。

- 生命骰：d4
- 武器和防具擅长：魂术师不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

需求：

技能：知识 8 级。
塑魂：能够塑造三个灵魂融合；能够将灵魂融合绑定到脉轮。
魂术师：魂能塑法和 2 级奥术法咒
灵魂显能者：蔚蓝天赋和 2 级异能

职业特性：

等级
1：奥术或灵能投资 1
2：
3：脉轮绑定（冠，足，手）
4：
5：
6：
7：奥术或灵能投资 2
8：脉轮绑定（臂，额，肩）
9：
10：魔法或灵能蒸馏

额外法咒：

每级，魂术师获得新的每日法咒或异能，如同在奥术施法或显能职业上也提升了一级。

额外塑魂：

在每个魂术师等级，你提升你的塑魂者等级，你能塑造的灵魂融合数量，你能创建的脉轮绑定数量以及你的魂能池，如同在获得魂术师等级之前所属的塑魂职业上提升了一级。然而，你不会获得该职业的任何其他能力，例如新的脉轮绑定层级。

投资：

魂术师：从 1 级开始，你可以将魂能投资到你的奥术法咒中，使其更强大。你可以选择将 1 点魂能投资到你已知的任何一个法咒中。下次你施放该法咒时，施法者等级和豁免 DC 都增加 1.一旦如此使用，魂能返回你的魂能池，可以投资到灵魂融合或其他效果中。你可以影响的法咒数量等于你的魂术师等级，并且你不能对同一法咒多次投资魂能。在 7 级时，你可以对每个法咒投资最多 2 点魂能，而非仅 1 点。2 点投资使法咒的施法者等级和豁免 DC 在单次施放中各增加 2。

灵魂显能者：从 1 级开始，你可以将魂能投资到你的灵能异能中，使其更强大。你可以选择将 1 点魂能投资到你已知的任何一个异能中。下次你显能该异能时，显能者等级和豁免 DC 都增加 1.一旦如此使用，魂能返回你的魂能池，可以投资到灵魂融合或其他效果中。你可以影响的异能数量等于你的灵魂显能者等级，并且你不能对同一异能多次投资魂能。在 7 级时，你可以对每个异能投资最多 2 点魂能，而非仅 1 点。2 点投资使异能的显能者等级和豁免 DC 在单次显能中各增加 2。

蒸馏：

魂术师：在 10 级时，通过牺牲一个你当前能施放的最高等级的奥术法咒，你获得等于该法咒等级的额外魂能点，持续 1 轮。这些魂能可以正常投资或使用，但在你下一轮开始时消失。此能力每轮可作为自由动作使用一次。

灵魂显能者：在 10 级时，通过支付等于显能你所知的最高等级异能的基础消耗的灵能点，你获得等于该异能等级的魂能点，持续 1 轮。这些魂能可以正常投资或使用，但在你下一回合开始时消失。此能力每轮可作为自由动作使用一次。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
From the arcane experiments of the wizards of the Last Watch arose the soulcasters, a cadre of arcane spellcasters who excel at incorporating soul energy into their magic. Those soulcasters still affiliated with the Last Watch dwell in crystal palaces on the Positive Energy Plane, where they work tirelessly to counter the machinations of the evil demon princes. Other members of this prestige class, however, have brought the knowledge of how to combine incarnum with arcane magic into the world and put it to more practical uses. 

This class combines the Soulcaster and Soulmanifester prestige classes into a single line. The requirements and abilities are subtly different depending on the choice.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Soulcaster does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Lore 8 ranks.
Meldshaping: Ability to shape three soulmelds; ability to bind a soulmeld to a chakra.
Soulcaster: Incarnum Spellshaping and 2nd level arcane spells
Soulmanifester: Azure Talent and 2nd level powers

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Arcane or Psionic Investment 1
2:  
3:  Chakra binds (crown, feet, hands)
4:  
5:  
6:  
7:  Arcane or Psionic Investment 2
8:  Chakra binds (arm, brow, shoulders)
9:  
10: Magic or Psionic Distillation 

BONUS SPELLS:

Each level, the Soulcaster gains new spells or powers per day as if they had also gained a level in their arcane spellcasting or manifesting class. 

BONUS MELDSHAPING:

At each soulcaster level, you increase your meldshaper level, the number of soulmelds you can shape, the number of chakra binds you can create, and your essentia pool as if you had gained a level in a meldshaping class to which you belonged prior to gaining the soulcaster level. You do not, however, gain any other abilities of that class, such as new tiers of chakra binds.

INVESTMENT:

Soulcaster: Beginning at 1st level, you can invest essentia in your arcane spells to make them more powerful. You can choose to invest 1 point of essentia in any single spell that you know. The next time you cast that spell, both the caster level and its save DC increase by 1. Once so used, the essentia returns to your essentia pool and can be invested into soulmelds or other effects. You can affect a number of spells equal to your soulcaster level, and you cannot invest essentia in the same spell more than once. At 7th level, you can invest up to 2 points of essentia in each spell rather than only 1. A 2-point investment boosts the spell's caster level and save DC by 2 each for a single casting.

Soulmanifester: Beginning at 1st level, you can invest essentia in your psionic powers to make them more powerful. You can choose to invest 1 point of essentia in any single power that you know. The next time you manifest that power, both the manifester level and its save DC increase by 1. Once so used, the essentia returns to your essentia pool and can be invested into soulmelds or other effects. You can affect a number of powers equal to your soulmanifester level, and you cannot invest essentia in the same power more than once. At 7th level, you can invest up to 2 points of essentia in each power rather than only 1. A 2-point investment boosts the power's manifester level and save DC by 2 each for a single manifestation.

DISTILLATION:

Soulcaster: At 10th level, by sacrificing one arcane spell of the highest level you can currently cast, you gain points of bonus essentia equal to that spell's level for 1 round. This essentia can be invested or otherwise used as normal, but it disappears at the start of your next round. This ability is usable once per round as a free action.

Soulmanifester: At 10th level, by paying a number of power points equal to the base cost to manifest the highest-level power that you know, you gain points of essentia equal to that power's level for 1 round. This essentia can be invested or otherwise used as normal, but it disappears at the start of your next turn. This ability is usable once per round as a free action.

dst: 哈马德终于把注意力转向了我发现的阴谋：变形蛛正在集结邪恶类人生物大军，准备进攻卡林杉。他收到了证实我发现的报告：地精在镜之森林集结，兽人在行军山脉集结。他建议了两个受到威胁的地点，我可以前往那里增援已经驻扎的士兵：镜之森林附近的特布纳斯村，以及行军山脉山麓的阿哈兹堡。我应该前往城门，从那里向东前往其中一个地点，假以时日或许两个都去。\n\n镜之森林的地精和来自行军山脉的兽人都已被解决，这两群生物都不应再构成太大威胁。此外，在其中一支军队的残骸中，我发现了一张地图，标出了蜘蛛沼泽中一个地点，显示为策划这场战争的变形蛛的主要基地，我把它带给了哈马德。这些信息或许能让我们除掉变形蛛首领，也许能一劳永逸地终结他们挑起的威胁，但若果真如此，那将是另一项任务了。这一项已经结束。
src: Hamad has finally turned his attention to the plot I discovered of aranea raising armies of evil humanoids to attack Calimshan. He has received reports confirming my discoveries: goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs in the Marching Mountains. He has suggested two threatened points that I could travel to in order to reinforce the soldiers already there: the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, and Fort Akhaz, in the foothills of the Marching Mountains. I should make my way to the city gates and from there travel east to one or the other of these locations, and in time perhaps both.\n\nBoth the goblins in the Forest of Mir and the orcs coming from the Marching Mountains have been dealt with, and neither group should pose much of a threat anymore. What's more, amongst the wreckage of one of these armies, I found a map marking a location in the Spider Swamp that is indicated as the main base of the aranea orchestrating this war, and brought it to Hamad. This information may enable us to take out the aranea leaders and perhaps end the threats they are stirring up once and for all, but if so, that will be a different quest. This one is concluded.

（基础职业）
以其无与伦比的勇气和严格的荣誉准则而闻名，武士是封建日本的贵族士兵。武士在战斗中坚韧不拔的名声常常先于他们到达战场，他们仅仅出现就足以让不光彩的敌人悄悄溜走。

- 阵营：任意守序。
- 生命骰：d10
- 擅长：所有简单和军用武器，以及中型和轻型护甲。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

职业技能：专注，手艺，说服，威吓，学识

职业特性：

1级：双刃擅长
2级：双武器战斗
3级：气合斩 1次/天
4级：--
5级：--
6级：瞪视
7级：气合斩 2次/天
8级：精通先攻
9级：--
10级：群体瞪视
11级：精通双武器战斗
12级：气合斩 3次/天
13级：--
14级：精通瞪视
15级：--
16级：高等双武器战斗
17级：气合斩 4次/天
18级：--
19级：--
20级：气势凶猛

双刃擅长（Ex）：在近战中，武士偏好武士刀和胁差（短剑）.许多武士会收到一套传家宝刀，称为双刃。由于武士受过使用它们的训练，他获得武士刀武器擅长作为奖励专长。

气合斩（Ex）：每天一次，3级或更高的武士可以在战斗中发出大喊，激励自己。当武士喊叫时，他的下一次攻击在攻击检定和伤害检定上获得等于其魅力调整值的加值（最低+1）.随着武士升级，他可以更频繁地使用气合斩。

瞪视（Ex）：在6级时，武士能够仅凭存在就让敌人感到恐惧。他在威吓检定上获得+4加值，并且可以使对手士气低落。

群体瞪视（Ex）：在10级时，武士有足够的威仪来威吓多个敌人。使用威吓检定，武士可以用一个动作使30英尺内的所有对手士气低落。

精通瞪视（Ex）：在14级时，即使武士严厉眼神的一瞥也足以让敌人犹豫。瞪视和群体瞪视的效果现在持续5轮，而不是标准的2轮。

气势凶猛（Ex）:20级武士的勇气，荣誉和战斗能力已成为传奇。当武士拔出刀刃时，30英尺内的对手必须成功通过意志豁免（DC 20 + 魅力调整值），否则陷入恐慌4d6轮（如果他们的生命骰为4或更少）或战栗4d6轮（如果他们的生命骰超过4，但少于武士）.生命骰多于武士的生物不受影响。任何成功抵抗此效果的敌人，在24小时内不能再次受到同一武士的气势凶猛影响。
src:
(BASE CLASS)
Known for their matchless bravery and strict code of honor, the samurai were the noble soldiers of feudal Japan. The reputation of samurai for being tenacious in combat often precedes them in battle, and their mere presence is often enough to make dishonorable enemies slink away in the darkness.

- Alignment: Any Lawful.
- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: All simple and martial weapons, with medium and light armor.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS SKILLS: Concentration, Craft, Persuade, Intimidate, Lore

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 1: Daisho Proficiency
Level 2: Two-Weapon Fighting
Level 3: Kiai Smite 1/Day
Level 4: --
Level 5: --
Level 6: Staredown
Level 7: Kiai Smite 2/Day
Level 8: Improved Initiative
Level 9: --
Level 10: Mass Staredown
Level 11: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
Level 12: Kiai Smite 3/Day
Level 13: --
Level 14: Improved Staredown
Level 15: --
Level 16: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting
Level 17: Kiai Smite 4/Day
Level 18: --
Level 19: --
Level 20: Frightful Presence

Daisho Proficiency (Ex): In melee combat, a samurai favors the katana and the wakizashi (a short sword). Many samurai receive an heirloom set of these two blades, known as the daisho. Because a samurai is trained in their use, he gains Katana Weapon Proficiency as a bonus feat.

Kiai Smite (Ex): Once per day, a samurai of 3rd level or higher can give a great cry during combat that invigorates him. When a samurai shouts, his next attack gains a bonus on the attack roll and damage roll equal to his Charisma bonus(minimum +1). As a samurai gains levels, he can make a kiai smite more often.

Staredown (Ex): At 6th level, a samurai becomes able to strike fear into his foes by his mere presence. He gains a +4 bonus on Intimidate checks and can demoralize an opponent.

Mass Staredown (Ex): At 10th level, a samurai has sufficient presence that he can cow multiple foes. Using a Intimidate check, the samurai can demoralize all opponents within 30 feet with a single action.

Improved Staredown (Ex): At 14th level, even a glance from the hard eyes of a samurai is enough to give his foes a pause. The effects of Staredown and Mass Staredown now last 5 rounds instead of the standard 2.

Frightful Presence (Ex): A 20th-level Samurais bravery, honor, and fighting prowess have become legendary. When the samurai draws his blade, opponents within 30 feet must succeed on a Will save(DC 20 + Cha Modifier) or become panicked for 4d6 rounds (if they have 4 or fewer Hit Dice) or shaken for 4d6 rounds (if they have more than 4 Hit Dice, but fewer than the Samurai). Creatures with more Hit Dice then the Samurai are not affected. Any foe that successfully resists the effect cannot be affected again by the same samurai's frightful presence for 24 hours.

巴拉姆，苦楚天使
  
曾经是一个极端善良的存在，巴拉姆在承担了一个不可能的任务并以失败告终后，变成了一个愤怒的残响。她赋予她的召唤者预见未来困难的能力和解读所见之物的智力，以及使用轻武器的技巧和令血肉冻结的凝视。

残响等级：5级
绑定DC:25
特殊要求：巴拉姆要求她的召唤者献祭。在召唤她的过程中，你必须对自己造成1点挥砍伤害。

影响：巴拉姆的影响导致你不信任牧师，圣武士和其他神祇的虔诚信徒。每当你进入神庙或其他神圣或邪恶场所时，巴拉姆要求你在地上吐口水并咒骂该地方。

授予能力：
巴拉姆赋予你预测未来事件的能力。她还教导狡诈和技巧，并赋予你用一瞥冻结敌人的能力。

巴拉姆的狡诈：你重掷下一次失败的豁免。一旦你使用了此能力，你无法在5轮内再次使用。

冰冷凝视：你获得一个凝视攻击，对目标造成2d6点寒冷伤害。成功通过意志豁免可抵消此伤害。

预知：你在事情发生前一刻瞥见未来。这种知识表现为每四个有效绑定者等级+1的洞察加值到先攻检定，反射豁免和AC上。

武器娴熟：你获得武器娴熟专长的好处。
src:
Balam, the Bitter Angel
  
Once a being of extreme goodness, Balam became a wrathful vestige after taking on an impossible task that ended in failure. She grants her summoners the ability to foresee future difficulties and the intellect to interpret what they see, as well as skill with light arms and a stare that chills flesh.

Vestige Level: 5th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: Balam requires a sacrifice of her summoner. In the process of calling her, you must deal 1 point of slashing damage to yourself.

Influence: Balam's influence causes you to distrust clerics, paladins, and other devotees of deities. Whenever you enter a temple or some other holy or unholy site, Balam requires that you spit on the floor and utter an invective about the place.

Granted Abilities: 
Balam grants you the power to predict future events. She also teaches cunning and finesse, and gives you the ability to freeze foes with a glance.

Balam's Cunning: You reroll your next failed saving throw. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Icy Glare: You gain a gaze attack that deals 2d6 points of cold damage to the target. A successful Will save negates this damage.

Prescience: You get a glimpse of the future a moment before it happens. This knowledge manifests as an insight bonus equal to +1 per four effective binder levels on initiative checks, Reflex saves, and AC.

Weapon Finesse: You gain the benefit of the Weapon Finesse feat.

dst: 一个奇怪的人形生物向你走来。这个生物似乎被某种黏液覆盖，黏液严重遮蔽了它的特征，以至于你无法分辨它属于什么物种，就算它是你能认出的物种也一样。对于幽暗地域来说不同寻常的是，没有任何敌意的迹象，这个生物显然只想和你说话：“她终于来了，正如预言所说。气之子！”
src: A strange humanoid approaches you. The creature appears to be covered in some sort of slime, obscuring its features so much that you cannot tell what species is represented, assuming it is even one you would recognize. Unusually for the Underdark, there is no evidence of hostile intent, the creature apparently intending only to speak to you: "At last she is here, as prophecied. The Child of Air!"

dst: 一个浑身覆盖着黏液的奇怪人形生物接近了我们，在说了一些表明其主人——一个显然名叫阿佐芬的实体——想要扎拉拉和泽法德之剑的话后，它冲向扎拉拉，抓住她，然后两人一起传送走了！我必须假设扎拉拉已被这个阿佐芬抓走，需要去营救。阿佐芬似乎与这个地区的寇涛鱼人结盟，所以如果我能找到寇涛鱼人的基地，就有希望在其中的某处找到扎拉拉。\n\n我发现了关于这个阿佐芬及其对扎拉拉的计划的一些更多信息。显然，他正以某种方式利用她和泽法德之剑从元素位面汲取力量。这种力量通过多种水晶引导，这些水晶组合起来使他几乎免疫任何可能的攻击。土水晶（以散发绿色奥术能量为特征）提供对酸、钝击武器、石化及致命一击的免疫；气水晶（白色能量）提供再生以及对电、音波和正能量伤害的免疫；火水晶（红色能量）提供对火和挥砍武器以及等级或属性吸取效果的免疫；水水晶（蓝色能量）提供对寒冷和穿刺武器以及击倒或麻痹的免疫；而最后一块水晶从多个位面汲取力量（以紫色能量为特征），提供对负能量和普通魔法能量以及死亡魔法的免疫。如果我必须与他战斗，这些信息可能很重要。
src: A strange slime-covered humanoid approached us, and after some remarks indicating its master, an entity apparently named Azoophun, wanted Zarala and the Sword of Zefad, rushed at Zarala, grabbed her, and teleported both of them away! I must presume that Zarala has been captured by this Azoophun, and will need to be rescued. Azoophun appears to be allied with the Kuo Toa in this region, so if I can locate the base of the Kuo Toa, I can hope that Zarala is to be found somewhere within.\n\nI have discovered some more information about this Azoophun and his plans for Zarala. Apparently he is somehow using her and the Sword of Zefad to draw power from the elemental planes. This power is being channeled through various crystals, which in combination make him invulnerable to almost any possible attack. The earth crystal (identified by the emission of green arcane energies) provides immunity to Acid, Bludgeoning weapons, Petrification and Critical hits, the air crystal (white energy) provides regeneration and immunity to electrical, sonic and positive damage, the fire crytal (red energy) provides immunity to fire and slashing weapons, as well as to level or ability draining effects, the water crystal (blue energy) provides immunity to cold and piercing weapons, as well as to Knockdown or Paralysis, while a final crystal, drawing from multiple planes (identified by purple energies) provides immunity to Negative and generic Magical energies, as well as to Death magic. This information might be important if I have to fight him.

dst: “我曾参与竖琴手对该教派另一个基地的突袭，发现自己不仅要与吸血鬼战斗，还要面对一条龙类！幸运的是，那生物尚未转变为不死状态，据我所知，这会让一条龙更加可怕。即便如此，我们之所以能获胜，只是因为组织中一些更强大的成员在场。我希望我们自己的能力足以粉碎这里的教徒，但如果前方有龙类，或者更糟，有龙巫妖这样的敌人，我没有信心我们足够强大去面对。”
src: "I once participated in a harper raid on another base of this cult, and found myself in battle not only against vampires, but a dragon as well! Fortunately the creautre had not yet made the transition to undeath, which I understand can make a wyrm even more powerful. Even so, we only prevailed because some of the more powerful members of our organization were present. I hope our own lesser abilities are sufficient to crush the cultists here, but I am not confident we are powerful enough to face a dragon, or worse, a dracolich, if such foes should lie ahead."

dst: "你真的要这么做？我可不太愿意充当刺客。"
src: "You're actually going to do this? I'm not very comfortable acting as an assassin."

dst: "害怕我是有充分理由的，如果我一旦失控，确实会很危险。无论如何，我非常同情他们的困境，我只是指出其中相当一部分是他们自己造成的。我怀疑这个位面上没有人能完全不受来自魔鬼与恶魔领域的影响，人类历史确实充满了罪行，但事实仍然是，我们所对抗的这些生物的历史更是如此。他们憎恨自己被憎恨这一事实，只会让他们的处境更糟，并犯下与他们所谴责的同样严重的罪行。不如接受世界永远不完美、充满苦难，并现实地努力减轻我们所能减轻的。"
src: "There is good reason to fear me, I would be dangerous indeed if I were ever to lose control of myself. In any case, I am quite sympathetic to their plight, I am simply pointing out that a considerable part of it is of their own making. I suspect no one on this plane is entirely free of influences stemming from the devilish and demonic realms, and it is certainly true that human history is full of crimes, but the fact remains that the history of these creatures we fight is even more so. By hating the fact that they are hated, they have only made their situation worse, and carried out crimes as great as any they condemn. Better to accept that the world will always be imperfect and full of suffering, and work realistically to alleviate what we can."

dst:
Crucians是一种类人生物，拥有宽大扁平的甲壳，如同沙漠蟹，包裹着上半身提供天然保护。它们不满足于仅有甲壳，常穿戴额外的皮护腿和臂环来保护身体其余部分。它们用色彩鲜艳的彩绘符文装饰甲壳，并在沙地战场上深刻刻下个人胜利的计数。大多数Crucians偏好使用巨大的战锤，其重量足以击碎最坚硬的敌人甲壳。
属性调整：+4 力量，-2 敏捷，+6 体质，-2 魅力
特殊能力

- 中型体型。
- 20英尺基础速度
- 微光视觉。
- +8 天生防御。Crucian的蟹状甲壳提供卓越保护。
- 天赋职业：德鲁伊。
- 等级调整 +2。
src:
Crucians are humanoids that sport broad, flat shells, like desert crabs, encompassing their upper bodies in nat-ural protection. Not content with just their shells, they often wear additional leather chaps and armlets to protect the rest of their bod-ies. They decorate their shells with brightly colored painted sigils, as well as deeply etched tallies of their personal triumphs on the sandy field of conflict. Most crucians prefer to wield enormous warhammers, weighted to crack even the hardest enemy shells. 
Ability Adjustments:  +4 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +6 Constitution, -2 Charisma 
Special Abilities

- Medium size. 
- 20' base speed
- Low-light vision. 
- +8 natural armor. A crucian's crablike shell gives it remarkable protection. 
- Favored Class: Druid. 
- Level adjustment +2.

dst: 港务长告诉我，一艘名为浪行者号的商船上正酝酿着某种麻烦，部分船员似乎威胁要发动暴力和哗变。与船长交谈后，我发现一些水手认为，由于浪行者号上次航行中遭遇了不寻常的麻烦，他们应该得到额外的报酬。其中一人持有火球术卷轴，并威胁说如果船长不满足他的要求，就点燃船帆。与他交谈后，我决定最好还是说服船长接受他的要求，给船员们额外发一笔奖金。\n\n我说服了船长，最好还是同意水手的要求。我应该通知那名水手，然后向港务长汇报此事已和平解决。
src: The harbormaster has told me that there is some sort of trouble brewing on a merchant vessel named the Wave Runner, with some of its crew apparently threatening violence and mutiny. Upon speaking to the captain, I found that some of the sailors feel they should be paid extra on account of the unusual troubles the Wave Runner ran into on its last voyage. One of them has a Fireball scroll and is threatening to set the sails on fire if the captain fails to comply with his demands. After speaking with him I decided it would be best to convince the captain to accept his demands and pay an extra bonus to his crew.\n\nI convinced the captain it would be best to agree to the sailor's demands. I should let the sailor know, and then report the peaceful resolution of this matter to the harbormaster.

你的双脚和小腿被一层蓝灰色能量包裹。这种物质类似冰，但像微小星星的光点也在其中漂移。

src:
Cerulean Sandals

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Incarnate, Soulborn
Chakra: Feet
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms into a pair of sandals that surround your feet and any other footwear you might have on. The sandals resemble blue crystal ice, but just beneath the surface, they seem to flow like water.

Your cerulean sandals make you immune to movement speed decreases. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld grants an enhancement bonus of +5 feet to your base land speed.

Chakra Bind (Feet)

Your feet and lower legs are encased in a sheath of blue-gray energy. This substance resembles ice, but motes of light like tiny stars drift through it as well.

You can use dimension door as the spell, up to a total distance of 10 feet per meldshaper level. You can use this ability (in increments of 10 feet) any number of times, until the total distance has been traversed, at which point the soulmeld unshapes. This requires a standard action to activate.

（进阶职业）
当德鲁伊背离大地时，大地也背离她。一些前德鲁伊接受这种改变；另一些则寻求恢复联系。然而，少数人实际上拥抱了与自然的断绝，成为灰飞烟灭的力量。这些少数人被称为枯萎者，所到之处带来荒芜。枯萎者通过剥夺大地生命来获得施法能力。她穿越荒野的路径总是留下一片被砍伐的土地。

绝大多数枯萎者是游牧的独行者，不断寻找绿色土地来摧毁。有些冷酷；另一些则嘲笑他们造成的破坏。然而，几乎所有人都没有朋友且疯狂。让他们崩溃的是知道自然笑到最后：为了获得法咒，他们必须寻找土地上最茂密的森林，即使只是为了摧毁它们。因此，即使他们背离了自然，也必须不断回归。只有人类前德鲁伊似乎大量被枯萎者之路吸引。传说几千年来一些精灵德鲁伊也转向了灰飞烟灭--考虑到他们在漫长一生中可以摧毁多少土地，这是一个可怕的景象。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
When a druid turns away from the land, the land turns away from her. Some ex-druids make peace with this change; others seek to restore the bond. A few, however, actually embrace their disconnection from nature and become forces of destruction. These few, called blighters, bring desolation wherever they tread. A blighter gains her spellcasting ability by stripping the earth of life. A swath of deforested land always marks her path through the wilderness. 

The vast majority of blighters are nomadic loners constantly in search of green lands to destroy. Some are grim; others laugh at the destruction they wreak. Almost all, however, are friendless and mad. What puts them over the edge is the knowledge that nature gets the last laugh: To gain their spells, they must seek out the richest forests of the land, even if it's only to destroy them. Thus, even though they've turned away from nature, they must constantly return to it. Only human ex-druids seem attracted in any number to the blighter's path. Legends say that a few elven druids have also turned to destruction over the millennia - a terrifying prospect given how much land they could destroy in their long lifetimes. 

- Hit Die: d8 
- Proficiencies: A blighter does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies. 
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Base Attack Bonus: +4
Alignment: Nongood
Special: Wild Shape as a class ability
Special: Must have been a druid

CLASS FEATURES:

Level

3: Undead Wild Shape - Wild Shape gains the Skeletal Template
4: Undead Wild Shape
5: Contagious Touch - Deliver diseases as touch attacks
   Undead Wild Shape - Gain new forms
6: Animate Dead Animal - Animate special undead creatures
   Undead Wild Shape

Spellcasting: The blighter gains spellcasting as per a druid, using Wisdom as his casting statistic. He can cast spells up to 9th level from the blighter spell list, gaining access to new spell levels each class level, provided he has a high enough wisdom score to cast a spell of that.

dst:
在穿越维尔达斯森林时，我遇到了一位名叫赛亚拉的树精。她最近被那些穿行于森林中、彼此交战的豺狼人和牛头人搅得不得安宁，尤其担心她那两个姐妹的命运——她们为了躲避这样一场战斗而 recently 逃走了。这两个树精中，一个逃进了附近的洞穴，另一个则逃向了东边的区域。两人都没有回来，赛亚拉担心她们遭遇了某种危险。她请求我调查这两个区域，先从洞穴开始，以救出她的姐妹，或至少查明她们的下落。

我发现赛亚拉的姐妹被囚禁在洞穴中。与此同时，我身后的门砰然关闭，断绝了退路。随后我面前出现了两条路可选，其中一条会杀死被囚的树精，另一条则会释放她，但代价是让我自己陷入更大的危险。不幸的是，后者似乎风险太大，所以我选择了导致树精死亡的那条路。我估计赛亚拉不会对此高兴，但这是糟糕选项中的最佳选择。现在我必须充分利用这条已经为我打开的道路。

赛亚拉果然很不高兴，也不愿给我任何奖励，但我还是杀了她，拿走了她所有的东西。
src:
While proceeding through the Wealdath forest, I came across a dryad named Saiala. She has been inconvenienced by the gnolls and minotaurs who have recently been moving through the forest, battling each other, and is particularly concerned with the fate of her two sisters, who recently fled in order to avoid becoming caught up in one such battle. One of these two dryads fled into a nearby cave, and the other to the regions to the east. Neither has returned and Saiala fears they have run into some sort of danger. She has asked that I investigate both areas, starting with the cave, in order to rescue her sisters or at least discover what became of them.

I found Saiala's sister held captive in the cave. At the same time, the door behind me snapped shut, preventing retreat. I was then given a choice of two paths to follow, one of which would slay the captive dryad, while the other would set her free at the cost of increasing my own danger. Unfortunately, the latter seemed too great a risk, so I chose to take the path resulting in the dryad's death. I expect Saiala will not be happy about that, but it was the best of set of bad options. Now I must make the best of the path that has now been opened for me.

Saiala was indeed unhappy and unwilling to give me any reward, but I killed her and took what she had anyway.

dst: "说实话，我其实挺高兴自己没怎么记得家乡发生的事。原因显而易见，也因为我不太知道该怎么真正重铸这把剑并击败阿兹古尔卡。这是件难事，而我对该怎么做只有最模糊的想法。我怎么可能指望成功做到这种事？不过据说我也被预言或命中注定会成功什么的，这想起来太奇怪了。我是说，我一直想出去冒险，但那样我多少能掌控自己在做什么。像这样的冒险自己找上门来，反而让人不安。"
src: "Truth be told, I was actually happy to not really be remembering what happened back home. For the obvious reasons, and because I don't really know how I'm supposed to actually reforge this sword and defeat Azghulkar. It's a difficult task and I only have the vaguest ideas about how to go about it. How can I possibly hope to succeed at something like that? Though supposedly I am also prohesied or destined or something to succeed, which is just too weird to think about much. I mean, I always wanted to go out and seek adventure, but there I'd have some sort of control over what I was doing. Having an adventure like this come to me instead is disconcerting."

src:
Embracing your draconic heritage is but one stop on your life journey. Your quest to understand, command, and harness your draconic energies has taken you into realm of the epic.

Hit Die: d12
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2+ Int Modifier
Bonus Feats:  The epic dragon disciple gains a bonus feat every four levels after 10th

Your breath weapon damage potential increases by 1d10 for every 3 levels after 10th.
The save DC against your breath weapon increases by +1 every 4 levels after 10th.
You gain an additional usage of your breath weapon every 3 levels after 10th, subject to a 1d4 round delay between uses.
Your natural AC increases by +1 for every 5 levels after 10th.
At 12th level, you gain the ability to use your wings to make additional slam attacks.
You increase in size at level 15th and 25th, with an appropriate increase in abilities.
At 17th level, you grow a tail, which can be used to make an additional attack with.
At 18th level, you gain Spell Resistance equal to 20+Dragon Disciple levels.
At 20th level, you gain True Seeing.

Epic Dragon Disciple Bonus Feats List:
Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell,  Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Prowess, Epic Reputation, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Toughness, Improved Combat Casting.

dst: 我会见了可怕的扎加什，一个我发现竟然住在沙漠巨龙客栈一个房间里的巫妖。他向我提出了一个有趣的提议。显然，那些似乎在策划对卡林杉发动战争的变形蛛不知怎么发现了他的命匣。他们利用对命匣的控制削弱了扎加什，降低了他的力量，并打算用永久摧毁命匣（从而也摧毁他）的威胁来敲诈他，让他为自己的事业效力。然而扎加什无意任他们摆布，并想出了一个计划：伪装后与一群冒险者同行，与他们作战。因此，他准备加入我在城外进行的任务，对抗变形蛛的各种类人盟友。\n\n我已经接受了他的提议，扎加什现在将作为同伴与我同行。我预计他会是一个宝贵的盟友。
src: I have met with Zagash the Terrible, a lich who I discovered occupying a room at the Desert Dragon Inn, of all places. He had an interesting offer to make me. Apparently the aranea who are seemingly orchestrating a war against Calimshan somehow discovered his phylactery. They have used their control of it to weaken Zagash and reduce his power, and intend to use the threat of destroying it (and therefore him) for good to blackmail him into serving their cause. Zagash however has no intention of letting them order him around and has conceived a plan to travel in disguise with a group of adventurers to fight against them. As a result, he is prepared to join with me on my quests outside the city to fight the various humanoid allies of the aranea.\n\nI have accepted his offer, and Zagash will now be traveling with me as a companion. I expect he will be a valuable ally.

dst: 有一笔20000金币的赏金，悬赏一个名叫图高尔的塔纳鲁克（半兽人半恶魔）的人头，他率领着一群兽人劫掠者。图高尔可以在云峰山脉北侧的一座堡垒中找到，离纳什凯尔不太远。除了兽人之外，这座堡垒还由许多“反魔法魔像”守卫，它们免疫法术和元素伤害，能够看穿潜行和幻术，并能解除魔法增益、防护和召唤。因此，除了正面战斗之外，很难用其他方式击败这个对手。如果我能应对这个挑战，就可以把图高尔的头带到纳什凯尔的奥布勒克处领取奖赏。\n\n图高尔已被杀死。我可以把他的头带给奥布勒克领取赏金。
src: There is a bounty of 20000 gold on the head of one Tughaur, a Tanarukk (part orc and part fiend) who leads a band of orcish raiders. Tughaur can be found in a fortress on the north side of the Cloudpeaks, not too far from Nashkel. In addition to orcs, this fortress is guarded by a number of "Anti-Magic Golems" who are immune to spells and elemental damage, able to see through stealth and illusions, and able to dispel magical buffs, protections and summons. Thus, it will be difficult to defeat this opponent by any means other than straightforward combat. If I prove up to this challenge, I can bring Tughaur's head to Oublek in Nashkel for a reward.\n\nTughaur has been slain. I can bring his head to Oublek to collect the bounty.

dst: 扎拉拉希望最终能前往烛堡的大图书馆，她相信在那里可以找到重铸泽法德之剑所需的知识，这样一把重铸的剑也许是阿兹古尔卡重返此位面时唯一能够抵抗他的武器。\n\n在前往烛堡的途中，我们绕道去了小镇纳什凯尔，首先遇到了一位名叫伊扎多·夸巴克斯的侏儒，他原来是一名竖琴手，一直在寻找我们以提供帮助。据他说，通往烛堡的路线被那些被扎拉拉和我的人头悬赏吸引而来的冒险者严密把守，要到达那里并不容易。他认为他也许能帮助我们，但还没等他说更多，我们就被一群想要我们人头的冒险者打断了（至少他们的首领是这样，不过他的同伴们原来另有打算）。等解决他们之后，我们应该再和伊扎多谈谈，了解更多情况。
src: Zarala hopes to eventually make her way to the great library of Candlekeep, where she believes she can find the knowledge needed to reforge the Sword of Zefad, such a reforged sword being perhaps the only weapon able to resist Azghulkar when he returns to this plane.\n\nDiverted to the small town of Nashkel on our way to Candlekeep, we first encountered a gnome named Izado Quabax, who turned out to be a Harper who has been looking for us in order to give us aid. According to him, the routes to Candlekeep are guarded well by adventurers lured by bounties on the heads of Zarala and myself, and it will not be easy to get there. He thinks he might be able to assist us, but before he could say more, we were interrupted by a band of adventurers seeking our heads (or at least their leader was, though his companions turned out to have other plans). Once they are dealt with, we should speak with Izado again to learn more.

Benefit: As long as you have an abjuration spell of 5th level or higher available to cast, you can make another creature's spellcasting harmful to itself. Use of this feat requires a melee touch attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. As a standard action, with a successful touch you can infuse another creature with baneful magic for a number of rounds equal to the level of the highest-level abjuration spell you have available. A successful Will save reduces this duration to 1 round. For the duration of the effect, each time the target completes the casting of a spell, it takes damage equal to the level of the abjuration spell that determined the effect's duration. Since the spell's casting has already been completed, this doesn't count as damage dealt during casting. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting abjuration spells.

目标：接触到的死亡生物

豁免：无
法术抗力：是（无害）

这个法咒的功能类似于复生术，除了你可以复活死亡时间长达每施法者等级10年的生物。这个法咒甚至可以带回身体被摧毁的生物，只要你以某种方式明确识别死者（最常见的方法是背诵死者的出生或死亡时间和地点）.
法咒完成后，生物立即恢复到满生命值，活力术和健康，不损失等级（或体质点数） 或准备的法咒。
你可以复活被死亡效果杀死的人，或者被变成不死生物然后被摧毁的人。这个法咒也可以复活元素生物或异界生物，但不能复活构装体或不死生物。
即使是完全复生术也无法复活因年老而死亡的生物。
src:
School: Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric/Healer 9
Components: V, S, M
Range: Touch
Target: Dead creature touched
Duration: Instantaneous
Save: None
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

This spell functions like Resurrection, except that you can resurrect a creature that has been dead for as long as 10 years per caster level. This spell can even bring back creatures whose bodies have been destroyed, provided that you unambiguously identify the deceased in some fashion (reciting the deceased's time and place of birth or death is the most common method).
Upon completion of the spell, the creature is immediately restored to full hit points, vigor and health, with no loss of level (or Constitution points) or prepared spells.
You can revive someone killed by a death effect or someone who has been turned into an undead creature and then destroyed. This spell can also resurrect elementals or outsiders, but it cant resurrect constructs or undead creatures.
Even true Resurrection can't restore to life a creature who has died of old age.

dst: "你或许想知道附近有哪些文明的前哨站。正如集市的存在所暗示的，这里不只有怪物和洞穴。从这里往北走一段路，你会找到一个夺心魔——有时也被称为灵吸怪——的聚居地。往南则能找到眼魔的殖民地。除非你准备好战斗，否则避开这两处。它们都只会杀死或奴役任何入侵者。卓尔和灰矮人也经常在这一带活动，不过据我所知，他们并没有特别靠近的大型聚居地。遇到这两个种族的巡逻队也很可能以暴力收场，尽管其中一些种族有可能愿意寻求和平的贸易，就像这里的这些人一样。但幽暗地域的种族中，很少准备好和平对待外来者，这个集市是那条规则中罕见的例外。"
src: "You may want to know of the outposts of civilization to be found nearby. As the presence of a market suggests, there are more than simply monsters and caverns about. Some way to the north of here you will find a settlement of Illithid, or Mind Flayers as they are sometimes called. To the south one can find a colony of Beholders. Steer clear of both unless you are prepared for a fight. Either will seek only to kill or enslave any intruders. Drow and Duergar can also often be found moving through this region, though they do not have any large settlements particularly close, as far as I am aware. Running into patrols of either race is likely to end in violence as well, though there is a chance that some of these races would be willing to seek peaceful commerce, like those here. But few of the peoples of the Underdark are ready to deal with outsiders peacefully, this marketplace being a rare exception to that rule."

src: Blood Drain (Ex): Some half-vampires can suck blood from a living victim with their fangs by making a successful grapple check. If the half-vampire pins the foe, it drains blood, dealing 1d4 points of Constitution drain each round the pin is maintained. A half-vampire can't drain more points of Constitution in a single hour than its Constitution score. When a half-vampire drains a victim's Constitution, it gains 5 temporary hit points, no matter how many points it drains. Temporary hit points gained in this way last for up to 1 hour. If a half-vampire has this ability, it also gains the blood dependency special quality.

你将自己的伤痛转移给他人。当你显能此异能并成功进行接触攻击时，你可以将 50 点伤害（或更少，如果你选择） 从自己转移给被接触的生物。你立即恢复等于你转移的伤害量的生命值。

你不能使用此异能获得超过你正常总值的生命值。转移的伤害本质上是共感的，因此目标可能拥有的伤害减免和再生等异能和能力不会减轻或改变此伤害。

此异能转移的伤害没有类型，因此即使目标对你原本所受的伤害类型免疫，转移仍正常发生并对目标造成生命值伤害。

增幅：你可以通过以下一种或两种方式增幅此异能。
1. 你每额外花费 1 点异能点，就可以额外转移 10 点伤害（每次显能最多 90 点）.
2. 如果你额外花费 6 点异能点，此异能影响以你为中心的 20 尺半径扩散范围内的所有生物。转移的伤害量在所有范围内的敌对生物之间平均分配。
src:
Telepathy [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Telepath 3, psychic warrior 3
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Creature touched
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will half
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 5
Metapsionics: Twin, Widen

You transfer your hurt to another. When you manifest this power and then make a successful touch attack, you can transfer 50 points of damage (or less, if you choose) from yourself to the touched creature. You immediately regain hit points equal to the amount of damage you transfer.

You cannot use this power to gain hit points in excess of your full normal total. The transferred damage is empathic in nature, so powers and abilities the subject may have such as damage reduction and regeneration do not lessen or change this damage.

The damage transferred by this power has no type, so even if the subject has immunity to the type of damage you originally took, the transfer occurs normally and deals hit point damage to the subject.

Augment: You can augment this power in one or both of the following ways.
1. For every additional power point you spend, you can transfer an additional 10 points of damage (maximum 90 points per manifestation).
2. If you spend 6 additional power points, this power affects all creatures in a 20-foot-radius spread centered on you. The amount of damage transferred is divided evenly among all hostile creatures in the area.

dst: 在击败牛头人海盗的过程中，瓦尔库尔之剑号的船员发现了一些海图，标明了其他海盗基地的位置。其中一个是他们长期以来一直希望铲除的一伙人类海盗的基地，所以我们的下一站将是他们所在的那座岛。自然，扎拉拉和我会参与这次突袭。我们已经航行了好几天，很快就要接近目标了。在与船长交谈以了解我们在即将到来的战斗中扮演的角色后，我得知我们将乘坐小船进行 stealthy 夜间突袭。扎拉拉和我会加入船员主力，攻击海盗船，而船长本人则领导岸上的二次攻击。\n\n我们已经偷偷登上了海盗船，正在控制它。一旦这项工作看起来已经稳妥，向东前往岸边看看船长的突袭是否需要额外支援可能是个好主意。似乎有一条绳子，我们可以用它荡到附近的浅水区。
src: In the process of defeating the minotaur pirates, the Sword of Valkur's crew discovered some charts indicating the locations of other pirate bases. One of them is the base of a group of human pirates they have long been hoping to put out of business, so our next stop will be the island where they can be found. Naturally Zarala and I will be taking part in this assault. We have been sailing for several days and will soon be approaching our target. Upon speaking to the captain to discover our part in the upcoming battle, I learned that we would be making a stealthy night assault in small craft. Zarala and I will join the main body of the crew in an assault on the pirates' ship, while the captain himself leads a secondary attack on the shore.\n\nWe have snuck on board the pirate vessel and are in the process of securing it. Once that work seems well in hand, it might be a good idea to head east towards the shore to see if the captain's assault needs additional support. There seems to be a rope we could use to swing out into nearby shallow water.

src: A commoner in Calimport has told me that he has been hearing strange noises in his basement, especially along the north wall. He wants me to investigate, and will pay me if I find and eliminate some danger. Looks like I'm off to another basement. I hope this doesn't turn out to be some silly rat-killing quest.\n\nAfter investigating and talking to the owner of the adjoining house, Egbar Elwab, it seems that the trouble began when some rats chewed through the wiring on a gnomish machine Egbar was using to reinforce some glass containers full of slimes he was studying. This allowed the slimes to break free and make their way into the neighboring house's basement. In the process they broke a summoning circle, releasing an elemental. After fighting through the slimes, the elemental, and a golem who I suppose mistook me for a thief, I have ended the danger and discovered its source. Time to report back and collect my reward.

dst:
瓦努斯，受唾弃者
  
因其罪行而受到过度的憎恨，微笑的瓦努斯对缚灵者来说仍是一个谜。瓦努斯赋予缚灵者恐吓和惩罚较弱敌人的能力，以不可思议的感知听到邪恶的脚步，并解放盟友脱离束缚。

契灵等级：6级
缚灵DC:29
特殊要求：瓦努斯拒绝在室内被召唤时出现，只有在远离建筑物的地方才会回应召唤者的呼唤。

影响：在瓦努斯的影响下，你会抓住每一个机会狂欢。即使小小的胜利也似乎是盛大庆祝的理由，如果你快乐，你希望周围的每个人都分享你的喜悦。如果你看到他人在庆祝，你必须加入。如果你在战斗中取得胜利，你必须立即花费一个整轮动作来夸耀你的胜利。

授予能力：
瓦努斯赋予你非凡的听力，仅凭你的存在就能煽动恐惧的能力，与比你弱的敌人战斗的技巧，以及解放盟友脱离囚禁的力量。

恐惧灵光：你察觉到的进入10尺范围内的敌人必须通过意志豁免。失败者会陷入恐惧。敌人在等于你缚灵者等级一半的轮数内保持恐惧。通过豁免的生物如果再次进入10尺范围必须重新掷骰。通过此能力豁免的生物在24小时内无需再次豁免。这是一个影响心智恐惧效果。

解放盟友：你可以指定任何盟友获得行动自由法咒的好处，持续一轮。你不能对自己使用此能力。一旦你使用了此能力，你5轮内不能再次使用。

贵族蔑视：当你用远程或近战武器攻击生命骰少于你的敌人时，你造成+1d6点伤害。

瓦努斯之耳：与瓦努斯绑定赋予你+10的聆听检定加值。
src:
Vanus, the Reviled One
  
Hated out of proportion for his sins, the smiling Vanus remains an enigma to binders. Vanus provides binders with the ability to frighten and punish weaker foes, hear evil afoot with uncanny perception, and free allies from constraints.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 29
Special Requirement: Vanus refuses to appear when summoned indoors, and will only answer the summoner's call when well away from buildings.

Influence: Under the influence of Vanus, you take every opportunity to revel. Even small victories seem like cause for grand celebrations, and if you're happy, you want everyone around to share your joy. If you see others in the act of celebration, you must join in. If you achieve victory in combat, you must immediately spend a full-round action crowing about your triumph.

Granted Abilities: 
Vanus grants you tremendous hearing, the ability to foment fear by your presence alone, skill at fighting foes weaker than yourself, and the power to free allies from imprisonment.

Fear Aura: Enemies that you are aware of who come within 10 feet must succeed at a Will save. Those who fail are frightened. Foes remain frightened for a number of rounds equal to half your binder level. Creatures that fail the save must roll again if they again come within 10 feet. A creature that makes its save against this ability need not make another save for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Free Ally: You may designate any ally to gain the benefits of the freedom of movement spell for one round. You cannot use this ability on yourself. Once you have used this ability you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Noble Disdain: When attacking a foe of fewer Hit Dice than yourself with a ranged or melee weapon, you deal +1d6 points of damage.

Vanus's Ears: Being bound to Vanus grants you a +10 bonus on Listen checks.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Wilder 1st
Specifics: A wilder can let her passion and emotion rise to the surface in a wild surge when she manifests a power. During a wild surge, a wilder gains phenomenal psionic strength, but may harm herself by the reckless use of her power (see Psychic Enervation, below).
A wilder can choose to invoke a wild surge whenever she manifests a power. When she does so, she gains +1 to her manifester level with that manifestation of the power. The manifester level boost gives her the ability to augment her powers to a higher degree than she otherwise could; however, she pays no extra power point for this wild surge. Instead, the additional 1 power point that would normally be required to augment the power is effectively supplied by the wild surge.
Level-dependent power effects are also improved, depending on the power a wilder manifests with her wild surge.
This improvement in manifester level does not grant her any other benefits (psicrystal abilities do not advance, she does not gain higher-level class abilities, and so on).
She cannot use the Overchannel psionic feat and invoke her wild surge at the same time.
At 3rd level, a wilder can choose to boost her manifester level by two instead of one. At 7th level, she can boost her manifester level by up to three; at 11th level, by up to four; at 15th level, by up to five; and at 19th level, by up to six.
In all cases, the wild surge effectively pays the extra power point cost that is normally required to augment the power; only the unaugmented power point cost is subtracted from the wilder's power point reserve.

类型：该生物的类型保持不变，但它获得土系亚种。

防御等级：天生防御改善+3。

特殊攻击：矿物战士保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得大地打击攻击。
大地打击（Ex）：每天一次，矿物战士可以对站在石头或土地上的任何敌人进行一次异常凶猛的攻击。矿物战士将其体质加值加到攻击检定上，并每
种族生命骰造成1点额外伤害。

特殊品质：矿物战士拥有基础生物的所有特殊品质，外加以下内容。
黑暗视觉（Ex）：矿物战士拥有60英尺的黑暗视觉，或基础生物的黑暗视觉，以较好者为准。
伤害减免（Ex）：矿物战士获得伤害减免8/精金。如果它已有伤害减免，它保留两种版本并使用适用的最佳一种。

属性：从基础生物变化如下：+2力量，+4体质，-2智力（最低1）,-2感知，-2魅力。
环境：与基础生物相同，以及地下。
等级调整：与基础生物相同+1。
src:
Mineral Warrior (also called "stony") is an acquired template that can be added to any corporeal creature that is not a construct, undead, or an elemental (referred to hereafter as the base creature). A mineral warrior uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here. 

Type: The creature's type remains the same, but it gains the earth subtype. 

Armor Class: Natural armor improves by +3. 

Special Attacks: A mineral warrior retains all the special attacks of the base creature and also gains the earth strike attack. 
Earth Strike (Ex): Once per day, the mineral warrior can make an exceptionally vicious attack against any foe that stands on stone or earth. The mineral warrior adds its Constitution bonus to its attack roll and deals 1 extra point of damage per
racial Hit Die. 

Special Qualities: A mineral warrior has all the special qualities of the base creature, plus the following. 
Darkvision (Ex): A mineral warrior has darkvision out to 60 feet or the base creature's darkvision, whichever is better. 
Damage Reduction (Ex): A mineral warrior gains damage reduction 8/adamantine. If it already has damage reduction, it retains both versions and uses the best one that applies. 

Abilities: Change from the base creature as follows: +2 Strength, +4 Con, -2 Int (minimum 1), -2 Wis, -2 Cha. 
Environment: Same as the base creature and underground. 
Level Adjustment: Same as the base creature +1.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
On the front lines of battle, injury is inevitable. Where the carnage is at its worst, the combat medic can be found, keeping her allies alive and tending to the fallen. For a combat medic, the goal is not to kill the enemy but to make sure the enemy does not kill her troops. Her ability to keep forces fighting makes her invaluable to an army. She is entrusted with the care of the best forces available, sometimes even assigned to elite strike teams.

dst:
（进阶职业）
据传，术士和吟游诗人的魔法力量与其家族血脉中的龙之血脉存在某种联系。龙脉术士是术士，有时也是吟游诗人，他们利用自身的魔法力量作为催化剂来激活其龙族血脉，实现其最大潜能。他们更偏爱探索的生活，而非隐居修行。由于已精通魔法，许多人追求冒险，尤其是当这有助于他们进一步了解自己的龙之血脉时。他们常感到被吸引至已知有龙出没的区域。

- 生命骰：特殊（见下文）
- 武器与防具擅长：龙脉术士不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

种族：任何非龙族（不能已是半龙类）
施法：能够无需准备施展奥术
技能：学识 8 级
特殊：玩家在获得此进阶职业第一级时选择一种龙类

职业特性：

等级
1：龙之甲 - 角色的皮肤发展出几乎不可见的鳞片，使其天生防御等级增加 +1。
  生命骰提升（d6） - 角色使用 d6 掷生命值。此变化不追溯。
2：龙族属性提升 - 力量 +2。
  爪击 - 角色获得 2 次爪击，可作为主要天生攻击使用。
  啮咬 - 角色获得一次啮咬，可作为次要天生攻击使用。
3：喷吐武器 I - 角色可以激活一种龙之吐息武器，对范围内每个对手造成 2d10 点伤害。
4：生命骰提升（d8） - 角色使用 d8 掷生命值。此变化不追溯。
  龙族属性提升 - 力量 +2。
5：龙之甲 - 角色的皮肤变得更加坚硬，使其天生防御等级提升至 +2。
6：生命骰提升（d10） - 角色使用 d10 掷生命值。此变化不追溯。
7：喷吐武器 II - 角色的喷吐武器伤害潜力提升至 4d10 点伤害。
  龙族属性提升 - 体质 +2。
8：龙之甲 - 角色的天生防御等级提升至 +3。
9：翅膀 - 角色长出红龙翅膀。
  龙族属性提升 - 智力 +2。
10：龙之甲 - +4 天生防御。
  黑暗视觉 - 角色获得龙类在黑暗中视物的能力。
  免疫睡眠，麻痹，以及基于龙脉术士类型的额外免疫。
  龙族属性提升 - 力量 +4，魅力 +2。
  喷吐武器 III - 角色的喷吐武器造成 6d10 点伤害。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
It is rumored that the magical powers of sorcerers and bards is somehow connected to the presence of dragon blood in their family tree. Dragon Disciples are sorcerers, and sometimes bards, who use their magical power as a catalyst to activate their dragon blood, realizing its fullest potential. They prefer a life of exploration to a cloistered existence. Already adept at magic, many pursue adventure, especially if it furthers their goal of finding out more about their draconic heritage. They often feel drawn to areas known to harbor dragons.

- Hit Die: Special (see below)
- Proficiencies: A dragon disciple does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Any non-dragon (cannot already be a half-dragon)
Spellcasting: Ability to cast arcane spells without preparation
Skills: 8 Ranks in Lore
Special: The player chooses a dragon variety when taking the first level in this prestige class

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Draconic Armor - The character's skin develops nearly invisible scales that increase his/her natural armor class by +1.
  Hit Dice Increase (d6) - The character rolls d6 for hit points. This change is not retroactive.
2: Draconic Ability Scores -  Strength +2.
  Claw Attack - The character gains 2 claws they can use as primary natural attacks.
  Bite Attack - The character gains a bite they can use as a secondary natural attack.
3: Breath Weapon I - The character can activate a Dragon Breath Weapon, dealing 2d10 points of damage to each opponent caught within.
4: Hit Dice Increase (d8) - The character rolls d8 for hit points. This change is not retroactive.
  Draconic Ability Scores -  Strength +2.
5: Draconic Armor  - The character's skin becomes even harder, raising his/her natural armor class to +2.
6: Hit Dice Increase (d10)  - The character rolls d10 for hit points.  This change is not retroactive.
7: Breath Weapon II - The character's breath weapon damage potential increases to 4d10 points of damage.
  Draconic Ability Scores - Constitution  +2.
8: Draconic Armor - The character's natural armor class increases to +3.
9: Wings  - The character grows red dragon wings.
  Draconic Ability Scores - Intelligence +2.
10: Draconic Armor  - +4 Natural Armor.
  Darkvision - The character gains a dragon's ability to see in the dark.
  Immunity to sleep, paralysis, and an additional immunity based on dragon disciple type.
  Draconic Ability Scores - Strength +4, Charisma +2.
  Breath Weapon III - The character does 6d10 points of damage with his breath weapon.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
While many view the Fists of Hextor simply as effective if brutal mercenaries, they are in fact templars sworn to the service of their unforgiving deity. The world is a dark and unforgiving place, or so says the Church of Hextor, wherein the strong survive by ruling the weak and forging order from the chaos. To support its dogma, the Church established this elite company of templars and made them available to hire to those whose cause complemented the Church's ultimate goals (and who could, naturally, afford to pay the hefty tithes necessary to maintain a crack unit of well-armed and well-trained men and women). The Fists are infamous for their efficient brutality: Nowhere will an employer in need of military aid locate mercenaries more dedicated to ensuring that the rule of law prevails over the forces of anarchy and chaos.

- Hit Dice: d10.
- Proficiencies: Fists of Hextor are proficient with simple and martial weapons, all types of armor, and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Lawful Evil, Neutral Evil or Lawful Neutral
Skills: Spot 4 ranks, Intimidate 4 ranks, Lore 4 ranks
Feats: Power Attack, Cleave, Any Martial Weapon Proficiency
Base Attack Bonus: +5

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Brutal Strike +1 - +1 to either attack or damage rolls. Permanent bonus.
2: Strength Boost - +4 Str for 4 rounds + Fist of Hextor level, once per day.
3: Frightful Presence - Fear in a radius of 5 feet per level, once per day.
4: Brutal Strike +2
5: Strength Boost - Can now be used twice a day.
6: Frightful Presence - Can now be used twice a day.
7: Brutal Strike +3
8: Strength Boost - Three times a day.
9: Frightful Presence - Three times a day.
10: Brutal Strike +4

Though I hope to restore my arm eventually, it will be a while before I can equip either, but perhaps you can make better use of one of them. dst: "所以没人跟你提过这事？我相信很快就会有人说的。我知道乍看之下我完全像个人类，但实际上我身上流着蛇人——来自南方丛林的蛇人——的血。我自己的族人，在楚尔特，发现这件事后就把我赶了出来。虽然北方人对蛇血的偏执不像南方那些紧邻蛇人聚居地的人那么严重，但很多人仍然不会信任我。"
src: "So no one has mentioned it to you? I am sure someone will soon enough. I know that I look perfectly human to a casual inspection, but I am in fact tainted with the blood of the Yuan-ti, the serpent people from the southern jungles. My own people, in Chult, cast me out when they discovered this, and while the people of the north are not quite as paranoid about snake-blood as those of the south who live in close proximity to yuan-ti settlements, many still would not trust me."

dst:
土元素裔在决策时耐心，固执且深思熟虑。他们出生时就带有明显反映其血统的特征，因此常被他人排斥，但他们的天赋体能使其能够抵御大多数攻击者。土元素裔显然不是人类，但除了与元素祖先相关的一两个显著特征外，他们大多具有人类特征，例如土质的皮肤，如黑洞或宝石般的眼睛，非常大的手脚，铁灰色的头发或皮肤或头发带有金属光泽。

土元素裔属性调整：+2 力量，+2 体质，-2 魅力，-2 感知。
天赋职业（战士）：在判断兼职经验惩罚时，土元素裔的战士职业不计入。

注意：元素裔牧师必须拥有相关的元素领域。

特殊能力：

- 黑暗视觉：土元素裔能在黑暗中视物。
- 坚韧对抗土：对抗土系和酸系法咒时豁免检定获得+1种族加值（每5级额外+1）.
- 异界生物：在法咒效果上，土元素裔被视为异界生物。
- 人类：在法咒效果上，土元素裔被视为人类。

src:
Earth genasi are patient, stubborn and contemplative in their decision making. Marked at birth with obvious traits reflecting their heritage, earth genasi are often shunned by others, but their physical gifts make them able to defend themselves against most attackers. Earth genasi are obviously not human, but have mostly human features except for one or two distinguishing traits related to their elemental ancestors like earthlike skin, eyes like black pits or gems, very large hand or feet, iron gray hair or metallic sheen to skin or hair.

Earth Genasi Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, +2 Con, -2 Cha, -2 Wis.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass earth genasis fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Note: Genasi clerics must have the relevant elemental domain.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Earth Genasi can see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Earth: +1 racial bonus on saving throws against earth and acid spells (additional +1 for every 5 levels).
- Outsider: Earth Genasi are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.
- Human: Earth Genasi are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Dragons hold a great deal of fascination for some individuals, leading those folk into closer and closer association with the powerful race.  Some individuals (primarily those related to sorcerers) feel the call more strongly, thanks to their dragon ancestry, occasionally even leading them to attempt to awaken their blood and bring those traits to the fore.  Learning more about dragons is the first step towards understanding them.  The dragon devotee expands upon this knowledge and begins to manifest dragonlike qualities.

REQUIREMENTS:
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Skills: Lore 1 rank.
Race: Nondragon

CLASS FEATURES:
1: Ability Increase - +2 to Charisma.
Natural Armor - You gain a +1 natural armor bonus.
2: Combat Technique - You can choose a bonus feat from the fighter bonus feat list, or add 1d6 of Sneak Attack.
3: Ability Increase - +2 to Constitution.
4: Claws - You gain claws that do 1d3 for Medium creatures.
Combat Technique
5: Ability Increase - +2 to Strength.
Draconic template - This grants you the dragonblooded subtype, Darkvision, and +2 to Intimidate and Spot.

这是一张周边地区的地图，上面标有一个地点。它是在一名塔洛斯——毁灭之神——的信徒的尸体上发现的，上面还写有一些笔记：

“我们发现了科扎神像的位置，我们的主塔洛斯在耐瑟瑞尔时代就被称为科扎。据信这尊神像非常强大，找回它将极大地助益毁灭大业。因此，我们受命找回它，但各路敌人已经得知了我们的计划，并试图阻挠我们。风暴先驱玛扎克想考验我们，派出多支队伍去寻找神像，谁先得到神像，以及杀死任何挡路的敌人，都会得到奖赏。如果我成功找回神像，我应把它带给风暴先驱玛扎克，他目前暂住在纳什凯尔客栈，并承诺会重赏任何成功把神像带给他的人。我还被警告不要过于靠近烛堡，因为那里有强大的冒险者和生物（听说还有一条龙！）守卫着通往那里的道路，正在寻找某个据说要前往那里的猎物。玛扎克想避免与他们发生任何冲突，因为他们的目标似乎与塔洛斯的目标并不冲突，而且无论如何他们都会分散注意力。”

你可以用这张地图自己找到神像，并把它带给玛扎克。
src:
This is a map of the surrounding region with a location marked. It was found on the body of a devotee of Talos, god of destruction, and some notes have been written on it:

"We have discovered the location of an idol to Kozah, as our lord Talos was called in the days of Netheril. This idol is believed to be very powerful and its recovery will greatly aid the cause of destruction. Thus, we have been tasked to recover it, but various enemies have learned of our plans and seek to thwart us. Stormherald Marzak seeks to test us by sending out multiple parties to recover the idol, with rewards to be bestowed on whoever first obtains it, as well as for slaying any foes who seek to get in our way. If I succeed in recovering the idol, I should bring it to Stormherald Marzak, who has taken up residence for now in the Nashkel Inn, and has promised to greatly reward whoever succeeds in bringing him the idol. I have also been warned not to get too close to Candlekeep, as there are powerful adventurers and creatures (including a dragon, I hear!) guarding the approaches to that place, seeking some quarry supposed to be headed there. Marzak wants to avoid any conflict with them, as it seems their goals do not conflict with those of Talos, and in any case they would be a distraction."

You could use this map to find the idol yourself, and bring it to Marzak.

咒法系（治疗）
等级：牧师 1，德鲁伊 1
成分：言语，姿势
施法时间：1 动作
距离：接触
目标：接触到的活物
持续时间：10 轮 + 1 轮/等级
豁免检定：意志无效（无害）
法术抗力：是（无害）

通过手的触碰，你提升受术者的生命能量，在法咒持续时间内赋予他或她快速治疗能力。此治疗仅适用于法咒持续期间所受的伤害，不适用于之前伤势造成的伤害。受术者每轮治疗 1 点此类伤害的生命值，直到法咒结束，并且如果在此期间因生命值损失而濒死，则自动稳定。

再生轻伤不能恢复因饥饿，口渴或窒息而失去的生命值，也不能使生物再生或接合失去的身体部位。多个再生法咒的效果不叠加，只有最高等级的效果生效。施加第二个同等等级的再生法咒会将第一个法咒的持续时间延长第二个法咒的完整持续时间。
src:
Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric 1, Druid 1,
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

With a touch of your hand, you boost the subject's life energy, granting him or her the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.  This healing applies only to damage sustained during the spell's duration, not to that from previous injuries.  The subject heals 1 hit point per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.

Regenerate light wounds does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts. The effects of multiple regenerate spells do not stack, only the highest-level effect applies.  Applying a second regenerate spell of equal level extends the first spell's duration by the full duration of the second spell.

src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific
Prerequisite: Warlock 1

Because the somatic components required for warlock invocations are relatively simple, a warlock can use any of his invocations while wearing light armor without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. However, like arcane spellcasters, a warlock wearing medium or heavy armor or using a shield incurs a chance of arcane spell failure (all invocations, including eldritch blast, have a somatic component). A multiclass warlock still incurs the normal arcane spell failure chance for arcane spells received from levels in other classes.

Use: Automatic.

src: Rajar has assigned me yet another mission. I am to steal the Serkhad Scarab, located in the treasure vault of the Serkhad Noble Estate. To get in I should enter the sewers beneath the noble estates, where I will find a passage to the basement of this estate. Once in, I will need to search the estate for two keys, one for the outer, and one for the inner door to the vault. Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.\n\nI acquired the Serkhad Scarab and returned it to Rajar, but he was unwilling to reward me because of the people I killed in the course of the mission. Perhaps I should have gotten involved with a less squeamish guild. In any event, the extra loot I found on the estate is the real reward.

dst: 沙玛什·凯齐尔当时正在卡林港，拜一位被他在锻造方面的卓越天赋所打动的大师铁匠为师。此时，他出生的村庄，包括他的全部家人，被一群从蜘蛛沼泽中出来的蜥蜴人和巨魔屠杀。听到这个消息后，凯齐尔回到了他被摧毁的家园。他找到了他父亲和兄弟倒下的尸体，他们是在最后的抵抗中阵亡的，每只死者的手中都紧握着一把弯刀。他撬开了弯刀，用这两把刀刃打造了这把单一的武器。他用它追捕了那些导致他家人死亡的怪物，并将它们全部杀死。沙玛什对他赋予这把武器的力量的描述如下：“巨魔将在我的愤怒之火中燃烧，蜥蜴将在我的冰冷仇恨前倒下。所有阻挡我的人都会听到我的复仇尖叫。”
src: Shamash Kezir was away in Calimport, apprenticed to a master smith impressed by his great talent at the forge, when the village of his birth, including his entire family, was slaughtered by a band of Lizardmen and Trolls that came out of the Spider Swamp. Upon hearing of this, Kezir returned to his destroyed home. He found the corpses of his father and brother where they had fallen in a last stand, each with a scimitar clutched in a dead hand. He pried the scimitars loose and fashioned this single weapon from the two blades. With it he hunted down the monsters responsible for his family's death and slew them all. Shamash's description of the powers with which he had imbued this weapon was as follows: "The Trolls shall burn in the fire of my wrath, the Lizards shall fall before my cold hatred. All who stand in my way shall hear my scream of vengeance."

src: He listens to your tale. "Very strange. It sounds as if there is some sort of fire-based planar faction out to kill Zarala Galhadr, and an air-based one out to protect her. Hard to see why either would care about her. In any case, now that I have your story I will begin making inquiries among some of my planar contacts to see if I can find out more about these matters. It would probably be best if you were to observe and report back to Pasha Galhadr about whatever we find. I'll begin by summoning a creature from the Plane of Fire."

It is a large tower surrounded by a water channel and I need only leave the Galhadr Estate and head to the south to find it.\n\nUpon entering the Zekar estate, I was mistaken for an attacker, and a magical defense was activated tranporting me to some fiery plane where I was set upon by elementals.
