红玉神卫是侍奉死亡与魔法女神维婕丝的天诛之剑教团。这些神秘莫测的隐秘战士是贾西特信仰的军事力量。他们保护维婕丝的庙宇，守卫教会的重要领袖，协助效忠女巫女神的强大术士和死灵法师，并帮助训练新手神职人员。当被召唤时，他们也充当间谍和刺客。在红玉神卫团中，复仇者骑士负责执行最后一种任务。大多数时候，复仇者骑士可以自由行事，但骑士团的领袖或信仰的高阶祭司偶尔会给他一项需要潜行，恐吓或暗杀的特殊任务。红玉神卫依靠他的精神力量以及天诛之剑很少掌握的武术技法来捕获或处决信仰的标记敌人。他以坚定不移的决心和正义的复仇进行打击，而他在教会中的赞助人则安心入睡，知道红玉神卫随时准备执行教会的命令。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Ruby Knights are a crusader order in the service of Wee Jas, goddess of death and magic. Inscrutable and mysterious, these secretive warriors serve as the militant arm of the Jasite faith. They protect the temples of Wee Jas, guard important leaders of the church, aid powerful sorcerers and necromancers sworn to the Witch Goddess, and help to train novice clergy. When called upon, they also serve as spies and assassins. Within the Ruby Knight order, the knights-vindicator are responsible for undertaking duties of the last variety. Most of the time, a knights-vindicator is free to do as he pleases, but every so often leaders of the knightly order or high priests of the faith come to him with a special assignment that requires stealth, intimidation, or assassination. A Ruby Knight vindicator relies on his spiritual strength and skill in martial disciplines rarely mastered by crusaders to capture or dispatch marked enemies of the faith. He strikes with unflinching determination and righteous vengeance, and his benefactors within the church sleep comfortably knowing the Ruby Knights always stand ready to do the church's bidding.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Ruby Knight Vindicator gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Hide 4 ranks, Intimidate 4 ranks, Lore 8 ranks.
Maneuvers: Must know at least one Devoted Spirit maneuver, and one Devoted Spirit stance.
Special: Must be able to turn undead, and must worship Wee Jas. Clerics must have the Death and Magic domains.

CLASS FEATURES:

2: Divine Recovery - Expend a Turning attempt to recover a maneuver

6:
7: Divine Impetus - Expend a Turning attempt to gain a swift action
8:
9: Divine Fury - Expend a Turning attempt to gain +4 attack, 1d10 damage
10:

Maneuvers

The Ruby Knight Vindicator may only select maneuvers from the Devoted Spirit, Shadow Hand, Stone Dragon, or White Raven disciplines. He adds his full class level to his initiator level. He gains new maneuvers known and readied at the indicated levels.

BONUS DIVINE SPELLS

Every level in Ruby Knight Vindicator, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

在扎泽斯普尔的伊尔梅特神殿——泪之屋的地下，我遇到了一个名叫妮尔瓦·瓦尔切扎的人，她是伊尔梅特的圣武士，正驻守在此，防范来自城市下方幽暗地域洞穴的威胁。在那里，她发现了一道由负能量构成的黑暗屏障，它正在扩张，并将幽暗地域的生物转化为亡灵怪物。她请求我为她找到一块游荡者之石，因为拥有它就能穿透这道屏障。在获得这样一件物品后，我也同意陪伴她，帮助她对抗黑暗屏障之后的任何邪恶。

穿过黑暗屏障后，我们遇到了显然是造成它存在的生物：一位前矮人圣武士，如今已堕落为亡灵末日骑士。他的家园显然很久以前被卓尔入侵者摧毁，他现在寻求向所有卓尔复仇。为了实现复仇，他与黑暗力量达成了某种契约，释放出一圈不断扩张的负能量，将落入其中的生物转化为亡灵。他声称它最终会扩张到覆盖整个扎泽斯普尔城，给他一支亡灵大军，他计划率领这支大军对卓尔发动灭绝战役。

我们成功挫败了他的计划，一路战斗穿过废弃的矮人厅堂，最终击败了末日骑士，并摧毁了一座奇怪的祭坛，它正是扩散负能量的源头。黑暗屏障现在应该开始收缩并最终崩塌。任务完成后，我们回到妮尔瓦的营地，并在那里分道扬镳。
src:
Beneath the House of Tears, a Temple of Ilmater in Zazesspur, I encountered one Nierva Var'cheza, a Paladin of Ilmater who is standing guard against a menace originating in the underdark caverns below the city. There she found a dark barrier of negative energy that is expanding and transforming creatures of the Underdark into Undead monstosities. She asked that I find a Rogue Stone for her, as possession of this would allow the barrier to be pentrated. Having acquired such an item, I then also agreed to accompany her and aid her against whatever evil lies beyond the dark barrier.

Having passed through the dark barrier, we encountered the creature apparently responsible for its presence: a former dwarven paladin, now a corrupted, undead Doom Knight. His home was apparently destroyed by Drow invaders long ago, and he now sought vengeance against all Drow. To obtain it, he made some compact with dark powers that unleashed an expanding orbit of negative power that transformed into undead those who fall within it. He claimed that it would eventually grow to encompass the entire city of Zazesspur, giving him an army of undead that he planned to lead on a campaign of extermination against the Drow. 

We were able to frustrate his plans, fighting our way through the ruined dwarven halls, eventually defeating the Doom Knight and destroying a strange altar that turned out to be the source of the spreading negative energy. The dark barrier should now begin to contract and eventually collapse. Our quest accomplished, we returned to Nierva's camp, and there parted ways.

德沙里斯，蔓延之魂
  
作为“城市出生的精类”中的第一个，如今以时代精神与灰小丑等生物为代表，德沙里斯是那些致力于传播文明者的恩惠，也是大多数精类和荒野崇拜者的天敌。他赋予缚灵者抵御荒野危险的庇护，并提供对抗自然开辟自己领域的力量。

契灵等级：6级
缚灵DC:27
特殊要求：德沙里斯不会在自然环境中回应你的呼唤，只在城市区域的人工景观中回应。

影响：在德沙里斯的影响下，你无法忍受独处，你周围的人越多越好。你永远不会自愿接受任何需要你独处的任务，并激烈反对会分裂队伍的选择。如果你有机会与一大群人社交（例如进入一间喧闹的酒馆），你必须抓住机会，除非这样做明显有害，或者你有理由怀疑这些人对你有敌意。

授予能力：
德沙里斯赋予的能力反映了他保护世界文明民族的愿望，并提供了一些显示他对精类和其他自然生物愤怒的能力。

城市居民：在承载德沙里斯时，你在城市区域获得+10尺的移动速度加值。此外，你获得+6的学识检定能力加值。

无限之门：每天一次，你可以传送，如同该法咒，施法者等级等于你的缚灵者等级。

斩击自然之魂：你可以尝试用一次近战攻击斩击一个动物，元素，精类或植物。你将魅力加值（如果有）加到攻击检定上，并每有效缚灵者等级造成1点额外伤害。如果你意外斩击了一个不属于上述类型的生物，该尝试无效。一旦你使用了此能力，你5轮内不能再次使用。

城市之灵：你可以活化物体，如同该法咒，施法者等级等于你的缚灵者等级。一旦你使用了此能力，你必须在效果结束后等待5轮才能再次使用。
src:
Desharis, the Sprawling Soul
  
The first of the "city-born fey," represented today by such creatures as the zeitgeist and the gray jester, Desharis is a boon to those who work to spread civilization, and anathema to most fey and worshipers of the wild. He grants binders shelter against the dangers of the wild, and he provides powers to carve out their own niche against nature.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 27
Special Requirement: Desharis will not answer your call in a natural environment, only responding in the worked landscapes of urban areas. 

Influence: Under Desharis's influence, you cannot stand to be alone, and the more people you have around you, the better. You never voluntarily accept any task that requires you to be alone, and you argue vigorously against options that would split the party. If you have the opportunity to socialize with large groups of people (such as entering a boisterous tavern), you must take it unless doing so is overtly harmful, or you have reason to suspect the individuals are hostile to you.

Granted Abilities: 
Desharis grants abilities that reflect his desire to protect the civilized peoples of the world, plus provides a few that show his anger at the fey and other creatures of nature.

City-Dweller: While hosting Desharis, you gain a +10 ft. bonus to move speed when in urban areas. In addition, you gain a +6 competence bonus on Lore checks.

Infinite Doors: Once per day, you may teleport, as per the spell, as a caster of your binder level.

Smite Natural Soul: You may attempt to smite an animal, elemental, fey, or plant with a single melee attack. You add your Charisma bonus (if any) to the attack roll and deal 1 extra point of damage per effective binder level. If you accidentally smite a creature that is not one of the above types, the attempt has no effect. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Spirits of the City: You can animate objects, as the spell, as a caster of your binder level. Once you have used this ability, you must wait 5 rounds after the effect has expired before you can do so again.

src: While exploring Dark Calimport, I came across a group of kobolds. This particular group did not attack me and seemed peaceful enough, but their chief told me that they might not remain that way. It seems they have been having a problem with a troll who has been killing many of them, and they made a deal with the aggressive wererats infesting Calimport's sewers. The wererats told the kobolds that they would help deal with the troll, but in return the kobolds are to join them in making war against Calimport. The kobold chief felt he had no choice but to agree with this. However, I have offered to slay the troll myself. If I can accomplish this and bring the troll's head to him, the chief has promised that he will not ally with the wererats, and reward me with some treasure he has collected as well. This troll wanders the regions to the west of the kobold encampment. I should set out to hunt it down as soon as I have made certain I possess some means of delivering enough fire or acid damage to overcome its regenerative powers.\n\nThe troll has been slain. I should take its head and return it to the kobold chieftan.

Range: Melee Attack.

dst: 当我最近从死亡中归来时，那个在这种场合迎接我的神秘实体要求我提供额外的服务。显然，恶魔阿兹古尔卡的爪牙正在入侵气元素位面，试图获取某种强大的魔法物品，而那个实体希望我协助对抗他们。这些敌人来自一个火焰传送门，我要用“风之力”战斗并关闭它（我猜这意味着我要对传送门施放“造风术”，因为那个实体还给了我一件可以释放这个法术的物品）。\n\n那个实体已经将我传送到了战斗现场，我成功关闭了火焰传送门，这是我在这里最重要的任务。我也调查了被争夺的魔法宝珠，扎拉拉做的某件事导致我们被它注入了力量。它确实非常强大，尽管其确切性质尚不清楚。我认为这里没有什么更多可做的了，所以我不妨通过另一个传送门回去，向派我来此的神秘实体汇报。
src: When I was recently returned from death, the mysterious entity that greets me on such occasions asked for an additional service from me. Apparently minions of the demon Azghulkar are invading the Plane of Air, seeking to acquire some powerful magical object, and the entity wants me to assist in fighting them. These enemies are coming from a fiery portal that I am to fight to and close with "the power of the wind" (which I assume means that I am to cast a "Gust of Wind" spell on the portal, since the entity also gave me an item that can unleash this spell). \n\nThe entity has transported me to the scene of the battle, and I was able to close the flaming portal, my most impotant task here. I have also investigated the magical orb being fought over, and something Zarala did caused us to be infused with power by it. It is indeed most powerful, though its precise nature is unclear. I do not think there is anything more to be done here, so I might as well return through the other portal to report to the mysterious entity that sent me here.

dst: 许多武僧满足于留在修道院中，向本派所信奉的神祇或哲学祈祷或冥想，而另一些则游历诸国度，或前往本派圣地朝圣，或更广泛地传播本派信仰。由于修行生活的禁欲苦修，这类武僧大多外表不起眼，身着破旧衣物，又因旅途艰辛而更加褴褛，看起来像是强盗或劫掠怪物的容易目标。然而，许多这样的朝圣武僧都装备着像这样的武器。它外表不过是一根没有魔法属性的普通手杖，实际上却与那些在身心灵魂完美和谐的修行目标上有所进展的人相调谐，在合适的人手中是极其强大的武器。强盗和劫掠者常常发现它是一个令人不快的惊喜。正如其持有者所受的许多训练一样，这把武器隐藏的魔法依赖于不同力量与元素之间的平衡。
src: While many monks are content to reside in their monasteries, praying to or meditating upon whatever deity or philosophy their Order is committed to, others wander the realms, either on pilgrimages to special sites sacred to their Order or to spread the Order's beliefs more widely. Due to the asceticism of their way of life, most such Monk present an unimpressive appearance, dressed in poor garments made worse by the rigors of travel, and appear to be easy targets for bandits or raiding monsters. Many such pilgrim monks, however, are equipped with weapons like this. In appearance no more than a simple walking staff without magical properties, it is in fact attuned to those who have made progress in the monastic goal of perfection and harmony of body, mind and soul, and is a most formidable weapon in the right hands. Bandits and raiders have often found it to be an unpleasant surprise. Like much of the training of its wielders, the hidden magicks of the weapon depend on a balance of different forces and elements.

However, the forest master becomes vulnerable to fire, and suffers double damage from fire attacks.

src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a mysterious hooded figure who claims to be a merchant of some sort. He asked me to acquire three items he needs as magical reagents: the hide of a displacer beast, the brain of an intellect devourer, and a diamond. I brought him all three items and in return received a little gold and a magical orb that is supposed to infuse me with knowledge and power. The orb is cracked, however, and it is uncertain how well it will work.\n\nHaving accomplished this task, the strange merchant has now asked me to provide him with an Orb of Xerxkatun, promising to pay me 25000 gold if I give him one. Such a large sum for an item of unclear purpose makes for a tempting offer, but I am uncertain if it would be a good idea to give away one of these mysterious objects retrieved from Xerxkatun's old lairs.

dst: 在惬意安息旅店，我遇到了一位名叫韦斯顿·凯尔姆的圣武士，并同意协助他处理一件需要扒手技能的事情。一颗强大而危险的魔法宝珠正被存放在一个名叫莫斯·贾尔津的邪恶法师的塔中，凯尔姆希望我将其取回。要进入塔中，我需要从贾尔津身上扒走他随身携带的钥匙（他也可以在这家惬意安息旅店找到），并用它进入那座塔，塔位于码头以北集市以东。一旦进入其中，我就需要搜寻那颗宝珠，应对贾尔津可能设置来阻挡去路的任何守卫怪物或其他危险，拿到它并带回给凯尔姆。\n\n宝珠已经取回。现在我只需把它交还给韦斯顿·凯尔姆。
src: In the Winsome Repose, I met a paladin named Weston Kelm, and agreed to assist him with a matter that requires the skills of a pickpocket. A powerful and dangerous magical orb is being held in the tower of an evil wizard named Maus Jarlzin, and Kelm wants me to recover it. To enter the tower, I will need to pickpocket the key being carried by Jarlzin (who can also be found here at the Winsome Repose) on his person, and use it to enter the tower, which can be found to the east of the markets north of the docks. Once within I will need to search the place for the orb, dealing with any guardian monsters or other hazards Jarlzin may have set to bar the way, take it and bring it back to Kelm.\n\nThe orb has been recovered. Now I need only return it to Weston Kelm.

dst:
学派：防护系
等级：游侠 4，术士/法师 3，诡术 3
成分：言语，姿势，材料
施法时间：1 个标准动作
距离：接触
目标：接触到的生物或物体
持续时间：1 小时/等级
豁免检定：意志，通过则无效（无害，物体）
法术抗力：是（无害，物体）

被防护的生物或物体变得难以被预言系法咒侦测，例如锐耳术/鹰眼术，定位物体和侦测法咒。回避侦测也能防止被水晶球等魔法物品定位。如果对受防护的生物或物品尝试预言系法咒，预言系施法者必须通过施法者等级检定（1d20 + 施法者等级）对抗 DC 11 + 施放回避侦测的施法者等级。如果你对自己或你当前拥有的物品施放回避侦测，DC 为 15 + 你的施法者等级。
如果对生物施放，回避侦测也会防护该生物身上的装备。

材料成分：一小撮价值 50 gp 的钻石尘。
src:
School: Abjuration
Level: Rgr 4, Sor/Wiz 3, Trickery 3
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Creature or object touched
Duration: 1 hour/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless, object)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless, object)

The warded creature or object becomes difficult to detect by divination spells such as clairaudience/clairvoyance, locate object, and detect spells. Nondetection also prevents location by such magic items as crystal balls. If a divination is attempted against the warded creature or item, the caster of the divination must succeed on a caster level check (1d20 + caster level) against a DC of 11 + the caster level of the spellcaster who cast nondetection. If you cast nondetection on yourself or on an item currently in your possession, the DC is 15 + your caster level.
If cast on a creature, nondetection wards the creature's gear as well as the creature itself.

Material Component: A pinch of diamond dust worth 50 gp.

Any with such blood who read the book will find themselves infused with knowledge and power, even if they lack the scholarship to understand the ancient writing.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide experience. That provided to dwarves will be quite significant, but the benefits to those of other races will be nominal. Note also that only those who are naturally dwarven will benefit, not those who have temporarily shifted or somehow polymorphed themselves into a dwarven form. There is also a slight bonus to those with a high lore skill.

dst:
哈马德一直在筹备对变形蛛总部的进攻，如今我们已掌握其位置情报，进攻几乎准备就绪，军队正集结于蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结地。哈马德指示我前往该集结地，为进攻贡献我的能力。抵达后，我需向那里的指挥官——卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以其认为合适的方式提供协助。该前往城门了，在那里带上我想带的任何随从，然后出发前往沼泽。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结地，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已与服务于我们变形蛛敌人的类人生物（此处多为蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会获胜，但担心等到胜利之时，我们敌人的首领早已逃离总部，以便从其他地点继续他们的战争。为防止这种情况，他计划派我沿斥候发现的一条向北的小路前进，这条小路能让我绕过敌军主力抵达基地。我将沿此路行进，并与驻扎在小路开始再次向南拐弯处之前的军队斥候会合。随后，我和斥候们将一路杀穿敌军后方——希望那里抵抗薄弱——以抵达基地。一旦到达，我需在变形蛛首领策划逃脱之前将其杀死。

虽然与军队斥候的会合并未按计划进行，但我仍抵达了基地并深入其中。是时候执行将军的计划了，在变形蛛及其可能在场的任何盟友设法逃脱之前，将他们尽数杀死。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

While the rendezvous with the army's scouts did not go as planned, I have nevertheless reached the base and penetrated within. It is time to proceed with the general's plan by killing the aranea here, along with any of their allies who may be present, before they can effect some sort of escape.

dst: 我们在尖牙森林与之战斗的一些豺狼人用一根魔法石柱打开了一道通往深渊的传送门。这根石柱是支撑一道通往深渊某层的传送门的两根石柱之一，那一层由塔纳厘恶魔耶诺古统治，许多豺狼人将他奉为神明。这样的石柱共有两根，另一根位于深渊那侧附近的某处。如果我们穿过传送门，摧毁或停用那根石柱，我们就能返回并摧毁这一根，从而关闭传送门，防止任何进一步的恶魔入侵。\n\n在深渊经历了一些冒险之后，那侧的传送门被停用了。现在我们自己位面上的传送门也已被摧毁。已经无法再通过传送门了。我预计它很快就会消散并彻底消失。
src: Some gnolls we were fighting in the Wood of Sharp Teeth responded by opening a portal to the Abyss, using a magical pillar. This pillar is one of two holding open a portal to a layer of the Abyss ruled by the tanar'ri Yeenoghu, worshipped by many gnolls as a god. It is one of two such pillars, with the other being somewhere nearby on the other side, in the Abyss. If we were to cross through the portal, and destroy or deactivate that pillar, we could then return and destroy this one, and thereby close the portal, protecting against any further demonic incursions through it.\n\nAfter some adventures in the Abyss, the portal on that side was deactivated. Now the portal on our own plane has been destroyed as well. It is no longer possible to transit the portal. I expect that it will soon fade away and disappear completely.

（进阶职业）
技艺精湛的铁匠能打造钢制武器，有些甚至能打造结合钢铁与魔法的武器，但只有钢魂铸师才能打造出将这两种技艺与灵魂精华塑造相结合的武器。钢魂铸师能同时制造出物理，魔法和灵魂融合的武器，在他手中，这确实成为一件强大的兵器。

所有钢魂铸师都是拥有制造武器和护甲技能的矮人大师铁匠，但他们也是矮人人民的伟大冠军。他们坚定而果断，作为古老传说的保存者，圣地的守护者，工艺与技能的教师，以及矮人神祇的神圣仆人。因为他们能锻造和挥舞具有可怕力量的武器，他们体现了矮人的信念：技能与勇气相结合可以击败任何敌人。

- 生命骰：d8
- 武器和护甲熟练：钢魂铸师不获得任何额外的武器或护甲熟练。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

种族：矮人。
阵营：任意非邪恶。
技能：手艺（护甲制造） 8级，知识 2级。
魂能塑造：塑造灵魂融合的能力（需要至少11点体质）

职业特性：

等级
1： 盾牌联结 - 将魂能投入盾牌以获得元素抗力
2： 锻造秘密 - 手艺（武器和护甲制造） 获得3倍职业等级加值
3： 锻造知识 - 手艺检定获得职业等级加值
4： 脉轮联结（手臂）
5： 护甲联结 - 将魂能投入护甲以获得伤害减免
6： 脉轮联结（腰部） 
7： 
8： 脉轮联结（肩部）
9： 武器联结 - 将魂能投入武器以获得伤害和眩晕效果
10：脉轮联结（心脏） 

额外魂能塑造：

在除第一级外的每个钢魂铸师等级，你增加你的魂能塑造者等级，你能塑造的灵魂融合数量，你能创建的脉轮联结数量，以及你的魂能池，如同你在获得魂能铸造者等级之前所属的魂能塑造职业中提升了一级。然而，你不会获得该职业的任何其他能力，例如新的脉轮联结层级。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Skilled smiths can produce weapons of steel, and some can create weapons incorporating both steel and magic, but only the ironsoul forgemaster can craft a weapon that combines these arts with the shaping of soul essence. An ironsoul forgemaster can produce a weapon that is physical, magical, and soulmelded all at the same time, and in his hands it becomes a potent armament indeed.

All ironsoul forgemasters are dwarven mastersmiths who possess skill at crafting arms and armor, but they are also great champions of the dwarven people. Resolute and determined, they serve as preservers of ancient lore, guardians of sacred places, teachers of craft and skill, and holy servants of the dwarf deities. Because they can forge and wield weapons of terrible power, they embody the dwarven belief that skill coupled with courage can defeat any foe.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: An Ironsoul Forgemaster does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Dwarf.
Alignment: Any nonevil.
Skills: Craft (armorsmithing) 8 ranks, Lore 2 ranks.
Meldshaping: Ability to shape soulmelds (requires a minimum of an 11 Constitution)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Shield Bond - Invest essentia into shield for elemental resistance
2:  Secrets of the Forge - 3x class level to Craft Arms and Armor
3:  Forge Lore - Class level to craft checks
4:  Chakra Bind (Arms)
5:  Armor Bond - Invest essentia into armour for damage resistance
6:  Chakra Bind (Waist) 
7:  
8:  Chakra Bind (Shoulders)
9:  Weapon Bond - Invest essentia into weapon for damage and dazing
10: Chakra Bind (Heart) 

BONUS MELDSHAPING:

At each ironsoul forgemaster level other than first, you increase your meldshaper level, the number of soulmelds you can shape, the number of chakra binds you can create, and your essentia pool as if you had gained a level in a meldshaping class to which you belonged prior to gaining the soulcaster level. You do not, however, gain any other abilities of that class, such as new tiers of chakra binds.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Ur-Priest 6
Benefit: Because they steal whatever power they can, ur-priests learn to manipulate their energy in ways that confound other casters. An ur-priest of 6th level or higher can temporarily sacrifice two (or more) lower-level spell slots and use those slots to prepare a higher-level spell. The higher-level spell must be of a level the ur-priest can cast. Only one exchange of this sort can be made each day. The levels of the lower-level slots are totaled, then reduced to three-quarters (round down) to determine the level of the extra higher-level spell slot. For example, an ur-priest who sacrifices a 3rd-level spell and a 5th-level spell can use that spell slot to prepare an additional 6th-level spell (3 + 5 = 8, and 8 * 3/4 = 6).
Use: Selected

src:
Pixies are merry pranksters that are known for leading travelers astray. They are equally known, however, for being roused to surprising ire when dealing with evil creatures. They are naturally adept with magic, with a high spell resistance and an affinity for spell casting. Being mischievous, they are particularly drawn to illusionary spells and can, in fact, cast invisibility on themselves with no specific magical training. Legend claims that pixies die only through injury or disease.

Pixie Ability Adjustments: +8 Dex, +6 Int, +6 Cha, +4 Wis, -4 Str
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass pixie's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether she suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Pixies are able to see in the dark.
- Small Stature
- +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
- +1 size bonus to AC.
- +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Dodge: The character gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from his current target or last attacker.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 15, plus 1 per character level.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 1.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Damage Reduction: Innate damage reduction of 10/+1.
- Spell-like Abilities: At Will - Invisibility; 1/day - Confusion, Entangle, Lesser Dispel, Polymorph Self. Caster level 8th, except Confusion, which is caster level 4th. The DC is Charisma-based.
- Fey: Pixies count as Fey for the purpose of spells.

泽西尔，星之眷族
  
泽西尔是一位凡人女术士，曾与来自遥远国度的异界力量交流。她痴迷于永生，寻找那些异界存在，希望学习它们永恒的秘密。当她死去时，她变成了一个可怕扭曲的残魂，永远试图通过她散布在世界各地的众多神器重新进入国度。泽西尔赋予你将身心转化为异界形态的能力，赋予你心智感应，对疯狂相关效果的抗力，召唤伪自然生物的能力，以及释放纯粹疯狂闪电的力量。

残魂等级：6级
绑定DC:25
特殊要求：无

影响：绝不承认你需要帮助或你比任何人都弱。以蔑视和轻蔑对待那些比你弱的人，尤其是年轻女性和自发施法者。

授予能力：
当绑定泽西尔时，你的身心变得异界化，允许你以多种方式引导星之眷族的力量。

异界形态：当绑定泽西尔时，你获得伪自然模板。

异界心智：你的心智是异界的，不像正常凡人那样运作。你对困惑，疯狂和怪异法咒免疫。此外，你在对抗影响心智效果的豁免检定上获得每四个绑定者等级+1加值。

疯狂闪电：你可以发射一道射线，使对手眩晕1d3轮。你必须成功进行远程接触攻击，射程为100英尺+10英尺/绑定者等级。成功的意志豁免可抵消该效果。一旦你使用了此能力，5轮内不能再次使用。

召唤异界生物：你可以召唤任何与你等级相同的术士能从召唤生物列表上召唤的生物。你用此能力召唤的任何生物都获得伪自然模板。因此，在10级时你可以召唤召唤生物I-V列表上的任何生物。当你达到14级时，你可以召唤召唤生物I-VII列表上的任何生物。一旦你使用了此能力，5轮内不能再次使用。
src:
Zceryll, the Star Spawn
  
Zceryll was a mortal sorceress who communed with alien powers from the far realm. She became obsessed with immortality, seeking out the alien beings in the hopes of learning their eternal secrets. When she died, she became a hideously twisted vestige, forever seeking to re-enter the Realms via numerous artifacts she dispersed across the world. Zceryll grants you the ability to transform your body and mind into an alien form, granting you telepathy, resistance to effects related to insanity, the ability to summon pseudonatural creatures, and the power to unleash bolts of pure madness.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: No

Influence: Never admit that you need help or that you are weaker than anyone else. Treat those that are weaker than you with scorn and contempt, especially young women and spontaneous spellcasters.

Granted Abilities: 
While bound to Zceryll, your body and mind become alien, allowing you to channel the power of the star spawn in a variety of ways.

Alien form: While bound to Zceryll, you gain the pseudonatural template.

Alien Mind: Your mind is alien and does not work like that of a normal mortal. You are immune to confusion, insanity, and weird spells. In addition, you receive a +1 bonus per four binder levels on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

Bolts of Madness: You can fire a ray that dazes an opponent for 1d3 rounds. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with a range of 100 ft. + 10 ft./binder level. A successful Will save negates the effect. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Summon Alien: You can summon any creature from the summon creature list that a sorcerer of your level could summon. Any creature you summon with this ability gains the pseudonatural template. Thus, at 10th level you could summon any creature from the summon creature I-V list. When you reach 14th level, you can summon any creature from the summon creature I-VII list.Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

魂能形成一排龙椎骨，漂浮在离你自己脊柱几英寸的地方。肋骨从椎骨中长出，形成一件隐藏你背部的斗篷。斗篷继续在你身后生长，延伸成一条长长的龙尾。

你形成一条龙尾，可以打击敌人，造成1d8点钝击伤害 + 你的力量调整值。你可以用尾巴作为标准动作每轮进行一次攻击。

src:
Dragon Tail
  
Descriptors: Draconic
Classes: Incarnate, totemist
Chakra: Feet, waist (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms a row of dragon vertebrae floating inches from your own spine. Ribs grow from the vertebrae, creating a cloak that conceals your back. The cloak continues to grow behind you, extending into a long dragon tail.

You form a draconic tail that can strike foes, dealing 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage + your Strength modifier. You can make one attack per round with the tail as a standard action.

Essentia: For every point of essentia invested in your dragon tail, the tail's attack gains a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls.

Chakra Bind (Feet)

The tail of this soulmeld grows broad and thick.

The dragon foil provides you with a measure of stability. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Balance and Jump checks. For each point of essentia invested in your dragon tail, the bonus improves by 2.

Chakra Bind (Waist)

The vertebrae fuse to your back, the ribs blending into your own. The tail becomes lively and animate, constantly twitching from side to side.

The dragon tail's damage dealt increases to 2d6 points + 1-1/2 ?your Strength bonus.

Chakra Bind (Totem)

The tail takes on the appearance of flesh and bone and becomes more agile and animated

As a standard action, you can make a tail sweep. All creatures adjacent to you automatically take damage as if they had been struck by your dragon tail (Reflex half).

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Incarnate 
Chakra: Brow or soul

Incarnum forms an ornate vestment draped over your shoulders, covering any other clothing, armor, or vestments you are wearing. The chasuble is little more than a large circle with a hole in the center for your head, but raw incarnum is woven like blue thread into intricate patterns down its front.

You also gain resistance 10 to a specific energy type, based on your alignment. Chaotic incarnates gain resistance to electricity 10, evil incarnates gain resistance to acid 10, good incarnates gain resistance to cold 10, and lawful incarnates gain resistance to fire 10. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested in your planar chasuble increases the resistance to the specified energy type by 5 points. 

Chakra Bind (Brow) 

When you activate your incarnum radiance, the glow surrounding you also courses through the incarnum threads in your planar chasuble.

The bonus granted by your incarnum radiance class feature increases by 1. 

Chakra Bind (Soul) 

The embroidered patterns formed by raw incarnum in the front of your planar chasuble constantly shift and seem to depict living scenes from planes beyond the material world.

Once per week you can cast gate.

dst:
纳西拉克告诉过我一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特信徒，他是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他武僧提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名武僧，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅，我之前没有理由注意到它，它通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通向隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我这也可能很危险。

我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他开始了我的训练计划，并给了我几项任务。首先，我要去拿他洞穴西南角一个袋子里的刚毛衬衣，我将在训练期间穿着它。接下来，他要我从我来这里时穿过的隧道里一具尸体上找到的四件武僧装备中拿一件，带到洞穴外的悬崖边，扔进那里的深渊。他相信这将帮助我培养对物质财富的漠不关心。

我扔掉了其中一件物品，然后回来在伊拉姆大师的指导下进行了一些体能训练。现在他要我去站在他洞穴的东北角，一动不动，直到他说可以为止，以帮助培养耐心和自制力。

伊拉姆大师表示我已经等得够久了。我现在应该去和他谈谈。
src:
Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.

I have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and given me a couple of tasks. Firstly, I am to get the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave, which I am to wear during my training. Next, he wants me to take one of four items of monk gear I found on a corpse in the tunnel I traversed coming here, bring it to the cliff outside the cave, and throw it into the chasm there. He believes this will assist me in developing a lack of concern for material possessions.

I threw away one of the items, and then returned to carry out some phyical exercises under Master Iram's direction. Now he wants me to go stand motionless in the northeast corner of his cave until he says otherwise, to assist in developing patience and self-control.

Master Iram has indicated that I have waited long enough. I should go speak with him now.

dst: <StartHighlight>[善良 +1]</Start> "泽卡尔曾像你现在这样说话，但看看他现在，是我意志的奴隶。你们愚蠢的凡人可能会宣称崇高的理想，但一旦你试图实现它们，你就会发现你必须在此过程中杀死和摧毁。你必须使用恶魔的工具来实现你所谓的‘善良’目标，这样做你就是在为我们服务，无论你是否意识到这一点。你们凡人永远不会明白，重要的不是你们的目的，因为比你们更强大的力量总会决定你们能否实现它们。只有你们选择用来确保它们的手段——光荣而富有同情心，还是无情而背信弃义——才是重要的，因为这决定了这些更强大的力量中哪一个愿意与你结盟，而深渊的方法是最实用的。"

dst:
再次乘坐瓦尔库尔之剑号出发时，我们遭到了一头强大的蓝龙的攻击，它显然与泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡合作，并试图杀死扎拉拉。那头龙摧毁了船只并杀死了大部分船员，船搁浅后，扎拉拉和我逃进了一个附近龙无法进入的小洞穴，才得以逃脱。那头龙的反应是砸碎周围的岩壁，把我们封在洞穴里，指望我们会在里面饿死。然而，我们找到了一条向下通往更大洞穴网络、并最终通往幽暗地域的路径。

我们在幽暗地域中游荡了一段时间，期间遇到了一个底栖魔鱼，它继承了阿兹古尔卡先前行走于大地之时留下的记忆。它绑架了扎拉拉，显然是其计划的一部分，目的是获得泽法德之剑的控制权，并在其回归时用它来对抗塔那厘。然而，我能够击败它并救出扎拉拉。

在地下经历了各种冒险之后，我们最终找到了一条通往地表的路径。现在我们已来到地面，位于云峰山脉以北，离烛堡不太远。
src:
Upon setting out once again aboard the Sword of Valkur, we were attacked by a powerful Blue Dragon, apparently working with Zekar and Azghulkar, and seeking to slay Zarala. The Dragon destroyed the ship and killed most of its crew, and Zarala and I escaped, after the ship ran aground, only by fleeing into a nearby cave too small for the dragon to enter. The Dragon responded by smashing the surrounding rockface, sealing us into the cave in the expectation we would starve within. However, we found a path heading down into a larger cave network, and ultimately into the Underdark.

We spent some time wandering around the Underdark, in the course of which we encountered an aboleth who had inherited memories from the time when Azghulkar previously walked the earth. He kidnapped Zarala, apparently as part of a plan to gain control of the Sword of Zefad and use it against the Tanar'ri when he return. However, I was able to defeat him and rescue Zarala.

After various adventures far underground, we eventually found a path to the surface. Now we have emerged above ground, north of the Cloudpeak mountains and not too far from Candlekeep.

dst: "我已经把自己的住处彻底搜过了（在东北方的上层），所以别进去，文件肯定在别的地方。你最好也别进上层的营房。我很少去那里，而且无论如何，如果文件在那里，肯定有人会注意到。除此之外，它们可能在任何地方。"
src: "I've searched my own quarters pretty thoroughly (they're on the upper level to the northeast), so stay out of them, the papers are surely somewhere else. You should probably stay out of the barracks on the upper level as well. I rarely go there, and in any case I'm sure someone would have noticed the papers if that was where they were. Aside from that, they could be anywhere."

dst: "我什么都不会告诉你的。"

dst: "也许不会。其实我并不特别介意你击败我。被守卫的不是我的宝藏。要说有什么宝藏的话。戈尔尊花了太多精力建造这些陵墓和宝库，以至于剩下能放进去的东西比人们想象的少：有点愚蠢。如你所见，戈尔尊活着的时候我就不怎么看得起他，几个世纪的不死也没有改善他。从这种奴役中解脱出来也不算坏事。事实上，如果你真的通过了我，我或许能告诉你一些有帮助的事情。这个地方到处都是难开的锁和致命的陷阱。也许你能应付。你肯定有这方面的技能，否则你一开始就进不来。但更深处还有其他守卫，他们可能比我更危险。"
src: "Perhaps not. I actually would not particularly mind if you defeated me. It's not my treasure being guarded. What treasure there is. Gorzhun spent so much building these tombs and vaults there wasn't as much left to put in them as one might expect: kind of idiotic. As you can see, I didn't think much of Gorzhun when he was alive, and centuries of Undeath haven't improved him. Being freed of this slavery wouldn't be all bad. In fact, I could probably tell you a few things that would help you if you do get past me. This place has got difficult locks and deadly traps all over the place. Maybe you can deal with that. You must have some skills along those lines or you couldn't have got in here in the first place. But there are other guardians deeper in who might be even more dangerous than me."

src: While ogres tend to be stupid, every now and then, by some strange fluke, an ogre will be born who is not only not an idiot, like most of his kin, but of exceptional intelligence even by the standards of races generally less dim-witted: intelligent enough, in fact, to master the arts of magic. These are the ogre magi, and they are very dangerous foes, for they combine the strength and toughness of an ogre with magical power, and often possess the cunning to make good use of both.

src: "A sporting sort, I see. Good. Here is the riddle: 'A noble adventurer was found dead in the desert, <his/her> soul departed to reside with <his/her> god. Attiring <his/her> corpse is a magnificent set of armor and clutched in <his/her> dead hand is a weapon with mighty enhancements. Rings, cloak, belt and boots adorn the body as well, each with powers of magic. Yet none of this magic was sufficient to save <him/her>. How did <he/she> die?' Answer carefully, or your own fate will soon resemble this riddle's subject."\n\n<StartAction>[Note: You, the player, may attempt to guess an answer at this point if you wish, before clicking the response. Whether your character can successfully answer in the game will be determined by <his/her> ability scores.]</Start>

dst: 卡达斯和他的探险队正在卡林沙漠中发掘一些古代遗迹。然而，在地下探索中，他们遭遇了巨型蜘蛛和亡灵带来的麻烦。由于没有准备好应对这些障碍，卡达斯请我替他探索遗迹。如果可能的话，我应该清除其中的怪物，或者至少留意那些有助于他研究的重要历史文物。\n\n遗迹已基本清理完毕，我也向卡达斯提交了最终报告。我想我不会再下去了。

我们必须设法获得一本价值连城的书，作为进入烛堡的代价。当我们抵达扎泽斯普尔时，特法拉姆船长建议我们去见一位名叫登萨斯·韦莱本的人，他在码头以北的市场区开了一家书店。他的理论是，作为稀有书籍的经销商，他可能有一本合适的书可供出售，如果没有，他应该知道我们可以去哪里找到一本。

我们照做了，登萨斯向我们讲述了兽人军阀古尔古穆克的古老陵墓，它被一道魔法屏障保护着，只有像我这样拥有大量兽人血统的人才能通过，同时还有亡灵以及可能只有有能力的冒险者才能克服的其他威胁守卫着。据说这座陵墓中有一份古尔古穆克统治时期的编年史副本，作为通常不识字的兽人 writings 的罕见且具有历史意义的例子，它是一本极其珍贵的书，应该可以用来进入烛堡。这座陵墓位于一段距离之外，开凿在星尖山脉的北侧，面向韦尔德斯森林，位置已在我的地图上标出。要到达那里，我们必须从市场区向北出去，前往贸易门，然后从那里沿着贸易之路向北行进，直到我们越过星尖山脉，然后向东进入韦尔德斯森林。

一旦我们成功找到合适的书，我们应该返回并与特法拉姆船长交谈（他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停留几周进行改装），他可能会在他下一次猎捕海盗的出击中带我们更接近烛堡。
src:
We must somehow acquire a book of great value as the price of admittance to Candlekeep. When we arrived in Zazesspur, Captain Tefaram advised us to speak to one Densath Wayleben, owner of a bookstore that can be found in the market district north of the docks, on the theory that, as a dealer in rare volumes, he might have had an appropriate book available for sale, and if not could be expected to know where we can go to find one.

We did as suggested, and Densath told us of the ancient tomb of the orcish warlord Gurgumuk, protected by a magical barrier that only someone with much orcish blood, such as myself, would be able to pass, and also guarded by undead and perhaps other threats that only a capable adventurer could expect to overcome. This tomb is said to contain a copy of a chronicle of Gurgumuk's reign that, as a rare and historically significant example of writings from normally illiterate orcs, constitutes a most valuable book that should serve to gain entrance to Candlekeep. This tomb is located some distance, cut into the north side of the Starspire Mountains, facing the Wealdeath Forest, at a location now marked on my maps. To reach it we must exit the Market District to the north, going to the Trade Gate, and from there travel north along the Trade Way until we pass over the Starspire mountains, and then head east into the Wealdeath.

Once we succeed in finding an appropriate book, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram (who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting), who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.

dst: 幽暗地域集市中一个神秘兜帽人，自称“灰守望者”，交给我一个任务：找回一只被深渊的塔纳厘偷走的金瓮，它目前被存放在那个危险的异界领域中。他告诉了我一座能带我去那里的界门的位置：我要从这座集市向东走，直到来到一个巨大的洞穴，有多条道路从那里通向四面八方，算是个十字路口。在这里，除了其他道路之外，我会找到一处洞穴，向上通往更高一层的洞窟群。我要上到这些更高的洞窟，在那一层我到达的第一个洞窟里，我会找到一座未激活的界门，只要把一颗游荡者之石放到附近的基座上，就能让它短暂激活。我得到了两颗游荡者之石，因为我回来时还需要另一颗。在界门另一侧的深渊区域中，附近会有一座堡垒，金瓮应该就在其中某处。自然，我必须提防在深渊中必定会遇到的众多危险塔纳厘。他承诺，如果我成功找回金瓮，归还后会给我25000金币。
src: A mysterious hooded figure, who calls himself the "Grey Watcher," in the Underdark market has tasked me with a quest, recovering a golden urn stolen by Tanar'ri of the Abyss, and currently contained in that dangerous extraplanar realm. He has told me the location of a portal that will take me there: I am to head east from this market, until coming to a large cavern with paths departing it in many directions, a crossroads of sorts. Here, among other paths, I will find a cave that leads upwards to a higher set of caverns. I am to go up to these higher caverns, and in the first I come to at that level, I will find an inactive portal, which can be activated for a brief time by placing a Rogue Stone on a nearby pedestal. I have been provided with two Rogue Stones, as I will need another to return. In the section of the Abyss on the other side of the portal, there will be a fortress nearby, and the golden urn should be found somewhere within. Naturally I will have to be wary of the numerous and dangerous Tanar'ri who will surely be encountered in the Abyss. I have been promised 25000 gold for returning the urn, if I succeed in recovering it.

You harness the soul energy of mighty warriors past, present, and future, shaping that incarnum into bands of bright blue steel that surround your wrists and lower arms. You feel a soft tingling in your wrists that grows stronger when danger is near.

All allies within 30 feet gain the +2 bonus on initiative granted by this soulmeld.

dst:
我们必须设法获得一本价值连城的书，作为进入烛堡的代价。当我们抵达扎泽斯普尔时，特法拉姆船长建议我们去见一位名叫登萨斯·韦莱本的人，他在码头以北的市场区开了一家书店。他的想法是，作为一名珍稀书籍经销商，登萨斯或许有合适的书可供出售，如果没有，他应该也知道我们该去哪里找。

我们照做了，登萨斯向我们讲述了一座有数百年历史的实验室，它曾属于侏儒巫师泽科·塔佐克，我们应该能在里面找到他的日志。泽科被称为“疯巫师”，据传他精神失常，进行过许多结合魔法与侏儒技术的实验。这些实验被认为怪异而危险，其相关知识遭到许多当权者的压制，结果泽科详细记录实验成果的技术日志变得相当稀有且难以找到。这使得任何一本这样的副本都成为稀有而珍贵的书（原稿更是如此），应该足以让我们进入烛堡。实验室受到一道魔法的保护，除了侏儒之外任何人都无法进入。对我来说这显然不是问题，但它还受到守卫魔像和陷阱的进一步保护，这些很可能构成威胁，所以我们需要小心。这座陵墓位于远处星尖山脉南麓的某个地方，具体位置现已标记在我的地图上。要到达那里，我们必须从码头区向东出去，前往“南门”，然后先沿苏杜斯昆河向东行进，再向北朝山脉方向前进。

一旦我们成功找到合适的书，就应该回来与特法拉姆船长谈谈（他应该还在这里，因为瓦尔库尔之剑号将在港口停留数周进行整修），他或许能在下次猎捕海盗时带我们更靠近烛堡。
src:
We must somehow acquire a book of great value as the price of admittance to Candlekeep. When we arrived in Zazesspur, Captain Tefaram advised us to speak to one Densath Wayleben, owner of a bookstore that can be found in the market district north of the docks, on the theory that, as a dealer in rare volumes, he might have had an appropriate book available for sale, and if not could be expected to know where we can go to find one.

We did as suggested, and Densath told us of a centuries old laboratory once owned by the gnomish wizard Zeko Tazoc, within which we should be able to find his journal. Zeko, called "the mad wizard," was reputedly insane, and conducted many experiments combining magic and gnomish technology. Considered bizarre and dangerous, knowledge of these experiments was suppressed by many authorities, with the result that Zeko's technical journal, detailing their results, has become quite rare and hard to find. This would make any such copy a rare and valuable book (and the original even more so) that should serve to gain entrance to Candlekeep. The lab is protected by a magic that prevents anyone but a gnome from entering. This should not be a problem for me, obviously, but is further protected by guardian golems and traps that may well be, so we will need to be careful This tomb is located some distance away along the southern face of the Starspire mountains, at a location now marked on my maps. To reach it we must exit the Docks going east, head to the "South Gate," and from there travel initially east along the Sulduskoon river, and then head north towards the mountains.

Once we succeed in finding an appropriate book, we should return and speak to Captain Tefaram (who should still be here as the Sword of Valkur is going to be spending a few weeks in port refitting), who may be able to take us closer to Candlekeep on his next pirate hunting foray.

dst:
纳西拉克告诉过我一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特修士，他是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他武僧提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名武僧，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅——我之前没有理由注意到它——那里通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通往隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我这也可能很危险。

我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他已经开始了我的训练计划，并要求我在与他交谈时，穿上他洞穴西南角袋子里的刚毛衬衣。

我已经完成了伊拉姆大师交给我的多项任务，并在他的指导下进行了一些练习和对练。现在他要我出去，冲进他洞穴南边池塘的中央。

这项任务已经完成。我应该去找伊拉姆大师谈谈，进行下一阶段的训练。
src:
Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.

I have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and requires that, when speaking to him, I be wearing the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave.

I have completed a number of tasks given me by Master Iram, and carried out some exercises and sparring under his direction. Now he wants me to go out and charge into the middle of the pond to the south outside his cave.

This task has been accomplished. I should go speak with Master Iram for the next stage of my training.

src: "Yes, I work at Gadaran's. Fezar Halam is the name, if you don't remember. Well, naturally as a merchant dealing in rare and valuable items I was quite capable of acquiring the sort of book that would allow me access to this library, so it seemed like something worth trying. Not a place one gets to visit every day! Though, come to think of it, you were one of the customers present at an even more memorable event. It's also not every day that our store gets attacked by Tanar'ri."

dst: 我在幽暗地域集市上遇到的斯涅布力侏儒商人弗兰泽布·寻宝者表示，他可能知道一条我能返回地面的路线。然而，除非我先为他完成一项任务，否则他不会透露。他所认识的一支由另外六名斯涅布力侏儒组成的队伍，曾在附近调查各个派系和近期事件，如今已经失踪。他要我找到并（如有必要）营救这些失踪的深地侏儒，或者至少查明他们的命运。这些斯涅布力侏儒分别是凯齐布·煤切者、弗雷博·渔夫、泽布利普·铁足、施纳巴·凿岩者、施内拉·潜影者和塔克塞维克·钢手。如果我找到其中任何一人或他们遭遇的证据，都应向弗兰泽布报告。\n\n我找到并营救了施内拉·潜影者，她曾被囚禁在一座夺心魔要塞中。据她说，弗雷博·渔夫和塔克塞维克·钢手与她一同被俘，但在夺心魔强迫他们参加的角斗中丧生。我还找到了施纳巴·凿岩者，他显然遭遇了一些眼魔并被它们石化。我已将他从石化状态中恢复，他表示可以自行前往幽暗地域集市。泽布利普·铁足也被找到了，就在一座底栖魔鱼要塞深处。不幸的是，他已被转化为受精神控制的奴隶，我们被迫杀死了他。至少他的命运已经查明。失踪的斯涅布力侏儒中，只剩下凯齐布·煤切者仍下落不明。
src: Vranzeb Gemfinder, a Svirfneblin merchant in the Underdark market I came across, has indicated he might know of a route by which I could return to the surface. However, he will not reveal it unless I first perform a task for him. A party of six other Svirfneblin known to him that was in the vicinity investigating various factions and recent events has gone missing. He wants me to either find and rescue (if necessary) these missing deep gnomes, or at least determine their fate. The Svirfneblin in question are Kezib Coalcutter, Frebo Fisher, Zeblip Ironfoot, Schnabar Rockhewer, Schnella Shadowsneaker, and Taxevek Steelhand. If I find any of these individuals or evidence of what became of them it should be reported to Vranzeb.\n\nI found and rescued Schnella Shadowsneaker, who was being held captive in a Mind-Flayer stronghold. According to her, Frebo Fisher and Taxevek Steelhand were captured along with her, but perished in gladiatorial combats in which the Mind Flayers forced them to participate. I also found Schnabar Rockhewer, who apparently fell afoul of some Beholders and was petrified by them. I have restored him from his petrified state, and he has indicated he can make his own way to the Underdark Market. Zeblip Ironfoot has also been found, deep in the stronghold of an Aboleth. Unfortunately, he had been transformed into a mind-controlled slave and we were forced to slay him. At least his fate has been discovered. Only one of the missing Svirfneblin, Kezib Coalcutter, remains unaccounted for.

dst:
卡林港的一位平民告诉我，他最近一直听到自家地下室传来奇怪的声响，尤其是沿着北墙那一带。他想让我去调查一下，如果能找到并消除某种危险，他会付钱给我。看来我又得去一趟地下室了。希望这不会变成那种无聊的杀老鼠任务。

经过调查并与隔壁房子的主人埃格巴·埃尔瓦布交谈后，事情似乎是这样开始的：一些老鼠咬断了埃格巴用来加固装满他正在研究的史莱姆的玻璃容器的侏儒机器的线路。这让史莱姆挣脱出来，进入了隔壁房子的地下室。在这个过程中，它们破坏了一个召唤法阵，释放出了一个元素生物。在打穿了史莱姆、元素生物，以及一个大概把我当成小偷的魔像之后，我结束了这场危险，并查明了它的源头。该回去报告并领取我的报酬了。

已报告并领取报酬。又一个任务完成。
src:
A commoner in Calimport has told me that he has been hearing strange noises in his basement, especially along the north wall. He wants me to investigate, and will pay me if I find and eliminate some danger. Looks like I'm off to another basement. I hope this doesn't turn out to be some silly rat-killing quest.

After investigating and talking to the owner of the adjoining house, Egbar Elwab, it seems that the trouble began when some rats chewed through the wiring on a gnomish machine Egbar was using to reinforce some glass containers full of slimes he was studying. This allowed the slimes to break free and make their way into the neighboring house's basement. In the process they broke a summoning circle, releasing an elemental. After fighting through the slimes, the elemental, and a golem who I suppose mistook me for a thief, I have ended the danger and discovered its source. Time to report back and collect my reward.

Reported and Rewarded. Another quest completed.

src: Each mephling has a breath weapon, the effect of which varies by the mephling's heritage. An air mephling's breath weapon is a cone of dust and grit (piercing damage), an earth mephling's breath weapon is a cone of rock shards and pebbles (bludgeoning damage), a fire mephling's breath weapon is a cone of flame (fire damage), and a water mephling's breath weapon is a cone of caustic liquid (acid damage). Regardless of the effect, a mephling's breath weapon fills a 15-foot cone, deals 1d8 points of damage to each target, and allows a Reflex save (10 + 1/2 mephling's Hit Dice + mephling's Con modifier) for half damage. A 1stlevel mephling can use his breath weapon once per day; a higher-level mephling gains one additional use per day for every four levels he has attained. If a mephling can use his breath weapon more than once per day, 1d4 rounds must pass between consecutive uses of the breath weapon.

dst:
学术传说中关于魔蝠人有两种不同的起源故事。其中一种说法是，魔蝠人是魔蝠与某种不确定的类人种族在很久以前结合所生的异界生物后裔。另一种则是关于一个狂妄自大的法师试图将自己的本质烙印在另一个种族上的更黑暗的传说。

事实是，魔蝠人偶尔会由魔蝠父母所生。魔蝠人比其魔蝠祖先更弱小，因此被魔蝠社群当作不受欢迎的矮小劣种而驱逐。他们被遗弃在恶劣的位面中自生自灭。对类人孩子感到厌恶的魔蝠父母会将婴儿留在充满敌意的位面上。善良的父母则会将孩子放在一个适宜居住的位面上，以便容易被其他生物发现。有时其他生物会收养这个被遗弃的婴儿，并将其抚养至成年。

作为由与自己截然不同的父母抚养长大的弃儿，魔蝠人经常感到格格不入。他们通常是孤独者，渴望一种难以捉摸的归属感。尽管如此，他们富有魅力且讨人喜欢，通常受到周围人的喜爱。

魔蝠人通常看起来像是其魔蝠父母不那么丑陋的版本，但翅膀发育不全。典型的魔蝠人身高不到3英尺，体重约30磅，女性比男性略高略重。火魔蝠人类似于一个微型魔鬼，拥有火焰般的红铜色皮肤。

火魔蝠人属性调整：+2 敏捷，-2 智力，+2 魅力。火魔蝠人敏捷而迅速。

天赋职业（术士）：在判断兼职经验值惩罚时，火魔蝠人的术士职业不计入兼职。

种族特性：
- 火魔蝠人的基础陆地速度为30英尺。
- 类人生物：魔蝠人原生于元素位面。他们具有类人生物类型，当不在其各自的祖先位面时获得异界生物子类型。与其魔蝠祖先不同，魔蝠人没有元素子类型。
- 小型：作为小型生物，魔蝠人在防御等级上获得+1加值，在攻击检定上获得+1加值，在躲藏检定上获得+4加值。
- 喷吐武器：每个魔蝠人都有一种喷吐武器，其效果因魔蝠人的血统而异。
- 元素施法：魔蝠人施展与其种类（风，土，火或水）相匹配的元素描述符法咒时，施法者等级+1。
- 简易武器：魔蝠人擅长所有简易武器。

等级调整：+1
src:
Scholarly lore contains two different origin stories for the mephlings. In one, mephlings are planetouched offshoots of long-ago unions between mephits and an indeterminate race of humanoids. The other is a darker tale of a megalomaniacal mage seeking to imprint his essence on another race.

What is true is that a mephling will occasionally be born to mephit parents. Weaker than their mephit ancestors, mephlings are put out of mephit communities as undesirable runts. They're left to the mercies of the inhospitable planes. Mephit parents revolted by their humanoid child will leave the babe on a hostile plane. Kindly parents will place the child on a habitable plane where it will easily be found by other creatures. Sometimes other creatures adopt the abandoned baby and it grows to reach adulthood.

As foundlings raised by parents very different from themselves, mephlings frequently feel out of place. They usually are loners who desire an elusive sense of belonging. Nevertheless, they're attractive and personable, generally liked by people around them.

Mephlings in general look like less homely versions of their mephit parents with stunted wings. A typical mephling stands less than 3 feet tall and weighs around 30 pounds, with females slightly taller and heavier than males.  A fire mephling resembles a miniature devil, with fiery, reddish-bronze skin.

Fire Mephling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Int, +2 Cha.  Fire mephlings are agile and quick.

Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass fire mephling's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- A fire mephling's base land speed is 30 feet.
- Humanoid: Mephlings are native to the Elemental Planes. They have the humanoid type and gain the extraplanar subtype when not on their respective ancestral plane. Unlike their mephit ancestors, mephlings do not have an elemental subtype.
- Small: As Small creatures, mephlings have a +1 bonus to Armor Class, a +1 bonus on attack rolls, and a +4 bonus on Hide checks.
- Breath Weapon: Each mephling has a breath weapon, the effect of which varies by the mephling's heritage. 
- Elemental Casting: Mephlings cast spells with an elemental descriptor that matches their kind (air, earth, fire, or water) at +1 caster level.
- Simple Weapons: Mephlings are proficient with all simple weapons.

Level Adjustment: +1

One of these pieces can currently be found in a Beholder Colony to the south, and another is in the possession of Mind Flayers who can be found in a stronghold to the north. The third has been acquired by Kuo Toa who have a base to the east. None of these factions is likely to be willing to part with their piece of the item, or indeed to react to my appearance with anything other than full-fledged hostility, so recovering the pieces will surely require some fighting.

dst: 在我的冒险历程中，我早前获得了一颗奇特的宝珠，上面刻有文字，表明它属于一个名叫萨斯拉斯的存在，并请求若有可能将其归还给该存在。这颗宝珠似乎与幽影界或类似领域相连，有时会泄漏负能量。总体而言，它似乎对这个位面具有不稳定效应。将它留在这个位面上很可能很危险，所以如果出现归还的机会，或许我确实应该将它归还。\n\n我将宝珠放在了一座标有“萨斯拉斯”的雕像上，那是在一座似乎位于幽影界的塔中。据我所能判断，那就是它该去的地方。这样做似乎加深了我与幽影界及与之相关魔法的联系。这在未来可能会有所助益。注意：从今往后，你召唤的任何幽影，无论是通过法术还是影舞者能力，其力量都将显著增强，如果你拥有“传奇幽影领主”专长则更是如此。
src: In the course of my adventures, I earlier acquired a stange orb, with writing on it that it belongs to someone called Sathras, and a request to return it to this entity if possible. The orb appears to be linked to the Shadow Plane or similar realm, and sometimes leaks negative energy. In general, it appears to have a destabilizing effect on this plane. It might well be dangerous to keep it on this plane, so perhaps I should indeed return it if an opportunity to do so presents itself.\n\nI placed the orb on a statue labeled "Sathras," in a tower on what appeared to be the Plane of Shadows. As best I can determine, that is where it belongs. Doing so appears to have deepened my connection to the Shadow Plane and magic associated with it. This may prove beneficial in the future. NOTE: Henceforth any Shadows you summon, whether through spells or the Shadowdancer ability, willl have their power significantly enhanced, especially so if you have the "Epic Shadowlord" feat.

src:
Tiger Claw (Strike)
Level: Swordsage 6, warblade 6
Prerequisite: Two Tiger Claw maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 full-round action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature

You slip between a larger foe's legs and strike its exposed side. You then cover in the shadow of your enemy's bulk.

You can use this maneuver only against an opponent of a size category larger than yours. As part of the maneuver, you enter your target's space without provoking an attack of opportunity. You can then attack your target as part of this maneuver. Your attack deals an extra 5d6 points of damage. You remain within your opponent's space after you complete this maneuver. You gain cover against all attacks until the end of the round, including those made by the target.

黄金矮人主要分布在南方的巨大裂谷附近。他们不仅以锻造和手工艺闻名，还以军事进步和传奇财富著称，黄金矮人维持他们的帝国数千年，未被时间流逝所屈服。黄金矮人皮肤是浅棕色或深晒色，她的眼睛通常是棕色或淡褐色。两性都留长发；发色从黑色到灰色或棕色不等，所有色调随时间流逝而褪为浅灰色。

黄金矮人属性调整：+2 体质，-2 敏捷。
天赋职业（战士）：兼职黄金矮人战士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

- 石工：在地下区域进行搜索检定时获得+2种族加值。
- 黑暗视觉：黄金矮人能够在黑暗中视物。
- 抗毒：对抗毒素的豁免检定获得+2种族加值。
- 抗法咒：对抗法咒的豁免检定获得+2种族加值。
- 对异怪的攻击训练：对异怪的攻击检定获得+1种族加值。
- 对巨人的防御训练：对巨人的防御等级获得+4闪避加值。
- 技能亲和（学识）：学识检定获得+2种族加值。
- 技能亲和（手艺）：制作护甲和制作武器检定获得+2种族加值。
- 技能亲和（估价）：估价检定获得+2种族加值。
- 矮人：就法咒而言，黄金矮人视为矮人。
src:
Found largely in the south in the immediate vicinity of the Great Rift. Renowned not only for their smithwork and craftsmanship but also for their military progress and legendary wealth, gold dwarves have maintained their empire for millennia, unbowed by the passage of time. The skin of a gold dwarf is light brown or deeply tanned, and her eyes are usually brown or hazel. Both genders wear their hair long; hair color ranges from black to gray or brown, with all shades fading to light gray as time progresses.

Gold Dwarven Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Dex.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass gold dwarf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Gold Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Poisons: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Aberrations: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against aberrations.
- Defensive Training vs. Giants: +4 dodge bonus to AC against giants.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor and Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Dwarven: Gold Dwarves count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

A creature's damage reduction, if any, applies to the damage from this spell. The damage from sudden stalagmite is treated as piercing for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

在镇上时，维蒂亚雷经常被看到在打嗝龙酒馆喝酒， accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn, presumably a friend or associate. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. I learned where to meet this Frago from a farmer named Hodgent, one of his customers, and from Frago I learned the location of Vitiare's hideout: an old abadoned house, sunk under water, a little to the south of Beregost. Vitiare and some associates have sealed off the basement from the water, and can be reached there from a secret door near some rocks to the south of the house.

I located and defeated Vitiare. Hopefully I can recover at least some of the gold he stole from me.
src:
An expert pickpocket known as Vitiare stole all my gold and then disappeared, while I was distracted by the rest of the adventuring party he was working with. This represents a considerable loss, if it is permanent, but perhaps there is some hope of locating this Vitiare and recovering my gold. It appears there is also a bounty on his head, that can be collected from Oublek. I should see if I can find any clues as to where Vitiare might now be found. He seems to commonly operate around Nashkel, so perhaps someone in that town would know something about him.

When in town, Vitiare is often seen drinking at the Belching Dragon accompanied by a halfling named Frago Hedgethorn, presumably a friend or associate. This Hedgethorn is perhpas a ranger and apparently lives in the surrounding wilderness. He sells healing services to those able to locate him. I learned where to meet this Frago from a farmer named Hodgent, one of his customers, and from Frago I learned the location of Vitiare's hideout: an old abadoned house, sunk under water, a little to the south of Beregost. Vitiare and some associates have sealed off the basement from the water, and can be reached there from a secret door near some rocks to the south of the house.

I located and defeated Vitiare. Hopefully I can recover at least some of the gold he stole from me.

src: While exploring the Underdark, I encountered a mysterious hooded figure who claims to be a merchant of some sort. He asked me to acquire three items he needs as magical reagents: the hide of a displacer beast, the brain of an intellect devourer, and a diamond. He promised to give me about 100 gold for each item acquired, and a valuable magical item after he gets all three.\n\nI gave him the brain of an intellect devourer. He still requires the other two items.

这些骑士是观星者组织的成员。一旦受任，中环骑士便接受对其忠诚和服从的严格要求，并承担许多重要职责。他们为观星者分会提供安全保障，也可能被召唤为观星者的盟友提供类似服务。由于观星者欢迎任何职业的成员加入其行列，中环骑士经常向曾为外环服务数年的正直善良的冒险者或专业天文学家递送入会邀请。骑士们经常向外环冒险者提供任务和委托，偶尔也会领导此类冒险。如果某项任务过于重要，不能让未宣誓效忠观星者的人知晓，中环骑士可能会被指派在某个更明显的活动掩护下秘密执行。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
These knights are members of the Stargazers organization. Once ordained, Knights of the Middle Circle accept strict demands for their allegiance and obedience and undertake many important duties. They provide security for Stargazer chapterhouses and may be called upon for similar service for allies of the Stargazers. Since the Stargazers welcome members of any class to their ranks, the Knights of the Middle Circle often deliver membership invitations to honorable, good adventurers or expert astronomers who have served the Outer Circle for several years. The knights often offer missions and quests to Outer Circle adventurers, and occasionally lead such adventures. If a mission is too important for those not sworn to the Stargazers to know of, Knights of the Middle Circle may be assigned to work on it secretly under the cover of some more obvious activity.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: A Knight of the Middle Circle is proficient with simple and martial weapons, shields, and all armor.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any Good.
Base Attack Bonus: +6.
Skills: Persuade 4 ranks, Bluff 4 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Blindfight
  Combat Sense +2 - Adds a +2 bonus to Attacks and AC vs. the targeted racial type for class level + 3 rounds. Unlimited uses a day.
3: True Strike 1/day - As the arcane spell.
5: Combat Sense +4 - The bonus to Attacks and AC increases to +4.
6: True Strike 2/day
9: True Strike 3/day
10: Combat Sense +6 - The bonus to Attacks and AC increases to +4.

SPELLCASTING

To cast a spell, the Knight of the Middle Circle must have a Wisdom score of 10 + the spell level. A Knight of the Middle Circle's caster level is equal to his class level.

src:
The epic dragonheart mage is the living embodiment of draconic majesty fused with arcane mastery. As their blood grows richer with ancient draconic power, so too does their spellcraft swell with elemental might. Their breath becomes an instrument of cataclysm, a devastating release of stored arcane potential shaped by the legacy of their draconic forebears. With every spell cast, their presence becomes more commanding, their body more resilient, their soul more like that of a true dragon. 

Hit Die: d6
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Dragonheart Mage gains a bonus Draconic feat every level ending in 2, 4, or 8.

Special:
Draconic Breath: The epic Dragonheart Mage's Draconic Breath damage increases to 3d8 at level 16, 4d6 at 20, 4d8 at 26, and 5d6 at level 30.
Spellcasting: At each class level the epic Dragonheart Mage continues to increase in arcane caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Epic Dragonheart Mage Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Craft Epic Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Epic Staff, Craft Epic Wondrous Item, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Leadership, Epic Prowess, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Reputation, Epic Skill Focus, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Fast Healing, Focused Spell Penetration, Forge Epic Ring, Great Charisma, Great Intelligence, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Tenacious Magic.

I've been stealthily scouting around, and he does spend most of his time in there, but if an attack is launched on the goblins, he'll most likely come out so as to fight with all his magic available. So once we attack the camp surrounding the shrine, we need to move to enter it quickly, before he can be warned and come out. Fortunately, I've found a path we can use to sneak very close to the goblin camp before we have to actually attack and announce our presence."

dst:
铁处女罗诺薇
  
罗诺薇在漫长的岁月中一直是个谜，但契灵学者现在相信她是一位生活在两千多年前的人类苦修者。作为一个残灵，她赋予召唤者远距离移动物体的力量，以武僧般的技巧进行打击，以及如风般飞跑的能力。

残灵等级：1级
绑定DC: 15
特殊要求：罗诺薇的印记必须画在开阔天空下的土壤中。

影响：罗诺薇的影响让你认为他人怀疑你的能力和才干。无论别人说什么，你都感到不断需要证明自己的价值。此外，罗诺薇要求你在与她绑定的整个期间既不进食也不饮用任何饮料（包括药水）.

授予能力：
罗诺薇赋予你如铁般打击，不接触物体即可举起它们，以及如风般飞跑的力量。

寒铁与魔法攻击：你的近战攻击在克服伤害减免时视为+1.当你达到7级有效契灵等级时，你的近战攻击在克服伤害减免时也视为+3。

隔空之手：作为一个迅捷动作，你可以按照隔空之手灵能的方式举起并移动一个无主物体。或者，你可以作为一个标准动作使用念力推动一个生物。该力量对目标造成1d6点伤害并引发一次冲撞，使用该力量的力量调整值并加上+2加值。一旦你以这种方式使用了隔空之手，你在5轮内不能再次使用它。该力量被视为中型体型，其力量值等于你的有效契灵等级。

罗诺薇之拳：你获得精通徒手打击专长的好处。你的徒手打击造成的伤害如同一个等级等于你有效契灵等级的武僧。此能力不授予你武僧的任何其他能力，例如疾风连击。

冲刺：你的基础陆地速度获得+10尺增强加值。
src:
Ronove, the Iron Maiden
  
Ronove remained a mystery for ages, but binder scholars now believe her to have been a human ascetic who lived more than two thousand years ago. As a vestige, she grants her summoners the power to move objects at a distance, to strike with the skill of a monk, and to run like the wind.

Vestige Level: 1st
Binding DC: 15
Special Requirement: Ronove's seal must be drawn in the soil under the open sky.

Influence: Ronove's influence makes you think that others doubt your abilities and competence. Despite what anyone says, you feel the constant need to prove your worth. In addition, Ronove requires that you consume neither food nor beverages (including potions) for the entire time you remain bound to her.

Granted Abilities: 
Ronove gives you the power to strike like iron, lift objects without touching them, and run like the wind.

Cold Iron and Magic Attacks: Your melee attacks count as +1 for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. When you attain an effective binder level of 7th, your melee attacks also count as +3 for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Far Hand: As a swift action, you can lift and move an unattended object as per the Far Hand psionic power. Alternatively, you can use the telekinetic force to push a creature as a standard action. The force deals 1d6 points of damage to the target and initiates a bull rush, using the force's Strength modifier and adding a +2 bonus. Once you have used your far hand in this way, you cannot use it again for 5 rounds. The force is considered Medium in size, and it has a Strength score equal to your effective binder level.

Ronove's Fists: You gain the benefit of the Improved Unarmed Strike feat. Your unarmed strikes deal damage as those of a monk of a level equal to your effective binder level. This ability does not grant you any other abilities of a monk, such as flurry of blows.

Sprint: You gain a +10-foot enhancement bonus to your base land speed.

dst: 我已与达伦·索尔伯爵谈过，他正寻求雇佣兵来对抗其领地上的怪物入侵。比大多数同类怪物更强大的熊地精和大地精团伙频繁出现在伯爵乡间庄园周围的土地上，他悬赏每带回一个熊地精或大地精的头颅便支付100金币，希望能借此削减它们的数量。我可以通过伯爵城中住所内的传送门前往那座乡间庄园，该住所位于码头以北、市场以西的区域。到达那里后，我便可以开始巡视乡间，搜寻地精类生物。伯爵还让我与那里的资深仆人，一位名叫林·梅伦多斯的人交谈，以便上交头颅或处理此事引发的其他问题。\n\n既然我已离开泰瑟尔，我便无法再为索尔伯爵做任何雇佣兵工作了。
src: I have spoken to Count Daren Thorl, who sought to hire mercenaries in order to combat monstrous incursions on his lands. Bands of Bugbears and Hobgoblins, more powerful than most such monsters, have been appearing frequently in the lands surrounding the Count's country estate, and he has offered a bounty of 100 gold for every Bugbear or Hobgoblin head adventurers can bring back, in hopes of thinning their numbers. I can travel to the country estate through a portal found in the Count's residence in the city, which is in an area north of the docks and west of the markets. Once there, I can commence to patrol the countryside in search of goblinoids. The Count has also told me to speak to the senior servant there, one Rin Merendos, to turn in heads or deal with any other questions raised by this matter.\n\nNow that I have departed from Tethyr, I will not be able to do any more mercenary work for Count Thorl.

化身武器

描述符：混乱，邪恶，善良，或守序  
职业：化身

豁免检定：见正文

魂能形成一件体现你阵营的单手近战武器。这件武器对你的手来说似乎很大，但它为你握持而完美平衡。将它握在手中，你感到它与你的最深信念和最坚定信仰产生共鸣，并随着力量而嗡鸣。

你将魂能塑造成一件近战武器。混乱化身创造战斧，邪恶化身创造连枷，善良化身创造战锤，守序化身创造长剑。使用化身武器时永远不会受到不擅长惩罚，尽管任何对特定类型武器产生效果的专长（如武器专攻） 会正常生效。如果你的化身武器因任何原因离开你的手，它会回到你的掌握中。

魂能：化身武器在攻击检定和伤害检定上获得等同于你投入其中魂能点数的增强加值。

脉轮绑定（手臂） 

钢带在你的前臂上形成。当你握持你的化身武器时，一条几乎不可见的蓝色魂能锁链将它连接到你持武器手上的钢制护腕，将你信念的力量直接引导到你的武器中。

作为一个移动动作，你可以用纯粹信念的震慑之力充能化身武器。如果你进行的下一次近战攻击成功，目标（只要其阵营中至少有一个组成部分与你所信奉的阵营对立） 必须成功通过强韧豁免，否则被震慑一轮。
src:
Incarnate Weapon

Descriptors: Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful  
Classes: Incarnate 
Chakra: Arms 
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms into a one-handed melee weapon that embodies your alignment. The weapon seems large for your hand, but it is balanced perfectly for you to wield it. Clutching it in your hand, you feel it resonate with your deepest convictions and firmest beliefs, and it hums with power.

You shape incarnum into a melee weapon. Chaotic incarnates create a battleaxe, evil incarnates create a flail, good incarnates create a warhammer, and lawful incarnates create a longsword. Nonproficiency penalties never apply to the use of an incarnate weapon, though any feats with effects that apply to a particular kind of weapon (such as Weapon Focus) function normally. If your incarnate weapon leaves your hand for any reason, it returns to your grasp.

Essentia: The incarnate weapon gains an enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in it.

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

Bands of steel form around your forearms. When you hold your incarnate weapon, a chain of nearly invisible blue incarnum connects it to the steel bracer on your weapon hand, channeling the force of your conviction directly to your weapon.

As a move action, you can charge the incarnate weapon with the stunning power of pure conviction. If the next melee attack that you make is successful, the target (as long as at least one component of its alignment is opposed to your devoted alignment) must succeed on a Fortitude saving throw or be stunned for one round.

dst:
获准进入烛堡后，扎拉拉在烛堡首席读者泰斯索瑞尔的帮助下，找到了一些她所需的学术资源，特别是一位名叫达尔泽斯·舍马尔的人写的一本稀有书籍，她需要这些来学习如何以魔法重铸泽法德之剑。她现在相信自己能够完成重铸。还剩一个麻烦，那就是重铸需要某种源自强大位面力量或实体的东西作为材料。不过，泰斯索瑞尔告诉我们，图书馆里有一样应该合适的东西：巴尔后裔的血液。不幸的是，图书馆的负责人乌尔劳恩只肯在我们先为图书馆完成一项服务之后才允许我们使用它，那就是清除最近出现在图书馆地下墓穴中的一群非常强大的亡灵。

墓穴的入口位于图书馆一层的后方，先下到一个放着一些额外书籍的小房间即可找到。那里通往更深处的门现在应该已经解锁了。在我们清理亡灵期间，扎拉拉和泰斯索瑞尔会预祝我们成功，并前往图书馆院落中的铁匠铺——位于南侧、沿西墙一带——开始重铸宝剑的工序。等消灭亡灵的任务完成后，我们可以在那里与他们会合。

看来这些亡灵是被死灵法师赛伦达·塔拉尔释放到墓穴中的，她是冒险者格玛拉克·科尔兹的同伴，而后者是泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡的盟友。亡灵已被消灭，赛伦达也被赶走了。这应该向泰斯索瑞尔汇报。
src:
Having gained access to Candlekeep, Zarala was, with the aid of Tethtoril, First Reader of Candlekeep, able to find some of the scholarly resources, in particular a rare book by one Darzeth Shemal, that she needed to learn how to magically reforge the Sword of Zefad. She now believes that she will be able to complete the reforging. There is one remaining complication, in that the reforging requires something derived from a mighty planar power of entity as a reagent. However, Tethtoril has told us that the library has something that should be suitable: blood from a Bhaalspawn. Unfortunately, Ulraunt, the head of the library, will only let us use this if we first perfom a service for the libary by clearing out an infestation of very powerful Undead who recently showed up in the catacombs beneath the library.

The entrance to the catacombs can be found at the back of the library's first level, after first descending to a small room with some additional books. The door there leading further down should now be unlocked. While we are clearing the Undead, Zarala and Tethtoril, in anticipation of our success, will head to the smithy in the library compound, which is south and along the western wall, to begin the process of reforging the sword. We can meet them there once the task of eliminating the Undead is accomplished.

It appears the Undead were released into the catacombs by the necromancer Sylenda Talar, a companion of the adventurer Gemarak Korz, who is an ally of Zekar and Azghulkar. The Undead have been eliminated and Sylenda driven off. This should be reported to Tethtoril.

[Divine]

You can channel energy into some of your divine spells to make them more powerful.

Prerequisite: Ability to turn undead or rebuke undead

Benefit: When you take this feat, choose a metamagic feat that you have. This feat applies only to that metamagic feat. As a free action, you can take the energy from turning or rebuking undead and use it to apply a metamagic feat to divine spells that you know. You must spend one turn or rebuke attempt, plus an additional attempt for each level increase in the metamagic feat you're using. For example, Jozan the cleric could sacrifi ce three turn attempts to empower a holy smite he's casting. Because you're using positive or negative energy to augment your spells, the spell slot for the spell doesn't change.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time you take this feat choose a different metamagic feat to which to apply it.

dst: 虽然大多数战士在战斗中依靠他们的力量，敏捷和坚韧，但少数人学会了挖掘他们心智的真正潜力。有点像武僧，这样的战士用严格的思维训练来补充他的身体训练，以磨练他的战斗能力。当他战斗时，他的身心合一，使他能够达到无与伦比的战斗精通水平。处于这种完美的身心和谐状态被称为维持战斗专注。（选择名为战斗专注的专长就是角色学习如何达到这种状态的方式；所有其他战斗形态专长都以战斗专注为先决条件。）维持战斗专注的任务既困难又费力。因此，战士无法长时间保持这种状态。然而，当他保持时，他可以使用他所拥有的任何战斗形态专长。
src: While most warriors draw on their strength, agility, and toughness in battle, a few learn to tap into the true potential of their minds. Somewhat like a monk, such a warrior supplements his physical practice with rigorous mentaltraining to hone his fighting abilities. His mind and body become one as he fights, allowing him to achieve unparalleled levels of combat mastery. Being in this state of perfect mental and physical harmony is known as maintaining a combat focus. (Taking the feat called Combat Focus is how a character learns to achieve this state; all other combat form feats have Combat Focus as a prerequisite.) The task of maintaining a combat focus is both difficult and  straining. Thus, a warrior cannot remain in this state for long.  While he does, however, he can use any combat form feats he possesses.

src: "That requires a bit of explanation. You'll need to go to the Wealdath forest to the north." He continues looking through papers. " You are fully human, I think? You will need to be to acquire this particular book. You see, some 1800 years ago, the Wealdath forest was a refuge for many escaped slaves from Calimshan. One Sandar Kadathin became the leader of a powerful band of such fugitives, and he had many conflicts with both Calishites and the elves of the Wealdath who distrusted these human intruders. As you may know, bands of this sort eventually formed an alliance with the elves, and became crucial in the formation of Tethyr as an independent nation, but that came later."

dst:
卡达斯和他的探险队正在卡林沙漠中发掘一些古代遗迹。然而，在地下探索中，他们遭遇了巨型蜘蛛和亡灵带来的麻烦。由于没有准备好应对这些障碍，卡达斯请我替他探索遗迹。如果可能的话，我应该清除其中的怪物，或者至少留意那些有助于他研究的重要历史文物。

在探索遗迹时，一扇受魔法控制的门在我身后砰然关闭。从这一侧似乎无法打开它：看来我可能被困在遗迹里了！我唯一能想到的办法就是继续深入，希望能找到另一个出口。

深入遗迹后，我遇到了一个幽灵般的幻影，结果他竟是友善的。他告诉我，我必须走北边通道（离开我们相遇的房间）才能逃离遗迹，但这条路有亡灵严密守卫，其中一些无法被非魔化武器伤害。他建议我先摧毁散布在遗迹各处的三颗死灵法球。这既能让他摆脱将他束缚于亡灵的诅咒，还能赋予他力量，为我具现出一把魔化武器，一把对亡灵特别有效的武器。我想我会照他说的做。是时候让我弄到一把魔化武器了！

虹光法球
防护系
等级：保护 9，术士/法师 9，太阳 9
成分：言语
距离：10 英尺
效果：以你为中心的 10 英尺半径球体

此法咒的功能如同虹光墙，除了你召唤一个无法移动的，不透明的，闪烁的
多彩光球，围绕你并保护你免受所有形式的攻击。这个球体闪烁着
可见光谱的所有颜色。 球体对生命骰少于 8 的生物的致盲效果持续 2d4x10 分钟。

你可以进出虹光法球并停留在它附近而不受伤害。然而，当你在
它内部时，球体会阻挡任何试图将某物投射穿过球体的尝试（包括法咒）. 其他
试图攻击你或穿过的生物会依次承受每种颜色的效果。

通常，只有球体的上半球会存在，因为你位于球体的中心，所以
下半部分通常被你站立的地板表面排除。

球体的颜色与虹光墙的颜色具有相同的效果：

红色     第1    造成 20 点火焰伤害（反射减半）.
橙色  第2    造成 40 点强酸伤害（反射减半）.
黄色  第3    造成 80 点电击伤害（反射减半）.
绿色   第4    毒素（杀死；强韧部分则改为 1d6 点体质伤害）.
蓝色   第5    变为石头（强韧否定）.
靛色  第6    意志豁免否则发疯（如同摄魂术法咒）.
紫色  第7    生物被送往另一个位面（意志否定）.
src:
Prismatic Sphere
Abjuration
Level: Protection 9, Sor/Wiz 9, Sun 9
Components: V
Range: 10 ft.
Effect: 10-ft.-radius sphere centered on you

This spell functions like prismatic wall, except you conjure up an immobile, opaque globe of shimmering,
multicolored light that surrounds you and protects you from all forms of attack. The sphere flashes in
all colors of the visible spectrum.  The sphere's blindness effect on creatures with less than 8 HD lasts 2d4x10 minutes.

You can pass into and out of the prismatic sphere and remain near it without harm. However, when you're
inside it, the sphere blocks any attempt to project something through the sphere (including spells). Other
creatures that attempt to attack you or pass through suffer the effects of each color, one at a time.

Typically, only the upper hemisphere of the globe will exist, since you are at the center of the sphere, so
the lower half is usually excluded by the floor surface you are standing on.

The colors of the sphere have the same effects as the colors of a prismatic wall:

Red     1st     Deals 20 points of fire damage (Reflex half).
Orange  2nd     Deals 40 points of acid damage (Reflex half).
Yellow  3rd     Deals 80 points of electricity damage (Reflex half).
Green   4th     Poison (Kills; Fortitude partial for 1d6 points of Con damage instead).
Blue    5th     Turned to stone (Fortitude negates).
Indigo  6th     Will save or become insane (as insanity spell).
Violet  7th     Creatures sent to another plane (Will negates).

血瘾（Ex）：如果半吸血鬼每天没有对至少一个活体生物使用其吸血特殊攻击，它必须通过DC 15的强韧豁免，否则会陷入疲乏。在第一天之后，半吸血鬼每有一天没有直接从活体生物身上吸血，DC就增加1，直到它豁免失败并陷入疲乏。此后，如果它没有使用吸血能力，它必须每周通过DC 20的强韧豁免（此后每周DC增加1），否则会陷入力竭。

由血瘾引起的疲乏或力竭无法通过休息消除（尽管魔法可以抵消该状态，直到吸血鬼再次豁免失败）.使用吸血能力可以立即消除半吸血鬼的疲乏，或将力竭降低为疲乏。

只有拥有吸血特殊攻击的半吸血鬼（见上文） 才获得此特殊性质。
src:
Blood Dependency (Ex): If a half-vampire does not use its blood drain special attack against at least one living creature each day, it must make a DC 15 Fortitude save or become fatigued. Each day after the first that the half-vampire does not drink blood directly from a living creature, the DC increases by 1 until it fails the save and becomes fatigued. After that, it must make a DC 20 Fortitude save each week (with the DC increasing by 1 each week thereafter) that it does not use its blood drain or become exhausted.

The fatigue or exhaustion caused by blood dependency cannot be eliminated by rest (though magic can offset the condition until the vampire fails another save). Using its blood drain ability eliminates a half-vampire's fatigue immediately, or reduces exhaustion to fatigue.

Only half-vampires with the blood drain special attack (see above) gain this special quality.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Disciple of Baalzebul, is a liar, a cheat, and a thief. She is more likely to kill a paladin while he sleeps than face him in direct combat. She uses deceit and trickery to get what she wants, betraying even her family and closest friends to achiever her goals. Her abilities make her an astute prevaricator and a sneaky backstabber, but she can wield her lords powerful influence with everything from devils to flies if she needs to.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: All simple and martial weapons, and light armor.
- Skill Points: 6+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS

Alignment: Any evil.
Skills: Bluff 10 ranks, Diplomacy, Persuade 8 ranks.
Feats: Disciple of Darkness.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Tongue of the Devil - Add Intelligence modifier as well as Charisma to Bluff checks.
2: Sneak Attack 1d6*
3: Suggestion - Once per day, cast a version of Charm with a DC of 10 + Disciple Class Level + Charisma modifier.
4: Baalzebul Summon 1 - Summon a devil once per day.
6: Insect Plague - Once per day summon biting flies to interrupt the concentration of your enemies.
7: Beguiling Nature - Every other day produce an effect identical to mass charm with a Will save DC of 10 + Disciple Level + Charisma modifier.
9: Baalzebul Summon 2 - Summon a greater devil once per day.
10: King of Lies - Gain a permanent +4 bonus to Charisma.

dst: 我们在尖牙森林中战斗的一些豺狼人用一根魔法石柱打开了一道通往深渊的界门。这根石柱是维持一道界门的两根石柱之一，界门通向塔纳厘耶诺古所统治的深渊层面，许多豺狼人将他奉为神明。两根石柱中的另一根位于深渊那侧附近的某处。如果我们穿过界门，摧毁或停用那根石柱，然后返回摧毁这一根，就能关闭界门，防止任何进一步的恶魔入侵。

This pillar is one of two holding open a portal to a layer of the Abyss ruled by the tanar'ri Yeenoghu, worshipped by many gnolls as a god. It is one of two such pillars, with the other being somewhere nearby on the other side, in the Abyss. If we were to cross through the portal, and destroy or deactivate that pillar, we could then return and destroy this one, and thereby close the portal, protecting against any further demonic incursions through it.
