src:
Baelnorns are elves who have sought undeath to serve their families, communities, or other purposes (usually to see a wrong righted or to achieve a certain magical discovery or deed).  They are lich-like creatures that appear as impressive-looking elves with shriveled skin and glowing white eyes.

REQUIREMENTS:

Race: Elf.
Skills: Concentration 5, Spellcraft 14.
Class : 11 levels in Sorcerer, Wizard, or Cleric
Alignment: Any Good
Must not have any levels in Lich.

CLASS FEATURES:
Baelnorn Properties: +8 bonus to Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Persuade, and Spot.
         Baelnorn Touch: Touch attack causes 1d8 + 5 damage and permanent paralyzation.
         Baelnorn Defense:  Damage Reduction 15/+2, Natural Armor + 5, immunity to cold and electricity, Turning Resistance +4.
         Turn Undead:  Can turn undead 3 times per day as a cleric of the same level.
         Turning Immunity:  Cannot be turned by Good or Neutral characters.
         Animate Dead :  5 times per day the Baelnorn animate dead as per the spell of the same name.
         Projection:  Three times per day the Baelnorn may create a projection of itself.
         Wisdom +2
         Intelligence +2.
         Charisma +2
         Undeath

     Note:  The Baelnorn is fully undead, and therefore is immune to sneak attacks, critical hits, level drain, poison, and disease.  An undead creature has no Constitution score.  However, this is not possible in Neverwinter Nights.  The player will gain +12 to constitution in order to simulate the increase of the Baelnorn's HD to d12.

A random pattern of color surrounds the subjects, protecting them from attacks, granting them resistance to spells cast by lawful creatures, and causing lawful creatures that strike the subjects to become confused. This abjuration has four effects.

First, each warded creature gains a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saves. Unlike protection from law, the benefit of this spell applies against all attacks, not just against attacks by lawful creatures.

Second, each warded creature gains spell resistance 25 against lawful spells and spells cast by lawful creatures.

Third, the abjuration blocks possession and mental influence, just as protection from law does.

Finally, if a lawful creature succeeds on a melee attack against a warded creature, the offending attacker is confused for 1 round (Will save negates, as with the confusion spell, but against the save DC of cloak of chaos).

骑乘时，你在近战伤害检定上获得+2洞察加值，在护甲等级上获得+2闪避加值。

src:
Riding Bracers

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Incarnate, Soulborn, Totemist 
Chakra: Arms (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You form incarnum into a pair of hard leather bracers that encircle your wrists. They smell noticeably of horse and hay.

Wearing the riding bracers grants you a +4 insight bonus on Animal Empathy and Ride checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested in the riding bracers increases the insight bonus on Animal Empathy and Ride checks by 2.

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

Your riding bracers clench tight around your wrists. When you mount a steed, your bracers almost seem to guide your hands on the reins. When you draw a weapon while mounted, you, your mount, and your weapon all seem to move in a coordinated, deadly dance.

When mounted, you gain a +2 insight bonus on melee damage rolls and a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

There is no change in the appearance of your riding bracers, but when you mount a steed, you feel a close connection with the animal. It almost seems to respond to your mental commands as much as to your hands on the reins.

When mounted, you gain evasion.

dst: 哈马德一直在筹备对阿然尼亚总部的进攻，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报，这次进攻几乎已经准备就绪，军队正集结在蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结地。哈马德指示我前往这个集结地，为进攻贡献我的能力。到达后，我需向那里的指挥官——卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以他认为合适的方式提供协助。是时候前往城门，带上我想带的任何随从，然后出发前往沼泽。\n\n我已抵达沼泽中的集结地，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已经在与服务于我们阿然尼亚敌人的类人生物（这里主要是蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会取得胜利，但担心等到胜利时，我们敌人的首领已经逃离总部，以便从其他地方继续他们的战争。为了防止这种情况，他计划让我沿着斥候发现的一条向北的小路前进，这条小路可以让我绕过他们的主力部队，直达基地。我将沿着这条小路前进，并与驻扎在小路开始再次向南拐弯之前的一支军队斥候会合。然后，我和斥候们将一路杀过敌人后方区域，那里希望抵抗较弱，以抵达基地。一旦到达那里，我将在阿然尼亚首领策划逃跑之前杀死他们。
src: The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.\n\nI have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

影阳忍者是一位研究善恶，光明与黑暗之间平衡的武术家。这所由一位改过自新的半恶魔创立的战斗学校教导学生从平衡中寻找力量。影阳忍者使用黑暗能量吸取敌人的生命，但随后转身使用光明的力量将偷来的力量借给盟友。影阳忍者是对比的典范。她知道邪恶潜伏在所有生物的心中。即使是最纯洁的人也会受到诱惑。通过探索她内心的恶魔，将它们带入光明，并接受它们作为她灵魂的一部分，她实现了对自己和内在力量的更深理解。影阳忍者会争辩说，否认而非接受一个人的基本冲动，就如同拒绝使用自己的左臂。

- 生命骰：d8
- 武器和防具擅长：影阳忍者不获得额外的武器和防具擅长。
- 技能点：4 + 智力调整值

要求：

阵营：任意善良
基础攻击加值：+3
技能：躲藏8级

武术招数：必须知道一个2级暮日派或阴影之手派招数，一个任意等级的暮日派招数，和一个任意等级的阴影之手派招数。

职业特性：

等级
1：武僧能力 - 你加上你的职业等级来决定你的徒手伤害和震慑拳次数。你获得武僧的AC加值。
   影阳之触 - 进行近战接触攻击造成负能量伤害。在下一轮接触一个生物来治疗目标。
2：影阳之焰 - 获得10点寒冷抗力持续一轮。向目标投掷能量束造成2d6点火焰伤害。
4：黑暗中的光明 - 速度爆发出光晕。如果目标未能看到你躲藏，他们进行强韧豁免（DC 10 + 1/2你的角色等级 + 你的感知调整值）否则目盲1轮。
5：光明中的黑暗 - 使自己目盲以获得+4攻击检定加值和对抗目盲对手的伤害加值。
7：影阳之空 - 获得+2偏斜AC加值。如果被击中，投射脉冲造成8d6点寒冷伤害，强韧豁免（DC 10 + 1/2你的角色等级 + 你的感知调整值）减半。
8：光阴影宠儿 - 架势在60英尺半径速度爆发造成目眩和60英尺半径黑暗之间交替。
10：光与暗的平衡 - 变身为黑暗生物。可以进行攻击造成负向等级。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
A Shadow Sun Ninja is a martial artist who studies the balance between good and evil, light and dark.  Founded by a reformed half-fiend, this fighting school teaches its students to find power in balance.  A Shadow Sun Ninja uses dark energies to drain his foe's life, but then turns and uses the power of light to lend that stolen strength to an ally.  A Shadow Sun Ninja is a study in contrasts.  She knows that evil lurks in the hearts of all living creatures.  Even the purest of the pure suffer temptation.  By exploring her inner demons, bringing them into the light, and accepting them as a part of her soul, she achieves a deeper understanding of herself and the strength within her.  A Shadow Sun Ninja would argue that denying, rather than accepting, one's base impulses would be the same as refusing to use one's left arm.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A shadow sun ninja gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any good
Base Attack Bonus: +3
Skills: Hide 8 ranks 
Feats: Improved Unarmed Strike
Martial Maneuvers: Must know one 2nd-level Setting Sun or Shadow Hand maneuver, one Setting Sun maneuver of any level, and one Shadow Hand maneuver of any level.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Monk abilities - You add your class levels to determine your unarmed damage and number of Stunning Fist attempts.  You gain the AC bonus of a monk.
   Touch of the Shadow Sun - Make a melee touch attack for negative energy damage.  On the following turn touch a creature to heal target.
2: Flame of the Shadow Sun -  Cold resistance 10 for one round.  Hurl bolt of energy at target for 2d6 fire damage.
4: Light Within Darkness - Burst into a corona of light.  If target failed to see you hiding, they make Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be blinded for 1 round.
5: Darkness Within Light - Blind yourself to gain +4 bonus to attack rolls and damage to blinded opponents.
7: Void of the Shadow Sun - Gain +2 deflection bonus to AC.  If hit, project pulse causing 8d6 points of cold damage, with a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier) for half damage.
8: Child of Shadow and Light - Stance alternating between 60'-radius burst causing dazzle and 60'-radius darkness.
10:  Balance of Light and Dark - Transform into creature of darkness.  Can make attacks causing negative levels.

src: "The relevance to you is that abandoned somewhere in Eastmarch was a copy of Vido's memoirs, 'The Green Book of Eastmarch' as his fellow villagers had taken to calling it. By all accounts, this book of his contained much interesting history related to his various adventurers. However, since Vido intended that it be read only by a handful of friends and relatives, no copies of it were ever made. That makes it a unique and valuable book that historians at Candlekeep would surely be interested in. Of course, since the magical field Vido set up has remained in place all these years, only a halfling could enter to seek it, and then only a halfling willing to face whatever menace lurks within."

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Maesters are the master crafters of the gnome world, combining technical and magical expertise to create incredible marvels. They specialize in the creation of magic items, bending all of their skill and ability toward the construction of items that are their art and livelihood.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: A Maester does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Arcane Spellcasting: Able to cast 5th level spells.
Feats: Any two item creation
Skills: Use Magic Device 4 ranks, any Craft 8 ranks.
Race: Gnome

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Bonus Feat - The Maester receives a bonus item creation feat.
    Quick Crafting - All crafting takes 1/2 the normal time.
3: Identification - A Maester can attempt to identify an item by making a Spellcraft check vs the item's Lore DC. He may only do this once per item.
5: Bonus Feat
BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Maester, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest arcane caster class. He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Thrall of Graz'zt
At 6th level, a Thrall of Graz'zt can increase damage dealt when casting a spell on a target or targets threatened in melee (and thus distracted).  The thrall can add half of their Spell Betrayal bonus (rounded down) to the damage dealt.

This bonus is +1d6 at 6th level, and +2d6 at 8th level.  This ability continues to progress during epic levels following the half spell betrayal bonus rounded down rule.

dst:
玛尔法斯，翻羽者
  
玛尔法斯允许他的召唤者在不被发现的情况下视物，不留痕迹地穿过周围环境，从视线中消失，并毒害他们的敌人。

契灵等级：2级
绑定DC:15
特殊要求：无

影响：在受玛尔法斯影响时，你太容易坠入爱河。一句善意的话或一个友好的举动就能让你完全献身于另一个人。如果那个人拒绝了你的爱意，那么当另一个有吸引力的人对你表现出善意时，你破碎的心就会立刻愈合。此外，如果你能获得毒药，玛尔法斯要求你在每个机会都对敌人使用它。

授予能力：
玛尔法斯赋予你无痕侦察，消失，安全使用毒药以及对脆弱敌人发动恶毒打击的能力。

秘法眼：随意，你可以以等同于你有效契灵师等级的法师等级施放秘法眼。

隐形：作为一个标准动作，你可以使自己隐形。进行攻击会结束隐形（如常），但除此之外，该效果持续轮数等于你的有效契灵师等级。在15级时，你可以以一个迅捷动作调用此能力。一旦你恢复可见，你5轮内不能再次使用此能力。

用毒：在处理毒药或将其涂在武器上时，你没有中毒的风险。

偷袭：你造成额外1d6点伤害，外加每四个有效契灵师等级1d6点。
src:
Malphas, the Turnfeather
  
Malphas allows his summoners to see without being seen, to pass through surroundings without leaving any sign, to vanish from sight, and to poison their enemies.

Vestige Level: 2nd
Binding DC: 15
Special Requirement: No

Influence: While influenced by Malphas, you fall in love too easily. A kind word or a friendly gesture can cause you to devote yourself entirely to another person. Should that person reject your affection, your broken heart mends the moment another attractive person shows you some kindness. In addition, if you have access to poison, Malphas requires that you employ it against your foes at every opportunity.

Granted Abilities: 
Malphas grants you the ability to spy without detection, to disappear, to use poison safely, and to strike vicious blows against vulnerable foes.

Arcane Eye: At will, you can cast Arcane Eye as a wizard of your effective binder level.

Invisibility: As a standard action, you can make yourself invisible. Making an attack ends the invisibility (as normal), but otherwise, the effect lasts a number of rounds equal to your effective binder level. You can invoke this ability as a swift action at 15th level. Once you return to visibility, you cannot use this ability again for 5 rounds.

Poison Use: You are not at risk of poisoning yourself when handling poison or applying it to a weapon.

Sneak Attack: You deal an extra 1d6 points of damage plus 1d6 points per four effective binder levels.

What is too often overlooked is that we also inherit some of the urges and appetites of fiends who delight in bringing misery and ruin to mortals, which makes it most difficult for us to behave in a proper and ethical manner. In my case, I am descended from demons, which means that I am filled with a passionate desire for bloodshed and chaotic destruction."

dst:
我与一位塞露涅的牧师谈过，他正试图在卡林港为这位神祇建立一座神殿，希望以此对抗莎尔在世界这一地区过大的影响力。他告诉我，神殿的建造工作正受到破坏者的干扰，他们夜间出动，捣毁白天建好的一些部分。他请求我设法处理此事。他建议我从神殿后门出去，那里堆放着大量建筑材料，找些板条箱躲在后面。从那里我可以在夜间（破坏行为发生时）进行监视，运气好的话，我会看到破坏者靠近，并能够阻止他们。如果可能的话，最好还能找到一些确凿的证据，查明幕后主使是谁。

我看到一个可疑的身影靠近神殿，在他造成任何破坏之前把他吓跑了。然而，如果我想查明他是谁或他的目的是什么，我就必须动身追赶。他跑得很快，如果我不尽快追上他，很可能会在这个错综复杂的巷弄迷宫中跟丢他。我需要朝他离开的方向追去，并希望在各个岔路口找到他往哪个方向去的线索。如果几分钟内还没找到他，很可能就再也追不上了。

我及时追上了正在追赶的那个人，正好看见他钻进这里一条小巷尽头的门里。很可能这里一直就是他的目的地，现在他逃不掉了，当然，除非他在打斗中胜过我。
src:
I spoke to a priest of Selune who is attempting to establish a temple to that deity in Calimport, in hopes of counteracting the excessive influence of Shar in this region of the world. He told me that construction work on the temple is being disrupted by vandals, who strike at night and wreck some of the building done during the day. He has asked me to try and do something about this. He suggests I go out the back entrance of the temple, where a lot of constuction materials are piled up, and find some crates to hide behind. From there I can watch during the night (when the vandalism occurs) and with any luck I will see the perpetrators approach and be able to stop them. It would be good as well to find some solid evidence about who is behind this, if possible.

I saw a suspicious figure approaching the temple and scared him off before he could do any damage. If I wish to find out anything about who he is or what his purposes are, however, I will have to set out in pursuit. He can run quickly and I will likely lose him in this complicated maze of alleys if I do not catch up to him soon. I need to head off in the direction he went and hope to find clues as to which direction he took at any intersections. If I have not found him within a few minutes it will likely be too late to ever do so.

I caught up to the man I am pursuing just in time to see him dart through a door at the end of one of the alleyways here. Likely this was his destination all along and he will not now escape me, unless he can beat me in a fight, of course.

驯兽师头环
  
描述符：无 
职业：图腾师 
脉轮：头冠（图腾）

你将未分化的灵魂能量导入一个闪亮的银色环带，环绕在你的前额约一英寸处。如果你集中精神，你可以听到非常安静的咆哮，尖叫和其他动物噪音的低语 - 野兽世界的嘈杂声。

你在动物 empathy 检定上获得 +2 加值。

魂能：你投入驯兽师头环的每点魂能使加值增加 2. 

脉轮绑定（头冠） 

你的银色头环融合到你的头上，将银蓝色的触须像微小的血管一样送入你的皮肤下。无尽的野兽噪音变得可理解 - 你理解驱动这些发声的需求和情感范围 - 但你仍然能够以一点专注忽略它。

你获得魅惑动物的能力，如同该法咒。你可以在任何你投入魂能到驯兽师头环的轮中使用此能力。DC 是你的塑魂 DC.

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

你的驯兽师头环不再表现为环绕头部的闪亮银带，而是表现为一圈银色头发，同时你头上所有的头发变得长而粗糙，如同野兽的鬃毛。

你获得使用动物恍惚的能力，如同该法咒。如果你在此魂合体上投入了魂能，你可以每分钟使用此能力一次。
src:
Beast Tamer Circlet
  
Descriptors: None 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Crown (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

You channel undifferentiated soul energy into a gleaming silver band that encircles your forehead at a distance of about an inch. If you concentrate, you can hear a very quiet murmur of growls, shrieks, and other animal noises - the cacophony of the beast world.

You gain a +2 bonus on Animal Empathy checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your beast tamer circlet increases the bonus by 2. 

Chakra Bind (Crown) 

Your silver circlet fuses to your head, sending silver-blue tendrils like tiny veins under your skin. The endless clamor of beast noises becomes intelligible to you - you understand the range of needs and emotions that drives these utterances - but you are still able to ignore it with a modicum of concentration.

You gain the ability to charm animals, as the spell. You can use this ability in any round during which you invest essentia in your beast tamer circlet. The DC is your Meldshaping DC.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Instead of a gleaming silver band around your head, your beast tamer circlet manifests as a ring of silver hair, while all the hair on your head becomes long and coarse like a beast's mane.

You gain the ability to use animal trance, as the spell. You can use this ability once per minute if you have essentia invested in this soulmeld.

dst: 在维拉尔的废墟中，我们发现了一个魔法拉杆，可以打开一道通往奥喀斯领域的界门。奥喀斯是一位塔纳厘领主，有时被称为“不死亲王”，因为他推崇死灵法术。他所统治的深渊层面是一个冰封的领域，除了该位面常见的恶魔实体外，还充斥着成群的亡灵。如果我们愿意，可以利用这道界门探索他的领域。这样的探险很可能极其危险，但也可能有利可图。\n
src: In the ruins of Vehlarr, we found a magical lever that can open a portal to the realm of Orcus, a lord of the Tanar'ri, sometimes referred to as the "Prince of the Undead," due to his promotion of necromantic practices. The layer of the Abyss he rules is a frozen realm filled with hordes of undead in addition to the demonic entities one would expect to find on that plane. We could use this portal to explore his realm if we wished. Such an expedition is likely to be very hazardous, but it might also be profitable.\n

dst: "要重新打开界门，你需要按下你西北方和东南方的两个发光的魔法球。不幸的是，你会发现它们被锁定在原地。要解锁它们，你需要向西走，并按正确的顺序多次扳动你在那里找到的拉杆。顺序可能会变化，所以我无法告诉你具体是什么，但有办法查明。当你第一次出现在那里时，你应该会看到一个未点燃的火盆，我想是在东北方。对它施放一个涉及火焰的法咒，比如燃烧之手或火球术，它就会亮起来，当它亮起时，你会看到火焰呈现出数字的形状。这些数字对应拉杆上的数字，并会指示扳动它们的正确顺序。"
src: "To re-open the portal, you need to press down the two glowing magical globes to the northwest and southeast of you. Unfortunately you will find them to be locked in place. To unlock them, you will need to head west, and flip the levers you find there a number of times in the correct order. The order is subject to change, so I can't tell you what it is, but there is a way to find out. When you first appear there, you should see an unlighted brazier, to the northeast I think. Cast a spell on it that involves fire, such as Burning Hands or Fireball, and it will light up, and as it does so you will see the flames take on the shape of numbers. These correspond to the numbers on the levers, and will indicate the correct sequence in which to flip them."

（基础职业）
“我拥有龙的力量。小心不要启蒙术那龙的愤怒。”
-卡莉亚，黑矛部落最后也是最伟大的龙之萨满

帝国崩溃，万古流逝，甚至神明也会凋零死亡，但龙依然存在。凡俗却永恒，真龙种族因其无与伦比的力量而历经岁月沧桑。很少有生物能在全力爆发的龙面前匹敌，无论是在武力的战斗还是智谋的较量中。龙之萨满认识到这一事实，并将真龙视为不仅仅是强大的存在。对龙之萨满而言，龙飞过头顶的掠影不是引发恐惧的征兆；而是一种祝福，揭示你正身处伟大之中。

龙之萨满尊重真龙为力量的化身。有些崇拜龙类，但大多数只是渴望为自己获得龙的力量。通过获得龙的能力和外形，龙之萨满寻求效仿那种力量并将那种力量体现于自身。

如果你以敬畏的目光注视龙并渴望分享它们的力量和威严，那么龙之萨满就是适合你的职业。通过选择图腾龙类，你分享真龙的力量并呈现出特定种类龙的特征。

龙之萨满尊重真龙为力量的化身。有些崇拜龙类，但大多数只是渴望为自己获得龙的力量。通过获得龙的能力和外形，龙之萨满寻求效仿那种力量并将那种力量体现于自身。

- 生命骰：d10
- 武器和防具擅长：龙之萨满擅长简易武器，轻甲和中甲，以及盾牌。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

职业技能：估价，唬骗，手艺，医疗，躲藏，威吓，跳跃，学识，潜行，说服，搜索，察言观色，法术辨识

职业特性：
基础攻击加值：+3/4
强豁免：强韧，意志

龙族灵光：你可以在1级选择3种灵光，之后每两级额外选择一种灵光，直到你掌握最多7种。这些灵光可以被激活以为你和你周围的盟友提供益处，并保持激活直到你切换到另一种。你在任何时候只能有一种龙族灵光激活。你的灵光等级从1级的+1开始，在5级增长到+2, 10级+3, 15级+4, 20级+5。

图腾龙类：当你成为龙之萨满时，你必须选择一种与你相关并从中获得其他能力的金属龙或彩色龙类型。这条龙应该在你的阵营的一步之内。

技能专攻：在第2,8和16级，你可以选择在估价，唬骗，医疗，躲藏，潜行，说服，搜索或法术辨识中获得技能专攻。

喷吐武器：在第4级，你获得一种与你图腾龙相同类型的喷吐武器。这种喷吐武器造成2d6点伤害，每2个职业等级再加1d6.反射豁免减半的DC为10 + 1/2你的职业等级 + 你的体质调整值。一旦你使用它，你必须等待1d4轮才能再次使用。如果你的喷吐武器是锥形，它在4级时达到15英尺，12级时30英尺，20级时60英尺。线形喷吐武器的距离加倍。

龙族决心：在第4级，你免疫魔法睡眠，麻痹和恐惧效果。

活力之触：在第6级，你获得一种类似圣武士的圣疗的能力，通过一次触摸治疗他人。每天你可以治疗等于你职业等级两倍乘以你的魅力加值的点数。
在第11级，你还可以消耗数点来治疗其他效果。消耗5点可以治疗属性伤害，或治愈眩晕。消耗10点可以治愈中毒或震慑。消耗20点可以治愈目盲，耳聋，疾病或负向等级。

天生防御：在第7级，你的皮肤变厚，长出模糊的鳞片，使你的天生AC提高1.在12级提高到2，在17级提高到3。

能量免疫：在第9级，你免疫与你图腾龙相关的能量类型。

龙翼：在第19级，你长出一对类似你图腾龙的翅膀。这些翅膀提供+10的跳跃加值。
src:
(BASE CLASS)
"I possess a dragon's power. Beware lest you awaken that dragon's wrath."
-Kalia, last and greatest dragon shaman of the Blackspear tribe

Empires crumble, eons pass, and even gods wither and die, but dragons remain. Mortal but eternal, the races of true dragons weather the roll of the ages because of their unsurpassed might. Few creatures can match a dragon in its full fury, whether in a combat of arms or battle of wits. Dragon shamans recognize this fact and see true dragons as more than powerful beings. To a dragon shaman, the passing shadow of a dragon flying overhead isn't a sign that invokes fear; it's a blessing that reveals you to be in the presence of greatness.

Dragon shamans respect true dragons as power incarnate. Some worship dragons, but most simply aspire to gain dragon powers for themselves. In assuming the abilities and the likeness of a dragon, a dragon shaman seeks to emulate that might and embody that power within himself.

If you gaze at dragons with awe and aspire to share their power and majesty, then the dragon shaman is the class for you. By choosing a totem dragon, you partake of a true dragon's power and take on aspects of a particular kind of dragon.

Dragon shamans respect true dragons as power incarnate.  Some worship dragons, but most simply aspire to gain dragon powers for themselves.  In assuming the abilities and the likeness of a dragon, a dragon shaman seeks to emulate that might and embody that power within himself.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Dragon shamans are proficient with simple weapons, with light and medium armor, and with shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS SKILLS: Appraise, Bluff, Craft, Heal, Hide, Intimidate, Jump, Lore, Move Silently, Persuade, Search, Sense Motive, Spellcraft

CLASS FEATURES:
Base Attack Bonus: +3/4
Strong Saves: Fortitude, Will

Draconic Auras: You can choose 3 auras at level 1, and an additional aura every two levels until you know your maximum of 7.  These auras can be activated to grant benefits to you and your allies around you, and stay active until you change to a different one.  You can only have one draconic aura active at any given time.  Your aura level starts at +1 at 1st level, and grows to +2 at level 5, +3 at 10, +4 at 15, and +5 at level 20.

Totem Dragon: When you become a dragon shaman, you must select a metallic or chromatic dragon type that you relate to and draw your other abilities from.  This dragon should be within one step of your alignment.

Skill Focus: At 2nd, 8th, and 16th levels you can select to gain Skill Focus in either Appraise, Bluff, Heal, Hide, Move Silently, Persuade, Search or Spellcraft.

Breath Weapon: At 4th level you gain a breath weapon of the type used by your totem dragon.  This breath weapon does 2d6 points of damage plus 1d6 for ever 2 class levels.  The DC of the Reflex save to half it is 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Con modifier.  Once you use it, you must wait 1d4 rounds before being able to use it again.  If your breath weapon is a cone it goes out to 15 feet at 4th level, 30 feet at 12th level, and 60 feet at 20th level.  Line breath weapons double those distances.

Draconic Resolve: At 4th level you become immune to magical sleep, paralysis, and fear effects.

Touch of Vitality: At 6th level, you gain an ability much like the paladin's lay on hands, to heal others with a single touch.  Each day you can heal a number of points equal to twice your class level, multiplied by your Cha bonus.
At 11th level, you can also heal other effects at the cost of several of these points.  For 5 points you can heal ability damage, or cure dazing.  For 10 points you can cure poison or stunning.  For 20 points you can cure blindness, deafness, disease, or negative levels.

Natural Armor: At 7th level your skin thickens, developing faint scales, improving your natural AC by 1.  At level 12 this goes up to 2, and at level 17 the increase goes up to 3.

Energy Immunity: At 9th level you become immune to the energy type associated with your totem dragon.

Draconic Wings: At 19th level you grow a pair of wings that resemble your totem dragon.  These wings grant a +10 bonus to Jump.

src: In the Winsome Repose Inn, I came across one Maus Jarlzin, who has hired me to assassinate a minor nobleman named Veric Arnsar. Arnsar can be found in a manor to the northwest of the markets that are found north of the docks. Arnsar has had forewarning of an assassination attempt, and the manor will have locks and guards I must somehow find a way past. Jarlzin would prefer I avoid killing any guards, and will reduce my reward for anyone on the the manor other than Arnsar that I end up finding it necessary to kill, so it would be best to employ stealth or invisiblity if possible. He has warned me that the main entrance is better guarded, but has easier locks, than the side doors, and that there may be other obstacles or hazards within beyond those he knows about.

src:
The epic runecaster no longer simply inscribes symbols of divine power, they weave divine essence into the world itself. Their runes thrum with ancient energy, etched into stone, metal, and the earth itself. Each mark is a silent hymn, a declaration of faith and force, holding power that rivals full incantations. Thieves no longer dare approach the runecaster's artifacts, and foes learn too late that every step toward a runecaster is a step deeper into a trap. Their runes do not merely cast spells, they shape destiny.

Hit Die: d8
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Runecaster gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:
Rune Craft: The epic Runecaster continues to gain a +1 on Runecarving checks at every odd level.
Rune Power: The epic Runecaster's Rune Power ability continues to gain +1 to DC and spell penetration checks at every even level.
Spellcasting: The epic Runecaster continues to increase in divine caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

Epic Runecaster Bonus Feat List:
Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Bonus Domain, Epic Skill Focus (Craft [any]), Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Toughness, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Inscribe Epic Rune, Tenacious Magic.

dst: 不清楚这个人为何要在沙漠中这个偏僻的地方避难。
src: It is not obvious why this man has taken refuge in this obscure part of the desert.

dst: "看来附近有一座夺心魔要塞、一个眼魔巢穴和一个寇涛鱼人基地，而且看起来我们很可能需要把这三处都调查一遍才能找到离开这里的路。既然你朝北走，看来你打算先对付夺心魔。你确定这是个好计划吗？根据它们的名声，夺心魔相当危险。也许我们应该先对付一个更容易的敌人。"
src: "So it seems nearby there is a Mind Flayer stronghold, Beholder warren, and Kuo Toa base, and it is looking like we will probably need to investigate all three to find a way out of here. Since you're heading north it seems you intend to hit the Mind Flayers first. Are you sure that's a good plan? Based on their reputation, Mind Flayers are quite dangerous. Perhaps we should take on an easier foe first."

dst: "你好。我妻子告诉我，她答应过你，找到我就会给你报酬，所以为了兑现承诺，我有些东西要给你。这东西对我来说太危险，没法好好利用，但我想像你这样的<CUSTOM106>可能会对它感兴趣。"他递给你一张看起来又旧又破的城市下水道地图。"这是我从前阵子住在温瑟姆安息所的另一位冒险者那里玩牌赢来的。你会注意到地图上有个位置被标记了。据给我地图的那个人说，那表示下水道里有一扇密门，最终能带你找到一些宝藏，不过不经历相当大的危险是到不了的。"
src: "Hello, there. My wife told me she promised you a reward for finding me, so to make good on that, I've got something for you. Something it would be too dangerous for me to make much use of, but I think <CUSTOM106> like you might take an interest in it." He hands you what appears to be an old and tattered map of the city's sewer system. "I won that in a card game from another adventurer who was staying at the Winsome Repose awhile back. You'll note that a location on the map is marked. According to the guy I won it from, that indicates a secret door in the sewers that can eventually lead you to some treasure, though you won't get to it without considerable hazard."

dst: "现在不行。"
src: "Not now."

dst: “现在不行。这段下水道似乎已经清理干净了，但鉴于遇到的抵抗程度，我们需要休息和战线重整，才能继续前进。我们很快就会返回神殿。如果你愿意，可以向高阶祭司阿达拉斯报告此事。我相信他会想为你的帮助奖赏你。”
src: "Not at the moment, no. This section of the sewers seems to be cleared, but given the level of opposition encountered, we will need to rest and regroup before venturing any further. We will be returning to the temple soon. You can report that to the high priest Adaras, if you wish. I'm sure he will want to reward you for our aid."

dst: "那我就不打扰你办事了。"

dst: 卡林港一家魔法商店的店主布林芬·泽姆昆告诉我，他在下水道里安装了一台机器，用来处理下水道的污水，从中提取有用的材料，并将其泵送到他的商店。不幸的是，这台机器最近似乎停止了工作，而且由于下水道里有鼠人的危险，布林芬不敢亲自去检查。他请我去调查这个问题。仅仅提供关于问题所在的信息，他就会付给我一些报酬，但如果我能设法修好机器并让它重新运转，他会付得更多。\n\n布林芬的机器被下水道里的鼠人破坏了，但我找到了缺失的零件并修好了它。当我把这件事报告给布林芬时，他应该会非常高兴。
src: Blimfin Zemquin, proprietor of a Calimport magic shop, has told about a machine he set up in the sewers to process the sewer water, extract useful material from it, and pump it up to his shop. Unfortunately, the machine appears to have stopped working recently, and because of the danger of wererats in the sewers, Blimfin dare not check on it himself. He has asked me to investigate the problem for him. He will pay me something simply for information about what the problem is, but even more if I somehow manage to repair the machine and get it working again.\n\nBlimfin's machine had been sabotaged by the sewer's wererats, but I was able to find the missing pieces and repair it. Blimfin should be quite pleased when I report this to him.

dst: 一些书被堆放在这里一个偏僻的角落里，仿佛烛堡的僧侣们想避免引起人们对它们的注意。出于好奇，你翻阅了它们。起初，你找到的全是些包含异域春宫图的书籍。你厌恶地把这些扔到一边，最终找到了更有用的著作：关于赞助黑暗卫士的宗教神学的指南，以及致力于将近战技巧与黑暗卫士力量相结合的实战手册，还有关于暗杀艺术的指南，以及为此目的运用潜行、奥术魔法和毒药技巧的讨论。
src: Some books have been piled in an out of the way corner here, as if the monks of Candlekeep wanted to avoid calling attention to them. Curious, you look through them. Initially, all you find are books containing exotic pornography. Throwing these aside in disgust, you eventually find more useful works: guides to the theology of religions sponsoring blackguards, as well as combat manuals devoted to combining melee techniques with blackguard powers, guides to the art of assassination and discussions of techniques for employing stealth, arcane magic, and poison for this purpose.
